source_text:
电脑電子計算機特效
在電影製作初期，電影的特別效果鏡頭加以各項技術來配合。一般意义上的特效镜头，使用合成遮片，多重曝光，微缩模型，逐格动画等多种技术实现。到如今，计算机生成图像已大量配合應用在電影製作上。计算机生成的图像具有完全的可操作性，数字化后可合成或者完全替换电影中景物与角色。电影特效业进入计算机时代以后，几乎百分之百的特效依靠计算机生成，只有少数电影，因特殊的美学追求，还保持传统物理特效的运用。
target_text: Computer-generated images have been widely used in filmmaking. Computer-generated images have been fully operable, digitized, and can be synthesized or completely replaced by film scenes and characters. After the advent of the computer age, almost 100 percent of film special effects are computer-generated, with only a few films, due to their special aesthetic pursuits, still retaining traditional physics effects.
title: 电影

source_text: 有时，现场演出采用了预先录制的声音。例如，DJ可以使用唱片来制造刮碟效果，而有些20世纪的作品用独唱或独奏表演和预制的磁带音乐同时进行。计算机和或多键盘乐器可以用来编程产生和播放MIDI音乐。听众也可以通过卡拉OK成为演出者，这种形式为日本人创造，它采用录像和无声乐的音轨，这样演出者就可以将他们自己的声音加上去。
target_text: Sometimes live performances use pre-recorded sounds. For example, DJs can use records to produce sound effects, while some 20th century works use solo or solo performances and pre-made cassette music to simultaneously perform. Computers and or more keyboard instruments can be used to program and play MIDI music. Listeners can also become performers through KARAOK, a form created for the Japanese, which uses video and soundtracks for voiceless performances to add their own voice.
title: 音乐

source_text: 与此同时，技术进步帮助人们重拾被行为主义抛弃的心理活动与表述，如認知等。英国神经科学家查尔斯·斯科特·谢灵顿爵士与加拿大心理学家唐纳德·赫布应用实验总结了心理现象与人脑结构、功能之间的联系。计算机科学与人工智能的兴起，使得人类信息处理时常与机械信息处理相互类比。对认知的研究被应用于二战，用以理解武器操作。在二十世纪晚期，认知主义成为心理学的统领范式，认知心理学成为了流行分支。
target_text: Meanwhile, technological advances have helped to resurrect psychological activities and expressions that have been abandoned by behaviorism, such as cognition. British neuroscientist Sir Charles Scott Sherington and Canadian psychologist Donald Hubb summarize the relationship between psychological phenomena and human brain structure and function. The rise of computer science and artificial intelligence has often compared human information processing with mechanical information processing.
title: 心理学

source_text:
计算模型
计算模型作为工具常被应用与数学心理学和认知心理学，即用计算机模拟某一特定行为。这种方式有其独特的优势。由于现代计算机处理信息的速度极快，可同时运行多个模拟程序，在短期内生成大量的统计数据。模型可以帮助心理学家观察心理事件的假设值，这在平时活动中是不易观察到的。
target_text: Computational models are often used as tools in mathematical psychology and cognitive psychology to simulate a particular behavior using computers. This method has its unique advantages. Due to the extremely fast speed of modern computers processing information, multiple simulation programs can be run simultaneously, generating large amounts of statistical data in the short term.
title: 心理学

source_text: 测绘学的成果之一是地图，因此测绘学发展的重要标志便是地图制图技术的提高。最早的地图刻画在陶片、铜板上，可靠性不高。公元前3世纪，埃拉托斯特尼首先将经纬线运用于地图上。公元前130年，西漢初期便有了《地形圖》和《駐軍圖》，为目前所發現中國最早的地圖。公元2世纪，托勒密在《地理学指南》中便阐述了编制地图的方法，并提出了地图投影问题。其后，西晋的裴秀创立了“制图六体”，使地图的可靠性得到了提升。第二次世界大战以后，计算机制图技术迅速发展，并由计算机辅助制图发展为多位一体的地理信息系统。
target_text: One of the achievements of cartography was the map, and thus an important sign of the development of cartography was the improvement of map-making techniques. The earliest maps were carved on ceramic tiles and copper plates, with low reliability. In the 3rd century BC, Eratosthenes first applied the line to the map. In 130 BC, in the early Western Han Dynasty, the first maps were found in China. In the 2nd century AD, Tom Mi explained the method of mapping in the Zheng Geography Guide Zheng and proposed map projections. Later, Zheng Zheng's problem-show created a system of polygonal mapping that improved the reliability of the map. After World War II, the map technology rapidly developed and helped to develop computer-aided computer-aided information mapping as a computational geographic system.
title: 测绘学

source_text: 在網際網路的歷史上，統一資源定位符的發明是一個非常基礎的步驟。统一资源定位符的语法是一般的，可扩展的，它使用美国信息交换标准代码的一部分来表示因特网的地址。统一资源定位符的开始，一般會标志着一个计算机网络所使用的网络协议。
target_text: In the history of the Internet, the invention of the Unified Resource Locator was a very basic step. The syntax of the Unified Resource Locator is general, extensible, and uses part of the US information exchange standard code to represent the Internet's addresses. The beginning of the Unified Resource Locator generally marks the network protocol used by a computer network.
title: 统一资源定位符

source_text: 在计算机科学中，数据结构（）是计算机中存储、组织数据的方式。数据结构意味着介面或封装：一个数据结构可被视为两个函数之间的介面，或者是由数据类型联合组成的存储内容的访问方法封装。大多数数据结构都由数列、记录、可辨识联合、引用等基本类型构成。举例而言，可為空的引用（nullable reference）是引用与可辨识联合的结合体，而最简单的链式结构链表则是由记录与可空引用构成。
target_text: In computer science, data structure is the way in which data is stored in a computer. Data structure means an interface or envelope: a data structure can be considered as an interface between two functions, or an access method for envelopeing storage content composed of data types combined. Most data structures are composed of basic types such as columns, records, recognizable combinations, references. For example, null references are combinations of references and recognizable combinations, while the simplest chain-shaped chain tables are composed of records and blank references.
title: 数据结构

source_text: 正確的数据结构選擇可以提高演算法的效率（請參考演算法效率）。在電腦程式设计的過程中，选择适当的数据结构是一項重要工作。许多大型系统的編寫经验顯示，程式設計的困难程度与最终成果的质量与表现，取决于是否选择了最適合的数据结构。
target_text: The correct choice of data structure can improve the efficiency of the algorithm. In the process of designing computer programs, selecting the right data structure is an important task. Many large systems have had a lot of experience in coding.
title: 数据结构

source_text: 系統架構的关键因素是数据结构而非算法的見解，导致了多种形式化的设计方法与编程语言的出现。绝大多数的语言都带有某种程度上的模块化思想，透过将数据结构的具体实现封装隐藏于使用者介面之后的方法，来让不同的应用程序能够安全地重用这些数据结构。C++、Java、Python等面向对象的编程语言可使用类 (计算机科学)来達到這個目的。
target_text: The key elements of system architecture are the view of data structures rather than algorithms, which have led to the emergence of many formalised design methods and programming languages. The vast majority of languages have some modularity in mind, with the goal of hiding the specific implementation packages of data structures from the user interface so that different applications can safely reuse these data structures. Object-oriented programming languages such as C++, Java, Python can be used in classes (computer science) to achieve this goal.
title: 数据结构

克利斯登·奈加特（，），挪威计算机科学家，社会活动家，图灵奖和冯·诺伊曼奖获得者，Simula的创始人，面向对象技术的先驱。生平
克利斯登·奈加特1926年生于挪威的奥斯陆，1956年于奥斯陆大学获得数学硕士学位，论文是《蒙特卡罗方法的理论方面》。1948年—1960年间克利斯登·奈加特全职工作于，进行计算、编程（1948年—1954年）和运筹学（1952年—1960年）方面的研究。
target_text: Kristin Negaret, Norwegian computer scientist, social activist, Turing Prize and the Fountain Neumann Prize winner, founder of Simula, pioneer of object technology. Kristin Negaret was born in 1926 in Oslo, Norway, and received her Master's degree in mathematics from the University of Oslo in 1956 with a thesis on the theory of Monte Carlo methods. From 1948 to 1960, Kristin Negaret worked full-time in computing, programming, planning, planning, and operations research (1948-1954) and operations research (1952-1960)
title: 克利斯登·奈加特

source_text: Linux内核（）是一种开源的类Unix操作系统宏内核。整个Linux操作系统家族基于该内核部署在传统计算机平台（如个人计算机和服务器，以Linux发行版的形式）和各种嵌入式平台，如路由器、无线接入点、专用小交换机、机顶盒、、智能电视、数字视频录像机、网络附加存储（NAS）等。工作于平板電腦、智能手机及智能手表的Android操作系统同样通过Linux内核提供的服务完成自身功能。尽管于桌面电脑的占用率较低，基于Linux的操作系统统治了几乎从移动设备到主机的其他全部领域。截至2017年11月，世界前500台最强的超级计算机全部使用Linux。
target_text: The Linux kernel is an open source type of Unix operating system macro-core. The entire Linux operating system family is based on this kernel deployed on traditional computer platforms such as personal computers and servers in the form of Linux distributions, and various embedded platforms such as routers, wireless access points, dedicated small switches, desktop boxes, smart TVs, digital video cameras, networked storage, NAS, etc. The Android operating system, which also operates on tablets, smartphones and smartwatches, performs its functions through the Linux kernel. Despite the lower utilization rates of desktop computers, Linux-based operating systems dominate almost all other domains from mobile devices to home computers. As of November 2017, the top 500 most powerful supercomputers in the world use Linux.
title: Linux内核

source_text: Linux内核最早是于1991年由芬兰黑客林納斯·托瓦茲为自己的个人电脑开发的，他当时在Usenet新闻组comp.os.minix登载帖子，这份著名的帖子标志着Linux内核计划的正式开始。如今，该计划已经拓展到支持大量的计算机体系架构，远超其他操作系统和内核。它迅速吸引了一批开发者和用户，利用它作为其他自由软件项目的核心，如著名的 GNU 操作系统。而今天，Linux 内核已接受了超过1200家公司的近12000名程序员的贡献，其中包括一些知名的软硬件发行商。
target_text: Linux kernel was first developed for personal computers in 1991 by Finnish hacker Linus Towaz, who posted a post on the Usenet newsgroup comp.os.minix that marked the official start of the Linux kernel program. Today, the program has expanded to support a large number of computer system architectures, far beyond other operating systems and kernels. It quickly attracted a number of developers and users, who used it as the core of other free software projects, such as the famous GNU operating system. Today, Linux kernel has accepted contributions from nearly 12,000 programmers from more than 1,200 companies, including some well-known software hardware vendors.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 从技术上说，Linux 只是一个符合POSIX 标准的内核。它提供了一套应用程序接口（API），通过接口用户程序能与内核及硬件交互。仅仅一个内核并不是一套完整的操作系统。有一套基于 Linux 内核的完整操作系统叫作Linux 操作系统，或是GNU/Linux（在该系统中包含了很多GNU 计划的系统组件）。
target_text: Linux is technically a single kernel that meets the POSIX standard. It provides a set of application interfaces (API) that allow user programs to interact with the kernel and hardware through the interface. Only one kernel is not a complete operating system. There is a complete Linux kernel-based operating system called the Linux operating system, or GNU/Linux (which contains many of the system components of GNU programs).
title: Linux内核

source_text: Linux 内核是在GNU通用公共许可证第2版之下发布的（加上一些非自由固件、blob与各种非自由许可证），是一个开源项目协作的突出例子。它的版本支持根据版本最长可达6年，貢獻者遍佈世界各地，日常开发相关的讨论在上。历史1991年，林納斯·托瓦茲，一名21岁的就读于芬兰赫尔辛基大学的计算机科学专业学生，基于一些简单的想法，打算编写一个操作系统内核。他通过英特尔80386汇编语言的任务切换器和一个终端驱动程序开始工作。8月25号，他在comp.os.minix新闻组里发了一封帖子：
target_text: Linux kernel is released under version 2 of the GNU General Public License (GPL) (along with some non-free fixtures, blobs and various non-free licenses), a prominent example of open source project collaboration. Its version support is up to 6 years, with contributors around the world, and daily development-related discussions are over. History In 1991, Linus Towaz, a 21-year-old computer science student at the University of Helsinki in Finland, intended to write an operating system kernel based on some simple ideas. He started working on a task switch and a terminal driver that compiled the language with Intel 80386.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 之后，许多人为这个项目贡献了代码。在早期，MINIX社区向 Linux 内核贡献了代码和想法。当时，GNU 项目已经创建了许多自由操作系统所需的组件，但是它自己的内核 GNU Hurd 尚不完整且无法使用；而BSD操作系统还没有摆脱合法的阻碍。因此，尽管早期版本的 Linux 功能有限，但它迅速获得了开发人员和用户。
target_text: Many contributed to the project. In the early years, the MINIX community contributed code and ideas to the Linux kernel. At the time, the GNU project had created many of the components needed for the free operating system, but its own kernel, the GNU Hurd, was not yet complete and unusable; and the BSD operating system was not yet free of legal barriers.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 二进制可移植性将保证任何程序在符合标准的给定硬件平台上一旦编译通过，可以在符合同样标准的任何其他硬件平台上以编译后的形式运行。二进制可移植性是在基于Linux内核的操作系统上建造独立软件供应商（ISV）应用有商业可行性的本质要求。现有唯一的二进制兼容标准是Linux标准规范（LSB）。
target_text: Binary portability will ensure that any program on a given hardware platform that meets the standard, once compiled, can run in post-compiled form on any other hardware platform that meets the same standard. Binary portability is the essential requirement for independent software vendors to build on Linux-based operating systems.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 尽管林納斯·托瓦茲的初衷不是使Linux成为一个可移植的操作系统，今天的Linux却是全球被最广泛移植的操作系统内核。從行動電話到超級電腦，甚至於有人成功的將Linux内核在索尼出品的遊戲機PS2及PS3和微軟出品的遊戲機Xbox上使用。Linux也是IBM超级计算机Blue Gene的操作系统。直至2011年11月，全球前五百大超級電腦（TOP500）有高達91.4%的比例採用Linux為它們的作業系統。一些为手机开发的操作系统，使用Linux内核的修改后的版本，其中包括谷歌Android、Firefox OS、HP WebOS和诺基亚Maemo。
target_text: Although Linus Towaz' original intent was not to make Linux a portable operating system, today Linux is the core of the most widely ported operating system in the world. From mobile phones to supercomputers, even to those who have successfully used Linux kernels on Sony's PS2 and PS3 gaming machines and Microsoft's Xbox. Linux is also the operating system of IBM's Blue Gene supercomputer. As of November 2011, up to 91.4% of the world's top 500 supercomputers (TOP500) have adopted Linux for their operating systems. Some mobile-developed operating systems use modified versions of Linux kernels, including Google, Firefox OS, HPOS, and Nokia Maemo.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 在Linux中，内核错误（）是指操作系统在监测到内核系统内部无法恢复的错误，相对于在用户空间代码类似的错误。操作系统试图读写无效或不允许的内存地址是导致内核错误的一个常见原因。内核错误也有可能在遇到硬件错误或操作系统BUG时发生。在许多情况中，操作系统可以在内存访问违例发生时继续运行。然而，系统处于不稳定状态时，操作系统通常会停止工作以避免造成破坏安全和数据损坏的风险，并提供错误的诊断信息。
target_text: In Linux, kernel error (or kernel error) refers to an error in the operating system's ability to monitor and recover from within the kernel system, as opposed to similar errors in user space code. An operating system's attempt to read and write invalid or unauthorized memory addresses is a common cause of kernel error.
title: Linux内核

source_text:
许可证
原先托瓦茲将 Linux 置于一个禁止任何商业行为的条例之下，但0.12版本之后改用 GNU 通用公共许可证第二版。 该协议允许任何人对软件进行修改或发行，包括商业行为，只要其遵守该协议，所有基于Linux的软件也必须以该协议的形式发表，并提供源代码。
target_text: The license was originally placed by Towaz under a regulation prohibiting any commercial behavior, but was changed to GNU General Public License version 2. after version 0.12. The protocol allows anyone to modify or distribute software, including commercial behavior, provided that all Linux-based software is published under the protocol and provides source code.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 理查德·马修·斯托曼（，簡稱rms，有时也用大写的RMS，），美国程序员，自由软件活动家。他发起自由软件运动，倡导软件使用者能够对软件自由进行使用、学习、共享和修改，确保了这些软件被称作自由软件。斯托曼发起了GNU项目，并成立了自由软件基金会。他开发了GCC、GDB、GNU Emacs，同时编写了GNU通用公共许可协议。
target_text: Richard Matthew Stoman (R.M.S. (R.M.S.R.), also known as RMS, is an American programmer and free software activist. He launched the Free Software Movement, advocating for free software users to use, learn, share and modify software freely, ensuring that these software are called free software. Stoman launched the GNU Project and founded the Free Software Foundation. He developed the GCCGDB, GNU Emacs, and wrote the GNU General Public License Agreement.
title: 理查德·斯托曼

source_text: 为了创建一个完全由自由软件组成的类Unix计算机操作系统，斯托曼在1983年9月推出了GNU项目。借此又发起了自由软件运动。他迄今为止一直是GNU项目的组织者，作为主要开发者的他开发了一些被广泛使用的GNU软件，其中包括GCC、GDB、GNU Emacs。在1985年10月他创立了自由软件基金会。
target_text: In order to create a Unix-like computer operating system that was entirely made up of free software, Stoman launched the GNU project in September 1983. He was the organizer of the GNU project until now, and as a key developer he developed some of the most widely used GNU software, including GCC, GDB, GNU Emacs. In October 1985, he founded the Free Software Foundation.
title: 理查德·斯托曼

source_text: 1989年，他和别人一起创立了。自20世纪90年代中期以来，斯托曼花他大部分时间组织参与宣传自由软件，反对软件专利和数字版权管理的以及他认为剥夺用户自由的其他法律和技术系统运动。这包括最终用户许可协议、保密协议、 产品激活、加密狗、软件复制保护、专有格式、二进制软件包（没有源代码的可执行文件）。
target_text: In 1989, he co-founded the company. Since the mid-1990s, Stoman has spent much of his time in the organization promoting free software, opposing software patents and digital copyright management, and other legal and technical systems movements that he believes deprive users of their freedom. These include end-user license agreements, confidentiality agreements, product activations, encryption dogs, software copy protection, proprietary formats, binary software packages (no source code executable documents).
title: 理查德·斯托曼

source_text: 1953年3月，斯托曼出生于美国纽约一个犹太人家庭，他的母亲爱丽丝·利普曼是一名老师，父亲丹尼尔·斯托曼是一名印刷机商人，斯托曼與父母關係並不親密。早年他就对计算机有很深的兴趣；在斯托曼作为一个青少年参加一个夏令营时，他阅读了一本IBM7090的手册。从1967年到1969年，斯塔曼参加了哥伦比亚大学的高中生周六编程课程。同时他也是洛克菲勒大学生物系的志愿者实验室助理。虽然他对数学和物理学感兴趣，但洛克菲勒大学的教授认为他有成为生物学家的希望。
target_text: In March 1953, Stoman was born to a Jewish family in New York, U.S.A. His mother, Alice Lipman, was a teacher, his father, Daniel Stoman, a printer's shopkeeper, and his parents were not close. At an early age, he had a deep interest in computers; while a teenager attended a summer camp, he read a manual on IBM 7090. From 1967 to 1969, Stoman attended Columbia University's high school programming program. He was also a volunteer laboratory assistant in the biology department at Rockefeller University. Although he was interested in mathematics and physics, a professor at Rockefeller University thought he had hopes of becoming a biologist.
title: 理查德·斯托曼

source_text: 1971年，斯托曼在哈佛大学第一年快结束的时候，他成为了麻省理工学院人工智能实验室的一名程序员，同时也成为黑客社区的常客，并以他的名字缩写RMS而闻名，1974年斯塔曼从哈佛大学毕业并取得了物理学学士学位。1975年斯托曼考虑过留在哈佛大学，但是他却转而决定去麻省理工学院去读研究生。他攻读物理学博士学位一年，但随后选择了放弃，专注于他在麻省理工学院AI实验室的编程。
target_text: In 1971, shortly after his first year at Harvard, Staman became a programmer at the MIT AI Lab, a regular visitor to the hacker community, and was known for his abbreviation RMS. In 1974, Staman graduated from Harvard University with a B.S. in physics. In 1975, Staman considered staying at Harvard, but decided to go to MIT for a year to study. He pursued a Ph.D. in physics, but then chose to give up and focus on programming in his MIT AI lab.
title: 理查德·斯托曼

source_text: 作为MIT计算机科学与人工智能实验室的黑客，斯托曼从事软件项目，如文本編輯器，不兼容的分时系统上的Emacs，还有lisp机器的操作系统项目。在这期间，他成为了实验室电脑限制访问技术的热心评论家，当时这个计划是由国防高级研究计划局资助的。当MIT计算机科学与人工智能实验室安装了一套密码控制系统，斯托曼很快就找到了一个解密密码的方式并发送给用户包含其已解码密码的消息，建议他们使用空字符串作为密码（事实上就是没有密码），这样就可以重新启用用户对系统的匿名访问。当时约有20％的用户遵循他的建议，尽管使用密码的行为最终占上风。对此，多年后斯托曼还一直向别人吹嘘着他当年的成功。
target_text: As a hacker at MIT Computer Science and AI Lab, Stoman worked on software projects such as text editors, emacs on incompatible part-time systems, and operating systems projects for lisp machines. During this time, he became an avid critic of the technology to restrict access to laboratory computers, which was funded by the National Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency. When MIT Computer Science and AI Lab installed a set of password controls, Stoman quickly found a way to decrypt the password and sent messages to users containing its decrypted passwords, suggesting that they use the blank strings as the password actually does not have a password, so that users can re-use the system anonymously. About 20% of users followed his suggestion, although the use of the password eventually took hold.
title: 理查德·斯托曼

source_text:
GNU项目的发起
1970到1980年代，斯托曼察覺到MIT计算机科学与人工智能实验室中的黑客文化开始式微，與實驗室有來往的公司為了商業利益開始限制其他人使用源代码或者停止提供原始碼，最終斯托曼開始了 GNU 運動用於創建 Unix 的替代品，並在1985年成立了自由软件基金会，並發表GNU宣言。 Stallman的麻省理工学院的同事布鲁斯特·卡勒（Brewster Kahle）所说，这种软件法律特征的转变可以被认为是1976年“美国版权法”所引发的后果。
target_text: Starting with the GNU project in the 1970s and 1980s, Stoman noticed that the hacker culture in MIT's Computer Science and AI Lab began to wane, and that companies that had visited the lab began to restrict others from using source code or to stop providing original code for commercial gain, eventually starting the GNU movement to use Unix as an alternative, and in 1985 founding the Free Software Foundation and publishing the GNU Declaration.
title: 理查德·斯托曼

source_text: 1991年芬兰大学生林納斯·托瓦茲在GNU通用公共許可證下发布了最初是为自己创作的Linux操作系统内核，暂时替代了GNU计划的Hurd内核。至此，GNU计划基本完成，此操作系统被命名为GNU/Linux（这类操作系统常常被称为Linux。斯托曼坚持认为 Linux 应该被稱作 GNU/Linux，因為 GNU 計劃更早出現，且在 Linux 作業系統的早期，GNU 社群的原始碼在其中起了關鍵的作用，例如 GCC 編譯器。
target_text: In 1991, Finnish university student Linnaeus Tovaz released the kernel of the Linux operating system he had originally created under the GNU General Public License, temporarily replacing the Hurd kernel of the GNU project. The GNU project was essentially completed, and the operating system was named GNU/Linux (commonly known as Linux).
title: 理查德·斯托曼

source_text:
自由軟體与开源软件
斯托曼是一名坚定的自由软件运动倡导者，与提倡开放源代码开发模型的人不同，斯托曼并不是从软件的-{zh-hans:质量; zh-hant:品質}-的角度而是从道德的角度来看待自由软件。他认为不自由的軟體是非常不道德的事，只有尊重用户自由的程序才是符合其道德标准。对此许多人表示异议，并也因此有了自由软件与开源软件之分。而事实上，1998年“开源”一词最初从自由软件社区中分化出来仅仅是因为在英文中“自由”（）一词有歧义，而其支持者认为“开源”（）一词更好。
target_text: Unlike those who advocate the open source development model, Stoman saw free software not from a software-{zh-hans: quality; zh-hant: quality} perspective but from an ethical perspective. He considered unfree software to be very immoral, and only procedures that respect users' freedom were in line with its ethical standards. Many objected to this and thus split free software from open source software.
title: 理查德·斯托曼

source_text: 施行GPL 自由软件基金会具有施行GNU通用公共许可证和其它GNU许可证的能力和资源，但自由软件基金会只对它拥有版权的软件负责。其它软件必须由它们自己的拥有人来负责，原因是从法律规定上自由软件基金会无法为这些其它软件负责。自由软件基金会每年约接触到50个违反GNU通用公共许可证的事件，自由软件基金会试图不通过法院使对方遵守GNU通用公共许可证。
target_text: The Free Software Foundation has the ability and resources to implement the GNU General Public License and other GNU licenses, but the Free Software Foundation is solely responsible for the software that owns the copyright. Other software must be held responsible by their own owners, because the Free Software Foundation cannot be held responsible for these other software under the law. target_text: The Free Software Foundation has the copyright to most GNU software and some non-GNU free software. Contributors to each GNU software package must sign a copyright document so that the Free Software Foundation can maintain the software in court in litigation. Furthermore, if the license changes, it is not necessary to seek the consent of all contributors to the software.

source_text: 操作系统（，縮寫：）是一组主管并控制计算机操作、运用和运行硬件、软件資源和提供公共服务来组织用户交互的相互关联的系统软件程序，同时也是计算机系统的核心与基石。操作系统需要处理如管理與配置内存、決定系統資源供需的優先次序、控制輸入與輸出裝置、操作网络與管理文件系统等基本事務。操作系统也提供一個讓使用者與系統互動的操作界面。
target_text: Operating systems (abbreviated as: operating systems) are a set of interrelated system software programs that manage and control the operation, operation and operation of computer hardware, software resources and public services to organize user interactions, and are the core and foundation of a computer system. Operating systems need to handle basic tasks such as managing and configuring memory, determining the priority of system resource supply, controlling input and output devices, operating networks and management file systems. Operating systems also provide an operating interface that allows users to interact with the system.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 操作系统的型態非常多樣，不同機器安裝的操作系统可從簡單到複雜，可從行動電話的嵌入式系统到超級電腦的大型作業系統。許多操作系统製造者對它涵盖范畴的定义也不尽一致，例如有些操作系统整合了图形用户界面，而有些僅使用命令行界面，將图形用户界面視為一種非必要的應用程式。
target_text: Operating systems are very diverse in their types, and the operating systems installed on different machines range from simple to complex, from embedded systems for mobile phones to large operating systems for supercomputers. Many operating system manufacturers do not agree on the definition of the category, for example, some operating systems integrate graphical user interfaces, while others use only command-line interfaces, which make graphical user interfaces an unnecessary application.
title: 操作系统

source_text:
1980年代
第一代微型计算机並不像大型電腦或小型電腦，沒有裝設作業系統的需求或能力；它們只需要最基本的作業系統，通常這種作業系統都是從ROM讀取的，此種程式被稱為監視程式（Monitor）。1980年代，家用電腦開始普及。通常此時的電腦擁有8-bit處理器加上64KB記憶體、螢幕、鍵盤以及低音質喇叭。而80年代早期最著名的套裝電腦為使用微處理器6510（6502晶片特別版）的Commodore C64。此電腦沒有作業系統，而是以一8KB唯讀記憶體BIOS初始化彩色螢幕、鍵盤以及軟碟機和印表機。它可用8KB唯讀記憶體BASIC語言來直接操作BIOS，並依此撰寫程式，大部分是遊戲。此BASIC語言的直譯器勉強可算是此電腦的作業系統，當然就沒有核心或軟硬體保護機制了。此電腦上的遊戲大多跳過BIOS層次，直接控制硬體。
target_text: The first generation of microcomputers in the 1980s was not like large computers or small computers, which did not require or have the capabilities of an operating system; they needed only the most basic operating system, usually read from ROM, which was called a monitoring program (Monitor). In the 1980s, home computers began to gain popularity. Typically, computers of the time had 8-bit processors plus 64KB memory, screen, keyboard and low-quality horns. The most famous early 1980s suite computer for microprocessing 6510 (652 chips special edition). The Commodore C64 did not have an operating system, but was initially colored screen, keyboard and keyboard and desktop printer with an 8KB memory only. It was available only in 8KBB as a direct translation of the computer language, and was written for the OS, and most computer games were written for the OS.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 1991年，芬兰学生林纳斯·托瓦兹根据类Unix系统Minix编写并发布了Linux操作系统内核，其后在理查德·斯托曼的建议下以GNU通用公共许可证发布，成为自由軟體Unix變種. Linux近來越來越受歡迎，它們也在個人桌面電腦市場上大有斬獲，例如Ubuntu系統。某些Unix變種，例如惠普的HP-UX以及IBM的AIX僅設計用於自家的硬體產品上，而SUN的Solaris可安裝於自家的硬體或x86電腦上。蘋果電腦的Mac OS X是一個從NeXTSTEP、Mach以及FreeBSD共同衍生出來的微核心BSD系統，此OS取代了蘋果電腦早期非Unix家族的Mac OS。
target_text: In 1991, Finnish student Linnaeus Tovaz wrote and released the Linux operating system kernel based on the Unix system Minix, which was later released under the GNU General Public License under Richard Stoman as a free software version of Unix. Linux has recently become increasingly popular and has also gained a large share in the personal desktop computer market, such as Ubuntu. Some Unix variants, such as HP's HP-UX and IBM's AIX, are designed for home hardware products only, while Sun's Solaris is installed on home hardware or x86 computers.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 优秀的操作系统必定要具备能让各种能力级别的用户满足各种需求的工具包可视化的高效简便程序环境，以程序来创建程序，就如立法的法律指导规范新的法案的创建。这其实是操作系统所隐含的一部分，决定了可以有多强的扩充能力。比如，某个操作系统有对应的开发者工具包集成环境程序并且是个可视化的，还能让能力不太高的人一看能懂的，用于修改某个声音合成器包含频谱显示，可要是操作系统本身不支持也没有提供可用的工具程序，就会变得很繁琐，很可能为了达到这个目标，开发者就要预备好各种相关的工具程序，甚至自己来编写一系列相关的工具程序创建专门的工具包，最后还要检查代码。若是有人想通过音乐来生成五线谱，要对类似标记语言的五线谱规则对应一下，对各种音色，音准采集并总结出一整套规律，通过声音识别可以识别出乐器的类别等，进而标出乐符完成从声音到乐谱的转换并生成。可是对人声却又更为复杂也不必要如此。若是需要用声音的波形图重现声音，没有相关的工具集是相当难实现，另外只有使用同一套声音的波形绘制规则的所生成的波形图用来再现的声音才是原来的声音。
target_text: A good operating system must have an efficient and simple programming environment that allows users of all skill levels to visualize a toolkit that meets a variety of needs, in order to create programs, such as legislation that guides the creation of new bills. This is actually part of what the operating system entails, which determines how powerful the expansion can be. For example, a developer has a suitable developer toolkit for an integrated environment and is a visualized one, but also allows people with low skills to see it at a glance, for modifying a sound synthesizer that contains spectrum, and if the operating system itself does not support or provide available tools, it becomes very complex, and it is likely that this goal will be achieved. Developers will need to prepare themselves to produce a variety of original tools to complete the production of a set of related tools, in order to write a set of related programs, a complete set of dedicated tools, and final code-checking tools.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 在作为商品出售的操作系统软件的历史中常常因为其中包含的浏览器，媒体播放器在美国遭到反垄断起诉，差点使得功能上残缺不全。少数操作系统软件能够提供较为全面的App和实用工具程序。操作系统软件的编译也需要对应的编译环境。在同一台计算机上运行不同的操作系统软件，就能够以不同的方式来使用计算机资源。比如，在Mac上运行OS X和Windows以两种不同的技术OpenCL，Core Image:DirectX来使用图形卡实现类似的作用。
target_text: In the history of operating system software sold as commodities, media players have often been subject to countermonopoly lawsuits in the United States because of the browsers they contain, which almost render them functionally disabled. Few operating system software can provide a more comprehensive App and practical toolkit program. Compilation of operating system software also requires a corresponding compilation environment. Operating system software on the same computer can use computer resources in different ways. For example, operating systems OS X and Windows on Mac with two different technologies OpenCL, Core Image:DirectX to use graphics cards to achieve similar functions.
title: 操作系统

source_text:
未來
研究與建立未來的作業系統依舊進行著。作業系統朝提供更省電、網路化、易用、華麗的使用者介面的方向來改進。類UNIX OS通過和桌面環境開發者協作，正努力讓自己改進使用環境。eyeOS是一套基於PHP實現的半開源模擬雲端運算操作系统，但其實質只是在網路瀏覽器中提供一種類似無界限的類獨立操作系统，其並非於任何類似虛擬化中實現的真正電腦操作系统，能提供諸如Word、PPT、Excel的在線處理功能…
target_text: In the future, research and development of future operating systems are still ongoing. The operating system is improving in the direction of providing more power, networking, ease of use, and a luxurious user interface. The adoption of UNIX OS and desktop environment developers are working to improve their own environments. EyeOS is a semi-open source simulated cloud operating system based on PHP, but in fact provides a kind of seemingly limitless independent operating system in web browsers, which is not a real computer operating system implemented in any virtualization, which can provide online processing functions such as Word, PPT, Excel ...
title: 操作系统

source_text:
GNU Hurd是一個以完全相容Unix並加強許多功能为目标的微核心架構。微軟Singularity是一個奠基於.Net並以建立較佳記憶體保護機制為目標的研究計畫。功能
操作系统位于底层硬件与用户之间，是两者沟通的桥梁。用户可以通过操作系统的用户界面，输入命令。操作系统则对命令进行解释，驱动硬件设备，实现用户要求。以现代标准而言，一个标准PC的操作系统应该提供以下的功能：
target_text: GNU Hurd is a microcore architecture that is fully compatible with Unix and enhances many functions. Microsoft Singularity is a research project based on.Net and aimed at building better memory protection mechanisms. Function The operating system is located between the underlying hardware and the user, and is a bridge between the two. The user can enter commands through the user interface of the operating system. The operating system interprets commands, drives hardware devices, and fulfills user requirements.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 不管是常駐程式或者應用程式，他們都以行程為標準執行單位。當年運用馮·諾伊曼結構建造電腦時，每個中央處理器最多只能同時執行一個行程。早期的操作系统（例如DOS）也不允許任何程式打破這個限制，且DOS同時只有執行一個进程（雖然DOS自己宣稱他們擁有終止並等待駐留能力，可以部分且艱難地解決這問題）。現代的作業系統，即使只擁有一個CPU，也可以利用多进程（multitask）功能同时执行多个进程。进程管理指的是操作系统调整多个行程的功能。
target_text: Whether it was a permanent program or an application, they used the process as the standard execution unit. At the time when using the John Neumann structure to build a computer, each CPU could only run one process at a time. Early operating systems (e.g. DOS) did not allow any program to break this limit, and DOS could only run one process at a time. Although DOS itself claimed to have the ability to stop and wait, this could be partially and difficult to solve.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 由於大部分的電腦只包含一顆中央處理器，在單核心（Core）的情況下多行程只是簡單迅速地切換各行程，讓每個行程都能夠執行，在多核心或多處理器的情況下，所有行程透過許多協同技術在各處理器或核心上轉換。越多行程同時執行，每個行程能分配到的時間比率就越小。很多操作系统在遇到此問題時會出現諸如音效斷續或滑鼠跳格的情況（稱做颠簸（Thrashing），一種操作系统只能不停執行自己的管理程式並耗盡系統資源的狀態，其他使用者或硬體的程式皆無法執行。行程管理通常實踐了分時的概念，大部分的操作系统可以利用指定不同的特權等級（priority），為每個行程改變所佔的分時比例。特權越高的行程，執行優先順序越高，單位時間內佔的比例也越高。互動式操作系统也提供某種程度的回饋機制，讓直接與使用者互動的行程擁有較高的特權值。
target_text: Since most computers contain only one central processor, in the case of single-core, multiple processes are simply switched quickly to allow each process to be executed, and in the case of multi-core or multi-processors, all processes are converted to multiple co-processors or cores through multiple technologies. The more processes are executed simultaneously, the smaller the time ratio assigned to each processor. Many operating systems encounter such problems as sound interruption or mouse jumps called thrashing, which allows an operating system to run its own system without stopping and running out of resources. Other users or programs usually run the same system. The more the concept of split time is implemented, the more the hard drive system can be used with different assigned privileges and privileges, the higher the percentage of the number of individual operating systems that have a high degree of direct execution, the higher the number of direct execution times, and the higher the number of individual operating systems that can be used for the same tasks.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 除了行程管理之外，操作系统尚有擔負起行程間通訊（IPC）、行程異常終止處理以及死锁（Dead Lock）偵測及處理等較為艱深的問題。在行程之下尚有執行緒的問題，但是大部分的操作系统並不會處理執行緒所遭遇的問題，通常操作系统僅止於提供一組API讓使用者自行操作或透過虛擬機器的管理機制控制執行緒之間的互動。
target_text: In addition to process management, the operating system still has more difficult problems such as inter-process communication (IPC), process anomalous termination processing, and dead lock detection and processing. There are still executable problems under the process, but most operating systems do not handle the executable problems encountered, and usually the operating system provides more than a set of APIs to allow users to operate themselves or control executable interactions via a virtual machine's management system.
title: 操作系统

source_text:
内存管理
根據帕金森定律：「你给程序再多内存，程序也会想尽办法耗光」，因此程式設計師通常希望系統給他無限量且無限快的記憶體。大部分的現代電腦記憶體架構都是階層式的，最快且數量最少的暫存器為首，然後是快取、記憶體以及最慢的磁碟儲存裝置。而操作系统的記憶體管理提供尋找可用的記憶空間、配置與釋放記憶空間以及交換記憶體和低速儲存裝置的內含物……等功能。此類又被稱做虛擬記憶體管理的功能大幅增加每個行程可獲得的記憶空間（通常是4GB，即使實際上RAM的數量遠少於這數目）。然而這也帶來了微幅降低執行效率的缺點，嚴重時甚至也會導致行程崩潰。
target_text: Memory management is based on Parkinson's law: "You give the program more memory, and the program will try to use up the light", so programmers usually want the system to give them unlimited and unlimited memory. Most modern computer memory architectures are hierarchical, with the fastest and least amount of temporary storage, first followed by the fastest, the memory and the slowest magnetic storage devices. While memory management in the operating system provides for finding available memory space, configuring and releasing memory space, and exchanging memory and the contents of low-speed storage devices... etc. This is also called virtual memory management, which greatly increases the amount of memory available for each process, usually 4GB, even if the actual amount of RAM is far less than this. However, this also leads to a reduction in execution efficiency, and even leads to severe crashes when the micro-data is not running.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 記憶體管理的另一個重點活動就是藉由CPU的幫助來管理虛擬位置。如果同時有許多行程儲存於記憶裝置上，作業系統必須防止它們互相干擾對方的記憶體內容（除非透過某些協定在可控制的範圍下操作，並限制可存取的記憶體範圍）。分割記憶體空間可以達成目標。每個行程只會看到整個記憶體空間（從0到記憶體空間的最大上限）被配置給它自己（當然，有些位置被操作系统保留而禁止存取）。CPU事先存了幾個表以比對虛擬位置與實際記憶體位置，這種方法稱為分頁配置。
target_text: Another key activity in memory management is to manage virtual locations with the help of a CPU. If multiple processes are stored on memory devices at the same time, the operating system must prevent them from interfering with each other's memory content (unless they operate within a controlled range through certain agreements and limit the range of memory available). Split memory space can achieve the goal. Each process sees only the entire memory space (from 0 to the maximum of memory space) being allocated to itself (of course, some locations are retained and prohibited by the operating system).
title: 操作系统

source_text: 藉由對每個行程產生分開獨立的位置空間，操作系统也可以輕易地一次釋放某行程所佔據的所有記憶體。如果這個行程不釋放記憶體，操作系统可以結束行程並將記憶體自動釋放。磁盘与文件系统所謂的檔案系統，通常指稱管理磁碟資料的系統，可將資料以目錄或檔案的型式儲存。每個檔案系統都有自己的特殊格式與功能，例如日誌管理或不需磁碟重整。
target_text: By creating separate location spaces for each path, the operating system can easily release all the memory occupied by a particular path at once. If this path does not release memory, the operating system can terminate the path and release the memory automatically. The so-called disk and file system, often referred to as the system for managing disk data, can store the data in the form of a directory or file. Each file system has its own special format and function, such as log management or disk reassembly.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 許多操作系统也支援多個過去網路啟蒙時代的各路網路通訊協定，例如IBM建立的系統網路架構、DEC在它所生產的系統所設定的架構與微軟為Windows製作的特殊通訊協定。還有許多為了特殊功能而研發的通訊協定，例如可以在網路上提供檔案存取功能的NFS系統。現今大量用於影音串流（Streaming media）及遊戲訊息傳送的UDP協定等。
target_text: Many operating systems also support various routing protocols from the Internet Enlightenment era, such as the IBM System Network architecture, the DEC architecture set up in the systems it produced, and the special protocols developed by Microsoft for Windows. There are also many special protocols developed for specific functions, such as NFS systems that can provide file access functions on the Internet. Today, UDP protocols are widely used for streaming video, streaming media, and video game messages.
title: 操作系统

source_text:
安全
大多數操作系统都含有某種程度的資訊安全機制。資訊安全機制主要基於兩大理念：
操作系统提供外界直接或間接存取數種資源的管道，例如本地端磁碟機的檔案、受保護的特權系統呼叫、使用者的隱私資料與系統執行的程式所提供的服務。
操作系统有能力認證資源存取的請求。允許通過認證的請求並拒絕無法通過的非法請求，並將適當的權力授權（）給此請求。有些系統的認證機制僅簡略地把資源分為特權或非特權，且每個請求都有獨特的身份辨識號碼，例如使用者名稱。資源請求通常分成兩大種類：
內部來源：通常是一個正在執行的程式發出的資源請求。在某些系統上，一個程式一旦可執行就可做任何事情（例如DOS時代的病毒），但通常操作系统會給程式一個識別代號，並且在此程式發出請求時，檢查其代號與所需資源的存取權限關係。
外部來源：從非本地端電腦而來的資源請求，例如遠端登入本機電腦或某些網路連線請求（FTP或HTTP）。為了識別這些外部請求，系統也許會對此請求提出認證要求。通常是請求輸入使用者名稱以及相對應的密碼。系統有時也會應用諸如磁卡或生物識別資料的它種認證方法。在某些例子，例如網路通訊上，通常不需通過認證即可存取資源（例如匿名存取的FTP伺服器或P2P服務）。
target_text: Security Most operating systems have some degree of information security mechanism. Information security mechanisms are based on two main concepts: the operating system provides a pipeline for direct or indirect access to multiple external resources, such as files on local hard drives; protected privilege system calls; user privacy data and services provided by programs running the system; the operating system has the ability to authenticate resource access requests; the authorization of an authentication request and the denial of unapproved claims; and the proper authorization of such requests; and the ability to access the request. Some systems are simply distributed as privileges or non-privileges, and each application has a unique identifier number, such as a user name. Resource requests are usually divided into two main types: source requests, such as those that are usually made by a computer program that is running a certificate of authentication; and the method of requesting the source of resource that is required by a computer program; the request for access to a system, such as a computer or a remote server; for example, the use of a computer program that is running a computer program, such as a PTP, is often used to request access
title: 操作系统

source_text: 肇因於軍方與商業組織將敏感資料記錄在電腦上，安全機制在操作系统歷史上是一個被長久關注與討論的問題。美國國防部（DoD）便創立了《可信賴之計算機系統評鑑程序》（），此手冊確立了評鑑安全機制成效的基本原則。這對操作系统作者來說非常重要，因為TCSEC是用於評鑑、分類與選拔出用於處理、儲存與獲取敏感或機密資料的電腦系統的標準程序。
target_text: Because military and commercial organizations have recorded sensitive information on computers, security mechanisms have been a long-standing concern and debate in the history of operating systems. The U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) created the Trusted Computer System Evaluation Program, which establishes the basic principles for the effectiveness of evaluation security systems. This is important to the authors of operating systems, as TCSEC is the standard program for evaluating, classifying, and selecting computer systems used to process, store, and obtain sensitive or classified information.
title: 操作系统

source_text:
內部通讯安全
內部資訊安全可視為防止正在執行的程式任意存取系統資源的手段。大多操作系统讓普通程式可直接操作電腦的CPU，所以產生了一些問題，例如怎樣把可如操作系统一樣處理事務、執行同樣特殊指令的程式強迫停止，畢竟在此情境下，操作系统也只是另一個平起平坐的程式。為通用操作系统所生產的CPU通常於硬體層級上實踐了一定程度的特殊指令保護概念。通常特權層級較低的程式想要執行某些特殊指令時會被阻斷，例如直接存取像是硬碟之類的外部裝置。因此，程式必須得經由詢問操作系统，讓操作系统執行特殊指令來存取磁碟。因此操作系统就有機會檢查此程式的識別身份，並依此接受或拒絕它的請求。
target_text: Internal communication security Internal information security can be seen as a means of preventing running programs from having arbitrary access to system resources. Most operating systems allow ordinary programs to directly operate the computer's CPU, so there are some problems, such as how to handle the same tasks as the operating system; forcing programs to stop executing the same special instructions, after all, in this situation, the operating system is just another flat-out program. The CPUs produced for general operating systems usually implement a certain degree of special instruction protection concept at the hardware level. Usually, programs with a lower privilege level are blocked when they want to execute certain special instructions, such as directly accessing external devices such as hard drives. Therefore, programs must be executed by the operating system to allow the operating system to execute special instructions to obtain magnetic strips.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 內部安全機制在多使用者電腦上特別重要：它允許每個系統使用者擁有自己個人的檔案與目錄，且其他使用者不能任意存取或刪除。因為任何程式都可能繞過操作系统的監控，更有可能繞過側錄程式的監控，擁有強制力的內部安全機制在側錄啟動時也非常重要。
target_text: Internal security is particularly important in multi-user computers: it allows each system user to own their own personal files and directories, and other users cannot arbitrarily access or delete them. Because any program can bypass the monitoring of the operating system, it is more likely to bypass the monitoring of side recorders, having a compulsory internal security mechanism is also important when side recording is activated.
title: 操作系统

source_text:
外部通讯安全
通常一個作業系統會為其他網路上的電腦或使用者提供（主持）各種服務。這些服務通常藉由端口或操作系统網路地址後的數字存取點提供。通常此服務包括提供檔案共享（NFS）、列印共享、電子郵件、網頁服務與檔案傳輸協定（FTP）。外部資訊安全的最前線，是諸如防火墙等的硬體裝置。在操作系统內部也常設置許多種類的軟體防火牆。軟體防火牆可設定接受或拒絕在操作系统上執行的服務與外界的連線。因此任何人都可以安裝並執行某些不安全的網路服務，例如Telnet或FTP，並且設定除了某些自用通道之外阻擋其他所有連線，以達成防堵不良連線的機制。
target_text: External communication security is usually provided by an operating system to a computer or user on the Internet. These services are usually provided through a digital access point after the port or operating system's Internet address. These services usually include file sharing (NFS), print sharing, email, web services and file transfer agreements (FTP). The frontline of external information security is hardware devices such as firewalls. Many types of software firewalls are also installed within the operating system. Firewalls can be set up to accept or reject connections with the outside world that are running on the operating system.
title: 操作系统

source_text:
使用者界面
今日大部分的操作系统都包含图形用户界面（GUI）。有幾類較舊的操作系统將圖形化使用者介面與核心緊密結合，例如最早的Windows與Mac OS實作產品。此種手法可提供較快速的圖形回應能力，且實作時不需切割模組因而較為省工，但是會有強烈副作用，例如圖形系統崩潰將導致整個系統崩潰，例如藍白當機畫面。許多近代的操作系统已模組化，將圖形介面的子系統與核心分開（已知Linux與Mac OS X原先就是如此設計，而某些擴充版本的Windows終於也採用此手法）。
target_text: Most operating systems today contain graphical user interfaces (GUI). Some older operating systems have a close relationship to the graphical user interface, such as the earliest Windows and Mac OS implementations. This method provides faster graphical responsiveness and is more economical without cutting modules, but has strong side effects, such as a graphical system crash that will lead to the entire system collapsing, such as the Blue Machine Graph. Modern operating systems have been modulated, separating graphical interface subsystems from the core (which is known to have been designed with Linux Mac OS X, and some extended versions of Windows have finally adopted this method).
title: 操作系统

source_text: 許多操作系统允許使用者安裝或創造任何他們喜歡的图形用户界面。大部分的Unix與Unix衍生系統（BSD、Linux與Minix）通常會安裝X Window系統配合GNOME或KDE桌面環境。而某些操作系统就沒有這麼彈性的圖形化使用者介面，例如Windows。這類的操作系统只能透過外加的程式來改變其圖形化使用者介面，甚至根本只能改變諸如選單風格或顏色配置等部分。
target_text: Many operating systems allow users to install or create any graphical user interface they like. Most Unix and Unix derivatives (BSD, Linux and Minix) typically install X Window systems with GNOME or KDE desktop environments. While some operating systems do not have such a flexible graphical user interface, such as Windows. Such operating systems can only change their graphical user interface with plugins, or even simply change parts such as single style or color configuration.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 所謂的驅動程式（Device driver）是指某類設計來與硬體互動的電腦軟體。通常是一設計完善的裝置互動介面，利用與此硬體連接的電腦匯排流或通訊子系統，提供對此裝置下令與接收資訊的功能；以及最終目的，將訊息提供給操作系统或應用程式。驅動程式是針對特定硬體與特定操作系统設計的軟體，通常以作業系統核心模組、應用軟體包或普通電腦程式的形式在操作系统核心底下執行，以達到通透順暢地與硬體互動的效果，且提供硬體在處理非同步的時間依賴性介面（asynchronous time-dependent hardware interface）時所需的中斷處理常式。
target_text: A device driver is a type of computer software designed to interact with hardware. Usually a perfectly designed device interface that uses a computer's remote flow or communications subsystem connected to the hardware to provide the functionality of commanding and receiving information to that device; and for the ultimate purpose of providing information to the operating system or application. A drive is software designed for specific hardware and specific operating systems, usually executed under the operating system core software module, application package, or ordinary computer program, to achieve smooth interaction with the hardware interface and provide the hardware with the necessary disconnect during the processing of asynchronous time-dependent hardware interfaces.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 設計驅動程式的主要目的在於操作抽象化，任何硬體模組，即使是同一類的裝置，在硬體設計面上也有巨大差異。廠商推出的較新模組通常更可靠更有效率，控制方法也會有所不同。電腦與其操作系统每每不能預期那些現有與新裝置的變異之處，因此無法知道其操作方法。為解決此問題操作系统通常會主動制訂每種裝置該有的操作方式，而驅動程式功能則是將那些操作系统制訂的行為描述，轉譯為可讓裝置瞭解的自訂操作手法。
target_text: The main purpose of a design drive is to abstract the operation, and any hardware module, even the same type of device, has huge differences in hardware design. The newer modules introduced by manufacturers are usually more reliable, more efficient, and different control methods. Each computer and its operating system cannot anticipate the changes to existing and new devices, so it is not possible to know its operating methods. To solve this problem, the operating system usually actively prepares the operating methods for each device, while the functions of the drive are those that describe the behavior of the operating system, which translate into automated operations that make the device understandable.
title: 操作系统

source_text:
结构
操作系统理论研究者有时把操作系统分成四大部分：
驱动程序 - 最底层的、直接控制和监视各类硬件的部分，它们的职责是隐藏硬件的具体细节，并向其他部分提供一个抽象的、通用的接口。
内核 - 操作系统之最核心部分，通常运行在最高特权级，负责提供基础性、结构性的功能。
支承库 - （亦作“接口库”）是一系列特殊的程序库，它们职责在于把系统所提供的基本服务包装成应用程序所能够使用的编程接口（API），是最靠近应用程序的部分。例如，GNU C运行期库就属于此类，它把各种操作系统的内部编程接口包装成ANSI C和POSIX编程接口的形式。
外围 - 所谓外围，是指操作系统中除以上三类以外的所有其他部分，通常是用于提供特定高级服务的部件。例如，在微内核结构中，大部分系统服务，以及UNIX/Linux中各种守护进程都通常被划归此列。
target_text: Structure Operating System Theorists sometimes divide the operating system into four main parts: the driver - the most basic, direct control and monitoring part of the hardware, which is responsible for hiding the specifics of the hardware and providing an abstract, universal interface to the rest. The core - the core part of the operating system, usually running at the highest privileged level, is responsible for providing basic, structural functions. The branch - (also known as the branch - branch) - is a series of specialised libraries that are responsible for packing the basic services provided by the system into the programming interfaces that can be used by the application. The API, which is the closest part of the application. For example, the GNU C library belongs to this class, which encompasses all the internal programming services of the operating system and the so-called CIXIX operating system. All the external structures are usually used in the third-party operating system, except for the main part, which is usually the micro-core, which is used in the third-party operating system.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 当然，本节所提出的四部结构观也绝非放之四海皆准。例如，在早期的微软视窗操作系统中，各部分耦合程度很深，难以区分彼此。而在使用外核结构的操作系统中，则根本没有驱动程序的概念。因而，本节的讨论只适用于一般情况，具体特例需具体分析。
target_text: Of course, the four structural concepts presented in this section are not necessarily all-encompassing. For example, in early Microsoft Windows operating systems, the interconnections were so deep that it was difficult to distinguish between them. In operating systems using non-nuclear structures, there was no concept of a driver. Therefore, the discussion in this section applies only to general situations, specific cases need specific analysis.
title: 操作系统

source_text:
分类
操作系统的分类没有一个单一的标准，可以根据工作方式分为批处理操作系统、分时操作系统、实时操作系统、网络操作系统和分布式操作系统等；根据架构可以分为单内核操作系统等；根据运行的环境，可以分为桌面操作系统，嵌入式操作系统等；根据指令的长度分为8bit, 16bit, 32bit, 64bit的操作系统。
target_text: Classification Operating systems are classified according to a single standard, which can be divided into batch operating systems, split-time operating systems, real-time operating systems, network operating systems and distributed operating systems, etc. Depending on the architecture, they can be classified as single-core operating systems, depending on the operating environment, they can be classified as desktop operating systems, embedded operating systems, etc. Depending on the length of the instructions, they can be classified as 8bit, 16bit, 32bit, 64bit operating systems.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 内核是操作系统最核心最基础的构件，其结构往往对操作系统的外部特性以及应用领域有着一定程度的影响。尽管随着理论和实践的不断演进，操作系统高层特性与内核结构之间的耦合有日趋缩小之势，但习惯上，内核结构仍然是操作系统分类之常用标准。
target_text: The kernel is the most basic component of the operating system, and its structure often has a degree of influence on the external characteristics of the operating system and its applications. Although the theory and practice has evolved and the combination of higher characteristics and core structure has been diminishing, in practice, core structure remains the standard standard for classifying operating systems.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 微内核结构是1980年代产生出来的较新的内核结构，强调结构性部件与功能性部件的分离。20世纪末，基于微内核结构，理论界中又发展出了超微内核与外内核等多种结构。尽管自1980年代起，大部分理论研究都集中在以微内核为首的“新兴”结构之上，然而，在应用领域之中，以单内核结构为基础的操作系统却一直占据着主导地位。
target_text: Micro-core structure is a newer core structure that emerged in the 1980s, emphasizing the separation of structural components from functional components. At the end of the 20th century, a number of structures based on micro-core structures were developed in the theoretical community, including super-micro-core and outer-core. Although most theoretical research has focused on the emerging silicon structure led by the micro-core since the 1980s, operating systems based on single-core structures have been dominant in the field of application.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 在众多常用操作系统之中，除了QNX和基于Mach的UNIX等个别系统外，几乎全部采用单内核结构，例如大部分的Unix、Linux，以及Windows（微软声称Windows NT是基于改良的微内核架构的，尽管理论界对此存有异议）。微内核和超微内核结构主要用于研究性操作系统，还有一些嵌入式系统使用外核。
target_text: Among the many operating systems in common use, almost all have single-core architectures, except for QNX and UNIX based on Mach, such as most Unix, Linux, and Windows. Microsoft claims that Windows NT is based on improved micro-core architectures, which is disputed by the management community.
title: 操作系统

source_text: 基于单内核的操作系统通常有着较长的历史渊源。例如，绝大部分UNIX的家族史都可上溯至1960年代。该类操作系统多数有着相对古老的设计和实现（例如某些UNIX中存在着大量1970年代、1980年代的代码）。另外，往往在性能方面略优于同一应用领域中采用其他内核结构的操作系统（但通常认为此种性能优势不能完全归功于单内核结构）。
target_text: Single-core operating systems typically have a longer history. For example, the vast majority of UNIX family histories date back to the 1960s. Most of these operating systems have relatively old designs and implementations (for example, some UNIXs have a large amount of code from the 1970s and 1980s).
title: 操作系统

source_text:
通用与专用、嵌入式
通用操作系统是面向一般没有特定应用需求的操作系统。由于没有特定的应用需求，通用操作系统为了适应更广泛的应用，需要支持更多的硬件与软件，需要针对所有的用户体验，对系统进行更新。通用操作系统是一个工程量繁重的操作系统。
target_text: General and special embedded general operating systems are operating systems that are generally not specific to specific application requirements. Because there are no specific application requirements, general operating systems require more hardware and software to be supported in order to adapt to wider applications, and to be updated for all user experiences.
title: 操作系统

source_text:
-{zh-hans:实时;zh-hant:即時;}-与非-{zh-hans:实时;zh-hant:即時;}-
「-{zh-hans:实时操作系统;zh-hant:即時作業系统;}-」（Real Time OS）泛指所有据有一定实时资源调度以及通讯能力的操作系统。而所谓“-{zh-hans:实时;zh-hant:即時;}-”，不同语境中往往有着非常不同的意义。某些时候仅仅用作“高性能”的同义词。但在操作系统理论中“-{zh-hans:实时;zh-hant:即時;}-性”所指的通常是特定操作所消耗的时间（以及空间）的上限是可预知的。比如，如果说某个操作系统提供实时内存分配操作，那也就是说一个内存分配操作所用时间（及空间）无论如何也不会超出操作系统所承诺的上限。-{zh-hans:实时;zh-hant:即時;}-性在某些领域非常重要，比如在工业控制、医疗器材、影音频合成、以及军事领域，-{zh-hans:实时;zh-hant:即時;}-性都是无可或缺的特性。
target_text: -{zh-hans: real time;zh-hant: instant;}- and non-{zh-hans: real time;zh-hant: instant;}----"{zh-hans: real-time operating system;zh-hant: instant operating system;}- "Real Time OS" refers to all operating systems based on a certain real-time resource scheduling and communication capability. While the term "zh-hans: real-time;zh-hant: instant;}-hans tends to have very different meanings in different languages. Sometimes it is used synonymously with just high-performance handouts. But in operating system theory, handouts are used to refer to specific and typically time-consuming operating systems such as (and) limited operating space.
title: 操作系统
