source_text: Smalltalk是“纯”面向对象编程语言，这意味着，不像C++和Java，在作为对象的值和作为原始类型的值之间没有区别。在Smalltalk中，原始值比如整数、布尔值和字符，也是对象，这么说的意义在于它们也是相应类的实例，而且要发送消息来调用在它们上的运算。编程者可以通过子类，改变或扩展实现原始值的类，使得可以向它们的实例定义新行为，例如实现一个新的控制结构，甚至使得它们现有行为得以改变。这个事实被总结成常听到的一句短语：“在Smalltalk中，所有东西都是对象”，它可以更精确的表达为：“所有的值都是对象”，因为变量不是。
target_text: Smalltalk is the “pure” object-oriented programming language, which means that, unlike C++ and Java, there is no difference between the value of the object and that of the original type. In Smalltalk, the original values, such as integer numbers, booleans and characters, are also the object, meaning that they are examples of the respective categories and send messages to call their calculations. The programmer can change or expand the categories in which the original value is achieved by subclassing them, allowing them to define new behaviour, such as achieving a new control structure or even changing their existing behaviour. This fact is summarized in a phrase that is often heard: “In Smalltalk, all things are objects”, which can be expressed more accurately as “all values are objects”, because the variables are not.
title: Smalltalk

source_text: 反射是一个计算机科学术语，适用于有能力检查它们自己的结构的软件程序，例如检查它们的分析树或输入和输出参数的数据类型。反射是动态、交互式语言比如Smalltalk和Lisp的一个特征。具有反射的交互式程序（要么解释的要么编译的）维护所有内存内对象的状态，包括代码对象自身，这是在解析/编译期间生成的，并且是在编程上可访问和修改的。
target_text: Reflecting is a computer science term that applies to software programs capable of checking their own structures, such as the types of data that examine their analytical trees or input and output parameters. Reflecting is a feature of dynamic, interactive languages, such as Smalltalk and Lisp. Interactive programs with reflective (either explained or compiled) maintain the status of all memory objects, including code objects themselves, which are generated during the process of dissecting/compiling and are accessible and modified on programming.
title: Smalltalk

source_text: Smalltalk-80还提供计算性反射，有能力观察系统的计算状态。在派生自最初Smalltalk-80的语言中，一个方法的当前活动（activation），可以作为通过伪变量命名的一个对象来访问，这个伪变量是作为六个保留字之一的thisContext。通过发送消息至thisContext，一个方法活动可以提问比如：“谁给你发送了这个消息？”。这些设施使得有可能实现协程，或类似Prolog的回溯，而不需要修改虚拟机。异常系统也是使用这个设施实现的。这个设施更有趣的用法之一，是在 web框架之中，它通过为每个编辑的页面存储续体，并在它们之间切换来导航一个web站点，缓解了编程者处理Web浏览器的返回按钮的复杂性。使用Seaside编程web服务器，可以使用更常规的编程风格来完成。
target_text: Smalltalk-80 also provides a computational reflection, capable of observing the system's computational state. In the language that came out of the original Smalltalk-80, the current activity of a method (activation) can be accessed as an object named by a pseudo-variant, which is the thisContext of one of the six reserved words. By sending the message to the thisContext, a methodological activity can ask, for example, “Who sent this message to you?” these facilities make it possible to achieve co-ordinates or similar prolog regression without changing the virtual machine. One of the more interesting uses of this facility is that it can be done by using more conventional programming styles, using the web framework, by storing pages for each editor and switching between them to navigate a web site, alleviating the complexity of programmers dealing with the return buttons of the Web browser.
title: Smalltalk

source_text: 通过建立只理解（实现）doesNotUnderstand:的一个类，可以建立一个实例，经由它的doesNotUnderstand:方法能拦截发送给它的任何消息。这种实例可以叫做透明代理（proxy）。可以使用这种代理来实现很多设施，比如分布式Smalltalk，这里的消息在多个Smalltalk系统之间交换，和数据库接口，这里的对象透明的从数据库中排除错误，还有promise等。分布式Smalltalk的设计影响了如CORBA这样的系统。
target_text: By creating a category that only understands (achievement) notUnderstand: an example can be created, via its doesnotUnunderstand: The method can intercept any message sent to it. This example can be called the Transparency Agent (proxy). Many facilities, such as distributed Smalltalk, where messages are exchanged between multiple Smalltalk systems and database interfaces, where the object is transparent enough to remove errors from the database, and promise. The distributed Smalltalk design affects systems such as CORBA.
title: Smalltalk

source_text:
基于映像的持久存储
多数流行的编程系统，将静态的程序代码（以类定义、函数或过程的形式），分离于动态的或运行时间的程序状态（比如对象或其他形式的程序数据）。它们在程序启动的时候装载程序代码，而任何先前的程序状态必须从配置文件或其他数据源显式的重新建立。程序（和编程者）未显式保存的设置，在每次重启时都必须再次设立。传统的程序在每次程序保存一个文件、退出和重载的时候，还失去很多有用的文档信息。这会失去细节比如回退历史或光标位置。基于映像的系统不会因为计算机关闭或OS更新，而强制失去所有这些东西。
target_text: Most popular programming systems based on images have static program codes (in the form of class definitions, functions or processes) separated from the dynamic or running-time program state (e.g. object or other form of program data). They load the program code at the start of the program, and any previous program state must be recreated from the configuration file or other data source display. The program (and the programmer) has no visible saving settings, which must be re-established every time it restarts. Traditional programs lose a lot of useful document information every time they save a file, exit and reload. This will lose details, for example, the historical or cursor location. A system based on an image will not be forced to lose all of these things because a computer closes or OS updates.
title: Smalltalk

source_text: 软件复用是一种计算机软件工程方法和理论。20世紀60年代的“软件危机”使程序设计人员明白难于维护的软件成本是极其高昂的，当软件的规模不断扩大时，这种软件的综合成本可以说是没有人能负担的，并且即使投入了高昂的资金也难以得到可靠的产品，而软件重用的思想是解决这一问题的根本方法。
target_text: Software reuse is a computer software engineering method and theory. The “software crisis” of the 1960s made programmers understand that the cost of software that is difficult to maintain is extremely high, that when software is growing in scale, the cost of such a combination can be said to be beyond the reach of anyone, and that it is difficult to obtain reliable products even with high investment, and that the idea of software reuse is the fundamental solution to this problem.
title: 软件复用

source_text: 软件复用的主要思想是，将软件看成是由不同功能部分的“组件”所组成的有机体，每一个组件在设计编写时可以被设计成完成同类工作的通用工具，这样，如果完成各种工作的组件被建立起来以后，编写一特定软件的工作就变成了将各种不同组件组织连接体来的简单问题，这对于软件产品的最终质量和维护工作都有本质性的改变。
target_text: The main idea of software reuse is to look at the software as an organism made up of “components” of different functional components, each of which can be designed as a generic tool for performing the same kind of work at the time of design, so that, when the components that complete the various tasks are built, the preparation of a particular software becomes a simple question of connecting the various components to the various organizations, which is a fundamental change in the ultimate quality and maintenance of the software products.
title: 软件复用

source_text:
简介
软件复用就是将已有的软件成分用于构造新的软件系统。可以被复用的软件成分一般称作可复用构件，无论对可复用构件不加修改直接使用还是修改后再使用，只要是用来构造新软件，则都可称作复用。从更大的角度理解，软件重用也包括应用项目的重用，规格说明（也称为规约）的重用，设计的重用，概念和方法的重用等等。
target_text: Reuse of software is the use of existing software components for the construction of new software systems. Software components that can be reused are commonly referred to as reusable components, whether direct or modified for use without modification of reusable components, and as long as they are used to construct new software. More broadly, re-use of software also includes the reuse of application projects, re-use of specifications (also referred to as statutes), re-use of design, re-use of concepts and methods, etc.
title: 软件复用

source_text:
如果在一个系统中多次使用一个相同的软件成分，则不称作复用，而称作共享；对一个软件进行修改，使它运行于新的软硬件平台也不称作复用，而称作软件移植。作用
软件重用有助于提高软件的质量和开发效率，降低软件的开发和维护成本。参考
target_text: If one of the same software components is used several times in a system, it is not called reuse, but sharing; a software is modified to run on a new hardware and software platform, not reuse, but software transplant. Reuse of software will help to improve the quality and efficiency of software development and reduce the cost of software development and maintenance.
title: 软件复用

source_text: 计算机图形学（，縮寫为）是研究计算机在硬件和软件的帮助下创建计算机图形的科学学科，是计算机科学的一個分支領域，主要關注數位合成與操作視覺的圖形內容。雖然這個詞通常被認為是指三維圖形，事實上同時包括了二維圖形以及影像處理。
target_text: Computer graphics (abcruited) is a scientific discipline in computer graphics created by computers with the help of hardware and software. It is a branch of computer science that focuses mainly on digital synthesis and operational visual content. Although this term is usually considered to refer to three-dimensional graphics, in fact it includes two-dimensional graphics as well as image processing.
title: 计算机图形学

source_text:
概述
简单地说，计算机图形学的主要研究内容就是研究如何在计算机中表示图形、以及利用计算机进行图形的计算、处理和显示的相关原理与算法。图形通常由点、线、面、体等几何元素和灰度、色彩、线型、线宽等非几何属性组成。从处理技术上来看，图形主要分为两类，一类是基于线条信息表示的，如工程图、等高线地图、曲面的线框图等，另一类是明暗图，也就是通常所说的真实感图形。
target_text: Briefly, the main study of computer graphics is to study how graphics are presented in computers, and the principles and algorithms associated with computing, processing and displaying graphics using computers. Graphics are usually composed of geometric elements such as points, lines, faces, body, etc., and non-geometric properties such as greyscale, colour, linear type, line width, etc.
title: 计算机图形学

source_text: 计算机图形学一个主要的目的就是要利用计算机产生令人赏心悦目的真实感图形。为此，必须建立图形所描述的场景的几何表示，再用某种光照模型，计算在假想的光源、纹理、材质属性下的光照明效果。所以计算机图形学与另一门学科计算机辅助几何设计有着密切的关系。事实上，图形学也把可以表示几何场景的曲线曲面造型技术和实体造型技术作为其主要的研究内容。同时，真实感图形计算的结果是以数字图象的方式提供的，计算机图形学也就和图像处理有着密切的关系。
target_text: A major purpose of computer graphics is to use computers to produce meaningful real-world graphics. To do this, it is necessary to create geometric representation of the landscape described by the graphics, and to calculate the light-lighting effects of imaginary light sources, textures, and material properties. So computer graphics is closely related to computer-assisted geometry in another discipline.
title: 计算机图形学

source_text: 图形与图像两个概念间的区别越来越模糊，但还是有区别的：图像纯指计算机内以位图形式存在的灰度信息，而图形含有几何属性，或者说更强调场景的几何表示，是由场景的几何模型和景物的物理属性共同组成的。计算机图形学的研究内容非常广泛，如图形硬件、图形标准、图形交互技术、光栅图形生成算法、曲线曲面造型、实体造型、真实感图形计算与显示算法、非真实感绘制，以及计算可视化、计算机动画、自然景物仿真、虚拟现实等。
target_text: The difference between the concepts of graphics and images is becoming increasingly blurred, but it is still somewhat different: images refer exclusively to greyscale information in the form of bitmaps within computers, which contain geometric properties or, more importantly, the geometry of the scene, which is made up of geometric models of the scene and the physical properties of the landscape. Computer graphics studies are extensive, such as graphic hardware, graphic standards, graphic interactive techniques, raster graphics generation algorithms, curve shapes, physical shapes, real sense graphics calculation and display algorithms, non-realistic drawings, and computing visualization, computer animation, natural landscape simulations, virtual reality, etc.
title: 计算机图形学

source_text:
计算机图形学的分支学科
這個科學廣義的分支学科，可大致可分為以下幾類
幾何：研究面的表示和處理的方法
動畫：研究移動的表示和操作方法
影像擬真/渲染：研究模擬光線傳遞效果的演算法
影像：研究影像的獲取或是編輯
拓扑结构：研究的空间和表面的结构。
target_text: The branch of computer graphics, which is a broad branch of science, can be divided broadly into the following types of geometry: expressions of research surfaces and methods of processing animation: expressions of motion and methods of operation Research image simulation/reflection: algorithms of simulating light transfer effects Research images: acquisition of images or editing of topping structures: spatial and surface structure of research.
title: 计算机图形学

source_text:
子领域
非真实感绘制
基于物理的渲染
实时渲染侧重于对于交互式应用程序（如游戏、建模时的实时预览）的使用，通常使用专门的硬件，比如图形处理器。
光照计算机图形计算机图形在学术中的广义被用来描述为“在计算机里除了文字与声音以外的一切”。
target_text: Sub-area non-realistic renderings Real-time renderings focus on the use of interactive applications (e.g., games, real-time previews at modelling), usually using specialized hardware, such as graphic processors. Photo-based computer graphics are widely used in the academic context to describe "everything other than text and sound in a computer."
title: 计算机图形学

source_text: 二维计算机图形二维计算机图形（2D computer graphics），是产生基于计算机的数字图像（例如二维几何模型，文本，和数字图像）。二维计算机图形被利用在许多方面，例如字体、地图、工程制图、广告、等等。三维计算机图形三维计算机图形（3D computer graphics）是计算机和特殊三维软件帮助下创造的作品。一般来讲，该术语可指代创造这些图形的过程，或者三维计算机图形技术的研究领域，及其相关技术。
target_text: Two-dimensional computer graphics (2D computer graphs) produce computer-based digital images (e.g., two-dimensional geometry models, text, digital images). Two-dimensional computer graphics are used in many ways, such as fonts, maps, engineering drawings, advertising, etc. Three-dimensional computer graphics (3D computer graphs) are created with the help of computers and special three-dimensional software.
title: 计算机图形学

source_text: 计算机动画（computer animation），又称计算机绘图，是通过使用计算机制作动画的技术。它是计算机图形学和动画的子领域。近年动画师越来越多的借助于三维计算机图形学，纵使二维计算机图形学仍然被广泛使用着。有时动画最后播放的地方就是计算机本身，有时候则是另外的媒体，例如电影。
target_text: Computer animation, also known as computer mapping, is a technique for making animations using computers. It is a sub-area of computer graphics and animations. In recent years, animationists have increasingly relied on three-dimensional computer graphics, even though two-dimensional computer graphics are still widely used. Sometimes the last place for animation is computers themselves, and sometimes other media, such as movies.
title: 计算机图形学

source_text: Logo的原型来自另一个计算机语言LISP，派普特修改了LISP的语法使其更易于阅读。Logo常被称作没有括号的Lisp。Logo继承了Lisp的「表」的概念，所以在函数处理等方面拥有强大的能力，也是有特殊需求的计算机科学家的好帮手。海龟绘图海龟绘图使得Logo用户可以通过简单的编程创作出丰富多彩的视觉效果或图案。假想一只带着画笔的海龟可以接受简单的命令，例如向前走100步，或者左转30度。通过对这只海龟发送命令，可以让它绘制出较为复杂的图形，例如正方形，三角形，圆等。
target_text: Logo's prototype came from LISP, another computer language, and Pappto modified the LISP syntax to make it easier to read. Logo was often referred to as Lisp without brackets. Logo inherited the concept of Lisp's “table”, so it had a strong capacity in function processing and was a good helper for computer scientists with special needs. Sea turtle mapping made it possible for Logo users to make rich visual effects or drawings through simple programming. Hypothetic turtles with brushes could take simple orders, such as walking 100 steps forward or turning 30 degrees left. By sending orders to this turtle, it could produce more complex graphics, such as squares, triangles, circles, etc.
title: Logo (程序语言)

source_text: 多晶和次晶相（见多晶体）由数量众多的小晶体或者微晶构成。多晶硅是一种由许多的较小硅晶构成的材料。多晶体晶胞可由一种可见的“片状金属效应”来识别纹理。半导体级（也包括太阳能级）多晶硅被转换为“单晶”硅——意味着在“多晶硅”中随机联接的晶体转变成了一个大的“单晶”。单晶硅被用于制造大多数硅基微电子设备。多晶硅能够达到99.9999%纯度。超纯多晶硅也应用在半导体工业里，比如2至3米长的多晶硅棒。在微电子业（半导体产业），多晶硅在宏观尺度和微观尺度（组分）皆有应用。单晶硅的生长工艺包括柴可拉斯基法、区熔和布里奇曼法。
target_text: Polycrystal and subcrystal (see polycrystal) are made of a large number of small crystals or microcrystals. Polycrystal silicon is a material made up of many smaller silicon crystals. Multicrystal crystals are used to identify the textures by a visible “filamental metal effect” . Semiconductor-level (and also solar-grade) multicrystal silicon is converted to “silicon” - meaning that the crystals that are randomly connected in “silicon” are transformed into a large single crystal.
title: 多晶硅

source_text: 软件工程师（）一般指从事软件开发职业的人。软件工程师跟一般程序员的區別，在于一个程序员的工作是按照指定的规格进行编码，而软件工程师的工作则需要设计和规划。不过，由于现时社会的分工愈來愈模糊，软件工程师跟程序员的分工也愈不明顯。但对于嚴格執行CMM的機構來說，各人的工作區分也比較清晰，這有助于了解软件工程师跟一般程序员的分別。
target_text: Software engineers () generally refer to people in the software development profession. The difference between a software engineer and a general programmer is that a programmer's job is coded according to the specified specifications, while a software engineer's job needs to be designed and planned. However, as the division of labour between software engineers and programmers becomes increasingly blurred in the present society, so does the division of labour between software engineers and programmers.
title: 软件工程师

source_text:
职位概述
软件工程师（Software Engineer）是一个认证考试，具体地说是从事软件职业的人员的一种职业能力的认证，通过它说明具备了工程师的资格。
一般情况下都是分4级：软件技术员
助理软件工程师
软件工程师
高级软件工程师相关内容
软件
软件工程
计算机
資訊業
target_text: The software engineer (Software Engineering) is a certification examination, specifically a certification of the professional competence of the person engaged in the software profession, through which the qualification of the engineer is demonstrated.
title: 软件工程师

source_text: 数学心理学是利用数学模型来研究心理现象的心理学分支。用定量的方法来描述心理现象。由于研究的对象的复杂性，一般只能对研究作模糊的定性描述，但在信息论、控制论、统计决策论和電腦科学发展的推动下，数学心理学也发展迅速，不断取得了新成果。用数学模型描述心理现象，其优越性不仅是它比自然语言的描述具有更大的概括性、准确性、演绎力和预测力，更重要的是它便于用计算机来模拟，为研究人工智能创造了更好的辅助。
target_text: Mathematical psychology is a branch of psychology that uses mathematical models to study psychological phenomena. A quantitative way of describing psychological phenomena. Due to the complexity of the subjects studied, research can generally be described in vague qualitative terms, but mathematical psychology is also rapidly developing and producing new results, driven by the development of informatics, control theory, statistical decision-making theory and computer science. Using mathematical models to describe psychological phenomena has the advantage not only of being more general, accurate, reflective and predictive than the description of natural languages, but, more importantly, of making it easier for computers to simulate, creating better support for the study of artificial intelligence.
title: 数学心理学

source_text:
介绍
電晶體發明並大量生產之後，各式固態半導體元件如二極體、電晶體等大量使用，取代了真空管在電路中的功能與角色。到了20世纪中後期半导体制造技术进步，便使集成电路成为可能。相对于手工组装电路使用個別的分立电子元件，積體電路可以把很大数量的微晶体管集成到一个小芯片，是一个巨大的进步。集成电路的规模生产能力、可靠性，电路设计的模块化方法确保了快速采用标准化集成电路代替了设计使用离散晶体管。
target_text: After the invention of crystals and their production in large quantities, solid semiconductors such as dipolars, crystals, etc. were used extensively to replace the functions and roles of vacuum tubes in electrical circuits. Technological advances in semiconductors in the second half of the twentieth century made integrated circuits possible. The use of separate electronic components in contrast to the manual assembly circuits, where a large number of microcrystal tubes could be integrated into a small chip, was a great advance. The large-scale production capacity, reliability of integrated circuits, and modular methods of electrical design ensured the rapid introduction of standardized integrated circuits instead of the design of discrete crystalline tubes.
title: 集成电路

source_text: 集成电路对于离散晶体管有两个主要优势：成本和性能。成本低是由于芯片把所有的元件通过照相平版技术，作为一个单位印刷，而不是在一个时间只制作一个晶体管。性能高是由于元件快速开关，消耗更低能量，因为元件很小且彼此靠近。2006年，芯片面积从几平方毫米到350 mm²，每mm²可以达到一百万个晶体管。
target_text: Integrated circuits have two main advantages for discrete transistors: cost and performance. The low cost is due to the chip printing all the components as a unit, through photolithography technology, rather than producing only one transistor at one time. The high performance is due to the rapid switch of the components, which consumes less energy, because the components are small and close to each other. In 2006, the chip was able to reach a million transistor per mm2 from a few square mm to 350 mm2.
title: 集成电路

source_text: 这些年来，集成电路持续向更小的外型尺寸发展，使得每个芯片可以封装更多的电路。这样增加了每单位面积容量，可以降低成本和增加功能－见摩尔定律，集成电路中的晶体管数量，每1.5年增加一倍。总之，随着外形尺寸缩小，几乎所有的指标改善了－单位成本和开关功率消耗下降，速度提高。但是，集成纳米级别设备的IC不是没有问题，主要是洩漏电流。因此，对于最终用户的速度和功率消耗增加非常明显，制造商面临使用更好几何学的尖锐挑战。这个过程和在未来几年所期望的进步，在半导体国际技术路线图中有很好的描述。
target_text: Over the years, integrated circuits have continued to evolve towards smaller external sizes, allowing each chip to encapsulate more circuits. This has increased the capacity per unit area, reducing costs and increasing functionality - see Moore's Law, where the number of transistors in integrated circuits has doubled every 1.5 years. In sum, almost all indicators have improved as the surface size has narrowed - unit cost and switch power consumption has declined and the speed has increased.
title: 集成电路

source_text: 人工神经网络（，ANNs）简称神经网络（neural network，NNs）或類-{}-神經網絡，在机器学习和认知科学领域，是一种模仿生物神经网络（动物的中樞神經系統，特别是大脑）的结构和功能的数学模型或计算模型，用于对函数进行估计或近似。神经网络由大量的人工神经元联结进行计算。大多数情况下人工神经网络能在外界信息的基础上改变内部结构，是一种自适应系统，通俗地讲就是具备学习功能。现代神经网络是一种非线性统计性数据建模工具，神经网络通常是-{zh-hans:通;zh-tw:透}-过一个基于数学统计学类型的学习方法（learning method）得以优化，所以也是数学统计学方法的一种实际应用，-{zh-hans:通;zh-tw:透}-过统计学的标准数学方法我们能够得到大量的可以用函数来表达的局部结构空间，另一方面在人工智能学的人工感知领域，我们-{zh-hans:通;zh-tw:透}-过数学统计学的应用可以来做人工感知方面的决定问题（也就是说-{zh-hans:通;zh-tw:透}-过统计学的方法，人工神经网络能够类似人一样具有简单的决定能力和简单的判断能力），这种方法比起正式的逻辑学推理演算更具有优势。
target_text: Artificial neurological networks (ANNs) are termed neural networks (neural network, NNs) or types - {}- neural networks, in the field of machine learning and cognitive sciences, are mathematical or computational models that imitate the structure and function of biological neural networks (the mid-neural system of animals, especially the brain), which are used to estimate or approximate functions. Neural networks are calculated by a large number of artificial neural links. In most cases, artificial neural networks can change the internal structure on the basis of outside information. They are self-adapted systems, popularly speaking means of learning.
title: 人工神经网络

source_text:
和其他机器学习方法一样，神经网络已经被用于解决各种各样的问题，例如机器视觉和语音识别。这些问题都是很难被传统基于规则的编程所解决的。背景
对人类中枢神经系统的观察启发了人工神经网络这个概念。在人工神经网络中，简单的人工节点，称作神經元（neurons），连接在一起形成一个类似生物神经网络的网状结构。
target_text: As with other mechanical learning methods, neural networks have been used to solve a variety of problems, such as machine visualization and speech recognition. These problems are difficult to solve by traditional rule-based programming. Background observations of the human central nervous system have inspired the concept of artificial neural networks. In artificial neurological networks, simple artificial nodes, called neurons, are linked together to form a grid structure similar to a bioneurons network.
title: 人工神经网络

source_text: 在神经网络的现代软件实现中，由生物学启发的方法已经有了很重大的延伸，現在主流的是基于统计学和信号处理的更加实用的方法。在一些软件系统中，神经网络或者神经网络的一部分（例如人工神经元）是大型系统中的一个部分。这些系统结合了适应性的和非适应性的元素。虽然这种系统使用的这种更加普遍的方法更适宜解决现实中的问题，但是这和传统的连接主义人工智能已经没有什么关联了。不过它们还有一些共同点：非线性、分布式、并行化，局部性计算以及适应性。从历史的角度讲，神经网络模型的应用标志着二十世纪八十年代后期从高度符号化的人工智能（以用条件规则表达知识的专家系统为代表）向低符号化的机器学习（以用动力系统的参数表达知识为代表）的转变。
target_text: There has been a significant extension of the biologically inspired approach in the realization of modern software for neural networks, which is now dominated by more practical methods based on statistics and signal processing. In some software systems, neural networks or parts of neural networks (e.g. artificial neurons) are part of larger systems. These systems combine adaptive and non-adaptive elements. While this more general approach used by such systems is more appropriate to solve real problems, it has nothing to do with traditional connecting artificial intelligence.
title: 人工神经网络

source_text:
历史
沃伦·麦卡洛克和沃尔特·皮茨（1943）基于数学和一种称为阈值逻辑的算法创造了一种神经网络的计算模型。这种模型使得神经网络的研究分裂为两种不同研究思路。一种主要关注大脑中的生物学过程，另一种主要关注神经网络在人工智能裡的应用。
target_text: History Warren McCallock and Walter Pitts (1943) created a computational model of neural networks based on mathematics and an algorithm called threshold logic. This model divides neural network research into two different research lines. One focuses primarily on biological processes in the brain and the other on the application of neural networks in artificial intelligence.
title: 人工神经网络

source_text: 法利和韦斯利·A·克拉克（1954）首次使用计算机，当时称作计算器，在MIT模拟了一个赫布网络。纳撒尼尔·罗切斯特（1956）等人模拟了一台 IBM 704计算机上的抽象神经网络的行为。创造了感知机。这是一种模式识别算法，用简单的加减法实现了两层的计算机学习网络。罗森布拉特也用数学符号描述了基本感知机里没有的回路，例如异或回路。这种回路一直无法被神经网络处理，直到保罗·韦伯斯(1975)创造了反向传播算法。
target_text: Farley and Wesley A. Clark (1954) used computers for the first time, when they were called calculators, to simulate a Hebb network at MIT. Nathaniel Rochester (1956) and others simulated the behavior of an abstract neural network on an IBM 704 computer. A sensor was created. It was a model recognition algorithm that achieved a two-storey computer learning network with simple additions and subtractions. Rosenblatt also described in mathematical symbols the circuits that were not found in basic sensors, such as different or loops. This circuit could not be processed by a neural network until Paul Webbers (1975) created a reverse dissemination algorithm.
title: 人工神经网络

source_text: 在马文·明斯基和西摩爾·派普特（1969）发表了一项关于机器学习的研究以后，神经网络的研究停滞不前。他们发现了神经网络的两个关键问题。第一是基本感知机无法处理异或回路。第二个重要的问题是电脑没有足够的能力来处理大型神经网络所需要的很长的计算时间。直到计算机具有更强的计算能力之前，神经网络的研究进展缓慢。
target_text: After Marvin Minsky and Seymour Pappett (1969) published a study on machine learning, research on neurological networks stagnated. They discovered two key questions about neurological networks. The first was that basic sensors could not handle differences or circuits. The second important issue was that computers did not have enough capacity to handle the long computing time required for large neural networks.
title: 人工神经网络

source_text:
反向传播算法与复兴
后来出现的一个关键的进展是保罗·韦伯斯发明的反向传播算法（Werbos 1975）。这个算法有效地解决了异或的问题，还有更普遍的训练多层神经网络的问题。在二十世纪80年代中期，分布式并行处理（当时称作联结主义）流行起来。和的教材对于联结主义在计算机模拟神经活动中的应用提供了全面的论述。
target_text: In the mid-1980’s, distributional parallel processing (then called bondism) became popular. And the teaching materials provided a comprehensive account of the use of bondism in computer simulation neuroactivity.

source_text:
人工神经网络的实用性
人工神经网络是一个能够学习，能够总结归纳的系统，也就是说它能够-{zh-hans:通;zh-tw:透}-过已知数据的实验运用来学习和归纳总结。人工神经网络-{zh-hans:通;zh-tw:透}-过对局部情况的对照比较（而这些比较是基于不同情况下的自动学习和要实际解决问题的复杂性所决定的），它能够推理产生一个可以自动识别的系统。与之不同的基于符号系统下的学习方法，它们也具有推理功能，只是它们是建立在逻辑演算法的基础上，也就是说它们之所以能够推理，基础是需要有一个推理演算法则的集合。
target_text: The practicality of artificial neural networks The artificial neural network is a system capable of learning and synthesizing, that is, it can learn and summarize -- {zh-hans: general; zh-tw: experiential application of known data. The artificial neural network -- {zh-hans: general; zh-tw: expansive comparison of local situations (which are based on automatic learning in different contexts and the complexity of the problem to be solved) leads to an automatic identification system. Unlike learning methods based on symbol systems, they also have the function of reasoning, but they are based only on logical algorithms, that is, on the need for a confluence of reasoning algorithms.

source_text:
计算机科学和人工智能领域
西摩爾·派普特就是根據皮亞傑的理論而開發了可供兒童學習使用電腦的Logo程式語言。Alan Kay以皮亞傑的理論為基礎，開發了Dynabook編程概念。以上這兩項技術，都是現今我們日常使用的圖形使用者介面（GUI）的基礎技術，使電腦從文字界面過渡至圖形界面，改寫了電腦技術的發展路向。
target_text: In the field of computer science and artificial intelligence, Simor Pappot has developed the Logo language for children to learn using computers based on Piaj's theory. Alan Kay has developed the Dynabook programming concept based on Piaj's theory. These two techniques are the basic techniques of the GUI that we now use today, enabling computers to leapfrog from the text interface to the graphic interface and to rewrite the evolution of computer technology.
title: 讓·皮亞傑

source_text: 随着分子生物学的产生与发展和测序技术的成熟，分子生物学序列逐渐取代了形态学数据成为了系统树主要的数据来源，由于分子生物学数据信息量大，主要的构建算法（邻接矩阵法、贝叶斯法、最大简约法、最大似然法等）计算量庞大，人力难以准确完成，因此现今一般使用计算机软件进行计算。
target_text: Molecular biology sequences have gradually replaced morphological data as the primary source of data for the system’s trees as molecular biology has matured, and since the amount of information on molecular biology data is so large that the major construction algorithms (neighbour matrix method, Bayes method, maximum simplicity method, maximum approximation etc.) are so large that it is difficult for the manpower to do it accurately today, computer software is generally used to calculate them.

source_text:
特徵
物件導向程式編程的定義是使用「物件」來做設計，但並非所有的程式語言都直接支援「物件導向程式編程」相關技術與結構。对于OOP的准确定义及其本意存在着不少争论。通常，OOP被理解为一种将程序分解为封装数据及相关操作的模块而进行的编程方式。有别于其它编程方式，OOP中的与某数据类型相关的一系列操作都被有机地封装到该数据类型当中，而非散放于其外，因而OOP中的数据类型不仅有着状态，还有着相关的行为。
target_text: Features The object-guided programming is defined as using "objects" for design, but not all programme languages directly support the technology and structure associated with "object-guided programming". There is much debate about the precise definition of OOP and its intended meaning. As a rule, OOP is understood as a programming method for disassemblying the program as a module for sealing data and associated operations. Unlike other programming methods, a series of OOP-related operations related to a particular data type are organically sealed into the data type, rather than scattered outside it, so that the OOP data type is not only state but also relevant.
title: 面向对象程序设计

source_text: OOP理论，及与之同名的OOP实践相结合创造出了新的一个编程架构；OOP思想被广泛认为是非常有用的，以致一套新的编程范型被创造了出来。（其它的编程范型例如函数式编程或过程式编程专注于程序运行的过程，而逻辑编程专注于引发程序代码执行的断言）。对面向模拟系统的语言（如：SIMULA 67）的研究及对高可靠性系统架构（如：高性能操作系统和CPU的架构）的研究最终导致了OOP的诞生。其中由Deborah J. Armstrong进行的长达40年之久的计算机著作调查中，显示出了一系列面向对象程序设计的基本理论。物件導向程式特徵被條列如下
target_text: OOP theory, combined with the OOP practice of the same name, has created a new programming architecture; the OOP idea has been widely recognized as very useful so that a new programming paradigm has been created. (Other programming paradigms, such as function programming or process programming, have focused on the process of running the program, while logical programming has focused on the assertion that it triggers the execution of the program code.) Studies on language oriented to the simulation system (e.g. SIMULA 67) and on high reliability system architecture (e.g. high performance operating systems and CPU structures) have eventually led to the creation of OOP. The 40-year computer book survey conducted by Deborah J. Armstrong has shown a series of basic theories for object-oriented program design.
title: 面向对象程序设计

source_text: 计算机科学中对象和实例概念的最早萌芽可以追溯到麻省理工学院的PDP-1系统。这一系统大概是最早的基于容量架构（capability based architecture）的实际系统。另外1963年Ivan Sutherland的Sketchpad应用中也蕴含了同样的思想。对象作为编程实体最早是于1960年代由Simula 67语言引入思维。Simula这一语言是奧利-約翰·達爾和克利斯登·奈加特在奥斯陆的为模拟环境而设计的。（据说，他们是为了模拟船只而设计的这种语言，并且对不同船只间属性的相互影响感兴趣。他们将不同的船只归纳为不同的类，而每一个对象，基于它的类，可以定义它自己的属性和行为。）这种办法是分析式程序的最早概念体现。在分析式程序中，我们将真实世界的对象映射到抽象的对象，这叫做“模拟”。Simula不仅引入了“类”的概念，还应用了实例这一思想——这可能是这些概念的最早应用。
target_text: The earliest creation of the concepts of object and example in computer science can be traced back to the PDP-1 system at MIT. This system is probably the first to be designed for a simulation environment based on capacity architecture (the language that was said to be designed to simulate ships and to be interested in the interplay of properties between ships). The same idea is also found in the Sketchpad application of Ivan Sutherland in 1963. The object was first introduced as a programming entity in 1960 by the Simula 67 language. This approach is reflected in the earliest concepts of analytical procedures. In the analytical process, the true world's objects are presented to an abstract object called “mocking.” Simula has not only introduced the concept of “types”, but it should also be used as an example of what these concepts may be the first to apply.
title: 面向对象程序设计

source_text:
技术观点
URL是一种URI，它标志一个互联网资源，并指定对其进行操作或取得该资源的方法。可能通过对主要访问手段的描述，也可能通过网络“位置”进行标志。例如，http://www.wikipedia.org/这个URL，标志一个特定资源（首页）并表示该资源的某种形式（例如以编码字符表示的，首页的HTML代码）是可以通过HTTP协议从www.wikipedia.org这个网络主机获得的。URN是基于某命名空间通过名称指定资源的URI。人们可以通过URN来指出某个资源，而无需指出其位置和获得方式。资源无需是基于互联网的。例如，URN urn:ISBN 0-395-36341-1 指定标志系统（即国际标准书号ISBN）和某资源在该系统中的唯一表示的URI。它可以允许人们在不指出其位置和获得方式的情况下谈论这本书。
target_text: For example, http://www.wikipedia.org/URL, which marks a particular resource (first page) and indicates that some form of the resource (e.g. in coded characters, first page HTML code) can be obtained through the HTTP protocol from the network host www.wikipedia.org. The URL is based on the URI of a named space that assigns the resource by name. One can identify a resource without the need to indicate its location and access. The resource need not be based on the Internet. For example, URN urn: ISBN 0-395-36341-1 designation system (i.e. ISBN) and the only indication of a resource in the system (i.e., the International Standard Book) can be allowed to talk about the book without indicating its location and how it is obtained.
title: 统一资源标志符

source_text: 为从URI引用获得URI，软件将URI引用与一个绝对“基址”基于一个固定算法合并，并转换为“绝对”形式。系统将URI引用视作相对于基址URI，虽然在绝对引用的情况下基址并无意义。基址URI一般标志包含URI引用的文档，但仍可被文档内包含的声明，或外部数据传输协议所包括的声明改写。若基址URI包括一个片段标志符，则该标志符在合并过程中被忽略。如果在URI引用中出现片段标志符，则在合并过程中被保留。
target_text: In order to obtain URI from the URL reference, the software merges the URI reference with an absolute base address based on a fixed algorithm and converts it to an `absolute' form. The system treats the URI reference as relative to the base address URI, although the base address does not make sense in the case of an absolute reference. The base URI logo contains URI-referenced documents, but it can be rephrased by the statement contained in the document, or by the statement included in the external data transfer protocol. If the base address URI includes a segment symbol, the URI is ignored during the consolidation process. If a segment URI symbol appears in the URI reference, it is retained during the consolidation process.
title: 统一资源标志符

source_text: 一个URI引用可以是一个同文档引用：一个指向包含URI引用自身的文档的引用。文档处理软件可有效地使用其当前的文档资源来完成对于同文档引用的解析而不需要重新取得一份资源。这只是一个建议——文档处理软件自然可以选用另外的方法来决定是否获取新资源。
target_text: An URI reference can be a reference to the same document: a reference to a document that contains an URI reference to itself. The document processing software can effectively use its current document resources to complete the analysis of the reference to the same document without the need to reacquire a resource. It is only a suggestion that the document processing software naturally chooses another way to decide whether or not to acquire a new resource.
title: 统一资源标志符

source_text: 資料庫，簡而言之可視為電子化的檔案櫃——儲存电子檔案的處所，使用者可以對檔案中的資料執行新增、擷取、更新、刪除等操作。所謂「資料庫」是以一定方式储存在一起、能予多个用户共享、具有尽可能小的冗余度、与应用程序彼此独立的数据集合。一个数据库由多个表空间（Tablespace）构成。
target_text: Databases, which can be seen, in short, as electronic filing cabinets - where electronic files can be stored - users can add, extract, update, delete, etc. to the data in the files. The so-called "databases" are stored together in a way that allows multiple users to share, has as little redundancy as possible, and is separate from the application. A database consists of multiple tablespaces.
title: 数据库

source_text:
技术初衷
在操作系统出现之后，随着计算机应用范围的扩大、需要处理的数据迅速膨胀。最初，数据与程序一样，以简单的文件作为主要存储形式。以这种方式组织的数据在逻辑上更简单，但可扩展性差，访问这种数据的程序需要了解数据的具体组织格式。当系统数据量大或者用户访问量大时，应用程序还需要解决数据的完整性、一致性以及安全性等一系列的问题。因此，必须开发出一种系统软件，它应该能够像操作系统屏蔽了硬件访问复杂性那样，屏蔽数据访问的复杂性。由此产生了数据管理系统，即数据库。
target_text: At first, the data were organized in a way that was much simpler logically, but less scalable, and the access to such data required an understanding of the specific organizational format of the data. When the system had a large amount of data or user access, the application also had to address a range of issues, such as data integrity, consistency and security. It was therefore necessary to develop a system software that would be able to block the complexity of access to the data, just as the operating system had blocked hardware access. As a result, the data management system, the database, was created.
title: 数据库

source_text:
数据库的分类
随着数据库技术与其他分支学科技术的结合，出现了多种新型数据库，例如：与分布处理技术结合产生的分布式数据库、与并行处理技术结合产生的并行数据库、与人工智能结合产生的演绎数据库、与多媒体技术结合产生的多媒体数据库。另外，数据库技术应用于特定的领域，出现了工程数据库、 地理数据库、统计数据库、空间数据库等特定领域数据库。
target_text: With the integration of database technology with other branch disciplines, a variety of new types of databases have emerged, such as distributed databases produced in conjunction with distribution processing technology, parallel databases generated in conjunction with parallel processing technology, interactive databases generated in conjunction with artificial intelligence, multimedia databases generated in conjunction with multimedia technology. In addition, database technology has been applied in specific areas, resulting in databases in specific areas such as engineering databases, geodatabases, statistical databases, spatial databases, etc.
title: 数据库

source_text: 为解决由于这些变化所带来的新问题，数据库管理系统也逐渐产生变化，包括：网络化的大型通用数据库管理系统的出现由于互联网应用的用户数量无法预测，这就要求数据库相比以前拥有能处理更大量的数据以及为更多的用户提供服务的能力，即更好的可伸缩性及高可用性，因此，能够支持Internet的数据库应用已经成为数据库系统的重要方面，学术界及各主流数据库公司都将大型通用数据管理系统作为主要发展方向。例如Oracle公司从 8 版起全面支持互联网应用，微软公司更是将 SQL Server 作为 其整个 .NET计划中的一个重要的成分。数据库安全系统及技术的提升由于数据库系统在现代计算机系统中的地位越来越趋于核心的地位，数据库系统的安全问题自然受到越来越多的关注。在目前各国所引用或制定的 一系列安全标准中，最重要的两个是由美国国防部制定的《可信计算机系统的评估标准》(简称TCSEC)和《可信计算机系统的评估标准关于可信数据库系统的解释》(简称 TDI)。目前，所有数据库的开发必须遵从相应的安全标准。XML及Web数据管理技术的普及随着越来越多的Web应用，如电子商务、数字图书馆、信息服务等采用XML作为数据表现形式、越来越多网站采用XML作为信息发布的语言，以XML格式数据为主的半结构化数据逐步成为网上数据交换和数据表示的标准。
target_text: In order to address the new problems arising from these changes, the database management system has evolved, including: the emergence of a networked large generic database management system, which is not predictable because of the number of users of Internet applications, which requires the database to have the capacity to process a larger volume of data and to provide services to a larger number of users than before, i.e., better scalability and high availability. Among the safety standards currently cited or developed by countries, two of the most important are the United States Department of Defense ' s Standards for the Evaluation of Credible Computer Systems (TCSEC) and Microsoft ' s Evaluation Standards for Credible Computer Systems, which explain a credible database system (known as TDI). source_text: Cyc是一个致力于将各个领域的本体及常识知识综合地集成在一起，并在此基础上实现知识推理的人工智能项目。其目标是使人工智能的应用能够以类似人类推理的方式工作。这个项目是由道格拉斯·萊納特在1984年设立的，由Cycorp公司开发并维护。该项目的一部分以OpenCyc形式发布，OpenCyc项目以开源许可的形式向开发者和使用者提供API，可下载的数据集（特别是为语义万维网实践者提供了OWL版本的数据集）等。
target_text: Cyc is an artificial intelligence project that seeks to integrate the various domains of body and common knowledge into one place and to achieve intellectual reasoning on that basis. Its objective is to enable artificial intelligence applications to work in a manner similar to human reasoning. This project was established in 1984 by Douglas Lennett and developed and maintained by Cycorp. Part of the project is published in OpenCyc, where OpenCyc projects provide developers and users with an API, downloadable data sets (especially the ODS version for semantic Web practitioners).

地图着色问题：為地图填色，每區用一色。如果要邻區颜色相异，是否只需四色？這是圖論題。
船夫过河问题：船夫要把一匹狼、一只羊和一棵菜运过河。只要船夫不在场，羊就会吃白菜、狼就会吃羊，但船每次只能运送一种东西。怎样把所有东西运过河？這是線性規劃題。
中国邮差问题：由中华民国组合数学家管梅谷教授提出。邮差要穿过城市的每一条路至少一次，怎样行走走过的路程最短？这不是NP完全问题，存在多项式复杂度算法：先求出度为奇数的点，用匹配算法算出这些点间的连接方式，然后再用欧拉路径算法求解。也是圖論題。

source_text: 强化学习（，簡稱）是机器学习中的一个领域，强调如何基于环境而行动，以取得最大化的预期利益。强化学习是除了监督学习和非监督学习之外的第三种基本的机器学习方法。与监督学习不同的是，强化学习不需要带标签的输入输出对，同时也无需对非最优解的精确地纠正。其关注点在于寻找探索（对未知领域的）和利用（对已有知识的）的平衡，强化学习中的“探索-利用”的交换，在问题和有限MDP中研究得最多。
target_text: Enhanced learning (simplely) is an area of machine learning, emphasizing how to act on an environmental basis to maximize the expected benefits. Enhanced learning is the third basic method of machine learning, in addition to monitoring learning and non-supervised learning. Unlike monitoring learning, enhanced learning does not require input-out pairs with labels, and does not require precise correction of non-optimal interpretations. The focus is on finding a balance between exploration (for unknown areas) and utilization (for existing knowledge), and on enhancing the exchange of “exploration-use” in learning.
title: 强化学习

source_text: 计算机模拟，又称为计算机仿真，是数学建模的过程，运行在计算机之上，旨在预测某个真实世界或物理系统的行为或者结果。其中，部分数学模型的可靠性可通过对比仿真结果和真实世界结果的一致性得出。目前计算机仿真，对于很多物理学（计算物理学）、天体物理学、气候学、化学、生物学、制造业中的自然系统，以及经济学、心理学、社学科学、医疗保健、工程学中的人类系统的数学建模，都是非常有帮助的工具。
target_text: Computer simulations, also called computer simulations, are mathematical modelling processes that operate on computers to predict the behaviour or results of a real world or physical system. Some of the reliability of mathematical models can be derived by comparing the true results with the true world results. Computer simulations are now very useful tools for many physics (calculation physics), astrophysics, climatology, chemistry, biology, natural systems in manufacturing, and mathematics modelling of human systems in economics, psychology, social sciences, health care, engineering.
title: 计算机模拟

source_text: 一次系统仿真代表一次系统模型的运行。它可以用来探索新技术，获取新的洞见，也可用于评估复杂系统的表现性能。计算机仿真可以是运行在小型机上的即时的小型程序，也可以是运行在基于网络的计算机组里费时多天的大型程序。计算机仿真所能模拟的规模远超传统用纸笔进行的数学建模。
target_text: A system imitation represents the operation of a system model. It can be used to explore new technologies, to acquire new insights, and to assess the performance of complex systems. Computer imitation can be a small, instantaneous program on a small machine, or a large, time-consuming program in a network-based computer group.
title: 计算机模拟

source_text:
仿真 vs 模型
计算机模型，是用于捕捉系统行为的一组算法和等式。反之，计算机仿真是针对包含这些算法和等式的程序的实际运行。因此，仿真是模型运行的过程。比如，通常我们不会说“构建仿真”，而会说“构建模型/仿真器”，同时还可以说“运行模型”或者“运行仿真”，是一个意思。
target_text: Simulating vs model Computer model is a set of algorithms and equations used to capture system behavior. Conversely, computer simulations are really for the actual operation of programs that contain these algorithms and equations. So, imitation is the process of running models. For example, we usually say, "building simulations," but we say, "building models/mixing machines," and it means "run models" or "run simulations".
title: 计算机模拟

source_text:
历史
计算机模拟的发展与电脑本身的迅速发展是分不开的。它的首次大规模开发是著名的曼哈顿计划中的一个重要部分。在第二次世界大战中，为了模拟核爆炸的过程，人们应用蒙特·卡罗方法用12个坚球模型进行了模拟。计算机模拟最初被作为其他的方面研究的补充，但当人们发现它的重要性之后，它便作为一门单独的课题被使用得相当广泛。
計算機模擬從運行數分鐘到數小時到數天。通過計算機模擬被模擬事件的規模已遠遠超過使用傳統紙和鉛筆數學建模任何可能的（甚至想像）。
target_text: Its first large-scale development was an important part of the famous Manhattan plan. In the Second World War, the Monte Carlo method was used to simulate nuclear explosions using 12 solid-ball models. Computer simulations were initially supplemented by research on other aspects, but when people found its importance, it was used quite extensively as a separate subject.
title: 计算机模拟

source_text: 中文房间（），是由美國哲學教授约翰·瑟尔提出的一个思想實驗，借以反驳强人工智能的观点。根据强人工智能的观点，只要计算机拥有适当的程序，理论上就可以说计算机拥有它的认知状态並且可以像人一样进行理解活动。該實驗出自约翰·罗杰斯·瑟尔的論文《心靈、大腦和程序》（Minds, Brains, and Programs）中，發表於1980年的《》。
target_text: The Chinese room () is an intellectual experiment proposed by US Philosophy Professor John Søle to counter the idea of strong artificial intelligence. From the point of view of powerful artificial intelligence, it is theoretically possible to say that a computer has its cognitive state and can be understood as a human being. target_text: John Søle believes that while people in the room can make a mistake and let the outsider think that he speaks Chinese, he does not know Chinese at all. And just as the insider cannot understand Chinese through a manual, the computer cannot gain understanding through a program.

source_text: 机器学习是人工智能的一个分支。人工智能的研究历史有着一条从以“推理”为重点，到以“知识”为重点，再到以“学习”为重点的自然、清晰的脉络。显然，机器学习是实现人工智能的一个途径之一，即以机器学习为手段，解决人工智能中的部分问题。机器学习在近30多年已发展为一门多领域科际整合，涉及概率论、统计学、逼近论、、计算复杂性理论等多门学科。
target_text: Machine learning is a branch of artificial intelligence. There is a history of artificial intelligence research ranging from a focus on “inference” to a focus on “knowledge” to a natural, clear pulse with a focus on “learning.” Clearly, machine learning is one way to achieve artificial intelligence by using machine learning as a means of solving some of the problems in artificial intelligence.
title: 机器学习

source_text: 机器学习理论主要是设计和分析一些让计算机可以自动“学习”的算法。机器学习算法是一类从数据中自动分析获得规律，并利用规律对未知数据进行预测的算法。因为学习算法中涉及了大量的统计学理论，机器学习与推断统计学联系尤为密切，也被称为统计学习理论。算法设计方面，机器学习理论关注可以实现的，行之有效的学习算法（要防止錯誤累積）。很多推论问题属于非程序化決策，所以部分的机器学习研究是开发容易处理的近似算法。
target_text: The theory of machine learning is essentially the design and analysis of algorithms that allow computers to automatically “learning.” Machine learning algorithms are those that automatically analyse patterns from data and use them to predict unknown data. Because of the large number of statistical theories involved in the algorithms, machine learning is particularly closely linked to extrapolated statistics, also known as statistical learning theories. In algorithm design, machine learning theory focuses on achievable and effective learning algorithms (to prevent accumulation of errors). Many of the inferences are non-programmatic decisions, so part of machine learning research is the development of quasi-calendar algorithms that can easily be handled.
title: 机器学习

监督学习从给定的训练数据集中学习出一个函数，当新的数据到来时，可以根据这个函数预测结果。监督学习的训练集要求是包括输入和输出，也可以说是特征和目标。训练集中的目标是由人标注的。常见的监督学习算法包括回归分析和统计分类。
target_text: Monitoring learning can be divided into the following categories: Supervising learning learns a function from the given training data pool, and when new data arrives, the results can be predicted based on this function. Monitoring learning requires training pools that include input and output, or that can be described as features and targets. The objectives of the training concentration are indicated by the person. Common monitoring learning algorithms include regression analysis and statistical classifications.

source_text: 出于服务维基百科的需求，软件的第一个版本于2002年被部署，后来，维基百科和其他维基项目继续定义了MediaWiki的大部分功能。为了有效地处理大型项目，MediaWiki得到了很好的优化，使其可以承载万亿字节的内容和每秒数十万次的访问请求。因为维基百科是全球最大的网站之一，需要MediaWiki能为开发者实现通过多层次的实现可伸缩性缓存和数据库响应，对开发者来说，这一直是一个让他们很头疼的大问题，而MediaWiki很好的解决了这一问题。

source_text: 自由軟體（），根據自由軟體基金會对其的定義，是一类可以不受限制地自由使用、複製、研究、修改和分發的，尊重使用者自由的軟體。這方面的不受限制正是自由軟體最重要的本質，與自由軟體相對的是专有软件（，一些人也会将其翻译为私有軟體、封閉軟體），后者的定義與是否收取費用無關，事实上，自由軟體不一定是免費軟體，同时自由软件本身也并不抵制商业化。自由軟體受到選定的「自由軟體授權協議」保護而發佈（或是放置在公有領域），其發布以原始碼為主，二進制檔案可有可無。
target_text: Free Software (FLF), according to its definition, is a software that can be freely used, copied, researched, modified and distributed without restriction, and that respects user freedom. Unrestricted software is the most important element of free software, and is related to free software (and some translate it into private software, closed software), which is not defined as free software, which is not necessarily free of charge, and free software itself is not resistant to commercialization. Free Software is released (or placed in a public domain) under the protection of the "free software licensing agreement" that has been selected, and its distribution is based on original codes, and binary files are available.
title: 自由软件

source_text:
用戶
自由软件对全世界的商业发展特別是硬件有巨大的贡献，多數嵌入式设备系统厂商鉴于自身无需支付授權費用和实用性方面的原因考虑也会在自由软件的基础上开发操作系统。世界上绝大多數操作系统多少都会包含有自由軟件组件（例如BSD的TCP/IP协议栈广泛被包括MacOS，Windows在内的专有商业操作系统使用）。隨著越來越多的自由軟體支援 Microsoft Windows 平台，還有得益於 Android 平台的普及，目前有上億的用戶在日常生活或工作中使用自由軟體。
target_text: Users of free software make a significant contribution to business development around the world, especially hardware. Most embedded equipment system manufacturers also consider operating systems based on free software for reasons that they do not have to pay for licensing and utility. Most of the world’s operating systems contain free software components (e.g. BSD’s TCP/IP Barracks are used extensively by proprietary commercial operating systems, including MacOS, Windows). As more and more free software supports Microsoft Windows platforms, and more benefits from the spread of Android platforms, billions of users now use free software in their daily lives or work.
title: 自由软件

source_text:
意義與歷史
自由軟體的英文為「」。在英文里「」一詞有「自由」、「免費」的雙重含意，对于如何区分自由軟體（）和免費軟體（），自由軟體運動社区的創始人——-{zh-hans:理查德·斯托曼; zh-hant:里查·史托曼;}-做出了以下的定義：“自由軟體的重點在於自由權，而非價格。要了解其所代表的概念，你應該將「free」想成是「言論自由」（）一词中的含义，而不是「免費啤酒」（）一词中的含义。”自由軟體代表用户可以自由地运行、拷贝、分发、学习、修改并改进该软件。自由软件的定义可以追溯至GNU宣言。
target_text: Meaning and history: Free software in English. The word "free" has the dual meaning of "free" and "free" in English. You should think of "free" as meaning "free speech" rather than "free beer" in terms of how to distinguish between free software () and free software. Free software represents what users can freely operate, copy, distribute, learn, modify and improve. The definition of free software can be traced back to the GNU Declaration.
title: 自由软件

source_text: 大部分自由軟體都在互聯網上自由發佈，往往不收取任何費用。一些或是以離線實體的方式發行，有時會酌情收取的費用（例如：工本費和運輸費），而人們可用任何價格來販售這些軟體。所以，自由軟體也可以是商業軟體：因為自由软件许可证并不限制販賣軟體或者提供商业服务，这些并没有違反例如GPL等自由軟體许可证。因此，“自由软件”是关乎自由的问题，与价格无关，软件如何定价并不影响它是否被归类为自由软件。
target_text: Most free software is freely available on the Internet, often free of charge. Some are issued in offline entities, sometimes with discretionary fees (e.g., for capital and transport costs), and people can sell them at any price. So free software can also be commercial software: because free software licences do not restrict the sale of software or the provision of commercial services, these do not contradict free software licences, such as GPLs.
title: 自由软件

source_text:
根據斯托曼和自由軟體基金會（FSF）的定義，自由软件赋予使用者四种自由:
自由之零：不论目的为何，有使用该软件的自由。
自由之一：有研究该软件如何运作的自由，并且得以修改该软件来符合使用者自身的需求。取得该软件之源码为达成此目的之前提。
自由之二：有重新散布该软件的自由，所以每个人都可以藉由散布自由软件来敦亲睦邻。
自由之三：有改善再利用该软件的自由，并且可以发表修訂後的版本供公众使用，如此一来，整个社群都可以受惠。如前项，取得该软件之源码为达成此目的之前提。
target_text: Freedom zero: there is freedom to use the software regardless of purpose. Freedom one: there is freedom to study how the software works and to adapt the software to the user’s own needs.
title: 自由软件

source_text: 如果一软件的使用者具有上述四种权利，则该软件得以被称之为「自由软件」。也就是说，使用者必须能够自由地、以不收费或是收取合理的散布费用的方式、在任何时间再散布该软件的原版或是改写版，在任何地方给任何人使用。如果使用者不必问任何人或是支付任何的许可费用从事这些行为，就表示其拥有自由软件所赋予的自由权利。
target_text: If the user of a software has the four rights described above, the software can be called "freeware." That is, the user must be free to distribute the software at any time, in a way that is free, free of charge, or with a reasonable cost of dissemination, or to rewrite it, anywhere. If the user does not have to ask anyone or pay any licence to do so, it means that he or she has the freedom to own free software.
title: 自由软件

source_text: 大部分的自由軟體可以无需费用自由获取，並且它的原始碼可以自由修改並散佈，但它並不是沒有版权。版权是當某項作品完成時就自然產生了，不需申請或註冊，而其内涵通常包括署名、发表（公开）、授予他人使用等权利。如合法享有著作权者无条件放弃所有著作权，则该作品就被“释入公有领域”。需要注意的是，被释入公有领域后，原著作权持有者就无法再对其他人如何使用该作品施加任何法律上的限制。因此科技巨头可以合法地使用该等作品进行二次创作（例如制作新软件），而该等二次创作品则在法律上享有完整的著作权，不受原著作权持有者的支配。
target_text: Most free software can be freely accessed at no cost, and its original code can be freely modified and distributed, but it is not copyrightless. Copyright is naturally generated when a work is completed, without the need to apply or register, and its content usually includes the right to sign, publish (publicly) or use by others. If a legally entitled author gives up all copyright unconditionally, the work is “released into the public domain.” It needs to be noted that, after being released into the public domain, the original author rights holder is no longer able to impose any legal restrictions on the use of the work by others.
title: 自由软件

source_text: 这并不符合自由软件的定义。自由软件必须能将“自由”无限传承下去。因此自由软件并未“释入公有领域”，而是将“传承自由属性”作为一项允许他人使用自由软件的条件。如任何人使用了自由软件二次开发的软件未向他人开放原始码，则其对该自由软件的二次开发，即属违反著作权法。因此，自由軟體在法律上并未放弃著作权，而是订明了若干“自由”的定义，并要求使用者如欲行使这些自由，必须对衍生作品維持相同授權。
target_text: This does not correspond to the definition of free software. Free software must be able to transmit “freedom” indefinitely. So free software does not “distribute to the public domain”, but rather makes “freedom attributes” a condition allowing others to use free software.
title: 自由软件

source_text: 相反的例子是非自由软件（封闭软件）。如果，當使用者付费購買或者免费获得某套軟體時，所得到的只是“使用權”，使用者必須接受該軟體的软件许可证才能使用這個軟體；而许可证列明軟體的原作者則仍然保有修改权，未经原作者同意进行修改属违反许可证之行为，则该等软件属于封闭软件。请注意，自由软件也有许可证，常见的如GNU通用公共许可证，但这些许可证不会限制你获取原始码或者限制你修改软件，唯一的要求是你对修改后的软件必须应用同样的或更宽松的许可证。即你修改后形成的新软件，其他人也可以获取其原始码并修改，你不得限制他们这样做，否则你当初的修改行为就因不符合GNU通用公共许可证而构成侵犯（之前参与编写这个软件的人所享有的）著作权。
target_text: The opposite is the case of non-free software (closed software). If, when a user buys a software package or obtains it free of charge, only “use rights” are obtained, the user must accept the software licence for the software; whereas the original author of the licence specifies that the software retains the right to modify, which is a violation of the licence without the consent of the original author, the software is closed software. Please note that free software also has a licence that is common, such as the GNU General Public Licence, but these licences do not restrict your access to the original code or the modification of the software, the only requirement being that you apply the same or more liberal licences to the modified software.
title: 自由软件

source_text:
自由軟體不使用封閉格式
封閉軟體通常會使用專屬的封閉格式，并且不允许使用者分发，這極大地限制了使用者的自由。而自由軟體則完全不同，由於自由軟體的原始碼是公開的，所以它所使用的任何格式都是透明的。自由軟體永遠不會只发布專屬的封閉格式软件來限制使用者修改的自由。
target_text: Free software, which does not use a closed format, usually uses a dedicated closed format and does not allow distribution by users, which limits users’ freedom. The free software is completely different, since the original code of free software is public, so any format it uses is transparent. Free software will never limit users’ freedom to modify only by publishing a dedicated closed format software.
title: 自由软件

source_text: 最早的開放源代碼定義是在1998年創建，來自Debian自由软件指导方针。虽然大多數的開放原始碼軟體同時也是自由軟體，但是，GNU项目认为“开源”这个词并没有抓住自由软件的真正涵义，容易让人过于着重軟件的质量、流行与成功而忽视或抛弃自由软件精神的道德观和社会价值，力主自由软件是一个道德底线。
target_text: The earliest open source code definition was created in 1998 from the Debian Free Software Guidelines. While most open source software is also free software, the GNU project believes that the term “open source” does not capture the true meaning of free software and makes it easier to focus too much on the moral and social values of software quality, popularity and success, while ignoring or abandoning the free software spirit.
title: 自由软件

source_text: 对于BSD、MIT这类较为宽松的自由软件协议，GNU项目认为这是对专有软件的松懈（）和宽容式（），因为这些协议不能避免其衍生作品成为限制用户自由的专有软件，一旦你允許他們這麼做，那麼你就無法捍衛其他人的自由了。，例如FreeBSD在PlayStation 4系统软件的使用以及BSD的TCP/IP协议栈在专有软件的使用等。
target_text: For more liberal free software agreements like BSD, MIT, the GNU project considers this to be lax (and tolerant) for proprietary software, because they cannot avoid their derivatives becoming proprietary software that limits user freedom, and once you allow them to do so, you cannot defend the freedom of others. For example, the use of FreeBSD software in PlayStation 4 and the use of the BSD TCP/IP Protocol in proprietary software.
title: 自由软件

source_text:
形式上的差異
开源软件與自由軟體是兩個不同的概念，-{只}-要符合开源软件定义的软件就能被称为开源软件。而自由软件有比開源软件更严格的概念，因此所有自由软件都是开放源代码的，但不是所有的開源软件都能被称为「自由」。但一般，绝大多数开源软件也都符合自由软件的定义。
target_text: Formal differences Open source software and free software are two different concepts, and -- {only} -- software that meets open source definitions can be called open source software. And free software has more stringent concepts than open source software, so all free software is open source, but not all open source software can be called " free " .
title: 自由软件

source_text:
自由软件与免费软件
自由及开放源代码软件列表
免費軟體（）是一種不須付費就可取得的軟體，但是通常有其他的限制，使用者並沒有使用、複製、研究、修改和分發的自由。該軟體的原始碼不一定會公開，有些免费软件即使所谓开源但是因为有會限制用户软件自由如限制用户修改重分发或者限定/限制特定人群使用等行为的限制性条款存在并不是自由软件。
target_text: Free and free software and free software, free and open source software lists Free software () is a free software that is available free of charge, but there are other restrictions that often do not allow users to use, copy, research, modify, and distribute. The original code of the software is not always publicly available, and some free software, even if it is so called open source, is not free because there are restrictive provisions that restrict user software freedom, such as limiting user redistribution or restricting/restricting the use of specific groups of people.
title: 自由软件

source_text: 是一种限制软件自由的行为，即通过检测可执行文件签名，禁止用户安装或运行修改后的可执行文件，这种行为被 Richard Stallman 称为“专制暴君”()。这个名字源自于Tivo公司在其数字视频录像机的产品中使用了GNU和Linux内核的源码但是其从设计上限制了用户的软件自由，用户不能在其产品上自由运行和使用修改后的系统。因此自由软件基金会出版了GPLv3，GNU项目软件的授权协议也随之升级，然而因为各种因素很多Linux内核开发者对升级表示反对。
target_text: It is an act that limits the freedom of software, i.e. by testing executable document signatures, prohibiting users from installing or running modified executable documents, which Richard Stallman calls the "authoritarian tyrant" ("the despotic tyrant"). The name originated from the use of GNU and Linux kernels in the products of Tivo's digital video recorder, but it is designed to restrict users' freedom of software, and users are not free to operate and use modified systems on their products. As a result, the Free Software Foundation published GPLv3, and the authorization agreement for GNU project software was upgraded because many Linux kernel developers objected to upgrades.
title: 自由软件

source_text: 数字限制管理数字限制管理（）或数字限制机制（）是自由软件社群对数字版权管理的一种讽刺性说法，因为这种行为限制了用户的软件自由权利。自由软件基金会针对此种从设计上就限制用户软件自由的行为发起了Defective By Design运动。JavaScript陷阱JavaScript陷阱（）指用户在浏览器中使用专有软件却毫不知情的现象，RMS在GNU项目网站上给出了具体的定义。
target_text: Digital limit management () or digital limit management () is an irony to the free software community about digital copyright management because it limits users’ rights to software freedom. The Free Software Foundation has launched a Technology By Design campaign to restrict user software freedom. JavaScript traps JavaScript traps () refer to users who use proprietary software on browsers with no knowledge, and RMS has given specific definitions on the GNU project website.
title: 自由软件

source_text: 为了解决这个问题，GNU项目创造了提供探测并拦截用户访问的网页上非自由、非平凡的JavaScript功能的给重视软件自由的用户使用。一些自由软件社群，为了解决此类问题也作出了一些努力，例如由自由软件基金会支持的为此专门成立了行动小组。參見
target_text: In order to address this problem, the GNU project created a non-free, unusual JavaScript-based user-friendly web page that provides detection and interception of user access. Some free software communities have also made efforts to address such problems, such as the creation of a dedicated action group supported by the Free Software Foundation.
title: 自由软件

source_text: 人机交互（HCI）学科是一个关注人和机器之间交互模式的多学科研究领域，其关注有关人和计算机之间的界面设计和实现的所有问题。由于其性质和目标，人机交互自然而然地会涉及到计算机科学的多个学科方向（图像处理，计算机视觉，编程语言等）以及人文学科的多个方向（人体工程学，人因，认知心理学等）。人机交互研究首先关心能够改善人机互动的新型界面的设计、实现和评估。这里的改善涉及多个方面，包括使用直观性和与接口稳健性。
target_text: The HCI discipline is a multidisciplinary area of research focusing on patterns of interaction between humans and machines, which focuses on all issues related to the design and implementation of interfaces between humans and computers. Because of its nature and objectives, the interaction naturally involves multiple disciplinary directions in computer science (image processing, computer visualization, programming language, etc.) as well as multiple directions in humanities (human engineering, human causes, cognitive psychology, etc.).
title: 人机交互

source_text: 在传统意义上，图书馆是收藏书和蒐集各种出版物的地方。然而，现在資料保存已经不止是保存图书，许多图书馆把地图、印刷物，或者其他档案和艺术作品保存在各种载体上，比如微缩胶片、磁带、CD、LP、盒式磁带、录像带和DVD。图书馆通过访问CD-ROM、订购数据库和互联网提供服务。因此，人們漸漸把现代图书馆重新定义为能够无限制得获取多种来源、多种格式的信息。除了提供资源，图书馆还有专家和图书馆员来提供服务，他们善于寻找和组织信息，并解释信息需求。近些年，人们对图书馆的理解已经超越了建筑的围墙，读者可以用电子工具例如电子书获得资源，图书馆员用各种-{zh-cn:数字工具;zh-tw:數位工具}-来引导读者和分析海量知识。图书馆的另一作用是收藏人们不愿意购买（或者无力购买）的資源，作為館藏提供大眾使用或查閱。
target_text: In the traditional sense, the library is a collection of books and publications. However, data preservation is now more than a mere book preservation, and many libraries keep maps, printed materials, or other archives and works of art on a variety of vehicles, such as microfiche, tape, CD, LP, cassette, video and DVDs. The library provides its services by accessing CD-ROMs, ordering databases and the Internet. As a result, modern libraries are being redefined as having unlimited access to multiple sources and formats. In addition to providing resources, there are specialists and librarians who are good at finding and organizing information and explaining information needs.
title: 图书馆

target_text: As of June 2022, the University of Guangzhou has entered the top 1% of the world ESI in six fields of study (engineering, computer science, chemistry, materials science, environment/ecology, social sciences), of which the fields of engineering and computer science have entered the top 3 per 1,000. The University of Guangzhou now has six high-level universities in six provinces, with a focus on building subjects, 14 provincial priority disciplines, and 16 municipal priority subjects.

source_text:

在计算机中，所有的数据在存储和运算时都要使用二进制数表示。例如，像a、b、c、d这样的52个字母（包括大写）以及0、1等数字还有一些常用的符号（例如*、#、@等）在计算机中存储时也要使用二进制数来表示，而具体用哪些二进制数字表示哪个符号，这就是编码。如果不同的计算机要想互相通信而不造成混乱，那么每台计算机就必须使用相同的编码规则，于是美国有关的标准化组织就推出了ASCII编码。

source_text:
SMTP（Simple Mail Transfer Protocol）：SMTP主要负责底层的邮件系统如何将邮件从一台机器传至另外一台机器。
POP（Post Office Protocol）：目前的版本为POP3，POP3是把邮件从电子邮箱中传输到本地计算机的协议。
IMAP（Internet Message Access Protocol）：目前的版本为IMAP4，是POP3的一种替代协议，提供了邮件检索和邮件处理的新功能，这样用户可以完全不必下载邮件正文就可以看到邮件的标题摘要，从邮件客户端软件就可以对服务器上的邮件和文件夹目录等进行操作。IMAP协议增强了电子邮件的灵活性，同时也减少了垃圾邮件对本地系统的直接危害，同时相对节省了用户察看电子邮件的时间。除此之外，IMAP协议可以记忆用户在脱机状态下对邮件的操作（例如移动邮件，删除邮件等）在下一次打开网络连接的时候会自动执行。
HTTP(S)：通过浏览器使用邮件服务时使用。
target_text: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol): The current version of IMAP4, an alternative to POP3, provides new functionality for mail retrieval and mail processing, so that users can see the headline summaries of mail without having to download the mail text, and can operate on mail and folder catalogues on the server from the mail client software. The IMAP protocol enhances e-mail flexibility while also reducing the direct risk of spam to local systems and saves users relative time to view e-mail. In addition, the IMAP protocol allows users to remember the operation of mail (e.g. mobile mail, delete mail, etc.) in offline status and will be automatically implemented at the next time the network is open.
title: 电子邮件

TrueType是一种最初由蘋果電腦公司开发的字体技術。考虑到Type 1字体太昂贵，有意用TrueType字体取代Type 1字体。像Type1字体一样，貝茲曲線用于描述字型，并可以内置点阵字体。现在它十分普及，在所有主要的操作系统上都有使用。能用PostScript打印机处理的TrueType字体称为Type42。TrueType使用2次贝塞尔曲线，其hint方式也与PostScript不同，使用的是小程序字节码的形式。TrueType可以包含点阵字体。
target_text: TrueType is a font technique originally developed by Apple Computers. Given that Type 1 is too expensive, TrieType is intended to replace Type 1 with a TypeType font. Like Type1, the Bates Curve is used to describe fonts and can be built-in. It is now widely available and is used in all major operating systems. TrueType is called Type42, which can be handled by PostScript printers. TrueType uses two Bézier curves in different ways than PostScript, and uses small program type numbers.
title: 计算机字体

source_text: 軟件後門指绕过软件的安全性控制，从比较隐秘的通道获取对程序或系统访问权的黑客方法。在软件开发时，设置后门可以方便修改和测试程序中的缺陷。但如果后门被其他人知道（可以是洩密或者被探测到后门），或是在发布软件之前没有去除后门，那么它就对计算机系统安全造成了威胁。
target_text: The back door of the software means bypassing the security controls of the software to obtain hacking methods for program or system access from more secret channels. When software is developed, the back door can be easily modified and tested for defects in the program. If the back door is known by others (which can be leaked or detected) or if the back door is not removed before the software is released, it poses a threat to the security of the computer system.
title: 軟體後門

source_text: 智能程序 (Knowbots)，最早由麻省理工学院的Marvin Minsky提出，指能自动运行完成工作的程序，如搜索引擎的蠕虫程序、自动在因特网上搜索信息的数据库智能代理程序。利用智能程序将加强数据库系统的功能。功能一个进入网络的智能程序，可以自动访问不同数据库／网站／节点等来完成它的主人所需要的信息。然后把结果发回给它的主人。
target_text: Smart programs (KnowBots), initially proposed by Marvin Minsky of MIT, refer to programs that can automatically run the work done, such as worm programs for search engines, database smart agents for automatic search for information on the Internet. Use smart programs to enhance the functionality of the database system. A smart program that accesss the network can automatically access different databases/sites/nodes, etc. to complete the information needed by its owners. Send the results back to its owners.
title: 智能程序

source_text:

Jonin has been experimenting with this technique since 1971 at Stanford University. Mountain engineers have adapted his algorithms to digital composites, adding methods similar to the "key scale" to enhance performance. This method can be used to avoid errors that usually occur in the process of matching systems. However, the commercialized digital composites of the first publicly available form should have been the 1979 Australian company (computer musicians, Computer Musical Instrument), the first digital synthesis/promotion system to be used for the actual multisounding.

source_text: FreeBSD是FreeBSD项目的发展成果，是开放源代码的类Unix操作系统，基于BSD Unix的源代码衍生发展而来。加州大学伯克利分校在1975年至1993年开发了BSD Unix操作系统。FreeBSD的许可证规定源代码开放，允许任何人自由使用，任何人都可以获得并使用它来满足各种需求，也可以修改它，然后再重发布：此功能专为个人和公司量身定制，可用于创作各种基于FreeBSD的商业和非商业产品。尽管FreeBSD直接从BSD Unix衍生，但它从法律角度来看並不是“UNIX”，因为现在“UNIX”商标属于国际开放标准组织，而FreeBSD并没有使用该商标的授权。
target_text: FreeBSD is the development outcome of the FreeBSD project, an open source-type Unix operating system based on BSD Unix's source code derivatives. The University of California, Berkeley, developed the BSD Unix operating system from 1975 to 1993. FreeBSD's licence provides for open source code, allowing anyone to use it freely, can access and use it to meet various needs, or modify it, and then reissue it: this function is tailored for individuals and companies to create a variety of freeBSD-based commercial and non-commercial products. Although FreeBSD is derived directly from BSD UNIX, it is not “UNIX” from a legal point of view, since the UNIX trademark is now part of the International Open Standards Organization, and FreeBSD does not have the authorization to use it.
title: FreeBSD

source_text: 游戏引擎提供一系列可视化开发工具和可重用组件。这些工具通过与开发环境进行集成，方便开发者简单、快速进行数据驱动方式的游戏开发。为了提高游戏开发人员的开发效率，引擎开发者会开发出大量的游戏所需要的软件组件。大多数引擎集成了图形、声音、物理和人工智能等功能部件。游戏引擎会被称为“中间件”，因为它们可以提供灵活和重用平台，向游戏开发者提供所需要的全部核心功能，从而节省大量的游戏开发费用，降低开发的复杂性，缩短游戏的上市时间，所有这些对于高竞争性的游戏产业来说都是关键因素。诸如虚幻系列引擎、、Unity3D、Frostbite Engine、zerodin引擎、Doom3引擎、CryENGINE、3DGame Studio、RenderWare、Gamebryo、Virtools、RE引擎和Source引擎等引擎。
target_text: Game engines provide a range of visual development tools and reusable components. By integrating them into the development environment, these tools allow developers to develop simple and fast data-driven game development. In order to increase the efficiency of game developers ' development, engine developers develop a large number of software components required for the game. Most engines are integrated into functional components such as graphics, sound, physics and artificial intelligence. The engines are called "intermediate" because they can provide flexible and reuse platforms that provide game developers with all the core functions they need, thus saving large amounts of game development costs, reducing the complexity of the development and reducing the time spent on the market, all of which are key factors for the highly competitive game industry. Engines such as the vanity series, Unity3D, Frostbite Engineering, Zerodin, Doom3, CryENGINE, 3DGame Studio, RenderWare, Gamebriyo, Virtools, RE and Source engines.
title: 游戏引擎

source_text: 3D引擎的渲染系统通常建立在一套高级图像API之上，诸如Direct3D或OpenGL，这些API封装了GPU和显卡的部分功能。级别低一点的如DirectX、SDL和OpenAL也经常使用，他们提供对其他硬件设备的独立支持，诸如输入设备（鼠标、键盘、控制杆）、网卡、声卡。在硬件加速圖形卡出现以前，开發者使用软件渲染。现在软件渲染依然被广泛用于非及时图像的渲染，或者是用戶的硬體設備不支持硬件渲染。
target_text: The 3D engine Rendering System is usually based on an advanced set of image APIs, such as Direct3D or OpenGL, which encapsulate parts of GPU and graphic cards. Lower-level devices such as DirectX, SDL and OpenAL are also often used to provide independent support for other hardware devices, such as input devices (mouses, keyboards, control poles), netcards, and sound cards. Before hardware acceleration graphic cards appear, developers use software to rewrite. Software rendering is still widely used for non-time images, or hardware is not supported by user hardware.
title: 游戏引擎
