source_text: 伯纳斯-李认为HTML是SGML的一个应用程序。1993年中期互联网工程任务组（IETF）发布首个HTML规范的提案：“超文本标记语言（HTML）”互联网草案，由伯纳斯-李与撰写。其中包括一个SGML文档类型定义来定义语法。草案于6个月后过期，不过值得注意的是其对NCSA Mosaic浏览器嵌入在线图像的自定义标签的认可，这反映IETF把标准立足于成功原型的理念。同样，在1993年末提出的与之竞争的互联网草案“HTML+（超文本标记格式）”建议规范已经实现的功能，如表格与填写表单。
target_text: Bernards-Lee considers HTML to be an application of SGML. In 1993, the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) published the first draft of the HTML code: “hypertext tag language (HTML)” on the Internet, prepared by Bernard-Li. This includes a definition of the SGML document type to define grammar. The draft expired six months later, although it is worth noting the endorsement of a self-defined label for the NCSA Mosaic browser embedded online images, which reflects the idea that the standards are based on a successful prototype.
title: HTML

source_text:
草案时间线
1991年10月 HTML标签，一个非正式CERN文件首次公开18个HTML标签。
1992年6月 HTML DTD的首个非正式草案， 后续有七个修订版（7月15日，8月6日，8月18日，11月17日，11月19日，11月20日，11月22日）。
1992年11月 HTML DTD 1.1（首个版本号，基于RCS修订版，版本号从1.1开始而非1.0），非正式草案。
1993年6月 超文本标记语言由IETF IIIR工作小组作为互联网草案（一个粗略的建议标准）。在被第二版取代一个月后，IETF又发布6个草案，最终在RFC1866中发布HTML 2.0。
1993年11月 HTML+由IETF作为互联网草案发布，是超文本标记语言草案的一个竞争性提案。它于1994年5月到期。
1995年4月 （1995年3月编写） HTML 3.0被提议作为IETF的标准，但直到提案在五个月过期后（1995年9月28日）仍没有进一步的行动。它包含许多拉格特HTML+提案的功能，如对表格的支持、围绕数据的文本流和复杂的数学公式的显示。W3C开始开发自己的Arena浏览器作为HTML 3和层叠样式表的，但HTML 3.0并没有获得成功。浏览器厂商，包括微软和网景，选择实现HTML3草案功能的不同子集并引入它们自己的插件（见浏览器大战）。
target_text: The initial informal draft of the HTML DTD in June 1992, followed by seven revised versions (15 July, 6 August, 18 August, 17 November, 19 November, 20 November, 22 November) The informal draft was published in November 1992 by HTML DTD 1.1 (first version, based on the RCS revised version, which started from 1.1 instead of 1.0), and by IETF IIIR Working Group in June 1993 as an Internet draft (a rough suggested standard). One month after being replaced by the second edition, IETF issued six drafts, eventually published in RFC 1866, HTML DTD 1.1 (the first version, based on the RCS revised version, started from 1.1 instead of 1.0) and was published as an informal draft.
title: HTML

source_text: 网页代理的一个重要类型是网络爬虫或搜索引擎蜘蛛。这些软件代理依赖于它们发现的网页的语义清晰度，因为它们一天要使用各种技术与算法来读取和索引数百万个网页并给网页用户提供搜索工具，没有这些万维网的有效性就会大大降低。
target_text: An important type of web agent is a web reptiles or search engine spiders. These software agents rely on the semantic clarity of the web pages they discover, as they use a variety of techniques and algorithms to read and index millions of pages and provide search tools to web users, without which the usefulness of the World Wide Web will be greatly reduced.
title: HTML

source_text: 长城的意义也更被進一步延伸到互联网络领域。1998年起，中国政府开始使用防火长城系统，用于过滤互联网国际出口上内容的软硬件系统的集合，这被认为是一种审查系统。外媒曾以谷歌事件为题，透过漫画形式指出中國政府屏蔽谷歌、youtube、维基百科等国外网站是在“构筑互联网络领域的‘数字长城’，以此阻止国内互联网用户透过国外网页了解某些事件的一种说法。
target_text: Since 1998, the Chinese government has been using the Great Wall fire protection system, a collection of hardware and software systems used to filter the content of international exports on the Internet, which is considered a censorship system. The foreign media used Google to highlight, through cartoons, the Chinese government’s blocking of overseas websites such as Google, Yooutube, and Wikipedia as “Digital Walls” in the construction of Internet networks, thereby preventing domestic Internet users from using foreign web pages to find out about certain events.
title: 长城

source_text: 互联网协议套件（，縮寫IPS）是网络通訊模型，以及整個网络传输协议家族，為網際网络的基礎通訊架構。它常通稱為TCP/IP协议族（，或TCP/IP Protocols），简称TCP/IP。因為该協定家族的兩個核心協定：TCP（传输控制协议）和IP（网际协议），為该家族中最早通過的標準。由於在網絡通讯协议普遍采用分层的结构，当多个层次的协议共同工作时，类似计算机科学中的堆栈，因此又称为TCP/IP协议栈（） 。这些协议最早发源于美国国防部（縮寫為DoD）的ARPA网项目，因此也稱作DoD模型（DoD Model）。這個協定套組由互联网工程任务组負責維護。
target_text: The Internet Protocol package (IPS) is a network communication model, and the entire network transfer protocol family, which is a basic communications architecture for the Internet. It is commonly known as the TCP/IP group (or TCP/IP Protocols), or TCP/IPs. The agreement is originally based on the two core protocols of the family: TCP (transmission control protocol) and IP (internet agreement), which are the first standards to be adopted in the family. This package is also called the DoD model (DoD Model), since the Internet Engineering Task Force (ITF) is responsible for maintaining it.
title: TCP/IP协议族

source_text:
研發初期
1983年1月1日，在因特网的前身（ARPA网）中通訊方式換成新的定義，TCP/IP取代旧的网络控制协议（NCP，Network Control Protocol），从而成为今天的互联网的基石。最早的TCP/IP由文顿·瑟夫和罗伯特·卡恩两位开发，慢慢地通过竞争战胜其他一些网络协议的方案，比如国际标准化组织ISO的OSI模型。TCP/IP的蓬勃发展发生在1990年代中期。当时一些重要而可靠的工具的出世，例如页面描述语言HTML和浏览器Mosaic，促成了互联网应用的飞速发展。
随着互联网的发展，目前流行的IPv4协议（网际协议版本四）已经接近它的功能上限。IPv4最致命的两个缺陷在于：
地址只有32位，IP地址空间有限；
不支持服务质量（Quality of Service，QoS）的想法，无法管理带宽和优先级，故而不能很好的支持现今越来越多实时的语音和视频应用。因此IPv6（网际协议版本六）浮出水面，用以取代IPv4。
TCP/IP成功的另一个因素在於对为数众多的低层协议的支持。这些低层协议对应OSI模型中的第一层（物理层）和第二层（数据链路层）。每层的所有协议几乎都有一半数量支持TCP/IP，例如：以太网（Ethernet）、令牌环（Token Ring）、光纤数据分布接口（FDDI）、点对点协议（PPP）、X.25、帧中继（Frame Relay）、ATM、Sonet、SDH等通訊方法中都可以應用。
target_text: The earliest TCP/IP was developed on 1 January 1983 by Venton Sev and Robert Kahn, slowly competing over other network agreements, such as the ISO OSI model. The TCP/IP boom took place in the mid-1990s. The emergence of some important and reliable tools, such as the page description of the language HTML and the browser Mosaic, contributed to the rapid development of Internet applications. As the Internet developed, the currently popular IPv4 (cyber protocol version IV) is close to its functional ceiling. The two most deadly defects of IPv4 are: 32 addresses, the IP address space limited; the DIP boom took place in the mid-1990s.
title: TCP/IP协议族

source_text:
开发过程
在构建阿帕网先驱之后，DARPA开始其他数据传输技术的研究。NCP诞生后两年，1972年，罗伯特·卡恩（Robert E. Kahn）受僱於DARPA的信息技术处理办公室，在那里他研究卫星数据包网络和地面无线数据包网络，并且意识到能够在它们之间沟通的价值。在1973年春天，已有的ARPANET网络控制程序（NCP）协议的开发者文顿·瑟夫（Vinton Cerf）加入到卡恩为ARPANET设计下一代协议而开发开放互连模型的工作中。到了1973年夏天，卡恩和瑟夫很快开发出基本的改进形式，其中的网络协议之间的差异通过使用公用互联网协议而隐藏起来，且可靠性由主机保证而不是ARPANET那样由网络保证。瑟夫称赞了Hubert Zimmerman和Louis Pouzin（CYCLADES网络的设计者）在这个设计上发挥重要影响。
target_text: In the spring of 1973, the developers of the already existing ARPANET network control program, Vinton Cerf, joined in the design of the next generation agreement for ARPANET to develop an open interconnection model. By the summer of 1973, Kán and Sev quickly developed a basic form of improvement, in which the differences in the network protocol were hidden through the use of public Internet protocols and the reliability of which was guaranteed by the mainframe rather than by the network.
title: TCP/IP协议族

source_text: 在传输层，应用程序最常用的是TCP或者UDP，并且服务器应用程序经常与一个公开的端口号相联系。服务器应用程序的端口由互联网号码分配局（IANA）正式地分配，但是现今一些新协议的开发者经常选择它们自己的端口号。由于在同一个系统上很少超过少数几个的服务器应用，端口冲突引起的问题很少。应用软件通常也允许用户强制性地指定端口号作为运行参数。
target_text: On the transmission layer, the most commonly used applications are TCP or UDP, and server applications are often linked to an open port number. Server applications are officially distributed by the Internet Number Distribution Authority (IANA), but developers of some of the new protocols today often choose their own port number. There are few problems with port conflicts as few servers are used on the same system.
title: TCP/IP协议族

source_text:
网络存取(连结)层
网络存取(连结)层实际上并不是因特网协议组中的一部分，但是它是数据包从一个设备的网络层传输到另外一个设备的网络层的方法。这个过程能够在网卡的软件驱动程序中控制，也可以在韧体或者专用芯片中控制。这将完成如添加报头准备发送、通过實體媒介实际发送这样一些数据链路功能。另一端，链路层将完成数据帧接收、去除报头并且将接收到的包传到网络层。
然而，链路层并不经常这样简单。它也可能是一个虚拟专有网络（VPN）或者隧道，在这里从网络层来的包使用隧道协议和其他（或者同样的）协议组发送而不是发送到實體的接口上。VPN和通道通常预先建好，并且它们有一些直接发送到實體接口所没有的特殊特点（例如，它可以加密经过它的数据）。由于现在链路“层”是一个完整的网络，这种协议组的递归使用可能引起混淆。但是它是一个实现常见复杂功能的一个优秀方法。（尽管需要注意预防一个已经封装并且经隧道发送下去的数据包进行再次地封装和发送）。
target_text: Network access (connection) layers The network access (connection) layer is not actually part of the Internet protocol group, but it is a way for data packages to be transferred from the network layer of one device to the network layer of another. This process can be controlled in the software-driven process of a network card, either in a receptor or in a dedicated chip. This will complete some of the data link functions such as adding a headline, actually sending through the physical medium. At the other end, the link layer will complete the data frame receipt, remove the headline, and transmit the received package to the network layer. However, it is not often as simple as this. It may be a virtual proprietary network (VPN) or a tunnel, where the package from the network layer is sent to the other (or the same) and not to the physical interface. VPN and access are usually pre-built, and they have special features that are not directly sent to the physical interface (e.g., it can encode the data through it).
title: TCP/IP协议族

source_text:
地址
IPv4使用32位（4字节）地址，因此地址空间中只有約四十億（4,294,967,296，232）个地址。不过，一些地址是为特殊用途所保留的，如专用网络（约1800万个地址）和多播地址（约2.7亿个地址），这减少了可在互联网上路由的地址数量。随着地址不断被分配给最终用户，IPv4地址枯竭问题也在随之产生。基于分类网络、无类别域间路由和网络地址转换的地址结构重构显著地减少了地址枯竭的速度。但在2011年2月3日，在最后5个地址块被分配给5个区域互联网注册管理机构之后，IANA的主要地址池已经用尽。
target_text: The address IPv4 uses 32 (four bytes), leaving only about 4 billion (4,294,967,296,232). However, some addresses are reserved for special purposes, such as dedicated networks (approximately 18 million addresses) and multiple broadcast addresses (approximately 270 million addresses), which reduces the number of addresses with Internet access. As addresses are constantly distributed to end-users, the problem of IPv4 address depletion also arises.
title: IPv4

source_text: 1993年，无类别域间路由（CIDR）正式地取代了分类网络，后者也因此被称为“有类别”的。CIDR被设计为可以重新划分地址空间，因此小的或大的地址块均可以分配给用户。CIDR创建的分层架构由互联网号码分配局（IANA）和区域互联网注册管理机构（RIR）进行管理，每个RIR均维护着一个公共的WHOIS数据库，以此提供IP地址分配的详情。
target_text: In 1993, the non-category inter-area route (CIDR) officially replaced the taxonomy network, which is thus referred to as a “class” network. The CIDR is designed to redraw address space, so that small or large address blocks can be distributed to users. The layered structure created by the CIDR is managed by the Internet Number Distribution Authority (IANA) and the Regional Internet Registry Authority (RIR), each of which maintains a public WHOIS database, thereby providing details of IP address allocation.
title: IPv4

source_text:
分片和组装
互联网协议（IP）是整个互联网架构的基础，可以支持不同的物理层网络，即IP层独立于链路层传输技术。不同的链路层不仅在传输速度上有差异，还在帧结构和大小上有所不同，不同MTU参数描述了数据帧的大小。为了实现IP数据包能够使用不同的链路层技术，需要将IP数据包变成适合链路层的数据格式，IP报文的分片即是IP数据包为了满足链路层的数据大小而进行的分割。
target_text: Fragmentation and assembly The Internet Protocol (IP) is the foundation of the entire Internet architecture that supports different physical layers of networks, i.e. IP layers independent of the chain layer transmission technology. Different chain layers vary not only in transmission speed, but also in frame structure and size, with different MTU parameters describing the size of the data frames. In order for IP data packages to be able to use different chain layer technologies, IP data packages need to be transformed into data formats appropriate to the chain layer, and IP data packages are split to meet the data size of the chain layer.
title: IPv4

source_text: 网际协议（，縮寫：IP）-{zh-hans:，又称互联网协议，是;zh-hant:是}-是互联网协议套件中的网络层通信协议，用于跨网络边界封包交換。它的路由功能实现了互联互通，并从本质上建立了互联网。IP是在TCP/IP协议族中网络层的主要协议，任务是仅根据数据包标头中的IP地址将数据包从源主机传递到目标主机。为此，IP协议定义了封装要传递的数据的数据包结构。它还定义了用于用源和目的地信息标记数据报的寻址方法。
target_text: Inter-network protocol (i.e., initial: IP) - {zh-hans:, or Internet protocol, yes; zh-hant:} - is a network-level communication protocol in the Internet protocol package for cross-network boundary sealing. Its route functions are connected and the Internet is built in essence. IP is the main protocol in the network layer in the TCP/IP family, with the task of transmitting the data package from the source host to the target host only on the basis of the IP address in the data package header. To this end, the IP protocol defines the data package structure to be communicated. It also defines the location method used to mark data with source and destination information.
title: 网际协议

source_text: 数据在IP互联网中传送时会封装为-{zh-hans:数据包; zh-hant:資料包;}-。网际协议的独特之处在于：在报文交换网络中主机在传输数据之前，无须与先前未曾通信过的目的主机预先建立好特定的“通路”。互联网协议提供了“不可靠的”数据包传输机制（也称“盡力而为”或“尽最大努力交付”）；也就是说，它不保证数据能准确的传输。数据包在到达的时候可能已经损坏，顺序错乱（与其它一起传送的封包相比），产生冗余包，或者全部丢失。如果应用需要保证可靠性，一般需要采取其他的方法，例如利用IP的上层协议控制。
target_text: When data are transmitted on the IP Internet, they are packaged as - {zh-hans: data packs; zh-hant: data packs;}--. The unique feature of the Internet protocol is that the host of a message exchange network does not need to pre-create a specific “roadway” with the host of the purpose for which it was not previously communicated. The Internet protocol provides an “unreliable” data package transfer mechanism (also referred to as “best effort” or “delivery”); that is, it does not guarantee the accurate transmission of the data. The data package may already be corrupted at the time of arrival, with a disorder of sequence (as compared to other packages transmitted together), resulting in redundancy packages or loss of all. If the application requires reliability, other methods are generally required, such as the use of the upper-level protocol control of the IP.
title: 网际协议

source_text: 互联网协议提供的唯一帮助是，IPv4规定透過在路由器節點计算校验和来确保IP数据报头是正确的。这个带来的副作用是当场丢弃报头错误的資料包。在这种情况下不需要发送通知给任一终端节点，但是互联网控制消息协议（ICMP）中存在做到这一点的机制。但是，IPv6为了快速传输已经放弃了计算校验和的使用。
target_text: The only help provided by the Internet protocol is that IPv4 provides for the calculation of verifications and for ensuring that IP data reports are correct by means of routers nodes. This has the side effect of discarding the head error package on the spot. There is no need to send a notification to any terminal nodes in this case, but there is a mechanism for doing so in the Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP). However, IPv6 has given up the use of computing verifications for rapid transmission.
title: 网际协议

source_text: 版本历史现在的国际互联网普遍的采用了网际协议。而现在正在网络中运行的网际协议是IPv4；IPv6为IPv4的后续版本。互联网现在正慢慢地耗尽IP地址，而IPv6的出现解决了这个问题，与IPv4的32位的地址相比而言，IPv6拥有128位的地址空间，可以提供比前者多很多的地址。版本0至3不是保留就是没有使用。而版本5用于实验流传输协议。其他的版本也已经分配了，通常是用于实验的协议，而没有广泛应用。
target_text: IPv4; IPv6 is a follow-up version of IPv4. The Internet is now slowly running out of IPV6 addresses, and IPv6 has 128 address space that is much larger than the 32-digit IPv4 address, which provides a much larger address than the former. Versions 0 to 3 are either retained or not used. Version 5 is used for experimental stream transfer protocols.
title: 网际协议

source_text: 广域网（，縮寫：WAN），又称廣域網路、外網、公網。是連接不同地区局域网或城域网计算机通信的远程网。通常跨接很大的物理范围，所覆盖的范围从几十公里到几千公里，它能连接多个地区、城市和国家，或横跨几个洲并能提供远距离通信，形成国际性的远程网络。互联网可以考虑为一个广域网。
target_text: Wide area networks (WAN), also known as Wide Area Networks, Outer Networks, and Public Networks, are remote networks that connect to LANs in different regions or to LAN computer communications in urban areas.
title: 广域网

source_text: 個人區域網絡（，縮寫為PAN），指个人范围（随身携带或数米之内）的计算设备（如计算机、电话、PDA、数码相机等）组成的通信网络。个人网即可用于这些设备之间互相交换数据，也可以用于连接到高层网络或互联网。个人网可以是有线的形式，例如USB或者Firewire（IEEE1394）总线；也可以是无线的形式，例如红外（IrDA）或蓝牙。採用無線技術的個人區域網絡，稱為無線個人區域網絡（，縮寫為WPAN）
target_text: The personal network can be used to exchange data between devices or to connect to high-level networks or the Internet. The personal network can be a wired form, such as the USB or Firewire (IEE1394) bus; it can be a wireless form, such as infrared (IRDA) or bluetooth.
title: 個人區域網絡

source_text:
如果接收方以很小的增量来处理到来的数据，它会发布一系列小的接收窗口。这被称作愚蠢窗口综合症，因为它在TCP的数据包中发送很少的一些字节，相对于TCP包头是很大的开销。解决这个问题，就要避免对小的window size做出响应，直到有足够大的window size再响应：
接收端使用David D Clark算法：如果收到的数据导致window size小于某个值，可以直接ack把window给关闭了，阻止了发送端再发数据。等到接收端处理了一些数据后windows size大于等于了MSS，或者接收端buffer有一半为空，就可以把window打开让发送端再发数据过来。
发送端使用Nagle算法来延时处理，条件一：Window Size>=MSS 且 Data Size >=MSS；条件二：等待时间或是超时200ms，这两个条件有一个满足，才会发数据，否则就是在积累数据。Nagle算法默认是打开的，所以对于一些需要小包场景的程序——比如像telnet或ssh这样的交互性程序，需要关闭这个算法。可以在Socket设置TCP_NODELAY选项来关闭这个算法。
target_text: If the recipient handles the incoming data with a small incremental amount, it releases a series of small reception windows. This is called the stupid window syndrome, because it sends few bytes in the TCP data package, which is a huge expense in relation to the TCP package. To solve this problem, it avoids responding to the small window size until there is enough big window size again: the recipient uses the David D Clark algorithm: if the received data results in window size being smaller than a value, it can shut the window down directly and prevent redistribution of the sender ' s data. By processing some data on the receiving end, windows size is more than MSS, or half of the receiving end buffer is empty, it can open the window to send the sender back data until there is a large window size. The sender uses the Nagle algorithm to extend the processing process, and conditions are: Windows Size MS > and Data =MS; Condition II: Waiting for MS, or 200 m.
title: 传输控制协议

source_text: 最近，一个新协议已经被加州理工学院的科研人员开发出来，命名为FAST TCP（基于快速活动队列管理的规模可变的传输控制协议）。它使用排队延迟作为拥塞控制信号；但是因为端到端的延迟通常不仅仅包括排队延迟，所以FAST TCP（或更一般地，所有基于排队延迟的算法）在实际互联网中的能否工作仍然是一个没有解决的问题。
target_text: Recently, a new agreement has been developed by researchers at the Caltech Institute of Technology, named FAST TCP (a variable-scale transmission control protocol based on fast-motivation queue management). It uses queuing delays as a condensed control signal; but since end-to-end delays usually include more than mere queuing delays, the question remains as to whether FAST TCP (or, more generally, all algorithms based on queuing delays) can work on the actual Internet.
title: 传输控制协议

source_text: 目前分布式计算项目通常使用世界各地上千万志愿者计算机的闲置计算能力，通过互联网进行数据传输（志愿计算）。如分析计算蛋白质的内部结构和相关药物的Folding@home项目，該项目結構庞大，需要惊人的计算量，由一台电脑计算是不可能完成的。虽然现在有了计算能力超强的超级計算機，但這些設備造價高昂，而一些科研机构的经费却又十分有限，藉助分佈式計算可以花費較小的成本來達到目標。
target_text: Current distributed computing projects typically use the idle computing power of tens of millions of volunteer computers around the world to transmit data (volunteer computing) via the Internet. For example, the Folding@home project, which analyses the internal structure of computing proteins and the associated drugs, has a huge structure that requires an amazing amount of computing, which cannot be done by a computer.
title: 分布式计算

source_text: 游戏在台湾推出时，在《软体世界》杂志的读者投票中，以与第二名千票之差票获得首位。在《大眾軟件》由玩家投票决定的游戏排行榜上连续6年占据前三。《仙剑奇侠传》在1997和1998年连续两年，入选连邦软件的十佳中国大陆PC软件榜，且是榜单中唯一的电子游戏软件。另外游戏亦获得了多個其他奖项，包括：1996年获得第三届臺湾多媒体 KING TITLE 金袋奖；1998年在CEM STAR 计算机育乐多媒体展入选最佳国内角色扮演类；2002年被GAME STAR 游戏之星授予国内自制角色扮演类奖。游戏获得《电脑报》“十个最值得珍藏的PC游戏”的首位，李逍遥和林月如分获“最受欢迎的十大电脑游戏角色”之最佳男、女主角。各版本的《仙剑》已经发售超过100万套。
target_text: When the game was launched in Taiwan, it was the only electronic game in the list. There were several other prizes, including: the third Gulf Multimedia KING TITLE gold bag in 1996; the best domestic role-player at the CEM STAR Computer Multimedia Exhibition in 1998; and the GAME STAR Games star in 2002 awarded an award of such kind to his home-made role. The game received the first of the 10 most valuable PC games in the Computer Journal, and Li was the best male and female lead in the 10 most popular computer games in the month of Lin.
title: 仙剑奇侠传 (游戏)

source_text: 游戏的情节、画面、音乐、获得称赞。《计算机时代》为游戏打出80/100分，称赞游戏的画风、音乐、感人的故事情节，多样的物品和敌人，以及复杂的迷宫。杂志还游戏是同类游戏学习的目标。《电脑》杂志的临风强调了游戏老练的情感运用，称大宇将《轩辕剑》中的悲哀元素升华为游戏主题。然而杂志批评游戏李逍遥和几名少女間情感模糊不清，同时走了单线剧情、走迷宫与练级的老路。《软件世界》的乐水也提到了游戏单线、单结局的不足。游戏迷宫的复杂性也存在争议。
target_text: The computer age gives 80/100 points for the game, praises the game ' s wind, music, touching storylines, diverse objects and enemies, and complex mazes. The magazine also aims to learn about games of the same kind. The impurity of the computer magazine emphasizes the practical use of games, calling Daewoo the sad elements of the Sword the theme of the game. But the magazine criticizes the games Li Yoo-yoon and several girls for their vague emotions, taking a single line of dramas, mazes and exercises. The music of the software world also refers to the lack of a single line, single endings. The complexity of the mazes is also controversial.
title: 仙剑奇侠传 (游戏)

source_text:
完全图灵测试
普通的图灵测试一般避免审问者与被测试计算机发生物理上的互动，因为物理上模拟人（比如像模拟人的外表）并不是人工智能的研究范畴。然而一些人工智能可能涉及一些人机在物理上的交互，所以人们又拓展出了“完全图灵测试”。在完全图灵测试中，可以包含必要的人机在物理层面上的交互。但是为了通过完全图灵测试，还需要在普通图灵测试之外另外两项额外技术课题。詢問者還可以測試受試者的感知能力（需要電腦視覺），和受試者操縱物體的能力（需要機器人學）。
target_text: The general Turing test generally avoids physical interaction between the interrogator and the tested computer, because physical simulators (e.g., the physical appearance of the simulated person) are not the subject of artificial intelligence. However, some artificial intelligence may involve the physical interaction of some people, so that one expands the “total Turing test.” In the full Turing test, the necessary human machine interacts at the physical level. But, in order to be fully Turing, two additional technical subjects need to be added to the general Turing test.
title: 图灵测试

source_text: Photoshop 由和约翰·诺尔在 1988 年首次发布。自那时起，它成为位图编辑的行业标准。该软件的名称经常被通俗地用作动词，如“P 图”，“正在 PS”和“PS 比赛”，尽管 Adobe 不鼓励这样使用。它可以编辑和合成多个图层中的位图，支持图层遮罩、图像合成且包含 RGB、CMYK、CIELAB、专色通道和双色调等多种颜色模型。该软件使用自己的 .PSD 和 .PSB 文件格式来支持上述功能。不过除位图以外，它编辑或渲染文本、矢量图形（尤其是剪辑路径）、3D 图形和视频的能力有限。它的功能可以通过 Photoshop 插件、独立于该软件开发和分发的程序来扩展，这些程序在其内部运行以增强或是提供全新的功能。
target_text: Photoshop was first published by John Norr in 1988. Since then, it has become a industry standard for bitmap editing. The name of the software is often used as a verb, such as “P Diagram”, “PS” and “PS” competitions, although Adobe does not encourage such use. It can edit and synthesize bitmap maps in multiple layers, supporting the synthesizing of layers, images and many colour models, such as RGB, CMYK, CIELAB, special colour channels and double colours. The software uses its own .PSD and .PSB file formats to support these functions. However, apart from the bitmap, it has limited capacity to edit or render text, vector graphics (especially the cut-out path), 3D graphics and videos. Its functions can be expanded through the Photoshop plug-in, independently of the software development and distribution process, which operates internally to enhance or provide new functions.
title: Adobe Photoshop

source_text:
历史
1987 年，在美国密歇根大学就读博士研究生，他用课余时间编写了一个叫“Display”的程序，程序的功能是让黑白位图显示器显示灰阶图像。托馬斯的兄弟约翰·诺尔就职于光影魔幻工业特效公司，他建议托馬斯将“Display”变成一个处理数字图像的程序，于是在 1988 年两兄弟用六个月合作完成这个项目。最初托马斯想将软件改名为“ImagePro”，但没曾想到这个名字已经被使用。同年晚些时候，托马斯将软件改名为“Photoshop”（实际上是参加展览时一位观众建议改为此名）并与一家扫描仪公司进行了短期合作，用于处理扫描仪扫描下来的图像。
target_text: In 1987, at the University of Michigan in the United States, he worked on a program called “Display” after school, the function of which was to have black-and-white bitmap displays of greyscale images. Thomas' brother John Noll, who had been in PVM Special Effects, advised Thomas to turn “Display” into a digital image-processing program, and in 1988 two brothers worked together for six months to complete the project. Thomas wanted to change the software to “ImagePro”, but never thought that it had been used. Later in the year, Thomas changed the name of the software to “Photoshop” (which was actually suggested by an audience at the exhibition) and worked briefly with a scanner company to process the scanned images.
title: Adobe Photoshop

source_text: 支持的图片文件格式.PSD：这是 Photoshop 默认的文件保存格式，PSD 是 Photo Shop Document 的缩写。该格式可以保留所有有图层、色板、遮罩、路径、未點陣化文字以及图层样式等，但無法保存文件的操作历史记录。Adobe 其他软件产品，例如 Premiere、Indesign、Illustrator 等可以直接导入 .PSD 文件。.PSB：PSB 是 Photoshop Big 的缩写，该格式最高可保存寬度和高度不超过 300,000 像素的图像文件，此格式用於大小超過 2 GB 的檔案，但只能在新版 Photoshop 中打开，其他软件以及旧版 Photoshop 不支持。.PDD：PDD 是 PhotoDeluxe Document 的缩写，此格式只用來支援 Photo Deluxe 的功能。Photo Deluxe 已經停止開發。.RAW：Photoshop RAW 具 Alpha 通道 的 RGB、CMYK 和灰度模式，以及没有 Alpha 通道的 Lab、多通道、索引和双色调模式。.BMP：BMP 是 Windows 操作系统专有的图像格式，用于保存點陣圖文件，最高可处理 24 位元图像，支持點陣圖、灰度、索引和 RGB 模式，但不支持 Alpha 通道。.GIF：GIF 因其采用 LZW 无损压缩方式并且支持透明背景和动画，被广泛运用于网络中。.EPS：EPS 是用于 Postscript 打印机上输出图像的文件格式，大多数图像处理软件都支持该格式。EPS 格式能同时包含位图图像和矢量图像，并支持位图、灰度、索引、Lab、双色调、RGB 以及 CMYK。.PDF：便携文档格式 PDF 支持索引、灰度、位图、RGB、CMYK 以及 Lab 模式。具有文档搜索和导航功能，同样支持位图和矢量。.PNG：PNG 作为 GIF 的替代品，可以无损压缩图像，并最高支持 244 位图像且可产生无锯齿状的透明度。但一些旧版浏览器（例如：IE5）不支持 PNG 格式。.TIFF：TIFF 作为通用文件格式，绝大多数绘图软件、图像编辑软件以及排版软件都支持该格式，并且扫描仪也支持导出该格式的文件。
target_text: Supported photo file formats. PSD: This is a default file preservation format for Photoshop, PSD is an abbreviation for PhotoShop Documentation. This format allows for the retention of all files with layers, colour panels, masks, paths, unscathed scripts, and floor styles, but it is not possible to preserve the operating history of files. Adobe other software products, such as Premiere, Indesign, Illustrator, etc. can be imported directly into . PSD: a default file. PSB: a thumbnail image for Photoshop Big. This format can save images with a width and height of no more than 300,000 pixels.
title: Adobe Photoshop

source_text: 因为使用汉字正简的不同，汉字计算机软件市场经常被分成两个不同的市场：简体字用户（中国大陆）和正体字用户（台港澳）。大陆计算机用户一般都会汉语拼音，所以拼音起源的输入法在大陆很普遍。在臺灣，注音輸入法比較流行，但市場上也有很多其他種類的輸入法，如倉頡、行列，香港等粵語地區也流行粵語拼音輸入法。
target_text: Because of the difference between the Chinese word and the Chinese word, the Chinese computer software market is often divided into two different markets: the French word user (continent China) and the Chinese word user (ports of Taiwan and Australia). The Chinese spelling is generally used in mainland computers, so the method of entering the origin of the spelling is common in the mainland. In Taiwan, the type of injection is more popular, but there are many other types of input methods in the market, such as the stubble, the combo, and the Hong Kong-speaking regions.
title: 中文输入法

source_text: 汉语拼音输入法是利用汉字的读音（汉语拼音）进行输入的一类汉字输入法。拼音输入法有几种输入方案包括全拼和双拼。市场上有许多用拼音作基础的输入软件。绝大多数中文操作系统均附带汉语拼音输入法，如内置于Windows操作系统中的智能ABC（已停止更新）和微软拼音。此外互联网早期时代还有紫光拼音、拼音加加、拼音之星、智能狂拼、黑马神拼等输入法，在之后由中国互联网公司开发的搜狗拼音、QQ拼音、百度输入法等输入法较为流行。
target_text: The Chinese-language spelling input is a type of Chinese-language input using the Chinese-language pronunciation (Hanese spelling). There are a number of input options, including full spelling and double spelling. There are many input software in the market based on spelling. Most Chinese-language operating systems are accompanied by Chinese-language spelling, such as smart ABC (which has stopped updating) and Microsoft collage embedded in Windows operating systems.
title: 中文输入法

source_text: 早期的计算机没有操作系统。只有单独的机器，操作者会带着记录有程序和数据的卡片（punch card）或較後期的打孔纸带去操作机器。程序读入机器后，机器就开始工作直到程序停止。由于程序难免有误，所以机器通常都会中途崩溃。程序一般通过控制板的开关和状态灯来调试。据说图灵能非常熟练地用这种方法操作曼切斯特1型机器。
target_text: The early computer does not have an operating system. Only a single machine, the operator carries a card (punch card) that records programs and data, or a later puncture paper. Once the program reads the machine, the machine starts to work until the program stops. Because of the inevitable error of the program, the machine usually collapses midway.
title: 操作系统历史

source_text: 概念意义上的操作系统和通俗意义上的操作系统差距越来越大。通俗意义上的操作系统为了方便而把最普通的包和应用程序的集合包括在操作系统内。随着操作系统的发展，一些功能更强的“第二类”操作系统软件也被包括进去。在今天，没有图形界面和各种文件浏览器已经不能称为一个真正的通俗意义上的操作系统了，但事实上，运行在数据中心和服务器等领域的操作系统往往是没有图形界面的。
target_text: Conceptually speaking, operating systems and generically speaking operating systems are becoming increasingly different. In general terms, operating systems include the most common packages and applications for convenience. As operating systems develop, some of the more functional "type two" operating system software is also included. Today, there is no graphical interface and various document browsers that can no longer be called a truly generic operating system, but in fact, operating systems in data centres and servers are often without graphical interfaces.
title: 操作系统历史

source_text: 早期的操作系统非常多样化，生产商生产出针对各自硬件的系统。每一个操作系统都有很不同的命令模式、操作过程和调试工具，即使它们来自同一个生产商。最能反映这一状况的是，厂家每生产一台新的机器都会配备一套新的操作系统。这种情况一直持续到二十世纪六十年代IBM公司开发了System/360系列机器。尽管这些机器在性能上有明显的差异，但是他们有统一的操作系统——OS/360（在开发OS/360过程中遇到的问题在Fred Brooks写的软件工程经典之作《人月神话》中详细地叙述了）
target_text: Early operating systems are very diverse, and producers produce systems for their own hardware. Each operating system has very different command patterns, operating processes, and debugging tools, even if they come from the same manufacturer. This situation is best illustrated by the fact that each new machine produced by the manufacturer will be equipped with a new operating system. This continued until the 1960s, when IBM developed the System/360 series of machines.
title: 操作系统历史

source_text: UNIX操作系统是在 1960 年由AT&T公司的貝爾實驗室开发出来的，原本是要用於 PDP-7 ，後來用於 PDP-11。 因為它的早期版本是完全免费的，可以轻易取得并容易修改，所以它得到了广泛的接受。他也成了貝爾實作業系統公司的系統基礎，由於他是以 C语言 撰寫，當這種語言撰寫的程式被移植到另一個架構時，unix 也能移植過去。 這種方便移植的特性，讓它成为發展第二代迷你電腦和第一代工作站作業系统的其中一種選項。
target_text: The UNIX operating system was developed in 1960 by AT&T's Bell Laboratory, originally for PDP-7, and later for PDP-11. Because its early version was completely free, easily accessible and easily modified, it was widely accepted.
title: 操作系统历史

source_text: 由于早期的广泛应用，UNIX 已经成为的操作系统的典范。不过，它始终属于AT&T公司，只有那些能负担的起许可费的企业才用得起，这限制了它的应用范围。早期的操作系统是可以被用户软件所利用的功能的集合。一些有能力的公司发展更好的系统，但他们不支持其他公司硬件的特性。
target_text: UNIX has become an example of an operating system as a result of its early widespread application. However, it has always belonged to AT&T, which is affordable only for companies that can afford licensing fees, which limits its application. Early operating systems are a pool of functions that can be used by user software. Some capable companies develop better systems, but they do not support the characteristics of other companies’ hardware.
title: 操作系统历史

source_text: 60年代末70年代初，几种硬件支持相似的或提供端口的软件可在多种系统上运行。早期的系统已经利用微程序来在他们的系统上实现功能。事实上，除了360/165和360/168外，360/40之后的大部分360系列的机器都实行微程序设计。藉由廣泛的被大量採用，UNIX 展示了在不同硬體架構上作業系統可以是一致的概念。後來還成 自由軟體 與 開源軟體 包含 GNU, Linux, BSD 的發展根基。
target_text: In the late 1960s and early 1970s, several hardware software supporting similar or providing ports could operate on multiple systems. Early systems have used micro-procedures to function on their systems. In fact, most of the 360 series of machines after 360/40 have been designed for microprocedures, with the exception of 360/265 and 360/6068. With a wide range of applications, UNIX has shown that operating systems in different hardware frames can be consistent. Later, free software and open-source software have been the basis for the development of GNU, Linux, BSD.
title: 操作系统历史

source_text: 微型处理器的发展使计算机的应用普及至中小企業及个人爱好者。而计算机的普及又推动了硬件组件公共接口的发展（如S-100,SS-50,Apple II,ISA和PCI总线），并逐渐地要求有一种“标准”的操作系统去控制它们。在这些早期的计算机中，主要的操作系统是8080/8085/Z-80 CPU用的CP/M-80，它建立在数位研究公司(Digital Research)先前几个针对PDP-11架构的操作系统的基础上。在此基础上又产生了MS-DOS（或IBM公司的PC-DOS）。这些计算机在ROM（只读存储器）都有一个小小的启动程序，可以把操作系统从磁盘装载到内存。IBM-PC系列的BIOS是这一思想的延伸。自1981年第一台IBM-PC诞生以来，BIOS的功能得到不断地增强。
target_text: The development of microprocessors has enabled computer applications to reach small- and medium-sized enterprises and individual lovers. The diffusion of computers has contributed to the development of public interfaces for hardware components (e.g. S-100, SS-50, Apple II, ISA and PCI buss) and has gradually required a “standard” operating system to control them. Among these early computers, the main operating system is CP/M-80 for 808085/Z-80 CPU, which is based on several previous operational systems for the PDP-11 architecture of Digital Research.
title: 操作系统历史

source_text:
随着显示设备和处理器成本的降低，很多操作系统都开始提供图形用户界面。如：许多UNIX提供的X Window一类的系统、微软的Windows系统、苹果公司的Mac OS和IBM公司的OS/2等。最初的图形用户界面是由Xerox Palo Alto研究中心70年代初期研发出来的，之后被许多公司模仿，继承发展。参看
操作系统列表
target_text: As the cost of displaying equipment and processors decreases, many of the operating systems begin to provide graphical user interfaces. For example: many UNIX systems such as X Windows, Microsoft Windows, Mac OS Apple, and IBM OS/2. The initial graphical user interface was developed by the Xerox Palo Alto Research Centre in the early 1970s, and has since been replicated and inherited by many companies. See the list of operating systems.
title: 操作系统历史

source_text: 數值穩定性是數值分析中一個重要的主題。若一演算法中不論什麼原因產生了誤差，此誤差不會在運算中明顯增加，此演算法為數值穩定的演算法。若問題為良置（well-conditioned）的，就會符合上述的特性，也就是問題數據微小的變化只會造成其解的微小變化。相反的，若問題數據微小的變化會造成其解的巨大變化，會稱問題為非良置或病態（ill-conditioned）。
target_text: Numerical stability is an important theme in value analysis. If, for whatever reason, errors are created in an algorithm, the error does not increase significantly in the algorithm, the algorithm is an algorithm for numerical stability. If the problem is good, it is consistent with the characteristics described above, i.e., minor variations in problem numbers can only cause minor changes in their resolution. Conversely, if the problem is minimally altered, it can be described as an unsound or sick matter.
title: 数值分析

source_text: 一個求解良置問題的演算法可能是數值穩定的，也可能是數值不穩定的。數值分析的重點就是找到適定性問題的數值穩定演算法。例如，計算2的平方根（大約是1.41421）本身是一個適定性問題。許多求解的演算法都是從一個初始的近似值開始去求解，例如，再繼續計算、等。巴比倫法就是一個具有此特性的演算法。另一個方法，先稱之為X方法，演算法為。以下分別用初始值 及，用二種方式進行幾次迭代。
target_text: For example, the square root of calculation 2 (approx. 1.41421) is itself an appropriate qualitative question. Many solver algorithms start with an initial approximation, for example, by continuing to calculate, etc. The Babylon method is an algorithm with this feature. Another method, known as the X method, is the algorithm.
title: 数值分析

source_text:
求根演算法是要解一非線性方程，其名稱是因為函數的根就是使其值為零的點。若函數本身可微且其導數是已知的，可以用牛頓法求解，其他的方法包括二分法、割線法等。線性化則是另一種求解非線性方程的方法。求解特徵值或奇異值問題
許多重要的問題可以用奇異值分解或特徵分解來表示。例如有些图像压缩演算法就是以奇異值分解為基礎。統計學中對應的工具稱為主成分分析。
target_text: The underlying algorithm is to solve a non-linear equation, named because the root of the function is the point where the value is zero. If the function itself is small and its guidance is known, it can be solved by the Newton method, and other methods include dichotomy, cutting lines, and so on. Linearization is another way to solve the non-linear equation. Many important questions about the solvency of the special or odd value can be expressed by the odd value decomposition or decomposition. For example, some image compression algorithms are based on the odd value decomposition.
title: 数值分析

source_text:
軟體
20世紀末，大部份数值分析的演算法都已用許多不同的程式語言實現。软件库包含了許多数值分析演算法的程式，大部份是Fortran及C語言的程式。商業產品也實現了許多不同的数值分析演算法，包括國際數學及統計程序庫數字型檔及软件库，GNU科学数值库則是自由軟體的数值分析演算法软件库。
target_text: Software at the end of the 20th century, most of the algorithms for numerical analysis have been implemented in many different languages. The software library contains many algorithms for numerical analysis, most of which are for Fortran and C. Commercial products have also implemented many different algorithms for numerical analysis, including the International Mathematics and Statistics Library digital files and software repositories, while the GNU Science Nucleus is a free software database for numerical analysis algorithms.
title: 数值分析

source_text: 传输层（）在计算机网络中是互联网协议套件与（OSI）网络堆栈中协议的分层结构中的方法的一个概念划分。该层的协议为应用进程提供端到端的通信服务。 它提供面向连接的支持、可靠性、流量控制、多路复用等服务。互联网与一般性网络的OSI模型的基础，TCP/IP模型的传输层的具体实现和含义（RFC 1122）是不同的。在OSI模型中传输层最常被称作第4层或L4，而TCP/IP中不常给网络层编号。
target_text: The transmission layer () in the computer network is a conceptual division between the ICP package and the stratified structure of the protocol in the (OSI) network stack. The protocol provides end-to-end communication services for the application process. It provides connectivity-oriented support, reliability, traffic control, multiple circuit re-use, etc. The Internet is based on the OSI model of the general network, and the specific realization and meaning of the TCP/IP transmission layer (RFC 1122) is different. The transmission layer is most commonly referred to in the OSI model as level 4 or L4, whereas the TCP/IP is not often assigned to network layer numbers.
title: 传输层

source_text:
服务
传输层服务通过传输层协议的编程接口传递给应用进程。该服务可以包括以下功能：
連接導向式通訊：通常对于一个应用进程来说，把连接解读为而非处理底层的无连接模型（如用户数据报协议（UDP）与网际协议（IP）的資料包模型）更加容易。
相同次序交付：网络层通常不保证数据包到达顺序与发送顺序相同，但这往往是一个可取的特点。这通常是通过给报文段编号来完成的，接收者按次序将它们传给应用进程。这可能会造成队头阻塞。
可靠性：由于网络拥塞和错误，数据包可能在传输过程中丢失。通过检错码（如校验和），传输协议可以检查数据是否损坏，并通过向发送者传ACK或NACK消息确认正确接收。自动重发请求方案可用于重新传输丢失或损坏的数据。
流量控制：有时必须控制两个节点之间的数据传输速率以阻止快速的发送者传输超出接收緩衝器所能承受的数据，造成缓冲区溢出。这也可以通过减少缓冲区不足来提高效率。
拥塞避免：拥塞控制可以控制进入到电信网络的流量。
多路复用：端口可以在单个节点上提供多个端点。例如，邮政地址的名称是一种多路复用，并区分同一位置的不同收件人。每个计算机应用进程会监听它们自己的端口，这使得在同一时间可以使用多个网络服务。它是在TCP/IP模型中是传输层的一部分，但在OSI模型中属于会话层。
target_text: The same order of delivery: The network level usually does not guarantee that the data package arrives in the same order as the sender, but this is often a desirable feature. This is usually done by numbering the message section, where recipients transmit them to the application process in a sequential manner. This can cause blockage. Reliability: As a result of network congestion and error, the data package may be lost in the transmission process. The transmission protocol can check whether the data is damaged (e.g. by checking the user data protocol) and the data package of the Internet protocol (IP).
title: 传输层

source_text: 电子游戏（），又称计算机游戏（），是一种涉及与用户界面或输入设备（如控制杆、控制器、键盘或设备）交互以从显示设备生成视觉反馈的电子类游戏，最常以视频格式显示在电视机、计算机显示器、平板显示器、移动设备上的觸控式螢幕或虛擬實境眼鏡上。大多数现代电子游戏是视听游戏，通过扬声器或耳机传递音频，并有时还配以其他类型的感官反馈（如提供体感感觉的触觉技术），一些电子游戏还可使用麦克风和网络摄像头进行和。
target_text: Electronic games (), also known as computer games (), are electronic games involving interaction with user interfaces or input devices (e.g. control poles, controllers, keyboards or devices) to generate visual feedback from displaying devices, most often in video format on television, computer monitors, flat screen displays, touch screens on mobile devices or virtual field glasses. Most modern electronic games are audio-visual games that transmit audio through loudspeakers or headphones and are sometimes accompanied by other types of sensory feedback (e.g., touch technology to provide physical senses), and some electronic games can also be conducted using microphones and webcams.
title: 电子游戏

source_text: 电脑游戏是一个相对于主机游戏和街机游戏的概念，指在个人电脑上运行的游戏软件，是一种本身提供娱乐功能的电脑软件。电脑游戏产业与电脑硬件、电影、电脑软件、互联网的发展联系甚密。电脑游戏为游戏参与者提供了一个虚拟的空间，从一定程度上让人可以摆脱现实世界，在另一个世界中扮演真实世界中扮演不了的角色。同時電腦多媒體技術的發展，使游戏给了人们很多体验和享受。
target_text: Computer games are a concept relative to mainframe and arcade games, that is, game software running on personal computers, a computer software that provides its own entertainment functions. source_text:
19世纪时
约翰·冯·莱斯维茨的战争游戏增加了现实性，规则十分复杂，所以又称为严格式军事演习。严格式军事演习虽然对人来说太过复杂，但是在计算机出现以后，这种方式被计算机军事演习和电脑游戏所沿用。19世纪中叶，许多人试图简化规则，但是都不成功。1876年，普鲁士陆军上校冯·凡尔第终于将它变成了一种自由式军事演习。自由式军事演习不需要复杂的规则，而是依据裁判的临场裁定。它受到了很大的欢迎。但是却降低了军事演习的检验价值。
target_text: In the 19th century, the war game of John von Leavic was more realistic and complex, so it was called a strict military exercise. Many tried to simplify the rules in the middle of the 19th century, but they were unsuccessful. In 1876, Colonel Von Verdi of the Prussia Army finally turned it into a free-style military exercise. Free military exercises do not need complex rules, but are based on ad hoc decisions.

source_text: 通信协议（，也称传输协议）在电信領域中指的是：在任何物理介质中允许两个或多个在中的终端之间传播信息的系统标准，也是指计算机通信或網路設備的共同语言。通信协议定义了通信中的语法学、语义学和同步规则以及可能存在的错误检测与纠正。通信协议在硬件、软件或两者之间皆可实现
target_text: The communication protocol (also referred to as the transmission protocol) in the telecommunications domain refers to: a system standard in any physical medium that allows the dissemination of information between two or more intermediate terminals, or the common language of computer communications or network devices. The communication protocol defines the linguistic, semantic and synchronous rules of communication, as well as possible error detection and correction. The communication protocol is achievable in hardware, software or both.
title: 网络传输协议

source_text: 为了交换大量信息，通信系统使用通用格式（协议）。每条信息都有明确的意义使得预定位置给予响应，并独立回应指定的行为，通信协议须参与实体都同意才能生效。为了达成一致，协议必须要有技术标准。编程语言在计算方面也应有相应标准，所以在这个方面可以用编程语言做类比：「编程语言是为了模式化的计算，而传输协议为了更畅通的交流。」
target_text: In order to exchange a large amount of information, the communication system uses a common format (agreement). Each message has a clear meaning that the intended location is responsive and that the consent of the participating entity is required for the communication agreement to enter into force. In order to reach an agreement, the agreement must have a technical standard. The programming language should also have the corresponding criteria for calculation, so that an analogy can be made in the programming language: "The programming language is for modelling calculations, while the transmission protocol is for easier communication " .
title: 网络传输协议

CD扇区内容
一张74分钟的标准CD包含333,000个扇区。
每个扇区为2352字节，模式1型的CD-ROM包含2048字节计算机数据，模式2型的CD-ROM包含2336字节PSX/VCD数据，音频包含2352字节信息。
扇区容量的差异来自头信息和纠错编码，计算机数据对精度要求最高，这类信息最多，VCD对精度要求不高，这类信息稍小，音频CD没有这类信息。
如果用RAW格式从盘片中读取数据，无论是什么数据类型，每个扇区都能够读出2352字节信息。因此：
高速刻录数据CD（40倍速）不会丢失信息。但是，由于音乐CD没有3层纠错码，如果高速刻录音樂CD，有可能导致不可挽回的错误，并在播放时发出咔哒的声音。
在一张74分钟的CD上，能够用RAW方式刻录更多的信息，这样做容量可以达到333,000×2352 = 783,216,000 字节（大约747MB）。这是74分钟650MB的CD的容量的上限。容量增加14.8%，但是，这样做将失去纠错数据。
当用RAW方式读取光盘时，容量永远为2352字节的倍数。
target_text: A 74-minute standard CD contains 333,000 sectors. Each sector contains 2352 bytes, the mode 1 CD-ROM contains 2048 bytes of computer data, the mode 2 CD-ROM contains 2336 bytes of PSX/VCD data, and the audio contains 2352 bytes of information. The difference in sector capacity is derived from head information and correcting code, the computer data is the most demanding for accuracy, the VCD is the least demanding for accuracy, and the audio CD does not have that type of information. If the RAW format is used to read data from a disk, no matter what type of data, each sector is able to read 2352 bytes of information. Therefore, the high-speed carving data CD (40 times faster) does not lose information. But, since the music CD has no three layers of error code, if the high-speed recording CD is not high, this type of information may lead to an irreversible error, and the audio CD does not have that type of information.
title: CD-ROM

source_text: 服务器通常以網路作为媒介，既可以通过內聯網对内提供服务，也可以通过互聯網对外提供服务。伺服器的最大特点就是其强大的运算能力或是具備大量磁碟儲存空間的電腦，使其能在短时间内完成大量工作及負載大量的檔案資料儲存，并为大量用户提供服务。20世纪90年代之後，随着调制解调器技术的发展，互联网由窄頻的電話撥接，升級成為寬頻網絡，這代表着以信息高速公路为象征的網路新時代來臨。互联网普及同時改變了電腦使用者習慣，更大大普及網路聯絡傳訊的方式，从文字到图片，再到视频，服务器所能完成的工作也越来越复杂；而雲端計算、大數據時代造就了各種新型態行業，如網路商店、網路電商、網路拍賣、網路銷售、網路遊戲、網站設計、網站架設、網誌，以及越來越普遍性的雲端資料庫或備份庫。標準伺服器（server）及檔案伺服器（NAS）的普及正在時時優化及改變現有人類的生活。
target_text: Since the 1990s, with the development of modem technology, the Internet has been connected by narrow-banded telephones that have been upgraded to broadband networks, representing a new era in the Internet that is symbolized by the information superhighway. Internet penetration has also changed the habits of computer users, wider access to Internet communications, from text to pictures to video, and more complex work that servers can do; and servers (servers) and filers (servers) are now changing their lives and making them more universal.
title: 服务器

source_text:
定义
有时，这两种定义会引起混淆，如网页服务器。它可能是指用于网站的计算机，也可能是指像Apache这样的软件，运行在这样的计算机上以管理网页组件和回应网页浏览器的请求。
伺服器的构成包括中央处理器、硬盘、内存等，和通用的计算机架构类似，但是由于需要提供高可靠的服务，因此在处理能力、稳定性、可靠性、安全性、可扩展性、可管理性等方面要求较高。
在网络环境下，根据服务器提供的服务类型不同，分为文件服务器，数据库服务器，应用程序服务器，Web服务器等。
target_text: Definitions sometimes lead to confusion, such as web servers. It may refer to computers used for web sites, or software such as Apache, which operates on such computers to manage web modules and respond to requests from web browsers. Servers comprise central processors, hard disks, memory, etc., and common computer structures, but require higher processing capacity, stability, reliability, security, scalability, managementability, etc. In a web environment, document servers, database servers, application servers, Web servers, etc., depending on the type of service provided by the server.
title: 服务器

source_text: 和普通的個人電腦相比， 服务器需要连续的工作在7×24小时环境。这就意味着服务器需要更多的稳定性技术RAS，比如支持使用ECC記憶體。根据不同的计算能力，服务器又分为工作组级服务器，部门级服务器和企业级服务器。服务器操作系统是指运行在服务器硬件上的操作系统。服务器操作系统需要管理和充分利用服务器硬件的计算能力并提供给服务器硬件上的软件使用。
target_text: The server needs to work continuously in a 7x24-hour environment compared to a normal personal computer. This means that the server needs more stable technology, such as RAS, to support the use of ECC memory. Depending on the ability to calculate, the server is divided into working group-level servers, departmental-level servers, and enterprise-level servers. The server operating system is the operating system running on server hardware. The server operating system needs to manage and make full use of server hardware computing capabilities and provide software use on server hardware.
title: 服务器

source_text: 在虚拟演播室系统中，摄像机的工作状态信息传送给图形工作站，计算机依此得到前景物体与摄像机之间的距离和相对位置，从而计算出虚拟场景最适宜的大小、位置，并按要求计算生成虚拟场景的三维模型。现场视频采用色键原理，将主持人或演员置身于蓝色或綠色背景幕布前表演，然后利用切换台上的色键功能将主持人从背景幕布中分离出来，实时地与计算机产生的三维模型完美无缺地集成在一起，构成一个现实中不存在的、但是在电视画面上却又起到演播室作用的那种假想的新的环境和气氛，最终得到把将实拍的人物与虚拟景物无缝地融合起来的画面。
target_text: In the virtual studio system, the camera transmits working-state information to graphic workstations whereby the computer gets the distance and relative position between the prospective object and the camera, thereby calculating the most appropriate size, location and, as required, the three-dimensional model for producing the virtual scene. The live video uses colour-key principles to put the host or actor in front of the blue or green background screen, and then uses the colour feature on the switchboard to separate the host from the background screen, to integrate the three-dimensional model produced by the computer in real time and to form a new environment and atmosphere that does not exist in reality, but is still playing the role of the studio on television, and eventually to create a picture that integrates the actual person and the virtual scene seamlessly.
title: 虚拟演播室

2021年计算机故障
2021年6月13日，哈勃望远镜的有效载荷计算机发现与仪器的通信出现错误而进入安全模式，地面控制中心试图切换到备用系统但仍然未能排除故障，之后经过地面模型的排查后，发现实际是计算机的电源控制单元出现故障，经过切换备用电源控制单元后，7月16日望远镜恢复正常运作。2021年10月23日，哈伯望遠鏡科學儀器再次發出錯誤代碼，團隊重设儀器後，隔天早上便恢復科學操作。同年10月25日2時38分，科學儀器再次發出錯誤代碼，自主進入安全模式狀態，为2021年的第三次。
target_text: On June 13, 2021, the Hubble payload computer discovered an error in communication with the instrument and entered the safety mode. The ground control centre attempted to switch to the backup system but still failed to solve the failure. After a ground model check, the actual computer power control unit was found to have malfunctioned, and the telescope returned to normal operations on July 16, after switching the backup power control unit. On October 23, 2021, the Hubble Telescope scientific instrument released the wrong code again, and the team reset the device, then resumed scientific operations the following morning. At 0238 hours on October 25, that year, the scientific instrument released the wrong code again and entered the safe mode autonomously for the third time in 2021.
title: 哈勃空间望远镜

source_text:
法律規管QQ群
2017年9月国家互联网信息办公室推出《互联网群组信息服务管理规定》規管QQ群等即時通訊群組。當月《检察日报》採訪了国家行政学院教授杨小军的看法，「杨小军也认为，管理责任并非上述一些网友所理解的『让群主也要承担群成员违法违规的责任』，在互联网群组中不只有群主一个责任主体，还有群主、参与人（发言人）、网络平台提供商、相关主管部门这四个主体共同参与，才有互联网及其群组的发展进步；同样，四个主体也分别承担相应责任」、「对于一些网友列举出群主需要对群成员的信息发布和传播行为而承担的诸多民事、行政乃至刑事责任，杨小军明确表示了反对：『这个观点实际上是让群主一人负担所有人的责任，甚至把管理部门的责任都归到群主身上。这既不客观，也不可能』」；報導又採訪中国政法大学教授王卫国，「有网友戏称通过司法考试才敢当群主。有的群主对法律法规不是很熟悉，那么其对群成员的信息交流是否违反法律法规该如何判断、管理呢？王卫国表示，这还是网友对管理责任的过大理解。实际上，群主只要根据当下社会环境，普遍的规范进行处理，认为群成员的表达明显不妥时，给予提示、禁止，就算是已经尽到管理责任了。对于比较专业化的问题，法律法规不可能赋予群主过度的责任，并且也做不到用群主履行所有职责。」

source_text: 图形用户界面（，缩写：GUI）是指采用图形方式显示的计算机操作用戶介面。与早期计算机使用的命令行界面相比，除了降低使用者的操作負擔之外，對於新使用者而言，图形界面对于用户来说在视觉上更易于接受，學習成本大幅下降，也讓電腦的大眾化得以實現。
target_text: A graphical user interface (Abbreviation: GUI) is a graphically displayed user interface for computer operations. In addition to reducing the operational burden on users, a graphical interface is easier for new users to visualize, learning costs are significantly reduced and computer publicization is possible.
title: 图形用户界面

source_text: 历史变迁1950年代SAGE Project（美国空军防空系统）和Ivan Sutherland提出，其於1963年開發的 Sketchpad 軟件為現在計算機輔助繪圖（CAD）的先驅。1968年，道格拉斯·恩格尔巴特在 SRI（Stenford Research Institute）開發 OLS 在線系統，並在ACM/IEEE會議上展示了所有演示之母，首次導入滑鼠作為互動介面。1970年，部分 SRI 的研究人員進入施樂公司參與開發地球上第一個 WIMP 系統（視窗、圖標、選單和指針/下拉式選單），希望打造孩子也能輕鬆使用的系統。1973年第一个可视化操作的电脑在施乐帕洛阿尔托研究中心（Xerox PARC）完成。該產品名為Alto，但當時GUI是面向計算工作站開發的，用在文書處理還是新概念，Alto雖然沒有販售，但取得的研發經驗眾多，是第一个把计算机所有元素所見即所得结合到一起的图形界面操作系统。它使用3键鼠标、位运算显示器、图形窗口、以太网络连接。1980年Three Rivers公司推出Perq图形工作站，图形用户界面（GUI）開始進入廠商視野中，不過此時電腦性能有限，能搭載GUI的產品主要是工作站等級的電腦，一般大眾很難接觸到。1981年施乐公司意識到後，才推出了Alto的继承者Star，曾首次使用了窗口设计。這部電腦仍為了工作站使用。1983年苹果电脑公司推出Apple Lisa个人电脑，是全球第一款搭载圖形介面的个人电脑，但沒有取得商業上的成功。1984年苹果电脑公司推出Macintosh，這次GUI造成了首次風行。1986年首款用于Unix的窗口系统X Window System发布。1988年IBM发布OS/2 1.10标准版演示管理器（Presentation Manager），这是第一种支持Intel计算机的稳定的图形界面。1992年微软公司发布Windows 3.1，增加了多媒体支持。

優先權佇列
在队列中，调度程序反复提取队列中第一个作业并运行，因为实际情况中某些时间较短的任务将等待很长时间才能结束，或者某些不短小，但具有重要性的作业，同样应当具有优先权。堆即为解决此类问题设计的最佳数据结构。戴克斯特拉演算法
在戴克斯特拉演算法中使用斐波那契堆積或二元堆可使得佇列的操作更為快速。
target_text: In the queue, the dispatcher repeats the first operation in the queue, because it is true that some short-lived tasks will wait a long time to be completed, or some minor, but important, work, which should also have priority. The stack is the best data structure designed to solve such problems. Dextra algorithms use the Faipona or binary stacks to make the queues more fast.
title: 堆積

1980年，（）的一名24岁的程序员（）花费了四个月时间编写出了 86-DOS 操作系统。1981年7月，微软以五萬美元的代價向西雅图公司购得本產品的全部版权，并将它更名为 MS-DOS。随后，IBM 发布了第一台个人计算机，当时采用的操作系统是西雅图電腦产品公司的 86-DOS 1.14，但微软很快改进了 MS-DOS，并使它成功地成为 IBM PC 采用的操作系统。并于1981年8月12日，正式发布 MS-DOS 1.0 和 PC-DOS 1.0。

source_text:
RS-232-C
也称标准串口，是目前最常用的一种串行通讯接口。它是在1970年由美国电子工业协会（EIA）联合贝尔系统、 调制解调器厂家及计算机终端生产厂家共同制定的用于串行通讯的标准。它的全名是“数据终端设备（DTE）和数据通讯设备（DCE）之间串行二进制数据交换接口技术标准”。传统的RS-232-C接口标准有22根线，采用标准25芯D型插头座。自IBM PC/AT開始使用简化了的9芯D型插座。至今25芯插头座现代应用中已經很少采用。电脑一般有两个串行口：COM1和COM2，9针D形接口通常在计算机后面能看到。现在有很多手机数据线或者物流接收器都采用COM口与计算机相连。
target_text: RS-232-C, also known as the Standard Serial Port, is one of the most commonly used communications interfaces at present. It is a standard for serial communications developed in 1970 by the United Bell System, Modems and Computer Terminal Producers of the American Electronic Industry Association (EIA). Its full name is “Technology standard for serial data exchange interfaces between data terminal equipment (DTE) and data communications equipment (DCE). The traditional RS-232-C interface standards have 22 lines, using standard 25-hole D plugs. The simplified 9-hole D plugin has been used since IBM PC/AT. So far, it has rarely been used in modern applications of 25-hole headplugs. Computers typically have two lines: COM1 and COM2, 9 needle-D interfaces that can be seen behind computers. There are now many mobile phone data lines or logistics receivers that use COM-to-computer connections.
title: 串行端口

source_text:
现代载体
现代的文献根据载体形式分为：
印刷型文献：是以纸质材料为载体，以印刷为记录手段而形成的文献形式，是目前整个文献中的主体，也是有着悠久历史的传统文献形式。它的特点是不需要特殊设备，可以随身携带，随处随时阅读。但存贮密度小，体积大，占据空间大，不便于保存。
缩微型文献是以感光材料为载体，以照相为记录手段而形成的一种文献形式，包括缩微胶卷、缩微平片、缩微卡片等。缩微型文献的优点是体积小，便于收藏和保存，价格便宜等，但阅读需要有较复杂的阅读设备来支持。目前在整个文献中，所占数量较少。
声像型文献是以磁性和感光材料为介质记录声音、图像等信息的一种文献形式。其优点是存取快捷，可闻其声，见其形，易理解。
电子数字型文献是伴随计算机技术和网络技术发展而产生的，以计算机处理技术为核心记录信息的一种文献形式。这种文献存贮容量大，检索速度快捷、灵活，使用方便。电子数字型文献又分为光盘文献和网络文献。
target_text: Modern literature is divided according to the form of the carrier: Printed documentation: in the form of paper-based material, which is produced as a means of recording, it is the subject of the current literature as a whole, and it is a traditional form of documentation with a long history. It is characterized by the absence of special equipment, which can be carried on and read at any time. However, the volume of audio-visual literature is small, and it is large, and it is not easy to preserve. It is a documentary form of information, such as audio-visual and visual materials, which is made up of photo-recording, microfilms, microcards, etc. The advantage of miniature literature is that it is small in size, easy to collect and preserve, cheaply priced, etc. It is supported by more sophisticated reading equipment.
title: 文献

source_text:
与CMOS的联系和区别BIOS与CMOS的关系
CMOS是计算机上另一个重要的存储器。之所以提到它，是因为BIOS程序的設定值、硬件參數偵測值就保存在CMOS中。而且，在BIOS程式啟動计算机時，需要载入CMOS中的設定值。CMOS通常被整合在南橋晶片組中。UEFI系統則多用NVRAM儲存設定。BIOS与CMOS的区别
二者的区别是，BIOS是儲存在只读存储器（EEPROM或快閃記憶體），而CMOS为随机存储器（RAM）；BIOS中存储的是程序，而CMOS中存储的是普通信息。
target_text: Links with and differences between BIOS and CMOS are another important memory on the computer. The reason for its reference is that BIOS program settings, hardware parameters, are stored in CMOs. Moreover, when the BIOS program activates the computer, the setting values in CFOs need to be entered. CFOs are usually integrated into the Southbridge chip group. The UEFI system uses NVRAM to store the settings. The difference between BIOS and CMOS is that BIOs are stored in read-only storage (EEPROM or flash memory), while CMOs are random storage (RAM); BIOS is stored in programs and CMOS is stored in regular information.
title: BIOS

source_text: 在密码学中，加密（）是将明文信息改變為難以讀取的密文內容，使之不可读的过程。只有擁有解密方法的對象，經由解密過程，才能將密文還原為正常可讀的內容。理想情况下，只有经授权的人员能够读取加密文所要传达的信息。加密本身并不能防止信息传输被截取，但加密能防止截取者理解其内容。因为种种技术原因，加密方法通常使用一个通过算法生成的伪随机密钥。虽然任何加密后的消息都可能被破解，但对于一个良好的加密算法而言，破解需要相当多的技术和算力。授权读取信息的人可以轻松通过发信人所提供的密钥解密信息，但未经授权的人员则不行。密码学历史中有众多加密方法；早期的加密方法常用于军事通讯。从此开始，现代计算中也出现了众多加密技术，并且加密在现代计算中也变得越来越常见。 现代的加密方式通常使用公钥或对称密钥。现代加密技术依赖现代计算机在破解密钥上并不高效的事实来保证其安全性。
target_text: Encryption () is a process in cryptography that transforms a given message into an unreadable secret content. Only those who have a decryption method, through a decryption process, can return the message to a normal readable content. Ideally, only authorized persons can read the message to which it is intended. Encryption itself does not prevent the transmission of information from being intercepted, but encryption does not prevent the interceptor from understanding its content. For various technical reasons, encryption usually uses a pseudo-confidential key generated by algorithms. While any post-encryption message may be decoded, it requires considerable technology and numeracy for a good encryption algorithm.
title: 加密

source_text:
相關軟件
加密或软件编码隐匿（Code Obfuscation）同时也在软件版权保护中，用于对付反向工程，未授权的程序分析，破解和软件盗版及數位內容的數位版權管理（DRM）等。加密算法
加密算法就是加密的方法。加密算法可以分为两类：对称加密和非对称加密。在密码学中，加密是将明文信息隐匿起来，使之在缺少特殊信息时不可读。
target_text: In software copyright protection, encryption or software codes are also used to deal with reverse engineering, unauthorised program analysis, cracking and digital rights management of software piracy and digital content. Encryption algorithm encryption is the method of encryption. Encryption algorithms can be divided into two categories: symmetric encryption and asymmetric encryption. In cryptography, encryption hides explicit information and makes it unreadable in the absence of special information.
title: 加密

source_text: 计算机协会（，简称ACM）是一个世界性的计算机从业员专业组织，创立于1947年，是世界上第一个科学性及教育性计算机学会，亦是現時全球最大的電腦相關學會。ACM每年都出版大量電腦科学的专门期刊，并就每项专业设有兴趣小组。兴趣小组每年亦会在全世界（但主要在美国）举办世界性讲座及会谈，以供各会员分享他们的研究成果。近年ACM积极开拓网上学习的渠道，以供会员在工作之余或家中提升自己的专业技能。截止20世纪末，ACM在全球拥有75,000个以上的成员，包括遍及学术界、工业、研究和政府领域的学生和计算机专业人员。成员的最高荣誉是会士（Fellow）。
target_text: The Computer Association (ACM) is the world’s first professional computer practitioner, founded in 1947 as the world’s first scientific and educational computer society and the world’s largest computer-related society. ACM publishes a large number of specialized journals on computer science every year, with interested groups for each profession. Interest groups also hold worldwide lectures and talks every year, but mainly in the United States, to share their research results. In recent years, ACM has been active in developing avenues for online learning to enable members to upgrade their professional skills beyond their work or at home. As of the end of the twentieth century, ACM has more than 75,000 members worldwide, including students and computer professionals from academia, industry, research and government.
title: 计算机协会

source_text: ACM通过支持全球700个以上的专业和学生组织，为当地和地区团体提供服务。其中约有20%不在美国境内。这些组织为专业人士提供服务，搜集信息，准备讲座，组织研讨会和竞赛。ACM主要成员刊物是ACM通讯，刊有一些广泛兴趣的文章，并对每月不同的热点问题展开讨论。ACM也出版了不少获得业内认可的期刊，这些期刊覆盖了计算机领域相当广泛的领域。
target_text: ACM serves local and regional groups by supporting more than 700 professional and student organizations around the world. About 20 per cent of them are not in the United States. These organizations serve professionals, gather information, prepare lectures, organize seminars and competitions. The key members of the ACM are the ACM newsletter, which contains articles of wide interest and discusses different topical issues on a monthly basis. The ACM also publishes a number of recognized periodicals covering a wide range of areas in the computer field.
title: 计算机协会

source_text: 信息安全，意为保护信息及信息系统免受未经授权的进入、使用、披露、破坏、修改、检视、记录及销毁。政府、军队、公司、金融机构、医院、私人企业积累大量與雇员、顾客、产品、研究、金融数据有关的机密信息，而绝大部分的信息现在被收集、产生、存储在电子计算机内，并通过网络传送到别的计算机。如果企业的顾客、财政状况、新产品线的机密信息落入竞争对手的掌握，这种安全性的丧失可能会导致经济上的损失、法律诉讼甚至该企业的破产。保护机密的信息是商业上的需求，而在许多情况中也是道德和法律上的需求。
target_text: Information security, intended to protect information and information systems from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, sabotage, modification, review, recording and destruction. Governments, military forces, companies, financial institutions, hospitals, private enterprises accumulate a large amount of confidential information related to employees, customers, products, research, financial data, and the vast majority of that information is now collected, generated, stored in computers and transmitted to other computers via the Internet.
title: 信息安全

source_text: 对于个人来说，信息安全对于个人隐私具有重大的影响，但这在不同的文化中的看法差异很大。信息安全在最近这些年经历巨大變化。有很多方式进入这一领域，并将之作为一项事业。它提供了许多专门的研究领域，包括：安全的网络和公共基础设施、安全的应用软件和数据库、安全测试、信息系统评估、企业安全规划以及数字取证技术等等。为保障信息安全，要求有信息源认证、访问控制，不能有非法软件驻留，不能有未授权的操作等行为。
target_text: For individuals, information security has a significant impact on their privacy, but views vary widely from one culture to another. Information security has changed dramatically in recent years. There are many ways to go into this area as a cause. It provides a number of specialized areas of research, including secure networks and public infrastructure, secure applications and databases, security testing, information system assessment, enterprise security planning, digital forensic techniques, etc.
title: 信息安全

source_text: 区别主要存在于达到这些目标所使用的方法及策略，以及所关心的领域。信息安全主要涉及数据的机密性、完整性、可用性，而不管数据的存在形式是电子的、印刷的还是其它的形式；计算机安全可以指：关注计算机系统的可用性及正确的操作，而并不关心计算机内存储或产生的信息。为保障信息安全，要求有信息源认证、访问控制，不能有非法软件驻留，不能有未授权的操作等行为。
target_text: The difference lies mainly in the methods and strategies used to achieve these goals, as well as in the areas of concern. Information security is primarily about data confidentiality, integrity, availability, whether electronic, printed or otherwise; computer security may mean: concern about the availability and proper operation of computer systems, and not about information stored or generated in computers. To ensure information security, there is a requirement for information source authentication, access control, no illegal software presence, no unauthorized operation, etc.
title: 信息安全

source_text: 20世纪末以及21世纪初见证通信、计算机硬件和软件以及数据加密领域的巨大发展。小巧、功能强大、价格低廉的计算设备使得对电子数据的加工处理能为小公司和家庭用户所负担和掌握。这些计算机很快被通常称为因特网或者万维网的网络连-{}-接起来。在因特网上快速增长的电子数据处理和电子商务应用，以及不断出现的国际恐怖主义事件，增加了对更好地保护计算机及其存储、加工和传输的信息的需求。计算机安全、信息安全、以及信息保障等学科，是和许多专业的组织一起出现的。他们都持有共同的目标，即确保信息系统的安全和可靠。
target_text: The late twentieth century and the early twenty-first century witnessed significant developments in the fields of communications, computer hardware and software, and data encryption. Cut-off, powerful and inexpensive computing equipment enabled the processing of electronic data to be affordable and controlled by small companies and household users. These computers quickly became known as Internet or World Wide Web network connections. The fast-growing use of electronic data processing and e-commerce on the Internet, as well as the emergence of international terrorism, increased the demand for better protection of computers and their stored, processed and transmitted information.
title: 信息安全

source_text: 姚期智（；），男，汉族，湖北孝感人，生于上海，中国计算机科学家，2000年图灵奖得主，是目前唯一一位获得此奖项的华人。现任北京清华大学交叉信息研究院院长、北京清华大学理论计算机科学研究中心主任兼教授、香港中文大學博文講座教授、新竹國立清華大學榮譽講座，以及國立臺灣大學特聘研究講座教授。
target_text: Yao Xiaoji (;) male, Han, Hubei, born in Shanghai, China's Computer Scientist, winner of the 2000 Turing Award, is currently the only Chinese recipient of this award. Currently, he is the Director of the Qinghua University Institute of Cross-Congress Information in Beijing, the Director and Professor of the Centre for Theory Computer Science Research at Qinghua University in Beijing, the Lecturer in Bo, the Honorary Speaker at Qinghua University in Xinhua, and the Professor of Special Studies at the University of Taiwan.
title: 姚期智

source_text: 1967年，姚期智毕业于国立臺湾大学，获物理学学士学位。之后赴美国深造。1972年获哈佛大学物理学博士学位，1975年获伊利诺伊大学香槟分校（UIUC）计算机科学博士学位。之后，1975年9月至1976年8月任麻省理工学院数学系助理教授，1976年9月至1981年8月任斯坦福大学计算机系助理教授。1981年9月至1982年9月任加州大学伯克利分校计算机教授。1982年10月至1986年6月任斯坦福大学计算机系教授。1986年7月至2004年6月任普林斯顿大学计算机科学系William and Edna Macaleer工程与应用科学教授。
target_text: From September 1975 to August 1976, he was an Assistant Professor, Faculty of Mathematics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, and from September 1976 to August 1981, an Assistant Professor, Department of Computers, Stanford University. From September 1981 to September 1982, he was a Professor of Computers, Berkeley University of California. From October 1982 to June 1986, he was a Professor, Faculty of Computers, Stanford University. William and Edna Macaleer, Faculty of Computer Sciences, Princeton University, Professor of Engineering and Applied Sciences, July 1986 to June 2004.
title: 姚期智

source_text: 自版本8，Internet Explorer提供一个下载监视器和安装监视器，允许用户分两步选择是否下载和安装可执行程序。这可以防止恶意软件被安装。用Internet Explorer下载的可执行文件被操作系统标为潜在的不安全因素，每次都会要求用户确认他们是否想执行该程序，直到用户确认该文件为「安全为止」。
target_text: Since version 8, the Internet Explorer provides a download monitor and installs a monitor that allows users to choose whether to download and install an executable in two steps. This prevents malicious software from being installed. The executable document downloaded by the Internet Explorer is marked by the operating system as a potential insecurity factor, and users are asked to confirm whether they want to execute the program until the user confirms that the document is " secure " .
title: Internet Explorer

source_text: 長期以來，質數被認為在純數學以外的地方只有極少數的應用。到了1970年代，發明公共密鑰加密這個概念之後，情況改變了，質數變成了RSA加密演算法等一階演算法之基礎。自1951年以來，所有已知最大的質數都由電腦所發現。對更大質數的搜尋已在數學界以外的地方產生出興趣。網際網路梅森質數大搜索及其他用來尋找大質數的分散式運算計畫變得流行，在數學家仍持續與質數理論奮鬥的同時。
target_text: In the 1970s, when the concept of public key encryption was invented, the situation changed to become the foundation of a system of algorithms, such as RSA encryption algorithms. Since 1951, all the most known prime numbers have been discovered by computers. Searching for larger prime numbers has gained interest outside the digital world. The Internet mass search and other decentralized calculations used to search for mass numbers have become popular, at the same time as digitalists continue to fight for fundamentals.
title: 质数

source_text: 現代測試一般的數字是否為質數的方法可分成兩個主要類型，隨機（或「蒙特卡洛」）與確定性演算法。確定性演算法可肯定辨別一個數字是否為質數。例如，試除法即是個確定性演算法，因為若正確執行，該方法總是可以辨別一個質數為質數，一個合數為合數。隨機演算法一般比較快，但無法完全證明一個數是否為質數。這類測試依靠部分隨機的方法來測試一個給定的數字。例如，一測試在應用於質數時總是會通過，但在應用於合數時通過的機率為。若重復這個測試次，且每次都通過，則該數為合數的機率為，會隨著測試次數呈指數下滑，因此可越來越確信（雖然總是無法完全確信）該數為質數。另一方面，若測試曾失敗過，則可知該數為合數。
target_text: For example, the method of diagnosing is a positive algorithm, because, if properly performed, it can always identify a prime number and a combination. The method of calculating a number is generally faster, but it cannot be fully proved that a number is prime. The test relies on a partial method of testing a given number. For example, a test that is always passed when applying a prime number, but the probability that it is passed when applying a matching number is always positive. If the test is repeated, and it is always adopted, the number is equal to the number of times tested, and it is more certain (although it is always impossible to be fully sure) that the number is correct.
title: 质数

source_text: 確定性演算法不會將合數錯誤判定為質數。在實務上，最快的此類方法為橢圓曲線質數證明。其運算時間是透過實務分析出來的，不像最新的AKS質數測試，有已被嚴格證明出來的複雜度。確定性演算法通常較隨機演算法來得慢，所以一般會先使用隨機演算法，再採用較費時的確定性演算法。
target_text: The certainty algorithm does not determine the number of errors. In practice, the fastest such method is evidence of the mass of an elliptical curve. It operates over a period of time which, unlike the most recent AKS primer test, is highly proven in complexity. The certainty algorithm is usually slower than random algorithms, so random algorithms are usually used first, followed by cost-effective deterministic algorithms.
title: 质数

source_text: 幾個公開金鑰加密演算法，如RSA與迪菲－赫爾曼金鑰交換，都是以大質數為其基礎（如512位元的質數常被用於RSA裡，而1024位元的質數則一般被迪菲-赫爾曼金鑰交換所採用）。RSA依靠計算出兩個（大）質數的相乘會比找出相乘後的數的兩個質因數容易出許多這個假設。迪菲－赫爾曼金鑰交換依靠存在模冪次的有效演算法，但相反運算的離散對數仍被認為是個困難的問題此一事實。
target_text: Several public key encryption algorithms, such as RSA-Diffi-Helman key swaps, are based on mass numbers (e.g. 512-bit primers are often used in RSAs, while 1024-digit quality is generally used in Diffi-Helman key swaps). RSAs arithmetic of two (large) prime numbers can easily create this hypothesis than the two factors that have been multiplied. Diffi-Helman key swaps rely on effective algorithms for the existence of models, but the opposite is still considered a difficult question.
title: 质数

source_text: 中间件（），又譯中介軟體、中介層，是一类提供系统软件和应用软件之间连接、便于软件各部件之间的沟通的軟體，应用软件可以借助中间件在不同的技术架构之间共享信息与资源。中间件位于客户机服务器的操作系统之上，管理着计算资源和网络通信。
target_text: The intermediate software (which also translates intermediary software, intermedial layers) is a type of software that provides connectivity between system software and applications and facilitates communication between parts of the software. The application allows information and resources to be shared between different technological structures using intermediates. The intermediate is located on the operating system of the client server, managing computing resources and network communications.
title: 中间件

source_text: 中间件在现代信息技术应用框架如Web服务、面向服务的体系结构等中应用比较广泛，如数据库、Apache的Tomcat，IBM公司的WebSphere,BEA公司的WebLogic应用服务器，中创的InforSuite系列产品，金蝶的Apusic系列产品，东方通的Tong系列中间件等都属于中间件。严格来讲，中间件技术已经不局限于应用服务器、数据库服务器。围绕中间件，Apache组织、IBM、Oracle（BEA）、微软各自发展出了较为完整的软件产品体系。（Microsoft Servers微软公司的服务器产品）。
target_text: The intermediates are more widely used in modern IT application frameworks such as Web Services, service-oriented architecture, etc., such as databases, Tomcat of Apache, WebSphere of IBM, WebLogic application servers of BEA, medium-created InforSuite series products, Golden Flutters, Topong series intermediates, etc. Strictly speaking, intermediate technology is no longer limited to application servers, database servers. In the middle, the Appache organization, IBM, Oracle (BEA) and Microsoft have each developed a more complete software product system. (Microsoft Microsoft Microsoft server product).
title: 中间件

source_text: 中间件技术建立在对应用软件部分常用功能的抽象上，将常用且重要的过程调用、分布式组件、消息队列、事务、安全、连结器、商业流程、网络并发、HTTP服务器、Web Service等功能集于一身或者分别在不同品牌的不同产品中分别完成。一般认为在商业中间件及信息化市场主要存在微软阵营、Java阵营、开源阵营。阵营的区分主要体现在对下层操作系统的选择以及对上层组件标准的制订。
target_text: The intermediate technology is based on abstraction of commonly used and important processes, distributed components, message queues, services, security, connectors, business processes, network co-distributions, HTTP servers, Web Service, etc. are performed individually or separately in different products of different brands. It is considered that there are mainly Microsoft camps, Java camps, and open source camps in the commercial intermediate and information market.
title: 中间件

source_text:
中间件是软件，而且是一大类具有不同功能的软件，而不是一种具备某具体功能的软件；
中间件是伴随着网络而应运而生的；
中间件是应用软件与系统软件之间的“中介件”“介中软件”，起到支撑与连接作用；
中间件不是开发工具，但它具有开发、管理和部署的功能；
中间件是为应用软件服务的，应用软件是为最终用户服务的，最终用户并不直接使用中间件；
中间件不是大众消费类软件产品，除非是一个行业内的专业人士，普通消费者是不会接触中间件的；
在基础软件（操作系统、数据库、中间件）中，中间件是最不为人所了解的；
target_text: (c) The intermediate is a “intermediate” medium between the application software and the system software, which supports and connects;
title: 中间件

source_text:
整合运行环境：中间件能够屏蔽、弥合底层运行环境中的差异性与异构性，确保整个系统在异构平台间能够稳定运行；
提高开发效率：中间件能够提高开发效率，大幅缩短开发周期；
软件质量：中间件能够明晰系统内的不同层级，对接不同的可插拔方式，从而保障软件的质量；
节约成本：中间件可大幅节省应用系统内的系统资源，并减少运行成本。

source_text:
ATM 信元构造
ATM信元由5个八位位组标头和48个八位位组有效负载组成。
ATM有两种不同的信元标准: 网络到网络接口（Network-Network Interface，NNI）和用户到网络接口（User-Network Interface，UNI）。大多数ATM链路使用UNI信元格式。GFC：通用流量控制
VPI：虚拟路径标识符
VCI：虚拟频道标识符
PT：有效载荷类型
CLP：拥塞丢失优先级
HEC：错误控制部署与应用
ATM在20世纪90年代初受到电信公司和部分计算机制造商的青睐。然而，即使到了90年代末，基于互联网协议的产品仍比ATM有更好的性价比。
FORE Systems等公司专注于ATM产品，而其他大型厂商，如思科等，则仅将ATM视作一种额外的选择。
target_text: ATM Construct ATM is composed of five eight-bit group headers and 48 eight-bit payloads. ATM has two different standards: Network to Network Interface (Network-Network Interface, NNI) and User to Network Interface (User-Network Interface, UNI). Most ATM links use UNI message formats.

source_text:
举个例子来说，编写一个处理医生记录的app，这些记录的索引是核心模块，同时关于存储记录或用户信息的数据的历史日志，或者登录的验证系统，由于和app中大部分模块都有关系所以成为了‘横切关系’。背景
横切关系是那些和程序中大部分模块都有联系的部分，它们形成了切面开发的基础单元。这样的横切关系部分不能自然得适配面向对象编程理念和面向过程编程理念。
target_text: For example, the preparation of an app dealing with medical records, indexing of which is a core module, and a historical log of data on which records or user information are stored, or a log-in validation system, becomes a `cross-tangular' because it has a connection to most of the modules in the application. The cross-titling is part of those parts that are associated with most of the modules in the process, and they form the building blocks of the development. The cross-titling parts cannot naturally be matched with object-oriented programming and process-oriented programming concepts.
title: 横切关注点

source_text: 面向切面的程序设计（AOP）的目的是将这些横切关系封装进切面来保持程序的模块化，也就可以保持自然得模块独立性和处理横切关系代码的可复用性。通过这些对横切关系的设计处理，作为对于面向对象编程的一个补充，软件工程的模块化和维护简单化的优势仍然可以保持。
target_text: The purpose of AOP is to encrypt these cross-sectional relationships in order to preserve the modularization of the program, and to maintain the automatic modular independence of the module and the re-useability of the cross-sectional code. Through the design of these cross-sectional relationships, as a complement to object-oriented programming, the advantages of modularization and maintenance of simplicity in software engineering can still be maintained.

source_text: 範圍信息技术的研究包括科学、技术、工程与管理学等学科，这些学科在信息的管理、传递和处理中的应用，相关的软件和设备及其相互作用。信息技术的应用包括计算机硬件与软件、网络与通讯技术、应用软件开发工具等。计算机与互联网普及以来，人们日益普遍地使用计算机来生产、处理、交换与传播各种形式的信息（如书籍、商业文件、报刊、唱片、电影、电视节目、语音、图形、影像等）。
target_text: Research on the range of information technologies includes science, technology, engineering and management disciplines, applications in the management, transmission and processing of information, related software and equipment, and their interactions. Information technology applications include computer hardware and software, network and communications technology, application software development tools, etc. Since the spread of computers and the Internet, computers have increasingly been used to produce, process, exchange and disseminate information in all its forms (e.g. books, business documents, newspapers, records, films, television programmes, voice, graphics, images, etc.).
title: 信息技术

source_text: 在企业、学校和其它组织中，信息技术体系结构是为了达成战略目标，而采用和发展信息技术的综合结构。它包括管理和技术的成分。其管理成分包括使命、职能与信息需求、系统配置、和信息流程；技术成分包括用于实现管理体系结构的信息技术标准、规则等。由于计算机是信息管理的中心，计算机部门通常被称为「信息技术部门」。有些公司称这个部门为「信息服务」（IS）或「管理信息服务」（MIS）。另一些企业选择外包信息技术部门，以获得更好的效益。
target_text: In enterprises, schools, and other organizations, the IT architecture is designed to achieve strategic objectives by adopting and developing an integrated IT structure. It includes elements of management and technology. Its management components include mission, function and information needs, system configuration, and information flow; and technology components include information technology standards, rules, etc. that are used to achieve the structure of the management system. As computers are central to information management, the computer sector is often referred to as the " IT sector " . Some companies refer to this sector as "Information Services" (IS) or "Managing Information Services" (MIS). Others choose to outsource the IT sector in order to obtain better benefits.
title: 信息技术

source_text: GNU编译器套裝（，縮寫為GCC）是GNU計劃制作的一种优化编译器，支持各种编程語言、操作系统、计算机系统结构。该编译器是以GPL及LGPL許可證所發行的自由軟體，也是GNU計劃的关键部分，还是GNU工具链的主要組成部份之一。GCC（特别是其中的C语言编译器）也常被认为是跨平台编译器的事实标准。1985年由理查德·马修·斯托曼開始發展，現在由自由軟體基金會負責維護工作。截至2019年，GCC大约有1500万行代码，是现存最大的自由程序之一。 它在自由软件的发展中发挥了重要作用，不仅是一个工具，还是一个典例。
target_text: The GNU compiler suite (with an abbreviation to GCC) is an optimal compiler for programming languages, operating systems, and computer systems. The compiler is a free software that is licensed by GPL and LGPL, and is also a key part of the GNU scheme, and is one of the main components of the GNU tool chain. The GCC (especially its C-language compiler) is often considered a de facto standard for cross-platform compilers.
title: GCC

source_text: 原名為GNU C語言編譯器（），因為它原本只能處理C語言。同年12月，新的GCC编译器可以编译C++语言。后来又为Fortran、Pascal、Objective-C、Java、Ada，Go等其他語言开发了前端。C和C++编译器也支持OpenMP和OpenACC规范。GCC编译器已经被移植到比其他编译器更多的平台和指令集架构上，并被广泛部署在开发自由和专有软件的工具中。GCC还可用于许多嵌入式系统，包括基于ARM和的芯片。
target_text: In December of the same year, the new GCC compiler was able to compile C++ languages. It was developed for other languages such as Fortran, Pascal, Objective-C, Java, Ada, Go. The C and C++ compiler also supports OpenMP and OpenACC norms. The GCC compiler has been migrated to more platforms and command set structures than the other compilers and is widely deployed in tools for the development of free and proprietary software. GCC can also be used in many embedded systems, including ARM-based chips.
title: GCC

source_text: GCC于1987年3月22日在麻省理工学院的文件传输协议上发布，斯托曼被列为作者，也提及了其他人并感谢他们的贡献：Jack Davidson和Christopher Fraser给出了使用暫存器傳遞語言作为中间语言的思路；Paul Rubin为预处理器贡献良多；以及Leonard Tower写了“部分解析器、RTL生成器、RTL定义和Vax机器描述”。被誉为“自由软件第一击”的GNU编译器发布正值太阳微系统将其操作系统与其开发工具解绑，并提价单独出售。这使得许多客户购买或下载GCC而非供应商的工具。尽管斯托曼认为GNU Emacs是他的主要工程，但截至1990年，GCC支持13种电脑架构，性能比其他编译器优越并为商业所用。
target_text: GCC was published on 22 March 1987 in the MIT Document Transfer Agreement, and Storman was listed as the author, and others were mentioned and thanked for their contributions: Jack Davidson and Christopher Fraser gave ideas on the use of a memory transmitter to convey language as an intermediate language; Paul Rubin contributed much to the preprocessor; and Leonard Tower wrote “Partial Solver, RTL Generator, RTL Definition and Vax Machine Description.” The GNU translator known as the “Free Software First Strike” released its operating system and its development tools, untied and sold separately at a price. This enabled many clients to purchase or download GCC tools rather than suppliers. While Storman considered GNU Emacs to be his major project, by 1990 GCC supported 13 computer structures that were superior to other compilers and commercially available.
title: GCC

source_text: GCC已经被移植到各种指令集架构上，并被广泛部署为开发自由或专有软件的工具。GCC还可用于许多嵌入式系统，包括Symbian（称为gcce）、基于ARM和基于Power ISA的芯片。该编译器可以在各种平台上输出，包括游戏控制器中的PS2、Cell微处理器架构的PS3以及Dreamcast。相比于其他编译器，GCC编译器被部署在更多的操作系统和处理器上。
target_text: The GCC has been transplanted to various command set structures and has been widely deployed as a tool to develop free or proprietary software. GCC can also be used in a number of embedded systems, including Symbian (known as gcce), ARM-based and Power ISA-based chips. The compiler can output on various platforms, including PS2 in the game controller, PS3 in the Cell microprocessor structure, and Dreamcast. GCC compilers are deployed on more operating systems and processors than other compilers.
title: GCC

source_text: 它以编程语言的书写形式指明算法的职能。相比于程序语言（例如Java、C++、C、Delphi 等等）它更类似自然语言。它是-{zh-hans:半形式化;zh-hant:半形式化}-、不标准的语言。我们可以将整个算法运行过程的结构用接近自然语言的形式（这里可以使用任何一种作者熟悉的文字，例如中文、英文，重点是将程序的意思表达出来）描述出来。使用伪代码，可以帮助我们更好地表述算法，不用拘泥于具体的实现。
target_text: It indicates the function of the algorithm in the form of writing in programmed languages. It is more like a natural language than a program language (e.g. Java, C++, C, Delphi, etc.). It is - {zh-hans: semi-formalization; zh-hant: semi-formalization} - an irregular language. We can describe the structure of the entire algorithmic process in a form that is close to the natural language (where any text that the author is familiar with, such as Chinese and English, is focused on expressing the meaning of the program).
title: 伪代码

source_text: 人们在用不同的编程语言实现同一个算法时意识到，他们做出来的实现（而非功能）很不同。程序员要理解一个用他們并不熟悉的编程语言编写的程序，可能是很困难的，因为程序语言的形式限制了程序员对程序关键部分的理解，而伪代码可以用于帮助人们理解解释代码的语法、规则、内涵和结构。于是伪代码就这样应运而生了。
target_text: When one achieves the same algorithm in different programming languages, it is realized that the achievement (rather than function) is very different. It may be difficult for programmers to understand a program that is written in a programming language that they are not familiar with, because the form of the program language limits programmers' understanding of key parts of the program, and the pseudo-code can be used to help people understand the syntax, rules, content and structure that interpret the code.
title: 伪代码

source_text:
線路設計
印制电路板的设计是以电路原理图為藍本，實現電路使用者所需要的功能。印刷电路板的设计主要指版图设计，需要内部电子元件、金属连线、通孔和外部链接的佈局、电磁保护、热耗散、串音等各种因素。优秀的線路設計可以节约生产成本，达到良好的电路性能和散热性能。简单的版图设计可以用手工实现，但複雜的線路設計一般也需要借助计算机辅助设计（CAD）实现，而著名的設計軟體有OrCAD、Pads （也即PowerPCB）、Altium designer（也即Protel）、FreePCB、CAM350、AutoCAD以及开源软件KiCad等。
target_text: The design of the printed circuit board requires a variety of factors, such as internal electronic components, metal lines, vents and external links, electromagnetic protection, heat dissipation, and stringing. Excellent circuit design saves production costs and achieves good circuit and radiative performance. Simple layouts can be done manually, but complex circuit designs generally need to be done with computer-assisted design (CAD), while well-known software such as OrCAD, Pads (also PowerPCB), Altium Designer (also known as Protel), FreePCB, Cam350, AutoCAD, and the open source software KiCad.
title: 印制电路板

source_text:

KiCad —— 是用于印刷电路板设计的自由软件，最初由法国人Jean-Pierre Charras于1992年推出，现由KiCad开发者团队维护。KiCad目前支持英语、法语、德语、意大利语、中文、日语等23个语言版本。
立创EDA —— 由嘉立创印刷电路板板厂推出的网页在线印刷电路板设计工具，亦有离线版本。
target_text: The PCB design software Altium Designer - an integrated electronic product development system. OrCAD - an automated electronic design package for electronic engineers to design printed circuit boards. KiCad - a free software for printing circuit board design, initially launched in 1992 by Jean-Pierre Charras, a French national, and now maintained by a team of KiCad developers. KiCad currently supports 23 language versions in English, French, German, Italian, Chinese and Japanese.

计算稠密图的最小生成树最早是由羅伯特·C·普里姆在1957年发明的，即普里姆算法。之后艾兹赫尔·戴克斯特拉也独自发明了它。但该算法的基本思想是由于1930年发明的。所以该算法有时候也被称为亞爾尼克算法或者普里姆-亞爾尼克算法。20世纪70年代，优先队列发明之后很快被用在了寻找稀疏图中的最小生成树上。1984年，迈克尔·弗里德曼和罗伯特·塔扬发明了斐波那契堆，普里姆算法所需要的运行时间在理论上由提升到了。约瑟夫·克鲁斯卡尔在1956年发表了他的算法，在他的论文中提到了普里姆算法的一个变种，而在20世纪20年代的论文中就已经提到了该变种。M.Sollin在1961年重新发现了该算法，该算法后成为实现较好渐进性能的最小生成树算法和并行最小生成树算法的基础。
