source_text: 邱奇-图灵论题（，又称邱奇-图灵猜想，邱奇论题，邱奇猜想，图灵论题）是一个关于可计算性理论的假设。该假设论述了关于函数特性的，可有效计算的函数值（用更现代的表述来说--在算法上可计算的)。简单来说，邱奇-图灵论题认为“任何在算法上可计算的问题同样可由图灵机计算”。
target_text: The Coch-Turling (also known as the Coch-Turling conjecture, the Cochranic conjecture, the Curch conjecture, the Turing theory) is an assumption of the theory of numeracy. The hypothesis deals with functional values that can be effectively calculated (in more modern terms -- in algorithms). In simple terms, the Coch-Turinian theory says that “any problem that can be calculated in algorithms can also be calculated by the Turing machine”.
title: 邱奇-图灵论题

source_text: 这三个理论在直觉上似乎是等价的--它们都定义了同一类函数。因此，计算机科学家和数学家们相信，可计算性的精确定义已经出现。邱奇-图灵论题的非正式表述说：如果某个算法是可行的，那这个算法同样可以被图灵机，以及另外两个理论所实现。
target_text: So computer scientists and mathematicians believe that the precise definition of numeracy has emerged. The unofficial expression of the Cochrane-Turing theory says that, if an algorithm is feasible, it can also be realized by the Turing Machine and two other theories.
title: 邱奇-图灵论题

source_text: 已知的三种计算过程（递归，λ演算和图灵机）都是等价的--这三种方法定义了同一类函数。这导致数学家和计算机科学家相信可计算性的概念可由上述三种等价的计算过程描述。简单来讲，邱奇-图灵论题认为如果某种方法（算法）可进行运算，那么该运算也可被图灵机执行（也可被递归定义的函数或λ函数执行）。
target_text: All three of the known computational processes (relative, arithmetic and tactile) are price-equal -- these three methods define the same type of function. This leads mathematicians and computer scientists to believe that the concept of numeracy can be described by the calculation process of the above-mentioned three equivalents.
title: 邱奇-图灵论题

source_text: 之后用于描述有效计算的许多其他机制也被提了出来，比如寄存器机、埃米尔·波斯特（Emill Post）的波斯特系统，组合子逻辑以及马尔可夫算法（Markov 1960）等。所有这些体系都已被证明在计算上和图灵机拥有基本相同的能力；类似的系统被称为图灵完全。因为所有这些不同的试图描述算法的努力都导致了等价的结果，所以现在普遍认为邱奇－图灵论题是正确的。但是，该论题不具有数学定理一般的地位，也无法被证明；說是定理不如說是個將可計算性等同於圖靈機的提議。如果能有一个方法能被普遍接受为一个有效的算法但却无法在图灵机上允许，则该论题也是可以被驳斥的。
target_text: Many other mechanisms used to describe effective calculations have since been mentioned, such as the sender machine, the Emill Post's Porsche system, the combination logic and the Markov algorithm 1960. All these systems have been shown to have essentially the same capabilities in computing as the Turing machine; similar systems are known as Turing. Because all these different attempts to describe algorithms have led to an equal value, it is now generally accepted that the Kuch-Tulling issue is correct.
title: 邱奇-图灵论题

source_text:
宇宙是一台图灵机（由此，在物理上对非递归函数的计算是不可能的）。该论述被定义为大邱奇－图灵论题。
宇宙不是一台图灵机（也就是说，物理的定律不是图灵可计算的），但是不可计算的物理事件却不能阻碍创建超计算机（hypercomputer）的可能性。比如，一个在物理上包含实数而非可计算实数的宇宙就可以被划为此类。
宇宙是一台超计算机，而且建造物理设备来实现这一特性并以之计算非递归函数是可能的。比如，一个悬而未决的问题是我们无法确定量子力学（quantum mechanical）的事件是否图灵可计算的，尽管诸如量子图灵机之类的严格模型实际上等价于确定性图灵机（但并不一定在效率上等价）。约翰·卢卡斯和名气更大一点的羅傑·潘洛斯曾经建议说人的心灵可能是量子力学和非算法计算的结果， 尽管并没有科学证据支持这一提议。
target_text: The universe is an engine (and thus physically impossible to calculate a non-reciprocal function). The discussion is defined as the Great Coop-Turing issue. The universe is not a Turing machine (that is, the laws of physics are not measurable), but uncalculable physical events cannot prevent the possibility of creating a hypercomputer (hypercomputer).
title: 邱奇-图灵论题

source_text: 有一些模型可用于计算（邱奇-图灵）不可计算函数：即所谓的超计算机。Mark Burgin认为类似归纳性图灵机的超递归算法（super-recursive algorithms）可用于反证邱奇-图灵论题。他的论述依赖于对算法更广泛的定义， 这种定义上的扩展使得一些归纳性图灵机包含的不可计算函数变得可计算。这种对邱奇-图灵论题的解读与计算机科学的常规解读不同，把超递归算法归于邱奇-图灵意义上的算法的这种看法并未受到相关领域的广泛接受。
target_text: There are models that can be used to calculate non-calculable functions (Kuchchi-Tuling): so-called supercomputers. Mark Burgin believes that super-reciprocal algorithms, similar to the summation machines, can be used to counter the Quic-Turling theory. His discussion relies on a broader definition of algorithms, an extension of which makes the non-calculable functions contained in some of the concrets to be computeable. This interpretation of the Kew-Turling issue is different from that of computer science, and it is not widely accepted in the field.
title: 邱奇-图灵论题

source_text: 小型计算机系统接口（，）是一种用于计算机及其週邊設備之间（硬盘、软驱、光驱、打印机、扫描仪等）系统级接口的独立处理器标准。SCSI標準定義命令、通訊協定以及實體的電氣特性（換成OSI的說法，就是佔據實體層、連結層、通訊層、應用層），最大部份的應用是在儲存設備上（例如硬碟、磁帶機），除外，SCSI可以連接的設備包括有掃描器、光學裝置（像CD、DVD）、印表機等等，SCSI命令中有條列出支援的裝置SCSI週邊裝置。理論上，SCSI不可能連接所有的裝置，所以有“1Fh - unknown or no device type”這個參數存在。
target_text: Small computer system interfaces (i.e.,) are independent processor standards for system-level interfaces between computers and their peripherals (hard disks, floppy drives, optical drives, printers, scanners, etc.). SCSI standard definition commands, communication protocols, and physical electrical properties (as described in the change to OSI, i.e., capture the physical layer, connection layers, communication layers, applications) with the largest portion of applications on storage devices (e.g. hard disks, tape recorders, etc.), except for those that SCSI can connect with, for example, scanners, optical devices (like CDs, DVDs, printers, etc.), the SCSI command contains a list of supported device SCSI perimeter devices. In theory, SCSI cannot connect to all devices, so the reference “1Fh-unkunown or nodevice type” exists.
title: 小型计算机系统接口

source_text: 涉及编程的一系列职业，如（软件）开发人员、网络开发人员、流動應用程式开发人员、嵌入式韌體开发人员、软件工程师、電腦科學家、游戏程序师、游戏开发人员和，通常还需要一系列其他类似的技能。用程序员这个词来指代这些职位，有时被认为是一种侮辱性的简化，甚至是贬损。
target_text: A range of occupations involved in programming, such as (software) developers, network developers, mobile application developers, embedded software developers, software engineers, computer scientists, game programmers, game developers and other similar skills are often required. The term programmer is used to refer to these positions, which is sometimes perceived as an insulting simplification or even a demeanor.
title: 程序员

source_text: 计算机程序员编写、测试、调试和维护被称为计算机程序的详细指令，计算机必须遵循这些指令来执行它们的功能。程序员还构思、设计和测试用计算机解决问题的逻辑结构。编程领域的许多技术创新——先进的计算技术、复杂的新语言和编程工具——重新定义了程序员的角色，提升了当今许多编程工作。职位名称和描述可能会有所不同，取决于组织。
target_text: Computer programmers prepare, test, debug and maintain detailed instructions known as computer programs, and computers must follow them to perform their functions. The programmers also conceptualize, design and test the logical structure of computer problem solving. Many technological innovations in programming — advanced computing techniques, complex new language and programming tools — redefine the role of programmers and upgrade many programming today. Job titles and descriptions may vary depending on the organization.
title: 程序员

source_text: 程序员在许多环境中工作，包括企业信息技术（“IT”）部门、大型软件公司、小型服务公司和各种规模的政府实体。许多专业程序员也以独立承包人的身份在客户现场为咨询公司工作。程序员通常不需要有从业执照就可以工作，但他们一般都会持有專業認證。编程被广泛认为是一个專業（但有些权威机构不同意这个看法，他们认为只有那些法律上规定要有从业执照的职业才能叫做专业）。
target_text: Programmers work in many environments, including business information technology (IT) departments, large software companies, small service companies, and government entities of various sizes. Many professional programmers also work as independent contractors on-site for consulting firms. Programmers usually do not need a license to work, but they usually have a professional accreditation. Programming is widely considered a profession (although some authorities do not agree with this view, they believe that only professions that legally require a licence to practise can be called professions).
title: 程序员

source_text: 程序员根据主要由高级程序员和系统分析员确定的规范编写程序。在设计过程完成后，程序员的工作就是将设计转换成计算机可以遵循的一系列逻辑指令。程序员用众多编程语言中的一种来编写这些指令。根据用途的不同，会使用不同的编程语言。例如，COBOL通常用于通常在大型和中型计算机上运行的业务应用程序，而Fortran则用于科学和工程。C++和Python广泛用于科学和商业应用程序。Java、C#、JS与PHP是Web和商业应用程序的流行编程语言。程序员通常了解一种以上的编程语言，因为许多语言是相似的，他们通常可以相对容易地学习新的语言。在实际中，通常会用程序员们了解的语言来描述程序员，比如，Java程序员，或者用他们所扮演的角色或他们的工作环境来描述：比如，数据库程序员、大型机程序员、Web开发人员等。
target_text: For example, COBOL is usually used for business applications that are usually run on large and medium computers, while Fortran is used for science and engineering. C++ and Python are used extensively for scientific and commercial applications. Java, C#, JS and PHP are popular programming languages for Web and commercial applications. Programmers usually know more than one programming language because many languages are similar, and they usually learn new languages relatively easily. In practice, programmers, such as Java programmers, or their roles or working environments, are used to describe programmers.
title: 程序员

source_text:
应用程序与系统编程
计算机程序员通常分为两大类：应用程序员和系统程序员。应用程序员编写程序来处理特定的工作，例如在组织内跟踪库存的程序。他们还可以修改现有的套装软件（），或定制通常从独立软件供应商购买的通用应用程序。相比之下，系统程序员编写程序来维护和控制计算机系统软件，如操作系统和数据库管理系统。这些工作人员对指令进行更改，这些指令决定了系统的网络、工作站和CPU如何处理给定的各种作业，以及如何与打印机和磁盘驱动器等外围设备通信。
target_text: Applications and system programming Computer programmers are usually divided into two main categories: application clerks and systems programmers. Application clerks prepare programs to deal with specific tasks, such as procedures for tracking inventories within the organization. They can also modify existing packages () or customize generic applications that are usually purchased from independent software providers. By contrast, system programmers prepare programs to maintain and control computer system software, such as operating systems and database management systems. These staff change instructions, which determine how systems networks, workstations and CPUs deal with assigned operations, and how they communicate with peripheral equipment such as printers and disk drives.
title: 程序员

source_text:
资格和技能
软件开发人员需要在计算机技术的某些方面具有深厚的技术专长。有些职位需要相关领域的学位，如计算机科学、信息技术、工程、编程或任何其他与IT相关的研究生学习。 一个理想的软件开发人员是一个自我激励的专业人员，在诸如C++、C#、PHP、Java、C、JavaScript、Visual Basic、Python、Smalltalk等关键编程语言上拥有动态的动手实践经验。
target_text: Some positions require degrees in related fields, such as computer science, information technology, engineering, programming, or any other IT-related postgraduate studies. An ideal software developer is a self-motivated professional with dynamic hands-on experience in key programming languages such as C++, C#, PHP, Java Java, JavaScript, Visual Basic, Python, and Smalltalk.
title: 程序员

source_text: 根据开发人员Eric Sink的说法，系统设计、软件开发和编程之间的差异更加明显。在当前的市场环境中，程序员和开发人员之间已经存在隔离，因为实现程序的人和设计类结构或层次结构的人是不一样的。开发人员成为或系统架构师（即设计大型软件系统的多层体系结构或组件交互的架构师）后，差异会更大。
target_text: According to the developer Eric Sink, the differences between system design, software development and programming are even more pronounced. In the current market environment, there is already a segregation between programmers and developers, as the person who achieves the program and the structure or hierarchy of the design class is different.
title: 程序员

source_text:
软件类型
软件开发公司的程序员可以直接与来自不同领域的专家合作来开发软件，包括为特定客户设计的程序或通用的套装软件，从电子游戏到教育软件，再到用于桌面出版和财务规划的程序。套装软件的编程是计算机服务行业增长最快的部分之一。一些公司或组织，即使是小公司，也建立了自己的IT团队，以确保内部软件的设计和开发能够满足内部最终用户非常特殊的需求，特别是在现有软件不适合或成本太高的情况下。研究中心的情况就是如此。
target_text: Software types Software developers programmers can work directly with experts from different fields to develop software, including programs or generic packages designed for specific customers, from video games to educational software to programs for desktop publishing and financial planning. The programming of packaged software is one of the fastest growing components of the computer services industry. Some companies or organizations, even small ones, have established their own IT teams to ensure that internal software is designed and developed to meet the very specific needs of internal end-users, especially when existing software is not suitable or costly.
title: 程序员

source_text: 在一些组织中，特别是小型组织中，通常被称为程序员分析师的人同时负责系统分析和实际的编程工作。从大型机环境过渡到主要基于个人电脑（PC）的环境，模糊了曾经严格的程序员和用户之间的区别。越来越多的熟练的终端用户正在接管许多以前由程序员执行的任务。例如，越来越多地使用套装软件，如电子表格和数据库管理软件包，让用户可以编写简单的程序来访问数据和执行计算。
target_text: In some organizations, especially small ones, people commonly referred to as programmer analysts are also responsible for systems analysis and practical programming. The transition from a large machine environment to an environment based primarily on personal computers (PCs) obscures the distinction between programmers and users that was once strict. A growing number of skilled end-users are taking over many of the tasks previously performed by programmers. For example, there is an increasing use of package software, such as spreadsheets and database management packages, allowing users to develop simple programs to access data and perform calculations.
title: 程序员

source_text: 除一般的结构材料外，一些高分子材料还具有光电磁等性能。例如在制造集成电路時高分子感光材料在光刻过程中被大量使用。导电高分子材料和有机半导体打开了单分子电路的大门。有机发光半导体材料为显示器件打开了一个大幅度降低成本的大门。高分子压电材料则为力与电的转换提供了新的途径。高分子热电材料则提供了新的热电转换途径。
target_text: In addition to general structural materials, some high-molecular materials have photomagnetic properties. For example, high-molecular light-sense materials are used extensively during the manufacture of integrated circuits. High-molecular materials and organic semiconductors open the door to single-molecular circuits. Organic luminous semiconductor materials open a door to displays that significantly reduce costs.
title: 高分子材料

source_text:
低介電係數材料
低介电常数材料（low-K材料）是当前半导体行业研究的热门话题。通过降低積體电路中使用的介电材料的介電係數，可以降低積體电路的漏电电流，降低导线之间的电容效应，降低集成电路发热等等。低介电常数材料的研究是同高分子材料密切相关的。传统半导体使用二氧化硅作为介电材料，二氧化硅的介電係數约为4。真空的介電係數为1，干燥空气的介電係數接近于1。
target_text: Low-mediativity materials Low-medial constant materials (low-K materials) are the subject of current research in the semiconductor industry. By reducing the number of intermediates used in the block circuits, it can reduce the number of electrical leaks in the block circuits, reduce the power flow between the conductors, reduce the heat of the integrated circuits, etc. The study of low-medial constant materials is closely related to high-molecular materials. The traditional semi-conductor uses silicon dioxide as a medium, with the number of intermediates for silicon dioxide being approximately 4.
title: 高分子材料

source_text:
1940年1月出生于中国江苏省常州市。
1956年9月进入南京航空学院学习，次年进入南京工学院（今东南大学）自动控制系计算技术专业学习。
1962年8月毕业后留校任教。
1987年起担任中国国家“863”高技术计划自动化领域CIMS主题第一、二、四届专家组成员和第三届自动化领域专家委员，兼任网络专题责任专家。
1993年研究高性能计算机网络协议，成为国际XTP（快捷传输协议）论坛成员。
1994年9月，江苏省成为国家第一个CIMS推广应用试点省份，由顾冠群担任专家组长。
1997年10月（至2006年6月）担任东南大学校长。
1997年11月当选为中国工程院院士。
2007年5月26日，顾冠群在南京逝世，终年67岁。
target_text: Born in January 1940 in Changzhou City, Jiangsu Province, China; Joined the Nanjing Aviation Academy in September 1956, and joined the Department of Automated Control in Calculatory Technology the following year in the Nanjing Institute of Technology (now South East University). Graduated in August 1962, he has been a teacher since 1987, serving as head of the country's first, second and fourth Panel of Experts in the field of CIMS automation in the “863” high-technology programme of the State of China and as a member of the third Panel of Experts in the field of automation, as well as as as an expert on network responsibilities; The 1993 Agreement on Research on High-performance Computer Networks became a member of the International XTP (fast-track transmission) Forum; Jiangsu became the country's first CIMS pilot province in September 1994, headed by the Group of Experts; was elected President of the South-East University in October 1997 (until June 2006).
title: 顾冠群

title: 顾冠群

source_text: 主要研究方向：计算机系统、计算机网络、开放式网络技术和网络工程、计算机集成制造系统（CIMS）。他作为中方首席专家主持了中国—欧共体合作项目“江苏省计算机应用网络”，并积极参加筹建了中国科研网和中国教育科研网。在《计算机学报》、《软件学报》、《计算机研究与发展》、《通信学报》等中国核心期刊上发表论文80余篇，出版专著五本。培养博士18名，硕士60名。
target_text: Main research directions: computer systems, computer networks, open network technology and network engineering, and computer integrated manufacturing systems (CIMS). He chaired the China-EC cooperation project “Computer Applications Network in Jiangsu Province”, and actively participated in the preparation of the Chinese Scientific Research Network and China's Educational Research Network. More than 80 papers and five monographs were published in China's core periodicals, such as Computer Journal, Software Journal, Computer Research and Development, Communications Journal, etc.
title: 顾冠群

source_text:
1965年研制成中国大陆第一台晶体管数字积分机（主要人员）
1976年起转向计算机网络研究和教学，是中国大陆为数不多的最早从事计算机网络研究及教学的研究人员之一
1980年编著中国大陆第一本计算机网络统编教材《计算机网络》
1988年开发出X25通信控制器。
1994年组织江苏省21家CIMS试点单位应用工程的开展。
target_text: The first transistor digital branch (principal personnel) in 1965 was developed in mainland China; the shift to computer network research and teaching began in 1976 and was one of the few first researchers to engage in computer network research and teaching in mainland China; the first computer network in mainland China, the Computer Network, was compiled in 1980; the X25 communications controller was developed in 1988; and the application of 21 CIMS pilot units in Jiangsu Province was organized in 1994.
title: 顾冠群

source_text:
数字化包括政府管理, 信息和通讯技术 (ICT),(BPR)和 电子公民等，包括国际、国家、省级、市级各级政府。电子政务定义
‘电子政务' (或称数字政务)是指‘使用因特网或互联网发布政府信息、服务给公民的形式’。'电子政务'(或称'电子政府')一般指‘利用信息技术、通讯技术、互联网通讯等提供和/或改进公共部门提供服务水平、效率的形式’ (Jeong, 2007).
target_text: Digitalization includes government administration, information and communication technology (ICT), (BPR) and e-civics, including international, national, provincial and municipal levels of government. E-government definition `e-government' (or digital government) means `the form in which government information and services are delivered to citizens using the Internet'. `E-government' (or `e-government') generally means `the use of information technology, communication technology, Internet communications, etc. to provide and/or improve the level and efficiency of services provided by the public sector' (Jeng, 2007).
title: 电子政务

source_text:
电子政务是指用科技提高政府的效率，拓宽政府信息和服务发布。电子政务，或称电子政府，很多用到互联网或非互联网的应用程序协助政府工作。
除了电话、传真外，电子政务是指政府用到其他电子设备，例如监控系统，跟踪系统，RFID标签，甚至电视、广播、雷达对政府的信息和服务及时发布给公民。
target_text: E-government refers to the use of technology to improve the efficiency of government and to expand the dissemination of government information and services. E-government, or e-government, uses many applications that assist governments with Internet or non-Internet applications. In addition to telephones, faxes, e-government refers to the use of other electronic devices by governments, such as surveillance systems, tracking systems, RFID labels, and even television, radio, and radar for the timely release of government information and services to citizens.
title: 电子政务

source_text:
非互联网电子政务
虽然电子政务一般指"在线政府"或"因特网政府"，但很多非互联网形式的"电子政务"科技也在广泛应用。非因特网电子政务包括电话、传真、个人数字助手（PDA）、短信息（SMS）、彩信（MMS）、无线网络和服务、蓝牙、闭路电视（CCTV）、跟踪系统、RFID、生物识别技术, 道路交通管理、法律法规、身份证, 智能卡和其他近场通讯应用程序; 投票站科技 (英国正在考虑采用非在线电子投票), 电视和广播发布政府服务(例如，操作控制系统中继软件，英文Control System Middleware for operator functioning (CSMW))、email、在线社区、新闻组和电子邮件列表、在线聊天、即时消息等科技。
target_text: While non-Internet e-government generally refers to "online government" or "Internet government," many non-Internet-based "e-government" technologies are also widely used. Non-Internet e-government includes telephones, faxes, personal digital assistants (PDA), short messages (SMS), colour mail (MMS), wireless networks and services, Bluetooth, closed-circuit television (CCTV), tracking systems, RFID, biometric technologies, road traffic management, laws and regulations, identity cards, smart cards and other near-field communication applications; Voting station technology (the United Kingdom is considering the use of off-line electronic voting), television and radio publishing government services (e.g., follow-on software in the operating control system, English Contractor for operating information (CSMW)), e-mail, online communities, news groups and e-mail lists, online chats, in-time news, etc.
title: 电子政务

source_text: 公众态度很多实验性的电子政务得到了民众的广泛接受和渴望。公民参与在线讨论政治话题，特别是年轻人，传统上对政治和政府工作不感兴趣，现在也加入了电子投票的流程。尽管互联网政府程序被批评缺乏可靠的隐私政策，研究表明，比起个人隐私，公众更偏向于揭发犯罪行为。90%的美国成年人同意使用互联网追踪罪犯，57%愿意牺牲一部分个人隐私，前提是能方便政府追查犯罪和恐怖分子。
target_text: Although Internet government processes have been criticized for lack of reliable privacy policies, research has shown that the public prefers to expose crime than private ones. Ninety% of American adults agree to use the Internet to track criminals and 57% are willing to sacrifice some of their privacy, provided that it is easy for governments to track down crime and terrorists.
title: 电子政务

source_text: 運行環境是一種介乎编译器及直译器的執行方式。大多数编程语言都有某种形式的运行时系统，提供程序运行的环境。这个环境可以解决许多问题，包括应用程序内存的管理、程序如何访问变量、程序之间传递参数的机制、与操作系统的接口等问题。编译器根据具体的运行时系统做出假设，以生成正确的代码。通常情况下，运行时系统将承担一些设置和管理堆和栈的责任，并可能包括诸如垃圾回收、线程或其他内置于语言中的动态功能。
target_text: The operating environment is a way of running between compilers and translators. Most programming languages have some form of running-time system that provides an environment in which the program operates. This environment solves many problems, including the administration of application memory, how the program accesss variables, the mechanism for transferring parameters between programs, and the interface with the operating system. The compiler makes assumptions based on the specific running-time system to generate the correct code.
title: 运行时系统

source_text: MySQL（官方發音為“My S-Q-L”，但也经常被读作“My Sequel”）原本是一個開放源碼的關聯式資料庫管理系統，原開發者為瑞典的MySQL AB公司，该公司于2008年被昇陽微系統（Sun Microsystems）收购。2009年，甲骨文公司（Oracle）收购昇陽微系統公司，MySQL成为Oracle旗下产品。MySQL在過去由于性能高、成本低、可靠性好，已经成为最流行的开源数据库，因此被廣泛地應用在Internet上的中小型網站中。随着MySQL的不断成熟，它也逐渐用于更多大规模网站和应用，比如维基百科、Google和Facebook等网站。非常流行的开源软件组合LAMP中的“M”指的就是MySQL。
target_text: MySQL (officially pronunciation “My S-Q-L” but also often read as “My Sequel” is an open source related database management system, originally developed by MySQL AB, Sweden, which was acquired in 2008 by Sun Microsystems. In 2009, Oracle acquired Oracle and MySQL became a product under the Oracle flag. MySQL was in the past known as MySQL, which had become the most popular open-source database in Sweden because of its high performance, low cost and reliability, and was therefore widely used on small and medium-sized websites on the Internet. As MySQL matures, it has also gradually been used for a larger number of websites and applications, such as Wikipedia, Google and Facebook.
title: MySQL

source_text: MySQL的license现在分为免费的社区版与收费的标准版、企业版等。一般说来，如果在非开源项目中发布了MySQL，或者需要Oracle公司提供对MySQL的技术支持，或者使用MySQL的一些企业版工具或插件，或者修改MySQL源代码并作为闭源的软件等等情形，需要购买商业版本。如果只是安装并使用MySQL，甚至修改并使用MySQL，无论是否收费；或者软件中不包含MySQL，软件的用户自行安装MySQL；或者使用GPL协议的开源软件产品中包含了MySQL，这些情形可能使用社区版MySQL。
target_text: MySQL is now divided into free community and fee standard, business and so on. Generally, if MySQL is published in a non-open-source project, or if Oracle provides technical support to MySQL, or uses some of MySQL ' s business version tools or plugins, or changes MySQL source code and closed-source software, etc., it is necessary to purchase a commercial version. If MySQL is installed and used, or even modify and use MySQL, regardless of the cost; or if the software does not contain MySQL, the users of the software install MySQL themselves; or if MySQL is included in the open-source software product using the GPL protocol, these situations may use the community version MySQL.
title: MySQL

source_text: 我们可以构造出一个特殊的图灵机，它接受任意一个图灵机的编码，然后模拟圖靈機的运作，这样的图灵机称为通用图灵机（Universal Turing Machine）。现代电子计算机的计算模型其实就是这样一种通用图灵机，它先接受一段描述另一图灵机，例如圖靈機的action table的字串，然後运行寫給圖靈機的程序，這樣通用圖靈機執行程序就像圖靈機一樣，能正確執行並实现程序所描述的算法。
target_text: We can construct a special Turing machine that accepts the code of any one of the Turing machines, and then simulates the operation of the Turing machine, which is called the Universal Turing Machine. A modern computer computing model is actually such a general Turing machine, which first accepts a string that describes another Turing machine, such as the action table, and then runs a program written to the Turing Machine, so that the General Engine executes the program as if it were an engine that correctly executes and implements the algorithms described by the program.
title: 图灵机

source_text: NEC为商业企业、通信服务提供信息技术（）和网络产品。它的经营范围主要分成三个部分：解决方案、网络解决方案和电子设备。解决方案主要是向商业企业和个人用户提供软件、硬件和相关服务。网络解决方案主要是设计和提供宽带系统、移动和无线通信网络系统、移动电话、广播和其他系统。NEC的电子设备包括半导体、显示器以及其他的电子器件。NEC还生产面向国际市场的系列笔记本电脑和面向日本国内市场的系列笔记本电脑。NEC还是地球模拟器的发明者，它曾经是世界上最快的超级计算机。
target_text: The NEC provides information technology (IT) and network products for commercial enterprises, communications services. Its scope of operation is divided into three main components: solutions, network solutions and electronic equipment. The solutions are mainly software, hardware and related services for commercial enterprises and individual users. The NET solutions are mainly the design and provision of broadband systems, mobile and wireless communication network systems, mobile phones, radio and other systems. The NEC electronic equipment consists of semiconductors, monitors, and other electronic devices. NEC also produces a series of laptop computers for international markets and a series of laptops for Japan’s domestic market.
title: 日本電氣

source_text: 1994年，推出PC-FX遊戲主機。1996年，日本电气欧洲有限公司C&C研究所在德国开张；日本电气（中国）有限公司作为中国业务的控股公司成立。1997年，NEC推出4G的动态随机存取存储器（DRAM），同时公司的半导体团队被授予第一届日本质量奖（Japan Quality Awards）。1998年，NEC的世界最先进的半导体研发中心落成。
target_text: In 1994, the PC-FX game host was launched. In 1996, the C&C Institute of Electricity and Europe Ltd. of Japan opened in Germany; the Electric (China) Ltd. of Japan was established as a holding company for Chinese operations. In 1997, the NEC launched the Dynamic Random Access Repository (DRAM) of 4G, while the company’s semiconductor team was awarded the first Japanese Quality Award (Japan Quality Awards). In 1998, the NEC’s world’s most advanced semiconductor research and development centre was inaugurated.
title: 日本電氣

source_text:
蛋白质组学的实际应用
人类基因和蛋白质研究的一个主要发展是鉴定用于治疗疾病的潜在新药。这依赖于基因组和蛋白质组信息来识别与疾病相关的蛋白质，然后计算机软件可以将其用作新药物的靶标。例如，如果某种蛋白质与疾病有关，则其3D结构提供了设计药物以干扰蛋白质作用的信息。适合酶的活性位点但不能被酶释放的分子使酶失活。这是新药物发现工具的基础，旨在寻找新的药物来灭活与疾病有关的蛋白质。由于发现个体之间存在遗传差异，研究人员希望利用这些技术开发出对个体更有效的个人化药物。
target_text: A major development in human genetic and protein research is the identification of potential new drugs for the treatment of diseases. This relies on genome and protein-based information to identify proteins associated with the disease, which computer software can then use as targets for new drugs. For example, if a protein is associated with the disease, its 3D structure provides information on the design of drugs to interfere with proteins. The molecules suitable for enzyme active sites but not released by enzyme cause the enzyme to lose their enzyme. This is the basis for a new drug discovery tool designed to find new drugs to kill proteins associated with the disease. Because of genetic differences between individuals, researchers want to use these technologies to develop more effective personalized drugs for individuals.
title: 蛋白质组学

source_text: Gentoo Linux（）是一種Linux操作系统，基于Portage包管理系统，而擁有幾乎無限制的適應性特性，被官方稱作元发行版（meta-distribution），支持多達10種以上的電腦系統結構平台。此项目和它的产品以巴布亚企鵝命名。Gentoo包管理系统的设计是模块化、可移植、易维护、灵活以及针对用户机器优化的。软件包从源代码构建，这延续了ports的传统。但是为了方便，也提供一些大型软件包在多种架构的预编译二进制文件，用户亦可自建或使用第三方二进制包镜像来直接安装二进制包。
target_text: Gentoo Linux() is a Linux operating system based on the Portage package management system, with almost unlimited adaptation features, officially known as meta-distrition, which supports more than 10 computer system architecture platforms. This project and its products are named after Papua penguins. The Gentoo package management system is designed to be modular, portable, easy to maintain, flexible and optimized for users. The software package is built from source code, which perpetuates the tradition of Ports. However, for convenience, some large software packages are pre-made and translated into binary files in a variety of structures, and users can build or use third-party two-pack mirrors to directly install bins.
title: Gentoo Linux

source_text:
优点
与大多数GNU/Linux发行版本不同，Gentoo Linux为用户提供了大量的应用程序源代码。Gentoo Linux的每一部分都可以在最终用户的系统上重新编译建造，甚至包括最基本的系统库和编译器自身。
通过依赖关系描述和源代码镜像的形式提供软件，Gentoo Linux提供了大量软件供用户选择。
标准的源代码镜像包括162G(2012年8月14日,镜像中distfiles目录)的数据。
选择不仅在软件整体方面，也存在于软件的内部。由于可以在本地编译软件，参数和变量的选择可以由用户自己指定。
target_text: Unlike most GNU/Linux releases, Gentoo Linux provides users with a large number of application source codes. Each part of Gentoo Linux can be reconstructed on the end-user system, including even the most basic system repository and compiler itself. By relying on relationship descriptions and source code mirrors, Gentoo Linux provides a large number of software options for users.
title: Gentoo Linux

source_text:
指定参数的优势不仅在于用户了解了设置，更多是增加了针对硬件进行性能提升的余地。
而且用户可以使用自己喜欢的补丁或插件对软件功能进行调整，比如当前的Gentoo Linux内核发布包括15种。由于系统及应用软件的安装方法差异显著，Gentoo Linux社区对安装内容的探讨相当深入。即便不使用
Gentoo Linux的用户也可以通过了解参数选择明白软件内部的设定。应用软件的配置设定都记录在ebuild文件中，由ebuild、emerge命令管理。
target_text: The advantage of the specified parameters is not only that users understand the settings, but also that there is more room for performance enhancement for hardware. Also, users can adjust the software functionality using their favorite patches or plugins, such as the current Gento Linux kernel release, which includes 15 items.
title: Gentoo Linux

source_text:
局限
安裝Gentoo Linux對計算機系統的效能也有較高的要求，包括CPU和記憶體，不过随着计算机产业的快速发展，即使中低端PC和笔记本也能较为快速地完成编译。當然這不意味着Gentoo Linux不能使用在低配置設備上，只是用戶將會在安裝相同的环境時会付出更多時間，或者使用另一台主机上预编译好的软件包（BINHOST方式）。所以，对于低配置的用户，软件包的挑选尤为重要。
target_text: Limited installation of Gentoo Linux has higher requirements for the efficiency of the computer system, including CPUs and memory, but even low- and middle-level PCs and notebooks can be compiled relatively quickly as the computer industry develops fast. This does not mean, of course, that Gentoo Linux cannot be used on low-configured devices, except that users will spend more time installing the same environment, or pre-compiled software packages on another mainframe (BINHOST). So, the selection of packages is particularly important for low-configured users.
title: Gentoo Linux

source_text:
USE标志
全局USE标志的设置位于Gentoo系统的/etc/portage/make.conf中，作用是使得emerge在处理依赖关系的时候可以做到不安装不需要的软件包（例如安装Gnome的用户没有必要因为一个软件包的依赖关系而安装KDE与Qt），而安装指定的软件包（同样以Gnome举例，Gnome的用户基本上都会安装GTK+），把系统的设置专注化。
target_text: The USE logo, which is located in the Gento system/etc/portage/make.conf, is designed to enable emerge to deal with dependency without installing the required package (e.g., it is not necessary for Gnome users to install KDE and Qt because of the dependency of a software package), while the specified package (also with Gnome for example, Gnome users basically install GTK+) to focus on system settings.
title: Gentoo Linux

source_text: AIX，是IBM专有UNIX操作系统的商标名。名稱來自先進互動執行系統（，縮寫為 AIX）。最初的名稱來自，但或许这个名字没有得到法律部门的允许，因此更改为"Advanced Interactive eXecutive"。AIX的一些流行特性例如chuser、mkuser、rmuser命令以及相似的东西允许如同管理文件一样来进行用户管理。AIX级别的逻辑卷管理正逐渐被添加进各种自由的UNIX风格操作系统中。
target_text: AIX, a brand name for the IBM proprietary UNIX operating system. The name came from the Advanced Interchange Implementation System (AIX, initialized). The original name came from, but perhaps it was not allowed by the legal department, and was changed to "Advanced Interactive eXCutive". Some of the AIX popular features, such as the chuser, mkuser, rmuser command, and similar things, allowed user administration like a management file. Logical volume management at the AIX level is gradually being added to a variety of free UNIX-style operating systems.
title: IBM AIX

source_text: AIX操作系统使用JFS文件系统(JOURNAL FILE SYSTEM), JFS文件系统是一种字节级日志文件系统，借鉴了数据库保护系统的技术，以日志的形式记录文件的变化。JFS通过记录文件结构而不是数据本身的变化来保证数据的完整性。这种方式可以确保在任何时刻都能维护数据的可访问性。
target_text: The AIX operating system uses the JFS file system (JOURNAL FILE SYSTEM), which is a byte log file system that draws on the technology of the database protection system to record changes in documents in log format. JFS ensures data integrity by recording changes in file structure rather than data itself. This ensures that data accessibility can be maintained at any time.
title: IBM AIX

source_text: 方式文献检索的方式可分为手工检索和计算机检索两种。手工检索是计算机检索的基础，计算机检索是手工检索的发展。从检索原理来讲，手检与机检并无差别，在检索进行之前都要进行检索课题的分析、检索工具(文摘或文档)的选用、根据检索课题的要求制定检索策略、选择检索途径和检索方法，然后才能进行检索操作。
target_text: A manual search is the basis for a computer search, and a computer search is a development of a manual search. In terms of the principle of retrieval, a manual check is no different from a mechanical search. The search is preceded by an analysis of the subject of the search, the selection of the search tool (extract or document), the development of a search strategy according to the requirements of the search topic, the selection of the search path and the search method before it can be retrieved.
title: 文献检索

source_text: 计算机检索是通过计算机来模拟人的手工检索过程，由计算机来处理检索者的检索提问，将检索者输入检索系统的检索提问(即检索标识)按检索者预先制定的检索策略与系统文档（机读数据库）中的存贮标识进行类比、匹配运算，通过“人机对话”而检索出所需要的文献。
target_text: Computer search is a computer that simulates the manual search process of the searcher, which handles the searcher's search questions, the searcher's entry into the search system (i.e. the search identifier) is compared to the search strategy developed by the searcher and the storage marking in the system's document (the machine-readable database), and the required documentation is retrieved through the `human machine dialogue'.
title: 文献检索

source_text: 计算机文献检索经常称为机检，是文献检索的一种方式。是通过计算机来模拟人的手工检索过程，由计算机来处理检索者的检索提问，将检索者输入检索系统的检索提问(即检索标识)按检索者预先制定的检索策略与系统文档（机读数据库）中的存贮标识进行类比、匹配运算,通过“人机对话”而检索出所需要的文献。
target_text: Computer literature retrieval, often referred to as machine-checking, is a method of document retrieval. Computers are used to simulate manual search processes for searchers, computers are used to handle searcher search questions, search questions for searchers entering the search system (i.e. search markings) are compared to search strategies developed in advance by searchers and stored markings in system documents (mechanical reading databases) and the required literature is retrieved through “person-to-person dialogue”.
title: 计算机文献检索

source_text: 1954年，美国海军武器实验站图书馆在一台电子管计算机上建立了世界上第一个计算机检索系统。1950年代末，IBM公司利用一台IBM650计算机成功地编制出关键词索引，并建立了世界上第一个定题情报检索（SDI，Selective Dissemination of information）系统，为用户定期检索和提供一定主题的新到文献，并很快得到了推广应用。
target_text: In 1954, the U.S. Navy Weapons Laboratory Library established the world’s first computer search system on a tube computer. In the late 1950s, IBM successfully indexed keywords using an IBM650 computer, and established the world’s first problem-based intelligence retrieval system, which regularly retrieves and provides users with some subject-specific new literature, which is soon being promoted.
title: 计算机文献检索

source_text: 1960—80年代，数据通讯网络出现，大容量计算机分时系统和强功能检索软件研制成功，使脱机检索发展到联机检索并迅速得到了推广。1970-80年代，联机检索得到迅速发展，一些联机检索系统开始向公众提供商业性服务，如DIALOG、ESA、ORBIT、BRS等许多世界著名的联机检索系统相继投入商业性运营。
target_text: In the 1960’s–80’s, the advent of data communication networks, the successful development of high-capacity computer time-to-time systems and high-capacity search software led to off-line retrieval and rapid diffusion. In the 1970’s, on-line retrieval was rapidly developed, and a number of online search systems began to provide commercial services to the public, such as DIALOG, ESA, ORBIT, BRS, many of the world’s famous online search systems.
title: 计算机文献检索

source_text: 网络系统1990年代，随着互联网的迅速发展及超文本技术的出现，基于客户/服务器的检索软件的开发，使客户/服务器网络检索模式开始取代以往的终端/主机结构，成为联机检索的发展趋势，使联机检索进入一个崭新的时期。计算机文献检索的发展趋势
target_text: During the 1990s, with the rapid development of the Internet and the advent of hypertext technology, the development of customer/server-based search software enabled the customer/server network search model to begin replacing the previous terminal/host structure and become a trend towards online retrieval, leading to an entirely new period of online retrieval.
title: 计算机文献检索

source_text:
误差与改进
由于使用该技术的人类分析员必然存在主观的偏见，但人们已经努力使用计算机程序做出更客观的估计，这得到了更高分辨率的卫星图像和更强大的计算机的帮助。由于热带气旋的卫星模式会随着时间的推移而波动，自动技术使用六小时的平均周期，导致更可靠的强度估计。客观的德沃夏克技术的发展始于1998年，它在有眼（飓风或台风强度）的热带气旋中表现最好。它仍然需要手动放置中心，在这个过程中保持一些主观性。到2004年，一种先进的客观的德沃夏克技术被开发出来，它利用带状特征来处理低于飓风强度的系统，客观地确定热带气旋的中心。2004年发现了一个中心压力的偏差，它与对流层顶的斜率和云顶温度有关，它随着纬度的变化而变化，有助于改善客观技术中的中心压力估计。
target_text: Errors and improvements due to subjective bias on the part of human analysts using the technology, but efforts have been made to make more objective estimates using computer programs, aided by higher resolution satellite imagery and stronger computers. Satellite models of tropical cyclones fluctuate over time, using an average cycle of automatic technology of six hours, leading to more reliable estimates of intensity. The development of objective Dvorsk technologies started in 1998 with the best performance in tropical cyclones with eyes (drought or typhoon intensity).
title: 德沃夏克分析法

source_text: 智能控制是一种控制技术，针对控制对象及其环境、控制目标和任务的不确定性和复杂性而提出。智能控制可以自动测量被控对象的被控制量，并求出与期望值的偏差，同时采集输入环境的信息，进而根据所采集的输入信息和已有知识进行推理，得到对被控对象的输出控制，同时使偏差尽可能减小或消除。一般使用如下人工智能控制方法如類神經網路，模糊逻辑，机器学习，进化计算和遗传算法。
target_text: Smart control is a control technology that is proposed for the uncertainty and complexity of the control object and its environment, control objectives and tasks. Smart control automatically measures the controlled amount of the accused person and seeks deviations from expectations, while collecting input information to the environment, leading to an output control of the accused person based on the input information collected and knowledge available, while minimizing or eliminating deviations.
title: 智能控制

source_text:
专家系统
专家系统是一种能在某个领域内，以人类专家的知识和经验来解决该领域中高水平的困难任务的计算机系统。其主题是一个基于知识的计算机程序系统。
专家控制的基本构成如下：
观察、监测系统中的有关变量和状态；
综合运用自己的知识和经验判断当前系统运行的状态；
分析比较各种可以采用的控制策略并选择其中最优者予以执行，用计算机与以实现。
target_text: Expert systems Expert systems Expert systems Expert systems A computer system capable of solving high-level difficult tasks in this field with the knowledge and experience of human experts. The subject is a knowledge-based computer program system.
title: 智能控制

source_text:
化合物
许多有机物难闻的味道来自于它们分解产生的硫化氢之类的化合物。这些化合物有一股特别的臭鸡蛋味道。硫化氢的溶液是酸性的，与金属反应形成金属的硫化物。铁的硫化物在大自然中很常见，如黄铁矿。黄铁矿有半导体的特性。方铅矿即硫化铅则是第一种被发现的半导体。
target_text: Compounds, many organics smell bad because of compounds such as hydrogen sulfide that they decompose. These compounds have a special smell of eggs. Hydrogen sulfide solutions are acidic, reacting with metals to form metal sulphides. Iron sulphides are common in nature, such as the iron ore. Yellow ore has semiconductor properties. Lead sulfide is the first semiconductor to be found.
title: 硫

source_text:
家庭
孙光远有二子。长子孙钟阳为建筑学家。次子孙钟秀为中国计算机软件学的重要先驱，也是孙光远1950年代在南京大学的硕士研究生，中国科学院院士；儿媳叶蓉华为南京大学物理学院教授，亲家叶南薰曾任南京大学数学天文学系、数学系、计算机科学系系主任。
target_text: The eldest son Jong-yang is an architect. Sun Jong-soo was an important pioneer in computer software science in China. He was a master ' s degree student at the University of Nanjing in Sun Gwang-yun in the 1950s and a member of the Chinese Academy of Sciences; his daughter-in-law Ye Yong-hua was a professor at the School of Physics at the University of Nanjing; and Ye Nam-jung was the former head of the Faculty of Mathematics Astronomy, Mathematics and Computer Science at the University of Nanjing.
title: 孙光远

source_text:
学术贡献
1957年调入中科院计算所三室工作后，冯康带领他的科研小组承担了使用计算机计算水坝弹性力学问题的国家任务。为了克服传统的差分方法难以处理几何与材料的复杂性以及缺乏理论保证的困难, 冯康、黄鸿慈等人开展了椭圆型方程计算方法的系统研究。在大量计算实践的基础上, 冯康进行了系统的理论分析及总结提高, 通过把变分原理与剖分逼近有机结合, 把传统上对立而各具优点的差分法与能量法辨证统一, 扬长抑短, 推陈出新, 一举克服了上述两方面的困难, 于1964年独创了数值求解偏微分方程的有限元方法, 形成了标准的算法形态,编制了通用的计算程序, 并及时地解决了当时中国最大的刘家峡水坝的应力分析问题。
target_text: In order to overcome the difficulties of using computers to calculate dam elasticity and the complexity of geometry and materials and the lack of theoretical assurance, Feng Kang and Huang Hong Xin, among others, carried out systematic research on elliptical equations. On the basis of extensive computational practices, Feng Kang undertook systematic theoretical analysis and summing-up, unifying the traditional contrasted and superior differences with energy forensics, length and shortness, and overcome both of the above-mentioned difficulties, created a limited meta-method of numerical solutions in 1964, developed standard algorithms, developed generic computational procedures, and addressed in a timely manner the stress of China’s largest Liujiang dam.
title: 冯康

source_text: APL 是 A Programming Language 或 Array Processing Language 的缩写。肯尼斯·艾佛森在1962年设计这个语言时他正在哈佛大学工作，1979年他因对数学表达式和编程语言理论的贡献而得到图灵奖。在过去数十年的使用历史中，APL 从它的原始版本开始不断改变和发展，今天的版本与1963年发表时的版本已经非常不一样了。但它始终是一种解释执行的计算机语言。现代的 APL 版本支持其初始版本不支持的结构和模式编程。APL 至今依然使用一种非标准化的字母表，这一直是他人对 APL 的批评。
target_text: APL is an acronym for A Programmeing Language or Array Processing Language. Kenneth Everson worked at Harvard University when he designed the language in 1962, and received the Turing Award in 1979 for his contribution to mathematical expressions and programming linguistic theory. In the past decades of use, the APL has changed and developed from its original version, which is now very different from the version that was published in 1963.
title: APL語言

source_text:
概述
在许多应用场合下（数学、科学、工程技术、电脑设计、机器人、数据显示、保险技术、传统的数据处理等等），APL是一种非常有力的、表达丰富的和简明的编程语言。它一般被用在一个与用户接口的环境中。它最初的设计目的是将数学公式写成一种电脑可以理解的方式。学它一般很容易，但要分析 APL 写成的程序往往需要一段时间。与传统的结构式编程语言不同的是，APL 的程序一般由一系列使用在序列上的单元的或双元的函数或运算符号组成。由于APL拥有许多非标准的运算符号，这些符号之间没有优先性（比如一般数学中的乘号、除号较加号、减号有优先权，APL中没有这样的优先权）。最初的APL语言没有任何控制结构如循环（do-while）或者条件选择（if-then-else），但一些序列运算符号可以用来模拟编程结构，比如iota（用来获得一个从1至N的序列）可以用来模拟循环（for）。
target_text: In many applications (mathematics, science, engineering technology, computer design, robotics, data data, insurance technology, traditional data processing, etc.), APL is a very powerful, rich and concise programming language. It is generally used in an interface environment with users. It was originally designed to write mathematical formulas into a computer understandable way. It is generally easy to learn, but it often takes some time to analyse APL-written programs. Unlike the traditional structured programming language, APL programs are typically composed of a series of functions or operating symbols using serial units or two-dimensional ones. Since APL has a number of non-standard computing symbols, there is no priority between these symbols (e.g., multiplying numbers in general mathematics, subtraction numbers have priority, APL does not have such priority). The initial APL language does not have any control structures such as loops (do-while) or conditionalities (if-then-else), but some series of operation symbols can be used to simulate process structures, such as iota (to obtain a sequence from 1 to N) that can be used for simulations (for example).
title: APL語言

source_text: 1995年4月，中新社的www.chinanews.com从香港设立服务器进入国际互联网，成为亚洲上网最早的中文媒体。随着互联网技术的发展，中新社建成了卫星专线通信系统，更新改造了新闻采编系统。1999年1月1日中新社北京总社正式开通运行“中国新闻网”（简称“中新网”），当时域名为www.chinanews.com.cn。另外，新成立的“中国新闻图片网”兼有采编与销售功能，可每日24小时滚动播发即时图片。中新社除创办初期在广东、福建、上海、广西四大侨乡的分支机构及在香港设的办事机构外，还新建新设了多个境内外分社。
target_text: In April 1995, the Chinese news agency www.chinaneews.com set up a server to access the Internet from Hong Kong and became the first Chinese-language medium to access the Internet in Asia. With the development of Internet technology, the China News Agency has built a satellite-based communications system and upgraded its news collection system. On 1 January 1999, the China News Network (known as “China News Network”) was officially launched by the China News Agency's Beijing General Bureau, known as www.chinanews.com.cn. In addition, the newly established China News Pictures Network, which combines editing and marketing functions, made it possible to roll images 24 hours a day.
title: 中国新闻社

source_text:
专家系统是早期人工智能的一个重要分支，它可以看作是一类具有专门知识和经验的计算机智能程序系统，一般采用人工智能中的知识表示和知识推理技术来模拟通常由领域专家才能解决的复杂问题。一般来说，专家系统=知识库+推理机，因此专家系统也被称为基于知识的系统。一个专家系统必须具备三要素：
领域专家级知识
模拟专家思维
达到专家级的水準
target_text: Expert systems are an important branch of early artificial intelligence, which can be seen as a computer-smart program system with specialized knowledge and experience, typically using intellectual expression and intellectual reasoning techniques to simulate complex issues that are usually solved by experts at the field level. Generally, expert systems = knowledge base plus reasoning machines, so expert systems are also called knowledge-based systems. A specialist system must have three elements: field-level knowledge, simulation of expert thinking, achievement of expert-level standards.
title: 专家系统

target_text: In February 2006, Gmail started integrating with chat software Google Talk. Users can access Gmail through WEB, using QuickContacts to directly chat text-to-text with their friends in Google Talk without the need to install any specific support software. source_text: 明代末年，由于历法改革的需要，西学东渐中陆续引进了几何学、三角学等西方数学。这项工作仍在清朝继续进行，其中最重要的是由波兰传教士穆尼阁和薛凤祚所介绍的对数方法。薛凤祚所著《历学会通》的数学部分主要是传自穆尼阁的《比例对数表》（1653年）、《比例四线新表》和《三角算法》等各一卷。《比例对数表》和《比例四线新表》分别给出了1～10000的六位对数表和六位三角函数（正弦、余弦、正切、余切）对数表。书中把今天所说的“对数”称为“比例数”或“假数”，并简单解释了把乘除运算化为加减运算的道理。这是对数方法在中国的首次介绍。对数是17世纪最重要的发现之一，它有效地简化了繁重的计算工作。在对数、解析幾何和微積分这三种当时西方最重要的数学方法中，也只有对数比较及时地传入了中国。《三角算法》所介绍的平面三角和球面三角知识，比《崇祯历书》中有关三角学的内容更丰富一些。如平面三角中包含有正弦定理、余弦定理、正切定理和半角定理等，且多是运用三角函数的对数进行计算。球面三角中增加半角公式、半弧公式、达朗贝尔公式和纳皮尔公式等。
target_text: Last year, Western mathematics, such as geometry, triangles, and so forth, was introduced into Western history as a result of the need for historical reform. The work continued, most importantly, with the logarithms presented by the Polish missionaries, Muni and Xue Fengyuan. The mathematical part of Xue's book called the “opaque” today the “proportional logarithm” (1653), the “new four-line table” and the “triangular algorithm” . The scale and the “new four-line chart”, respectively, presented in China for the first time, is one of the most important discoveries in the 17th century, and it effectively simplifies the work of the triads, the diagonals, the diagonals, and the diagonals of the diagonals.
title: 三角学

source_text:
综合数据库也称为动态库或工作存储器，是反映当前问题求解状态的集合。存放内容
系统运行过程中所产生的所有信息
原始数据：
用户输入的信息
推理的中间结果
推理过程的纪录作用
动态库中由各种事实、命题和关系组成的状态，既是推理机选用知识的依据，也是解释机制获得推理路径的来源。
target_text: A comprehensive database, also known as a dynamic library or a work memory, is a collection that reflects the state of resolution of the current problem. The repository of all the information generated during the system's operation The raw data: Information entered by the user The intermediate result of the reasoning The recording of the reasoning process The state of the dynamic library consisting of various facts, propositions and relationships is both the basis for the knowledge of the reasoning machine and the source of the explanation mechanism for the path to the reasoning.
title: 综合数据库

source_text:
推理策略
正向推理 （数据驱动，其基本思想是：从问题已有的事实（初始证据）出发，正向使用规则，当规则的条件部分与已有的事实匹配时，就把该规则作为可用规则放入候选规则队列中，然后通过冲突消解，在候选队列中选择一条规则作为启用规则进行推理，并将其结论放入数据库中，作为下一步推理时的证据。如此重复这个过程，直到再无可用规则可被选用或者求得了所要求的解为止。）
反向推理 （目标驱动，它是首先提出某个假设，然后寻找支持该假设的证据，若所需的证据都能找到，说明原假设是正确的；若无论如何都找不到所需要的证据，则说明原假设不成立，此时需要另做新的假设。）
双向推理（正向推理与逆向推理同时进行, 且在推理过程中的某一步骤上 “碰头” 的一种推理）
人工智能
target_text: The reasoning strategy is going to reasoning (data-driven, the underlying idea is that the rule is being used from the facts (initial evidence) that are already in question, and that when the conditional part of the rule matches the existing facts, the rule is placed as a usable rule in the queue of candidate rules, then dissipated by conflict, choosing a rule as an activation rule in the queue, and placing its conclusions in the database as evidence for the next line of reasoning. This repeats the process until there is no more available rule to be chosen or sought.) Reverse reasoning (objective driven, it is the first to present a hypothesis and then to find evidence to support that hypothesis, and if the required evidence is found, the original assumption is correct; if the evidence is not found in any case, it is clear that the original hypothesis is not valid and that a new one is needed at this time).
title: 推理机

source_text: 文本编辑器是种计算机软件，主要用来编写和查看文本文件。特殊的文本编辑器支持增加自有的格式来丰富文档的表现形式。操作系统或者集成开发环境通常会带有可以查看和编辑纯文本的编辑器，可增加格式的文本编辑器通常是个人用户或者公司在制作需要格式的文件中使用。
target_text: Text editor is a computer software that is used primarily to prepare and view text files. A special text editor supports the addition of a self-contained format to enrich the presentation of documents. The operating system or integrated development environment usually has an editor who can view and edit pure text, and the text editor that can be added to the format is usually used by individual users or companies in the production of documents that need to be formatted.
title: 文本编辑器

source_text:
不同的文本编辑器
有些文本编辑器简洁易用，只能编辑纯文本文件，也有些文本编辑器功能丰富复杂，支持大量格式的文本文件。Unix和类Unix操作系统都提供了vi编辑器（或其变种），但是也有部分操作系统提供了Emacs编辑器。这两款文本编辑器以其独特的快捷键操作和可定制的工作环境而在程序员世界中广泛应用；普通用户则喜欢使用Microsoft Office来为文本添加格式。Windows系统同样提供了可编辑纯文本文件的记事本和类似Word的写字板提供了基本的写作功能。也有很多人，尤其程序员更喜欢Windows下功能更丰富，更专业的其它编辑器。OS X提供的TextEdit可以编辑纯文本也可以编辑多信息文本，类似DOS的Wordstar.
target_text: Different text editors, some of which are simple and easy to use, can only edit pure text files, and some text editors have a rich and complex function that supports text files in a large number of formats. Unix and Class Unix operating systems provide vi editors (or their variants), but some of them also provide Emacs editing. These text editors are widely used in the world of programmers with their unique shortcuts and customable work environments; ordinary users prefer Microsoft Office to use them to add text. Windows also provides basic writing functions for a journal that edits pure text files and a writing board similar to Word. There are also many people, especially programmers, who prefer to have more functionality under Windows and other professional editors.
title: 文本编辑器

source_text: 许多用于开发软件的文本编辑器支持语法高亮和自动完成源代码，使程序更易读写。程序编辑器通常还允许你选取子程序或者变量，然后跳转到它的定义部分，再跳回原来的位置。ctags等附加工具就是专门用来定位定义部分。随着计算机网络发展，又诞生了可以多人协同编辑的文本编辑器，如Windows操作系统的Netpad可让多人同时编辑或阅读同一份文件。
target_text: Many text editors for software development support syntax height and auto-completion of the source code, making the program easier to read and write. The program editor also usually allows you to select sub-programmes or variables and then jump back to its definition section. Additional tools, such as ctags, are specifically used to locate the definition section. As the computer network develops, a text editor that can be edited by many people, such as Netpad of the Windows operating system, can allow many people to edit or read the same document at the same time.
title: 文本编辑器

英特尔很快意识到，IA-64架构缺乏软件将是未来的一个严重问题，并向各大ISV厂商提供了数千个基于安腾处理器的原型机系统以刺激相关软件的开发，一年后，英特尔和惠普共同推出了安腾2处理器。安腾2：2002-2010体系结构
IA-64架构是顯式並行指令運算（EPIC）的64位架构。EPIC是基于超长指令字VLIW（Very Long Instruction Word）的设计，通过将多条指令放入一个指令字，有效的提高了CPU各个计算功能部件的利用效率，提高了程序的性能。
target_text: Intel quickly realized that the lack of software in the IA-64 architecture would be a serious problem for the future, and provided thousands of prototype systems based on the Anten processor to major ISV manufacturers to stimulate the development of the software. One year later, Intel and Hewlettett Packard jointly launched the Anten2 processor. The 2002-2010 architecture IA-64 architecture is a 64-digit architecture for visible parallel command operation (EPIC). EPIC was designed on the basis of the super-long command word VLIW (Very Long Construction Word), which effectively improved the efficiency of the use of CPU components and improved the performance of the process by placing multiple commands in one command word.
title: IA-64

source_text:
重复的囚徒困境（多人）
美國政治學家罗伯特·阿克塞尔罗德（）在其著作《合作的进化》（）中，探索了经典囚徒困境情景的一个扩展，并把它称作“重复的囚徒困境”（IPD）。在这个博弈中，参与者必须反复地选择他们彼此相关的策略，并且记住他们以前的对抗。阿克塞尔罗德邀请全世界的学术同行来设计计算机策略，并-{}-在一个重复囚徒困境竞赛中互相竞争。参赛的程序的差异广泛地存在于这些方面：算法的复杂性、最初的对抗、宽恕的能力等等。
target_text: Repeated prisoner dilemmas (many) The American political scientist Robert Akselrod, in his book The Evolution of Cooperation () explores an extension of the classic prisoner dilemma and calls it the “repeated prisoner distress” (IPD). In this game, participants must repeatedly choose their respective strategies and remember their previous confrontations. Akselrod invites academic colleagues from all over the world to design computer strategies and-------------- compete in a competition that repeats the prisoner’s dilemma. The differences in the process of contesting are widespread in these areas: the complexity of the algorithms, the initial confrontation, the ability to forgive, etc.
title: 囚徒困境

source_text:
贝叶斯纳什均衡：如果对抗策略的统计分布能被确定（例如，50％以牙还牙，50％一直合作），就能从数学上获得最佳的相对策略。
已经有了人群的蒙特卡罗模拟，在这里低分个人消失了，高分个人一再被生产出来（一种获得最佳策略的天才算法）。决赛人群中的算法合成通常依赖于初赛人群中的算法合成。
target_text: Beyesnash Balances: If the statistical distribution of countermeasures is determined (e.g., 50% against the teeth and 50% over time), the best relative strategy can be derived from mathematics. There is a Monte Carlo simulation of the crowd, where low-scoring individuals disappear, and high-scoring individuals are produced over and over again (a genius algorithm that gets the best of the strategy).
title: 囚徒困境

source_text: 作为商人，他是软件公司沃尔夫勒姆研究公司的创立者和首席执行官。在公司内部，他是数学软件 Mathematica 和计算型知识引擎 Wolfram Alpha 的主要设计师。他近期的工作主要是基于知识的编程，把 Mathematica 编程语言进一步拓展为 Wolfram 语言。他的相关著作《Wolfram 语言入门》的英文版发行于2015年。在学术上，他以粒子物理学、元胞自动机、宇宙学、复杂性理论、计算机代数系统上的研究成果闻名于世。他是一名左撇子。
target_text: As a businessman, he was the founder and CEO of the software company Wolflum Research. Within the company, he was the main designer of Mathematica and the computing knowledge engine Wolfram Alpha. His recent work was mainly based on knowledge programming, expanding Mathemica programming language further into Wolfram language. The English version of his book Wolfram Language Introduction was published in 2015.
title: 史蒂芬·沃爾夫勒姆

source_text:
教育和早期经历
童年时期，沃尔夫勒姆一开始学业上并不顺利，在学习算术上遇到了困难。 12岁时，他编写了一部关于物理的字典。 13岁至14岁之间，他编写了3本关于粒子物理的书籍。 它们没有发表。斯蒂芬·沃尔夫勒姆15岁时发表第一篇科学论文，17岁进入牛津大学学习；20岁时获得加州理工學院理论物理博士学位，22岁获得麦克阿瑟奖，23岁时创立复杂系统研究（complex systems research）领域，27岁时开发Mathematica软件，创立了斯蒂芬·沃尔夫勒姆公司，从事Mathematica以及其他数学软件、电脑软件的开发和发行。43岁时出版《一种新科学》。其中，Mathematica及相关产品同时获得了技术与商业上的巨大成功，成为支撑斯蒂芬·沃尔夫勒姆公司的旗舰产品。
target_text: At the age of 12, he prepared a dictionary on physics. From 13 to 14, he produced three books on particle physics. They were not published. Stephen Wolfram published his first scientific paper at the age of 15 and entered Oxford University at the age of 17; at the age of 20, he obtained a Ph.D. in theoretical physics from the California Institute of Technology, at the age of 22, the MacArthur Prize, at the age of 23, the creation of complex systems research, at the age of 23, the development of the Mathemica software at the age of 27, and the creation of Stephen Wolfram, which was engaged in the development and distribution of Mathemica and other mathematical, computer and software.
title: 史蒂芬·沃爾夫勒姆

source_text: 2014年6月，沃爾夫勒姆正式宣布 Wolfram 语言作为新型普适性多模态编程语言。 该语言的文档在2013年10月在每台Raspberry Pi机器上Mathematica和 Wolfram 语言绑定推出时发布。虽然 Wolfram 语言已经作为一种主要的编程语言在Mathematica中使用超过25年，直到2014年它才正式命名。 沃尔夫勒姆的儿子克里斯托弗在 SXSW 大会上使用 Wolfram 语言做了一个实时编码演示 并且发布关于 Wolfram 语言的官方博文。
target_text: In June 2014, Wolfram’s language was officially announced as a new generic multimodel programming language. The document was released in October 2013 at the time of the release of Mathemica and Wolfram languages on each Raspberry Pi machine.
title: 史蒂芬·沃爾夫勒姆

source_text:
简介
它是一个事务型的对象数据库平台。Zope除了能储存内容，数据外，还能存放动态的HTML模板、脚本、搜索引擎、关系数据库管理系统（RDBMS）接口和代码。Zope裡的一切都是对象。它有一个强大的基于web的在线开发模板，让使用者能在世界上任何地方，任何时间方便地更新自己的网站。作为对以上功能的安全保障，Zope提供了一个集成的安全模型，能方便对数据库的内容进行分层授权管理。可以把个人的内容分配给个人用户管理，部门的内容分配给部门管理员管理，整个网站的内容由系统管理员管理。现在基于Zope平台已开发出了大量的产品，能方便地嵌入Zope中以扩展它的基本功能。
target_text: In addition to storing content, data, Zope can store dynamic HTML templates, scripts, search engines, relationship database management system (RDBMS) interfaces and codes. Everything in Zope is an object. It has a powerful web-based online development template that allows users to update their web sites easily and easily anywhere in the world. As a security guarantee for these functions, Zope provides an integrated security model that facilitates layered authorization management of the content of the database. Individual content can be allocated to individual users, departmental content to departmental administrators, and the entire web site content is managed by system administrators.
title: Zope

source_text: 半导体器件（）是利用半导体材料的特殊电特性来完成特定功能的-{zh-hans:电子器件; zh-hant:電子電路組件;}-。半導體的導電性介於良導電體與絕緣體之間，这些半导体材料通常是硅、锗或砷化镓，並經過各式特定的滲雜，產生P型或N型半導體，作成整流器、振盪器、發光器、放大器、測光器等元件或設備。 常見的半導體元件有二極體、電晶體等。
target_text: Semiconductor devices () are {zh-hans: electronic devices; zh-hant: electronic circuit components;}-. Semiconductor-guide guidance is between a good guide and an insulation, usually silicon, thorium or arsenicized silicon, and through a variety of specific trimmings that produce a P or N semiconductor, which is made of integer, oscillator, lumber, magnifier, light detector, etc.
title: 半导体器件

source_text: 普通半导体如硅、砷化镓、碳化硅等材料构成的传统器件中，电子和空穴通常可以用非相对论性的抛物线型色散关系来描述其，而在最近研发的新型半导体中，包括由麻省理工学院的唐爽和崔瑟豪斯夫人提出的准狄拉克材料、半狄拉克材料等（唐-崔瑟豪斯理论）, 电子和空穴可以具有不同的相对论效应。这些相对论性的新型半导体材料或可引领下一代计算机芯片、能源装置的研发。

source_text:
可靠性
半导体器件对杂质和灰尘很敏感。所以在繁复的生产工艺中，精确控制杂质和灰尘的等级是非常必要的。最终产品的品質很大程度上依靠生产中的各个相对独立而又相互影响的生产阶段，例如金属化（metallization）、芯片材料（chip material）、封装等。由于技术飞速进步，新材料和新工艺不断被用于新研发的器件中，设计时间表根据非循环工程常数（non-recurring engineering）限定，再加上市场对设计时间不断提出苛刻要求，所以可靠性设计基本不可能按照已有的产品进行。
target_text: Reliability Semiconductor devices are sensitive to impurities and dust. In complex production processes, precise control of levels of impurities and dust is necessary. The final product depends to a large extent on the production stages of production that are relatively independent and interactive, such as metalization, chip material, sealing, etc. Because of technological advances, new materials and processes are constantly being used in newly developed devices, the design schedule is limited by the non-cyclical engineering constant (non-recycleing engineering), coupled with the fact that the market is constantly demanding design times, so reliability design is largely unlikely to follow established products.
title: 半导体器件

source_text: 为达到一定的经济指标，半导体产品总一大批量生产的；并且修理半导体产成品也是不实际的。所以半导体产品在设计阶段加入可靠性的概念和在生产阶段减少变量就成为十分必要的要求。半导体器件可靠性取决于装配，使用，环境状况。影响因素包括气体、灰尘、沾污、电压、电流密度、温度、湿度、应力，往复振动，剧烈震荡、压强和电磁场的强度。
target_text: In order to achieve certain economic targets, semiconductor products are produced in large quantities; and it is not practical to repair semiconductor products. So semiconductor products are required to incorporate the concept of reliability at the design stage and to reduce variables at the production stage. The reliability of semiconductor devices depends on their assembly, use, state of the environment. Impact factors include gas, dust, contamination, voltage, current density, temperature, humidity, stress, resonance, severe shock, pressure and strength of the electromagnetic field.
title: 半导体器件

source_text:
提高方法
半导体器件可靠性依靠以下方法保证其处于高水准：
在無塵室内生产，以控制杂质。
严格的工艺控制，减少变量。
老化（短时间，极端条件下运转）并测试以减少不合格品漏过。
半导体芯片测试，指在封装前，用连接测试设备的探针，在显微设备下接触芯片并进行测试，去除不合格品。
用整套参数测试封装后的半导体器件，确保产品能正常运作。
target_text: Aging (for short periods, operating under extreme conditions) and testing to reduce non-conforming leakages. A semiconductor chip test, which refers to a probe linking the test equipment, contacting the chip under microscopic equipment and testing to remove the non-conforming material, is used to test the packaged semiconductor elements to ensure the normal functioning of the product.

source_text:
重要特征
Ada语言最早针对嵌入式和-{zh-hans:实时计算; zh-tw:即時運算}-设计，至今依然在这些领域广泛使用。Ada95版，是由INTERMETRICS公司的塔克·塔夫特于1992到1995年间设计的，旨在改进对于系统、数字、财务软件编程的支持。Ada语言的重要特征就是其嵌入式风格，模块化编程，编译检查，平行处理，异常处理及泛型编程。Ada在1995年加入了对面向对象设计的支持，包括动态分配等。
target_text: The Ada language was originally designed for embedding and - {zh-hans: real-time calculation; zh-tw: real-time calculation} - design, which is still widely used in these areas. The Ada95 version, designed by Tucker Taft of INTERMETRICS from 1992 to 1995, was designed to improve support for system, digital and financial software programming. The important features of the Ada language are its embedded style, modular programming, translation and examination, parallel processing, unusual handling and generic programming.
title: Ada

source_text:
历史
在1970年代，美国国防部（DoD）所属的嵌入式计算机系统项目中使用的编程语言数量逐日增多，其中的很多语言十分陈旧或者依赖于硬件，而且没有一个支持安全的模块化编程，对此DoD感到十分担心。基于这个原因，在1975年成立了高级语言工作组（HOLWG），它的使命是就是寻找或者创造某种适合国防部需要的编程语言，以便减少现有编程语言数量。该小组最终的工作成果就是Ada语言。由此，类似项目中使用的高级编程语言的数量大大减少了，1983年的450种编程语言，到1996年只剩下37种。
target_text: In the 1970s, the number of programming languages used in the United States Department of Defense (DoD) embedded computer systems project grew daily, with many of these languages being very old or dependent on hardware, and no modular programming that supports security. For this reason, the Senior Language Working Group (HOLWG) was established in 1975 to find or create a programming language suitable for the Department’s needs in order to reduce the number of programming languages available. The final outcome of the group’s work was the Ada language. As a result, the number of advanced programming languages used in similar projects was significantly reduced, from 450 programming languages in 1983 to 37 languages in 1996.
title: Ada

source_text: 德州仪器（），簡稱德儀（），是一家美国跨國科技公司，總部位於德克萨斯州的达拉斯，以开发、制造、销售半导体和计算器技术闻名于世，主要从事数字信号处理与模拟电路方面的研究、制造和销售。它在25个国家有制造、设计或者销售机构。根據2021年IC Insights統計，德州仪器是世界第九大半导体制造商；曾經是行動電話的第二大芯片供应商，仅次于高通；同时也是在世界范围内的第一大数字信号处理器（DSP）和模拟半导体元件的制造商，其产品还包括计算器、微控制器以及多核处理器。德州仪器居世界半导体公司20强。

source_text:
开创新产业
在发展半导体和微处理器之后，德州仪器遇到了两个关于工程和产品开发方面的有趣的问题。第一，用于创造半导体的化学药品、机械和技术原先都不存在，必须通过自己“发明”他们；第二，早期的市场需求较小，公司必须“发明”这些产品的“用途”以打开销路。例如，其第一款晶体管收音机就是这样发明的。另外一个例子是，20世纪70年代后期开发的安装在墙上、由计算机控制的家用恒温器，很可能由于其价格较为高昂，无人问津。德州仪器在田纳西州约翰逊城设立了一个工业控制部门，为化学和食品工业生产自动进程控制计算机。这个商业非常成功。1991年9月，德州仪器把它卖给了西门子公司，随后转向了军用和政府设施方面。最好的例子就是美国的阿波罗登月计划里的电子设备的制造。

source_text:
多元樹霍夫曼編碼
多元樹霍夫曼編碼演算法使用字母集 {0, 1, ... , n − 1} ，來構建一棵 n 元樹。霍夫曼在他的原始論文中考慮了這種方法。這與二進制（n=2）算法僅有的差別，就是它每次把 n 個最低權的符號合併，而不僅是兩個最低權的符號。倘若 n ≥ 2, 則並非所有源字集都可以正確地形成用於霍夫曼編碼的多元樹。在這些情況下，必須添加額外的零概率佔位符。這是因為該樹必須為滿的 n 叉樹，所以每次合併會令符號數恰好減少 (n -1), 故這樣的 n 叉樹存在當且僅當源字的數量模 (n -1) 餘 1. 對於二進制編碼，任何大小的集合都可以形成這樣的二叉樹，因為 n -1 = 1.
target_text: The only difference between this and the binary (n=2) algorithm is that it combines n-minimum symbols at a time, not just two. If n-two, not all source-sets can be properly formed as multiple trees for Hoffman codes. In these cases, extra zero probability placeholders must be added. This is because the tree has to be filled with n-kamps, so the number of symbols for each merger is reduced (n-1), so that the n-point tree is present and only the number of source-coded trees (n-1).
title: 霍夫曼编码

source_text:
霍夫曼模板演算法
在霍夫曼編碼的實現中，通常會使用權重表示數值概率，但是上面給出的算法不需要這樣;它只需要權重形成一個完全有序的可交換么半群，這意味著一種訂購權重和添加權重的方法。霍夫曼模板算法使人們能夠使用任何類型的權重（成本，頻率，權重對，非數字權重）和許多組合方法之一（不僅僅是加法），這個問題首先應用於電路設計。
target_text: The Hoffman template algorithm usually uses weighting to represent numerical probability in Hoffman coding, but it does not need to be; it only needs weighting to form a fully sequenced interchangeable half group, which means a way to order and add weight. The Hoffman template algorithm enables people to use any type of weight (cost, frequency, weight, non-digit weight) and one of many combinations (not just additions), a question that should first be used in electrical design.
title: 霍夫曼编码

source_text:
長度限制霍夫曼編碼/最小變異霍夫曼編碼長度限制霍夫曼編碼
長度受限的霍夫曼編碼是一種變體，其目標仍然是實現最小加權路徑長度，但是存在另外的限制，即每個碼字的長度必須小於給定常數。包合併算法通過一種與霍夫曼演算法非常相似的簡單貪婪方法解決了這個問題。
target_text: Longitude limits Hoffman coding/minimum variation Hoffman coding coding coding coding limits Hoffman coding coding coding coding coding coding is a variation whose goal is still to achieve the minimum plus path length, but there are other limitations that each code has to be smaller in length than given a constant. The Compatibility algorithm solves the problem by a simple method of greed that is very similar to Hoffman numeric algorithms.
title: 霍夫曼编码

source_text: Sasser蠕蟲，中文名为震荡波蠕蟲，也有人稱之為「殺手」蠕蟲。Sasser蠕蟲利用微软WindowsNT内核平台上的LSASS漏洞，随机的扫描其它网络中计算机的IP端口，然后进行传播。尽管可以利用防火墙阻止该電腦蠕蟲的传播，但安全专家建议，给系统打上MS04-011 补丁是最根本的解决措施。尽管该蠕蟲在Windows 2000、Windows XP上发作，不会感染安装Windows 95/98/Me操作系统的计算机，但可以在这些操作系统上运行，而成为传播源。
target_text: Sasser worms, also known as " killers" worms, use the LSASS bugs on the Microsoft WindowsNT inner nuclear platform to randomly scan the IP ports of computers in other networks and then disseminate them. While firewalls can be used to stop the spread of the computer worm, safety experts suggest that the basic solution is to hit the system with MS04-011 patches. Although the worm developed on Windows 2000, Windows XP, it does not infect the computers that install Windows 95/98/Me operating systems, it can operate on these operating systems and become a source of transmission.
title: 震盪波蠕蟲

实例
以常见的冯·诺伊曼计算机的设计为例，体系结构设计包括了：
指令集架構（Instruction set architecture；簡稱ISA）：被視為一種機器語言，包含了許多相關的指令集（記憶體定址、處理器控制，暫存器控制等等……）。
微体系结构/微架構（Microarchitecture）或稱電腦組織（Computer organization）：是更詳細的敘述系統內部各元素如何進行合作與溝通。
数据表示，即硬件能直接识别和处理的数据类型和数据格式；
寻址方式，包括最小寻址单位和地址运算等；
寄存器定义，包括操作数寄存器、变址寄存器、控制寄存器等的定义、数量和使用方式；
指令系统，包括机器指令的操作类型和格式、指令间的排序和控制机制等；
异常机制，包括中断、NMI和内部异常等；
机器工作状态的定义和切换，如管态和目态等；
输入输出结构，包括处理机、存储器与输入输出设备之间的连接方式、数据传送方式、数据流量、以及数据交换过程的控制等；
target_text: An example is the design of the common von Neuman computer, and the architecture of the system includes: Instruction Constituencies (Instruction set Achitecture; short name ISA): conceived as a robotic language, containing a number of related commands (memographic fixes, processor controls, temporary memory controls, etc.); Microsystem Structures/Microarchitecture or Computer Organization (Computer control): a more detailed description of how elements of the narrative system work together and communicate; Data Expressions, i.e. data types and data formats that hardware can directly identify and process; Location search methods, including minimum location units and address calculations; The definition of a sender, including operating deposits, a translator, a control depositor, quantity and mode of use; Instruction systems, including the type and format of operation of machine instructions, and the sorting and control mechanisms between instructions; Anomalous mechanisms, including interruptions, NMI and internal anomalies; The definition of a server, the mode of data transfer, the mode of transmission of data, the mode of transmission, the mode of transmission, the flow of data, etc.

source_text: SQL基于关系代数和元组关系演算，包括一个数据定义语言和数据操纵语言。SQL的范围包括数据插入、查询、更新和删除，数据库模式创建和修改，以及数据访问控制。尽管SQL经常被描述为，而且很大程度上是一种声明式编程（4GL），但是其也含有过程式编程的元素。
target_text: SQL calculates based on relationship algebras and meta-relations, including a data definition language and data manipulation language. The scope of SQL includes data insertion, querying, updating and deleting, database model creation and modification, and data access control. While SQL is often described as, to a large extent, a declaratory programming (4GL), it also contains elements of process programming.
title: SQL

source_text: SQL是对埃德加·科德的关系模型的第一个商业化语言实现，这一模型在其1970年的一篇具有影响力的论文《一个对于大型共享型数据库的关系模型》中被描述。尽管SQL并非完全按照科德的关系模型设计，但其依然成为最为广泛运用的数据库语言。SQL在1986年成为美国国家标准学会（ANSI）的一项标准，在1987年成为国际标准化组织（ISO）标准。此后，这一标准经过了一系列的增订，加入了大量新特性。虽然有这一标准的存在，但大部分的SQL代码在不同的数据库系统中并不具有完全的跨平台性。
target_text: SQL was realized in the first commercial language of Edgar Cod’s relationship model, described in an influential paper, A Relationship Model for Large Shared Databases, in 1970. Although SQL was not designed in full accordance with the Cod’s relationship model, it remained the most widely used database language. SQL became a standard of the American National Standards Institute (ANSI) in 1986 and the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) standard in 1987.

source_text:
语言特点
SQL是高级的非過程化編程語言，它允许用户在高层数据结构上工作。它不要求用户指定对数据的存放方法，也不需要用户了解其具体的数据存放方式。而它的界面，能使具有底层结构完全不同的数据库系统和不同数据库之间，使用相同的SQL作为数据的输入与管理。它以记录项目〔records〕的合集（set）〔项集，record set〕作为操纵对象，所有SQL语句接受项集作为输入，回送出的项集作为输出，这种项集特性允许一条SQL语句的输出作为另一条SQL语句的输入，所以SQL语句可以嵌套，这使它拥有极大的灵活性和强大的功能。在多数情况下，在其他編程語言中需要用一大段程序才可实践的一个单独事件，而其在SQL上只需要一个语句就可以被表达出来。这也意味着用SQL可以写出非常复杂的语句，在不特別考慮效能下。
target_text: The SQL is a high-level, off-the-shelf programming language that allows users to work on high-level data structures. It does not require users to specify the method of storing data, nor does it require users to understand the exact way in which data are stored. Its interface enables the same SQL to be used as input and management of data between database systems and different databases with a completely different bottom structure. It uses the same SQL as a combination (set) of recording items [records] [sets, record set] for manipulation purposes. In most cases, a single event that requires a large number of procedures to be put into practice can be expressed in SQL, which also means that SQL can be used as an input to another SQL statement, which is very complex, without special consideration.
title: SQL

source_text: 最简单地说，AWK是一种用于处理文本的编程语言工具。AWK在很多方面类似于Unix shell编程语言，尽管AWK具有完全属于其本身的语法。它的设计思想来源于SNOBOL4、sed、Marc Rochkind设计的有效性语言、语言工具yacc和lex，当然还从C语言中获取了一些优秀的思想。在最初创造AWK时，其目的是用于文本处理，并且这种语言的基础是，只要在输入数据中有模式匹配，就执行一系列指令。该实用工具扫描文件中的每一行，查找与命令行中所给定内容相匹配的模式。如果发现匹配内容，则进行下一个编程步骤。如果找不到匹配内容，则继续处理下一行。
target_text: In short, AWK is a programming language tool for text processing. AWK is in many ways similar to the Unix shell programming language, although AWK has its own grammar. It is designed from SNOBOL4, sed, Marc Rochkind's valid language, language tools Yacc andlex, and, of course, from the C language. When AWK was first created, it was designed to be used for text processing, and the language was based on a series of instructions as long as there was a pattern match in the input data. The practical tool scans each line of the document to find a pattern that matches the content specified in the command line. If matching content is found, the next programming step is taken. If matching content is not found, the next line is dealt with.
title: AWK

source_text:
