source_text: 脚本语言（）是为了缩短传统的「编写、编译、链接、运行」（edit-compile-link-run）过程而创建的计算机编程语言。早期的脚本语言经常被称为批处理语言或。一个脚本通常是解释运行而非编译。脚本語言通常都有簡單、易學、易用的特性，目的就是希望能讓程式設計師快速完成程式的編寫工作。而巨集語言則可視為脚本語言的分支，兩者也有實質上的相同之處。
target_text: Script languages () are computer programming languages created to shorten the traditional process of edit-compile-link-run. Early script languages are often referred to as batch languages or languages. A script usually explains how to run rather than compile. Script languages are simple, easy to learn, easy to use.
title: 脚本语言

source_text: 虽然许多脚本语言都超越了计算机简单任务自动化的领域，比如JavaScript、Perl、PHP、Python、Ruby和Tcl，成熟到可以编写精巧的程序，但仍然还是被称为脚本。几乎所有计算机系统的各个层次都有一种脚本语言。包括操作系统层，如计算机游戏，网络应用程序，字处理文档，网络软件等。在许多方面，高级编程语言和脚本语言之间互相交叉，二者之间没有明确的界限。
target_text: Although many script languages go beyond the realm of simple computer task automation, such as JavaScript, Perl, PHP, Python, Ruby and Tcl, mature enough to write sophisticated programs, they are still called scripts. Almost all computer systems have one script language at all levels. These include operating systems layers, such as computer games, network applications, word-processing documents, network software. In many respects, advanced programming languages and script languages intersect, and there is no clear line between the two.
title: 脚本语言

source_text: 一些通用动态语言，比如Perl，从一门脚本语言发展成了更通用的编程语言，由于“解释执行，内存管理，动态”等特性，它们仍被归类为脚本语言。脚本编程常与系统编程相对比，如在或中做出的那样。在这种视角下，脚本是，被来连接软件组件，专门用于这个目的的语言叫做胶水语言。
target_text: Some of the most popular dynamic languages, such as Perl, have evolved from a script language to a more common programming language, which is still classified as script languages because of features such as “interpretation execution, memory management, dynamics”. Script programming is often compared to system programming, as it is done in or out. From this perspective, scripts are used to connect software components, and the language used for this purpose is called glue language.
title: 脚本语言

source_text: GUI出现带来一种专业的控制计算机的脚本语言。它在用户和图形界面，菜单，按钮等之间互动。它经常用来自动化重复性动作，或设置一个标准状态。理论上它可以用来控制运行于基于GUI的计算机上的所有应用程序，但实际上这些语言是否被支持还要看应用程序和操作系统本身。当通过键盘进行互动时，这些语言也被称为巨集语言。
target_text: GUI appears to produce a professional script language for controlling computers. It interacts between users and graphical interfaces, menus, buttons, etc. It is often used to automate duplicate actions, or to set a standard state. It can theoretically be used to control all applications running on GUI-based computers, but in practice these languages are supported by the application and the operating system itself. When interacting with them through keyboards, they are also referred to as condensed languages.
title: 脚本语言

source_text: 本专业既培养学生应用概率统计的方法进行数据分析的能力与利用数学模型进行判断和预测的能力，同时又培养学生运用统计学的一般理论和方法在电商、金融、工程、人工智能、大数据等各个领域的分析应用能力。专业学术型的统计学人才：统计学、人工智能、大数据、生物统计、生态环境、经济金融等方面的相关专业的硕士生优质生源。就业创业型的统计学人才：在银行、证劵等金融机构从事商务数据挖掘和统计分析、风险评估与预测、金融和投资决策分析、决策咨询等工作；在咨询、广告、互联网等涉及数据分析的企事业单位从事统计分析与咨询等工作；在政府公共管理、教育、医药、工程、电力、环境、社交网络和科学研究等领域从事统计调查、统计信息管理、教育教学、数据分析、质量控制及智能决策等工作的应用型和通用型人才。
target_text: The profession both develops the ability of students to apply probabilistic methods for data analysis and the ability to use mathematical models for diagnosis and forecasting, while also building the capacity of students to apply general theories and methods of statistical application for analysis in various fields, such as electricity, finance, engineering, artificial intelligence, and big data. Professional academic talent in statistics: statistics, artificial intelligence, big data, biostatistics, eco-environment, economic finance, etc.; statistical talent in employment entrepreneurship: applications and generics in business data extraction and statistical analysis, risk assessment and forecasting, financial and investment decision-making analysis, policy-making advice, etc., in financial institutions such as banks, certificates; statistical analysis and consulting in enterprises involved in data analysis, such as counselling, advertising, the Internet, etc.; statistical surveys, statistical information management, education, medicine, engineering, electricity, environment, social networks and scientific research in the areas of government public administration, education, teaching, data analysis, quality control and intellectual decision-making.
title: 南昌工程学院

source_text: 二十世纪九十年代中期，人们发现对球状星团的观测结果与大爆炸理论出现矛盾：人们进行了和球状星团的星族观测相符的计算机模拟，其结果显示这些球状星团的年龄竟然高达150亿年，这与大爆炸理论所预言的宇宙的年龄为137亿年严重不符。九十年代后期，更完善的计算机模拟考虑了恒星风引起的质量损失效应，这一矛盾也基本得到了解决：最新得出的球状星团年龄要比原先的结果小很多。虽然人们还不确定这种方法测定的球状星团年龄到底有多精确，但已经明确的是它们无疑是宇宙中最古老的天体之一。
target_text: In the mid-1990s, it was discovered that observations of spherical clusters of stars were in contradiction with the Big Bang theory: computer simulations of groups of stars, consistent with observations of groups of spherical stars, showed that the age of those groups was as high as 15 billion years, which was significantly different from the 13.7 billion age of the universe predicted by the Big Bang theory. In the late 1990s, better computer simulations took into account the qualitative loss effects of a starwind, a contradiction that was largely resolved: the most recent spherical groups were of a much smaller age than the original results.
title: 大爆炸

source_text:
不过，三态逻辑（）这个术语不应该同三值逻辑混淆。应用三态逻辑缓冲器还可以被用在数据选择器中，尤其是那些具有大量输入的情况。另外，三态逻辑对于总线的工作十分关键。
三态逻辑能够减少用于驱动一系列发光二极管所用的导线数量。输出选择和芯片选择

The application of the three-state logic buffer can also be used in data selections, especially where there is a large input. Moreover, the three-state logic is critical to the work on the bus. The output selection and chip selection of many storage devices (e.g. RAM and ROM) designed to connect the bus (e.g. RAM and ROM) have (chip selection,) and (output energy,) are used to produce a three-state logic. source_text: 当芯片选择连接到一个低电平，那么芯片内部将会进行预设的工作流程，只是因为输出使能引脚未连接低电平，最后并未输出对应的信号。当总线正在进行其他工作的时候，这种特性将会起到作用，而当最后输出使能连接到低电平之后，数据才会以最小延迟的状态输出。具有这样的输出使能引脚的 ROM 或者 SRAM 通常具有两个存取时序：一个是芯片被选择以及地址有效，另一个是输出被使能。

When the bus is doing other work, the feature works, and when the final output is connected to the low level, the data is exported with the least delayed state. With such output, the ROM or SRAM that makes the foot-publisher usually has two time series for access: the chip is selected and the address is valid, and the output is enabled.
title: 三态逻辑

source_text:
概述
大型多人在线角色扮演游戏使用客户端-服务器结构，分为客户端和服务器端两部分。玩家透过客户端软件扮演虚拟世界中一名角色，而服务器端則负责主持玩家身处的虚拟世界。服务器端通常由游戏代理商提供，而玩家的资料則会被保存在服务器端。玩家从客户端通过互联网连接，登陆服务器端后才能进入游戏。登入游戏中的世界後，便能與來自世界不同地方的其他玩家進行實時互動。在正常情況下，大型多人在线角色扮演游戏的開發商需負責管理游戏中的虚拟世界，以及不断為游戏作出更新，以留住玩家及吸引其他人來玩該游戏。
target_text: A large number of online role-playing games use client-server structures, divided into client-server structures. Players play a role in the virtual world through client-based software, while server-ends host the virtual world of players. Server end is usually provided by game agents, while player information is kept on the server. Players access the server to the game only after they have access to the Internet. Once they have entered the world, they can interact effectively with other players from different parts of the world. Under normal circumstances, the creator of a large number of online role-players is responsible for managing the virtual world in the game, as well as continuously updating the game to keep the player and attract others to play the game.
title: 大型多人在线角色扮演游戏

source_text:
殉职
国际媒体权利组织保护记者委员会表示，2011年全球各地有至少46名记者被杀害。巴基斯坦连续2年成为记者殉职最多的国家。总部位于纽约的保护记者委员会发布的“新闻工作者所受袭击”年度报告称，随着政治骚乱席卷阿拉伯世界，记者们在报道街头抗议等危险任务时的死亡人数在2011年达到创纪录的水平。这份报告说，有17名记者在执行危险任务时死亡。以事件发生的国家来看，巴基斯坦发生了7起记者死亡事件，位居首位；而利比亚和伊拉克分别发生了5起，列在第2位，墨西哥发生了3起。摄影师和摄像人员占死亡记者总人数的40%左右。该组织说，互联网记者的死亡人数提高了。在2008年之前，很少有互联网记者死亡，2011年则有9名网络新闻记者被杀害。2011年的记者死亡人数比2010年多2人。
target_text: According to the Committee for the Protection of Journalists of the International Organization of Media Rights, at least 46 journalists were killed around the world in 2011. Pakistan was the country with the largest number of journalists killed for two consecutive years. The annual report of the New York-based Committee for the Protection of Journalists on attacks on journalists states that, as political unrest engulfed the Arab world, journalists’ deaths in covering dangerous missions such as street protests reached record levels in 2011. The report states that 17 journalists died while on dangerous missions.
title: 記者

source_text:
隱寫術與電子水印
首先在概述隱寫術時必須提到它的近親兄弟電子水印（Watermarking），水印用於識別物品的真偽（比如：新台幣上面翻轉隱約可見到梅花、人民幣上面的隱約可見的毛澤東頭像），或者作為著作權聲明的標誌，或者加入作品屬性信息。電子水印與隱寫術的相同點是，二者都是將一個文件隱寫至另一個文件當中，而兩者的區別在於使用目的與處理算法的不同。電子隱寫側重將秘密文件隱藏，而電子水印則較重視著作權的聲明與維護，防止多媒體作品被非法複製等等。電子隱寫術一旦被識破，則秘密文件十分容易被讀取，相反，電子水印不隱藏及隱寫文件的隱蔽性，而在乎加強（Robustness）除去算法的攻擊。
target_text: In the first place, cloaking and electron watermarks must be mentioned in an overview of their close cousins' electronic seals, which are used to identify the authenticity of objects (e.g., retweets on the new currency can be seen in the face of clubs, in the face of the people's coins, in the face of the hidden maze), or as a sign of copyright, or as an addition to the property information of the works. The same thing about electronic watermarks and covert writings is that they cover up a document to another document, while the difference between the two is in the purpose and the method of processing. The electronic seals hide secret documents, while the electronic seals focus on the sound and preservation of copyrights, prevent the illegal reproduction of multi-media works, and so on.
title: 隐写术

source_text: 網路電影資料庫（，簡稱）是一个关于电影演员、电影、电视节目、电视藝人、电子游戏和電影製作小組的在线数据库。IMDb開辦於1990年10月17日，從1998年開始成為亚马逊公司旗下的网站，在2020年10月17日時，IMDb慶祝了他們30週年的紀念。截至2021年9月，IMDb收錄了共8,313,921部作品以及151,033,000个人物的資料。
target_text: On October 17, 2020, IMDb celebrated their 30th anniversary. As of September 2021, IMDb recorded 8,313,921 works and 151,033,000 personal items.
title: 互联网电影数据库

source_text:
概要
IMDb上有丰富的电影作品信息，包括影片演员、导演，剧情，影评这类的基本信息，也有更深层的内容，比如影片相关的琐事花絮，片中出现的漏洞，影片音轨，屏幕的高宽比，影片的不同版本等等。演员，导演，作者和其他工作人员都在数据库中有自己的条目，其中列出他们参加过的影片，通常还有他们的传记。用户还可以在akas.imdb.com 找到那些在不同语言不同国家发行时使用了不同片名的电影。
target_text: The IMDb contains a wealth of information about film productions, including film actors, directors, dramas, film reviews, basic information such as these, as well as deeper content, such as film-related trimmings, gaps in films, video tracks, high-width ratios on screens, different versions of films, etc. Actors, directors, authors, and other staff have their own entries in the database, listing the films in which they have participated, and usually their biography. Users can also find movies that use different titles when they are distributed in different languages.
title: 互联网电影数据库

source_text: IMDb不只是电影和电子游戏等的数据库，还提供每日更新的电影电视新闻，以及为不同电影活动比如奥斯卡奖推出特别报道。IMDb的论坛也十分活跃，除每个数据库条目都有留言板之外，还有关于多种多样的主题的各种综合讨论版。IMDb扩展出来的姐妹站IMDbPro为专业人士提供额外的信息，如电影业界人士的联系方式，电影活动日期表等等。IMDbPro不是专门为普通大众设计服务的，内容也不是免费的。
target_text: IMDb is not only a database of movies and electronic games, but also provides daily updates of film and television news, as well as special stories for different film events, such as the Oscars. The IMDb forum is also very active, and there are comprehensive discussion pages on a variety of topics, in addition to each database entry. The IMDb expanded sister station IMDbPro provides additional information to professionals, such as contacts with the film industry, a schedule of film events, etc. IMDbPro is not designed for the general public, nor is it free of charge.
title: 互联网电影数据库

source_text: 历史1989年时，Col Needham和其他人在Usenet新闻组rec.arts.movies电影和交换信息。他们编写了一个常见问题解答（FAQ）列表，包含演员，导演和已经去世的电影制作者的传记。在1990年末，他们的FAQ已经收录了将近10,000部电影和电视剧。在1990年10月17日，Needham发布了一套UNIX的Shell脚本，该脚本可以搜索这4个FAQ，IMDb也由此诞生，不过那时的名字是rec.arts.movies电影数据库。到了1993年，数据库已经扩展到包括琐事花絮，传记，影片情节等内容，还带有一个集中的电子邮件界面，用于搜索该数据库。当年晚些时候，IMDb被移到了万维网上（当时还处在婴儿期的网络）。数据库被放置在威尔士卡地夫大学的计算机科学系的服务器上。最初的网页界面作者是Rob Hartill。在1994年，扩展了的电子邮件界面开始接受自动数据提交，人们不必再给指定的维护人员发信而间接提供新内容了。这些年里，数据库在连接着世界各地镜像的网络上靠捐赠的带宽运行。在1995年，这一项目发展得很大，对Col Needham和其他的志愿者来说，依靠捐款和他们的空闲时间来维护它的运行已经明显不太可能。1996年，成立商业公司的决定被作出，IMDb在英国注册成为互联网电影数据库公司。维护数据库的人们成为其股东，依靠广告，许可证和合作获得利润。这种状态持续到1998年。数据库每时每刻都在成长，再一次到达了关键的时刻；利润被用在设备上，股东们很难接受辛苦劳动却只能得到很少收入的事实。
target_text: At the end of 1989, Col Needham and others published a set of UNIX Shell scripts, which could have led to the creation of four FAQs and IMDb films and the exchange of information. They prepared a list of frequently asked questions (FAQs), which contained biography of actors, directors, and dead film producers. By 1993, the database had been expanded to include metropolises, biography, film plots, etc., and had a centralized e-mail interface for searching the database. Later that year, IMDb was moved to the World Wide Web, and the decision to operate the database was taken by the Internet (the network in its infancy was again made available to the server of the University of Wales’s computer department of labor, the initial web interface of which was made available to the company Robares, and it was very unlikely that the company’s Internet would have been able to operate the database, and it would have been able to maintain the data for the year.
title: 互联网电影数据库

source_text: 一些大公司出价试图收购数据库，然而IMDb的股东们不肯轻易将其出售给无法保证继续免费提供其信息的其他企业。就在这时，亚马逊的杰夫·贝索斯出现了。达成的交易是，IMDb得到了为股东们提供应有收入的资金，而Amazon.com可以在出售其DVD和录像带时使用IMDb的信息资源。IMDb的功能继续不断扩展，2002年新增了针对娱乐界专业人士的IMDbPro，提供多样的服务，包括电影制作和票房详细资料，以及电影公司目录。订阅的价格是每月$12.95，或每年$99.95（2005年4月5日价格）。
target_text: Some large companies offered to buy databases, yet IMDb’s shareholders refused to sell them easily to other businesses that could not guarantee the continued free supply of their information. At that time, Jeff Bezos of the Amazon appeared. The deal was that IMDb had the funds to provide the shareholders with the income they deserved, while Amazon.com could use IMDb’s information resources when selling its DVDs and videos. IMDb’s functionality continued to expand, with the addition of IMDbPro for entertainment professionals in 2002, providing a variety of services, including film production and fare details, and a movie company catalogue. The subscription price was $12.95 per month, or $99.95 per year (at 5 April 2005).
title: 互联网电影数据库

source_text:
250部最佳影片
「佳片250」旨在列出資料庫內評級最高的250部電影，評級以資料庫註冊用戶評分為基礎，再套用下列所述公式。入選規範必須是曾公開上映的非紀錄片，片長至少45分鐘，評分達兩萬五千人次以上，並且只有定期投票習慣的用戶才會採用計票，至於有效票數量多少、如何才是符合「有定期投票習慣」則還不為人知。IMDb宣稱為了保持「佳片250」名單的公信力，他們「故意不公開有效計票的標準」。除此之外，「佳片250」還套用精算學的「可信度公式」，對評分作加權評級，獨立資料的數量越大（在此就是指合格用戶的評分），統計處理後的可信度越高，IMDb原以下列公式計算加權評級（IMDb不公開現時公式）：
target_text: 250 of the best films, "Beauty 250" are designed to list the top 250 films in the database, based on the database's registered user rating, and apply the following formula. The selection rule must be a non-record film that was publicly released for at least 45 minutes, with a rating of more than 25,000, and only regular voters who are accustomed to voting will take a vote, and the number of valid votes is not known. In order to maintain the credibility of the "Best 250" list, the IMDb claims that they "deliberately ignore the criteria for valid counting." In addition, "Beautery 250" uses the actuarial "reputable formula" to give more weight to ratings, and the number of unique data is larger (i.e., the number of qualified users), and the credibility of the post-calculation is higher.
title: 互联网电影数据库

source_text: 该榜因其综合广泛性以及不时的令人吃惊的结果而受到嘱目。上榜的电影中既有老电影（如《吸血僵尸》，1922年），也有新电影（如《黑暗騎士》，2008年）；既有流行影片（如得到超过420,000次投票的《魔戒首部曲：魔戒现身》），也有少有人问津的影片（如只有12,700张投票的《日出》）。榜上有各种不同类型的电影（如黑色影片《双重保险》、科幻片《银翼杀手》、音乐片《雨中曲》、西部片《黄昏三镖客》、动画片《机器人总动员》等等）；以及票房一般、很少获奖但却在影迷群体中有广泛的追随者的电影（比如《刺激1995》、《死亡幻覺》等等）。截至2019年10月28日《刺激1995》、《教父》、《教父II》为排名前三的电影。
target_text: The list is given because of its comprehensiveness and the surprising results from time to time. The list includes both old films (e.g. Blood-smoking Zombies, 1922) and new ones (e.g. Dark Rider, 2008); popular films (e.g. The First Song of the Ring: The Ring appeared, which received more than 420,000 votes), and films with fewer followers (e.g. Sunrise, which only 12,700 votes). There are different types of films on the list (e.g., Black Film, Double Insurance, Sci-fi, Silver Wing Killers, Musical, Rain in the Rain, Western Film, Trinity of the Night, Animation of Robot General Motion, etc.); and films with a general, few prizes but a wide audience in the group of fans (e.g., Incentive 1995, Death Disillusion, etc.). As of 28 October 2019, various types of films (e.g., Stimulation 1995, Father, Father II) were the top three films.
title: 互联网电影数据库

source_text: 这些条件是否能提供一个公正没有偏见的排行榜是有争议的。比如，新近上映的影片总是容易从一见钟情的影迷那里得到较高的评分，而这与成功影片应该经得起反复观赏的观念是不相符的。因此，有时新上映的影片冲进250最佳影片榜，甚至前100名，但随着更多观众的评分和重复观看后的评分而退出榜外的情景就十分常见了。另外一种对该榜的主要批评则是它反映的只是影片的受欢迎程度，并不体现对影片历史和艺术的客观知识。但实际上，在评论家年度评选和历史影片评选中，名列前茅的影片在最佳250部影片中通常排名很高。
target_text: For example, it is always easy to get a higher rating from fans of love at first sight, which is inconsistent with the notion that successful films should stand up to repeated views. Thus, sometimes the new ones rush into the best 250, or even the top 100, but it is quite common to get out of the list as more viewers score and repeat the ratings.
title: 互联网电影数据库

source_text:
目前在最佳250部電影名單中，主演最多影片的演員以詹姆斯·史都華的10部作品最多，勞勃·狄尼洛及哈里遜·福特各以9部作品居次。在IMDb上还有最差的100部影片榜用基本相同的方法投票产生。经常位列榜首的影片是《》和《Plan 9 from Outer Space》。前20名名單留言板

source_text:
中国大陆访问状况
2010年1月7日，IMDb.com被中国大陆防火长城封锁，与其他被封的海外网站一样，官方没有提供任何解释。2010年2月3日，在中国大陆被解封，可以正常访问。
2010年10月，IMDb.com再次被封锁。坊间盛传的一个原因是，当时IMDb首页上出现了一部和西藏有关的记录片《云后的太阳》（《When the dragon swallowed the sun》）的预告视频。此后在中国大陆访问该网站一直处于不稳定状态。
2013年3月初，IMDb.com被解除封锁，各项功能均可在中国大陆正常使用，页面显示完整。
target_text: On 7 January 2010, IMDb.com was blocked by the Great Fire Safety Wall on mainland China, and, like other blocked overseas websites, no official explanation was given. On 3 February 2010, it was unsealed in mainland China, and allowed normal access.
title: 互联网电影数据库

source_text:

IMDb的数据在官网上可以免费下载，可惜的是免费提供下载的数据是文本格式，不能检索。为了使IMDb的数据能够被更多人使用，许多开发人员用各自的方法实现了不同的API，目前主要有以下几种：IMDB API ORG

source_text: 模擬器（），也有译作仿-{}-真器，是指主要透過硬件或軟件使得一台计算机系统（称作主host）在行为上类似于另一台计算机系统（称作客户guest）。模拟器一般允许在主系统上运行给客户系统设计的软件或者外部設備。模拟（）是指在一台电子设备或一个计算机程序能够模拟（)另外一台设备或程序。例如：很多制造商生产的打印机模拟惠普LaserJet打印机，使得大量设计给惠普打印机的软件也能在这些品牌打印机上使用；在PC上运行虚拟机执行其他操作系统或者电视游戏和街机；虚拟光驱；一些基于FPGA的硬件模拟器。
target_text: Simulators () and translator ({}-real) means that a computer system (known as master) behaves in a manner similar to another computer system (known as customer guest) mainly through hardware or software. Simulators generally allow the operation of software designed for client systems on the main system or external devices. Simulation () means that an electronic device or a computer program can simulate () another device or program. For example: many manufacturers simulate the HP LaserJet printer, enabling a large number of software designed for Hewlett-Packard printers to be used on those brand printers; other operating systems or television games and arcades to run on PCs; virtual optical drive; and some hardware simulators based on FPGA.
title: 仿真器

source_text: Cg语言主要参照ANSI C建模，但也从C++和Java以及早期的绘制语言如RenderMan and the Stanford shading language中吸取了一些思想。这些使得很容易写程序然后由编译器进行优化，提高了可读性。而且Cg的设计考虑了GPU的体系结构，如可编程多处理器单元（顶点处理器，像素处理器，外加不可编程单元）。这些部分和应用都是通过数据流连接起来。Cg语言允许分别为顶点和像素写程序。Cg API引入了profiles的概念以处理顶点和像素编程所缺乏的通用性。一个Cg profile就定义了一套整个Cg语言的子集以适应不同的硬件平台和API。Cg程序可以根据运行时的需要或者事先编译成GPU汇编代码。这样可以很容易地将一个Cg像素程序和手写的顶点程序结合起来，或者甚至采用不可编程的OpenGL或者DirectX顶点流水线，反之亦然。
target_text: The Cg language is based mainly on ANSIC modelling, but it also draws ideas from C++ and Java, as well as from earlier drawing languages such as Renderman and the Stanford drawing planguage. These make it easier to write and then optimize the programming by the compiler, improving readability. And the design of the Cg takes into account the architecture of the GPU (the apex processor, pixel processor, plus non-programmable units). These parts and applications can be linked by data streaming. The Cg language allows for the combination of a Cg pixel program and hand-written top-point programming. Cg API introduces the concept of profiles to deal with the lack of universality of top-point and pixel programming. A Cg profile defines a subset of the entire Cg language to adapt to different hardware platforms and APIs. The Cg program can easily be translated into the GPU compilation code, depending on operational needs or in advance.
title: Cg語言

source_text:
硬件
据2010年的估计，防火长城可能拥有数百台曙光4000L服务器。历史方滨兴称此系统起步于1998年，然而第一次使用 Great Firewall 这个名字的是白杰明和桑晔所写的文章《》，文章发表于1997年6月1日，称当时中國金橋信息網和中国公用计算机互联网已经有在屏蔽国外新闻网站，这一审查系统开发开始在 1996 年。
target_text: Hardware estimates in 2010 suggest that the Great Wall could have hundreds of dawn 4000 L servers. Historic Ribbon calls the system to begin in 1998, but for the first time, the name Great Firewall was used in the article by Benjamin and Sanjou, published on 1 June 1997, stating that the China Golden Bridge Information Network and the Chinese public computer Internet were already blocking foreign news sites, and that the review system was being developed in 1996.
title: 防火长城

source_text: 2014年1月21日下午三点半，中国互联网顶级域名解析不正常，出錯網站解析到的IP是65.49.2.178，這個IP位於美国加利福尼亚州费利蒙市Hurricane Electric公司，被Dynamic Internet Technology（即自由门的开发公司）租用于翻墙软件连接节点。研究人员认为这是因为防火长城的工作人员操作失误，另一些人认为，虽然这个IP地址指向一家美国公司，但不能排除真正的黑客借这一IP地址作为跳板发动攻击的可能。
target_text: On 21 January 2014, at 3:30 p.m., the top-level domain name of the Chinese Internet was deconstructed abnormally, and the wrong site was deconstructed with an IP of 65.49.2.178, located in Hurricane Electric, Philadelphia, California, United States, and leased by Dynamic Internet Technology (the freegate development company) to the wall-rolling software connection node. Researchers consider this to be due to a fire safety staff error, while others believe that while the IP address points to an American company, it cannot be ruled out that a real hacker could use the IP address as a springboard to launch an attack.
title: 防火长城

source_text: 因为有防火长城的存在，大量境外网站无法在中国大陆境内正常访问，于是大陆网民开始逐步使用各类-{zh-hans:翻墙; zh-tw:破網}-软件突破防火长城的封锁。针对网上各类突破防火长城的-{zh-hans:翻墙; zh-tw:破網}-软件，防火长城也在技术上做了应对措施以减弱-{zh-hans:翻墙; zh-tw:破網}-软件的穿透能力。通常的做法是利用上文介绍的各种封锁技术以各种途径打击-{zh-hans:翻墙; zh-tw:破網}-软件，最大限度限制-{zh-hans:翻墙; zh-tw:破網}-软件的穿透和传播。
target_text: Because of the existence of the Great Wall of Fire, a large number of out-of-country sites could not be accessed properly in mainland China, and the continent's web users began to use various types of -- {zh-hans: wall flipping; zh-tw: software breaking through the Fire Wall. The usual approach was to use the various blockade technologies described above to hit -- {zh-hans: wall flipping; zh-tw: web breakup -- software with maximum restrictions -- {zh-hans: wall flipping; zh-tw: web break-up -- software penetration and dissemination.
title: 防火长城

source_text:
被动检测
自2021年11月初以来，防火长城部署了一种类似白名单的检测方法：应用规则来豁免那些不太可能是完全加密的流量；然后它阻止其余未被豁免的流量。由于翻墙软件的流量多是完全加密的，这种方法十分有效，仅会误伤大约0.6%的非翻墙互联网流量。
target_text: Passive testing Since the beginning of November 2021, the Great Wall of Fire has deployed a sort of white list test: applying rules to exempt traffic that is unlikely to be fully encrypted; and then preventing the rest of the non-exempted traffic. As the flow of wall flip software is mostly fully encrypted, the method is effective, and only about 0.6 per cent of non-walled Internet traffic will be injured by error.
title: 防火长城

source_text:
间歇性封锁国际出口
从2011年5月6日起，中国大陆境内很多互联网公司以及高校、学院、科研单位的对外网络连接都出现问题，包括中国科学院。有分析指断网可能是因为防火长城已经具有了探测和分析大量加密流量并对用户IP地址执行封锁的能力，而各大机构的出口被封也在其中。具体表现为：当用户使用了破网（翻墙）软件后，其所在的公共网络IP地址会被临时封锁，所有的国际网站都无法访问，包括MSN、iTunes Store等，而访问国内网站却正常，但如果使用境外的DNS解析域名则将会由于DNS服务器被封锁导致无法解析任何域名，国内网站也会无法打开。也有分析指，此举是中国当局在测试逐步切断大部分人访问国际网站的措施，以试探用户反应并最终达到推行网络「白名单」制，也就是凡没有在名单上的企业或团体其网络域名将不能解析，一般用户也无法访问。而中共党机关报《人民日报》旗下的《环球时报》英文版则引述方滨兴指，一些ISP必须为自己的用户支付国际流量费用，因此这些公司「有动机」去阻碍用户访问国外网站。一位不愿留名的工信部官员说，用户碰到这些情况应先检查自己和网站的技术问题。
target_text: Since 6 May 2011, many Internet companies in mainland China, as well as universities, colleges, and scientific research units, have had problems accessing their external networks, including the Chinese Academy of Sciences. The analysis of the network may be due to the fact that the Fire Safety Wall already has the ability to detect and analyse large encrypted traffic and enforce a blockade on its IP address, and that the exports of the major agencies are blocked. This is reflected in the fact that, when users use breaking-up (wall) software, their public network IP addresses will be temporarily blocked, all international websites will be blocked, including MSN, iTunes Store, etc., while access to domestic websites is normal, and if businesses or groups that do not have their own list have their own domain names, the DNS servers will be blocked and no domain names will be opened.
title: 防火长城

source_text: 美国作家伊森·葛特曼说，思科系统和一些其他通信设备供应商向中华人民共和国政府提供了具有流量监控和过滤功能的互联网设备，用来封堵网站和追踪网上一些活跃的民运人士。2006年2月，美国国会为此召开听证会，向思科、微软、雅虎、Google四家公司提出质询。美国中国信息中心的亨利·吴（Henry Wu，China Information Center）指责，思科不断主动地与中国中央及各省国家安全部门联系，向其提供最新技术，包括警车间的即时通讯和指挥系统、以及声音识别技术和指纹鉴别技术。记者Sarah Lai Stirland在Wired News发表了一篇文章，并公布了一份泄漏的思科机密PPT文档。该文档详细描述了思科和中国政府在金盾工程上具有商业性质的合作。她还在文章中指责，思科在市场营销中将这些技术明确划分为“镇压工具（A Tool of Repression）”。思科的辩护者声称，实际上，在中国大陆现行的内容过滤系统中，路由器只是作为底层执行设备对人为指定的目的地址进行屏蔽，这是任何一台商用路由器都必须提供的基本功能，思科并没有向中国政府提供特别开发和定制的互联网设备。。奇虎360公司已经加入中国GFW防火长城计划，并早在在2005年的时候，奇虎360就已经特派两位高管齐向东、石晓虹加入研究搜索引擎安全管理系统，助力该项目的实行。

在早期，GIF所用的LZW压缩算法是CompuServe所开发的一种免费算法。然而令很多软件开发商感到意外的是，GIF文件所采用的压缩算法忽然成了Unisys公司的专利。据Unisys公司称，他们已注册了LZW中的W部分。如果要开发生成（或显示）GIF文件的程序，则需向该公司支付版税。在專利失效前曾引起部份開放原始碼社群發起「Burn all GIFs」的運動抵制使用GIF格式。因此，人们开始寻求一种新技术，以减少开发成本。它一方面满足了市场对更少的法规限制的需要，另一方面也带来了更少的技术上的限制，如颜色的数量等。

If the process of generating (or displaying) GIF documents is to be developed, the company is to be paid royalties. source_text:
整理信息
搜索引擎整理信息的过程称为“建立索引”。搜索引擎不仅要保存搜集起来的信息，还要将它们按照一定的规则进行编排。这样，搜索引擎根本不用重新翻查它所有保存的信息而迅速找到所要的资料。想象一下，如果信息是不按任何规则地随意堆放在搜索引擎的数据库中，那么它每次找资料都得把整个资料库完全翻查一遍，如此一来再快的计算机系统也没有用。
target_text: The process of collating information, the search engine is called "building an index." The search engine not only saves the collected information, but also organizes it according to certain rules. In this way, the search engine does not quickly find the information it wants by retraces all the information it holds. Imagine, if the information is stored in a search engine database randomly and without any rules, it has to look through the entire database every time it looks for it, so that the computer system is useless.
title: 网络搜索引擎

source_text:

They are all databases created by extracting information from various websites from the Internet (based on web text).

source_text:
简介
Fortran最初由IBM在1950年代开发，用于科学和工程应用，并随后长时间统治了科学计算编程。它已经在计算密集领域里应用了超过六个年代，比如数值天气预报、有限元分析、计算流体力学、地球物理学、计算物理学、晶体学和计算化学。它是高性能计算的流行语言，并被用于世界上最快超级计算机的基准测试和排名。
target_text: Fortran was originally developed by IBM in the 1950s for scientific and engineering applications, and subsequently dominated scientific computing programming for a long time. It has been used for more than six years in such fields as numerical weather forecasting, limited meta-analysis, computational hydrodynamics, geophysics, computational physics, crystallology and computing chemistry. It is a popular language for high performance calculations and is used for benchmarking and ranking the world’s fastest supercomputers.
title: Fortran

source_text: 尽管编程社区质疑新方法能否胜过手工编码，它将操作一台机器所需的编程语句数目缩减了20倍，因而快速的获得了接受。John Backus在1979年与IBM 雇员杂志《Think》的一次访谈中说道：“我的多数工作出于懒惰。我不喜欢写程序，所以当我工作在上，为计算弹道轨迹书写程序的时候，我开始制造一个编程系统来使得书写程序更加容易”。
target_text: Although the programming community questioned whether the new method was better than manual coding, it reduced the number of programming statements needed to operate a machine by 20 times, and thus quickly accepted. John Backus, in an interview with the IBM employee magazine Think in 1979, said, “Most of my work is lazy. I don't like to write programs, so when I was working, I started to create a programming system to make it easier”.
title: Fortran

source_text: FORTRAN语言被科学家广泛接纳，用来书写数值计算密集程序，这鼓励编译器作者生产可以生成更快和更高效代码的编译器。在语言中包括，使得Fortran特别适合于技术应用比如电子工程。到了1960年，FORTRAN版本已经可获得于、、和7090计算机上。FORTRAN流行性的显著增长，刺激了竞争计算机制造商在它们的机器上提供FORTRAN编译器，因此到了1963年，存在了超过40个FORTRAN编译器。故此，FORTRAN被认为是第一个广泛使用的跨平台编程语言。
target_text: Fortran is widely accepted by scientists as an intensive programming tool for writing values, which encourages compilers to produce compilers that generate faster and more efficient codes. Among them are languages that make Fortran particularly suitable for technology applications, such as electronic engineering. By 1960, the Fortran version was available on, and is available on, 7090 computers. Fortran’s popular growth stimulated competing computer manufacturers to provide Fortran compilers on their machines, so by 1963 there were more than 40 Fortran compilers. Fortran is thus considered the first widely used cross-platform programming language.
title: Fortran

source_text: 早期的FORTRAN编译器在子例程中不支持递归。早期的计算机架构不支持堆栈的概念，当它们直接支持子例程调用的时候，返回位置经常存储在毗邻这个子例程代码的一个固定位置（例如IBM 1130），或一个特定的机器寄存器（IBM 360系列）之中，它们只能在如下条件下允许递归，即由软件来维护一个堆栈，这个返回地址要在进行调用之前存储在堆栈之上，并在这个调用返回之后恢复。尽管没有规定于FORTRAN 77之中，很多F77编译器将其作为一个选项来支持递归，而，设计有内建的递归，而将其作为缺省来支持。它在Fortran 90中通过新关键字RECURSIVE而成为标准。
target_text: Early FORTRAN compilers do not support regression in the subroutine. Early computer structures do not support the concept of stacking, and when they directly support subroutine calls, return locations are often stored in a fixed location adjacent to this subroutine code (e.g. IBM 1130) or in a specific machine memory (IBM 360 series), which can only allow regression, i.e., the maintenance of a stack by software, a return address that is stored on a stack before the call is made and recovered after the call is returned. Although not specified in FORTRAN 77, many F77 compilers use it as an option to support regression, but are designed with built-in retroactivity and supported by default.
title: Fortran

source_text: FORTRAN被提供给计算机，通过一种创新的63阶段编译器，它完整的运行于只有8000个（六位元）字符的磁芯内存中。这个编译器可以从磁带或者从2200张打孔卡开始运行；它不进一步的使用磁带或磁盘存储。它保持程序在内存中并装载覆盖部分，就地逐步将它转换成可执行形式，正如Haines描述的那样。此文被重印编辑于两版的《编译器剖析》和IBM手册《Fortran规定和操作过程，IBM 1401》之中。这种可执行形式不完全是机器语言；转而浮点数算术、下标、输入/输出和函数引用是解释执行的，这早先于UCSD Pascal的P-code两个年代。IBM后来为计算机提供了FORTRAN IV编译器。
target_text: Fortran is provided to computers through an innovative 63-stage compiler, which is fully operational in the magnetic core memory of only 8,000 (six-bit) characters. This compiler can be run from a tape or from a 2200 punctuation cards; it does not further use tape or disk storage. It keeps the program in memory and loads the overlay, gradually converting it into an executable form, as Haines described it. It is reproduced in two editions of the compiler profile and the IBM manual Fortran prescription and operation process, IBM 1401. This executable form is not entirely machine language; it turns to floating point algorithms, subscripts, input/outputs, and function references are executory, as previously described by UCSD Pascal’s P-code.
title: Fortran

source_text:
过渡到ANSI标准Fortran
开发继FORTRAN 77之后的修订标准被反复的推迟，因为标准化过程难以跟上计算和编程实践的快速变化。与此同时，作为“标准FORTRAN”将近十五年，FORTRAN 77成为了编程语言历史上最重要的Fortran方言。一個重要的FORTRAN 77实用扩展，是1978年发行的MIL-STD-1753。這個由美國國防部制定的规范，標準化了由多数FORTRAN 77編譯器实现，却並未引入ANSI FORTRAN 77標準之中的很多特征。这些特征最終合併入Fortran 90標準之中。
target_text: The transition to ANSI standard Fortran developed revised standards after FORTRAN 77 was repeatedly delayed, as the standardization process was difficult to keep pace with rapid changes in computational and programming practices. At the same time, for almost 15 years, Fortran 77, as the standard Fortran, became the most important Fortran dialect in programming language history.
title: Fortran

source_text: 在1990年代早期，人们认为Borland公司的C++工具要优于当时的处于市场追赶地位的Microsoft。另外，Borland的Paradox及其ObjectPAL编程语言与Microsoft的软件尤其是Access出现了激烈的竞争。到了1990年代中期，Borland开始从软件工具市场的巅峰位置滑落，人们认为这是来自于Microsoft的竞争带来的后果。另外一些人认为Philippe Kahn将公司的资源投入到了太多的项目上，以与Microsoft在多个层面展开竞争。在Kahn的任期内，Borland引进了许多当时还很模糊、市场还没有接受的概念，持续关注这些技术的耗尽了Borland的资源，而其它公司则抓住了将这些新概念变成资本的契机。
target_text: In the early 1990s, Borland’s C++ tools were thought to be better than Microsoft, which was in the market at the time. Others argued that Philippe Kahn had invested his company’s resources in too many projects to compete with Microsoft at many levels.
title: Borland

source_text: 但是仍然有其他人相信是市场环境的变化使Borland从霸主的位置上跌落下来。Phillipe Kahn已经把注意力放在了计算机程序员市场上。在80年代，没有几个公司能意识到个人电脑市场的增长，所以很多技术人员都有购买他们认为他们需要的任何软件的自由。Borland在具有高度技术偏好人员市场上的确做的不错。但是到90年代中期，很多公司都开始质疑在这波不受他们控制的PC软件购买热潮中，他们投资了这么多，究竟得到了什么。公司的决策层开始询问这些技术人员很难回答的问题，所以一些共同的标准就开始制定了。这要求软件厂商提供一种新的市场和支持资源，但此时在Kahn领导下的Borland没有迅速的意识到市场已经改变了。一些竞争对手如微软等却做的很棒，他们看到了这种变化并且开始向PC厂商提供他们正在寻找的信息。
target_text: In the 1980s, few companies were aware of the growth of the PC market, so many technicians were free to buy whatever they thought they needed. Borland did well in a highly technologically favoured market. But by the mid-1990s, many companies began to question how much they invested and what they had in the heat of purchasing PC software that they did not control. The company’s decision-making level began to ask the technicians what they were hard to answer, so some common standards began to be developed. This required software manufacturers to provide a new market and support resources, but Borland, under Kahn, was not quick to realize that the market had changed.
title: Borland

source_text: 全面的产品工具集让Borland有了宣布进入应用生命周期管理（ALM）市场的能力，这要提供从需求分析，设计开发到测试发布所需要的一系列的软件开发工具。2004年，Borland公布了它的软件付运优化（SDO）市场计划，这是一个包含了ALM和更高级软件生产概念如项目组合管理和评估工具的计划。
target_text: In 2004, Borland published its software delivery optimization (SDO) market plan, a plan that includes both ASM and more advanced software production concepts, such as portfolio management and evaluation tools.
title: Borland

source_text: 一个基于计算机的信息系统是以计算机软件、硬件、資料存取和資訊流通等技术为核心的人机交互系统。信息系統是由一系列相互關聯的組件構成，是通過信息的收集，處理，存儲及發佈為組織決策和組織控制提供支持的系統。信息系統包括組織內部及其周邊環境中所有重要人員，地理​​位置，和事物的相關信息。來自《Management Information Systems Managing The Digital Firm》
target_text: A computer-based information system is an interactive human system centred on computer software, hardware, access to data, and communication technologies. The information system is a series of interconnected components that are designed to support organizational decision-making and control by collecting, processing, storing and publishing information. The information system includes all key people within the organization and its surroundings, geographical locations, and information about things.
title: 信息系统

source_text: 軟計算（Soft computing）是通過對不確定、不精確及不完全真值的容錯以取得低代價的解決方案和強健性的處理方式，和傳統計算（硬計算）不同。硬計算的主要特徵是嚴格、確定和精確。但是硬計算並不適合處理現實生活中的許多問題，例如駕駛汽車。它模擬自然界中智能系統的生化過程（人的感知、腦結構、進化和免疫等）來有效處理日常工作。軟計算包括幾種計算模式：模糊邏輯、人工神經網絡、遺傳算法和混沌理論。神經網絡通常用於預測。多層感知神經網絡的基本結構由輸入層、中間隱藏層和輸出層組成，輸入因子 (ai) 和權重 (wij) 的乘積被饋送到與神經元偏差 (bj) 相加的結點。模糊邏輯已被用於解決多準則決策、模式識別和疾病診斷等問題。混沌及其應用包括化學、生態學和經濟學。在管理運籌學領域研究包括很多混沌系統，如排隊系統、庫存系統、計劃調度系統等。這些系統的主要特點是在不同的管理決策規則下隊列、庫存和計劃調度的混亂。 混沌管理依賴於變化規則，變化規則是基於有序或無序變化、適應性、新的有序出現過程的一套規則這些算法可以容忍不精確、不確定、部分真實和近似。軟計算與硬計算形成對比：算法可以找到問題的可證明正確和最佳解決方案。這些模式是互補及相互配合的，因此在許多應用系統中組合使用。
target_text: Soft computing is an effective way of dealing with day-to-day work by emulation of uncertainties, inaccuracies, and faults with incomplete truths, in order to achieve low-cost solutions and robustness (hard calculations), unlike conventional calculations. The main features of hard calculations are rigidity, certainty, and precision. But hard calculations are not appropriate to deal with many of the problems in real life, such as driving cars. It emulates the biochemistry of natural intelligence systems (human perception, brain structure, evolution, immunisation, etc.) to effectively handle everyday work.
title: 软计算

source_text:
与传统人工智能的区别
传统人工智能进行符号操作，这基于一种假设：人的智能存储在符号化的知识库中。但是符号化知识的获得和表达限制了人工智能的应用（即符号主义的缺点）。一般的，软计算不进行太多的符号操作。因此，从某种意义上说，软计算是传统人工智能的补充。
target_text: The difference from traditional artificial intelligence is that traditional artificial intelligence operates symbolically, based on the assumption that human intelligence is stored in a symbolic knowledge base. But the acquisition and expression of symbolic knowledge limits the application of artificial intelligence (i.e. the disadvantage of symbolicism). Generally, soft computing does not operate too much symbolically. So, soft computing is, in a sense, a complement to traditional artificial intelligence.
title: 软计算

source_text: 群件（Collaborative software或Groupware），又稱為-{zh-hans:群组软体、協同軟件、协作软件;zh-hk:群件;zh-sg:群组软体;zh-tw:協同作業軟體、協同軟體、群件;}-。群件是一个「网络软件」的概念，它定义了由一组（群）人使用的应用程序。它是基于这样一个设想，因为网络连接用户，这些用户应当通过网络互相协作，作为一个整体而提高组的生产率。电子郵件是一个很好的群件例子。它能使用户间相互通信和协调活动。此处，群件是一个许多不同地方定义许多不同事情的术语。Microsoft Office不是典型的群組軟件的例子。
target_text: Groupware (Collaborate Active Software or Groupware), also known as -- {zh-hans: Group Soft Software, Convergence Software, Collaboration Software; zh-h-hk: Group Software; zh-sg: Group Soft; zh-tw: Working Together Software, Collusive Software, Groupware;}-. Groupware is a concept of "network software" that defines applications used by a group of people. It is based on the idea that, because users are connected to a network, these users should work together through a network to increase group productivity as a whole. E-mail is a good example of groupware. It allows users to communicate and coordinate activities with each other. Groupware is a term that defines many different things in many different places. Microsoft is not a typical example of group software.
title: 群件

source_text: 2003年1月，中国工业科技管理大连培训中心加挂“国家经济贸易委员会大连经理学院”牌子，由国家经济贸易委员会负责管理。同年12月，大连理工大学被中共中央确定为中管干部学校。2006年3月中国工业科技管理大连培训中心改组为“中国大连高级经理学院”，改隶中共中央组织部，是专门培养高级经济管理人才、从事经济与社会发展重大课题研究和国际学术交流的国家教育基地。2012年，由于主管部门职能调整，中国大连高级经理学院改由国务院国有资产监督管理委员会管理，为其直属副部级单位。2007年3月，英特尔与大连市政府、大连理工大学就创建半导体技术学院签署协议。半导体技术学院位于大连市经济技术开发区辽河西路191号。2009年6月21日，校方举行了建校60周年的盛大庆典。2010年，大连理工大学与数所兄弟院校签署卓越人才培养合作框架协议。2012年7月28日，大连理工大学与辽宁省盘锦市签署设立并共办大连理工大学盘锦校区协议。2012年大连理工大学正式启动领军型大学建设工程。
target_text: In March 2006, the China Training Centre for Industrial Science and Technology was reorganized into the “China Senior Management College” and transformed into the Central Organization of China into the National Education Base, which specializes in high-level economic management, research on major economic and social development topics and international academic exchanges. source_text:
所提供功能
Portage主要特色是从源码编译用户所需要安装的软件包。此过程中用户可以调整编译器和目标程序的选项以符合系统需要或自己的喜好。与系统管理相关的功能包括：允许平行版本安装、追踪跨软件包依赖、维护记录已安装软件的数据库、提供本地ebuild库、使本地库与远程库相同步。与个别软件包安装相关的功能有：为目标机器指定编译选项、定制构成软件包的组件。
target_text: The main features of Portage are to compile the software packages that users need to install from the source code. In this process the user can adjust the compiler and target program options to the system ' s needs or preferences. The functions associated with system management include: allowing parallel version installation, tracking cross-package reliance, maintaining a database of records of installed software, providing a local ebuild library, and making the local library the same step as the remote library. The functions associated with the installation of individual packages are: specifying the compiler options for the specific machine, customizing the components that make the package.
title: Portage

source_text: 《玩具總動員》（）是一部於1995年上映的美国计算机动画冒险喜剧片，由皮克斯动画工作室制作，华特迪士尼影业发行。该片是约翰·拉塞特的导演处女作，也是皮克斯制作的一部计算机动画长片和第一部剧场影片。影片的主角是一队在人类面前假装没有生命的拟人化玩具，侧重于提线牛仔玩偶（汤姆·汉克斯配音）和宇航员活动人偶巴斯光年（提姆·艾倫配音）之间的关系。影片由约翰·拉塞特、安德鲁·斯坦顿、、和乔斯·韦登编剧，兰迪·纽曼配乐。史蒂夫·乔布斯和艾德文·卡特姆担纲执行制片人。影片于1995年11月22日在剧院上映。
target_text: Toys Editor () is an American computer animated adventurous comedy, which was launched in 1995 by the Pikes Animated Studio and released by the Walter Disney Films industry. The film was written by John Lacett's director, a long computer animated film and a theatre film by Pikes. The film featured a team of graphic toys pretending to be lifeless in front of humans, focusing on the relationship between the wire-cowboy doll (Tom Hanks dictation) and the cosmonaut-acting cosmonaut, Tim Allen X. The film was filmed by John Lacet, Andrew Stanton, and José Weyden, Randy Newman Quell.
title: 玩具总动员

source_text: 为宣传他们的计算机而制作动画短片的皮克斯在以小玩具讲故事的短片《小锡兵》大获成功后，接触迪士尼，打算制造一部计算机动画长片。拉塞特、斯坦顿和皮特·多克特将先前写好的剧本大纲交给迪士尼，推动一部更前卫的电影。故事卷轴被毁灭后，制作被中断，剧本被重写，皮克斯所希望的“玩具深深希望孩子们能和它们一同玩耍，这种欲望驱动着它们的希望、恐惧和行动”的主题和基调得到更好地反映。工作室之后组建了一支员工相对较少的团队，利用稍微紧缩的财务制作影片。
target_text: The Pixar, who produced animated short films to promote their computers, reached out to Disney, after the success of the short toy story-telling film, and intended to create a long computer animation. Lasset, Stanton, and Peter Dockt gave Disney their previously written scripts to promote a much more advanced film. After the axle was destroyed, the production was interrupted, the script rewrited, and the theme and the tone of the “Toys are keen to play with them, and this desire drives their hopes, fears and actions” was better reflected. After the studios, a relatively small team of staff was formed, using a slightly tight financial production of the film.

source_text: 导演约翰·拉塞特最早的计算机动画经历是在华特迪士尼动画工作室担任动画师时，当时他的两个朋友给展示了《电子世界争霸战》的夜光摩托场景。这次大开眼界的经历使拉塞特意识到计算机生成动画这种新媒介带来的可能性。拉塞特试图给迪士尼提出全计算机动画电影的想法，但想法被驳回，拉塞特也被解雇。他后来供职于卢卡斯影业，后来成为皮克斯的创办人之一，后来1986年皮克斯被企业家、苹果公司创办人史蒂夫·乔布斯买下。在皮克斯，拉塞特创作计算机动画短片，炫耀皮克斯图像计算机的实力。1988年以玩具角度讲故事的短片《小锡兵》引用了拉塞特对经典玩具的喜爱，后来于1988年成为首部赢得奥斯卡最佳动画片奖的计算机动画影片。
target_text: The first computer animation experience of director John Lassett was when he worked as an animator at the Wat Disney Animation Studio when two of his friends showed the night-light motorcycle scene of the Electronic World Wars. The experience of this big opening made Lassett realize the potential of computer-generated animation as a new medium. Lassette tried to present Disney with the idea of a full computer-based animated film, but his idea was rejected, and Lassett was fired. He later worked in the Lucas Film Industry and became one of the founders of Pix, later bought in 1986 by Steve Jobs, an entrepreneur and founder of Apple.
title: 玩具总动员

source_text:
动画
影片的动画师招募很活跃。吸引人才的磁力不是普普通通的薪水，而是参与首部计算机动画长片的魅力。拉塞特表示影片中计算机动画的挑战“迫使我们让影片开起来更有机。必须创造每一片树叶和草叶。我们得给世界一种历史感，所有把门撞开，地板要有磨损。”影片从故事板动画化开始，指引动画师们开发一众角色。27名动画师利用400个计算机模型动画化角色。每个角色要么是泥塑的，要么是用计算机绘制图表建模，之后才进入计算机动画设计。一旦动画师有了模型、发音或编好码的运动控制，每个角色就有了各种各样的运动方式，例如说法、走路或跳跃。所有角色当中，伍迪是最复杂的，需要723项运动控制，其中脸部占212项，嘴部占58项。首段动画是30秒的测试片段，于1992年6月交付迪士尼，当时公司要求影片应有一段展现影片大概的样本。拉塞特用测试中的突破传统手绘动画的东西激发迪士尼创新，如伍迪的黄色格子红色条纹相间衬衣、巴斯头盔的发射和他太空服上的贴花，还有落在安迪房间上的威尼斯人阴影。

From storyboarding, the film has to be designed to guide animators to develop a role. Twenty-seven animationists use 400 computer models to impress the role. source_text: 每个镜头必须经过八个团队的手。艺术部给出每个镜头的配色方案和大致昭明。由克雷格·古德（）主管的布局部则负责把模型放在镜头中，透过设置虚拟相机的位置定好每一帧，给所有机位的移动编程。为了让媒介的感觉尽可能地让人觉得熟悉，他们试图像拍真人电影的真实镜头、开板车、三脚架和起重机那样，保持限度。在指挥动画师里奇·奎德（）和的主导下，每个镜头从布局部转交给动画部。拉塞特选择打破迪士尼指定每位动画师专门负责整部影片中的一个角色的套路，在场景中作出特定例外，在他看来，表演是尤为关键的。动画师使用程序设定每个角色所需的姿势。一旦创建好一系列的关建格，软件就会在帧与帧之间创建关联动作。动画师研究演员录像获取灵感，拉塞特则拒绝自动唇形同步技术。为了让角色的嘴型与演员录制声音的面部表情同步，每8秒的动画就要花费动画师们一个星期时间。
target_text: In order for the media to feel as familiar as possible, they try to keep their limits as if they were shooting real people's films, driving cars, tripods, and cranes. source_text: 互联网协议安全（IPsec）最初是由互联网工程任务组（IETF）为IPv6开发的，在RFC 6434将其作为建议之前，所有符合标准的IPv6实施中都要求使用该协议。这个基于标准的安全协议也被广泛用于IPv4和第二层隧道协议。它的设计符合大多数安全目标：可用性、完整性和保密性。IPsec使用加密技术，将IP数据包封装在IPsec数据包内。解封发生在隧道的末端，原始的IP数据包被解密并转发到其预定的目的地。IKEv2是一个缩写，代表互联网密钥交换第二卷。它是由微软和思科创建的，与IPSec一起用于加密和认证。它的主要用途是在移动设备上，无论是3G还是4G LTE网络，因为它能在连接丢失时有效地重新连接。传输层安全（SSL/TLS）可以对整个网络的流量进行隧道化处理（如OpenVPN项目和SoftEther VPN项目）或确保单个连接的安全。一些供应商通过SSL提供远程访问VPN功能。SSL VPN可以从IPsec遇到网络地址转换和防火墙规则问题的地方连接。数据报传输层安全（DTLS）在Cisco AnyConnect VPN和中使用，以解决SSL/TLS在TCP上进行隧道传输的问题（在TCP上进行隧道传输会导致巨大的延迟和连接中止）。微软点对点加密（MPPE）与点对点隧道协议以及其他平台上的一些兼容实现一起工作。微软安全套接字隧道协议（SSTP）通过SSL/TLS通道对点对点协议（PPP）或第2层隧道协议的流量进行加密（SSTP在Windows Server 2008和Windows Vista Service Pack 1中引入）。多路径虚拟专用网络（MPVPN）。Ragula系统开发公司拥有注册商标 "MPVPN"。Secure Shell（SSH）VPN - OpenSSH提供VPN隧道（有别于端口转发），以确保远程连接到网络或网络间链接。OpenSSH服务器提供有限数量的并发隧道。

source_text: 數學模型（mathematical model）是使用數學來將一個系統簡化後予以描述。數學模型廣泛應用在自然科學（如物理學、化學、生物學、宇宙學）、工程学科（如计算机科学，人工智能）、以及社會科學（如經濟學、心理學、社會學和政治科學）上。科學家和工程師用模型來解释一个系统，研究不同组成部分的影响，以及对行为做出预测。常見的模型包括動態系統、概率模型、微分方程或賽局模型等等。描述不同對象的模型可能有相同的形式，同一個模型也可能包含了不同的抽象結構。

Common models include kinetic systems, probabilistic models, differential equations, or calibration models.

source_text:
广告投放者必须向媒体付费，以求传递它们想要的讯息。这将我们引向了广告投放者用于评判媒体实效性的三条基本标准：
该媒体能接触到的广告投放者的目标市场人群数量有多少？并且，通过市场调查可以进一步了解，他们是什么样的人？
使用该媒体的成本是多少？（与其他媒体相比，该媒体是性价比最高的吗？）
作为广告媒体，尤其是宣传特定商品或服务的媒体，它的影响力和说服力如何？
互联网在短短十几年的时间里已经赢得广告市场的巨大份额。互联网的大多数收益来自“搜索”广告，这类广告让你通过点击广告商提供的列表，转到相应的促销网站。互联网搜索广告行为类似于传统的分类广告，互联网所获得的大多数搜索广告原本属于报纸和杂志上的分类广告。但是，互联网上的展示广告（横幅、弹出窗口，以及类似的其他展示广告）同样也从传统媒体那里抢来了一部分收入，虽然这种抢夺的程度远远比不上“搜索”广告那么夸张。互联网广告已经有了十多年的发展历史，即便如此，没有人能够预测最终它将占到广告业的多大份额，同样也没有人能够预言，传统媒体究竟会遭受怎样的打击。但人们普遍认为，互联网的广告增长还将持续很多年。

source_text:
数码革命
或许创意代理与媒体代理的分离将广告行为的三方架构进一步细分为四方架构：广告投放者、媒体、创意代理和媒体代理。但是当这些变化还没完全被接受的时候，在20世纪末，一股新的活力进入广告业，那就是数码广告，尤其是互联网广告。互联网广告的制作方式和互联网空间的购买方式都不同于以往创意代理和媒体代理的运作。广告代理和客户以两种相反的方式作出回应。一方面，他们建立了高度专业化的新的数码代理；另一方面，许多现有的创意代理和媒体代理建立了数码“部门”，通常以子公司的形式来处理客户的数码广告需求。
target_text: The digital revolution, perhaps the separation of creative agents from media agents, has further broken down the tripartite structure of advertising behaviour into a quadripartite structure: advertisers, media, creative agents, and media agents. But when these changes were not fully accepted, at the end of the twentieth century a new dynamic entered the advertising industry, namely, digital advertising, especially Internet advertising.
title: 廣告

source_text: “搜索”功能是互联网的强大优势，占到所有网络广告收入的60%（剩下的部分属于分类招聘广告）。它与传统广告类别中的名录和分类广告很相似。但互联网有着传统方式难以匹敌的速度和全面性。搜索公司，如Google、Yahoo！、MSN等，在列出的搜索结果中加上广告投放者的公告，鼓励网络用户点击进入广告投放者的网站去寻找更多信息，有时用户会直接在网上购买所需商品。广告投放者出现在电脑屏幕上的位置极大地影响了它所获得的回应。互联网上的展示广告和其他媒体上的展示广告收费方式一样。广告投放者支付的费用取决于受众的规模和性质，以及广告本身的大小和性质。之前我们已经谈到，建立一个网站不存在“媒体费用”。但是，“搜索”广告却有着独特的收费模式：按点击量支付。广告投放者支付给搜索公司以求出现在后者网站上的费用取决于互联网用户通过点击进入该广告投放者网站的次数。这意味着广告投放者的成本与网站访问者的人数直接相关，并且显然（虽然没那么直接）和所取得的销售也相关。这样的紧密联系使得对互联网搜索广告的评估相比其他广告形式更易于量化，虽然量化程度比不上传统的直邮方式。

数据，精确可用的数据可以影响到查询和分析的结果。
硬件，硬件的性能影响到处理速度，使用是否方便及可能的输出方式。
软件，不僅包含GIS软件，还包括各种資料庫，绘图、统计、影像处理及其它程序。
过程，GIS要求明确定义，一致的方法来生成正确的可验证的结果。
target_text: The geo-information system (expansion:) is a comprehensive discipline, combined with geography and cartography, which has been widely applied in different fields, and is a computer system for entering, storing, querying, analysing and displaying geo-data, which can be divided into the following five parts: People, the most important component of GIS. Developers must define the various tasks performed in GIS and develop processing procedures. Skilled operators can usually overcome the deficiencies in GIS software functions, but the reverse is not the case.
title: 地理信息系统

source_text: 一个地理信息系统是一种具有信息系统空间专业形式的数据管理系统。在严格的意义上，这是一个具有集中、存储、操作、和显示地理参考信息的计算机系统。例如，根据在数据库中的位置对数据进行识别。实习者通常也认为整个GIS系统包括操作人员以及输入系统的数据。
target_text: A geographic information system is a data management system with a professional form of information system space. In a strict sense, it is a computer system with centralized, stored, operated, and displaying geo-referenced information. For example, data are identified according to the location in the database.
title: 地理信息系统

source_text: 如果能将你所在州的降雨和你所在县上空的照片联系起来，就可以判断出哪塊湿地在一年的某些时候会乾涸。一个GIS系统就能够进行这样的分析，它能够将不同来源的信息以不同的形式应用。对于源数据的基本要求是确定变量的位置。位置可能由经度、纬度和海拔的x，y，z坐标来标注，或是由其他地理编码系统比如ZIP码，又或是高速公路英里标志来表示。任何可以定位存放的变量都能被反馈到GIS。一些政府机构和非政府组织正在生产制作能够直接访问GIS的计算机数据库。可以将地图中不同类型的数据格式输入GIS。GIS系统同时能将不是地图形式的数字信息转换可识别利用的形式。例如，通过分析由遥感生成的数字卫星图像，可以生成一个与地图类似的有关植被覆盖的数字信息层。
target_text: The basic requirement for source data is to determine the location of variables. Locations may be marked by longitude, latitude, and altitude x, y, z coordinates, or by other geocoding systems, such as ZIP codes, or highway mileage markers. Any variables that can be located can be fed back to GIS. Some government agencies and non-governmental organizations are producing computer databases that can directly access GIS.
title: 地理信息系统

source_text: 空间分析能力是GIS的主要功能，也是GIS与计算机制图软件相区别的主要特征。空间分析是从空间物体的空间位置、联系等方面去研究空间事物，以及对空间事物做出定量的描述。一般地讲，它只回答What（是什么？）、Where（在哪里？）、How（怎么样？）等问题，但并不（能）回答Why（为什么？）。空间分析需要复杂的数学工具，其中最主要的是空间统计学、图论、拓扑学、计算几何等，其主要任务是对空间构成进行描述和分析，以达到获取、描述和认知空间数据；理解和解释地理图案的背景过程；空间过程的模拟和预测；调控地理空间上发生的事件等目的。
target_text: Space analysis is the primary function of GIS and the main feature of the difference between GIS and computer mapping software. Space analysis is a study of space affairs from the space location, connection, etc., and a quantitative description of space matters. In general, it answers only the questions of what (what?), Where (where?), How (how?), How (how?) but does not (can) answer to Why (Why?). Space analysis requires complex mathematical tools, the most important of which are spatial statistics, graphics, hoisting, geometry, etc. The main tasks of which are to describe and analyse the composition of space in order to obtain, describe and recognize space data; to understand and interpret the background of geocharts; to simulate and predict space processes; and to regulate events in geospatial space.
title: 地理信息系统

source_text:
空间分析技术与许多学科有联系，地理学、经济学、区域科学、大气、地球物理、水文等专门学科为其提供知识和机理。除了GIS软件捆绑空间分析模块外，目前也有一些专用的空间分析软件，如GISLIB、SIM、PPA、Fragstats、GeoDa、SatScan、Geodetector等。数据建模将湿地地图与在机场、电视台和学校等不同地方记录的降雨量关联起来是很困难的。然而，GIS能够描述
地表、地下和大气的二维三维特征。
target_text: Space-based analysis techniques are linked to many disciplines, and specialized disciplines such as geography, economics, regional science, atmosphere, geophysics, and hydrology provide them with knowledge and mechanisms. In addition to GIS software, which binds space analysis modules, there are now dedicated space-based analysis software such as GISLIB, SIM, PPA, Fragstats, GeoDa, SatScan, Geodetector, etc. Data modelling links wetland maps to rainfall recorded in different locations, such as airports, television stations, and schools.
title: 地理信息系统

source_text:
汽車導航
汽車導航系統是地理資訊系統的一個特例，它除了一般的地理資訊系統的內容以外，還包括了各條道路的行車及相關信息的數據庫。這個數據庫利用矢量表示行車的路線、方向、路段等信息，又利用网络拓扑的概念來决定最佳行走路線。地理数据文件（GDF）是为导航系统描述地图数据的ISO标准。汽车导航系统组合了地图匹配、GPS定位和来计算车辆的位置。地图资源数据库也用于航迹规划、导航，并可能还有主动安全系统、辅助驾驶及位置定位服务（Location Based Services, LBS）等高级功能。汽车导航系统的数据库应用了。
target_text: A car navigation system is an exception to the geo-information system, which includes, in addition to the general geo-information system, a database of cars and related information on all roads. This database uses vectors to indicate the route, direction, segment, etc., and the concept of web-training to determine the best walking line. The geo-data file (GDF) is an ISO standard for the navigation system to describe map data. The vehicle navigation system combines map matching, GPS positioning, and calculating the location of vehicles. The map resource database is also used for navigational planning, navigation, and may include advanced features such as the active safety system, the auxiliary driving and position positioning service (Location Services, LBS).
title: 地理信息系统

source_text: 开放地理联合会是一个参与一致进程以开发公开地理处理规格的384家公司、政府机构、大学和个人组成的国际行业联合会。由OpenGIS规格定义的开放接口和协议，支持可交互操作的解决方案，网络、无线和定位服务和主流IT。让复杂的空间信息和服务在各种应用可以被授权技术开发人员使用。开放地理联合会协议包括网络地图服务WMS和网络功能服务WFS。地理信息系统由OGC产品划分为两大类型，基于遵循OGC规格的完整准确的软件。地理信息系统技术标准促进GIS工具进行交流。兼容的产品是符合OpenGIS规范的软件产品。当一个产品经过测试，并通过OGC测试项目证明是兼容的，这个产品就在这个地点上自动注册为“兼容”。现实软件产品，即实现OpenGIS规格但还没有通过兼容测试的软件产品。合规测试不可作用于所有的规格。开发者可以注册他们的产品为实施草案或经核准的规范，而OGC有权审查和确认每个条目。
target_text: The Open Geography Association is an international industry federation of 384 companies, government agencies, universities and individuals involved in a consistent process to develop open geo-processing specifications. Open interfaces and protocols defined by OpenGIS specifications support interactive solutions, networks, wireless and positioning services and mainstream IT. Make complex space information and services available to authorized technology developers. The Open Geography Association agreement includes web map services WMS and web function services WFS. GIS is divided into two main types of OGC products, based on complete and accurate software that conforms to OGC specifications. The GIS technical standards facilitate the exchange of GIS tools. Compatible products are software products that meet OpenGIS specifications.
title: 地理信息系统

source_text:
社会
随着GIS在决策中的普及，学者们已经开始审议地理信息系统的社会影响。有人认为，地理信息的生产、分配、利用和表述的很大程度上与社会环境有关。其他相关议题包括版权、隐私和审查的讨论。较为乐观的GIS社会应用是将它作为一个公众参与的工具来应用。
就业方向大概分为：应用和开发。应用主要包括：gis数据处理与分析，遥感图像处理与分析以及测量等相关内容，开发主要可以分为：底层开发、二次开发、web开发等，从某种角度上来说，GIS开发只是计算机编程技术在该领域的具体表现。
target_text: With the spread of GIS in decision-making, scholars have begun to consider the social implications of GIS. It has been argued that the production, distribution, use and presentation of geo-information are largely related to the social environment. Other relevant topics include the discussion of copyright, privacy, and censorship.
title: 地理信息系统

source_text:
安全散列演算法（，縮寫為SHA）是一個密碼雜湊函數家族，是FIPS所認證的安全雜湊演算法。能計算出一個數位訊息所對應到的，長度固定的字串（又稱訊息摘要）的算法。且若輸入的訊息不同，它們對應到不同字串的機率很高。SHA家族的演算法，由美國國家安全局（NSA）所設計，並由美國國家標準與技術研究院（NIST）發佈，是美國的政府標準，其分別是：
SHA-0：1993年发布，当时称做安全散列标准（Secure Hash Standard），发布之后很快就被NSA撤回，是SHA-1的前身。
target_text: The security hash algorithms (as initialized as SHA) are a coded multiplicity family, certified by FIPS, which calculates a fixed long string (also known as the message digest) of a digital message. And if the messages entered differ, they have a high probability of responding to different strings. The SHA family algorithm, designed by the United States National Security Agency (NSA) and published by the United States National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), is a standard for the United States Government, which is different: SHA-0: published in 1993, when it was known as Secure Hash Standard, was quickly withdrawn by NASA, the predecessor of SHA-1.
title: SHA家族

title: SHA家族

source_text: SHA-1（，中文名：安全散列算法1）是一种密码散列函数，美国国家安全局设计，并由美国國家標準技術研究所（NIST）发布为聯邦資料處理標準（FIPS）。SHA-1可以生成一个被称为消息摘要的160位（20字节）散列值，散列值通常的呈现形式为40个十六进制数。2005年，密码分析人员发现了对SHA-1的有效攻击方法，这表明该算法可能不够安全，不能继续使用，自2010年以来，许多组织建议用SHA-2或SHA-3来替换SHA-1。Microsoft、Google以及Mozilla都宣布，它们旗下的浏览器将在2017年停止接受使用SHA-1算法签名的SSL证书。
target_text: SHA-1 (Chinese name: Safe hash algorithm 1) is a cryptographic hash function designed by the National Security Service of the United States and published by the National Institute of Standard Technology (NIST) of the United States as a federal data processing standard (FIPS). SHA-1 produces a 160-bit (20 bytes) hash value known as a digest of messages, which is usually presented in 40 hexadecimals. In 2005, password analysts discovered effective methods of attack on SHA-1, suggesting that the algorithm may not be safe enough to continue to be used. Since 2010, many organizations have suggested replacing SHA-1 with SHA-2 or SHA-3. Microsoft, Google and Mozilla have announced that their browsers will cease to accept SSL certificates using the SHA-1 algorithm signatures in 2017.
title: SHA-1

source_text: 最初載明的演算法於1993年發佈，稱做安全雜湊標準（Secure Hash Standard），FIPS PUB 180。這個版本現在常被稱為SHA-0。它在發佈之後很快就被NSA撤回，並且由1995年發佈的修訂版本FIPS PUB 180-1（通常稱為SHA-1）取代。SHA-1和SHA-0的演算法只在壓縮函數的訊息轉換部份差了一個位元的循環位移。根據NSA的說法，它修正了一個在原始演算法中會降低雜湊安全性的弱點。然而NSA並沒有提供任何進一步的解釋或證明該弱點已被修正。而後SHA-0和SHA-1的弱點相繼被攻破，SHA-1似乎是顯得比SHA-0有抵抗性，這多少證實了NSA當初修正演算法以增進安全性的聲明。
target_text: The original default algorithm was released in 1993, calling it the Security Hash Standard, FIPS PUB 180. This version is now often called SHA-0. It was withdrawn by the NSA shortly after release and replaced by revised versions of FIPS PUB 180-1 (often referred to as SHA-1) released in 1995. The algorithms for SHA-1 and SHA-0 merely missed the rotation of a dimension in the conversion of compressed functions. According to the NSA, it amended a weakness in the original algorithm that would reduce the safety of the dispensaries. However, the NSA did not provide any further explanation or prove that the weakness had been amended.
title: SHA-1

source_text: 就應用層面的考量而言，一種新的破密法出現，暗示着將來可能會出現更有效率、足以實用的改良版本。雖然這些實用的破密法版本根本還沒誕生，但確有必要發展更強的雜湊演算法來取代舊的演算法。在「碰撞」攻擊法之外，另有一種反譯攻擊法（Pre-image attack），就是由雜湊出的字串反推原本的訊息；反譯攻擊的嚴重性更在碰撞攻擊之上，但也更困難。在許多會應用到密碼雜湊的情境（如用戶密碼的存放、文件的數位簽章等）中，碰撞攻擊的影響並不是很大。舉例來說，一個攻擊者可能不會只想要偽造一份一模一樣的文件，而會想改造原來的文件，再附上合法的簽章，來愚弄持有公钥的驗證者。另一方面，如果可以從密文中反推未加密前的使用者密碼，攻擊者就能利用得到的密碼登入其他使用者的帳戶，而這種事在密碼系統中是不能被允許的。但若存在反譯攻擊，只要能得到指定使用者密碼雜湊過後的字串（通常存在影檔中，而且可能不會透露原密碼資訊），就有可能得到該使用者的密碼。
target_text: In addition to "collapse" attacks, there is another type of anti-translation attack (Pre-image attack), which is an attempt to reform the original document, with a legitimate signature attached to it, which makes it more difficult to cover up the public key. On the other hand, the impact of collision attacks is not significant in many situations where passwords are not yet available (e.g., password storage, digital signature of documents, etc.).
title: SHA-1

source_text: 影片的开发在1996年的动画长片《钟楼怪人》完成后开始，制作团队希望这部作品不再是歌舞片，而是以儒勒·凡尔纳著作为灵感的动作历险电影。影片中采用了漫画主创迈克·米格诺拉（）的独特视觉风格。电影上映时，其中使用的计算机绘图镜头比例比迪士尼之前任何动画长片都高，并且仍然是为数不多的几部以变形格式摄制的作品。语言学家马克·奥克兰德专门为本片创作了一种语言，电影配乐由詹姆斯·纽顿·霍华德谱写。本片上映时，观众对动画电影的兴趣正逐渐从手绘动画转移到完全由计算机绘图制作的作品。
target_text: The development of the film began in 1996 with the completion of the animation long film The Clock Tower Monster, which the team hoped would no longer be a song and dance film, but was inspired by Jules Verner's action and adventure film. The film used the unique visual style of the cartoon owner Mike Mignolla. At the time of the film's presentation, the proportion of computer graphics footage used was higher than any of those used before Disney and was still a few of them in a distorted format. Mark Oakland, a linguist, created a language for the film that was written by James Newton Howard. At the time of the film's presentation, the audience's interest in graphic films was gradually shifting from hand-painting to entirely computer-based drawing.
title: 亚特兰蒂斯：失落的帝国

source_text: 《亚特兰蒂斯：失落的帝国》上映时创下了迪士尼动画长片使用计算机绘图镜头的新纪录。为了提高制作效率，两位导演让数字艺术家同传统动画师在整个制作过程中一起合作。许多重要镜头都需要大量采用数字动画，例如利维坦、“尤利西斯号”潜艇和救生舱、亚特兰蒂斯之心以及石体巨人等。制作期间，马特·科德和吉姆·马丁先在纸上绘出“尤利西斯号”，然后再请来格雷格·阿罗诺维茨（）制作潜艇的比例模型，用于给数字动画师绘出“尤利西斯号”的3D图形做参照。最后完成的电影共有362个数字特效镜头，并采用了计算机程序来把2D和3D图像无缝连接。片中3D“尤利西斯号”从停靠海湾进入水中时的救生舱镜头就是通过这一技术来完善。随着镜头拉进，以2D形式展现的迈罗出现在船舱内部并引领镜头前进方向。技术人员表示，他们必须要让2D和3D图像完美结合，避免观众看出破绽，这对他们的工作构成很大挑战。数字制作还让导演们可以使用独特的虚拟摄影机制作电影中的复杂镜头。这种镜头可以在z平面上运行，通过数字线框模型来移动；背景和细节内容则是之后通过手绘加到线框图上。电影开头亚特兰蒂斯上空的飞翔镜头和水下潜艇与利维坦的追逐镜头都使用了这一技术来拍摄。
target_text: During the production period, Matt Cod and Jim Martin first drew on paper the “Ulysses” and then asked Greg Aronowitz to create a scale model of the submarine that would be used to frame the 3D image of the digital artist. The resulting films had 362 digital effects and computer programs to connect the 2D and 3D images seamlessly to the Stone Titans. The 3D “Eulis” in the film had been drawn up on paper, and the images that could be taken from the Gulf into the frame had been refined by this technology.
title: 亚特兰蒂斯：失落的帝国

source_text:
票房
电影上映前，多位记者预计影片面临来自梦工厂的全计算机绘图动画长片《史瑞克》和派拉蒙電影动作冒险片《古墓丽影》（）的竞争，票房上恐怕很难大展拳脚。对于市场从传统动画向计算机动画的转变和竞争，柯克·维斯表示：“包括我在内的任何传统动画师都难免会感到阵痛。我认为（电影）归根究底还是围绕剧情和角色展开的，一种形式也并不就会完全被另一种取代，就像照片不能取代绘图一样。当然，也有可能我对此只是视而不见。”《娱乐周刊》的杰夫·詹森（）认为，像《史瑞克》这样的计算机动画电影可能对于那些通常对动画不感兴趣的青少年更具吸引力，他认为本片无论是在营销还是创意上都是一场赌博。
target_text: Before the film was shown, several journalists predicted that the film would face competition from the dream factory's full computer-based animated long film, Shrek and Paramount Film Action Adventures, and that it would be difficult to make a big punch on the ticket house. For the change and competition in the market from traditional animators to computer animators, Kirk Weiss said: “Any traditional animators, including me, may be more attractive to young people who are usually not interested in animation. I think that one form, whether in marketing or in creative terms, would not be entirely replaced by another, just like a picture. Of course, I may simply ignore it.” Jeff Jensen of the Entertainment Weekly thinks that computer animators like Slick may be more attractive to young people who are usually not interested in animation, and he believes that this film is a gamble in marketing or in creativity.
title: 亚特兰蒂斯：失落的帝国

source_text: 搜狐是2008年北京奥林匹克运动会唯一的互联网赞助商，也是奥林匹克运动会历史上第一个互联网内容的赞助商。尽管搜狐在首页标题声称自己是中国最大的门户网站，但其Alexa排名却低于同类门户网站腾讯网和新浪。在2018年其在Alexa的中国排名于第5位，在门户网站中仅次于腾讯。现时为中国五大视频网（优酷、爱奇艺、腾讯视频、芒果TV）之一。
target_text: Searching Fox is the only Internet sponsor of the 2008 Olympic Games in Beijing and the first Internet content in the history of the Games. Despite its title on the first page claiming to be China’s largest portal, its Alexa ranks lower than its own portal, its web network and its new wave.
title: 搜狐

source_text: 2009年4月2日，搜狐旗下子公司畅游（NASDAQ：CYOU）在美国纳斯达克成功上市，搜狐公司因此也成为中国互联网企业在纳市的第一个“双子星”。2010年9月，搜狐视频的独播剧15天播放总量超过2亿，成为中国网络视频历史上首部进入“两亿”播放量的电视剧。2013年4月24日，搜狐公司旗下移动互联网产品搜狐新闻客户端用户量突破一亿，成为中国首个用户数过亿的新闻客户端。2015年第一季度，搜狗输入法在PC端的覆盖率达到92%，移动端活跃用户规模排名前三。
target_text: On 2 April 2009, NASDAQ:CYOU was successfully marketed in Nasdak, United States, and therefore the Fox Company became China’s first Internet company in Na City as well. In September 2010, a 15-day stand-alone show of Fox video was broadcast totalling more than 200 million, making it the first television show in China’s online video history to reach “200 million.” On 24 April 2013, the search-and-fox clientele for mobile Internet products under the flag of Fox broke 100 million and became China’s first user for hundreds of millions of news. In the first quarter of 2015, dog entry laws reached 92% coverage at the PC end, with mobile end-to-end active users ranked third in the top three.
title: 搜狐

source_text: 2006年，搜狐正式启动公益频道，建立了互联网最大的公益互助平台。2007年4月，搜狐正式成立中国首个“博客基金”，推出了搜狐公益博客群，这是中国首家以博客为载体的专业公益平台，也是中国互联网公司首次将博客这一新媒体系统地引入公益领域，受到了社会各界人士和广大网民的关注与支持。
target_text: In 2006, the search for foxes officially launched the public good channel, creating the largest public good platform on the Internet. In April 2007, the search for foxes officially established China’s first “Blog Fund” and launched the search for fox public good blogs, the first professional public good platform in China with blogs as a vehicle, and the first time that China’s Internet company has systematically introduced this new media for blogs into the public good, with the interest and support of all sectors of society and the wider Internet community.
title: 搜狐

source_text:
遭监管部门查处
2014年4月24日，中国全国“扫黄打非”工作小组办公室通报称，新浪网涉嫌在其读书频道和视频节目中传播淫秽色情信息，并决定拟吊销新浪公司的《互联网出版许可证》和《信息网络传播视听节目许可证》，依法停止其从事互联网出版和网络传播视听节目的业务，并处以5至10倍于违法金额的罚款。新浪随后发布声明，称“对于网络主管部门给予我们的严厉处罚，我们将认真执行，决不推诿”，并向公众“致以最诚挚的道歉”。
target_text: On 24 April 2014, the Office of the Working Group on Cleaning Up the Yellow Badness of China reported that Xinwanet was suspected of spreading obscene and pornographic information on its reading channels and video programmes, and decided to cancel the Internet Publishing Licence and the Information Network Audio-Visual Program Licence of the New Wave Company, cease its operations in Internet publishing and broadcasting audiovisual programmes on the Internet in accordance with the law, and impose a fine of 5 to 10 times the amount of the offence. The new wave subsequently issued a statement stating that “we will seriously enforce the severe penalties imposed on the authorities of the Internet, and will not be discouraged” and that it “commits its sincerest apologies to the public”.
title: 新浪

source_text: 2018年4月16日，国家互联网信息办公室指导北京市互联网信息办公室针对新浪网对用户发布违法违规信息未尽到审查义务，持续传播炒作导向错误、低俗色情、虚假不实等违法有害信息的严重问题，约谈新浪公司负责人，责令其立即自查自纠，全面深入整改。新浪网负责人表示将落实网信部门管理要求，整改期间对问题突出的“新浪博客”网页版、“新浪看点”网页版自行暂停更新1个月，并对“新浪新闻”手机客户端、“新浪博客”手机客户端下架1个月，暂停更新及下架时限为自4月17日15时至5月17日15时。
target_text: On April 16, 2018, the National Internet Information Office directed the Beijing City Internet Information Office to continue to disseminate the serious problem of illegal and harmful information, such as falsely directed, indecently pornographic and falsely false information, in response to the failure of the new wave network to comply with its obligation to review it, and to interview the head of the new wave company with a view to prompt self-censorship and complete overhaul. The head of the new wave network said that he would implement the management requirements of the web service, suspend the web page version of the new wave blog, the new wave viewer page during the reform process for a period of one month, and suspend the new wave news for a period of one month from 17 April to 17 May.
title: 新浪

source_text: 网易是一家中国大陸大型互联网科技公司。目前提供网络游戏、门户网站、移动新闻客户端、移动财经客户端、电子邮件、电子商务、搜索引擎、博客、相册、社交平台、互联网教育等服务。截至2020年1月16日，网易公司的市值为442亿美元，其收入中大约79%来自于在线游戏服务（2019年第三季度）。
target_text: As of January 16, 2020, the market value of the Internet company was $44.2 billion, with approximately 79% of its revenue coming from online games (third quarter of 2019).
title: 网易

source_text:
初创卓越网
1998年8月，金山软件公司得到联想集团注资900万美元，成为中国通用软件业第一大公司。此时，互联网热潮刚刚在中国国内兴起，金山软件也打算投资开设一个IT网站，期望在互联网大潮中有一个立足之地。时任金山软件总经理的雷军联系了知名的个人网站paulgao.com.cn的站长高春辉，计划打造一个专业的下载网站。
target_text: At a time when the Internet boom has just emerged in China, Kimsan is also planning to invest in an IT website, hoping to have a foothold in the Internet. The then Director-General of Kimshan software contacted the well-known personal website, Paulgao.com.cn’s station manager, Takahashi, and plans to build a professional download site.
title: 亚马逊中国

source_text: 1999年2月，卓越网开始上线试运行，当时仅有5名员工，属于金山软件公司下属的一个事业部。卓越网当时的发展目标是「做最大最好的中文下载网站」。卓越网用了半年时间就在CNNIC的网站排名上排到33位，成为知名的中文软件下载网站。1999年8月，卓越网推出自己的离线软件服务系列光盘《卓越软件空间》，随后又推出《卓越软件空间II》以及《卓越软件空间2000》。
target_text: In February 1999, the Network of Excellence began to run on-line, with only five employees at that time belonging to a business department of Kimsan Software. The goal of the Network was to “make the best possible download site in Chinese.” After six months, the Network was ranked 33 on the CNNIC web site, becoming a well-known download site for Chinese software. In August 1999, the Network launched its own off-line software service series, “Excellent Software Spaces”, followed by “Excellent Software Space II” and “Experient Software Space 2000”.
title: 亚马逊中国

source_text:
网上书店模式创立
1999年的中国大陆互联网发展还不健全，作为一个提供IT资讯和下载服务的网站很难得到实际收益。卓越网每月维持运营的费用达到20万人民币，而基本上没有任何收入，全部依赖金山软件的投资。卓越网随后开始改组，转型为B2C电子商务网站，定位为「网上精品店」。2000年1月，卓越网从金山软件公司中分拆出来，金山软件为第一大股东，联想集团所属联想投资为第二大股东，由雷军任董事长，高春辉任总经理。随后，卓越网开始尝试增加网上商店。2000年4月，高春辉宣布因理念不同，辞去总经理职务，离开卓越网。卓越网遂全面停止原有的软件下载服务，随后又停止了IT资讯内容的提供。
target_text: The online bookshop model was created in 1999 as an Internet site providing IT information and downloading services, with little real gain. The network’s monthly maintenance cost is RMB 200,000, with virtually no income, and relies entirely on investment in the gold mountain software. The network of excellence was then restructured and transformed into a B2C e-commerce site, which is known as the “Internet Fine Shop.” In January 2000, the network of excellence was separated from the Golden Mountain Software Corporation, where it was the first shareholder, and the consortium’s association wanted to invest in the second largest shareholder, led by the Lui Army and Director General Kochun.
title: 亚马逊中国

source_text: 2002年，联想集团自己运营的网站FM365.com因定位不明确且无盈利点，在当时中国互联网大潮退却的泡沫中濒于消失。此时联想集团期望从其控股的金山软件手中得到前途看好的卓越网。经过一系列的运作，联想成为卓越网的最大股东。2002年8月16日，王树彤辞去卓越网总裁职位，十天后，联想控股有限公司企划部部主任林水星接任卓越网总裁。2003年4月，运营3年后的卓越网宣布开始盈利。同月，成立卓越网广州分公司，以扩大其在华南地区的影响。9月，德盛老虎基金下属的老虎科技注资5200万，成为卓越网第三大股东。此后，卓越网开始涉足各种日用品的网上零售。
target_text: After a series of operations, Wang Ying became the largest shareholder of the Network of Excellence. Ten days after his resignation from the post of CEO of the Network of Excellence on 16 August 2002, Lin Shui-Sung, the director of the Planning Department of the Federation Limited, took over as CEO of the Network of Excellence. In April 2003, after three years of operation, the Network of Excellence announced that it would be profitable. In the same month, the Guangzhou Branch of the Network of Excellence was established to expand its influence in South China.
title: 亚马逊中国

source_text:
贡献
沃尔是rn新闻组客户端 和广泛使用的patch 程序的作者。他两次在国际C语言混乱代码大赛中获胜，也是1998年自由软件基金会自由软件提升奖获得者。超出他的技术技能，沃尔聪明而且幽默。他在源码的注释里与Usenet中展示幽默。例如：“我们都同意妥协很重要。但是当妥协真地重要时，就开始不同意了。” 以及：
target_text: Vol is the author of the R. News Group client and the widely used patch program. He won two international C-language confusion competitions and was also the winner of the 1998 Free Software Foundation Free Software Promotion Award. Beyond his technical skills, Vol is smart and funny. He shows humor in his source-code notes with Usenet. For example, "We all agree that compromise is important. But when compromise is really important, we don't agree." And:
title: 拉里·沃尔

source_text:
Nmap（网络映射器）是一款用于网络发现和安全审计的网络安全工具，在其首次发布后的前几年之间是 GPL 自由软件，但最近版本的 nmap 是否是 FOSS 自由软件还存在许多质疑和争议。 软件名字Nmap是Network Mapper的简称。通常情况下，Nmap用于：
列举网络主机清单
管理服务升级调度
监控主机
服务运行状况
Nmap可以检测目标主机是否在线、端口开放情况、侦测运行的服务类型及版本信息、侦测操作系统与设备类型等信息。
它是网络管理员必用的软件之一，用以评估网络系统安全。
target_text: Nmap (webmap) is a network security tool for network discovery and security audits, and between the first years after its first release it was GPL Free Software, but the most recent version of Nmap is a FOSS Free Software with many questions and disputes. The software name Nmap is a short name for Network Mapper. Usually, Nmap is used to: list the network host list, manage service upgrade schedule, monitor the host's performance, and Nmap is used to detect information about the target host, port opening, type of services to detect operations and version information, detection operating systems and equipment types. It is one of the software required for network administrators to assess network system security.
title: Nmap

source_text:
Nmap不仅可以用于扫描单个主机，也可以适用于扫描大规模的计算机网络（例如，扫描英特网上数万台计算机，从中找出感兴趣的主机和服务）。Nmap 核心功能主机发现
用于发现目标主机是否处于活动状态。
Nmap 提供了多种检测机制，可以更有效地辨识主机。例如可用来列举目标网络中哪些主机已经开启，类似于Ping命令的功能。
target_text: Nmap can be used not only to scan individual hosts, but also to scan large computer networks (e.g. to scan tens of thousands of computers on the Internet and identify interested hosts and services). The Nmap core server found that it was used to find out if the target host was active. Nmap provides a variety of detection mechanisms that allow more effective identification of the host. For example, it can be used to identify which hosts in the target network are already active, similar to Ping commands.
title: Nmap

source_text:
操作系统侦测
用于识别目标主机的操作系统类型、版本编号及设备类型。
Nmap目前提供1500个操作系统或设备的指纹数据库，可以识别通用PC系统、路由器、交换机等设备类型。防火墙/IDS规避和哄骗
Nmap提供多种机制来规避防火墙、IDS的的屏蔽和检查，便于秘密地探查目标主机的状况。
基本的规避方式包括：封包分片、IP诱骗、IP伪装、MAC地址伪装。
target_text: An operating system detects the type of operating system, version number, and type of equipment used to identify the target host. Nmap currently provides a fingerprint database of 1,500 operating systems or equipment that can identify the type of equipment such as generic PC systems, routers, switches, etc. Firewall/IDS circumvention and deception. Nmap provides a variety of mechanisms to avoid firewalls, IDS shielding and checking.
title: Nmap

source_text:
其他
Nmap 常被跟評估系統漏洞軟件Nessus混為一談。Nmap 以隱祕的手法，避開入侵检测系统的監視，並儘可能不影響目標系統的日常操作。Nmap 在电影《黑客帝国》中，連同的32位元迴圈冗餘校驗漏洞，被崔妮蒂用以入侵發電站的能源管理系統。网路管理软件
端口掃描器
Unix网络相关软件
跨平台軟體
Lua可脚本软件
网络分析器
C++軟體
Python軟體
Linux安全软件
安全测试工具
target_text: Other Nmaps are often confused with Nessus, the evaluation system leak software. Nmap avoids surveillance of the intrusion detection system in a covert way, and may as well not affect the day-to-day operation of the target system. Nmap, in the movie "Hacking Empire" , shares a 32-bit redundancy calibration gap that Trinity uses to hack the power management system of the power station.
title: Nmap

source_text: 在计算方法方面，随着计算机的发展，量子化学计算方法也飞速发展，在1920年代至今的数十年内，涌现出了组态相互作用方法（CI）、多体微扰理论（MP）、密度泛函理论（DFT）以及数量众多形式不一的旨在减少计算量的半经验计算方法，由于量子化学家们的工作，现在已经有大量商用量子化学计算软件出现，其中很多都能够在普通PC机上实现化学精度的量化计算，昔日神秘的量子化学理论，已经成为化学家常用的理论工具。约翰·波普與瓦尔特·科恩分別因為發展首個普及的量子化學軟件（Gaussian）和提出密度泛函理論 （Density Functional Theory）而獲得1998年诺贝尔化学奖。2009年日本山口大學堀憲次教授和行政法人科技振興機構聯合成立過渡狀態科技公司，開拓量子化学於製藥業的實用商用化。
target_text: With the development of computers and the rapid development of quantum chemistry methods, in the decades since the 1920s, cluster interaction methods (CI), multi-body microturbation theory (MP), density-level letter theory (DFT) and a large number of different forms of semi-experienced computational methods aimed at reducing computing have emerged, as a result of the work of quantum chemists, many of which have been able to quantify chemical accuracy on ordinary PC machines. The mysterious quantum chemistry theory of the past has become a common theoretical tool for chemists.
title: 量子化学

source_text: Gaussian ：量子化学领域最著名和应用最广泛的软件之一，由量子化学家約翰·波普的实验室开发，可以应用从头算方法、半经验计算方法等进行分子能量和结构；过渡态能量和结构；化学键及反应能量；分子轨道；偶极矩；多极矩；红外光谱和拉曼光谱，核磁共振，极化率和超极化率，热力学性质，反应路径等分子相关计算。可以运行在Windows、Linux、Mac操作系统中运行，目前最新版本为Gaussian 16。但由於Gaussian Inc.（Gaussian的發展者）排斥其他軟件發展者的行為，而引來不少批評；其行為包括逐使原開發者約翰·波普離開Gaussian Inc.（因而成為學術界其中一件為人齒冷的事件）；禁止其他開發者（包括約翰·波普在內）使用Gaussian（引發起Banned By Gaussian運動）和禁止任何使用者發表比較Gaussian與其他量子化學軟件效能的報告等。Gamess-US ：由於免費與開放源碼，成為除Gaussian以外，最廣泛應用的量子化學軟件，目前由Iowa State Uinversity的Mark Gorden教授的研究組主理。ORCA ：一款从头算量子化学计算软件，包含了密度泛函理论、多体微扰、耦合簇方法、多参考方法以及半经验计算方法。程序包致力于解决较大分子体系、过渡金属及其光谱的计算。程序包由马克斯普朗克煤炭研究所的Frank Neese教授课题组开发与维护。该程序包为闭源，学术用户可免费申请。Q-Chem ：由一群隨約翰·波普離開Gaussian Inc.的學者創立的一個商業量子化學軟件。Spartan ：提供一個十分優良的圖形介面作量子化學計算，尤其適合非從事量子化學研究的學者使用。
target_text: Gaussian: one of the most well-known and widely applied software in the field of quantum chemistry, developed by the laboratory of quantum chemist John Popper, can operate molecular energy and structure from scratch, semi-experienced computing methods, etc.; transition energy and structure; chemical keys and reaction energy; molecular orbits; paranoia; multipolarity; infrared and Raman spectrometry, magnetic resonance, polarisation and hyperpolarization rates, thermal properties, reaction pathways, etc., can operate from the Windows, Linux, Mac operating systems, and currently the latest version is Gausian 16; but other software developers (including Gausian growers) have been excluded, leading to criticisms; their behavior includes the extraction of the original user John Popps from Gausian, the extraction of its miniatures, and the extraction of its miniatures from the technology.
title: 量子化学

source_text: 此軟件中有很大部的電子相關方法的計算程序實源自Q-Chem，所以當使用到該些計算方法而作出報告時，應同時於文獻參考中引述Spartan與Q-Chem。CASTEP ：為一量子力學為基礎的週期性固態材料化學計算的套裝軟體，此程式由英國劍橋大學卡文迪许实验室（Cavendish Laboratory）的凝態物理理論組所共同研究開發。CASTEP是由密度泛函理論為基礎的計算程式所組成，同時採用平面波（plane wave）為基底處理波函數，可針對具有週期性的固態材料表面進行化學模擬計算，而此軟體更具有高精準度以及高效能計算能力的表現。MOLPRO ：应用广泛的量子化学计算软件，软件长于高精度计算，用多参考CI，耦合簇等方法处理电子相关问题能够对较大的分子体系进行准确的从头计算。MOPAC ：应用最广泛的半经验量子化学计算软件，能够以AM1，AM1-d，PM3，MNDO，MNDO-d，MINDO/3等半经验计算方法计算分子体系的自由能，活化能，反应路径，偶极矩，非线性光学特性以及红外光谱等性质。MOPAC 7以前的版本为免费软件，自MOPAC 7开始转为商业软件，目前最新版本为MOPAC2007。MOLCAS ：是一套包含各种量子化学计算方法的软件，可以进行分子结构计算，键能，化学反应的能垒，激发能（包括自旋-轨道耦合），振动分辨吸收光谱，以及各种分子特性的计算，并且可以产生分子间的作用力，用于分子动力学的计算。目前最新版本为MOLCAS 7。CP2K:应用广泛的量子化学和凝聚态物理计算软件，它可以模拟固体材料，溶液，分子，晶体，生物体系。
target_text: CASTEP: A package of periodical solid material chemistry calculations, which is developed by the Q-Chem team at the Cavendish Laboratory, University of Cambridge, using these calculations, should also be used to report on them. CASTEP is based on the Q-Chem. CASTEP is based on the Q-Chem.

source_text: 在今天，Usenet在互联网论坛、博客、邮件列表和社交媒体方面的重要性已经下降。但Usenet在几个方面与这些媒体不同：Usenet不需要注册个人账号；信息不需要存储在远程服务器上；存档随时可用；并且阅读消息不需要使用邮件客户端或浏览器，而是使用新闻组客户端。现在可以使用普通的互联网浏览器阅读和参与Usenet新闻组，因为现在大多数新闻组都被镜像到许多万维网站点。
target_text: Today, Usenet has become less important in Internet forums, blogs, mailing lists, and social media. But Usenet is different from these media in several ways: Usenet does not need to register personal accounts; information does not need to be stored on remote servers; archiving is readily available; and news reading does not need to use mail or browsers, but rather newsgroup clients. It is now possible to read and participate in the Usenet News Group using a normal Internet browser, as most news groups are now mirrored to many web sites.
title: Usenet

source_text:
使用Usenet
许多互联网服务提供商和许多其他互联网站点为其用户提供新闻服务器访问权限。在早期，服务器和新闻阅读器是在同一系统上运行的单个程序。今天，人们使用单独的新闻阅读器客户端软件，这个程序类似于电子邮件客户端，但它用于访问Usenet服务器。一些客户端也提供这种功能，如Mozilla Thunderbird和Outlook Express。
target_text: Many Internet service providers use Usenet and many other Internet sites to provide access to news servers for their users. In the early days, servers and news readers operated on the same system as individual programs. Today, people use a separate newsreader client software similar to an e-mail client, but it is used to access Usenet servers. Some clients also provide this function, such as Mozilla Thunderbird and Outlook Express.
title: Usenet

source_text: 计算机存储器可分为内部存储器（又称内存或主存）和外部存储器，其中内存是CPU能直接寻址的储存空间，由半导体器件制成。内存的特点是存取速率快。我们平常使用的程序，如Windows操作系统、打字软件、游戏软件等，一般都是安装在硬盘等外部記憶體上的，但必须把它们调入内存中运行，才能真正使用其功能，我们平时输入一段文字，或玩一个游戏，其实都是在内存中进行的，数据产生后不断地由内存向外部記憶體进行讀写。就好比在一个书房里，存放书籍的书架和书柜相当于电脑的外部記憶體，而我们工作的办公桌就是内存。通常我们把要永久保存的、大量的数据储存在外部記憶體上，而把一些临时的或少量的数据和程序放在内存上，当然内存的好坏会直接影响电脑的运行速度。
target_text: Computer storage can be divided into internal storage (also referred to as memory or master memory) and external storage, in which memory is a storage space where CPU can directly locate, made of semiconductor devices. The memory is characterized by speed of access. The programs that we usually use, such as Windows operating systems, typing software, game software, etc., are typically installed in external memories, such as hard disks, but they must be brought into memory to be used in order to actually use their functionality, either by entering a text or playing a game, which is actually done in memory, and the data generated is constantly read to external memory. As in a library, the bookcases and cabinets in which books are stored are equivalent to the external memory of the computer, and the desk in which we work is stored.
title: 電腦記憶體

source_text: 大O符号（），又稱為漸進符號，是用于描述函数渐近行为的数学符号。更确切地说，它是用另一个（通常更简单的）函数来描述一个函数数量级的渐近上界。在数学中，它一般用来刻画被截断的无穷级数尤其是渐近级数的剩余项；在计算机科学中，它在分析算法复杂性的方面非常有用。
target_text: Large O symbol(s), also known as progressive symbol, is the mathematical symbol used to describe the behaviour of the function as it is moving closer. More precisely, it is used as another (often simpler) function to describe the step-by-step dimension of a function. In mathematics, it is generally used to carve the rest of the cut-off infinite grades, especially the step-by-step number; in computer science, it is very useful in analysing the complexity of algorithms.
title: 大O符号
