Ping-up programming, in the ping-pong ping-ting program, the observer prepares a failed test example, the driver revises the code to use that example, the observer prepares a new module test example, and so on. This cycle lasts until the observer does not write an example of a failed test. But this method takes more time than an estimated plan.

2017年9月国家互联网信息办公室推出《互联网群组信息服务管理规定》規管多人聊天群組。當月《检察日报》採訪了国家行政学院教授杨小军的看法，「杨小军也认为，管理责任并非上述一些网友所理解的『让群主也要承担群成员违法违规的责任』，在互联网群组中不只有群主一个责任主体，还有群主、参与人（发言人）、网络平台提供商、相关主管部门这四个主体共同参与，才有互联网及其群组的发展进步；同样，四个主体也分别承担相应责任」、「对于一些网友列举出群主需要对群成员的信息发布和传播行为而承担的诸多民事、行政乃至刑事责任，杨小军明确表示了反对：『这个观点实际上是让群主一人负担所有人的责任，甚至把管理部门的责任都归到群主身上。这既不客观，也不可能』」；報導又採訪中国政法大学教授王卫国，「有网友戏称通过司法考试才敢当群主。有的群主对法律法规不是很熟悉，那么其对群成员的信息交流是否违反法律法规该如何判断、管理呢？王卫国表示，这还是网友对管理责任的过大理解。实际上，群主只要根据一般人的判断，认为群成员的表达明显不妥时，给予提示、禁止，就算是已经尽到管理责任了。对于比较专业化的问题，法律法规不可能赋予群主过度的责任。」

source_text:
历史发展
Palm OS是早期由U.S. Robotics(其后被3Com收购，再独立改名为Palm公司)研制的专门用于其掌上电脑产品Palm的操作系统。由于此操作系统完全为Palm产品设计和研发，而其产品由推出时就超过了苹果公司的Newton而获得了极大的成功，所以Palm OS也因此声名大噪。其后曾被IBM、Sony、Handspring等厂商取得授权，使用在旗下产品中。Palm OS操作系统以简单易用为大前提，运作需求的内存与处理器资源较小，速度也很快;但不支援多线程，长远发展受到限制。Palm OS版权现时由PalmSource公司拥有，并由PalmSource开发及维护。2005年9月9日，PalmSource被日本软件开发商爱可信收购，之后改以Access Linux Platform为名，继续开发。新出产的Palm类产品中的Palm OS版本大部分为5.0甚至更高，但市场上仍然未有采用Palm OS 6的产品。
target_text: Palm OS is an operating system developed earlier by U.S. Robotics (subsequently acquired by 3Com and independently renamed Palm) specifically for its hand-held computer product Palm. As the operating system is designed and developed entirely for Palm products, which, at the time of their introduction, were more successful than Newton, Palm OS is now owned by PalmSource and developed and maintained by IBM, Sony, Handspring, among others, under the flag. On 9 September 2005, PalmSource was credibly acquired by Japanese software developers, with smaller memory and processor resources for operational needs, and was quickly restricted in the long term by not supporting multiple lines.
title: Palm OS

source_text:
互联网
由于人们经常受到互联网在线互动的影响，在身份的匿名方面往往更容易被对方交换到手，线下社会的不平等经常会影响人们转移注意力（包括智力、精力、教育和人格），把他们向着互联网上发泄和传达。这个时候，一个人的性别，种族，宗教和社会地位很容易被混淆，不被理解，导致问题愈演愈烈，最后酿成网络暴力。
target_text: The Internet, because people are often affected by online interactions on the Internet, is often more likely to be exchanged for anonymity, and the inequalities in underline societies often affect the diversion of attention (including intelligence, energy, education and personality) and their release and transmission to the Internet. This is a time when a person ' s sex, race, religion and social status are easily confused and not understood, leading to an escalation of the problem and, ultimately, to cyber-violence.
title: 精英政治

综合监控系统
研究互联网、全球化和亚洲人权关系的独立研究员Greg Walton于2001年在加拿大人权与民主发展国际中心（International Centre for Human Rights and Democratic Development）发表了一篇报告《全国公安工作信息化工程：庞大的中国电讯监控工程》。该报告认为，全国公安工作信息化工程是一个对中华人民共和国公民进行综合监控的系统，分数据库和监控网络两部分。他猜测中国大陸當局正在开发或者计划从国外引进的有关技术包括：
target_text: In 2001, Greg Walton, an independent researcher on the relationship between the Internet, globalization and human rights in Asia, published a report entitled National Public Security Information Project: China’s Large Telecom Monitoring Project at the Canadian International Centre for Human Rights and Democratic Development. The report argues that the National Public Security Information Project is a system of comprehensive monitoring of citizens of the People’s Republic of China, with separate databases and surveillance networks.
title: 全国公安工作信息化工程

優勢
中国大陸當局称，该工程旨在提高公共安全部门的反应速度、工作效率和侦查破案水平，并增强各政府部门之间的信息共享。在2000年11月北京举行的“国际社会公共安全产品及警用装备博览会2000”上，公布的全国公安工作信息化工程范围包括：“出入口监控、反骇客入侵、通信安全、电子计算机配件和软件、解密和加密、电子商业安全、外联网和内联网保安、防火墙、网络通讯、网络安全和管理、安全操作、智能卡保安、系统安全、病毒察觉、信息科技有关服务”等
target_text: According to the Chinese Regional Bureau for mainland China, the project aims to improve the responsiveness, efficiency and detection of cases in the public security sector, and to enhance information-sharing among government departments. At the International Expo on Public Security Products and Police Equipment 2000, held in Beijing in November 2000, the national public security information project was launched in the following areas: “access control, anti-homicide intrusion, communications security, computer accessories and software, declassification and encryption, electronic business security, extranet and Intranet security, firewalls, network communications, network security and management, security operations, smart card security, system security, virus detection, information technology and related services”
title: 全国公安工作信息化工程

source_text:
而在技术层面上，

防火長城的科研实力雄厚，中华人民共和国国内研究信息安全的顶尖人才和实验室有不少在为其服务，比如哈工大的信息安全重点实验室、中科院计算所、北邮；而金盾的科研实力相对较弱，主要负责研发维护工作的公安系统的公安部第三研究所信息网络安全研发中心、国家反计算机入侵与防病毒研究中心都缺乏科研力量和科研成果。
防火長城之父方滨兴没有参与全国公安工作信息化工程，工程院里支持全国公安工作信息化工程的是沈昌祥。
target_text: At the technical level, the Fire Safety Wall is dependent on three international Internet exports, with China’s internal exchange centres conducting intrusion defenses, spreading to some of the routes located at ISPs to achieve the effects of blocking IPs and some of the websites, concentrating their positions and having fewer equipment; and the King Shield, which is located at the major clearing-house data centres, is a vast and ubiquitous source of scientific research. The Fire Safety Wall’s scientific capacity is so strong that many of the best people and laboratories in the People’s Republic of China for research and information security, such as the Information Security Focus Laboratory, the Chinese Academy Calculator, and the North Post, are serving it; and the Golden Shield’s scientific capacity is relatively weak, with the Security Research and Development Centre of the Third Institute of the Public Security Department, which is primarily responsible for developing and maintaining the Public Security System, the National Centre for Anti-computer Invasions and Antivirus Research, lacking scientific power and research results.

source_text: 发展藍牙用于在不同的设备之间进行无线连接，例如连接计算机和外围设备，如：打印机、键盘等，又或让个人数码助理（PDA）与其它附近的PDA或计算机进行通信。具备藍牙技术的手机可以连接到计算机、PDA甚至连接到免持听筒。事实上，根据已订立的标准，藍牙可以支持功能更强的长距离通讯，用以构成无线局域网。。可以将每个设备配置为不断向附近的设备声明其存在以便建立连接。另外也可以对二个设备之间的连接进行密码保护，以防止被其他设备接收。
target_text: Bluetooth development is used to connect wirelessly between different devices, such as computers and peripherals, such as printers, keyboards, etc., or to allow personal digital assistants (PDAs) to communicate with other nearby PDAs or computers. Cell phones with bluetooth technology can be connected to computers, PDAs, or even freephones. Indeed, according to established standards, Bluetooth can support more functional long-distance communications to form wireless local area networks.
title: 藍牙

source_text: 可计算性（Computability）是指一个实际问题是否可以使用计算机来解决。从广义上讲如“为我烹制一个汉堡”这样的问题是无法用计算机来解决的（至少在目前）。而计算机本身的优势在于数值计算，因此可计算性通常指这一类问题是否可以用计算机解决。事实上，很多非数值问题（比如文字识别，图象处理等）都可以通过转化成为数值问题来交给计算机处理，但是一个可以使用计算机解决的问题应该被定义为“可以在有限步骤内被解决的问题”，故哥德巴赫猜想这样的问题是不属于“可计算问题”之列的，因为计算机没有办法给出数学意义上的证明，因此也没有任何理由期待计算机能解决世界上所有的问题。分析某个问题的可计算性意义重大，它使得人们不必浪费时间在不可能解决的问题上（因而可以尽早转而使用除计算机以外更加有效的手段），集中资源在可以解决的问题上。
target_text: Computability refers, in fact, to whether a practical problem can be solved by a computer. Problems such as “cooking me a hamburger” in the broad sense are not resolved by a computer (at least for the moment), and the computer itself has the advantage of numeracy, so computing usually refers to whether this type of problem can be solved by a computer. Many non-numeric problems (such as word recognition, image processing, etc.) can be transferred to a computer by conversion to a numerical problem, but a problem that can be used should be defined as “a problem that can be solved within a limited step”, so Goldbach assumes that such an issue is not one of “calculable” because the computer does not have the means to provide mathematical proof and therefore has no reason to expect that the computer can solve all the problems of the world.
title: 可计算性

source_text: 《电脑报》是在中国大陆由重庆科学技术协会主管，重庆电脑报出版有限责任公司出版发行的一份以电脑及其相關訊息的周报，由陳宗周于1992年1月3日創辦，早年与西南师范大学计算机学院合办，后该学院退出。电脑报报名由聂荣臻题写。現每周近88版版面，內容以產品測試、硬件配置、應用軟件、編程技術與新聞評論等大類，並接受讀者投稿、選舉等。电脑报每份定价人民币3元，每周周一发行新报。自创刊以来一直是中国大陆销量最高的计算机类刊物，并且报纸中开设短信、邮件等读者互动栏目。每月月末的一期为月末刊，有时可能会增加新版块。每年年底电脑报发行合订本，一般为上下两册合订书和电子光盘。另外电脑报开设有 数动连线 ，主要内容为IT评测门户。
target_text: The Computer Journal is a weekly newspaper published by Chongqing Science and Technology Association in China and published by Chongqing, the company with limited responsibility, with computers and their related messages. It was launched on 3 January 1992 by Chen Jong-hyeon and co-sponsored with the University College of Computers of the Southwest Teacher University in the early years, after which it was withdrawn. The computer newspaper was registered by Nie Yong. It is now published in nearly 88 editions a week, with product tests, hardware configurations, software applications, programming techniques and news reviews, and receives readers' contributions, elections, etc. Each computer report is priced at RMB3 and is published on Monday. It has been the most popular computer magazine in the mainland of China since its inception, and has an interactive field for readers, such as SMS, mail, and so on.
title: 电脑报

source_text: 和这些系统的定性研究相关的领域是物理、化学和生物，以及机械工程和电子工程。但是，由于纳米科技的多学科和学科交叉的特性，物理化学、材料科学和生物医学工程的学科也被视作纳米技术重要和不可缺少的组成部分。纳米工程师们住眼观新材料的设计，合成，定性描述和应用。例如在分子结构上的聚合物制造，在表面科学基础上的计算机芯片分布设计，都是纳米科技在当代的应用例子。在纳米科技中，胶状悬浮也有很重要的地位。
target_text: The areas relevant to the qualitative study of these systems are physics, chemistry, biology, and mechanical and electronic engineering. But, because of the multidisciplinary and multidisciplinary nature of nanotechnology, the disciplines of physicochemistry, material science, and biomedical engineering are also considered to be important and essential components of nanotechnology. Nani engineers look at the design, synthesis, qualitative description and application of new materials. For example, polymer production on molecular structures, and computer chip distribution based on surface science, are examples of contemporary applications of nanotechnology.
title: 纳米技术

source_text: 電腦協助證明是二十世紀出現的證明方式。直到二十世纪中，人们一直认为任何的数学证明都应当能够被一个水平足够的数学家检验，以证实其正确性。然而，今天的数学家已经能够运用计算机来证明定理，并且完成人类難以做到的计算。1976年四色定理的证明是计算机辅助证明的经典例子。证明的方法是将地图上的无限种可能情况减少为1936种状态，并由计算机对每个可能的情况进行验证。有不少数学家对于计算机证明持谨慎态度，因为很多证明太长，不能由人手直接验证。此外，算法上的错误，输入时的失误甚至计算机运行期间出现的错误都有可能导致错误的结果。
target_text: Computer help proved to be the proof of the twentieth century. Until the twentieth century, it was thought that any mathematical proof should be tested by a mathematician at a level sufficient to prove its validity. Today, however, mathematicians have been able to use computers to prove theorem and to complete calculations that humans could not do. The proof of the four-colour theory in 1976 was a classic example of computer-assisted proof. The proof was to reduce the limitless conditions on the map to 1936 states and to be validated by computers. Not many scientists were cautious about computer proof because many certificates were too long and could not be verified directly by hands.
title: 數學證明

source_text:
动画制作
《南方公园》风格的灵感来自于特里·吉列姆为蒙提·派森的飞行马戏团制作的剪纸动画。两个短片和预订剧集是靠传统硬纸板剪成的形象利用定格动画制作而成的。随后的剧集都是用電腦制作完成的，只是模仿了剪纸的风格。所有的角色和物体都是由简单的图形和各种原色组成。大多数儿童角色都有同样的形状和大小，需要靠不同的衣服来区分。与其他手绘动画不同，制作人员故意将他们行动时的动作绘制得十分僵硬。但偶尔一些真实世界中的名人角色的头是直接从他们真实的照片截取下来的。节目中的加拿大人的形象更为抽象。当该节目改用计算机制作时，所有的硬纸板都被扫描到计算机中并通过CorelDRAW重新绘制，然后被导入运行在硅谷图形公司工作站上的中。这些工作站与54-处理器的一个每小时能处理10到15个镜头的着色农场连接在一起。从第五季开始，制作者们改用了Maya。制作组现在采用的是120-处理器、能每小时处理30多个镜头的着色农场。尽管制作组采用了更多现今的软件提高了画面的品質，但他们依然采用了各种技术来保留节目廉价硬纸板风格。
target_text: Animated by the Southern Park style, most of the roles of children are drawn in the same shape and size as the flying circus of Monti Parsons. Unlike other hand-paintings, the action of the producers in their actions is deliberately rigid. But occasionally, the head of some of the world’s famous characters is cut directly from their real pictures. Canadians in the show are more abstract. When the program is computer-made, all of the paperboards are scanned in computers and redrawed through CorDRAW. Most of the children’s characters need different clothes.
title: 南方公園

source_text: PowerBuilder是Powersoft（美国著名的数据库应用开发工具厂商，现已被德国SAP集团旗下的Sybase公司收购）推出的可视化数据库集成开发工具，它是一个专业的客户机／服务器应用程序开发工具。PowerBuilder目前的最新版本是12.6，最新版本最大特点是支持了Odata，且和APPEON結合可以達到寫一套程式可以在C/S、手機(android和iOS)和WEB平台上使用。它能够设计传统的基于客户机／服务器体系结构的应用系统，从6.0版本开始也能够开发基于Internet的应用系统（Web.PB）。
target_text: PowerBuilder, a visualized database integration development tool introduced by PowerBuilder, a well-known database development tool manufacturer in the United States that has now been acquired by Sybase, under the flag of the German SAP group, is a professional client/server application development tool. PowerBuilder, the latest version of which is currently 12.6, is most characterized by support for Odata and has been able to combine with APPEON to produce a program that can be used on C/S, mobile phones (androids and iOS) and WEB platforms. It is able to design the traditional customer-based system of application/server systems, and can also develop an Internet-based application system (Web.PB) from version 6.0.
title: Powerbuilder

source_text: 随着移动终端设备的广泛使用，移动计算机和移动终端等设备也开始需要接入网路（Internet），但传统的IP设计并未考虑到移动节点会在连接中变化互联网接入点之问题。传统的IP地址包括两方面的意义：一方面是用来标识唯一的主机，另一方面它还作为主机的地址在数据的路由中起重要作用。但对于移动节点，由于互联网接入点会不断发生变化，所以其IP地址在两方面发生分离，一是移动节点需要一种机制来唯一标识自己，另一是需要这种标识不会被用来路由。移動IP便是为了能让移动节点能够分离IP地址这两方面功能，而又不彻底改变现有互联网的结构而设计。
target_text: With the widespread use of mobile terminal devices, mobile computers and mobile terminal devices have started to require access to the Internet, but the traditional IP design does not take into account the fact that mobile nodes change Internet access points in connection. The traditional IP address has two meanings: on the one hand, it is used to mark the only mainframe and, on the other hand, it is used as the host address that plays an important role in the route of the data. For mobile nodes, however, as Internet access points are subject to constant change, their IP addresses are separated in two ways, firstly, the mobile node requires a mechanism to mark itself and, on the other hand, the node is not required to be used as a route. The move IP is designed to enable the mobile node to separate the functions of the IP node without completely changing the structure of the existing Internet.
title: 移动IP

source_text: 网际协议第6版（，縮寫：IPv6）是网际协议的最新版本，用作互联网的協議。用它来取代IPv4主要是为了解决IPv4地址枯竭问题，同时它也在其他方面对于IPv4有许多改进。IPv6的设计目的是取代IPv4，然而长期以来IPv4在互联网流量中仍佔据主要地位，IPv6的使用增长缓慢。在2022年4月，通过IPv6使用Google服务的用户百分率首次超过40%。
target_text: IPV4 is the most recent version of the Internet protocol, which is used as an agreement for the Internet. It was used to replace IPv4 primarily to address the depletion of IPv4 addresses, while it also has many improvements on IPv4. IPv6 was designed to replace IPv4, but IPv4 has long been dominant in Internet traffic, and IPv6 has been used slowly. In April 2022, the percentage of users using Google services through IPv6 exceeded 40% for the first time.
title: IPv6

source_text:
背景與目標
现今的-{zh-hans:互联网络;zh-hk:互聯網絡;zh-sg:互联网络;zh-tw:網際網路;}-发展蓬勃，截至2018年1月，全球上網人數已達40.21億，IPv4僅能提供約42.9億個IP位置。雖然目前的网络地址转换及无类别域间路由等技術可延緩網路位置匱乏之現象，但為求解決根本問題，從1990年開始，互联网工程工作小组開始規劃IPv4的下一代協定，除要解決即將遇到的IP位址短缺問題外，還要發展更多的擴充功能，為此IETF小組創建IPng，以讓後續工作順利進行。1994年，各IPng領域的代表們於多倫多舉辦的IETF會議中，正式提議IPv6發展計劃，該提議直到同年的11月17日才被認可，並於1996年8月10日成為IETF的草案標準，最終IPv6在1998年12月由互联网工程工作小组以互聯網標準規範（RFC 2460）的方式正式公佈。
target_text: As of January 2018, the number of Internet users in the world had reached 4,021 million, and IPv4 could provide only about 4,290 million IP positions. While the current Internet address conversion and the lack of inter-area access could be delayed by technology, zh-hk: Internet; zh-sg: Internet; zh-sg: Internet; zh-tw: Internet;}-development boom, as of January 2018, the Internet Engineering Working Group began to work on the next generation of IPv4, which, in addition to the shortage of IP addresses that will soon be encountered, will be expanded until November 17, when IPng for the IETF small group will be created in order to facilitate the continuation of the work. In 1994, IPng representatives in various fields formally referred to the development of IPv6 in the IETF conference held in Toronto, which was the first time to address the need to address the shortage of IPv4 and the need to develop additional capabilities until November 24, when it became the official version of the ITF, which was announced in August, 1998 (which is the latest version of the ITF, which will be used in August).
title: IPv6

source_text:
主要的IPv6公告
在2003年，日本經濟新聞（在2003年被CNET亚洲机构引用）报告中说日本、中国和韩国声称已经决定要在网络技术中寻求领先，将部分参与IPv6的开发并在2005年开始全面采用IPv6。
ICANN在2004年7月20日发表声明，称DNS根服务器已经建立对应日本（.jp）和韩国（.kr）的顶级域名服务器的AAAA记录，序列号为2004072000。对应法国的（.fr）IPv6记录会再晚一点时间加入。
2011年互联网协会将6月8日定为世界IPv6日。包括Google、Facebook和雅虎在内的参与者将在当天对他们的主要服务启用IPv6，以推进互联网工业加速部署全面IPv6支持。

target_text: The external data expression (abcrypted as XDR) is a standard data sequence format used primarily for computer network protocols. This is done in the OSI representation layer. source_text: 组件对象模型（，縮寫）是微軟的一套软件组件的二进制接口标准。这使得跨编程语言的进程间通信、动态对象创建成为可能。COM是多项微软技术与框架的基础，包括OLE、、ActiveX、COM+、DCOM、Windows shell、DirectX、Windows Runtime。COM與實作語言種類無關，如此使用它實作的物件可用在不同於開發它的環境，甚至跨越機器邊界。對製作良好的物件，COM使物件得以重複使用，而無須知道其內部實作，因為它強制實作者提供與實作分離、確切定義的介面。各語言不同的儲存配置語意使用物件參照計數(Reference counting)管理其自身的產生與銷毀。不同介面間型別轉換的鑄型用 QueryInterface 方法。

辅助网页浏览的技术
残障人士会使用以下辅助技术来进行和协助网页浏览：
屏幕阅读器软件使用合成的声音来朗读屏幕上的指定内容（对有阅读或学习困难的用户很有帮助），或者读取屏幕上一切内容（针对盲人或视力障碍患者）。
盲文设备，包括可刷新的盲文显示机，以及普通键盘或盲文键盘。盲文显示器会将文字渲染成盲文字符（通常通过在平坦表面上打孔来实现点阵的表现）。
屏幕放大软件可放大计算机显示器上的内容，从而帮助视力障碍患者阅读。
语音识别软件可以识别对计算机发出的语音指令，或者将语音转换为逻辑通顺的对应文字，此类软件对那些使用鼠标或键盘有困难的人很有帮助。
对于那些移动不便的人，键盘覆盖器可以使打字变得更容易或更准确。
视频中针对盲人提供的字幕或者手语。
target_text: (c) Braille devices, including new Braille displays, as well as normal keyboards or Braille keyboards. The Braille displays render the text into Braille characters (typically performed by punctures on flat surfaces). The screen magnifying software helps people with visual impairments to read the contents of computer displays. Voice recognition software recognizes voice commands given to computers, or converts them to logical correspondence, which is helpful to those who have difficulty using mouse marks or keyboards. For those who are unable to move, keyboard covers can make it easier or more accurate to type words.
title: 網頁親和力

source_text: Dingbats，俗称杂锦字型，本来是印刷品之中使用的装饰及图形符号。在计算机被用来制作印刷刊物后，印刷业界便制造了各种杂锦字型，最著名的是Adobe的Zapf Dingbats字型。微软于Windows 3.1操作系统之中，提供了Wingdings杂锦符号字型。而微软于1997年之后发行的操作系统，再加入了Webdings杂锦符号字型。
target_text: Dingbats, commonly known as Combine fonts, were used as decorations and graphic symbols in print products. After computers were used to produce printed publications, various cobbler fonts were created in the printing industry, the most famous being Zapf Dingbats in Adobe. Microsoft, in Windows 3.1, provided the Wingdings cobbler font. And Microsoft issued the operating system after 1997, adding Webdings cobbler fonts.

source_text: DHCP使用了租约的概念，或称为计算机IP地址的有效期。租用时间是不定的，主要取决于用户在某地连接Internet需要多久，这对于教育行业和其它用户频繁改变的环境是很实用的。透过较短的租期，DHCP能够在一个计算机比可用IP地址多的环境中动态地重新配置网络。DHCP支持为计算机分配静态地址，如需要永久性IP地址的Web服务器。
target_text: DHCP uses the concept of a lease, or the period of validity of a computer IP address. The renting time is uncertain, depending mainly on how long it takes for the user to connect to the Internet somewhere, which is practical for the education industry and other users to change frequently. Through a shorter lease term, DHCP is able to reconfigure the network dynamically in an environment where a computer has more access to an IP address. DHCP supports the allocation of static addresses to computers, such as web servers that require a permanent IP address.
title: 动态主机设置协议

source_text: 由于计算过程是对整个图像的并行处理，需要进行计算的信息量可能非常巨大（Tb/s）。这样大的计算量可以补偿通常几微秒的记录时间。几微秒的时间对于通常使用的电子计算机来说已经是很长的时间了。对动态全息图像的光处理也不如电子计算机的处理方法灵活。从一方面来说，人们总是需要对整个图像进行处理，但是从另一方面来说，对全息图像的处理又是非常基本的，通常是乘法或者相位共轭等等。但是在光学处理中，加法和傅立叶变换在线形材料中都是非常实现的（傅立叶变换可以简单的通过透镜来实现）。这样就使得在某些应用中，设备可以使用光学方法对图像进行比较。
target_text: Since the computation process is parallel processing of the entire image, the volume of information that would need to be calculated may be very large (Tb/s). source_text: 目前的研究中，人们正在积极寻找一些新型的非线性光学材料。最常见的材料就是光折变晶体，还有半导体、半导体异质（如量子阱）、原子蒸汽和气体、等离子体，甚至是能够产生全息图像的液体。一个非常可能得到重要应用的研究是光学相位共轭。它可以通过让光线再次穿过具有共轭相位的介质来移除光线在穿过致像差介质时产生的波前失真。在自由空间光通信中，这个技术可以用于补偿大气干扰（这是造成星光闪烁的原因）。
target_text: Current research is actively looking for new types of non-linear optical materials. The most common materials are photo-transformation crystals, semiconductors, semiconductors (e.g. quantum luminescence), atomic vapours and gases, plasmas, and even liquids capable of generating holograms. A study that is very likely to be used for important applications is optical phase co-location. It can remove pre-polar truths from light as it passes through a medium with a common phase. In free space light communication, this technology can be used to compensate for atmospheric interference (which is the cause of star flashing).
title: 全息摄影

source_text: 微处理器的元件常安装在一个单片上或在同一组件内，但有时分布在一些不同芯片上。在具有固定指令集的微型计算机中，微处理器由算术逻辑单元和控制逻辑单元组成；在具有微程序控制的指令集的微型计算机中，它包含另外的控制存储单元。
target_text: The components of the microprocessor are often installed on a single piece or in the same component, but are sometimes distributed on a number of different chips. In microcomputers with fixed command sets, the microprocessor consists of arithmetic logic units and control logic units; and in microcomputers with microprogramme control packages, it contains additional control storage units.

source_text: 1968年盖瑞特被邀请参加研制一种数字计算机，以同正在开发中的用于美国海军F-14雄猫战斗机的主飞行控制电脑的电机系统竞争。这个以基于MOS（金屬氧化物半導體）技术的芯片组为核心的CPU于1970年设计完成，并以更小的体积和更高的可靠性打败了基于电机系统的设计，被运用于早期的所有雄猫战斗机。但今天看来，知道CADC和MP944芯片组的人并不多，主要原因在于美国海军认为这种技术太过先进而不允许将其设计细节公开，这种情况一直持续到1997年。
target_text: In 1968, Garrett was invited to participate in the development of a digital computer to compete with the main flight control system being developed for the American Navy F-14 males and cats. The CPU, which was designed in 1970 as a core of a chip group based on MOS (metal oxide semiconductors), defeated the design of an electrical system with smaller volumes and higher reliability, and was applied to all the early male cat fighters. Today, however, it appears that there are not many people who know the CADC and MP944 chips, mainly because the US Navy considered the technology to be too advanced to allow the details of its design to be made public, a situation that continued until 1997.

source_text: 根据麻省理工出版的《现代计算史》第200页到221页，英特尔同圣安东尼奥的一家叫做计算机终端的公司（后改名为数点公司）签署了一份合同，合作设计一块用于终端的芯片。数点后来决定不用这块芯片了，而採用TTL邏輯電路設計跑相同的指令集，英特尔隨即将該芯片其命名为8008,并于1972年4月上市销售。这是世界上第一块8位微处理器，也是后来《无线电电子》杂志卖的著名的马克-8计算机的主要部件。8008及其后继产品8080开创了微处理器的市场。
target_text: According to the modern computing history published by MIT, pp. 200-221, Intel signed a contract with a company called a computer terminal in San Antonio (subsequently renamed Dots Company) to design a chip for the terminal. The dots later decided not to use the chip, and TTL logical circuits were used for the same set of instructions, which Intel was named 8008 and marketed in April 1972. This was the first eight microprocessors in the world and the main component of the famous Mark-8 computer that was later sold in Radioelectronic magazine.
title: 微处理器

source_text: 另外德州仪器出的TMS 9900也是早期的单片16位处理器，同TI 990兼容。9900用在了TI 990/4小型机，TI-99/4A家用电脑和TM990系列OEM品牌微机上。这块芯片封装成在一块陶瓷64脚双内线（DIP）芯片，而当时大多数8位微处理器都用更便宜的40脚DIP。后续产品TMS 9980针对英特尔的8080推出，全兼容TI 990的16位指令集，一次传输8位数据，设计成塑料40脚DIP，但是只能寻址16KB。TMS 9995是这个系列的第三块芯片，使用了全新的设计。此系列产品后来扩展到了99105和99110。
target_text: TPS-9900 from the Texas instrument was also an early single 16-bit processor compatible with TI990. 9900 was used on the TI 990/4 mini machine, the TI-99/4A home computer and the TM990 series OEM micromechanical microchip. The chip was wrapped in a ceramic 64-footed inner line (DIP) chip, and most of the eight microprocessors used a cheaper 40-foot DIP. The follow-up product TMS 9980 was launched for 8080 in Intel, which was fully compatible with the T-990 set of 16 commands, transmitted eight-bit data at a time, designed as 40-foot DIP in plastic, but was only able to locate 16 KB. TPS 9995 was the third chip in the series, using new designs.
title: 微处理器

source_text: 英特尔走了一条不同的路，由于没有小型机可以模拟，他们采取扩充8080的办法设计出了16位的8086，这是后来几乎统治PC芯片的x86家族的第一个成员。英特尔推出的8086使得8080上的软件可以很经济的移植重用，商业上获得的成功超出预期。接着英特尔又发布80186，80286，还有1985年推出的32位80386，这些处理器都是向前兼容的，造就了英特尔PC市场的霸主地位。
target_text: Intel took a different path, and, in the absence of a small machine that could be simulated, they designed a 16-digit 8086 by expanding it to 8080, the first member of the X86 family who later ruled almost the PC chip. Intel launched 8086, which enabled 8080 software to be economically transplanted, with commercial success exceeding expectations. Intel then released 80186,80286 and 32 of the 80386, introduced in 1985, which were compatible with the dominance of the IntelPC market.

source_text: 世界上第一块单片32位微处理器是AT&T贝尔实验室的BELLMAC-32A，样本于1980年，1982年正式投产。1984年AT&T解体后更名为WE32000（WE代表西部电子），后来又推出了后续产品WE32100和WE32200。这些芯片用在了AT&T的3B5及3B14小型计算机、世界上第一台超级台式微机3B2，还有世界上第一台笔记本式超级微机“亚历山大”上（这种系统使用类似于现在游戏机上用的ROM插件）。所有这些系统都运行贝尔实验室的UNIX操作系统，包括叫做xt-layers的第一个窗口系统。
target_text: The world's first single 32-bit microprocessor, BelLMAC-32A of the AT&Tbel Laboratory, was officially commissioned in 1980 and 1982. After the dissolution of AT&T in 1984, it was renamed WE32000 (WE for Western Electronics) and subsequently launched WE32100 and WE32200. The chips were used on 3B5 and 3B14 small computers at AT&T, the first super-desk microscope in the world, 3B2 and the world's first laptop super-microscope “Alexander” (a system similar to that currently used on a game machine). All these systems run the UNIX operating system at Bell Laboratory, including the first window system called xt-layers.
title: 微处理器

source_text: 最著名的32位微处理器是摩托罗拉于1979年推出的MC68000。这片被称为68K的芯片具有32位的寄存器，但是内部和外部数据总线都是16位的，这样可以减少芯片的脚数。摩托罗拉将其描述为16位处理器，但是显然这是块有32位结构的芯片。由于速度快、内存寻址空间大（16兆）价格低廉，MC68000很快成为此类CPU中最流行的型号。1980年代中期，很多公司都用它来装配机器，其中包括Atari ST和Commodore Amiga，最为知名的大概算苹果公司的Apple Lisa和Macintosh了。
target_text: The 32 most famous microprocessors are MC 68,000, which was launched by Motorola in 1979. The chip, known as 68K, has a 32-digit transmitter, but the internal and external data bus is 16-digit, which reduces the number of feet of the chip. Motorola describes it as a 16-digit processor, but apparently it is a 32-digit chip. Because of its speed, the high price of the memory search space (16 gigabytes), MC 68,000 quickly became the most popular model of this type of CPU. In the mid-1980s, many companies used it to assemble machines, including Atari ST and Comodore Amiga, the most well-known major apple companies, Apple Lisa and Macintosh.

source_text: 68000的成功让摩托罗拉继续推出MC68010，这块芯片加入了对虚拟内存的支持。1985年又推出了MC68020，增加了完全的32位数据和地址总线。68020在Unix超级微机市场上获得巨大成功，许多小公司也用它生产桌面系统。MC68030芯片内集成了内存管理器，几乎成为除DOS外所有机器的标准处理器。MC68040合成了浮点运算器，数学运算性能得到提高。68050未能达到设计要求，没有发行。后继的68060采用了更快的RISC设计。1990年代早期，68K开始淡出桌面系统的市场。
target_text: The success of 68,000 has allowed Motorola to continue to roll out MC68010, a chip that has joined the support for virtual memory. A further MC68020 was launched in 1985, adding a full 32-digit data and address bus. 68020 was a great success in the Unix super-micromarket, and many small companies used it to produce desktop systems. MC68030 was built into a memory manager and became a standard processor for almost all machines except DOS. MC68040 synthesized a floating-point operator and mathematical operations were improved. 68050 failed to meet design requirements and was not issued. Subsequent 68060 adopted a faster RISC design. In the early 1990s, 68K began to fade out of the market for desktop systems.

As a result, only one excellent product, the Sequent NS 32032 system, was phased out, and Sequent was replaced by Intel’s microprocessor.
title: 微处理器

source_text: 互联网协会（，簡稱ISOC）是一個非營利的國際性組織，成立於1992年，以促进使用互联网使用為目的。它的会员制有以下几种：个人（任何人均可免费加入）、公司、组织、政府及大学。由它产生的主要标准，会交到網際網路工程工作小组（IETF）和網際網路结构委员会（IAB）。互联网协会有两个联合办事处，分别位于美国維吉尼亞州及瑞士日内瓦。
target_text: The Internet Association (ISOC) is a non-profit international organization established in 1992 to promote the use of the Internet. It has the following membership: individuals (free of charge for anyone), companies, organizations, governments and universities. The main standards it generates are referred to the Internet Engineering Working Group (IETF) and the Network Structures Committee (IB). The Internet Association has two joint offices, in Virginia, the United States, and Geneva, Switzerland.
title: 互联网协会

source_text: 随着计算机技术的迅速发展，使用计算机进行大量数值运算来求解空氣動力學方程式成为可能。利用數值法以及計算流體力學方法，可以求出非線性偏微分方程的数值解，得到所需要的各種数据，从而省去了大量的實驗成本。由于数学模型的不断完善以及计算机计算能力的不断提高，现在已经可以采用電腦模擬流場的方式來取代部分空气动力学實驗。
target_text: With the rapid development of computer technology, it is possible to use computers for a large number of numerical calculations to solve air dynamics equations. Using numerical values and computational fluid mechanics methods, it is possible to achieve the numerical resolution of non-linear differential fractional equations and to obtain the various types of data needed, thus saving a great deal of experimental costs. As a result of the continued refinement of mathematical models and the increasing computing capacity of computers, it is now possible to replace some aerodynamic experiments with computer simulation dumps.
title: 空气动力学

source_text: 主引导扇区记录着硬盘本身的相关信息以及硬盘各个分区的大小及位置信息，是数据信息的重要入口。如果它受到破坏，硬盘上的基本数据结构信息将会丢失，需要用繁琐的方式试探性的重建数据结构信息后才可能重新访问原先的数据。主引导扇区内的信息可以通过任何一种基于某种操作系统的分区工具软件写入，但和某种操作系统没有特定的关系，即只要建立了有效的主引导记录就可以引导任意一种操作系统（操作系统是建立在高级格式化的硬盘分区之上，是和一定的文件系统相联系的）。
target_text: The main steering sector records relevant information about the hard disk itself, as well as information about the size and location of each segment of the hard disk, which is an important entry to the data information. If it is destroyed, the basic data structure information on the hard disk will be lost and it will require a cumbersome attempt to recreate the data structure information before it can re-access the original data. The information in the main steering sector can be written through any sort of partitioning tool software based on an operating system, but there is no specific connection to an operating system, i.e., any operating system (the operating system is based on an advanced formatted harddisk partition and is linked to a certain file system) if an effective primary lead record is established.
title: 主引导记录

source_text: PSP是在其推出时功能最为强大的便携式电子游戏机，在许多任天堂便携式电子游戏机的竞争对手（如SNK的Neo Geo Pocket和诺基亚的N-Gage）失败以后，这是它的第一个真正的对手，PSP以其先进的图像性能，使其成为一种十分流行的便携式娱乐设备。其能够连接至PlayStation 2和PlayStation 3电子游戏机、运行Microsoft Windows和麥金塔操作系统的个人电脑、其他的PSP游戏机及互联网。PSP是除飞利浦CD-i 370外唯一一款主要使用光盘格式存储的便携式电子游戏机，其使用的光盘为通用媒體光碟（或称为UMD）。它受到大多数电子游戏评论家的积极评价，截至2012年共售出了7600万部。
target_text: The PSP, which was the most powerful portable video game machine at the time of its launch, was the first real competitor of many Nintendo portable video games (e.g. Neo Geo Pocket of SNK and N-Gage of Nokia), with its advanced visual performance, making it a very popular portable entertainment device. It was able to connect to PlayStation 2 and PlayStation 3 electronic games, personal computers running Microsoft Windows and McKintat operating systems, other PSP games and the Internet. The PSP was the only portable video game machine stored mainly in CD-ROM format, except for Philips CD-I 370, which used CD-ROMs (or UMD). It was positively evaluated by most electronic game commentators, with 76 million copies sold as of 2012.
title: PlayStation Portable

source_text: 虽然系统软件不区分机器的区域版本，但索尼建议用户应该下载对应机型区域的系统更新。系统软件更新为PSP增加了许多功能，包括网络浏览器，Flash播放器的支持，各种媒体的附加编解码器，PlayStation 3（PS3）的连接以及针对安全漏洞（以及的执行）的补丁。最新版本的系统软件的版本为6.61，于2015年1月15日发布。
target_text: While the system software does not distinguish between regional versions of machines, Sony suggests that users should download system updates of the corresponding machine-type areas. The system software upgrades add many features to the PSP, including web browsers, Flash player support, additional codecs for various media, PlayStation 3 (PS3) connections, and patches to address security gaps (and implementation). The latest version of the system software was 6.61, released on 15 January 2015.
title: PlayStation Portable

source_text: 2005年6月15日，黑客反汇编了PSP的代码并将代码公布在互联网上。最初，修改过后的PSP只能运行一些玩家自制的代码或一小部分受保护的软件，比如自制的PSP应用程序、计算器或文件管理器。索尼也一直在通过升级系统固件来封堵被黑客利用的系统漏洞，但一些用户对系统固件进行了修改，使其能够运行更多的自制内容和运行拥有数字版权管理的软件和游戏。黑客为PSP编写了一些特殊的程序，使其能从记忆棒中读取UMD光碟的ISO备份文件，来运行拥有版权数字管理的游戏。比较受欢迎的PSP有M33自制固件，Minimum Edition (ME/LME) CFWm和PRO CFWl。
target_text: On June 15, 2005, the hacker countercompiled the PSP code and posted it on the Internet. Initially, the modified PSP was able to run only a few home-made PSP codes or a small number of protected software, such as home-made PSP applications, calculators, or file managers. Sony has also been blocking the system loopholes used by hackers by upgrading system fixes, but some users have modified the system solids to enable them to run more home-made content and run software and games with digital copyright management.
title: PlayStation Portable

source_text:
圆周率
蒙特卡罗方法可用于近似计算圆周率：让计算机每次随机生成两个0到1之间的数，看以这两个实数为横纵坐标的点是否在单位圆内。生成一系列随机点，统计单位圆内的点数与总点数，（圓面積和正方形面積之比為PI:4，PI為圓周率），当随机点取得越多时，其结果越接近于圆周率（然而準確度仍有爭議：即使取10的9次方个随机点时，其结果也仅在前4位与圆周率吻合）。用蒙特卡罗方法近似计算圆周率的先天不足是：第一，计算机产生的随机数是受到存储格式的限制的，是离散的，并不能产生连续的任意实数；上述做法将平面分割成一个个网格，在空间也不是连续的，由此计算出来的面积当然与圆或多或少有差距。
target_text: The Monte Carlo method can be used to calculate the circle ratio approximately: let the computer randomly generate two zero-to-one numbers at each time, to see whether the points at which these two figures are the vertical coordinates are in a unit. Generate a series of random points, the number of points in the statistical unit circle versus the total number of points (the ratio of the dots to the squares is PI:4, the dotted ratio) and, when the random points are obtained, the result is closer to the circle rate (although the exact level is still controversial: even if the nine dots of 10 are taken, the result is only the first four dots of the dome ratio. The Monte Carlo method is close to the birth of the dome rate: first, the random numbers generated by computers are restricted by the storage format, are scattered and do not produce any continuous, arbitrary numbers; the approach above divides the plane into a grid and is not continuous in space, and the resulting area is certainly not consistent with the circle or more or less.
title: 蒙地卡羅方法

source_text:
在机器学习中的应用
蒙特卡洛算法也常用于机器学习，特别是强化学习的算法中。一般情况下，针对得到的样本数据集建立相对模糊的模型，透過蒙特卡洛方法对于模型中的参数进行选取，使之于原始数据的残差尽可能的小。从而达到建立模型拟合样本的目的。
target_text: The Monte Carlo algorithm is also often used in machine learning, especially for enhanced learning. Generally, a relatively vague model of the sample datasets obtained is developed to select the parameters in the model through the Monte Carlo method so that they are as small as possible from the original data.
title: 蒙地卡羅方法

source_text: 该算法以谷歌公司创始人之一的拉里·佩奇（）的名字來命名。谷歌搜索引擎用它来分析网页的相关性和重要性，在搜索引擎优化中經常被用來作为評估網頁优化的成效因素之一。目前，佩奇排名算法不再是谷歌公司用来给网页进行排名的唯一算法，但它是最早的，也是最著名的算法。
target_text: The algorithm is named after Larry Page, one of Google’s founders. The Google search engine uses it to analyse the relevance and importance of web pages, often used in search engine optimization as one of the factors for evaluating the effectiveness of website optimization. At present, the Pec ranking algorithm is no longer the only algorithm that Google uses to rank web pages, but it is the first and most famous algorithm.
title: PageRank

source_text: PageRank是一种链接分析算法，它通过对超链接集合中的元素用数字进行权重赋值，实现“衡量集合范围内某一元素的相关重要性”的目的。该算法可以应用于任何含有元素之间相互引用的情况的集合实体。我们将其中任意元素E的权重数值称为“E的PageRank”（The PageRank of E），用符号表示为 。其他的因素，类似“作者排名（Author Rank）”同样可以影响到该元素的权重值。
target_text: PageRank is a link analysis algorithm that achieves the purpose of "measures the relative importance of an element within a set" by giving weight values to elements in a hyperlinked collection using numbers. This algorithm can be applied to any collective entity that contains cross-references between elements. We call any element E the weight value of the element "The PageRank of E" as a symbol. Other factors, similar to the author's ranking, can also affect the weight of the element.
title: PageRank

source_text:
算法
PageRank算法通过输出概率分布来体现某人随机地点击某个链接的概率。PageRank值（PR）可以在任何规模的文件（document）集合中计算得出，而每个链接都指向该集合中的某个特定文件。相关研究论文指出，在初次计算前，总概率将被均分到每个文件上，使得集合中的每个文件被访问的概率都是相同的。接下来在重复多次的计算（又称为“迭代”）中，算法将根据集合的实际情况不断调整PR值，使得其越来越接近最真实的理论值。
target_text: The PageRank algorithm reflects the probability that a person will randomly click on a link by output probability distribution. The PageRank value can be calculated in a document collection of any size, and each link points to a particular file in the collection. The study notes that, before the initial calculation, the total probability will be distributed equally to each file, making every file in the collection the same probability of being visited. Next, in repeated calculations (also referred to as “overlay”), the algorithm will continuously adjust the PR value to the actual situation of the collection, bringing it closer to the most real theoretical values.
title: PageRank

source_text:
缺陷
PageRank算法的主要缺點在于旧的页面的排名往往会比新页面高。因为即使是质量很高的新页面也往往不会有很多外链，除非它是某个已经存在站点的子站点。这也是PageRank需要多项算法结合以保证其结果的准确性的原因。例如，PageRank似乎偏好于维基百科页面，在条目名称的搜索结果中，维基百科页面经常在大多数页面甚至所有页面之前，此现象的原因则是维基百科内部网页中存在大量的内链，同时亦有很多站点链入维基百科。
target_text: The main drawback of the PageRank algorithm is that old pages tend to rank higher than new ones. Because even new pages of high quality often do not have many outer chains, unless it is a subsite where a site already exists. This is why PageRank needs multiple algorithms to combine to ensure the accuracy of its results. For example, PageRank seems to prefer Wikipedia pages, which often predates most and all pages in search of entries.
title: PageRank

source_text: OS/2是由微软和IBM公司共同创造，后来由IBM单独开发的一套操作系统。OS/2是“”的缩写，是因为该系统作为IBM第二代个人电脑PS/2系统产品线的理想操作系统引入的。历史在DOS于PC上的巨大成功后，以及GUI图形化界面的潮流影响下，IBM和Microsoft共同研制和推出了OS/2这一当时先进的个人电脑上的新一代操作系统。最初它主要是由Microsoft开发的，由于在很多方面的差别，微软最终放弃了OS/2而转向开发Windows系统。

source_text: 控制点的摄影测量加密是摄影测量的一项主要内容，以往控制点的加密主要采取图解法或光学机械法，随着电子计算机工业的发展，测绘计算也采用了计算机，控制点的加密现今都采用了解析空中三角测量。它是将建立的投影光束、单位模型或航带模型以及区域模型的数学模型，根据少量的地面控制点，按最小二乘的原理进行平差计算，解求出各加密点的地面坐标。

source_text: 量子点是在把激子在三个空间方向上束缚住的半导体纳米结构。粒子在三个方向上都处在势阱中。势阱可以由于静电势（由外部的电极，掺杂，应变，杂质产生），两种不同半导体材料的界面（例如：在自組量子点中），半导体的表面（例如：半导体纳米晶体），或者以上三者的结合。量子点具有分离的量子化的能谱。所对应的波函数在空间上位于量子点中，但延伸于数个晶格周期中。其中的能级可以用类似無限深方形阱的模型来描述，能级位置取决于势阱宽度。
target_text: The quantum point is the nanostructure of the semiconductor that binds the impulse in three spatial directions. The particles are in a position of strength in each of the three directions. The position can be attributed to static power (by external electrodes, mixing, reaction, impurities), the interface between two different semiconductor materials (e.g., in self-assembly subpoints), the surface of the semiconductor (e.g., semiconductor nanocrystals), or a combination of the three above. The quantum point has a discrete mass nucleic spectrum. The corresponding wave function is located in the space at a quantum point, but extends to several crystal cycles. The level of energy can be described in a model similar to that of an open-treathed square, depending on the width of the position.

source_text: 假体旨在尽量恢复缺失身体部位的正常功能，冀望用其修復器官或肢體的功能障礙（不論暫時性或永久性），或是用來掩飾肢體傷殘。例如截肢康复主要由康复医师协调一组调跨领域团队，其成员含康复医师、假肢技师、护理师、物理治疗师和作业治疗师。假体可由手工或计算机辅助设计制作，目前多利用后者以软件界面生成二维和三维图形以及其分析工具、优化工具，来协助技师设计和分析假体作品。
target_text: Prosthetics are designed to restore the normal function of missing parts of the body as much as possible, hoping to use them to repair organs or limbs for functional impairments (regardless of temporary or permanent nature) or to disguise limb injuries. For example, amputation rehabilitation is coordinated by a rehabilitation physician, a cross-cutting team consisting of rehabilitation practitioners, prosthetic technicians, paramedics, physiotherapists and operation therapists. Prosthetics can be designed manually or computer-assisted, and the latter are now used to generate two-dimensional and three-dimensional graphics with software interfaces, as well as their analytical tools, optimization tools to assist technicians in the design and analysis of prosthetics.
title: 假體

source_text: 間諜軟體（）是在未经用户许可的情况下搜集用户个人信息的计算机程序。这个词在1994年创建，至2000年开始广泛使用，并且和广告软件以及恶意软件经常互换使用。间谍软件本身屬於一种恶意软件，用来侵入用户计算机，在用户没有许可的情况下有意或者无意对用户的计算机系统和隐私权进行破坏。
target_text: Spy software () is a computer program that collects user personal information without user permission. The term was created in 1994 and began to be widely used until 2000, and is used interchangeably with advertising software and malicious software.
title: 间谍软件

source_text:
功能
间谍软件采用一系列技术記录用户的个人信息，例如记录键盘输入、录制用户访问互联网的行为，以及扫描用户计算机上的文件。间谍软件的用途也多种多样，从盗窃用户的网上账户（主要是银行信用卡帐户）和密码，到统计用户的网络行为作為广告用途。一些间谍软件统计用户访问的网站，并且不断在用户计算机上弹出广告窗口，但是更多间谍软件搜集用户的密码以侵占用户的财产。
target_text: Spy software uses a range of techniques to record user personal information, such as keyboard input, recording user access to the Internet, and scanning user computers. Spy software is also used for a variety of purposes, ranging from the theft of user online accounts (mainly bank credit card accounts) and passwords to the statistical user’s online behaviour for advertising purposes. Some spy software users visit websites and consistently eject advertising windows on user computers, but more spy software collects user’s passwords to usurp user’s property.
title: 间谍软件

source_text:
運作模式
间谍软件的常見運作模式不外乎利用色情或樂趣利誘用戶，或是採用“訴諸恐懼”的策略。一般來說，不少間諜軟件都會透過網路廣告，欺騙用戶他們的電腦有問題，而只要他們下載廣告內宣傳的軟件就可以解決問題。之後，軟件會指用戶的電腦有問題，並欺騙用戶只有他們的軟件才能夠解決問題；若用戶意圖取消使用，軟件可能會作出恐嚇。
target_text: The usual mode of operation of spy software is no more than the use of pornography or euphoria to seduce users, or the use of a “prosecution of fear” strategy. In general, a lot of spy software uses Internet advertising to deceive users and their computers, and they can solve the problem by downloading the announced software. After that, software will point to computer problems for users, and it will only be possible for users to use their software to solve the problem; if users intend to deuse it, software may be a threat.
title: 间谍软件

source_text:
爭議
间谍软件催生一个新兴的反间谍软件行业，很多程序被设计用以删除间谍软件，阻止间谍软件的安装，以及从用户的电子邮件中删除间谍软件，一些软件也捆绑间谍软件甚至集成间谍软件的功能，使得反间谍软件的工作更加困难。一些人争论这些软件的合法性，认为用户在安装软件之前應得到用户同意，但是用户通常对软件的间谍行为不知情，同时也未许可软件利用用户的计算机资源为软件拥有者谋利。
target_text: Some argue about the legitimacy of the software, arguing that users should consent to the software before it is installed, but that users are often not aware of the spy behaviour of the software and are not authorized to use the user’s computer resources to benefit software owners.
title: 间谍软件

source_text:
反制方式
手動或利用軟體，把它們所屬公司的網址放入屏障之內。
谨慎安装随软件附带的插件。例如3721科技公司旗下的「上網助手」及「網絡實名」、百度插件、划词搜索、网络猪等。
对于Windows系统需要经常更新（update），为Internet Explorer的漏洞打上补丁。使用非IE浏览器，例如Firefox、Opera等，可以避免很多网页恶意代码。使用反间谍软件扫描和清理系统，例如Windows Defender、AVG Anti-Spyware、CounterSpy等。
使用可以监视程序通信情况的防火墙，例如在Windows下可以使用ZoneAlarm防火墙，禁止不明程序访问网络。
检查系统中是否还有残存的不明程序，可以使用IceSword，大部分内核级的恶意程序，都会在IceSword中现形，当然也要求用户对Windows系统比较熟悉。
target_text: The use of non-IE browsers, such as Firefox, Opera, and so on, avoids a lot of negative web codes. The use of anti-intelligence software scanning and cleaning systems, such as Windows Defender, AVG Anti-Spyware, CounterSpy, etc., will require regular updating (update) of the Windows system and patches to the bugs of the Internet Explorer.

source_text: USACO提供一个题库可供全世界所有的信息学竞赛选手进行训练。题库共有6个chapter，为六档难度的试题。每一个chapter中一般有4~5个section，每一个section集中介绍某一类型的试题。在section的开头一般会有一篇算法介绍，然后有4~5道试题。每一道试题都可以提交USACO服务器评测。与一般的在线评测系统不同的是，USACO不仅会告诉你评测结果，还会提供给你所有的测试数据。另外，在通过一道题之后，还会提供USACO自己撰写的题解，只是在交上去之后，你的程序并不能被保存，所以不能从上面得到你的源代码。
target_text: USACO provides a collection of questions for all of the world's informatics contestants. source_text: USACO的训练题库具有非常强的顺序性。除非将某一个section中所有试题都通过，你无法得到下一个section的算法介绍和试题。这训练了信息学竞赛选手面对棘手的问题和错误时坚持不懈的品质，但也在某种程度上为选手造成了麻烦。USACO极为重视对算法时间效率与优化水平的考察，很多试题必须要进行非常细致的优化才能够通过。几个典型的例子如Checker Challenge, Cryptcowgraphy, Latin等。
target_text: The USACO training library is very sequential. Unless all of the tests in one section are passed, you will not be able to get the next section's algorithmic introduction and test. This has trained the information contesters in the quality of perseverance in the face of difficult problems and mistakes, but it has also caused some difficulty for the contestants. USACO attaches great importance to the examination of the time efficiency and optimization of the algorithms, and many of the tests will have to be optimized very carefully. Several typical examples are Checker Challenge, Cryptcowgraphy, Latin, etc.

source_text:
早期
开发飞行模拟器的计划始于1976年。当时，一位名叫的程序员在一组关于三维计算机图形程序的文章中提出了他的设想。当杂志编辑对他说订阅用户想要购买这个程序时，Bruce Artwick便开始着手开发，并在1977年成立了一家名为的公司。公司最初为包括Intel 8080、Altair 8800和在内的若干计算机平台销售飞行模拟器。1979年，subLOGIC公司在Apple II平台上发布了模拟飞行1(FS1 Flight Simulator )。在1980年，subLOGIC发布了可以在上运行的版本。1982年，他们将一个支持彩色图形适配器的IBM PC版本授权给微软，该版本被称为微软模拟飞行(Microsoft Flight Simulator 1.00)。它的不同寻常之处在于，它不是一个需要操作系统的应用程序，而是包含了自己的操作系统。只要打开了程序在运行，默认安装的操作系统就不会运行。在IBM PC兼容系统还不到100%的早期，在IBM PC兼容机还未100%普及的早期，飞行模拟器和Lotus 1-2-3被用作新电脑的非官方兼容性测试软件。 1983年，subLOGIC在Apple II上发行模拟飞行II(Flight Simulator II)，并在1984年移植到Commodore 64、MSX和平台，最后于1986年移植到Amiga和雅达利ST平台上。与此同时，Bruce Artwick离开subLOGIC并设立了，在1988年开始跟进微软模拟飞行3.0及其后的版本。其在3.1版本中达到了商业上的成熟，且继续包含了3D建模和图形硬件加速的使用。
target_text: Early plans for the development of the flight simulator began in 1976. When the editor of the magazine told him that the subscriber wanted to purchase the three-dimensional computer graphics program, Bruce Artwick began to develop it in 1977 and set up a company called the company. The company initially sold the flight simulators for a number of computer platforms, including Intel 8080, Altair 8800 and others. In 1979, SubLOGIC published the simulator 1 (FS1 Flight Simulatort) on the Apple II platform. In 1980, the magazine published the simulator 1 (FS1 Flight Simulatort) on the three-dimensional computer graphics program. In 1980, the sub Logic published a version that could be operated on it. In 1982, they authorized a version of IBM to support the colored graphic adaptor, which was known as a Microsoft simulation flight (Might Simulator 1.00 on the second version of the simulator and the simulator on the second version of the simulator, which had not yet been used in the second version of the Mobura).

Attach more than 70 special sign fonts, hundreds of formula symbols and templates, covering the scientific fields of mathematics, physics, chemistry, geography, etc.

生平

source_text: Unicode标准，额外定义了许多与字符有关的语义符号学。Unicode详细说明了绘制某些语言（如阿拉伯语）表达形式的算法，处理双向文字（比如拉丁文和希伯来文的混合文字）的算法，排序与字符串比较所需的算法，等等。由于Unicode这一名字比较好记，因而它使用更为广泛。不过一般认为，用于打印ISO/IEC 10646-1标准的字体在某些方面的质量，要高于Unicode 2.0。
target_text: Unicode standards, which define many additional semantics associated with characters. Unicode details the algorithms used to map expressions in certain languages (e.g. Arabic), to deal with two-way text (e.g. a mixture of Latin and Hebrew texts), to sort the algorithms needed to compare strings, and so on. It is more widely used because the name Unicode is a better name. However, it is generally believed that the font used to print ISO/IEC 10646-1 standards is in some respects higher than Unicode 2.0.
title: 通用字符集

source_text: 應用程式（），简称应用（或），是软件的主要分類，指為針對使用者的某種特殊應用目的所撰寫的程序，例如文本处理器、表格、会计应用、浏览器、媒体播放器、航空飞行模拟器、命令行游戏、图像编辑器等。与之相对应的是主要功能为驱动计算机运行的系统软件。或者说，应用软件可以直接完成终端用户的工作。 从某种意义上来讲，系统软件是为应用软件服务的，应用软件才是真正直接提供用户工作的。
target_text: Application () applications, short-term applications and/or short-term applications are the main subcategories of software. They refer to programs that are written for a specific user purpose, such as text processors, tables, accounting applications, browsers, media players, aerial flight simulators, command-line games, image editors, etc. Correspondingly, the main function is the system software that drives the computer.
title: 应用程序

source_text: 应用软件可能与计算机及其系统软件相捆绑，也可以被分开发布，并且可能以私有、开源或通用项目的形式编写。为移动平台所编写的应用被称为移动应用。从目前的计算机应用现状来看，业内已有各种各样的应用软件，许多专家也从不同的角度提出了多种不同的应用软件分类方式。
target_text: Applications for mobile platforms are called mobile applications. Given the current state of computer applications, there are a wide range of applications in the industry, and many experts have proposed different types of application classifications from different angles.
title: 应用程序

source_text:
應用軟件的類別
常见的应用软件类型包括：工业自动化软件、业务软件、内容访问软件、 教育软件、仿真软件、多媒体开发软件、产品工程软件等。（一）工业自动化软件
工业自动化（Industrial Automation）是指对工业生产线、工艺流程、生产机器进行控制以便减少人工干预的控制系统，而工业自动化软件则是指用于工业控制系统的应用软件，包括数字化控制、可编程逻辑控制器以及其他工业控制系统等。
target_text: Common types of applications include: industrial automation software, business software, content access software, educational software, imitation software, multimedia development software, product engineering software, etc. (i) industrial automation refers to control systems that control industrial production lines, process processes, production machines to reduce manual intervention, while industrial automation refers to applications used in industrial control systems, including digital controls, programmable logical controllers and other industrial control systems.
title: 应用程序

source_text:
（二）业务软件
业务软件（Business Software）是有助于提高业务生产效率或者度量业务生产效率的应用软件。业务软件又可以细分成多种类型，包括企业软件、企业基础设施软件、信息工作者软件等。需要指出的是，各种类型的软件之间的界限并不是很清晰，有时某种业务软件可能同时属于多种不同的类型。
target_text: (ii) Business Software is an application that contributes to the efficiency of business production or measures the efficiency of business production. Business software can also be broken down into a variety of types, including enterprise software, enterprise infrastructure software, information worker software, etc. It should be noted that the boundaries between various types of software are not very clear, and sometimes some types of business software may belong to a variety of different types at the same time.
title: 应用程序

source_text:
（四）教育软件
教育软件（Educational Software）是一种用于教学或自学的计算机软件。 主要包括儿童学习软件、居家学习软件、教学课件、教学管理软件、娱乐教育软件、教育参考软件、教育软件定制平台、公司培训软件以及特殊教育软件等。（五）仿真软件
仿真软件（Simulation Software）是一种以研究分析、操作培训、娱乐等为目的，模仿真实情景的物理仿真系统或数据仿真系统的计算机软件。仿真软件又可以分为科学仿真、社会仿真、战场仿真、应急响应仿真、飞行驾驶仿真、汽车驾驶仿真、仿真游戏等。
target_text: (iv) Education software. Education software is a computer software used for teaching or self-learning. Mainly, it includes learning software for children, home learning software, teaching lessons, teaching management software, recreational education software, educational reference software, educational software customization platforms, company training software, and special education software. (v) Simultaneous software. Simultaneous software. Simultaneous software is a computer software that imitates real-life physical or data simulation systems for research analysis, operation training, entertainment, etc.. Simulation software can also be divided into scientific simulations, social emulations, battlefield simulations, emergency response simulations, flight driving simulations, auto driving simulations, simulation games, etc.
title: 应用程序

source_text:
（六）多媒体开发软件
多媒体开发软件（Media Development Software）是指用于图形、图像、音频、 视频等多媒体开发的计算机软件。多媒体开发软件又可以分为计算机三维图像软件、计算机动画和图形艺术软件、光栅图形编辑软件、矢量图型编辑软件、视频编辑软件、音频编辑软件、音乐生成器、Web超媒体开发软件等。
target_text: (vi) Multimedia development software (Media Development Software) refers to computer software for multimedia development such as graphics, images, audio, video. 數位視訊電話一直到影像壓縮技術發展到一定程度後才具有可能性。因為頻寬的緣故，以未壓縮的視訊進行視訊電話在早期來說是不切實際的。舉例來說，要實現以無壓縮視訊圖形陣列（VGA）品質（解析度480p、256色）進行即時的視訊通信，需要超過92 Mbps的頻寬。能夠實現數位視訊電話與視訊會議最重要的影像壓縮技術是離散餘弦變換（DCT）。DCT是一種破壞性資料壓縮，這個概念在1972年由Nasir Ahmed提出。並在1973年由德州大學的 T. Natarajan與K. R. Rao開發出演算法。第一個能使用於數位視訊會議的影像編碼標準H.261即以DCT演算法為基礎，國際電信聯盟電信標準化部門（ITU-T）於1988年建立了標準化的H.261，隨後又建立了一系列的H.26x標準。

source_text:
历史概要
數學（算學）在南京大學有的悠久的歷史。何承天、祖沖之等數學家曾是古代南京大學的教席，明朝時南京國子監曾刊刻《演算法》、《演算法大全》等算學著作。清末算學教席楊冰與崔朝慶曾合著中國第一部近代學堂所用綜合科學用表《算表合璧》。民国8年（1919年），南京高等师范学校理化部改为数理化部。随后，何鲁回国来校执教。民国9年（1920年），南京高师国文史地部和数理化部合并为文理科，成立算学系，属文理科。民国10年（1921年），南京高师改为东南大学，是年秋，熊庆来受聘来校，担任数学系主任，编著了中国最早的高等数学教材。民国早年成立的南京大学数学系是中国第一个现代高等数学系。此一时期任教的还有胡明复、段子燮等人。
1927年后中央大学时期，何鲁再度来校，担任数学系主任。1933年，孙光远来校执教，担任系主任，1949年中央大学更名南京大学后，仍任系主任。曾执教的有钱宝琮、唐培经、胡坤升、曾远荣、周鸿经、周炜良等人。
target_text: After being a teacher at the ancient Nanjing University in August (1919), Nanjing’s Pedagogical Department was appointed to serve as the teacher’s teacher’s college’s science department. He returned to the school to be the director of the Faculty of Mathematics in nine years (1920), Nanjing’s Department of Arts and History and the Department of Digitalization were merged into the Faculty of Mathematics and the Faculty of Mathematics of Nanjing in China’s first Ministry of Mathematics in 10 years (1921), Nanjing’s High School was transformed into the Faculty of Mathematics in South China.
title: 南京大学数学系

source_text: 秦九韶算法是一个求一元高次方程的数值解的通用算法，是对贾宪的增乘开方术的改进。13世纪，中国数学家关于开方术的著作很多，但大多散佚，而现传于世的李冶和朱世杰的著作中并没有开方的详细演算步骤。因此，《数书九章》中的“正负开方术”是了解当时解高次方程方法的重要依据。在《数书九章》中，开方法得到极大完善，利用随乘随加的方法得到方程的根。秦九韶的算法中规定“实常为负”。这里的“实”指的是方程中常数项的系数。实际上，秦九韶将方程写作，以便统一解决，这是以往的开方术中没有的。所求的方根是无理数时，刘徽曾经首创继续开方，用十进小数来近似表示方程的根的方法。然而这种方法并没有得到后人的重视，直到秦九韶重新采取这种方法。

source_text: DHT全称为分布式-{zh-hans:哈希; zh-hant:雜湊;}-表（Distributed Hash Table），是一种分布式存储方法。在不需要服务器的情况下，每个客户端负责一个小范围的路由，并负责存储一小部分数据，从而实现整个DHT网络的寻址和存储。使用支持该技术的BT下载软件，用户无需连上Tracker就可以下载，因为软件会在DHT网络中寻找下载同一文件的其他用户并与之通讯，开始下载任务。
target_text: DHT is called Distributed Hash Table, a distributed storage method. Each client is responsible for a small range of routers and for storing a small number of data, thereby enabling the location and storage of the entire DHT network. Using the BT download software that supports the technology, users can download without having to connect to Tracker because the software will find and communicate with other users downloading the same file in the DHT network.

source_text:
歷史
1991年，让-路易·加西带领包括AppleNewton开发员Steve Sakoman在内的一众Apple员工创建了Be公司。Be公司开发了一个全新的操作系统，从设计之初就针对多CPU和多线程的应用程序。与此同时，Apple已陷入不能推出其新操作系统Copland的困境，正在寻找代替品。加西认为这是个黄金时机。1996年，加西要价4亿美金，允许Apple Computer使用BeOS。然而Apple估算Be公司的总值为8000万美金，故此出价1.2亿，后来上升到2亿。最终未能成交，Apple转而购买NeXTSTEP，同时重新得到史蒂夫·乔布斯。
target_text: In 1991, Jean-Louis Gasi led a group of Apple employees, including AppleNewton developer Steve Sakoman, to create Be. Be developed a brand-new operating system that was designed for multiple CPUs and multiline applications from the beginning. At the same time, Apple is in a state of trouble not to roll out its new operating system, Copland, and is looking for alternatives.
title: BeOS

source_text:
特征
BeOS的設計理念是專門用於多媒體處理的“多媒體作業系統”，採用先進的64位文件系統，支援多處理器，其多媒體性能異常優越。BeOS开始是运行在BeBox硬件之上的。与其他同期的操作系统不同，BeOS是为了充分利用现代硬件的优点而编写。针对数字媒体工作优化，BeOS能够充分利用多处理器系统通过模块化的I/O带宽，多线程，抢断式的多任务和被称为BFS的定制64位日志文件系统。BeOS的GUI遵循清晰整洁的设计原理而开发。其API是用C++编写而成，非常容易编程。虽非源于Unix的操作系统，但其实现了POSIX兼容，并通过Unix Shell命令行界面来访问
target_text: Unlike the other operating systems of the same period, BeOS is designed to take full advantage of modern hardware. For digital media optimization, BeOS is able to take full advantage of the multiprocessor system through modular I/O bandwidth, multiwidths, swipedden multitasks, and custom-made 64-bit log file systems called BFS. BeOS GUI follows a clear and neat design theory. Its API is developed using C++ and is easily programmed. It is not derived from Unix ' s operating system, but is compatible with POSIX, and is accessed through the Unix Shell command interface.
title: BeOS

source_text: 1980年代末，个人电脑开始进入中国，当时包括中国政府部门的在内的所有个人电脑几乎全部是安装MS-DOS操作系统。1992年海湾战争和1999年北约入侵南斯拉夫联盟科索沃地区时，成功运用信息战瘫痪了对方几乎所有通讯系统，这使得中国政府很多人认为，由于伊拉克和南联盟各部门使用的电脑操作系统百分之百是微软和其它外国公司的操作系统，虽然没有证据说明美国的计算机软件公司和通讯公司在这场信息战中向美国军方提供了某些后门或计算机病毒，但如果有自己独立的电脑操作系统及相应的软件，在信息战中将比较不容易受到攻击。于是中国科学院软件研究所奉命研制基于Linux的自主操作系统，并于1999年8月发布了红旗Linux 1.0版。红旗Linux最初主要用于关系国家安全的重要政府部门。
target_text: In the late 1980s, personal computers began to enter China, when almost all personal computers, including those of the Chinese government, installed MS-DOS operating systems. When the Gulf War and the NATO invasion of the Yugoslav Federal Republic of Kosovo in 1999, the successful use of the Information War paralysed almost all communication systems of the other side, which led many Chinese governments to believe that since 100% of the computer operating systems used by various sectors in Iraq and the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia were those of Microsoft and other foreign companies, although there was no evidence that American computer software companies and communications companies had supplied some backdoor or computer viruses to the United States military in this information war, their own independent computer operating systems and corresponding software would be less vulnerable to attack in the information war.
title: 紅旗Linux

source_text: 理論上DTMF信號只會在兩個固定的頻率點上出現能量，如何準確又高效地估計這兩個頻率值(低/高頻組)是識別撥號音的關鍵。傳統的頻譜估計方法得到的是一個頻率區間內所有頻率點的估計結果，而對於DTMF信號我們只在乎那8個固定頻率點上的功率譜估計值。而Goertzel算法就是估計DTMF信號功率譜最經典又實用的方法，這個算法只估計DTMF信號特定頻率點上的功率譜。
target_text: The theory is that a DTMF signal will only generate energy on two fixed frequency points, and how to accurately and efficiently estimate these two frequency values (low/high frequency groups) is the key to understanding the sound of the signal. The conventional frequency estimate is the result of an estimate of all frequency points in a frequency range, whereas for a DTMF signal we only care about the value of the power set at the eight fixed frequency points. The Goertzel calculation is the best method for estimating the use of the DTMF power system, which estimates only the power base at the specific frequency point of the DTMF signal.

source_text:
应用
半素数在密码学和数论中非常有用，最显著的例子的是RSA加密演算法和隨機數發生器等公开密钥加密应用。这些应用的基本原理是，计算两素数相乘结果（一个半素数）的过程简单，而反过来整数分解大半素数则比较困难。简单的来说，虽然35很容易就可以被分解成5×7，但是要想分解很大的半素数就不是那么容易了。RSA加密演算法中有一個稱為RSA-2048的半素数，有2,048位元，十進位有617位，RSA曾經公開懸賞200,000美元，給予成功將RSA-2048因數分解的人，迄2007年活動終止，未有人挑戰成功領取懸賞。
target_text: The basic principles of these applications are that the process of calculating the two-digit number multiplys the result (a-digit number) is simple, and in turn it is more difficult to decompose most of the half-digits. In simple terms, 35 can easily be broken into 5 x 7, but it is not so easy to decipher a large half-digit. In the RSA encryption algorithm, there is a half-digit known as RSA-2048, with 2,048 bits, 617 bits, and RSA has been publicly awarded $200,000 to those who have succeeded in dissolving RSA-2048, and no one has successfully won the prize until the end of 2007.
title: 半素数

组件对象模型
组件对象模型（COM）将DLL概念扩充到了面向对象编程。对象能够从另外一个进程调用或者在另外一台机器上运行。COM对象有一个唯一的GUID并且能够实现强大的后台以简化如Visual Basic和ASP这样的GUI前台应用。它们也可以使用脚本语言编程。COM对象的创建和使用比DLL更为复杂。
target_text: The component object model The component object model (COM) expands the DLL concept to an object-oriented programming. The object can be called from another process or run on another machine. The COM object has a unique GUID and can achieve a powerful backstage to simplify GUI front-office applications such as Visual Basic and ASP. They can also be programmed in script language.

source_text:
安全方面
许多P2P网络一直受到怀有各种目的的人的持续攻击。例子包括：
中毒攻击（提供内容与描述不同的文件）
拒绝服务攻击（使网络运行非常慢甚至完全崩溃）
背叛攻击（吸血）（用户或软件使用网络却没有贡献出自己的资源）
在数据中插入病毒（如，下载或传递的文件可能被感染了病毒或木马）
P2P软件本身的木马（如，软件可能含有间谍软件）
过滤（网络运营商可能会试图禁止传递来自P2P网络上的数据）
身份攻击（如，跟踪网络上用户并且进行不断骚扰式的或者是用合法性地攻击他们）
垃圾信息（如在网络上发送未请求的信息--不一定是拒绝服务攻击）
target_text: In terms of security, many P2P networks have been subjected to sustained attacks by individuals with various purposes. Examples include: poisoning attacks (providing different content and description of documents), denial of service attacks (making networks very slow or even completely dysfunctional), betrayal of attack (blood-smoking) (users or software use networks do not contribute their own resources) inserting viruses into data (e.g. downloading or transmitting files may be infected with a virus or a wooden horse) P2P software itself (e.g. software may contain spy software), filtering (network operators may try to prohibit the transmission of data from P2P networks) Identity attacks (e.g. tracking users on the network and engaging in constant harassment or attacking them legally) Garbage information (e.g. sending unsolicited information on the network - not necessarily denial of service attacks)
title: 對等網路

source_text: 目前中国各大ISP对网络接入都进行了限速，对占用带宽的应用比如P2P，会采取措施，常用的手段有限制TCP连接数，封锁P2P协议，限制下载/上传速度等。但是由于这些行为大部分都是秘密进行，因此中国众多P2P使用者称，此举严重侵犯了他们的知情权和使用权。在中国，被限制最多的P2P软件是BitTorrent系列软件和eMule。
target_text: Many P2P users in China claim that this is a serious violation of their right to information and access. In China, the most restricted P2P software is the BitTorrent series and eMule.

source_text:
日本
在日本，根据日本现行著作权法，日本境内一切免费提供商业软件/或其他数据下载的网站均属非法。违法情节严重的可被判处有期徒刑，同时处以罚款。BitTorrent系列软件和eMule均被禁止。但因為Share和Winny软件的存在，P2P技术在日本仍然流行。这两款软件都采用了IP加密和数据加密的技术，目前日本有几百万人使用这两款软件来交流动画，游戏，音乐，软件等数据，但显然警方已经掌控了追查使用者的方法。2008年5月9日，三名在share上发布大量版权保护作品的职人遭到逮捕。这两款软件的流行也带来了一些负面问题，比如机密资料的泄漏和计算机病毒的传播。
target_text: In Japan, all sites in Japan where commercial software/or other data are downloaded free of charge are illegal under Japan’s current copyright laws. Serious offences are punishable by imprisonment and a fine. BitTorrent series and eMule are banned. But P2P technologies are still popular in Japan because of the presence of Share and Winny software. Both software use IP encryption and data encryption techniques. Millions of people in Japan now use both software to share animations, games, music, software, etc., but it is clear that the police already have control over the methods of tracing users. On 9 May 2008, three persons who publish a large number of copyright-protected works on Share were arrested.

source_text: 光子晶体是由周期性排列的不同折射率的介质制造的规则光学结构。这种材料因为具有光子带隙而能够阻断特定频率的光子，从而影响光子运动。这种影响类似于半导体晶体对于电子行为的影响。由半导体在电子方面的应用，人们推想可以通过光子晶体制造的器件来控制光子运动，例如制造光子计算机。另外，光子晶体也在自然界中发现。
target_text: Photon crystals are the standard optical structures made by media with different refraction rates in cyclical order. This material can block photons at a given frequency because of its photoband gap, thus influencing photon motion. This effect is similar to the effect of semiconductor crystals on electronic behaviour. By semiconductor applications in electronics, it is assumed that photon motion can be controlled by devices made from optical crystals, for example, by making photon computers.
title: 光子晶体

source_text: 1996年，Thomas Krauss制作出了世界上第一个在光学尺寸上的二维光子晶体。他成功的开辟了一条新路，即利用已有的半导体技术来制造半导体材料的光子晶体。到2017年，伴随着凝聚态物理中拓扑绝缘体的发展，光子晶体拓扑绝缘体和光子外尔晶体也都相继实现。光子晶体的拓扑性质成为当下的热点。
target_text: In 1996, Thomas Krauss made the world’s first two-dimensional photon crystal in optical dimensions. He succeeded in opening a new path by using existing semiconductor technology to manufacture photon crystals of semiconductor materials. By 2017, along with the development of capricious insulations in condensate physics, the photon crystals insulation and the photon extrapolated crystals were realized.
title: 光子晶体

source_text: 如今，二维光子晶体，即半导体的薄片堆层应用在很多领域；如利用全内反射将光限制在晶体中而产生光子晶体效应及控制光的色散。世界上有很多研究围绕在利用光子晶体制作计算机芯片以提高计算机的运行速度。虽然这项技术还远没有达到商业应用，二维光子晶体已经被应用在光纤上。光子晶体光纤最早由Philip Russell在1998年制作，它相对于普通光纤有很多先进之处。
target_text: Today, two-dimensional optical crystals, the thin layer of semiconductors, are used in many areas; e.g., full-scale reflection is used to limit light to crystals to produce optical crystal effects and to control the colour dispersion of light. There are many studies around the world that focus on using optical crystal systems as computer chips to increase computer speed. Although the technology is far from commercial, the two-dimensional optical crystal has been applied to fibre-optics.
title: 光子晶体

source_text: 光子晶体体积非常小，在新的纳米技术中、光计算机、芯片等领域有广泛的应用前景。使用光子晶体制造的，也有比传统光纤更好的传输特性，可以进而应用到通信、生物等诸多前沿和交叉领域。2005年美國的研究人員成功地使用兩種新式二維光子晶體，將光的群速度降低了超過一百倍。這項裝置未來可望被應用於各種光學系統及元件中，其中包括高功率、低閾值的光子晶體激光。
target_text: Photon crystals are very small, with a wide range of applications in new nanotechnologies, optical computers, chips, and so on. They also have better transmission properties than conventional optical crystals, which can then be applied to many frontier and cross-cutting areas, such as communications, biology, etc. In 2005, American researchers successfully used two new two-dimensional optical crystals, reducing the concentration of light by more than 100 times. The device is expected to be used in future in various optical systems and components, including high-power, low-value optical crystal lasers.
title: 光子晶体

source_text: 有机碲化合物主要在研究中受到关注。人们已经检查了多种用于有机金属化学气相沉积法生长 II-VI 半导体材料的前体。这些前体包括二甲基碲、二乙基碲、二异丙基碲、二烯丙基碲和甲基烯丙基碲。二异丙基碲 (DIPTe) 是通过有机金属化学气相沉积法低温生长 CdHgTe 的首选前体。在这些过程中会使用最高纯度的有机硒化合物和有机碲化合物，这些用于半导体工业的化合物是通过制备的。
target_text: Organic tellurium compounds are mainly the subject of concern in the study. Precursors have been examined for the chemical phase deposition of organic metals growing in II-VI semiconductor materials. These precursors include dimethylazine, diethylene, difluoropropylene, dipropylene and methylenedioxymetrazine. Dipropylene (DIPTe) is the preferred precursor for low temperature growth in CdHgTe via the chemical phase deposition of organic metals. The highest purity of organotinium compounds and organotinium compounds are used in these processes, which are prepared for the semiconductor industry.
title: 碲

source_text: 基于组件的软件工程（Component-based software engineering，简称CBSE）或基于组件的开发（Component-Based Development，简称CBD）是針對系統的廣泛功能，進行关注点分离的軟體工程方式。此方式是以復用為基礎的作法，定義、實現許多鬆耦合的獨立组件（Component），再將組件組合成為系統。此作法的目的是希望在軟體本身的短期益處以及開發軟體組織的長期益處之間取得平衡。
target_text: A component-based software project (Component-based software integration) or a component-based development (Component-Based Development, CBD) is a software engineering approach to the system’s wide-ranging functions, with a focus on separation. This approach is based on a reuse-based approach that defines and realizes many loosely integrated, stand-alone components, and then integrates the components into the system. The purpose of this approach is to balance the short-term benefits of the software itself with the long-term benefits of the development of the software organization.
title: 基于组件的软件工程

source_text:
软件工程師會將组件視為是的啟始平台。例如在Web服务以及面向服务的体系结构（SOA）中，组件可以透過Web服务轉變為服務，而且本身就會有許多原來组件不會有的特性。组件可以產生或是消費事件，也可以用在 (EDA）中。相關條目
业务逻辑
模块化编程
服务组件架构（SCA）
（JTRS SCA）
target_text: Software engineers see components as starting platforms. For example, in Web services and service-oriented architectures (SOAs), components can be transformed into services through Web services, and they themselves have many features that they would not have. Components can generate or consume events, or they can be used in (EDAs). Related items Business logic modular programming service components (SCAs) (JTRS SCAs)
title: 基于组件的软件工程

source_text: 1982年，电影大师斯坦利·库布里克买下了《人工智能》的拍摄权，由于当时电影科技水準的限制被暂时搁置。到1993年，斯蒂芬·斯皮尔伯格导演的《侏罗纪公园》的成功，促使库布里克根据1969年（Brian Aldiss）的短篇故事《》改编了剧本，并与斯皮尔伯格探讨了剧本，委托工业光魔公司设计特效。1999年，库布里克意外辞世，斯皮尔伯格于2000年初宣布了自己的拍摄计划，并于2001年将亡友的这部未完成作品搬上银幕。影片中应用了当时最新的“实时3D电脑游戏引擎”系统和“On-Set Visualization”技术。
target_text: In 1982, the film master Stanley Kubrik bought the right to film Artificial Intelligent, which was temporarily put on hold because of the limitations of film technology at the time. By 1993, the success of the Jurassic Park, directed by Stephen Spielberg, had prompted Kubrik to reform the script based on a short story from Brian Aldiss in 1969, and to discuss the script with Spielberg, entrusting the industrial light company with the design of the special effects. In 1999, Cubrik died unexpectedly, Spielberg announced his own project in early 2000 and moved to the silver screen the unfinished work of his friend in 2001.
title: 人工智能 (电影)

source_text: 正是在这种氛围下，一个著名的加利福尼亚人威廉·肖克利搬到了这里。威廉的这次搬家可以称得上是半导体工业的-{里}-程碑。1953年由于与同事的分歧而离开贝尔实验室。离婚之后孤身一人回到他获得科学学士学位的加州理工学院，在1956年他又搬到了距他母亲很近的加利福尼亚山景城去建立肖克利半导体实验室。在这之前的时期，尚未成型的半导体工业主要集中在美国东部的波士顿和纽约长岛地区。为了公司的发展，他特意从东部召来八位年轻人，这其中就有诺宜斯、摩尔。
target_text: It was in this atmosphere that a famous Californiar, William Shawkley, moved here. William's move could be described as a semiconductor industry {Ri}-problem. He left Bell's lab in 1953 because of disagreement with his colleagues. After a divorce, he returned to the California Institute of Technology, where he obtained a bachelor's degree in science. In 1956, he moved to California Hillview, close to his mother, to set up a semiconductor laboratory. In the pre-existing period, the semiconductor industry was concentrated in Boston and Long Island in the east of the United States. For the company's development, he specifically called eight young people from the east, among them Nories and Moore.
title: 硅谷

source_text: 個人電腦（，缩写：），通称電腦，是在大小、性能以及價位等多個方面適合于個人使用，并由最终用户直接操控的計算機的統稱。它与批处理计算机或分时系统等一般同时由多人操控的大型计算机相对。从桌上型電腦（或稱台式電腦、桌面电脑）、笔记本电脑到小型筆記型電腦和平板電腦、智慧型手機及-{zh-hans:超级本;zh-tw:超極致筆記型電腦}-等都属于个人電腦的範圍。
target_text: Personal computers (Abbreviation:) generic computers are used by individuals in a variety of ways, such as size, performance and price, and are controlled directly by the end user. It is compared to large computers that are typically controlled by multiples at the same time, such as batch computers or time-series systems. From desktop computers (or desktop computers, desktop computers), laptops to small laptops and panels, smart phones and - {zh-hans: superb; zh-tw: ultra-written laptops}, etc.
title: 个人电脑

source_text: 它有客製化的行動操作系統，可瀏覽網頁和播放多媒體檔案，也可通過安裝應用軟體、電子遊戲等程式來擴充功能。现有折叠屏手机超級移動電腦：是一種具有近似筆記本電腦（Laptop PC）的效能及掌上電腦（Pocket PC）體積的電腦。可攜式電腦：其體積小、重量輕，方便攜帶，但不能如筆記型電腦一樣能在沒有外部電源供應的情形下使用。車用電腦：是一種用於汽車的嵌入式系統，可以提供多媒體娛樂、GPS導航、遊戲、上網、電話、汽車信息和故障診斷功能。特斯拉：特斯拉公司生产的特斯拉自动驾驶 （FSD Computer）特斯拉完全自动驾驶计算机。工作站：是一種高階的微型電腦。它是為了個人使用者使用並提供比同時代個人電腦更強大的效能，尤其是影像處理與多工運算能力。服务器:服务器指： 一个管理资源并为用户提供服务的计算机软件，通常分为文件服务器，数据库服务器和应用程序服务器。运行以上软件的计算机，或称为网络主机。工業電腦：工業電腦（Industrial PC，簡稱IPC）主要是指用在是專供工業界使用的個人電腦，可作為工業控制器使用。工業電腦基本性能與相容性與同樣規格的商用個人電腦相差無幾，但是工業電腦更多的防護措施，注重的部份在不同環境下的穩定， 如飲料生產線控制、汽車生產線控制等等，在惡劣的環境下要求穩定，如防塵、防水、防靜電等。
target_text: The computer is small, lightweight, portable, but not capable of being used as a laptop with no external power supply. The computer is an embedded system for cars that can provide multi-media entertainment, GPS navigation, video games, telephones, car information and malfunctioning. Tesla: Tesla produces a Tesla autopilot (FSD Computer) but cannot be used as an automatic computer without an external power supply.
title: 个人电脑

source_text: 工業用電腦並不要求當前最高效能，只求達到符合系統的要求，需符合工業環境中的可靠性要求與穩定，否則用於生產線萬一遇到電腦當機，則可能造成嚴重損失，因此工業用電腦所要求的標準值都有要求符合嚴格的規範與擴充性。ECDIS：電子海圖顯示與信息系統（英語：ECDIS， Electronic Chart Display and Information System），是指符合有關國際標準的航用電子海圖系統。它以計算機為核心，連接定位、測深、計程儀、雷達等設備，以ENC（電子海圖\航道圖）為基礎，綜合反映船舶行駛狀態，為船舶駕駛人員提供各種信息查詢、量算和航海記錄專門工具，是一種專題地理信息系統（GIS）。网络附接存储: 又名 网络附接存储服务器 缩写NAS 是一种文件级（与块级存储相对）的计算机数据存储服务器。工作属性是以计算机网络为核心，并提供对异构网络数据用户进行的网络文件服务器， 它也算是一台用于处理专业网络文件的计算机设备之一。大多数，人们使用它用于搭建私人云存储平台。和小型ITX台式机较为相似，也有ATX NAS的台式机。网络录像机:又名 网络录像服务器 缩写NVR 网络录像机是一种能处理监控视频流数据的专业型服务器。一般用于存储大型的CCTV的闭路电视的监控网络的视频流数据。家用游戏机: 家用娱乐计算机设备，专为家用电视娱乐打造。翻译机: 智能翻译机，类似于PDA或手机形态。可穿戴计算机 智能手表或智能手环等
target_text: Industrial computers do not require pre-existing maximum efficiency, but only compliance with systems requirements, reliability and stability in the industrial environment, or significant loss in the case of computer machines encountered with the production line, so the standard values required by industrial computers require strict specifications and extension. ECDIS: Electronic sea map display and information systems (English: ECDIS, Electric Chart Display and Information System), which are compatible with the relevant internationally-coded electronic electronic charting system.
title: 个人电脑

source_text: 由於电脑产业发展迅速，大部分軟件開發商傾向亦更具能力開發用更高運算資源來達成更多更強大功能的軟件，因此硬件不断有升级的必要。例如一部五六年前被认为是頂級配置的个人电脑，在今天看来其中央处理器、内存和周边设备速度、容量等都只是中階甚至中低階配置，已無法如五六年前般順暢运行部分的软件。而市场上主流操作系统软件（例如微软公司的Windows）的每一次大型升级在帶來新的便捷的同時，也对个人电脑硬件系统提出新的更高需求，要求硬件更新换代。通常而言存储器和一些外围设备（如显示卡和磁盘存储器）较易升级，用户多數可以自己动手。为了升级计算机的处理能力等，則需更换處理器和主板，但受制於舊式數據傳輸規格無法支援更快更大量的數據傳輸，因此處理器、主板、內存等通常無法相互兼容具代差的配件。而新的處理器、主板、內存意味整台電腦的硬件更換。
target_text: As a result of the rapid growth of the computer industry, most software developers are more capable of developing more and more high-capacity software with higher operating resources, so hardware needs to be upgraded. For example, a personal computer that was considered the top configuration five or six years ago, its central processor, memory and peripheral equipment speed, capacity, etc., appears to be more easily upgraded today, and many users can do it themselves. To upgrade the processing capacity of computers, there is a need to replace processors and master boards, but each major upgrade of mainstream operating system software (e.g., Microsoft Windows) in the market does not support faster and more high demand for personal computer hardware systems.
title: 个人电脑

source_text: 作業系統用於管理与控制計算機資源，並可讓用戶通過各種程序使用這些資源。它是计算机运行的平台以及应用软件的基础。目前PC市場上佔有率最高的是微軟所推出的Windows系列，其次是蘋果公司推出的macOS，再來是有開放原始碼的Linux和類Unix系列的操作系统比如FreeBSD等。
target_text: The operating system is used to manage and control computer resources and allows users to use them through a variety of programs. It is the platform for computer operations and the basis for applications. The highest rate of access in the PC market is found in the Windows series launched by Microsoft, followed by MacOS by Linux and Unix-type operating systems such as FreeBSD, which are open-sourced.
title: 个人电脑

source_text: 應用軟體应用软件是為执行各種特定的任務或解决特定的问题而开发的程序。應用程序依賴於作業系統等系统软件的支援，需要系統軟體为其提供内存管理、網絡連接以及設備驅動等常規服務。常見的應用软件包括文字處理程序等办公软件、媒體播放程序等多媒体软件以及遊戲軟體等。
target_text: Applied software applications are programs that are developed to perform specific tasks or solve specific problems. Applications depend on the support of system software, such as the operating system, and require the system software to provide regular services such as memory management, network connections, and design drives.
title: 个人电脑

source_text: 软件配置管理（Software Configuration Management，简称：SCM），又稱軟體形態管理、或軟體建構管理，簡稱軟體形管。界定軟體的組成項目，對每個項目變更進行管控（版本控制），並維護不同項目之間的版本關聯，以使軟體在開發過程中任一時間的內容都可以被追溯，包括某幾個具有重要意義的數個組合，例如某一次交付給客戶的軟體內容。
target_text: Software configuration management (Software Management Management, SCM), also known as software management, or software construction management, short-term software tubes. Defines the grouping of software items, controls changes to each item (version control) and maintains version connections between different items so that software content can be traced back at any time in the development process, including a few significant combinations, such as software content that is delivered to a client at a given time.
title: 软件配置管理

source_text: VB.NET的支持者们认为新语言在很多方面比旧版本更为强大，比如它以相比早期版本更为自然、紧密和完全的方式地加入了现代面向对象的编程范式。反对者们有不同意见，虽然VB6对对象模型支持有缺点，但是二次开发升级到VB.NET的成本比升级后的收益要高得多。而开发软件发布因特网版本的独立程序员也对VB.NET的RunTime尺寸过大不满。
target_text: VB.NET’s supporters believe that the new language is stronger in many ways than the old version, for example, by adding a modern, object-oriented programming paradigm to it in a more natural, tight and complete way than the earlier version. The opponents disagree that, although VB6 has shortcomings in object model support, the cost of upgrading to VB.NET for secondary development is much higher than the benefit of the upgrade.
title: Visual Basic .NET

source_text: Usenet最初是由UUCP网络发展而来，在UUCP网络上，大部分文章都是直接通过两台电脑间的电话线连接传送。发帖人和阅读者必须登入相同服务器的主机然后从本地硬盘阅读文章。后来随着LAN和網際網路的普及，人们希望新闻阅读器能够在个人电脑上运行，同时人们也迫切希望了解文章在互联网上传播的路径，因为当时网络上互联网兼容文件系统并不存在，于是人们开发出一个新的类似SMTP的协议，与SMTP不同的是，这种协议只用来阅读新闻组。
target_text: Usenet was originally developed by the UUCP network, where most of the articles were sent directly through a telephone link between two computers. Senders and readers had to log into the same server's mainframe and read the articles from the local hard disk. With the spread of LAN and the Internet, people wanted news readers to run on their personal computers, and people were eager to learn the way to disseminate the articles on the Internet, because Internet-compatible document systems did not exist at the time, so people developed a new SMTP-like agreement, unlike SMTP, which was used only to read news groups.
title: 網路新聞傳輸協定

source_text: X-Face是贝尔实验室1980年代开发Vismon程序的副产品。有很多支持X-Face的软件。它们中的大部分是UNIX及其变种平台上的自由软件。也有在线的，网络平台上的X-Face产生器以及流行的如KMail或Sylpheed这样的程序用来产生X-Face。并非所有的電子郵件客戶端都支持X-Face信头。大部分安装在域内或是商用电脑内的邮件程序对此无能为力。即使是在大学或是在研究机构这样经常使用UNIX的地方，也只有很少完全支持X-Face的邮件客户端安装。
target_text: X-Face is a by-product of the development of the Vismon program in Bell's lab in the 1980s. There are many software to support X-Face. Most of them are free software on UNIX and its variable platforms. There are also online X-Face generators on web platforms and popular programs like KMail or Sylpheed that generate X-Face. Not all e-mail clients support X-Face heads.
title: X-Face

source_text: 在互联网上传递的数据包，信息（负载）前需要加上信息头。信息头包括发送人和接收人的IP地址，对负载内容格式的通信协议管理以及其他格式信息。信息头格式被定义为网络协议的一部分。在图像文件格式中，信息头可能包括关于图像大小，解析度，表达色彩数目之类的信息。
target_text: Information headers are required before information (loading) is transferred on the Internet. The message header includes the IP address of the sender and the recipient, the communication protocol management for the load content format, and other formatting information. The message header format is defined as part of the network protocol. In the image file format, the message header may include information such as image size, resolution, number of colours.
title: 信头

source_text: Forté Agent是一款流行于Windows系统平台上的Usenet客户端。该软件从1990年代中期开始一直流行至今，Forté是第一款真正易于使用的Usenet客户端。无论如何，近几年该软件的使用人数由于其他同类型产品的竞争而有所缩减，特别是Microsoft Windows系统上绑定的Outlook Express对其威胁最大。但是，对于那些乐于下载并解码大量二进制文件的用户，类似Forté Agent这样高性能的软件要比Outlook Express好。
target_text: Forté Agent is an Usenet client that is popular on Windows platforms. The software has been popular since the mid-1990s, and Forté is the first Usene client that is truly easy to use. In any case, its use has been reduced in recent years by competition with other types of products, particularly the Outlook Express, which binds Microsoft Windows. However, for users who are happy to download and decode a large number of binary files, software like Forté Agent is better than Outlook Express.
title: Forté Agent
