source_text: Mozilla公共许可证（，简称）是个自由、开源、详细的软件许可证，由Mozilla基金会开发并维护。该條款融合了BSD许可证和GNU通用公共许可证的特性，追求平衡专有软件和开源软件开发者之间的顾虑。此條款已有两个版本，最新发布的2.0版以更简潔和更好的兼容其他條款为目标。
target_text: Mozilla’s public licence (hereinafter, Mozilla) is a free, open-source, detailed software licence developed and maintained by the Mozilla Foundation. This provision combines the characteristics of the BSD licence with the GNU general public licence, seeking to balance concerns between proprietary and open-source software developers.
title: Mozilla公共许可证

source_text:
条款
MPL既是得到自由软件基金会承认的自由软件许可证，也是得到开放源代码促进会承认的开源软件许可证。MPL允许在其授权下的源代码与其他授权的文件进行混合，包括私有许可证。但在MPL授权下的代码文件必须保持MPL授权，并且保持开源。这样的条款让MPL既不像MIT和BSD那样允许衍生作品完全转化为私有，也不像GPL那样要求所有的衍生作品，包括新的组件在内，全部必须保持GPL。通过允许在衍生项目中存在私有模块，同时保证核心文件的开源，MPL同时激励了商业及开源社区来参与帮助开发核心软件。
target_text: The terms MPL are both free software licences recognized by the Free Software Foundation and open source software licences recognized by Open Source Promotion. MPL allows the source code under its authority to be commingled with other authorized documents, including private licences. But the code file under MPL is required to maintain MPL authorization and to maintain open source. Such clauses allow MPL to neither allow derivatives to be fully privately owned as MIT or BSD, nor require all derivatives, including new components, as is the case with GPL. By allowing private modules to exist in derivative projects, and by guaranteeing the source of the core document, MPL also motivates business and open-source communities to participate in the development of core software.
title: Mozilla公共许可证

source_text: 但最近索尼公司采取了其他技术手段防止新发行的游戏以ISO镜像文件运行。据称在2.00/2.01/2.50版本的PSP上有一个特殊的PRX芯片，当用户在使用镜像文件时会弹出出错提示框，而在1.00-1.52版本上没有。但如今使2.00版本的游戏在1.5版本PSP上运行已经取得了一定进展。最近已有一种叫做“Devhook”的ISO载入软件，能够在1.5版PSP上模拟2.71版，使得1.5版用户也可使用PSP网页浏览器、运行2.71或更高版本游戏。
target_text: Recently, however, Sony used other technical means to prevent newly released games from operating with ISO mirrored files. A special PRX chip was said to be on the PSP version 2.00/2001/2.50, with users ejecting error hint boxes when using the mirror file, and not on the 1.00-1.52 version. However, some progress has been made in making the 2.00 version run on the 1.5 version of the PSP. There has recently been an ISO loading software called Devhook, which can simulate version 2.71 on the 1.5 version of the PSP so that users can also use the PSP web browser and run the 2.71 or higher version of the game.
title: 通用媒體光碟

source_text: 数字图像可以许多不同的输入设备和技术生成，例如数码相机、扫描仪、坐标测量机、seismographic profiling、airborne radar等等，也可以从任意的非图像数据合成得到，例如数学函数或者三维几何模型，三维几何模型是计算机图形学的一个主要分支。数字图像处理领域就是研究它们的变换算法。
target_text: Digital images can be generated with many different input devices and technologies, such as digital cameras, scanners, coordinates, seismographing, airborne radar, etc., or from arbitrary non-image data, such as mathematical functions or three-dimensional geometry models, which are a major branch of computer graphics.
title: 数字图像

source_text: 图像处理是信号处理的子类，另外与计算机科学、人工智能等领域也有密切的关系。传统的一维信号处理的方法和概念很多仍然可以直接应用在图像处理上，比如降噪、量化等。然而，图像属于二维信号，和一维信号相比，它有自己特殊的一面，处理的方式和角度也有所不同。
target_text: Image processing is a subcategory of signal processing, which is also closely related to computer science, artificial intelligence, and so on. Many traditional one-dimensional signal processing methods and concepts can still be applied directly to image processing, such as noise reduction, quantification, etc. However, the image is a two-dimensional signal, and it has its own special side, and it is handled differently and from different angles than a one-dimensional signal.
title: 图像处理

source_text: 从通常意义上讲，数字图像处理技术更加普适、可靠和准确。比起模拟方法，它们也更容易实现。专用的硬件被用于数字图像处理，例如，基于流水线的计算机体系结构在这方面取得了巨大的商业成功。今天，硬件解决方案被广泛的用于视频处理系统，但商业化的图像处理任务基本上仍以软件形式实现，运行在通用个人电脑上。
target_text: In general, digital image-processing techniques are more universal, reliable, and accurate. They are easier to achieve than simulations. Specialized hardware is used for digital image-processing, for example, computer architecture based on waterlines has had great commercial success in this area.
title: 图像处理

source_text: 图像分析（image analysis）和图像处理（image processing）关系密切，两者有一定程度的交叉，但是又有所不同。图像处理侧重于信号处理方面的研究，比如图像对比度的调节、图像编码、去噪以及各种滤波的研究。而图像分析更侧重于研究图像的内容，包括但不局限于使用图像处理的各种技术，它更倾向于对图像内容的分析、解释和识别。因而，图像分析和计算机科学领域中的模式识别、计算机视觉关系更密切一些。
target_text: Image analysis (image analysis) and image processing (image processing) are closely related, with some degree of overlap, but different. Image processing focuses on studies in signal processing, such as image contrast reconciliation, image coding, noise removal, and various filters. Image analysis focuses more on the content of images, including, but not limited to, technologies using image processing, which prefers analysis, interpretation, and identification of image content.
title: 图像分析

source_text: 另外，一些厂商也推出了“游戏VCD”，可以运行带有任天堂红白机或世嘉MD游戏的VCD光盘，只要接上手柄就可以进行游戏。也有厂商开发出“电-{}-脑VCD”，将仿Windows界面的操作系统集成到光盘中，并且内置上网、文字处理、电子表格等软件。SVCDSVCD是VCD的改進標準，它採用MPEG-2壓縮，採用可變壓縮率來獲得較好的影片品質。

source_text:
MP3走向大众
为了生成位兼容的MPEG Audio文件（Layer 1、Layer 2、Layer 3），ISO MPEG Audio委员会成员用C语言开发的一个称为ISO 11172-5的参考模拟软件。在一些非实时操作系统上它能够演示第一款压缩音频基于DSP的实时硬件解码。一些其他的MPEG Audio实时开发出来用于面向消费接收机和机顶盒的数字广播（无线电DAB和电视DVB）。
target_text: MP3 moves to the general public to generate location-compatible MPEG Audio files (Layer 1, Layer 2, Layer 3), a reference simulation software called ISO 11172-5, developed by members of the ISO MPEG Audio Commission in C. On some non-real-time operating systems, it can demonstrate the first real-time DSP-based hardware decoding of audio. Some other MPEG Audio developed in real time for digital broadcasting (radio DAB and TV DVB) for consumer receivers and machine caps.
title: MP3

source_text: 后来，1994年7月7日弗劳恩霍夫协会发布了第一个称为的MP3编码器。Fraunhofer开发组在1995年7月14日选定扩展名：".mp3"（以前扩展名是".bit"）。使用第一款实时软件MP3播放器（1995年9月9日发布）许多人能够在自己的个人电脑上编码和播放MP3文件。由于当时的硬盘相对较小（如500MB），这项技术对于在计算机上存储娱乐音乐来说是至关重要的。
target_text: Later, on 7 July 1994, the Fraunhof Association released its first MP3 encoder. The Fraunhofer Development Group selected an extension on 14 July 1995: ".mp3" (formerly known as ".bit"). Using the first real-time software MP3 player (published on 9 September 1995), many people were able to encode and play MP3 files on their personal computers. Because of the relatively small hard disk at the time (e.g. 500MB), this technology was essential for storing entertainment music on computers.
title: MP3

source_text:
MP3音频编码
MPEG-1标准中没有MP3编码器的一个精确规范，然而与此相反，解码算法和文件格式却进行了细致的定义。人们设想编码的实现是设计自己的适合去除原始音频中部分信息的算法（或者是它在频域中的改進的離散餘弦變換表示）。在编码过程中，576个时域样本被转换成576个频域样本，如果是瞬变信号就使用192而不是576个采样点，这是限制量化噪声随着随瞬变信号短暂扩散。
target_text: MP3 audio code MPEG-1 standards do not contain a precise specification for MP3 encoder, but instead the decoding algorithms and file formats are carefully defined. It is assumed that the encodes are realized by designing their own algorithms suitable for removing some of the information in the original audio (or their modified separated cosine changes in the frequency range). During the encoding process, 576 temporal domain samples were converted into 576 frequency domain samples, using 192 instead of 576 sampling points if the transient signal was used, which is a restriction on the short spread of quantitative noise as the signal changes.
title: MP3

source_text: 解决算法问题包括构造一个能解决某一指定集及其他相关集的算法，如果该算法无法构建，则表明该问题是不可解的。证明此种问题不可解性的定理是算法理论中的一大突破，邱奇的算法即为该类算法的首例。邱奇证明了基本几何问题的算法不可解性。同时证明了一阶逻辑中真命题全集的解法问题是不可解的。
target_text: The solution to the algorithmic problem includes the construction of an algorithm that solves a given set of specified and other related sets, and if the algorithm is unconstructed, it shows that the problem is inexplicable. The reasoning that proves the incomprehensibility of the problem is a breakthrough in the algorithmic theory.
title: 阿隆佐·邱奇

source_text: 1991年，东芝成立了第一个海外研发中心——剑桥研究实验室，在低维半导体器件领域展开基础研究。如今该实验室已经有三个研究小组：量子信息组，主要研究量子物理学在信息技术中的应用；语音技术组，成立于2002年，以开发语音识别与合成系统为主要研发项目；计算机视觉组，成立于2006年，研究重点是从图象和手势识别中对三维立体形状建模。1998年，通信技术研究实验室在英国布里斯托成立，并与剑桥研究实验室合为东芝欧洲研究有限公司。
target_text: In 1991, Toshiba established the first overseas research and development centre, the Cambridge Research Laboratory, to carry out basic research in the field of low-dimensional semiconductor devices. There are now three research teams in the Laboratory: the Quantum Information Group, which deals mainly with the application of quantum physics in information technology; the Voice Technology Group, which was established in 2002 as the main research and development project for the development of speech recognition and synthesis systems; and the Computer Visual Group, which was established in 2006 with a focus on modelling the shape of the 3D shape in image and gesture recognition. In 1998, the Communications Technology Research Laboratory was established in Bristol, United Kingdom, and co-located with the Cambridge Research Laboratory as Toshi European Research Ltd.
title: 东芝

source_text:
世界觀
“近年来捕获突如其来的数码生命体并在钥匙链大小的机器中培养”这就是所谓大的世界观设定。另外，根据相关杂志和攻略书等记载的各数码兽和舞台背景的说明文字，表明了研究者的活跃和其他组织、人物等。
数码兽的诞生：因为黑客（Hacker）在计算机上的网络犯罪行为（Cyber Terrorism），具备人工智能的病毒扩散开来，这就是数码兽的开始。这种病毒吸收世界上的数据改变外形和性格成为生物的模样，这样便成了数码兽。
数码兽的捕获：在个人计算机上使用数码兽捕获（Digimon Capture）软件映射到数码世界，就变成了寻找野生数码兽。被发现的数码兽被捕获到一种叫数码兽装载器（Digimon Loader）的软件中，由数码蛋的状态转移为数码怪兽的原貌并随身携带，变得任何时候都可以进行对战。
数码兽的利用者（网络使用者，Networker）：包括以驯兽师为首，存在着各种利用者。
target_text: Digital beasts: because hackers are caught on computers, cybercrimes spread through an artificially intelligent virus, which is the beginning of a digital beast. The virus absorbs the world’s data by changing their appearance and character into a living model of the key chain, becoming a digital beast.
title: 数码宝贝系列

source_text: 数码怪兽（Digital Monster，）通称數碼兽（Digimon，）。數碼兽在被称为“数码世界”的计算机网络上的模拟网络空间（Cyberspace）中生息，是一种拥有人工智能的数据生命体（Data Organism）。牠们摄取网络上存在的庞大数据，由于生存本能而持续进化和互相竞争，形成了各种各样的属性和等级，模拟存在于现实世界的动植物、机械、人型和突然变异等，呈现出多种多样的种族。
target_text: Digital Monster (Digital Monster) is commonly known as Digimon. Digital beasts live in analogue cyberspace on a computer network called the “digital world” and are an artificially intelligent data life form (Data Organism). They take the vast data that exists on the network, which evolves and competes with each other through survival instincts, creating a variety of attributes and hierarchies that simulate plants and animals, machines, humans and sudden mutations that exist in the real world and present a variety of races.
title: 数码宝贝系列

source_text:
成就
周济长期致力于优化设计、CAD、数控和CIMS技术的研究和工程应用。提出并组织实施适合国情的推广应用CAD／CAM的技术路线，提出并实现了单调性分析优化、数控加工直接插补等算法理论。
曾主持开发出优化设计、机械CAD等一系列软件产品及华中I型数控系统，应用于1000余家工业企业。
先后获国家科技进步三等奖4项，省部级科技进步奖14项，出版著作11本，发表论文200余篇。在其领导下的华中理工大学CIMS中心，曾获得国际制造工程师协会颁发的1999年度“大学领先奖”。
在华中科技大学主政期间，周济提倡教研产相结合，鼓励把科研成果转化为生产力。在这种思想的引导下，先后诞生了“华中数控”“华工科技”等华工系企业。
周济任中国教育部部长期间：推出全国农村全面免除义务教育阶段学杂费；国家在教育部直属师范大学实行师范生免费教育，培养造就优秀中小学教师和教育家，鼓励优秀人才长期从教。
target_text: Xiaoji has long been working to optimize the research and engineering applications of design, CAD, digital control, and CIMS technologies. Four national prizes for scientific and technological progress, 14 departmental prizes for scientific and technological progress, 11 publications, and more than 200 papers have been published. During his leadership, the CIMS Centre of China Polytechnic University (CIMUS), which was awarded by the International Association of Manufacturing Engineers (IAU), received the 1999 “University Leadership Award.” During the administration of the Chinese University of Science and Technology, Zhou Ji advocated a combination of design, mechanical CAD products and Chinese I digital control systems to be applied to more than 1,000 industrial enterprises.
title: 周济

source_text: 为DIY的爱好者提供免费的知识性服务，这个产业紧随互联网的发展而出现，最早通过BBS，论坛等以网页的形式发布比如电脑的硬件软件安装维修等知识。2005年视频网站Youtube的推出后，在这个平台上很多专业领域的DIY教学频道陆续开通，涉及的领域非常广，从美容化妆，房屋装修，电器维修，到汽车修理等。Youtube上手机和相机维修的教学视频非常收欢迎，手机维修视频的代表是美国ifixit公司的iFixit Video频道，相机维修视频的代表是德国Chip-Tip公司的KAMERA HANDY STATION频道。
target_text: Since the launch of the video site Youtube in 2005, DIY teaching channels in many areas of specialization on this platform have been opened, covering a wide range of areas ranging from beauty makeup, house improvement, electrical maintenance, and auto repair. The teaching videos on YouTube on mobile phones and camera maintenance are very popular, and mobile phone maintenance videos are represented by iFixit Video of the United States company iFixit Video, and video maintenance by Kamera Handy Station of the German company Chip-Tip.
title: DIY

source_text: 一个双极性晶体管由三个不同的掺杂半导体区域组成，它们分别是发射极区域、基极区域和集电极区域。这些区域在NPN型晶体管中分别是N型、P型和N型半导体，而在PNP型晶体管中则分别是P型、N型和P型半导体。每一个半导体区域都有一个引脚端接出，通常用字母E、B和C来表示发射极（）、基极（）和集电极（）。
target_text: A bipolar transistor is made up of three different mixed semiconductor regions, each of which is a launch pole region, a subpolar region and a central electrode region. These areas are N, P and N semiconductors in the NPN type, and PNP and P semiconductors in the PNP type. Each semiconductor area is connected with an inductor, usually using letters E, B and C to indicate the emitter poles (), the base poles () and the collectors (C).
title: 双极性晶体管

source_text:
用户调研：通过用户调研的手段（介入观察、非介入观察、采访等），交互设计师调查了解用户及其相关使用的场景，以便对其有深刻的认识（主要包括用户使用时候的心理模式和行为模式），从而为后继设计提供良好的基础。找出可能的契機點與方案方向。
概念设计：通过综合考虑用户调研的结果、技术可行性、以及商业机会，交互设计师为设计的目标创建概念（目标可能是新的软件、产品、服务或者系统）。整个过程可能来回迭代进行多次，每个过程可能包含头脑风暴、交谈（无保留的交谈）、细化概念模型等活动。
创建用户模型：基于用户调研得到的用户行为模式，设计师创建场景或者用户故事或者storyboard来描绘设计中产品将来可能的形态。通常，设计师设计人物誌(persona)来作为创建场景的基础.
创建界面流程：通常，交互设计师采用线框图来描述设计对象的功能和行为。在线框图中，采用分页或者分屏的方式（夹带相关部分的注解），来描述系统的细节。界面流图主要用于描述系统的操作流程。
开发原型以及用户测试：交互设计师通过设计原型来测试设计方案。原型大致可分三类：功能测试的原型，感官测试原型以及实现测试原型；总之，这些原型用于测试用户和设计系统交互的质量。原型的可以是实物的，也可以是计算机模拟的；可以是高度仿真的，也可以是大致相似的。
target_text: User research: Through the means of user research (interference observation, non-intrusive observation, interviews, etc.), interactive designers may investigate the user and the scenes used by him/her in order to have a profound understanding of the user and the related use (mainly psychological and behavioural models used by the user) and thus provide a good basis for subsequent design. Conceptual design: by taking into account the results of user research, technical feasibility, and business opportunities, interactive designers create concepts for design objectives (the object may be new software, products, services or systems). The whole process may be repeated several times, each process may include brainstorms, conversations (unreserved conversations), fine-tune conceptual models, etc.
title: 交互设计

source_text: 在计算机科学中，分治法（）是建基於多項分支遞歸的一种很重要的算法範式。字面上的解释是“分而治之”，就是把一个复杂的问题分成两个或更多的相同或相似的子问题，直到最后子问题可以简单的直接求解，原问题的解即子问题的解的合并。这个技巧是很多高效算法的基础，如排序算法（归并排序、快速排序）、傅立叶变换（快速傅立叶变换）。
target_text: In computer science, partition () is a very important algorithmic paradigm based on the transfer of multiple branches. The literal interpretation is “divide and rule”, which is to divide a complex issue into two or more identical or similar sub-issues, until the final sub-issue can be solved simply and directly, and the solution to the original problem becomes the solution of the sub-issue. This technique is the basis for many efficient algorithms, such as sorting algorithms (consortization, fast sorting), and Folite switching.
title: 分治法

source_text: 分治法這個名稱有時亦會用於將問題簡化為只有一個細問題的算法，例如用於在已排序的列中尋找其中一項的折半搜索算法（或是在數值分析中類似的勘根算法）。這些算法比一般的分治算法更能有效地執行。其中，假如算法使用尾部遞歸的話，便能轉換成簡單的迴圈。但在這廣義之下，所有使用遞歸或迴圈的算法均被視作「分治算法」。因此，有些作者考慮「分治法」這個名稱應只用於每個有最少兩個子問題的算法。而只有一個子問題的曾被建議使用減治法這個名稱。
target_text: The title of partition is sometimes used to simplify the problem to a very minor algorithm, for example by searching for a half-search algorithm of one of the sorted columns (or a rooting algorithm similar to that used in value analysis). These algorithms are more effective than average partition algorithms. In this case, if the algorithm were to return to the end, it could be converted into a simple circle. But in this broad sense, all algorithms that use surrender or loop are treated as "fragmentation". Thus, some authors consider that the term "segregation" should be used only for each calculation that has at least two sub-problems.
title: 分治法

source_text:
早期历史上的先例
折半搜索算法——一個將原來問題連逐地拆細成大約一半大小的單一子問題的分治算法——擁有一段悠長歴史。雖然算法在計算機上的清楚描述出現在1946年約翰莫齊利（John Mauchly）的一篇文章裡，然而利用已排序的物件序列去加快搜尋的構想早已在公元前200年的巴比倫尼亞出現。另一個單一子問題的分治算法是找出2個數的最大公因數的輾轉相除法（透過將數字化小至使子問題變得簡單），於公元前數世紀已經出現。
target_text: Precedents in early history: half-search algorithms – a partition algorithm that divides the original problem into a single problem of about half its size – have a long history. Although the algorithm is clearly described on the computer in 1946 in an article by John Mauchly, structures that use sequenced object sequences to speed up the search have already appeared in Babilnia, 200 B.C. The other single-issue algorithm is the dichotomy that identifies the two-digit number of the greatest commons factor (by simply reducing the number to the sorcerer problem) and has already appeared in pre-C.
title: 分治法

source_text: 一個早期有多個子問題的分治算法是高斯在1805年描述關於快速傅立葉变换的算法，儘管他沒有量化地分析它的操作數目，而快速傅立葉变换直至在一世紀之後被重新發現之前亦沒有廣泛流傳。這個算法現在稱為库利－图基快速傅里叶变换算法。
target_text: An early, multi-sub-issue partition algorithm was the one that Gus described in 1805, even though he did not quantify the number of his operations and did not spread widely until it was rediscovered after the first century. The algorithm is now called the Couli-Tucky fast Fourier conversion.

source_text: 至於專門用於計算機之上而且正確地分析的分治算法早期例子，則可以數到约翰·冯·诺伊曼於1945年發明的歸並排序。另一個顯著的例子是Anatolii Alexeevitch Karatsuba於1960年發明在步驟內將兩個n位數相乘的Karatsuba算法。它反證了安德雷·柯爾莫哥洛夫於1956年認為這個乘法需要步驟的猜想。
target_text: Another notable example is Anatoli Alexeevich Karatsuba’s Karatsuba algorithm, which multiplied two n-digits in step in 1960. It contradicts André Kolmoglov’s presumption in 1956 that the multiplication required steps.
title: 分治法

source_text:
解决困难问题
分治算法是一个解决复杂问题的好工具，它可以把问题分解成若干个子问题，把子问题逐个解决，再组合到一起形成大问题的答案。比如，汉诺塔问题如果采用分治算法，可以把高度为n的塔的问题转换成高度为n-1的塔来解决，如此重复，直至问题化简到可以很容易的处理为止。
target_text: The separation algorithm is a good tool for solving complex problems. It can break down the problem into several sub-issues, solve the sub-questions individually, and then combine the answer to the big question. For example, if the division algorithm is used in Hannota, it can transform the problem of a tower with a high n into a high n-1, so that it repeats it until the problem can be dealt with easily.
title: 分治法

source_text:
算法效率
人们发现有很多效率很高的分治算法，比如，Karatsuba快速乘法算法、快速排序算法和并行算法、矩阵乘法的施特拉森演算法、快速傅里叶变换等。同步性修正控制实现循环递归
在每一层递归上都有三个步骤：
分解：将原问题分解为若干个规模较小，相对独立，与原问题形式相同的子问题。
解决：若子问题规模较小且易于解决时，则直接解。否则，递归地解决各子问题。
合并：将各子问题的解合并为原问题的解。
target_text: There are many efficient partition algorithms, such as Karatsuba fast multiplying algorithms, fast sorting algorithms and parallel algorithms, array multiply Stratson algorithms, fast Fourier transformations, and so on. Synchronous correction controls lead to a recycling of three steps at each level: decomposition: decompositioning the original problem into smaller, relatively independent, sub-issues that are the same as the original problem. Solving: when the sub-issue is smaller and easy to solve. Otherwise, resolving the sub-problems backwards. Consolidation: decombining the sub-problems into original ones.
title: 分治法

source_text: 由於受法例所限，這類色情遊戲只准售賣予18歲或以上人士，故此计算机软件伦理机构將這類遊戲稱為「R18遊戲」，不過一般人大多直稱其為「H-Game」或「18禁遊戲」等非正式名稱。由於這類遊戲的性幻想對象或虛擬女友幾乎全是動漫風格的美少女角色，故此日本玩家及開發商愛稱其為美少女遊戲（），然而因為「美少女遊戲」也涵蓋沒有露骨性愛描繪但同樣使用動漫風格美少女角色的遊戲，故此該詞的歧義可能會引起誤解。

source_text: 日本成人遊戲在銷售倫理管制上，除了政府要求製作者自己的自主規制，以及《青少年保護育成條例》等法律上的管束外，其他還包括有電腦軟體倫理機構（EOCS）、電腦娛樂供應商協會（CESA）、日本娛樂電子工業協會（JAMMA）、映畫倫理委員會（EIRIN）等機構的管理，其中又以计算机软件伦理机构為主要的監管組織。這些作為除了管控了一些遊戲的內容外，並強制各個開發廠商為遊戲標示限制註明，同時銷售商也禁止向未滿18歲的人士提供這些成人遊戲。
target_text: In addition to government regulations requiring producers to make their own autonomous regulations, and laws such as Juvenile Protection Regulations, Japanese adult games include the management of institutions such as EOCS, CESA, JAMMA, and EIRIN, which, in addition to regulating a number of games, impose restrictions on the use of computer software by various developers, and prohibit the provision of these adult games to persons under the age of 18.
title: 日本成人遊戲

source_text: 另一方面，許多成人遊戲公司為避免自加出產的18禁遊戲受到大眾輿論的壓力，進而影響到遊戲的銷售數量，因此會對遊戲中關鍵部位的描寫作一定程度上的「自主規制」，對自家的產品內容進行修改處理。這些遊戲廠商的自我規制並沒有任何資料或者理論來限制規範，關於遊戲中有關性描寫的開放所佔的比例程度，全部是由遊戲製作公司轄下的開發團隊主觀的來決定限制範圍。然而如此一來便容易出現在管制內容與針對範圍有所不一，而隨著遊戲開發公司的不同而會有所差異。在很多情況之下，遊戲公司並無法客觀的了解須要限制哪些內容才不會受到大眾的抨擊，因此絕大多數的自主規制只能盡可能假想一般社會大眾所能接受的範圍來實行。為了能解決這一情況，在2004年6月日本經濟產業省的主導之下，決定聯絡计算机软件伦理机构、日本娛樂電子工業協會、映畫倫理委員會、日本映像倫理協會等機構組成映像作品倫理聯絡會議（）來討論這類遊戲自我規制等問題。

The self-regulation of the players does not have any data or theory to limit the scope of the rules.

source_text: 有鑒於種種對於沙織事件所引來的各種批判，有一股呼聲出現要求組織一個自律組織。1992年10月计算机软件伦理机构為此成立，負責管轄對於成人遊戲之中的內容呈現的限制。计算机软件伦理机构最初參考了日本映像倫理協會（NEVA）的規制方法，但由於兩者所關注的對象並不相同，導致大眾對於包括计算机软件伦理机构的規制方法以及其本身的可靠性，都產生了強烈的不信任感。另一方面，1990年發生了Comic Market被禁止使用幕張展覽館的會場事件，Comic Market也開始強制對於加入的成人遊戲公司進行了有關性描寫的自我限制。除了不斷加強要求動漫畫以及遊戲的限制之外，也開始有遊戲公司將「非實寫性描寫的呈現方式」引入成人遊戲之中。

The computer software ethics agency first consulted Japanese screenings of the NEVA, but since the concerns of the two parties were not the same, creating a strong sense of distrust among the public about the rules and methods of the computer software ethics agency and its own reliability. source_text: 由於计算机软件伦理机构的成立，成人遊戲因此脫離了過去無人管制的時代。最明顯的是要求在遊戲作品的圖像中，需要在生殖器處加上馬賽克，其次是大幅限制有關近親相姦的故事描寫。1996年在瑞典斯德哥爾摩舉辦了「反對兒童色情產業世界大會」，在大會之中對於當時亞洲各國常見的雛妓問題，以及日本社會中出現的兒童色情給與眾多批評。另一方面日本政府在國際輿論之下，宣布將會修訂法律並加強執法效率。這一時期御宅族已經儼然成為一個龐大商機的消費族群，但他們所喜愛具有「動漫風格美少女」卻在一定程度上與性刺激的要素有所重疊；也由於御宅族客戶群的出現，市場也開始對於這類產品越趨寬容。這一時期的成人遊戲，也有很大的比例是由這些具有萌感的角色來作為遊戲之中的女主角。

On the other hand, the Japanese government, under international discourse, announced that the law would be amended and enforced.

source_text: 2009年時，由ILLUSION公司所製作的凌辱系遊戲《電車之狼》在英國國會上引起爭論，而在紐約市議會中也起大量的批判。到了5月時，基進女性主義組織Equality Now對這些成人遊戲展開示威活動，也成了首次於日本海外對成人遊戲的抗議活動。5月28日，TBS電視台首次報導指出《電車之狼》引起歐美政府乃至國際人權團體的嚴重關注，這也在日本引起了一陣騷動，製作廠商ILLUSION也決定暫時取消《電車之狼》的發售。而在當時各界的壓力之下，计算机软件伦理机构決定自2009年6月2日起開始實施經修改過的審查標準，以全面禁絕凌辱系遊戲的製作與販售計畫。但之後許多成人遊戲公司指其這僅不過是偽造的新聞，因為對於凌辱系遊戲今後的規制方向，计算机软件伦理机构以及其他機構的會員直到2009年6月2日才開始作討論；而在公布消息的當天5月28日時，並沒有任何有關禁止凌辱系遊戲製作與販售的決定出現。這段期間內執政的自由民主黨派人於秋葉原的商店街進行視察，並組織了「性暴力遊戲自主規制研討會」（）來探討以法律規範的可能，其中也有部分人士主張應該對遊戲公司進行懲罰。而在6月時计算机软件伦理机构推出了「有關強姦與性暴力內容遊戲」禁止生產和販售的決議，並對市場之中的成人遊戲進行了更嚴格的審核。

source_text: 在沙織事件爆發之後，政府對於成人遊戲的管理越趨嚴格了起來；另一方面在1992年時，作為自主審查組織的计算机软件伦理机构也緊接著成立。然而雖然计算机软件伦理机构最初便是參考了日本映像倫理協會的倫理管制協定，但是相比之下日本映像倫理協會主要負責成人影片的部分，因此其專門適用於寫實影像的倫理方針並不適合以圖片為主體的成人遊戲使用。另一方面由於计算机软件伦理机构並沒有公布組織內部負責審查的員工，同時也沒有公開有關自身的業務內容，甚至還有「協會會為那些給予他們工作員工的公司，提供在審查上的便利性」這類抱持懷疑的意見出現。由於這採用了他家不同機構所使用的規制方法，以及對於自身業務不公開的做法，導致大眾對於包括计算机软件伦理机构的存在以及其本身的可靠性，都產生了強烈的不信任感，而這也連帶影響了同一時期許多大型遊戲公司的信任程度。
target_text: The government’s management of adult games became more stringent after the sarcophagus incident; in 1992, the computer software ethics agency, the self-censorship organization, was set up. However, while the computer software ethics agency initially consulted the rules of law governing Japan’s image association, there were doubts that Japan’s image would be primarily responsible for the adult film component of the association, and that it would therefore not be suitable for the image-based adult game. 算法
一般来说，插入排序都采用in-place在数组上实现。具体算法描述如下：
从第一个元素开始，该元素可以认为已经被排序
取出下一个元素，在已经排序的元素序列中从后向前扫描
如果该元素（已排序）大于新元素，将该元素移到下一位置
重复步骤3，直到找到已排序的元素小于或者等于新元素的位置
将新元素插入到该位置后
重复步骤2~5
target_text: Algorithms In-place is generally used to perform the sorting of insertions. The algorithm is described as follows: Starting with the first element, the element can be considered to have been sorted out of the next element, scanning the next step forward in the sequence of already sorted elements, and if the element is larger than the new element, then move it to the next position, repeat step 3, until the location of the sorted element is smaller or equal to the new element, insert the new element into that position and repeat steps 2-5.
title: 插入排序

source_text:
算法复杂度
如果目标是把n个元素的序列升序排列，那么采用插入排序存在最好情况和最坏情况。最好情况就是，序列已经是升序排列了，在这种情况下，需要进行的比较操作需次即可。最坏情况就是，序列是降序排列，那么此时需要进行的比较共有次。插入排序的赋值操作是比较操作的次数减去次，（因为次循环中，每一次循环的比较都比赋值多一个，多在最后那一次比较并不带来赋值）。平均来说插入排序算法复杂度为。因而，插入排序不适合对于数据量比较大的排序应用。但是，如果需要排序的数据量很小，例如，量级小于千；或者若已知輸入元素大致上按照順序排列，那么插入排序还是一个不错的选择。
插入排序在工业级库中也有着广泛的应用，在STL的sort算法和stdlib的qsort算法中，都将插入排序作为快速排序的补充，用于少量元素的排序（通常为8个或以下）。

The reflection, refraction, and absorption of the light are calculated when the light interacts with an object or medium in the scene.

source_text:
光线投射算法
Arthur Appel 于 1968 年首次提出用于渲染的光线投射算法。光线投射的基础就是从眼睛投射光线到物体上的每个点，查找阻挡光线的最近物体，也就是将图像当作一个屏风，每个点就是屏风上的一个正方形。通常这就是眼睛看到的那个点的物体。根据材料的特性以及场景中的光线效果，这个算法可以确定物体的浓淡效果。其中一个简单假设就是如果表面面向光线，那么这个表面就会被照亮而不会处于阴影中。表面的浓淡效果根据传统的三维计算机图形学的浓淡模型进行计算。光线投射超出扫描线渲染的一个重要优点是它能够很容易地处理非平面的表面以及实体，如圆锥和球体等。如果一个数学表面与光线相交，那么就可以用光线投射进行渲染。复杂的物体可以用实体造型技术构建，并且可以很容易地进行渲染。
target_text: The light projection algorithm Arthur Appel first proposed in 1968 a light projection algorithm for rehearsing. One simple assumption is that if the surface is directed towards the light, the surface will be lighted and not shaded. The thin effect of the surface is calculated on the basis of the traditional three-dimensional computer graphics. An important advantage of the light projection beyond the scanning line is that it can easily handle the surface of the surface and the entity, such as the cone and the sphere. source_text: 位于纽约 Elmsford, New York Mathematical Applications Group, Inc.（MAGI）的科学家首次将光线投射技术用于生成计算机图形。1966 年，为了替美国国防部计算放射性污染创立了这个公司。MAGI 不仅计算了伽马射线如何从表面进行反射（辐射的光线投射自从二十世纪四十年代就已经开始计算了），也计算了它们如何穿透以及折射。这些研究工作帮助政府确定一些特定的军事应用；建造能够保护军队避免辐射的军用车辆，设计可以重入的太空探索交通工具。在 Philip Mittelman 博士的指导下，科学家们开发了一种使用同样基本软件生成图像的方法。1972 年，MAGI 转变成了一个商业动画工作室，这个工作室使用光线投射技术为商业电视、教育电影以及最后为故事片制作三维计算机动画，他们全部使用光线投射制作了 Tron 电影中的绝大部分动画。MAGI 于 1985 年破产。

Under the guidance of Dr. Philip Mittelman, scientists developed a method of using the same basic software to generate images. source_text:
光线追踪算法
下一个重要的研究突破是 Turner Whitted 于 1979 年做出的。以前的算法从眼睛到场景投射光线，但是并不遞迴地跟踪这些光线。当光线碰到一个物体表面的时候，可能产生三种新的类型的光线：反射、折射与阴影。光滑的物体表面将光线按照镜像反射的方向反射出去，然后这个光线与场景中的物体相交，最近的相交物体就是反射中看到的物体。在透明物质中传输的光线以类似的方式传播，但是在进入或者离开一种物质的时候会发生折射。为了避免跟踪场景中的所有光线，人们使用阴影光线来测试光线是否可以照射到物体表面。光线照射到物体表面上的某些点上，如果这些点面向光源，那么就跟踪这段交点与光源之间的光线。如果在表面与光源之间是不透明的物体，那么这个表面就位于阴影之中，光线无法照射。这种遞迴多层次的光线计算使得光线跟踪图像更加真实。
target_text: The next important research breakthrough was made in 1979 by Turner Whitted. The previous algorithms projected the light from the eye to the scene, but did not track it backwards. When the light touches an object's surface, three new types of light can be created: reflection, refraction and shadow. The smooth surface of the object reflects the light in the direction of mirror reflection, and if the light interacts with the object in the scene, the nearest intersection is the object seen in the mirror. If the light is transmitted in transparent matter in a similar way, but is refractied when entering or leaving a substance, then the surface is in the shadow. To avoid tracking all the light in the landscape, the shadow is used to test whether the light is able to shine on the object's surface. The light hits certain points on the surface of the object, and if these dots are directed towards the source, then the light between the intersection and the source of the light. If the light is intransparent between the surface and the source, the surface is in the shadow, it cannot be seen.
title: 光線追蹤

source_text:
光线追踪的优点
光线跟踪的流行来源于它比其它渲染方法如扫描线渲染或者光线投射更加能够现实地模拟光线，象反射和阴影这样一些对于其它的算法来说都很难实现的效果，却是光线跟踪算法的一种自然结果。光线跟踪易于实现并且视觉效果很好，所以它通常是图形编程中首次尝试的领域。
target_text: The advantage of light-tracking is that light-tracking is popular because it is more realistic to simulate light than other rendering methods, such as scan-line rendering or light projection, and that some effects, such as reflection and shadow, are difficult to achieve for other algorithms, but are a natural result of light-tracking algorithms. Light-tracking is easy to achieve and has a good visual effect, so it is usually the first attempt in graphic programming.
title: 光線追蹤

source_text:
光线追踪的缺点
光线跟踪的一个最大的缺点就是性能，扫描线算法以及其它算法利用了数据的一致性从而在像素之间共享计算，但是光线跟踪通常是将每条光线当作独立的光线，每次都要重新计算。但是，这种独立的做法也有一些其它的优点，例如可以使用更多的光线以抗混叠现象，并且在需要的时候可以提高图像质量。尽管它正确地处理了相互反射的现象以及折射等光学效果，但是传统的光线跟踪并不一定是真实效果图像，只有在非常近似或者完全实现渲染方程的时候才能实现真正的真实效果图像。由于渲染方程描述了每个光束的物理效果，所以实现渲染方程可以得到真正的真实效果，但是，考虑到所需要的计算资源，这通常是无法实现的。于是，所有可以实现的渲染模型都必须是渲染方程的近似，而光线跟踪就不一定是最为可行的方法。包括光子映射在内的一些方法，都是依据光线跟踪实现一部分算法，但是可以得到更好的效果。
target_text: One of the biggest disadvantages of light-tracking is that it correctly addresses the phenomenon of refraction and optical effects such as refraction, but traditional light-tracking is not necessarily a real-effect image, and real-real-effect images can be achieved only when the consistency of the data is used, or when the equation is fully achieved. Since the rehearsing equation describes the physical effects of each beam, real-real effects can be achieved, but, given the computational resources that are required, it is usually not possible to improve the quality of the image. So, all models of resonance that can be achieved must be close to the angle, and light-tracking is not necessarily the most feasible method.
title: 光線追蹤

source_text:
光线穿过场景的反方向
从眼睛发出光线到达光源从而渲染图像的过程有时也称为后向光线跟踪，这是因为它是实际光线传播方向的反方向。但是，对于这个术语来说还有一些混淆的地方。早期的光线跟踪经常是从眼睛开始，James Arvo 等早期研究人员用后向光线跟踪表示从光源发出光线然后收集得到的结果。因为如此，将它们分成基于眼睛或者基于光源的光线跟踪将会更加清楚。在过去的几十年中，研究人员已经开发了许多组合了这两种方向的计算方法与机制以生成投降或者偏离交叉表面的或多或少的光线。例如，辐射着色算法通常根据光源对于表面的影响进行计算并且存储这些结果，然后一个标准的递归光线跟踪器可以使用这些数据生成场景的真实、物理正确的图像。在全局照明算法如光子映射以及 Metropolis light transport 中，光线跟踪只是一个用来计算光线在表面之间传输的简单工具。
target_text: Early light tracking often begins in the eyes, and early researchers such as James Arvo track the results from light sources and collects them later. Thus, it is clearer to divide them into light-based or light-based patterns. Over the past few decades, researchers have developed many methods and mechanisms for calculating these two directions in order to generate surrenders or to deviate from cross-surface transmissions, or more or less. For example, radiation colouring algorithms usually calculate and store these results on the basis of the impact of light on surfaces, and a standard relativity tracker can use these data to generate real, physically correct images of the landscape.
title: 光線追蹤

source_text:
实时光线跟踪
人们已经进行了许多努力，改进如计算机与视频游戏这些交互式三维图形应用程序中的实时光线跟踪速度。OpenRT 项目包含一个高度优化的光线跟踪软件内核，并且提供了一套类似于 OpenGL 的 API 用于替代目前交互式三维图形处理中基于光栅化（rasterization）的实现方法。
target_text: Real-time light tracking. Many efforts have been made to improve the speed of real-time light tracking in interactive three-dimensional graphic applications, such as computer and video games. The OpenRT project contains a highly optimized light-tracking software kernel and provides an API similar to OpenGL to replace the current interactive three-dimensional graphic processing with a rasterization-based approach.

source_text: 贪心算法（），又称-{zh-cn:贪婪; zh-tw:貪心;}-算法，是一种在每一步选择中都采取在当前状态下最好或最优（即最有利）的选择，从而希望导致结果是最好或最优的算法。比如在旅行推销员问题中，如果旅行员每次都选择最近的城市，那这就是一种贪心算法。贪心算法在有最优子结构的问题中尤为有效。最优子结构的意思是局部最优解能决定全局最优解。简单地说，问题能够分解成子问题来解决，子问题的最优解能递推到最终问题的最优解。
target_text: Greed algorithms () – {zh-cn: Greed; žh-tw: Greed;} ~ Arithmetic is the best or the best (i.e. the best) option in every step of the choice, hoping to result in the best or the best. In the case of travel salesmen, for example, if the traveller chooses the nearest city, that is a greedy algorithm. Greed algorithm is particularly effective in problems with the best substructure.
title: 贪心算法

source_text: 贪心法可以解决一些最优化问题，如：求图中的最小生成树、求哈夫曼编码……对于其他问题，贪心法一般不能得到我们所要求的答案。一旦一个问题可以通过贪心法来解决，那么贪心法一般是解决这个问题的最好办法。由于贪心法的高效性以及其所求得的答案比较接近最优结果，贪心法也可以用作辅助算法或者直接解决一些要求结果不特别精确的问题。在不同情況，選擇最優的解，可能會導致辛普森悖論（Simpson's Paradox），不一定出現最優的解。
target_text: Greed methods can solve some of the most optimal problems, such as the smallest generation of trees in the plan, the Huffman code, etc. Greed methods generally do not get the answers we ask for on other issues. Once a problem can be solved by greed, it is generally the best way to solve it. Because of the efficiency of greed and the fact that the answer it seeks is closer to the best result, it can also be used as an auxiliary algorithm or as a direct solution to some of the problems that require less precise results.
title: 贪心算法

列表中的需求一般都很抽象和缺乏关联
这样的列表一般表示不列出需求之间怎样组成一个整体。
从列表中很难看出哪些需求更重要。
抽象后的列表为读者提供了许多理解的余地，因此不同的读者对文件的理解可能不同。一个项目越大，读者越多，理解的方式就越多。
从抽象后的列表中很难看出它是否完全。它们往往忽视了许多细节。
顾客和开发者对这个列表的理解往往完全不同。
这样的合同式的列表给顾客一个错误的安全感，好像他们的要求都已列入了。但是由于列表本身对细节问题不能细述因此许多关键的细节问题实际上并未列出和解决。这些问题一直到后来软件开发时才被发现。那时开发者一般要与顾客再次讨论并试图按他们的意愿和条件来解决。
这个列表对此后的系统设计不提供任何帮助，它们的结构无法直接进入新软件。
target_text: It is difficult to see what needs are more important from the list. The abstract list gives readers a lot of room for understanding, so that different readers can understand the document differently.
title: 需求分析

source_text:
原型（Prototype）
从1980年代中开始，越来越多的人将作原型看作是解决需求分析困难的办法。原型模拟最终软件的屏幕显示，这样用户可以看到最终软件将是什么样，而实际上在这些屏幕显示的背后还一切都空着呢。这样顾客可以在系统还没有建立之前就做出设计决定。当原型首次被使用的时候它们的效果被视为非常惊人。引入原型往往提高顾客与开发者之间的信息交换。原型的屏幕显示后来往往很少被改变，因此可以大大地降低费用。
target_text: From the mid-1980s onwards, Prototypes were seen by a growing number of people as a solution to the difficulties of demand analysis. The prototype simulation final software screen shows, so that users can see what the final software will look like, and in fact everything is empty behind these screens. So that customers can make design decisions before the system is built. Their effects are seen as amazing when the prototype is first used.
title: 需求分析

source_text:
用例（Use Case）
参见用例用例是一种記录新系统或软件更换时的需求的技术。每个用例包含一个系统在作业时与用户或与其它系统之间交换信息的场景。一般用例避免使用术语，而尽量使用顾客、用户或他们的专家的语言。一般用例由软件开发者和顾客一起写成。
target_text: The example (Use Case) refers to the example as a technology for recording the needs of new systems or software replacements. Each example contains a scenario in which a system exchanges information with users or with other systems during its operation.
title: 需求分析

source_text: 在1990年代中用例很快地成为了記录需求分析的最主要的方式。尤其在它的发源地，在面向对象的程序设计中它的普及性非常高。但用例不仅可以用在面向对象的程序设计系统中，实际上用例本身并非面向对象的。每个用例集中于描写如何来完成一个作业目标或任务。对传统的软件工程来说每个用例描写系统的一个特点。对大多数软件项目来说一个新的系统有多个（往往十几个）用例。不同的软件项目的格式或项目的进展都可能影响用例的细节性。
target_text: In the mid-1990s, the example quickly became the most important method of recording needs analysis. Especially at its origin, it is very popular in object-oriented programming. But it can be used not only in object-oriented programming systems, but in fact it is not object-oriented in itself. Each example focuses on describing how to accomplish an operational objective or task. For traditional software engineering, a feature of an example-based system. For most software projects, there are many (often ten) examples of a new system. The format of different software projects or the progress of projects may affect the detail of the example.
title: 需求分析

source_text:
光学
在实验室中，氟化钙通常用作红外和紫外波长的窗口材料，因为它在这些区域（约0.15µm至9µm）是透明的，并且折射率随波长的变化极小。此外，该材料受到少量试剂的侵蚀。波长短至157nm，这是用于集成电路光刻的半导体步进制造的常用波长，氟化钙的折射率在高功率密度下表现出一些非线性，这抑制了其用于此目的。21世纪初，氟化钙的步进市场崩溃，许多大型制造设施已经关闭。佳能和其他制造商已在镜头中使用合成生长的氟化钙晶体来辅助复消色差设计，并减少光色散。这种用途在很大程度上已被较新的透镜和计算机辅助设计所取代。作为一种红外光学材料，氟化钙被广泛使用。

source_text:
增强型EDGE
增强型EDGE(Evolved EDGE或者) 通过多种方式对EDGE进行了提高。 通过把降低一半(约10ms到20ms)来减少延时。 峰值带宽提升到了1Mbit/s并且在使用双载波的情况下将延时降低到了80ms,使用更高的符号率和（使用32QAM和16QAM代替8PSK）, Turbo码 的使用也提升了纠错能力。最后的信号质量提升是通过使用双天线，平均比特率和频谱效率因此而提升。增强型EDGE通过软件逐步升级，以利用现有的优势。通过增强型EDGE，最终用户将可以体验到相当于500kbit/s的ADSL服务的移动互联网连接。
target_text: The enhanced EDGE enhanced EDGE (Evolved EDGE or EDGE) has improved the EDGE in a number of ways. The delay has been reduced by reducing it by half (approximately 10ms to 20ms).
title: GSM增强数据率演进

source_text: Bochs主要用于操作系统开发（当模拟操作系统崩溃，它不崩溃主机操作系统，所以可以调试仿真操作系统）和在主机操作系统运行其他来宾操作系统。它也可以用来运行不兼容的旧的软件（如电脑游戏）。它的優點在於能夠模擬跟主機不同的機種，例如在SPARC系統裡模擬x86，但缺點是它的速度卻慢得多。
target_text: Bochs is used mainly for operating system development (when the simulator system collapses, it does not crash the mainframe operating system, so it can be decoded) and running other guest operating systems in the mainframe operating system. It can also be used to run non-compatible old software (e.g. computer games). It has the advantage of emulating different types of machines from the host, for example, x86 in the SPARC system, but it is much slower.
title: Bochs

source_text: 到了1980年代，以色列希伯来大学的数学家Eliyahu Rips和物理学家Doron Witstum利用计算机高速计算对比（一套精密的数学运算模式），挑選圣经时代以来的32位知名人物，结果发现他们的名字和出生与死亡日期在《创世记》中都是编在一起的。后来他们把整本希伯来文圣经原文去除了所有字间距，连贯成总长304805个字（因为根据传说，摩西从上帝手中接受的圣经就是“字字相连，无一中断”），采用计算机跳跃码方式，在字符串中寻找名字、单词和词组，最终找到了一系列相关信息。据此完成了《聖經密碼》，经过耶鲁大学、哈佛大学、希伯来大学多名数学家验证，以及美国Statistical Science杂志（Institute of Mathematical Statistics的機關期刊之一）的三次复核后（他们经过数学分析，证实圣经密码为巧合的可能性只有二十五亿分之一，后来研究人员以更高难度测试，发现为巧合的可能性低至五万兆分之一），于1994年8月，正式发表在了Statistical Science杂志上（对于这篇论文的争论参见下面的“各方观点”）。
target_text: In the 1980s, Israel’s Hebrew University mathematicians Eliyahu Rips and physicist Doron Witstum used computer high-speed comparisons (a sophisticated mathematical mode) to select 32 prominent figures from the time of the Bible, whose names and dates of birth and death were compiled in Genesis. As a result, the entire Hebrew original text was removed from all word spacing and was consistent with 304805 words (because, according to legends, the Bible that Moses received from God was “word-connected without interruption”), after three reviews using computer leaping codes, searching for names, words and phrases in the string, and eventually finding a series of relevant information. As a result, they completed the Bible password, which was certified by several mathematicians at Yale University, Harvard University, Hebrew University, and the United States Statistical Science magazine (Institute of Mathematical Statistics), which was published as one of the most difficult times of the 1994 debate.
title: 圣经密码

source_text:
XnView MP
XnView MP是该软件的跨平台版本，支持Windows、Linux和Mac平台。它使用Qt库开发。相比起Classic版，它的特点是能在默认码表为ASCII的Unicode操作系统上识别包含有Unicode字符的路径和文件名、在全平台上支持多语言界面與活用多核心。XnView社区的成员mezich和thibaud为这款软件贡献了新的工具条按钮和图标。特性
XnView兼容了著名看图软件ACDSee的图片注释方法，即在图片文件夹下新建一个隐藏的文本文件，名为 Descript.ion，将逐个图片的注释存储在这一文件，并能够在图片浏览和查看时显示。
target_text: XnView MP XnView MP is a cross-platform version of the software that supports Windows, Linux, and Mac. It is developed using the Qt library. It is characterized by the ability to identify paths and filenames containing Unicode characters on the default list of the Unicode operating system for ASCII. Members of the XnView community contribute new toolbar buttons and icons to the software. The characteristic XnView is compatible with the photo annotation method of ACDSee, which creates a new hidden text file under the photo folder called Descript.ion, which will store this document on a picture-by-photo note and be able to show it at the time of viewing and viewing.
title: XnView

source_text:
正交性
在人所熟悉的三维空间里，有三对主要方向：上下（高度），南北（纬度），东西（经度）。这三对方向两两正交，也就是说，它们两两成直角。从数学方面讲，它们在三条不同的坐标轴，、、 上。计算机图形学中讲的深度缓冲指的就是这条 轴，在计算机的二维屏幕上代表深度。
target_text: There are three main directions: up and down (altitude), north and south (latitude), and east and west (longitude). These three directions are two or two, that is, they are two or two square angles. They are mathematically marked by three different axes, on, and on. The depth buffer in computer graphics refers to this axis, which represents depth on the two-dimensional screen of the computer.
title: 四维空间

source_text: 作为一門科学学科，计算机视觉研究相关的理论和技术，试图建立能够从图像或者多维数据中获取「信息」的人工智能系统。这里所指的信息指香农定义的，可以用来帮助做一个“决定”的信息。因为感知可以看作是从感官信号中提取信息，所以计算机视觉也可以看作是研究如何使人工系统从图像或多维数据中“感知”的科学。
target_text: As a scientific discipline, computer visualization attempts to build an artificial intelligence system that can get "information" from images or multidimensional data. The information here refers to Shannon, which can be used to help make a "decision" message. Since perception can be seen as extracting information from sensory signals, computer visualization can also be seen as the science of how to make artificial systems “sense” from images or multidimensional data.
title: 计算机视觉

source_text:
作为一个工程学科，计算机视觉寻求基于相关理论与模型来建立计算机视觉系统。这类系统的组成部分包括：
过程控制（例如工业机器人和无人驾驶汽车）
事件监测（例如图像监测）
信息组织（例如图像数据库和图像序列的索引建立）
物体与环境建模（例如工业检查，医学图像分析和拓扑建模）
交感互动（例如人机互动的输入设备）
target_text: As an engineering discipline, computer visualization seeks to build computer visual systems based on relevant theories and models. The components of such systems include: process control (e.g., industrial robots and unmanned vehicles) event monitoring (e.g., image monitoring), information organization (e.g., image database and indexing of image sequences), object and environment modelling (e.g., industrial inspection, medical image analysis and modeling) interaction (e.g., input equipment for human interaction)
title: 计算机视觉

source_text: 计算机视觉同样可以被看作是生物视觉的一个补充。在生物视觉领域中，人类和各种动物的视觉都得到了研究，从而建立了这些视觉系统感知信息过程中所使用的物理模型。另一方面，在计算机视觉中，靠软件和硬件实现的人工智能系统得到了研究与描述。生物视觉与计算机视觉进行的学科间交流为彼此都带来了巨大价值。
target_text: Computer visualization can also be seen as a complement to bio-visualization. In the field of bio-visualization, the visualization of humans and of animals has been studied, thus creating the physical models used in the process of sensing information about these visual systems. On the other hand, in computer-visualization, artificial intelligence systems made possible by software and hardware have been studied and described. The interdisciplinary exchange between bio-visual and computer-visual has brought great value to each other.
title: 计算机视觉

source_text: 这一领域的先驱可追溯到更早的时候，但是直到20世纪70年代后期，当计算机的性能提高到足以处理诸如图像这样的大规模数据時，计算机视觉才得到了正式的关注和发展。然而这些发展往往起源于其他不同领域的需要，因而何謂“计算机视觉問題”始终没有得到正式定义，很自然地，“计算机视觉问题”应当被如何解决也没有成型的公式。
target_text: The pioneers in this field date back even earlier, but it was not until the late 1970s that computer performance was raised enough to handle large-scale data such as images that computer vision received formal attention and development. However, these developments often stem from the needs of different fields, so what is called “computer visual problems” has never been formally defined and, naturally, the “computer visual problems” should be solved or shaped.
title: 计算机视觉

source_text: 对这些方法的应用通常作为某些解决复杂问题的大规模系统的一个组成部分（例如医学图像的处理，工业制造中的质量控制与测量）。在计算机视觉的大多数实际应用当中，计算机被预设为解决特定的任务，然而基于机器学习的方法正日渐普及，一旦機器學習的研究進一步發展，未來「泛用型」的電腦視覺應用或許可以成真。
target_text: The application of these methods is usually an integral part of some large-scale systems that solve complex problems (e.g. medical image processing, quality control and measurement in industrial manufacturing). In most practical applications of computer visualization, computers are pre-defined for specific tasks, but methods based on machine learning are becoming more widely available and, once machine learning research is advanced, future applications of general-purpose computer visual applications may become real.
title: 计算机视觉

source_text: 人工智能所研究的一个主要问题是：如何让系统具备「计划」和「决策能力」？从而使之完成特定的技术动作（例如：移动一个机器人通过某种特定环境）。这一问题便與计算机视觉問題息息相關。在这里，计算机视觉系统作为一个感知器，为决策提供信息。另外一些研究方向包括模式识别和机器学习（這也隶属于人工智能領域，但与计算机视觉有着重要联系），也由此，计算机视觉時常被看作人工智能與计算机科学的一个分支。
target_text: One of the main questions studied by AI is how to equip the system with a "plan" and a "decision-making capability” that allows it to perform certain technical actions (e.g. moving a robot through a particular environment). The problem is related to computer visual problems. Here, computer visual systems are used as a sensor to inform decision-making. Other research directions include model recognition and machine learning (which are also part of the artificial intelligence domain, but have important links to computer visualization), and thus computer visualization is often seen as a branch of artificial intelligence and computer science.
title: 计算机视觉

source_text: 计算机视觉关注的目标在于充分理解电磁波——主要是可见光与红外线部分——遇到物体表面被反射所形成的图像，而这一过程便是基于光学物理和固態物理，一些尖端的图像传感器甚至会应用到量子力学理论，来解析影像所表示的真實世界。同时，物理学中的很多测量难题也可以通过计算机视觉得到解决，例如流体运动。也由此，计算机视觉同样可以被看作是物理学的拓展。
target_text: The goal of computer visual attention is to fully understand the images of the electromagnetic waves – mainly the visible and infrared parts – that are reflected on the surface of the object, and the process is based on optical physics and solid physics, where some of the cutting edge image sensors can even be applied to quantum mechanics to interpret the real world in which the image is expressed. At the same time, many of the measurement challenges in physics can also be solved through computer visuals, such as fluid motion.
title: 计算机视觉

source_text: 在整个20世纪中，人類對各种动物的眼睛、神经元、以及与视觉刺激相关的脑部组织都進行了广泛研究，这些研究得出了一些有关“天然的”视觉系统如何運作的描述（尽管仍略嫌粗略），这也形成了计算机视觉中的一个子领域——人们试图建立人工系统，使之在不同的复杂程度上模拟生物的视觉運作。同时计算机视觉领域中，一些基于机器学习的方法也有參考部分生物機制。
target_text: Throughout the twentieth century, humans carried out extensive research into the eyes, neurons, and brain tissues associated with visual stimulation of all kinds of animals, which produced some descriptions of how “natural” visual systems operate (though still a little rough), which also formed a sub-area of computer visualization – an attempt to create artificial systems that simulated the visual operation of organisms to varying degrees of complexity. And in the field of computer visualization, a number of machine-based methods also refer to partial biomechanisms.
title: 计算机视觉

source_text: 计算机视觉的另一个相关领域是信号处理。很多有关单元变量信号的处理方法，尤其对是时变信号的处理，都可以很自然的被扩展为计算机视觉中对二元变量信号或者多元变量信号的处理方法。但由于图像数据的特有属性，很多计算机视觉中发展起来的方法，在单元信号的处理方法中却找不到对应版本。这类方法的一个主要特征，便是他们的非线性以及图像信息的多维性，以上二點作为计算机视觉的一部分，在信号处理学中形成了一个特殊的研究方向。
target_text: Another relevant area of computer visualization is signal processing. Many of the methods used to handle cell-variant signals, especially those that are transient, can naturally be expanded into binary-variate or multivariate-variant signals in computer visuals. Because of the unique properties of image data, many of the methods developed in computer visuals do not find a corresponding version in unit-based signals processing. One of the main features of such methods is their non-linear nature and the multi-dimensional nature of image information.
title: 计算机视觉

source_text: 除了上面提到的領域，很多研究课题同样可被当作纯粹的数学问题。例如，计算机视觉中的很多问题，其理论基础便是统计学，最优化理论以及几何学。如何使既有方法通过各种软硬件实现，或说如何对这些方法加以修改，而使之获得合理的执行速度而又不损失足够精度，是现今计算机视觉领域的主要课题。
target_text: In addition to the fields mentioned above, many subjects of study can also be treated as purely mathematical issues. For example, many of the issues in computer visualization are based on statistics, optimizing theory, and geometry. How to make available the methods available through various hardware and software, or how to modify them, so that they can be implemented at a reasonable pace without losing sufficient precision, is the main topic in the field of computer visuals today.
title: 计算机视觉

source_text: 计算机视觉，图像处理，图像分析，机器人视觉和机器视觉是彼此紧密关联的学科。如果你翻开带有上面这些名字的教材，你会发现在技术和应用领域上他们都有着相当大部分的重叠。这表明这些学科的基础理论大致是相同的，甚至让人怀疑他们是同一学科被冠以不同的名称。
target_text: Computer vision, image processing, image analysis, robotic vision and machine vision are closely related disciplines. If you turn over the teaching materials with the names above, you will find that they have a significant overlap in technology and applications.

source_text: 然而，各研究机构，学术期刊，会议及公司往往把自己特别的归为其中某一个领域，于是各种各样的用来区分这些学科的特征便被提了出来。下面将给出一种区分方法，尽管并不能说这一区分方法完全准确。计算机视觉的研究对象主要是映射到单幅或多幅图像上的三维场景，例如三维场景的重建。计算机视觉的研究很大程度上针对图像的内容。

頂點是多種領域的術語，在不同的环境中有不同的意义。
数学和计算机科学
頂點 (事物)：頂點一般指一個事物的相對高點或極端點。
頂點 (測繪學)：一般稱顶峰，在測繪學中指在一個相對的附近地區最高的一個點。
頂點 (幾何)：在平面几何学中，顶点是指多边形或角的两条边的公共端点。
頂點 (多胞形)：在立体几何学中，顶点是指在多面体中三个或更多的面连接的地方。
頂點 (分子構型)：在化學中，頂點是指分子構型對應幾何形狀的頂點。
頂點 (曲線)：在解析幾何學中，曲線的頂點通常代表曲線有局部極值的位置。
顶点 (图论)：在图论中，顶点（，）可以理解为一个事物（object），而一张图则是由顶点的集合和顶点之间的连接构成的。
頂點 (電腦圖學)：在计算机绘图中，顶点是空间中的一个点，一般由它的坐标表示。两个点可以确定一条直线，三个点可以确定一个平面。
頂點 (物理學)：在粒子物理学中，頂點是指粒子發生相互作用的點，例如LHC中兩粒子對撞產生反應的那個點就是頂點。

Tops (axis): In the geometry of the curves, the top points represent the public ends of the curves or angles. source_text: 1991年，新西兰奥克兰大学的统计学家罗斯·伊哈卡和罗伯特·杰特曼开始对S语言的一个新版本进行开发。伊哈卡与杰特曼两人名字首字母都是R，R语言因此得名。同时，R这个单一字母的名字也表明R语言与S语言一脉相承。1993年8月，伊哈卡与杰特曼在数据平台StatLib和邮件列表s-news中发布了R的早期版本。1995年，在统计学家马丁·梅克勒的建议下，伊哈卡与杰特曼通过GNU通用公共许可证把R做成了一款免费开源软件。软件于1995年6月进行了首次官方发布。首个稳定测试版本（1.0）于2000年2月29日发布。
target_text: In 1991, statisticians from the University of Auckland, New Zealand, Ross Ihaka and Robert Jetman began to develop a new version of the S language. Both Ihaka and Jettman initial letters are R, and therefore the R language. At the same time, the name of the single R letter also indicates a connection between R and S. In August 1993, Ihaka and Jettman published an early version of R in the data platform StatLib and Mail Lists-news. In 1995, Ihaka and Jettman, at the advice of the Statistician Martin Meckle, turned R into a free source software through the GNU General Public Licence. The first version of the stabilization test (1.0) was released in June 1995.

“好奇号”漫游车的质量为899千克(1982磅)，由多任务放射性同位素热电发电机（MMRTG）供电的六轮摇杆转向架系统每小时可行驶90米(300英尺)，并使用X波段和特高频波段进行通信。
计算机：两台相同的车载计算机，称为“漫游车计算元件”(RCE)，包含抗辐射内存，可承受来自太空的极端辐射，并防止断电循环。每台计算机的内存包括256KB的可擦除只读存储器、256MB的随机存取存储器和26GB的闪存的。与之相比，火星探测漫游者使用的内存容量则为3MB的可擦除只读存储器，128MB的随机存取存储器和256MB的闪存容量。
车载计算机使用运行频率为200兆赫兹的"RAD750"型芯片(火星探测漫游者所用“RAD6000”芯片的后续型)，RAD750 芯片处理速度高达400百万指令/秒(MIPS)，而 RAD6000 型芯片最多只支持每秒3500万条指令。在两台车载计算机中，一台设置为备份，在主计算机出现问题时接管。
target_text: Computers: Two of the same computers, called “Rover Car Calculators” (RCE), contain an anti-radiative memory that can withstand extreme radiation from space and prevent power outages. Each computer contains a six-wheel-rolling (300-foot) rack system, powered by a multi-mission radioisotope thermal generator (MMRTG), capable of travelling 90 metres per hour (300 feet) and using a X-band and an ultra-high frequency band. Compared to this, the X-band memory capacity used by Mars explorers is a 3-readable memory unit, 128 MB's random storage memory unit and 256 MB's flash capacity, which can withstand extreme radiation from space and prevent power out-breaking cycles.

source_text: 降低着陆精度误差的大部分方式是通过再入引导算法实现的，该算法源自阿波罗计划中用于引导阿波罗指令舱返回地球的算法。该制导利用气动外壳承受的升力来“飞出”任何探测到的范围误差，从而到达目标着陆点。为了使气动外壳具有升力，其质心需偏离中轴线，从而在大气层飞行中产生偏心配平角。这是通过在进入大气层前几分钟弹出两个75千克（165磅）钨配重压载物实现的。升力矢量由两组四台反推力系统（RCS）引擎控制，每对引擎约产生500牛（100磅力）的推力。这种改变升力方向的能力使航天器能够对周围环境做出反应，并转向着陆区。在降落伞展开之前，进入飞行器弹出更多的压载物，包括六块25千克（55磅）的钨块，从而消除了重心偏移。
target_text: Most ways to reduce landing accuracy errors are achieved by re-entry guidance algorithms, which are derived from the Apollo plan to guide the Apollo command module back to Earth. The system uses the lifts that are held by two sets of repulsors to “fly” any detectable range error, thus reaching the target landing point. In order for the aerodynamic shell to have an acceleration, its mass needs to deviate from the central axis, thus creating a dichotomy in atmospheric flight. This is achieved by ejecting two 75 kg (165 pounds) of tungsten with heavy ballast loads a few minutes before entering the atmosphere. The lift vector is controlled by two sets of four anti-propulsion systems (RCS) engines, which generate about 500 cows (100 pounds) per engine. This ability to change the orientation enables the spacecraft to react to the surrounding environment and turn to the landing zone.

OEM 授权是软件公司发售授权许可的一种模式，其最大的特点是授权一般直接附加于主機板等重要硬件上。微软是一个著名的例子，为他们的 Windows 作業系統提供 OEM 版的软件。OEM 产品密钥比相对应的零售版价格更为低廉，但兩者使用相同的软件。OEM 密钥主要是提供给直接的代工生产厂家与系统开发者，所以一般是作为批量许可密钥订单出售给这种製造大厂（例如惠普，戴尔，东芝，联想等）。个人同样可以购买它们作为个人使用（包括虚拟硬件），也可用于他们所组建的电脑的销售或转销。在每一个微软有关于 OEM 的最终用户许可协议中，产品密钥都与它原来安装的电脑主板相绑定，之后这种密钥一般是不能在电脑之间进行转让，它们只能为同一台电脑进行激活。这与零售密钥相反，后者可以被转让。一次重大的硬件更换会触发一个再激活提醒，这与零售版相同。
target_text: OEM is a model for software companies to issue licences, and its greatest feature is that it is generally authorized to attach directly to important hardware such as mainframes. Microsoft is a well-known example of software that provides OEM versions for their Windows operating systems. OEM product keys are cheaper than the corresponding retail versions, but both use the same software. OEM keys are mainly provided to direct surrogate manufacturers and system developers, so they are generally sold as bulk-licensed key orders to such major plants (e.g., Hewlett-Packard, Del, Toshiba, etc.). Individuals can also buy them as personal use (including virtual hardware) and can sell or transfer computers they have made. In every Microsoft end-user licensing agreement on OEM, the product keys are tied to the computer master panels that they originally installed, and then the key is generally not transferable between computers, and they can only be activated for the same computer. Contrary to retail keys, the latter can be transferred.
title: 代工生产

source_text: NASA WorldWind（有直譯為世界风者），是美国国家航空航天局（NASA）发布的一个开放源代码的地理科普软件，由NASA Research开发，NASA Learning Technologies來發展，它是一个可视化地球仪，将NASA、USGS以及其它WMS服务商提供的图像通过一个三维的地球模型展现，近期还包含了火星和月球的展现。用户可在所观察的行星上随意地旋转、放大、缩小，同时可以看到地名和行政区划。软件还包含了一个软件包，能够浏览地图及其它由因特网上的OpenGIS Web Mapping Service提供的图像。
target_text: NASA WorldWind (with a direct translator to World Wind), an open source geocomp software released by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), developed by NASA Research and developed by NASA Learing Technologies, is a visual globe displaying images provided by NASA, USGS and other WMS service providers through a three-dimensional Earth model and, more recently, Mars and the Moon. Users can rotate, magnify, narrow, and can see geographical names and administrative divisions on the planet they observe. The software also contains a software package that provides access to maps and other images provided by OpenGIS Web Mapping Service on the Internet.
title: NASA World Wind

source_text: 数字用户线路（，缩写：）是通过铜线或者本地电话网提供-{zh-hans:数字;zh-hk:數碼;zh-tw:數位;}-连接的一种技术。它的历史要追溯到1988年，贝尔实验室一位工程师设计了一种方法可以让-{zh-hans:数字;zh-hk:數碼;zh-tw:數位;}-信号加载到电话线路未使用频段，这就实现了不影响话音服务的前提下在普通电话线上提供数据通信。但是贝尔的管理层对这个并不热心，因为如果用户安装两条线路会带来更多的利润。这一状况直到1990年代晚期有线电视公司开始推销-{zh-hans:宽带;zh-hk:寬頻;zh-tw:寬頻;}-互联网访问时才得到改善。当意识到大多数用户绝对会放弃安装两条电话线访问互联网，贝尔公司才搬出他们已经讨论了10年的DSL技术，来争夺有线电视网络公司的宽带市场份额。

Its history dates back to 1988, when a Bell lab engineer designed a method to allow {zh-hans: numbers; zh-hk: numbers; zh-tw: numbers;}-signing to load telephone lines without using frequency bands, which enabled data communications to be provided on normal telephone lines without compromising voice services. But Bell’s management was not interested in this, because if the user installed two lines, it would bring more profits. This situation began to be marketed by cable television companies until the late 1990’s {zh-hans: broadband; zh-hk: broadband; zh-tw: broadband;}-Internet access improved.

source_text: Plone是一种建立在Zope应用服务器之上的开源内容管理系统。Plone是自由软件并且设计为可扩展的。它可以使用于内网和外网服务器，文档发布系统，并且可以作为位置分享的实体协作软件工具。其最早由Alan Runyan、Alexander Limi與Vidar Andersen在1999年开始，之后迅速成为流行而又强大的内容管理系统。
target_text: Plone is an open-source content management system based on the Zope application server. Plone is free software and designed to be scalable. It can be used on inner and outline servers, document distribution systems, and can be used as a physical collaboration software tool for location sharing. It was first started in 1999 by Alan Runyan, Alexander Limi and Vidar Andersen, and then quickly became a popular and powerful content management system.
title: Plone

target_text: The most significant advance in modem design is the 56 kbps standard, introduced in the late 1990s. This standard is similar to the earlier high/low speed systems rejected by users in the 1980s, but it is gradually accepted as the Internet is being used at a slight rate of sacrifice. A narrow channel is described. Today’s standard modem was named “intellectual modem” in 1980. It consists mainly of two important components: the analogue part is used to generate signals and operate telephones; and the digital part is used to set and control. The two parts are actually integrated into a chip, which is only theoretically or separately.

source_text: 數據機实际上工作在2种「模式」：数据模式时通过电话线发送或者接受数据给计算机；命令模式 时數據機监听从计算机发来的命令数据并发送出去。一个典型的会话开始于经过自动假定设置的上电（一般是内置类型） ，然后數據機开始拨出一个电话号码用来连接远程的另一个數據機。连接成功之后數據機自动进入数据模式，可以收发数据了。当用户使用完了，逸出序列，「+++」跟在大约1秒的暂停之后，數據機就转入命令模式，发送命令挂机。这样处理有一个问题就是。數據機并不真的知道一个字符串是命令还是数据。已知的解决方法，例如，可以使用转义字符来解决连续「+++」的情况。
target_text: The mode actually works in two " mode": data mode sends or receives data to computers via telephone lines; command mode listens to command data from computers and sends them out. A typical session starts with automatically assumed powering (generally built-in type), and the modem starts to assign a phone number to a remote other mode. Once the connection has been successfully connected, the modem automatically enters the data mode and receives the data. When the user runs out of the sequence, ++ follows a pause of about one second, the mode passes to the command mode and sends the command hanger. One problem is that the modem does not really know whether a string is an order or a data.
title: 调制解调器

source_text: 几乎所有的现代數據機都可以作为傳真機使用。1980年代开始的数字化传真只是一种特定的图像格式，通过高速數據機（4800/9600/14400 bps）来传送。计算机中的传真软件可以转换任何图像为數據機可以发送的传真格式。这种软件开始曾经需要另外购买，现在已经十分的普遍了。
target_text: Virtually all modern modems can be used as faxes. Digital faxes, which began in the 1980s, are a specific image format, transmitted by high-speed modems (4800/9600/14400 bps). Fax software in computers can convert any image into a fax format that can be sent by modems.
title: 调制解调器

source_text: Winmodem或者软件调制解调器，是一个为Windows系统简化的數據機，它用软件实现了部分硬件的功能。在这种情况下计算机内置的声音硬件（声卡）用来产生數據機模拟部分的声音信号。 另外的问题就是WinModems因为只能在过于依赖特定操作系统而缺乏灵活性，可能不会被其他操作系统（例如Linux）所支持，因为他们的制造商可能既不支持其他操作系统也不提供足够的技术支持和驱动程序。如果他们的驱动程序没有集成进系统的驱动程序库，后续的微软Windows系统可能也不会（或者不能很好的）支持Winmodem。
target_text: Winmodem, or software modem, is a modem that is simplified for Windows, which achieves part of the hardware function with software. In this case, computer built-in sound hardware (soundcards) is used to generate sound signals for the modem component of the modem.
title: 调制解调器

source_text: 在计算机科学（特别是在程序设计语言和数据库的关系模型），多元组通常被定义为从字段名到特定值的有限函数（在此情況又可譯為值組）。其目的和在数学中一样，就是指出特定的实体，或那些包含特定部件且（或）具有特定性质的对象。但是，这里的部件透过唯一的字段名来识别，而不是透过位置，這樣通常會是更用户友好的記法。
target_text: In computer science (especially in the context of program design language and database relationship models), multiple groups are usually defined as limited functions ranging from field names to particular values (in which case they can be translated into value groups). The purpose is, as in mathematics, to identify specific entities, or objects that contain specific components and/or have specific properties. But, here, components are identified by the only field name, not by location, which is usually more user-friendly.
title: 多元组

过程性标志
过程性标志语言（Procedural markup）一般都專門於文字的表達，但通常对于文本编辑者可见，并且能够被软件依其出现顺序依次解读。为了格式化一个标题，在标题文本之前，会紧接着插入一系列的格式标志符，以指示计算机转换到居中的显示模式，同时加大及加粗字体。在标题文本之后，会紧接缀上格式中止标志；对于更高级的系统宏命令或者堆栈模式会让这一过程的实现方式更加丰富。大多数情况下，过程性标志能力包含有一个Turing-complete编程语言。过程性标志语言的范例有：nroff, troff, TeX, Lout以及PostScript。过程性标志语言被广泛应用在专业出版领域，专业的出版商会根据要求使用不同的指标语言以达到出版要求。
target_text: For the purpose of formatting a title, a series of formatting symbols will be inserted immediately before the title text to indicate the computer's mode of display in-house, and also to increase and add bold fonts. After the title text, the formatting will be suspended; higher system macro commands or stacking patterns will enrich the process. In most cases, process marking capabilities include a Turing-complete programming language. Examples of process marker languages are: nroff, troff, TeX, Lout, and PostScript. The process signs language is widely applied in the professional publishing field, and the professional publishing chambers are required to use different indicator languages to meet publication requirements.
title: 置标语言

target_text: GenCodeTeXTeX is a powerful type-out software developed by the American computer professor Donald E. Knuth. It is popular in academia, especially in mathematics, physics and computer science. TeX is widely recognized as a good type-out tool, especially when dealing with complex mathematical formulas. Using terminal software such as LaTeX, TeX can type out excellent texts. SGML SGML is a dedicated tag language used as an electronic version of the Oxford English Dictionary. It is difficult to popularize because of the complexity of SSML.

source_text: HTML超文件标志语言（英文：HyperText Markup Language，简称为HTML）是为网页创建和其它可在网页浏览器中看到的信息设计的一种标志语言。XML可扩展标志语言（eXtensible Markup Language，简称XML），又称可扩展标记语言，是一种标志语言。标志指计算机所能理解的信息符号，通过此种标记，计算机之间可以处理包含各种信息的文章等。
target_text: HTML super-file sign language (English: HyperText Markup Language, or HTML) is a sign language for web page creation and other information designs that can be seen in web browsers. The XML extenuable sign language (eXtensible Markup Language, or XML), also known as extensible tag language, is a sign language. The sign refers to information symbols that computers understand, through which computers can process articles containing a variety of information, etc.
title: 置标语言

source_text: 在1970年代中期至1980年代，多功能的小型计算机充当路由器。尽管多功能小型计算机可以胜任路由工作，但在後期，高性能计算机被充当了高速路由器，它比小型計算機加入了更多的硬件，這使它擁有更高的执行效率，例如数据包转发，IPsec加密等等。工程師為了提升路由器的可靠性，路由器作出了許多改變，例如使用直流电而不是交流，在數據中心中，路由器的直流電可由数据中心的电池直接提供；或使用固态存储而不是磁性存储介质来载入程序等。随着这些技术漸趨成熟，一些小型路由器也已成为家用电器，而大型路由器变得越来越像电话交换机，也许路由器最終将取替电话交换机。
target_text: In the mid-1970s and 1980s, multifunctional mini-computers served as routers. While multifunctional mini-computers could be competent for route work, in the latter period, high-performance computers were used as high-speed routers, adding more hardware than small calculators, which made them more efficient in implementation, such as data package relays, IPsec encryption, and so on. Engineers, in order to increase the reliability of routers, have made many changes, such as the use of direct current power instead of communication, in a data centre, where routers can be provided directly by a data centre battery; or the use of solid-state storage rather than magnetic storage mediums to load programs. As these technologies mature, some small routers have also become home appliances, while large routers have become more and more like telephone exchanges, which may end up replacing telephone switches.
title: 路由器

source_text: 自从1946年世界上第一台电子计算机问世以来，计算机应用的一个重要里程碑是1962年美国麻省理工学院发明了世界上第一台图形显示器。自此之后，计算机可以透过图形显示器直接输入、输出图形，并且可以在显示屏上透過游标的移动，直接修改图形。而在这之前，工程师是透过一厚叠纸上密密麻麻的数字来间接表达工程图形的。
target_text: Since 1946, when the world’s first computer came into existence, an important milestone in computer applications has been the creation of the world’s first graphic display by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 1962. Since then, computers can enter and export graphics directly through graphic monitors, and can modify them directly through the movement of cursors on screens.
title: 计算几何

source_text: 1962年被认为是美国和欧洲CAD开始发展的一年。首先的应用领域是汽车、飛機和造船工业。这3个行业，由于其产品的外形曲面特别复杂，要求特别苛刻，而成为CAD首先应用的领域。与此同时，也就发展出了一门新兴学科——计算几何，它在美国常常被称为CAGD（Computer Aided Geometric Design，计算机辅助几何设计），专门研究“几何图形信息（曲面和三维实体）的计算机表示、分析、修改和综合”。1972年在美国举行CAGD第一次国际会议，标志计算几何学科的形成。
target_text: The three industries, because of the particularly complex and demanding surfaces of their products, became the first areas of application of the CAD. At the same time, an emerging discipline – calculating geometry – was developed in the United States, often referred to as the CAGD (Computer Aided Geometric Design, Computer-assisted Geometry Design), which specializes in “the representation, analysis, modification, and integration of geometrical information (cube and three-dimensional entities) in computers.” The first CAGD international conference, held in 1972 in the United States, marked the formation of geometric disciplines.
title: 计算几何

source_text: 功能防火墙最基本的功能就是隔离網路，透過將網路劃分成不同的區域（通常情況下稱為ZONE），制定出不同区域之间的访问控制策略来控制不同信任程度区域间传送的数据流。例如互联网是不可信任的区域，而内部网络是高度信任的区域。以避免安全策略中禁止的一些通信。它有控制信息基本的任务在不同信任的区域。典型信任的区域包括互联网(一个没有信任的区域) 和一个内部网络(一个高信任的区域) 。最终目标是:根据最小特权原则，在不同水平的信任区域，透過連通安全政策的运行，提供受控制的连通性。例如：TCP/IP Port 135~139是 Microsoft Windows 的【网上邻居】所使用的。如果電腦有使用【网上邻居】的【分享資料夾】，又沒使用任何防火牆相關的防護措施的話，就等於把自己的【分享資料夾】公開到Internet，使得任何人都有機會瀏覽目錄內的檔案。且早期版本的Windows有【网上邻居】系統溢位的無密碼保護的漏洞（這裡是指【分享資料夾】有設密碼，但可經由此系統漏洞，達到無須密碼便能瀏覽資料夾的需求）。防火牆的本義，是指古代構築和使用木製結構房屋時，為防止火災發生及蔓延，人們將堅固石塊堆砌在房屋周圍做為屏障，這種防護結構建築就被稱為防火牆。
target_text: The most basic function of the functional firewall is to isolate the network by dividing it into different areas (often referred to as ZONE) and developing access control strategies between regions to control the flow of data transmitted between regions with different levels of trust. source_text:
利用计算机网络技术进行调查，具有以下优点：
成本低：不用印制大量纸质问卷，不用雇佣和培训访员等等，节约时间成本、人力成本、交通费用。
速度快：通过即时通讯软件和IP电话，就同电话一样，可以迅速得到被调查者的回复。
便易性：利用数字技术和事先编制好的程序，可以使数据的收集、整理自动完成，快速准确，甚至可以即时查看结果。调查内容快速、准确、完整地记录下来，为以后的统计分析带来了极大的方便。
广域性：潜在的受访者可以在任何时间、任何合适的地点接受并回复调查，时空限制小。
匿名性：不会受到调查员及其他外在因素的误导和干预，回答往往比较大胆、坦诚，容易获得传统调查不容易获得的敏感信息。
可控性。网络调查可在被调查者提交回复后，由计算机程序自动实施检查复核，防止错答、漏答，可以有效地保证调查结果的有效性。另外可利用IP地址识别技术防止被调查者重复投票，当然，对于某些计算机知识丰富的被调查者，有些防止作弊的技术对他们不起作用。
多样性：网络调查可以利用计算机多媒体技术，利用文字、图形、声音、动画、视频等信息，使调查更容易理解，充满乐趣，从而吸引和帮助被调查者参加调查。
target_text: The use of computer network technology for investigations has the following advantages: low cost: it is not necessary to print a large number of paper questionnaires, do not hire and train visitors, etc., save time costs, manpower costs, transportation costs, etc. Speed: it is possible to obtain a quick response from the respondents, as is the case with telephone calls, via instant communication software and IP telephones.
title: 社会统计调查

source_text: 随机数生成器（Random number generator）是通过一些算法、物理訊號、環境噪音等来产生看起來似乎沒有關聯性的數列的方法或裝置。丟硬幣、丟骰子、洗牌就是生活上常見的隨機數產生方式。大部分计算机上的偽随机数，并不是真正的随机数，只是重复的周期比较大的數列，是按一定的算法和种子值生成的。
target_text: The random number generator (Random number generator) produces a number of algorithms, physical signals, environmental noises, etc. that appear to be unconnected. Throwing coins, dice, shuffling is how random numbers are generated that are common to life. Most computers have false random numbers that are not really random, but that repeat larger columns of cycles that are generated by certain algorithms and seed values.
title: 随机数生成

source_text:
發展歷史
直到1970年代，「質性研究」這個詞都還被視為人類學或社會學的研究方法。而1970年代至1980年代，其他學科開始採用質性研究，定性研究逐漸變成教育研究、社會工作研究、女性研究、殘疾研究、資訊研究、管理研究、護理研究、醫學研究、政治科學、心理學、傳播、人机交互、计算机支持的协同工作、软件及系统设计研究和其他領域的重要研究類型。在這個階段，研究者透過質性研究來調查新消費商品的產品定位或行銷機會。1980年代晚期至1990年代，企業花費在傳統媒體廣告的開支開始減少，故必須研究和尋求更有效率進行廣告的方式。
target_text: In the 1970’s and 1980’s, other faculties began to use qualitative research, and qualitative research evolved into educational research, social work research, female research, disability research, information research, management research, nursing research, medical research, political science, psychology, transmission, interpersonal interaction, computer-supported teamwork, software and systems design research, and other types of research of importance in other domains. At this stage, researchers used quality research to investigate the positioning or marketing opportunities of products for new consumption.
title: 質性研究

source_text: 外部网（Extranet）是一个使用与互联网同样技术的计算机网络，它通常属于一个企业或组织的内部网（Intranet）或建立在互联网中并为指定的用户提供信息的共享和交流等服务。外部网应用互联网与内部网的技术去服务一些外部企业，包括特定的客户、供应商或生意上的伙伴。
target_text: Extranet is a computer network that uses the same technology as the Internet, which usually belongs to an enterprise or organization’s Intranet (Intranet) or is built on the Internet and provides information sharing and communication for designated users.
title: 外部网

source_text: 笔记本电脑（）又称-{膝上}-電腦（）、便携计算机、-{zh-cn:手提电脑，简称笔记本、笔电;zh-tw:手提notebook，簡稱筆電;zh-hk:筆記本電腦、筆記型電腦;}-，是自带屏幕和字母数字键盘的小型便携式个人电脑（PC），重量通常在左右，屏幕尺寸大多在之间。随着计算机技术的发展，筆記型電腦的体积越来越小，重量越来越轻，而性能却越发强大。為了要縮小體積，筆記型电脑通常需要有液晶显示器（液晶屏），部分機種還有觸控螢幕。除了鍵盤以外，笔记本电脑還裝有触摸板或觸控點作为定点设备，也可以用USB或Thunderbolt连接其它外部设备。

As computer technology develops, laptops are smaller and lighter in size, while their properties become stronger. source_text: 在现代程序语言中，源代码可以是以书籍或者磁带的形式出现；但最常用的格式是文本文件，这种典型格式的目的是为了编译出计算机程序。计算机源代码的最终目的是将人类可读的文本翻译成为计算机可以执行的二进制指令，这种过程叫做编译，通过编译器完成。
target_text: In modern program languages, the source code can be in the form of a book or tape; but the most commonly used format is text files, a typical format designed to compile computer programs. The ultimate purpose of the source code is to translate human-readable texts into binary instructions that can be implemented by computers.
title: 源代码

生成目标代码，即计算机可以识别的代码。

source_text:
代码组合
源代码作为软件的特殊部分，可能被包含在一个或多个文件中。一个程序不必用同一种格式的源代码书写。例如，一个程序如果有C语言库的支持，那么就可以用C语言；而另一部分为了达到比较高的运行效率，则可以用汇编语言编写。就目前的情况而言，很少有需要直接用汇编语言来编写的软件了，因为很多时候编译器生成的优化程序的运行效率已经很好了，更多的时候是用C/C++这样的编译语言来写核心需要速度的部分，用Perl、Python和Lua等这样的动态语言来做核心的扩展，例如界面，管理配置等等。这样既不会损失效率，也增加了程序的灵活性。
target_text: Combining the source code as a special part of the software may be contained in one or more documents. A program does not need to be written in the same form of source code. For example, if a program is supported by a C-language library, it can be written in the C language, while the other part can be written in the compiled language to achieve a more efficient operation. In the present case, few software need to be prepared directly in the compilation language, because many times the optimized process generated by the compiler is run very efficiently, more often in the C/C++ translation language, and the core speed required is expanded in dynamic languages such as Perl, Python and Lua, for example, interfaces, management configurations, etc. This does not lose efficiency and increases the flexibility of the process.
title: 源代码

source_text: 较为复杂的软件，一般需要数十种甚至上百种的源代码的参与。为了降低种复杂度，必须引入一种可以描述各个源代码之间联系，并且如何正确编译的系统。在这样的背景下，版本控制系统（VCS）诞生了，并成为研发者对代码修订的必备工具之一。还有另外一种组合：将为一种平台编写的软件移植到另外一种平台上，例如将Windows下的软件移植到Linux或者MacOS下，专业术语叫做软件移植。一般可以运行在多个平台下的软件叫做跨平台软件。
target_text: In this context, the version control system (VCS) has been created and has become one of the necessary tools for developers to revise the code. There is another combination: software for a platform is transplanted to another platform, such as the software under Windows to Linux or Macos, a specialized term called software transplantation. Software that can normally run under multiple platforms is called cross-platform software.
title: 源代码

source_text: 对于算术运算（如加法和减法），该算法首先对操作数的最低位片段进行运算，从而生成最低位对应的结果和进位。随后将该结果储存至某个指定的位置，而处理器通常会存储 ALU 状态输出中的进位。然后，该算法继续计算每个操作数片段集合的下一个片段，并对这些片段调用 ALU 操作，并将先前 ALU 操作的进位一起输入，从而产生另一个更高位的片段和进位。重复此过程，直到处理完所有操作数片段为止，从而在存储位置中得到完整的运算结果。
target_text: For arithmetic operations (e.g. additions and subtractions), the algorithm first calculates the lowest bits of the number of operations, thereby generating the lowest bit corresponding result and entry. The result is then stored at a given location, while the processor usually stores the entry of the ALU state output. The algorithm then continues to calculate the next segment of each segment of the operation, and calls the ALU operation to these segments, and then inputs the entry of the previous ALU operation together, thereby generating another higher segment and entry. Repeats the process until all the operational segments are processed, so that the complete calculation results are obtained in the storage location.
title: 算術邏輯單元

source_text: 在整个信息时代的初期，电子电路的成本，尺寸和功耗都相对较高。因此，尽管所有串行计算机和许多早期计算机（例如 PDP-8）都具有一个简单的 ALU，但它一次只能处理一个数据位，而程序员们使用更长的字长。最早的具有多个分立单位 ALU 电路的计算机是1948年的 Whirlwind I，它使用了16个这样的“数学单元”，以使其能够对16位数据进行操作。
target_text: The cost, size and power of electronic circuits were relatively high throughout the early days of the information age. So, while all serial computers and many early computers (e.g. PDP-8) have a simple ALU, they can only handle one data slot at a time, while programmers use a longer word length. The earliest computer with multiple separate units ALU circuits was the 1948 Whirlwind I, which used 16 such “mathematical units” to enable them to operate 16 bits of data.
title: 算術邏輯單元

source_text: 1967年，仙童半导体推出了第一款用集成电路实现的 ALU，名为 Fairchild 3800，由一个带累加器的八位 ALU 构成。随后，其他集成电路 ALU 也相继出现，包括4位 ALU，如 Am2901 和 74181。这些设备通常具有“位片”功能，这意味着它们可以输出“超前进位”的信号，从而有助于使用多个 ALU 芯片相互连接以构成字长更宽的 ALU。这些设备迅速流行起来，并广泛用于位片微型计算机。
target_text: In 1967, the Fairchild semiconductor introduced the first ALU, known as Fairchild 3800, which is made up of eight ALUs with a compounder. Subsequently, other integrated circuits, including four ALUs, such as Am2901 and 74181. These devices usually have a “bit” function, which means that they can export a “super-forward” signal, thus facilitating the use of multiple ALU chips to connect to each other to form a word-wide ALU.
title: 算術邏輯單元

source_text: 尽管近现代的数十年间摩尔定律均成立，但它仍应被视为是对现象的观测或对未来的推测，而不应被视为一个物理定律或者自然界的规律。从另一角度看，未来的增长率在逻辑上无法保证会跟过去的数据一样，也就是逻辑上无法保证摩尔定律会持续下去。近年来，行业专家尚未就摩尔定律何时停止适用达成共识。虽然原本预计摩尔定律将持续到至少2020年，然而，2010年国际半导体技术发展路线图的更新增长已经在2013年年底放缓，低于摩尔定律预测的速度。但是，截至2018年，一些强大的半导体制造商已经开发出大规模生产的半导体元件制造工艺，据称这些工艺与摩尔定律仍将保持同步。
target_text: Although Moor laws have been in place for recent decades, they should be seen as an observation of phenomena or speculation about the future, not as a law of physics or a law of nature. From another perspective, there is no logical guarantee that future growth rates will remain the same as in the past, i.e., that there is no logical guarantee that Moor laws will continue.
title: 摩尔定律

source_text: 简化分子线性输入规范（，簡稱SMILES），是一种用ASCII字符串明确描述分子结构的规范。SMILES字符串可以被大多数分子编辑软件导入并转换成二维图形或分子的三维模型。转换成二维图形可以使用Helson的“结构图生成算法”（Structure Diagram Generation algorithms）。最初的 SMILES 规范始于 1980 年代，已经被多次修改和扩展。 2007 年，开源化学社区开发了一个名为 OpenSMILES 的开放标准。
target_text: Simplification of molecular linear input norms (simple SMILES) is a norm that clearly describes the structure of molecules using the ASCII string. SMILES strings can be imported by most molecular editing software and converted into a three-dimensional model of two-dimensional graphics or molecules. Converting to two-dimensional graphics can use Helson's Structure Generation algorithms. The original SMILES code began in the 1980s and has been modified and expanded several times.
title: 简化分子线性输入规范

source_text: 描述 CANGEN 算法的原始论文声称可以为表示分子的图形生成唯一的 SMILES 字符串，但该算法在许多简单情况下都失败了（例如cuneane 、1,2-二环丙基乙烷）并且被认为不能使用正确的方法典型地表示图形。 目前没有跨商业软件的系统比较来测试这些软件包中是否存在此类缺陷。
target_text: The original paper describing the CanGEN algorithm claims to be the only SMILES string that can be generated for the representation of molecules, but the algorithm has failed in many simple cases (e.g. cuneane, 1,2-dicyclopropylene) and is considered not to be typical of graphics using the correct method. There is currently no system comparison of cross-commercial software to test the existence of such defects in these packages.
title: 简化分子线性输入规范

source_text:
发展
SMARTS是SMILES基础之上的改进版。SMARTS中增加的一点是，它允许使用通配符表示原子和化学键。因此，它在化合物数据库中广泛用于结构的计算机化搜索。这种搜索的机理是先-{zh-cn:通过;zh-tw:透過}-输入的SMILES式重构化学式，再搜索子图的同形；而不是直接-{zh-cn:通过;zh-tw:經由}-SMILES式的对比完成的。
target_text: The development of SMARTS is an improved version based on SMILES. The addition to SMARTS is that it allows the wildcards to be used to denote atoms and chemical keys. It is therefore widely used in the compound database for a computerized search of structures. The search mechanism is first -- {zh-cn: through; zh-tw: through the SMILES-inputed reconstructed chemical formula, re-searching the image of sub-maps; not directly -- {zh-cn: through; zh-tw: through a comparison of}-SMILES.
title: 简化分子线性输入规范

source_text:
其他记法及比较
其他著名的线性记法包括維斯威歇線性表示式（Wiswesser Line Notation，WLN），ROSDAL和SLN。最近国际纯粹与应用化学联合会推荐国际化合物标识作为标准的分子式表达式。然而普遍认为，SMILES与InChI相比更具有(對人來說的)可读性；而且很多软件都支持SMILES，其中不少软件都具有图论等方面的理论基础。
target_text: Other well-known linear ways of remembering and comparing include Wiswer Line Note, ROSDAL, and SLN. Recently, the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUP) has recommended international labels for compounds as standard molecular expressions. However, it is widely accepted that SMILES is more readable than InChi; and that many software support SMILES, many of which have theoretical foundations, such as graphics.
title: 简化分子线性输入规范

source_text: 软件版本控制软件工程师常利用版本控制來跟踪、维护源代码、檔案以及配置文件等的改动。有時候，一个程序同時存有两个以上的版本有其必要性，例如：发布版本中程序错误已經被修正，但沒有加入新功能；而开发版本則有新的功能正在开发、也有新的错误待解決，于是便需要同时维护两个不同的版本。
target_text: Software version control software engineers often use version control to track, maintain source code, file, and profile changes. Sometimes it is necessary for a program to store more than two versions at the same time, e.g., a program error in the release version has been corrected but no new functionality has been added; while a new version is being developed, there are new errors to be resolved, so it is necessary to maintain two different versions at the same time.
title: 版本控制

source_text: 湘潭大学的图书馆于20世纪70年代随着大学的重设而创立，当时，一些中国高校为新建的湘大图书馆捐赠了典籍，也包括《钦定古今图书集成》、《四部丛刊初编》、线装本《二十四史》、《大清会典》等珍藏古籍，其中于清朝雍正年间成书的《钦定古今图书集成》日后更成为该图书馆的镇馆之宝。校图书馆还创办专职培训班，帮助学校自身建立图书情报与档案管理学科群，以为中国各地的图书馆培养合格的管理人才。学校还利用现有人文资源优势，自行创建了毛泽东数字图书馆、红色旅游资源数据库等特色数据库。
