source_text: 18世纪，随着牛顿提出了宇宙中普遍适用的定律，有些哲学家开始思考，是否可以使用纯粹的物理定律解释心灵。其中首位具有影响力的推行者是法国启蒙思想家朱利安·奥弗雷·拉·美特利，他为此创作了《人是机器》，用以论证人也如宇宙中其他事物一般，只是物理定律的产物。然而，他为此作出的论证十分晦涩难懂。现代关于意识的理论主要基于心理学和神经科学。由神经科学家杰拉尔德·埃德尔曼、安东尼奥·达马西奥，以及哲学家丹尼尔·德内特等人寄希望于从大脑内部神经事件出发解释意识。部分神经科学家，例如克里斯托夫·科赫已探索了构成意识的神经学基础，但并未尝试构建一个全面统一的理论。与此同时，计算机科学家也在借助人工智能技术，尝试在计算机程序中模拟或嵌入意识。
target_text: In the 18th century, with Newton proposing the laws of the universe in general, some philosophers began to wonder whether a purely physical law could be used to explain the mind. The first influential promoter was the French enlightened thinker, Julian Orfrey La Maitley, who created the " Man is the Machine " to argue that human beings, like other things in the universe, are simply the product of the laws of physics. However, his argument for this is difficult to understand. Modern theory of consciousness is based mainly on psychology and neuroscience.
title: 意识

source_text:
科学研究
多个世纪以来，科学界一直回避意识研究话题，因为意识现象的主观性与客观的科学实验方法难以相协调。1975年，美国心理学家发表了一篇极具影响力的心理学文章，他在文中区分了缓慢、序列化、有限度的意识过程和快速、并行、扩展的无意识过程。1984年科学与宗教论坛（）年度会议以“从人工智能到人类意识”为主题，呼吁将意识的本质作为研究对象，英国人工智能学者是本次会议的主题发言人。自1980年代开始，一些神经科学家和心理学家开始参与到一个新兴的研究领域“意识研究”，并由此产生了许多实验研究。这些研究发表在各类书籍或学术期刊（例如《》、《意识研究前沿》（）、《》、《》），并有多个团体（例如、）定期组织相关会议。
target_text: For centuries, the scientific community has avoided the topic of consciousness research, because the subjectivity of consciousness phenomena is difficult to reconcile with objective scientific experimental methods. In 1975, American psychologists published an influential psychological article that distinguished between slow, sequenced, limited, and rapid, parallel, expanding unconscious processes. The annual meeting of the Science and Religion Forum () in 1984, on the theme “From artificial intelligence to human consciousness”, called for the nature of consciousness to be the subject of research, and British artificial intelligence scholars were the keynote speakers for the conference. Since the 1980s, neuroscientists and psychologists began to participate in “awareness research” in an emerging field of research, resulting in many experimental studies.
title: 意识

source_text: 对人工意识的探讨历史久远，许多神话传说都涉及这一主题。例如，古罗马诗人奥维德在《变形记》中记述了雕刻家皮格马利翁的故事，故事中皮格马利翁的雕刻作品被赋予意识，成为了与人类相似的生命体。类似地，在中世纪犹太魔像传说中，也描绘了人们通过塑造陶土创造出人工生命何蒙库鲁兹的情节。对于机器意识的现代探讨最早可以追溯到英国诗人拜伦之女爱达·勒芙蕾丝，她在1842年有关查尔斯·巴贝奇分析机的文章中提出了现代计算机的雏形。然而，勒芙蕾丝并不认分析机可以创造意识：最好不要夸大分析机的能力……这种机器不具备对事物的意图，它只能完成我们所知可以让它完成的任务。它可根据规则进行分析，但没有能力预测任何分析关系或揭示真理。因此，它的功能是在我们已经熟知的领域中为我们提供协助。针对人工意识，最具影响力的贡献来自英国数学家阿兰·图灵发表于1950年的论文《》。文章开篇，图灵首先否认了界定术语的意义，他认为即便是“机器能思考吗？”这类问题也搭载了太多值得怀疑的内涵。因此，他主张将所有对于人工意识的问题转化为一种可实际操作的测试，其被后人称为“图灵测试”。一个计算机程序只有在能够与人类展开对话，并且不被识别出它的机器身份，那么才可称为有意识。
target_text: For example, the ancient Roman poet Ovid wrote the story of the carving of the sculptor Pygmalión, who, in 1842, created consciousness and became a living body similar to humans. Similarly, in the legend of the medieval Jewish statues, described the creation of artificial life by shaping the pottery, and the circumstances of what we know can be done. The modern exploration of machine consciousness dates back to the British poet Beren's daughter, Aida Lefres, who, in her 1842 article on the Charles Babbage analyser, presented the prototype of a modern computer. However, Lefres does not think that the analyser can create consciousness: it is best not to exaggerate the ability to analyse things; it has no intention of doing what we know, but it has no ability to predict any relationship or truth.
title: 意识

source_text: 针对“强人工智能”可产生意识的说法，美国哲学家约翰·瑟尔提出了“中文屋”实验作出反驳。不过，他同时认可可能会出现一种“弱人工智能”，其程序可以被设计成模仿意识状态。瑟尔的观点是，意识具有主观的、第一人称的特性，其源自人类大脑生物学层面的运作。尽管人脑可以执行计算，但它的计算方式与计算机程序在本质上是不同的。瑟尔对“中文屋”的表述如下：一个对中文一窍不通，只说英语的人被关在一间只有一个开口的封闭房间中。房间里有一本用英文写成的手册，指示该如何处理收到的中文讯息及如何以中文相应地回复。房外的人不断向房间内递进用中文写成的问题。房内的人便按照手册的说明，寻找合适的指示，将相应的中文字符组合成对问题的解答，并将答案递出房间。在这个案例中，房间里的英语使用者的行为就如计算机程序。瑟尔表示，尽管房间内的人可以准确地处理中文，却并非真正理解输入和输出的含义。假设外界用英文提问并获得英文回答，那么因为房间内的人了解英文，他可以不依赖手册直接生成回答。在使用中文和英文的情况下，房间里的人都可通过图灵测试。然而，他只有在使用英文时才能真正具备意识，使用中文时通过图灵测试只是得益于程序对句法的正确处理，而语法并不能直接产生语义。
target_text: In response to the claim that “strong artificial intelligence” can generate consciousness, the American philosopher John Søle has argued against the “Chinese House” experiment. However, he agrees that there may be a “weak artificial intelligence” that can be designed as an imitation of consciousness. The view of Søle is that consciousness is subjective, first-person, and that it is derived from the biological dimension of the human brain. While the brain can perform calculations, it is calculated differently from the computer program. The “Chinese House” is described as follows: a person who knows nothing but English is kept in a closed room with only one opening. In this case, the correct English user behaves as a computer procedure.
title: 意识

source_text:
更詳細的說，UTF-8編碼具有以下幾點優點：
ASCII是UTF-8的一个子集。因为一个纯ASCII字符串也是一个合法的UTF-8字符串，所以现存的ASCII文本不需要转换。为传统的扩展ASCII字符集设计的软件通常可以不经修改或很少修改就能与UTF-8一起使用。
使用标准的面向字节的排序例程对UTF-8排序将产生与基于Unicode代码点排序相同的结果。（尽管这-{只}-有有限的有用性，因为在任何特定语言或文化下都不太可能有仍可接受的文字排列顺序。）
UTF-8和UTF-16都是可扩展标记语言文档的标准编码。所有其它编码都必须通过显式或文本声明来指定。
任何面向字节的字符串搜索算法都可以用于UTF-8的数据（-{只}-要输入仅由完整的UTF-8字符组成）。但是，对于包含字符记数的正则表达式或其它结构必须小心。
UTF-8字符串可以由一个简单的算法可靠地识别出来。就是，一个字符串在任何其它编码中表现为合法的UTF-8的可能性很低，并随字符串长度增长而减小。举例说，字元值C0,C1,F5至FF从来没有出现。为了更好的可靠性，可以使用正则表达式来统计非法过长和替代值（可以查看W3 FAQ: Multilingual Forms 上的验证UTF-8字符串的正则表达式）。
與UCS-2的比較：ASCII轉换成UCS-2，在編碼前插入一個0x0。用這些編碼，會含括一些控制符，比如"或 '/'，這在UNIX和一些C函數中，將會產生嚴重錯誤。因此可以肯定，UCS-2不適合作為Unicode的外部編碼，也因此誕生了UTF-8。
target_text: In more detail, the UTF-8 code has the following several advantages: ASCII is a subset of UTF-8. A pure ASCII string is also a valid UTF-8 string, so the existing ASCII text does not need to be converted. Software designed for the traditional extended ASCII character set can be used with UTF-8 without modification or little modification. All other codes must be specified by display or text statements. Any string search method for the control section will result in the same sequence of UTF-8 based on the Unicode code point. (Although it can only be used by a limited number of UTF-8 characters, since it is unlikely that any particular language or culture will still have an acceptable sequence of text.) UTF-8 and UTF-16 are standard codes for the marking of language files.
title: UTF-8

source_text: 因为變種UTF-8并不是UTF-8，所以用户在交换信息和使用互联网的时候需要特别注意不要误把變種UTF-8當成UTF-8数据。Mac OS XMac OS X操作系统使用正式分解万国码（canonically decomposed Unicode），在文件系统中使用UTF-8编码进行文件命名，這做法通常被称为UTF-8-MAC。正式分解万国码中，预组合字符是被禁止使用的，必须以组合字符取代。
target_text: Since UTF-8 is not UTF-8, users need to pay particular attention when exchanging information and using the Internet not to mistook the UTF-8 as UTF-8 data. Mac OS XMac OS X operating system uses formal decompose Unicode to name files using UTF-8 codes in the file system, commonly known as UTF-8-MAC. The pre-combined characters are banned from use and must be replaced with group characters.
title: UTF-8

source_text: 對於任何一個網站來说，要想在網站推廣中取得成功，搜尋引擎最佳化都是至為關键的一项任務。同时，随着搜尋引擎不断變换它們的搜尋排名演算法规则，每次演算法上的改變都會讓一些排名很好的網站在一夜之間名落孫山，而失去排名的直接後果就是失去了網站固有的可觀訪問流量。所以每次搜尋引擎算演法的改變都會在網站之中引起不小的骚動和焦慮。可以说，搜尋引擎最佳化是一個愈來愈複雜的任務。
target_text: For any site to succeed in its promotion, the optimization of the search engine is a key task. At the same time, as search engines change their search ranking algorithm rules, every change in the algorithm will make some of the best-ranked sites fall overnight, and the immediate consequence of losing the ranking is the loss of the site’s inherent flow of access.
title: 搜尋引擎最佳化

source_text: 然而網站員們已經開發出對付Inktomi搜索引擎的連結操作工具和計劃。這些方法證明對Google 算法一樣管用。許多站集中於交換、買賣大量連結。隨著網站員尋求獲取連結只單單要影響Google送更多流量給該站，而不管對站點訪客是否有用，這種行為的增加，讓網頁級別對原始算法的信賴度漸漸被破壞了。
target_text: However, website users have developed tools and plans for connecting to the Inktomi search engine. These methods have proved to be equally useful for Google algorithms. Many stations are concentrated on swapping, buying and selling large numbers of links. As website users seek access to links only to affect Google's ability to send more traffic to the station, regardless of the usefulness of site visitors, this increase has led to a loss of web-level trust in the original algorithms.
title: 搜尋引擎最佳化

source_text: 此時，是Google 和其它查尋引擎對廣大範圍的站外因子仔細檢視的時候。開發更加聰明的算法有其他原因。網際網路已經擴大到擁有並無相關技術的廣大用戶。他們經常無法使用先進的提問技巧來取得資訊；而且他們得面對網際網路比起發展早期更龐大資料、更複雜的索引。搜尋引擎必須開發具備預測性、語義性、語言性和啟發性演算法。
target_text: There are other reasons for developing smarter algorithms. The Internet has expanded to a wide range of users with non-relevant technology. They often cannot use advanced questioning techniques to obtain information; and they have to deal with web-based indexes that are much bigger and more complex than they did in the early stages of development. Search engines must develop predictive, linguistic, linguistic and enlightening algorithms.
title: 搜尋引擎最佳化

source_text:
Google針對蓋版廣告進行演算法打擊
在2017年1月10日，Google正式加入新的演算法變化，將蓋版廣告(Pop-up, 又稱侵入性插頁式廣告)納入演算法因素之一。舉例來說，當網站使用了大篇幅的侵入性插頁式廣告，導致使用者在手機的使用者體驗非常不佳時，就會受到此演算法的影響，從而影響排名。
但 Google 也表示，並非所有的侵入性插頁式廣告都會遭到演算法的影響，只要合理的正當使用，就不會受到此演算法的懲罰。舉例來說，要求 Cookie 存取權限與年齡驗證的畫面就不會受到此演算法的影響。
Google 這次會針對侵入性插頁式廣告進行排名的打擊，主要是為了針對行動裝置的使用者體驗提升，促使採用大量侵入性插頁式廣告的網站從而調整廣告篇幅與方式，進而達到提升使用者體驗的目的。
target_text: For example, when a website uses a large number of intrusive page ads that cause users to experience very poorly on their mobile phones, Google also points out that not all intrusive page ads are subject to algorithmic changes, and that they are not punished for them as long as they are reasonably used. For example, cookies are required to have access to their rights and age proofs that would not be affected by the algorithms.
title: 搜尋引擎最佳化

source_text: 中国教育和科研计算机网（简称中国教育网或教育网，，缩写：CERNET）始建于1994年，是全球最大的学术互联网，也是中国大陸最大的学术计算机互联网络，也是中国骨干网运营商之一。中国教育网由中华人民共和国教育部投资管理、赛尔网络有限公司运作，清华大学等高校承担建设和运行。
target_text: China’s computer network for education and scientific research (the Chinese network for education or education, CERNET) was established in 1994 as the largest academic Internet in the world, the largest academic computer network in China’s mainland and one of China’s backbone network operators. China’s educational network is run by the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China, which is operated by Sal Network Ltd. Qinghua University and other high-level schools are responsible for its construction and operation.
title: 中国教育和科研计算机网

source_text: 1994年1月，国家计委和国家教委有关领导在国家教委召开会议，讨论建设“中国教育和科研计算机网”。1994年2月，清华大学成立“中国教育和科研计算机网”项目建议书起草小组。1994年3月底，清华大学、北京大学、上海交通大学、西安交通大学、华南理工大学、东南大学等六所高等学校通过国家教委向国家计委提交了“中国教育和科研计算机网CERNET项目建议书”。1994年7月初，“中国教育和科研计算机网CERNET”试验网开通，该网络连接北京、上海、广州、南京、西安等五座城市，并与互联网互联，成为中国第一个运行TCP/IP和X.25协议的全国性计算机互联网络。1994年8月，国家计委正式批复“中国教育和科研计算机网CERNET项目建议书”。随后，东北大学、华中科技大学、电子科技大学和北京邮电学院加入筹备。1994年9月，“中国教育和科研计算机网CERNET示范工程可行性研究报告”通过了由叶培大院士为首的专家委员会的论证。1994年11月26日－29日，亚太地区网络工作组在清华大学召开工作会议。经与亚太地区网络信息中心协商，确定了中国教育网的统一IP地址申请与管理模式。1995年1月，中国大陆第一个电子刊物《神州学人》在CERNET上出版1995年8月，中国大陆第一个BBS站点水木清华BBS在CERNET上开通1995年12月，建成中国第一个采用TCP/IP和DDN专线的全国互联网主干网1996年11月，建成中国第一条与欧洲互联网连接的国际线路1996年12月，建成中国大陆第一条与香港互联网连接的线路
target_text: At the end of March 1994, Qinghua University, Beijing University, Shanghai Transport University, Xianan Transport University, China Technology University, South East University, six higher schools submitted to the National Planning Commission, through the National Commission, a CERNET project proposal for China's computer network for education and research. In early July 1994, Qinghua University opened a pilot network for China's computer network for education and scientific research, connecting five cities to Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Nanjing and Xian, and connected to the Internet, China's first national computer interconnection network for the operation of the TCP/IP and X.25 Agreement. source_text: 自由电子气的费米面是一个球面；周期体系中的费米面则通常是扭曲面。费米面包围的体积决定了系统中的电子数，而费米面的拓扑结构则与金属的各种传导性质（如电导率）直接相关。对费米面的研究有时被称为“费米学”（Fermiology）。按电子运动维度可分为一维，二维和三维。二维电子气（two-dimensional electron gas， 2DEG）是指电子可以在二维方向自由移动，而在第三维上则受到限制的现象。在某些材料表面，电子密度很高，是一种平面电子集合，是一种二维液体。电子晶体（electride）：在离子性材料里存在周期性的空档，而电子正好落在这些空档里，充当了阴离子（anion）的角色。按照空档的维度来分类，有0维，1维和2维的电子晶体。这个维度指的是陷落电子势阱维度。电子晶体是一种双曲材料。一维和二维电子晶体材料从结构上就有严重的各向异性：电子在一个多两个方向不局域代表有很强的金属性，而在另外的方向金属性很弱，满足双曲材料最本质的要求。准三维电子晶体（quasi-three-dimensional electron crystal）：介于二维和三维之间的一种物质，将极纯净的半导体材料置入超低温环境下，并对其施加垂直和平行的强磁场中，半导体内的二维电子系统转变为准三维电子固体系统绝缘体。多级有序态（multipolar order）：晶体里的电子运动无序，在合适的情况下，晶体中的电荷会排列成重复的有序结构电荷有序态。电荷是一种标量，用数值或者量级可以描述这种物质形态。
target_text: The size of a free electronic gas is determined by the size of the system, which is directly related to the various conductive properties of the metal (e.g. electrical conductivity). The study of a free electronic gas is sometimes referred to as “Fermiology” (Fermiology). The two-dimensional electronic gas (two-dimensional egron gas, 2DG) is divided into two-dimensional dimensions. The two-dimensional electron gas (two-dimensional ges, 2DEG) is defined by the fact that the electron can move freely in two-dimensional directions, while the electron structure is restricted in a third-dimensional direction. In some material surfaces, the electron density is high and is a two-dimensional liquid. The electron crystalline (electride) in an ion material is a three-dimensional and an electron-distorted material (the electron-distorted) is used as a two-dimensional medium.

source_text: 在量子自旋冰和团簇莫特绝缘体中除了有分数化的磁单级子的激发之外，还涌现出满足量子电动力学层展U(1)规范场理论所描述的低能“光子”，其中的拓扑元激发包含衍生光子和自旋子。衍生光子的物理性质类似于量子电动力学中的光子，而自旋子则类似于电荷。。这样的物质形态不能用传统的以对称性自发破缺为基础的凝聚态相变理论来描述。中国研究团队，运用量子蒙特卡洛蠕虫算法，使用“天河1号”超级计算机和其他计算平台，发现了1/4 和3/4 玻色子占据的两种团簇莫特绝缘体，证实了1/4, 1/2和3/4 玻色子占据的团簇莫特绝缘体（其中1/2 玻色子占据的团簇莫特绝缘体就是量子自旋冰）是具有量子电动力学层展U(1) 规范场特性的奇异物质形态。量子自旋冰（Quantum spin ice）：是三维的量子自旋液体，其晶格由正四面体共点链接，形成烧绿石结构。每个四面体顶点都被局域磁矩很强的磁性稀土离子占据，而晶体场的影响迫使稀土离子磁矩表以伊辛自旋形式，自旋方向由平行于相邻两个四面体体心连线指向四面体体心或体外两个方向。由此，自旋冰中的阻挫就表现为每个四面体单元内局域能量最低的自旋排列方式是：两个自旋指向体心，两个自旋指向体外，即所谓“两进两出”自旋构型，类比于冰中氢氧之间的空间距离。因此这种自旋排列规则被称为“冰规则”，想象颇为丰富浪漫。

source_text: 在RFC诞生之时，互联网还不存在，只有4大研究中心的4台计算机连接成的原始网络：加州大学洛杉矶分校，斯坦福研究所，加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校，和盐湖城的犹他大学。最初的RFC作者使用打字机撰写文档，并在美国国防部国防前沿研究项目署（ARPA）研究成员之间传阅。1969年12月，他们开始通过ARPA网途径来发布新的RFC文档。第一份在1969年4月7日公开发表的RFC 1。当初克罗克为了避免打扰他的室友，是在浴室里完成这篇文档的。
target_text: At the time of the birth of the RFC, the Internet did not exist; only four computers from four major research centres were connected to the original network: University of California, Los Angeles, Stanford Institute, University of California, Santa Barbara, and Utah University in Salt Lake City. The original RFC authors used typewriters to write files and circulated them among research members of the Defense Front Research Program (ARPA) of the United States Department of Defense. In December 1969, they started publishing new RFC files through the ARPA network.

source_text:
由于最常有的字符都在基本多文种平面中，许多软件处理代理对的部分往往得不到充分的测试。这导致了一些长期的bug与潜在安全漏洞，它们甚至存在于广为流行且评价颇高的应用软件中。从U+D800到U+DFFF的码位
Unicode标准规定U+D800...U+DFFF的值不对应于任何字符。但是在使用UCS-2的时代，U+D800...U+DFFF内的值被占用，用于某些字符的映射。但只要不构成代理对，许多UTF-16编码解码还是能把这些不符合Unicode标准的字符映射正确的辨识、转换成合规的码元。按照Unicode标准，这种码元序列本来应算作编码错误。
target_text: Since the most common characters are in the basic multilingual plane, many software processing agents are often not adequately tested. This has led to some long-term bugs and potential security gaps, even in widely popular and highly evaluated applications. The Unicode standard from U+D800 to U+DFFF specifies that U+D800...U+DFFF values should not correspond to any character. But in the era of using UCS-2, values in U+D800...U+DFFF were taken and used for the mapping of certain characters. But many UTF-16 code decodings, as long as they do not constitute proxy pairs, can correctly identify and convert these character maps that do not meet the Unicode standard.
title: UTF-16

source_text: 約翰·波普作出的第一项重大贡献是在1953年提出的对π电子体系的分子轨道近似理论，由于理论化学家Rudolph Pariser和罗伯特·帕尔在同年亦提出了等价于波普理论的类似方法，因而这种近似方法现在又被称为PPP方法。1965年波普又提出了完全忽略异核双电子积分的CNDO方法以及部分忽略异核双电子积分的INDO方法，CNDO和INDO是至今仍有广泛应用的近似计算三维分子中分子结构性质的半经验量子化学计算方法。此外，波普还对计算化学理论的发展作出了许多重大的贡献。约翰·波普对量子化学从头计算方法作出了改进，他引入了斯莱特型函数和高斯型函数组成的基组来模拟波函数，这大大降低了从头计算的计算成本，而如今迅猛发展的计算机技术更是凸现了波普所引入的新方法在计算中的优势。约翰·波普最为人们所了解的贡献，便是他将计算化学理论方法工具化，开发出了现今应用最广泛的量子化学计算程序包GAUSSIAN，但是令人遗憾的是，1991年之后，波普不仅被排除出GAUSSIAN软件的开发团队，甚至被公司禁止使用这一软件。
target_text: The first major contribution was made by John Pop, who in 1953 proposed an approximation of the molecular orbit of the internucleic system, which is now known as the PPP method because theoretical chemists Rudolph Pariser and Robert Parr have proposed similar methods of calculating the molecular structure of three-dimensional molecules in the same year. In addition, Pope has made a number of significant contributions to the development of the chemical theory. John Popper’s contribution to the first-hand calculation of quantum chemistry, which he introduced as a base group of Slate and Gausssian functions to simulate the wave function, has significantly reduced the computing costs of the transnuclear dual-electronic component, while the rapid growth of computer technology has now highlighted the advantages of the new methodology introduced in the calculation.
title: 約翰·波普 (化學家)

source_text: 许多算术编码所用的不同方法受美国专利的保护。其中一些专利对于实现一些国际标准中定义的算术编码算法是很关键的。在这种情况下，这些专利通常按照一种合理和非歧视（RAND）授权协议使用（至少是作为标准委员会的一种策略）。在一些著名的案例中（包括一些涉及IBM的专利）这些授权是免费的，而在另外一些案例中，则收取一定的授权费用。RAND条款的授权协议不一定能够满足所有打算使用这项技术的用户，因为对于一个打算生产拥有所有权软件的公司来说这项费用是“合理的”，而对于自由软件和开源软件项目来说它是不合理的。
target_text: Many of the different methods used for arithmetic coding are protected by American patents. Some of these patents are critical to achieving the arithmetic coding algorithms defined in some international standards. In this case, these patents are usually used under a reasonable and non-discriminatory RAND authorization agreement (at least as a strategy of the Standards Commission). These authorizations are free in some well-known cases (including some IBM-related patents), while in others they charge a certain authorization fee. RAND terms of authorization do not necessarily satisfy all users who intend to use the technology, since they are “reasonable” for a company that intends to produce proprietary software and are not reasonable for free and open source software projects.
title: 算术编码

source_text:
弹出广告的种类
一种弹窗形式被稱為“鼠标陷阱”（mousetrapping），它使用一个网页或广告遮住整个屏幕，没有任何菜单或按钮可以让用户关闭这个窗口。这个问题主要影响IE浏览器的用户。解决该问题的一个方法是使用Ctrl、Alt、Del或者Ctrl、Shift、Esc（Windows2000以及以上系统）调出任务管理器来结束进程，但这也会将与弹窗无关的窗口关闭。更好的方法是使用Alt、F4组合键关闭当前窗口，因为弹出的窗口总是在最前端。除了网页浏览器会弹出广告，一些间谍软件和广告软件也会弹出广告窗口。
target_text: One way to solve this problem is to use Ctrl, Alt, Del, or Ctrl, Shift, Esc (Windows 2000 and above) to end the process, but this will also close the window that has nothing to do with the window. The better way to close the current window is to use the Alt, F4 combo key, because the popup window is always at the front end. In addition to advertising, some spy and advertising software will pop the window.
title: 弹出式广告

source_text: 有一种广告通过部分版本的Windows操作系统内置的来传播。这类广告出现时就像系统的对话框，上面出现的文字往往把人们引导到一个网站。在Windows XP SP2中，信使服务默认是关闭的，因此不会受到滋扰，Windows Vista等更新的操作系统则没有信使服务，所以也不会受到滋扰。随着这些操作系统的流行，这种广告正变得稀少起来，正像当初它们泛滥时那样。
target_text: In Windows XP SP2, the messenger service is by default closed, so it is not disturbed, and updated operating systems such as Windows Vista have no courier services and are therefore not disturbed. As these operating systems become popular, the ads are becoming scarce, as they were when they proliferated.

屏蔽弹出广告的软件
Opera是第一款开发出屏蔽弹窗工具的主流浏览器，Mozilla浏览器也通过改进出现类似的功能，但仅能屏蔽载入页面时弹出的子页面。早在2000年，除了IE的其他所有主流浏览器都几乎完全允许用户屏蔽他们不想看到的弹窗。2004年，微软发布了Windows XP SP2补丁，为IE添加了弹窗阻止功能。然而，很多用户没有意识到这项功能，或者干脆不用它。另外有许多用户不会使用这项功能，就像他们不安装SP2补丁而使用老版本的操作系统。现在许多浏览器都附加弹出窗口阻止工具，第三方工具都倾向于包含比如广告过滤这样的功能，但过滤广告会面临法律诉讼，甚至败诉的可能性。

source_text:
困难
开发软件时，国际化和本地化对开发者是一个有挑战性的任务，特别是当软件当初设计时没有考虑这个问题时。通常作法是将文本和其他环境相关的资源与程序代码相分离。这样在理想的情况下，应对变化的环境时无需修改代码，只要修改资源，从而显著简化了工作。
target_text: Internationalization and localization is a challenging task for developers when software is developed, especially when the software was originally designed without consideration of the issue. The usual approach is to separate text and other environment-related resources from the program code. In this case, ideally, there is no need to change the code when dealing with a changing environment, as long as resources are modified, thus significantly simplifying the work.
title: 国际化与本地化

source_text: 开发团队需要人了解其他语言和文化；而这样的人才，可能难以寻觅。而且资源的复制也可能成为维护恶梦。例如，如果某个语言中显示给用户的信息变化了，其他的翻译版本都要随之变化。Gettext之类软件库有助于解决这一问题。自由软件自由地修改和再分发，因此比较容易国际化，例如KDE拥有70个语言版本。然而大多数专有软件只提供商业上有利可图的语言版本。
target_text: Development teams need people to understand other languages and cultures; this kind of talent can be difficult to find. And replication of resources can also be a nightmare. For example, if information to users changes in one language, other translations change. The Gettext software library helps to solve this problem. Free software is freely modified and redistributed, making it easier to internationalize, for example, KDE has 70 language versions. Most proprietary software, however, provides commercially profitable language versions.
title: 国际化与本地化

source_text: 当然很多自由软件由于程序结构设计的原因几乎难以国际化，比如HandBrake。区域设置（locale）计算机中一套定义用户的语言、国家和用于定义用户希望在其用户界面上看到的各种可以改变的选择的参数集合。通常一个 locale 标识符至少包括一个语言标识符和一个区域标识符。
target_text: Of course, many free software can hardly be internationalized because of the program ' s structure design, such as HandBlake. The regional settings (locale) computer contains a set of parameters that define the user ' s language, the country, and the variable options that users want to see on their user interface. A locale identifier usually includes at least one language identifier and one regional identifier.
title: 国际化与本地化

source_text: LDAP目录与普通数据库的主要不同之处在于数据的组织方式，它是一种有层次的、树形结构。所有条目的属性的定义是对象类object class的组成部分，并组成在一起构成schema；那些在组织内代表个人的schema被命名为white pages schema。数据库内的每个条目都与若干对象类联系，而这些对象类决定了一个属性是否为可选和它保存哪些类型的信息。属性的名字一般是一个易于记忆的字符串，例如用cn为通用名（common name）命名，而"mail"代表e-mail地址。属性取值依赖于其类型，并且LDAPv3中一般非二进制值都遵从UTF-8字符串语法。例如，mail属性包含值“user@example.com”；jpegPhotos属性一般包含JPEG/JFIF格式的图片。
target_text: The main difference between the LDAP directory and the general database is the way the data are organized. It is a hierarchical, tree-shaped structure. The properties of all entries are defined as components of the object classobject class, which is made up of Schema; those Schema representing individuals in the organization are named White Pages schema. Each entry in the database is linked to a number of object classes, which determine whether an attribute is optional and the type of information it keeps. The property name is generally a memory-friendly string, for example, named by cn for the common name, while "mail" represents e-mail addresses. The attribute extraction values are dependent on their type, and the generic non-double value in LDAPv3 follows the UTF-8 syntax. For example, the mail properties contain the value "user@example.com”; the properties of jpegPhotos generally contain pictures in JPEG/JFIF formats.
title: 轻型目录访问协议

source_text: 直接制版机（英文：computer-to-plate，缩写）是由计算机直接制版的设备。直接制版机是在计算机排版发展到一定阶段的产物。在计算机直接出软片之后水到渠成而出现的一项新工艺。直接制版机是将计算机拼组好的页面按照印刷机的型号、折页的要求拼组成大版，通过RIP后直接在印版上成像的设备。由于它免除了软片、显影等传统印刷的工序，很快在印刷界得到普及。
target_text: A direct copy maker (English: computer-to-late, abbreviation) is a computer-made device. A direct copy maker is a product of a certain stage of computer layout development. A new process that emerges after a computer has gone straight out of a film, is a new process. A direct copy maker is a large version of a computer-combined page that is formulated in accordance with the type of printing machine, the folding page, and then directly imaged on the print version through RIP. As it dispenses with traditional printing processes such as film, graphics, etc., it is soon widely available in the print world.
title: 直接制版机

软PLC控制技术也称Soft logic和基于PC的控制技术。软PLC采用，具有良好的网络通讯能力，能够完成比较复杂的控制任务，可以满足和实现当前和今后工业自动化领域控制系统开放性和柔性的要求。组成
软PLC系统由上位机和下位机两部分组成。上位机为一个软件系统，它的主要作用是提供友好的编辑界面和多种编程语言环境，便于使用者在PC机上进行PLC程序的编辑。同时它还能够对下位机的一些状态量进行监控并给下位机发送指令。
target_text: Soft logic and PC-based controls are also known as soft PLC control technologies. Soft PLC uses a good network communication capability that allows users to perform more complex control tasks that meet the requirements of openness and flexibility of control systems in the current and future areas of industrial automation. Soft PLC systems are made up of top and bottom units. The upper machine is a software system whose primary role is to provide a friendly editing interface and multiple programming language environments that allow users to edit PLC programs on PC machines. It also allows it to monitor some of the positions of the lower machines and give instructions to the lower ones.
title: 软PLC控制技术

𝑝进动力系统理论
算术动力系统是二十世纪九十年代提出的数学理论，整合了动力系统及数论。传统的离散动力系统会探讨迭代函数在复平面或是实数中的性质。算术动力系统则探讨多项式或解析函数在整数、有理数、进数及几何点中的迭代特性。进数动力系统在计算机科学领域中的直线式程序（straight-line programs）问题、数值分析与模拟中的伪随机数问题、密码学中的流加密问题上都有重要作用。在计算机科学和自动机理论中，进遍历理论可以帮助快速制造大拉丁方。後者在实验设计、软件测试和通信理论中都有良多应用。
target_text: Arithmetic power systems are mathematical theories introduced in the 1990s, integrating power systems and numerical theories. Traditional discrete power systems explore the nature of antecedent functions in the level or in the real number. Arithmetic power systems explore the iterative properties of multiple types or resolution functions in in integer, numeric, factoring and geometry. The questions of straight line-line processes in computer science, numerical analysis and simulation, and flow encryption in cryptography all play an important role. In computer science and self-motivation theory, penetration theory can help to rapidly create big Latins.

Poison-resistant software typically contains immediate program surveillance identification, malign program scans and clean-up and auto-up virus databases, as well as anti-drug software plus damage recovery, and is an important component of a computer-protected system (including anti-virus software, firewalls, protection and removal procedures for Trojan carp and other malware, intrusion into anti-security systems, etc.

source_text:
另外，防毒軟體更涉及更多掃描技術：
掃描壓縮檔技術：即是對壓縮檔案和封裝文件作分析檢查的技術。
程序竄改防護：即是避免惡意程式藉由刪除防毒偵測程序而大肆破壞電腦。
修復技術：即是對惡意程式所損壞的檔案進行還原
急救盘杀毒：利用空白U盘制作急救启动盘，来检测电脑病毒。
智能扫描：扫描最常用的磁盘，系统关键位置，耗时较短。
全盘扫描：扫描电脑全部磁盘，耗时较长。
勒索软件防护：保护电脑中的文件不被黑客恶意加密。
开机扫描：当电脑开机时自动进行扫描，可以扫描压缩文档和可能不需要的程序。
target_text: Resort: Retract the damaged files of the malware: use a blank flash drive to make a first-aid starter to detect a computer virus. Smart scan: scan the most commonly used disks, system key positions, and shorter periods of time.
title: 杀毒软件

source_text: 杀毒软件就是一个信息分析的系统，它监控所有的数据流动（包括：内存－硬盘网络－内存网络－硬盘），当它发现某些信息被感染后，就会清除其中的病毒。信息的分析（或扫描）方式取决于其来源，杀毒软件在监控光驱、电子邮件或局域网间数据移动时工作方式是不同的。
target_text: Poisonous software is a system of information analysis, which monitors all data flows (including: memory-hard disk network, memory network, hard disk) and removes the virus when it discovers that some information has been infected. The way in which information is analysed (or scanned) depends on its source, and the way in which it works when monitoring optical drive, e-mail or LAN data movements.
title: 杀毒软件

source_text:
杀毒软件的监控位置：
内存监控：当发现内存中存在病毒的时候，就会主动报警；监控所有进程；监控读取到内存中的文件；监控读取到内存的网络数据。
檔案监控：当发现写到磁盘上的文件中存在病毒，或者是被病毒感染，就会主动报警。
邮件监控：当发现电子邮件的附件存在病毒时进行拦截。
网页防护：阻止网络攻击和不安全下载。
行为防护：提醒用户可疑的应用程序行为。
target_text: (a) Memory surveillance: when a virus is found in the memory, it alerts the police; controls all processes; monitors access to the files in the memory; monitors access to the data in the memory of the network. File surveillance: when a file on the disk is found to contain a virus or infected with the virus, it alerts the police. Mail surveillance: when an attachment to an e-mail is found to contain a virus.
title: 杀毒软件

source_text:
基本功能
防范病毒：指根据系统特性，采取相应的系统安全措施预防病毒侵入计算机。
查找病毒：指对于确定的环境，能够准确地报出病毒名称，该环境包括，内存、文件、引导区（含主导区）、网络等。
清除病毒：指根据不同类型病毒对感染对象的修改，并按照病毒的感染特性所进行的恢复。该恢复过程不能破坏未被病毒修改的内容。感染对象包括：内存、引导区（含主引导区）、可执行文件、文档文件、网络等。
target_text: (a) Prevention of the virus: In accordance with the characteristics of the system, a system-based security measure is taken to prevent the virus from entering a computer. The search for the virus: for a defined environment, the name of the virus can be accurately stated, including memory, file, guide area (including the dominant area), network, etc. The elimination of the virus: the modification of the object of the infection according to the different types of virus and its recovery in accordance with the infectious properties of the virus. The recovery process must not undermine the contents that have not been modified by the virus. The object of the infection is: memory, the guiding area (including the main guide area), executable documents, document files, networks, etc.
title: 杀毒软件

source_text:
特征码扫描
机制：将扫描信息与病毒数据库（即所谓的“病毒特征库”）进行对照，如果信息与其中的任何一个病毒特征符合，杀毒软件就会判断此文件被病毒感染。杀毒软件在进行查杀的时候，会挑选文件内部的一段或者几段代码来作为他识别病毒的方式，这种代码就叫做病毒的特征码；在病毒样本中，抽取特征代码；抽取的代码比较特殊，不大可能与普通正常程序代码吻合；抽取的代码要有适当长度，一方面维持特征代码的唯一性，另一方面保证病毒扫描时候不要有太大的空间与时间的开销。
特征码类别：1.文件特征码：对付病毒在文件中的存在方式：单一文件特征码、复合文件特征码（通过多处特征进行判断）；2.内存特征码：对付病毒在内存中的存在方式：单一内存特征码、复合内存特征码
优点：速度快，配备高性能的扫描引擎；准确率相对比较高，误杀操作相对较少；很少需要用户参与。
缺点：采用病毒特征代码法的检测工具，面对不断出现的新病毒，必须不断更新病毒库的版本，否则检测工具便会老化，逐渐失去实用价值；病毒特征代码法对从未见过的新病毒，无法知道其特征代码，因而无法去检测新病毒；病毒特征码如果没有经过充分的检验，可能会出现误报，数据误删，系统破坏，给用户带来麻烦。
target_text: Characteristic code scanning Mechanisms: Scanning information against a virus database (the so-called “virus identity library”) which, if the information matches any of the virus features, will determine that the file is infected by the virus. In the course of the killing, the drug-killing software selects one or more parts of the code inside the file as the way he identifies the virus, which is called the virus's characterization code; In the case of a virus sample, extracting the characterization code; extracting the code is special and is unlikely to match the normal normal application code; extracting the code is required to maintain the uniqueness of the characteristic code, on the one hand, while maintaining the uniqueness of the characterization code, on the other hand, ensuring that there is not much space and time to be spent on the virus scan.
title: 杀毒软件

source_text:
主动防御技术
主动防御并不需要病毒特征码支持，只要杀毒软件能分析并扫描到目标程序的行为，并根据预先设定的规则，判定是否应该进行清除操作
主动防御本来想领先于病毒，让杀毒软件自己变成安全工程师来分析病毒，从而达到以不变应万变的境界。但是，计算机的智能总是在一系列的规则下诞生，而普通用户的技术水平达不到专业分析病毒的水平，两者之间的博弈将主动防御推上一个尴尬境地。
target_text: Active defense technology does not require viral signature code support, as long as the anti-torture software analyses and scans the behaviour of the target program and determines whether, according to predefined rules, it should be removed, the active defence would have preferred to lead the virus and turn the anti-torture software itself into a security engineer to analyse the virus, thus reaching a level of immutable response. But computer intelligence is always born under a series of rules, and the technology of ordinary users is not at the level of professional analysis of the virus, and the game between the two would be an embarrassment.
title: 杀毒软件

source_text:
机器学习识别技术
机器学习识别技术既可以做静态样本的二进制分析，又可以运用在沙箱动态行为分析当中，是为内容/行为+算法模式。伴随着深度学习的急速发展，各家厂商也开始尝试运用深度学习技术来识别病毒特征，如瀚思科技的基于深度学习的二进制恶意样本检测
target_text: Machine learning recognition techniques can be used both for binary analysis of static samples and in sandbox dynamic behavior analysis for content/behaviour plus algorithm models. With the rapid development of deep learning, manufacturers have also begun to try to identify virus characteristics using deep learning techniques, such as the deep-learning-based binary malignant sample testing of the Think Technology.
title: 杀毒软件

source_text: Kademlia是一种通过分散式雜湊表实现的协议算法，它是由Petar Maymounkov与David Mazières为非集中式P2P计算机网络而设计的。Kademlia规定了网络的结构，也规定了通过节点查询进行信息交换的方式。参与通讯的所有节点形成一张虚拟网（或者叫做覆盖网）。这些节点通过一组数字（或称为节点ID）来进行身份标识。节点ID不仅可以用来做身份标识，还可以用来进行值定位（值通常是文件的散列或者关键词）。其实，节点ID与文件散列直接对应，它所表示的那个节点存储着哪儿能够获取文件和资源的相关信息。当我们在网络中搜索某些值（即通常搜索存储文件散列或关键词的节点）的时候，Kademlia算法需要知道与这些值相关的键，然后分步在网络中开始搜索。每一步都会找到一些节点，这些节点的ID与键更为接近，如果有节点直接返回搜索的值或者再也无法找到与键更为接近的节点ID的时候搜索便会停止。这种搜索值的方法是非常高效的：与其他的分散式雜湊表的实现类似，在一个包含n个节点的系统的值的搜索中，Kademlia仅访问O(log(n))个节点。非集中式网络结构还有更大的优势，那就是它能够显著增强抵御拒绝服务攻击的能力。即使网络中的一整批节点遭受泛洪攻击，也不会对网络的可用性造成很大的影响，通过绕过这些漏洞（被攻击的节点）来重新编织一张网络，网络的可用性就可以得到恢复。
target_text: Kademlia is a protocol algorithm that is achieved through a decentralized synthesizing table. Node IDs can be used not only for identification, but also for value positioning (which is usually the hash or the keyword of the document). In fact, node IDs correspond directly to the bulk of the document, where information about files and resources is stored. When we search for certain values in the network (that is, usually the dots or the keywords of the document) form a virtual network (or the dots). These nodes need to be marked through a set of numbers (or node IDs). Node IDs can be used not only to mark the values, but can also be used to identify value locations (which are usually the hashs of the document or the keywords of the document).
title: Kademlia

source_text: 尽管异或标准对于理解Kademlia并不是必要，但是对于协议的分析却至关重要。异或运算形成了允许闭合分析的循环群，为了能够预见网络的行为和正确性，其他的一些分散式雜湊表协议和算法都要求模拟或复杂的形式分析，而Kademlia并不需要，另外，把位组作为路由信息也简化了Kademlia算法。
target_text: While variations or criteria are not necessary to understand Kademlia, they are essential to the analysis of protocols. Differentials or algorithms create cycles that allow closed analysis. In order to be able to predict the behaviour and correctness of the network, some of the other decentralized miscellaneous table protocols and algorithms require simulations or complex forms of analysis, which Kademlia does not need, and the use of location groups as route information has simplified Kademlia algorithms.
title: Kademlia

source_text:
迄今為止，發綠光的有机发光二極體是最有效的器件。Tang曾報導，用香豆素摻雜Alq的器件具有5~6lｍ／Ｗ的效率。據文獻報導，效率最大的發綠光的有机发光半导体是由Sano制成的，用Bebq作為HTM，其效率為15lｍ／Ｗ。與發綠光的OLED比較，對發紅光和藍光的OLED的研究工作少得多。
目前已知的，效率最好的發藍光的OLED是由Idemitsu的Hosokawa等人研制的，其發光效率為5.0lｍ／Ｗ，對應的表面量子效率為2.4%。據Tang等人報導，將DCM染料攙入Alq制成了發紅光的OLED器件，其發光效率為2.5lｍ／Ｗ。
需要說明的是，上述文獻所報導的發光效率，都是在發光強度約為100cd/m2或更小的條件下測得的。而實際應用的有机发光半导体是由多路驅動的，最大的發光強度要高一些。因此，顯示象素會被驅動到很高的發光強度，導致發光效率下降。也就是說，隨著發光亮度增加，發光效率將因驅動電壓的增加而降低。發綠光的有机发光半导体，在發光亮度為10,000cd／m2時，其發光效率降為2lm/W，只有低亮度下的30%。發紅光和藍光的有机发光半导体，其發光效率隨著發光亮度的增加降低得更多。因此，有机发光半导体技術可能更適用于不需要有源矩陣驅動的小尺寸、低顯示容量的顯示器件。
target_text: The most efficient organic light semiconductor of green light is reported to have been produced by Sano, using Bebq as HTM, with 15 mlm/W. Compared to green light, research on red and blue light of OED is much less efficient. The most efficient light of OED is developed by Hosokawa et al. of Idemitsu with 5-6llm/W. As reported, the most efficient organic light semiconductor of green light is produced by Sano, using Bebq as HTM with 15lm/W. As compared to green light of OEDs, it may be much less research on red and blue light of OEDs. What is known is that the most efficient of blue light is produced by Hosokawa et al.
title: 有機發光二極體

source_text:
器件的壽命和衰變
在過去的几年中，對有机发光半导体器件的壽命有過一些報導。但由于每個實驗室測量器件壽命的方法不同，無法對這些數據進行有意義的比較。在報導中，應用最多的測量器件壽命的方法，是在器件維持一恆定電流的條件下，測量從初始亮度下降至一半亮度的時間。據柯達公司的VanSlyke報導，亮度在2000cd/ｍ2時，器件的工作壽命達到了1000小時。Sano也報導了，在TPD中摻雜紅熒烯得到的器件，其初始亮度為500cd/m2、半亮度壽命為3000小時。對壽命進行比較的最佳量值是亮度和半亮度壽命的乘積。據報導，該量值對使用壽命最長的器件是：綠光為7,000,000cd/m2-hr；藍光為300,000cd/m2-hr；紅─橙色為1,600,000cd/m2-hr。一個雙倍密封的有机发光半导体器件的儲存壽命約為５年。
target_text: The life of the device and its deterioration have been reported in the past few years. Because of the difference in the way each laboratory measures the life of the device are measured, it is not possible to make a meaningful comparison of these data. In the report, the most suitable measure of life is the time when the measure has dropped from the initial brightness to half the brightness of the device under the condition that it maintains a constant electrical current. Van Slyke of Corda reports that the brightness of the device reached 1,000 hours at 2000cd/m2. Sano also reports that the initial light of the device obtained in TPD is 500cd/m2 and the half light is 3,000 hours. The best measure of life comparison is the amount of brightness and half brightness life. Van Slyke reports that the brightness of the device reached 1,000 hours at 2000cd/m2.
title: 有機發光二極體

source_text:
特色與關鍵技術
過去的市場上有机发光半导体一直沒辦法普及，主要的問題在於早先技術發展的有机发光半导体樣品大多是單色居多，即使採用多色的設計，其發色材料和生產技術往往還是限制了有机发光半导体的發色數。實際上有机发光半导体的影像產生方法和CRT顯示一樣，皆是藉由三色RGB畫素拼成一個彩色畫素；因為有机发光半导体的材料對電流接近線性反應，所以能夠在不同的驅動電流下顯示不同的色彩與灰階。
OLED核心可以做得很薄，厚度爲目前液晶的1/3，加上有机发光半导体爲全固態組件，抗震性好，能適應惡劣環境。
OLED主要是自體發光的，讓其幾乎沒有視角問題；與LCD技術相比，即使在大的角度觀看，顯示畫面依然清晰可見。OLED的元件為自發光且是依靠電壓來調整，反應速度要比液晶元件來得快許多，比較適合當作高畫質電視使用。2007年底SONY推出的11吋O有机发光半导体電視XEL-1，反應速度就比LCD快了1000倍。
OLED對低溫的適應能力强。舊有的液晶技術在零下75度時，即會破裂故障，有机发光半导体只要電路未受損仍能正常顯示。
OLED的效率高，耗能較液晶略低還可以在不同材質的基板上製造，甚至能成製作成可彎曲的顯示器，應用範圍日漸增廣。
target_text: The main problem is that organic light semiconductor samples from the past market have mostly been monochrome, which, even with multi-colour designs, often limit the coloring of organic light semiconductors. The image generation of organic light semiconductors, as well as CRT displays, have been assembled by three-colour RGB drawings into a colour painting; since the organic light semiconductor is close to the linear reaction to the electrical flow, it can display different colours and greyscales under different driving currents. The OLED core can be very thin, as thick as one third of the current liquid crystal, plus organic light semiconductors, as long as they are resistant to shock, they can be adapted to poor conditions.
title: 有機發光二極體

source_text:
應用
OLED可應用於製造平價可彎曲顯示器、照明設備、發光衣或裝飾牆壁。2004年開始，有機發光二極體已廣泛應用於隨身MP3播放器。显示领域有机发光半导体技術的主要優點是主動發光。現在，發紅、綠、藍光的有机发光半导体都可以得到。研究者們一直致力于開發有机发光半导体在從背光、低容量顯示器到高容量顯示器領域的應用。
target_text: The application of OLED can be used to create low-cost, curable displays, lighting, luminous clothes, or decorative walls. Starting in 2004, organic light diodes have been widely applied to the walk-through MP3 player. The main advantage of organic light semiconductor technology in the field of displaying organic light is primary light. Now, organic light semiconductors with red, green, blue light are available. Researchers have been working on the application of organic luminous semiconductors from backlight, low-capacity monitors to high-capacity monitors.
title: 有機發光二極體

source_text:
有机发光半导体在1999年首度商業化，技術仍然非常新。現在用在一些黑白／簡單色彩的汽車收音機、行動電話、掌上型電動遊樂器等。都屬於高階機種。

source_text: 软件工程师通常从目标系统开发者那里获得软件开发包。为了鼓励开发者使用其系统或者语言，许多SDK是免费提供的。SDK经常可以直接从互联网下载。有时也被作为营销手段。例如：甲产品或许会免费提供构件SDK以鼓励人们使用它，从而会吸引更多人由于能免费为其编程而购买其构件。

source_text:
服务器软件
Web 2.0的功能是在已有的Web服务器架构上建立的，但是更加强调后台软件。数据联合不仅仅是名称上和内容管理發布方法不同，而且Web服务要求更加强壮的数据库和工作流的支持，并且变得与传统的企业内部网的应用服务器功能更加相似。供应商不管是用一个通用服务器方法，可以把所有需要的功能都集中到一个服务器平台上，或者是一个Web服务器插件的方法，可以使用增强了API接口的标准发布工具和其他工具。不管选择的是哪种途径，Web 2.0的进化不会为这些选择做出重大改變。
target_text: The server software Web 2.0 functionality is built on the existing Web server architecture, but more emphasis is placed on back-office software. Data integration is not just a different way of publishing names and content management, and Web services require more robust database and workflow support and become more similar to the application server functions of the traditional enterprise Intranet. A supplier, whether using a universal server method, can concentrate all required features on a server platform or a Web server plugin, using standard publishing and other tools that enhance the API interface. Whatever route is chosen, the evolution of Web 2.0 will not make a major difference to these choices.
title: Web 2.0

source_text: 更简单的发布流程和更随意（被限制的話題、領域）的写作方式，使得参与到网络内容贡献中的门槛降低，更大程度的推动了网络内容建设和个体信息贡献。基于位置信息的服务（LBS）集地理信息系统（GIS）、微博（Twitter）和移动设备（Mobile）以及A-GPS定位服务于一身的增强型微博系统，其主导思想是每一条信息不仅利用时间为索引、同时也加入了地理经纬度的索引，从而不仅可通过时间对信息进行筛选、亦可利用地理坐标对信息进行合理的筛选。即时通讯（IM）即时通讯软件可以说是目前中国上网用户使用率最高的软件。聊天一直是网民们上网的主要活动之一，网上聊天的主要工具已经从初期的聊天室、论坛变为以MSN、QQ为主要代表的即时通讯软件。

The instant communication software (IM) can be said to be one of the most commonly used software in China. Chat has been one of the main online activities.

target_text: Malaysia’s identity card (Macaca) contains very few textual data, because all the data have been recorded in a chip on the identity card. The chip can only get very basic data if read by a government-authorized machine used in an ordinary store, and other important data require special machines in government departments to read it, protect privacy, and protect them from theft.
title: 身分證

source_text: 2004年3月29日起中国大陆正式开始为居民换發内藏非接触式IC卡智能芯片的第二代居民身份证，公安部表示，居民身份证更新换代工作将在2008年前全部完成。第二代身分证较第一代身分证做了很多改进。第二代身分证表面采用防伪膜和印刷防伪技术，使用个人彩色照片，而且内置了数字芯片，采用了数字防伪措施，存有个人图像和信息，可以用机器读取。还采用了更大字库，目的在于解决人名地名中的冷僻字问题。《中华人民共和国居民身份证法》第一章总则第五条规定：十六周岁以上公民的居民身份证的有效期为十年、二十年、长期。十六周岁至二十五周岁的，发给有效期十年的居民身份证；二十六周岁至四十五周岁的，发给有效期二十年的居民身份证；四十六周岁以上的，发给长期有效的居民身份证。
target_text: The Ministry of Public Security has indicated that the renewal of the identity card will be completed by 2008. The second-generation identity card is a much improved version of the first-generation identity card. The second-generation identity card covers the use of anti-false film and printing techniques, the use of personal colour photographs, and the inclusion of digital chips, the use of digital anti-false measures, the possession of personal images and information, and the use of machine-readable devices. A larger print bank is also used to solve the problem of remote characters in personal names. Article 5 of chapter I of the Law of the People ' s Republic of China on Identity Cards provides that: the identity card of a citizen over the age of 16 years shall be valid for 10 years, 20 years, long-term, and valid for 10 years; the identity card of a resident between the age of 26 and 45 years, valid for 20 years; and the identity card of a resident over the age of 46 years, valid for a long-term period.

source_text:
驱动程序类型
JDBC驱动程序共分四种类型：类型1：JDBC-ODBC桥
这种类型的驱动把所有JDBC的调用传递给ODBC，再让后者调用数据库本地驱动代码（也就是数据库厂商提供的数据库操作二进制代码库，例如Oracle中的oci.dll）。优点：
只要有对应的ODBC驱动（大部分数据库厂商都会提供），几乎可以访问所有的数据库。
缺点：
执行效率比较低，不适合大数据量存取的应用；
由于需要客户端预装对应的ODBC驱动，不适合Internet/Intranet应用。
target_text: The driver type JDBC driver is divided into four types: Type 1: JDBC-ODBC Bridge, the type of driver that transmits all JDBC calls to ODSC, which then calls the database ' s local driver code (i.e. the database operator provides the database operation binary code library, such as Oci.dll in Oracle). Advantage: Almost all databases can be accessed as long as there is a corresponding ODBC driver (which is available from most database manufacturers).
title: Java数据库连接

source_text:
类型2：本地API驱动
这种类型的驱动通过客户端加载数据库厂商提供的本地代码库（C／C++等）来访问数据库，而在驱动程序中则包含了Java代码。优点：
速度快于第一类驱动（但仍比不上第3、第4类驱动）。
缺点
由于需要客户端预装对应的数据库厂商代码库，仍不适合Internet/Intranet应用。
target_text: Type 2: Local API driver The type of driver is to access the database through the local code library (C/C++, etc.) provided by the client loader of the database manufacturer, while the driver contains Java code. Advantages: faster than Category 1 driver (but still less than Category 3, 4 driver). Disadvantages due to the need for the client to pre-load the corresponding database vendor code library, are still not suitable for Internet/Intranet applications.
title: Java数据库连接

source_text:
类型3：网络协议驱动
这种类型的驱动给客户端提供了一个网络API，客户端上的JDBC驱动程序使用套接字（Socket）来调用服务器上的中间件程序，后者在将其请求转化为所需的具体API调用。优点：
不需要在客户端加载数据库厂商提供的代码库，单个驱动程序可以对多个数据库进行访问，可扩展性较好。
缺点：
在中间件层仍需对最终数据进行配置；
由于多出一个中间件层，速度不如第四类驱动程序。
target_text: Type 3: Network protocol driver This type of driver provides the client with a network API, and the client ' s JDBC driver uses the Socket to call the middleware program on the server, which translates its request into the specific API call required. Advantages: individual drivers can access multiple databases without the need to load the code library provided by the database manufacturer on the client ' s end, and are more scalable.
title: Java数据库连接

source_text:
类型4：本地协议驱动
这种类型的驱动使用Socket，直接在客户端和数据库间通信。优点：
访问速度最快；
这是最直接、最纯粹的Java实现。
缺点：
几乎只有数据库厂商自己才能提供这种类型的JDBC驱动。
需要针对不同的数据库使用不同的驱动程序。API概述

Advantage: Access is the fastest; this is the most direct and purest Java is achieved. Disadvantage: Database manufacturers can provide this type of JDBC drive almost exclusively themselves. Different drivers need to be used for different databases. source_text: 思科成立於1984年，创始人是斯坦福大学的一对计算机科學家——列昂纳德·波萨克（Leonard Bosack）和桑德·勒纳（Sandy Lerner）。他們倆協助把斯坦福校园的计算机連接起來，並率先提出以支援多種協議的路由系統連接位於不同地理位置的電腦。1990年上市時，思科市值2.24億美元，到了2000年互聯網泡沫將近结束时，思科市值超過5,000億美元。
target_text: Cisco was founded in 1984 by a pair of computer scientists from Stanford University, Leonard Bosack and Sandy Lerner. source_text:
有关争议
思科被批评参与了中华人民共和国互联网审查机制。美国作家Ethan Gutmann说，思科和一些其他通信设备供应商向中华人民共和国政府提供了具有流量监控和过滤功能的互联网设备，用来封堵网站和追踪网上一些活跃的民运人士。2006年2月，美国国会为此召开听证会，向思科、微软、雅虎、Google四家公司提出质询。美国中国信息中心的亨利·吴（Henry Wu，China Information Center）指责，思科不断主动地与中共政權中央及各省国家安全部门联系，向其提供最新技术，包括警车间的即时通讯和指挥系统、以及声音识别技术和指纹鉴别技术。记者Sarah Lai Stirland在Wired News发表了一篇文章，并公布了一份泄漏的思科机密PPT文档。该文档详细描述了思科和中共政府在金盾工程上具有商业性质的合作。她还在文章中指责，思科在市场营销中将这些技术明确划分为“镇压工具（A Tool of Repression）”。思科的辩护者声称，实际上，在中国大陆现行的内容过滤系统中，路由器只是作为底层执行设备对人为指定的目的地址进行屏蔽，这是任何一台商用路由器都必须提供的基本功能，思科并没有向中共政府提供特别开发和定制的互联网设备。。
target_text: In February 2006, the United States Congress held a hearing to question four companies, namely Cisco, Microsoft, Yahoo, Google. The American author Ethan Gutmann, a Chinese information centre, accused Cisco and a number of other communications equipment providers of providing traffic monitoring and filtering devices to the Chinese government to block websites and track some of the online activists. In February 2006, the United States Congress conducted a hearing to question four companies, Cisco, Microsoft, Yahoo, and Google. The Chinese information centre, Henry Wu, China Information Center, accused Cisco and the Chinese government of continuing to actively contact the central and provincial security services of the Communist Party, providing them with state-of-the-art technologies, including instant communication and command systems in police workshops, and voice recognition technology and fingerprint identification techniques.
title: 思科系统

source_text:
處理器架構
PPE 可以作为資源管理使用，SPE 可以作为数据处理器使用。PPE 上的程序可以将任务分解到 SPE 上完成，然后相互传输数据。SPE 缺少一般处理器中的大部分通用特性，它们根本不能执行常见的操作系统任务，没有虚拟内存的支持，不能直接访问计算机的RAM，中断支持也非常有限。将 SPE、PPE 和主存控制器连接在一起的是一个名为 Element Interconnect Bus 的总线，这是数据传输的主要通道。
target_text: The processor structure PPE can be used as resource management, and the SPE can be used as data-processing. The PPE program can break down the task to the SPE and then transmit the data to each other. The SPE lacks most of the common features of the general processor, they are simply unable to perform common operating system tasks, do not have virtual memory support, do not have direct access to the computer RAM, and the interruption support is very limited. The SPE, PPE and the master memory controller are connected to the main channel of data transmission, the main channel.
title: Cell (微處理器)

source_text: 一般认为，CMM并不涉及到具体的軟體流程的细节，仅仅是关注了制定、管理、控制软件流程所必须关注的管理要点，但是在某些情况下，CMM的确暗含了某种脱胎于国防工程的过程样式，在指导商业企业依据SW-CMM/CMMI等进行流程改进时，必须充分了解到这一点。它用于衡量软件企业的开发管理水平，既可作为软件发包方评估承包方执行能力的参考标准，也可以被软件企业作为軟體流程改进工作的参考模型。实际上，CMM已经发展成为了众多标准的集合体，比如关于人力资源的，关于软件采办的SA-CMM等等。
target_text: It is generally felt that the CCM does not deal with the details of specific software processes, but focuses only on the management elements that must be addressed in the development, management, and control of software processes, but in some cases the CCM does imply some sort of process-style departure from defence work, which must be fully understood when guiding business enterprises to process improvements based on, for example, SW-CMM/CMMI. It is used to measure the level of development management of software enterprises, either as a reference point for the software originator to assess the implementation capacity of the contractor or as a reference model for the software enterprise to work on software process improvement. In fact, the CCM has developed into a cluster of standards, such as SA-CM for human resources, for software processing, etc.
title: 能力成熟度模型

source_text:
與人工智能的關係
现代的计算机科学技术和人工智能科学把最优化作为一个重要的领域来研究。我们也可以认为人工智能的一些算法，就是模拟了人类寻求实际问题最优解的过程。例如，利用人工智能方法设计软件，配合外部的电子设备例如摄像头识别人脸；利用数据挖掘和神经网络算法来寻找投资的最佳时机等。
target_text: Modern computer science and technology and artificial intelligence science look at optimization as an important area. We can also think that some of the algorithms of artificial intelligence are simulations of the best way in which humans seek to solve practical problems. For example, software is designed using artificial intelligence methods, coupled with external electronic devices such as cameras for human face recognition; data mining and neurological network algorithms are used to find the best opportunity to invest.
title: 最优化

source_text: 使得当增大，区间变小，而前个这种区间的交不空。我们使用来计算它所表示的实数的任何精度的有理数近似。在这个定义下，实数可以用一个算法表示，它对于每个计算出最大的整数使得然后输出。这个定义和采用柯西列的经典定义相关，除了要求序列是构造式的：也就是说，我们有个计算第个序列中的元素的算法，所以有一个计算任意精确的对的有理数近似的算法。
target_text: This definition is relevant to the use of the classic Corsille definition, except that the sequence is tectonic: that is, we have an algorithm that calculates the elements in the first sequence, so there is an algorithm that calculates the exact exact numbers.
title: 数学构成主义

source_text: 注意构造性要求使得上述定义和通常非构造主义的实数定义不相容：因为每个算法必须是一个有限指令集上的有限序列，存在一个双射函数。所以所有算法的集合和所有自然数的集合有同样的基数。当使用一个非构造式的定义时，康托对角线论证证明实数比自然数有更高的基数。
target_text: Note that tectonic requirements make the above definition incompatible with the usual non-tectonic physical definition: each algorithm must be a limited sequence on a limited command set, with a double-launched function. So the sum of all algorithms has the same base as the sum of all natural numbers. When using a non-constructural definition, the Conto Diagonal Argument demonstrates that the real number has a higher base than the natural number.
title: 数学构成主义

source_text:
现在假设有一个算法A(w,C)取两个参数，一个串w，也就是我们的决定问题的输入串，而另一个串C是“建议证明”，并且使得A在最多nk步内产生“是／否”答案（其中n是w的长度而k不依赖于w）。然後假设：w是一个答案为“是”的例子，当且仅当，存在C使得A(w,C)返回“是”。
则我们称这个问题可以在非决定性多项式时间内解决，且将它放入NP类。我们把算法A作为一个所建议的证明的检验器，它运行足够快。（注意缩写NP代表“Non-deterministic（非确定性）Polynomial（多项式）”而不是代表“Non-Polynomial（非多项式）。）
target_text: Now assume that there is an algorithm A (w, C) that takes two parameters, a string w, that is, the input string for our decision question, and a string C that is “proposing proof”, and that gives A a “yes/no” answer within the maximum nk step (in which n is the length of w and k is not dependent on w). Then assume that w is an example of an “yes” answer, and that there is a “yes” case where there is a “C” that allows A (w, C) to return to “yes.” So we say that this issue can be resolved in a non-decisive multi-modal time, and it can be placed in the NP category. We use algorithm A as a suggested tester for proof, which works fast enough. (Note that NP stands for “Non-deterministic (non-determinational) Polynomial (multiple) rather than for “Non-Polynomial (non-multiple).)
title: P/NP问题

source_text:
P≠NP的觀點
相信P≠NP。该信念的一个关键原因是经过数十年对这些问题的研究，没人能发现一个NP完全问题的多项式时间算法。而且，人们早在NP完全的概念出现前就开始寻求这些算法（Karp的21个NP完全问题，在最早发现的一批中，有所有著名的已经存在的问题）。进一步，P=NP这样的结果会导致很多惊人结果，那些结果现在被相信不成立，如NP=反NP和P=PH。
target_text: One of the key reasons for this belief is that, after decades of research on these issues, no one can find a multi-modal time algorithm for a complete NP problem. Moreover, people have sought these algorithms long before the complete concept of NP (the 21 NP in Karp, among the first to be discovered, all known problems already exist). Further, results like the P=NP result have led to a lot of amazing results that are now believed to be unconvinced, as in the case of NP=anti-NP and P=PH.
title: P/NP问题

source_text: 藉由加長密钥和初向量、減少和密钥相關的封包個數、再加上安全訊息驗證系統，WPA使得侵入無線區域網路變得困難許多。Michael演算法是WPA設計者在大多數舊的網路卡也能使用的條件下找到的最強的演算法，然而它可能會受到偽造封包攻擊。為了降低這個風險，WPA網路每當偵測到一個企圖的攻擊行為時就會關閉30秒鐘。
target_text: WPA makes it much more difficult to access the wireless area network by increasing the number of keys and primary vectors, reducing the number of envelopes associated with the key, and adding to the security information verification system. Michael algorithms are the strongest algorithms that WPA designers can find under conditions that most of the old Internet cards can use, but they may be attacked by a false envelope. To reduce this risk, the WPA network closes for 30 seconds every time an intended attack is detected.
title: WPA

source_text: 地址解析协议（，缩写：）是一个通过解析网络层地址来找寻数据链路层地址的网络传输协议，它在IPv4中极其重要。ARP最初在1982年的（征求意见稿）中提出并纳入互联网标准STD 37。ARP也可能指是在多数操作系统中管理其相关地址的一个进程。ARP是通过網路位址来定位MAC地址。 ARP已经在很多网路层和数据链接层之间得以实现，包括IPv4、、和Xerox （PUP）使用IEEE 802标准， 光纤分布式数据接口， X.25，帧中继和异步传输模式（ATM），IEEE 802.3和IEEE 802.11标准上IPv4占了多数流量。
target_text: Address parsing protocol (Abbreviation:) is a network transfer protocol to find data chain level addresses by dissecting network level addresses, which is extremely important in IPv4. ARP initially proposed in 1982 (Application draft) and incorporated the Internet standard STD 37. ARP may also mean a process to manage related addresses in most operating systems. ARP locates MAC addresses by means of a network address. ARP has already been achieved between many network levels and data link layers, including IPv4, and Xerox (PUP) using IEE 802, fibre-optic distribution data interfaces, X.25, membrane and step-to-step transmission mode (ATM), IEE 802.3 and IEE 802.11 standards, which account for most of the flow of IPv4.
title: 地址解析协议

source_text:
互联网控制消息协议（，缩写：）是互联网协议族的核心协议之一。它用于网际协议（IP）中发送控制消息，提供可能发生在通信环境中的各种问题反馈。通过这些信息，使管理者可以对所发生的问题作出诊断，然后采取适当的措施解决。ICMP 依靠IP來完成它的任务，它是IP的主要部分。它与传输协议（如TCP和UDP）显著不同：它一般不用于在两点间传输数据。它通常不由网络程序直接使用，除了 ping 和 traceroute 这两个特別的例子。
IPv4中的ICMP被称作ICMPv4，IPv6中的ICMP则被称作ICMPv6。
target_text: The Internet Control Message Protocol (ICP) is one of the core protocols of the Internet protocol community. It is used to send control messages in the Internet protocol (IP) and to provide feedback on issues that may occur in the communication environment. Through this information, managers can diagnose problems that occur and then take appropriate measures to solve them. ICMP relies on IP to perform its task, which is a major part of IP. It is significantly different from the transmission protocol (e.g. TCP and UDP): it is not generally used to transmit data between two points. It is usually not used directly by network programs, except for the two special examples of ping and traceroute. ICMP in IPv4 is referred to as ICMPv4, and ICMP in IPv6 is referred to as ICMPv6.
title: 互联网控制消息协议

source_text:
技術細節
ICMP是在 RFC 792 中定义的互联网协议族之一。通常用于返回的错误信息或是分析路由。ICMP错误消息总是包括了源数据并返回给发送者。
ICMP错误消息的例子之一是TTL值过期。每个路由器在转发数据报的时候都会把IP包头中的TTL值减1。如果TTL值为0，“TTL在传输中过期”的消息将会回报给源地址。
每个ICMP消息都是直接封裝在一个IP数据包中的，因此，和UDP一样，ICMP是不可靠的。
target_text: The technical detail ICMP is one of the Internet protocolrs defined in RFC 792. It is usually used to return the wrong information or to analyse the route. The ICMP error always includes the source data and returns it to the sender. One example of the ICMP error message is that the TTL has expired. Each router reduces the TTL value from the IP package when transmitting the data report by one. If the TTL is 0, the "TTL expired in transmission" message returns to the source address. Each ICMP message is directly sealed in an IP data package, so, like UDP, the ICMP is unreliable.
title: 互联网控制消息协议

source_text: 重定向 报文是网关发出的，用于要求主机或路由器改变数据报的传输路径的ICMP报文。ICMP 重定向是路由器将路由信息传达给主机的机制。这种类型的报文通知主机更新它的路由信息（请求主机改变其路由）。如果一个主机在通信时将数据报发送给了路由器R1，而R1将这个数据报转发给了另一个路由器R2，且主机到路由器R2之间有一条直连的路径（也就是说，此主机和路由器R2处于同一以太网段上），那么路由器R1会发送一条重定向报文给主机，来通知它到路由器R2可用路径里有一条更短、更优化的路径。这个主机在接收到这个重定向报文之后应该改变其路由至这个优化版本的路由信息，来将抵达这个目的地的数据报直接发送到路由器R2，并且路由器仍将原始数据报发送到预期目的地。但是，如果一个数据报携带有路由信息，那么即使有更加优化的路径，路由器也不会发送重定向报文。并且，RFC 1122 指出，重定向报文应该只由网关发送，而不应该由互联网主机发送。
target_text: This type of message informs the host to update its route information (requesting the host to change its route). If a host sends the data to the router R1, and R1 forwards the data to another router R2, and there is a direct route between router and router R2 (that is, the host and router R2 are on the same section of the web), the router R1 will send a redirected message to the host (requesting the host to change its route). If a host sends the data to the router R1 and the router R2 has a shorter and more optimal path to the roadr R2 available, the host will change the route to the optimal version of the route R2 (i.e., the host and router R2 is on the same section of the web), then the router R1 will send a re-directed message to the main route (which will be sent to the road) to the route (which is a shorter and more optimized route) to the destination (which should not be sent to the destination), even if the signal is sent by an optimator 22.
title: 互联网控制消息协议

target_text: On 25 July 2006, the OpenDarwin team announced that the project had been closed because they believed that OpenDarwin “has become the sole hosting tool for Mac OS X-related projects” and that efforts to create an independent Darwin operating system failed. source_text: 《电子游戏软件》（简称“电软”，副刊名最初为《GAME集中营》，后改为《GAME风景线》），是中国大陆最早创办并大规模发行的电视游戏杂志。原为月刊，后改为半月刊。内容包括有游戏机软件、硬件信息。《电软》是1990年代最重要的游戏杂志之一，它所开创的轻松幽默，适合青少年审美取向的办刊风格，吸引和培育了一代玩家。
target_text: Electronic Game Software, originally known as the GAME concentration camp and later changed to the GAME landscape, was the first television game magazine to be launched and distributed on a large scale in mainland China. It was a monthly magazine and then became a half-monthly magazine. It includes information on video games software and hardware. It is one of the most important games magazine in the 1990s. It creates an easy sense of humor that suits young people ' s aesthetic style and attracts and nurtures a generation of players.
title: 电子游戏软件

source_text: 互联网工程任务组（，縮寫：IETF）是一个开放的标准组织，负责开发和推广自愿互联网标准（Internet Standard，英文缩写为STD），特别是构成TCP/IP协议族（TCP/IP）的标准。 它没有正式的会员资格或会员资格要求。 所有参与者和经理都是志愿者，尽管他们的工作通常由雇主或赞助商资助。互联网工程任务组（IETF）最初是作为一项由美国联邦政府支持的活动开始的，但自1993年以来，它在互联网协会（Internet Society，ISOC,一个国际会员制非营利组织）的支持下作为标准制定职能运作。
target_text: The Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) is an open standard organization responsible for the development and promotion of voluntary Internet standards (Internet Standard, English acronym STD), especially those that constitute the TCP/IP community (TCP/IP). It does not have formal membership or membership requirements. All participants and managers are volunteers, although their work is usually funded by employers or sponsors. The Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF), originally started as an activity supported by the United States federal government, has operated as a standard-setting function since 1993, with the support of the Internet Association (Internet Society, ISOC, an international membership non-profit organization).
title: 互联网工程任务组

source_text:
历史
1990年代以前，IETF曾为计算机出版界所宠爱。它宣称自己与迟钝、嘈杂的ISO和ITU-T的官僚作风比较，将是更敏捷、虚心和开放的标准化实体。不幸的是，IETF在1980年代的效率不过是它相对规模较小的自然结果，之后便消失了。1993年，大多数观察者清楚地发现，互联网正在成为下一个超级交流媒介；而与之竞争的OSI项目失败了。突然间，所有有点技术知识的家伙都试图通过参加IETF在计算机历史上留下一笔。工作组规模扩张，导致其效率降低。
target_text: In 1993, most observers clearly discovered that the Internet was becoming the next supermedia; and the competing OSI project failed. Suddenly, all those with some technical expertise tried to leave a legacy in computer history by participating in the IETF.
title: 互联网工程任务组

source_text:

source_text:
1985年问世的80386开启了32位CPU时代。地址总线为32比特，寻址空间为232（即4 GiB）。386 CPU保护模式下有两种内存寻址方式：
可以分页寻址，这是此后的x86上的Windows操作系统与Linux操作系统最广泛采用的方法；
也可以非分页寻址而采取与286保护模式兼容的寻址方式，采用16位的选择器（selector）寄存器与32位的偏移量寄存器寻址，这时描述符表的条目中保存的段起始物理地址为32位，而段长的数据宽度为20位，但可以设置段长的粒度为1 B或4 KiB，所以段的最大长度可以是1 MiB或者4 GiB。
target_text: The 32-bit CPU era was opened in 1985 by 80386. The address line is 32 bits and the address search space is 232 (i.e. 4 GiB). There are two ways to locate the memory under the CPU protected mode: a page search can be made, which is the most widely used method for the Windows operating system on x86 and the Linux operating system; or a location search compatible with the 286 protective mode can also be conducted in a non-page search using a 16-digit server and a 32-digit deflector search site, where the starting physical address of a segment saved in an entry in the descriptive table is 32 places, while the length of the segment is 20 places, but the length of the segment can be set at 1 B or 4 KiB, so the maximum length of the segment can be 1 MiB or 4 GiB.
title: 保護模式

source_text:
386 CPU开创的分页内存管理，比286保护模式寻址具有更多的优点：
操作系统可以控制与限制进程对页面的访问权限
为应用程序创造一个连续的、独立的、线性的虚拟内存空间
页面可以移出主存，存入更慢速的次级外存如硬盘。这使得操作系统可以使用比物理内存更大的存储空间。
target_text: The CPU created page-based memory management, which has more advantages than the 286 protected mode location: The operating system can control and limit the access of the process to the page, creating a continuous, stand-alone, linear virtual memory space for the application The page can be moved out of the main memory and placed into a slower secondary memory, such as a hard disk. This allows the operating system to use a larger storage space than physical memory.
title: 保護模式

source_text: 第一版的指令集与高层的体系结构的设计仅用了3个月。 在没有CAD工具的时代，4名工程师与12名布线绘图员平行工作， 用了2年多的时间才把8086的高层设计实现为可运行测试的产品。这在当时算是很快的研发速度。8086是随机逻辑与微码的混合实现，使用了大约20,000个晶体管（算上所有的ROM与可编程逻辑阵列为29,000个晶体管）。芯片面积为33 mm²，-{zh-tw:製程;zh-cn:制造工艺}-为3.2 μm.
target_text: The first version of the command set took only three months to design the top architecture. In an era without CAD tools, four engineers worked in parallel with 12 cabling cartographers, and it took more than two years to make 8086 high-level designs operational as a testable product. This was a quick pace of development at the time. 8086 was a combination of random logic and microcodes, using about 20,000 transistors (taking into account all ROM and programming logic arrays as 29,000). The chip was 33 mm2, - {zh-tw: preparation; zh-cn: manufacturing process} - 3.2 μm.
title: Intel 8086

source_text:
8086芯片封装的8个控制引脚在min或max下有不同功能。"min"模式是使用单处理器的小型计算机系统，"max"模式是使用多处理器的中到大型计算机系统。寄存器与指令
8086有8个16比特的寄存器，包括栈寄存器SP与BP，但不包括指令寄存器IP、控制寄存器FLAGS以及四个段寄存器。AX, BX, CX, DX,这四个寄存器可以按照字节访问；但BP, SI, DI, SP,这四个地址寄存器只能按照16位宽访问。
target_text: The eight control fuses contained in the 8086 chip have different functions under the min or max. The "min" mode is a small computer system using a single processor, and the "max" mode is a medium-to-large computer system using multiple processors. The sender and the 8086 directive have 8 16 bits of transmitters, including the warehousing depositors SP and BP, but does not include the command depositor IP, the control depository FLAGS, and four parts of the register. AX, BX, CX, DX, the four transmitters can be accessed by bits; but BP, SI, DI, SP, the four addresses senders can only be accessed by 16 bits.
title: Intel 8086

source_text: 一个20位的物理地址对应着4096个不同的"段地址：偏移量"的组合。这是因为，偏移量的最低4位对应于物理地址的最低四位，而偏移量的高12位共有4096个取值。段地址所对应的物理地址的粒度是16字节（=24），称之为paragraph。段地址确定后，偏移量的取值最多为64KiB（=65536），这就是分段寻址的最大的线性地址空间。实际上在8086处理器上，操作系统分配的线性地址空间可以是不大于64KiB的任意数量。程序可以自由访问整个物理内存空间，操作系统没有任何权限限制或监管（supervision）。
target_text: A 20-bit physical address corresponds to a combination of 4096 different "parts": deviations. This is because the minimum of 4 places of deviation corresponds to the minimum of 4 places of physical address, while the 12 places of deviation correspond to a total of 4096 withdrawals. The physical addresses of the segment address correspond to 16 bytes (=24), called paragraph. Once the segment has been determined, the deviation is taken to a maximum of 64 KiB (=65536), which is the largest linear address space for the sub-location. On the 8086 processor, the linear address space allocated to the operating system can be no greater than the arbitrary amount of 64 KiB. The program has free access to the entire physical memory space and has no privileges or controls (subvision).
title: Intel 8086

source_text: 1986年高中毕业后，桑格就读于里德学院哲学系，期间对互联网及其作为出版渠道的潜力产生兴趣。他设立了一个邮件列表服务器，为有辅导需求的学生与导师建立沟通平台，以此建立论坛，用来提供个别辅导课程、个别辅导的方式及自愿提供辅导的可能性及优点，打造成导师和学生打破传统大学环境，在互联网上寻找彼此的自由网络。为此，桑格牵头成立哲学讨论列表系统哲学协会（Association for Systematic Philosophy）。
target_text: After graduating from high school in 1986, Zangger attended the Faculty of Philosophy at Reed College, where he was interested in the Internet and its potential as a publishing channel. He set up a mailing list server to create a platform for communication between students with counselling needs and mentors, thereby creating a forum for offering individual tutorial courses, individual tutoring and the possibility and advantages of voluntary tutoring, creating mentors and students to break the traditional university environment and seek free networks on the Internet. To this end, Zangger led the establishment of the Philosophy Association for Philosophy of Philosophy.

source_text: 桑格是维基百科的唯一一位编辑员工。2002年初，母公司Bomis计划用维基百科营利，宣布在网站上投放广告，用一部分收入给桑格付薪水。但维基百科项目公开反对商业化行动，加上当时互联网广告的市场非常小。到2002年2月，在互联网泡沫的冲击下，Bomis不再向维基百科拨款，停止资助桑格的工作。3月1日，桑格正式辞任Nupedia总编辑和维基百科总召集人。他表示自己不会以志愿者名义参与维基百科和Nupedia，因为以兼职的身份来做这项任务不合理。桑格也对持续的内容战感到沮丧，并自己缺乏威尔士的支持。
target_text: In February 2002, as a result of the impact of the Internet bubble, Bomis stopped allocating funds to Wikipedia. On March 1, Sanger officially resigned as editor-in-chief of Nupedia and as head of Wikipedia. He stated that he would not participate in Wikipedia and Nupedia as volunteers, because it was not reasonable to do the job on a part-time basis.

source_text: 散列函数（）又称-{zh-cn:散列算法、哈希函数; zh-tw:雜湊演算法}-，是一种从任何一种数据中创建小的数字“指纹”的方法。散列函数把消息或数据压缩成摘要，使得数据量变小，将数据的格式固定下来。该函数将数据打乱混合，重新创建一个叫做散列值（，，，或）的指纹。散列值通常用一个短的随机字母和数字组成的字符串来代表。好的散列函数在输入域中很少出现散列冲突。在散列表和数据处理中，不抑制冲突来区别数据，会使得数据库记录更难找到。
target_text: The hash function () is also called - {zh-cn: hash algorithm, Hashi function; zh-tw: hash algorithm} - is a method of creating small numbers of "prints" from any type of data. The hash function compresss messages or data into a summary, making the data volume smaller and the data format fixed. The function mixes the data and recreates a fingerprint called hash value (, or). The hash value is usually represented by a string of short random letters and numbers. Good hash functions rarely conflict with the hash in the input field. In the hash list and data processing, it does not suppress conflicts to distinguish data, which makes it more difficult to locate database records.
title: 散列函數

source_text:
语音识别
对于像从一个已知列表中匹配一个MP3文件这样的应用，一种可能的方案是使用传统的散列函数——例如MD5，但是这种方案会对时间平移、CD读取错误、不同的音频压缩算法或者音量调整的实现机制等情况非常敏感。使用一些类似于MD5的方法有利于迅速找到那些严格相同（从音频文件的二进制数据来看）的音频文件，但是要找到全部相同（从音频文件的内容来看）的音频文件就需要使用其他更高级的算法了。
target_text: For applications such as matching a MP3 file from a known list, one possible option would be to use traditional hash functions, such as MD5, but such options would be sensitive to time-shifting, CD-reading errors, different audio compression algorithms, or mechanisms for achieving volume adjustments. Use of some MD5-like methods would facilitate the quick finding of sound files that are strictly identical (from binary data of audio files), but to find all the same audio files (from the content of audio files) would require other advanced algorithms.
title: 散列函數

source_text: 那些并不紧随IT工业潮流的人往往能反其道而行之，对于那些微小差异足够健壮的散列函数确实存在。现存的绝大多数散列算法都是不够健壮的，但是有少数散列算法能够达到辨别从嘈杂房间里的扬声器里播放出来的音乐的健壮性。有一个实际的例子是Shazam 服务。用户可以用手机打开其app，并将话筒靠近用于播放音乐的扬声器。该项服务会分析正在播放的音乐，并将它于存储在数据库中的已知的散列值进行比较。用户就能够收到被识别的音乐的曲名。
target_text: Those who do not follow the tide of the IT industry are often able to do the opposite, and there are small, small, robust hash functions. Most of the hash algorithms that exist are not robust enough, but there are a few hash algorithms that can distinguish the strength of music that comes from the loudspeaker in the loud room. One example is the Shazam service. Users can open their apps with a mobile phone and bring the microphone close to the loudspeaker for playing music. The service analyses the music that is being played and compares it with the known hash values stored in the database.
title: 散列函數

source_text: 为了使远端客户程序显示到本地服务器，用户一般需要启动一个终端窗口和到达远端计算机的telnet或者ssh，令其显示到用户计算机，（例如：在运行bash的远端计算机上export DISPLAY=[用户的计算机]:0）然后启动客户端。然后客户端就会连接到本地计算机，并且远端应用程序会显示到本地屏幕并被本地输入设备所控制。与之对应，本地计算机上也可以执行一个连接到远端计算机的小型代理程序，并在該端启动與執行自有需求與指定的应用程序。
target_text: In order for a remote client program to be displayed on a local server, the user usually needs to start a terminal window and a telenet or ssh that reaches a remote computer, so that it can be displayed on the user ' s computer (e.g., on a remote computer running bash, export DISPLAY=[user ' s computer]:0) and then start the client. The client will then connect to the local computer, and the remote application will be displayed on the local screen and controlled by the local input device. Correspondingly, the local computer can also execute a small proxy that connects to a remote computer and starts and executes its own needs and specified applications on that end.
title: X視窗系統

source_text:

target_text: The molecular structure of the carbon nanotubes determines some of its unique properties. The theory predicts that the carbon nanotubes have an unusually strong strength, thermal conductivity, magnetic resistance, and their nature changes with the structure, and can be transformed by insulation into semiconductors, from semiconductors to metals; and the magnetic fluxes passed by the metal-guided nanotubes are quantitative, showing the Ahanov-Bom effect (A-B effects).
title: 碳纳米管

source_text:
用途与实现
虚拟内存技术是现代计算机系统结构中不可分割的一部分。现代所有用于一般应用的操作系统都对普通的应用程序使用虚拟内存技术，例如文字处理软件，电子制表软件，多媒体播放器等等。大部分架构通过CPU中独立的硬件内存管理单元来辅助实现这一功能。部分仿真器和虚拟机也能够通过宿主系统中的硬件来提高性能。老一些的操作系统，如DOS和1980年代的Windows，或者那些1960年代的大型机，一般都没有虚拟内存的功能——但是，和苹果公司的Lisa都是很值得注意的例外。
target_text: The use and realization of virtual memory technology is an integral part of the structure of modern computer systems. All modern operating systems for general applications use virtual memory technology for general applications, such as word-processing software, electronic tabulation software, multimedia players, etc. Most structures are supported by separate hardware memory management units in CPUs. Some emulators and virtual machines can also improve performance through hardware in host systems. Old operating systems, such as DOS and Windows in the 1980s, or large machines in the 1960s, generally have no virtual memory functions — but, with the exception of the Apple Lisa, they are very noteworthy.
title: 虚拟内存

source_text: 伯纳斯-李是万维网联盟的主席，1994年创立了万维网联盟，为关注万维网发展而创办的组织。他也是的创办人。伯纳斯-李还是麻省理工学院计算机科学及人工智能实验室创办主席及高级研究员。同时，伯纳斯-李是网页科学研究倡议会的总监。最后，他是麻省理工学院集體智慧中心咨询委员会成员。2011年，他被任命為福特基金會的董事會成員。
target_text: Bernard Lee, president of the World Wide Web Alliance, created the World Wide Web Consortium in 1994 to focus on the development of the World Wide Web. He was also a founder. Bernard Lee was also the founding president and senior researcher of the Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Bernard Lee was also the head of the Web-based Scientific Research Initiative. Finally, he was a member of the Advisory Board of the MIT Collective Intelligence Center. In 2011, he was appointed a member of the board of directors of the Ford Foundation.
title: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李

source_text: 2004年，英女皇伊丽莎白二世向伯纳斯-李颁发大英帝国爵級司令勋章。2009年4月，他获选为美国国家科学院外籍院士。他被《時代》雜誌列為時代100人：本世紀最重要的人物。在2012年夏季奧林匹克運動會開幕典禮上，他获得了“万维网发明者”的美誉。伯纳斯-李本人也参与了開幕典禮，在一台NeXT计算机前工作。他在Twitter上发表消息说：“这是给所有人的”，体育馆内的液晶显示器光管随即显示出文字来。2017年，他因“发明了万维网、第一个浏览器和使得万维网得以扩展的基础协议及算法”而获得2016年度的图灵奖。
target_text: In 2004, the British Queen Elizabeth II presented Bernards-Lie with the Order of Commander of the British Empire. In April 2009, he was elected as a foreign member of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States. He was listed in the Times magazine as 100: the most important figure of the century. At the opening ceremony of the 2012 Olympic Games, he was awarded the reputation of “the inventor of the World Wide Web.” Bernard-Lee himself participated in the opening ceremony and worked in front of a NeXT computer. On Twitter, he said, “This is for everyone”, and the LCD tubes in the stadium showed the text. In 2017, he received the Tulling Award for “inventing the World Wide Web, the first browser and the underlying protocol and algorithm that enabled the World Wide Web to expand”.
title: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李

source_text: 1980年，柏內茲-李離開CERN後，转而任職于约翰·普尔图形计算机系统有限公司，该公司位于英國伯恩茅斯。在这间公司裡，他参与的计划是一个远程过程调用，从而获得了计算机网络经验。1984年，伯纳斯-李以研究員的身份重返CERN。在1989年的时候，CERN是全歐洲最大的互联网节点。伯纳斯-李因此看到了将超文本系统与互联网结合在一起的-{zh-hans:机会; zh-tw:契機}-：
target_text: In 1980, when Bernez Lee left CERN, he was transferred to John Pool Graphics Computer Systems Ltd., located in Bernmouth, United Kingdom. In this company, he was involved in a remote process call, thereby gaining experience with the computer network. In 1984, Bernard Lee returned to CERN as a researcher. title: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李

source_text: 2001年，伯纳斯-李成为了东多塞特古迹信托会名誉保护人，他在东多塞特居住过。2004年12月，伯纳斯-李接受了英格兰南安普敦大学电子及计算机科学学院计算机科学主席一职，研究语义网。伯纳斯-李在接受泰晤士报访问时，承认网址中的双斜线（//）并非必要。他还表示，他可以轻易设计出一种无需斜线的URL。伯纳斯-李为掉以轻心道歉，并说“这个主意在那时看起来不错。”
target_text: In 2001, Bernard Lee became the Honorary Protector of the Eastern Dosset Monument Trust, who lived in East Dosset. In December 2004, Bernard Lee accepted the post of Chairman of Computer Science at the Faculty of Electronics and Computer Sciences of the University of Southampton, England, to study semantic networks. Bernard Lee, in his interview with the Times, acknowledged that the two-slash (/) in the site was not necessary. He also said that he could easily design a URL without a slash. Bernards Lee apologized lightly and said, "That idea looked good at the time."
title: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李

source_text: 2009年11月，伯纳斯-李创办了。伯纳斯-李是网络中立性的支持者之一，他还说互联网服务供应商的连接供应“不应带有任何条件”，也不应在未征得同意的情况下，监视用户活动。他认为，网络中立性是一种网络人权，“如果公司、政府干涉或监视互联网流量，基本人权会受到威胁。”
target_text: In November 2009, Bernards Lee was founded. Bernards Lee, one of the supporters of Internet neutrality, added that Internet service providers' access supply “should not be subject to any conditions” and should not be subject to surveillance of user activities without consent. In his view, cyberneutrality is a cyberhuman right, “if companies, governments interfere with or monitor Internet traffic, fundamental human rights will be threatened”.
title: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李

source_text: 荣誉1994年，他成为万维网名人堂的成员之一。1995年，他赢得凯尔贝基金会的“年度青年发明家”奖项。同年，他获得了ACM软件系统奖。1997年，在英女皇寿辰上，为表扬他在“全球计算机网络”方面作出的贡献，他获颁大英帝国官佐勳章。1998年，他获得艾塞克斯大學荣誉博士学位。1999年，他入选时代杂志20世纪最重要的100个人物。2000年3月，他获得公开大学荣誉博士学位。2001年，他入选美国文理科学院。2002年，他入选英国广播公司最伟大的100名英国人。2003年，为表扬他对万维网发展的开创性贡献，他获颁计算机历史博物馆研究奖。2004年4月15日，他獲得首屆千禧技术奖。奖金高达一百万欧元，奖项在同年6月15日由芬兰总统向他颁发。同年7月16日，因获颁大英帝国爵级司令，他获封为爵士。2004年21日，他获得兰开斯特大学荣誉科学博士学位。2005年1月27日，因他的成就，与他展示出英国人的特质，“羞怯、决心、敏锐的幽默感及良好的适应能力”，他入选2004年最伟大的英国人。2007年，他获得金盘奖。同年，他与艾伯特·霍夫曼一起并列每日电讯报“最伟大的100名在生天才”榜首。同年6月13日，他获颁功绩勋章。2008年，为表扬他“构思出万维网，并进一步发展万维网”，他获得了。2008年12月2日，他获得曼彻斯特大学荣誉博士学位。2009年4月21日，他获得馬德里理工大學荣誉博士学位。同年4月28日，他获选为美国国家科学院外籍院士。同年6月8日，因他的终生成就，他获得威比奖。颁奖仪式于纽约市举行。
target_text: In 1994, he became a member of the World Wide Web Hall of Honours. In 1995, he won the Kelbe Foundation's “Annual Young Innovator” award. source_text: 快速的查询效果是通过维护一个多层次的链表实现的，且与前一层（下面一层）链表元素的数量相比，每一层链表中的元素的数量更少（见右下角示意图）。一开始时，算法在最稀疏的层次进行搜索，直至需要查找的元素在该层两个相邻的元素中间。这时，算法将跳转到下一个层次，重复刚才的搜索，直到找到需要查找的元素为止。跳过的元素的方法可以是随机性选择或确定性选择，其中前者更为常见。
target_text: The quick search effect is achieved by maintaining a multi-layered chain table, and the number of elements in each chain table is smaller than the number of elements in the previous (lower) layer (see the lower right corner map). At the outset, the algorithms search at the thinest level until the elements that need to be found are among the two adjacent elements in that layer. At this point, the algorithm will jump to the next level, repeating the search until the elements that need to be searched are found. The way to jump the elements can be random selection or determinative selection, the first of which is more common.
title: 跳跃列表

source_text: 中国网络实名制是中华人民共和国境内的互联网服务提供商和互联网内容提供商（尤其是用户生成内容的站点）在提供服务时需要收集用户的真实姓名、身份证号等信息的实名制制度。由于网络实名制的實施有可能引致網民的受宪法保护的言論空間遭到侵犯和收窄，因此引来了各方的关注，在中国社会产生很大的争议。世界上只有少數国家，如南韓曾經實施過網絡實名制。
target_text: China’s Internet real-name system is one in which Internet service providers and Internet content providers in the People’s Republic of China (especially content-producing sites) need to collect user’s real names, identity numbers, etc. In providing their services, the implementation of the Internet real-name system may lead to the violation and narrowing of the constitutionally protected spaces of speech for the Internet.
title: 中国网络实名制

source_text:
歷史
1999年8月三个朋友在互联网泡沫的潮流中创建Blogger.com，它是全球第一批专用于網誌发布的工具之一，被公认对推广網誌有重要贡献。而Blogger这个名词也随之成了最新的互联网时尚名词。具体来说，用户不用手动编写HTML帖子，并且频繁上传新的帖子，而是透过提交一个Blogger网站上的表单来发布新的网志文章。
target_text: In August 1999, three friends created Bloger.com in a wave of Internet bubbles, one of the first worldwide tools dedicated to publishing and recognized as an important contribution to the promotion of the journal. The term Blogger became the latest Internet fashion term. Specifically, users do not write HTML posts manually and often upload new posts, but publish new web articles by submitting a form on a Blogger website.
title: Blogger

source_text:
從Word發布Blogger
2005年8月16日，Google發表了官方的免費外掛程式 Blogger for Word。這個外掛软件会在微软文字处理软件Microsoft Word的主界面中增加一个工具栏，用户可以直接在Word中编辑文字，并立刻发布到Blogger上，所以線上和離線同樣都可以編輯文章。此外挂还允许用户把网络上已经发布的帖子备份到本机上编辑修改。不过遗憾的是，这款插件不支持图片编辑功能，且只能安装到Word 2000以上版本的Word软件中。
target_text: On August 16, 2005, Google released an official free plugin, Blogger for Word. This plugin will add a toolbar to the Microsoft Word main interface of Microsoft Text Processing Software, where users can edit text directly in Word and post it immediately on Blogger, so that both online and offline articles can be edited. It also allows users to copy post posts posted on the network to edit changes on the machine. Unfortunately, this plugin does not support photo editing functions and can only be installed in Word 2000 or more.
title: Blogger

source_text: SIGGRAPH是由（美国计算机协会计算机图形专业组）组织的计算机图形学顶级年度会议。第一届SIGGRAPH会议于1974年召开。该会议有上万名计算机从业者参加，最近一次在洛杉矶举行。过去的SIGGRAPH曾经在达拉斯、波士顿、西雅图、新奥尔良、圣地亚哥和美国的其他地点举办。SIGGRAPH 2011于2011年在温哥华举行，这是SIGGRAPH首次在美国以外的城市举行。
target_text: SIGGRAPH was the top-level annual conference on computer graphics organized by the Computer Graphics Professional Group of the American Computer Association. The first SIGGRAPH Conference was held in 1974. It was attended by tens of thousands of computer practitioners, most recently in Los Angeles. The previous SIGGRAPH was held in Dallas, Boston, Seattle, New Orleans, Santiago, and elsewhere in the United States.
title: SIGGRAPH

source_text: 非真实感绘制（，NPR）是计算机图形学的一类，主要模拟艺术式的绘制风格，也用于发展新绘制风格。和传统的追求真实感的计算机图形学不同，NPR受到油画、素描、，和的影响。NPR已经以“卡通渲染”的形式出现在电影和电子游戏中，也出现在科学可视化、建筑插图和试验动画中。这个方法在现代实用的例子是卡通动画（Cel-shaded animation）。
target_text: The non-realistic drawing (NPR) is a type of computer graphics, mainly simulated art style, which is also used to develop new drawing styles. Unlike traditional computer graphics seeking truth, the NPR is affected by paintings, sketches, and the influence. The NPR has appeared in movies and video games in the form of "cartoons" and in scientific visualization, architectural illustrations, and experimental animations.
title: 非真实感绘制

这样表示的模型可以用于有限元分析

target_text: Space occupation (Spatial occupation, or space listings) The entire space sub-block is divided into rule blocks (cells, cells, cellular cavities) and the object is expressed by assigning it to those blocks. The object thus expressed can be used for limited differential analysis, usually after model completion, as part of pre-treatment of analytical software. Decomposition and "space occupancy" are similar, but blocks can be irregular and not pre-weaving. The model thus expressed can be used for limited meta-analysis, usually after model completion, as part of pre-processing of analytical software.
