source_text: 典型的基于提取、转换、加载（ETL）的数据仓库使用分级、数据集成和访问层来存放其关键功能。分级层或分级数据库存储从每个不同的源数据系统中提取的原始数据。集成层通过转换来自分级层的数据，将不同的数据集合在一起，通常将转换后的数据存储在ODS数据库中。然后将集成的数据转移到另一个数据库（通常称为数据仓库数据库），在这个数据库中，数据被分为层次组（通常称为维度），并被分成事实和聚合事实。事实和维度的组合有时被称为。访问层帮助用户检索数据。
target_text: A typical data warehouse based on extraction, conversion, loading (ETL) uses a hierarchy, data set integration and access layer to store its key functions. A hierarchical or hierarchical database stores raw data extracted from each of the different source data systems. By converting data from the hierarchical layers, the integrated layer aggregates different data, usually storing the converted data in the ODS database. The integrated data is then transferred to another database, commonly known as the data warehouse database, where the data is divided into hierarchical groups (often called dimensions) and is divided into facts and aggregated facts. The combination of facts and dimensions is sometimes referred to as access layers to help users retrieve the data.
title: 資料倉儲

source_text: 《物探化探计算技术》创刊于1979年。主要刊登中国国内外地球探测信息处理和计算机处理及其应用的学术论文及研究成果。被美国《化学文摘》（CA）、《中国石油文摘》、《中国地质文摘》及美国《地质光盘数据库》、俄罗斯《文摘杂志》等十多家中国国内外知名文摘收录，还成为《中国科学引文数据库CSCD》、《中国科技论文统计》等知名检索机构的来源期刊。
target_text: Founded in 1979, Discovery Calculating Techniques were published mainly in academic papers and studies on Earth exploration information processing and computer processing and their applications in China and abroad. Published by the United States Chemical Digest (CA), China Oil Digest, China Geology Digest and the United States Geological CD-ROM database, the Russian Digest magazine, among others, as well as by leading Chinese national and international digests, and as source journals for the Chinese Science Reference Database, CSCD, and Statistics of Chinese Science and Technology Papers.
title: 成都理工大学

source_text: 《国土资源科技管理》（原《地质科技管理》、《地质系统管理研究》）创刊于1984年，由国土资源部国际合作与科技司和成都理工大学主办，是一份刊载土地、矿产、水、海洋等自然资源科技和管理研究成果的综合性学术刊物。是中国学术期刊综合评价数据库来源期刊；《中国学术期刊（光盘版）》全文收录期刊；《中国期刊网》 入网期刊；万方数据——数字化期刊群入网期刊；《中文科技期刊数据库》原文收录期刊；《中国人文社会科学引文数据库》来源期刊；CEPS收录期刊；《CAJ-CD规范》执行优秀期刊。
target_text: The Management of Land Resources Science and Technology (formerly Geological Science and Technology Management, Geological Systems Management Research) was launched in 1984 and hosted by the Department of International Cooperation and Science and Technology of the Ministry of Land Resources and the Chengdu University of Technology as a comprehensive academic journal containing the results of research on technology and management of natural resources such as land, minerals, water and oceans. It is the source of the comprehensive evaluation database of Chinese academic journals; the full-text collection of Chinese academic journals (CD-ROM editions); the online journal of the Chinese Journal Network; the digitalized periodicals of all China; the original collection of periodicals of the Chinese Journal of Science and Technology; the source of the Chinese Humanist Social Science Database; the CEPS collection of periodicals; and the implementation of the CAJ-CD Code.
title: 成都理工大学

source_text:
QR分解法是一種将矩阵分解的方式。這種方式，把矩阵分解成一个正交矩阵与一个上三角矩阵的积。QR分解经常用来解线性最小二乘法问题。QR分解也是特定特征值算法即QR算法的基础。定义
实数矩阵A的QR分解是把A分解为这里的Q是正交矩阵（意味着QTQ = I）而R是上三角矩阵。类似的，我们可以定义A的QL, RQ和LQ分解。
target_text: QR decomposition is a way to decompose the matrix. This way, the matrix is broken down into a logarithmic matrix with an upper triangle. QR decomposition is often used to delineate the least two-fold problem of linearity. QR decomposition is also the basis for the particular feature value algorithm, the QR algorithm. Defines the QR decomposition of the real array A as the active array here (means QTQ = I) and R as the upper triangle. Similarly, we can define the QL, RQ and LQ decomposition of A.
title: QR分解

source_text: 通过流式细胞仪获取样本数据的过程叫做“获取过程”（acquisition）。这个过程是以连接在流式细胞仪的计算机，和处理细胞计数器的软件为媒介的。其中，软件可以调节用于检测样本的不同参数值，如电压（voltage），补偿（compensation）等，并且在获取样本数据时协助样本信息的数字显示，以确保参数正确的设置。现代的流式细胞仪很多应用在荧光标记（ fluorescently labeled ）的抗体（antibody）上。
target_text: The process of obtaining sample data through a flow cytometer is called the " capture process " (acquisition). This process is carried through computers connected to a flow cytometer, and software for processing cell counters. In this, software can regulate the different parameters used to detect samples, such as voltage, compensation, etc., and assist in the digital display of sample information when obtaining sample data to ensure that the parameters are correctly set. Many of the modern flow cytometers are applied to the antibodies (antibody) of fluorescence tags (Fluorescently labeled).
title: 流式細胞術

source_text: 在插值问题中，样条插值通常比多项式插值好用。用低阶的样条插值能产生和高阶的多项式插值类似的效果，并且可以避免被称为龙格现象的数值不稳定的出现。并且低阶的样条插值还具有“保凸”的重要性质。在计算机科学的计算机辅助设计和计算机图形学中，样条通常是指分段定义的多项式参数曲线。由于样条构造简单，使用方便，拟合准确，并能近似曲线拟合和交互式曲线设计中复杂的形状，样条是这些领域中曲线的常用表示方法。
target_text: In the case of plugs, the sample plug usually works better than the multiple plugs. The lower sample plugs produce similar effects to those of the higher ones, and avoid the occurrence of a numerical instability known as the dragon phenomenon. And the lower sample plugs also have an important "intended" character. In computer-assisted design and computer graphics, the sample usually refers to the several parameter curves defined by the sub-sections. Since the sample is simple, user-friendly, accurate and close to the curves and complex shapes in the interactive curve design, the sample is a common expression of the curves in these areas.
title: 样条函数

source_text: 在计算机被使用之前，数字演算用手工完成。虽然分段定义的象signum函数或阶梯函数这样的函数也被用到，一般人更喜欢多项式因为它们比较容易算。随着计算机的发展，样条变得越来越重要。它们一开始是作为多项式在插值中的替代品，后来又作为在计算机图形学中构造光滑和可变形状的工具。
target_text: Digital algorithms are performed manually before computers are used. While functions such as signum or staircase functions, which are defined in the subsections, are also used, the general population prefers multiple models because they are easier to calculate. As computers develop, specimens become more and more important. target_text: On 23 April 1991, Tung-8ACT normally completed the routine test flight, jumped 30 centimetres when landing, and the pilot pushed the pole to stop the head. source_text: 分子生態學是利用进化生物学理论，采用分子生物学和基因组学的实验方法和技术手段、统计学和数学的分析方法，通过计算机科学的技术和算法，旁及地学、古气候学等, 研究物种和种群的遗传变异及表观遗传变异、遗传谱系, 探讨生物多样性演化、生物地理演化、物种分化、生态适应等的生态学和进化生物学机制。
target_text: Molecular biology uses evolutionary biology theory, experimental and technical methods of molecular biology and genomics, statistical and mathematical methods of analysis, through computer science techniques and algorithms, back-to-back geology, ancient climatology, etc., to study the genetic variability of species and species and visual genetic variability, genetic spectrometry, ecological and evolutionary biological mechanisms of biodiversity evolution, biogeographic evolution, species differentiation, ecological adaptation, etc.
title: 分子生態學

source_text:
发展历史
分子生態學开始于1950年代。是随着DNA双螺旋结构的发现，分子水平的群体遗传学研究得以开展，相继出现了同工酶电泳、限制性内切酶酶切技术、分子克隆和DNA测序技术等，使遗传变异研究得以实现, 并可以在群体水平进行检测。分子进化的中性理论的提出，引发了适应性进化和中性进化的争论，推动了群体遗传学和分子进化研究，分子钟假说的提出和谱系进化关系重建理论、方法、算法和软件的出现, 进一步促进了分子进化和分子群体遗传学研究的发展。
target_text: Development history Molecular biology began in the 1950s. As a result of the discovery of the DNA dual helix structure, group genetics studies at molecular levels were carried out, followed by co-workase electrophoresis, restrictive inner-chip enzyme cutting techniques, molecular cloning, and DNA sequencing techniques, which enabled genetic mutation studies to be made possible and could be tested at group level. The introduction of neutral theory of molecular evolution led to arguments about adaptive evolution and neutral evolution, stimulating research into group genetics and molecular evolution, and the emergence of theory, methodology, algorithms and software to re-establish the evolutionary relationship between molecular bells and spectrometry, further promoting the development of molecular evolution and genetic research in molecular groups.
title: 分子生態學

source_text:
工作站（）是一种高端的微型计算机，它是为专业领域而设计的，主要供个人用户使用，提供了较主流普通个人计算机更高的性能，它们配置了专业级或高性能的CPU和GPU，较大的内存容量和大量的接囗。这使它们的多任务处理能力以及图型处理能力非常优越。
另外，工作站一词也被用来指代连接到服务器的终端。
target_text: Workstations () are high-end microcomputers designed for professional fields, primarily for individual users, providing higher performance than mainstream general personal computers, equipped with higher-level or high-performance CPUs and GPUs, with larger memory capacity and a large number of connections. This makes their multitasking and graphic processing capabilities very superior.
title: 工作站

source_text: 2003年10月21日，他們在美國加里福尼亞州帕洛瑪天文台的48英寸塞缪尔·奥斯钦望远镜作例行觀察。由于阋神星移动缓慢，小组的图像自动分析软件没有发现该星体。當時为了降低假阳性的比例，软件把移动低于1.5弧秒/小时的物体排除在外。赛德娜发现的时候其移动是1.75弧秒/小时。受此启发，研究小组用更低一点的角度移动限制，再次分析了以前的数据，并人工排查。2005年1月，再次分析的数据才揭示了阋神星在背景星空下的缓慢移动。
target_text: On October 21, 2003, they routinely observed the 48-inch Samuel Oschin telescope at the Paloma Observatory in California, United States. Due to the slow movement of the star, the group’s image autoanalyzing software did not find it. In order to reduce the false positive ratio, the software excluded objects that moved less than 1.5 arcs/hours. Sedna discovered that the move was 1.75 arc seconds/hour.
title: 阋神星

source_text:
電腦輸入
在中國大陸通行的计算机QWERTY格式键盘的中文拼音输入法中，间隔号的位置依输入法的不同而不同，但最常见的是数字键2的上档位置和“`”键（位于数字键1左侧）。由于中国大陆通行的计算机大都采用美式键盘，键盘本身并没有表示间隔号的位置，因此一般人，包括一些论坛和网络媒体在输入非汉字文化圈人名时会以连字符“-”代替间隔号。
target_text: Computer input The location of the spacing numbers varies according to the input method in the Chinese spelling of the computer QWERTY format keyboard, which is used in mainland China, but the most common are the upper position of the digital key 2 and the "`" key (on the left side of the digital key). Since most computers in mainland China use American keyboards, keyboards themselves do not indicate the location of the spacing numbers, general people, including a number of forums and network media, use hyphens "-" instead of the separator when they enter the names of non-Hanja cultural circles.
title: 间隔号

source_text:
描述
ABI涵盖了各种细节，如：
数据类型的大小、布局和对齐;
调用约定（控制着函数的参数如何传送以及如何接受返回值），例如，是所有的参数都通过栈传递，还是部分参数通过寄存器传递；哪个寄存器用于哪个函数参数；通过栈传递的第一个函数参数是最先push到栈上还是最后；
系统调用的编码和一个应用如何向操作系统进行系统调用；
以及在一个完整的操作系统ABI中，目标文件的二进制格式、程序库等等。
target_text: Description ABI covers a variety of details, such as: size, layout and alignment of data types; call protocol (how the parameters controlling the function are transmitted and how the return value is accepted), e.g. whether all parameters are passed through the stack or part of the parameter is passed through the depositor; which depositor is used for which function parameter; whether the first function parameter is passed through the pad is first and last; how the system code and the application are called to the operating system; and, in a complete operating system ABI, the binary format of the target file, the library, etc.
title: 应用二进制接口

source_text:
ABI不同于应用程序接口（API），API定义了源代码和库之间的接口，因此同样的代码可以在支持这个API的任何系统中编译，然而ABI允许编译好的目标代码在使用兼容ABI的系统中无需改动就能运行。
在Unix风格的操作系统中，存在很多运行在同一硬件平台上互相相关但是不兼容的操作系统（尤其是Intel 80386兼容系统）。有一些努力尝试标准化ABI，以减少销售商将程序移植到其他系统时所需的工作。然而，直到现在还没有很成功的例子，虽然Linux标准化工作组正在为Linux做这方面的努力。
target_text: ABI differs from the application interface (API), API defines the interface between the source code and the library, so the same code can be compiled in any system that supports API, yet ABI allows the compiled target code to run without change in a system that is compatible with ABI. In Unix-style operating systems, there are many incompatible operating systems (in particular the Intel 80386 compatible system) operating on the same hardware platform. There are some attempts to standardize ABI to reduce the work required by the vendor to transplant the program to other systems.
title: 应用二进制接口

source_text:
EABI
嵌入式应用二进制接口指定了文件格式、数据类型、寄存器使用、堆积组织优化和在一个嵌入式软件中的参数的标准约定。开发者使用自己的汇编语言也可以使用EABI作为与兼容的编译器生成的汇编语言的接口。
支持EABI的编译器创建的目标文件可以和使用类似编译器产生的代码兼容，这样允许开发者链接一个由不同编译器产生的库。EABI与关于通用计算机的ABI的主要区别是应用程序代码中允许使用特权指令，不需要动态链接（有时是禁止的），和更紧凑的堆栈帧组织用来节省内存。
广泛使用EABI的有Power PC和ARM.
target_text: EABI Embedded application binary interfaces specify standard protocols for file formats, data types, server use, stacking organization optimization and parameters in an embedded software. Developers can also use EABI in their own compilation language as an interface to the compilation language generated by compatible compilers. Target files created in support of EABI compilers can be compatible with codes generated by similar compilers, allowing developers to link to a library generated by different compilers. The main difference between EABI and ABI on a universal computer is that the application code allows the use of privileged instructions, without the need for dynamic links (sometimes prohibited) and more compact stacking organizations to save memory.
title: 应用二进制接口

source_text: 互联网分组交换协议（Internetwork Packet Exchange，IPX）是由Novell公司提出的运行于OSI模型第三层的协议，标准为RFC 1132。具有可路由的特性。IPX的地址分为网络地址和主机地址，网络地址由管理员分配，主机地址为MAC地址。作为 Novell NetWare 的内置协议，IPX 协议曾在80年代末到90年代中期十分流行，成为当时网际互联的主流协议之一。
target_text: The Internet Group Exchange Agreement (Internet Packet Exchange, IPX) is an agreement put forward by Novell to operate on the third floor of the OSI model, with the standard RFC 1132. The address of IPX is classified as a network address and host address. The address of IPX is assigned by the administrator and the address of the host is MAC. As a built-in protocol of Novell NetWare, the IPX protocol was popular from the late 1980s to the mid-1990s and became one of the main protocols of the Internet connection at that time.
title: 互联网分组交换协议

source_text: IPX的一大优势是IPX驱动程序占用内存小，这对于MS-DOS和Windows 95版本十分重要。IPX另一个优势是客户端计算机的配置简单。然而IPX对于诸如因特网等大型网络来说不能很好地扩展，因此随着互联网的繁荣使得TCP/IP普及，IPX的使用量下降。计算机可以运行多个网络协议，组成多种网络，因此几乎所有的IPX站点都会同时运行TCP/IP协议族，使其连接到Internet。
target_text: One of the major advantages of IPX is that the IPX driver has a small memory, which is important for MS-DOS and Windows 95 versions. Another advantage of IPX is that the configuration of the client-end computer is simple. However, IPX does not extend well to large networks, such as the Internet, and therefore the use of IPX declines as the Internet flourishes. Computers can run multiple network protocols and form multiple networks, so almost all IPX sites run simultaneously the TCP/IP community, connecting it to the Internet.
title: 互联网分组交换协议

source_text: Lua是在1993年由罗伯托·耶鲁萨林斯希、Luiz Henrique de Figueiredo和Waldemar Celes创建的，他们当时是巴西的里约热内卢天主教大学的计算机图形技术组（Tecgraf）成员。Lua的先驱是数据描述/配置语言“SOL”（简单对象语言）和“DEL”（数据录入语言）。他们于1992年–1993年在Tecgraf独立开发了需要增加灵活性的两个不同项目（都是用于工程应用的交互式图形程序）。在SOL和DEL中缺乏很多控制流结构，需要向它们增加完全的编程能力。
target_text: Lua was created in 1993 by Roberto Jerusarinshi, Luiz Henrique de Figueiredo and Waldemar Celes, who were members of the Tecgraf Group of Computer Graphics Technologies of the Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Lua was pioneered by the data description/configuration language “SOL” (simple target language) and “DEL” (data entry language). They independently developed two different projects in Tecgraf in 1992-1993 (all interactive graphic programs for engineering applications).
title: Lua

source_text:
语法和语义
Lua是一种多重编程范型的程式设计语言：它只提供了很小的一个特性集合来满足不同编程范型的需要，而不是为某种特定的编程范型提供繁杂的特性支援。例如，Lua并不提供继承这个特性，但是你可以用元表格来模拟它。诸如命名空间、类这些概念都没有在语言基本特性中实现，但是我们可以用表格结构（Lua唯一提供的复杂数据结构）轻易模拟。正是提供了这些基本的元特性，我们可以任意的对语言进行自需的改造。
target_text: Syntax and semantic Lua is a multiprogramming model programming language: it provides only a small collection of characteristics to meet the needs of different programming paradigms, rather than a complex feature support for a particular programming paradigm. For example, Lua does not provide for succession to this feature, but you can model it with metasheets. These concepts, such as naming space, classes, are not realized in the basic features of languages, but we can easily simulate them with a table structure (the only complex data structure that Lua provides). It is these basic meta-specific features that we can adapt languages at will.
title: Lua

source_text: 还可以使用Lua API写扩展模块。扩展模块是通过向Lua脚本提供本地设施，用来扩展解释器的功能的共享对象。从Lua方面看来，这种模块出现为一个名字空间表格，它持有自己的函数和变量。Lua脚本可以使用require装载扩展模块，就像用Lua自身写的模块一样。一组仍在增长中的叫做“rock”的模块可以通过叫做的软件包管理器获取到，类似于CPAN、RubyGems和。对大多数流行的编程语言包括其他脚本语言，都存在预先写好的Lua绑定。对于C++，有许多基于模板的方式和一些自动绑定生成器。
target_text: The extension module can also be used using the Lua API extension module. The extension module is used to expand the common object of the interpreter function by providing local facilities to the Lua script. From Lua ' s point of view, the module appears as a name space table with its own functions and variables. Lua scripts can use the require loading extension module, like the one written by Lua itself. A set of modules called "rock" that are still growing can be obtained through the so-called package manager, similar to CPAN, RubyGems and others. For most popular programming languages, including other script languages, there are pre-written Lua bindings. For C++, there are many template-based approaches and some automatic binding generators.
title: Lua

source_text: 应用在视频游戏开发中，Lua被程序员广泛的用作脚本语言，主要由于它的可感知到的易于嵌入、快速执行，和短学习曲线。在2003年，GameDev.net组织的一次投票，说明了Lua是游戏编程的最流行脚本语言。在2012年1月12日，Lua被《》宣布为编程工具范畴的Front Line奖2011年度获奖者。大量非游戏应用也出于可扩展性而使用Lua，比如TeX排版设置语言实现LuaTeX、键-值数据库Redis、文本编辑器Neovim和web服务器Nginx。
target_text: In the development of video games, Lua is widely used as script language by programmers, mainly because of its perceptible ease of embedding, rapid execution, and short learning curves. In 2003, GameDev.net organized a vote explaining that Lua is the most popular script language in the programming of games. On 12 January 2012, Lua was declared a front Line award winner in 2011 as a programming tool. A large number of non-playing applications were also used to achieve LuaTeX, key-value database Redis, text editor Neovim, and Web server Nginx, using e.g. TeX layout setting languages.
title: Lua

source_text:
天城文鍵盤布局INSCRIPT
InScript是給天城文的標準鍵盤佈局。它內建於所有主要操作系统中。Microsoft Windows支持InScript佈局（使用Mangal字體），它可以被用來輸入Unicode天城文字符。InScript在一些觸控螢幕手機上也可獲得。打字機
這種佈局在没有計算機或计算机不常用的時代用在手動打字機上。出於向後兼容性一些錄入工具如Indic IME仍提供這種佈局。
target_text: The skyscraper layout INSCRIPT InScript is a standard keyboard layout for the skyscraper. It is built in all major operating systems. Microsoft Windows supports the InScript layout (using Mangal characters), which can be used to enter Unicode sky characters. InScript is also available on some of the screen-touched phones. Typewriters such layouts are used on hand typewriters without a calculator or a computer that is not commonly used. Some entry tools from back-compatibility, such as Indic IME, still provide such layouts.
title: 天城文

source_text: 语义网（英语：Semantic Web）是由万维网联盟的蒂姆·伯纳斯-李（Tim Berners-Lee）在1998年提出的一个概念，它的核心是：通过给万维网上的文档（如: HTML文档）添加能够被计算机所理解的语义（元数据），从而使整个互联网成为一个通用的信息交换媒介。语义万维网通过使用标准、置标语言和相关的处理工具来扩展万维网的能力。不过语意网概念实际上是基于很多已有技术的，也依赖于后来和text-and-markup与知识表现的综合。
target_text: Semantic Web is a concept put forward in 1998 by Tim Berners-Lee of the World Wide Web Alliance, which focuses on making the entire Internet a universal information clearing house by adding synonyms (metadata) that can be understood by computers to the documents on the World Wide Web (e.g. HTML files). The semantic World Wide Web expands its capacity through the use of standards, sign language and related processing tools.
title: 语义网

source_text: 特洛伊木马（Trojan Horse）简称木马，在计算机领域中指的是一种后门程序，是黑客用来盗取其他用户的個人訊息，甚至是远程控制对方的電子設備而加密制作，然后通过传播或者骗取目标执行该程序，以达到盗取密码等各种数据资料等目的。和病毒相似，木马程序有很强的隐秘性，會随著操作系统启动而启动。
target_text: Trojan Horse, for example, refers in the computer field to a back door program that hackers use to steal personal messages from other users, or even to encrypt, even by remote control of each other’s electronic devices, and then executes the program by disseminating or defrauding targets for various data items, such as the theft of passwords. Similar to the virus, the wooden horse program is highly secretive and will be activated with the start-up of the operating system.
title: 特洛伊木马 (电脑)

source_text: “木马”这一名称来源于希腊神话特洛伊戰爭的特洛伊木馬。攻城的希腊联军佯装撤退后留下一只木马，特洛伊人将其当作战利品带回城内。当特洛伊人为胜利而庆祝时，从木马中出来了一队希腊軍隊，他们悄悄打开城门，放进了城外的军队，最终攻克了特洛伊城。计算机中所说的木马与病毒一样也是一种有害的程序，其特征与特洛伊木马一样具有伪装性，表面上没有危害、甚至还附有使用者需要的功能，却会在使用者不经意间，对使用者的计算机系统产生破坏或窃取数据，特别是使用者的各种账户及口令等重要且需要保密的信息，甚至控制使用者的计算机系統。
target_text: When the Trojans celebrated their victory, a team of Greek troops came out of the horses, quietly opened the gates of the city, entered the army outside the city, and eventually seized the city. The wooden horses in the computer, like the virus, were a harmful procedure, characterized by the same hypocrisy as the Trojans, which appeared to be harmless and even accompanied by the functionality needed by the user, but which inadvertently destroyed or stole data from the user's computer system, especially important and confidential information such as user accounts and passwords, and even controlled the user's computer system.
title: 特洛伊木马 (电脑)

source_text: 第五代，驱动级木马。驱动级木马多数都使用大量的Rootkit技术来达到在深度隐藏的效果，并深入到内核空间的，感染后针对杀毒软件和网络防火墙进行攻击，可将系统SSDT初始化，导致杀毒防火墙失去效应。有的驱动级木马可驻留BIOS，并且很难查杀。第六代，随着身份认证UsbKey和杀毒软件主动防御的兴起，黏虫技术类型和特殊反显技术类型木马逐渐开始系统化。前者主要以盗取和篡改用户敏感信息为主，后者以动态口令和硬证书攻击为主。
target_text: The fifth generation, the driver-level carousel, most of them using a large amount of rootkit technology to achieve hidden effects in depth and deep into the inner nuclear space. In the event of infection, an attack on poison-killing software and network firewalls could initialize the system SSDT, leading to a loss of effect. Some of the drivers were able to stay in BIOS, and it was difficult to detect it. The sixth generation, with the rise of identification-certified UsbKey and anti-toxic software active defence, was gradually beginning to systematize the type of sticky technology and the type of special anti-reflection technology. The former mainly focused on the theft and manipulation of user-sensitive information, while the latter was dominated by dynamic oral and hard-certifical attacks.

source_text: 在计算机领域，绝大多数中央处理器（CPU）以MHz或GHz标识它们的时钟频率。这一数值是指CPU的主时钟脉冲信号的频率。时钟脉冲信号是一种数字信号，以方波的形式出现，在高电平和低电平中不断切换。赫兹已成为普通大众接受的测量CPU性能的主要测量单位，但许多专家并不认同。他们认为这是一种可以的评价方式。有报道指出，由于不同的设计方式，某些CPU可以在一个周期中处理更多指令，使它快于其他具有更高时钟频率的CPU。除了时钟频率以外，还有晶体管数量、缓存大小和总线速度等许多其他影响CPU性能的因素。对于家用的个人计算机而言，CPU的时钟频率从1970年代的1 MHz到IBM POWER的6 GHz不等。
target_text: In the computer field, most central processors (CPUs) identify their clock frequencies by MHz or GHz. This value refers to the frequency of primary CPU clock pulse signals. The clock pulse signal is a digital signal that appears in the form of a square wave, which is constantly changing in both high and low level. Hertz has become the main measurement unit for measuring CPU performance accepted by the general public, but many experts do not agree with it. It has been reported that, as a result of different design methods, some CPUs can process more instructions in one cycle, making them faster than others with higher clock frequencies. In addition to clock frequencies, there are many other factors affecting CPU performance, such as the number of crystal tubes, the size of buffers and the rate of the total line. For personal computers used, CPU clock frequencies vary from 1 MHz to 6 GHz in IBM PWOER in the 1970s.

source_text:
模型
模型包含着应用的状态，状态可能是临时的也可能是长久性保存在数据库中的。需要注意的是模型不仅包含数据，而且包含数据代表的逻辑。在Rails中，模型通常是由一些代表关系数据库中RDBMS表的类组成的。在Rails中，模型类是通过Active Record模式进行处理的。一般来说，程序员要做的是继承ActiveRecord类，同时程序会自动计算出要使用哪个RDBMS表，这个表有哪些列。表与表之间的关系通过简单的命令来指明。
target_text: Model Model The model contains the state of application, which may be temporary or permanent in the database. What needs to be noted is that the model contains not only data, but also the logic of data representation. In Raws, the model is usually composed of the categories of RDBMS tables in some representative relationship databases. In Raws, the model class is handled through the Active Record mode. Generally, the programmer is going to inherit the ActiveRecord class, while the program automatically calculates which RDBMS tables are to be used. The relationship between the table and the table is identified by simple commands.

source_text: 用于自动DNA测序的链末端终止法：原初的方法須以荧光标记DNA的引物端，以便在测序凝胶板上确定DNA色带的位置。改进的方法分别以荧光标记作为链终止剂的４种双脱氧核苷酸（ddTBP），电泳结束后不同长度的DNA分子彼此分开，经紫外线照射，４种已标记的双脱氧核苷酸发出不同波长的荧光，分析荧光光谱便可以分辨出DNA序列。DNA探测：溴化乙啶（EtBr）是荧光染料，当它在溶液中自由改变构型时，只能发出很弱的荧光；当它嵌入核酸双链的碱基对之间与DNA分子结合后，便可以发出很强的荧光。因此在凝胶电泳中，一般加入溴化乙啶將DNA染色。DNA微阵列（生物芯片）：需要以荧光标记基因组探针，最后通过荧光信号确定靶标序列。免疫学中的免疫荧光检查法：以荧光标记抗体，从而可以根据荧光的分布和形态确定抗原的部位和性质。流式细胞仪（又称荧光激活细胞分选器，FACS）：以荧光标记样本细胞，再用激光束激发使之产生特定的荧光，然后用光学系统检测并将信号传输到计算机分析得到细胞相应的各种特性。荧光技术还用于探测和分析DNA及蛋白质的分子结构，尤其是较复杂的生物大分子。水母发光蛋白（英語：Aequorin）最早是从海洋生物維多利亞多管發光水母中分离出来的。当它与鈣离子共存时可发出绿色荧光。这一性质已经应用于实时观察细胞内鈣离子的流动。

2015年5月，IBM在量子運算上取得兩項關鍵性突破，開發出四量子位原型電路（Four Quantum Bit Circuit），成為未來10年量子電腦基礎。另外一項是，可以同時發現兩項量子的錯誤型態，分別為Bit-Flip（位元翻轉）與Phase-Flip（相位翻轉），不同於過往在同一時間內只能找出一種錯誤型態，使量子電腦運作更為穩定。2016年8月，美国马里兰大学学院市分校发明世界上第一台由5量子位元组成的可编程量子计算机。

source_text: 恶意软件（），又称「流氓软件」，一般是指通過網路、可攜式存儲裝置等途徑散播的，故意對個人電腦、伺服器、智慧型裝置、電腦網路等造成隱私或機密資料外洩、系統損害（包括但不限於系統崩潰等）、資料丟失等非使用預期故障及資安問題，並且試圖以各種方式阻擋使用者移除它們，如同「流氓」一樣的軟件。惡意軟體的形式包括二進位可執行檔、腳本、活動內容等。就定義來說，電腦病毒、電腦蠕蟲、特洛伊木馬、勒索軟體、間諜軟體、恐嚇軟體、利用漏洞執行的軟體、甚至是一些廣告軟體，也被囊括在惡意軟體的分類中。不過，無意的非使用預期的電腦裝置故障，則一般視作軟體臭蟲（software bug）。
target_text: Malicious software () or " hooligan software" is generally disseminated via the Internet, portable storage devices, which intentionally cause private or confidential data leaks to personal computers, servers, smart devices, computer networks, etc., system damage (including but not limited to system breakdowns), non-use defaults and equity problems such as data loss, and attempts to block users from removing them in various ways, such as "rogue" software. 强制安装：指在未明确提示用户或未经用户许可的情况下，在用户计算机或其他终端上安装软件的行为。
难以卸载：指未提供通用的卸载方式，或在不受其他软件影响、人为破坏的情况下，卸载后仍活动程序的行为。
浏览器劫持：指未经用户许可，修改用户浏览器或其他相关设置，迫使用户访问特定网站或导致用户无法正常上网的行为。
广告弹出：指未明确提示用户或未经用户许可的情况下，利用安装在用户计算机或其他终端上的软件弹出广告的行为。
恶意收集用户信息：指未明确提示用户或未经用户许可，恶意收集用户信息的行为。
恶意卸载：指未明确提示用户、未经用户许可，或误导、欺骗用户卸载非恶意软件的行为。
恶意捆绑：指在软件中捆绑已被认定为恶意软件的行为。
其他侵犯用户知情权、选择权的恶意行为。
target_text: Compulsive installation: The act of installing software on a user's computer or other terminals without a clear indication to the user or a user's permission; The difficulty of unloading: the failure to provide a common mode of unloading or, without the influence of other software or human sabotage, the fact that the program is still active after unloading; Browser hijacking: the act of modifying a user's browser or other related settings to force users to access a particular site or to prevent the user from accessing normal Internet access without a user's permission; Advertising: the act of using software installed on a user's computer or other terminal without a clear indication or user's permission; malicious collection of user information: the act of collecting user information maliciously without a clear indication to the user or without user's permission; malicious unloading: the act of not clearly indicating the user, without user's permission, or misleading or deceiving the user to unload non-motivated software; malicious binding: the act of binding a user in the software that has been identified as malicious software; other malicious act of violating the user's right to know, choice.
title: 恶意软件

source_text: 随着宽带互联网的普及，恶意软件的设计越来越多地以盈利为目的。自2003年以来，大多数广泛传播的病毒和蠕虫多用于控制用户的计算机以达到非法目的。被感染的“僵尸计算机”可以被用来发送垃圾邮件，“走私”儿童色情相关的违禁数据，或以分布式拒绝服务攻击作为一种勒索形式。
target_text: Since 2003, most widely disseminated viruses and worms have been used to control users’ computers for illicit purposes. Infected “zombie computers” can be used to send spam, “smuggling” child pornography-related prohibited data, or distributed denial-of-service attacks as a form of extortion.
title: 恶意软件

source_text: 间谍软件是用于监控用户网页浏览，显示未经请求的广告，或重定向营销收入的程序。虽然不会像病毒一样传播，但它们通过系统的安全漏洞进行安装，并能够被隐藏起来与其他不相关软件进行捆绑打包安装。勒索软件是在用户支付赎金前，阻止用户访问某些相关文件的程序。勒索软件有两种变体，分别是加密勒索和“储物柜”勒索。“储物柜”勒索软件只锁定计算机系统，不加密其内容，而加密勒索软件锁定系统，并加密其内容。
target_text: Spy software is a program used to monitor user web page browsing, displaying unsolicited advertising, or redirecting marketing revenues. While it is not likely to spread like a virus, it is installed through a system of security holes and can be hidden in a bundled package installation with other unrelated software. Extortion software is a program that prevents users from accessing certain related documents before the user pays ransom. Extortion software has two variants: encryption extortion and “storage” extortion.
title: 恶意软件

source_text: 除了以犯罪形式盈利，恶意软件还可以用于出于政治/商业动机的破坏活动。例如，震网病毒(Stuxnet)的设计用于破坏特定的工业设备。某些被称为“computer killing”(文译：杀死计算机)的攻击能用于关闭大型计算机网络，大规模删除文件，破坏主引导记录。例如，索尼影业(Sony Pictures Entertainment)和沙特阿美(Saudi Aramco)于2014年11月25日就遭受了类似的攻击。
target_text: In addition to profiting in the form of a crime, malicious software can also be used for politically/commercially motivated sabotage. For example, Stuxnet is designed to destroy specific industrial equipment. Some attacks called “computer killing” can be used to shut down large computer networks, large-scale removal of documents, and destruction of master-guided records. For example, the Sony Pictures Industry and Saudi Aramco were subjected to similar attacks on 25 November 2014.

source_text: 与RAID 5相比，RAID 6增加第二个独立的奇偶校验信息块。两个独立的奇偶系统使用不同的算法，数据的可靠性非常高，任意两块磁盘同时失效时不会影响数据完整性。RAID 6需要分配给奇偶校验信息更大的磁盘空间和额外的校验计算，相对于RAID 5有更大的IO操作量和计算量，其“写性能”强烈取决于具体的实现方案，因此RAID 6通常不会通过软件方式来实现，而更可能通过硬件方式实现。
target_text: RAID 6 adds a second independent odd check information block compared to RAID 5. The two stand-alone doll systems use different algorithms, the data are highly reliable, and any two disks fail without affecting their integrity. RAID 6 needs to be assigned larger disk space and extra calibration calculations, with greater IO operations and computations compared to RAID 5, whose “writing performance” is strongly dependent on specific realization options, so RAID 6 is often not achieved by software, but more likely by hardware.
title: RAID

title: ISCSI

source_text: 操作系统会将SAN视为一组LUN，并且在LUN上维护自己的文件系统。这些不能在多个操作系统/主机之间进行共享的本地文件系统，具有非常高的可靠性和十分广泛的应用。如果两个独立的本地文件系统存在于一个共享的LUN上，它们彼此没有任何机制来知道对方的存在，没有类似的机制，所以可能发生数据丢失的情况。因此，在主机之间通过SAN共享数据，需要一些复杂的高级解决方案，例如SAN文件系统或者计算机集群。撇开这些问题，SAN对于提高存储能力的应用有很大帮助，因为多个服务器可以共享磁盘阵列上的存储空间。SAN的一项典型应用是需要高速块级别访问的数据操作服务器，比如电子邮件服务器、数据库、高利用率的文件服务器等。
target_text: The operating system sees AN as a group of LUNs and maintains its own file system on LUN. These local file systems, which cannot be shared between multiple operating systems/hosts, have very high reliability and extensive applications. If two separate local file systems exist on a shared LUN, they have no mechanism to know each other ' s existence and no similar mechanism to do so, there may be a loss of data. Therefore, sharing data between hosts through SON requires sophisticated advanced solutions, such as SAS file systems or computer clusters.

source_text: CPU的缓存曾经是用在超级计算机上的一种高级技术，不过现今電腦上使用的的AMD或Intel微处理器都在芯片内部集成了大小不等的数据缓存和指令缓存，通称为L1缓存（L1 Cache即Level 1 On-die Cache，第一级片上高速緩衝存儲器）；而比L1更大容量的L2缓存曾经被放在CPU外部（主板或者CPU接口卡上），但是现在已经成为CPU内部的标准组件；更昂贵的CPU会配备比L2缓存还要大的L3缓存（level 3 On-die Cache第三級高速緩衝存儲器）。
target_text: CPU caches used to be an advanced technology on supercomputers, although the AMD or Intel microprocessors currently used on computers have been assembled within the chip into data caches and command caches of varying sizes, commonly known as L1 caches (L1 Cache or Level 1 On-die Cache, high-speed buffers on the first film); while L2 caches with greater capacity than L1 were placed outside the CPU (mainboard or CPU interface), they are now standard components within the CPU; the more expensive CPUs will be equipped with L3 caches larger than the L2 cache (Lvel 3 On-die Cache, high-speed buffers on the third level).
title: 缓存

source_text: 主存容量远大于CPU缓存，磁盘容量远大于主存，因此无论是哪一层次的缓存都面临一个同样的问题：当容量有限的缓存的空闲空间全部用完后，又有新的内容需要添加进缓存时，如何挑选并舍弃原有的部分内容，从而腾出空间放入这些新的内容。解决这个问题的算法有几种，如最久未使用算法（LFU）、先进先出算法（FIFO）、最近最少使用算法（LRU）、非最近使用算法（NMRU）等，这些算法在不同层次的缓存上执行时拥有不同的效率和代价，需根据具体场合选择最合适的一种。
target_text: Since the master capacity is much greater than that of the CPU cache, and the disk capacity is much greater than that of the master, the same problem arises for any level of cache: when all the free space available for the limited capacity cache is exhausted and new elements need to be added to the cache, how to select and discard some of the original contents, thus freeing the space from the new content. There are several algorithms that address this issue, such as the longest non-use algorithm (LFU), the advanced first-out algorithm (FIFO), the recent least-use algorithm (LRU), the non-recent use algorithm (NMRU), etc., which have different efficiencies and costs when implemented at different levels of the cache, and which need to be chosen according to the specific context.
title: 缓存

As this method is located in the Object category, programmers are able to use cloning methods in all categories defined as Java (although, for normal use, it needs to be adapted in accordance with its application to different levels).

target_text: The programming paradigm provides and determines the programmer's view of the program's execution. For example, in object-oriented programming, programmers consider the program to be the object of a series of interactions, and because of differences in methodology, object-oriented programming is divided into a sequence based on class programming and prototype programming, while a program in a function programming is regarded as a non-state function.
title: 编程范型

source_text: 很多编程范型已经被熟知他们禁止使用哪些技术，同时允许使用哪些。例如，纯函数式编程不允许有副作用；大部分高階程序語言都期望使用者進行结构化编程而避免非结构化编程，其中结构化编程不允许使用 goto。可能是因为这个原因，新的范型常常被那些习惯于较早的风格的人认为是教条主义或过分严格。然而，这样避免某些技术反而更加证明了关于程序正确性，或仅仅是理解它的行为的法则，而不用限制程序语言的一般性。
target_text: Many programming paradigms are well known about which technologies they prohibit and which are allowed to use. For example, pure function programming does not allow side effects; most high-level programming languages expect users to structure programming to avoid unstructured programming, which does not allow the use of goo. For this reason, the new paradigm is often perceived by those who are accustomed to earlier styles as dogmatic or overly restrictive. This, however, avoids certain techniques that more evidence the law on procedural correctness or merely understanding its behaviour, rather than limiting the general nature of procedural language.
title: 编程范型

source_text: 编程范型和编程语言之间的关系可能十分复杂，由于一个编程语言可以支持多种范型。例如，C++ 设计时，支持过程式编程、面向对象编程以及泛型编程。然而，设计师和程序员们要考虑如何使用这些范型元素来构建一个程序。一个人可以用 C++ 写出一个完全过程化的程序，另一个人也可以用 C++ 写出一个纯粹的面向对象程序，甚至还有人可以写出杂揉了两种范型的程序。
target_text: The relationship between programming paradigms and programming languages can be complex, because one programming language can support a variety of paradigms. For example, C++ design supports process programming, object-oriented programming, and generic programming. However, designers and programmers have to consider how to use these paradigms to construct a program. One can write a fully processable program with C++, and another can write a purely object-oriented program with C++, and even one can write two model programs.
title: 编程范型

source_text: 数据冗余发生在数据库系统中，指的是一个字段在多个表里重复出现。举个例子，如果每条客户购买商品的信息都连带记录了客户自身的信息，这样的数据冗余可能造成不一致，因为客户自身的信息可能不一样。 数据冗余会导致数据异常和损坏，一般来说设计上应该被避免。 数据库规范化防止了冗余而且不浪费存储容量。 适当的使用外键可以使得数据冗余和异常降到最低。但是，如果考虑效率和便利，有时候也会设计冗余数据，而不考虑数据被破坏的风险。
target_text: Data redundancy occurs in database systems, meaning that a field is repeated in multiple tables. For example, if each customer buys goods with information from the client itself, such data redundancy can be inconsistent, because the client’s own information may be different.
title: 数据冗余

source_text: 虚拟机（），在计算机科学中的体系结构裡，是指一种特殊的软件，可以在计算机平台和終端用戶之间建立一种环境，而終端用戶则是基于虚拟机这个软件所建立的环境来操作其它软件。虚拟机（VM）是计算机系统的仿真器，通过软件模拟具有完整硬件系统功能的、运行在一个完全隔离环境中的完整计算机系统，能提供物理计算机的功能。
target_text: Virtual machines (VMs), in the architecture of computer science, refer to a special software that creates an environment between computer platforms and end users, while end users operate other software based on the environment created by the software. Virtual machines (VMs) are imitators of computer systems that provide the functionality of physical computers by simulations of complete hardware systems that operate in a completely segregated environment.
title: 虛擬機器

source_text:
系统虚拟机（也称为全虚拟化虚拟机）可代替物理计算机。它提供了运行整个操作系统所需的功能。虚拟机监视器（hypervisor）共享和管理硬件，从而允许有相互隔离但存在于同一物理机器上的多个环境。现代虚拟机监视器使用虚拟化专用硬件（主要是主机CPU）来进行硬件辅助虚拟化。
程序虚拟机 被设计用来在与平台无关的环境中执行计算机程序。
target_text: A system virtual machine (also known as a fully virtualized virtual machine) can replace a physical computer. It provides the functionality needed to run the entire operating system. Virtual machine monitors (hypervisor) share and manage hardware, allowing multiple environments that are isolated but present on the same physical machine. Modern virtual monitor uses virtualized specialized hardware (mainly host CPU) for hardware-assisted virtualization.
title: 虛擬機器

source_text:
定义
虚拟机最初由波佩克与戈德堡定义为有效的、独立的真实机器的副本。当前包括跟任何真实机器无关的虚拟机。例子：
用Java编写的程序可以通过对Java运行环境（JRE）软件发命令获得服务，取得期望的结果。透过提供这种服务，JRE起到了虚拟机的作用。程序不必为特定的操作系统或硬件编写。
target_text: The virtual machine was originally defined by Popek and Goldberg as a true, independent machine. It currently includes a virtual machine that has nothing to do with any real machine. Example: A program written by Java can obtain the desired result by issuing an order to Java's operating environment (JRE) software. By providing this service, JRE acts as a virtual machine. The program does not have to be written for a specific operating system or hardware.
title: 虛擬機器

source_text: 虚拟机根据它们的运用和与直接机器的相关性分为两大类。「系統虚拟机」提供一个可以运行完整操作系统的完整系统平台。「程序虚拟机」則为运行单个计算机程序设计，这意味它支持单个进程。虚拟机的一个本质特点是运行在虚拟机上的软件被局限在虚拟机提供的资源里，也就是說它不能超出虚拟世界。「作業系統層虛擬化」不提供完整作業系統環境，將母機內核分給多個獨立空間的應用程式，不同於系統虛擬機需要運行完整作業系統，也不像程序虚拟机運行特定程式語言。
target_text: Virtual machines are divided into two categories depending on their applications and their relevance to direct machines. The System Virtual Machine provides a complete system platform that can run complete operating systems. The Program Virtual Machine is designed to run individual computer programs, which means that it supports individual processes. One of the essence features of virtual machines is that software operating on virtual machines is limited to the resources provided by virtual machines, that is, it cannot go beyond the virtual world.
title: 虛擬機器

source_text:
技术（硬件的模拟）
基于这种虚拟机，用户可以运行任何操作系统，比如可以在他们“个人的”虚拟电脑上运行兩個不同的操作系统，这也被称为“访客”（guests）。这样的话，新版的实验性操作系统就可以与旧版的较稳定版本一同在单独的虚拟机上运行。这个过程甚至可以重复（recursive）；IBM就在运行于旧版的虚拟机上的虚拟机上调试它新版的虚拟机操作系统——VM。
target_text: On the basis of this virtual machine, users can run any operating system, such as two different operating systems on their "personal" virtual computers, also known as "guests." In this way, the new version of the experimental operating system can run on a separate virtual machine with the more stable version of the old version. This process can even be repeated (recursive); IBM is running its new version of the virtual operating system on a virtual machine running on an old version of the virtual machine — VM.
title: 虛擬機器

source_text: 这个概念的一个早期使用者就是IBM大型计算机上的「VM/CMS time-sharing」产品，该产品使用的交互式计算单用户操作系统——CMS（Conversational Monitor System），相对来说比较简单，运行于VM上。通过这种方式，CMS编写起来就比较简单，就好像只有它一个在运行一样，VM操作系统就在幕后提供多任务以及资源管理服务。
target_text: An early user of this concept is the VM/CMS time-sharing product on the IBM large computer, which uses an interactive computing single user operating system, CMS, which is relatively simple and operates on VM. In this way, CMS is relatively simple to prepare, as if it were the only one operating, and the VM operating system provides multiple tasks and resource management services behind the scenes.
title: 虛擬機器

source_text: 当然，不是每个VM用户都必须运行CMS；有些用户选择在一个或者多个虚拟机上运行某种「OS/360」（或者「MVS」），来提供传统上的批处理任务。今天，IBM大型机还在使用VM，许多虚拟机上运行的是Linux操作系统。「VMware」、「TwoOStwo」、「SVISTA」软件包在现代電腦上都在处理类似截获硬件访问，模拟除了处理器以外的任何主板上的器件的事情。
target_text: Of course, not every VM user has to run CMS; some users choose to run some "OS/360" (or "MVS") on one or more virtual machines to provide traditional batch tasks. Today, IBM large machines are still using VM, and many virtual machines operate on Linux operating systems. "VMware", "TwoOStwo" and "SVISTA" packages deal with similar intercepts of hardware on modern computers and simulate anything on the panel other than the processor.
title: 虛擬機器

source_text:
動態適應性去交錯（motion adaptive deinterlacing）
動態適應性去交錯方法是偵測影像中何處是動態的，以及何處是靜態的；在畫面中靜態的部份使用場間去交錯以得到垂直方向完整的解析度，而在動態的部份使用單一場去交錯以避免鋸齒以及鬼影的現象。使用這個方法偵測動態的演算法是相當重要的，不好的演算法也會導致一些偵測錯誤使得畫面中出現一些惱人的線條。使用動態適應性去交錯方法需要比較快速的硬體去計算動態偵測演算法，另外也需要一或多個場的緩衝記憶體，演算法使用越多的場來偵測動態將會越準確，但是相對的需要更好更昂貴的硬體。
target_text: Momental adaptive deinterlacing (momental adaptive deinterlacing) Motivative adaptive deinterlacing methods are important, and the use of this method may lead to errors in detecting where the images are moving, and where they are static. Using the static part of the picture to intertwine to obtain a full resolution in a vertical direction, and using only one side of the dynamics to avoid the occurrence of teeth and ghost. The use of this method to detect kinetic algorithms is important.
title: 去交錯

source_text: 1996年，Winamp1.0版的发布成为MP3格式流行的催化剂。Fraunhofer开始向采用他们的算法的公司索要许可证费用，因此其他替代的免费算法开始被研发。LAME发布于1998年，并于此后成为主要的MP3编码器。最近以来，其它的MP3格式的挑战者包括高级音频编码或者叫AAC（用于苹果公司的iTunes）、Ogg Vorbis（一个无专利的自由编解码器）、Opus（是開放格式，標準定義於IETF RFC 6716，有更低的延遲和更好的聲音壓縮率）。
target_text: In 1996, the release of Winamp1.0 became a popular catalyst for MP3 formats. Fraunhofer began to claim licence fees from companies using their algorithms, so alternative free algorithms were developed. LAME was published in 1998 and has since become the main MP3 encoder. More recently, other MP3 formats challengers include advanced audio coding or AAC (iTunes for Apple), Ogg Vorbis (an unproprietary free codecer), Opus (an open format, defined as IETF RFC 6716), with lower delay and better voice compression rates).
title: 音频文件格式

source_text:
APE 庞大的WAV音频文件可以通过Monkey's Audio这个软件进行压缩为APE格式。通过Monkey's Audio解压缩还原以后得到的WAV文件可以做到与压缩前的源文件完全一致。
FLAC 格式的源码完全开放，而且兼容几乎所有的操作系统平台。它的编码算法已经通过了严格的测试，而且在文件点损坏的情况下依然能够正常播放。该格式不仅有成熟的Windows制作程序，还得到了众多第三方软件的支持。此外，Rio公司的硬盘随身听Karma，建伍的车载音响MusicKeg以及PhatBox公司的数码播放机都能支持FLAC格式。
Apple Lossless 为苹果的无损音频压缩编码格式，可将非压缩音频格式（WAV、AIFF）压缩至原先容量的40%至60%左右，编解码速度很快。
WavPack 允许用户压缩、取消复原8、16、24、32位元整型以及32位元浮点表示的WAV格式音讯档案，另外它还支援多声道资料流以及非常高的取样频率。另外WavPack引入了一种独特的「混合」模式，它使用一个附加的档案从而也具有了失真压缩的优点。
target_text: The large WAV audio files can be condensed to APE through Monkey's Audio, which is a mature Windows production program supported by many third-party software. In addition, the hard drive of Rio, which listens to Karma, the built vehicle sound MusicKeg and the digital player of PhatBox can support the FLAC format. Apple Lossles, which is a non-destructive audio compression code for apples, can still be broadcast properly in case of damage to the file point. The format not only has a mature Windows production program, but is supported by a large number of third-party software.
title: 音频文件格式

source_text: Peripheral Component Interconnect Express，简称PCI-E，官方简称PCIe，是计算机总线的一个重要分支，它沿用既有的PCI編程概念及信号标准，并且构建了更加高速的串行通信系統标准。目前这一标准由PCI-SIG组织制定和维护。PCIe仅应用于内部互连。由于PCIe是基于既有的PCI系统，所以只需修改物理层而无须修改软件就可将现有PCI系统转换为PCIe。
target_text: Peripheral Computer Intercontract Express, the official PCI-E, is an important branch of the computer bus, following established PCI programming concepts and signal standards, and building standards for a more high-speed serial communication system. This standard is currently developed and maintained by the PCI-SIG organization. PCIE applies only to internal interconnections. Since PCI is based on existing PCI systems, it is possible to convert existing PCI systems to PCI without modification of software.
title: PCI Express

source_text: PCIe保证了相容性，支援PCI的作業系統無需進行任何更改即可支援PCIe總線。这也给用户的升级带来方便。由此可见，PCIe最大的意义在于它的通用性，不仅可以让它用于南桥和其他设备的连接，也可以延伸到芯片组间的连接，甚至也可以用于连接圖形處理器，这样，整个I/O系统重新统一起来，将更进一步简化计算机系统，增加计算机的可移植性和模块化。
target_text: PCIe ensures compatibility and supports the PCI operating system without any change. This also facilitates the upgrading of users. Thus, the greatest significance of PCI is its universality, which can be used not only to connect to the South Bridge and other devices, but also to connect to the chip group, or even to the graphical processor, so that the entire I/O system can be reunified and the computer system will be more streamlined, with increased portability and modularization.
title: PCI Express

source_text:
竞争协议
基于高速序列构架产生了很多传输标准，包括HyperTransport、InfiniBand、RapidIO和StarFabric等等。这些标准均有业界的不同企业支援，背后也都有大量的资金投入标准的研究开发，所以每一标准都声称自己与众不同，独占优势。主要的差异在于可扩展性、灵活性与反应时间、单位成本的取舍平衡各不相同。其中的一个例子是在传输包上增加一个复杂的头信息以支援复杂路由传输（PCI Express不支援这种方式）。这样的信息增加降低了接口的有效带宽也使传输更复杂，但是相应创造了新的软件支援此功能。这种架构下需要软件追踪网络拓扑结构的变化以实现系统支援热插拔。InfiniBand和StarFabric标准即能实现这一功能。另一个例子是缩小信息包以减少反应时间。较小的信息包意味着包头占用了包的更大百分比，这样又降低了有效带宽。能实现此功能的标准是RapidIO和HyperTransport。PCI Express取中庸之道，定位于设计成一种系统互连接口而非一种设备接口或路由网络协议。另外为了针对软件透明，它的设计目标限制了它作为协议，也在某种程度上增加了它的反应时间。
target_text: The competition agreement, based on a high-speed sequence structure, produces a number of transmission standards, including HyperTransport, InfiniBand, RapidIO and StarFabric, among others. These standards are supported by a variety of firms in the industry and are backed by substantial investment in research and development of standards, so each of which claims to be different. The main differences are that expansionability, flexibility, and response time, and the balance of unit costs. One example is that a complex head information is added to the package to support a complex route by which it is transmitted (which is not supported by PCI Express). This information increases the effective bandwidth of the interfaces and makes transmission more complex, but the corresponding new software supports this function. The standard for this structure requires software tracking the changes in the network ' s topping structure to achieve system support heating. The InfiniBand and StarFabric standards can achieve this function.
title: PCI Express

source_text: 在2005年，PCIe已近乎成为新的个人电脑主機板标准。关于此有不少评论，但最基本的原因是它对于软件开发者完全透明——为PCI所设计的操作系统可以不做任何代码修改来启动PCIe设备。其二，它能增强系统性能，还有强有力的品牌认知。各类网卡、声卡、显卡，以及当下的NVMe固態硬碟都使用了PCIe标准。下面为主流的使用PCIe 的外设产品。
target_text: In 2005, PCIe became almost the new PC mainframe standard. There have been a number of comments, but the most important reason is that it is completely transparent to software developers - the operating system designed for PCI can start the PCI without any code changes. Second, it enhances systemic performance and strong branding. Various webcards, sound cards, visual cards, and current NVMe solid hard disks use the PCI standard.
title: PCI Express

target_text: The usual ads, “Certificate 13***,” “Certificate execution, quick”, “Certificate, quick access” (the word “Inline” in this ad is used to refer false documents to the Internet) and provide this service because of the fact that a substantial part of documentation in mainland China provides access to genuine documents that are not detectable on the Internet.
title: 虚假证件

source_text:
图书档案馆
安德森图书馆（Andersonian Library）是斯特拉斯克莱德大学的主要图书馆。 它成立于1796年，是苏格兰最大的图书馆之一。 它坐落在Curran大楼。 安德森图书馆目前分布在5个楼层，拥有超过2,000个阅读器位置，450个计算机位置和广泛的Wi-Fi区域供笔记本电脑使用。 它拥有大约一百万册的印刷本，可以访问超过540,000种电子书籍，239种数据库和超过38,000种电子期刊，并且可以从任何适当设置的计算机上全天候使用。
target_text: The Anderson Library is currently located on five floors, with more than 2,000 readers, 450 computer positions, and an extensive Wi-Fi area for laptop use. It has about one million copies, with access to more than 540,000 electronic books, 239 databases, and more than 38,000 electronic periodicals, and can be used on any suitable computer on a 24-hour basis.
title: 斯特拉斯克萊德大學

source_text: 指令的长度相差悬殊，从一些微控制器（）中的4位（）到一些超长指令字系统中的几百位。大部分现代的个人计算机、大型计算机、超大型计算机中的处理器的指令尺寸在16到64位之间。在一些构架中，特别是RISC构架中，指令长度是固定的，通常与其构架的字长一致。在其他的构架中，指令有不同的长度，但通常是字节或者半个字的整数倍。
target_text: The length of the instructions varies widely, from four in some microcontrols () to hundreds in some very long command-word systems. Most modern PCs, large computers, and processors in super-large computers have instructions ranging from 16 to 64 in size. In some structures, especially the RISC structure, the length of the instructions is fixed, usually consistent with the length of their structure. In others, the instructions have different lengths, but usually multiples of bytes or semi-words.
title: 指令

Computer-based Chinese and Chinese characters that are commonly used in modern Japanese have been recorded in JIS X 0208 and Unicode, which contains JIS X 0208, are widely used in computer processing and communication. However, Sakamoto's three-language literature continues to document a large number of characters that have not yet been coded and written in Chinese, such as JIS and Unicode.

source_text: 2004年6月23日，一个目的在于大公司 IIS 服务器的攻击即是通过使用 Internet Explorer 中两个先前未发现的漏洞，借以在不知情的大量最终用户的浏览器中插入垃圾邮件发送软件而成。该恶意软件被定名为Download.ject，它会在用户浏览网页时偷偷电脑中安装后门以及一个键盘击键记录软件。被感染的电脑包括许多金融網站。
target_text: On 23 June 2004, an attack aimed at a large company IIS server was made by using two previously undetected holes in the Internet Explorer to insert spam distribution software into an uninformed, large end-user browser. The malicious software was named Download.ject, which installs backdoors and a keyboard-clicking recorder software on the user’s web page.
title: 对Internet Explorer的批评

source_text:
组件对象模块
许多的IE安全问题皆与组件对象模块（COM）相关。IE通过ActiveX或浏览器帮助对象（Browser Helper Object）将COM深植其中。这种功能的结合为电脑病毒、特洛依木马程序以及间谍软件的进入大开方便之门。这些恶意软件的攻击与传遍通常皆要利用ActiveX。微软早已经认识到这一问题，1996年Charles Fitzgerald－微软的Java团队程序负责人曾说，「如果你想在『網路上』安全，请关掉你的电脑。我们从来没有准备让ActiveX安全。
target_text: Many IE security issues are related to the component object module (COM). IE helps the target (Browser Helper Object) through ActiveX or through a browser. The combination of this function opens the door to computer viruses, Troyma programs, and spy software. These malicious software attacks and circulations usually involve the use of AcliveX. Microsoft has recognized this problem, and the 1996 Charles Fitzgerald-Microsoft team program leader said, "Close your computer if you want to be secure on the Internet." We've never been prepared to make AcliveX safe.
title: 对Internet Explorer的批评

source_text:
间谍软件·广告软件与Windows XP SP2
间谍软件与广告软件，如同其他的恶意软件一样，通常把目标对准Windows/Internet Explorer为基础的作业系统。较旧的间谍软件对系统的危害已经因为Windows XP SP2的安全增强而有所缓解，但对IE新型的攻击会在SP2上安装间谍软件。微软不建议在已经感染间谍软件的系统上安装SP2，因为这可能导致不能自举：
target_text: Spy software, as well as Windows XP SP2 spy software and advertising software, as with other malicious software, usually target Windows/Internet Explorer-based operating systems. The damage to the system from older spy software has been mitigated by Windows XP SP2, but the new IE attack will install spy software on SP2. Microsoft does not recommend the installation of SP2 on systems already infected with spy software, as this could lead to self-inflicted:
title: 对Internet Explorer的批评

source_text: 遗传编程或称基因编程，簡稱GP，是一种从生物演化过程得到灵感的自动化生成和选择计算机程序来完成用户定义的任务的技术。从理论上讲，人类用遗传编程只需要告诉计算机“需要完成什么”，而不用告诉它“如何去完成”，最终可能实现真正意义上的人工智能：自动化的发明机器。
target_text: Genetic programming or genetic programming, known as the GP, is a technology for automating and selecting computer programs inspired by bioevolutation processes to accomplish user-defined tasks. In theory, human genetic programming only tells computers “what needs to be done” and not “how to do it”, which may eventually lead to real artificial intelligence: automated inventive machines.
title: 遗传编程

source_text: 遗传编程是一种特殊的利用进化算法的机器学习技术，它开始于一群由随机生成的千百万个计算机程序组成的“人群”，然后根据一个程序完成给定的任务的能力来确定某个程序的适合度，应用达尔文的自然选择（适者生存）确定胜出的程序，计算机程序间也模拟两性组合，变异，基因复制，基因删除等代代进化，直到达到预先确定的某个终止条件为止。
target_text: Genetic programming is a special machine learning technique using evolutionary algorithms that begins with a group of “crowds” of millions of randomly generated computer programs, then determines the suitability of a given program based on the ability of a program to perform the given task, uses Darwin's natural choice (the survival of the fittest) to determine a winning program, and simulates gender combinations between computer programs, mutation, genetic reproduction, genetic removal etc., until a predetermined termination condition is met.
title: 遗传编程

source_text: 使用遗传编程的计算机程序可以用很多种编程语言来写成。早期（或者说传统）的GP实现中，程序的指令和数据的值使用树状结构的组织方式，所以那些本来就提供树状组织形式的编程语言最适合与GP，例如Koza使用的Lisp语言。其他形式的GP也被提倡和实现，例如相对简单的适合传统编程语言（例如Fortran、BASIC和C語言）的线性遗传编程。有商业化的GP软件把线性遗传编程和汇编语言结合来获得更好的性能，也有的实现方法直接生成汇编程序。
target_text: Computer programs that use genetic programming can be written in a variety of programming languages. Early (or traditional) GPS realizations, program instructions and data values are organized using tree structures, so programming languages that provide tree tissue are best suited to the Lip language used by GP, such as Koza. Other forms of GP are also promoted and realized, such as linear genetic programming that is relatively simple and suitable for traditional programming languages (e.g. Fortran, BASIC, and C languages).
title: 遗传编程

source_text: 遗传编程所需的计算量非常之大（处理大量候选的计算机程序），以至于在90年代的时候它只能用来解决一些简单的问题。近年来，随着遗传编程技术自身的发展和中央处理器计算能力的指数级提升，GP开始产生了一大批显著的结果。例如在2004年左右，GP在多个领域取得近40项成果：量子计算、电子设计、游戏比赛、排序、搜索等等。这些计算机自动生成的程序（算法）中有些与2000年后人工产生的发明十分类似，甚至有两项结果产生了可以申请专利的新发明。
target_text: In recent years, with the development of genetic programming technology itself and the upgrading of the index level of central processors’ ability to calculate. For example, in 2004, the GP achieved nearly 40 results in a number of areas: quantum computing, electronic design, games, sequencing, searching, and so on. Some of these computer auto-generated programs (calculations) are very similar to artificial inventions produced since 2000, and even two have produced new inventions that can be patented.
title: 遗传编程

source_text: 在90年代，人们普遍认为为遗传编程发展一个理论十分困难，GP在各种搜索技术中也处于劣势。2000年后，GP的理论取得重大发展，建立确切的GP概率模型和马尔可夫链模型已成为可能。遗传编程比遗传算法适用的范围更广（实际上包含了遗传算法）除了生成计算机程序，遗传编程也被用与产生可发展的硬件。
target_text: In the 1990s, it was widely recognized that developing a theory for genetic programming was difficult, and that the GP was at a disadvantage in a variety of search techniques. After 2000, the GP theory had developed significantly, making it possible to establish a precise GP probabilities model and a Markov chain model.
title: 遗传编程

title: 方镛钦

source_text: 1988年11月2日，康奈尔大学计算机科学研究生罗伯特·塔潘·莫里斯（Robert Tappan Morris）释放了后来被称为“莫里斯蠕虫”（Morris worm）的病毒，预估在所有连网的计算机中，有1/10倍被扰乱。在莫里斯的上诉过程中，美国上诉法院预估每个装置需要花费200美元到5.3万美元来移除蠕虫。莫里斯蠕虫促使CERT协调中心和Phage邮件列表的诞生，而莫里斯本人也成为第一个根据1986年《计算机欺诈和滥用法案》而受审，并被定罪的人。
target_text: On 2 November 1988, Robert Tappan Morris, a computer science student at Cornell University, released the virus, later known as Morris Worm, which was estimated to have disrupted one-ten times the number of computers connected to the network. During the appeal process, the U.S. Court of Appeal estimated that each device would cost between US$ 200 and US$ 53,000 to remove worms. Maurice worms prompted the creation of the CERT focal point and the Phage mailing list, and Morris himself became the first person to be tried and convicted under the Computer Fraud and Misuse Act 1986.
title: 電腦蠕蟲

source_text:
工作机理
与電腦病毒不同的是，電腦蠕蟲不需要附在别的程序内，可以不用使用者介入操作也能自我複製或執行。電腦蠕蟲未必會直接破壞被感染的系統，卻幾乎都對網路有害。電腦蠕蟲可能會执行垃圾代码以发动分散式阻斷服務攻擊，令计算机的执行效率极大程度降低，从而影響電腦的正常使用；可能會損毀或修改目標電腦的檔案；亦可能只是浪費頻寬。（惡意的）電腦蠕蟲可根据其目的分成2類：
一种是面对大规模计算机使用网络发动拒绝服务的電腦蠕蟲，雖說會綁架電腦，但使用者可能還可以正常使用，只是會被占用一部份運算、連網能力。
另一种是针对个人用户的以执行大量垃圾代码的電腦蠕蟲。電腦蠕蟲多不具有跨平台性，但是在其他平台下，可能会出现其平台特有的非跨平台性的平台版本。第一个被广泛注意的電腦蠕蟲名为：“莫里斯蠕虫”，由罗伯特·泰潘·莫里斯编写，于1988年11月2日释出第一个版本。这个電腦蠕蟲间接和直接地造成了近1亿美元的损失。这个電腦蠕蟲释出之后，引起了各界对電腦蠕蟲的广泛关注。
target_text: Unlike computer viruses, computer worms do not have to be attached to other programs, and can be self-produced or executed without user involvement. Computer worms do not necessarily destroy infected systems directly, but are almost all harmful to the Internet. Computer worms can perform garbage codes in order to launch decentralized service disruption attacks, which can affect the normal use of computers; computer worms that can damage or modify the files of target computers; and they may be simply wasteful; but other platforms can be divided into two: the first computer worms that are widely noted as “Maurice Worms” that can be used to launch a network that rejects services, but that can be used normally, but that can only take part of the operation and network capability. The second computer worm that is used by individual users to implement a large number of waste codes can affect the normal use of computers. Most computer worms are not of a platform-wide nature, but under other platforms there may be a non-platform platform-specific version of their platform.
title: 電腦蠕蟲

source_text:
QuakeWorld（即雷神之锤World）是id Software开发的雷神之锤I游戏的升级版本。游戏增加了多人游戏的特性（TCP/IP支持）可以让玩家进行互联网对战。历史
升级之前雷神之锤I的网络代码，在局域网对战的时候不会产生严重延迟。但原始的雷神之锤并不标示出网络连接的地址，会造成了互联网游戏中延迟和丢包。
target_text: QuakeWorld (the Hammer of Thunderbolts) is an upgraded version of the Thunderbolt I game developed by id Software. The game adds to the character of multiplayer games (TCP/IP support) to allow players to fight over the Internet. The network code of Thunderbolt I before history upgrades does not cause serious delays in the local area network fight. But the original hammer of Thunderbolt does not indicate the address of the network connection, which causes delay and loss of packages in Internet games.
title: 雷神世界

source_text: 冒泡排序（）又稱為泡式排序，是一種簡單的排序算法。它重複地走訪過要排序的數列，一次比較兩個元素，如果它們的順序錯誤就把它們交換過來。走訪數列的工作是重複地進行直到沒有再需要交換，也就是說該數列已經排序完成。這個算法的名字由來是因為越小的元素會經由交換慢慢「浮」到數列的頂端。
target_text: The sorting of bubbles () is also called the sorting of bubbles, which is a simple sorting algorithm. It repeats its visits to the rows to be sorted, comparing the two elements at once, and swaps them if their order is wrong. The task of the list of visits is to repeat them until there is no longer a need for them to be exchanged, that is to say, the row has been sorted. The name of the algorithm is given because the smaller elements are exchanged slowly to the top of the array.
title: 冒泡排序

source_text: 冒泡排序是與插入排序擁有相等的漸近時間複雜度，但是兩種算法在需要的交換次數卻很大地不同。在最壞的情況，冒泡排序需要次交換，而插入排序只要最多交換。冒泡排序的實現（類似下面）通常會對已經排序好的數列拙劣地執行（），而插入排序在這個例子只需要個運算。因此很多現代的演算法教科書避免使用冒泡排序，而用插入排序取代之。冒泡排序如果能在內部迴圈第一次執行時，使用一個旗標來表示有無需要交換的可能，也可以把最優情況下的複雜度降低到。在這個情況，已經排序好的數列就無交換的需要。若在每次走訪數列時，把走訪順序反過來，也可以稍微地改進效率。有時候稱為雞尾酒排序，因為演算法會從數列的一端到另一端之間穿梭往返。
target_text: The order of bubbles is the same amount of time and complexity as the order of insertion, but the two algorithms differ considerably in the number of times they need to be exchanged. In the worst cases, the order of bubbles requires a second exchange, while the order of insertion is as much as the maximum. The reality of the order of bubbles (similarly below) usually runs poorly on a number of well-sequenced lines (and the order of insertions in this case only needs to be calculated. Many contemporary algorithms avoid the order of bubbles and replace them with the order of insertions. The order of bubbles is sometimes called cocktails, if one flag is used for the first time in the inner circle to indicate that there is no possibility of switching, and it reduces the complexity of the best cases. In this case, there is no need to change the order.
title: 冒泡排序

source_text:
紀念
國際單位制中的壓強單位帕斯卡（Pa）以他的名字命名。
一种结构化计算机编程语言帕斯卡语言为纪念他而命名。
在法國，年度傑出獎頒給布莱兹‧帕斯卡‧查爾斯全國傑出科學家獎以進行他們在法蘭西島的研究。
一座位於法国克萊蒙費朗的大學，以帕斯卡的名字命名為布莱兹‧帕斯卡大學。
加拿大安大略省的滑鐵盧大學每年都會舉辦一場以他命名的數學競賽。帕斯卡競賽開放給世界上每一位年齡在15歲或9年級以下的學生參加。
羅伯托·羅塞里尼导演了一部傳記式的電影（標題為布莱兹‧帕斯卡），在1971在意大利開始播送。
帕斯卡在1984年BBC Two第一版的紀錄片《海洋的真相》裡成為主題，由克匹特饰演。
NVIDIA在2016年推出的NVIDIA GeForce 10系列的架構使用帕斯卡命名。
target_text: In France, the annual award was awarded to scientists from all over the world, Briz Pascal Charles, to conduct their research in France. One seat was held at the University of Clement Fairan, France, under the name of Brez Pascal, the University of Pascal.
title: 布莱兹·帕斯卡

source_text: GameSpy Arcade是公司提供在线游戏配对的旗舰产品。用户能通过它寻找不同在线游戏的服务器，而不论这个在线游戏服务是免费的还是需要另外购买，并且用户还可以连接到该服务器进行游戏。GameSpy Arcade的技术同样被主要的游戏开发商广泛采用并整合在他们的游戏中，主要用于游戏内的服务器搜索。 GameSpy Arcade也内置了Roger Wilco语音聊天软件，主要希望运用在强调团队合作的游戏中的交流和协调，用户登录到一个运用语音通信技术的服务器，和其他用户聊天。这个软件和其他主要的语音聊天软件 GameComm以及Teamspeak产生了直接竞争。
target_text: GameSpy Arcade is the company’s flagship product that provides online game pairs. Users can use it to find servers for different online games, regardless of whether the online game service is free of charge or needs to be purchased, and users can connect to the server for games. GameSpy Arcade technology is also widely adopted and integrated by major game developers, mainly for server searches within the game. GameSpy Arcade has built up Roger Wilco voice chat software, mainly to use communication and coordination in games that emphasize teamwork, to log on to a server that uses voice communication technology, and to chat with other users. This software and other major voice chat software, GameComm and Teamspeak, have directly competed.
title: GameSpy

source_text: 快速排序（），又稱分区交換排序（），是一種排序演算法，最早由東尼·霍爾提出。在平均狀況下，排序個項目要（大O符号）次比較。在最壞狀況下則需要次比較，但這種狀況並不常見。事實上，快速排序通常明顯比其他演算法更快，因為它的內部循环（inner loop）可以在大部分的架構上很有效率地達成。
target_text: Quick sorting (), also known as partition swap sorting (), is a sorting algorithm that was first proposed by Tony Hall. In a situation of average, sorting items is to be compared (large O symbols). In the worst cases, comparisons are needed, but this is not common. In fact, fast sorting is often faster than other algorithms, because its inner cycle (inner loop) can be achieved efficiently in most structures.
title: 快速排序

source_text:
优化的排序演算法
快速排序是二叉查找树（二元搜尋樹）的一個空間最佳化版本。不是循序地把数据项插入到一個明確的樹中，而是由快速排序組織這些数据項到一個由递归调用所隐含的樹中。這兩個演算法完全地產生相同的比較次數，但是順序不同。对于排序算法的稳定性指标，原地分割版本的快速排序算法是不稳定的。其他变种是可以通过牺牲性能和空间来维护稳定性的。
target_text: Optimized sorting algorithms. Fast sorting is a space optimal version of a two-fork search tree. Not by sequentially inserting data items into a clear tree, but by fast sorting these data items into a tree that is implicit in a back-to-back call. These two algorithms produce exactly the same number of comparisons, but different sequences. For a sorting stability indicator, the fast sorting algorithm of the original split version is unstable. Other variants can preserve stability by sacrificing performance and space.
title: 快速排序

source_text:
選擇的關連性
選擇算法（selection algorithm）可以選取一個數列的第個最小值；一般而言這是比排序還簡單的問題。一個簡單但是有效率的選擇算法與快速排序的作法相當類似，除了對兩個子數列都作遞迴呼叫外，它僅僅針對包含想要的元素之子數列作單一的結尾遞迴（tail recursive）呼叫。這個小改變降低了平均複雜度到線性或是時間，且讓它成為一個原地算法。這個算法的一種變化版本，可以讓最壞情況下降為（參考選擇算法來得到更多資訊）。
target_text: Selecting relevance The selection algorithm can select the first minimum value for a number of rows; this is generally a problem that is easier than ranking. A simple but efficient algorithm is quite similar to a fast sorting approach, which, apart from a repeat call for both subnumbers, focuses only on a single tailing call for the number of children containing the desired element. This minor change reduces the average complexity to a linear or time, and makes it an original algorithm. A variant of this algorithm can reduce the worst to (more information can be obtained by the reference algorithm).
title: 快速排序

source_text: 儘管直覺主義邏輯無法利用，排中律和雙重否定的消除這兩個對古典邏輯貢獻極大的規則，而面臨隨之而來的嚴峻挑戰，但直覺主義邏輯具有實際用途。其中一個原因是它所受的限制，反而因此產生了必須具備存在性的證據，使其也適用於其他形式的數學建構主義。非正式地，這意味著如果存在對象存在的建設性證據，則該構造性證據可用作生成該對象的示例算法，該原理即稱為證明和算法之間的柯里-霍华德同构。直覺邏輯這種特性如此有價值的原因，是它使研究者能夠使用廣泛的計算機化工具，稱為證明輔具。這些工具可以幫助用戶驗證（和生成）大規模的證據，這些證據的大小通常會排除發布和審查數學證據的常規人工檢查。因此，使用證明輔具（例如 Agda 或 Coq）使現代數學家和邏輯學家能夠開發和證明極其複雜的系統，遠超出那些僅由手工創立和檢查的系統。在這些工具出現之前，無法驗證的著名範例是四色定理的證明。這個定理困擾了數學家一百多年，直到一個證據被開發出來，排除了大量可能的反例，但仍然留下可能性，需要一個計算機程序才能完成證明。這個證據在一段時間內引起爭議，但最終使用 Coq 進行了驗證。
target_text: One of the reasons for the intuitive logic is that it cannot be used for other forms of digital construction. Informally, it means that if there is evidence of the existence of a device, it can be used as an example to generate an algorithm for the object, which is called the Cori-Howard contemplation between proof and algorithms. The reason why the intuitive logic is so valuable is that it allows researchers to use a wide array of computing tools, which are called proofs.
title: 直觉主义逻辑

source_text: 威廉·吉布森由于他的小说《神经浪游者》（1984年）而通常被人们与赛博朋克联系起来。他注重风格、角色成长以及传统科幻小说的氛围，神经浪游者曾被授予雨果奖及星云奖。根据术语档案，吉布森对计算机和当今黑客文化认识不深，使他对计算机和黑客在将来的角色有着特别的推测，而这种看法对黑客们来说天真的令人愤怒，却又令他们感到非常刺激。
target_text: William Gibson is usually associated with Cyberbunk because of his novel NeuroRover (1984). He focuses on style, role growth, and the atmosphere of traditional science fiction.
title: 赛博朋克

source_text: 由于3DNow!使用的寄存器与x87寄存器重叠，任务切换时，保存x87寄存器状态的同时也保存了3DNow!的状态，所以3DNow!不需要操作系统的额外支持。只要CPU支持3DNow!，含有3DNow!代码的程序可以在只考虑到x87状态的原有的操作系统上不加修改地运行。由于3DNow!依平坦模式访问寄存器，对3DNow!浮点单元的管线化变得容易，这也利于编译器生成高效的浮点代码。
target_text: 3Dnow! No additional support is required for the operating system as long as the CPU supports 3Dnow! The program with the 3Dnow! code can operate without modification on the original operating system that only takes into account x87. The 3Dnow! Impressive mode access to the depositor makes it easier to line the 3Dnow! floating point module, which also facilitates the production of an efficient floating point code by the compiler.
title: 3DNow!

source_text: VirtualDub是开放源代码的视频捕捉及线性处理软件，由Avery Lee编写，遵循GPL协议。该软件有很多高级功能，并且可以通过插件来添加不同的视频处理方法。功能VirtualDub的早期版本可以打开微软的*.asf文件，后来由于软件专利问题，在1.3d版中去除了这个功能。附加项目提供Avery Lee的版本中不存在的额外功能，如支持MPEG-2和Ogg Theora。
target_text: VirtualDub is an open source video capture and linear processing software, prepared by Avery Lee, which follows the GPL protocol. The software has many advanced features and can be used to add different video processing methods by plugins. An early version of the function VirtualDub can open a Microsoft *.asf file, which was later removed from version 1.3d due to software patent problems. Additional items provide additional functions that do not exist in the Avery Lee version, such as support for MPEG-2 and Ogg Theora.
title: VirtualDub

source_text: Arch Linux () 是一个独立开发的x86-64架构通用GNU/Linux发行版，它致力于通过滚动更新来提供大多数软件的最新稳定版本。默认安装是一个最小的基本系统，由用户自行添加需要的软件。Arch Linux使用pacman作为包管理器。Arch Linux采用滚动更新。Arch Linux努力维护其软件的最新稳定版本，除非需要合理地避免系统包损坏。
target_text: Arch Linux() is a self-developed X86-64 architecture general GNU/Linux release that works to provide most software with the latest stable version of the software through rolling updates. The default installation is the smallest basic system, with the user adding the required software. Arch Linux uses pacman as package manager. Arch Linux uses rolling updates. Arch Linux works to maintain the latest stable version of its software, unless it is reasonably necessary to avoid package damage.
title: Arch Linux

source_text: 简单：避免任何不必要的添加、修改和复杂增加。现代：尽全力保持软件处于最新的稳定版本，采用滚动升级策略，安装之后可以持续升级。实用：开发者依赖基于事实的技术分析和讨论，避免政治因素，不会被流行观点左右。仓库中既提供了开源、自由的软件，也提供了闭源软件。实用性大于意识形态。用户中心性：尽管许多 GNU/Linux 发行版都试图对用户更加友好，但 Arch Linux 一直是，并且将始终保持以用户为中心。该发行版旨在满足为其贡献者的需求，而不是试图吸引尽可能多的用户。它面向精通 GNU/Linux 的用户，或任何愿意阅读文档并解决自己问题的自己动手的态度的人。也鼓励每一个用户 参与 和贡献，报告和帮助修复 bugs，提供软件包补丁和参加核心 项目，Arch 的开发人员是志愿者，积极的贡献者通常会发现自己成为该团队的一部分。多功能性：Arch Linux 是一个通用的发行版。安装时只提供命令行环境；用户无需删除不需要的包，而是可以通过在x86-64架构的官方软件仓库中提供的数千个高质量包中进行选择来构建自定义系统。Arch 是一个由pacman支持的滚动发布模型， pacman是一个轻量级、简单和快速的包管理器，允许使用一个命令持续升级整个系统。Arch 还提供Arch Build System，一个类似于BSD Ports的系统，可以轻松地从源代码构建和安装包，也可以与一个命令同步。
target_text: Simple: avoid any unnecessary additions, modifications and complications. Modern: Make every effort to keep the software in the latest stable version, adopt a rolling upgrade strategy, and be continuously upgraded after installation. Practical: Developers rely on facts-based technical analysis and discussion, avoid political considerations, and are not influenced by popular views. The warehouse provides both open-source, free-source software and closed-source software. More functional than ideological. User centrality: Although many GNU/Linux releases try to be more user-friendly, Arch Linux releases have been, and will always be, user-centred. They are designed to meet the needs of their contributors, rather than trying to attract as many users as possible. They are oriented towards users who are proficient in GNU/Linux, or anyone who is willing to read files and solve their problems.
title: Arch Linux

source_text:
core，包含启动系统所必需的、链接互联网时可能需要的、编译软件包时需要的、检查、修复文件系统的工具、在安装过程中可能用到的软件包和它们的依赖。
extra，提供基本系统不需要的软件包，包括桌面环境和其他程式。该仓库由社区软件包维护者和Arch开发者共同维护。
multilib，为x86_64用户提供的支援在64位元环境下使用32位元软件的集中化仓库。
target_text: Corre, which contains tools needed to start the system, which may be needed to connect to the Internet, to compile the package, to check, to repair the file system, to be used in the installation process, and to rely on it. Extra, which provides basic software packages not required by the system, including the desktop environment and other programs. The warehouse is maintained jointly by the community package maintainer and Arch developers. Multilib, a centralized warehouse that supports X86_64 users to use 32-bit software in a 64-bit environment.
title: Arch Linux

source_text:
unstable仓库已在2008年7月撤销，其中的大部分软件包也已移动至其他仓库。
在官方仓库以外还存在一些非官方的用户仓库，其中最知名的是托管在Arch Linux站点上的Arch User Repository（AUR）。此外也有不少用户独立建立的非官方仓库。Arch 编译系统
Arch 编译系统 （Arch Build System，ABS）是一套能從源代码编译软件的类 ports 系统。Pacman 是 Arch 下特定的二進制安裝包管理工具（也包括管理那些從 ABS 構建的二進制安裝包），而 ABS 則是 Arch 下特定的編譯工具，將源代碼編譯為一個可供安裝的 .pkg.tar.xz 包。
target_text: The unstable warehouse was dismantled in July 2008 and most of the software packages were moved to other warehouses. A number of unofficial user warehouses exist outside the official warehouse, the most famous of which are hosted on Arch User Repository (AUR) at Arch Linux site. There are also a number of non-official warehouses that have been created independently by users. Arch compiler system Arch compiler (Arch Build System, ABS) is a class of port systems that can be translated from source code. Pacman is a specific binary installation management tool under Arch (also includes those that manage binary installation packages constructed from ABS), while ABS is a specific compilation tool under Arch that translates source code into an installed .pkg.tar.xxz package.
title: Arch Linux

source_text:
2017年5月15日，Arch Linux宣布放弃支持ABS，并推荐用户切换到 ASP 。Arch 用户软件仓库
Arch 用户软件仓库（Arch User Repository，AUR）是一个面对广大Arch用户、以社区为主导的软件仓库。AUR的初衷是组织社区内分享PKGBUILD，并且促使热门的用户贡献软件包进入community软件库。AUR被称为Arch的新软件包的发源地，在AUR里用户贡献出他们自己的软件包。AUR社区对它们进行投票或反对，一旦某个软件包拥有足够多的票数，AUR的受信用户就会将它加入到[community]软件库，使得可以通过pacman和ABS来使用它们。
target_text: On May 15, 2017, Arch Linux renounced its support for ABS and recommended that users switch to ASP. Arch User Software Repository, AUR, is a community-led software warehouse that confronts a wide range of Arc users. AUR was originally designed to share PKGBUILD within the organizational community and encourage popular users to contribute software packages to the Comunity software library. AUR, the origin of its new software package, AUR called Arc, contributed their own software packages to AUR. The AUR community voted or objected to them, and once a package had a sufficient number of votes, AUR's mail users added it to the [community] software library, making it possible to use them through Pacman and ABS.
title: Arch Linux

source_text:
历史Voodoo
Voodoo是3dfx第一款纯3D加速芯片，它并非单独的显示卡，而是一块3D子卡，需要配合2D显示卡使用。即使其售价高于同时期的RIVA 128、i740，但因为性能远远领先竞争对手，Voodoo依然在市场上非常受欢迎。Voodoo Rush
3dfx第一款2D+3D显示卡，可单独使用，其2D芯片采用的是Alliance生产的AT3D，但性能与兼容性不佳，销售亦不好。
target_text: The historical Voodoo Vodoo is the 3dfx paragraph 1 pure 3D acceleration chip, which is not a stand-alone display card, but a 3D subcard that needs to be used in conjunction with the 2D card. Even if it sells at a higher price than the RIVA 128 and i740 of the same period, Vodoo is very popular in the market because it is far ahead of its competitors. The Voodoo Rush 3dfx paragraph 2D+3D display card, which can be used separately, and its 2D chip, which uses AT3D produced by Alliance, has poor performance and compatibility, as well as bad sales.
title: 3dfx Interactive

source_text:
BLAST可以指：
BLAST (生物資訊學)（，可译为基于局部比对算法的搜索工具），是生物信息学中一种用来比对生物序列的一级结构的算法。
BLAST (无线通信)（，可译为贝尔实验室分层空时），是贝尔实验室提出的一种能极大提高无线通信能力的技术。
BLAST (能耗模拟)（，可译为建筑物负荷分析和系统热力学），是一种建筑物能耗模拟软件。
target_text: BLAST can refer to: BLAST (bioinformation) (which can be translated as a search tool based on local matching algorithms) as an algorithm used in bioinformatics to compare the first-level structure of biological sequences. BLAST (wireless communication) (which can be translated into Bell's laboratory space) is a technology proposed by Bell Laboratory that can significantly improve wireless communication capabilities. BLAST (energy consumption simulation) (which can be translated into building load analysis and system thermals) is a building energy consumption simulation software.
title: BLAST

source_text: 1996年，曾经是微软员工的加布·纽维尔和麦克·哈灵顿一同创建了Valve软件公司。他们在1996年下半年取得了雷神之锤引擎的使用许可（在id Software的朋友迈克尔·亚伯拉什的帮助下），用来开发半条命系列。最初的计划是在1997年晚些时候发布，但是最终的日期被确定为1998年10月31日。Valve许可TF软件公司（制作了絕地要塞（Team Fortress）游戏模式）制作一个独立的游戏《军团要塞》。Team Fortress Classic游戏模式，最初是一个由TF公司为《雷神之锤》制作的模式，它的半条命版本于1999年发布。在其後的十年裏，Valve繼續研發及制作《絕地要塞2》，並取得各界的好評。
target_text: In 1996, Gabe Newville, a former Microsoft employee, and Mike Harrington, created Valve Software. In late 1996, they obtained permission to use the Thunderbolt Hammer Engine (with the help of Michael Abrahams, a friend of id Software) for the development of a half-life series. The original plan was released later in 1997, but the final date was set for 31 October 1998. Valve licensed TF Software (which produced the Team Fortress model) to produce an independent game, " Fortress " .
title: Valve

source_text:
软件交付及维护
Steam的主要服务是允许其用户将其虚拟软件库中的游戏和其他软件作为游戏缓存文件（GCF）下载到本地计算机。最初，Valve被要求成为这些游戏的发行商，因为他们可以单独访问Steam的数据库和引擎，但是随着2008年5月Steamworks软件开发工具包（SDK）的推出，任何人都可以在Steam上发布游戏，而无需Valve的直接参与。
target_text: The main service of software delivery and maintenance is to allow its users to download games and other software from their virtual repository as game cache files (GCFs) into their local computers. Initially, Valve was asked to be the distributor of these games, as they had individual access to the database and engine of Steam, but with the launch of the Steamworks software development toolkit (SDK) in May 2008, anyone could post games on Steam without the direct involvement of Valve.
title: Steam

source_text: 2009年前，大多数在Steam上发布的游戏都有传统的反盗版措施，包括分配和分发产品密钥以及支持数字版权管理（DRM）软件工具，如SecuROM或非恶意的rootkit。随着2009年3月Steamworks SDK的更新，Valve在Steamworks SDK中加入了“自定义可执行文件生成”（Custom Executable Generation，CEG）的方法，从而消除了对这些其他措施的需求。CEG技术为特定的用户创建了一个独特的、加密的游戏可执行文件副本，允许他们在多个设备上多次安装，并制作其软件的备份副本。软件被下载和安装后，用户必须通过Steam进行认证，以解密可执行文件来进行游戏。通常情况下，这是在用户的证书验证后连接到互联网时进行的，但一旦他们登录过一次Steam，用户就可以指示Steam在特殊的离线模式下启动，以便能够在没有网络连接的情况下玩他们的游戏。除了Steam的CEG以外，开发者也可以使用其他形式的DRM和Steam以外的其他认证服务；例如，部分育碧的游戏需要使用他们的Uplay游戏服务。也有游戏需要，2014年该服务关闭后，许多游戏转而使用Steamworks CEG。
target_text: Prior to 2009, most of the games released on Steam had traditional anti-piracy measures, including the distribution and distribution of product keys and support for digital copyright management (DRM) software tools, such as SecuROM or non-malignant rootkit. With the update of Steamworks SDK in March 2009, Valve had to use Steam certification to decipher the executable files. This was done when user certificates were validated to connect to the Internet, but once they had access to Steam, users could direct Steam to start several copies of their software on several different devices and to be able to play their games without connectivity.
title: Steam

source_text:
商城特色
Steam客户端包括一个名为Steam商店（Steam Store）的數位商城，用户可以通过它购买电脑游戏。购买游戏后，软件许可证将永久附加到用户的Steam帐户，允许他们在任何兼容设备上下载软件。在某些条件下，可以将游戏许可证授予其他帐户。内容由国际服务器网络使用专有的文件传输协议提供。截至2015年，Steam根据用户的位置以美元、加拿大元、欧元、英镑、巴西雷亚尔、俄罗斯卢布、印度尼西亚卢比及印度卢比销售其产品。2010年12月，客户端开始支援支付系统，该系统在许多欧洲、中东和亚洲国家都很流行。2016年4月至2017年12月，Steam接受了比特币支付，但后来由于币值波动剧烈和服务费高昂而放弃了对它的支援。Steam店面会验证用户所在地区；由于发行日期、游戏分类或与发行商的协议，部分游戏可能仅限于特定地区购买。自2010年以来，Steam翻译服务（）项目在用户的帮助下已将Steam客户端、店面和部分Valve游戏翻译成28种语言。Steam还允许用户购买游戏的可下载内容（DLC），并且某些特定游戏（例如《絕地要塞2》）可以购买游戏内库存物品。2015年2月，Steam开始为第三方游戏开放类似的游戏内物品购买选项。
target_text: In December 2010, the software licence will be permanently attached to the user ' s Steam account, allowing them to download the software on any compatible device. Under certain conditions, the licence will be granted to other accounts. The content will be supplied by an international server network using a proprietary file transfer agreement. As of 2015, Steam will verify the user ' s location; parts of the game may be purchased only in specific areas because of the distribution date, game classification or agreement with the distributor.
title: Steam

source_text:
隐私、安全及滥用
Steam的流行导致其遭到黑客攻击。2011年11月6日，Steam遭到fkn0wned网站的黑客攻击，Valve暂时关闭了Steam论坛。几天后，Valve报告说，黑客获得了进入Steam数据库的权限，该数据库包括用户的信用卡号、密码、电子邮件地址、帐单地址等个人信息。Valve表示不知道入侵者是否真的访问了这些信息或破解了加密的方法，但强制用户更改Steam论坛密码。
target_text: A few days later, Valve reported that hackers had access to the Steam database, which included personal information such as user credit card numbers, passwords, e-mail addresses, and bill addresses. Valve stated that it was not clear whether the intruder had actually accessed the information or deciphered the encryption method, but forced users to change the Steam Forum password.
title: Steam

目前用途
大多数现代总线（GTL+和EV6）是CPU和芯片组的连接主干。芯片组（通常由南桥和北桥组成）是和系统中其他总线的连接节点。PCI、AGP、PCIe和内存总线均和芯片组相连，以使设备间数据能相互传送。这些第二级系统总线的运行速率取决于前端总线的速率。总之，高的前端总线速率意味着计算机的高处理性能。
target_text: Most modern bus lines (GTL+ and EV6) are currently used as the backbone of the CPU and the chip group. The chip group (usually made up of the South and North Bridges) is the connecting node with other bus lines in the system. PCI, AGP, PCIe and the memory bus are all connected to the chip group so that inter-equipment data can be transmitted. The rate of operation of these secondary system buss depends on the rate of the front bus. In sum, the high front bus rate means high processing performance of computers.
title: 前端总线

source_text: 量子计算机（）是一种使用量子邏輯進行通用計算的設備。与电子计算机（或稱傳統電腦）不同，量子計算用來儲存數據的對象是量子位元，它用量子演算法來操作數據。马约拉纳费米子的反粒子就是它自己本身的属性，或许是令量子计算机的制造变成现实的一个关键。量子计算机在輿論中有時被過度渲染成無所不能或速度快數億倍等，其實這種電腦是否強大，需要视問題而定。若該問題已經有提出速算的量子演算法，只是困於傳統電腦無法執行，那量子计算机確實能達到前所未有的高速；若是沒有發明演算法的問題，則量子计算机表現與傳統计算机無異甚至更差。

source_text:
历史
隨著计算机科学的發展，史蒂芬·威斯納在1969年最早提出「基於量子力學的計算設備」。而关于「基於量子力學的信息處理」的最早文章則是由亞歷山大·豪勒夫（1973）、帕帕拉維斯基（1975）、羅馬·印戈登（1976）和尤里·马宁（1980）年發表。史蒂芬·威斯納的文章發表於1983年。1980年代一系列的研究使得量子计算机的理論變得豐富起來。1982年，理查德·費曼在一個著名的演講中提出利用量子體系實現通用計算的想法。緊接著1985年大衛·杜斯提出了量子圖靈機模型。人們研究量子计算机最初很重要的一個出發點是探索通用計算機的計算極限。當使用計算機模擬量子現象時，因為龐大的希爾伯特空間而資料量也變得龐大。一個完好的模擬所需的運算時間則變得相當长，甚至是不切實際的天文數字。理查德·費曼當時就想到如果用量子系統所構成的計算機來模擬量子現象則運算時間可大幅度減少，從而量子计算机的概念誕生。半導體靠控制積體電路來記錄及運算資訊，量子電腦則希望控制原子或小分子的狀態，記錄和運算資訊。
