概要
Cinema 4D的前身是1989年发表的软件FastRay最初只发表在Amiga上，Amiga是一种早期的个人电脑系统，当时还没有图形界面。两年后，在1991年FastRay更新到了1.0，但是这个软件当时还并没有有涉及到三维领域。1993年FastRay更名为CINEMA 4D 1.0，仍然在Amiga上发布。德国MAXON公司出品的CINEMA 4D，是一套整合3D模型、动画与算图的高级三维绘图软件，一直以高速图形计算速度著名，并有令人惊奇的渲染器和粒子系统，其渲染器在不影响速度的前提下使图像品质有了很大的提高，針對打印、出版、设计來创造产品视觉效果。
target_text: The Cinema 4D predecessor was originally published in 1989 only on Amiga, where Amiga was an early personal computer system without a graphical interface. Two years later, Fastray was updated to 1.0 in 1991, but the software did not cover a three-dimensional area. Fastray was renamed CINEMA 4D 1.0 in 1993 and is still published on Amiga. CINEMA 4D, a high-level three-dimensional mapping software that integrates 3D models, animations and algorithms, has been well known for high-speed graphics and has an amazing recouper and particle system, whose resonants have greatly improved image quality, without affecting speed, and have been designed to create visual effects on printing, publishing, and designing products.
title: Cinema 4D

source_text: 目前来看，网络心理学的研究领域主要有，互联网使用对人的认知、情感、意志、行为、人格、一般能力、记忆能力、学习能力、社会适应性等心理特征的一般影响；互联网人格的形成机制与影响因素；互联网使用者的网上/网下双重人格问题；互联网对青少年人格形成的影响；互联网使用成瘾(或称网络成瘾、网瘾)的早期干预、治疗，及网络成瘾者的愈后的社会再适应问题；色情、暴力等不良网络信息对网络使用者的影响；等。其中最热门的题材，即网瘾形成及及戒断方法、互联网对人格形成改变和重建的影响。
target_text: At present, the main areas of research in cyberpsychology are the general impact of Internet use on such psychological features as human perception, emotion, will, behaviour, personality, general ability, memory capacity, ability to learn, social adaptability, etc.; mechanisms and factors influencing the formation and impact of Internet personality; the dual personality problems of Internet users on/under the Internet; the impact of the Internet on the personality formation of young people; early intervention, treatment of Internet addiction (or Internet addiction, Internet addiction) and the social re-adaptation of Internet addicts; the impact of negative web-based information, such as pornography, violence, on Internet users; and so on. The most popular of these topics are Internet addiction formation and disciplining methods, and the impact of the Internet on the transformation and reconstruction of personality formation.
title: 网络心理学

The 2-3-4 tree is relatively difficult to achieve in most programming languages, because the operation of the tree involves a lot of special circumstances. source_text: 分布式操作系统（Distributed operating system），是一种软件，它是许多独立的，网络连接的，通讯的，并且物理上分离的计算节点的集合。每个节点包含全局总操作系统的一个特定的软件子集。每个软件子集是两个不同的服务置备的复合物。第一个服务是一个普遍存在的最小的内核，或微内核，直接控制该节点的硬件。第二个服务是协调节点的独立的和协同的活动系统管理组件的更高级别的集合。这些组件抽象微内核功能，和支持用户应用程序。
target_text: Distributed operating system (distributed operating system) is a software that is many independent, network-connected, communicable, and physically separated combinations of computing nodes. Each node contains a specific software subset of the global master operating system. Each software subset is a composite of two different services. The first service is a universal minimum inner core, or micronuclear, directly controlling the hardware of the node. The second service is a higher assembly of independent and coordinated activity system management components at the coordinating node. These components are abstract micronuclear functions and support user applications.
title: 分布式操作系统

source_text: 分布式操作系统是分布式软件系统的重要组成部分，负责管理分布式处理系统资源、控制分布式程序运行等。分布式软件系统是支持分布式处理的软件系统，包括分布式操作系统、分布式程序设计语言及其编译(解释)系统、分布式文件系统和分布式数据库系统等。
target_text: Distributed operating systems are an important part of distributed software systems, which are responsible for managing distributed processing system resources, controlling distributed program operations, etc. Distributed software systems are software systems that support distributed processing, including distributed operating systems, distributed program design languages and their compilation (interpretation) systems, distributed file systems and distributed database systems.
title: 分布式操作系统

source_text: 中文「小型计算机」（小型机）曾用来表示一种多用户、采用终端/主机模式的计算机，它的规模介于大型计算机和个人电脑之间，有的厂商可能会用其他名称代替。近代中國電腦界依然常常以「小型机」来称呼UNIX服务器，目前已經延伸為所有精简指令集处理器，性能和价格介于服务器和大型主机之间的高性能64位计算机都稱小型機。
target_text: The Chinese term "small computer" (small machine) has been used to represent a multi-user, terminal/host model that is of a size between large computers and personal computers, some of which may be replaced by other names. The recent Chinese computer community continues to refer to UNIX servers as "small machines" and is now extended to all streamlined command set processors, with 64 high-capacity computers with features and prices between servers and large hosts.
title: 小型计算机

source_text:
大型计算机（），又称大型机、大型主机、主机服务器等，是從开始的一系列计算机及與其兼容或同等級的计算机，主要用于大量數據和关键项目的计算，例如银行金融交易及数据处理、人口普查、企业资源规划等。特征
现代大型计算机并非主要通过每秒运算次数MIPS来衡量性能，而是可靠性、安全性、向后兼容性和极其高效的I/O性能。大型机通常强调大规模的数据输入输出，着重强调数据的吞吐量。
target_text: Large computers (also referred to as large machines, large hosts, mainframe servers, etc.) are a series of start-up and compatible or equivalent computers, which are used mainly for the calculation of a large number of data and key items, such as bank financial transactions and data processing, population censuses, enterprise resource planning, etc. Characteristics of modern large computers that measure performance not primarily by the number of MIPS per second, but by reliability, security, back-to-back compatibility and extremely efficient I/O performances. Large machines usually emphasize large-scale data input output, with an emphasis on the volume of data throughput.
title: 大型计算机

source_text: 有些大型计算机可以同时运行多操作系统，因此不像是一台计算机而更像是多台虚拟机，因此一台大型机可以替代多台普通的服务器，是虚拟化的先驱。同时主机还拥有强大的容错能力。大型机的投资回报率取决于处理数据的规模、减少人力开支、实现不间断服务和其他成本的缩减。若大型机的平台与操作系统并不連接互聯網，將很难經由互聯網被駭客攻擊，安全性會增強。
target_text: Some large computers can run multiple operating systems simultaneously, thus not being a computer, but more like a virtual machine, so a large machine can replace a number of normal servers and be a pioneer in virtualization. The mainframe also has a powerful capacity for error. The return on investment in large machines depends on the size of data processing, reduced human costs, uninterrupted service and other cost reductions.
title: 大型计算机

source_text:
大型机使用专用的操作系统和应用软件，在大型机上编程常采用COBOL，同时采用的数据库为IBM自行开发的DB2或是甲骨文公司開發的Oracle等。在大型机上工作的DB2数据库管理员能够管理比其他平台多3～4倍的数据量。市场
IBM目前控制大型机市场超过90%的市场份额。历史
在1960年代，大多数主机没有交互式的界面，通常使用打孔卡、磁带等等。
target_text: Large machines use dedicated operating systems and applications, programming on large aircraft often uses COBOL, while using databases that are self-developed by IBM, DB2 or Oracle, etc. DB2 database administrators working on large aircraft are able to manage 3-4 times more data than other platforms. Market IBM currently controls a market share of more than 90% of the large machine market.
title: 大型计算机

source_text: 1964年，IBM引入了System/360，它是由5种功能越来越强大的计算机所组成的系列，这些计算机运行同一操作系统并能够使用相同的44个外围设备。1972年，为System/360开发了革命性的“企業資源規劃”系统。1999年，Linux出现在中，第一次将开放式源代码计算的灵活性与主机的传统可伸缩性和可靠性相结合。
target_text: In 1964, IBM introduced System/360, a series of five increasingly powerful computers that run the same operating system and can use the same 44 peripherals. In 1972, a revolutionary “business resource planning” system was developed for System/360. In 1999, Linux appeared in the centre, combining for the first time the flexibility of open source computing with the traditional scalability and reliability of the mainframe.
title: 大型计算机

source_text: 大型机更倾向于整数运算，如订单数据、银行数据等，同时在安全性、可靠性和稳定性方面优于超级计算机。而超级计算机更强调浮点运算性能，如數值天气预报。大型机在处理数据的同时需要读写或传输大量信息，如海量的交易信息、航班信息等等。
target_text: Large machines tend to operate in whole numbers, such as order data, bank data, etc., while at the same time being superior to supercomputers in terms of security, reliability, and stability. Supercomputers place greater emphasis on floating point operations, such as numerical weather forecasts.
title: 大型计算机

source_text: 微生物天然产物数据库的前身是协和生技所1980年代开发的微生物数据管理系统，组建该系统的最初目的是用于管理已经提取的微生物次级代谢产物，避免重复的提取分离和生理活性数据。随着管理系统的扩大，容纳的数据越来越多，遂逐渐转变为存储化合物结构数据的微生物天然产物数据库。
target_text: The natural products of micro-organisms database is preceded by the micro-organisms data management system developed by the Institute in the 1980s, which was originally designed to manage extracts of secondary metabolites of micro-organisms, avoiding duplication of extraction separation and physiological activity data. With the expansion of the management system, more and more data are contained, the system is gradually being transformed into a database of natural micro-organisms that store structural data on compounds.
title: 微生物天然产物数据库

source_text: 微生物天然产物数据库收录了15000种化合物的数据，其结构类型涵盖β-内酰胺类化合物、大环内酯类化合物、氨基糖苷类化合物、多肽、氯霉素类化合物、四环素类化合物、蒽类化合物、苯衍生物、醌类化合物、色霉酮苷类化合物、安莎类化合物、核苷、糖类化合物、杂环类化合物、萜类化合物等化合物类型。数据库提供的信息包括化合物的俗名、别名、化学名、分子量、分子式、结构类型、CAS登陆号、化合物的物理性质如晶形、熔点、旋光度、溶解度、光谱性质等、化合物的二维和三维结构、化合物的来源、分离提取方法和生理活性数据、相关文献以及专利信息。
target_text: Data on 15,000 compounds are included in the microbial natural product database. The structure of the database covers beta-neoamide compounds, large cyclic ester compounds, amino-sugar compounds, polymeric compounds, chlorcin compounds, tetracyclic compounds, platinum compounds, benzene derivatives, platinum compounds, chromatone compounds, Antha-type compounds, nuclear platinum, sugar compounds, circulatory compounds, cythopaedic compounds, thorium compounds, etc. The database provides information on the popular name of the compound, aliases, chemical names, molecular weight, molecular formula, structural type, CAS landing sign, physical properties of the compound such as crystallization, melting point, spectrometry, solubility, spectrum properties, etc., the compound’s two-dimensional structure, sources of the compound, separation extraction methods and biological activity data, relevant literature and proprietary information.
title: 微生物天然产物数据库

source_text: 7-Zip预设的格式是其自行开发的7z格式，副檔名為.7z。7z格式包含多種演算法，最常使用的就是Bzip2以及作者伊戈尔·帕夫洛夫開發的LZMA。LZMA演算法比起其他常見的傳統壓縮演算法，如Zip、RAR來說相對較新，壓縮率也比較高。7z格式支持Unicode，且将其默认用于儲存檔案名稱，可以避免不同系统、语言环境间压缩解压乱码的问题。除7-Zip外，目前流行的壓縮程式也大多支持此格式，如WinRAR、Peazip等。
target_text: The 7-Zip preset format is its own 7-z format, with an extension of 7-z. The 7-z format contains multiple algorithms, the most commonly used being Bzip2 and the LZMA developed by Igor Pavlov. LZMA algorithms are relatively new to other conventional compression algorithms, such as Zip, RAR, and have a higher compression rate. The 7-z format supports Unicode and uses its default to save file names to avoid problems with different systems, inter-linguistic compressions. In addition to 7-Zip, popular compression programs, such as WinAR, Peazip, etc., also support this format.
title: 7-Zip

source_text:
院系设置
学院设有侦查系、刑事科学技术系、法医学系、警犬技术系，社会科学部、基础部、警体部。有侦查学、经济犯罪案件侦查、禁毒学、信息安全、刑事科学技术、法医学、警犬技术7个本科专业，有刑事侦查、治安管理、涉外警务、计算机犯罪侦查、经济犯罪侦查、禁毒学、痕迹检验、文件检验、交通事故处理、公安图像技术、法化学、法医学、警犬技术13个专业方向。1998年学院被国务院批准为硕士学位授予单位，并从1999年开始招收硕士学位研究生和第二学士学位学生。研究生教育设有诉讼法学、刑法学、分析化学、计算机应用技术和法医学专业5个硕士点。第二学士学位教育设有侦查学、计算机犯罪侦查，刑事科学技术、法化学、法医学等专业或专业方向。
target_text: In 1998, the Academy was approved by the State Council for the award of a Master ' s degree and began in 1999 with postgraduate and second bachelor ' s degrees. Postgraduate education has five master ' s degrees in litigation law, criminal law, analysis of chemistry, computer applications and forensic medicine.
title: 中国刑事警察学院

source_text: 管理者制造的机械化人士兵，美奈和的“姐姐”，对美奈和很照顾，但最后由于认为有“缺陷”被“销毁”。在漫画版中，美奈和从菲尔德蓝斯得知所有被“销毁”的生化士兵其实是被提取了脑部作为管理者总部计算机的生物电脑处理器，一度令美奈和十分震惊。在太白星攻占管理者总部时，帆风博士请美奈和借助装置成功呼唤到成为生物电脑处理器的369，并救赎了其他被变成生物电脑处理器的生化士兵们，从而令管理者总部的计算机管理系统彻底瘫痪。

During the Tai White Star attack on the manager's head office, Dr. Fanfeng asked Mina and with the device to successfully call for 369 biocomputer processors and redeem the other biochemical soldiers who had been transformed into biocomputer processors, thereby paralysing the manager's head office computer management system.

source_text: 归结规则生成的子句叫做两个输入子句的归结（resolvent）。当两个子句包含多于一对的互补文字的时候，归结规则可以（独立的）应用到每个这种文字对上。但是，只有要消去（resolve）的文字对可以去除：所有其他文字对仍保留在归结后的子句中。一种归结技术当外加上完备的搜索算法的时候，归结规则生成一个可靠的和完备的算法来决定命题公式的可满足性，并且经过扩展，决定句子在一组公理下的有效性。
target_text: The sentence generated by the closing rule is called the end of the two entry sentences (resolvent). When the two sentences contain more than one pair of complementary words, the closing rule can be applied (independently) to each of these words. But only the words to be removed can be removed: all the other words remain in the closing sentence. When a result technique is extrapolated with a full search algorithm, the closing rule generates a reliable and complete algorithm to determine the satisfaction of the word formula and, by extension, the validity of the sentence under a set of common sense.
title: 归结原理

source_text: 因此，可靠的公钥密码算法均能构建出可靠的数字签名。下面講解為何反用公鑰密碼算法能夠構建出安全的數字簽名。Alice是簽名者，假設她要對消息A進行簽名。現在, Alice生成了其公私鑰密碼對，公佈該公鑰，然後將消息用私鑰加密後發布。現在，希望Alice的簽名算法具有如下特性：1,確認消息在傳輸過程中沒有丟位，沒被篡改（完整性）. 2,確認消息的發送者是發布公鑰的Alice（認證）. 3,確認Alice的確發布過該消息（不可否認性）
target_text: So a reliable public key password algorithm can build a reliable digital signature. Here's why the anti-key password algorithm can construct a secure digital signature. Alice is the signatory, assuming she has to sign message A. Now Alice has created its public and private key pair, which is published, and the message is encrypted with a private key. Now, it is hoped that Alice's signature algorithm will have the following characteristics: one, confirmation that the message has not been lost in the transmission process and has not been tampered with (integrity) and two, confirmation that the sender of the message is Alice, who issued the key. Three, confirmation that Alice sent the message.
title: 數位簽章

source_text:
实现数字签名算法是依靠公钥加密技术来实现的。在公钥加密技术里，每一个使用者有一对密钥：一把公钥和一把私钥。公钥可以自由发布，但私钥则秘密保存；还有一个要求就是要让通过公钥推算出私钥的做法不可能实现。普通的数字签名算法包括三种算法：
一种密码生成算法
标记算法
验证算法
target_text: Digital signature algorithms are achieved by public key encryption techniques. In public key encryption techniques, each user has a pair of keys: a public key and a private key. Public keys can be released freely, but private keys are kept secret. There is also a requirement that it is impossible for a private key to be extrapolated by a public key. The normal digital signature algorithm consists of three algorithms: a password-generated algorithm, tag algorithm, authentication algorithm.
title: 數位簽章

source_text: ER模型常用於信息系统设计中；比如它们在概念结构设计阶段用来描述信息需求和／或要存储在数据库中的信息的类型。但是数据建模技术可以用来描述特定论域（就是感兴趣的区域）的任何本体（就是对使用的术语和它们的联系的概述和分类）。在基于数据库的信息系统设计的情况下，在后面的阶段（通常叫做逻辑设计），概念模型要映射到逻辑模型如关系模型上；它依次要在物理设计期间映射到物理模型上。注意，有时这两个阶段被一起称为「物理设计」。
target_text: ER models are commonly used in information systems design; for example, they are used at the conceptual structure design stage to describe information needs and/or the type of information to be stored in a database. But data modelling techniques can be used to describe any body in a particular domain (i.e., the area of interest) (i.e., an overview and classification of the terms used and their links). In the case of database-based information systems, at the later stage (often called logical design), the conceptual model is designed to map the logical model, such as relationship models; it is secondary to the physical model during the physical design. Note that sometimes the two phases are referred to together as “physical design”.
title: ER模型

source_text: 实体（）表示一个离散对象。实体可以被（粗略地）认为是名词，如计算机、雇员、歌曲、数学定理。联系描述了两个或更多实体相互如何关联。联系可以被（粗略地）认为是动词，如：在公司和计算机之间的拥有关联，在雇员和部门之间的管理关联，在演员和歌曲之间的表演关联，在数学家和定理之间的证明关联。实体绘制为矩形，联系绘制为菱形。
target_text: Entity(s) indicates a discrete object. The entity can be considered a noun (boughtly) such as a computer, employee, song, mathematical theory. The connection describes how two or more entities are connected to each other. Linkage can be considered a verb (broughtly) such as: having a connection between a company and a computer, managing a connection between an employee and a sector, performing a link between an actor and a song, proving a connection between a mathematician and aorta.
title: ER模型

source_text:
背景
在1980年代早期，早期微型计算机市场普遍存在的混乱和不兼容问题已经让位于少数事实上的行业标准，包括 、CP/M、、只读存储器 (ROM) 中的 Microsoft BASIC , 和 英寸软盘。没有一家公司能控制这个行业，激烈的竞争确保了硬件和软件的创新是规则而不是例外。 微软 Windows 和英特尔处理器获得了优势，他们的持续联盟使他们获得了市场主导地位。
target_text: In the early 1980s, the confusion and incompatibilities that prevailed in the early microcomputer markets had given way to Microsoft BASIC, and the inch diskette in a few de facto industry standards, including CP/M, read-only storage (ROM). No company could control the industry, and intense competition ensured that innovation in hardware and software was the rule rather than the exception.
title: Wintel

source_text: 1981 年 IBM 进入微型计算机市场。 IBM PC 是由该公司的一个小部门创建的。 对于 IBM 产品来说，这很不寻常，因为它主要来自外部组件供应商，并且旨在运行第三方操作系统和软件。 IBM 公布了 PC 的技术规范和原理图，允许第三方公司生产兼容的硬件，即所谓的。 IBM PC 成为有史以来最成功的计算机之一。
target_text: For IBM products, this is unusual because it comes mainly from external component suppliers and aims to run third-party operating systems and software. IBM has published technical specifications and rationales for PCs, allowing third-party companies to produce compatible hardware, so-called IBMPCs, one of the most successful computers ever.
title: Wintel

source_text: 因为 IBM PC 是带有 IBM 徽章的 IBM 产品，所以个人电脑变得受人尊敬。 与一两年前相比，企业更容易证明购买微型计算机的合理性，并且最容易证明购买 IBM 个人计算机的合理性。 因为 PC 架构在 IBM 手册中有详细记录，并且 PC DOS 的设计类似于早期的 CP/M 操作系统，PC 很快就有了数千种不同的第三方附加卡和软件包可用。 这使得 PC 成为许多人的首选，因为 PC 支持他们所需的硬件和软件。
target_text: As IBM PC is an IBM product with IBM badges, personal computers become respected. Compared to a year ago, businesses are easier to justify the purchase of microcomputers, and it is easier to justify the purchase of IBM personal computers.
title: Wintel

source_text:
竞争对手
行业竞争对手采取了几种方法之一来应对不断变化的市场。有些（例如 苹果公司、Amiga、雅达利 和 艾康电脑）坚持使用他们独立且完全不同的系统。在这些系统中，苹果公司的麦金塔是市场上仅存的一款。其他公司（例如当时世界第二大计算机公司迪吉多、惠普和 ）专注于制造类似但技术上更优越的模型。其他早期的市场领导者（例如 Tandy-Radio Shack 或德州仪器）在过时的架构和专有操作系统上停留了一段时间，然后才意识到市场趋势的走向并转向最成功的长期业务战略，即制造一台尽可能复制 IBM PC 的机器，然后以稍低的价格或更高的性能出售它。鉴于早期 IBM 个人电脑的工程设计非常保守，而且价格高于平均水平，这起初并不是一项非常艰巨的任务，只有在制作一个完全复制 IBM BIOS 功能但不侵犯版权的 BIOS 时才会面临巨大的技术挑战。
target_text: Other companies (e.g. Digido, Hewlett-Packard and others, the second largest computer company in the world at the time) focused on creating similar but technologically superior models. Other early market leaders (e.g. Tandy-Radio Shack or a Texas instrument) stayed on outdated structures and proprietary systems for some time before realizing market trends and moving to the most successful long-term business strategy, creating a machine to replicate IBM PC as much as possible, and then selling it at a slightly lower or higher level. Given that the early IBM personal computer project was very conservative and above average, that was not a very difficult task at first, but only when producing a BOS that fully replicates IBM BIOS functions without violating copyright.
title: Wintel

source_text: 1987 年，IBM 推出了 PS/2 计算机系列。尽管 PC 及其继任者的取得了巨大的成功，并且他们是最大的单一制造商，但大部分市场都在购买其他公司制造的更快、更便宜的 IBM 兼容机器。 PS/2 保持软件兼容，但硬件完全不同。它引入了技术上优越的总线以实现系统内的更高速通信，但未能维持开放的 AT 总线（后来称为工业标准结构），这意味着现有的数百万个附加卡都无法正常工作。换句话说，新的 IBM 机器与 IBM 不兼容。
target_text: In 1987, IBM launched the PS/2 computer series. Despite the great success of PC and its successors, who are the largest single manufacturers, most markets are buying faster and cheaper IBM compatible machines made by other companies. PS/2 maintains software compatibility, but hardware is completely different. It introduces a technically superior bus to achieve higher speeds of communication within the system, but fails to maintain an open AT bus (later known as the industrial standard structure), which means that millions of additional cards are not working properly. In other words, the new IBM machine is incompatible with IBM.
title: Wintel

source_text:
支配地位
在接下来的几年中，Wintel 合作伙伴关系中的两家公司都将试图扩大其垄断地位。英特尔成功进军主板和芯片组市场——成为世界上最大的主板制造商，在某个阶段，几乎是唯一的芯片组制造商——但在进军图形芯片市场的尝试中失败了，并且（从 1991 年开始） ) 在其核心 CPU 领域面临来自超微半导体、Cyrix、威盛电子和全美达的激烈竞争。
target_text: Over the next few years, two companies in the Wintel Partnership will try to expand their monopoly status. Intel has successfully entered the main plate and chip group market – the world’s largest and, at some stage, almost the only chip group manufacturer – but has failed in their attempts to enter the graphic chip market, and (started in 1991) has faced fierce competition in its core CPU fields from ultra-microconductors, Cyrix, Weiss Electronics, and all of America.
title: Wintel

source_text: 微软表现更好。 1990 年，微软在其核心市场有两个竞争对手（Digital Research 和 IBM），而英特尔则没有。到 1996 年，英特尔在其核心市场 (CPU) 上有两个竞争对手，而微软则没有。微软一直奉行坚持按处理器计费的政策，从而使竞争操作系统对计算机制造商没有吸引力，并引发欧盟委员会和美国当局的监管审查，导致微软承诺停止此类做法。 然而，将 DOS 集成到 Windows 95 是主线：不仅其他操作系统供应商被冻结，微软现在可以要求计算机制造商遵守其要求更高价格的痛苦（就像它要求 IBM 停止积极营销 OS/2 否则为 Windows 95 支付其竞争对手 Compaq 两倍以上的费用一样） 或扣留“为 Windows 95 设计”的背书（这被认为是一种重要的硬件营销工具）。微软还能够要求硬件制造商向他们提供免费宣传。 （例如，几乎所有现代键盘上的 Windows 键广告符号，或者对系统启动期间和 Windows 桌面上可能显示或可能不显示的内容的严格许可限制。）此外，微软以Windows NT能够接管大部分网络市场（以前是 的 和 Novell 的 NetWare 的领域），以及以Microsoft Office接管商业应用程序市场（以前由 莲花软件 和 WordPerfect 领导） 。

source_text: ALGOL，名稱源自演算法語言（）的縮寫，是一族指令式編程語言，發展於1950年代中期，對許多其它程式語言產生了重大影響。计算机协会在教科書及學術文章採用此語言做為描述演算法的標準語法超過三十年。由大多數近代程式語言皆使用類似ALGOL的語法來看，ALGOL可與差不多同時期的FORTRAN、LISP及COBOL並列為四大最有影響力的高階語言。ALGOL被設計用來避免FORTRAN中一些已知的問題，最終引領了許多其它程式語言的興起，包括PL/I、Simula、BCPL、B、Pascal及C。
target_text: ALGOL, an abbreviated name derived from the algorithmic language(s), is a command-based programming language that developed in the mid-1950s and has had a significant impact on many other programming languages. The computer association has adopted this language as a standard syntax for descriptive algorithms in books and academic articles for more than 30 years. Most of the contemporary programming languages use a syntax similar to ALGOL, and ALGOL can be listed as four of the most influential high-level languages of almost the same time. ALGOL has been designed to avoid some of the known problems in FORTRAN, and has eventually led to the emergence of many other programming languages, including PL/I, Simula, BCPL, B, Pascal and C.
title: ALGOL

source_text: 架构QEMU的架构由纯软件实现，并在Guest与Host中间，来处理Guest的硬件请求，并由其转译给真正的硬件。然而因为QEMU是纯软件实现的，所有的指令都要经过QEMU，使得性能很差，而配合KVM则可以解决这一问题。QEMU虚拟化的思路是：提取Guest代码，翻译为TCG中间代码，而后翻译为Host代码。相当于实现了一个“中间人”的角色。
target_text: The architecture of the QEMU is made possible by pure software, which handles Guest's hardware requests and translates them into real hardware between Guest and Host. However, since the QEMU is purely software-based, all instructions go through QEMU, which makes performance poor, while the KVM solves the problem. The idea behind the virtualization of the QEMU is to extract the Guest code, translate it into an intermediate TCG code, and then translate it into a Host code.
title: QEMU

source_text: QEMU集成了多种服务以允许主机和访客系统进行通信;例如，集成的SMB服务器和网络端口重定向（以允许传入连接到虚拟机）。它也可以在没有引导程序的情况下引导Linux内核。QEMU不依赖主机系统上的图形输出方法。相反，它可以允许通过集成的VNC服务器访问客户操作系统的屏幕。它还可以使用模拟的串行线，而不使用任何屏幕和适用的操作系统。
target_text: QEMU combines services to allow host and visitor systems to communicate; for example, integrated SMB servers and network portals are reoriented (to allow access to virtual machines). It can also direct Linux kernels without a steering program. QEMU does not rely on graphic output on the mainframe system. Instead, it allows access to the screens of the client operating system via integrated VNC servers. It can also use analogue string lines rather than any screen and applicable operating system.
title: QEMU

source_text:
丰富互联网应用程序（，简称），又譯為豐富性網路應用服務，是一种具有近似于传统桌面应用软件系统功能和特性的网络应用系统。RIA系统最大的特点是将大部分处理任务都从用户界面端移植到客户端，仅保留一些必要数据与服务器端进行信息交互。
RIA系统的特性：
运行于浏览器中，不需要额外安装支持软件
在本地运行时，受安全沙箱全程保护
target_text: The largest feature of the RIA system is the migration of most processing tasks from the user interface to the client, with only some of the necessary data remaining to interact with information on the server end.
title: 丰富互联网应用程序

source_text:
尽管与开发运行在桌面的程序相比，开发运行在浏览器中的应用程序要更受限、更复杂、更困难，但是这种努力还是值得的，因为它具有以下优点：
安装简便—终端用户可在任何连接到互联网上的設備中使用程序，而應用程序會自动或以简单手动方式更新到最新版本，更新与使用费用与桌面程序和操作系统相比要经济的多。
有很多工具支持离线使用，例如Adobe AIR，Google Gears等等。
多数丰富互联网应用程序藉由網頁瀏覽器，可以跨平台使用
与可执行文件相比，基于网络的应用程序可以有效的避免病毒侵袭(此一优点或已過時)
target_text: Although the development of applications running on the desktop is more limited, complex and difficult than the development of applications running on the desktop, this effort is worthwhile because it has the following advantages:
title: 丰富互联网应用程序

source_text:
由于丰富互联网应用程序采用客户端引擎，所以它具有以下特点：
表现力丰富：丰富互联网应用程序能在基于标准浏览器的网页应用，实现 HTML标签難以实作的用户界面效果。这种内涵更丰富的交互涵盖所有在客户端所能实现的功能，例如拖拽功能、滑块功能，而且这些功能无需与伺服器端交互数据，完全是在客户端进行运算，如抵押计算。
target_text: As the Internet applications are enriched with client engines, they have the following features: Performance: The Internet applications are enriched with web applications based on standard browsers that achieve user interface effects that HTML labels are difficult to perform. This rich interaction covers all functions that can be performed at the client end, such as drag functions, slide functions, and these functions do not have to interact with the server end data, and are performed exclusively on the client, such as collateral calculations.
title: 丰富互联网应用程序

source_text:
而且，使用客户端引擎还有以下好处：
C/S结构的负担平衡(此点或为誤解，實作剛好相反)：丰富互联网应用程序可以使客户端和伺服器端对资源的需求更加平衡，从而使伺服器不必再像传统网页应用中那样一直高负荷的运转。由此伺服器端的资源得到了解放，从而提升了同一伺服器端硬件能并行服务的客户端会话数量。
target_text: Moreover, the use of the client engine has the following benefits: C/S structure has a burden balance (this point, or for misinterpretation, is exactly the opposite): enriching Internet applications allows for a more balanced demand for resources on both the client and the server, so that the server does not have to operate as heavily as in traditional web applications. As a result, the server ' s resources are freed, thus increasing the number of client sessions that the same server ' s hardware can serve in parallel.
title: 丰富互联网应用程序

source_text: 异步通信：无须等待用户执行诸如在按钮或链接上点击的交互操作，客户端引擎便可与服务器端进行交互。如此，用户便可在客户端引擎跟伺服器端通信的同时，异步地进行页面浏览或交互。丰富互联网应用程序的设计方式，便可在免予让用户等待的情境下，在客户端与服务器端之间传输数据(因此伺服器端可能收到更多 http請求，负荷會比傳統網頁更重)。程序会预先从服务器端讀取数据，即程序预见到未来可能需要某些数据的时候，会先于用户端發出请求之前将其下载，可提升回应后续请求的速度。Google Maps便是利用了这种技术，先于用户将屏幕滚动到临近地区，预取到周圍的图片資料。
target_text: Antagonistic communication: Client engines can interact with the server ' s end without waiting for users to perform interactive operations such as clicking on buttons or links. In this way, users can interact with the client ' s end engine while they communicate with the server ' s end. A rich Internet application is designed in such a way as to transmit data between the client ' s end and the server ' s end (and thus the server ' s end may receive more requests from http and load more than the traditional web pages). The program will read data in advance from the server ' s end, i.e. the program foresees that certain data may be needed in the future, downloading them before the user ' s end makes a request and increasing the speed of responding to follow-up requests. Google Maps uses this technology by pre-empting the user to scroll the screen to a nearby area and pre-empting the surrounding photo data.
title: 丰富互联网应用程序

source_text: 网络效率高(此点或为誤解，實作剛好相反)：丰富互联网应用程序的网络通信量也会明显减少，这是由于在决定需要与伺服器端交换什么数据时，为应用程序专门设计的客户端引擎，会比标准的网页浏览器更智能(?)。由于每次交互所需传输的数据量变少了，从而总负载也减轻了(总负载並不因而减轻)，所以每个请求和响应的速度也就提升。
target_text: Network efficiency (this is a misunderstanding, the opposite is true): there will also be a significant decrease in network traffic for the enrichment of Internet applications, as the client-end engine specially designed for the application is smarter than the standard web browser (?) when deciding what data to exchange with the server end of the application is needed. As the amount of data to be transmitted for each interaction decreases, the total load is reduced (and therefore the total load is not reduced), the speed of each request and response increases.
title: 丰富互联网应用程序

source_text: 丰富互联网应用程序存在以下缺陷：受限于安全沙箱。由于丰富互联网应用程序程序运行在安全沙箱中，所以其对系统资源的访问会受到限制。一旦对系统资源的访问出现错误，那么丰富互联网应用程序程序就将无法正常运行。依赖于脚本支持。丰富互联网应用程序程序常常需要JavaScript或其它脚本语言的支持。一旦用户浏览器对这些脚本进行屏蔽，丰富互联网应用程序将无法正常运作。客户端运行速度受限。为实现平台无关性，一些丰富互联网应用程序选用诸如JavaScript这类脚本语言来编写其客户端脚本，从而导致了性能上的损失（在移动设备中，此类问题尤为显著）。而对于如Java这类的客户端语言是不存在这类问题的，因为它的性能已可比拟传统的编译型语言了，而对于Flash，Curl或Silverlight，因为在其插件中所运行的代码也是经过编译的，所以同样也不存在这类问题。下载脚本的延时。虽然无需安装软件，但是丰富互联网应用程序的客户端引擎还是要从服务器端传送信息到客户端。虽然绝大多数传输信息会被缓存，但这种传输也至少要执行一次。根据下载的类型和大小，脚本的下载可能会是一件令人苦恼的事情。对此，丰富互联网应用程序的开发者可采取压缩、分段等技术在一定程度上减少这种延迟带来的影响。集成困难。
target_text: The following deficiencies exist in the enrichment of Internet applications: it is limited to secure sandboxes. Access to system resources is limited by the fact that the enrichment of Internet applications operates in secure sandboxes. In the event of an error in access to system resources, the enrichment of Internet applications cannot function properly. Support is dependent on scripts. The enrichment of Internet applications often requires the support of JavaScript or other script languages. Once user browsers screen these scripts, the proliferation of Internet applications will not work. Client end-of-end speed is limited. In order to make the platform irrelevant, some enrichment of Internet applications use scripts such as JavaScript to prepare their client scripts, which may result in a loss of performance (particularly in mobile devices).
title: 丰富互联网应用程序

source_text: 如果基于X/HTML开发应用，那么应用程序的目的（向往控制一切表现效果和行为）和X/HTML的目的（向往解除一切控制）之间的冲突会进一步加剧。X/HTML的DOM接口为创建丰富互联网应用程序提供了一个可能，但是该方案又会导致丰富互联网应用程序中的一些功能瘫痪。因为在该方案中，丰富互联网应用程序的客户端可以修改应用程序的基本结构并覆盖其的表现效果和行为，这可能将导致应用程序在客户端的执行错误。最终，该问题通过采用新式的客户端机制来解决，在该机制中，丰富互联网应用程序将受限于只能对其自身范围的资源进行修改。（标准的运行在本地软件之所以不存在该类问题是因为其遵循一个自动程序的定义，只能处理它自行分配的资源）。搜索引擎优化困难。搜索引擎可能无法搜索应用程序文本内容中的索引。依赖于互联网连接。最理想的替代桌面程序的互联网应用程序要允许用户间断性的上网，这样用户就可以游走在各个热点与办公地之间。鉴于此，一些特殊的平台（如Adobe AIR，Google Gears）就需要允许离线操作的丰富互联网应用程序程序。可访问性存在困难。在丰富互联网应用程序中存在很多访问性的困难，其中多数明显地表现为屏幕阅读器在探测由JavaScript引起的HTML内容更变上遇到了极大的困难。无法部署。
target_text: If an application based on X/HTML is developed, the conflict between the purpose of the application (to control all performances and behaviour) and the purpose of X/HTML (to remove all controls) is further exacerbated. The DOM interface of X/HTML offers the possibility of creating a rich Internet application, but the program will also lead to the paralysis of some functions in the enrichment of Internet applications. Because in the program, the client who enriches the Internet application can modify the basic structure of the application and cover its performance and behaviour, which may lead to an error in the implementation of the application on its client side. Ultimately, the problem is resolved through the introduction of a new client-to-client mechanism, in which the enrichment of Internet applications will be limited to resources of its own scope. (This type of problem does not exist in local software, as it follows a definition of an automated application, but only deals with its own allocation of resources.) The search engine may not be able to search for the index of the text content of the application.
title: 丰富互联网应用程序

source_text:
软件开发复杂性
丰富互联网应用程序技术的出现，给网页应用的开发引入了相當可观的复杂度。仅使用标准 HTML 构建的传统网页应用，其软件架构相对来说較为简单，同时开发方案选择也有限，所以比較起來易于设计和管理。对使用丰富互联网应用程序技术的个人或组织而言，他们所面临额外的复杂度是更难于进行设计、测试、评估和支援。
target_text: The complexity of software development enriches the technology of Internet applications and introduces considerable complexity into the development of web applications. The traditional web applications built using standard HTML are relatively simple in their software architecture and limited options for developing them, making them easier to design and manage.
title: 丰富互联网应用程序

source_text: 丰富互联网应用程序技术的使用，引起了若干个在服务级管理（service level management，简称SLM）上的新挑战。而这些挑战至今也仍未得到彻底解决。服务级管理所关心的并非总是应用开发者的焦点所在，也甚少为应用使用者所察觉，但它们对一个在线应用的成功交付，却起着至关重要的作用。丰富互联网应用程序架构中，使管理过程相對复杂化的方面包括：
target_text: Enriching the use of Internet applications technology has given rise to several new challenges in service-level management (service level management, SLM). These challenges have yet to be fully addressed. Service-level management concerns are not always the focus of application developers and are rarely perceived by users, but they play a crucial role in the successful delivery of an online application.
title: 丰富互联网应用程序

source_text: 更大的复杂度让开发变得更加困难：将代码移至客户端的能力，给了应用设计者和开发者更多的创造空间。但是这反过来也让开发变得更加困难，增加了发生过失（bugs）的可能性，也加大了软件测试的复杂度。无论引入何种方法論或过程，这些复杂程度都會延长开发过程。这些问题中有些可能利用网页应用框架，对丰富互联网应用程序的设计和开发进行标准化来减轻。但是不论以何种解决方案，如果增加了使用案例的数量，则导致後續的测试过程也将隨之复杂化並延长工期。而不完整的测试又会降低应用的品质，和使用时的可靠性。
target_text: Greater complexity makes development more difficult: the ability to move codes to clients gives more creative space to application designers and developers. But this, in turn, makes development more difficult, increases the likelihood of error (bugs) and increases the complexity of software testing. Whatever methodological theory or process is introduced, these complexity extend the development process. Some of these problems may be reduced by using web application frameworks to standardize the design and development of rich Internet applications.
title: 丰富互联网应用程序

source_text: 有人可能要说，上边的讨论并非只是丰富互联网应用程序技术特有的，而是关于复杂性的广泛问题。例如，同样的争论就发生于苹果跟微软分别在 1980年代发布其GUI时，甚至可能还发生于 Ford 发布其Model T时。不過在十幾年间，人类已展現了調適並且吸收新技术优势的能力。
target_text: It may be argued that the discussion above is not just about enriching the technology of Internet applications, but about a wide range of issues of complexity. For example, the same controversy occurred when Apple and Microsoft, respectively, released their GUI in the 1980s, and possibly even when Ford published its Model T. Over a decade, however, humans have demonstrated their ability to adapt and absorb the advantages of new technologies.
title: 丰富互联网应用程序

source_text: 丰富互联网应用程序架构违反了网页范式：传统的网页应用为一系列的网页檔案，每一网页都需单独经由 HTTP GET 请求发起载入页面过程。这种模型被称为网页范式。丰富互联网应用程序幾乎跳過了这樣子的流程，额外引入了异步的伺服器端通信方式来支持反应更迅速的用户界面。在丰富互联网应用程序中，完整加载一个页面所需的时间，可能不再是用户所能察觉到的重要指标，因为（打个比方说）客户端引擎可能预先载入了某些内容。为了能有效地评估丰富互联网应用程序，反映用户体验的指标，應会有新技术被设计出来。在这种评估技术出现之前，丰富互联网应用程序的开发者，应该指示他们的应用代码来为SLM产生测量数据。
target_text: The enrichment of Internet applications is a violation of the web paradigm: the traditional web application is a series of web files, and each page is required to initiate a page-loading process individually via HTTP GET. This model is called a web-page paradigm. The enrichment of Internet applications almost skips the process, with an additional off-the-shelf server-end communication to support a more responsive user interface. In enrichment of Internet applications, the time required to load a page in its entirety may no longer be an important indicator that users can detect, as the client engine may pre-inform certain content. In order to be able to effectively assess the enrichment of Internet applications, indicators that reflect user experience, new technologies should be designed. Before this assessment technology occurs, developers of Internet applications should be instructed to use codes to generate measurements for SLM.
title: 丰富互联网应用程序

source_text: 异步通信导致难以隔离性能问题。看似矛盾地，增强应用的响应能力的措施，同时也使其难于衡量、理解、报告以及管理响应能力。一些丰富互联网应用程序在加载第一个页面后，便不再从浏览器发送任何 HTTP GET请求，而是通过其客户端引擎使用异步请求来初始化后续下载。
target_text: Asynchronous communication makes it difficult to isolate performance problems. Paradoxically, measures to enhance the responsiveness of applications also make it difficult to measure, understand, report, and manage the responsiveness. Some rich Internet applications do not send any HTTP GET requests from browsers after loading the first page, but rather initialize follow-up downloads through the use of asymmetric requests on their client engines.
title: 丰富互联网应用程序

source_text: VMware Workstation是VMware公司销售的商业软件产品之一。该工作站软件包含一个用于英特尔x86相容電腦的虚拟机套装，其允许用户同时创建和运行多个x86虚拟机。每个虚拟机可以运行其安裝的操作系统，如（但不限于）Windows、Linux、BSD变生版本。用简单术语来描述就是，VMware Workstation允许一台真实的電腦在一個作業系統中同时開啟並运行数个操作系统，其它VMware产品帮助在多个宿主電腦之间管理或移植VMware虚拟机。免费版本為VMware Workstation Player。
target_text: VMware Workstation is one of the commercial software products that VMware sells. The workstation software contains a virtual machine package for Intelx86 compatible computers, which allows users to create and run several x86 virtual machines simultaneously. Each virtual machine can run its installed operating systems, such as (but not limited to) Windows, Linux, and BSD variants. As a simple term, VMware Workstation allows a real computer to open and run several operating systems simultaneously in an operating system, while other VMware products help manage or transplant VMware virtual machines between multiple host computers.
title: VMware

source_text: 数据中心亦可使用VMware服务器产品运行，但运行该产品须依赖于宿主环境的基本操作系统；此外，在运行软件的额外层面时也会产生对机器的附加开销。然而VMware服务器产品具有一点超过ESX产品的优势：它支持的设备的规格更多，例如可支持USB连接方式和某些PCI设备。
target_text: The data centre can also operate using the VMware server product, which is dependent on the host environment’s basic operating system; in addition, additional aspects of the software can result in additional costs for the machine. However, the VMware server product has a somewhat greater advantage than the ESX product: it supports more specific equipment, such as USB connections and certain PCI devices.
title: VMware

source_text:
其它产品
其它三种与ESX协同运行的产品是：虚拟中心（VirtualCenter）、VMotion和P2V（将物理计算机运行环境直接移植为虚拟机的工具）。
虚拟中心可用来监视和管理多个ESX或GSX服务器。
VMotion可用来在服务器之间实现几乎无停滞地移动运行中的虚拟机。
P2V允许用户通过使用映像软件，将一台物理的服务器制作为虚拟机映像，从而创造出一个从物理机到虚拟机的重现。它用虚拟的驱动文件代替了实际的驱动文件，并且在VMware的数据存储中创建出机器空间。
target_text: Other products The other three products that work with ESX are the Virtual Centre (Virtual Center), VMotion and P2V (a tool to convert the physical computer operating environment directly into a virtual machine). Virtual centres can be used to monitor and manage multiple ESX or GSX servers. VMotion can be used to move virtual machines almost unstagnated between servers. P2V allows users to create a physical server into a virtual image by using image software, thus creating a recurrence from a physical machine to a virtual machine. It replaces actual drivers with virtual drivers and creates machine space in VMware data storage.
title: VMware

source_text: 运行VMware工作站进程的计算机和操作系统被称为宿主机（host）。在一个虚拟机中运行的操作系统实例被称为虚拟机客户（guest）。类似仿真器，VMware工作站为客户操作系统提供完全虚拟化的硬件集–例如，客户机只会检测到一个AMD PCnet网络适配器，而和宿主机上真正安装的网络适配器的制造和型号无关。VMware在虚拟环境中将所有设备虚拟化，包括视频适配器、网络适配器、以及硬盘适配器。它还为USB、串行和并行设备提供传递驱动程序（pass-through drivers，指将对这些虚拟设备的访问传递到真实物理设备的驱动程序）。
target_text: Computers and operating systems running the VMware workstation process are known as hosts (host). Examples of operating systems operating in a virtual machine are referred to as virtual machine customers (guest). Similar emulators, the VMware workstations provide complete virtual hardware sets for client operating systems - for example, the client will detect only an AMD PCnet network adapter and have nothing to do with the manufacture and model of a network adapter that is actually installed on the host. VMware virtualizes all equipment in a virtual environment, including video adapters, network adapters, and hard disk adapters.
title: VMware

source_text: 由于与宿主机的真实硬件无关，所有虚拟机客户使用相同的硬件驱动程序，虚拟机实例是对各种计算机高度可移植的。例如，一个运行中的虚拟机可以被暂停下来，并被拷贝到另外一台作为宿主的真实计算机上，然后从其被暂停的确切位置恢复运行。借助VMware的VirtualCenter（虚拟机中心）产品中一种称为Vmotion的新功能，甚至可以在移动一个虚拟机时不必将其暂停–就是说现在即使在向不同的宿主机上移植虚拟机时，这些虚拟机仍然可以保持运行。
target_text: For example, a running virtual machine can be suspended and copied to another real computer as host, and then resumed from its exact location. With VMware’s VirtualCenter product, a new function called Vmotion can be used without even having to suspend a virtual machine when moving it – that is, even now, when a virtual machine is transplanted to different hosts.
title: VMware

source_text: 和Virtual PC for Windows产品及带有kqemu附加模块的QEMU产品一样，VMware工作站使用了一种更加优化的方式，在尽可能的情况下直接运行程序代码，在x86中这是执行用户模式和虚拟8086模式的程序代码的情况而言。当不能直接运行程序代码时，这几种软件产品会动态地重写代码，这是在执行内核级别和实模式的程序代码的情况而言。在VMware中，经过翻译的代码是被放入内存的空闲区域中的，一般是在地址空间的尾部，这个区域可以随即被保护起来并通过分段机制标记为不可见的。由于这些原因，VMware比仿真器显著地快，能以超过在真实硬件上运行速度的80%的速度运行虚拟的客户操作系统。VMware对在运行高强度计算的应用程序时只有小到3%-5%的效能损耗而自豪。
target_text: Like the Virtual PC for Windows and the QEMU product with the kqemu additional module, the VMware workstation uses a more optimal approach, operating the program code directly as far as possible, and in x86 this is the application code for the implementation of the user model and the virtual 8086 model. When it cannot run the program code directly, these software products dynamically rewrite the code, in the case of the application code for the implementation of the kernel level and physical mode. In VMware, the translated code is in the spare area that is stored inside, usually at the end of the address space, which can then be protected and marked invisible by a branch mechanism. For these reasons, VMware can operate a virtual client operating system at a significantly faster rate than 80% of the speed at which the actual hardware are running. VMware is proud of having less than 3 to 5% of the efficiency in running applications calculated with high intensity.
title: VMware

source_text: 缺点是客户操作系统的指令代码必须和宿主机的CPU兼容。因此不同于仿真器，VMware工作站不能用来在一个英特尔x86处理器上运行Mac/PPC软件。另一个缺点是通常不可能有效率地嵌套使用VMware虚拟机（指在虚拟机客户中运行另一个VMware虚拟机，即以一个虚拟机客户作为宿主机再运行VMware）。最后，尽管VMware虚拟机是运行于用户模式下的，VMware工作站宿主程序本身必须在宿主操作系统下安装多种驱动程序，尤其是为了能动态切换GDT和IDT表。
target_text: The disadvantage is that the command code of the client operating system must be compatible with the host ' s CPU. Thus, unlike the emulator, the VMware workstation cannot be used to run the Mac/PC software on an Intelx86 processor. The other disadvantage is that it is not usually possible to efficiently embed the VMware virtual machine (i.e. to run another VMware virtual machine in a virtual client, i.e. to rerun VMware with a virtual client as host). Finally, while the VMware workstation itself must install multiple drivers under the host operating system, especially for dynamic switching of GDT and IDT tables.
title: VMware

source_text: 除了为到网络适配器、CD-ROM读盘机、硬盘驱动器、以及USB设备的访问提供桥梁外，VMware工作站还提供模拟某些硬件的能力。例如，能将一个ISO文件作为一张CDROM安装在系统上、也能将.vmdk文件作为硬盘驱动器安装、以及可将网络适配器驱动程序配置为通过宿主计算机使用网络地址转换（NAT）来访问网络，而非使用与宿主机桥接的方式（该方式為：宿主网络上的每个客户操作系统必須分配一个IP地址）。
target_text: In addition to providing bridges to network adaptors, CD-ROM readers, hard disk drives, and access to USB devices, the VMware workstation provides the capability to simulate some hardware. For example, an ISO document can be installed on the system as a CDROM, a .vmdk file can be installed as a hard drive, and a network adaptor driver can be configured to access the network by using a network address conversion (NT) on a host computer instead of using a host bridge (this way: each client operating system on the host network has to be assigned an IP address).
title: VMware

source_text: VMware工作站还允许无须将LiveCD烧录到真正的光盘上、也无须重启计算机，而对这些LiveCD进行测试。还可以捕获在VMware工作站下运行的某个操作系统的快照。每个快照可以用来在任何时候将虚拟机回滚到保存的状态。这种多快照功能使VMware工作站成为销售人员演示复杂的软件产品、开发人员建立虚拟开发和测试环境的非常流行的工具。VMware工作站包含有将多个虚拟机指定为编队的能力，编队可以作为一个物体来开机、关机、挂起和恢复—这使VMware工作站在用于测试客户端-服务器环境时特别有用。
target_text: VMware workstations also allow for the testing of LiveCDs without the need to burn LiveCDs on real CDs or restart computers. They also capture snapshots of an operating system running under VMware workstations. Each snapshot can be used to roll the virtual plane back to the state of preservation at any given time. This multi-switching function makes VMware workstations a very popular tool for salesmen to demonstrate complex software products, for developers to build virtual development and test environments. The VMware workstations contain the ability to assign several virtual machines to formations that can be set up as objects to turn off, turn off, mount and recover - which makes the VMware workstations particularly useful when used to test client-server environments.
title: VMware

source_text: 这些文件标有“微软机密”，对开源软件（OSS）进行鉴定，特别是Linux操作系统，被认为是对微软占控制地位的软件业的主要威胁，文件还建议微软如何可以抑制开源软件的发展。这些文件除了承认开源／自由软件／Linux产品在技术上是部分微软产品的有力竞争对手，还对如何取而胜之出谋划策。这些文件使微软相当尴尬，因为跟微软以前在这方面的表态自相矛盾。
target_text: In addition to recognizing open source/free software/Linux products as a powerful technically competitive competitor for some Microsoft products, these documents provide advice on how to win. These documents make Microsoft rather awkward, as they contradict Microsoft's previous pronouncements in this regard.
title: 万圣节文件

source_text:

注意：只有部分内部备忘录被泄露而成为发布的“万圣节文件”，特别是文件I、II、VII、VIII以及X。文件III是公开声明。其他是埃里克·雷蒙对各种专栏、新闻稿等文章的回复。
target_text: Both original documents were released, and Microsoft's memos on a range of related topics were leaked and published. They all showed Microsoft's sense that open-source software competitors could threaten his survival in the software industry. Note: Only part of the internal memos were leaked and became published as “Hallowday documents”, especially documents I, II, VII, VIII, and X. Document III is a public statement. Others are Eric Raymond's responses to articles in columns, press releases, etc.
title: 万圣节文件

source_text:
在中国大陆的情况
中華人民共和國国家测绘地理信息局在2012年2月宣布，Google在中国合资公司的互联网地图服务目前可维持现状，显示中国官方和Google在互联网地图服务上的争执有所缓和。测绘局公告称，Google在华合资公司——北京谷翔信息技术有限公司已于2011年11月提出互联网地图服务测绘资质申请，在资质审批过程中，其互联网地图服务可维持现状，但不得增加新的互联网地图服务内容。这意味中国版地图被当局禁止推出街景服务。
target_text: On mainland China, the China People’s Republic of China’s National Mapping and Geo-Information Agency announced in February 2012 that Google’s Internet Map Service at China’s joint venture could currently maintain the status quo, showing that disputes between Chinese officials and Google over the Internet Map Service had subsided. The Survey and Mapping Authority announced that Google, a joint venture company in China, Beijing Valley Information Technology Ltd., had submitted an application for Internet Map Service mapping qualifications in November 2011, and that its Internet Map Service could maintain the status quo during the qualification process, but not add new Internet Map Service content.
title: Google地图

以在计算机科学中的应用为导向的逻辑学研究。例如：组合子逻辑和抽象释义；
以逻辑形式自然表达的计算机科学基本概念。例如：编程语言的形式语义，霍尔逻辑和逻辑编程；

For example, combination logic and abstract interpretation; Basic concepts of computer science expressed naturally in logical form. For example, formal semantics in programming languages, Hall logic and logical programming; Aspects of basic questions of formal logic in computing theory. For example, Curry-Howard corresponds to and plays games semantics; Be used as a logical tool for applying computer science. For example, autonomy proof and model effects. Formal methods developed by software (and hardware), such as the use of word logic in Z symbols.
title: 计算机逻辑

source_text: 1970年代早期推出的惠普HP 9830型计算机是早期采用自动控制的卡式录音带进行数据存储的桌上型计算机之一。它可以根据数字存储和查找文件，并能根据引带检测磁带末尾。很多早期的微型计算机都实现了基于（Kansas City Standard）的数字化数据存储。1970年代晚期和1980年代早期的很多家用计算机也能够使用卡式录音带作为软盘的廉价替代品进行数据存储，只是常常需要手动停止或启动卡带存储器。甚至连1981年推出的第一版IBM PC都包括一个卡式录音带端口和一条操作该端口的BASIC指令。由于随后软驱成为了高端机器的基本配件，这一端口和指令都很少得以使用。
target_text: The HP 9830 computer, which was launched in the early 1970s, was one of the desktop computers for the early storage of data using auto-controlled card tapes. It can store and search files digitally, and can detect the end of the tape based on the tape. Many of the early mini-computers have achieved digital data storage based on Kansas City Standard. Many of the home computers in the late 1970s and early 1980s were also able to store data using the tape as a cheap replacement for diskettes, often requiring a manual suspension or activation of the tape memory. Even the first version of IBM PC, launched in 1981, includes a card tape port and a BASIC directive that operates the portal.
title: 卡式录音带

source_text: 1970年代晚期，使用卡式录音带作为主要存储设备的家用电脑包括、和Apple II。直至软盘和硬盘的流行使得卡带存储退出了美国日常的计算机应用。然而，卡式录音带仍然在某些便携系统上獲采用，并在很多国家仍然是8位计算机的主要存储系统。在包括英国、匈牙利、波兰和荷兰等国，卡带存储曾经非常流行，以至于广播电台会广播计算机程序以供听众使用卡式录音带录制并随后载入电脑中使用。
target_text: In the late 1970s, Carnets were used as primary storage devices for home computers, including Apple II. Until the fashion of diskettes and hard disks made the tape storage out of daily computer applications in the United States. However, the tape was still used in some portable systems and was still the main storage system for eight computers in many countries. In countries such as the United Kingdom, Hungary, Poland and the Netherlands, tape storage used to be so popular that radio stations broadcast computer programs for use by listeners and subsequently recorded in computers.
title: 卡式录音带

source_text: 可擦除可编程只读存储器（），由以色列工程師發明，是一種斷電後仍能保留數據的計算機儲存芯片——即非易失性的（非揮發性）。它是一組浮柵晶體管，被一個提供比電子電路中常用電壓更高電壓的電子器件分別編程。一旦資料寫入完成後，EPROM只能用強紫外線照射來擦除。通過封裝頂部能看見硅片的透明窗口，很容易識別EPROM，這個窗口同時用來進行紫外線擦除。
target_text: A programable read-only memory () developed by an Israeli engineer is a computer memory chip that can retain data after a blackout — non-flexibility (non-floating). It is a float transistor, which is programmed by an electron device that provides higher voltage than is commonly used in electronic circuits. Once the data is finished, EPROM can only be wiped out with a strong ultraviolet line. Through a transparent window that can see silicon at the top, it is easy to identify EPROM, which is used to remove the ultraviolet line at the same time.
title: 可擦除可規劃式唯讀記憶體

source_text: 因為玻璃窗口造價昂貴，於是引進了一次性可編程芯片（One-time programmable，OTP chip，或一種PROM），用於不需重複燒寫的量產產品中可降低ROM成本而被廣泛使用；唯一的不同在於，EPROM芯片被封在不透明的封裝中，因此這種芯片在寫入程序後無法擦除。這種一次性可編程技術，用於生產EPROM和基於EPROM的微控制器。然而，一次性可編程EPROM正逐漸被快閃記憶體（flash memory）芯片所取代，後者具有相近的硅片價格，並且在一個無窗口封裝中可重複編程。
target_text: Because the glass windows are expensive, one-time programmable chip (One-time programable, OTP chip, or a PROM) is widely used to reduce ROM costs in volume products that do not need to be re-burned; the only difference is that the EPROM chip is contained in a non-transparent envelope, so it cannot be erased after it has been written into the program. This one-time programming technique is used to produce EPROM and an EPROM-based microcontrol device. However, the one-time programming EPROM is being replaced by a flash memory chip, which is followed by a similar silicon price and can be reproduced in a non-window envelope.
title: 可擦除可規劃式唯讀記憶體

source_text:
資訊科学排队理论互联网应用
谷歌所使用的网页排序算法（PageRank）就是由马尔可夫链定义的。如果 是已知的网页数量，一个页面 有 个链接到这个页面，那么它到链接页面的转换概率为，到未链接页面的概率为， 参数 的取值大约为0.85。马尔可夫模型也被应用于分析用户浏览网页的行为。一阶或者二阶的马尔可夫模型可以用于对一个用户从某一网络链接转移到另一链接的行为进行建模，然后这些模型可以用于对用户之后的浏览行为进行预测。
target_text: Information science queues theoretical Internet applications. The PageRank system used by Google is defined by the Markov chain. If the number of pages is known, and one page has a link to this page, the probability of conversion to the link page is that the parameter is about 0.85. The Markov model is also used to analyse the behaviour of users to browse their web pages. The Markov model can be used to model the behaviour of a user from one web link to another, and then the models can be used to predict the behaviour of a user to browse after the user.
title: 马尔可夫链

source_text:
社会科学生物数学
马尔可夫链也有众多的生物学应用，特别是增殖过程，可以帮助模拟生物增殖过程的建模。隐蔽马尔可夫模型还被用于生物信息学，用以编码区域或基因预测（見哈代-溫伯格定律。）遗传学游戏音乐
马尔可夫链也被用于算法作曲，例如在Csound 、 Max和SuperCollider等软件中。在一阶链中，该系统的状态是音符或音高，再构建每个音符的转移概率，完成转移矩阵。算法根据转移矩阵生成音符的输出，该值可以是MIDI音符值、音高或其他量。
target_text: There are many biological applications to the socio-scientific biomathematics Markov chain, especially the enrichment process, which can help to simulate the modelling of biological enrichment processes. The hidden Markov model is also used in bioinformatics to encode regional or genetic predictions (see Hardy-Wemberg Law). The genetics game music is also used to compute algorithms, for example in software such as Csound, Max and SuperCollider. In the first hierarchy, the system is in a state of note or sound height that builds the transfer probabilities of each note and completes the transfer matrix.
title: 马尔可夫链

source_text: 为解决此问题，美国工程师约翰·莫希莱于1942年提出了关于研究高速电子管计算装置，即事实上第一台电子计算机的初步方案。军方对此高度重视，将它列入了陆军军械部的总体计划。1943年6月5日，莫工电工学院与军械部签订协定，将它命名为“莫希莱方案”。在军方的大力支持下，研究者们利用无线电、雷达、微波和脉冲技术，于1945年在宾夕法尼亚大学制成了世界上第一台电子计算机——电子数值积分计算机（，简写：ENIAC，又名伊尼亞克和埃尼阿克）。它的运算速度为每秒5000次，比其他设备要快上1000倍。这台计算机使用了18800个电子管，1500个继电器，耗电量约为150千瓦。1946年2月14日，这一成果被公之于众，次日它开始在宾夕法尼亚大学正式投入使用。后来形成了第一代电子计算机——电子管计算机。虽然在当时它的效率很高，但如果以今天的视角来分析的话，这台计算机是非常落后的，它的缺点是成本高、体积大、耗电多、维护难，程序语言也很不熟练，需要使用二进制进行编程，极为繁琐。
target_text: In order to address this problem, in 1942, the American engineer John Moshile presented a preliminary programme for the study of the high-speed electronic tube computing device, the first electronic computer in fact. The military attached great importance to it, including it in the general plan of the Army's Department of Armies. On 5 June 1943, Motechnic signed an agreement with the Ministry of Armies to name it the “Moshile Programme.” With the strong support of the military, researchers, using radio, radar, microwave and pulse technology, made the world's first electronic computer — the digital numeric component computer (synthesis: EniAC, also known as Enyak and Enikak) in 1945 at the University of Pennsylvania. The first generation of electronic computers — computers — computers — computers — was formed at a speed of 5,000 times per second, 1,000 times faster than other equipment — used 18,800 electron tubes, 1,500 relays, consumed about 150 kilowatts. On 14 February 1946, the result was made public, and it became officially operational at the University of Pennsylvania.
title: 數字化革命

source_text: 第二代电子计算机是晶体管计算机，诞生于20世纪50年代，其基础为于40年代发明并在此后逐步取代电子管的晶体管。1956年，美国研制了军用小型晶体管计算机，此后在美国的努力研究下，第一台大型通用晶体管计算机于1959年问世。1960年，晶体管计算机开始被批量生产。新计算机的速度变为每秒几十万次，内存容量变为几十万字，主存储器为磁芯，外存采用磁带和磁盘。与电子管计算机相比，它的成本、体积、功耗和重量大大减少、可靠性大幅上升。此外，更高级的编程语言、管理程序、调试及诊断程序也开始出现。
target_text: The second generation of computers was transistor computers, born in the 1950s, based on transistor tubes that were invented in the 40s and gradually replaced them since then. In 1956, the United States developed a small military transistor computer, and the first major transistor computer was launched in 1959, under United States efforts. In 1960, the transistor computer began to be manufactured in bulk. The speed of the new computer changed to hundreds of thousands of words per second, the memory capacity became hundreds of thousands of words, the primary memory was magnetized, tape and disk were used in the outer memory.
title: 數字化革命

source_text: 第三代电子计算机是集成电路电子计算机，诞生于20世纪60、70年代。1958年，美国德州仪器公司成功研制了半导体集成电路，但成本高昂；1964年，IBM完成了IBM360系统的研制，集成电路计算机的时代由此展开。此时，十几个乃至数百个电子元件组成的逻辑电路已经可以建立在几平方毫米大的单晶硅片上，它们组成的小规模集成电路（，简写：SSI）代替了分立元件。这代计算机的速度提升至每秒百万次量级，体积变小、速度变快、能耗减少、价格降低、可靠性变强，软件逐渐完善。多道系统和分时系统于此时出现，它们是操作系统诞生的标志。微电脑的发展速度极为迅猛，开始走入日常的办公与学习之中。IBM为此耗费了50亿元，费用约为曼哈顿工程的2.5倍，此项研究工作因此成为了世界上最大的私人企业投资项目。
target_text: A third generation of electronics was integrated circuit computers, born in the 1960’s and 1970’s. In 1958, Texas instrument companies successfully developed semiconductor integrated circuits, but at a high cost; in 1964, IBM completed the IBM360 system, and the era of integrated circuit computers began. At this point, a dozen or even hundreds of logical circuits of electronic components can be built on single crystals with several square millimetres of size, and their small integration circuits (SSI) (simplified: SSI) have replaced separate units. The speed of the generation of computers has risen to a million-second level, with smaller volumes, faster speeds, reduced energy consumption, lower prices, higher reliability, and improved software.
title: 數字化革命

source_text: 第四代电子计算机是大规模集成电路电子计算机和超大规模集成电路电子计算机，但也有文献认为第四代计算机只包含了大规模集成电路计算机，超大规模集成电路计算机为第五代电子计算机，它们的界限都比较模糊、难以区分。电子计算机的发明是人类智力发展道路上的里程碑、第三次科技革命的标志性成果之一，它可以代替人类进行一部分脑力活动。
target_text: The fourth generation of computers is a large-scale integrated circuit computer and a super-large integrated circuit computer, but there is also a literature that suggests that the fourth generation includes only large-scale integrated circuit computers, and that the super-large integrated circuit computer is a fifth generation computer, whose boundaries are blurred and difficult to distinguish. The invention of computers is one of the landmarks on the path to human intellectual development and one of the landmarks of the third technological revolution, which can replace a part of human brain activity.
title: 數字化革命

source_text: 图形设备接口（，縮寫 GDI）是微软视窗系统提供的应用程序接口，也是其用来表徵图形对象、将图形对象传送给诸如显示器、打印机之类输出设备的核心组件。GDI 是视窗操作系统（Microsoft Windows）的三大核心部件（也称“子系统”）之一。GDI+ 在 GDI 的基础上调整了编程模型，同时加入了渐变色画刷、Alpha混合等功能。
target_text: Graphical device interfaces (i.e. initial GDI) are applications interfaces provided by Microsoft Windows and are core components that are used to display graphic objects and transmit them to output devices such as monitors and printers. GDI is one of the three core components of the Windows operating system (also known as " subsystems " ). GDI+ adapts programming models based on GDI, with the addition of gradient colour brushes, alpha blends, etc.
title: GDI+

source_text: 关系数据库（），是建立在关系模型基础上的数据库，借助于集合代数等数学概念和方法来处理数据库中的数据。现实世界中的各种实体以及实体之间的各种联系均用关系模型来表示。关系模型是由埃德加·科德于1970年首先提出的，並配合“科德十二定律”。现如今虽然对此模型有一些批评意见，但它还是数据存储的传统标准。标准数据查询语言SQL就是一种基于关系数据库的语言，这种语言执行对关系数据库中数据的检索和操作。
target_text: The relationship database () is a database based on relationship models, using mathematical concepts and methods, such as a collection of algebras, to process data in the database. Links between entities in the real world and between entities are expressed in relationship models. The relationship model was first proposed by Edgar Cod in 1970, in line with the Cord XII Law. Now, although there are some criticisms about the model, it is a traditional standard for data storage. The standard data search language SQL is a language based on relationship databases, which implements the retrieval and operation of data in relation databases.
title: 关系数据库

source_text:
外模式
外模式用来描述用户看到的或使用的部分的数据的逻辑结构，用户根据外模式用户数据操作语句或者程序操作数据库中的数据。
模式
又称逻辑模式，是数据库中全部数据的逻辑结构和特征的描述。
内模式
内模式对应于物理机器的数据库，是三层模式中最底层的表示，描述数据在存储介质上的存储方式和物理结构。
target_text: The external mode describes the logical structure of the part of the data that the user sees or uses, and the data in the database that the user operates according to the external mode of the user's data operation statement or program. The logic model, also known as the logical mode, describes the logical structure and characteristics of all data in the database. The internal mode corresponds to the database of the physical machine, which is the bottom of the three-storey pattern, describing the way in which the data is stored and the physical structure on the stored medium.
title: 关系数据库

source_text: 表（關聯Relation）是以行（值組Tuple）和列（屬性Attribute）的形式组织起来的数据的集合。一个数据库包括一个或多个表（關聯Relation）。例如，可能有一个有关作者信息的名为authors的表（關聯Relation）。每列（屬性Attribute）都包含特定类型的信息，如作者的姓氏。每行（值組Tuple）都包含有关特定作者的所有信息：姓、名、住址等等。在关系型数据库当中一个表（關聯Relation）就是一个关系，一个关系数据库可以包含多个表（關聯Relation）
target_text: The table (relationship to Relation) is a collection of data organized in the form of rows (value group Tuple) and columns (associate Attribute). A database includes one or more tables (relation to Relation). For example, there may be a table with author information called " Attribute " . Each column contains specific types of information, such as the author ' s name. Each line (value group Tuple) contains all information about a particular author: surname, name, address, etc.. In a relationship database, a table (relationship to Relation) is a relationship, and a relationship database can contain multiple tables (relation to Relation).
title: 关系数据库

source_text:
歷史PDP-11開始
最初的Unix套件源自1970年代的貝爾實驗室，操作系统中包含源碼，這樣研究人員以及大學都可以參與修改擴充。1974年，第一個伯克利的Unix系統被安裝在PDP-11機器上，計算機科學係而後將其用作擴展研究。其他大學開始對伯克利的軟件感興趣，在1977年，伯克利的研究生比爾·喬伊將程序整理到磁帶上，作為First Berkeley Software Distribution（1BSD）發行。 1BSD被作為第六版Unix系列，而不是單獨的操作系统。主要程序包括Pascal編譯器，以及比爾·喬伊的ex行編輯器。
target_text: History PDP-11 began with the original Unix package, which originated in the 1970s at Bell Labs, and contained a source code in the operating system so that researchers and universities could be involved in modifying and expanding it. In 1974, the first Unix system in Berkeley was installed on the PDP-11 machine, and computer science was later used as an extension study. Other universities began to be interested in Berkeley software, and in 1977 Bill Joy’s graduate student in Berkeley organized the program on tape as First Berkeley Software Distribution (1BSD). 1BSD was used as the sixth edition of the Unix series, rather than as a stand-alone operating system.
title: BSD

source_text: 有意思的是，通過一個二進制兼容層（compatibility layer），在BSD操作系统上，可以運行相同構架下其他操作系统上的原程序。這比模擬器要快得多，通過這個方法，針對Linux的應用程序，也可以在BSD上全速運行。所以，BSD不僅適合作為服務器，也可作為工作站來使用，眾所周知，現在針對Linux的商業或封閉源碼軟件越來越多。管理員也可以將一些原本只用於商業Unix變種的專屬軟件，轉移到BSD，這樣在保持原有功能的同時，操作系统更趨現代，可繼續使用這些軟件，直到有更好的替代。
target_text: Interestingly, BSD is used not only as a server, but also as a workstation, and it is known that more commercial or closed source software for Linux is now available. Managers can also transfer to BSD software that would otherwise have been used only for commercial Unix variants, so that the operating system is more contemporary in the same time that it remains functional and can continue to use these software until there is a better alternative.
title: BSD

source_text: 突破网络审查或突破网络封锁，在中国大陆俗稱翻墙、科學上網等，是指通过技术方式绕过网络审查的措施。在中国大陆，突破网络审查一般指突破防火长城，访问被其封锁的网站，实现此类功能软件通常被称作翻墙软件或梯子，比如VPN、Shadowsocks、V2Ray等。审查突破软件的原理一般为使屏蔽机制失效，比如通过代理、使用域前置工具。
target_text: Breaking through cybercensorship or breaking through cyberblocks, popularly referred to in mainland China as wall flips, scientific access, etc., refers to measures that bypass web censorship by technical means. In mainland China, breaking through web censorship generally refers to breaking through the Great Wall of Fire, visiting sites that have been blocked by it, and achieving such functional software is often referred to as wall flip software or ladders, such as VPN, Shadowsocks, and V2Ray.
title: 突破网络审查

source_text: 這類破网技术的出现出于反对政府进行网络审查封锁，透過這種方式以抵制政府的監控、封鎖等。互联网的分布式设计从体系上使得任何一个政府或组织完全控制互联网极其困难。与网络审查的技术发展相对应，通过代理服务器或其他技术方法可以绕过审查、突破封锁的技术、类似方法或软件被用于绕过网络审查。
target_text: The Internet’s distributional design makes it very difficult for any government or organization to fully control the Internet in a systematic way. Corresponding to technological developments in Internet censorship, technologies, similar methods, or software can be used to bypass censorship, break-out technologies, or to circumvent censorship through proxy servers or other technical methods.
title: 突破网络审查

source_text: 此外，一方面"中国信息网络国际联网管理暂行规定"中，并非完全禁止访问国际网络。另外限于执法难度和收益原因，在中国大陆地区"翻墙"行为并未被完全禁止，民众或企业等，可以通过代理服务器或VPN、HTTPS、Hosts、域前置乃至镜像站等访问。因此目前中国大陆政府也漸漸默许了一般民众普遍性的翻墙需求，但是根据中华人民共和国《计算机信息网络国际联网管理暂行规定》计算机联网必需使用国家公用电信网提供的国际出入口信道，不得非法使用其他信道进行国际联网。
target_text: On the other hand, access to international networks is not completely prohibited in the "Temporary Regulations on the International Network Management of Information Networks in China" . Also limited to the difficulties and benefits of law enforcement, the "turnover" of walls in mainland China is not completely prohibited, and people or businesses, etc., can be accessed through proxy servers or VPN, HTTPS, Hosts, domain front and even mirror sites.
title: 突破网络审查

source_text: 违反规定的，给予警告，可以并处15000元以下罚款，没收违法所得。但是按照《计算机信息网络国际联网管理暂行规定实施办法》的定义，“国际出入口信道”是指国际联网所使用的物理信道，即通信光缆、电缆、微波等硬件设施，而民众使用代理服务器为软件范围，一般不涉及使用非法的硬件。
target_text: In violation of the regulations, a warning can be given and fines of up to US$ 15,000 may be imposed to confiscate the proceeds of the violation. However, according to the definition of the Scheme of Implementation of the Interim Provisions for the International Networking of Computer Information Networks, “international access channel” means a physical channel used by the international network, i.e. a hardware facility such as a telecommunications cable, a cable, a microwave, etc., while a proxy server is used by the population for the scope of the software and does not normally involve the use of illegal hardware.
title: 突破网络审查

source_text: 其中中国公用计算机互联网（ChinaNet）是中国移动、中国联通、中国电信所連接的通道，政府同時也表態支持開展國際業務，称企业可以“向依法设置国际通信出入口局的电信业务经营者租用线路或网络”，或使用官方批准的VPN服务，从而不受限訪問境外網站。
target_text: China's public computer Internet (CinaNet) is a gateway to China's mobile, Chinese connection and Chinese telecommunications, and the Government has also expressed its support for the opening of international services, stating that enterprises can “rent lines or networks from the telecommunication operators that have established the International Communications Entrance in accordance with the law” or use officially authorized VPN services, thereby providing unrestricted access to offshore websites.
title: 突破网络审查

source_text: 随着1996年1月份中国公用计算机互联网（CHINANET）全国骨干网建成，2月1日国务院第195号令发布了《中华人民共和国计算机信息网络国际联网管理暂行规定》，为首次对接入国际互联网颁布正式管制规例。时邮电部紧接着颁布《中国公用计算机互联网国际联网管理办法》。6月份，国务院信息化工作领导小组也宣布成立。2017年1月22日，中华人民共和国工业和信息化部发布《工业和信息化部关于清理规范互联网网络接入服务市场的通知》，规定未经电信主管部门（各一级行政区通信管理局）批准，不得自行建立或租用VPN等其他信道开展跨境经营活动。这也意味着中国大陆的企业和个人如需要建立VPN服务器提供翻墙等服务，必须取得各一级行政区通信管理局的批准。然而，中国大陆的一些网民通过翻墙访问Facebook发表反「台獨」等言论，也受到官媒的讚揚，使得人們認為，因宣揚共產黨等理由翻牆，才是被默許甚至有時被鼓勵的行為。不過依然有外界指出，新规出台后，可能会提高翻墙上网的难度。2017年3月27日，重庆市政府公众信息网发布了修订后的《重庆市公安机关网络安全管理行政处罚裁量基准》。根据该规定，擅自建立、使用非法定信道进行国际联网行为者，责令停止联网、警告并处以罚款。对此《重庆晨报》报道称，这一规定宣告了“翻墙”成为非法行为。
target_text: With the construction of China’s public Internet network (CHINANET) in January 1996, the Ministry of Industry and Informatization of the People’s Republic of China issued the Provisional Regulations for the Management of the International Network of Computer Information Networks of the People’s Republic of China on 1 February, promulgating official regulations for the first time to regulate access to the international Internet. The Ministry of Post and Telecommunications immediately followed the promulgation of China’s Internet International Network Management Scheme. In June, the State Council’s Head Group for Informationization was also announced. On 22 January 2017, the Ministry of Industry and Informatization of the People’s Republic of China issued the Circular on the Clean-up of the Market of Internet Access Services of the Ministry of Industry and Information, which states that it is not possible to establish or rent other carriers, such as VPNs, without the approval of the telecommunications authorities at all levels.
title: 突破网络审查

source_text:
ASN.1与特定的ASN.1编码规则一起通过使用独立于计算机架构和编程语言的方法来描述数据结构，为结构化数据的交互提供了手段，特别是在网络环境的应用程序。应用
应用层协议如X.400（email）、X.500和LDAP（目录服务）、H.323（VoIP）和SNMP使用 ASN.1 描述它们交互的协议数据单元。在UMTS的接入和非接入层也有广泛的应用。ASN.1的其他应用领域参见此处。
target_text: ASN.1 together with specific ASN.1 code rules, provides the means for structured data interactions, particularly in applications in the network environment, by using methods that describe data structures independently of computer structures and programming languages. Aggression protocols such as X.400 (email), X.500 and LDAP (catalogue service), H.323 (VoIP) and SNMP use ASN.1 to describe their interactive protocol data units. There are also extensive applications in the UMTS access and non-accession layers.
title: ASN.1

source_text: 智能手机（）是一种既可用来拨打行動电话又有多功能移动運算的移动设备。它配备定制的移动操作系统，可浏览网页和播放多媒体文件，也可通过安装流動應用程式、电子游戏等程序来扩充功能。智能手机通常有许多半导体以及各种传感器，支持无线通信协议。其运算能力及功能均优于传统功能手机。
target_text: Smartphones () are mobile devices that can be used both to dial mobile phones and to move operations with multiple capabilities. They are equipped with customized mobile operating systems that can view web pages and broadcast multimedia files, and can also be expanded by installing mobile applications, video games, etc.
title: 智能手机

source_text: 20世纪90年代中晚期，许多人同时拥有移动电话和PDA，它们都搭载Palm OS、Newton OS、塞班系统和Windows CE/Pocket PC等作業系統。这些操作系统演化成早期的移动操作系统。这时期大多数“智能手机”都是电话与PDA的合体。结果这些设备比传统移动电话或PDA体积大，但能够使用蜂窝数据。于是，PDA与手机生产商在减小设备尺寸方面开始了竞争。但这些智能手机高昂售价和昂贵的移动数据计划费用，加上例如续航问题、扩展限制等令人无法接受的缺点。普及程度较低。1996年3月，惠普公司发布OminiGo 700LX，原型是HP 200XL掌上电脑，以诺基亚2110手机为外壳，并提供了基于ROM的软件。它有640x200分辨率并兼有四阴影灰度的LCD显示屏，可拨打和接听电话和收发短信、邮件、传真。配有DOS5.0系统，可运行数千种软件，包括早期版本的Windows。
target_text: In the late 1990s, many people had both mobile phones and PDAs, and they started to compete with mobile producers in reducing the size of the equipment. These smart phones were expensive and costly for mobile data planning, coupled with unacceptable shortcomings such as extension problems, expansion restrictions, etc., were less widely available. In March 1996, Hewlett-Packard released OminiGo 700LX, an original HP 200XL laptop, with nokia 2110 mobile phones for the outer shell, and provided software based on ROM. It had 640x200 resolution combined with four-shadowed LCD screens, ready to call and receive phone calls and SMS version 5.
title: 智能手机

source_text: 从2007年第一代iPhone面世，主流手机逐渐变成了正面为平面的设计，大尺寸的多点触控屏幕取代了原来的实体键盘與觸控筆，系统供应商开始提供用户下载与购买软件程序的软件商店，逐步具有云存储和同步、虚拟助理等功能，甚至目前的所有智能手机都支持移动支付功能。
target_text: From the appearance of the first generation of iPhone in 2007, mainstream mobile phones were gradually transformed into front-to-face designs, large multitouch screens replaced the original physical keyboards and touch pens, system providers began to offer software stores for user downloads and purchase of software programs, gradually with cloud storage and synchronization, virtual assistants, and even all current smartphones support mobile payment functions.
title: 智能手机

source_text: 动态编程语言是高级编程语言的一个类别，在计算机科学领域已被广泛应用。它是一类在运行时可以改变其结构的语言：例如新的函数、对象、甚至代码可以被引进，已有的函数可以被删除或是其他结构上的变化。动态语言目前非常具有活力。众所周知的ECMAScript（JavaScript）便是一个动态语言，除此之外如PHP、Ruby、Python等也都属于动态语言，而C、C++、Java等语言则不属于动态语言。
target_text: Dynamic programming language is a category of advanced programming languages that are widely used in computer science. It is a type of language that can change its structure when running: new functions, objects, and even codes can be introduced, existing functions can be deleted or changed on other structures. Dynamic language is currently very dynamic. The well-known ECMAScript (JavaScript) is a dynamic language, except that PHP, Ruby, Python and others are dynamic languages, while C, C++, Java are not.
title: 动态语言

source_text:
使用時的缺點
使用Internet前，需先透過PPPoE進行撥接，而非電腦開機後立即上網。
部分ISP会對PPPoE的連線用戶採取定時斷線，以節省營運成本及IP位址的佔用，故對於需長時間掛網的使用者較不利。但也有部份ISP为提供用戶選擇PPPoE可發配非固定IP或固定IP的服务。
目前Windows XP之後的Windows，Mac OS X、Linux等操作系统等皆已內建PPPoE的撥接功能，更早期的操作系统需另行安裝PPPoE的撥接程式，如Enternet 300、RAS PPPoE等。
target_text: Some ISPs take a time break to PPOE's connection users to save running costs and the use of IP addresses, and are therefore disadvantageous for users who have to spend a long time on the Internet. But some ISPs have access to non-fixed IPs or fixed IP services to provide users. Currently Windows, Mac OS X, Linux, etc., after Windows XP have built PPOE connections, and earlier operating systems need to install PPOE extensions, such as Enternet 300, RSPPOE, and others.
title: PPPoE

source_text: Cygwin由两部分组成：动态链接库（DLL），以C标准库的形式作为API兼容性层提供POSIX API功能的重要部分，以及提供Unix的大量软件工具和应用程序样的外观和感觉。另外还有一个名为MinGW的库，可以跟Windows本地的MSVCRT库（Windows API）一起工作。MinGW占用内存、硬盘空间都比较少，能够链接到任意软件，但它对POSIX规范的实现没有Cygwin库完备。
target_text: Cygwin is made up of two parts: the Dynamic Link Library (DLL), which provides an important part of the POSIX API function as an API compatibility layer in the form of a standard library, as well as a large number of Unix software tools and applications. There is also a library called MinGW, which works with Windows local MSVCRs API. MinGW has fewer memory, hard disk space, and can link to any software, but it is not complete with Cygwin for the realization of the POSIX norms.
title: Cygwin

source_text:
这项技术需要一个圆锥型NAT设备才能够正常工作。对称型NAT不能使用这项技术。这项技术在P2P软件和VoIP电话领域被广泛采用。它是Skype用以绕过防火墙和NAT设备的技术之一。相同的技术有时还被用于TCP连接——尽管远没有UDP成功。算法
假设有两台分别处于各自的私有网络中的主机：A1和A2。N1和N2是两个网络的NAT设备，分别拥有IP地址P1和P2。 S是一个双方共知的、从任何地方都能访问得到的IP地址的公共服务器。
target_text: This technology requires a conical NAT device to work properly. The symmetric NAT does not work. This technology is widely used in the field of P2P software and VoIP telephony. It is one of the technologies Skype uses to bypass firewalls and NAT equipment. The same technology is sometimes used for TCP connections, although far from UDP success. The algorithm assumes that there are two hosts in their respective private networks: A1 and A2. N1 and N2 are network NAT devices with IP addresses P1 and P2, respectively. S is a well-known public server with access to IP addresses anywhere.
title: UDP打洞

source_text: 在一个更详细的方法中，两个主机将开始发送给对方，使用多次尝试。在受限制的Cone NAT上，来自其他主机的第一个数据包将被阻止。在此之后，NAT设备就有记录发送了一个数据包到另一台机器，并让任何数据包来自该IP地址和端口号。这项技术广泛应用于点对点软件和互联网协议语音电话。它也可以用来协助建立通过UDP运行的虚拟专用网络。相同的技术有时会扩展到传输控制协议（TCP）连接，但成功率较低，因为TCP连接流由主机操作系统控制，而不是应用程序，序列号随机选择。
target_text: In a more detailed approach, the two hosts will start sending to each other, using multiple attempts. The first data package from other hosts will be stopped on the restricted Cone NT. After that, the NAT device records sending a data package to another machine and allowing any data packages to come from the IP address and port number. This technology is widely applied to point-to-point software and Internet protocol voice calls. It can also be used to assist in the creation of virtual private networks run through UDP. The same technology sometimes extends to transmission control protocol (TCP) connections, but with lower success because TCP connections are controlled by the mainframe operating system rather than by application, serial number selection.
title: UDP打洞

source_text: 历史Tor的核心技术“洋葱路由”，是在1990年代中期由美国海军研究实验室的员工，数学家保罗·西维森（Paul Syverson）和计算机科学家邁克·里德（G. Mike Reed）和大衛·戈爾德施拉格（David Goldschlag），为保护美国情报通信而开发的软件。之后，洋葱路由于1997年交由美国國防高等研究計劃署進行进一步开发。
target_text: History Tor’s core technology, “Onion Routes,” was developed in the mid-1990’s by employees of the US Navy’s Research Laboratory, mathematicians Paul Syverson and computer scientists, G. Mike Reed, and David Goldschlag, to protect American intelligence communications. Onion Road was then commissioned for further development by the US Defense Advanced Research Program in 1997.
title: Tor

source_text: Tor的测试版由西维森和计算机科学家罗根·丁格伦（Roger Dingledine）和尼克·马修森（Nick Mathewson）开发 ，并將其命名为“洋葱路由项目”（The Onion Routing project，简称TOR项目）。這個测试版于2002年9月20日发布。次年推出首個公开发行版本。2004年8月13日，西维森、丁格伦和马修森在第13届USENIX安全研讨会上以「Tor：第二代洋葱路由器」為題進行演講。2004年，美国海军研究实验室以自由软件许可证发布了Tor代码，电子前线基金会开始资助丁格伦和马修森继续开发。
target_text: The test version of Tor was developed by Segerson and computer scientists Roger Dingledine and Nick Mathewson, and named the Onion Road Project. The test version was released on 20 September 2002. The first public release was launched the following year. On 13 August 2004, the 13th USEIX Safety Seminar was delivered under the title "Tor: Second Generation Onion Router." In 2004, the US Navy Research Laboratory released Tor code with a free software licence, and the Electronic Front Foundation began funding the continued development of Tengren and Matthewson.
title: Tor

source_text:
由於洋蔥服務會把它們的所有流量皆經由Tor網絡路由，所以它們的連接為端到端加密的，且不能夠成為竊聽的目標。但Tor的洋蔥服務仍有安全問題。例如所有能透過Tor洋葱服務和公共互联网存取的服务皆易受相关攻击（correlation attacks）的影響，由此可見它的匿名性並不是完美的。其他隱患包括服務設定错误（例如Web伺服器的默認錯誤頁面可能會包含識別信息）、運行和停機時間統計、交集攻击（intersection attacks）以及用戶錯誤
。獨立安全研究者開發了一個名為「OnionScan」的开源软件，用於全面檢測洋葱服務上的漏洞（劉易斯還是研究透過洋蔥路由來進行遠程性愛的先驅，因為她認為性玩具不應透過互聯網不安全地連接。）
target_text: For example, all onion services that can be accessed through Tor onion services and the public Internet are vulnerable to related attacks, which makes it possible to see that anonymity is not perfect. Other pitfalls include service set-up errors (e.g. Wib server's obscenity page may contain awareness information, running and downtime statistics, intermission attacks, and user error).
title: Tor

source_text: 商业软件（）是在计算机软件中被作为商品进行交易的软件，未必是商用軟體。至2000年代，大多數的軟體都屬於商業軟體。商业软件大部份都是專有軟體（Proprietary Software），但自由軟體（Free Software）亦可以是商業軟件，只是自由軟件甚少進行收費銷售。相對於商業軟體，有非商業、可供免費使用的共享軟體（Shareware）、免費軟體（Freeware）等。
target_text: Commercial software () is a software traded as a commodity in computer software, not necessarily as a commercial software. By the 2000s, most software was owned by commercial software. Commercial software is mostly proprietary Software, but Free Software can also be commercial software, with very little free software for sale. For commercial software, there are non-commercial, free-of-charge shared software (Shareware), free software, etc.
title: 商业软件

source_text: 文本框是图形用户界面的计算机软件中能够显示（有时也可允许人们添加或更改）文本的框格区域。在一些用户界面中，文本框通常被设计成三维视觉效果，以让人们产生“框”的感觉。但在某些编辑软件中，文本框主要被用来对用户编辑的文字进行定位和格式调整，所以其边框可以被设定成无外形即透明样式，这样便成了没有边框的感觉。
target_text: Text boxes are the box areas in the computer software of the graphical user interface in which text can be displayed (and sometimes allowed to be added or changed). In some user interfaces, text boxes are usually designed to create a three-dimensional visual effect that allows people to feel " box " . In some editing software, however, text boxes are used primarily to locate and format text that is edited by users, so that the frame can be set to be a non-exterior or transparent style, thus creating a feeling that there is no border.
title: 文本框

source_text:
部件工具箱（）亦称为GUI工具箱（），在程序设计中指的某些基本的GUI的构件元素的集合。他们一般以库或者应用程序框架的形式出现。成功因素
一套部件工具箱是否有广大的使用人群，与以下几个因素有关：支持的操作系统是否多样，支持的操作系统市场占有率是否大，使用是否方便，是否有良好的「所见即所得」（WYSIWYG）的开发工具支持，是否有经济实力的雄厚的大公司支持等等。
target_text: The component toolbox () is also known as the GUI toolbox (), a collection of elements of some of the basic GUI components that are referred to in the program design. They usually appear in the form of a library or application framework. Success factors. Whether a component toolbox is used by a wide range of people are related to the following factors: whether the supported operating systems are diverse, whether the supported operating systems are marketable, whether they are easy to use, whether there are good WISIWYG development tools supported, whether there is strong corporate support, etc.
title: 部件工具箱

技术规格
哈比无人机具有三角形机翼（长2米），采用活塞推动，火箭加力。哈比无人机配有红外自导弹头、优越的计算机系统和全球定位系统，以及确定打击次序的分类软件。哈比无人机从卡车上发射， 沿设计好的轨道飞向目标所在地区，在空中盘旋，可以自主攻击目标或返回基地。如测出陌生的雷达，将载着32公斤高爆炸药撞向目标，同归于尽。哈比无人机的特点是：机动灵活，航程远，续航时间长，反雷达频段宽，智能程度高，生存能力强，可全天候使用。哈比无人机采用普通车用汽油或航空汽油作为燃料。
target_text: Hubby drones have triangular wings (two metres long) with a piston-driven rocket. Hobbie drones are equipped with infrared missile heads, superior computer systems and global positioning systems, and strike-order classification software. Hobbie drones are launched from trucks, flying along well-designed orbits to target areas, hovering in the air, and can autonomously attack targets or return to their bases. If an unknown radar is detected, 32 kg of high explosive charge will hit the target and will be destroyed. Hobbi drones are characterized by mobility, distance, duration, anti-radar bands, intelligence, and survival capability.
title: 哈比无人机

source_text: 早在1933年，中国大陆便有使用电传打字机发电报，但直至中华人民共和国成立时大多公众电报终端设备仍为落后的人工电报机和自动电报机。1956年，邮电部上海器材厂的BD55型机械电传机研制成功并大量投入使用，中国公众电报自1957年逐步实行电传机通报，公众电报网采用四级辐射汇接的结构形式，采用撕断纸条式转接。1980年，SHZB64路自动转薄系统研制成功并于当年12月11日投入使用，随后被推广到全国多地的电信局使用，而北京电报局则在1986年采用了日本OKI公司的KD1000B型自动转报系统，全国公众电报网由人工转报逐渐发展为自动转报。1985年12月起，公众电报网实行两级交换制，任意两个终端间通信时报文交换不超过4个交换中心。80年代后期，中国研制了汉字智能电报终端，随后翰林智能汉字电报终端替代了电子电传机。1988年3月，全国用户电报网由32个省级交换局调整为八大中心交换局，各网点开始采用瑞士哈斯拉（Hasler）公司。1990年，中国与瑞士合作开发了公用电报交换系统M203软件，该系统利用T203交换机多余的处理能力为公众电报提供转报功能，M203与用户电报交换系统T203软件合用一个硬件实体。

In 1980, the SHZB64 automatic transmission system was successfully developed and put into use on 11 December of the same year, and was subsequently extended to the National Multi-Telecom, while the Beijing Telegraph Service adopted the KD1000B automatic transmission system of Japanese OKI in 1986 and the national public cable network was gradually developed by artificial transmissions as automatic transmissions. 技术细节与概括
使用伪3D而不是“真实” 3D计算机图形的原因是，必须模拟三维外观的图形的系统功能不足，无法处理3D计算机图形的计算密集型例程，但仍能够使用修改2D图形（如位图）的技巧。这些技巧之一是越来越多地拉伸位图，从而使其在每个步骤中都变大，以使对象的效果越来越接近播放器。

One of these techniques is the increasing stretching of the bitmap, which makes it larger in each step, so that the object ' s effects are closer to the player.
