source_text: 支持端口转换的NAT又可以分为两类：源地址转换和目的地址转换。前一种情形下发起连接的计算机的IP地址将会被重写，使得内网主机发出的数据包能够到达外网主机。后一种情况下被连接计算机的IP地址将被重写，使得外网主机发出的数据包能够到达内网主机。实际上，以上两种方式通常会一起被使用以支持双向通信。
target_text: NAT, which supports port conversion, can be divided into two categories: source address conversion and destination address conversion. The IP address of the computer that initiated the connection in the first case will be rewritten so that the data package from the intranet host can reach the outer network host. In the latter case, the IP address from the connected computer will be rewritten so that the data package from the outer network host can reach the inner network host. In fact, the two approaches are usually used together to support two-way communications.
title: 网络地址转换

target_text: PDP, the code name of the small machine series produced by DEC. PDP is the acronym for the “Programmed Data Processor.” The entire computer industry has grown to considerable size in the early stages of computer development, but computers can only be used by a number of well-funded companies and institutions, because at that time computers were vast, powerful and complex (and certainly not comparable to modern ones).

source_text: PDP系列计算机使DEC公司成为了小型机时代的领头羊。由于小型机的推广，降低计算机产品的使用成本，使得更多的人获得了接触计算机的机会，大大促进了计算机产业以及相关行业的发展，并直接促进了个人计算机（PC）的发展。尽管DEC公司因为推动计算机大众化而获得成功，DEC却因为反对个人计算机的出现而遗憾的成为了历史的笑柄。随着比小型机还小型化的苹果等大批个人计算机出现时，還在堅持機構客戶的DEC业绩一落千丈。
target_text: Despite the success of DEC’s success in promoting the popularization of computers, DEC’s regrettable opposition to the emergence of personal computers has become a laughingstock in history. With the emergence of a large number of personal computers, such as apples, smaller than miniature ones, the ability to maintain their client’s DEC performance has fallen dramatically.

source_text: 软件优点作为一款P2P软件，Share也有其突出的地方，对于用户来说还是有很大帮助：Share特有的加密体系（相对于eMule／eDonkey、BitTorrent来说），能更好的保护用户的隐私，使某些机构无法轻易的追踪到数据的传输对象（来源地和目的地）。同其他P2P程序类似，Share也是不通过某个主要的服务器来进行数据传输，他依赖的是整个网络，所以这个网络不会轻易地被某些机构所取消或关闭。Share特有的插件系统，在一定程度上能扩充Share自身的功能，与此同时也满足了不同用户对于Share的不同要求。另外有兴趣的程序员还可以根据释出的SharePDK（Share的插件开发工具）来编写自己想要的插件。独特的群集系统，可以使用户根据自己搜索需要选择至多5个关键词来进行搜索。因为Share的搜索方式是：通过搜索节点上的群集，若匹配就进行深度的搜索，否则放弃该节点。你可以设定实现自动下载／删除／过滤／添加到数据库的条件，这样使Share变得更加灵活。伪造文件警告系统，可以通过标记所选文件来警告其他用户某些文件可能是伪造的（假档，不完整档）或者是含有病毒。在Share主程序更新的时候，在程序上方会出现提示来告知用户可以更新本软件而无须特意关注某些网站来获取版本更新信息。特有的磁盘配额系统，可以让用户设定在磁盘空间占用达到一定数量时清理缓存文件夹。

Share在亚洲相当受欢迎，尤其是在除日本本土外的中国大陆，香港，台湾等地区。但与此同时，软件自身的限制也造成了一些不利于使用的地方：
在日本，高速网络相较于西欧与北美洲可说是非常普及。Share内部设定至少要有50KB/s的上传带宽，这样一些窄-{zh-hans:带; zh-hant:頻;}-用户（例如Modem拨-{zh-hans:号; zh-hant:接;}-用户，无线上网用户等）在速度上会有些欠缺。
Share的初次使用并非其他P2P软件那样容易，使用之前需要设定很多内容。对于局域网用户（小区，公司等无法接触主机的用户）来说，使用Share基本上是不可能的，除非在主机或服务器上作端口映射。
target_text: The software’s shortcomings are quite popular in Asia, especially in mainland China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and other areas except Japan. At the same time, the software’s own limitations have led to a number of disadvantages: in Japan, high-speed networks are much more prevalent than in Western Europe and North America.
title: Share

source_text:
软件下载
因为考虑到在日本的合法性，Share正式发布的版本目前在日本仅有为数不多的网站提供下载。不过也可以从日本以外的网站上下载到本软件，或者通过搜索引擎来进行搜索以找到下载链接。目前最新的版本是于2006年4月1日发布的EX2版。ED2K或者其他P2P网络中也可以找到該軟體檔案。
target_text: The software downloads because the officially released version of Share is currently available in only a few sites in Japan, given its legitimacy in Japan. However, it can also be downloaded from websites other than Japan, or search through search engines to find download links. The latest version is EX2, which was released on 1 April 2006. The software file can also be found in ED2K or other P2P networks.
title: Share

source_text:
使用要点
第一次使用时先设置所使用的ID、缓存文件夹、叢集以及端口。
如果缓存文件和下载文件保存在同一目录时，要提前预留所下载文件双倍的空间。因为Share在下载完成时并不会自动删除缓存。
下载时可善加利用「触发条件」（，Trigger）来保存搜寻到的结果并添加到数据库，否则之前的信息有可能会消失。
在使用插件时尽量将插件保存到同一个目录并分别存放，这样有利于区分和管理。
取消 「一般设定 > 性能」 中的 「降低程序CPU线程的最大负载」 在一定程度上可以突破软件自身线程的限制。
对于硬盘容量较小的用户，可以取消 「一般设定 > 动作」中的 「自动添加新的缓存文件至上传文件夹」 来减少磁盘空间的占用。
内网用户使用该软件可能存在很大困难，建议首先进行端口映射或者NAT（网络地址转换）于路由器，服务器或其他可以直接连入因特网的设备。
有關叢集：Share與Winny的連接優先權是以得分來計算，每个吻合的全形字得2分。例如某人的叢集是「，「動畫 動畫 動畫」」，而另一人的也是「」，所以得6分。得分越高，優先越高。因此，有人想到如果把搜尋字句和一些自訂的說話加在一起做成叢集，那么得分就可以大大提高，而且愈多人使用同樣的字句，效果會更大。就好像：「」是分享同人動／漫的常用叢集。
target_text: If the cache and the download file are kept in the same directory, double the amount of space available for downloading the file. Because Share does not automatically delete the cache when downloading it. For users with smaller hard disk capacity, the word "generally set > action" can be used to save the search results and add the information to the database, otherwise the information may disappear. When plugs are used, the plugin can be kept in the same directory and stored separately, thus making it easier to distinguish and manage.
title: Share

source_text:
词汇区别
互联网並不等同万维网。互联网是指网络与网络之间所串而连成的一个逻辑上的单一巨大国际网络，这些网络以一组通用的协议相连。万维网是一个由许多互相链接的超文本组成的系统，可以理解为互联网的一项服务，通过互联网访问。
target_text: The Internet is a logically large international network that links networks to networks, connected by a set of universal protocols. The World Wide Web is a system of many linked hyperlinks that can be understood as a service to the Internet, accessed via the Internet.
title: 互联网

source_text: 在20世紀50年代，通信研究者认识到需要允许在不同计算机用户和通信网络之间进行常规的通信。这促使分散网络、排队论和封包交換的研究。1960年，美国国防部高等研究计划署（DARPA）出于冷战考虑建立的ARPANET引发技术进步并使其成为互联网发展的中心。ARPANET的發展始於兩個網路節點，由倫納德·克萊因羅克帶領的加利福尼亞大學洛杉磯分校的網路測量中心與加利福尼亞州門羅帕克（SRI）道格拉斯·恩格爾巴特的NLS系統兩個節點之間連接。第三個節點是加利福尼亞大學聖塔芭芭拉分校，第四個節點是犹他大学。到1971年底，已經有15個節點連接到ARPANET。1973年6月，挪威地震陣列所（）連接到ARPANET成為美國本土之外的第一個網路節點。
target_text: In the 1950s, communications researchers recognized the need to allow regular communication between different computer users and communication networks. This led to the decentralization of networks, queuing, and the exchange of envelopes. In 1960, the United States Department of Defense ' s Advanced Research and Program (DRPA) created ARPANET for cold war reasons triggered technological progress and made it a centre for Internet development. ARPANET began at two Internet nodes, which were connected to ARPANET by Leonard Klein Roark at the University of California ' s Los Angeles branch. In June 1973, the Norwegian seismological campaign (reconnected by ARPANET) became the first Internet node outside the United States of America.
title: 互联网

source_text: 網際網路的成功，可從“Internet”这个术语的大、小寫分化窺知一二。最初，互联网一詞代表那些使用IP協定架設而成的網路，而今天，它已引申泛指各種類型的網路，不再侷限於IP網路。於是以小寫的互联网（internet，開頭的「i」是小寫字母）為任何分離的實體網路之集合，這些網路以一組通用的協定相連，形成邏輯上的單一網路。而大寫的互联网（Internet，開頭的「I」是大寫字母）專指前身為ARPANET，後使用IP協定將各種實體網路連結成此單一邏輯網路。大寫的互聯網是小寫互聯網的其中一種形式，反過來卻不然。2002年起，有学者开始提议将“internet”一词用小写表示，理由是互联网已经成为人类生活的一部分，失去专有的意义；2016年，美联社认为“互联网”已和“电话”一样成为一件一般的事物，不具有专属商标的意义，于是开始在其格式手册中规定“internet”和“web”一词全部小写，纽约时报也随后跟进，但同时亦有媒体提出不同意见。
target_text: The success of the Internet can be seen from the large, low-cased set of Internet terms. Initially, the Internet word represents a network that uses IP protocol frames, and today it has been introduced to refer broadly to various types of Internet, which are no longer limited to IP networks. So the Internet, with an initial "i" as a lower-case network, is a collection of any discrete real-world network, which is linked to a universal set of protocols and forms a single logical network. Since 2002, scholars have started to propose the word "internet" on the grounds that the Internet has become part of human life and that the use of the Internet has lost its relevance; in 2016, the Internet has become a single Internet network.
title: 互联网

source_text: 任何需要使用網際網路的计算机必须通过某种方式与網際網路进行连接。網際網路接入技术的发展非常迅速，带宽由最初的14.4Kbps发展到目前的100Mbps甚至1Gbps带宽，接入方式也由过去单一的电话拨号方式，发展成现在多样的有线和无线接入方式，接入终端也開始朝向移动设备发展。并且更新更快的接入方式仍在继续地被研究和开发。
target_text: Any computer that needs to use the Internet must be connected to it in one way or another. Internet access technology has developed very rapidly, from the original 14.4 Kbps to the current 100 Mbps or even 1 Gbps bandwidth, and access has evolved from a single telephone dial-up mode in the past to the current variety of wired and wireless access modes, with access terminals beginning to move to mobile devices.
title: 互联网

source_text:
互联网安全
经过多年的发展，互联网已经在社会的各个层面为全人类提供了便利。但是随之而来的不全是正面的影响，並影響著人们的正常生活。惡意軟體
惡意軟體是透過互聯網使用和散發的軟件，包括在人為協助下複製的電腦病毒、自我複製的電腦蠕蟲、阻斷服務攻擊軟體、勒索軟件、殭屍網絡以及蒐集使用者活動和鍵入資訊的間諜軟件，通常這些行為足以構成網路犯罪。
target_text: Internet security has evolved over the years, and the Internet has facilitated all of humanity at all levels of society. But not all of the attendant positive effects have affected the normal life of people. Malicious software is software that is used and distributed through the Internet, including computer viruses, self-reproduced computer worms, service disruptions against software, extortion software, zombie networks, and spy software that aggregates user activities and key information, often sufficient to create cyber crime.
title: 互联网

source_text: 普及率截至2020年6月，全球約有48億網民，互聯網普及率是62%。截至2019年，互联网普及率最高的國家或城市為科威特（99.6%）；第二至第五位分別是卡塔尔（99.6%）、福克兰群岛（99.3%），百慕大（99.2%）及冰岛（99.0%）。根据中国互联网络信息中心在2022年8月31日发表的第50次《中国互联网络发展状况统计报告》，截至2022年6月，中国的网民规模为10.51亿，为世界首位。互联网普及率达74.4%，已远高于世界平均水平。
target_text: As of June 2020, there were around 4.8 billion Internet users worldwide, with 62 per cent Internet penetration. As of 2019, Kuwait was the country or city with the highest Internet penetration rate (99.6 per cent); the second to fifth divide was Qatar (99.6 per cent), the Falkland Islands (99.3 per cent), Bermuda (99.2 per cent) and Iceland (99.0 per cent). According to the 50th State of China ' s Internet Development Statistical Report, published by the China Internet Information Centre on 31 August 2022, the size of China ' s Internet penetration was 1,051 million, the world ' s highest.
title: 互联网

source_text: MD5訊息摘要演算法（），一種被廣泛使用的密碼雜湊函數，可以產生出一個128位元（16個字元(BYTES)）的散列值（hash value），用于确保信息传输完整一致。MD5由美國密碼學家罗纳德·李维斯特（）設計，於1992年公開，用以取代MD4演算法。這套演算法的程序在 RFC 1321 中被加以規範。将数据（如一段文字）运算变为另一固定长度值，是雜湊算法的基础原理。
target_text: The MD5 digest algorithm () is a widely used password-mixing function that produces a hash value of 128 bits (16 characters (BYTES)) to ensure complete consistency in the transmission of information. MD5 was designed by US cryptographer Ronald Levester in 1992 to replace MD4 algorithms. The application of this algorithm is regulated in RFC 1321. The conversion of data (e.g., a text) to another fixed length value is the underlying principle of the mosaic algorithm.
title: MD5

source_text:
1996年後被證實存在弱點，可以被加以破解，對於需要高度安全性的資料，專家一般建議改用其他演算法，如SHA-2。2004年，證實MD5演算法無法防止，因此不適用於安全性認證，如SSL公開金鑰認證或是數位簽章等用途。历史与密码学
1992年8月，罗纳德·李维斯特向互联网工程任务组（IETF）提交了一份重要文件，描述了这种算法的原理。由于这种算法的公开性和安全性，在90年代被广泛使用在各种程序语言中，用以確保资料傳遞無誤等。
target_text: Since 1996, it has been established that there are weaknesses that can be decoded, and for data that require a high degree of security, experts have generally suggested alternative algorithms, such as SHA-2. In 2004, the validation of MD5 algorithms could not be prevented and was therefore not suitable for security authentication purposes, such as SSL public key recognition or digital signature. History and cryptology submitted an important document to the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) in August 1992, describing the rationale for such algorithms. Because of their openness and security, the algorithms were widely used in various procedural languages in the 1990s to ensure that there was no error in the transmission of information.
title: MD5

source_text:
MD5由MD4、MD3、MD2改进而来，主要增强算法复杂度和不可逆性。应用
MD5曾被用於檔案校驗、SSL/TLS、IPsec、SSH，但MD5早已被發現有明顯的缺陷。算法MD5是輸入不定長度信息，輸出固定長度128-bits的演算法。经过程序流程，生成四个32位数据，最后联合起来成为一个128-bits散列。基本方式为，求餘、取餘、调整长度、与链接变量进行循环运算。得出结果。
target_text: MD5 was improved by MD4, MD3 and MD2 primarily to enhance the complexity and irreversibility of algorithms. The application MD5 was used for file calibration, SSL/TLS, IPsec, SSH, but MD5 has already been identified as having a distinct defect. The algorithm MD5 is the calculation of an uncertain length of input, with a fixed length of 128-bits. The process results from the generation of four 32-bits data, which together become a 128-bits haste.
title: MD5

source_text:
Windows 8、8.1、10Windows 8取消在工作列上顯示的開始按鈕，這讓部份Windows的使用者在操作上感到不便，因此微軟於Windows 8.1恢復了開始按鈕。這是微軟自Windows 95已來唯一一次取消開始按鈕。Windows 10的工作列新增了Cortana、工作檢視、熒幕鍵盤、重要訊息中心。同时语言栏被移到托盘区图标右侧。其他操作系统
Windows并不是唯一具有任务栏的操作系统，在其他操作系统例如Linux中也有类似条状工具。macOS的Dock也是一种任务栏。
target_text: Windows 8, 8.1, 10 Windows 8 cancels the start button shown on the workbar, which makes some Windows users feel operationally inconvenienced, so that Microsoft recovers the start button from Windows 8.1. This is the only time that Windows 95 has canceled the start button. Windows 10 has added Cortana, job view, screen keyboard, and key message centre. The language bar is also moved to the right side of the tray icon. Windows is not the only operating system with taskbars, and there are similar bar-like tools in other operating systems, such as Linux.
title: 任务栏

source_text: 南昌大学位于江西省省会南昌市。现有前湖主校区、青山湖校区、东湖校区、共青校区、抚州校区5个校区，占地面积8036亩，具有一流的基础设施，是教育部中国教育和科研计算机网（CERNET）江西主节点，是江西唯一一所全面升级为IPV6并接入中国下一代互联网示范工程CNGI示范网络的高校。学校图书馆藏书328万余册，每年订购期刊1866种，被全国高校文献保障中心和江西省教育厅确定为江西省高校文献信息服务中心，设有江西省唯一一个教育部科技查新工作站。有各级各类附属（直属）医院12所，其中国家三级甲等大型综合性医院6所，三级甲等口腔医院1所。
target_text: Nanchang University is located in Nanchang City, capital of Jiangxi Province. There are five campuses in the former Lake Main School, Qingshan Lake School, East Lake School, Congqing School, Chizhou School District, covering an area of 8036 acres, with a first-class infrastructure, the Chinese Education and Scientific Research Computer Network (CERNET) of the Ministry of Education, which is the only high school in Jiangxi, which has been fully upgraded to IPV6 and has access to the CNGI model project for the next generation of Internet in China. The school library contains more than 3.2 million copies of periodicals ordered each year. It has been identified by the National Centre for Higher School Documents Protection and the Jiangxi Education Department as the Centre for Documentation and Information Services of the Jiangxi High School, with the only Ministry of Education's new science and technology search station in Jiangxi province.
title: 南昌大学

source_text: 先后组建了南昌爱乐乐团等文化艺术社团，承办了第29届世界音乐教育大会等国际、国内有影响的文化艺术活动，创造性地开展了以"前湖"文化品牌为主体的校园文化系列活动。青年教师郑璐获得2010年全国红歌会总冠军。积极传承传统艺术，建成了赣客方言数据库、江西红色文化数据和江西历史文化研究数据库，组建了四方艺术研究院、书画研究院、国学研究院、赣剧文化艺术中心、影视艺术研究中心、赣学研究院、遥远艺术研究中心、中国中部发展研究中心、江西省大学生思想政治教育研究中心等一批重点研究基地，加强哲学和社会科学理论研究，积极开展名家论坛、校地共建、咨询服务和巡回宣讲等活动，引导和推动区域文化发展。
target_text: The cultural and artistic societies, such as the Nanchang Ai Orchestra, have been formed to host the twenty-ninth World Music and Education Congress and to carry out a series of influential national cultural and artistic events and creatively develop a school culture series featuring the "former Lake" cultural brand. Young teachers have won the title of President of the National Red Song Society in 2010. The traditional arts have been actively transmitted, and a database has been set up for the study of the dialect, the Jiangxi red culture and the Jiangxi history and culture, as well as a quadripartite art institute, a book and painting institute, the National Academy of Music, the Centre for the Arts of the Theatre, the Centre for the Study of the Visual Arts, the Academy of Sciences, the Centre for the Study of the Far Arts, the Centre for the Study of the Development of Central China, the Centre for the Study of the Intellectual and Political Education of University Students of Jiangxi, among others, has been set up to guide and promote the development of regional culture.
title: 南昌大学

source_text: 在从前的开发模式中，每个openSUSE稳定版本 (13.0, 13.1,...) 都会附带创建滚动版本，这些滚动版本会持续不断收到软件包更新。当新的稳定版即将发布时，Tumbleweed的软件包体系就会重置到这一稳定版，换言之，Tumbleweed的软件包版本将与这个新稳定版一致。因为Tumbleweed的大部分软件包版本通常比最新发布的稳定版还要新，导致问题的出现。
target_text: In previous development models, every openSUSE stable version (13.0, 13.1,...) would be accompanied by the creation of rolling versions, which would be continuously updated by software packages. When the new stable version is about to be released, Tumbleweed’s package system will be reset to this stable version, in other words, the Tumbleweed package version will be consistent with the new stable version. Because most of Tumbleweed’s packages are usually new to the latest version, leading to problems.
title: OpenSUSE

source_text: MicroOS 采用全新的方法来满足边缘计算或云计算的需求：MicroOS从只读文件系统运行，从而最大限度地减少维护需求。这样能够在一定程度上防止意外更改和恶意软件攻击。该系统是自包含和事务性的，这意味着 MicroOS 在更新时要么完全成功要么失败且不留下任何更改（即事务性更新），并在出现问题时回滚到前一阶段。事务更新不会影响正在运行的系统。基本上所有可用于 Tumbleweed 的软件也可用于 MicroOS。由于附带了podman这个容器运行时，MicroOS 可完美用于容器主机。
target_text: MicroOS uses entirely new methods to meet the need for margin or cloud computing: MicroOS operates from a read-only file system, thereby minimizing maintenance needs. This allows for some protection from accidental changes and malicious software attacks. The system is self-inclusive and transactional, which means that MicroOS either succeeds or fails completely at the time of the update without leaving any changes (i.e., transactional updates) and rolls back to the previous stage when problems arise. The update does not affect the system in operation. Basically, all software that can be used for Tumbleweed can also be used for MicroOS. MicroOS can be used perfectly for the container mainframe when it operates with Podman.
title: OpenSUSE

source_text: 开放构建服务为软件开发人员提供了用于编译、发布软件的工具，它已被用于许多发行版系统，包括Mandriva、Ubuntu、Fedora、Debian和Archlinux等。 它通常能够有效简化打包过程，因此开发人员可以更轻松地为许多发行版以及许多 openSUSE 发行版打包单个程序，使得无论用户使用何种分发版本都可以安装并使用。它是在GNU GPLv2+协议下发布的。
target_text: Open Build Services provides software developers with tools to compile and publish software, which has been used in a number of distribution systems, including Mandriva, Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, and Archlinux. It is usually effective in simplifying the packing process, so developers can easily package individual programs for many distributions and many openSUSE distributions, so that they can be installed and used regardless of the distribution version used by the user.
title: OpenSUSE

source_text:
增量 RPM
默认情况下，openSUSE Leap在更新安装时使用 （增量 RPM）。 Delta RPM 包含软件包的旧版本和新版本之间的区别。这意味着只需要下载已安装软件包和新软件包之间的更改。这减少了带宽消耗和更新时间，对慢速 Internet 连接尤为重要。桌面创新Xgl 与 Compiz
2006年1月2日，SUSE开发人员David Reveman 发布了一种X服务器体系结构 Xgl，旨在通过OpenGL驱动程序利用现代显卡，并通过 glitz 在 OpenGL 上进行分层。 Compiz 是X Window系统的首批合成窗口管理器之一，它也发布了可以利用这种OpenGL加速功能的版本。
target_text: The incremental RPM default was used by openSUSE Leap to update the installation (additional RPM). Delta RPM contains the difference between old and new versions of the package. This means that only changes between installed packages and new packages need to be downloaded. This reduces bandwidth consumption and updates time, which is particularly important for slow Internet connectivity. source_text: 点对点协议（，缩写：PPP）工作在数据链路层（以OSI参考模型的观点）。它通常用在两节点间建立直接的连接，并可以提供连接认证、传输加密以及压缩。PPP被用在许多类型的物理网络中，包括串口線、电话线、中继链接、移动电话、特殊无线电链路以及光纤链路（如SONET）。PPP还用在互联网接入上。早年，互联网服务提供商（ISP）使用PPP为用户提供到Internet的拨号連接，这是因为IP报文无法在没有数据链路协议的情况下通过调制解调器线路自行传输。PPP的两个衍生物PPPoE和PPPoA被ISP广泛用来与用户建立数字用户线路（DSL）、FTTx互聯網服务连接。
target_text: Point-to-point protocols (Abbreviation: PPP) work on the data chain layer (in the view of the OSI reference model). It is usually used to create direct connections between two nodes and can provide connection authentication, transmission encryption, and compression. PPP is used in many types of physical networks, including serial, telephone, trunking links, mobile phones, special radio links, and fibre-optic links (e.g. SONET). The PPP is also used for Internet access. In early years, Internet service providers (ISPs) used PPPs to provide dial-up connections to the Internet for users because IP reports cannot be transmitted on their own by modem lines without a data link protocol. Two PPP derivatives, PPOE and PPOA are widely used by ISPs to establish digital user lines (DSL), TTx interconnectivity services.
title: 点对点协议

In addition, there is a new 32-bit control/status temporary storage unit (MXCSR).
title: SSE

source_text: MD4是麻省理工学院教授Ronald Rivest于1990年设计的一种信息摘要算法。它是一种用来测试信息完整性的密码散列函数的实行。其摘要长度为128位。这个算法影响了后来的算法如MD5、SHA家族和RIPEMD等。1991年Den Boer和Bosselaers发表了一篇文章指出MD4的短处, 2004年8月王小云报告在计算MD4时可能发生杂凑冲撞。
target_text: MD4 is an information abstract algorithm designed by Professor Ronald Riverst at MIT in 1990. It is a password hash function used to test the integrity of information. It has a summary length of 128 bits. This algorithm affects later algorithms such as MD5, the SHA family, and RIPEMD. In 1991, Den Boer and Bosselaers published an article pointing out the weakness of MD4, and in August 2004 Wang Xiaoyan reported that there could be a bump in MD4 calculations.
title: MD4

source_text:
簡歷
1984年8月获合肥工业大学微型机应用研究所计算机应用学士学位。

title: 吴信东

source_text:
在图论中，标号树的普吕弗（Prüfer）序列是由树唯一地产生的序列。n顶点的标号树有长n − 2的普吕弗序列，可以从一个简单的迭代算法得到。普吕弗序列在1918年首先由海因茨·普吕弗用来证明凯莱公式。算法
一棵树要得到普吕弗序列，方法是逐次去掉树的顶点，直到剩下两个顶点。考虑树T，其顶点为{1, 2, ..., n}。在第i步，去掉标号最小的叶，并把普吕弗序列的第i项设为这叶的邻顶点的标号。
target_text: In the graph, the Prüfer sequence of the labeled tree is the single sequence produced by the tree. The n-top tree has a long n-two Pluff sequence, which can be obtained from a simple iterative algorithm. In 1918, the Pruff sequence was first used by Heinz Pluff to prove the Kale formula. The algorithm is that a tree gets the Pluff sequence by removing the top of the tree from time to time until the two tops are left. Consider tree T, the top of which is {1,2, n}. On the first step, remove the smallest leaf of the label and set the first item of the Pruff series as the next top of the leaf.
title: 普吕弗序列

source_text:
一棵树的序列明显是唯一的，而且长为n − 2。例子
把上述算法用在右图标号树。第一步，顶点1是最小标号的叶，因此首先去掉，普吕弗序列首项是"4"，接着去掉顶点2和3，"4"两次加进序列。顶点4现在是叶，去掉后剩下2个顶点，所以把"5"加进序列后结束。树的序列是{4,4,4,5}。復原算法
从一个普吕弗序列，可以求得一棵树有这一普吕弗序列。
target_text: The sequence of a tree is clearly the only one, and it grows in n-2. For example, the above algorithm is used in the right icon number tree. The first step, cap 1 is the leaves of the minimum mark, so the first step is removed, and the first line of the Pluff series is "4", followed by the top two and three, and the top four is now the leaves, and the last two tops are removed, so the sequence ends with the "5" added to the sequence. The sequence of the tree is {4,4,4,5}.
title: 普吕弗序列

source_text:
移动版 SpeedStep： 操作系统可以根据运行需要调节CPU频率以节能。
移动 MMX： 43 条新的 SIMD 指令 包含了 完整的 MMX 指令集 和一些SSE 指令集中的整数指令。 移动 MMX 提供了 16 条额外的 64位 寄存器，并可以被当成双重32位的来处理，像四个16位halfwords 或八个 8位 字节。 这项能力可以加速芯片的编码和解码速度，提高多媒体和游戏的性能。
附加的外部设计： 例如USB-Host界面和摄像头界面。
集成 256KB SRAM 缓存，降低功耗和延迟。
target_text: Mobile MMX: 43 new SIMD commands contain complete MMX command sets and integer commands for some SSE command concentrations. Mobile MMX provides 16 additional 64-bit senders and can be treated as a double 32-bit process, like four 16-bit hlfwords or eight-bit bytes. This capability can accelerate the coding and decoding of chips and improve multimedia and game performance. Additional external design: e.g. USB-Host interface and camera interface. Combination 256KB SRAM cache, reducing power consumption and delay.
title: XScale

source_text: 現在的精子计数平均水平在西方约为每毫升6000万，而数十年前该数量明显高于此值，并且呈现每年1~2%的下降速度。现在已经出现可以家用的精子计数芯片，可以在使用不同日期收集的3分样品来估算精子计数。这种芯片可以通过对比精液样品和含聚乙烯珠液体的控制样品，来测量精子的密度。
target_text: The average sperm count is now about 60 million per milliliter in the West, which was significantly higher than that a few decades ago, and shows a rate of decline of between 1 and 2% per year. A home-based sperm count of chips has emerged, which can be used to estimate sperm count using a three-point sample collected on different dates. Such chips can measure sperm density by comparing sperm samples with control samples containing polyethylene pearl fluids.
title: 精液分析

source_text: 任何自动或半自动的计算机辅助分析手段都可以被称为计算机辅助精液分析（CASA）。其中大多数系统都是基于影响分析，但也存在一些其他的分析方法，例如通过一个数字化面板来追踪精子的运动轨迹。计算机辅助技术通常会被使用在评估精子集中度以及精子活力，例如速度、直线速度等。虽然许多系统可以对有活力的精子的运动特性给出非常准确的信息，然而如果不进行染色，却不能将不移动的精子和其它类型的细胞、微粒、残体等进行准确的区分。早期的系统所给出的精子集中度和精子活动能力等级比例数据并不准确，至少在精液样品中存在许多其它微粒、细胞或者残体的情况下是不准确的。在分析活动能力时如果出现明显的“路径交叉”的情况，大多数系统的分析结果都是不太可靠的。这是因为在此情况下，很难区分到底是两个精子的活动路径出现交错，还是四个精子在互相接近。当然，现在已经存在几秒钟就能获得完整的、近乎完美的结果的分析系统，这是因为这些系统采取了新的影响分析技术。这些使用了某些新技术的设备，在精子集中度以及活动能力的测量上，其可靠性至少与目前的人工测量方法相当。
target_text: While any automatic or semi-automatic computer-assisted analysis can be described as a computer-assisted sperm analysis (CASA). Most of these systems are based on impact analysis, but there are other analytical methods, such as tracking sperm tracks through a digital panel. Computer-assisted technology is often used to assess sperm concentration and sperm dynamics, such as speed, straight-line velocity. While many systems can give very accurate information about the dynamic sperm's motor properties, without dyeing, it is not possible to distinguish between non-moveable sperm and other types of cells, particulates, residues, and so on. The earlier systems give inaccurate data on sperm concentration and sperm activity level ratios, at least in the case of sperm samples, and many other microparticles, cells or residues, are not accurate. In the case of a clear “path intersection” of activity, most system analyses are less reliable because, in this case, it is difficult to distinguish between the inter-routing of two sperm, or the four sperm at the same time.
title: 精液分析

source_text: 阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机（Atanasoff–Berry Computer，通常简称ABC计算机）是世界上第一台电子数字计算设备。这台计算机在1937年设计，不可编程，仅仅设计用于求解线性方程组，并在1942年成功进行了测试。然而，这台计算机用纸卡片读写器实现的中间结果存储机制是不可靠的。而且，在发明者约翰·文森特·阿塔纳索夫因为二战任务而离开爱荷华州立大学之后，这台计算机的工作就没有继续进行下去。ABC计算机开创了现代计算机的重要元素，包括二进制算术和电子开关。但是因为缺乏通用性、可变性与存储程序的机制，将其与现代计算机区分开来。这台计算机在1990年被认定为IEEE里程碑之一。
target_text: Atanasoff-Berry Computer, commonly known as ABC, was the first digital computing device in the world. The computer was designed in 1937, unprogrammable, and was designed to solve linear equations only, and successfully tested in 1942. However, the intermediate result storage mechanism achieved by the computer with a card reader was unreliable. And, after the inventor John Vincent Atanasov left Iowa State University for World War II, the computer did not continue its work. The ABC computer created important elements of modern computers, including binary algorithms and electronic switches. But because of the lack of mechanisms for generalization, variability and storage, it was distinguished from modern computers.
title: 阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机

source_text: 阿塔纳索夫和克利福德·贝瑞的计算机工作直到1960年才被发现和广为人知，并且陷入了谁才是第一台计算机的冲突中。那时候，ENIAC普遍被认为是第一台现代意义上的计算机，但是在1973年，美国联邦地方法院注销了ENIAC的专利，并得出结论：ENIAC的发明者从阿塔纳索夫那里继承了电子数字计算机的主要构件思想。因此，ABC被认定为世界上第一台電子计算机。
target_text: Atanasov and Clifford Berry’s computer work was not discovered and well known until 1960, when ENIAC was generally considered to be the first computer in the modern sense, but in 1973 the US Federal District Court cancelled ENIAC’s patent and concluded that ENIAC’s inventor inherited the idea of the main component of a digital computer from Atanasov. As a result, ABC was recognized as the world’s first electron computer.
title: 阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机

source_text: 根据阿塔纳索夫的讲述，ABC计算机的几个关键概念是在1937-1938年的一次长时间的夜间行驶中突然构想出来的。ABC的创新包括了电子计算、二进制算术、并行处理、蓄热式电容内存，还有存储和计算功能的分离。其机械和逻辑设计都是阿塔纳索夫博士在后面的一年中完成的。一个建立概念验证原型的资金申请在1939年3月提交到了农学部门，农学部门也对提高用于经济和研究分析的计算速度深感兴趣。纽约的非营利研究组织RCSA给予5000美金作为进一步资金支持。
target_text: According to Atanasov, several key concepts of ABC computers were suddenly conceived during a long night drive in 1937-1938. ABC innovations included computing, binary arithmetic, parallel processing, accelerator memory, and the separation of storage and computing functions. Its mechanical and logical design was completed by Dr. Atanasov in the following year. A funding application for a prototype proof of concept was submitted in March 1939 to the agronomy sector, which was also interested in increasing the speed of computation for economic and research analysis. RCSA, a non-profit research organization in New York, gave $5,000 as further financial support.
title: 阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机

source_text: ABC计算机是由阿塔纳索夫博士和研究生克利福德·贝瑞于1939到1942年，在艾奥瓦州立大学的物理楼地下室裡建造的。9月获得了初始资金之后，1939年10月完成了11个管件的演示原型。12月的演示为建造一个完整的机器带来了资金支持。接下来的两年里，ABC计算机完成了建设和测试。《得梅因纪事报》（Des Moines Register）在1941年1月15日声称，ABC计算机是由300多个真空管组成的“电子计算机器”，可以“计算复杂的代数方程”（但没有给出精确的计算机技术说明）。计算机系统的重量超过320千克（700磅），包含了大约1.6公里（1英里）的电线、280个双三极真空管、31个闸流管，大小相当于一个书桌。
target_text: The ABC computer was built between 1939 and 1942 by Dr. Atanasov and a graduate student, Clifford Berry, in the basement of the Physics Building at the State University of Iowa. After initial funding was obtained in September, a prototype of 11 tubes was completed in October 1939. The December demonstration brought financial support for the construction of a complete machine. In the next two years, ABC computers completed construction and testing. Des Moines Register claimed on 15 January 1941 that ABC computers were “computers” made up of more than 300 vacuum tubes and could “calculate complex intergenerational equations” (without giving a precise description of computer technology). The computer system weighs more than 320 kg (70 pounds), containing approximately 1.6 km (one mile) wires, 280 double three-polar vacuum tubes, and 31 brake tubes, the size of which corresponds to one desk.
title: 阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机

source_text: ABC不是图灵完全的计算机。图灵完全将其与很多通用计算机区分开来，比如康拉德·楚泽的Z3计算机，或者更晚的计算机，如1946年的ENIAC、1949年的EDVAC、曼彻斯特大学的设计，以及艾伦·图灵于战后在英国国家物理实验室和其他地方的设计。而且，ABC也没有实现存储程序结构。如果实现的话，它将成为真正的全通用、可重新编程的计算机。
target_text: ABC is not a complete computer for Turing. Turing completely distinguishes it from many generic computers, such as Conrad Chuzer ' s Z3 computer, or even later computers, such as the 1946 ENIAC, the 1949 EDVAC, Manchester University design, and Alan Turing ' s design at the British National Physics Laboratory and elsewhere after the war. And ABC has not achieved a storage program structure. If implemented, it will become a truly universal, reprogrammable computer.
title: 阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机

source_text:
然而，这台计算机实现了三个关键思想，这些思想在现代计算机中仍然是一个组成部分：
使用二进制数表示所有的数值和数据
使用电子器件进行所有计算操作，而不是滚轮、棘轮或者机械开关
计算和存储在系统中分离成两部分另外，这套系统开创了对蓄热式电容内存的使用，今天它仍在DRAM中广泛使用。
target_text: However, the computer has achieved three key ideas, which are still an integral part of modern computers: using binary numbers to indicate all values and data, using electronic devices to perform all computational operations instead of rolling wheels, thorn wheels or mechanical switches to calculate and store in two separate parts of the system, which has created the use of the accelerator memory, which is still widely used in the DRAM today.
title: 阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机

source_text: ABC计算机的存储体是一对转鼓，每个转鼓包含1600个电容器，它们围绕着共同的轴旋转，每秒一圈。每个转鼓上的电容器被分为32个“带”（“band”）（30个是活跃的，另外两个是在有电容器坏掉的时候备用的），每个带上有50个电容器，从而使机器每秒种可完成30次加减操作。数据表示成50位定点二进制数。存储体和运算单元的电子器件能同时存储和操作60个这样的数（3000位）。
target_text: The ABC computer is stored in a pair of drums, each of which contains 1,600 capacitors, rotated around a common axis, one circle per second. The capacitors on each drum are divided into 32 “bands” (30 active and the other two when the capacitor is broken) with 50 capacitors, thus enabling the machine to perform 30 plus-minus operations per second. The data represent a 50-digit fixed-point binary number. The electronic components of the storage and operation units are capable of storing and operating 60 such units at the same time (3,000).
title: 阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机

source_text: 虽然ABC计算机是早期计算机器发展的重要一步，但是它在解决一整个问题的时候并不能完全自动地运行。需要有一个操作员操作控制开关来设置各种功能，很像当时的机电计算器和单元计算设备。选择要进行的操作、读取、写出、二进制和十进制数的相互转换，或者化简方程组，这些操作都要通过前面面板上的开关来完成，有些情况下需要操作跳线。
target_text: While ABC is an important step in early computer development, it does not run completely automatically when solving an entire problem. There is a need for an operator to operate a control switch to set a variety of functions, similar to those of the electromechanical calculators and unit computing devices at the time.
title: 阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机

source_text:
功能
ABC计算机是为特定目的而设计的，就是求解线性方程组。它能求解多达29个方程组成的方程组，而这是当时的一个难题。这种规模的问题在约翰·阿塔纳索夫工作的物理学机构中已经很常见了。这台机器能够利用两个具有29个变量和一个常数项的方程，消掉其中一个变量。这个过程中需要重复地手动操作每个方程，最终得出消掉一个变量的方程组，然后再重复这个过程来消掉另一个变量，依此向下进行。
target_text: The ABC computer is designed for specific purposes. It solves the equation of up to 29 equations, which was a problem at the time. Problems of this magnitude are common in the physics institutions where John Atanasov works. The machine can use two equations with 29 variables and one constant item to remove one of them. This process requires a repeated manual operation of each equation, resulting in the elimination of the equation of one variable, and then a repeat of the process to remove the other variable and proceed downwards accordingly.
title: 阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机

source_text: 約翰·皮斯普·埃克特（John Adam Presper "Pres" Eckert）和约翰·莫齐利（John Mauchly）发明ENIAC，是第一个电子计算设备专利的获得者。约翰·莫齐利曾经在1941年测试过ABC计算机，并且莫齐利以前的学生艾萨克·奥尔巴赫指控说，这影响了莫齐利之后关于ENIAC的工作，虽然莫齐利拒绝承认。1967年，霍尼韦尔起诉斯佩里·兰特，试图推翻他们对于ENIAC的专利，声称ABC计算机是在先技术。1973年10月19日，美国明尼苏达地区地方法院宣布裁决，在霍尼韦尔对斯佩里·兰特的诉讼中发现，ENIAC专利是由约翰·阿塔纳索夫的发明所衍生的。这个判决没有人提出上诉。
target_text: John Adam Presper " Pres" Eckert and John Mauchly invented ENIAC as the first recipient of a patent for computing equipment. John Motzili tested ABC computers in 1941 and a former student, Isaac Olbach, in Motzili, alleged that this affected ENIAC’s work after Mozili, although Motzili refused to admit it. In 1967, Honiwell sued Speri Lant, seeking to overturn their patent on ENIAC, claiming that ABC computers were the first technology. On 19 October 1973, the United States District Court of Minnesota announced its decision that ENIAC’s patent was derived from John Atanasov’s invention in a lawsuit against Sperry Land.
title: 阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机

source_text: 1973年10月19日，案件在法律上得到了解决，美国地方法院法官厄尔·拉尔森认为ENIAC的专利无效，判决说ENIAC从阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机上继承了很多基础思想。法官拉尔森明确表示：“埃克特和莫齐利并非他们自己首先发明了自动电子数字计算机，而是继承了约翰·文森特·阿塔纳索夫的发明。”
target_text: On 19 October 1973, the case was legally settled, and Judge Earl Larson of the United States District Court considered ENIAC's patent invalid and ruled that ENIAC inherited a number of basic ideas from Atanasov-Berry's computer. Judge Larson made it clear that “Ector and Motzili did not invent automatic digital computers themselves, but rather inherited the invention of John Vincent Atanasov.”
title: 阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机

source_text:
复制品
当学校将地下室改造成教室的时候，原始的ABC计算机最终被拆掉了，而且所有的零部件（除了一个存储器转鼓）都被丢弃了。1997年，由埃姆斯实验室（位于爱荷华州校园）的约翰·古斯塔夫森领导的研究团队花费了35万美元，建造了一台能工作的ABC计算机复制品。现在，这台ABC计算机复制品永久展览于爱荷华州立大学达勒姆计算和通信中心一楼大厅。
target_text: When the school transformed the basement into a classroom, the original ABC computer was eventually removed, and all the parts (except one memory drum) were discarded. In 1997, a research team led by John Gustavson at the Emes Laboratory (on the campus in Iowa) spent $350,000 to build a working ABC computer copy. Now, the ABC computer copy is permanently displayed on the first floor of the Dalem Computing and Communications Center at the University of Iowa.
title: 阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机

source_text:
著名校友
张淑仪，中国科学院院士、著名女物理学家。
邱爱慈，中国工程院院士。
张琴秋，红军女将领，纺织工业部第一任副部长。
王晓棠少将，原八一电影制片厂厂长，中国电影家协会副主席，著名的电影表演艺术家，一级演员。

source_text: 最初的可编程序逻辑控制器只有電路逻辑控制的功能，所以被命名为可程式邏輯控制器，后来随着不断的发展，这些当初功能简单的计算机模块已经有了包括逻辑控制，时序控制、模拟控制、多机通信等许多的功能，名称也改为可程式控制器（Programmable Controller），但是由于它的縮写也是PC，与个人电脑（Personal Computer）的縮写相同，也因為多年来的使用习惯，人们还是经常使用可程式邏輯控制器这一称呼，并在术语中仍沿用PLC这一缩写。
target_text: The original compiler logical controllers, which had only the function of electrical logical control, were named as programmable logic controllers and, as they evolved, the original simple computer modules had many functions, including logical control, time sequence control, simulation control, multi-machine communications, and the name had been changed to Programmable Controller, but, since it was also a PC, it had the same acronym as the PC, and because of its usage over the years, it was often referred to as a programmed logic controller and it was still used in the terminology as a PLC.
title: 可编程逻辑控制器

source_text: 在可程式邏輯控制器出现之前，一般要使用成百上千的继电器以及計數器才能组成具有相同功能的自动化系统，而现在，经过编程的简单的可程式邏輯控制器模块基本上已经代替了这些大型装置。可程式邏輯控制器的系统程序一般在出厂前已经初始化完毕，用户可以根据自己的需要自行编辑相应的用户程序来满足不同的自动化生产要求。
target_text: The simple programmed logical controller module has largely replaced these large devices by using hundreds of relays and calculators that have the same functionality before they appear. title: 可编程逻辑控制器

source_text: Skype是一款即时通信应用软件，可通过拥有连接互联网的系統設備包含手机、平板电脑等提供与其他联网设备或传统电话/智能手机间进行视频通话和语音通话的服务。使用者可通过Skype收发即时通讯信息，传输文件，收发多媒体信息，进行视频会议。Skype可使用于Microsoft Windows，Mac和Linux系统，同时也可运行在使用Android、Blackberry、iOS和Windows 10 Mobile的智能手机和平板电脑中。Skype服务大部分免费，但当使用者需要打到固定电话或手提电话时，需要购买Skype点数或订购套餐。Skype软件基于freemium许可协议框架进行授权。
target_text: Skype is an instant communication application that provides video and voice calls with other networking devices or with traditional/smart telephones, such as mobile phones, tablets and other systems with Internet connections. Users can send and receive instant messaging through Skype, transmit documents, receive and send multimedia information, and conduct videoconferences. Skype can use Microsoft Windows, Mac and Linux systems, and can also operate on smart cellular peaceboard computers using Android, Blackberry, iOS and Windows 10 Mobile. Skype services are mostly free, but when users need to call a fixed phone or hand-call, they need to buy Skype points or order a meal package.
title: Skype

source_text: Skype允许用麥克風來进行交流，又可以通过摄像头來进行视频通讯，也可以用文字即时通讯。Skype软件之间的通话（Skype-to-Skype calls）无需付费，但当需要（通过传统的公共交换电话网）致电给固定电话或移动电话时，用户需要通过名为“Skype点数”的用户账户系统付费。与大多数VoIP软件不同，Skype混合使用了点对点架构和主从式架构。这一架构通过Skype安装在计算机上的后台进程实现。这一架构体现在Skype的原计划启用名称Sky Peer-to-Peer（端对端）。
target_text: Skype allows communication with microphones, video communications via cameras, or text-based instantaneous communications. Skype calls are free of charge, but when calls are needed (through the traditional public exchange network) to fixed phones or mobile phones, users are required to pay through a user account system called “Skype Point”. Unlike most VoIP software, Skype uses a combination of point-to-point architecture and main-side architecture. This structure is achieved through the back-office process installed on a computer by Skype. This structure is reflected in Skype's original plan to launch the name Sky Peer-to-Peer (end-to-end).
title: Skype

source_text: 现在的杜伊斯堡—埃森大学是一所新型的、现代化的综合大学。拥有先进的教学设施、经验丰富的教授及学生住校的住宿条件。通过合并，两校在专业设置上可以得到互补，如埃森大学的医学专业是杜伊斯堡大学所没有的，反之杜伊斯堡大学的哲学专业也是埃森大学所欠缺的，同时学术交流可以更加密切，总之双方的综合实力都能够增强。杜伊斯堡—埃森大学在新的信息学专业和应用信息学专业外，还将增设应用通信与媒体学学士／硕士专业。这个新的信息技术专业是建立在应用性通信与媒体学的基础上的。就读者既可在获得学士学位后毕业，也可以继续读硕士。该专业具有信息、心理、文学研究和社会等多学科组合的特点。在这个针对项目和实践的专业中，学生可以学到"信息学与新媒体"、"通信、语言和文学"及"人类与公共关系"等领域的职业行为能力。这个新专业的创新之处在于把信息技术与人文知识结合在一起。另外关于应用信息学，还有一些相关信息。杜伊斯堡—埃森大学还开设应用信息学专业。学生除了须牢固掌握信息学和与信息相关的数学基础知识外，还要学习电子技术及经济学的基础知识。在专业学习阶段，要加深数据库、人工智能、编程语言和编程器、科学计算、交互式人机通信方面的知识。

source_text: 逆运动学（）是决定要达成所需要的姿势所要设置的关节可活动对象的参数的过程。例如，给定一个人体的三维模型，如何设置手腕和手肘的角度以便把手从放松位置变成挥手的姿势？这个问题在机器人学中是很关键的，因为操纵机械手臂通过关节角度来控制。逆运动学在游戏编程和三维建模中也很重要，虽然其重要性因为运动捕获数据的大型数据库越来越多的使用而降低了。
target_text: Reverse kinetics () is the process of determining the parameters of what a joint is meant to be active in order to achieve the required position. For example, a three-dimensional model of the human body is given how to set the wrist and elbow angle so that the hand can move from a relaxed position to a wave position? The issue is critical in robotics, because mechanical arm manipulation is controlled by a joint. Inverse motionology is also important in game programming and 3-D modelling, although its importance is reduced by the increasing use of large databases of motor capture data.
title: 逆运动学

source_text: 计算机的文件系统是一种存储和组织计算机数据的方法，它使得对其存取和查找变得容易，文件系统使用文件和树形目录的抽象逻辑概念代替了硬盘和光盘等物理设备使用数据块的概念，用户使用文件系统来保存数据不必关心数据实际保存在硬盘（或者光盘）的地址为多少的数据块上，只需要记住这个文件的所属目录和文件名。在写入新数据之前，用户不必关心硬盘上的那个块地址没有被使用，硬盘上的存储空间管理（分配和释放）功能由文件系统自动完成，用户只需要记住数据被写入到了哪个文件中。
target_text: A computer file system is a method of storing and organizing computer data, which makes it easier to access and search for them. The document system uses the abstract logic concept of file and tree catalogues to replace the concept of data blocks for physical devices such as hard disks and CD-ROMs. Users use the file system to save data without having to care about how much data is actually stored on a hard disk (or CD-ROM) address, but only to remember the directory and filename to which the document belongs. Before writing new data, users need not be concerned that the address on the hard disk is not used, and the storage space management (distribution and release) function on the hard disk is automatically performed by the file system.
title: 文件系统

source_text:
数据库文件系统
文件管理方面的一个新概念是一种基于数据库的文件系统的概念。不再（或者不仅仅）使用分层结构管理，文件按照他们的特征进行区分，如文件类型、专题、作者或者亚数据进行区分。于是文件检索就可以按照SQL风格甚至自然语言风格进行。
target_text: A new concept for file management in the database file system is the concept of a database-based document system. Documents are no longer (or not only) managed in a hierarchical structure, and are differentiated according to their characteristics, such as file type, topic, author or subdata. File retrieval can then be done according to SQL style or even natural language style.
title: 文件系统

source_text:

1986年，王永民开发了五笔字型输入法，从那时起，五笔字型在中国大陆的调整汉字录入软件中一直占居着主导的地位。出于对王码的认同，微软公司从王码公司手上购得授权，把五笔字型输入法软件集成到微软OFFICE办公套件中，从那里起五笔字型输入法的外观及功能便基本确定下来。随着电脑科技的发展及中国大陆电脑的普及，很多用户开始对五笔字型输入法的简单功能表示怀疑，在90年代初，五笔字型输入法第一个创新产品陈桥智能五笔问世，智能五笔开创了五笔输入法创新的道路。从那以后中国程序员对五笔字型输入法的创新就没有停止过。
target_text: In 1986, Wang Young-min developed five font input techniques, and since then, five fonts have been dominant in China’s mainland adjusted Han word entry software. With the development of computer science and technology and the spread of mainland Chinese computers, many users have expressed doubts about the simple functionality of five font entry methods. source_text: 辐射度算法，一种全局光照算法，用于三维计算机图形学绘制。和倾向于只在一个表面上模拟一次光的反射的直接光照算法(例如光线跟踪)不同，像辐射度算法这样的全局光照算法模拟光在一个场景裡的多次反射，通常会导致更柔和更自然的影子和反射。
target_text: Radiological algorithms, a global light algorithm, are used in three-dimensional computer graphic drawings. Unlike direct light algorithms (e.g. light tracking) that tend to mimic light only once on a surface, global photometer algorithms such as radiometric algorithms simulate multiple reflections in a scene, often resulting in softer and more natural shadows and reflections.
title: 辐射度算法

source_text:
物理特点
基本的辐射度算法方法其基础在于热辐射的理论，因为辐射度依赖于两个表面之间光能的传输。为了简化计算，辐射度算法假设该数值在整个面片上恒定（完全或理想漫射曲面）；这意味着要计算精确的图像，场景表述的几何部分必须分解成更小的区域，或者说面片，然后把它们组合起来得到最后的图像。
target_text: Physical characteristics Basic radiometric algorithms are based on the theory of thermal radiation, because radiation levels depend on the transfer of light energy between the two surfaces. To simplify the calculation, radiometric algorithms assume that the value is constant throughout the surface (a complete or ideal translator curve); this means that, in order to calculate accurate images, geometry in the presentation of the scene has to be broken down into smaller areas, or a profile, and then put together for the final image.
title: 辐射度算法

source_text:
内存的使用
电脑运行时，电脑的主内存按照被使用情况可分类为：
可利用（Available）物理内存：可立即分配给程序使用的内存。包括：
空闲（Free）物理内存：完全未被使用，内容为全 0
缓存（Cached）物理内存
备用（standby）物理内存：操作系统预先把可能要用到的硬盘数据加载所占用的内存，还没被用户进程所使用，因此可随时丢弃从新初始化为 0
已修改（modified）物理内存：已被修改过的 caching 用途的内存，可在任意时刻写回硬盘文件（不是分页文件）然后被重用。由于硬盘 I/O，已修改（modified）物理内存不能计入空闲（Free）物理内存
被使用（used）物理内存：已经被进程使用的内存
用户进程使用的物理内存，即工作集（Working set）。Working Set 包含了可能被其他程序共享的内存，例如DLL。所以所有进程的Working Set加起来有可能大于实际的被使用（used）的物理内存。Private Bytes 是只被本进程提交（commit）的虚拟地址空间，不包括其他进程共享的内存。Virtual Byte 是整个进程占用的全部虚拟地址空间。32 位 Windows 用户模式下，进程最大可以使用 2GiB，可以通过修改 Boot.ini 文件扩展为最大可以使用到 3GiB。任务管理器中的 Memory Usage 对应的是 working set，VM Size 对应的是 private bytes
核心进程使用的物理内存
分页的核心进程使用的物理内存：可以交换到分页文件中，从而可被回收的物理内存
未分页（Non paged）的核心进程使用的物理内存：不能交换到分页文件的内存，总是要保留在物理内存中
硬件保留（hardware reserved）的物理内存：被 CPU 中的 GPU 核心或者其他外设硬件占用的，不由操作系统使用的内存

source_text: 三维计算机图形（）是電子計算機和特殊三维软件帮助下创造的作品。一般来讲，该术语可指代创造这些图形的过程，或者三维计算机图形技术的研究领域，及其相关技术。该術語也用于指代这些模型本身。。三维计算机图形和二维计算机图形的不同之处在于计算机内存储存了几何数据的三维表示，用于计算和绘制最终的二维图像。
target_text: Three-dimensional computer graphics (() is a work created with the help of an electron calculator and a special three-dimensional software. In general, the term may refer to the process of creating these graphics, or to the field of research in three-dimensional computer graphic technology and related techniques. The term is also used to describe the models themselves. The difference between three-dimensional computer graphics and two-dimensional computer graphics is that the computer contains three-dimensional expressions of geometric data, which are used to calculate and draw the final two-dimensional images.
title: 三维计算机图形

source_text: 一般来讲，为三维计算机图形准备几何数据的三维建模的艺术和雕塑及照相类似，而二维计算机图形的艺术和绘画相似。但是，三维计算机图形依赖于很多二维计算机图形的相同算法。计算机图形软件中，该区别有时很模糊：有些二维应用程序使用三维技术来达到特定效果，譬如灯光，而有些主要用于3D的应用程序采用二维的视觉技术。二维图形可以看作三维图形的子集。
target_text: Generally, three-dimensional modelling of geometric data for three-dimensional computer graphics is similar in art and sculpture and photography, while two-dimensional computer graphics are similar in art and painting. However, three-dimensional computer graphics depend on the same algorithms for many two-dimensional computer graphics. In computer graphics, the distinction is sometimes vague: some two-dimensional applications use three-dimensional techniques to achieve specific effects, such as lighting, while others, mainly 3-D, use two-dimensional visual techniques. Two-dimensional graphics can be considered a subset of three-dimensional graphics.
title: 三维计算机图形

source_text: Singularity操作系统會在系统构建、編寫程式等应用微软最先进的技术，例如Singularity的核心技术之一：软件独立进程（Software Isolated Processes，SIP）将采用型別安全的编程语言以及精简的指令完成，保证系统運作之间的高度独立性。SIP保证每个程序、驅動程式以及系统扩展组件都在獨立的SIP内运行，並不允许互相共享内存或修改自身代码，能夠使系统的稳定性增強。
target_text: The Singularity operating system will apply one of the most advanced technologies of Microsoft, such as systems construction, programming, and so on, such as one of the core technologies of Singularity: the software stand-alone process (Software Users, SIP) will use a different and secure programming language and streamlined instructions to ensure a high degree of independence between the operation of the system. The SIP guarantees that every program, driver, and extension component of the system will operate within a stand-alone SIP and does not allow for sharing memory or modifying its own code, which will enhance the stability of the system.
title: Singularity

source_text:
设计
Singularity是一个微内核操作系统；无论如何，不似过去的微内核，Singularity的不同组件不在单独的地址空间（进程）内运行，而是每個软件独立进程（SIP）分配到一个独立的单一地址空间。这些SIP的行为类似普通进程，但SIP将不会在任务调度时请求开销惩罚（overhead penalty）。系统的保护由不变式（invariants）集提供，比如内存不变式将维护内存内两个SIP间没有交互參照（或循环的内存指针）。这项规则将在应用程序安装阶段进行检查，并且不得违反，否则Singularity将禁止安装（注意：Singularity系统中安装完全由操作系统管理）。
target_text: Designing Singularity is a micronuclear operating system; in any case, unlike the past microkernels, different components of Singularity do not operate in a separate address space (process), but each software stand-alone process (SIP) is assigned to an independent single address space. These SIPs behave like normal processes, but SIPs will not request an overhead penalty (overhead penalty) during task schedule. System protection is provided by invariants, e.g. memory immobilization will maintain two SIPs in memory without cross-references (or looped memory needles). This rule will be checked at the application installation stage and cannot be violated, otherwise Singularity will prohibit installation (note: Singularity is installed entirely managed by the operating system).
title: Singularity

历史
电信系统通常是由电信工程师设计的，其源于19世纪末电报行业和20世纪初无线电和电话行业的技术进步。 如今，电信已广泛普及，在该过程中诞生的设备（例如电视，广播和电话）在世界许多地方都很普遍。 同时可以通过许多网络连接这些设备，包括计算机网络、公用电话交换网 （PSTN）、无线电网络和电视网络。通过互联网连接的计算机通信是电信的典型示例之一。电信在世界经济中发挥着重要作用，并且电信行业的收入占世界生产总值的3％左右。
target_text: Telecom systems are typically designed by telecommunications engineers, and are derived from technological advances in the cable industry at the end of the nineteenth century and in the radio and telephone industries at the beginning of the twentieth century. Today, telecommunications are widely available, and the equipment born in the process (e.g. television, radio, and telephone) is common in many parts of the world.

source_text: 椭圆曲线密码学（，缩写：）是一種基于椭圆曲线数学的公开密钥加密演算法。ECC的主要优势是它相比RSA加密演算法使用較小的密鑰長度并提供相当等级的安全性。ECC的另一个优势是可以定义群之间的双线性映射，基于Weil对或是Tate对；双线性映射已经在密码学中发现了大量的应用，例如基于身份的加密。
target_text: Ellipse cryptography (Abbreviation:) is a public key encryption algorithm based on elliptical mathematics. The main advantage of the ECC is that it uses smaller key lengths and provides a reasonable level of security than RSA encryption algorithms. Another advantage of the ECC is that it defines bilinear mapping between groups, based on Weil versus Tate versus Tate; it has found a large number of applications in cryptography, such as identity-based encryption.
title: 椭圆曲线密码学

source_text: 在2005年2月16日，NSA宣布决定采用椭圆曲线密码的战略作为美国政府标准的一部分，用来保护敏感但不保密的信息。NSA推荐了一组被称为Suit B的算法，包括用来密钥交换的橢圓曲線Menezes-Qu-Vanstone（ECMQV）和橢圓曲線Diffie-Hellman（ECDH），用来數字簽名的椭圆曲线数字签名算法。这一组中也包括AES和SHA。安全性
target_text: On 16 February 2005, NSA announced its decision to adopt an elliptical code as part of the US government standard to protect sensitive, but not confidential, information. NSA recommended a set of algorithms called Suit B, including Menezes-Qu-Vanstoone (ECMQV) and Diffie-Hellman (EDDH) for key exchange, and AES and SHA for digital signature.
title: 椭圆曲线密码学

source_text:
量子計算攻擊
如果攻击者拥有大型量子计算机，那么他可以使用秀尔算法解决离散对数问题，从而破解私钥和共享秘密。目前的估算认为：破解256位素数域上的椭圆曲线，需要2330个量子比特与1260亿个托佛利门。相比之下，使用秀尔算法破解2048位的RSA则需要4098个量子比特与5.2万亿个托佛利门。因此，椭圆曲线会更先遭到量子计算机的破解。目前还不存在建造如此大型量子计算机的科学技术，因此椭圆曲线密码学至少在未来十年（或更久）依然是安全的。但是密码学家已经积极展开了後量子密碼學的研究。其中，（SIDH）有望取代当前的常规椭圆曲线密钥交换（ECDH）。
target_text: When the attacker has a large quantum computer, he can solve the discrete logarithmic problem by using the Sulu algorithm to crack the private key and share secrets. Current estimates suggest that breaking the elliptical curve in the 256-digit domain will require 230 bits and 126 billion Toweri Gates. By contrast, breaking 2048-digit RSAs using the Siu algorithm will require 4098 bits and 5.2 trillion Tovelians. So the elliptical curve will be deconstructed before the quantum computer. There is no science or technology to build such a large quantum computer, so elliptical cryptography is still safe at least for the next decade (or more).

计算机辅助出版
随着计算机图形功能的成熟，它们开始被用于直接渲染字符、分列、页面甚至多页签名，而不是简单地从预先提供的集合中调用照相模板。阴极射线管（CRT）除了被用作计算机操作员的显示设备，还被用来渲染照相排版文本。然而，CRT显示器的弯曲特性，导致了屏幕上文字和艺术作品向屏幕外缘扭曲。2010年初"平板屏幕"显示器（LCD、LED和最近的OLED）的出现消除了老式CRT显示器造成的失真问题。截至2016年，平板显示器几乎完全取代了CRT显示器。
target_text: Computer-assisted publishing, as computer graphic functionality matures, they begin to be used for direct rendering of characters, breakdowns, pages, and even multiple pages of signatures, rather than simply calling photo templates from pre-provided pools. In addition to being used as display equipment for computer operators, the cathode ray tubes (CRTs) are also used to rewrite photographic layout text. However, the curved properties of the CRT monitors cause the distortion of text and art works on the screen to the outer edge of the screen. The emergence of the flat screen monitors (LCD, LED and, most recently, OLED) in early 2010 eliminated the distortion caused by the old CRT monitors. As of 2016, the flat screen monitors almost entirely replaced the CRT monitors.
title: 版面设计

source_text: 连接到计算机的打印机可以直接打印文档，多份打印，也可以作为原件在上述的机器或复印机上复印 。所见即所得的文字处理器使普通办公用户和消费者能够制作更复杂的页面布局，使用文本对齐，并使用比打字机更多的字体。早期的点阵打印对于办公文档来说已经足够了，但是对于专业排版来说质量还是太低。喷墨打印和激光打印确实拥有足够多的质量类型，因此具有这些类型的打印机的计算机很快就取代了照相排版机。
target_text: Printers connected to computers can print documents directly, print many copies, or copy them as originals on the machines or photocopiers mentioned above. The text processors that are available enable ordinary office users and consumers to create more complex page layouts, use text alignment and use more fonts than typewriters. Early dotted printing is sufficient for office documents, but it is too low quality for professional layouts. Inkjet and laser printing do have enough quality types, so computers with these types of printers quickly replace the camera layouts.
title: 版面设计

source_text: 借助旗舰软件Adobe InDesign和基于云的Lucidpress等现代桌面出版软件，布局过程可以完全在屏幕上进行。（类似布局选项可用于桌面排版软件支持的专业打印店进行粘贴;相比之下，“文字处理”软件通常只具有更有限的布局和排版选择，权衡一下，其灵活性易于使用，适用于更常见的应用。）完成的文档可以直接打印为复制就绪版本，无需人力组装（给定足够大的打印机）。如果将灰度图像发送到胶印机，则灰度图像必须是数字半色调，或者单独发送以供打印店插入标记区域。完成的作品也可以用数字方式传送到印刷厂，印刷厂可以自己打印，直接拍摄到胶片上，或者使用计算机制版技术完全跳过物理原件。PostScript和可移植文档格式 （PDF）已成为数字传输的标准文件格式。
target_text: Modern desktop publishing software, such as the flagship software Adobe InDesign and cloud-based Lucidpress, can be configured entirely on the screen. (Similar layout options can be used for pasting by professional print shops supported by desktop layout software; by contrast, word-processing software usually has a more limited layout and layout selection, weighing that its flexibility is easy to use and applies to more common applications.) The completed document can be printed directly as a copy-ready version without a human capacity to assemble (set enough printers). If the grey-scale image is sent to a camera, the grey-scale image must be digital semi-coloured, or sent separately for insertion of the mark area in a printing shop. The finished work can also be delivered digitally to the printing plant, which can print directly onto the film, or by fully skipping the physical original using the computing mechanism technology. PostScript and the portable document format (PDF) have become standard file formats for digital transmission.
title: 版面设计

source_text:
数字媒体（非纸质）
自个人计算机问世以来，页面布局技术已扩展到电子媒体和印刷媒体。
电子书 ，PDF文档和静态网页的镜像文件相对紧密，但计算机还可以添加多媒体动画和交互性。交互式媒体的页面布局与界面设计和用户体验设计重叠;交互式“页面”更好地称作图形用户界面 （GUI）。
target_text: Digital media (non-paper) Since the advent of personal computers, page layout technology has been extended to electronic and print media. Electronic books, PDF documents and static web page mirror files are relatively close, but computers can also add multimedia animations and interactive features. Interactive media pages layouts overlap with interface design and user experience design; interactive pages are better referred to as graphical user interfaces (GUI).
title: 版面设计

source_text: 在20世纪40年代使用高射投影仪和20世纪50年代的幻灯机投影仪以透明胶片进行演示（使用不透明文本和图像）变得流行。一些复印机可以打印高射投影仪的透明胶片 。计算机演示程序于20世纪80年代上市，可以以数字方式布置演示文稿。计算机开发的演示文稿可以通过一些激光打印机打印成透明的，转移到幻灯片，或使用LCD顶置投影仪直接投影。现代演示通常使用视频投影仪 ， 计算机显示器或大屏幕电视则以数字方式显示。
target_text: The use of anti-aircraft projectors in the 1940s and of slide projectors in the 1950s for transparent film presentation (with opaque text and images) became popular. Some photocopiers can print transparent film from anti-aircraft projectors. Computer presentations are available in the 1980s, and presentations can be digitally distributed. Computer-developed presentations can be printed in a transparent way by laser printers, transferred to slides, or directly projected using LCD top projectors. Modern presentations usually use video projectors, and computer monitors or large-screen televisions display digitally.
title: 版面设计

source_text: 大多数桌面出版软件的网格是以页面上填充彩色线或点呈现的，这些线或点放置在指定的相等的水平和垂直距离上。可以在整个文档中指定自动边距和小册子书脊线（装订线）以供全局使用。可以在页面上的任何点放置多个额外的水平和垂直线。对最终用户/读者不可见的形状可以放在页面上，作为页面布局和打印处理的指导。软件模板是通过复制模板数据文件或在多页文档中使用母版页特性实现的。母版页可以包括网格元素和模板元素，例如页眉和页脚元素、自动页码和自动目录功能。
target_text: Most grids for desktop publishing software are displayed on pages filled with colour lines or points that are placed at the specified equivalent level and vertical distance. Automatic margins and pamphlet spinalines can be specified for global use throughout the document. Multiple additional horizontal and vertical lines can be placed at any point on the page. A shape that is invisible to the end user/reader can be placed on the page as a guide for page layout and printing processing. The software template is achieved by copying template data files or using master page features in multiple pages. The parent page can include grid elements and template elements, such as headers and footers, automatic page numbers and automatic directory functions.
title: 版面设计

source_text: 电子页面可以通过划分页面或通过组合效果来利用静态和动态布局特征。例如，页面的一部分（例如web横幅）可以包含交换内容区域内包含的静态或动态图形。通过使用不可见的间隔物将文本推离边缘，动态或实时文本可以缠绕在不规则形状的图像周围。一些计算机算法可以检测包含轮廓周围的透明度和流动内容的对象的边缘。
target_text: Electronic pages can use static and dynamic layout features either by dividing pages or by grouping effects. For example, a part of a page (e.g. a web banner) can contain static or dynamic graphics contained in an exchange content area. Text can be removed from the edge by using an invisible space, and dynamic or real-time text can be entangled around an image in an irregular shape. Some computer algorithms can detect the edges of objects that contain transparency and mobile content around the contour.
title: 版面设计

source_text:
前端与后端
随着现代化的媒体内容检索和输出技术的发展， 视觉传达（前端 ）和信息技术（后端 ）之间出现了很多交叉。大型印刷出版物（厚书，特别是教学性的书籍）和电子页面（网页）需要元数据来实现自动索引、自动重新格式化、数据库发布、动态页面显示和最终用户交互。许多元数据（meta标记）必须在页面布局过程中人工编码或指定。这将艺术家和工程师之间的页面布局工作划分开来，也有时艺术家或工程师单独执行这两项工作。更复杂的项目可能需要两个单独的设计：页面布局设计作为前端 ，功能编码设计作为后端。在这种情况下，前端可以使用其他页面布局技术（如图像编辑软件）进行设计，或使用手绘方法在纸上进行设计。大多数图像编辑软件都包含用于转换页面布局的功能，以便在“ 所见即所得 ”编辑器或功能中使用，以导出图形供桌面出版软件使用。在大多数情况下，所见即所得编辑器和桌面出版软件允许在后端编码之前进行前端设计。界面设计和数据库发布可能涉及更多技术知识，或与前端信息技术工程的协作。有时，后端的功能是自动检索和排列前端的内容。
target_text: Many metadata (meta tags) must be manually encoded or designated in the page layout process. This separates the page layout work between artists and engineers, and also allows artists or engineers to perform the two in isolation. More complex projects may require two separate designs: page layout design as front end, functional coding as back end. In this case, the front end can be designed using other page layout techniques (e.g. image editing software), or hand-painting methods to design on paper. Most image editing software contains features that can be used to convert page layouts, so that they can be used by artists or engineers on their own in order to produce graphics for desktop publishing software.
title: 版面设计

source_text:
章和节的标题，或标题和小标题
图片标题
拉引号和螺母图可能会被添加到课程或使短篇故事适合布局
Boxout和侧边栏，用于显示主要文本流中的信息
页眉和页脚，其内容通常在主题页面上是统一的，因此由布局软件自动复制。页码通常包含在页眉或页脚中，软件会自动为每页增加页码。
目录列表
脚注和尾注等注释; 参考书目 ，例如在学术期刊或教科书中
在报纸制作中，最终选择和裁剪伴随故事的照片可能留给布局编辑器（因为照片的选择可能影响必要区域的形状，而影响布局的其余部分），或者可能有单独的照片编辑。同样， 标题可能由布局编辑器，副本编辑器或原始作者编写。
target_text: Titles of chapters and sections, or titles and sub-headings Photo captions, quotations and screw charts may be added to the curriculum or make short stories suitable for layout Boxout and sidebars to display information headers and footers in the main text stream, the content of which is usually uniform on the theme page, and therefore reproduced automatically by layout software. Page numbers are usually included in headers or footers, and the software automatically adds page numbers to each page. Catalogue lists footnotes and endnotes, for example; Bibliography, for example, in academic journals or textbooks, the final selection and editing of photographs accompanying the story may be left to layout editors (as the selection of photographs may affect the shape of the necessary area and the rest of the layout), or there may be separate photo editing. Similarly, titles may be prepared by layout editors, copy editors or original authors.
title: 版面设计

source_text:
附文： 从主文本中附加出来的。例如，关于产品使用的技术手册可能在附文中包括各如何使用该产品的示例。也称为intermezzo 。见附文（发布） 。
程序：关于计算机编程的文章和书籍通常将代码和算法放在图中。
公式：数学著作可能会将大块的数学符号放在与主文本分开的浮动块中。
target_text: Enclosure: Attached from the main text. For example, a technical manual on the use of the product may include examples of how to use the product in the attachment. Also known as Intermezzo. See enclosure. Programs: articles and books on computer programming usually place codes and algorithms in graphs. Formula: Mathematical writings may place large mathematical symbols in floating blocks separate from the main text.
title: 版面设计

source_text: 在数学中，布尔函数（Boolean function），又称逻辑函数，描述如何基于对布尔输入的某种逻辑计算确定布尔值输出。它们在复杂性理论的问题和数字计算机的芯片设计中扮演基础角色。布尔函数的性质在密码学中扮演关键角色，特别是在对称密钥算法的设计中（参见S-box）。
target_text: In mathematics, the Boolean function, or logic function, describes how a boolean value output is determined on the basis of some logical calculation of a boolean input. They play a fundamental role in the question of complexity theory and the chip design of a digital computer. The nature of the boolean function plays a key role in cryptography, especially in the design of symmetric key algorithms (see S-box).
title: 布尔函数

source_text:
张立纲（，），物理学家。原籍吉林永吉，出生于河南开封。张立纲先生乃为著名华裔物理学家、半导体物理、材料科学与器件等多科性交叉形成的前沿领域——半导体量子阱、超晶格的主要奠基人之一。生平
1949年來到臺灣，在此長大。1957年自國立臺灣大學電機工程系毕业後，赴美留學，1961年，取得南卡羅來納大學（電子/電機工程系）碩士學位。1963年，获斯坦福大学（固態電子/電機工程系）博士学位。
target_text: Mr. Zhang is one of the leading architects of the semiconductor quantum mass, hypercrystal, which is a multidisciplinary frontier of Chinese physicists, semiconductor physics, material science and instruments. He grew up here in 1949 in Taiwan. After graduating from the University of Taiwan Electric Engineering Department in 1957, he went to American studies and, in 1961, obtained a bachelor's degree from the University of South Carolina (the Faculty of Electrical/Electrical Engineering). In 1963, he obtained a doctorate from Stanford University (the Department of Solid Electric/Electoral Engineering).
title: 张立纲

source_text: 油轮卸货时所使用的泵直接放在船上。今天的油轮与几乎所有其它海轮一样配有货物计算机，这部计算机可以监视货物的装卸以及计算装卸过程中船所受的所有的力。除油箱和管道外，油轮上还配有锅炉、螺旋桨、发电机、泵（大的油轮上的装卸泵可以每小时泵上万吨液体）和灭火装置。
target_text: The pumps used to unload the tankers are placed directly on board the ships. Today the tankers, like almost all other ships, are equipped with a cargo computer that monitors the loading and unloading of the cargo and calculates all the forces to which the ships are exposed during loading and unloading. In addition to the tanks and pipelines, the tankers are equipped with boilers, propellers, generators, pumps (loading pumps on large tankers can pump tons of liquid per hour) and fire-fighting devices.
title: 油輪

source_text:

许多专业软件都提供给开发者撰写插件所需要的API，目的是为了扩展软件的功能。以下是应用程序及其插件的例子：
電子郵件用戶端使用插件来进行加密和解密（良好隱私密碼法）

target_text: Examples: Many specialized software are provided to developers to write APIs needed for plugins to expand the functionality of the software. The following are examples of applications and their plugins: E-mail client uses plugins to encrypt and declassify (good private passwords) Drawing software uses plugins to support different file formats, handles images (Adobe Photoshop) media players use plugins to support different file formats and provide filters. Data package monitors use plugins to decode data packages () use plugins to process data sent by different types of sensors () integrate open environment plugins to support programming languages (Eclipse,jEdit, MonoDevelop) Web browsers use plugins to broadcast video and other formats (Flash, QuickTime)

title: OddMuse

source_text: PSO 算法最初是为了图形化地模拟鸟群优美而不可预测的运动。而通过对动物社会行为的观察，发现在群体中对信息的社会共享提供一个演化的优势，并以此作为开发算法的基础。通过加入近邻的速度匹配、并考虑了多维搜索和根据距离的加速，形成了 PSO 的最初版本。之后引入了惯性权重w来更好的控制开发（exploitation）和探索（exploration），形成了标准版本。为了提高粒群算法的性能和实用性，中山大学、（英国）格拉斯哥大学等又开发了自适应（Adaptive PSO）版本和离散（discrete）版本
target_text: The PSO algorithm was originally designed to graphically simulate the beautiful and unpredictable movement of birds. By observing animal social behavior, it was discovered that the social sharing of information in the community provided an evolutionary advantage and served as a basis for the development of the algorithm. The initial version of the PSO was created by joining the velocity matching of the immediate neighbourhood, taking into account the acceleration of multidimensional search and distance. The inertial weight w was introduced to better control development and exploration, resulting in a standard version. In order to improve the performance and usefulness of particle group algorithms, the Adaptive PSO and Disconnection versions were developed at the University of Central Shan (United Kingdom) and the University of Glasgow, among others.
title: 粒子群优化

source_text:
算法原理
PSO 算法是基于群体的，根据对环境的适应度将群体中的个体移动到好的区域。然而它不对个体使用演化算子，而是将每个个体看作是 D 维搜索空间中的一个没有体积的微粒（点），在搜索空间中以一定的速度飞行，这个速度根据它本身的飞行经验和同伴的飞行经验来动态调整。第 i 个微粒表示为 Xi =(xi1, xi2, …, xiD) ，它经历过的最好位置（有最好的适应值）记为 Pi = (pi1, pi2, …, piD)，也称为 pbest。在群体所有微粒经历过的最好位置的索引号用符号 g 表示，即 Pg，也称为 gbest 。微粒 i 的速度用 Vi = (vi1, vi2, …, viD) 表示。对每一代，它的第 d+1 维（1 ≤ d+1 ≤ D）根据如下方程进行变化：
target_text: The algorithm PSO algorithm is based on groups, moving individuals in groups to good areas based on environmental adaptation. However, instead of using an evolutionary calculus for individuals, it treats each individual as one of the unsized particles (points) in the D-dimensional search space, flying at a certain speed in the search space, which is dynamically adjusted by its own flight experience and that of its peers. No. i is expressed as Xi = (xi1, xi2, ..., xiD), the best position it has experienced (with the best adaptation values) is marked as Pi = (pi1, pii2, ... pibet), also known as pbest. The index number for the best position experienced by all particles in the group is expressed as g, also known as gbest.
title: 粒子群优化

source_text:
公司介绍
无界网络创立于2002年，总部位于美国硅谷。无界网络公司提供的产品主要是无界浏览和无界通软件，该软件可以免费下载。软件除了中文版外，还有英文版。美國參議院2011年2月15日公佈的報告称，一些翻牆軟件，如自由門和無界網絡，是兩家由法轮功成員建立的公司開發的，這些軟件用於幫助中國大陸網民及法轮功學員翻越防火長城。
target_text: In addition to the Chinese version, the software is available in English. According to a report released by the United States Senate on February 15, 2011, a number of wall-rolling software, such as a free door and an open network, were developed by two companies set up by Falun Gong practitioners and used to help Chinese Internet users and Falun Gong practitioners across the Wall.
title: 无界网络

source_text:
效果
据美国参议院2011年2月15日公布的报告显示，埃及、叙利亚、伊朗、沙特阿拉伯、缅甸和越南等国民众使用自由门和无界网络等软件以翻越自己国家的互联网审查。该报告指出，由法轮功学员研发的自由门和无界网络是目前最有效的翻牆软件。纽约时报专栏作家、普利兹奖得主纪思道（Nicholas Donabet Kristof）2009年撰文宣称，法轮功学员开发的突破网络封锁软件，将推倒21世纪独裁者的「柏林牆」。
target_text: According to a report published by the United States Senate on 15 February 2011, citizens in Egypt, Syria, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Myanmar, and Viet Nam use software such as free doors and borderless networks to overturn their own countries’ Internet censorship. The report states that free door and borderless networks developed by Falun Gong practitioners are the most effective wall-breaking software available.
title: 无界网络

source_text: 翻牆软件在独裁国家所产生的影响引起关注，在美國智库哈德逊研究中心（Hudson Institute）长期专注宗教自由的研究员、同时也是前里根政府官员霍洛维茨（Michael Horowitz）的遊說下，《纽约时报》专栏作家、《华尔街日报》、《华盛顿邮报》的社论版要求美国国务院资助互联网自由软件公司；共和党参议员布朗巴克（Sam Brownback）更扬言，若不将资金分发出去，就暂停国务院官员的任命审核。
target_text: The impact of wall-breaking software in authoritarian countries is a cause for concern. Following a long-standing talk by the Hudson Institute of Research, a United States think tank dedicated to freedom of religion, and by former Reagan government official Michael Horowitz, New York Times columnist, Wall Street Journal, and Washington Post editorial editions have asked the United States Department of State to fund Internet Free Software; Republican Senator Sam Brownback has threatened to suspend the appointment of State Department officials if funds are not distributed.
title: 无界网络

source_text: 2010年5月，美国国务院决定拨款150万美元給技术上有优势的全球网络自由联盟（Global Internet Freedom Consortium），此聯盟由法轮功學員所創立。2011年3月4日，全球网络自由联盟创办者之一的电脑工程师黄艾伦表示，全球网络自由联盟的加盟成员都是法轮功学员组建的公司：“网络自由联盟是由四家公司组成的非盈利机构，他们在推广破网软件中起到了巨大作用：有无界浏览，有自由门，有花园网，还有火凤凰、世界通。现在还有其他破网软件也出现了，但是网络自由联盟开发的软件用户最多、也最强有力。”
target_text: In May 2010, the U.S. Department of State decided to allocate $1.5 million to the technically superior Global Internet Free Association, a coalition founded by Falun Gong practitioners. On March 4, 2011, Huang Allen, a computer engineer of one of the founders of the Global Network Freedom Alliance, said that the members of the Global Network Freedom Alliance were companies of Falun Gong practitioners: “Wenet Freedom Alliance, a non-profit organization made up of four companies, played a huge role in the promotion of Web breakup software: there was access to the world, a free door, a garden network, and a fireflake. There are other broken web software, but the Internet Freedom Alliance has developed the most user and powerful software.”
title: 无界网络

source_text: 美国参议院2011年2月15日公布的报告，严厉指责国务院在使用由「互联网审查翻牆技术委员会」（Congress for Internet Censorship Circumvention Technology）筹集的资金在使用落实上进展缓慢。报告建议，这笔资金今后由广播理事会支配，该机构负责监管美国之音、自由亚洲电台和其它美国广播电视网络。报告称，自2008年以来，美国国务院共获得5,000万美元资金用于互联网自由项目，但其中3,000万美元至今尚未使用，而使用的款项中用于互联网翻牆技术的微乎其微。
target_text: The report issued by the United States Senate on 15 February 2011 strongly accuses the Department of State of the slow progress in the implementation of the funds raised by the “Congress for Internet Review of Wall Rolling” Commission. The report recommends that such funds be placed at the disposal of the Broadcasting Council in the future, which oversees the Voice of America, Radio Free Asia and other American radio and television networks. The report states that, since 2008, the United States Department of State has received $50 million for Internet Freedom projects, of which $30 million has not yet been used, and that the amount used for Internet wall flip technology is minimal.
title: 无界网络

source_text: 据美国国会参议院2011年2月15日公布的报告显示，埃及、叙利亚、伊朗、沙特阿拉伯、缅甸和越南等国民众使用自由门和无界网络等软件以翻越自己国家的互联网审查。该报告指出，自由门和无界网络是目前最有效的翻牆软件。纽约时报专栏作家、普立兹奖得主纪思道（Nicholas Donabet Kristof）2009年称，突破网络的封锁软件将推倒21世纪独裁者的「柏林牆」。
target_text: According to a report published by the Senate of the United States Congress on 15 February 2011, citizens in Egypt, Syria, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Myanmar, and Viet Nam use software such as free doors and borderless networks to overturn their own countries’ Internet censorship. The report states that free doors and borderless networks are currently the most effective wall-turning software.
title: 无界浏览

source_text: 2012年4月的报告中，Appelbaum进一步批评无界浏览的内部过滤（包括阻挡某些色情网站） ，该报告指出，根据google分析，使用无界浏览有可能洩露用户资料，因为该软件某部分系统并没有最新最好的补丁。Appelbaum并表示无界浏览使用开放软件Putty和zlib是违规行为。同天无界浏览回应表示问题已全数解决，Appelbaum的报告有误导之嫌；它指出，无界浏览和Appelbaum的Tor Project的差异在于基点不同，两者使用不同的方式来避开网路审查。
target_text: In its April 2012 report, Appelbaum further criticized the browsing of internal filters (including blocking certain pornographic sites), noting that, according to Google analysis, the use of browsing could reveal user information because some parts of the software did not have the most up-to-date and best patches. Appelbaum also indicated that browsing with open software Putty and zlib was a violation. The same browsing response indicated that the problem had been solved in full, and the Appelbaum report was misleading; it noted that the differences between the browsing and the Appelbaum Tor Project were based on the difference between the base points and the different ways in which they avoided web censorship.
title: 无界浏览

target_text: Common applications are: as a voltage element in inkjet printers, as an accelerator to control collisions using the airbag protection system in cars, as a gyroscope to determine car tilt, as a dynamic stabilization control system, as a pressure sensor in tyres, as a medical measure of blood pressure, as a digital microscope chip, as a micromicrophone array, as a MEMS micro projector, as a light exchange system in the computer network, which is integrated with intelligent dust technology.
title: 微机电系统

source_text:
研究和开发
MEMS研究人员使用一系列的工程软件工具来测试他们设计的仿真度和原型。MEMS设计经常用到有限元素分析。对动态力，热度等等的仿真可用ANSYS，COMSOL、IntelliSuite和CoventorWare-ANALYZER等软件实现。其他软件，比如ConvertorWare-ARCHITECT和MEMS-PRO用来开发更适合加工制造的产品布局，甚至用来仿真嵌入型的MEMS系统。当原型机开发完成后，研究人员能够用各种仪器比如激光多普勒扫描振動计，显微镜，频闪观测仪等来测试它们。
target_text: Research and development MEMS researchers use a range of engineering software tools to test simulations and prototypes that they design. MEMS design is often used for limited element analysis. Simulations of dynamic energy, heat, etc. can be done with software such as ANSYS, COMSOL, IntelSuit and CoventorWare-ANALYZER. Other software, such as Contractor Ware-ARCCHITECT and MEMS-PRO, are used to develop product layouts that are better suited for processing, and even to imitate embedded MEMS systems.
title: 微机电系统
