source_text: 1997年，江民公司在其反病毒软件KV300 L++版中设置了逻辑炸弹，据其自称仅检测针对本软件的盗版用户锁死硬盘用以反制盗版行为。此举导致许多用户的电脑硬盘数据被锁死且难以恢复（未有统计数据），并引发了当时软件业界的轰动和对此的广泛争议。后中国大陸公安部门认定江民公司此行为属于故意输入有害数据危害计算机信息系统安全，并根据《中华人民共和国计算-{}-机信-{}-息系统安全保护条例》第23条之规定，对其处以3000元人民币的罚款。
target_text: In 1997, Jiangmin set up a logical bomb in its anti-virus software version KV300 L++, claiming that it only detected pirate users locking up hard disks for anti-piracy purposes. This led to the locking down of computer hard disk data by many users (no statistics available) and to widespread controversy in the software industry at the time. The public security authorities in China and the mainland then found that Jiang Min had deliberately entered harmful data to endanger the security of computer information systems and imposed a fine of 3,000 yuan in accordance with article 23 of the Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on the Security Protection of the Computation--Mechanism-{}-Care System.
title: 江民殺毒軟件

source_text: 二维计算机图形主要用于本来采用传统印刷和绘制技术的那些应用场合，例如字体、地图、工程制图、广告、等等。在那些应用中，二维图像不仅仅是现实世界物体的一个表示，它本身是有附加含义的独立个体；因而二维模型在那些应用中更为实用，因为它们给出了比三维计算机图形更为直接的控制（三维图形更象摄影而非打印）。
target_text: Two-dimensional computer graphics are mainly used in applications where traditional printing and drawing techniques are used, such as fonts, maps, engineering drawings, advertising, etc. In those applications, two-dimensional images are not just an expression of real world objects; they are in themselves an independent individual with additional meanings; hence, two-dimensional models are more practical in those applications because they give more direct control than three-dimensional computer graphics (three-dimensional graphics are more like photography than printing).
title: 二维计算机图形

source_text: 在诸如桌面发布、工程、和商务这样的很多领域，基于二维计算机图形的文档的表述比相应的数字图像可能会小得多—经常只有1/1000 或者更小。该表示法也更灵活，因为它可以在不同的图像解析度进行绘制以适应不同的输出设备。因而，文档和插图经常采用二维图形文件存储和传输。
target_text: In many areas, such as desktop publishing, engineering, and commerce, documents based on two-dimensional computer graphics may be much smaller in presentation than the corresponding digital images - often only 1/1000 or smaller. The expression is also more flexible because it can be drawn with different image resolution to suit different output devices. As a result, documents and illustrations often use two-dimensional graphic files for storage and transmission.
title: 二维计算机图形

source_text:
在面向对象图形中，图像通过一个有自绘制方法—一个用任意的算法来赋予图像像素色彩值的例程—的对象来描述。复杂的模型可以通过将更简单的对象组合起来得到，可以采用面向对象编程的范式。直接绘制
创建一个复杂图像的一个简易办法是从一块空白画布开始—填满单一背景色的光栅图（像素数组—也称为位图）—然后通过正确的次序“画”，“漆”或者“贴”上简单的色块。特别的有，画布可以是计算机显示器的帧缓存。
target_text: In object-oriented graphics, images are described by an object with a self-programming method — a routine in which the image's pixel colour value is given by any algorithm. Complex models can be obtained by combining simpler objects, using a paradigm of object-oriented programming. A simple way to create a complex image is to draw directly from a blank canvas — filled with a single background-coloured raster (also known as a pixel array) — and then, in the right order, “paints”, “paints” or “paints” on a simple section. Specially, a canvas can be a frame cache of a computer monitor.
title: 二维计算机图形

source_text:
层次
二维计算机图形采用的模型经常不提供三维形状，也不提供光照、阴影、反射、折射、等等这样的三维光学效果。但是，它们通常会有多个层次的模型（概念上就是墨水、纸、或者胶片组成的层次；可以是不透明、透明、或者半透明—并且以特定次序叠加。该次序通常用单个数字定义（该层次的深度，或者说离观察者的距离）。
target_text: The two-dimensional computer graphics often use models that do not provide three-dimensional shapes and do not provide three-dimensional optical effects such as light, shadow, reflection, refraction, etc. However, they usually have multiple layers of models (conceptically, layers of ink, paper, or film composition; they can be opaque, transparent, or semi-transparent - and folded in a given order. The order is usually defined by a single number (the depth of the layer, or distance from the observer).
title: 二维计算机图形

source_text: 分层模型有时称为2 1/2维计算机图形。它们使得模拟传统的基于胶片和纸的草图和印刷技术成为可能；并使得用户能够不对其它层次产生任何影响地编辑任意一层。因此，它们在多数图形编辑器中得到采用。分层模型使得复杂图像的反走样变得更好，并且为诸如榫接和奇偶规则的特殊技术提供了一个正确的模型。
target_text: Tier models are sometimes referred to as 2 1/2-dimensional computer graphics. They make it possible to simulate traditional film- and paper-based sketching and printing techniques; and allow users to edit any layer without any influence on other levels. They are therefore used in most graphic editors. Tier models make the reverse look of complex images better and provide a correct model for special techniques such as swirling and wonder-guy rules.
title: 二维计算机图形

source_text:
二维图形硬件
现代计算机图形卡几乎全部采用光栅技术显示，把整个屏幕分成像素的矩形点阵，这是因为基于光栅的图形硬件和矢量图形硬件相比要低价。多数图形硬件对于位图传送操作和精灵绘制有内部支持。专门用于位图传送的协处理器称为传送器芯片。
target_text: Two-dimensional graphic hardware Modern computer graphics cards are almost entirely displayed using rectangular arrays that divide the entire screen into pixels, because they are less expensive than grid-based graphic hardware and vector graphic hardware. Most graphic hardware has in-house support for bitmap transfer operations and elves mapping. The co-processor that specializes in bitmap transfer is called the transporter chip.
title: 二维计算机图形

source_text:
二维图形软件
很多图形用户界面（GUI），包括Mac OS，微软视窗，或者X视窗系统，主要基于二维图形概念。这些软件提供了和计算机交互的视觉环境，并且常常包括某种形式的视窗管理器来帮助用户从概念上区分不同的应用程序。
单个软件应用程序的典型用户界面也是本质上二维的，部分因为最普通的输入设备（例如鼠标）被限制于做二维的运动。
target_text: Many graphical user interfaces (GUIs), including Mac OS, Microsoft Windows, or X Windows, are based mainly on two-dimensional graphic concepts. They provide visual environments that interact with computers and often include some form of window manager to help users distinguish between different applications conceptually. The typical user interfaces for individual software applications are also essentially two-dimensional, partly because the most common input devices (e.g. mouse) are limited to two-dimensional exercises.
title: 二维计算机图形

source_text: 二维图形编辑器或者说绘图程序是应用程序级的软件，用于图像、流程图、插图等的创建，它采用二维图形体素的直接操纵实现（通过鼠标，绘图版，或者类似的设备）。这些编辑器一般提供二维几何体素以及数字图象；有些甚至支持程序化模型。插图通常内部表示为分层模型，经常会有一个等级结构以方便编辑。这些编辑器通常输出图形文件，其中层和体素分别以其原始形式保存。MacDraw，是于1984年在麥金塔系列计算机上创建的，它是这类程序的一个早期的例子；现代的例子有商用产品Adobe IllustratorAdobe Animate 和CorelDraw，以及免费编辑器xfig。也有很多二维图形编辑器专用于特定的制图，例如电气、电子和大规模集成电路线路图、地形图、计算机字体、等等。
target_text: The two-dimensional graphic editor, or drawing program, is an application-level software for the creation of images, flow charts, illustrations, etc., using direct manipulation of the two-dimensional graphics (by mouse, drawing version, or similar devices). These editors generally provide two-dimensional geometry and digital images; some even support program models. The illustrations are usually internalized as stratification models, often with a hierarchical structure to facilitate editing. These editors usually produce graphic files, which are stored in their original form separately. MacDraw, created in 1984 on the MacDraw series of computers, is an early example of such programs; modern examples include commercial products Adobe Illustrator Adobe Animate and CorelDraw, and free editor xfig.
title: 二维计算机图形

source_text: 图像编辑器是专用于数字图像的操作的，主要通过自由手绘和信号处理操作。他们主要采用直接绘制的范型，其中用户控制虚拟笔、刷、以及其他自由手动艺术设备来将色彩绘于虚拟画布上。有些图像编辑器支持多层模型；但是，为了支持象模糊这样的信号处理操作，每个层通常表示为一个数字图像。所以，任何编辑器提供的几何体素直接被转换成像素并描到画布上。光栅图形编辑器这个名称有时被用来强调该方法和一般也能处理矢量图形的编辑器的不同。最早的流行的图形编辑器有苹果公司的MacPaint，MacDraw的伴侣软件。现代的例子有免费的GIMP编辑器，商用产品Photoshop和Paint Shop Pro。这类软件也包括很多专门化的编辑器—用于医药、遥感、数字摄影、等等。
target_text: Image editors are used exclusively for digital image operations, mainly through free hand painting and signal processing. They use the example of direct drawing, in which users control virtual pens, brushes, and other free hand art devices to paint colours on virtual canvass. Some image editors support multilayer models; however, each layer is usually described as a digital image to support signal processing operations such as blurry. So, the geometry provided by any editor is directly converted into pixels and painted on canvasses. The name of the raster graphic editor is sometimes used to emphasize the difference between the method and the editor who generally handles vector graphics. The earliest graphic editor is MacPaint, MacDraw's partner software.
title: 二维计算机图形

source_text: 在计算机技术的历史中，-{zh-hans:宏;zh-hk:巨集;zh-tw:巨集;}-病毒（）是一种使得应用软件的相关应用文档内含有被称为-{zh-hans:宏;zh-hk:巨集;zh-tw:巨集;}-的可执行代码的病毒。一个電子表格程式可能允许用户在一个文档中嵌入“-{zh-hans:宏;zh-hk:巨集;zh-tw:巨集;}-命令”，使得某种操作得以自动运行；同样的操作也就可以将病毒嵌入电子表格来对用户的使用造成破坏。
target_text: In the history of computer technology, {zh-hans: macros; zh-hk: macros; zh-tw: macros;}-virus(s) is a virus that allows the application document to contain what is called {zh-hans: macros; zh-hk: macros; zh-hk: macros; zh-tw: macros;}-executable code viruses. An electron table program may allow users to embed in a document '-{zh-hans: macros; zh-hk: macros; zh-tw: macros;}-commands that allow an operation to operate automatically; the same operation can also cause damage to the user ' s use by embedding the virus into a spreadsheet.
title: 宏病毒

source_text: 有些计算机程序设计员和系统管理员，特别是那些为Linux编写软件的，对微软公司大加批评，他们认为是微软公司造成了-{zh-hans:宏;zh-hk:巨集;zh-tw:巨集;}-病毒隐秘的进行大肆传播而没有受到任何阻碍的局面。而与之形成对比的是OpenOffice，它所使用的-{zh-hans:宏;zh-hk:巨集;zh-tw:巨集;}-语言中被慎重的去掉了某些-{zh-hans:宏;zh-hk:巨集;zh-tw:巨集;}-功能（例如：自动执行功能）， 这样的话就能避免-{zh-hans:宏;zh-hk:巨集;zh-tw:巨集;}-造成的一些问题。微软公司这些年来也在通过不断增加对-{zh-hans:宏;zh-hk:巨集;zh-tw:巨集;}-病毒传播的难度来加强其程序的安全特性，但是这些被严格约束而去除的-{zh-hans:宏;zh-hk:巨集;zh-tw:巨集;}-功能确实让用户觉得十分有用，而这些用户也因此又开启了这些功能，这使得用户承受了被电脑病毒破坏电脑系统的风险。
target_text: Some computer programmers and system administrators, particularly those who have written software for Linux, have been critical of Microsoft, which they believe has caused - {zh-hans: macros; h-hk: macros; zh-tw: macros;}-viruses are spreading unobstructed without any hindrance. {zh-hans: macros; zh-h-k: macros: macros: zh-hk: macros; zh-tw: solid collections;}-languages have been carefully removed — {zh-hans: macros; h-tw: macros: macros;}-functionality (e.g. auto-execution functions), thus avoiding {zh-hans: macros: macros; zh-hk:h-s:h-s:h-systems: h-systems; this has also been used by the Microsoft company for years.
title: 宏病毒

source_text: 绝大多数的-{zh-hans:宏;zh-hk:巨集;zh-tw:巨集;}-病毒都是根据微软公司系列软件所特有的-{zh-hans:宏;zh-hk:巨集;zh-tw:巨集;}-功能所编写，这一方面是因为其他应用软件对编写-{zh-hans:宏;zh-hk:巨集;zh-tw:巨集;}-病毒来说十分困难，另一方面也是因为微软公司系列软件得到了最广泛的使用，以致于它们成为了这些电脑病毒的首要目标。
target_text: The vast majority of {zh-hans: macros; zh-hk: macros; zh-tw: macros;}-viruses are unique to Microsoft software series - {zh-hans: macros; zh-hk: macros; zh-tw: macros;}-functionally written because other applications are designed to produce {zh-hans: macros; zh-h-hk: macros; zh-tw: megas;}-viruses are very difficult, on the one hand, and because Microsoft software series are the most widely used so that they become the primary targets of these computer viruses, on the other hand.
title: 宏病毒

source_text: 自由门（）是主要成员为法轮功学员的全球網絡自由聯盟及动态互联网技术公司（Dynamic Internet Technology, Inc.）联合開發的一种破网软件，一般用来突破中華人民共和國政府建立的防火长城以浏览被当局屏蔽的网站或收发邮件。除了中国大陆，在伊朗、叙利亚、阿联酋等含有互联网审查的国家中也有很多用户使用该软件访问被其政府屏蔽的网站。
target_text: Freedom Gate () is a web-breaking software jointly developed by Dynamic Internet Technology, Inc., a leading member of Falun Gong practitioners, commonly used to break through the Fire Safety Wall established by the People’s Republic of China to view blocked websites or receive and send mail. In addition to mainland China, many users in countries with Internet censorship, such as Iran, Syria, and the United Arab Emirates, also use the software to access sites blocked by their governments.
title: 自由门

source_text:
成立
2001年，美国非盈利组织全球网络自由联盟成立，动态网即是此聯盟于2002年3月创建，主要成员为法轮功学员，创立的初衷为突破中華人民共和國政府对法轮功信息的封锁，該聯盟主要从事突破网络封锁软件的开发，主要软件有自由门、逍遥游、动网通等多款。
target_text: In 2001, the Global Network Freedom Alliance of the non-profit organization of the United States was founded as a dynamic network, founded in March 2002 with the main membership of Falun Gong practitioners, to break through the embargo on Falun Gong information imposed by the Central Chinese People ' s Republic. The Alliance is mainly engaged in the development of software to break through the Internet embargo. The main software consists of free access, free travel, mobile access, etc.
title: 自由门

source_text:
恶意软件报告
2004年，《金融時報》引述赛门铁克在中国大陸的员工的报告，指出諾頓防毒会将自由门视为特洛伊木马软件。有人担心这可能是中国政府鼓励从计算机中删除特定软件的伎俩。赛门铁克解释说，这是因为自由门有与木马有类似的行为，即使用代理穿透防火墙。之后赛门铁克修改了木马的检测方法以排除自由门。
target_text: In 2004, the Financial Times quoted Simon Tek’s employees on China’s mainland, stating that Norton’s drug control would treat free doors as Trojan horse software. There are fears that this could be a Chinese government tactic to encourage the removal of specific software from computers.
title: 自由门

source_text: 有报道指出，2013年叙利亚的亲政府人员向反叛分子发送消息，鼓励他们下载一个名为“Freegate”的文件，并称该文件旨在帮助持不同政见者规避国家监管机构。但实际上它是一个恶意软件，使得入侵者能够监控受害者在他们的计算机上输入的内容，读取或删除受害者的文件。
target_text: It has been reported that in 2013 pro-government elements in Syria sent information to the rebels encouraging them to download a document called Freegate, claiming that the document was intended to help dissidents circumvent national regulatory bodies. But it is in fact a malicious software that allows invaders to monitor what victims enter on their computers and to read or delete their victims’ documents.
title: 自由门

source_text: Stunnel是一个自由的跨平台软件，用于提供全局的TLS/SSL服务。针对本身无法进行TLS或SSL通信的客户端及服务器，Stunnel可提供加密安全连接。该软件可在许多操作系统下运行，包括类Unix系统，以及Windows。Stunnel依赖于某个独立的库，如OpenSSL或者SSLeay，以实现TLS或SSL协议。Stunnel使用基于X.509数字证书的公开密钥加密算法来保证SSL的安全连接。客户端也可以选用自签名的数字证书来得到授权。
target_text: Stunnel is a free, cross-platform software that provides a global TLS/SSL service. Stunnel provides secure encrypted connections to clients and servers that are unable to communicate TLS or SSL on their own. The software can be operated under many operating systems, including Unix-type systems, and Windows. Stunnel relies on an independent library, such as OpenSSL or SSLeay, to achieve the TLS or SSL protocol. Stunnel uses a public key encryption algorithm based on X.509 digital certificates to secure SSL connections.
title: Stunnel

source_text:
为了提供对数据流的保密，需要对数据流进行加密和解密。关于这一点，安全实时传输协议（结合安全实时传输控制协议）只为一种加密算法，即制定了使用标准。这种加密算法有两种加密模式，它们能将原始的块密文转换成流密文：
分段整型计数器模式——一种典型的计数器模式，它允许对任意块的随机访问——这一点对于实时传输协议的数据流在可能丢包的不可靠网络上进行传输是非常必要的。一般情况下，几乎所有的函數都能被作为计数器使用，只要它在一次循环中重复的次数不要太多就可以。但是，用于实时传输协议数据加密的仅仅是一个普通的整型递增计数器。运行在这一模式下的是其默认的加密算法，它使用的是默认128位长度的加密密钥和默认112位长度的会话盐密钥。
f8模式——输出反馈模式的一个变种，它增加了定位功能并改变了初始化功能。其加密密钥和盐密钥的默认值和计数器模式下的AES是一样的。运行在这种模式下的被用于移动网络。
target_text: In order to provide confidentiality of data streams, encryption and decryption of data streams are required. On this point, a secure real-time transmission protocol (combined with a secure real-time transmission control protocol) has been developed for only one encryption algorithm, i.e., the standard for use. There are two encryption models for this encryption system, which converts the original encoded text into a streaming code: a partial integer mode, which allows random access to any random block, which is necessary for the transmission of data streams on unreliable networks that may be lost in real-time transmission protocols. In general, almost all functions are used as counters, as long as they are not repeated too often in a loop. However, only one normal integer increment for real-time transmission of data from protocols is used to encrypt.
title: 安全实时传输协议

source_text: 除了AES加密算法，安全实时传输协议还允许彻底禁用加密，此时使用的是所谓的“零加密算法”。它可以被认为是安全实时传输协议支持的第二种加密算法，或者说是它所支持的第三种加密模式。事实上，零加密算法并不进行任何加密，也就是说，加密算法把密钥流想像成只包含“0”的流，并原封不动地将输入流复制到输出流。这种模式是所有与安全实时传输协议兼容的系统都必须实现的，因为它可以被用在不需要安全实时传输协议提供保密性保证而只要求它提供其它特性（如认证和消息完整性）的场合。
target_text: In addition to the AES encryption algorithm, a secure real-time transmission protocol allows for the complete exclusion of encryption, which is then used as the so-called “zero encryption algorithm”. It can be considered to be the second encryption algorithm supported by a secure real-time transmission protocol, or the third encryption mode it supports. In fact, the zero encryption algorithm does not provide any encryption, that is, the encryption algorithm imagines the key stream as containing only a “0” stream, and reproduces the input stream to the output stream intact. This mode is essential for all systems compatible with a secure real-time transmission protocol, as it can be used in situations where it provides security assurances of confidentiality that do not require a secure real-time transmission protocol, but only requires it to provide other characteristics (e.g. authentication and message integrity).
title: 安全实时传输协议

source_text: 尽管从技术上来说安全实时传输协议能轻松地纳入新的加密算法，但安全实时传输协议标准指出除上述加密算法以外的新的加密算法不一定能被简单地添加到一些安全实时传输协议的具体实现中去。添加一种新的加密算法并确保它与安全实时传输协议标准相兼容的唯一有效方式是发布一个明确定义该算法的新的伴生的标准跟踪。
target_text: While a safe real-time transmission protocol can be technically easily integrated into a new encryption algorithm, the SRT standard suggests that a new encryption algorithm other than the above-mentioned encryption algorithm may not be simply added to the actual realization of some SRT protocols. The only effective way to add a new encryption algorithm and ensure its compatibility with the SRT standard is to issue a new companion standard tracking that clearly defines the algorithm.
title: 安全实时传输协议

source_text: 为了进行消息认证并保护消息的完整性，安全实时传输协议使用了算法（在中定义）。这种算法使用的是默认160位长度的认证密钥。但是它不能抵御重放攻击；重放保护方法建议接收方维护好先前接收到的消息的索引，将它们与每个新接收到的消息进行比对，并只接收那些过去没有被播放过的新消息。这种方法十分依赖于完整性保护的使用（以杜绝针对消息索引的欺骗技术）。
target_text: In order to authenticate the message and protect its integrity, the safe real-time transmission protocol uses algorithms (defined in this context). This algorithm uses the authentication key of the default 160-digit length. But it is not resistant to replaying the attack. Replaying the protective method recommends that the recipient maintain an index of previously received messages, matching them with each new message received, and only receives new information that has not been broadcast in the past.
title: 安全实时传输协议

source_text: EDI是组织间结构化的数据方式。被用来传输电子文档或者商业数据从一个计算机系统到另外的计算机系统。比如从一个商业伙伴到另外一个商业伙伴无人工的参与。它是高于Email.举个实例，某组织系统用适合的EDI message代替提单或者支票。这可以参考标准的数据族。
target_text: EDI is an inter-organizational structured data mode. It is used to transmit electronic files or commercial data from one computer system to another. For example, there is no manual involvement from one business partner to another. It is higher than Email.
title: 电子数据交换

source_text: 网站镜像（mirror sites, mirrors；鏡像站點，鏡像網站）是指对网站内容的拷贝，这类网站通常具有与原站不同的URL，但托管了相同或者是几乎相同的内容。镜像原意是光学里指的物体在镜面中所成之像。-{引申}-到计算机网络上，镜像通常用于为相同信息内容提供不同的源，特别是在下载量大的时候提供了一种可靠的网络连接。制作镜像是一种文件同步的过程，可以以多种网络协议（network protocol）进行传输（如HTTP、FTP等）
target_text: Web mirrors (mirror scenes, mirrors; mirror sites, mirror sites) refer to a copy of the content of the site, which usually has the same or almost the same URL as the original site, but which hosts the same or almost the same content. Mirrors are intended to be images of objects that are optically indicated in the mirror. - {Quoted} - On a computer network, mirrors are usually used to provide different sources of the same information content, especially when downloads are large, providing a reliable network connection.
title: 网站镜像

source_text: Soundex是一种语音算法，利用英文字的读音计算近似值，值由四个字符构成，第一个字符为英文字母，后三个为数字。在拼音文字中有时会有会念但不能拼出正确字的情形，可用Soundex做类似模糊匹配的效果。例如Knuth和Kant二个字符串，它们的Soundex值都是「K530」。其在计算机科学家高德納名著《計算機程序設計藝術》都有詳細的介紹。
target_text: Soundex is a voice algorithm that calculates approximate values using the pronunciation of English words, which consists of four characters, the first character being English letters, and the last three characters being numbers. There are sometimes cases in spelling that can read but cannot spell the correct words, soundex can be used to make similar vague matches. For example, Knuth and Kant have two strings, all of which are "K530" values.
title: Soundex

source_text:
比对方法
对于很短或非常相似的序列，我们可以人工进行比对。然而，在很多问题中，我们需要对非常长的序列进行比对，这是单靠人类的努力所不能解决的。在这种情况下，我们通过构造算法来进行高效的序列比对，有时还需要对最终结果进行调整，因为有些结果难以通过算法表达出来（特别是核苷酸序列）。序列比对的计算方法一般分为两类：全局性比对（global alignments）和局部比对（local alignments）。计算一个全局性的路线，是一个全局优化的形式，其强制按照整个长度的所有查询序列对齐。与此相反，局部比对只确定局部的相似而整个长序列却往往大相径庭。局部比对往往是可取的，但可能更难以计算的，因为还有来自确定其他相似区域的挑战。各种计算算法已应用于序列比对的问题，包括缓慢，但正规的像动态规划的优化方法和高效率，但不彻底的启发式算法，或大型数据库搜索设计的概率方法。
target_text: However, in many cases, we need to compare a very long sequence, which cannot be solved by human effort alone. In this case, we use construction algorithms to make an efficient sequence matching, sometimes requiring adjustments to the final result, because some results are difficult to express by algorithms (especially nucleic acid sequences). The method of calculating sequence comparisons is generally divided into two types: global comparisons and local comparisons. The calculation of a whole sequence is an optimal form that is forced to match all query sequences of the entire length. On the contrary, local comparisons are often more likely to be desirable than the determination of local similarities, but they may be more difficult to calculate, because there are also challenges from determining other similar regions. Various calculations have been applied to sequence comparisons, including slow, but formal, dynamic planning methods of optimization and efficiency.
title: 序列比對

source_text: 多序列比对是成对比对的延伸，是为了在一次比对里面处理多于两条的序列。多序列比对方法试图比对一个指定序列集合里面的所有序列，这可以帮助确定这些序列的共同区段。进行多序列比对有几种方法，最常用的一种是Clustal程序集，它使用渐进多序列比对算法。Clustal在cladistics中被用来建立进化树，在PSI-BLAST和Hidden Markov model- (HMM-)中用来建立序列档案以在序列数据库中搜索更远的同源序列。
target_text: Multisequencing is an extension of a comparison to treat more than two sequences in a single match. Multisequencing attempts are made to compare all sequences in a specified sequence collection, which helps to determine the common segments of these sequences. Multisequencing is the most common method, with the Clustal application, which uses progressive multisequencing algorithms. Clustal is used to create evolutionary trees, and in PSI-BLAST and Hidden Markov Model-(HMM-) to create sequence files to search for more distant homogenous sequences in sequence databases.
title: 序列比對

source_text: eDonkey網路（，也称eDonkey2000 Network、eD2k、eD2k網路或電驢網路），是一种分布式的、主要基于服务器的P2P檔案分享网络。它通常用于共享电影视频文件、音乐专辑和计算机程序软件等。和大多数文件共享网络一样，它是分布式的，文件不存储在任何中枢服务器之上，服务器参与用户之间基于點對點原理相互数据交换。
target_text: The eDonkey network (also known as eDonkey2000Network, eD2k, eD2k, or eD2k, or donkey), is a distributed, server-based P2P file-sharing network. It is usually used to share film video files, music albums and computer program software. Like most file-sharing networks, it is distributed, documents are not stored on any central server, and servers are involved in data exchange between users based on point-to-point principles.
title: EDonkey网络

source_text:
NURBS是非均匀有理B样条曲线（non-uniform rational B-spline）的缩写，NURBS由Versprille在其博士学位论文中提出，1991年，国际标准化组织（ISO）颁布的工业产品数据交换标准STEP中，把NURBS作为定义工业产品几何形状的唯一数学方法。1992年，国际标准化组织又将NURBS纳入到规定独立于设备的交互图形编程接口的国际标准PHIGS（程序员层次交互图形系统）中，作为PHIGS Plus的扩充部分。Bezier、有理Bezier、均匀B样条和非均匀B样条都被统一到NURBS中。
非均匀有理样条（，NURBS），是在计算机图形学中常用的数学模型，用于产生和表示曲线及曲面。它为处理解析函数和模型形状提供了极大的灵活性和精确性。NURBS通常在计算机辅助设计（CAD），制造 （CAM），及工程 （CAE） 中有广泛应用。是众多行业宽泛标准中的一部分，如IGES, STEP, ACIS和PHIGS。同时在很多不同的3D建模和动画软件中也能找到NURBS的工具集。
通过计算机程序，他们可以很有效率的被处理，还允许进行简单的人机交互。NURBS 曲面是映射到三维的空间中的曲面的两个参数的函数。由控制点确定曲面的形状。NURBS 曲面可以用紧凑的形式表示简单的几何形状。T-样条和细分曲面更适合于复杂的有机形状，因为和 NURBS 曲面相比，它们减少了控制点数目。
一般情况下，编辑 NURBS 曲线和曲面有高度直观性和可预测性。控制点要么和曲线或曲面直接相连，要么表现的如同他们通过一根橡皮筋而相连。根据用户界面的类型，可以通过元素的控制点实现编辑，最明显常见的例子是贝塞尔曲线。
target_text: NURBS is the only mathematical method for defining the geometry of industrial products. In 1992, the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) incorporated NUBBS into the international standard PHIGS (programmer-level interactive B-spline), presented by Versprille in his doctoral dissertation; in 1991, the industrial product data exchange standard STEP, promulgated by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), used as the only mathematical method for defining the geometry of industrial products.
title: 非均匀有理B样条

source_text: 该发展的先驱包括：皮埃尔·贝塞尔（Pierre Bézier）和两个法国人， 前者曾是雷诺的工程师，后者在雪铁龙工作。贝塞尔基本是和德·卡斯特里奥独立发展的，两人互相不知道对方的工作。但是因为贝塞尔发表了他的工作的结果，今天的一般的计算机图形学用户认为样条 -- 通过在曲线上的控制点表示的那类 - 为贝塞尔样条，而德·卡斯特里奥的名字仅作为他为计算参数化曲面所设计的算法而为人所知。在1960年代，人们认识到非均匀有理B样条是贝塞尔曲线的一个推广，而贝塞尔曲线可以视为均匀有理B样条。
target_text: Among the pioneers of this development were Pierre Bézier, a former engineer of Renault, and two Frenchmen who worked in the Snow Dragons. Bézier was largely independent with De Castrío, who did not know each other’s work. But because Bethel had published the results of his work, today’s average computer graphic users thought the sample – the type expressed by the point of control on the curve – was a Bézier sample, while the name of De Castrío was known only as the algorithm he had designed to calculate the curve of parameters. In the 1960’s, it was recognized that the diversity B was an extension of the Bézier curve, which could be considered to be a balanced B formula.
title: 非均匀有理B样条

target_text: Initially, NURBS was used only for private computer-assisted design packages for automobile companies. In 1993, CAS Berlin (a small start-up company working with Berlin Industries) developed the first interactive NURBS modeler on personal machines, called NöRBS. source_text: WARP就是，将通过互联网公开的学术杂志、政府机关网页等内容，经其管理者许可后保存于国立国会图书馆的储存设备，并通过互联网对外公开的系统。与不能改变内容的CD-ROM不同，WARP是一种将可被管理者自由改写的网络电子信息与纸质媒体一样收集、整理、保存、公开的尝试。
target_text: WARP is an attempt to collect, organize, preserve, and make public online electronic information that can be freely rewritten by the administrator, like paper-based media, unlike CD-ROMs, which cannot change the content.

source_text: 作为今后的发展方向，国立国会图书馆在考虑对互联网上的电子信息也进行网罗收集和保存。作为对呈缴本制度的审议机构，呈缴本制度审议会于2004年召开的“有关网络电子出版物的收集的问答会”上，提出对互联网信息的收集、保存和提供实行制度化。国立国会图书馆也根据这个建议，开始探讨根据一定的频率自动非选择性地收集来源于日本国内的网页内容的做法，并明确了应首先选择具有公共性质的go.jp、ac.jp、ed.jp等域名的网页。这一连串的变革，随着自由民主党e-Japan重点计划特别委员会提出的《实现世界最先进的IT国家的议案》（2004年）而开始备受关注。但是此后，随着该议案的主要倡导者众议员野田圣子和众议员山口俊一退出自民党（而後歸黨），加上有观点认为图书馆实施的资料收集活动，可能助长傳播兒童色情、猥褻物、侵犯隱私權的資訊等不法行为，因此目前仍被认为难以实现。
target_text: On the basis of this proposal, the Library of the National Congress has begun to explore the automatic and non-selective collection of web content originating in Japan on a certain frequency basis, and has made it clear that the selection of web pages with public names such as go.jp., ac.jp., ed.jp., etc. should first be made available. This chain of changes, which began to receive attention in 2004 at the “Q & A session on the collection of electronic publications on the Web.”

target_text: The main features of the feature and high performance 7z format are: open-source and modular component structures (which allow any compression, conversion or encryption algorithms to be used), high compression ratios (which have different results using different compression algorithms), encryption using AES-256 to support super-large files (maximum support to 16EB) Unicode file names, support, allow internal files to compress in a stream, enabling similar content to be effectively compressed.

source_text:
加密
7z格式支持256位键钥AES算法加密。键钥则由用户提供的口令（密码短语）进行SHA-256hash算法得到。SHA-256执行218 (262144)次（这种技术称为密钥延伸），使得对口令的暴力解码更加困难。当前基于GPU的或是自制硬件限制了这种密钥延伸的有效性，所以选择一个强口令仍然很重要。7z格式提供了选项可以加密文件名。
target_text: Encryption 7z supports 256-bit AES algorithm encryption. Keys are obtained by password (password phrase) for SHA-256hash. SHA-256 executes 218 (262144) times (known as key extensions), making violent password decoding more difficult. Currently GPU-based or home-made hardware limits the validity of such key extensions, selecting a strong password remains important. The 7z format provides options to encrypt file names.
title: 7z

source_text: 鴿巢原理經常在計算機領域得到真正的應用。比如：哈希表的重複問題（衝突）是不可避免的，因為Keys的數目總是比Indices的數目多，不管是多麼高明的算法都不可能解決這個問題。這個原理，還證明任何無損壓縮算法，在把一些輸入變小的同時，作為代價一定有其他的輸入增大，否則對於長度為L的輸入集合，該壓縮算法總能將其映射到一個更小的長度小於L的輸出集合，而這與鴿巢理論相悖。
target_text: The dove principle is often used for real applications in the computer domain. For example: Hashi's repeated problems (conflicts) are inevitable, because Keys always have more numbers than Indices, and no amount of smart algorithms can solve the problem. This principle also proves that any non-destructive compression method, at the same time that some inputs are smaller, must have additional inputs as a price, or that, for L-lengths, the compression method can always project it to a smaller group of L-sizes, which is contrary to the dove theory.
title: 鴿巢原理

source_text:
互联网研究专门工作组（Internet Research Task Force）是一个由互联网架构委员会（IAB）授权对一些长期的互联网问题进行理论研究的组织。同IETF一样，IRTF有很多研究小组，分别针对不同的研究题目进行讨论和研究。目标
通过建立许多集中的，长期的小型研究小组来促进对未来互联网发展的重要研究。这些研究方向包括互联网协议，应用，架构和技术等相关领域。
target_text: The Internet Research Task Force (Internet Research Force) is an organization mandated by the Internet Architecture Commission (IAB) to conduct theoretical research on a number of long-term Internet issues. Like IETF, IRTF has a large number of research groups that discuss and study different research topics. The objective is to promote important research on future Internet development through the establishment of many centralized, long-term small research groups.
title: 互联网研究专门工作组

source_text:
背景
互联网研究专门工作组的研究小组对互联网协议，应用，架构和技术等相关领域进行研究。研究小组需要有稳定长期（相对于小组的生命期而言）的成员关系以促进研究方向上的合作与协作。参与的形式为个人方式，而不是以组织的形式。IRTF由IRTF主席与因特网研究指导组（IRSG）协商管理。IRSG成员包括IRTF主席，各研究小组的主席和一些其他的可能的来自研究团体的个人（占大多数）。
target_text: The research team of the Task Force on Internet Research conducts research in areas related to Internet protocol, applications, architecture, and technology. The research team needs to stabilize its membership over the long term (as opposed to the lifetime of the Group) to facilitate cooperation and collaboration in the direction of research. Participation takes the form of an individual approach, not an organizational one. IRTF is managed by the IRTF President in consultation with the Internet Research Steering Group (IRSG).
title: 互联网研究专门工作组

source_text: IRTF主席由互联网架构委员会（IAB）指定，研究小组的主席们是各小组的一部分，IRSG其余占大多数的成员由IRTF主席与其他IRSG成员协商选择，并由IAB批准通过。除了管理各研究小组外，IRSG还不时地组织专题研究组关注对互联网发展有重大意义的研究领域，更多的是一些普通小组，如：根据对互联网的观察讨论研究的优先权。
target_text: The IRTF Chair is appointed by the IRTF Committee on Internet Architecture (IAB), and the chairs of the research groups are part of the groups. The remaining majority of IRSG members are selected by the IRSF Chair in consultation with other IRSF members and approved by IAB. In addition to managing the research groups, IRTF has from time to time organized thematic research groups focusing on areas of importance to Internet development, and more generally on ordinary groups, such as the priority of research based on observational discussion of the Internet.
title: 互联网研究专门工作组

历史
Xenix是微软为微型计算机推出的Unix版本。由于微软购买的授权无法直接让该操作系统以“UNIX”为名，便將之命名为Xenix。微软在1979年从美国电话电报公司购买了Unix授权，并于1980年8月25日发布面向16位系统的版本，由SCO公司将该系统移植至英特尔8086/8088架构。自第七版后，Xenix合作使用了BSD的技术，再加上当时x86处理器的价格低廉，很快便成为当时最受欢迎的Unix发行版。
target_text: History Xenix is the Unix version of Microsoft's microcomputer. Since Microsoft's purchase authorization did not allow the operating system to be named “UNIX” directly, it was named Xenix.
title: Xenix

source_text: 当微软和IBM达成开发OS/2操作系统的协议后，便失去了推广Xenix的兴趣。1987年，微软与SCO达成了一项协议，前者以持有后者股票25%的条件转让了Xenix的所有权。在失去对OS/2的兴趣后，微软最终转向Windows NT。但在微软内部依旧在使用Xenix，其1987年为支持新功能的补丁扩散到了Xenix及SCO UNIX。据说截止至1992年，微软还在使用基于Xenix的Sun的工作站及VAX微型计算机。
target_text: When Microsoft and IBM entered into an agreement to develop the OS/2 operating system, they lost interest in promoting Xenix. In 1987, Microsoft and SCO entered into an agreement to transfer ownership of Xenix on the condition of holding 25% of the latter’s shares. After losing interest in OS/2, Microsoft eventually turned to Windows NT. But Xenix was still being used inside Microsoft, and in 1987 its patches in support of the new functionality spread to Xenix and SCO UNIX. As of 1992, Microsoft was said to be using Xenix-based Sun workstations and VAX microcomputers.
title: Xenix

source_text: X.25是在一个哑终端的时代发展起来的，需要连接到主计算机。取代直接连接到主计算机—这需要主计算机拥有自己的调制解调器和电话线，而且还需要没有本地通话来进行长距离呼叫请求—主机可以同网络服务器建立X.25连接。这样哑终端用户可以直接进行拨号连接到网络了。本质上来说，调制解调器和端口为一端，X.25连接在另一端，这是由ITU-T X.29和X.3标准定义的。
target_text: X.25 was developed in the age of a dumb terminal, which requires connectivity to the main computer. The replacement of a direct connection to the main computer – which requires the main computer to have its own modem and telephone line, as well as the absence of local calls for long-distance call requests – allows the mainframe to establish X.25 connections with the network server. This allows the dumb terminal user to dial up directly to the network. In essence, the modem and port are one end, and X.25 are connected to the other end, as defined by the standards ITU-T X.29 and X.3.
title: X.25

source_text:
快取文件置換方法有：
先進先出演算法（FIFO）：最先进入的内容作为替换对象
最少使用算法（LFU）：最久没有访问的内容作为替换对象
最近最少使用算法（LRU）：最近最少使用的内容作为替换对象
非最近使用算法（NMRU）：在最近没有使用的内容中随机选择一个作为替换对象
Belady's algorithm
target_text: Cache file replacement methods are: first-in-first-out algorithms (FIFO): first-in-first-to-substitution algorithms (LFUs): last-not-accessed content as replacement object (LRUs): last-minute minimum-use algorithms (LRUs): last-used least-used content as replacement object (NMRUs): random selection of an object as replacement in recently unused content (Belady's algorithm)
title: 快取文件置換機制

source_text: 安全外壳协议（Secure Shell Protocol，简称SSH）是一种加密的网络传输协议，可在不安全的网络中为网络服务提供安全的传输环境。SSH通过在网络中建立来实现SSH客户端与服务器之间的连接。SSH最常见的用途是远程登录系统，人们通常利用SSH来传输命令行界面和远程执行命令。SSH使用频率最高的场合是类Unix系统，但是Windows操作系统也能有限度地使用SSH。2015年，微软宣布将在未来的操作系统中提供原生SSH协议支持，Windows 10 1803版本已提供OpenSSH工具。
target_text: The safe shell protocol (Secure Shell Protocol, SSH) is an encrypted network transfer protocol that provides a secure transmission environment for network services in an unsafe network. SSH connects SSH clients to servers by creating it in the network. The most common use of SSH is remote login systems, where SSH is usually used to transmit command line interfaces and remote execution commands. The most frequent use of SSH is the type Unix system, but the Windows operating system has limited access to SSH. In 2015, Microsoft announced that it would provide raw SSH protocol support in a future operating system, and Windows version 10 1803 already provides OpenSSH tools.
title: Secure Shell

SSH客户端。从云计算的角度上讲，SSH能够阻止一些因直接暴露在互联网而产生的安全问题，在解决连接问题上发挥了重要作用。SSH隧道可以在互联网、防火墙和虚拟机之间提供一个安全的通道。
target_text: Most modern operating systems (including macos, most Linux, OpenBSD, FreeBSD, Solaris, etc.) provide SSH, including Windows (after Windows version 10 1809). At the software level, many proprietary, free software and open source software on SSH have been developed, such as document management software (syncing, copying, removing, etc.), e.g., WinSCP under PuTY and Windows, Konqueror under the Unix system. SSH client. From the perspective of cloud computing, SSH can play an important role in solving connectivity problems by preventing some security problems arising from direct exposure to the Internet.
title: Secure Shell

source_text:

需要逆向工程的原因如下：
接口设计：由于互操作性，逆向工程被用来找出系统之间的协作协议。
军事或商业机密：窃取敌人或竞争对手的最新研究或产品原型。
改善文档：当原有的文档有不充分处，又当系统被更新而原设计人员不在时，逆向工程被用来获取所需数据，以补充说明或了解系统的最新状态。
软件升级或更新：出于功能、合规、安全等需求更改，逆向工程被用来了解现有或遗留软件系统，以评估更新或移植系统所需的工作。
制造没有许可／未授权的副本。
学术／学习目的。
去除复制保护和伪装的登录权限。
文件丢失：采取逆向工程的情况往往是在某一个特殊设备的文件已经丢失了（或者根本就没有），同时又找不到工程的负责人。完整的系统时常需要基于陈旧的系统上进行再设计，这就意味着想要整合原有的功能进行项目的唯一方法便是采用逆向工程的方法分析已有的碎片进行再设计。
产品分析：用于调查产品的运作方式、部件构成、估计预算，以及识别潜在的侵权行为。
target_text: The reasons for the need for reverse engineering are as follows: Interface design: Reverse engineering is used to identify collaboration agreements between systems because of interoperability; Military or commercial secrets: steal latest research or product prototypes from enemies or competitors; Improved documentation: Reverse engineering is used to obtain the required data to supplement or understand the latest state of the system when the original document is inadequate and when the system is updated and the original designer is absent; Reverse engineering is used to identify the work required for updating or transplanting systems because of changes in functional, compliance, security, etc. Reverse engineering is used to understand existing or legacy software systems to assess the work required for updating or transplanting systems; Manufacturing has no authorized/unauthorised copies; Academic/Learning purposes. Removing access rights to duplicate protection and disguise.
title: 逆向工程

source_text:
机械设备
随着计算机辅助设计的流行，逆向工程变成了一种能根据现有的物理部件通过CAD、CAM、CAE或其他软件构筑3D虚拟模型的方法。逆向工程的过程採用了通过測量实际物体的尺寸并将其制作成3D模型的方法，真实的物件可以通过如CMMs、激光扫描仪、结构光源转换仪，或者X射线断层成像等这些3D扫描技术进行尺寸测量。这些测量数据通常被认作是點雲，缺乏拓扑信息并且同时通常会被制作成更有用格式例如多边形网格，NURBS曲线或者CAD模型。由于點雲本身并不像3D软件裡的模型那样直观，所以如同、Imageware、、或者杰魔公司等这些软件都提供了将點雲变成能可视图像，或者被其他应用软件如3D CAD、CAM、CAE识别的格式的功能。
target_text: With the prevalence of computer-assisted design, reverse engineering has become a way of constructing a 3D virtual model based on existing physical components through CAD, CAM, CAE, or other software. Reverse engineering has been done by measuring the size of the actual object and making it into a 3D model. Real objects can be measured by 3D scanning techniques, such as CCMs, laser scanners, structural light source converters, or X-ray fault imaging. These measurements are usually considered cloudy, lack of top-up information and are usually produced in more useful formats, such as polygonal grids, NURBS curves, or CAD models. Since the dotted cloud is not per se as a model in 3D software, these software, like Imageware, or Ceyrc, provide the function of turning the dotted cloud into a viewable image, or are identified by other applications, such as 3D CAD, CAM, CAE.
title: 逆向工程

source_text:
软件
由于「逆向工程」一词用在软件工程（简称「软工」）领域中的具体含义模糊不清，Chikofsky和Cross为此写了篇文章，以阐清及区分「逆向工程」与各种相近的概念。据文章所述，逆向工程是一种分析目标系统的过程，其目的是识别出系统的各个组件以及它们之间的关系，并以其它的形式或在较高的抽象层次上，重建系统的表征（Representations）。 软件逆向工程也可被视作「开发周期的逆行」。
在此定义下，对一项软件程序进行逆向工程，类似于逆行传统瀑布模型中的开发步骤，即把实现阶段的输出（即软件程序）还原回在设计阶段所做的构思。软件逆向工程仅仅是一种检测或分析的过程，它并不会更改目标系统（否则就成了软件再工程）。
target_text: As the term “reverse engineering” is used in the field of software engineering (referred to as “software”), Chikofsky and Cross have written an article to clarify and distinguish between “reverse engineering” and similar concepts. According to the article, reverse engineering is a process of analysing target systems, with the aim of identifying the components of the system and their relationship, and re-establishing the system’s representation in other forms or at a higher abstract level. Software reverse engineering can also be regarded as a “reverse to the development cycle.”
title: 逆向工程

source_text: 软件防篡改技术被用于遏制对专有软件进行逆向工程及再工程。大部分人都熟悉这个词的第二种用法。软件的逆向工程可以使用净室技术来避免侵犯版权。软工中的黑盒测试与逆向工程有很多共同点，但黑箱测试人员常供以API以作测试，并且测试的目的就是通过外部攻击，找出程序漏洞和未归档的特性。
target_text: Software tampering techniques are used to deter reverse engineering and re-engineering of proprietary software. Most people are familiar with the second use of the term. Reverse engineering of software can use net room technology to avoid copyright infringement.
title: 逆向工程

source_text:
二进制软件技术
软件逆向工程有多种实现方法，主要有三：
分析通过信息交换所得的观察。最常用于协议逆向工程，涉及使用和数据包嗅探器。在接入计算机总线或网络的连接，并成功截取通信数据后，可以对总线或网络行为进行分析，以制造出拥有相同行为的通信实现。此法特别适用于设备驱动程序的逆向工程。有时，由硬件制造商特意所做的工具，如JTAG端口或各种调试工具，也有助于嵌入式系统的逆向工程。对于微软的Windows系统，受欢迎的底层调试器有SoftICE。
反汇编，即藉用反汇编器，把程序的原始机器码，翻译成较便于阅读理解的汇编代码。这适用于任何的计算机程序，对不熟悉机器码的人特别有用。流行的相关工具有Interactive Disassembler。
反编译，即藉用反编译器，尝试从程序的机器码或字节码，重现高级语言形式的源代码。
target_text: There are a number of ways in which reverse software can be achieved. There are three main ways in which reverse software works can be performed. Analysis of observations obtained through exchange of information is most often used in reverse protocol engineering, involving the use and use of data pack sniffers. For Microsoft Windows, the popular bottom-tier is SoftICE. Countercompiling, by using a transcoder, the original machine code of the program can be translated into a more readable compilation code. This applies to any computer program that is particularly useful for people who are not familiar with machine codes.
title: 逆向工程

source_text:
集成电路和智能卡
分析智能卡的逆向工程具有侵入性和破坏性，智能卡被层层刮掉用电子显微镜拍照。这种技术可以完整地揭示出智能卡的硬件和软件部份。主要的问题就是，把所有的东西按正确的顺序放好以找出每一个部件是如何工作的。工程师们用打乱内存位置的方法隐藏密码和操作，例如busscrambling。有时甚至可以在智能卡运行的时候用探针直接测量电压，设计师则用感应器来检测和防止。破坏支付业务中使用的智能卡很困难，只有大芯片制造商使用那些专业的设备。况且，和其他安全机制例如阴影帐户相比，这种方法回报太低。
target_text: Integrated circuits and smart cards analyze the reverse engineering of smart cards that are intrusive and destructive, and smart cards that are scratched off with electronic microscopes. This technology provides a complete picture of the hardware and software components of smart cards. The main problem is to put everything in the right order to find out how each component works. Engineers hide passwords and operations by disrupting the location of their memory, such as bosscrambling.
title: 逆向工程

source_text: 为了互用性（例如，支持未公开的文件格式或硬件外围），而对软件或硬件系统进行的逆向工程被认为是合法的，虽然专利持有者经常反对并试图打压以任何目的对他们产品进行的逆向工程。为了获取一个有版权的计算机程序中隐含的思想和功能元素且有合法的理由要获取，当只有拆解这一种方法时，根据法律判定，拆解是对有版权作品的合理使用。
target_text: Reverse engineering of software or hardware systems is considered lawful for the purpose of interoperability (e.g. supporting undisclosed file formats or hardware peripherals), although patent holders often oppose and try to crush reverse engineering of their products for any purpose. source_text: OSPF协议是“开放式最短路径优先（Open Shortest Path First）”的缩写，属于链路状态路由协议。OSPF提出了“区域（area）”的概念，每个区域中所有路由器维护着一个相同的链路状态数据库（LSDB）。区域又分为骨干区域（骨干区域的编号必须为0）和非骨干区域（非0编号区域），如果一个运行OSPF的网络只存在单一区域，则该区域可以是骨干区域或者非骨干区域。如果该网络存在多个区域，那么必须存在骨干区域，并且所有非骨干区域必须和骨干区域直接相连。OSPF利用所维护的链路状态数据库，通过最短路径优先算法（SPF算法）计算得到路由表。OSPF的收敛速度较快。由于其特有的开放性以及良好的扩展性，目前OSPF协议在各种网络中广泛部署。
target_text: The OSPF agreement is an abbreviation of the Open Shortest Path Priority (Open Shortest Path First), which is a chain route route agreement. The OSPF proposes the concept of “regional (area)” in which all routers in each region maintain an identical chain state database (LSDB). The region is also divided into bone regions (the backbone area must be numbered 0) and non-column areas (non-0-number areas). If a network of operational OSPFs exists in a single region, the region can be either a backbone area or a non-column region. If the network exists in multiple areas, there must be a backbone area and all non-column backbone areas must be directly connected to the backbone area.
title: 路由协议

source_text:

在函数式编程中，函数是头等对象即头等函数，这意味着一个函数，既可以作为其它函数的输入参数值，也可以从函数中返回值，被修改或者被分配给一个变量。λ演算是这种范型最重要的基础，λ演算的函数可以接受函数作为输入參數和输出返回值。
target_text: In function programming, the function is a first-class object, or first-class function, which means that a function can either be used as an input parameter value for other functions, or a value can be returned from the function, modified or assigned to a variable. The function can be the most important basis for this paradigm, and the function can accept the function as input parameter and output return value.
title: 函数式编程

source_text:
歷史
阿隆佐·邱奇在1930年代开发的λ演算，是建造自的一种计算形式系统。在1937年，艾伦·图灵证明了λ演算和图灵机是等价的计算模型，展示了λ演算是图灵完备性的。λ演算形成了所有函数式编程语言的基础。另一种等价的理论公式化是组合子逻辑，它由和哈斯凯尔·柯里在1920年代和1930年代开发。
target_text: History, Alonzo Coch, developed in the 1930s, is a self-built system of computations. In 1937, Alan Turing demonstrated that the calculus and the Turing machine were the computational models of the same price, and showed that the prognosis was the basis of all the functional programming languages. The other theoretical equation was the combination sublogic, developed with Haskell Corey in the 1920s and 1930s.
title: 函数式编程

source_text: 于20世纪50年代后期，John McCarthy在麻省理工学院，开发了早期的函数式语言LISP，运行在大型IBM主机（）上。LISP的函数定义借鉴了邱奇的λ表示法，并扩展了标签构造来允许递归函数。最开始的LISP是多范型语言，并且随着新的范型的发展，越来越多的编程风格得到了支持。后来发展出来的方言比如Scheme、Clojure，和分支语言比如Dylan等，试图围绕一个清晰的函数式核心，来得出简化和理性化的LISP，而Common Lisp旨在保留并更新它所替代的各种更早先LISP方言的那些范型特征。
target_text: In the late 1950s, John McCarthy, at MIT, developed an early functional language LISP, running on a large IBM mainframe (). LISP ' s functional definition drew on Quiche ' s s symmetry and expanded the label structure to allow for relativity. The first LISP is a multi-model language, and as the new paradigm develops, more programming styles are supported. The later developed dialects such as Scheme, Clojure, and branch languages such as Dylan, try to focus around a clear core of functions to produce simplified and rational LISPs, while Common Lip aims to preserve and update the typical features of the earlier LISP dialects that it has replaced.
title: 函数式编程

source_text: 而于1956年发明的IPL语言，一般被认为是第一个基于计算机的函数式编程语言。 它是一种用于操纵符号列表的汇编式语言。它有一个生成器的概念，相当于一个接受函数作为参数的函数，并且，由于它是汇编级语言，代码可以是数据，因此IPL可以被视为具有高阶函数。但是，它在很大程度上依赖于改变列表的结构和类似的指令式编程特征。
target_text: The IPL language, which was invented in 1956, is generally considered to be the first computer-based functional programming language. It is a compilation language used to manipulate the symbols list. It has a generator concept, equivalent to a function that accepts a function as a parameter, and, since it is a compilation language, the code can be data, IPL can be regarded as having a high-level function. However, it relies to a large extent on changing the structure of the list and similar command programming features.
title: 函数式编程

source_text: 1977年John Backus在他的图灵奖颁奖演讲《编程可以从冯·诺依曼式风格中解放出来吗？一种函数式风格及其程序代数》中，展示了他提出的FP。他将函数式编程定义为通过“组合形式”以分层方式构建，允许“程序代数”; 在现代语言中，这意味着函数式程序应遵循复合性原理。Backus的论文推广了函数式编程的研究，虽然它强调的是函数级编程而不是现在所说的λ演算风格。
target_text: John Backus, in 1977, in his Turing Award presentation, " Programming can be freed from the von Neuman style? A functional style and its program algebra, which he presented. He defined the function programming as being structured in a layered way through the " combination form " , allowing the " program algebra " ; in modern languages, this means that the function programming process should follow the principle of complexity. Backus’s thesis promotes the study of function programming, although it emphasizes function-level programming rather than what is now called the " function-level programming style " .
title: 函数式编程

source_text: 在1970年代，Guy L. Steele和Gerald Jay Sussman开发了Scheme，如有影响力的“λ论文集”和经典的1985年教科书《计算机程序的构造和解释》中所描述的那样。Scheme是使用词法作用域和尾调用优化的第一个Lisp方言，将函数式编程的影响力提升到更广泛的范围，让更多的编程语言社区接触到它们。在1980年代，佩尔·马丁-洛夫开发了直觉类型论（也称为构造类型论），它将函数式编程与表现为依赖类型的数学证明联系起来。这导致了的新方法的产生，并影响了后续的函数式编程语言的发展。
target_text: In the 1970s, Guy L. Steele and Gerald Jay Sussman developed Scheme, as described in the influential “studies” and the classic 1985 textbook “Constructions and Interpretations of Computer Programs.” Scheme was the first Lisp dialect to be optimized, using the word fields and tailings, to raise the impact of functional programming to a wider range and to reach more programming language communities. In the 1980s, Per Martin-Lof developed intuitive typologies (also called typologies of construction), which linked functional programming to mathematical certificates that were seen as dependent. This led to the creation of new methods and influenced the development of subsequent typographical programming languages.
title: 函数式编程

source_text: 在1985年开发的惰性求值函数式语言Miranda出现，它採用了來自ML與Hope语言的概念，作為他先前所設計的SASL和KRC语言的後繼者。Miranda对后来的Haskell有很强的影响，由于它当时是专有软件，所以Haskell社区于1987年开始达成共识，以形成函数式编程研究的开放标准，对标准的实现自1990年以来一直在进行中。
target_text: Miranda, the inert value-seeking function language developed in 1985, has emerged, using concepts from the ML and Hope languages as successors to the SASL and KRC languages that he had previously designed. Miranda has a strong influence on later Haskell and, since it was a proprietary software at the time, the Haskell community began to reach consensus in 1987 to form open standards for functional programming studies, the realization of which has been in progress since 1990.
title: 函数式编程

source_text:
工业
函数式编程长期以来在学术界流行，但几乎没有工业应用。造成这种局面的主因是函數式編程常被認為嚴重耗費CPU和記憶體資源 ，这是由于在早期實現函數式編程語言時並沒有考慮過效率問題，而且面向函数式编程特性，如保证等，要求独特的数据结构和算法。
target_text: Industrial function programming has long been popular in academia, but there are few industrial applications. The main reason for this is that function programming is often considered a serious cost to CPU and memory resources, because efficiency issues are not taken into account in the early realization of function programming language and because function programming features, such as assurances, require unique data structures and algorithms.
title: 函数式编程

source_text:
然而，最近几种函数式编程语言已经在商业或工业系统中使用，例如：
Erlang，它由瑞典公司爱立信在20世纪80年代后期开发，最初用于实现容错电信系统。此后，它已在Nortel、Facebook、Électricité de France和WhatsApp等公司作为流行语言建立一系列应用程序。
Scheme，它被用作早期Apple Macintosh计算机上的几个应用程序的基础，并且最近已应用于诸如训练模拟软件和望远镜控制等方向。
OCaml，它于20世纪90年代中期推出，已经在金融分析，驱动程序验证，工业机器人编程和嵌入式软件静态分析等领域得到了商业应用。
Haskell，它虽然最初是作为一种研究语言，也已被一系列公司应用于航空航天系统，硬件设计和网络编程等领域。
target_text: Recently, however, several functional programming languages have been used in commercial or industrial systems, such as Erlang, which was developed by the Swedish company Ericsson in the late 1980s and was initially used to achieve faulty telecommunications systems. Since then, it has developed a series of applications as popular languages in such companies as Nortel, Facebook, Électricité de France, and WhatsApp. Scheme, which has been used as the basis for several applications on the early Apple Macintosh computer and has recently been applied in directions such as training simulation software and telescope control.
title: 函数式编程

source_text:
其他在工业中使用的函数式编程语言包括多范型的Scala、F#，还有Wolfram语言、Common Lisp、Standard ML和Clojure等。教育

target_text: Other functional programming languages used in industry include multi-model Scala, F#, and Wolfram languages, Commun Lip, Standard ML, and Clojure. title: 函数式编程

source_text: 虚拟组合化学是组合化学技术与计算机辅助药物设计方法相结合的产物，这种方法将构建组合化学库的工作从实验室移植到计算机上完成，通过计算机的模拟，在短时间内迅速建立拥有成千上万个化合物的虚拟库，并通过一些算法表征分子结构并优化化合物库，尽可能合理地减少库中化合物的数量，之后再有针对性地合成优化后的化合物库。由于优化了化合物库，虚拟组合化学方法极大的削减了传统组合化学的研究成本。随着计算化学的发展，虚拟组合化学还在不断改进，并与其他计算机辅助药物设计方法结合，成为新药开发中非常重要和有效的方法。
target_text: Virtual combination chemistry is the product of a combination of chemical technology and computer-assisted drug design methods, which combines the construction of a combination chemical bank from a laboratory to a computer. Virtual combination chemistry is rapidly built over a short period of time, using computer simulations, with thousands of compounds in a virtual bank, and, through a number of algorithmic molecular structures and the optimization of the compounds bank, reduces the number of compounds in the bank to the extent possible and then synthesizes them in a targeted manner. As a result of the optimization of the compounds bank, virtual combination chemistry significantly reduces the research costs of traditional combination chemistry. As computing chemistry develops, virtual combination chemistry continues to improve and is combined with other computer-assisted drug design methods, becoming a very important and effective method in the development of new drugs.
title: 组合化学

中國
2017年9月国家互联网信息办公室推出《互联网群组信息服务管理规定》規管聊天室。當月《检察日报》採訪了国家行政学院教授杨小军的看法，「杨小军也认为，管理责任并非上述一些网友所理解的『让群主也要承担群成员违法违规的责任』，在互联网群组中不只有群主一个责任主体，还有群主、参与人（发言人）、网络平台提供商、相关主管部门这四个主体共同参与，才有互联网及其群组的发展进步；同样，四个主体也分别承担相应责任」、「对于一些网友列举出群主需要对群成员的信息发布和传播行为而承担的诸多民事、行政乃至刑事责任，杨小军明确表示了反对：『这个观点实际上是让群主一人负担所有人的责任，甚至把管理部门的责任都归到群主身上。这既不客观，也不可能』」；報導又採訪中国政法大学教授王卫国，「有网友戏称通过司法考试才敢当群主。有的群主对法律法规不是很熟悉，那么其对群成员的信息交流是否违反法律法规该如何判断、管理呢？王卫国表示，这还是网友对管理责任的过大理解。实际上，群主只要根据一般人的判断，认为群成员的表达明显不妥时，给予提示、禁止，就算是已经尽到管理责任了。对于比较专业化的问题，法律法规不可能赋予群主过度的责任。」

source_text: 蚁群算法（Ant Colony Optimization，ACO），又称蚂蚁算法，是一种用来在图中寻找优化路径的机率型算法。它由Marco Dorigo于1992年在他的博士论文“Ant system: optimization by a colony of cooperating agents”中提出，其灵感来源于蚂蚁在寻找食物过程中发现路径的行为。蚁群算法是一种模拟进化算法，初步的研究表明该算法具有许多优良的性质。针对PID控制器参数优化设计问题，将蚁群算法设计的结果与遗传算法设计的结果进行了比较，数值仿真结果表明，蚁群算法具有一种新的模拟进化优化方法的有效性和应用价值。
target_text: The ant group algorithm, also known as an ant algorithm, is a probability algorithm used to find optimal pathways in the graph. It was suggested by Marco Dorigo in 1992 in his doctoral thesis “Ant system: operation by a codeny of cooperating agents” and was inspired by the behavior of an ant in finding paths in the search for food. The ant group algorithm is a simulation evolutionary algorithm, and preliminary research has shown that the algorithm has many excellent properties. For PID control parameter optimization, the results of the ant group algorithm design are compared with those of the genetic algorithm design.
title: 蚁群算法

source_text:
常见的扩展
下面是一些最常用的变异蚁群算法：精英蚂蚁系统
全局最优解决方案在每个迭代以及其他所有的蚂蚁的沉积信息素。最大最小蚂蚁系统（MMAS）
添加的最大和最小的信息素量[ τmax，τmin ]，只有全局最佳或迭代最好的巡逻沉积的信息素。所有的边缘都被初始化为τmax并且当接近停滞时重新初始化为τmax。
target_text: The most common extension is some of the most common atropine algorithms: the elite ant system is the best solution for sediment information for each and all other ants. The maximum and smallest amount of information added by the minimum ant system [and max, and min] is only the best or the best translator in the world. All the edges are initialized as max and recommended as max when nearing stagnation.
title: 蚁群算法

source_text:
连续正交蚁群（COAC）
COAC的信息素沉积机制能使蚂蚁协作而有效地寻解。利用正交设计方法，在可行域的蚂蚁可以使用增大的全局搜索能力和精度，快速、高效地探索他们选择的区域。
正交设计方法和自适应半径调整方法也可推广到其他优化算法中，在解决实际问题施展更大的威力。
target_text: Consequent orthodox (COAC) COAC information-based sedimentation mechanisms allow ants to work together effectively to find solutions. Using orthographic design methods, ants can quickly and efficiently explore areas of their choice using increased global search capabilities and accuracy in feasible areas.
title: 蚁群算法

source_text:
收敛
一些版本的算法可以被证明是收敛的（即它能够在有限时间找到全局最优解）。第一个蚁群算法收敛的证据制作于2000年，建立了基于图像的蚁群算法，继而是ACS和MMAS的算法。像大多数元启发式方法一样，估计理论收敛速度是很难的。在2004年，Zlochin和他的同事们表明，COA-type算法在分布算法的叉熵和估计方面能被随机梯度下降法吸收。他们建议这些元启发式方法作为一个“研究性模式”。
target_text: In 2004, Zlochin and his colleagues showed that the COA-type algorithms could be absorbed by random gradients for entropy and estimation of distribution algorithms. They suggested that these metrology methods be used as a “research model”.
title: 蚁群算法

source_text:
应用
蚁群优化算法已应用于许多组合优化问题，包括蛋白质折叠或路由车辆的二次分配问题，很多派生的方法已经应用于实变量动力学问题，随机问题，多目标并行的实现。它也被用旅行推銷員問題的拟最优解。在图表动态变化的情况下解决相似问题时，他们相比模拟退火算法和遗传算法方法有优势；蚁群算法可以连续运行并适应实时变化。这在网络路由和城市交通系统中是有利的。
target_text: Applying ant optimisation algorithms has been applied to many combinations of optimization issues, including protein folding or secondary distribution of roadways vehicles, and many derivative methods have been applied to real-variant dynamics issues, random problems, multi-target parallel realization. It is also the best solution to the travel saleser problem. They have an advantage in solving similar problems in the context of map dynamics. They have a comparative advantage over simulated fire decomposition algorithms and genetic algorithms; ant group algorithms can function continuously and adapt to real-time changes. This is beneficial in network routers and urban transport systems.
title: 蚁群算法

source_text: 第一蚁群优化算法被称为“蚂蚁系统”，它旨在解决推销员问题，其目标是要找到一系列城市的最短遍历路线。总体算法相对简单，它基于一组蚂蚁，每只完成一次城市间的遍历。在每个阶段，蚂蚁根据一些规则选择从一个城市移动到另一个：它必须访问每个城市一次;一个越远的城市被选中的机会越少（能见度更低）;在两个城市边际的一边形成的信息素越浓烈，这边被选择的概率越大;如果路程短的话，已经完成旅程的蚂蚁会在所有走过的路径上沉积更多信息素，每次迭代后，信息素轨迹挥发。
target_text: At each stage, ants choose to move from one city to another on the basis of rules: it must visit each city once; the further away a city is selected less (with less visibility); the more information is created on one side of the edge of the two cities, the more likely it is chosen; and, if it is short, the more information is deposited on all the routes that have passed, the more information is lost.
title: 蚁群算法

target_text: The Distributed Information Retrieval grid workflow system identifies methods associated with protein folding electronic circuit design. Dissolved combinations or mutations increase understandings, in which poor-quality resolution is discarded, and the search for advanced solutions imitates this evolution. source_text: 禁忌搜索（TS）类似于模拟退火，他们都是通过测试独立解的突变来遍历解空间的。而模拟退火算法对于一个独立解只生成一个突变，禁忌搜索会产生许多变异解并且移动到产生的解中的符合度最低的一个。为了防止循环并且促进在解空间中的更大进展，由部分或完整的解组建维系了一个禁忌列表。移动到元素包含于禁忌列表的解是禁止，禁忌列表随着解遍历解空间的过程而不断更新。
target_text: The taboo search (TS) is similar to the simulation of fire retreats, all of which pass through space by testing mutations of independent resolution. The simulation of the decomposition algorithm creates only one mutation for an independent resolution, and the taboo search produces many mutations and moves to the lowest level of conformity in the resulting resolution. To prevent loops and promote greater progress in the resolution space, a list of taboos is maintained by partial or complete decomposition.
title: 蚁群算法

source_text: 動態隨機存取記憶體通常被組織成一系列的記憶體芯片，這些芯片可以通過總線或其他互連技術進行連接。每個記憶體芯片可以包含數百萬到幾十億個記憶單元。由於DRAM存儲器需要刷新操作，因此通常需要使用一些控制電路，例如記憶體控制器或記憶體介面控制器，以管理存儲器操作，如讀取、寫入、刷新等。
target_text: Motivated access to memory is usually organized into a series of memory chips that can be connected by a bus or other interconnectivity technology. Each memory chip can contain millions to billions of memory units. Since the DRAM repository needs to be refreshed, a number of control circuits, such as memory controllers or memory interface controllers, are usually used to manage storage operations, such as reading, writing, refreshing, etc.
title: 动态随机存取存储器

source_text: 在逻辑中，术语时间逻辑被用来描述为表现和推理关于时间限定的命题的规则和符号化的任何系统。它有时也被称为时态逻辑，这是 Arthur Prior 在1960年代介入的基于模态逻辑的特殊的时间逻辑系统。它后来被计算机科学家特别是 Amir Pnueli (阿米尔·伯努利) 和逻辑学家进一步的开发。中国著名计算机科学家唐稚松在这一领域亦有较深入的研究，并写有专著《时序逻辑程序设计与软件工程》。
target_text: Logically, the temporal logic of terminology is used to describe any system of expression and reasoning of the rules and symbols of time-bound propositions. It is sometimes referred to as the temporal logic, which Arthur Prior intervened in the 1960s as a special time logic based on modular logic. It was further developed by computer scientists, in particular Amir Pnueli (Amer Bernoli) and logic scientists.
title: 时间逻辑

source_text:
历史
爱丁堡大学信息学院建立于1998年, 是爱丁堡大学理工学院（College of Science and Engineering）下属学院之一。为了拉进计算机科学和认知科学的距离，学校的计算机科学系（Department of Computer Science），人工智能系（Department of Artificial Intelligence）和认知科学系（Department of Cognitive Science）被整合为一个学科，统称信息学（Informatics）。爱丁堡大学将信息学定义为研究人工和自然计算系统中資訊的表达，处理和通讯的基础学科，希望能对人工计算系统和生物有机体系统中的计算现象做出最基本的解释。自然科学试图解释的最根本疑问是：什么是物质？什么是生命？什么是思维？物理和生物科学试图探索前两个问题，而信息学试图探索后两个问题，希望能够为我们了解有认知能力的生物体中的各种认知过程提供理论基础，从而最终复制和重建此类系统。
target_text: The Faculty of Artificial Sciences and the Department of Cognitive Sciences of the University of Edinburgh were established in 1998 as one of the colleges of Technology of the University of Edinburgh. The University of Edinburgh defines informatics as the basic discipline for the study of the expression, processing and communication of information in artificial and natural computing systems, with the hope of providing the most basic explanation for computational and bioorganic systems.

source_text: MMC定义了SPI和1位比特MMC/SD协议。这一协议已存在多年，并成为众多微控制器的标准特性。从社会学的角度看，另外是否有必要颁布一个新的SD/MMC协议值得商榷。开发一个互不兼容，同时也是不必要的协议仅仅是帮助开发者收取授权费用和会员费，但却提高了开发硬件和软件的成本。新协议可支持多种卡在同一总线上工作，但这也引起了一些问题。SPI协议要求每种卡采用三个共享通道外加一个独立的芯片选择，新的协议可支持最高30种卡连接到这三个共享通道上（不需芯片选择），代价是异常复杂的卡初始化功能和每种卡必须有一个唯一序列号以支持即插即用功能。这个功能其实很少用到，而且考虑到速率和电力消耗的原因，在新的标准（每种卡使用完全独立的通道）下也不建议这样做。
target_text: MMC defines SPI and a bit MMC/SD agreement. This agreement has been in place for many years and has become a standard feature for many microcontrols. From a sociological point of view, it is questionable whether a new SD/MC protocol would be necessary. Development of an incompatible agreement, while unnecessary, would only help developers collect authorization fees and membership fees, but would raise the cost of developing hardware and software. The new agreement could support multiple cards working on the same bus line, but it also raises some questions. The SPI agreement requires that each card use three shared paths plus an independent chip option, and that the new agreement would support a maximum of 30 cards to be connected to these three shared paths (without chip selection), at the cost of an unusually complex initialization function and the need for each card to have a single serial number to support the intone function. This function is rarely used, and it is not recommended under new standards (each card uses a fully independent route) and takes into account the speed and power consumption.
title: SD卡

source_text: MMC定义了SPI和1位MMC/SD协议。基本的SPI协议已经作为许多微控制器的一个标准特点存在了许多年。从社会的观点来看，定义一个新的不兼容的SD/MMC协议的理由是值得怀疑的；开发一个不兼容的并且是非必需的新协议可能有利于贸易协会收取授权费用和成员费用，但是它在许多方面增加了硬件和软件的费用。新的协议使用开放的信号转换接头（open collector signalling）以允许在同一总线上使用多个存储卡，但是这实际上在使用更高时钟频率时带来了问题。尽管SPI使用三条共享的信号线外加一个单独的芯片选择每个存储卡，新协议允许多达30块存储卡连结到同样的三条线上（不包含片选），这样做的代价是更加复杂的闪存卡初始化和需要每个卡有一个唯一的序列号用于即插即用；这个特性实际上很少使用并且由于速度和功耗问题在新标准中不建议它的使用。有类似所有权的1位协议被扩展到四位宽（SD和MMC）和八位宽用来支持更高速度，但是计算机产业的其它大部分都在向更高速度更窄的通道转移；标准的SPI能够简单地使用更高数据速度的时钟（如133 MHz）以获得比四位SD更高的性能——没有更高时钟速度的嵌入式处理器无论如何也不能处理更快速度的数据。SD协会放弃了一些旧的一位MMC协议命令的支持，并且添加了另外一些与版权保护相关的命令。
target_text: MMC defines SPI and one MMC/SD agreement. The basic SPI agreement has existed for many years as a standard feature of many microcontrols. From a social perspective, the rationale for defining a new incompatible SD/MMC agreement is questionable; the development of an incompatible and non-necessary new agreement may facilitate the collection of authorized and membership fees by trade associations, but it increases hardware and software costs in many ways. The new agreement uses an open signal conversion interface (open collector signalling) to allow multiple storage cards to be used on the same bus line, but this poses problems when using a higher clock frequency. Although the new agreement allows up to 30 storage cards to be connected to the same three lines (without a single selection), the cost is a more sophisticated flashcard initialization and requires a single serial number for each card to be used immediately; this feature is in fact very little use and due to speed and power problems not recommended for use in the new standard.
title: 多媒體記憶卡

source_text: Java虚拟机有自己完善的硬件架构，如处理器、堆栈、寄存器等，还具有相应的指令系统。JVM屏蔽了与具体操作系统平台相关的信息，使得Java程序只需生成在Java虚拟机上运行的目标代码（字节码），就可以在多种平台上不加修改地运行。通过对中央处理器（CPU）所执行的软件實作，实现能执行编译过的Java程序码（Applet与应用程式）。
target_text: The Java virtual machine has its own perfect hardware architecture, such as processors, stacks, depositors, etc., and the corresponding command system. JVM screens the information related to the specific operating system platform, so that Java can run on multiple platforms without modification by simply generating the target code (byte code) that is running on the Java virtual machine.
title: Java虚拟机

source_text:
技术规范
据技术规范所述，Java虚拟机是一部抽象（虚拟）的计算机。但技术规范未定义使用的垃圾回收算法及优化Java虚拟机指令的内部算法，这主要是为了不给实现者带来过多困扰与限制。所有的Java程序仅可在对Java虚拟机的抽象技术规范的具体实现环境中才可运行。
target_text: According to the technical specifications, the Java virtual machine is an abstract (virtual) computer. But the technical specifications do not define waste recovery algorithms and optimize internal algorithms for the Java virtual machine instructions, mainly in order not to cause too much trouble and constraint to the implementers.
title: Java虚拟机

source_text: 指令集存在的目的是为了保证二进制文件的兼容性。每个独立宿主操作系统需要对Java虚拟机及运行时环境的不同实现。这些Java虚拟机以相同方式语义解析字节码，但具体实现可能有所不同。比模拟字节码更复杂的是在兼容且高效的情况下实现必须映射至不同的宿主操作系统的。
target_text: The purpose of the command set is to ensure the compatibility of binary files. Each independent host operating system requires different realizations of the Java virtual machine and the operating environment. These Java virtual machines interpret the bytes in the same way, but the actual realization may be different. More complex than the simulation bytes is the achievement of compatibility and efficiency that must map different host operating systems.
title: Java虚拟机

source_text: 上述指令集通过操作共同的执行命令，而非以使用特定指令集架构的原生数据类型的方式运行。Java虚拟机语言Java虚拟机语言是指使用Java虚拟机托管的有效类文件来表示功能的任意编程语言。类文件中含有Java虚拟机指令集（Java字节码）、符号表及其他辅助信息。类文件是用于表达编译后的类及接口的二进制格式，与硬件及操作系统无关。
target_text: The above set of instructions operates by operating a common execution command, not by using the type of raw data used in a given command set. Java virtual language means any programming language that uses a valid type of file hosted by the Java virtual machine. The class file contains Java virtual machine command set (Java byte code), symbol tables and other supporting information. The class file is a binary format used to express the type and interface that has been compiled and has nothing to do with hardware and operating systems.
title: Java虚拟机

source_text: WMF文件格式漏洞是一个源于微软Windows操作系统的漏洞，被一个计算机安全邮件列表Bugtraq于2005年12月27日公开 ，在24小时内就成为一些恶意程序，例如间谍软件和木马程序的载体。微软于1月6日发布了针对Windows 2000和Windows XP版本中不当处理WMF函数SETABORTPROC的补丁，并且在1月16日发布了针对Windows Vista的补丁，但是其他的操作系统仍旧会受到该漏洞的威胁。
target_text: The WMF file format gap is a bug originating from the Microsoft Windows operating system, which was made public on 27 December 2005 by a computer secure mailing list, Bugtraq, which became a carrier of malicious programs, such as spy software and carousel programs, within 24 hours. Microsoft issued patches on 6 January for Windows 2000 and Windows XP versions that mishandled the WMF functions SETABORTPROC and released patches on 16 January for Windows Vista, but other operating systems are still threatened by the bug.
title: WMF文件格式漏洞

source_text: 该漏洞源于Windows的核心模块gdi32.dll处理WMF格式的方式，允许在计算机上不经过用户许可即执行代码。因此该漏洞成为恶意代码的载体，通常被用来暗中下载其他恶意软件。1月9日，Bugtraq报告另外两个WMF函数ExtCreateRegion和ExtEscape也有同样的漏洞，但是微软声称这两个漏洞只会造成性能问题 。
target_text: This gap stems from the way the Windows core module gdi32.dll handles WMF formats, allowing the code to be executed on a computer without the user's permission. The bug thus becomes a carrier for malicious code and is usually used to download other malware clandestinely. On January 9, Bugtraq reported two other WMF functions, ExtCreateRegion and ExtEscape, but Microsoft claims that these two loopholes only cause performance problems.
title: WMF文件格式漏洞

source_text: 因为该漏洞是WMF文件的特性之一，该漏洞的已知影响范围从Windows 98到Windows Vista，但是甚至連Windows 3.0和非Windows的操作系统都可能受影响。但是，因为-{只}-有Windows XP和启用了图像预览功能的Windows ME默认会打开WMF文件，所以这个系统比其他系统更加容易受到攻击。更旧的Windows版本和非Windows操作系统并不默认支持打开WMF文件，但是ACDSee这样的第三方程序可能使系统受到影响。
target_text: Because the leak is one of the features of the WMF file, the known range of impacts of the leak ranged from Windows 98 to Windows Vista, but even Windows 3.0 and non-Windows operating systems may be affected. However, since -{only} Windows XP and Windows ME, which enabled image previews, will open WMF files by default, the system is more vulnerable than other systems. The older Windows version and non-Windows operating systems do not implicitly support the opening of WMF files, but third-party processes such as ACDSee may affect the system.
title: WMF文件格式漏洞

source_text:
非Windows的操作系统不直接受到影响，但是一些模拟Windows行为的模拟器在打开WMF文件的时候可能会受到攻击。有报告说Linux和BSD操作系统中可以在WINE上运行的Cedega程序有这个漏洞 。Wine的代码已经更新以修正这个问题 。弱点
微软的安全公告 声称，这个漏洞存在于图形呈现引擎处理特制的WMF图像的方式中，可能允许执行任意代码，控制受影响的系统。
target_text: The non-Windows operating system is not directly affected, but some simulators that simulate Windows behavior may be attacked when opening WMF files. There are reports of this gap in the Cedega program that Linux and BSD operating systems can run on WINE. Wine's code has been updated to correct the problem. Microsoft security bulletin states that this gap exists in the way the graphic display engine handles WMF images, which may allow the implementation of any code and control of the affected system.
title: WMF文件格式漏洞

source_text:
浏览一个被感染的站点或者预览被感染的电子邮件。如果浏览器自动下载並显示WMF文件（有可能并非以.WMF为扩展名）的话，感染过的WMF文件中的代码可能被执行。在一些浏览器提示下载和打开感染过的WMF文件时，如果用户选择确认，那么恶意代码也可能被执行。一些允许在帖子内容中插入图像的论坛因此停止了允许插入图像的功能。
在Windows资源管理器中预览感染过的WMF文件。
在一些软件，比如即时通讯软件中点击收到的消息中的链接。
target_text: Browse an infected site or preview an infected e-mail. If the browser automatically downloads and displays an infected WMF file (possibly not in the name of.WMF extension), the code in the infected WMF file may be executed. If the user chooses to confirm it, the malicious code may also be executed. Some forums that allow the insertion of images in the post content therefore stop allowing the insertion of images. Preview the infected WMF file in the Windows resource manager. Click on links in incoming messages in some software, such as instant communication software.
title: WMF文件格式漏洞

source_text:
针对这个漏洞，用户可以考虑采取以下步骤：
安装微软发布的官方补丁。
如果使用的是硬件（例如AMD的64位CPU）实现的数据执行保护，打开所有程序的数据执行保护。
设置WMF文件的默认关联程序为一个不可能执行WMF指令的程序，例如记事本。
通过设置Internet选项中的默认安全设置为高来关闭下载。
確保防毒軟體為最新版本，并且考虑频繁地手动检查更新。
在网络内通过过滤文件头来禁止发送WMF文件。
尽可能减少用户的权限。
禁用Google Desktop的索引功能，直到该问题被解决。
使用非Windows的操作系统，例如Linux、FreeBSD或者Unix。
在可能自动显示WMF文件的程序，例如Internet Explorer 和Outlook 中关闭图像的显示。使用非Internet Explorer的浏览器会减轻一点风险，但是不能识别改名为其他扩展名的恶意WMF文件。
使用非Windows的操作系统进行高危操作，例如进行聊天或者浏览可以在帖子中插入图像的论坛。
在Windows中禁用索引服务
target_text: In response to this gap, users could consider the following steps: Install the official patches released by Microsoft. If hardware (e.g. 64-bit CPU) is used to perform data protection, open the data protection of all programs if available. Set the default association of WMF files to a program that is not likely to execute WMF commands, such as a logbook. Close downloads by setting the default security settings in the Internet option. Ensure that the anti-drug software is the latest version and consider frequent manual checking of updates. Disable the distribution of WMF files by filtering the head of a file on the network. Minimize user privileges. Disable the index function of GoogleDesktop until the issue is resolved. Use the non-Windows operating system, such as Linux, FreeBSD or Unix.
title: WMF文件格式漏洞

source_text:
历史
终端其实就是一种输入输出设备，相对于计算机主机而言属于外设，本身并不提供运算处理功能。早期的计算机终端一般是机电的电传打字机，比如ASR33。但是对于大多数应用来说它们太慢了，在卡片或磁帶等物理性的材料上標記好資料之後，放入計算機再印出結果，過程非常費工。1970年代初许多电脑公司认识到电视输入终端比穿孔卡片要好得多，而且可以使得计算机更加容易与用户互动，产生新的应用。当时的毛病在于相对于当时的小型计算机来说要显示一页文字所需要的内存太大了。在集成电路普及以前要显示电视信号所需要的速度对当时的逻辑门所提出的技术挑战也太高了。当时有一家公司宣布要生产一台价值15,000美元的视频终端，吸引了许多购户，但是最后它的工程师们决定这个计划无法完成。另一个解决方法是泰克公司发明的存储管，这台机器可以显示输出给它的信息，但是无法刷新。
target_text: History, the end is actually an input output device, which is not an outsider as opposed to a computer host. Early computer terminals are usually electromechanical typewriters, such as ASR33. But for most applications, they are too slow to mark data on physical materials, such as cards or tapes, to reprint the results in a calculator, which is a very expensive process. Many computer companies in the early 1970s realized that television entry terminals were much better than perforated cards, and that computers could interact more easily with users and produce new applications.
title: 終端

source_text: 早期的IBM个人计算机虽然也使用绿色的螢幕，但是它不算终端。个人计算机的螢幕不包括任何产生字母的硬件，所有的视频信号是在个人计算机的顯示卡裡产生的。但是使用相应的模拟程序一台个人计算机可以与大型计算机相连模拟终端。使用微处理器的个人计算机大大地取消了对终端的需要，人與電腦的接觸直接用圖像的作業系統來代勞了。但今天大多数个人计算机的Telnet用户端仍提供最普遍的终端（一般VT100）的模拟，但這不是真正的物理終端。
target_text: Early IBM PCs, although also using green screens, are not terminals. Personal computer screens do not include any hardware that produces letters, and all video signals are generated in personal computer display cards. But a personal computer that uses the corresponding simulation program can be connected to a large computer simulation terminal. Personal computers using microprocessors have significantly eliminated the need for terminals, and people's access to computers is directly covered by the graphical production system.
title: 終端

source_text:
图形终端
有些终端不但可以显示文字，而且可以显示矢量图形和位图。计算机向终端输出绘图指令，终端则向计算机输送用户输入（通过键盘或者定位设备）。事实上今天过去简单的图形终端已经完全被全功能视频显示器代替了。今天在计算机中图形用户界面无处不在。大多数终端模拟程序是在图形环境内运行的。我們現在主要是透過這些輔助工具，已經很少有直接終端的存在。
target_text: Graphical terminals Some of the terminals show not only text, but vector graphics and bit maps. Computers produce drawing instructions to the terminal, and terminals transmit user input to the computer (by keyboard or positioning device). In fact, today simple graphic terminals have been completely replaced by full-functional video monitors. Today, graphical user interfaces are everywhere in the computer. Most of the terminal simulation programs are run in the graphic environment. We are now mainly using these assistive tools, and there are few direct end-ends.
title: 終端

source_text:
X终端是专门给X Window系统设计的图形终端，提供连接到服务器系统上运行的KDE、GNOME或其它基于X Window系统的平台的可能性。目前
由于个人电脑的普及今天已经很少有专门的计算机终端作为界面了。现代的操作系统如Linux和BSD及其衍生物使用与硬件基本无关的虚拟终端。输出系统一般是螢幕，输入系统则是键盘。
target_text: The X terminal is a graphical terminal designed for the X Windows system that provides the possibility of connecting to KDE, GNOME or other platforms based on the X Windows system that run on the server system. Today, because of the penetration of personal computers, there are few dedicated computer terminals as interfaces. Modern operating systems such as Linux and BSD and their derivatives use virtual terminals that have nothing to do with hardware. The output system is usually a screen, while the input system is a keyboard.
title: 終端

source_text:
教会法亲等计算法
根据中世纪欧洲教会法（Canon law），血亲计算如下：
直系血亲计算法
和罗马法亲等计算法相同
旁系血亲计算法
从己身上数至共同的直系血亲，再从所指亲属也上数至共同的直系血亲。取数目较大者为血亲代数。譬如一个人和他的亲兄弟姐妹是一亲等旁系血亲；和他的舅舅或者他的舅舅的女儿（表姐妹）是二亲等旁系血亲。
target_text: According to the European Church Law of the Middle Ages, blood is calculated as follows: The direct blood family is calculated in the same way as Roman filiation, which is calculated from the number of direct blood relatives on its own to the common blood relatives, and from the number of relatives referred to to to the common blood relatives. The larger number of persons taken is blood relatives. For example, a person and his brothers and sisters are next-to-kin blood relatives; and the daughter of his uncle or his uncle's cousin is next-to-back blood relatives.
title: 血親

source_text:
婚姻限制在六親等內，六親，泛指所有親屬。據《左传》，六親指父子、兄弟、姑姐（父親的姐妹）、甥舅、婚媾（妻的家屬）及姻亞（夫的家屬）。中华人民共和国婚姻法定义的血亲
《中华人民共和国婚姻法》（2003年）第二章第七条规定：这个定义既不是使用罗马法亲等计算法，也不是使用教会法亲等计算法。按照中国法律门户网，“所谓三代内的旁系血亲，是指从自己上溯至同一血缘的亲属，再向下数三代。”即包括表、堂兄弟姐妹。这也是最常见的解释。
target_text: Marriage is limited to six relatives, six relatives, and all relatives in general. According to the Left Passage, the six relatives refer to their fathers, brothers, sisters (the father's sister), nephews, marriage (the wife's family) and marriage (the husband's family). The marriage law of the People's Republic of China defines blood relatives as the marriage law of the People's Republic of China (2003) Chapter 7 of the Marriage Law of the People's Republic of China provides that this definition is neither calculated by Roman law nor by church law.
title: 血親

source_text: 禁忌搜索（，TS，又稱禁忌搜尋法）是一種現代啟發式算法，由美國科罗拉多大学教授弗雷德·格洛弗于1986年左右提出，并于1989年实现规范化。 这种搜寻法是一個用來跳脫局部最优解的搜索方法。其先创立一個初始化的方案；基于此，算法“移动”到一相邻的方案。經過許多连续的移動过程，提高解的质量。
target_text: A taboo search (TS, also known as a taboo search method) is a modern-day, enlightened algorithm proposed by Fred Glover, a professor at Colorado University in the United States, in 1986 or so, and standardized in 1989. This search is a method used to jump off the best local search. It starts with an initialized scheme; on this basis, the algorithm “moves” to a neighbouring one.
title: 禁忌搜索

source_text:
约翰·麦卡锡（，），生于美国马萨诸塞州波士顿，计算机科学家。他因在人工智能领域的贡献而在1971年获得图灵奖。实际上，正是他在1956年的达特矛斯会议上提出了“人工智能”这个概念。履历
1927年9月4日，约翰·麦卡锡出生於美國麻薩諸塞州波士頓。他的父親John Patrick是愛爾蘭裔美國人，母親Ida Glatt McCarthy是立陶宛的猶太人。
target_text: John McCarthy, born in Boston, Massachusetts, United States, computer scientist. He won the Turing Prize in 1971 for his contributions in the field of artificial intelligence. In fact, it was he who proposed the concept of “an artificial intelligence” at the Dartmouth Conference in 1956. John McCarthy was born in Boston, Massachusetts, United States, on 4 September 1927. His father, John Patrick, was an Irish American, and his mother, Ida Glatt McCarthy, was a Lithuanian Jew.
title: 约翰·麦卡锡

source_text:
奖项荣誉
1971年，麦卡锡获得了计算机界的最高奖项图灵奖。
1988年，麦卡锡获得了京都奖。
1990年，麦卡锡获得了美国国家科学奖章。
1999年，麦卡锡成为了计算机历史博物馆研究员。
2003年，由于麦卡锡在计算机和认知科学方面的成就，获得了富蘭克林獎章。
2012年，麦卡锡获得了斯坦福大学工程英雄称号。
target_text: McCarthy won the highest prize in the computer world, Turing in 1971. McCarthy won the Kyoto Prize in 1988.
title: 约翰·麦卡锡

source_text:
達特矛斯夏季人工智慧研究計劃（）由约翰·麦卡锡等人于1956年8月31日发起，旨在召集志同道合的人共同讨论“人工智能”（此定义正是在那时提出的）。会议持续了一个月，基本上以大范围的集思广益为主。这催生了后来人所共知的人工智能革命。發起歷史
约翰·麦卡锡是這場會議的最初提議者，他當時任教於达特茅斯学院。正式的會議發起人有四位。
target_text: Launched by John McCarthy and others on August 31, 1956, the Dharma Summer Artificial Wisdom Research Program was designed to bring together like-minded people to discuss “artificial intelligence” (the definition was made at that time). The meeting lasted for a month, largely based on broad brainstorming.
title: 达特矛斯会议

source_text:
研究成果
在有限元计算中提出使用“最优剖分”和“最优形函数表示”原则。
在工程计算中发现了“超收敛”不是个别点的现象，而是一个整体现象。在推进工程计算的理论研究的同时，证明了在流体计算中也是“超收敛”现象。
与群体协作建立了包括算子迭代、校正和外推在内的高精度算法的系统理论，提出了既可保证算法的高精度又无需引进复杂算法的新的技术路线。
target_text: Research suggests the use of the principles of “best anatomy” and “best anatomy” in limited meta-counting. The discovery of “over-accumulation” in engineering computing is not a stand-alone phenomenon, but a whole phenomenon.
title: 林群

source_text: Java EE 连接器架构（，简称JCA，原名J2EE Connector Architecture，即有简称J2C、J2CA）是基于Java的连接应用服务器和企业信息系统（EIS）的技术解决方案，作为企业应用集成 (EAI)解决方案的一部分。就像JDBC专门用于连接Java EE应用和数据库，JCA是一种连接legacy system（包括数据库）的更通用的体系架构。在Java EE连接器结构中定义了连接器（也称为资源适配器）和应用服务器之间的契约，以及客户端和连接器之间的契约。前者通过服务提供者接口定义，后者通过客户端调用接口定义。
target_text: Java EE connector architecture (JCA, formerly J2EE Contractor Arcitecture, or J2C, J2CA) is a technical solution based on Java's connection application server and enterprise information system (EIS) as part of the enterprise application integration (EAI) solution. Just as JDBC is dedicated to connecting Java EE applications and databases, JCA is a more generic architecture for connecting Legacy system (including databases). In the Java EE connection structure, the contract between the connector (also known as the resource adapter) and the application server, as well as between the client and the connector, is defined through the service provider interface definition and the client interface through the client interface definition.

target_text: Composer The compiler is the translator used to convert advanced programming languages to lower programming languages. The compiler takes time to complete its work, because it converts all advanced codes into lower-level codes at once and saves them in memory. The compiler relies on processors and platforms. It has been processed under the following alternative names: special compilers, cross-compilers and source-to-source compilers.
title: 翻译程序

source_text:
解释器
解释器类似于编译器，因为它是用于将高级编程语言转换为低级编程语言的翻译器。不同之处在于它一次将程序转换为一行代码，并在检测到错误时报告错误，同时还进行转换。解释器比编译器更快，因为它在读取代码时立即执行代码。它通常用作软件开发的调试工具，因为它一次可以执行一行代码。解释器也比编译器更便携，因为它独立于处理器，您可以在不同的硬件架构之间工作 .
target_text: The interpreter is similar to the compiler because it is a translator that converts advanced programming languages to lower programming languages. The interpreter is faster than the compiler because it immediately executes the code when reading replacement numbers. It is usually used as a debugger for software development because it can execute a line of code at a time. The interpreter is more portable than the compiler because it is independent of the processor and you can work between different hardware structures.
