source_text: SRAM由存储矩阵、地址译码器和读/写控制电路组成，容量的扩展有两个方面：位数的扩展用芯片的并联，字数的扩展可用外加译码器控制芯片的片选输入端。SRAM中的每一bit储存在由4个场效应管（M1, M2, M3, M4）构成两个交叉耦合的反相器中。另外两个场效应管（M5, M6）是储存基本单元到用于读写的位线（Bit Line）的控制开关。
target_text: SRAM consists of a storage matrix, address translator, and a reading/writing control circuit. The volume expansion is twofold: the combination of a digital extension with a chip, and the word extension with an extra translator to control the chip's selected input end. Each bit in SRAM is stored in two cross-coupled inverses consisting of four field effect tubes (M1, M2, M3, M4). Two other field effect tubes (M5, M6) are control switches that store basic units to Bit Line for reading and writing.
title: 静态随机存取存储器

source_text:
用于计算机
SRAM用于PC、工作站、路由器以及-{zh-hans:外设; zh-hant:外接設備}-：内部的CPU高速缓存，外部的突发模式使用的SRAM缓存，硬盘缓冲区，路由器缓冲区，等等。LCD显示器或者打印机也通常用SRAM来缓存数据。SRAM做的小型缓冲区也常见于CDROM与CDRW的驱动器中，通常为256 KiB或者更多，用来缓冲音轨数据。线缆调制解调器及类似的连接于计算机的设备也使用了SRAM。
target_text: For computers SRAM is used for PCs, workstations, routers and - {zh-hans: external settings; zh-hant: external interface}: internal CPU high-speed caches, external emergency mode SRAM caches, hard drive buffers, routers buffers, etc. LCD monitors or printers also usually use SRAM to store data. Small buffer zones made by SRAM are also common in CDROM and CDRW drives, usually 256 KiB or more, and are used to buffer track data.
title: 静态随机存取存储器

source_text: 该治疗方法的独特之处在于其给药方式及释放系统。在外科手术过程中，先将肿瘤组织切除，留下一个小空腔，然后植入这种定期释放的芯片。这些芯片会在2~3周之内慢慢地分解、融化，释放出的药物可直接进入肿瘤区，杀死那些在外科手术中没有切除干净的肿瘤细胞，并且能在不损害其它组织的情况下使病变局部能达到有效的血药浓度，延缓了疾病的进展。
target_text: This treatment is unique in its method of delivery and release system. During surgery, tumor tissues are removed, a small cavity is left, then implanted into this periodic release chip. These chips slowly disassemble and melt within two to three weeks, releasing drugs that can go directly into the tumor area, kill those tumor cells that have not been removed from the surgery, and slow down the progress of the disease by enabling the local transformation to reach a valid blood dose level without compromising other tissues.
title: 腦瘤

source_text: 火星文，字面上解作火星人文字，但實際上是指一类網絡語言。随着互联网的普及，年轻网民為求方便或彰顯個性，开始大量使用同音字、音近字、特殊符号来表音的文字。由于这种文字与日常生活中使用的文字相比有明显的不同，文法也相当奇异，難以讀懂，故稱為火星文，取「地球人看不懂的文字」的諷刺效果。“火星文”这种称法最早出现于台湾社会，随即流行于香港、中國大陸和海外华人社会，成为中文互联网上特色。

物理学／电子工业中，指未知内部结构，只露出若干接头的电路，如二端口网络；
计算机科学中，指内部工作方法不清楚的程序。（也许是闭源软件）
系统工程学中指一个系统只能根据其外部表征来推测其系统功能，而不能了解其内部详细构造。例如中医就是一个黑箱系统，尤其是经络结构。
target_text: Examples of black boxes are: Physics/electronics, where the internal structure is unknown and only a number of connections, such as the secondary network; Computer science, where the internal working methods are unclear. (Perhaps closed-source software) Systems engineering, where a system can only extrapolate its system function on the basis of its external appearances, and cannot understand its internal detailed construction. For example, Chinese medicine is a black box system, especially a network structure.
title: 黑箱

source_text:
工作模式
交互机制（消息通信机制），或理解为协作机制：
同步：调用者会主动等待调用结果。按照“调用者”线程在等待调用结果时的状态可分为：
阻塞：线程被操作系统挂起。
非阻塞：线程不被操作系统挂起，可以处理其他事情。
异步：调用者发起一个异步调用，然后立即返回去做别的事。“被调用者”通过状态、通知、回调函数等手段来通知“调用者”。异步IO不是FIFO有序的，例如进程A与进程B先后对一个端口发起了异步读操作，有可能是进程B先得到读操作的结果。
target_text: Work mode Interactive mechanism (message mechanism), or understood as a collaboration mechanism: Synchronization: Callers will wait for the call result. The status of the caller line while waiting for the call result can be divided into: Blocking: Threads are hung up by the operating system. Non-blocking: Threads are not hung up by the operating system, and other things can be dealt with. Differential: The caller initiates an anesthetic call, and then returns immediately to do something else. The caller informs the caller by means of status, notification, echo functions, etc.
title: I/O

source_text: GMA 900是第一款以Intel图形加速器作为产品名称的显示核心，整合于Intel 910G, 915G，以及915Gx芯片组中。相较于之前的Extreme 3D显示核心，GMA 900在性能上有显著的进步，但是与其它的图形加速方案相比，还停留在很基础的层面上。例如，它的3D核心缺乏对于T&L和类似的顶点着色器等3D加速管线中重要技术的硬件支援，而是改以软件模拟的方式提供支持，降低了3D游戏的兼容性和表现。
target_text: GMA 900 is the first display core of the Intel graphic accelerator as a product name, integrated into the Intel 910G, 915G, and 915Gx chip groups. Compared to the former Extreme 3D, the GMA 900 shows significant progress in performance, but remains at a very basic level compared to other graphic acceleration programmes. For example, its 3D core lacks hardware support for 3D accelerator technologies such as T&L and similar top-hulls, and instead is supported by software simulations that reduce the compatibility and performance of 3D games.

source_text:
GMA 3000
946GZ, Q965 和 Q963 芯片组集成的显示核心为GMA 3000。 GMA 3000 的3D 核心与 X3000 的完全不同，虽然名称很类似。它更多的基于之前 GMA 900 和 GMA 950 显示核心的体系，并且与它们同属于 "i915" 芯片组家族。它的像素和顶点渲染单元只支援到shader model 2.0 的特性，并且顶点渲染单元依旧只是软件模拟的方式工作。另外视频播放的硬件加速，即基于硬件的离散余弦变换，ProcAmp（独立视频流的色彩校正）和 VC-1 的解码并没有在硬件上实现。在所有集成 GMA 3000 显示核心的芯片组中，只有 Q965 保留了双重独立显示器的支持。规格表中的核心频率为400 MHz，像素填充率为1.6 Gpixel/s，然而在硬件白皮书中它的核心频率却为667 MHz。
target_text: GMA 3000 946 GZ, Q965 and Q963 core displays GMA 3000 cores. GMA 3000 core 3D cores are completely different from X3000, although their names are similar. It is more based on the previous GMA 900 and GMA 950 core systems, and they belong to the "i915" family. source_text: 整个核心由不同时钟频率的单元组成，这就意味着整块芯片并不运行在相同的时钟频率上，这会使得衡量它多种功能的峰值输出时引起一些麻烦。更令人混乱的是，在 Intel G965 芯片组的白皮书中，它的核心频率为667 MHz，然而在 Intel G965 的规格表中却为 400 MHz。有多种方式能够定义 IGP 显示核心的能力，最常见的是核心每时钟频率能够进行1.6个像素和3.2个材质渲染。像素渲染的最大潜力为每时钟频率2.0个像素渲染，这只存在于一个"clear"循环中。相类似的，它能够进行每时钟频率4个像素渲染的深度操作，与此同时材质渲染率降低到每时钟频率 3.2个像素。导致当 X3000 工作于 667 MHz 时理论上的填充率为1067 megapixels/s 和 2133 megatexel/s。
target_text: The entire core is made up of units with different clock frequencies, which means that the whole chip does not run on the same clock frequency, which causes some difficulty in measuring the peak output of its multiple functions. More confusing is the fact that in the White Paper of the Intel G965, its core frequency is 667 MHz, but in the Standard Table of Intel G965, it is 400 MHz. There are a number of ways to define the IGP ability to display the core, the most common being that the core is capable of producing 1.6 pixels and 3.2 pixels per clock frequency. The maximum potential for pixel rehearsing is 2.0 pixels per clock frequency, which is only present in a "clear" cycle. Similarly, it is capable of performing a depth operation of 4 pixels per clock frequency, while at the same time it is reduced to 3.2 pixels per clock.

可供Yum下载的软件包包括Fedora本身的软件包以及源自rpmfusion 等非官方软件仓库的软件包，全部是由Linux社区维护的，并且基本是自由软件。所有的包都有一个独立的GPG签名，主要是为了用户的系统安全。对于Fedora core 4及更高版本的用户，来自新软件仓库的签名是自动导入并安装的。
target_text: The packages that Yum can download include Fedora's own packages and those from unofficial software warehouses such as rpmfusion, all maintained by the Linux community and basically free software. All packages are signed by an independent GPG, mainly for user system security. For users of Fedora core 4 and higher versions, signatures from the new software warehouse are automatically imported and installed.
title: Yellowdog Updater, Modified

source_text: 画图（英文 MS Paint或者Microsoft Paint）是图像绘画程序，是微软公司Windows操作系统的預載軟件之一。自從發佈以來，大部分的Windows操作系统都內建了這個軟體。這個軟體可以打开并查看WMF和EMF文件，打开並保存BMP（24-bit、256色、16色和單色）、JPEG、GIF（不包括透明和動畫數據，但Windows 98和更新後的Windows 95可以支援後者）、PNG（不包括阿尔法通道）以及TIFF格式的图像文件。比较舊的小畫家版本不支持PNG格式，也只能在使用图像过滤的情况下打开GIF、JPEG、和TIFF文件。另外，新版本不再支持PCX格式，以及其他比较古老的格式（例如RLE）。新版本也不再支持在Windows 3.x中的画笔以及Windows 1和2中的画图所支持的MSP文件格式。
target_text: Painting (MS Paint or Microsoft Paint) is an image drawing program that is one of the pre-screened software applications for Microsoft Windows operating systems. Since its release, most Windows operating systems have built this software. This software allows for opening and viewing WMF and EMF files, opening and preserving BMP (24-bit, 256 colours, 16 colours and monochromatics), JPEG, GIF (excluding transparent and animation data, but Windows 98 and the updated Windows 95 can support later generations), PNG (excluding the Alpha Channel) and TIFF. The older versions of small painters do not support the PNG format, and can only open GIF, JPEG, and TIFF files using image filtering. Furthermore, the new versions no longer support the PCX format, but also other older versions (e.g. RLE).
title: 画图

source_text: 深度作業系統，亦稱為deepin，原名Hiweed Linux及Linux deepin，是武汉深之度科技有限公司开发的开源操作系统。它是基于Debian的稳定版本的一个Linux发行版。它可以运行在个人计算机和服务器上，并免费提供给个人用户使用。据DistroWatch的数据，截至2017年，deepin是最受欢迎的源自中国的Linux发行版。2019年，华为开始销售预装有深度操作系统的笔记本电脑。
target_text: Deep Business, also known as Deepin, originally known as Hiweed Linux and Linux Deepin, an open-source operating system developed by Wuhan Deep Science Ltd. It is a Linux release based on a stable version of Debian. It can run on personal computers and servers and be used by individual users free of charge. As of 2017, Deepin was the most popular Chinese-origin Linux release. In 2019, China began to sell laptops with deep operating systems.
title: 深度操作系统

source_text: 2011年，deepin开发团队成立武汉深之度科技有限公司，以支持深度操作系统的商业开发。成立首年，深之度即获得商业投资。2015年，深度开发团队科技加入Linux基金会。2019年，华为开始销售预装有深度操作系统专业版的笔记本电脑，但华为笔记本预装的深度操作系统只提供基础功能，不预装深度应用商店。
target_text: In 2011, the Deepin development team set up Wuhan Deep Science Ltd. to support the commercial development of the deep operating system. In its first year of existence, the depth of business investment was obtained. In 2015, the Deep Development team joined the Linux Foundation. In 2019, China began the sale of laptop computers pre-loaded with specialized versions of the deep operating system, but it provided only basic functionality for the in-depth operating system pre-loaded and did not pre-load deep application stores.
title: 深度操作系统

source_text: 目前Deepin系统已支持超過40種不同的語言，參與的社區用戶和開發者超過300人。深度科技每年会举办一次深度操作系統用戶與開發者大會，截至2022年底，大會已举办12届。在Ubuntu开发商Canonical宣布终止俄罗斯业务后，2022年5月18日举办的线上发布会上，deepin宣布将脱离Debian社区，并建设“中国桌面操作系统根社区”。
target_text: At the end of 2022, the Congress had held 12 sessions. Following the announcement by Ubuntu developer Canonical that Russian operations had been terminated, on 18 May 2022, Deepin announced that he would leave the Debian community and build “China’s desktop operating system root community.”
title: 深度操作系统

source_text:
软件
除了深度桌面环境（DDE），deepin系统包含多个专门针对deepin开发的软件，如深度控制中心、深度商店等，并根据GPL第三版协议开放源代码。Deepin也附带了一系列由deepin开发团队制作的应用程序，包括深度影院、深度终端、深度启动盘制作器、深度录屏、深度录音、深度截图、深度图像查看器、深度编辑器等等。
target_text: In addition to the Deep Desktop Environment (DDE), the Deepin system contains a number of software specifically designed for Deepin, such as the Deep Control Centre, the Deep Shop, etc., and is open to source code under the GPL III protocol. Deepin also has a series of applications produced by the Deepin development team, including the Deep cinema, the Deep Terminal, the Deep Start Disk Maker, the Deep Recorder, the Deep Recorder, the Deep Screen, the Deep Image Viewer, the Deep Editor, etc.
title: 深度操作系统

source_text:
特性
模組化方式使Slax容易加入其他軟件，这使得定制Slax成为一件很容易的事情。在它的usb或者liveCD版本安装或者卸载软件，使用者只需下載包含該軟件的Slackware組件，並將它拷貝到Slax的/slax/modules目录下面即可。Slax的软件管理是Slackware的管理方式，依赖关系需要用户自行解决。此外，Slackware的软件包可通过tgz2lzm命令转化成Slax的模块，当然借助deb2lzm用户也可以将强大的debian包转化成Slax的模块。
target_text: Features Modification makes it easy for Slax to join other software, making customizing Slax an easy task. Installing or unmounting the software in its usb or LiveCD version simply downloads the Slackware component, which contains the software, and copying it under the Slax/slax/modules directory. Slax software management is how Slackware manages, and relying on relationships requires user resolution. Furthermore, Slackware's package can be transformed into a slax module through the tgz2lzm command, and, of course, by deb2lzm users can convert a powerful debian package into a slax module.
title: Slax

source_text: 高级打包工具（，缩写为）是Debian及其衍生的Linux軟體包管理器。APT可以自动下载，配置，安裝二进制或者源代码格式的软件包，因此简化了Unix系統上管理软件的过程。APT最早被設計成dpkg的前端，用來處理deb格式的軟件包。現在經過APT-RPM組織修改，APT已經可以安裝在支援RPM的系統管理RPM套件。
target_text: The advanced package tool (as abbreviated) is the Debian and its derivative Linux software package manager. The APT can automatically download, configure, install binary or source code-format software packages, thus simplifying the process of managing software on the Unix system. The APT was first designed as the front end of dpkg to handle software packages in the Deb format. Now, modified by the APT-RPM organization, the APT can already be installed in a system management RPM package that supports RPM.
title: APT

source_text:
软件包（packaged software）是对于一种软件所进行打包的方式。在不同的操作系统中，软件包的类型有很大的区别。对于Linux、BSD系统
在Linux、BSD系统中，软件包主要以两种形式出现：二进制包以及源代码包。二进制包
rpm：传统的red hat linux二进制包。
deb：debian系列的二进制包。
Autopackage源码包管理
源代码包则主要适用于自由软件的安装，用户需要自己编译它们。
portage：gentoo的包管理工具。
target_text: The package (packaged softwareware) is the way in which a software is packaged. In different operating systems, the type of package varies considerably. For Linux, BSD systems, in Linux, BSD systems, the package appears mainly in two forms: binary packages and source packages. Binary packages rpm: traditional reded hat linux binary packages. deb: binary packages of the debian series. Autopackage source packages are mainly applicable to the installation of free software, and users need to compile them themselves.
title: 软件包

source_text: Chessmaster是育碧软件公司发行的一款国际象棋游戏，它不仅提供了一个与众多实力相当高的计算机选手对弈的机会，还提供了能帮助玩家提供游戏水平的工具，如错棋分析、测验、开局学习等。游戏还提供了新的在线功能。包含了大量的个人指导和象棋资料，还有介绍国际象棋规则和战略的指南。该游戏画面相当精彩，尤其是不同的角色和战斗动画，甚至能引起不少初学者不小的兴趣。程序中有大量各个水平的虚拟棋手可供对战，等级（大师分）从十余分至超过2700分不等，同时各个棋手还有自己的特点（Personalities），如偏向进攻、保守、善于快棋等等。
target_text: Chessmaster, a chess game issued by Yuphi Software, not only provides an opportunity to compete with a large number of powerful computer players, but also provides a tool to help players provide a level of play, such as wrong chess analysis, testing, opening learning, etc. The game also provides new online functionality. It contains a large amount of personal guidance and chess information, as well as guidance on chess rules and strategies. The game is impressive, especially with different characters and combat animations, and even attracts the interest of many early scholars.
title: Chessmaster

source_text:
互联网上的匿名
在互联网上，匿名是互联网独特的一种特性。1993年《纽约客》杂志上彼得·斯坦纳的一幅漫画被网民们所信奉。这幅漫画的标题是“在网上，没有人知道你是一条狗”。虽然在网络上匿名给予了人们更大的自由（阅读与发布信息的自由），但是其代价则是丧失了信息来源的确定性，而且也会引发许多不良的和违法的行为。例如网络色情、诽谤性的言论，欺诈行为，侵犯版权等等。
target_text: Anonymity on the Internet is a unique feature of the Internet. A 1993 New Yorker magazine's cartoon by Peter Steiner was endorsed by Internet users. The cartoon is entitled “Online, no one knows you are a dog.” While anonymity on the Internet gives people greater freedom (freedom to read and publish information), it costs losing certainty as to the source of information, and it also causes many undesirable and illegal acts, such as Internet pornography, defamatory statements, frauds, copyright violations, etc.
title: 匿名

source_text:
访问数据库的程序自主决定数据如何储存在记录里，Berkeley DB不对记录里的数据进行任何包装。记录和它的键都可以达到4G字节的长度。尽管架构很简单，Berkeley DB却支持很多高级的数据库特性，比如ACID 数据库事务处理，细粒度锁，XA接口，热备份以及同步复制。Berkeley DB與SQLite的整合
Berkeley DB 11g R2加入SQLite程式組件並開始支援SQL語言。
target_text: The process of accessing the database determines how the data is stored in the records, and the Berkeley DB does not package the data in the records. Both records and their keys can reach the 4G byte length. Despite the simplicity of the structure, Berkeley DB supports a number of advanced database features, such as ACID database processing, fine particle locks, XA interfaces, thermal backups, and synchronization. Berkeley DB and SQLite integration Berkeley DB 11g R2 add SQLite components and start supporting SQL language.
title: Berkeley DB

source_text: 理论方面，微扰量子色动力学也有许多新的成果。为处理高阶修正产生的发散（也就是高阶修正在某些情况下趋近于无穷大），人们发展了QCD因子化定理，将发散吸收到普适的部分子分布函数或者部分子碎裂函数中。人们利用计算机和符号计算软件，将微扰量子色动力学推进到3圈的精度，也就是的修正。计算到这个精度，需要处理几万甚至几十万个费曼图，需要用高性能计算机，更重要的是高效率高智能的符号计算软件。这方面的进展，是人类通过机器扩展自己能力极限的惊人之作。
target_text: Theoretically, there are many new results in microdisturbing quantum colour dynamics. In order to deal with the spread of high-level amendments (i.e., high-level amendments are in some cases closer to infinity), people have developed QCD factored theorems, absorbing it into the universal sub-distribution function or part of the sub-break function.
title: 量子色動力學

source_text:
V模型是最具有代表意义的测试模型。V模型是软件开发瀑布模型的变种，它反映了测试活动与分析和设计的关系 。
从左到右，描述了基本的开发过程和测试行为，非常明确地标明了测试过程中存在的不同级别，并且清楚地描述了这些测试阶段和开发过程期间各阶段的对应关系 。
左边依次下降的是开发过程各阶段，与此相对应的是右边依次上升的部分，即各测试过程的各个阶段。
target_text: The V model is the most representative test model. The V model is a variant of the software development waterfall model that reflects the relationship between the test activity and the analysis and design.
title: 软件测试模型

source_text:
V模型问题：
测试是开发之后的一个阶段。
测试的对象就是程序本身。
实际应用中容易导致需求阶段的错误一直到最后系统测试阶段才被发现。
整个软件产品的过程质量保证完全依赖于开发人员的能力和对工作的责任心，而且上一步的结果必须是充分和正确的，如果任何一个环节出了问题，则必将严重的影响整个工程的质量和预期进度
target_text: The process quality assurance of the entire software product depends entirely on the ability of the developer and on his or her responsibility for the work, and the results of the previous step must be adequate and correct, and if anything goes wrong, it will seriously affect the quality and expected progress of the entire project.
title: 软件测试模型

source_text:
W模型
W模型由Evolutif公司公司提出，相对于V模型，W模型增加了软件各开发阶段中应同步进行的验证和确认活动。W模型由两个V字型模型组成，分别代表测试与开发过程，图中明确表示出了测试与开发的并行关系。W模型中测试与开发对应关系如下：开发：需求分析、概要设计、　　详细设计、　　编码、　　软件集成、系统集成、部署
↑　　　　↑　　　　　　　↑　　　　　↑　　　　　　↑　　　　↑　　　↑
测试：需求评审、概要设计评审、详细设计评审、单元测试、集成测试、系统测试、验收测试
target_text: The W model W was proposed by Evolutif, and the W model added to the V model the validation and validation activities that should be synchronized at each stage of software development. The W model consists of two V font models representing the testing and development process, which clearly indicates the parallel relationship between the testing and development. The W model tested and developed the following: development: needs analysis, outline design, detailed design, coding, software integration, system integration, deployment,       test: needs review, outline design evaluation, detailed design review, unit testing, integration testing, system testing, acceptance testing
title: 软件测试模型

source_text:
W模型强调：测试伴随着整个软件开发周期，而且测试的对象不仅仅是程序，需求、设计等同样要测试，也就是说，测试与开发是同步进行的。W模型有利于尽早地全面的发现问题。例如，需求分析完成后，测试人员就应该参与到对需求的验证和确认活动中，以尽早地找出缺陷所在。同时，对需求的测试也有利于及时了解项目难度和测试风险，及早制定应对措施，这将显著减少总体测试时间，加快项目进度。
但W模型也存在局限性。在W模型中，需求、设计、编码等活动被视为串行的，同时，测试和开发活动也保持着一种线性的前后关系，上一阶段完全结束，才可正式开始下一个阶段工作。这样就无法支持迭代的开发模型。对于当前软件开发复杂多变的情况，W模型并不能解除测试管理面临着困惑。
target_text: The W model emphasizes that testing is accompanied by the entire software development cycle, and that testing is not just about the program, demand, design, etc., that is, that testing and development are synchronized. The W model facilitates the early and comprehensive identification of problems. For example, once the needs analysis is completed, the tester should be involved in the validation and validation of needs in order to identify deficiencies as early as possible.
title: 软件测试模型

source_text:
H模型
在H模型中，软件测试的过程活动完全独立，形成了一个完全独立的流程，贯穿于整个产品的周期，与其他流程并发进行，某个测试点准备就绪后就可以从测试准备阶段进行到测试执行阶段；软件测试可以根据被测产品的不同分层进行。X模型
X模型也是对V模型的改进,X模型提出针对单独的程序片段进行相互分离的编码和测试,此后通过频繁的交接,通过集成最终合成为可执行的程序。
target_text: In H models, the process activity for software testing is completely independent, forming a fully stand-alone process that runs through the product cycle, in parallel with other processes, where a test point is ready from the test preparation stage to the test execution stage; software testing can be carried out according to the different layers of the product being tested. The X models are also an improvement on the V model, and the X models propose separate coding and testing of individual sequences, which are then integrated and eventually synthesized into executable programs.
title: 软件测试模型

source_text:
X模型的左边描述的是针对单独程序片段所进行的相互分离的编码和测试，此后将进行频繁的交接，通过集成最终成为可执行的程序，
然后再对这些可执行程序进行测试。己通过集成测试的成品可以进行封装并提交给用户，也可以作为更大规模和范围内集成的一部分。
多根并行的曲线表示变更可以在各个部分发生。由图中可见，X模型还定位了探索性测试，这是不进行事先计划的特殊类型的测试，
这一方式往往能帮助有经验的测试人员在测试计划之外发现更多的软件错误。但这样可能对测试造成人力、物力和财力的浪费，
对测试员的熟练程度要求比较高。
target_text: The left side of the X model describes the separate coding and testing of individual program fragments, after which there will be frequent handovers, which will eventually become executable by integration and then test the executables. The products that have been tested through integration can be sealed and presented to the user, or as part of a larger and larger-scale integration. Multiple parallel curves indicate that changes can take place in various parts. As can be seen, the X model also locates exploratory tests, which are specific types of tests that are not planned in advance, often by helping experienced testers to find more software errors outside the testing scheme.
title: 软件测试模型

source_text: 稀疏矩阵（），在数值分析中，是其元素大部分为零的矩阵。反之，如果大部分元素都非零，则这个矩阵是稠密(dense)的。在科学与工程领域中求解线性模型时经常出现大型的稀疏矩阵。在使用计算机存储和操作稀疏矩阵时，经常需要修改标准算法以利用矩阵的稀疏结构。由于其自身的稀疏特性，通过压缩可以大大节省稀疏矩阵的内存代价。更为重要的是，由于过大的尺寸，标准的算法经常无法操作这些稀疏矩阵。
target_text: A thinner matrix () is, in numerical analysis, a matrix of mostly zero elements. Conversely, if most of the elements are not zero, the matrix is dense. Large thin arrays are often found in scientific and engineering modems. In computer storage and operation of thinner matrices, standard algorithms often need to be modified to take advantage of the thinner structure of the matrix. Because of their own thinner properties, the internal cost of thinner matrices can be greatly saved by compression. More importantly, standard algorithms often fail to operate these thinner matrices because of their oversized dimensions.
title: 稀疏矩阵

source_text: 現時，-{zh-cn:绿色软件; zh-tw:綠色軟體}-的定義和-{zh-cn:可携式软件; zh-tw:可攜式軟體}-（Portableware）十分接近，一般指可以連同設定資料一併置於可移除式儲存媒體內轉移至不同電腦使用或可在網絡硬碟上運行的應用軟體。由於設定檔（如ini檔或xml檔）是置於程式資料夾內而非寫入登錄或其他位置，因此轉移到不同電腦後仍可正常執行；移除儲存裝置後紀錄也不會將資料留在本機電腦上。這種設計架構的軟體可存取即用，使很多人都把程式「帶著走」，以便自己在不同地方使用相同的設定，尤其是具備人性化設定的瀏覽器軟件，這使得可攜式軟體得到普及。
target_text: At the moment, {zh-cn: Green Software; zh-tw: Green Software} definitions and {zh-cn: Portable Software; zh-tw: Portable Software}- (Portableware) are very close, generally referring to applications that can be moved to different computer applications or that can be operated on web-based hard disks in combination with configuration data. Since configuration files (e.g., inini or xml files) are placed in the program folder instead of writing log-ins or other locations, migration to different computers can still be carried out properly; removal of the storage device from the record will not leave the data on the computer. source_text:
奎因－麦克拉斯基算法（Quine-McCluskey算法）是最小化布尔函数的一种方法。它在功能上等同于卡诺图，但是它具有文字表格的形式，因此它更适合用于电子设计自动化算法的实现，并且它还给出了检查布尔函数是否达到了最小化形式的确定性方法。方法涉及两步：
找到这个函数的所有素蕴涵项。
使用这些素蕴涵项（prime implicant）来找到这个函数的本质素蕴涵项（essential prime implicant），对覆盖这个函数是必须的其他素蕴涵项也同样要使用。
target_text: The Quinn-McCluskey algorithm is one way to minimize the boolean function. It is functionally equivalent to the Kanoto function, but it is in the form of a text form, so it is more suitable for use in electronic design automation algorithms, and it also gives a definitive way to check whether the boolean function has reached its minimum form. The method involves two steps: finding all the contents of the function. Using the prime implicant to find the essence content of the function, which is equally used for other content that is necessary to cover the function.
title: 奎因-麦克拉斯基算法

source_text:
复杂度
尽管在处理多于四个变量的时候比卡诺图更加实用，奎因－麦克拉斯基算法也有使用限制，因为它解决的问题是NP-困难的：奎因－麦克拉斯基算法的运行时间随输入大小而呈指数增长。可以证明对于n个变量的函数，素蕴涵项的数目的上界是3n/n。如果n = 32，则可能超过6.1 * 1014，或617万亿个素蕴涵项。有大量变量的函数必须使用潜在的非最优的启发式方法来最小化。
target_text: Complexity, though more practical than Kanoto when dealing with more than four variables, is also limited by the use of the Quinn-Mclaski algorithm, which solves the problem NP-difficult: the running time of the Quinn-Mclaski algorithm increases exponentially with the size of the input. It can be demonstrated that the upper limit of the number of content items is 3 n/n for a function of n variables. If n = 32, it may exceed 6.1 * 1014 or 61.7 trillion content items.
title: 奎因-麦克拉斯基算法

source_text:
设计
GFS专门为Google的核心数据即页面搜索的存储进行了优化。数据使用大到若干G字节的大文件持续存储，而这些文件极少被删除、覆盖或者减小；通常只是进行添加或读取操作。它也是针对Google的计算机集群进行的设计和优化，这些节点是由廉价的“常用”计算机组成，这就意味着必须防止单个节点的高损害率和随之带来的数据丢失。其它设计理念包括高数据吞吐率，甚至这带来了存取反应期变差。
target_text: The GFS is designed to optimize the storage of Google's core data, page searches. The data are stored continuously using large files larger than a number of G bytes, which are rarely deleted, overwrited or reduced; usually simply add-and-read operations. It is also designed and optimized for Google's computer cluster, which consists of cheap “common” computers, which means that the high damage rate of individual nodes and the resulting loss of data must be prevented. Other design concepts include high data nodes, which even lead to a change in access response periods.
title: Google檔案系統

source_text:
批评意见
只能有一个主服务器——代码不允许存在多个主服务器。这看起来是限制系统可扩展性和可靠性的一个缺陷，因为系统的最大存储容量和正常工作时间受制于主服务器的容量和正常工作时间，也因为它要将所有的元数据进行编制，并且因为几乎所有的动作和请求都经过它；但是Google的工程师们辩解说事实并不是这样。元数据是非常紧凑的，仅仅只有数K到数M的大小，并且主服务器通常是网络上性能最好的节点之一；至于可靠性，通常有一个“影子”主服务器制作主服务器的镜像，一旦主服务器失败它将接替工作。另外，主服务器极少成为瓶颈，因为客户端仅仅取得元数据然后将它们缓存起来；随后的交互工作是直接与chunkservers进行。同样，使用单个的主服务器可以大幅度地降低软件的复杂性，如果有多个的主服务器，软件将变得复杂以能够保证数据完整性、自动操作、负载均衡和安全性。
target_text: Criticism can only be based on one main server - the code does not allow multiple main servers. This appears to be a flaw in limiting the system's scalability and reliability, since the maximum storage capacity and normal working hours of the system are subject to the capacity and normal working hours of the main server, and because it is required to compile all metadata, and because almost all movements and requests pass through it; but Google's engineers argue that this is not the case. The metadata are very compact, with only the size of K-to-M, and the main server is usually one of the best nodes of network performance; as for reliability, there is usually a “shadow” main server that produces mirrors of the main server that will replace it once the main server fails. Moreover, the main server rarely becomes a bottleneck, because the client simply obtains metadata and then saves them; then the interactive work is done directly with chunksersvers.
title: Google檔案系統

source_text: 在老式的采用RS-232串行口连接的计算机终端，哑终端指不能执行诸如“删行”、“清屏”或“控制光标位置”的一些特殊ANSI转义序列（escape sequences）的计算机终端。在此意义上，哑终端还被称作玻璃电传打字机（glass teletypes），因为它与电传打字机有着类似的有限功能。这类哑终端仍然被现代的类Unix操作系统所支持。可以将系统的环境变量TERM设置为dumb来启用支持。（smart或intelligent是指那些支持ANSI转义序列的终端。
target_text: In the old version of a computer terminal connected to RS-232, the dumb terminal refers to a computer terminal that cannot perform a number of special ANSI conversion sequences, such as “delete”, “clean screen” or “control cursor positions.” In this sense, the dumb terminal is also called glass teletypes, because it has a similar limited function to an telex typewriter. The dumb terminal is still supported by a modern type of Unix operating system. The system's environmental variable TERM can be set to domb to enable support. source_text: MapReduce是Google提出的一个软件架构，用于大规模数据集的并行运算。概念“Map（映射）”和“Reduce（归约）”，及他们的主要思想，都是从函数式编程语言借鉴的，还有从矢量编程语言借来的特性。当前的软件实现是指定一个“Map”（映射）函数，用来把一组键值对映射成一组新的键值对，指定并发的“Reduce”（归约）函数，用来保证所有映射的键值对中的每一个共享相同的键组。
target_text: MapReduce is a software architecture developed by Google for parallel calculations of large-scale data sets. Concepts “Map” and “Reduce” and their main ideas are drawn from the functional programming language, as well as features borrowed from the vector programming language. The current software realization is the designation of a “Map” function, which is used to map a set of key values into a new set of key pairs, and the simultaneous “Reduce” function, which is used to ensure that each of the mapd key pairs shares the same key sets.

source_text: 戴克斯特拉算法（），又稱迪杰斯特拉算法、Dijkstra算法，是由荷兰计算机科学家艾茲赫尔·戴克斯特拉在1956年发现的算法，并于3年后在期刊上发表。戴克斯特拉算法使用类似廣度优先搜索的方法解决赋权图的单源最短路径问题。该算法存在很多变体：戴克斯特拉的原始版本仅适用于找到两个顶点之间的最短路径，后来更常见的变体固定了一个顶点作为源结点然后找到该顶点到图中所有其它结点的最短路径，产生一个最短路径树。
target_text: The Dixtra algorithm, also known as the Dijkstra algorithm, was discovered by Dutch computer scientist Ezher Dixtra in 1956 and published in a journal three years later. The Dixtra algorithm solves the shortest path of the single source of the empowerment map using a similar wide-scale priority search. There are many variations in the algorithm: Dixtra’s original version is only for finding the shortest path between the two peaks, and the more common variant then fixes a top as the source point and then finds the shortest path to all the other nodes in the map, producing a shortest path tree.
title: 戴克斯特拉算法

source_text: 该算法解决了圖 上带权的单源最短路径问题。具体来说，戴克斯特拉算法设置了一顶点集合，在集合中所有的顶点与源点之间的最终最短路径权值均已确定。算法反复选择最短路径估计最小的点并将加入中。该算法常用于路由算法或者作为其他图算法的一个子模块。举例来说，如果图中的顶点表示城市，而边上的权重表示城市间开车行经的距离，该演算法可以用来找到两个城市之间的最短路径。
target_text: The algorithm solves the problem of the shortest single-source path with rights on the map. target_text: Dextra, when he was a programmer at the Netherlands Institute of Mathematics and Computer Science in 1956, had thought about the solution to the problem of the shortest path in order to demonstrate the functionality of the new computer ARMAC. His goal was to make the problem and the solution understandable to those who could not actually calculate, and he then made a simple experiment with ARMAC after discovering the algorithm. In 1959, he officially published it in a journal, and the algorithm became one of the cornerstones of Dexter’s name.
title: 戴克斯特拉算法

source_text:
数据库营销（Database Marketing）将营销和客户数据建立数据库，并根据对数据库内数据的分析，进行营销策略和活动。数据库营销常被视作是“直效营销”（Direct marketing）的一个分支，也是一種關係行銷，並且強化客户管理和忠誠度。方法
将客户的销售历史数据等营销数据建立数据库，并根据对数据库内数据的分析，确认目标客户，迅速准确地获知其需求，了解其特征，传达产品和服务的相关信息，以便更有效地进行市场营销活动，维系顾客和提高销售额。
target_text: Database marketing (Database Marketing) creates a database of marketing and client data and conducts marketing strategies and activities based on analysis of data in the database. Database marketing is often seen as a branch of Direct Marketing and is also a matter of relationship marketing and strengthens customer management and loyalty.
title: 数据库营销

source_text:
数据库营销旨在建立互信共赢的客户关系，数据库服务过程本身即可视为数据库营销过程。数据库的数据必须是动态的，可扩充的和及时更新的，涵盖现有客户和潜在客户。数据库的海量处理往往要依赖数据挖掘（Data Mining）技术。意义与现状
数据库营销不仅仅被视为是一种营销工具、方法或者技术平台，而是一种企业经营理念，深刻地改变了企业的营销模式以及服务模式。
target_text: Database marketing is aimed at building mutually trusted and win-win customer relationships, and the database service process itself can be considered as a database marketing process. Database data must be dynamic, expandable and up-to-date, covering existing clients and potential customers.
title: 数据库营销

source_text:
数据库营销在欧美国家的市场营销实践中已相当普及。美国85%的零售商和制造商认为一个强大的营销数据库来支持他们的营销活动，以增强竞争力。2003年，美国数据库营销专家唐·E·舒尔兹在清华大学演讲时说：行业实例
例如在电信行业，用户基数成长到海量规模时，与客户的沟通通过信函、电话、电子邮件就难以解决了，而利用数据挖掘技术就能从海量的数据中找出最易流失的客户，并利用营销工具对其加强沟通来维持他们的品牌忠诚度。
target_text: In 2003, the US database marketing expert Don E. Schultz, speaking at Qinghua University, said that in the case of telecommunications, for example, when the base of users rises to a large size, communication with customers is difficult to solve through letters, telephones, e-mails, and data mining techniques can identify the most vulnerable customers from big data and use marketing tools to enhance communication with them to maintain their brand loyalty.
title: 数据库营销

三片DLP投影仪
三片DLP投影仪内部安装三片DMD芯片，光源发出的光被棱镜分离成三路，这三路光线经过滤光分别成为红、绿、蓝三种颜色，然后分别照射到相应的DMD芯片上。最后，三束经过DMD芯片调制的光线借助棱镜再重新合并成一路光线，并通过镜头投射到屏幕上。三片DLP系统能够显示35万亿种颜色，相比之下，单片DLP系统却只能够显示1670万种颜色。
target_text: Three DLP projectors installed three DLD chips inside the DLP projector, and the light from the light source was separated by the prism into three paths, filtering the light into red, green, blue, and then into the corresponding DDD chip. Finally, three beams of light from the DDD chip modem were recombined with the prism and were projected on the screen. Three DLP systems were able to display 3.5 trillion colours, compared to a single DLP system showing only 16.7 million colours.
title: 数字光处理

source_text: 大部分DSP使用的是定點算法，這是因為在信號處理的一般實際應用中不需要使用浮點運算比定點運算多提供的那部分額外的精度範圍，而使用定點算法犧牲了不需要的精度，卻大大提高了速度。另一方面，浮點DSP則常用在科學計算和某些需要高精度的應用中。
target_text: Most DSPs use fixed-point algorithms, because they do not need to use the extra precision range provided by floating-point operations in the general practical applications of signal processing, while using the fixed-point algorithms, while sacrificing the required accuracy, greatly increases speed. On the other hand, floating-point DSPs are often used in scientific calculations and in some applications that require high-precision.

source_text: 其他大型海王星外天体在21世纪初才被发现。它们得到发现时一般会被视为行星，而此前天文学家已经很少使用行星符号。麻薩諸塞州软件工程师丹尼斯·莫斯科维茨（Denis Moskowitz）提出矮行星创神星、塞德娜、亡神星、妊神星、阋神星、鸟神星和共工星的符号。这些符号常见于占星学社群（例如在软件中）。莫斯科维茨也提出小行星20000、小行星28978和小行星120347的符号，而其他人也提议其他海王星外天体的符号，但各篇文献所用的符号不太一致。NASA已经在天文学语境下使用了莫斯科维茨的妊神星、鸟神星和阋神星的符号，而Unicode将（于2022年添加的）妊神星、鸟神星、共工星、创神星和亡神星的符号标注为“天文符号”。由于Unicode收录塞德娜的符号，下表会包括该符号。

source_text:
保留扇区，位于最开始的位置。 第一个保留扇区是引导扇区（分区启动记录）。它包括一个称为基本输入输出参数块的区域（包括一些基本的文件系统信息尤其是它的类型和其它指向其它扇区的指针），通常包括操作系统的启动调用代码。保留扇区的总数记录在引导扇区中的一个参数中。引导扇区中的重要信息可以被DOS和OS/2中称为驱动器参数块的操作系统结构访问。
FAT区域。它包含有两份文件分配表，这是出于系统冗余考虑，尽管它很少使用，即使是磁盘修复工具也很少使用它。它是分区信息的映射表，指示簇是如何存储的。
根目录区域。它是在根目录中存储文件和目录信息的目录表。在FAT32下它可以存在分区中的任何位置，但是在早期的版本中它永远紧随FAT区域之后。
数据区域。这是实际的文件和目录数据存储的区域，它占据了分区的绝大部分。通过简单地在FAT中添加文件链接的个数可以任意增加文件大小和子目录个数（只要有空簇存在）。然而需要注意的是每个簇只能被一个文件占有，这样的话如果在32KB大小的簇中有一个1KB大小的文件，那么31KB的空间就浪费掉了。
target_text: The number of sectors is recorded in one of the parameters in the lead sector. The key information in the lead sector can be accessed by the operating system structure called the drive parameter in DOS and OS/2. The FAT area contains two file allocation tables, which are considered to be a system redundancy, although it is rarely used, even if it is a disk repair tool. It is a map of the area information, which indicates how it is stored. The root directory is a catalogue of files and catalogue information in the root directory. It can be stored in any location in the partition under FAT32, but in earlier versions it can always follow the FAT area. The data area is an area where actual document and catalogue data are stored, although it is rarely used.

source_text: -{zh-hans:分区; zh-hant:分割;}-允许在一个磁盘上有多个文件系统。有许多理由需要这么做：有利于管理，系统一般单独放一个区，这样由于系统区只放系统，其他区不会受到系统盘出现磁盘碎片的性能影响。碍于技术限制（例如旧版的微软FAT文件系统不能访问超过一定的磁盘空间；旧的PC BIOS不允许从超过硬盘1024个柱面的位置启动操作系统）如果一个分区出现逻辑损坏，仅损坏的分区而不是整个硬盘受影响。在一些操作系统（如Linux）交换文件通常自己就是一个分区。在这种情况下，双重启动配置的系统就可以让几个操作系统使用同一个交换分区以节省磁盘空间。避免过大的日志或者其他文件占满导致整个计算机故障，将它们放在独立的分区，这样可能只有那一个分区出现空间耗尽。两个操作系统经常不能存在同一个分区上或者使用不同的“本地”磁盘格式。为了不同的操作系统，将磁盘分成不同的逻辑磁盘。许多文件系统使用固定大小的簇将文件写到磁盘上，这些簇的大小与所在分区文件系统大小直接成比例。如果一个文件大小不是簇大小的整数倍，文件簇组中的最后一个将会有不能被其它文件使用的空闲空间。这样，使用簇的文件系统使得文件在磁盘上所占空间超出它们在内存中所占空间，并且越大的分区意味着越大的簇大小和越大的浪费空间。
target_text: - {zh-hans: partition; zh-hant: partition;} - allows multiple file systems to be installed on a disk. There are many reasons to do this: it is in the interest of management, and the system generally has a separate area, so that other areas are not affected by the performance of disk fragments on the disk because the system area is confined only to the system. In this case, the dual-starting system allows several operating systems to save disk space by using the same exchange area (e.g. the old version of the Microsoft FAT file system does not allow access to more than a certain amount of disk space; the old PC BIOS does not allow the operation system to be activated from a position exceeding the hard disk of 1024 columns. If there is a logical damage in one section, only the damaged partition and not the entire disk is affected.
title: 硬盘分区

source_text: 电子地图（）也称数码地图（），是利用计算机技术、以数码方式存储和查阅的地图。電子地圖儲存資訊的方法，一般使用向量式圖像儲存，地圖比例可放大、縮小或旋轉而不影響顯示效果，早期使用點陣圖式儲存，地圖比例不能放大或縮小，现代电子地图软件一般利用地理信息系统来储存和传送地图数据，也有其他的信息系统。
target_text: Electronic maps () are also referred to as digital maps () that are stored and accessed digitally using computer technology. Electronic maps are used to store information, usually using vector-based images, which can be scaled up, scaled up or rotated without affecting the effect, early use of point-map deposits, which cannot be magnified or scaled down, and modern electronic map software, which generally uses geographic information systems to store and transmit map data, as well as other information systems.

source_text: 为确保宇航员安全返回，路线选择至关重要。如果采用“直接中止”机制，在抵达月球前用服务舱主发动机（服务推进系统）返回，那么不但要确保服务推进系统没有因事故受损，而且燃料电池必须继续供电至少一小时才能满足功率要求。克兰兹决定迂回：航天器先绕月球旋转，转到朝地球方向时再返航。事故发生时，阿波罗13号位于混合轨道，准备前往弗拉·毛罗高地，如今需要回到自由返回轨道。登月舱的下降级推进系统虽不及服务推进系统强劲，但足以完成上述任务。不过，任务规划从未考虑在登月舱操控服务与指令舱，所以需要技术人员在任务控制中心的计算机上编写新软件。洛弗尔关闭指令舱时抄下制导系统方向信息，经过笔算输入登月舱制导系统。接下来任务控制中心根据宇航员要求检查数据，登月舱导航计算机尚处关机状态。任务启动61小时29分43.49秒，下降级推进系统点火34.23秒，将阿波罗13号带回自由返回轨道。
target_text: In order to ensure the safe return of astronauts, route selection is essential. If the “direct suspension” mechanism is used and the main service engine (service propulsion system) is returned before arrival on the Moon, not only will it be necessary to ensure that the service propulsion system is not damaged by an accident, but also that the fuel cell must continue to supply at least one hour of power requirements. Krantz decided to go back: the spacecraft rotated around the moon first and returned to Earth. At the time of the accident, Apollo 13 was in a mixed orbit, preparing to go to the Pla Mauro Heights, and now needs to return to the free track. The down-stage propulsion system in the login module, although not strong enough for the service propulsion system, was sufficient to perform the above-mentioned task. However, mission planning never considered the start of a 61-hour control service and command module, so technicians are required to prepare new software on the computer in the mission control centre.

source_text: 宇航员长时间忍受严寒而且休息不足，可能导致再入前不能准时启动各部件。飞行控制中心在任务第133小时同意洛弗尔全面启动登月舱升温，包括启动登月舱导航计算机。计算机打开后洛弗尔便能导航瞄准并校准登月舱惯性测量单元。指令舱计算机按与登月舱正常设置程序相反的顺序校准，登月舱计算机掌握位置和方位信息，减少重启过程步骤，提升阿波罗主制导、导航与控制系统控制再入的精度。
target_text: Astronauts endure severe cold for long periods of time and lack of rest, which may lead to non-starting of components on time before re-entry. The Flight Control Centre agreed, on mission 133 hours, that Lovell would be fully activated for the lift-up of the Moon module, including the start-up of the Moon module navigation computer. When the computer is open, Lovell will be able to direct and calibrate the Inertity Measurement Unit for the Moon module. The command module computer will be calibrated in a sequence that is contrary to normal accommodation procedures for the Moon module, it will have position and location information, reduce steps in the reboot process, and improve the accuracy of the Apollo master guidance, navigation and control system to control re-entry.

source_text: 在20世纪80年代非常著名的计算机公司康懋达在不伦瑞克有一家工厂，但在90年代初衰弱，传奇的C64就在这里制造的。2014年，不伦瑞克是英特尔在欧洲最大的芯片研发中心，拥有120名员工。从2000年开始，这里已经研发了六款芯片。欧洲高性能计算技术能力中心则重点开发拥有高性能计算机和超级计算机的芯片。英特尔还资助了不伦瑞克工业大学的“高级VLSI（超大规模集成电路）设计”课程，重点研究高度复杂的微芯片技术。在2013年秋季，研发中心关闭，人员随后被富士通接管了。如今，不伦瑞克仍然是德国的IT大本营，IT专家的比例是全国平均水准的三倍。

source_text: 半导体二极管的非线性电流-电压特性，可以根据选择不同的半导体材料和掺杂不同的杂质从而形成杂质半导体来改变。特性改变后的二极管在使用上除了用做開關的方式之外，還有很多其他的功能，如：用来调节电压（齐纳二极管），限制高电压从而保护电路（雪崩二极管），无线电调谐（变容二极管），产生射频振荡（隧道二极管、耿氏二极管、IMPATT二极管）以及产生光（发光二极管）。
target_text: The non-linear current-voltage properties of semiconductor diodes can be modified by selecting different semiconductor materials and mixing different impurities to form impurity semiconductors. The modified properties of diodes have many other functions in addition to the way they are used as switches, such as: regulating voltage (Zina diode), limiting high voltage to protect circuits (Avalanche diodes), radio modulation (modified diodes), generating radio frequency vibrations (tunnel diodes, Gentodes, IMPATT diodes) and generating light (light diodes).

source_text:
历史
20世纪初，由于无线电接收器探测器的需要，热离子二极管（真空管）和固态二极管（半导体二极管）大约在相同的时间分别研发。直到20世纪50年代之前，真空管二极管在收音机中都更为常用。这是因为早期的点接触式半导体二极管（猫鬚探测器）并不稳定，并且那时大多数的收音机放大器都是由真空管制成，二极管可以直接放入其中。而且那时真空管整流器和充气整流器处理一些高电压、高电流整流任务的能力更是远在半导体二极管（如硒整流器）之上。
target_text: At the beginning of the twentieth century, thermoion diodes (vacuum tubes) and solid-state diodes (semiconductor diodes) were developed at approximately the same time, owing to the need for radio receiver detectors. Until the 1950’s, vacuum tubes were more commonly used on radios. This was because the early point-to-point semiconductor diodes (cats detectors) were unstable, and most radio amplifiers were then controlled by vacuums, where they could be placed directly.
title: 二極體

source_text: 整个真空管时代，这种二极管应用于模拟信号，并在消费电子产品（如收音机、电视机、音响系统）的直流供电设备中当做整流器。20世纪40年代，在那些供电设备内的真空管开始被硒整流器所替代，然后在1960年代又被半导体二极管替代。如今，二极管仍然在一些高功率应用场合中使用，由于能够承受瞬变和较好的鲁棒性，使得他们比半导体器件的优势能够显现出来。尤其是音频处理上，真空管基本不存在瞬态互调失真、开关失真及交越失真等影响音质的问题。因此近年来，在音响发烧友和录音棚所用的音频设备中，应用真空二极管的老式音频设备有回潮的迹象，如家用音响系统甚至是吉他效果器。
target_text: During the entire vacuum-pipe era, the diode is still used in high-power applications, allowing them to demonstrate their advantage over semiconductor units, especially in audio processing, where the vacuum tubes are rarely subject to transient decoupling, switch failure, and cross-recording problems that affect sound quality. In recent years, there have been signs of a backsliding of old audio equipment that uses a vacuum diode in audio equipment used by sound-burners and studios, such as sound systems and even guitars.

source_text:
点接触式二极管
点接触式二极管和下文所述的面接触式二极管工作原理类似，不过构造较为简单。主要结构即為一个由第三主族金属制成的导电的尖端，和一块与其相接触的N型半导体。一些金属会进入半导体，接触面的这一小片区域就成为了P型半导体。长期流行的1N34锗型二极管，目前还在无线电接收器中的检波器中使用，并有时会在一些应用模拟电子的场合使用。
target_text: A point-to-point diode, a point-to-point diode, and a face-to-face diode, as described below, work on the same principles, but with a simpler structure. The main structure is the cutting edge of a guidance made of third-dominant metals and an N semi-conductor. Some metals enter into semiconductors, and this small area of exposure becomes a P semi-conductor. The long-prevalence 1N34 diode, which is currently used in a wave detector in a radio receiver and is sometimes used in a number of applications of analog electrons.
title: 二極體

source_text: 面接触式PN结二极管是由一块半导体晶体制成的。不同的掺杂工艺可以使同一个半导体（如本征硅）的一端成为一个包含负极性载流子（电子）的区域，称作N型半导体；另一端成为一个包含正极性载流子（空穴）的区域，称作P型半导体。两种材料在一起时，电子会从N型一侧流向P型一侧。这一区域電子和電洞相互抵銷，造成中间区域載流子不足，形成“空乏層”。在空乏層内部存在“内电场”：N型側帶正電，P型側帶負電。两块区域的交界处为PN结，晶体允许电子（外部来看）从N型半导体一端，流向P型半导体一端，但是不能反向流动。
target_text: Face-to-face PN diodes are made of a semiconductor crystal system. Different blending processes can make one end of the same semiconductor (e.g., this silicon) an area containing a negative polar current (electronic), known as the N semiconductor; the other end is an area containing a positive orthodoxy current (a cave), known as the P semiconductor. When the two materials are combined, the electron will flow from the N side to the P side. The region’s electron and the electrical hole are counterbalanced, resulting in an inadequate mid-area current, forming an “altitude layer”. There is an “inner field” inside the empty layer: N-side positive, P-side negative. The boundary of the two regions is a PN bond, which allows the electron (externally) from the end of the N semiconductor to the end of the P-conductor, but it cannot be reversed.
title: 二極體

source_text: 从1980年代个人电脑普及开始，信息的传递变得越来越简便、快捷、廉价，人们寻求一种更快捷的通信方式，恰恰美国将用于军事、商业的网络完全开放，形成实际意义的互联网。网络的发展令网络软件应运而生，即时通讯软件、电邮令分隔两地的人可以于短时间内实现通讯。它完全打破了地域、距离、意识形态的限制，使人们能接触到各种思想、文化，更主要的是实现了信息的即时性。前期的互联网称为Web 1.0，是指其只实现了单向的信息广播，而目前正处于Web 2.0的过渡之中，即通过互联网实现各种互动。
target_text: Starting with the introduction of personal computers in the 1980s, the transmission of information has become easier, faster and cheaper, and a faster mode of communication has been sought, precisely through the United States, which will be fully open to military and commercial networks to form a meaningful Internet. The development of the network has led to the development of web-based software, which allows people who are separated by instantaneous communication software, e-mails, to communicate within a short period of time. It has completely broken geographical, distance, ideological limitations, access to ideas, cultures, and, above all, to the instantity of information. The former Internet, called Web 1.0, means that it has achieved only one-way information broadcasting, and is now in the transition of Web 2.0, that is, interaction through the Internet.

source_text:
与死机的区别
死机是一种不可在软件层面上解决的现象，一旦死机，操作者必须通过重启甚至更换硬件等硬件层面上的措施才能使计算机恢复正常运行。而假死机通常只是由于硬件资源暂时性地被消耗殆尽，因而无法对外部指令进行响应的现象。通常计算机操作者只需等待一定时间，待计算机将先前的应用程序处理完毕，腾出多余的硬件资源后便可以恢复到正常的工作状态。
target_text: Unlike a dead machine, which can't be solved at the software level, the operator has to reboot or even replace hardware to enable the computer to function properly. It is often simply a phenomenon where hardware resources are temporarily depleted and therefore cannot respond to external instructions.
title: 假死机

source_text:
与死机的联系
假死机与死机在初期并没有严格意义上的差别。如果在计算机处于假死机状态时继续输入指令，有可能使之死机。然而，计算机从假死机中恢复所需的时间并无定数，因此，当计算机操作者在等待一定时间后采取硬件层面上的措施解决这个问题时，也令对此次计算机出现情况的判断成为不可能。
target_text: There is no strict difference in the initial sense between a stagger and a stagger. If a computer continues to enter instructions when it is in stagger status, it is likely to kill it. However, the time it takes for a computer to recover from a stagger is uncertain, so when a computer operator takes steps at the hardware level to resolve this problem after a certain period of time, it is also impossible to judge what happened to the computer.
title: 假死机

source_text: 死机与假死机的判定一個無反應的計算機是否是假死機是半可判定的，由于无法证明被认为是死机的计算机是否能够在一个无限长的时间内恢复，因此也就无法对处于对应用程序没有响应状态下的计算机是否死机进行判断。在现实生活中，人们通常是根据结果来判断计算机的无响应是否属于死机现象。即：如果计算机在特定操作者所能接受的等待时间内恢复正常，此特定操作者则认为刚才发生的现象属于假死机范畴。如果计算机在特定操作者所能接受的等待时间内未恢复正常，最终导致了操作者采用硬件层面上的措施解决此次无响应现象，从而对刚才所发生现象是否属于死机范畴的判断造成了时空上的不可能性。但此操作者通常认为刚才发生的现象属于死机范畴。由于各个操作者所能接受的最大等待时间长短不一，因此也许计算机会在有较长等待时间的操作者那里恢复了正常，而在只有较短等待时间的操作者那里恢复过程尚未来得及完成便被操作者采取的硬件措施所终止。此时，对于前一个操作者，计算机的此次状态被认定为假死机，而对于后者为死机。因此，各人对同样的计算机无响应事件会做出不同的判断。即对死机和假死机的判断存在各人间的特异性。
target_text: It is not possible to judge whether a computer that is in a state of non-responsiveness is dead in reality. In reality, the failure to respond is usually based on results. If the computer is back to normal within a certain period of time acceptable to the operator, this particular operator considers that the phenomenon that has just occurred falls within the range of dead machines. If the computer does not return to normal during the waiting period acceptable to the operator, it eventually leads the operator to take measures at the hardware level to resolve the non-response, thus creating an improbability of whether the phenomenon that has just occurred falls within the range of dead machines.
title: 假死机

1938年到1941年间，巴丁担任明尼苏达大学助理教授，1941年到1945年在华盛顿海军军械实验室工作。1945年10月，約翰·巴丁在贝尔电话公司实验研究所研究半导体及金属的导电机制、半导体表面性能等问题。巴丁是固態物理組的成員。组长是威廉·肖克利和化學家斯坦利·摩根（Stanley Morgan）。其他组员还包括沃尔特·布拉顿、物理學家杰拉爾德·皮爾遜（Gerald Pearson），化學家羅伯特·吉尼（Robert Gibney），電子專家希爾伯特·摩爾（Hilbert Moore）和幾個技術員。他搬家到新澤西州。巴丁在麻薩諸塞州學校認識肖克利。巴丁在普林斯頓大學時代通過布拉顿的兄弟鮑勃·布拉顿認識了布拉顿。鮑勃·布拉顿也是普林斯頓大學的學生。無論是在實驗室或高爾夫球場，巴丁和布拉顿在週末把所有時間都放在實驗和组织理論。

source_text:
PGP加密如何工作
PGP加密由一系列散列、数据压缩、对称密钥加密，以及公钥加密的算法组合而成。每个步骤均支持几种算法，用户可以选择一个使用。每个公钥均绑定一个用户名和/或者E-mail地址。该系统的最初版本通常称为可信网或X.509系统；X.509系统使用的是基于数字证书认证机构的分层方案，该方案后来被加入到PGP的实现中。当前的PGP加密版本通过一个自动密钥管理服务器来进行密钥的可靠存放。
target_text: PGP encryption is a combination of hash, data compression, symmetric key encryption, and public key encryption algorithms. Each step supports several algorithms, and the user can choose one. Each public key binds a user name and/or E-mail address. The initial version of the system is commonly referred to as a credible network or X.509 system; the X.509 system uses a layered scheme based on a digital certifier, which is later added to the PGP implementation. The current PGP encryption version provides a reliable storage of keys through an automated key management server.
title: PGP

source_text:
机密性
PGP可用于发送机密消息。为此，PGP结合了对称密钥加密和公钥加密。PGP使用对称加密算法对消息进行加密，该算法需要对称密钥。每个对称密钥也称为会话密钥仅被使用一次。消息及其会话密钥被发送到接收方。 会话密钥必须被发送给接收方以解密消息，但是为了在传输过程中保护它，它使用接收方的公钥进行加密。只有属于接收方的私钥才能解密会话密钥。
target_text: Confidential PGP can be used to send classified messages. To this end, PGP combines symmetric key encryption and public key encryption. PGP encrypts messages using symmetric encryption algorithms that require symmetric encryption. Each symmetric key is also referred to as a session key only once. Messages and their session keys are sent to the receiving party. The session key must be sent to the receiving party to decrypt the message, but in order to protect it during transmission, it uses the recipient ' s public key to encrypt the session key. Only a private key belonging to the receiving party can decrypt the session key.
title: PGP

source_text: 软件第一个版本包含一个齐默曼自己设计的对称密钥算法，与周六夜现场的一个小品BassOmatic同名。作为一个老牌的反核能活跃分子，齐默曼为了让所有有相似倾向的人们可以安全的使用BBS并且安全存储消息和文件而创造了PGP加密。在非商业用途上是不需要授权的，无须任何费用，并且在所有的发行中附带了完整的源代码。

As an old anti-nuclear activist, Zimmerman created PGP encryption to make BBS safe for all like-minded people and to store messages and documents safely. There is no need for authorization for non-commercial uses, no cost, and full source code attached to all distributions.

source_text: 齐默曼使用了一种富有想象力的方法来对抗这一规定。他将PGP的全套源代码出版成一本书，由MIT 出版社发行，受到了广泛欢迎。任何想要构建自己的PGP版本的人只需买下这本60美元的书，切掉封面，分离页面，然后使用OCR（文字扫描识别）程序进行扫描和文字识别（或者直接输入），生成一系列的源代码文本文档。接下来便可以使用自由分发的GCC来编译程序。PGP就是这样在全世界变得可用。声明的原则很简单：对军需品——枪支、炸药、飞机和软件的出口是被限制的，然而书本出口受到第一修正案（言论自由部分）的保护。这个问题从未再在法庭中检查过。后来，在另外两个案件（伯恩斯坦诉合众国案和荣格诉戴利案）中，法院皆判定加密软件的源代码是受第一修正案保护的，享有言论自由。如今PGP不再被认为是军需品，但仍需符合一般出口产品的实体清单规定，不得出售给特定的国家、实体或个人。
target_text: Zimmerman uses an imaginative method to counter this provision. He publishes the full source code of the PGP into a book, distributed by the MIT publishing house, which is widely welcomed. Anyone who wants to build his PGP version only buys the 60-dollar book, cuts off the cover, separates the page, and then uses the OCR (scanning for text) program to scan and identify (or directly enter) a series of source code text files. In two other cases (Bernstein v. United States of America and Eureka v. Dary), the court then decided that the source code for encrypted software was protected by the first amendment and enjoyed freedom of expression. The statement is simple: the export of military supplies — guns, explosives, aircraft and software is restricted, yet the export of books is protected by the first amendment (freedom of expression).
title: PGP

source_text:
商業應用
PGP一般在企业资源规划（即ERP）软件连接到银行系统时使用，防止信息在传输过程中被删改或盗取，从而减少商业秘密泄露和遭遇诈骗的风险。OpenPGP
1997年7月，PGP Inc.与齐默尔曼同意IETF制定一项公开的互联网标准，称作OpenPGP，任何支持这一标准的程序也被允许称作OpenPGP。
target_text: Commercial PGP is generally used when ERP software is connected to the banking system to prevent information being deleted or stolen during transmission, thereby reducing the risk of trade secrets leaking and fraud. In July 1997, PGP Inc. and Zimmerman agreed that IETF should develop an open Internet standard, known as OpenPGP, and that any procedures to support this standard are also allowed to be called OpenPGP.
title: PGP

它的设计目标是将软件开发人员从大量相同的数据持久层相关编程工作中解放出来。无论是从设计草案还是从一个遗留数据库开始，开发人员都可以采用Hibernate。
target_text: Hibernate is an object relationship mapping (ORM) solution in Java's language. It is a free, open-source software issued using GNU-wide public licences. It provides a user-friendly and sustainable framework for mapping target-oriented area models to traditional relationship-type databases. It is designed to free software developers from a large number of relevant programming exercises on the same data sustainability layer.
title: Hibernate

source_text:
Hibernate不仅负责从Java类到数据库表的映射（还包括从Java数据类型到SQL数据类型的映射），还提供了面向对象的数据查询检索机制，从而极大地缩短了手动处理SQL和JDBC上的开发时间。发展历程
2001年，澳大利亚墨尔本一位名为Gavin King的27岁的程序员，买了一本SQL编程的书，他厌倦了实体bean，认为自己可以开发出一个符合对象关系映射理论，并且真正好用的Java持久化层框架，因此他需要先学习一下SQL。这一年的11月，Hibernate的第一个版本发布了。
target_text: Hibernate is responsible not only for mapping from the Java category to the database table (and also for mapping from the Java data type to the SQL data type), but also for providing object-oriented data search and retrieval mechanisms, thus significantly shortening the development time of manual processing on SQL and JDBC. In 2001, a 27-year-old programmer named Gavin King from Melbourne, Australia, bought a copy of SQL programming, and he was tired of the entity Bean, believing that he could develop an object-specific mapping theory and a truly useful Java Persistency Framework, so he needed to learn about SQL. In November of the year, the first version of Hibernate was released.
title: Hibernate

source_text: 基于UDP的数据传输协议（，缩写：UDT）是一种互联网数据传输协议。UDT的主要目的是支持高速广域网上的海量数据传输，而互联网上的标准数据传输协议TCP在高带宽长距离网络上性能很差。顾名思义，UDT建于UDP之上，并引入新的拥塞控制和数据可靠性控制机制。UDT是面向连接的双向的应用层协议。它同时支持可靠的数据流传输和部分可靠的数据报传输。
target_text: The UDP-based data transfer protocol (UDP, Abbreviation: UDT) is an Internet-based data transfer protocol. The main purpose of UDT is to support high-volume data transmission on high-speed wide-area networks, while the standard data transfer protocol on the Internet, TCP, has poor performance on high-bandwidth long-distance networks. By definition, UDT is built on UDP and introduces new crowd control and data reliability control mechanisms. UDT is a two-way application-level protocol for connectivity.
title: 基于UDP的数据传输协议

source_text: 由于UDT完全在UDP上实现，它也可以应用在除了高速数据传输之外的其它应用领域，例如点到点技术（P2P），防火墙穿透，多媒体数据传输等等。UDT由开源软件作者谷云洪在美国伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校攻读博士期间开发，并由他在毕业后继续维护和升级。UDT的开源软件可以在SourceForge上获取。
target_text: Since UDT is fully operational on UDP, it can also be applied in applications other than high-speed data transmission, such as point-to-point technology (P2P), firewall penetrating, multimedia data transmission, etc. UDT was developed by open-source software authors Taniun during his PhD study at the University of Illinois in Chicago, United States, and continues to be maintained and upgraded after his graduation. source_text: 不间断电源（或稱UPS，即 Uninterruptible Power Supply）是在电网异常（如停电、欠压、干扰或浪湧（湧浪電流））的情况下不间断的为电器负载设备提供后备交流电源，维持电器正常运作的设备。通常情况下不间断电源被用于维持计算机（尤其是服务器）或交换机等关键性商用设备或精密仪器的不间断运行，防止计算机数据丢失，电话通信网络中断或仪器失去控制。
target_text: Uninterruptible power supply (or UPS, or Uninterruptible Power Supply) is an uninterrupted supply of back-up communication power for electrical load equipment in the event of electrical grid anomalies (e.g. power outages, unpressures, jamming or wave currents) and maintenance of equipment for the normal operation of electrical appliances. Uninterruptible power supply is usually used to maintain uninterrupted operation of critical commercial or sophisticated equipment, such as computers (especially servers) or switches, to prevent loss of computer data, interruption of telephone communication networks or loss of control of equipment.
title: 不间断电源

source_text: 威廉·福特·吉布森（，）是美国裔加拿大推想小说家、散文家，公认为科幻分支艺术形式赛博朋克的创始人。吉布森1970年代开始写作，早期作品多属，背景设于近未来，探讨技术、控制论和计算机网络对人类“结合低端生活和高新科技”的影响，早在1990年代互联网普及前便绘出信息时代前景。吉布森自创新词“信息空间”，意为“互相连通的普及数字技术”，在短篇小说《整垮铬萝米》（1982年）首度应用，随后写入长篇小说处女作、名篇《神经漫游者》（1984年），自此广为人知。吉布森的上述早期作品在1980年代被认为是对科幻文学的“革新”。吉布森随后续写《神经漫游者》，于1986年写下《》，于1987年写下《》。三部书统称为《》，以反乌托邦为主题。吉布森此后与布鲁斯·斯特林合作，1990年合著的长篇小说《差分机》是蒸汽朋克艺术形式代表作。吉布森1990年代创作《》系列小说，探究近未来城市环境下的社会发展、后工业社会、以及等主题。自世纪之交，九·一一事件之后，吉布森写下了一系列愈发具有现实主义色彩的长篇小说，即《模式识别》（2003年）、《》（2007年）、《》（2010年）三部作品，均设定于略同于当代的世界。这些作品是吉布森的首批主流畅销书。吉布森最新的两部长篇小说，《边缘世界》（2014年）和《》（2020年），重新开始直白地引入技术主题和典型的科幻主题。1999年，英国《卫报》称吉布森“可能是近二十年最重要的小说家”；澳大利亚《悉尼先驱晨报》称其为赛博朋克的“黑暗先知”。

source_text: 早在早期互联网在1980年代初出现之前，吉布森就已在《神经漫游者》中用“矩阵”（"matrix"）一词来形容互联网的形象。这意味着吉布森在万维网出现多年以前，就设想了一种环球通讯网络；虽然，类似的观念此前就已有人提出，其中也包括一些科幻作家。在创作《整垮铬萝米》时，吉布森“产生了一种直觉，感觉（互联网）会改变一切，就像汽车普及造成的大改观一样。”1995年，吉布森提出，互联网的出现，演变和发展这一过程是“本世纪内人类成就中史无前例的一个，也是最有趣的一个”，作为一种新文明的出现，其重要性堪与城市的出现相类；2000年，又预测互联网会导致民族国家的消亡。
target_text: Earlier in the early 1980s, Gibson had used the term “matrix” to describe the image of the Internet in The Nerves. This meant that Gibson had conceived a global communications network many years before the advent of the World Wide Web; although similar ideas had been raised earlier, including some science fiction writers. In the creation of Chrome Collapse, Gibson “created an intuitive feeling that (the Internet) would change everything, just like that caused by the spread of cars.” In 1995, Gibson suggested that the Internet had emerged, and that the process of evolution and development had been “one of the unprecedented human achievements of this century, and the most interesting,” and that as a new civilization, its importance was similar to that of the city; and in 2000, it was predicted that the Internet would lead to the demise of the nation.

休伯特·德雷福斯进路（当代社会）
在对人工智能（AI）纲领的批判中，休伯特·德雷福斯（1992）认为过去关于技能发展的理解方式是错误的。他认为，这是早期人工智能共同体不加批判采用的模型。在对这个观点的批评中，他同海德格尔一样主张，当我们学习日常实践中的新技能时，我们观察到恰恰相反的东西。我们都是从明确的规则或预设的方法开始，然后转向特殊情况的多样性，就像发展成一名专家一样。他的观点直指海德格尔关于作为存在者的人类的存在与时间方面的解读，而这些存在者往往已经被置于世界中。作为“在世之中”的人类，我们已经是应付日常生活的专家，处理每一个特定情况的微妙之处；这就是为什么日常生活看起来如此显而易见的原因。因此，日常活动的复杂专业知识被遗忘，并理所当然地被当成是AI的一个假定的起点。 Dreyfus在对AI的批判中强调的是这一事实，即技术（AI算法）并不会由自身产生意义。让技术设备和解决方案显得有意义，这是假定的、被遗忘的日常实践的视域。如果我们要理解技术，我们需要“回归”到意义的视野，使它显现为我们所需要的、想要的和渴求的人造物。我们需要去考虑这些技术如何将我们揭示（或去蔽）。

These multiplicity tables combine the signal using a flat root method so that even if the input signal is not an ideal sine wave, they can correctly read the real voltage value. Some of the multiplicity tables can be connected to personal computers/personal computers by infrared lines, RS-232, IEE-488 devices, or USBs. In these ways, computers can record readings during measurements, or upload a set of results from the device into the computer.
title: 多用表

source_text:
表头（数字式）
数字多用表的表头一般由一顆A/D（類比/數位）转换芯片+外围元件+液晶显示器组成，多用表的精度受表头的影响，多用表由于A/D芯片转换出来的数字，一般也称为3 1/2位数字多用表,4 1/2位数字多用表等等。最常用的芯片是ICL7106(3位半LCD手动量程经典芯片，后续版本为7106A,7106B,7206,7240等等）,ICL7129（4位半LCD手动量程经典芯片）,ICL7107（3位半LED手动量程经典芯片）。带有自动量程、真有效值显示等功能数字多用表则普遍使用二进制输出的 A/D 芯片搭配嵌入式计算机，此时计算机内的信号处理算法对精度也会有影响。
target_text: The most commonly used chips are ICL 7106 (three semi-LCD master chips with subsequent versions of 7106A, 7106B, 7206,7240, etc.), ICL 7129 (four-and-a-half LCD master chip chips), ICL 7107 (3-a-half LED classic chips with automatic ranges, real validity values, etc.) and A/D chips with universal access to second-line output.
title: 多用表

source_text: 可计算函数集合的编号有时叫做哥德尔编号或有效编号。哥德尔编号可以被解释为一个编程语言，带有指派哥德尔数到每个可计算函数作为在这种编程语言中计算这个函数的值的程序。Roger 等价定理特征化了是哥德尔编号的可计算函数集合的编号。
target_text: The numbering of the computeable function pool is sometimes called a godel number or a valid number. The Godel number can be interpreted as a programming language, with a program that assigns the Godel number to each calculator function as the value for which this function is calculated in this programming language. Roger 's equivalency algorithm characterizes the number of the computeable function pool that is the Godel number.
title: 哥德尔数

The park is also the home of a number of well-known technology firms, such as IFS, Intentia Software and Allegro Software.

More than 100 research projects have received national and provincial ministerial awards, more than 130 publications have been published, more than 1,500 papers have been published in various academic journals and 157 have been recorded by SCI, EI and ISTP.

離散對數在一些特殊情況下可以快速計算。然而，通常沒有具非常效率的方法來計算它們。公鑰密碼學中幾個重要算法的基礎，是假設尋找離散對數的問題解，在仔細選擇過的群中，並不存在有效率的求解算法。

Dispersed logarithm can be calculated quickly in some special cases. However, there is usually no very efficient way to calculate them. The foundation of several important algorithms in key cryptography is to suppose that there is no efficient solution in the carefully selected groups.
title: 离散对数

source_text: 系统分析師（System Analyst，簡稱SA（SAn），旧譯系統分析员），是在信息系统研发中，负责通过需求分析确认系统的需求，并进而形成系统产品设计的人。 通常他们也会涉及可行性評估、项目管理、开发前评估、需求验证等工作。虽然在软件系统、硬件系统研发中都有系统分析师存在，但普遍多指软件开发中的人员。
target_text: Systems analysts (System Analyst, SAN, former system analysts) are those in the development of information systems who are responsible for identifying the system’s needs through needs analysis, and who then form the system’s product design. They usually also involve feasibility assessments, project management, pre-development assessments, needs validation, etc. While systems analysts exist in software systems, hardware systems development, they are commonly referred to as personnel in software development.
title: 系统分析员

source_text:
要求
系统分析師在軟體開發團隊中，屬於中高階的基層管理者與領導者。他們在專業領域中，除了需要掌握软件开发流程(SDLC)、软件开发方法论、质量控制等等管理知識以外，在軟體開發的基層工作上，最好也能有相當程度的歷練。在人格特質方面，需擁有良好的分析、組織及邏輯思考能力，有時更需要有隨時接受未知事物挑戰的勇氣；而在重視團隊精神的軟體開發工作中，他們也必須具備優秀的溝通協調能力，並擁有良好的人際關係。
target_text: Systems analysts are expected to be part of the senior and middle-level management and leadership of software development teams. In their field of expertise, in addition to management knowledge of software development processes (SDLCs), software development methodologies, quality control, etc., they are best placed to have considerable experience in software development foundations. In terms of personality characteristics, they need good analytical, organizational and logical thinking skills and, at times, the courage to be challenged by unknowns at any time; and, in the development of software that values the spirit of the team, they must also have excellent communication skills and good people-to-people relationships.
title: 系统分析员

source_text:
闵乃大（2002年），江苏如皋石庄人，德籍华人科学家，中国计算机科学先驱。生平
1936年自清华大学电机工程专业毕业后赴德国柏林卡劳腾堡工业大学留学。1944年获博士学位。抗战胜利后于1948年回国任清华大学电机系电讯网络研究室主任、教授。1952年秋，中国科学院数学研究所建立了中国第一个电子计算机科研小组，1953年1月任组长。参与中国计算机研制的奠基工作。
target_text: Min Nae Da, Jiang Su, a Chinese scientist and pioneer in computer science in China. He studied in 1936 at the Kalautenburg Industrial University, Berlin, after graduating from Qinghua University in electrical engineering. He obtained a doctorate in 1944. He returned to China in 1948 as head of the telecommunication network research unit of the Qinghua University Electrical Department. In the autumn of 1952, the Institute of Mathematics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences established China’s first computer research team, which was led in January 1953.
title: 闵乃大

source_text: 1956年3月12日至17日，闵乃大率中国代表团参加在莫斯科举行的“苏联数学机械与数学仪器制造发展的途径”国际会议。参观了苏联的若干研究计算机的科研机构，考察了莫斯科大学计算机专业的课程计划，与苏联计算机权威座谈，听取了他们对中国发展计算机事业的建议。3月28日，代表团回国。
target_text: From 12 to 17 March 1956, the Chinese delegation took part in an international conference in Moscow on “Ways for the development of Soviet Mathematics and Mathematical instruments.” A number of research and research institutes in the Soviet Union were visited, courses in computer science were studied at Moscow University, and discussions were held with Soviet computer authorities and suggestions were received for the development of a computer career in China. On 28 March, the delegation returned to China.
title: 闵乃大

source_text:
学术
唐稚松于20世纪60年代中从事自动机理论研究，证明计算机转移命令的许多结构性性质，如转移命令可用循环代替，它比Bohm－Jacopi定理早一年。20世纪70年代中从事结构程序设计与结构化语言的研究，推动了中国国内这方面工作的开展。20世纪80年代初，唐稚松开始致力于时间逻辑的研究，有专著《时序逻辑程序设计与软件工程》。为解决硬件运行正确性验证的问题创造了XYZ/E语言（一种可以覆盖VDHL的并发性与时序性模拟的运行于XYZ系统的可执行描述语言）。他毕生主要的贡献在于：结构程序设计理论、程序语言、形式文法、汉字信息处理、软件工程等多个方面。早在1965年，唐稚松在《数学学报》发表了一篇关于计算机指令系统性质的论文，提出转移指令可用循环替代。这一重要结果比中国国外同行的类似结果早发表一年。二十世纪七十年代中期，他分析总结了国际上结构程序设计研究方面的大量资料，完成了长篇论文“结构程序设计与结构程序语言”。在此基础上，他设计了一个广谱的结构程序语言，取名为系列化语言族，简称XYZ系统。
target_text: In the early 1980s, Tang was engaged in a study of time logic and software engineering. In order to solve the problem of the correct validation of hardware, the XYZ/E language was created (an executive description of the XYZ system that can cover VDHL, which can be replaced by a transfer order). The main contribution of his life was the theory of structural programming, the language of procedure, the law of form, the processing of Chinese-language information, and software engineering. As early as 1965, Don Yusso published a paper on the nature of the computer command system in Mathematics, proposing a transfer instruction that could be replaced by a circular result that was similar to that of China's foreign counterparts.
title: 唐稚松

source_text: 1980年，唐稚松成为来自中国的第一位国际信息处理联合会（IFIP）专家组成员；还先后担任《计算机学报》《软件学报》《自然科学进展》《Journal of Symbolic Computation》等杂志的编委；中国软件行业协会顾问；中国中文信息学会常务理事；中国自然辩证法研究会理事；武汉大学、重庆大学、中南工业大学名誉教授；中国科学技术大学、西北大学、贵州大学等校兼职教授；计算机科学国家重点实验室名誉主任。
target_text: In 1980, Tang Junzon became a member of the first expert group of the International Information Processing Federation (IFIP) from China; was also a member of the editorial board of journals such as the Journal of Computer Science, Progress of Natural Sciences; an adviser to the Chinese Software Industry Association; a permanent member of the Chinese Chinese Information Society; a member of the China Natural Defense Law Research Council; an honorary professor at Wuhan University, Chongqing University, China Nan Industrial University; a part-time professor at the Chinese University of Science and Technology, Northwestern University, Guizhou University, etc.; and an honorary director of the National Focus Laboratory for Computer Science.
title: 唐稚松

source_text:
早期的生活與教育
拉里·佩奇出生于1973年3月26日，出生在美國密西根州東蘭辛市的一個猶太家庭 ，他的母亲是犹太人但佩奇不信仰任何宗教。他的父亲卡尔·维克托·佩奇获得了密歇根大学的计算机科学博士学位，当时正在建立新的科学领域。BBC记者形容他为计算机科学的“先锋和人工智能”。他的父亲和他的母亲戈洛瑞雅（Gloria）在密西根州立大學担任计算机科学的教授，在莱曼布里格斯学院和密歇根州立大学担任计算机科学讲师。
target_text: Early life and education, Larry Pec, born on 26 March 1973, was born in a Jewish family in the city of Eastern Lansing, Michigan, United States of America, whose mother was a Jew but did not believe in any religion. His father, Carl Victor Pec, obtained a doctorate in computer science from the University of Michigan, where he was building a new scientific field. BBC journalists described him as a “frontline and artificial intelligence” in computer science. His father and his mother, Gloria, were professors in computer science at Michigan State University and lecturers in computer science at Leman Briggs College and Michigan State University.
title: 拉里·佩奇

source_text: 科技是城市经济的重要组成部分，市内现有1200多家科技公司。美国科技公司的高密度使得硅林一词被用来形容波特兰地区，指的是该地区科技公司如同树林里的树木，和加州北部的硅谷相对应。该地区还为软件公司和在线创业公司提供设施，其中一些得到了当地种子基金组织和企业孵化器的支持。计算机部件制造商英特尔公司是波特兰地区最大的雇主，为15,000多人提供了就业机会，在波特兰中部西部的希尔斯伯勒市有几个园区。

title: 波特蘭 (俄勒岡州)

在实践中，大型矩阵的特征值无法通过特征多项式计算。计算该多项式本身相当费资源，而根的精确表达式对于高次的多项式来说很难计算和表达：阿貝爾-魯菲尼定理显示五次或更高次的多项式的根无法用次方根来简单表达。对于估算多项式的根的有效算法是有的，但特征值中的微小误差可以导致特征向量的巨大误差。因此，寻找特征多项式和特征值的一般算法，是迭代法。最简单的方法是：取一个随机向量，然后计算如下的一系列单位向量
, , , ...
这个序列几乎总是收敛于最大绝对值的特征值所对应的特征向量。这个算法很简单，但是本身不是很有用。但是，像QR分解这样的算法正是以此为基础的。
target_text: In practice, the characteristics of a large matrix cannot be calculated in multiple styles of features. The precise expression of the root is difficult to calculate and express for a high number of models to calculate and express: Abel-Rufini theorem shows five or more times of multiple roots that cannot be easily expressed by sub-lines. There are valid algorithms for estimating the roots of multiple styles, but minor errors in the characteristic values can lead to significant errors in the characterization vectors. Thus, the general algorithm for finding feature multiples and feature values is an iterative one. The simplest approach is: to take a random vector and then calculate a series of unit vectors, which is almost always drawn on the characteristics corresponding to the values of the largest absolute values.
title: 特征值和特征向量

source_text:
历史
在ODBC诞生之前，如果要开发数据库应用程序，则必须要使用数据库厂商随数据库产品一同发布的一些工具集来访问数据库，或者在程序中使用嵌入式SQL来访问数据库。当时，对于访问数据库的方法，缺乏一个基于C语言的统一编程接口。在这种背景下，微软于1992年发表了ODBC。之后，X/Open组织以及ISO标准化组织基于ODBC 3.0的规范，进一步进行了标准化，于1995年发表了SQL/CLI标准。该标准已经成为了SQL标准的一部分。
target_text: Prior to the birth of ODSC, if database applications were to be developed, databases would have to be accessed using a set of tools published by the database manufacturer with the database products, or the embedded SQL in the program. At that time, there was a lack of a single programming interface based on the C language for access to the database. In this context, Microsoft published ODSC in 1992. X/Open and ISO standards based on ODSC 3.0 have been further standardized, and SQL/CLI standards were published in 1995. This standard has become part of the SQL standard.
title: ODBC

source_text: 斑马鱼是一种常见且常用的科研模式生物，被用于研究脊椎动物的发育以及基因功能。由美国分子生物学家及他在俄勒冈大学的同事在1970、80年代首先在实验室中使用作模式生物。George Streisinger所进行的斑马鱼克隆实验形成了最早一批成功的脊椎动物克隆体之一。 斑马鱼在科研领域的重要性在成功的大规模先导性中被凸显，这一实验常被称为Tübingen/Boston筛查（the Tübingen/Boston screens）。该品种鱼目前已有特有的线上数据库，包括遗传学数据库、基因组学数据库、发育信息数据库、 (Zebrafish Information Network，简称ZFIN)。斑马鱼国际资源中心（The Zebrafish International Resource Center，简称ZIRC）储存了斑马鱼的遗传学信息，并由29,250对等位基因的信息对研究领域发布。斑马鱼也是少数几种之一。
target_text: The importance of zebra fish in the field of scientific research has been highlighted in a successful large-scale pioneering approach, often known as the Tübingen/Boston Screening (the Tübingen/Boston Screens). The species currently have unique linear databases, including genetics databases, genomics databases, developmental information databases, (Zebrafish Information Network, ZFIN) and are one of the few sites where genetic information is available.
title: 斑馬魚

source_text:
单元的解释（interpretation of units）：单元可以解释为神经元或神经元组。
激活的定义（definition of activation）：激活可以透過多种方式进行定义。例如，在玻尔兹曼机中，激活被解释为产生动作电位尖峰的概率，并透過逻辑函数确定输入到单元的总和。
学习演算法（learning algorithm）：不同的網路以不同的方式修改其聯結。通常，聯結权重會隨時間的改變，用於該變化的数学定义都称为“学习演算法”。
target_text: Unit interpretation (interpretation of units): The unit can be interpreted as neurons or neurons. Activation definition: Activation can be defined in a variety of ways. For example, in a Boltzmann machine, activation is interpreted as the probability of creating action-level peaks, and the sum of the units is determined by logical functions. Learning algorithms: different networks modify their connections in different ways. Normally, the weight of association changes over time and the mathematical definition used for that change is called “learning algorithms”.
title: 联结主义

source_text: 大多数心灵哲学家，要么是一种还原论的物理主义者，要么是非还原论的物理主义者，各自都以不同方式来维持心灵的地位，使心灵不脱离身体/物体而存在。这些物理主义观点在科学中很有影响力：尤其是社会生物学、计算机科学（尤其是人工智能）、演化心理学，以及各种神经科学。 还原论的物理主义者认为，所有精神状态和精神属性都最终能用科学解释，用生理学过程、生理学状态解释。 非还原论的物理主义者则论证，尽管心灵不是独立的实体，精神属性却给物理属性带来及其巨大的影响；还认为，描述精神的语词是不可或缺的，也不能被还原成语言或者更第一级的物理科学解释。 神经科学上持续的进展，帮助解决了上述问题的一部分，但还远没有完全解决。当代心灵哲学家比较感兴趣，神经科学如何解释人的主观特质和精神状态、精神属性的意向性。
target_text: Most psychophysiologists, either a physicist or a non-reciprocal physicist, each in a different way, maintain the status of the mind, so that it does not separate from the body/object. These physicalist ideas are influential in science: in particular, social biology, computer science (especially artificial intelligence), evolutionary psychology, and various neurosciences.
title: 心灵哲学

source_text: 计算机科学关心自动信息处理（或至少关心，符号的物理系统，这个符号是信息的赋值对象）。方法是依靠类似电子计算机的东西。 从一开始，程序员就能够写出这样的程序，它能让电脑执行有心灵的生物才能做的任务，比如计算。但我们还不清楚，电脑能不能说“有心灵”，也不清楚他们未来会不会有心灵。这个问题推进了许多哲学讨论，尤其是因为人工智能领域的研究。
target_text: Computer science cares about automatic information processing (or at least about the physical systems of symbols, which are the objects of information). The solution is to rely on computer-like things.
title: 心灵哲学

source_text: 人工智能当中，可以区分出两个目标：这一区分由约翰·罗杰斯·希尔勒提出，关于所谓人工智能哲學。根据希尔勒，“弱人工智能”独一无二的目标，是对心灵状态成功的模仿，而没有尝试让电脑变得有意识等等；相反，“强人工智能”的目标是使得电脑有意识且模仿得像人类。 强人工智能的观点可以上溯到计算机的先驱之一艾伦·图灵。它构想了图灵测试，作为对“机器能否思考”这一问题的答案。 图灵相信计算机可以说是在“思考”，仅当它独自在一间房间里，隔壁房间是人类，第三方同时问二者问题，仅凭二者的答案，第三方区分不出哪间屋子里是人类。必要地，图灵对机械智能与心灵-智能的行为主义模型一样智能。图灵测试招致了很多批评，其中最著名的是中文房间的思想實驗，提出者是约翰·塞尔。
target_text: According to Hiller, the unique goal of “weak artificial intelligence” is to mimic a successful state of mind without trying to make computers conscious, etc. On the contrary, the goal of “strong artificial intelligence” is to make computers conscious and imitate human beings.
title: 心灵哲学

source_text: 关于计算机或机器人敏感度（感质）的可能性仍然是个开放问题。一些计算机科学家相信人工智能的专长仍然可以对“心物问题”做出可能的回答，他们相信，基于所有电脑都有软件和硬件的关系，也有可能某天，正确的理论可以得到发现，让我们更好地理解人类心灵和大脑之间的相应影响。（参见）。
target_text: The possibility of computer or robot sensitivity (sense) remains an open question. Some computer scientists believe that the expertise of artificial intelligence can still provide a possible answer to the question of the "hearts" and believe that, based on the fact that all computers have a relationship of software and hardware, it is possible that one day the correct theory can be found, so that we can better understand the corresponding impact between the human mind and the brain. (See).

source_text:
认知科学
认知科学研究心灵及其过程，与很多其他科学相关，考察認知是什么，做什么，怎么运作。它包括了关于智能和行为的研究，特别关注信息怎么表达、运作、转换（与感知、语言、记忆、推理、情感等相关），论域是在神经系统（人和其他动物）与机器（例如计算机）。认知科学和很多其他科学相关，包括心理学、人工智能、哲学、神经科学、语言学、人类学、社会学和教育。 它包括很多程度的分析，从低等级机械运作如学习和决策，到高等级的逻辑和计划等；从神经回路到模块化脑组织（modular brain organization）。认为，认知是行为的、具体的、嵌入的（enactive, embodied, embedded），情感的，和（潜在地）扩展的。这一立场认为认知的夹在（sandwiched）感知和行为之间的“经典三明治”是虚假的；认知必须是成对的交互，不能这样划分。
target_text: It includes studies on intelligence and behaviour, with particular attention to how information is expressed, operated, converted (related to perception, language, memory, reasoning, emotion, etc.), and the domain is related to machines (e.g. computers) in the nervous system (humans and other animals). It is related to the cognitive sciences and many other sciences, including psychology, artificial intelligence, philosophy, neuroscience, linguistics, anthropology, sociology and education. It includes many degrees of analysis, ranging from low-level machinery to learning and decision-making, to high-level logic and planning; from neural circuits to modular brain tissues (modular brain organization); it is assumed that cognitive knowledge is behavioral, concrete, embedded (enactive, embodied, embeded), emotional, and (potentially) expansion.
title: 心灵哲学

source_text: 信号量的概念是由荷兰计算机科学家艾兹赫尔·戴克斯特拉（）发明的，广泛的应用于不同的操作系统中。在系統中，給予每一個行程一個信号量，代表每個行程目前的狀態，未得到控制權的行程會在特定地方被強迫停下來，等待可以繼續進行的訊號到來。如果信號量是一個任意的整數，通常被稱為計數訊號量（），或一般訊號量（）；如果信號量只有二進位的0或1，稱為二進位訊號量（）。
target_text: The concept of signal volume was invented by Dutch computer scientist Ezher Dextra and applied widely to different operating systems. In the system, a signal amount is given to each trip, representing the current status of each trip, and an uncontrollable process is forced to stop in a given place, waiting for a signal that can continue. If the signal number is an integer, it is commonly called the number of signal numbers () or the number of signal in general (; if the signal number is only zero or one in two, it is called the number of signal in two).
title: 信号量

source_text: 霍爾邏輯（），又稱弗洛伊德-霍爾邏輯（），是英国计算机科学家東尼·霍爾开发的形式系统，这个系统的用途是为了使用严格的数理逻辑推理來替计算机程序的正确性提供一组逻辑规则。這個想法起源於罗伯特·弗洛伊德於較早的研究，他为流程图提供了类似的系统。東尼·霍爾於1969年首次發表，随后为其他研究者所精制。
target_text: Hol logic, also known as Freud-Hol logic, is a formal system developed by British computer scientist Tony Hall, which is designed to provide a set of logical rules for the correctness of computer programs by using strict numerical logic reasoning. The idea originated from earlier research by Robert Freud, who provided a similar system for flow charts. Tony Hall was first published in 1969, and then refined by other researchers.
title: 霍尔逻辑

source_text: 启动转换（）是苹果公司用於幫助用户在內置Intel處理器的蘋果電腦上安装微軟的Windows系列操作系统的机制。軟件包含了不具破壞性的分割磁碟工具和支援Windows的驅動程式CD映像檔案。除這些驅動程式外，还包括了Windows控制台便于設定用戶主要的操作系统。它不是一個虛擬化的程式，因為它容許Windows和Mac OS X兩種操作系統並存。不過，Boot Camp只容許用戶每次開機使用一種操作系統。當用戶使用Windows并需要轉回Mac OS X時，则必須重新啟動電腦，反之亦然。
target_text: Launching the conversion () is the mechanism used by Apple to help users install the Microsoft Windows series of operating systems on apple computers with built-in Intel processors. The software contains non-destructive partition disk tools and driver CD images supporting Windows. In addition to these drivers, the Windows Console is designed to configure the user ' s main operating system. It is not a virtual program because it allows Windows and Mac OS X to co-exist. However, Boot Camp only allows users to use an operating system every time they open. When users use Windows and need to return Mac OS X, they must restart the computer, and vice versa.
title: 启动转换

source_text: Google使用一種名為PageRank的演算法，配合搜尋字串來排名網頁，PageRank是以公司創辦人拉里·佩奇命名。PageRank演算法根據加權係數，推斷該其他連結到網頁的價值來處理。PageRank如此取得由人所建立的链接，與及與人關聯的重要性。先前的排名搜尋方法，採用了許多搜尋器，以搜尋的關鍵詞和何時搜尋來排名頁面，或有多相關地關聯該搜尋。另外，Google亦採用其他秘密準則，決定排名網頁的結果。
target_text: Google uses an algorithm called PageRank to rank the web page in conjunction with a search string, and PageRank is named after the company ' s founder, Larry Pec. PageRank calculates the value of the other links to the web page according to the power multiplier. PageRank thus captures the connections established by people and their importance in relation to people. Previous ranking searches have used many searchers to rank the page with the key words to the search and when, or how relevant to the search. Google also uses other secret criteria to determine the outcome of the list.
title: Google搜索

source_text:
Google跳舞
Google跳舞是一种经常被讨论的现象，Google跳舞指的是Google月底大量更新数据库和算法的几天时间，因为可以发现，这几天对Google搜索关键字如www.yahoo.com得到的结果数是不一样的。在跳舞期间，一个站点的等级可能在短时间里戏剧般的改变，而且不同的Google服务器（举例来说：www.google.com， www2.google.com， www3.google.com， www.google.co.uk， www.google.com.hk 等）可能为相同的关键字提供不同的结果。跳舞似乎当是googlebot机器人抓取网页期间随即发生的。快速更新的网站，高级别的网页和新闻网站是最经常被检查的，虽然新闻不一定如此。小的调节在每月里持续进行以确定网页级别。在一些情况下，可能需要二到三个月让新建页面出现在搜索结果里。从2003年的夏季开始，每月的搜索，索引和等级更新被不间断的持续更新所取代。这种改变大大减少了Google搜索结果的不稳定性。2003年11月15日，Google似乎进行了有史以来最重要的一次算法升级，后来被称为“佛罗里达更新”。在这次更新中，几乎所有商业领域的关键词都受到了影响，尤其是一些热门的关键词，Google搜索的结果页完全变了个样儿，很多头一天还排在首位的网站被远远甩到了500名之后。
target_text: Google dances are a frequently discussed phenomenon, and Google dances refer to days of extensive updating of databases and algorithms at the end of Google, because it can be observed that these days have different results for Google search keywords, such as www.yahoo.com. During dances, one site may change in dramatic terms during a short period of time, and different Google servers (www.google.com, www2.google.com, www3.google.com, www.google.co.uk, www.google.com. hk) may provide different results for the same key words. Dances are likely to occur during Googlebot robot grabs of web pages. Rapidly updated websites, high-level web pages and news sites are most frequently examined, although news is not necessarily so. Small-day adjustments continue to determine the level of web pages at the end of the month. In some cases, the results of new pages may be found in two to three months.
title: Google搜索

source_text: 还有一种被普遍采用的技术是很多网站使用一个相同的关键字连接到某一个特定的网站，以使用户在Google搜索这个关键字的时候，这个网站的排名会出现在结果的较前面。这种方法被称为Google炸弹。现在Google算法更新的频率非常快，据猜测，现在算法公式中涉及的变量有300多个，PageRank™在整个Google算法中的影响力已经下降到20%左右，最终平衡的算法中最重要的变量所占的比例不会超过10%，单纯靠技术手段提升排名的网站已经禁不住时间的考验。
target_text: Another commonly used technology is that many websites use the same key word to connect to a particular site, so that when users search the key word in Google, the site will be ranked ahead of the result. This method is known as the Google bomb. Now Google algorithms are updated very quickly. It is assumed that there are more than 300 variables involved in the algorithm formula, that PageRankTM’s influence in the whole Google algorithm has been reduced to about 20 per cent, and that the most important variables in the final balanced algorithm will not be more than 10 per cent, and that websites that simply upgrade their ranking by technical means will no longer be tested for time.
title: Google搜索
