（Error hiding）：在显示给用户之前捕捉到错误信息，要么什么都不显示，要么显示无意义的信息
硬编码（Hard code）：将对系统环境的假设写入实现中
熔岩流（Lava flow）：保留不想要的（冗余的或是低质量的）代码，仅因为除去这些代码的代价太高或是会带来不可预期的结果
（Loop-switch sequence）在循环结构中使用switch语句来编写连续步骤
魔術數字（Magic numbers）：在算法里直接使用数字，而不解释含义
（Magic strings）：直接在代码里使用常量字符串，例如用来比较，或是作为事件代码
自我复制（Repeating yourself）：通过不断复制已有代码的模式或代码段进行编码；而非采用once and only once（抽取原则）
（Soft code）：在配置文件里保存业务逻辑而不是在代码中
面条代码（Spaghetti code）：指那些结构上完全不可理解的系统，尤其是因为误用代码结构
（Shotgun surgery）：开发人员一次性在一个多个实现的代码基中增加功能
target_text: (Boat anchor): Keeping useless parts of the system busy waiting (Cusy waiting): Reoccupation of CPUs when special cases are discovered is usually due to the introduction of duplicate checks rather than appropriate information mechanisms (Caching file): errors are corrected and the error marks are forgotten to be reset (Caching file): hard encoding (Hard code): inclusion of assumptions about the system environment in the achievement of molten rock streams (Lava follow): retention of unwanted (redundant or low-quality) code(s): new codes are added to solve the problem when special cases are discovered (Error Hiding): error information is captured before users are shown, or meaningless information is displayed (Shoop-switch code) is used in a circular structure (Shred code is used to understand the use of non-useable code(s) or non-useable code(s) is used as a direct result of the use of the code (shuts) or the use of the code(s)
title: 反面模式

source_text:
MVC模式最早由Trygve Reenskaug在1978年提出，是施乐帕罗奥多研究中心（Xerox PARC）在20世纪80年代为程序语言Smalltalk发明的一种软件架构。MVC模式的目的是实现一种动态的程式设计，使后续对程序的修改和扩展简化，并且使程序某一部分的重复利用成为可能。除此之外，此模式透过对复杂度的简化，使程序结构更加直观。软件系统透过对自身基本部分分离的同时也赋予了各个基本部分应有的功能。专业人员可以依據自身的专长分组：
模型（Model） - 程序员编写程序应有的功能（实现算法等等）、数据库专家进行数据管理和数据库设计(可以实现具体的功能)。
视图（View） - 界面设计人员进行图形界面设计。
控制器（Controller）- 负责转发请求，对请求进行处理。
target_text: The MVC model was first proposed by Trygve Reenskaug in 1978 as a software architecture developed by the Xerox PARC for the program language Smalltalk in the 1980s. The MVC model aims to achieve a dynamic programming design that will simplify subsequent modifications and extensions of procedures and make possible the reuse of one part of the program. In addition, the model makes the program structure more visible by simplifying complexity. The software system, by separating its basic parts, also gives the basic parts the functionality that they deserve. Professionals can respond to their own groups of expertise: Models (Model) - programmers prepare program functions (attaining algorithms, etc.), data management and database design by database specialists (which can achieve specific functions). View (View) - Interface designers are designed.
title: MVC

source_text: 其次，Controller 是自包含（self-contained,指高獨立內聚）的物件，与 Model 和 View 保持相对独立，所以可以方便的改变应用程序的数据层和业务规则。例如，把数据库从MySQL移植到Oracle，或者把RDBMS数据源改变成LDAP数据源，只需改变 Controller 即可。一旦正确地实现了控制器，不管数据来自数据库还是LDAP服务器，View 都会正确地显示它们。由于MVC模式的三个模块相互独立，改变其中一个不会影响其他两个，所以依据这种设计思想能构造良好的少互扰性的构件。
target_text: Second, Controller is a self-inclusive (self-contained, referred to as a high independence cluster) object that is relatively independent from Model and View, so that it can easily change the data layers and operating rules of the application. For example, by transplanting the database from MySQL to Oracle, or by changing the RDBMS data source to LDAP data sources, it is sufficient to change the Controller. Once the controller is correctly achieved, regardless of whether the data is from the database or from the LDAP server, View will correctly show them. Since the three modules of the MVC model are independent, changing one of them would not affect the other two, it is possible to construct a good, less intrusive component based on this design idea.
title: MVC

source_text: Rosetta可以让在Power PC平台上开发的软件在英特尔平台的麦金塔电脑上顺利运行。它基于Transitive公司的QuickTransit技术，也是麦金塔电脑从PowerPC向英特尔转换的一个重要部分，确保原先的Mac OS X程序能在新的英特尔平台上运行。虽然和英特尔原生编译的软件比较起来会有速度上的差别，但是对大多数对CPU资源使用不是很多的软件来说，速度上的差别是非常小的。在Intel版本的Mac OS X上，用户可以在通用二进制程序的选项里选择是否使用Rosetta来运行程序。
target_text: Rosetta can allow software developed on the Power PC platform to operate smoothly on the Intel platform's McKintat computer. It is based on the QuickTransit technology of Transitive and is an important part of McKinta's conversion from PowerPC to Intel, ensuring that the original Mac OS X program can run on the new Intel platform. While there are speed differences in comparison with the original software compiled by Intel, the speed difference is very small for most of the software not used for CPU resources. On the Intel version of Mac OS X, users can choose whether to use Rosetta to run the program in the generic binary program option.
title: Rosetta

source_text:
性能

target_text: Performance Rosetta preloads the Intel Chip McKinta operating system. It translates the G3, G4 and AltiVec commands, but does not compile the G5 software -- these applications need to be modified by the developers themselves. However, there is hardly any software that needs a high configuration like the G5 processor, so Rosetta can work for the vast majority of applications.

source_text: 首批海底通讯电缆提供电报通讯，后来開始引入电话通讯，以及互联网通讯。现代的电缆还使用了光纤技术，并且设立更先进的电话通讯、互联网与专用数据通讯，被称为海底光缆。海底光纜不僅歷史悠久，對比通訊衛星在傳輸數據上也有著壓倒性的優勢。雖然人造衛星的方案看似简单不少，但是通信衛星均部屬在3.5萬公里高的地球同步軌道或甚至更遠的閃電軌道上，封包來回花費的時間與海底光纜相比會長很多，通訊品質和速度也無法与之相比。
target_text: The first submarine communications cables provided cable communications, and then started to introduce telephone communications, as well as Internet communications. title: 海底電纜

source_text:
概要
目前以硬體描述語言（Verilog或VHDL）描述的逻辑電路，可以利用逻辑合成和布局、布线工具软件，快速地燒錄至FPGA上進行測試，这一过程是現代集成电路设计验证的技術主流。这些可编程逻辑元件可以被用来实现一些基本的邏輯閘数字电路（比如与门、或门、异或门、非门）或者更复杂一些的组合逻辑功能，比如译码器等。在大多数的FPGA里面，这些可编辑的元件里也包含記憶元件，例如正反器（Flip－flop）或者其他更加完整的記憶塊，从而构成时序逻辑电路。
target_text: These programmable logical elements can be used to achieve some of the basic logical digital circuits (such as doors, doors, different doors, non-doors) or more complex combination logic functions, such as code translator. In most FPGAs, these editable components also contain memory elements, such as reversible devices (Flip-flop) or other more complete memoirs.
title: 现场可编程逻辑门阵列

source_text: FPGA一般来说比特殊應用積體電路（ASIC）的速度要慢，无法完成更复杂的设计，并且会消耗更多的电能。但是，FPGA具有很多优点，比如可以快速成品，而且其内部逻辑可以被设计者反复修改，从而改正程序中的错误，此外，使用FPGA进行除錯的成本较低。厂商也可能会提供便宜、但是编辑能力有限的FPGA产品。因为这些芯片有的可编辑能力较差，所以这些设计的开发是在普通的FPGA上完成的，然后将设计转移到一个类似于专用集成电路的芯片上。在一些技术更新比较快的行业，FPGA几乎是电子系统中的必要部件，因为在大批量供货前，必须迅速抢占市场，这时FPGA方便灵活的优势就显得很重要。
target_text: FPGA is generally slower to complete more complex designs than the Special Application Cable (ASIC) and consumes more power. However, FPGA has a number of advantages, such as fast-finished products, and its internal logic can be modified repeatedly by designers to correct procedural errors, and the costs of using FPGA for debugging are lower. Vendors may also provide cheap, but limited editorial capacity for FPGA products. As these chips have less editorial capacity, they are developed on a normal FPGA and then transferred to a chip similar to a dedicated integrated circuit. In some industries where technology is more up-to-date, the FPGA is almost a necessary component of the electronic system, because the FPGA’s flexibility advantages are important when it is necessary to quickly take over the market before large quantities are supplied.
title: 现场可编程逻辑门阵列

source_text:
專業貢獻
李德財的研究興趣在於演算法設計分析、計算幾何學、VLSI佈局、演算法視覺化、生物資訊、軟體安全、數位圖書館、網際網路解題平台以及智慧傳輸系統等。他已經發表近200篇的學術性論文於重要期刊上，並經由Institute for Scientific Information（ISI）評選為論文被高度引用之學者。李德財除了擁有數項美國及中華民國專利，尤對計算幾何有傑出貢獻，是計算機科學領域中最具影響力的學者之一。目前李德財也擔任許多重要國際期刊的編輯委員、指導國內學生進行研究，並且主持多項重要大型研究計畫，包括多媒體生活環境的數位內容科學、資通安全研究與教學中心……等。
target_text: He has published nearly 200 academic papers in important journals and has been selected by Instituto for Scientific Information (ISI) as highly quoted scholars. In addition to having a number of American and Chinese expertise in the field of media life, in particular, he is one of the most influential in accounting, and is one of the most influential scientists in the field of computer science. He is currently a editor of many important international journals, directing students in the country, and leading a number of major research projects, including digital science, intellectual research and teaching centres in multi-media life.
title: 李德財

source_text: 潘洛斯撰写了探讨基础物理与人类（或者动物）意识之间联系的一些书籍。在《皇帝新脑》（1989）一书中，他声称已知的物理定律不足以解释意识现象。潘洛斯提议新物理学所具有的特性应该能填补经典物理学和量子力学（他本人称之为正确的量子引力理论）之间的理论沟壑。潘洛斯使用图灵的停机问题的变体（比如，考虑只有 ON 和 OFF 两个状态的机器，当给定的图灵机停机时，系统状态被置为 ON；当图灵机运行时，系统则被置为 OFF。如此，系统状态将完全取决于图灵机本身。但是并没有算法上可行的方法来确定图灵机是否停机）来说明一个确定性的系统并不需要一定是图灵可计算的（从算法角度讲可进行有效计算的）。
target_text: Panlos wrote books that explored the connection between basic physics and human (or animal) consciousness. In the book The Emperor’s New Brain (1989), he claimed that the known laws of physics were not sufficient to explain the phenomenon of consciousness. Panlos proposed that the properties of the new physics should fill the theoretical gap between classic physics and quantum mechanics (what he himself called the correct quantum gravity theory). Panlos used the shape of Tulin’s shutdown (for example, considering that only the machines in the state of ON and OFF were in the state of the given Turing Machine, which was in the state of the system when the engine was in operation, the system was in the position of OFF. Thus, the state of the system would depend entirely on the Turing Machine itself.
title: 羅傑·潘洛斯

source_text: 潘洛斯相信这种确定性和非算法性共存的计算过程或许在量子力学波动方程的推导中起到作用，甚至可能在智能的产生中具有作用。他认为作为一种算法确定性的系统，当前的电子计算机无法产生智能。他反对认为大脑的推理过程是完全的图灵可计算的观点（若此则大脑可被足够复杂的电子计算机复制）。潘洛斯的这方面观点与强人工智能支持者的观点相左，后者即认为思维可用算法模拟。为了驳斥后者的观点，潘洛斯声称意识是超越数理逻辑的，因为诸如停机问题的不可解性质和哥德尔不完备定理导致基于算法的逻辑系统不能产生具有人类智能特性的智能（比如，对数学的洞见）。这些说法最早得到了牛津大学莫頓学院的哲学家約翰·盧卡斯（John Lucas）的支持。
target_text: He believes that, as a system of algorithmic certainty, the current computer cannot produce intelligence. He opposes the idea that the brain's reasoning process is fully numeracy (if the brain can be replicated by sufficiently sophisticated computers). This view of Panlos is contrary to the view of powerful artificial intelligence supporters, who believe that thinking can be simulated. To refute the latter, Panlos claims that consciousness transcends logic, because logic such as the indissoluble nature of decomposition and Kodel's incompetence lead to a system of logic based on algorithms that does not produce intelligence with human intelligence (for example, insight into mathematics). These arguments were first supported by John Lucas, a philosopher at the University of Oxford's Morton College.
title: 羅傑·潘洛斯

source_text:
Windows恢复环境（WinRE）
从Windows Vista开始，微软基于WinPE开发了新的Windows恢复环境（WinRE）来取代之前XP时代的故障恢复控制台。默认情况下，在系统多次正常启动失败后，引导程序就会放弃正常启动操作系统、转而去启动WinRE，然后用户就可以利用WinRE执行系统还原、从之前的备份镜像恢复等操作，也可以使用命令提示符来备份文件、运行其他工具软件。不少OEM厂商也会对WinRE进行二次开发，利用WinRE给用户提供“一键恢复”等功能。
target_text: Windows Rehabilitation (Windows) starts with Windows Vista, and Microsoft has developed a new Windows Restoration Environment (Windows Rehabilitation) based on Winpe to replace the former XP-era failure recovery controller. By default, when the system has failed several times, the pilot program will abandon the normal start-up system and switch to WinRE, then the user will be able to use the Winre Implementation System to restore the previous backup mirrors, etc., or to use command prompts to back up files and run other tool software.
title: Windows預先安裝環境

source_text: WinPE原本是完全加载到内存中运行的，这样就可以完全摆脱WinPE系统运行中需要占用、读写磁盘的依赖。换句话说，就是在WinPE启动后，即便将搭载它的光盘/U盘等介质直接弹出，也不会影响WinPE系统本身的正常运作。但是，有些修改版WinPE因为打包了太多工具软件的缘故，要把所有数据都加载进内存，会拖慢WinPE加载启动的速度；而且，在内存容量较小的电脑上可能面临困难。因此，不少修改版WinPE制作者将镜像分为两个部分，一部分像以前一样，会被引导器完整读取、加载到内存（这个部分被一些WinPE制作者称为“内核”，很显然，此“内核”并非计算机科学术语“内核”）；另一部分则是在WinPE系统完成基本的启动过程后，再被挂载到系统上（类似地，这个部分被一些WinPE制作者称为“外壳”，此“外壳”也并非上文提到的计算机科学术语“壳层”），其中的文件数据并不会被完整加载到内存，而是按需读取。
target_text: In other words, when WinPE is activated, it will not affect the proper functioning of WinPE itself. However, some modified WinPE, because it has packed too many tool software, will be able to load all the data into the memory and slow down the speed of WinPE loading start-up; and others may face difficulties on computers with smaller memory capacity. Thus, many modified WinPE producers will have their mirrors in two parts, some of which, like the previous ones, will be fully read and loaded into the memory (this part is called “inner core” by some WinPE producers, apparently “inner core” is not a computer science term “inner core”, and the other part will be placed on the system after the basic start-up process in WinPE.
title: Windows預先安裝環境

target_text: The role of this key combination is somewhat different from that of the design of microsoft intergenerational systems, but its purpose is all the same: “for the immediate termination of the abnormal state of the computer.” By default, for example, when the operating system has not started before the machine starts (real mode), this combination allows BIOs to make a hot start (soft start), such as Windows 3.0 in the standard mode of Windows and Windows Windows in the early version of Windows; in Windows 9x, this key can be removed from the "Close Program" window, and twice in a row; in Windows 2000 and Windows XP, the "Windows Security" window can be removed; in Windows XP, the "Safety Options" window can be called out when the Welcome picture is used (default); and in Windows post-Windows Vista version, this combination will be called the "Safety Options" window.

source_text: 联机分析处理（），简称OLAP ()，是计算机技术中快速解决（MDA）的一种方法。 OLAP是更广泛的商业智能范畴的一部分，它还包括关系数据库、报告编写和数据挖掘。 OLAP的典型应用包括销售、市场营销、管理报告、业务流程管理（BPM）、預算和、財務報表以及类似领域，新的应用正在出现，如农业。 术语“OLAP”是对传统数据库术语“联机事务处理”（OLTP）稍微修改而成的。
target_text: OLAP is part of a broader range of business intelligence, including relationship databases, report writing, and data mining. The typical applications of OLAP include sales, marketing, management reporting, business process management (BPM), budgeting and financial reporting, and similar areas, and new applications are emerging, such as agriculture.
title: 線上分析處理

source_text: 为OLAP配置的数据库使用多维数据模型，允许快速执行复杂的分析查询和即席查询。 它们借鉴了、层次型数据库和关系型数据库的各个方面。OLAP通常与OLTP（联机事务处理）形成对比，OLTP的特点是查询的复杂性要小得多，而且查询量要大得多，以处理事务，而不是用于商业智能或报告。OLAP系统主要针对读取进行优化，而OLTP得能处理各种查询（读取、插入、更新和删除）。
target_text: Using multi-dimensional data models for OLAP-configured databases, they allow for the quick implementation of complex analytical queries and spot searches, drawing on various aspects of hierarchical and relationship-based databases. OLAPs are usually compared to OLTPs (on-line transaction processing), which are characterized by a much smaller complexity of queries and a much larger number of queries to deal with transactions rather than commercial intelligence or reporting. OLAP systems are primarily designed to optimize access, while OLTPs are able to process all kinds of queries (reading, inserting, updating and deleting).
title: 線上分析處理

source_text:
多维数据库
多维结构被定义为“使用多维结构组织数据并表达数据之间关系的关系模型的变体”。 该结构被分解成多个超立方体，并且在每个超立方体的范围内都能存储和访问数据。“多维结构中的每个单元都包含与其维度上的元素相关的聚合数据”。 即使对数据进行操作，也很容易访问并继续构成一种紧凑的数据库格式。数据仍然是相互关联的。
对于使用OLAP应用程序的分析数据库，多维结构非常流行。 分析型数据库使用这些数据库，是因为它们能够快速地为复杂的业务查询提供答案。可以从不同的角度查看数据，这与其他模型不同，为问题提供了更广阔的视角。
target_text: The multidimensional structure is defined as “a variant of the relationship model that uses multidimensional structure data to organize and express the relationship between the data.” The structure is broken down into multiple supercubes and contains and accesss data within each supercube. “Each element of the multidimensional structure contains aggregate data associated with elements of its dimensions.” Even when the data is operated, it is easily accessible and continues to constitute a compact database format. The data remain interconnected.
title: 線上分析處理

source_text: 因为通常有许多可以计算的聚合，所以通常只有预先确定的数字被完全计算; 其余的则根据需要求解。决定要计算哪些聚合（视图）的问题称为视图选择问题。视图选择可以受到所选聚合集的总大小、根据基础数据的更改更新它们的时间的限制，或者同时受两者的限制。视图选择的目标通常是最小化进行OLAP查询的平均时间，尽管一些研究也最小化了更新时间。视图选择是NP完全问题。这个问题已经被探索了许多方法，包括贪心算法、随机搜索、遗传算法和A*搜尋演算法。
target_text: Because there are usually many computable polymers, usually only predefined numbers are fully calculated; the rest are solved as required. The question of which polymers (views) are to be calculated is referred to as views selection. View selection can be limited by the total size of the selected polymers, by the time they are updated according to changes in the underlying data, or by both. View selection is usually aimed at minimizing the average time of OLAP queries, although some studies minimize the time of updates. View selection is a complete question for NP. The question has been explored in many ways, including graft algorithms, random searches, genetic algorithms and A* search algorithms.
title: 線上分析處理

source_text: 卡尔曼滤波的演算法是二步驟的程序。在估計步驟中，卡尔曼滤波會產生有關目前狀態的估計，其中也包括不確定性。只要觀察到下一個量測（其中一定含有某種程度的誤差，包括隨機雜訊）。會通過加權平均來更新估計值，而確定性越高的量測加權比重也越高。演算法是迭代的，可以在實時控制系統中執行，只需要目前的輸入量測、以往的計算值以及其不確定性矩陣，不需要其他以往的資訊。
target_text: The Calman filter algorithm is a two-step process. In the estimation, the Calman filter produces an estimate of the current state, which also includes uncertainty. As long as the next measurement is observed (which must contain some degree of error, including random information). The estimate is updated on average by adding rights, and the higher the weight of the determinative measure and the weight of the power. The algorithm is iterative and can be executed in the real-time control system, requiring only current input measurements, past calculations and uncertainty matrix, without any other prior information.
title: 卡尔曼滤波

source_text: 组合子逻辑是Moses Schönfinkel和哈斯凱爾·加里介入的一种符号系统，用来消除数理逻辑中对变量的需要。它最近在计算机科学中被用做计算的理论模型和设计函数式编程语言的基础。它所基于的组合子是只使用函数应用或早先定义的组合子来定义从它们的参数得出的结果的高阶函数。
target_text: Combining sublogic is a symbolic system in which Moses Schönfinkel and Haskell Garry intervenes to eliminate the need for variables in mathematical logic. It has recently been used in computer science as the basis for the theoretical model of calculation and the programming language of the design function. It is based on the combination that uses only functions or earlier defined combinations to define the high-level functions of the results derived from their parameters.
title: 组合子逻辑

source_text: 组合子逻辑可以被看作是lambda演算的变体，它把lambda表达式（用来允许函数抽象）替代为组合子的有限集合，它们是不包含自由变量的原始函数。很容易把lambda表达式变换成组合子表达式，并且因为组合子归约比lambda归约要简单，它已经被用做用软件中的某些非严格的函数式编程语言和硬件的图归约机的实现基础。
target_text: Combining sublogic logic can be seen as a variant of the lambda calculation, which replaces the lambda expression (used to allow the abstraction of functions) with a limited collection of the combinations, which are original functions that do not contain free variables. It is easy to convert the lambda expression into a combination of subexpressions, and because the combination is simpler than the Rambda offer, it has been used as a basis for the realization of some of the non-reciprocal functional programming languages and hardware in the software.
title: 组合子逻辑

source_text: Kenneth E. Iverson在他的J编程语言中使用了基于Curry的组合子的原语（primitive），J语言是APL语言的后继者。这使得Iverson达成了隐式编程，就是说，编程采用不包含变量的函数表达式，并一起使用与这种程序共同工作的强力工具。结果是在任何带有用户定义算子的类APL语言中隐式编程都是可能的。
target_text: Kenneth E. Iverson uses the original Curry-based combination (primitive) in his J programming language, which is the successor to the APL language. This has enabled Iverson to use implicit programming, i.e. a functional expression that does not contain variables, and a powerful tool to work with the program together. The result is that it is possible to do so in any type of APL language with user-defined algorithms.
title: 组合子逻辑

source_text: 有类型lambda演算是使用lambda符号（）指示匿名函数抽象的一种有类型的形式化。有类型lambda演算是基础编程语言并且是有类型的函数式编程语言如ML和Haskell和更间接的指令式编程语言的基础。它们通过Curry-Howard同构密切关联于直觉逻辑并可以被认为是范畴的类的内部语言，比如简单类型lambda演算是笛卡尔闭范畴（CCC）的语言。
target_text: There are types of lambda plays that are sort of a type of formalization that uses the lambda symbol() to indicate the abstract of anonymous functions. Some types of lambda plays are basic programming languages and are the basis for type of functional programming languages, such as ML and Haskell, and more indirect command programming languages. source_text: make是一个在软件开发中所使用的工具程式（Utility software），經由讀取“makefile”的文件以自動化建構軟體。它是一種转化文件形式的工具，转换的目标称为“target”；与此同时，它也检查文件的依赖关系，如果需要的话，它会调用一些外部软件来完成任务。它的依赖关系检查系统非常简单，主要根据依赖文件的修改时间进行判断。大多数情况下，它被用来编译源代码，生成结果代码，然后把结果代码连接起来生成可执行文件或者库文件。它使用叫做“makefile”的文件来确定一个target文件的依赖关系，然后把生成这个target的相关命令传给shell去执行。
target_text: Make is a tool program used in software development (Utility software) that is automatically constructed by reading the "makefile" file. It is a conversion file format tool with a conversion goal called "target"; at the same time, it also examines the dependency of the document and calls some external software, if necessary, to complete the task. It relies on a relationship check system that is very simple, judging mainly by the time the document is modified. In most cases, it is used to compile the source code, generate the result code, then connect the result code to the executable file or library file. It uses a document called "makefile" to determine the dependency of a target file and then transmits the relevant command that generated the target to Shell for execution.
title: Make

source_text:

target_text: The source is that, although there are a number of dependent inspection tools, make is the most widely used. This is due to its inclusion in the Unix system. In 2003, Stuart Feldman received a software system award from the American Computer Association (ACM) for having invented such an important tool.

source_text: 起初，复读机被他称为“电子式语言学习机”。复读机是在便携式磁带收录机的基础上，增加了微处理芯片、数字存储芯片后形成的多功能语言信号存取设备。复读机所有状态的转换均是在电脑微处理芯片的控制下来完成的。它是在磁带放音的同时将模拟信号转换为数字信号，储存在数字存储芯片中；复读状态时再将数字存储器中的信号转换为模拟信号，通过功率放大后由扬声器还原出声音。由于复读过程无需倒带，可有效避免磁头磨损。另外，复读机还具有跟读对比功能，即将磁带录音与使用者的录音反复播放，以纠正使用者的发音。

source_text: 在编程语言中，命名空间是对作用域的一种特殊的抽象，它包含了处于该作用域内的标识符，且本身也用一个标识符来表示，这样便将一系列在逻辑上相关的标识符用一个标识符组织了起来。许多现代编程语言都支持命名空间。在一些编程语言（例如C++和Python）中，命名空间本身的标识符也属于一个外层的命名空间，也即命名空间可以嵌套，构成一个命名空间树，树根则是无名的全局命名空间。
target_text: In programming languages, naming space is a special abstraction of the field of interest, which contains identifiers in the field and is expressed in an identifier itself, so that a series of logically relevant identifiers are organized with an identifier. Many modern programming languages support naming space. In some programming languages (e.g. C++ and Python), naming space itself also belongs to an outer layer of naming space, i.e., a naming space can be nested, forming a naming space tree, with roots being an anonymous global naming space.

source_text: EEPROM分为四種工作模式：讀取模式、寫入模式、擦除模式、校驗模式。讀取時，芯片只需要Vcc低電壓（一般+5V）供電。而在編程寫入時，芯片会通過Vpp（一般+25V, 有时較新者會使用 +12V 或 +5V）獲得編程電壓，並通過PGM編程脈衝（一般為50ms）寫入數據。擦除時，只需使用Vpp高電壓，不需要紫外線照射，便可以擦除指定地址中的內容。為保證寫入正確，每寫入一塊數據後，都需要進行類似於讀取的校驗步驟，若錯誤就重新寫入。現今的 EEPROM 通常已不再需要使用額外的 Vpp 電壓，且寫入時間也已有縮短。在民用的DDR SDRAM及其主流後續產品中，一般 EEPROM 主要用於保存內存的開發者信息、生產時間、內存信息、通訊協議、既定内存频率、供電電壓、供電電流、物理訊息以及內存XMP等訊息，且電腦會在开机自檢（Power-On Self-Test；POST）時會讀取這些訊息以保持電腦的正常开机。
target_text: EEPROM is divided into four modes of work: reading the mode, writing the mode, wiping the mode, and proofing the mode. When you read the chip, only Vcc low voltage (general +5V) is needed. When you write it, the chip gets programmed voltage via Vpp (general +25V, sometimes newer users use +12V or +5V) and using the PGM programming pulse (generally 50 ms) to write the data. When you erase it, you use Vpp high volt pressure, without the need for ultraviolet radiation, you can erase the contents of the designated address. To ensure that it is correctly written, the chip will need to be copied through Vpp (generally +25V, sometimes newer users use +12V or +5V).
title: 電子抹除式可複寫唯讀記憶體

target_text: The file format APE APE is an audio file format, usually using the .ape extension and sometimes the .MAC extension. The APE format uses non-destructive data compression, which allows limited compression of WAV track files without lowering the audio quality, generally at about 55%. In sound quality, there is an absolute advantage over formats that undermine data compression such as WMA, MP3, AAC. The APE file structure is defined by Monkey's Audio. Monkey's Audio provides software to convert to other audio file formats. Through plugins, APE files can be shown in multimedia software from different system platforms such as foobar 2000, Nullsof's Winamp and Microsoft's media player, and more and more portable media players have recently joined support for APE files.

source_text: 在早期，基因识别的主要手段是基于活的细胞或生物的实验。通过对若干种不同基因的同源重组的速率的统计分析，我们能够获知它们在染色体上的顺序。若进行大量类似的分析，我们可以确定各个基因的大致位置。现在，由于人类已经获得了巨大数量的基因组信息，依靠较慢的实验分析已不能满足基因识别的需要，而基于计算机算法的基因识别得到了长足的发展，成为了基因识别的主要手段。
target_text: At an early stage, the primary means of genetic recognition was based on experiments in living cells or organisms. By statistical analysis of the rate of reorganisation of several homogenous genes, we were able to learn their sequence on chromosomes. If there were a lot of similar analyses, we could determine the approximate location of the genes. Now, since humankind has acquired a huge amount of genome information, it is impossible to meet the need for genetic recognition on the basis of slower experimental analysis, and genetic recognition based on computer algorithms has developed considerably and has become the primary means of genetic identification.
title: 基因预测

source_text: 在基因的间接识别法（Extrinsic Approach）中，人们利用已知的mRNA或蛋白质序列为线索在DNA序列中搜寻所对应的片段。由给定的mRNA序列确定唯一的作为转录源的DNA序列；而由给定的蛋白质序列，也可以由密码子反转确定一族可能的DNA序列。因此，-{在}-线索的提示下搜寻工作相对较为容易，搜寻算法的关键在于提高效率，并能够容忍由于测序不完整或者不精确所带来的误差。BLAST是目前以此为目的最广泛使用的软件之一。
target_text: In the indirect recognition of genes (Extrinsic Approach), people use known mRNA or protein sequences as clues to search for the corresponding fragments in the DNA sequence. The given mRNA sequence determines the only DNA sequence that serves as a transposable source; and the given protein sequence, which can also be reversed by a code child, determines the possible DNA sequence of a family. Thus, the search under the hint of the clue is relatively easy, and the key to the algorithm is to improve efficiency and to tolerate errors caused by incomplete or inaccurate sequencing. BLAST is one of the most widely used software for this purpose.
title: 基因预测

source_text: 全自动区分计算机和人类的图灵测试（，簡稱CAPTCHA），又称验证码，是一种区分用户是機器或人類的公共全自动程序。在CAPTCHA测试中，作为服务器的计算机会自动生成一个问题由用户来解答。这个问题可以由计算机生成并评判，但是必须只有人类才能解答。由于機器无法解答CAPTCHA的问题，回答出问题的用户即可視為人类。
target_text: A complete automatic distinction between computers and humans ' Turing Tests, also known as CAPTCHA, is a public, fully automated program that distinguishes users from machines or humans. In CAPTCHA tests, a computer that serves as a server automatically generates a question for users to answer. This question can be generated and judged by computers, but only humans must answer it. Since machines cannot answer CAPTCHA ' s questions, users who answer questions can be considered humans.
title: 验证码

source_text:
簡介
CAPTCHA这个词最早是在2002年由卡内基梅隆大学的路易斯·馮·安、Manuel Blum、Nicholas J.Hopper以及IBM的John Langford所提出。卡内基梅隆大学曾试图申請此詞使其成为注册商标， 但该申请于2008年4月21日被拒绝。一种常用的CAPTCHA测试是让用户输入一个扭曲变形的图片上所显示的文字或数字，扭曲變形是為了避免被光學字元識別之類的電腦程式自動辨識出圖片上的文數字而失去效果。由于这个测试是由计算机来考人类，而不是标准图灵测试中那样由人类来考计算机，人们有时称CAPTCHA是一种反向图灵测试。
target_text: The word CAPTCHA was first proposed in 2002 by Luis Von Ann, Manuel Blum, Nicholas J. Hopper and John Langford of IBM at Carnegie Melon University. Carnegie Melon University tried to apply for the term to be a registered trademark, but the application was rejected on 21 April 2008. A common CAPTCHA test was to allow users to enter words or numbers on a distorted image, which was distorted to avoid automatic identification of the graphic numbers by a computer program that had an optical mosaic. Since the test was a computer for humans, rather than a standard Turing test, it was sometimes described as a counter-Turling test.
title: 验证码

source_text: 為了無法看到圖像的身心障礙者，替代的方法是改用語音讀出文數字，為了防止語音辨識分析聲音，聲音的內容會有雜音或仍可以被人类接受的变声。根據CAPTCHA測試的定義，產生驗證碼圖片的算法必須公開，即使該算法可能有專利保護。這樣做是證明想破解就需要解決一個不同的人工智能難題，而非僅靠發現原來的（秘密）算法，而後者可以用逆向工程等途徑得到。
target_text: In order to be unable to see the physical and mental impairments of the image, the alternative is to read text numbers in words, and to prevent speech recognition and sound analysis, the content of the sound may be murky or still acceptable to humans. According to the definition of the CAPTCHA test, the algorithm for producing the proof-code image must be made public, even if it may have proprietary protection. This is proof that a solution to the problem requires a different artificial intelligence problem, rather than merely discovering the original (secret) algorithms, which can be obtained through reverse engineering and so on.
title: 验证码

source_text:
历史
早期，代码页是IBM称呼计算机的BIOS所支持的字符集编码。当时通用的操作系统都是命令行界面，这些操作系统直接使用BIOS提供的字符绘制功能来显示字符（或者是一组嵌入在显卡字符生成器中的字形）。这些BIOS代码页也被称为OEM代码页。图形操作系统使用自己的字符呈现引擎（rendering engine），可以支持多个不同的字符集编码，这类代码页被称作ANSI代码页。
target_text: Early on, the code page was the character set coding supported by the BIOS, which IBM called the computer. At that time, the universal operating system was a command line interface, using the character drawing function provided by BIOS directly to display characters (or a set of characters embedded in the card character generator). These BIOS code pages are also called OEM code pages. The graphic operating system uses its own character presentation engine, which supports several different character set coding lines, known as the ANSI code page.
title: 代码页

source_text: 1987年4月，IBM发布了PC-DOS 3.3，正式开始使用16比特的无符号整数标识不同的代码页。这时的PC机使用CGA显示系统的字符界面，绘制不同语言的字符依靠BIOS硬件厂商（在当时就是指制定业界标准的IBM）提供的功能。如果想更换所支持的字符集，就必须换上支持该字符集的ROM芯片。微软作为DOS操作系统的软件厂商，并不拥有绘制这些字符集的知识产权。所以这些字符集的绘制实现，称作OEM代码页。最常见、最具代表性的OEM代码页是"IBM PC或MS-DOS 代码页437"。
target_text: In April 1987, IBM released PC-DOS 3.3, officially starting to use 16 bits of unsigned integer identifiers for different code pages. At this time, the PC machine uses the CGA character interface for displaying the system, drawing the characters in different languages, relying on the functionality provided by the BIOS hardware manufacturer (which at the time meant setting industry standards IBM). If you want to replace the supported character set, you have to replace the ROM chip that supports the character set. Microsoft, as the software manufacturer of the DOS operating system, does not have the intellectual property right to draw these character sets. So the drawing of these sets is called the OEM code page. The most common and representative OEM code page is "IBM PC or MS-DOS code page 437".
title: 代码页

source_text: 分布式数据库是用计算机网络将物理上分散的多个数据库单元连接起来组成的一个逻辑上统一的数据库。每个被连接起来的数据库单元称为站点或节点。分布式数据库有一个统一的数据库管理系统来进行管理，称为分布式数据库管理系统。
target_text: Distributed databases are a logically unified database that is linked by a computer network to physically dispersed multiple database modules. Each linked database unit is called a site or node. Distributed databases are managed by a unified database management system, known as a distributed database management system.
title: 分布式数据库

source_text: 分布式数据库的基本特点包括：物理分布性、逻辑整体性和站点自治性。从这三个基本特点还可以导出的其它特点有：数据分布透明性、按既定协议达成共识的机制、适当的数据冗余度和事务管理的分布性。分布式数据库按照各站点中数据库管理系统的数据模型的异同分为异构型分布式数据库和同构型分布式数据库，按照控制系统的类型分为全局控制集中性、全局控制分散型和全局控制可变型。
target_text: The basic features of the distributed database are: physical distribution, logical integrity and site autonomy. Other features that can be derived from these three basic features are transparency in data distribution, mechanisms for reaching consensus on established agreements, appropriate data redundancy and distribution of service management. Distributive databases are divided into hesitant distributed databases and identical distributed databases according to the differences in the data models of the database management system in each site, and global control concentration, global control fragmentation and global control variable according to the type of control system.
title: 分布式数据库

source_text:
事务性质
由于分布式数据库的结构特性，根据分布式系统的CAP定理，实现ACID事务需要付出很大的成本来维护可用性，所以为了保障可用性而总结出一套弱化的事务特性：
基本可用（Basically Available）：系统能够基本运行、一直提供服务。
软状态（Soft-state）：系统不要求一直保持强一致状态。
最终一致性（Eventual consistency）：系统需要在某一时刻后达到一致性要求。
简称BASE，与ACID相对应（acid为“酸”的英文名称，base为“碱”的英文名称）。
target_text: Because of the structural characteristics of the distributed database and the high cost of maintaining the availability of the ACID services according to the CAP theorem of the distributed system, a weaker set of service features has been developed for the purpose of ensuring usability: Basic Available: the system is capable of basic operation and continuous service provision. Soft-state: the system does not require constant consistency. Final Consistency: the system needs to meet the requirements of consistency at a certain point in time.
title: 分布式数据库

在数学和计算机科学中，高阶函数是至少满足下列一个条件的函数：
接受一个或多个函数作为输入
输出一个函数
在数学中它们也叫做算子（运算符）或泛函。微积分中的导数就是常见的例子，因为它映射一个函数到另一个函数。在无类型lambda演算，所有函数都是高阶的；在有类型lambda演算中，高阶函数一般是那些函數型別包含多于一个箭头的函数。在函数式编程中，返回另一个函数的高阶函数被称为Curry化的函数。
target_text: In mathematics and computer science, a high-level function is a function that meets at least one of the following conditions: Accepts one or more functions as input output of a function, and in mathematics they are also called arithmetic (operator) or a general message. The guide in the calculus is a common example because it maps a function to another function. In the non-type lambda calculation, all functions are elevated; in the case of a type lambda calculation, the high-level function is typically those in which the function type contains more than one arrow. In the function programming, the higher function that returns another function is called a Curry function.
title: 高阶函数

source_text:
当代的无线电探空仪经由无线电与地面的计算机通讯。计算机实时存储这些传回的数据。最初无线电探空测风仪由地面通过经纬仪观测，通过测量大气中仪器的位置变化来估算风速。而当代无线电探空仪可选用多种装置测定风速和风向，诸如Loran（远距离无线电导航系统）、无线电定向仪、GPS等。当代无线电探空仪测量的重要数据包括：大气压力、高度、经纬度、温度、相对湿度和风速风向等。
一些无线电探空仪同时测量大气臭氧浓度。通过对数据的分析可以绘制图表。科学家可以用图表解释说明大气现象例如大气逆温现象。
target_text: Contemporary radio soundings are communicated by radio and ground computers. Computers store these returned data in real time. The initial radio soundings are observed on the ground by longitudinal instruments, which measure changes in the position of instruments in the atmosphere to estimate wind speeds. Contemporary radio soundings can choose to use a variety of devices to determine wind speed and direction, such as Loran (long-range radio navigation system), radio orientation devices, GPS, etc. Important data from contemporary radio soundings include atmospheric pressure, altitude, longitude, temperature, relative humidity, and wind speed winds.
title: 无线电探空仪

source_text: 两个主要原因让用户使用对象数据库技术。首先，关系数据库在管理复杂数据时显得笨重。其次，被应用软件操作的数据一般是用面向对象的编程语言如C++, Java, Delphi和C#写成，而那些用来转化数据表示和关系数据库元组的代码很冗繁，执行时也有不少耗时。这种应用程序和数据库表示信息的模式之间的不匹配有时也被称为impedance mismatch。
target_text: Two main reasons allow users to use object database technology. First, the relationship database is cumbersome in managing complex data. Second, the data operated by the application software is usually written in object-oriented programming languages such as C++, Java, Delphi and C#, while the codes used to convert data expressions and related database components are cumbersome and time-consuming to implement. The mismatch between this application and the mode in which the database expresses information is sometimes referred to as impedance mismatch.
title: 对象数据库

source_text:
对象数据库的采纳
基于持久编程的对象数据库在一些应用领域获得了认可，如工程和空间数据库，通信和科学领域如高能物理和分子生物。他们对主流的商业数据处理没有什么影响，尽管获得了一些应用在部分特殊领域如金融服务。值得指出的是：对象数据库保持着「世界上最大的数据库（超过1000Terabytes在斯坦福线性加速中心）和最高摄取率（一Terabyte每小时）」的记录。
target_text: The adoption of object databases based on persistent programming has been recognized in a number of applications, such as engineering and space databases, communications and science such as high-energy physics and molecular biology. They have had little effect on mainstream commercial data processing, although some applications have been obtained in specific areas, such as financial services.
title: 对象数据库

source_text:
技术特性
在纯物件式資料庫中，資料以物件的形式存储，这些对象只能由其所属的类中定义的方法来操作。对象被组成一种类型层次（有时是格式lattic），子类继承其超类的特性。对象中可以有到其他对象的引用，于是应用程序可以以一种导航式的编程风格访问数据。
target_text: Technical properties In a pure object database, the data is stored as objects, which can only be operated by a method defined in the category to which you belong. The object is formed at a level of type (sometimes formatattic), and the subcategory inherits its superclassic properties. The object can be referenced to other objects, so the application can access data in a navigational programming style.
title: 对象数据库

source_text: 多数物件式資料庫也提供了一些查询语言，允许用声明式编程访问对象。在对象查询语言以及查询和导航接口的集成领域，产品间出现了很大的区别。ODMG用对象查询语言OQL作了标准化的尝试。访问数据可以更快，表的联合常常是不必要的（在关系数据库的表实现方式下）。这是因为无需查询只需通过指针（）就可以直接获得对象。
target_text: Most object databases also provide query languages that allow statement programming to access objects. There are significant differences between products in the object query language and in the integration of query and navigation interfaces. ODSG uses object query language OQL as a standardized attempt. Access data can be faster, and synthesizing tables is often unnecessary (in the form of the relationship database).
title: 对象数据库

source_text: 产品间的另一点不同是数据库定义模式的方式。然而一般的特征是编程语言和数据库模式使用相同类型的定义。多媒体应用程序将变得容易因为与数据相关的类方法保证了数据的正确解释。许多对象数据库提供对版本的支持。一个对象可以看作是他所有版本的集合。同时，对象版本也可以被看作是对象自身的属性。一些对象数据库也提供了对触发器和约束的语义支持，这些特性是活跃数据库（active database）的基础。
target_text: Another difference between products is the way the database defines the model. However, the general feature is that programming languages and database models use the same type of definition. Multimedia applications will become easier to interpret data correctly because of data-related class methodologies. Many object databases provide support for the version. An object can be seen as a collection of all his versions. At the same time, an object version can also be seen as the attributes of the object itself. Some object databases also provide semantic support for triggers and constraints, which are the basis for active databases.
title: 对象数据库

source_text:
优势和劣势
对ODBMS和关系DBMS的基准测试显示ODBMS在某些任务上优势明显。主要原因是许多操作使用导航式而不是声明式接口，并且对数据的导航式访问通常可以有指针高效的实现。对基于导航数据库技术，如ODBMS的批评指出，基于指针的技术为一些特殊的搜索路径或视点（viewpoint）作了优化。而且，对一般目的的查询，基于指针的技术比关系型要慢并难于形式化。导航式显得适合于特定应用而失了普遍，未来的使用。
target_text: The main reason is that many operations use navigational rather than declaratory interfaces, and navigational access to data can often be achieved efficiently by pointing. Critics of navigation-based database technologies, such as ODSMS, suggest that guidance-based techniques optimize special search paths or viewpoints. And, for general purpose queries, pointer-based techniques are slower and more difficult to form than relationship patterns.
title: 对象数据库

source_text: ODBMS的其他技术，显得缺失了与SQL世界中大量工具或特性的互操作性，包括但不限于产业标准互联性，报告工具，OLAP工具以及备份和恢复标准。另外，不像关系数据库，对象数据库缺少形式化的数学基础，而这反过来导致他们在查询支持上的弱势。不过，这一缺陷被部分弥补，因为一些ODBMS除了导航式访问外也提供了对SQL的完全支持，如Objectivity/SQL++。
target_text: Other ODBMS technologies appear to lack interoperability with a large number of tools or features in the SQL world, including, but not limited to, industry standard connectivity, reporting tools, OLAP tools, and backup and restoration standards. Moreover, unlike relationship databases, subject databases lack a formalised mathematical base, which in turn makes them vulnerable to search support.
title: 对象数据库

source_text: 事实上，在概念封装，即隐藏数据，使他只能通过公布的一些接口访问和关系数据库技术假定：数据只能由基于数据内容的查询，而不是预定义的查询路径的形式访问之间，存在着本质的张力。数据库中心论，倾向于用声明和属性驱动的观点看世界，而面向对象倾向于从行为的观点看世界。这就是围绕着OOP和数据库的许多impedance mismatch问题之一。
target_text: In fact, there is an essential tension between the conceptual encapsulation, i.e. the concealment of data, which allows him to access the database technology only through some published interfaces: data can only be accessed in the form of a query based on the content of the data, rather than a predefined search path. The central theory of the database is that it tends to look at the world from a statement and attribute-driven perspective, and towards the object from a behavioural point of view. That is one of the many problems surrounding OOP and the database.
title: 对象数据库

source_text:
兽药中心最基本的工作是监管提供给食用动物的药品，确保其不至于影响对人类的食物供应。美国食品药品监督管理局控制疯牛病的工作也是通过兽药中心对饲料制造商的检查得以施行。
2007年12月19日，美国食品药品监督管理局宣布建立一个用以跟踪食物系统中的克隆动物的数据库，借以使相关鉴别程序得以有效进行。这个数据库将成为全国动物识别系统（National Animal Identification System）的一部分，该系统用于跟踪全美所有从还在农场饲养到已上餐桌的家畜。
target_text: On December 19, 2007, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration announced the establishment of a database to track cloned animals in the food system, which will be part of the National Animal Identification System, which will be used to track all United States livestock from farm to table.
title: 美国食品药品监督管理局

source_text:
HMM有三个典型(canonical)问题:
预测(filter)：已知模型参数和某一特定输出序列，求最后时刻各个隐含状态的概率分布，即求 。通常使用前向算法解决。
平滑(smoothing)：已知模型参数和某一特定输出序列，求中间时刻各个隐含状态的概率分布，即求 。通常使用前向-后向算法解决。
解码(most likely explanation)：已知模型参数，寻找最可能的能产生某一特定输出序列的隐含状态的序列，即求 。通常使用Viterbi算法解决。
target_text: HMM has three typical (canonical) problems: Forecast (filter): known model parameters and a given output sequence, seeking the probability distribution of the last implied state, i.e., the probability distribution of the last moment. Usually solves with forward algorithms. Smoothing: known model parameters and a given output sequence, looking for the probability distribution of the implied state of the intermediate moment. Usually solves with forward-back algorithms. Decoding (morst likely exitation): known model parameters, looking for the most likely sequence to produce the hidden state of a given output sequence, i. e. usually with Viterbi algorithms.
title: 隐马尔可夫模型

source_text:
Moravec 角檢測演算法
這是最早使用來做角檢測的做法，他首先定義所謂的「角」就是那些自我相似程度低的點。這個演算法檢查所有圖像中的像素，並考慮以該像素為中心點的一片範圍，該範圍與他周圍覆蓋最大的另一個範圍的相似度做為參考，而相似度通常是將兩個範圍的對應點計算誤差的平方和(SSD: Sum of Squared differences) ，越小代表相似度越高。
target_text: The Moravec Corner Test algorithm, which was the first to be used for an angle test, defines the so-called "angle" as the low self-resemblance. The algorithm examines pixels in all images and considers that they are a range centred on the pixel, which is considered to be similar to the other of the largest dimensions around him, whereas the similarities are usually the squares of the counter-point miscalculations of the two dimensions (SSD: Sum of Square differences).
title: 角检测

source_text: 然而，标准的Base64并不适合直接放在URL裡传输，因为URL编码器会把标准Base64中的/和+字符变为形如%XX的形式，而这些%号在存入数据库时还需要再进行转换，因为ANSI SQL中已将%号用作通配符。为解决此问题，可采用一种用于URL的改进Base64编码，它不在末尾填充=号，并将标准Base64中的+和/分别改成了-和_，这样就免去了在URL编解码和数据库存储时所要做的转换，避免了编码信息长度在此过程中的增加，并统一了数据库、表单等处对象标识符的格式。
target_text: However, standard Base64 is not suitable for direct transmission in URL, because the URL encoder will transform the characters in standard Base64 and + into forms such as %XX, and these % numbers will need to be converted when they are placed in the database, because the ANSI SQL has used the % as a wildcard. To address this problem, an improved Base64 code for URL could be used, which is not filled = at the end, and changes + and / respectively in standard Base64 to _, thus eliminating the conversions to be made in URL decoding and database storage, avoiding an increase in the length of encoded information in this process, and harmonizing the format of the database, form, etc. object identifiers.
title: Base64

source_text:
历史
伊朗软件工程师Roozbeh Pvrnadr和M. Lynqyan把维基软件翻译为波斯語。当时波斯語維基百科仅有1000个条目。后来条目数量不断增加，2008年10月31日数量突破5万，2010年8月25日突破10万。波斯語維基百科条目数在此之后分别超越沃拉普克语维基百科、泰语维基百科、斯洛伐克语维基百科、罗马尼亚语维基百科、土耳其语维基百科和韩语维基百科，在2012年7月12日条目数突破20万。
target_text: History Iranian software engineers Roozbeh Pvrnadr and M. Lynqyan translated Wikipedia software into Persian. There were only 1,000 entries in the Persian language. The number of subsequent entries rose to 50,000 on October 31, 2008 and 100,000 on August 25, 2010. The number of Persian Wikipedia entries went beyond Vorapuk Wikipedia, Thai Wikipedia, Slovak Wikipedia, Romanian Wikipedia, Turkish Wikipedia and Korean Wikipedia, respectively, to 200,000 on July 12, 2012.
title: 波斯語維基百科

source_text:
波斯語維基百科遇到的主要挑战和问题有：
互联网普及率低，2007年伊朗使用互联网的人约750万，占总人口的10.6％；而阿富汗的互联网普及率仅为1.1％，只有三十万人口使用互联网。
语言标准不规范：用Google搜索波斯文时里面如果多出了零宽非连接空格会得到完全不同的结果。
互联网上波斯文内容不多：编辑者从网上查到的波斯文内容不少是在一个叫Khvdnvshtha的博客中，不符合可靠来源的标准。
网络连接问题：宽带家庭上网，大多数伊朗人只能从网络提供商申请到128kbps的带宽，很少用户可以使用ADSL。因为很多图像大小超过1MB，上传这些图像需要数十秒钟。
国家没有成熟的版权法规，早期上传的图片很多侵权。
target_text: The main challenges and problems encountered by the Persian language Wikipedia are: low Internet penetration, with approximately 7.5 million people using the Internet in Iran in 2007, accounting for 10.6% of the total population; and Internet penetration in Afghanistan, with only 1.1% and only 300,000 people using the Internet. Language standards are irregular: zero-wide non-connection spaces are available when Google searches Persian.
title: 波斯語維基百科

Symbian是以EPOC為基礎，而它的架構於許多桌上型作業系統相似，它包含先佔式多工、多執行緒和記憶體保護。Symbian的最大優勢是在於它是為便攜式裝置而設計，而在有限的資源下，可以執行數月甚至數年。而這要歸功於节省記憶體、使用Symbian风格的编程理念和清除堆栈。將這些功能與其他技術搭配使用，會使記憶體使用量降低且記憶體泄漏量極少。類似技術也運用於节省磁碟（尽管在Symbian设备中，硬盘通常指闪存）和記憶卡使用空間。而且，Symbian的編程是使用事件驱动，當應用程式沒有处理事件时，CPU會被關閉。這是通过一种叫主動式对象的编程理念实现的。正確的使用這些技術將能夠延長電池使用時間。
這些技術讓Symbian的C++變得非常專業，並有著過陡的學習曲線。然而，許多Symbian的设备也可以利用OPL、Python、Visual Basic、Simkin以及Perl來搭配J2ME和自行開發的Java來使用。
target_text: Symbian is based on the EPOC, which is built in a number of desktop systems that are similar to pre-occupied multi-work, multi-manufacturing, and memory protection. Symbian's greatest advantage is that it is designed for portable devices, which, with limited resources, can run for months or even years. And Symbian's programming is driven by events, and CPU is shut down when the appliance does not deal with events. This is done through a programming concept called active objects.
title: Symbian

source_text:
发展阶段
在Symbian发展阶段，出现了三个分支：分别是Crystal、Pearl和Quarz。前两个主要针对通信设备市场，也是出现在手机上最多的，是塞班智能手机操作系统的主力军。第一款基于Symbian 系统的手机是2000年上市的爱立信手机。而真正较为成熟的同时引起人们注意的则是2001年上市的诺基亚9210，它采用了Crystal分支的系统。而2002年推出的诺基亚7650与3650则是Symbian Pearl分系的机型，其中7650是第一款基于2.5G网的智能手机产品，他们都属于Symbian的6.0版本。索尼爱立信推出的一款机型也使用了Symbian的Pearl分支，版本已经发展到7.0，是专为3G网络而开发的，可以说代表了当今最强大的手机操作系统。此外，Symbian从6.0版本就开始支持外接存储设备，如MMC,CF卡等，这让它强大的扩展能力得以充分发挥，使存放更多的软件以及各种大容量的多媒体文件成为了可能。
target_text: In the development phase of Symbian, three branches have emerged: Crystal, Pearl, and Quartz, respectively. The two former major markets for telecommunications equipment, and the largest on mobile phones, are the main forces of the Saban smartphone operating system. The first is based on Symbian's mobile phone, which was listed in 2000.
title: Symbian

source_text:
開放性
一個普遍的共同問題是Symbian並不是"開放"的。它並沒有開放到核心源代码（源代码从沒有公開）。然而，几乎所有源代码都提供給使用Symbian的手機製造商和其他合作夥伴。再者，很多應用程序接口（API）都有公開其技術文件，使任何人都可以開發Symbian的软件。這與其他傳統的嵌入式作業系統形成對比，因為後者除了Java程序以外並無法提供任何後繼市場的软件。
2011年3月30日诺基亚公司的开源项目主管 Petra Soderling 以“We are Open”为名在诺基亚官方博客宣称Symbian从即日（即2011年3月30日）起，新一代的Symbian操作系统的绝大源代码将上传到collab.symbian.nokia.com网站（此域名现已无法访问），供平台开发合作伙伴下载进行再开发。也就是说任何人、任何公司都能无条件使用Symbian代码。因为诺基亚在3月份和微软合作开发Windows Phone 7，并将其作为诺基亚手机的主打系统，虽然会继续保持对其的技术支持，包括提供开发工具和SDK等形式，但不再提供对Symbian系统进行更新。
target_text: A common problem that is common to all is that Symbian is not an "open" system. It is not open to core source code (the source code has never been made public). However, almost all source code is available to mobile manufacturers and other partners using Symbian. Moreover, many app interfaces (APIs) have published their technical documents so that anyone can develop Symbian software. This contrasts with other traditional embedded business systems, since the source code of the new generation of Symbian operating system will not provide any rear market software other than the Java program.
title: Symbian

source_text: PCI标准被立即应用于服务器中，取代了先前的MCA及EISA，成为服务器扩展总线的不二选择。在主流个人计算机中，PCI标准则缓慢地取代着VESA局部总线（VLB）；直至1994年后期第二代奔腾PC推出后，该标准方得以实现具有重要意义的市场突破。1996年，VLB彻底退出了个人计算机市场，制造厂商甚至将PCI标准应用于486计算机中。EISA标准则与PCI标准共存使用至2000年。苹果电脑在1995年中期将PCI标准应用于专业产品Power Macintosh电脑中（而取代了NuBus），而消费者产品Macintosh Performa则于1996年中期完成了换代（取代了LC PDS）。
target_text: PCI standards were immediately applied to servers, replacing previous MCAs and EISAs as a universal option for server extension. In mainstream personal computers, the PCI standard slowly replaced the VESA local bus (VLB); until the introduction of the second generation of the Pentecostal PC in late 1994, the standard was able to achieve a significant market breakthrough. In 1996, VLB completely withdrew from the PC market, and manufacturers even applied the PCI standard to 486 computers. The EISA standard was used in harmony with the PCI standard until 2000. Apple computers applied the PCI standard to the professional Power Macintosh computer in mid-1995 (which replaced NuBus), while the consumer product Macintosh Performa completed a replacement (which replaced LCPDS) in mid-1996.

source_text: DirectShow（有时缩写如DS或DShow），开发代号Quartz，是一种由微软公司开发的能够让软件开发者对媒体文件执行各种不同处理的应用程序设计接口。它是微软公司对早先Windows视频科技的一次更新。基于微软公司Windows组件对象模型（COM）框架，DirectShow为大部份微软公司程序设计语言提供了一个媒体的普遍接口，而且是一个可扩展的，能在使用者或开发者的命令下播放或记录媒体文件的，以Filter为基础的框架。DirectShow开发工具及凭证被加入到微软公司SDK平台的一部份。Windows Media Player这样的应用程序运用DirectShow或者它的各种衍生来播放来自文件或是互联网上的内容。DirectShow's的最大的竞争对手是苹果计算机的QuickTime框架。
target_text: DirectShow (in some cases, DS or DShow) provides a universal media interface for most Microsoft programming languages and is an extended Quantz-based framework that allows software developers to perform different kinds of processing of media documents. DirectShow development tools and certificates are added to a part of the Microsoft SDK platform. Windows Media Player applications use DirectShow or its derivatives to broadcast content from documents or the Internet. The biggest competitor of DirectShow's is the QuickTime Framework for Apple Computers.
title: DirectShow

source_text: 不同于为了读取媒体文件必须在循环中需要调用MoviesTask的为QuickTime设计的main C API，DirectShow以一种透明的方式处理这个问题。它在后台创建了一些线程来平缓的播放这些来自文件和互联网的数据与此同时不需要程序做很多工作。还跟QuickTime正好相反的是，在读取一段来自互联网数据而不是读取硬盘文件的时候没有特别的需要：DirectShow的filter graph摘录了来自程序的这些明细。然而，QuickTime（包括一个ActiveX控制）在这方面的发展相比之下逊色很多。
target_text: Unlike MoviesTask's main C API, DirectShow, designed for QuickTime, which needs to be called in the loop to read media documents, in a transparent manner. It creates some threads backstage to flatten these data from documents and the Internet while not requiring much work. Contrary to QuickTime, there is no special need to read a piece of data from the Internet instead of a hard disk file: DirectShow's filtter graph extracts these details from the program. However, QuickTime (including an activeX control) has developed much less in this area.

药效团是对一系列生物活性分子的总结，归纳了对活性起最重作用的结构特征。药效团模型可以通过构象搜索和分子叠合来模拟配体分子的活性构象，可以据此来推断和解释受体与配体分子之间可能的作用模式。药效团模型还可以用来辅助分子的结构改造，对于结构复杂的分子，可以考虑保留药效团结构对其进行简化，这样简化的同时依然能保持生物活性。药效团最直接的用途是用来判断一个分子是否具有某一类的药效特征。近些年，随着化合物数据库和计算机技术的发展，用药效团模型对数据库的进行虚拟筛选得到了广泛的应用，已经成为发现先导化合物的重要手段之一。

source_text:
坎尼算法的发展
坎尼的目标是找到一个最优的边缘检测算法，最优边缘检测的含义是：
好的检测 - 算法能够尽可能多地标识出图像中的实际边缘。
好的定位 - 标识出的边缘要与实际图像中的实际边缘尽可能接近。
最小响应 - 图像中的边缘只能标识一次，并且可能存在的图像雜訊不应标识为边缘。
target_text: The goal of Canny's development is to find an optimal margin detection algorithm, which means that: Good detection - the algorithm can identify the actual edges of the image as much as possible. Good positioning - the edges of the logo are as close as possible to the actual edges of the actual image.
title: 坎尼算子

source_text:
参数
坎尼算法包含许多可以调整的参数，它们将影响到算法的计算时间与实效。
高斯滤波器的大小：第一步所用的平滑滤波器将会直接影响坎尼算法的结果。较小的滤波器产生的模糊效果也较少，这样就可以检测较小、变化明显的细线。较大的滤波器产生的模糊效果也较多，将较大的一块图像区域涂成一个特定点的颜色值。这样带来的结果就是对于检测较大、平滑的边缘更加有用，例如彩虹的边缘。
阈值：使用两个阈值比使用一个阈值更加灵活，但是它还是有阈值存在的共性问题。设置的阈值过高，可能会漏掉重要信息；阈值过低，将会把枝节信息看得很重要。很难给出一个适用于所有图像的通用阈值。目前还没有一个经过验证的实现方法。
target_text: The larger filters also have a greater degree of ambiguity and paint a larger image area into a particular point. The result is more useful for detecting larger, smooth edges, such as the edge of a rainbow. Thresholds: the use of two thresholds is more flexible than the use of a threshold, but it still has a common problem with the threshold. The threshold is too high to allow important information to be missed; the threshold is too low to be important. It is difficult to give a generic threshold for all images.
title: 坎尼算子

匹配
一个圖的匹配是这个图中一些邊所形成的集合，滿足任意集合中的两条边都没有公共的顶点。許多關於匹配的問題都有可以被多項式時間的演算法解決，例如最大匹配問題 (尋找一個匹配包含最多的邊)，，和穩定婚姻問題。在大部分的情況，如果已知原圖是二分圖，匹配問題會變得單純很多，而且許多演算法只能處理二分圖上的情況，例如專門用來計算最大匹配的邊數的霍普克洛夫特－卡普演算法。

In most cases, if it is known that the original is a two-point map, the matching problem becomes much purer, and many algorithms deal only with the two-point scenario, such as the Hopekloft-Kapp algorithm, which is used exclusively to calculate the maximum number of matches.

source_text: 网域名称（，简称：Domain），简称域名、网域，是由一串用点分隔的字符组成的互联网上某一台计算机或计算机组的名称，用于在数据传输时标识计算机的电子方位。域名可以说是一个IP地址的代稱，目的是为了便于记忆后者。例如，wikipedia.org是一个域名。人们可以直接访问wikipedia.org来代替IP地址，然后域名系统（DNS）就会将它转化成便于机器识别的IP地址。这样，人们只需要记忆wikipedia.org这一串带有特殊含义的字符，而不需要记忆没有含义的数字。
target_text: A domain name (a short name: Domain), a short domain name, is the name of a computer or computer group on the Internet that is made up of a series of character that is separated by a point, and is used to identify the computer's electronic location at the time of data transmission. The domain name can be described as a proxy for an IP address, for the purpose of remembering the latter. For example, wikipedia.org is a domain name. People can directly access wikipedia.org to replace an IP address, and then the domain name system (DNS) converts it into an IP address that can be easily identified by the machine. In this way, one needs only the memory wikipedia.org string with a special meaning, rather than a number where memory has no meaning.
title: 域名

source_text: 1985年1月1日（不排除注册日期被重置的可能），世界上第一个域名nordu.net得以註冊。1985年3月15日，美国马萨诸塞州剑桥市的计算机系统公司注册了第一个.com域名symbolics.com。到1992年，登记的com域名不到15,000个。互联网的兴起，使域名这一概念变得家喻户晓，也有很多人开始注册一个甚至多个域名。截止到2015年第一季度，已有2.94亿个域名登记注册。其中很大一部分属于.com，已有1.156亿个.com域名。2012年7月，.com的注册数量超过了所有ccTLD的总和。
target_text: On 1 January 1985 (not excluding the possibility of the date of registration being replaced), the world’s first domain name, Nordu.net, was registered. On 15 March 1985, computer systems in Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States, registered the first .com domain name, symbolics.com. By 1992, fewer than 15,000 domain names had been registered. The rise of the Internet made the concept of domain names known and many people had started to register one or more domain names. As of the first quarter of 2015, 294 million domain names had been registered.
title: 域名

source_text: 今天，办事处位于美国的互联网名称与数字地址分配机构（ICANN）负责互联网域名空间的开发和架构。只有经过它授权的域名注册管理机构和域名注册商，才能对外界提供顶级域名管理和注册服务。另外，互联网号码分配局（IANA）负责运营域名系统根区域、委派顶级域名的管理，并负责.int和.arpa两个域名的管理。
target_text: Today, ICANN, which is based in the United States, is responsible for the development and architecture of the Internet domain name space. Only its authorized domain name registration authority and domain name registrars can provide top-level domain name management and registration services to the outside world. In addition, IANA is responsible for running the domain name system root area, assigning top-level domain names, and managing both.int and.arpa domain names.
title: 域名

source_text: 另一方面，美国政府对ICANN的政治影响与干涉也在社会上引起争议。20世纪80年代，互联网域名与地址的管理权一直由美国政府垄断（比如将.edu、.mil、.gov等域名用作美国自己使用，而不用.edu.us二级域名）。1998年，美国政府与ICANN签订合同，授权由ICANN负责协调管理。但美国政府仍然拥有对域名的控制权，并有时进行干涉（例如2005年，ICANN根据其政策初步批准了.xxx顶级域名的使用，但美国政府扬言要利用其合同权利来推翻ICANN的决定，而ICANN最终也因此屈服，此举曾遭到欧盟等组织的批评）。2013年，美国曝出的“棱镜门”丑闻引发了风波。尽管NSA的窃听与ICANN控制域名无关，但美国对ICANN的影响力象征着美国在互联网上的力量。“棱镜门”丑闻曝光带来的压力，促使奥巴马政府最终决定放弃对ICANN的权力。直到2016年10月，美国政府机构正式将互联网域名的管理权完全移交给ICANN，才结束了对域名管理近20年的垄断。
target_text: On the other hand, the U.S. government’s political influence and interference with ICANN was also controversial in society. In the 1980’s, for example, ICANN initially approved the use of .xxx top-level domain names under its policy, the U.S. government threatened to use its contractual rights to overturn the ICANN’s decision, which was eventually criticized by organizations such as the EU. In 2013, the US government’s exposure to the “Blackgate” scandal triggered a windfall.
title: 域名

source_text: 注册表（，中国大陆译作-{zh-hans:注册表;zh-hant:註冊表;}-，港澳台译作-{zh-hant:登錄檔;zh-hans:登录档;}-）是Microsoft Windows操作系統和其應用程序中的一个重要的层次型数据库，用于存储系统和应用程序的设置信息。早在Windows 3.0推出OLE技术的时候，注册表就已经出现。但是，从Windows 95开始，注册表才真正成为Windows用户经常接触的内容，并在其后的操作系统中继续沿用至今。随后推出的Windows NT是第一个从系统级别广泛使用注册表的操作系统。
target_text: Registration forms (in mainland China - {zh-hans: registration form;, in Hong Kong, in Hong Kong, in Hong Kong, in Hong Kong - {zh-hant: login file; zh-hans: login file;} -) are an important layered database for the Microsoft Windows operating system and its applications to store the setting information of systems and applications. The registration forms appear as early as when Windows 3.0 rolled out OLE technology. However, starting with Windows 95, the registration forms become a regular contact for Windows users and continue to be used in their subsequent operating systems to date. The later launch of Windows NT is the first operating system to make extensive use of the registration forms from the system level.
title: 注册表

source_text:
使用第三方或自行编写的软件
访问注册表的系统功能对编程人员是开放的，因此有许多软件都有读写注册表的功能。事实上，Windows平台下开发的软件几乎都在不同程度上修改注册表，以便保存一些在程序多次运行之间需要保留的信息，以及让软件可以通过某种特定方式（例如，右键菜单）启动。也有一些软件是专门开发出来对注册表进行优化和设置的。
target_text: Using third-party or self-generated software Access to the registry system functionality is open to programmers, so many of the software has read-write registration features. In fact, the software developed under Windows platform almost always changes the registration form to varying degrees in order to preserve some of the information that needs to be retained between multiple program runs and to allow the software to be started in a particular way (e.g. right-key menu). Some software is also specifically developed to optimize and set up the registration form.
title: 注册表

source_text:
分散与集中之争
关于分散的文本文件和集中的注册表两种软件配置方式的优劣，目前仍有争论。主流操作系统中，Linux操作系统一直使用单独的文本文件来存放配置信息。而Windows平台下基于.NET框架的软件对注册表的依赖性也大大减弱。事实上，.NET软件通常使用纯文本的XML（称为app.config）文件而不是注册表进行配置，这在某种意义上是向当初的ini文本配置方式的一种回归。部分绿色软件支持者认为，集中式的注册表要求软件需要进行专门的安装步骤才可以正常运行，而单独的文本配置文件则可以不需要安装，只要将软件的文件目录拷贝过来就可以使用；当不再需要软件的时候，除删除相关文件外对于注册表也需要进行卸载步骤，才有可能不在系统中留下痕迹（很多软件即使提供了卸载步骤，仍然会留下痕迹），如果使用文本配置文件，则能做得更干净。但是，文本配置方式导致某些系统软件的配置较为困难且缺乏统一的界面（如Linux中的情况），也是不争的事实，尽管现在已经有很多软件可以方便进行系统配置，但仍存在标准不够统一的问题。
target_text: In fact, the XML (known as app.config) files, rather than the registration forms, are usually configured using pure text, which in a sense is a return to the original ni-text configuration. Some green software supporters believe that centralized registration forms require that the software require specific installation steps to be performed properly, while separate text configuration documents may not be required to be installed as long as the software file catalogues are available; when software is no longer needed, offloading steps are also required for the forms to be removed, it is possible not to leave traces in the system (although many software, even if offloaded, still leaves traces), and if text configuration documents are used, they can be made more clean.
title: 注册表

source_text: 著名开源软件Fetchmail的作者Eric S. Raymond在《UNIX编程艺术》一书中有如下叙述：从2000年以来部分恶性病毒如熊猫烧香等的破坏情形看，的确存在“破坏本身干扰注册表编辑器”的问题。在某些情况下，病毒程序会监视系统进程列表，并强行关闭名为regedit的任何程序。这使得受损用户难以直接通过编辑注册表进行恢复。
target_text: Eric S. Raymond, the author of the famous open-source software Fetchmail, in the UNIX Programming Arts book, describes as follows: Since the destruction of some of the virulent viruses, such as panda burning, since 2000, there has indeed been a problem of “destructing itself with the register editor.” In some cases, the virus program monitors the system process list and forces the closure of any program called regedit. This makes it difficult for damaged users to recover directly through editing the register.
title: 注册表

source_text: 遊戲普遍獲得正面評價。遊戲評論網站Metacritic基於31條評論給予遊戲88/100的評價。日本杂志《Fami通》和中国大陆杂志《游戏机实用技术》《电子游戏软件》均点评了游戏。情节方面，《Fami通》和《游戏机实用技术》称赞游戏故事更为饱满、角色更为鲜明。游戏系统上，三家杂志均认为教学系统是新玩家的福音，但对老玩家而言多余。《电子游戏软件》的MASCAR称，《烈火之剑》系统虽无本质变化却依然新颖；但《游戏机实用技术》LIKY持相反观点，称本作“不思进取”，“几点改进全部都是不关痛痒的东西”。对于游戏艺术设计，《游戏机实用技术》的邪魔天使称，游戏淡化了前作中可爱儿童的角色设定；《电子游戏软件》的星川名人则认为，淡彩铅插画令人耳目一新。
target_text: In terms of the context, the Famips and the Playmaker Practicals praise the fact that the game stories are fuller and more visible. In the game system, all three magazines consider the teaching system to be a evangelical for new players, but redundant for older players.
title: 火焰之纹章 烈火之剑

source_text: 自2021年開始，CNET開始大批刪除其之前的舊報道，並且使用互聯網檔案館存檔，該舉動被認為是嘗試推高網站排名。2022年，被揭發使用人工智能撰寫文章，而且相關文章的質量參差不齊，同時也開始裁員、凍結晉升。相關事件引發爭議之後，最終決定在2023年1月終止使用人工智能。
target_text: Starting in 2021, CNET began a massive process of deleting its previous reports and using the Internet archive, which was considered an attempt to elevate the ranking of the site. In 2022, it was revealed that it used artificial intelligence to write articles and that the quality of the articles in question varied, and at the same time it began to lay off and freeze up. After the controversy, it was finally decided to end the use of artificial intelligence in January 2023.
title: CNET

source_text: 为什么是N-1,而不是N，Bessel's correction给出了解释查找协方差矩阵的特征值和特征向量计算矩阵C 的特征向量其中，D 是C的特征值对角矩阵，这一步通常会涉及到使用基于计算机的计算特征值和特征向量的算法。在很多矩阵代数系统中这些算法都是现成可用的，如R语言，MATLAB, Mathematica, SciPy, IDL(交互式数据语言), 或者GNU Octave以及OpenCV。
target_text: Why N-1, rather than N, Bessel's recognition, gives a description of the characteristics vectors of the model C of the matrix for the search for the parameters and characteristics vectors, of which D is the feature value diagonal matrix of C, a step that usually involves the use of computer-based calculations of the characteristics value and characteristics vector algorithms. These algorithms are readily available in many matrix algebra systems, such as R, MATLAB, Mathemica, SciPy, IDL (interactive data language), or GNU Octave and OpenCV.
title: 主成分分析

source_text: 马来西亚于1998年3月启用电子护照，是全世界第一个推出和使用这项技术的国家，而后国际民航组织对电子护照标准化为Doc 9309文件“电子机读旅行证件（eMRTD）”标准。目前世界各国签发的电子护照均依照此标准设计，此标准規定了生物特徵識別的標準，其中人脸识别为强制性要求，各国签发部门还可选择性对敏感数据进行加密，在此标准中包括了通讯方式、存储格式等内容，如證件持有人的容貌影像须以JPEG或JPEG2000格式存储在芯片内、芯片的存储容量至少32千位元組的EEPROM，应符合ISO/IEC 14443通讯协议，保证与各地区的出入境口岸的护照阅读器可与护照非接触式交互内容，以在出入境口岸利用人臉識別、指纹和虹膜等生物特徵識別功能來验证旅行證件持有人的身份。存储在晶片内的生物特征信息带有公開金鑰基礎建設数位签名，以保證生物特徵資料的准确性。符合标准的生物特徵護照封面印有「電子旅行證件」的標誌。
target_text: Malaysia’s introduction of an electronic passport in March 1998 was the first country in the world to introduce and use this technology, and ICAO has standardized the electronic passport to the Doc 9309 “eMRTD” standard. The electronic passport currently issued worldwide is designed in accordance with this standard, which sets out criteria for biological identity, including the mandatory identification of human faces, and the selective encryption of sensitive data by national issuing authorities, including means of communication, storage formats, such as the image image of the holder of the certificate in the form of a bio-specific feature, such as JPEG or JPEG 2000, which must be stored in a chip with at least 32 krono units, in accordance with the ISO/IEC 14443 communication agreement, which guarantees that passport readers at border crossings in various areas may be used for non-contact interactive content of passports, in order to verify the identity of the holder of the travel document by using a bio-specific feature function, such as a bio-specific feature, such as a bio-specific feature, in the form of a biometric signature, which is stored in a public-owned signature with a public key.
title: 生物特徵護照

source_text: 名称由来Good-Turing平滑法由古德於1953年提出，而这种算法的思想则来自图灵，算法证明参见：Church et al.（1990）计算方法Good-Turing基本思想是：用观察计数较高的N元语法数重新估计概率量的大小，并把它指派给那些具有零计数或者较低计数的N元语法。涉及的符号含义为：：某个N元语法出现的频数。
target_text: The name was proposed by Good-Turing smoothing in Good-Gud in 1953, and the idea of this algorithm came from Turing, which proves that the basic idea of the Church et al. (1990) calculation method Good-Turing is to re-estimate the size of the probability by observing a higher N-syntax and assign it to those N-syntaxes that have a zero or lower count. The symbols involved are: the frequency of a particular N-syntax.
title: 图灵估计

source_text: 这项技术的拥护者称它将会使计算机更加安全、更加不易被病毒和恶意软件侵害，因此从最终用户角度来看也更加可靠。此外，他们还宣称可信计算将会使计算机和服务器提供比现有更强的计算机安全性。而反对者认为可信计算背后的那些公司并不那么值得信任，这项技术给系统和软件设计者过多的权利和控制。他们还认为可信计算会潜在地迫使用户的在线交互过程失去匿名性，并强制推行一些不必要的技术。最后，它还被看作版权和版权保护的未来版本，这对于公司和其他市场的用户非常重要，同时这也引发了批评，引发了对不当审查（censorship）关注。
target_text: Proponents of this technology claim that it will make computers safer, less vulnerable to viruses and malicious software, and therefore more reliable from an end-user’s point of view. Moreover, they claim that credible computing will make computers and servers more secure than they already have.
title: 可信计算

source_text: 很多著名的安全专家已经表明了对可信计算技术的反对，因为他们相信它将给计算机制造商和软件作者更多限制用户使用自己的计算机的能力。有一些人关注的则是可信计算可能（或者本身就是要）起到限制自由软件市场、私有软件开发和更一般化的整个IT市场竞争的作用。有些人，如理查德·斯托曼，因此给它起了一个恶名——背叛的计算（Treacherous computing）。
target_text: Many well-known security experts have expressed their opposition to credible computing techniques, because they believe that it will place more restrictions on the ability of computer manufacturers and software authors to use their own computers. Some are concerned that credible computing may (or is in itself meant to) limit competition in the free software market, private software development, and, more generally, the entire IT market.
title: 可信计算

source_text:
安全输入输出（I/O）
安全输入和输出（I/O）指的是计算机用户与他们认为与之进行交互的软件间的受保护的路径。在当前的计算机系统中，恶意软件有很多途径截取用户与软件进程间传送的数据。例如，键盘监听者（Keyboard Logger）和屏幕截取者（Screen Scraper）。安全I/O表现为受硬件和软件保护和验证的信道，采用校验值来验证进行输入输出的软件没有受到篡改。将自身注入到信道间的恶意软件会被识别出来。
target_text: Security input output (I/O) Security input and output (I/O) refers to a protected path between computer users and the software with which they believe they interact. In the current computer system, malicious software has many ways of intercepting data transmitted between users and software processes. For example, keyboard listeners (Keyboard Logger) and screen interceptors (Screen Scraper). Security I/O is expressed as a hardware and software protected and authenticated channel where calibrated values are used to verify that the software used for input output has not been tampered with.
title: 可信计算

source_text:
尽管安全（I/O）提供针对软件攻击的防护，但它未必提供对基于硬件的攻击的防护，例如物理插入用户键盘和计算机间的设备。内存屏蔽
内存屏蔽扩展為当前的内存保护技术，提供了对内存敏感区域（如放置密钥的区域）的全面隔离。甚至操作系统也无法访问屏蔽的内存，所以其中的信息在侵入者获取了OS的控制权的情况下仍然是安全的。
target_text: While security (I/O) provides protection against software attacks, it does not necessarily provide protection against hardware-based attacks, such as physical insertion of user keyboards and inter-computer devices. Memory shieldes. Memory shieldes.
title: 可信计算

source_text:
封装存储
封装存储从当前使用的软件和硬件配置衍生出的密钥，并用这个密钥加密私有数据，从而实现对它的保护。这意味着该数据仅在系统拥有同样的软硬件组合的时候才能读取。例如，用户在他的计算机上保存自己的日记，不希望其他的程序或计算机读取。这样一来，病毒可以查找日记，读取它，并将它发给其他人。Sircam 病毒所作的与此类似。即使日记使用了口令保护，病毒可能运行字典攻击。病毒还可以修改用户的日记软件，用户使用软件打开日记时通过受篡改的软件可能泄漏其中的内容。使用封装存储，日记被安全地加密，只有在该计算机上的未被修改的日记软件才可以打开它。
target_text: For example, the user keeps his own diary on his computer and does not want other programs or computers to read it. In this way, the virus can search the journal, read it, and send it to others. The Sircam virus does the same. Even if the journal uses password protection, the virus may run a dictionary attack. The virus can also modify the user ' s journal software, which may leak its contents through tampered software when the software opens it. Use the seal storage, the journal is safely encrypted, and it can only be opened on the computer ' s unmodified journal software.
title: 可信计算

source_text:
远程证明
远程证明使得用户或其他人可以检测到该用户的计算机的变化。这样可以避免向不安全或安全受损的计算机发送私有信息或重要的命令。远程证明机制通过硬件生成一个证书，声明哪些软件正在运行。用户可以将这个证书发给远程的一方以表明他的计算机没有受到篡改。
target_text: Remote proof allows users or others to detect changes in the user's computer. This avoids sending private information or important commands to an unsafe or compromised computer. The remote proof mechanism generates a certificate through hardware stating which software is running. The user can send the certificate to a remote party to show that his computer has not been tampered with.
title: 可信计算

source_text: 再用上面日记的例子，用户的日记软件可以将日记发送给其他的机器，但是只能发给那些能够证明所运行的是一份安全的日记软件。与其他的技术结合起来，远程证明可以为日记提供一个更加安全的路径：通过键盘输入以及在屏幕显示时受到安全I/O的保护，内存屏蔽在日记软件运行时保护日记，而封装存储在它存储到硬盘的时候保护它，并且远程证明保护它在其它计算机使用时不受非授权软件的破坏。
target_text: Again, in the example of the journal above, the user ' s journal software can send the journal to other machines, but only to those who can prove that it is running a secure journal software. In conjunction with other technologies, remote proof can provide a safer path for the journal: secure I/O by keyboard input and on screen display, memory shield to protect the journal while the journal software is running, and seal to store it while it is stored on hard disk, and remote proof that it is protected from non-authorized software when it is used on other computers.
title: 可信计算

source_text: 剑桥大学的密码学家Ross Anderson非常关切的一个问题是"可信计算可能支持远程审查[...] 一般而言，支持可信计算的计算机系统的属主所创建的数字对象将始终受到其控制，而非那些控制数字对象存储在的计算机的人[...] 所以，如果有人写了被法庭认定为诽谤的文章，作者将被迫进行审查—并且如果作者拒绝，编写文字处理软件的公司可能被命令删除该文章。在这种可能之下，我们可以预料可信计算将被用于压制包括色情文学到对政治领导人的批评在内的任何事"
target_text: One of the issues of great concern to the cryptographer Ross Anderson at Cambridge University is that "Credible computing may support remote scrutiny [...] In general, digital objects created by the owners of computer systems that support credible computing will always be under their control, rather than those that control the computers stored by digital objects [...] So if someone writes an article that is considered defamatory by the court, the author will be compelled to examine it - and if the author refuses, the company that wrote the word-processing software may be ordered to delete it. In this case, we can expect that credible computing will be used to suppress anything, including pornography to criticism of political leaders."
title: 可信计算

source_text:
用户不能更换软件
在日记的例子中，封装存储保护日记不受病毒等恶意程序的伤害，但它无法区分恶意程序与有用的程序（如将日记转换为新格式的程序或提供对日记进行查找新方法的程序）。如果用户希望使用另外的日记程序，他将发现新日记程序不可能打开已有的日记，这样，用户就被“锁定”在旧的程序中。同样，用户如果未得到日记软件的允许，他将无法读取或修改自己的日记。如果他使用的日记软件没有编辑或删除的选项，那就无法修改或删除已有的日记条目。
target_text: The user cannot replace the software In the journal example, the sealing of the protection journal is not harmed by malicious procedures such as viruses, but it cannot distinguish the malware program from the useful program (e.g., a program that converts the journal to a new format or provides a program to search the journal for new methods). If the user wishes to use another journal program, he will find it impossible for the new journal program to open the existing journal, so that the user is “locked” in the old program. Similarly, the user will not be able to read or modify his journal without the permission of the journal software. If the journal software he uses does not have the option to edit or delete it, it will not be possible to modify or delete the existing journal entries.
title: 可信计算

source_text:
用户不能控制他们接收的信息
可信计算常受到的一个批评就是，封装存储可能阻止用户将封装的文件移动到新的计算机。这个限制可能来自于糟糕的软件设计或内容提供者故意实施的限制。TPM规范的迁移部分要求一些特定类型的文件只能移动到采用相同安全模型的计算机上。如果一个旧型号的芯片不再生产，就根本不可能将数据转移到新计算机；那些数据将與旧计算机一同长眠。
target_text: Credible computing is often criticized as preventing users from moving sealed files to new computers. This limitation may stem from poor software design or deliberate restrictions imposed by content providers. The migration part of the TPM regulation requires that certain types of files be moved only to computers using the same safety model. If an old-type chip is no longer produced, it is impossible to transfer data to new computers; those data will sleep long with the old computer.
title: 可信计算

source_text: 此外，批评者还注意到TPM可以强制用户接受间谍软件，例如强制音乐文件只能在那些在播放时会通知唱片公司的机器上播放。同样一个新闻杂志可能要求用户证明使用特定的阅读器后，才允许下载他们的文章。阅读软件可能在杂志网站上的版本变化后，禁止阅读最初的新闻。这种最新版本限制的实施将允许杂志通过修改或删除文章来“重写历史”。即使用户将最初的文章存储在自己的计算机中，阅读软件发现网站变化后，也可能拒绝阅读请求。
target_text: Moreover, critics also note that TPM can force users to accept spy software, such as music files, only on machines that inform record companies when playing. The same news magazine may require users to certify the use of specific readers before downloading their articles. Reading software may prohibit reading the original news after the version on the magazine website has changed. The application of this latest version restriction will allow the magazine to “rew history” by modifying or deleting the article. Even if users store the original article on their own computer, reading software may refuse to read requests after the website has changed.
title: 可信计算

source_text:
丧失互联网上的匿名性
由于装有可信计算设备的计算机可以唯一证明自己的身份，厂商或其他可以使用证明功能的人就能够以非常高的可能性确定用户的身份。这种能力大小要视用户提供自愿或间接提供身份信息的机会而定。一个常见的获取信息途径就是用户购买计算机后就注册个人信息。另外一个常见的途径是用户为厂商的会员网站提供身份信息。
target_text: Loss of anonymity on the Internet, because computers with credible computing devices can only prove their identity, manufacturers or others who can use the certification function are able to identify users with a very high probability. This ability depends on the user’s opportunity to provide voluntary or indirect identification information. One common way of obtaining information is to register personal information after the user has purchased the computer. Another common way is for users to provide identity information to the manufacturer’s member’s website.
title: 可信计算

source_text: 可信计算的赞成者指出，它可以使在线购物和信用卡交易更安全，但这可能导致计算机用户失去访问互联网时希望拥有的匿名性。批评者指出这可能导致对政治言论自由，新闻记者使用匿名信息源，揭发政治博客，以及其他公众需要通过匿名性来防止报复的领域，产生抑制作用。
target_text: Proponents of credible calculations argue that it can make online shopping and credit card transactions safer, but this may result in computer users losing the anonymity they want to have when accessing the Internet. Critics argue that this may lead to a disincentive to freedom of political expression, the use of anonymous sources of information by journalists, the disclosure of political blogs, and other areas where the public needs to prevent retaliation through anonymity.
title: 可信计算

source_text: 激活属主重载将允许使用安全的I/O路径来确保属主通过物理接触（physical present）操作，进而绕过保护。这样的重载将允许通过远程证明表明当前的环境符合用户的规范，例如创建证书表明IE正在运行，而实际上是另外的浏览器在运行。这样不是通过阻止软件修改，而是通过远程证明来表明软件受到了未经属主授权的修改。
target_text: Activating the main load will allow the use of a safe I/O path to ensure that the main is operated by physical contact, thereby bypassing protection. Such a load will allow remote proof that the current environment conforms to the user’s specifications, such as the creation of a certificate that indicates that IE is running, but that another browser is running. This means that the software is not modified by blocking the software, but by remote proof that the software has been modified without the authorization of the owner.

source_text: 一些可信计算组织的成员认为属主重载对可信计算计划是一个威胁。他们认为属主重载伤及对远程计算机的信任，因为远程证明并未集中实施。属主重载提供了为计算机属主提供了安全和实施的好处，但并未阻止其他属主在自己的计算机上放弃规则和限制。在这样的场景下，无论是日记、DRM音乐或联合的项目的数据，一旦被发送到其他人的计算机，并且这些计算机由他人控制安全，那这些计算机将可以对这些数据进行复制。
target_text: Some members of a credible computing organization believe that the main load is a threat to a credible computing plan. They believe that the main load injury and trust in remote computers is not centralized because remote certification is not performed. The main load provides security and implementation benefits for computer owners, but does not prevent other owners from abandoning rules and restrictions on their own computers. In such a scenario, data, whether from journals, DRM music or joint projects, can be copied by computers that are sent to others and that are controlled by others.

source_text:
可信计算的一个重要前提是属主不可信任。这里假定用户将或者由于疏忽或者故意为之，来试图破坏自己的系统。例如，IT管理员无法确保笔记本电脑将运行一个特定的操作系统。关于实用性的质疑

Here it is assumed that the user will attempt to destroy its own system, either by negligence or by deliberate intent. For example, IT administrators cannot ensure that a laptop will run a particular operating system. The same intense debate about utility and some of the assumptions underlying a credible calculation are somewhat unrealistic in the “real world” and users may find it necessary to use the main load at the conventional level, or will not be willing to use these functions at all, despite the insistence of software manufacturers.

source_text: 已经证实这些问题已经在升阳的下一代芯片UltraSPARC T2中得到解决。这款芯片将具有8个核，每个核具有8个硬件线程支持能力（这比UltraSPARC-T1多一倍）。同时，每个核心都具有独立的浮点运算单元。因此，这款芯片的浮点运算能力甚至可用于高性能计算领域（需要大量浮点运算支持）。

source_text: 同为多核心处理器，Sun的Niagara系列芯片（UltraSPARC T1, T2）与IBM的多核心芯片Cell显著不同。首先，前者是对等结构，各核之间地位对等、没有差异；而后者是主从结构。其次，前者的每个核心均具有完整的SPARC V9指令集支持能力，均可独立执行任何指令，理论上二进制代码可以直接运行；后者只有一个Power核心作为主控，其余核心实质上都是矢量处理单元（VPE），只负责执行SIMD指令，如果要充分发挥其处理能力，应用程序必须以SIMD指令重写。以上不同造成了两款芯片面向不同应用的事实，即前者适合于处理无规则数据流，如网络服务器；后者适合大批量规则运算，如做为游戏机处理芯片。
target_text: As a multi-core processor, Sun's Niagara series (UltrasPARC T1, T2) is significantly different from the IBM's multi-core chip Cell. First, the former is an equivalent structure, with no difference in status between the nuclears; the latter is the main structure. Secondly, each core has a full SPARC V9 command set of support capabilities, which allows for the execution of any instructions independently and, in theory, the binary code can run directly; the latter only has a Power core, with the remaining core being a vector processing unit (VPE), which is responsible only for implementing the SIMD directive, and applications must be rewritten if they are to be fully capable of processing. These differences create the fact that the two chips are oriented towards different applications, i.e., the former are suitable for dealing with non-ruled data streams, such as web servers; the latter are suitable for bulk rule operations, such as processing chips for games machines.

source_text: UltraSPARC T1是針對單顆CPU的系統所設計，所以它不具備對稱處理（SMP）能力，即由UltraSPARC T1组成的系统，最多只能有一颗多核心芯片。而未來昇陽的CMT UltraSPARC處理器，如Rock（研發代號）將會是多顆處理晶片的伺服器架構，多颗多核心Rock芯片将能组成对称多处理机（SMP）系统，进一步扩展运算能力。Rock處理器將鎖定在傳統資料運算工作，如資料庫執行。因此，Rock看來將成為昇陽電腦在SMP架構處理器上的新接替，預計會取代現有的UltraSPARC III、UltraSPARC IV。

source_text: 5月24日暴风影音发出《暴风公司关于断网事件向网民和新老用户的公开信》，表示已报案并整理好相关材料和服务器数据上交了公安局网监处，希望早日捉拿攻击DNSPod导致整个事件的始作俑者。在工信部领导下暴风影音配合中国电信、中国网通、DNSPod处理了问题，截至20日凌晨1时20分受影响地区的网络已恢复正常。同时承认了软件存在不足，没有考虑到网络环境异常情况(DNS服务无法解析),公司已开始对软件进行修改。在事件发酵后，网友与媒体的舆论一直谴责暴风，认为暴风在事件中负有责任却以受害者自居。其中网易科技报道评论称暴风影音应为断网事故负责，虽然事件起因是某游戏”私服”对其竞争对手使用的DNS服务商DNSPod的服务器进行了攻击，但暴风影音的程序中开机自动运行的Stormliv进程也是一个重要原因，即使用户没有手动运行，暴风影音还是会发出大量DNS解析请求，海量的数据信息最终导致了电信运营商服务器资源的耗尽，也引发了全国网络出现大范围瘫痪。大量用户电脑上的后台进程不断向一个服务器发出请求致使服务器资源耗尽，与黑客进行DDOS攻击很相似。

source_text: Windows 7 Beta還有「Sandbox」（沙盒）功能，其功能接近於在開發Longhorn系統時的「Alpha/White Box」，所有非管理代碼將會在沙盒系統中運行，這樣接入「外界」將被操作系统控制。對底層的訪問將被從沙盒內部禁止，同樣還有對文件系統、硬件抽象層（HAL）以及完全內存地址的直接訪問。所有對外部應用程序、文件和協議的請求都將被操作系统管理，任何惡意行為都將被立刻中止。如果這一方法成功，它預示著極強的安全和保障：如果惡意軟件能被有效地鎖在一個玻璃盒中的話，它事實上不可能對系統造成任何傷害。不过在正式发行版移除了沙盒功能。
target_text: Windows 7 Beta also has Sandbox functions that are close to "Alpha/White Box" when the Longhorn system is developed, and all non-managerial codes will operate in the sandbox system, and access to the "outside" will be controlled by the operating system. All requests for external applications, documents and protocols will be managed by the operating system, and any malpractices will be suspended immediately. 历史
虚拟化技术起源于20世纪60年代末，美国IBM公司当时开发了一套被称作虚拟机监视器（Virtual Machine Monitor）的软件，该软件作为计算机硬件层上面的一层软件抽象层，将计算机硬件虚拟分割成一个或多个虚拟机，并提供多用户对大型计算机的同时、交互访问。虚拟化技術的类别
