source_text: Killer NIC是全球首款专为電腦游戏而設的网卡，由Bigfoot Networks推出。配合MaxFPS技术，这款网卡能够帮助处理器独立处理网络数据，保证CPU性能不受网络连接影響。在此之前，nVIDIA就已经在nForce 500芯片组中提供类似的网络处理功能。Killer NIC的价格约为250美元。Killer NIC网卡使用了嵌入式Linux系统，网卡可以完全独立工作，并运行程序。随卡附带了软件可登陆网卡操作系统，安装程序，并附带SDK，供玩家自行开发程序。独立工作时，网卡上的USB接口可以连上闪存盘或抽取式硬盘，在网卡內的Linux系统运行下载程序。
target_text: Killer NIC is the global premiere network card dedicated to computer games, launched by Bigfoot Networks. With Max FPS technology, the web card helps process the network data independently and ensures that the CPU is not affected by network connections. Prior to this, nVIDIA already provided similar network processing functions in the nForce 500 chip group.
title: Killer NIC

source_text: 《设计模式：可复用面向对象软件的基础》（）是软件工程领域有关设计模式的一本书，提出和总结了对于一些常见软件设计问题的标准解决方案，称为软件设计模式。该书作者是埃里希·伽瑪（Erich Gamma）、、和，后以“四人帮”（，）著称，书中的设计模式也被称為「四人帮设计模式」（Gang of Four design patterns）。
target_text: Design Mode: The Basis for Reusable Object-oriented Software () is a book on design models in the field of software engineering that presents and summarizes standard solutions to some of the common software design problems, called software design models. The book is written by Eric Gamma, and later by the "Four People" (known as the "Four Design Models").
title: 设计模式：可复用面向对象软件的基础

source_text: 任何两种相接触的固体的费米能级（Fermi level，或者严格意义上，化学势）必须相等。 费米能级和真空能级的差值称作功函数。接触金属和半导体具有不同的功函数，分别记为和。当两种材料相接触时，电子将会从低功函（高Fermi level）一边流向另一边直到费米能级相平衡。从而，低功函（高Fermi level）的材料将带有少量正电荷而高功函（低Fermi level）材料则会变得具有少量负电荷。最终得到的静电势称为内建场记为。这种接触电势将会在任何两种固体间出现并且是诸如二极管整流现象和熱电效应等的潜在原因。内建场是导致半导体连接处能带弯曲的原因。明显的能带弯曲在金属中不会出现因为他们很短的屏蔽长度意味着任何电场只在接触面间无限小距离内存在。
target_text: The difference in contact with the metal and semiconductor levels is called a function. When the two materials are in contact, the electron will flow from the lower letter (high Fermi level) to the other side until it is in balance. Thus, the lower letter (high Fermi level) will have a small active charge and the higher charge (low Fermi level) material will not appear in the metal. The final static will be known as an internal field record. Such contact will occur between either of the two solids and may be a potential cause, for example, of secondary tube flow phenomena and heat effects.

桌面出版以前
桌面出版诞生之前，电脑上的编辑作业操作是通过TeX等一些程序进行的。在TeX中，是通过添加各种命令标签实现排版功能的，并不能算是“桌面排版”。金山軟件的WPS中文处理软件的早期DOS版本也是这样的情况。这些软件与现代桌面出版最大的不同，就是在于旧的操作方式不是WYSIWYG，所以它在排版过程中无法直观预览实际排版效果。

source_text:
桌面出版的各种问题
在实际作业工作中，桌面出版系统的主要问题有：
兼容性问题。包括跨平台兼容（Mac系统和Windows系统之间），版本兼容（同一平台，如Mac OS 9和X之间；或者同一软件，如 Illustrator 的CS2版本文件和 8.0版本文件之间），格式兼容（对于同样扩展名的文件，如EPS文件，可能是Photoshop创建，也可能是Illustrator创建）等等。
字体问题：各种格式字体的流失、套用导致版面错乱，例如主流的桌面出版软件对中、日、韩文字符支持问题。亦有这些国家自研的桌面出版程序，但质量难以与主流程序相比。
校对问题：打印版本、胶片版本的红字校正，色彩管理以及电子文档PDF校正管理。
流程问题：分工不清导致各个部门的重复作业，文件传输导致的流失数据问题，文件共享导致版本混乱问题（在服务器上的文件，两个工序分别做了不同的修改，导致最后统一成新文件很困难）。

These include cross-platform compatibility (between the Mac and Windows systems), version compatibility (between the same platform, such as Mac OS 9 and X; or the same software, such as Illustrator ' s CS2 and 8.0 versions), format compatibility (for documents of the same extended name, such as EPS files, possibly Photoshop created, or Illustrator created), font problems: loss of fonts of various formats, application leading to page loss problems, such as mainstream desktop publishing software for medium, day, Korean character support, etc. There are also desktop publishing programs developed by these countries, but the quality is difficult to compare with that of mainstream processes.

source_text: SAC（Single Assignment C）是一门严格的纯函数式编程语言，以满足数值计算领域的需求为主要目的。怎样实现对多维数组的高效计算是SAC的核心部分。效率在程序设计领域可以有两方面的理解。一方面是提供高级的数组运算操作，以加快开发程序，另一方面是在某种模式下优化编译程序，以减少其所需的运行时间和存储容量。作为一门成功的计算机语言，必须满足第二个条件。
target_text: The SAC (Single Assembly C) is a strictly functional programming language designed primarily to meet the needs of the field of numerical computing. Efficient calculation of multi-dimensional arrays is a central part of the SAC. Efficiency can be understood in two ways in the area of program design. On the one hand, it provides an advanced array operation to speed up the development of the program and, on the other hand, optimizes the programming under some mode to reduce its running time and storage capacity. As a successful computer language, the second condition must be met.
title: SAC语言

source_text: 尽管Windows 9x拥有内存保护机制，但它并没有保护内存的首个兆字节以防止来自用户空间应用程序的侵害。这个内存区含有让操作系统正常运作的关键码。写入这些内存区将可能造成系统崩溃或死机。错误的应用程序可能意外写入此内存区并使操作系统停止运行。这是系统不稳定的原因之一。
target_text: Although Windows 9x has memory protection mechanisms, it does not protect the first megabytes of memory from the user ' s space application. This memory contains a key code that allows the operating system to function properly. Writing these memory areas could cause a system crash or crash. The wrong application could accidentally be entered into this memory area and the operating system could be out of operation. This is one of the reasons for the system ' s instability.
title: Windows 9x

source_text: 一些与Windows 9x同时期的操作系统（不管是多用户的或是拥有多个不同访问权限的用户户口）的重要系统文件（譬如内核映像）在大多数用户户口底下都是不可更动的。相反的，Windows 95及其后的操作系统为多个用户提供简档选项，它们没有访问权限的概念，使它们大致相当于单用户的、单户口的操作系统，意味着所有进程都可修改所有未打开的文件及引导扇区，或对硬盘进行修改。这使病毒及其它被秘密安装的软件更紧密地与操作系统结合在一起，使用户难以对它们进行侦查及撤消。在Windows 9x中的用户简档支持仅是为了方便而已。除非修改一些注册表项，在登录时可按下“取消”以访问系统，即使所有的简档都拥有口令保护。Windows 95的默认登录对话框允许在不登录的情况下创建新用户的简档。
target_text: Conversely, Windows 95 and subsequent operating systems, which provide simple slotting options for multiple users, do not have the concept of access, which makes them broadly equivalent to single-user, single-hub operating systems, meaning that all processes can modify all unopened files and lead sectors, or modify hard disks. This allows viruses and other secretly installed software to be more closely integrated with the operating system, making it difficult for users to detect and remove them. The user profiles in Windows 9x are supported only for convenience. Unless some registration forms are revised, access systems can be “cancelled” at the time of entry, even if all simplified files are protected. Windows 95 default login dialogs allow the creation of new user profiles without access.
title: Windows 9x

source_text: 用户或应用程序可通过删除或覆写重要的系统文件来使操作系统无法运作。用户或应用程序也可自由更改配置文件以致操作系统无法启动或正常运作。安装软件常常覆盖或删除系统文件，但没有正确检查被覆盖或删除的文件是否为更新的版本或正在使用着。这就是DLL地狱的由来。
target_text: Users or applications can make the operating system unwieldy by deleting or overwriting important system files. Users or applications can also freely change configuration files so that the operating system cannot start or function.
title: Windows 9x

source_text: 写给Windows 9x/Windows Me的驱动程序被加载到与内核同样的地址空间，说明驱动程序可能有意或无意地覆写操作系统的关键内存区。这将导致系统崩溃，死机及硬盘损坏。故障的操作系统驱动程序乃操作系统不稳定的其一原因。单内核或混合内核之流，如Linux及Windows NT者也易受失常的驱动程序扰乱内核运作。
target_text: The driver written to Windows 9x/Windows Me is loaded into the same address space as the kernel, indicating that the driver may intentionally or unintentionally overwrite the critical memory of the operating system. This will result in system breakdowns and dead and hard disk damage. The malfunctioning operating system driver is one of the reasons for the system's instability. Single or mixed kernel flows, such as Linux and Windows NT, are also vulnerable to abnormal drivers disrupting the operation of the kernel.
title: Windows 9x

source_text: 在程序设计和计算机图形学领域，细节层次（Level of detail）随着物体或者模型远离观察者而逐步降低。由于它能够通过减少多边形的数目从而提升渲染效率，所以在计算机与视频游戏中使用了这项技术。由于物体距离很远，所以理论上并不会察觉到模型或者物体的视觉质量会有所下降。当然，这根据单个系统或者游戏的不同而有所不同。
target_text: In the area of program design and computer graphics, the level of detail (Live of detail) decreases as objects or models move away from observers. This technology is used in computer-video games because it can increase rendering efficiency by reducing the number of polygons. Because of the distance of an object, it does not theoretically detect a decrease in the model or the visual quality of an object. This, of course, varies according to the individual system or game.
title: 细节层次

source_text: 其它一些更加先进的方法带有生成预先计算的边缘折叠或者顶点分割数值的列表，这样的列表可以用于物体细节层次的实时计算。这种方法经常称为渐进网格。更加先进的细节层次运行系统使用的算法为了增加衰减能够合并几个三维物体或者简化合并的物体，这样的算法叫作分级细节层次算法。
target_text: Other more advanced methods have a list of values that generate precounted edge folds or vertex partitions, which can be used for real-time calculations of the object’s level of detail. This method is often referred to as gradual grids. The algorithm used by the more advanced level of detail operating system can be used to combine several three-dimensional objects or to simplify the consolidation of objects in order to increase decay, which is called a hierarchical level of detail algorithm.
title: 细节层次

source_text: 渲染（，或称为-{zh-hans:绘制;zh-hant:算繪、繪製}-或-{zh-hant:渲染;zh-hans:彩现}-）在電腦繪圖中，是指以软件由模型生成图像的过程。模型是用语言或者数据结构进行严格定义的三维物体或虚拟场景的描述，它包括几何、视点、纹理、照明和阴影等信息。图像是数字图像或者位图图像。彩現用于描述：计算视频编辑软件中的效果，以生成最终视频的输出过程。
target_text: Rendering (or called - {zh-hans: Draw; zh-hant: Arithmetic, Painting} - or -{zh-hant: Rendering; zh-hans: Colour} -) in computer graphics refers to the process by which the image is generated by software from a model. The model is a description of a strictly defined three-dimensional object or virtual scene in language or data structure, which includes geometric, visual, texture, lighting, shadow, etc. The image is a digital image or a bitmap image. The colour image is used to describe: the calculation of the effect in the video editing software to produce the output process of the final video.
title: 渲染

source_text: 渲染是三维计算机图形学中的最重要的研究课题之一，并且在实践领域它与其它技术密切相关。在图形流水线中，渲染是最后一项重要步骤，通过它得到模型与动画最终显示效果。自从二十世纪七十年代以来，随着计算机图形的不断复杂化，渲染也成為一項越来越重要的技术。
target_text: Rendering is one of the most important research topics in three-dimensional computer graphics, and in practice it is closely related to other technologies. In graphic waterlines, Rendering is the last important step through which models and animations are finally shown. Since the 1970s, as computer graphics become more complex, Rendering has become an increasingly important technology.
title: 渲染

source_text: 渲染的应用领域包含：计算机与视频游戏、模拟、电影或者电视特效以及可视化设计，每一种应用都是特性与技术的综合考虑。作为产品来看，现在已经有各种不同的渲染工具产品，有些集成到更大的建模或者动画包中，有些是独立产品，有些是开放源代码的产品。从内部来看，渲染工具都是根据各种学科理论，经过仔细设计的程序，其中有：光学、视觉感知、数学以及软件开发。
target_text: The applications for rendering include computer and video games, simulations, film or television effects, and visual design, each of which is a combination of characteristics and technology. As a product, there are now a variety of Rendering Tool products, some integrated into larger modelling or animation packages, some stand-alone and some open source products. From an internal perspective, Rendering tools are carefully designed based on a variety of scientific theories, including optical, visual, mathematical and software development.
title: 渲染

source_text: 对于电影动画来说，需要渲染几幅或几帧图像，并且将这些图像在动画制作程序中将它们连结在一起。大多数的三维图像编辑程序都能够完成这项工作。特性渲染的图像有许多显著的特性，渲染研究的领域，也主要集中在寻找：高效模拟这些特性的方法。有些特性只与特定的算法有关，有些却与多个算法相关。
target_text: For film animations, several or several frames need to be rendered and linked to them in animation programming. Most three-dimensional image editing programs are able to do this. Images with feature renderings have many significant features, and the area of rendering research is focused on finding ways to simulate them efficiently. Some features are related only to specific algorithms, while others are related to multiple algorithms.
title: 渲染

source_text: 技术研究人员已经研究出了许多渲染算法，渲染软件可以使用多种不同的技术，以生成最终图像。对场景中的每束光线进行跟踪不太现实，并且需要耗费大得惊人的时间。如果没有采样进行很好的约束，即使是一部分光线的跟踪以生成图像也需要非常大量的时间。
target_text: Technical researchers have developed a number of rendering algorithms, and rendering software can use a variety of different techniques to generate the final image. Tracking each beam of light in the scene is unrealistic and takes an amazing amount of time. It takes a lot of time to generate the image if there are no good constraints on sampling.
title: 渲染

source_text: 如果使用一个未经验证的渲染算法，那么图像函数中的高频成分将会导致最终图像中出现难看的混疊现象。混叠现象通常表现为锯齿图或者是可见像素栅格处的锯齿边。为了去除混叠现象，所有的渲染算法如果想要生成好看的图像的话都必须对图像函数进行滤波以去除高频成分，这个过程叫作抗混叠。
target_text: If an unverified rendering algorithm is used, the HF component in the image function will lead to an ugly mix in the final image. Collapse usually takes the form of a sawtooth map or a sawn edge at a visible pixel grid. To remove the folding, all the rewrite algorithms must filter the image function to remove the HF component if they want to generate a good image, a process called anti-complexing.
title: 渲染

source_text:
电影渲染
电影渲染通常在一个紧密相连的计算机组成的网络渲染集群（render farm）。当今用于电影制作三维图像描述发展水平代表是Pixar设计的RenderMan 场景描述语言。它与VRML这样较简单的三维文件格式或者是经过修改专门用于三维硬件加速的OpenGL以及DirectX等应用程序编程接口（）有所不同。
target_text: Film Rendering Film Rendering is usually a network of render arrays in a closely connected computer. Today, three-dimensional images used in film production describe the level of development as the Renderman presentation language designed by Pixar. It differs from a simpler three-dimensional file format like VRML, or a modified programming interface for applications such as OpenGL and DirectX, which are dedicated to three-dimensional hardware acceleration.
title: 渲染

source_text: ENIAC为美国陆军的弹道研究实验室（BRL）所使用，用于计算火炮的火力表。ENIAC在1946年公布的时候，就被当时的新闻赞誉为“巨脑”。它的计算速度比机电机器提高了一千倍。这是一个飞跃，之前没有任何一台单独的机器达到过这个速度。它的数学能力和通用的可编程能力，令当时的科学家和实业家非常激动。发明它的人为了进一步推广这些新思想，举办了一系列关于计算机体系结构的讲座。
target_text: ENIAC was used by the United States Army's ballistics research laboratory (BRL) to calculate the artillery matrix. When it was published in 1946, ENIAC was praised by the then news as a "brain." It was a thousand times faster to calculate than a machine. It was a leap, and no single machine had ever done so before. Its mathematical and generic programmable capabilities were very exciting to scientists and industrialists at the time. Its creators, in order to further promote these new ideas, conducted a series of lectures on the structure of computer systems.
title: 電子數值積分計算機

source_text:
编程
虽然弹道研究实验室是ENIAC的发起者，但是直到这个三年的项目进行了一年以后，约翰·冯·诺伊曼才注意到这台计算机，当时他在洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室研究氢弹。这个实验室随后深入参与了ENIAC项目，以至于对ENIAC的第一次测试运行是计算氢弹相关数据，而不是火力表。这次测试的输入、输出数据是一百万张卡片。
target_text: Although the ballistic research laboratory was the initiator of ENIAC, it was not until a year after the three-year project, John von Neuman noticed the computer when he was working on hydrogen bombs at the Los Alamos National Laboratory. The laboratory was then deeply involved in the ENIAC project, so that the first test run of ENIAC was to calculate hydrogen bomb-related data, not a fire meter. The input and output data for this test was a million cards.
title: 電子數值積分計算機

source_text: 当时在ENIAC编程方面做得最多的六位女士，1997年入选国际科技名人堂。根据她们在1946年互相的称呼，她们是凯·麦克纳尔蒂（凯瑟琳·安东内利）、贝蒂·詹宁斯（让·Bartik）、贝蒂·斯奈德（贝蒂·Holberton）、Marlyn·Wescoff（Marlyn·梅尔策）、弗兰·Bilas（弗朗西丝·斯宾塞），和露丝·Lichterman（露丝·泰特鲍姆）。珍妮弗·S.·莱特的文章《当计算机是女人》记录和阐述了操作ENIAC的女士们的角色，以及历史上对女性在计算机科学历史中角色的遗漏或淡化。ENIAC程序员的角色也在2010年的一个纪录片中被正视。
target_text: At the time, six of the most successful women in ENIAC programming were selected in 1997 for the International Science and Technology Celebrity Hall. According to what they called each other in 1946, they were Kay McNalty (Katherine Antonelli), Betty Jannings (Jean Bartik), Betty Schneider (Bethy Holberton), Marlyn Wescoff (Marlyn Meltze), Fran Bilas (Frances Spencer) and Ruth Lichterman (Ruth Teterbaum). Jennifer S. Wright ' s article, " Computers are Women " , documented and elaborated on the role of women who operate ENIAC, as well as the historical omission or dilution of women ' s roles in the history of computer science.
title: 電子數值積分計算機

source_text: ENIAC是个独一无二的设计，从来没被复製过。1943年设计的冻结意味着，计算机设计缺乏创新，发展得不好，尤其是缺乏存储程序的能力。Echert和Mauchly开始了一个新的设计工作，后来被称为EDVAC，这个设计不但更简单，而且更强大了。特别是在1944年，Eckert写了他对于存储单元的描述（汞的延迟线存储器）。这种存储单元既存储数据，又存储程序。冯·诺伊曼向穆尔学校征询EDVAC，并旁听了穆尔学校的会议。存储程序的概念在这个会议上提出来了，他写下了不完整的笔记（《关于EDVAC的报告初稿》），拟用作内部的备忘录，描述、说明会议上提出的关于正规逻辑预言的思想。ENIAC的管理员和安全人员赫尔曼·戈德斯坦向一些政府和教育机构分发了《初稿》的副本，广泛地带动了对构建新一代电子计算机（包括EDSAC和SEAC）的兴趣。
target_text: In 1944, Eckert wrote his description of the storage unit (delay line storage for mercury). The freeze, designed in 1943, meant that the computer design was not innovative and poorly developed, especially with regard to the ability to store. Echert and Mauchly started a new design, later known as EDVAC, which was not only simpler, but also stronger. In 1944, Eckert wrote his description of the storage unit (the mercury delay line storage unit). This storage unit was both stored and stored. von Neumann asked Mor School for EDVAC and listened to the Mur School meeting. The concept of storage procedure was introduced at this meeting, and he wrote incomplete notes (the preliminary draft report on EDVAC) to be used as an internal memorandum to describe and explain the ideas presented at the meeting about formal logic predictions. Herman Goldstein, the administrator and security officer of ENIAC, distributed copies of the preliminary draft to a number of governments and educational institutions, which widely inspired interest in building a new generation of electronic computers, including EDSAC and SEAC.
title: 電子數值積分計算機

source_text: 从1948年期，ENIAC进行了若干次升级，其中就包括原始的只读程序存储机制。这个机制以函数表作为程序的只读存储器，由理查德·Clippinger博士提出，并包含在了ENIAC的专利中。Clippinger向冯·诺伊曼询问实现什么样的指令集。Clippinger想出了一种三地址结构，而冯·诺伊曼提出了一地址结构，因为实现起来更简单。一个累加器（6）的三个数字用作程序计数器，另一个累加器（15）用作主累加器，第三个累加器（8）用作从函数表中读取数据的地址指针，另外的大部分累加器（1-5、7、9-14、17-19）用作数据存储。ENIAC中存储的程序的编程工作是由贝蒂·詹宁斯、Clippinger和阿黛勒·戈德斯坦完成的。1948年9月16日，ENIAC运行了一个由阿黛勒·戈德斯坦写给冯·诺伊曼的程序，因此成为了第一个存储程序计算机。这个修改在六个因素上降低了ENIAC的速度，并且限制了并行计算能力，但是因为把重新编程的时间从几天减少到了几个小时，所以性能上有些损失也是值得的。分析也显示，因为电子计算速度和机电输入/输出速度的巨大差异，即使不利用原始机器的并行功能，几乎所有现实世界的问题也完全是（I/O bound）的，即使因为上述修改，速度降低了之后仍然是这样。1952年的早些时候，ENIAC上添加了一个高速移位器，在五个因素上提高了移位速度。1952年7月，添加了一个100字的核心存储扩展，此存储体采用BCD码和Excess-3数字表示。
target_text: From 1948 onwards, ENIAC undertook several upgrades, including the original read-only process storage mechanism. The mechanism was presented as a function table by Dr. Richard Clippinger and included in ENIAC's patent. Clippinger asked von Neumann for a set of instructions. Clippinger came up with a three-site structure, while Von Neumann proposed an address structure, because it was easier to do. Three figures for an amplifier (6) were used as program counters, another self-record (15) was used as a master reacquirer, and the third was used as an address pointer for reading data from the table, and most of the recoupers (1-5, 7, 9-14, 17-19) were used for data storage.
title: 電子數值積分計算機

source_text: 机械和电子计算机器从19世纪就开始出现了，但是20世纪30、40年代被看作是现代计算机时代的开端。德国计算机（1941年5月公布）是康拉德·楚泽设计的。这是第一台通用的数字计算机。但是它是机电计算机，而不是电子计算机，因为所有功能都使用继电器。它使用二进制数学进行逻辑地计算。它可用打孔纸带编程，但是没有逻辑分支。尽管当初设计的不是图灵完全的，但是在1998年人们发现它是图灵完全的（但是如果要利用这种图灵完全性质，需要复杂、聪明的破解）。1943年，这台计算机在柏林毁于轰炸袭击。美国阿塔纳索夫-贝瑞计算机（ABC，1941年夏天公布）是第一台电子计算设备。它使用真空管实现了二进制计算，但是不是通用的，而是仅仅用于求解线性方程组。这台计算机也没有利用电子计算的速度优势。有两方面限制了它的速度：一是旋转电容鼓存储器，另一个是它的输入输出系统要把中间结果写出到纸片上。这台计算机是手动控制的，并且不可编程。英国的巨人计算机（Colossus computer，1943年用于密码分析）是汤米·弗劳尔设计的。这些计算机是数字的、电子的，可用插板和开关编程，但是仅用于密码破译，并不是通用的。霍华德·艾肯在1944年设计的马克一号电脑使用继电器，可用打孔纸带编程。可以计算一般的数学函数，但是没有分支结构。
target_text: Mechanical and electronic computers began to appear in the 19th century, but in the 1930s and 1940s they were seen as the beginning of the modern computer age. The German computer (published in May 1941) was designed by Conrad Chuzer. It was the first digital computer to be used. But it was an electron computer, not an electron computer, because all functions used relays. It used binary mathematics, but it had no logical branch. Although it was not fully designed by Turing, it was discovered in 1998 that it was entirely Turing (but if it was to take advantage of the motor, it would require a complex, intelligent decomposition). In 1943, the computer was destroyed in Berlin: an electric banker (ABC, published in the summer of 1941) was the first electronic computing device. It used a vacuum pipe, but it was not merely an interpolator, but it was not an interpolator, it was an interpolator, it was not an interpolator.

source_text: 《计算机程序的构造和解释》（，）是一本关于计算机程序设计的总体性观念的基礎教科书，由麻省理工学院出版社與麦格罗希尔出版社共同出版行銷。作者是麻省理工学院教授哈尔·阿伯尔森、傑拉德·傑伊·薩斯曼，此外傑拉德·傑伊·薩斯曼的妻子朱莉·苏斯曼也有參與本書的製作。封底的作者圖像是由其實驗室的同僚尼克·帕帕达基斯後製的合成照。
target_text: Computer Program Construction and Interpretation (,) is a basic textbook on the general concept of computer program design, which is published by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) Press and McGroshire Publishing House. The authors are Hal Abilsen, Gerard Jay Sasman, Professor at MIT, and Julie Susman, the wife of Gerard Jay Sasman, who is also involved in the production of the book. The author of the envelope is a synthetic photograph of Nick Papadakis, a colleague of his lab.
title: 计算机程序的构造和解释

source_text:

《经典力学的结构与解释》，由SICP啟發，杰拉德·杰伊·萨斯曼參與的古典力學教材。（SICP激發的創作中，唯一非電腦科學領域的。）
《如何设计程序》，由SICP出發的改良品。有簡體中文版《程序設計方法》。DrScheme 是作者群搭配本書推出的 Scheme 教學用實作品。
《程序设计语言的基本要素》，以特定語言Scheme推演全書，這種寫法在程式語言結構的主題十分罕見。
《碎片化Lisp》，專談Scheme的編譯器與直譯器原理與製作。
《建议方案》，為了讓SICP更容易上手的先備書籍。SICP的部份作者也參與了本書先期的製作過程。
《具体抽象》，比SICP擁有更多例子並且不那麼要求讀者的數學能力。
target_text: The book is widely regarded as a classic in computer science and has had a profound impact in the field of computer science. source_text: BioModels Database 是一个完全免费的，用来存储描述生化反应的数学模型的数据库。同时也提供很多其他功能，例如反应模拟、提取子模型等。什么是BioModels DatabaseBioModels Database是一个免费的生物模型在线数据库。数据库中主要存储数量型生物化学模型。所有的模型都是在相关的科学文章中发表过的并且经过了同行评审。
target_text: BioModels Database is a completely free database of mathematical models that describe biochemical reactions. It also provides many other functions, such as response simulations, extraction submodels, etc. What is BioModels DatabaseBioModels Database is a free online database of biological models. The database contains mainly quantitative biochemistry models. All models are published in relevant scientific articles and peer-reviewed.
title: 生物模型数据库

source_text: 所有BioModels Database中的模型都是已经发表在各种学术刊物上的，并且被验证人员用模拟软件模拟验证过的. 模型中所涉及的生化物质和反应也被尽量链接到参考数据库中的相关条目，方便用户快速获得详细信息。生物学家可以将描述生化反应的数学模型以SBML和CellML两种格式上传到数据库中。当模型上传后，系统会自动校验模型，并生成更多的数据格式供科研人员下载使用：SBML, CellML, XPP, SciLab, BioPAX和一些图形格式， 如GIF, SVG和applet。模型也可通过Web服务查询获取。
target_text: All models in BioModels Database have been published in various academic journals and have been simulated by certified personnel using analogue software ... Biochemical substances and reactions in models have been linked as much as possible to relevant entries in reference databases to facilitate user quick access to detailed information. Biologists can upload mathematical models describing biochemical reactions into databases in both SBML and CellML formats. When the models are uploaded, the system automatically verifies the models and produces more data formats for download by scientists: SBML, CellML, XPP, SciLab, BioPAX and some graphic formats, such as GIF, SVG and applet.
title: 生物模型数据库

source_text: 管理员（），在平常的生活中一般指对人事、资本的管理人员，在计算机行业中，管理员指维护软件或者硬件设备正常工作的专业人员。公共管理社会科学內的指公务员或进行管理的政府。工商管理参与商业竞争的企业中的管理人员，此类型的管理人员分类较多，各个部门各有分工。
target_text: Managers () generally refer in normal life to managers of personnel, capital, and in the computer industry to professionals who maintain the normal work of software or hardware equipment. In the social sciences of public administration, to civil servants or the government of management.
title: 管理员

source_text:
在计算机行业中“管理员”指以下类型的管理人员，通常拥有较高的权限：
系统管理员（SYSOP，System administrator），维护企业服务器操作系统正常运行与安全
网络管理员（Network administrator），维护网络设备与网络安全
数据库管理员（Database administrator），主管数据库的维护
论坛管理员（Forum administrator），维护网络社区论坛运转
Web 2.0当中，wiki与網誌也会有管理人员。網誌中的管理员一般指用户自己和網誌服务提供商，类似于Windows操作系统管理员“Administrator”帐号，一般比访客（guest）多拥有写入与删除权限，而匿名的访客大多只有唯读权限。
超级用户，计算机系统中权限较高的一类账户，也被称为管理员账户。
target_text: “Administrator” in the computer industry refers to the following types of managers, usually with a higher level of authority: system administrators (SYSOP, System administrator), maintenance of normal operation and security of enterprise server operating systems Network administrators (Network administrator), maintenance of network equipment and network security Database administrators (Database administrator), maintenance of databases (Forum administrator), maintenance of web community forums, and management of wiki and journal in Web 2.0.
title: 管理员

source_text: 高动态范围成像最初只用于纯粹由计算机生成的图像。之後又开发出一些从不同曝光范围照片中生成高动态范围图像的方法。随着数码相机的日渐流行以及桌面软件变得易于使用，许多业余摄影师使用高动态范围成像的方法生成高动态范围场景的照片，但是，实际上高动态范围还有许多其它的应用。
target_text: High dynamic range imaging was initially used only for purely computer-generated images. Some methods were developed to generate high dynamic range images from different exposure ranges. source_text: 当用于显示的时候，高动态范围图像经常要进行色调映射，并且要与其它几种 一起使用。历史在计算机图形学中开创高动态范围成像的先驱是Paul Debevec，据说Debevec是第一个使用高动态范围成像图生成计算机图像以逼真地对计算机图形物体进行照明与动画处理。人们普遍认为Gregory Ward是高动态范围成像文件格式的奠基人。
target_text: When used for display, high-dynamic-range images are often colour-maped and used in conjunction with other types of images. Gregory Ward is generally considered to be the cornerstone of high-dynamic-range imaging file formats.
title: 高动态范围成像

source_text: 二笔输入法的前身是“阴阳双极声形码输入系统”，是陈劲松先生于1992年发明的一种声形码输入法，1996年获得国家专利。高精炼在1998年收购了该专利，1999年将“阴阳码”更名为“二笔输入法”，并于2000年1月在广州成立了广东二笔软件有限公司。二笔公司对原来阴阳码进行优化，并向外界推出二笔输入法软件，从此二笔输入法正式出现在大众的视野中。
target_text: The two entry methods were preceded by the "Yinyang Bipolar Code Input System", a sound code input method invented by Mr. Chen Jinsong in 1992, which was patented in 1996. High-level refinements acquired the patent in 1998, changed the name of the "Yinyang" to "two input methods" in 1999, and established the Guangdong II Software Company in Guangzhou in January 2000. The two companies optimized the original Yin-yang codes and introduced two input software software to the outside world.

source_text: 经过广东二笔软件有限公司的努力开发和推广，二笔得到大量好评和荣誉，但由于以高价销售二笔输入法软件，而且当时已经得到广泛使用的智能ABC输入法和五笔字型输入法是免费的产品，只有很少人愿意付费尝试使用二笔。最终导致以经营二笔输入法软件为主要业务的广东二笔软件有限公司濒临倒闭，2004年7月22日将二笔的相关专利出售转让给珠海盈创科技发展有限公司。而后来持有二笔专利的珠海盈创科技公司并没有对二笔进行商业推广，也没有进行后续的开发和维护。至2013年1月1日，二笔输入法发明专利自申请日起已满20周年，专利有效期届满后的二笔输入法编码技术成为社会的公共财富，任何单位或个人都可以无偿地使用。
target_text: As a result of the development and promotion of Guangdong 2 Software Ltd., two related patents were transferred on 22 July 2004 to Pearl Hae-Yun-Technology Development Ltd. source_text: 栅格化（英式英語：、美式英語：），又稱光柵化，是将向量圖形格式表示的图像转换成點陣圖以用于显示器或者印表機输出的过程。综述總體上来說，栅格化這個術語可以用於任何將向量圖形转换成點陣圖的过程。在通常的应用中，这个术语用来表示在计算机上显示三维形状的流行渲染算法。栅格化目前是生成实时三维计算机图形最流行的算法。实时应用需要立即响应用户输入，并且通常需要至少每秒 24 帧的速率。
target_text: Figuration (English: US: English), also known as photosterization, is the process of converting images expressed in graphic format into a point map for displays or printer output. The general overview states that it can be used in any process of transforming vector graphics into a point map. In the usual application, the term is used to indicate a three-dimensional display of a pop-record algorithm on a computer. Flacing is now the most popular algorithm for generating real-time three-dimensional computer graphics. Real-time applications require immediate response to user input and usually require at least 24 frames per second.
title: 栅格化

source_text: 扫描变换传统的栅格化过程的最后一步就是填充图像平面中的二维三角形，这个过程就是「扫描变换」。第一个需要考虑的问题就是是否需要绘制给定的像素。一个需要渲染的像素必须位于三角形内部、必须未被裁掉，并且必须未被其它像素遮挡。有许多算法可以用于在三角形内进行填充，其中最流行的方法是扫描线算法。
target_text: The final step in the process of scanning the conventional grid conversion is to fill the two-dimensional triangle of the image plane, which is "scan transformation." The first question to consider is whether a given pixel needs to be drawn. A pixel that needs to be rendered must be inside the triangle, must not be cut, and must not be blocked by other pixels. There are many algorithms that can be used to fill it in the triangle, the most popular of which is the scanning line algorithm.
title: 栅格化

source_text: 有许多可以用于光栅化的浓淡算法。所有的浓淡处理算法都必须考虑与光源的距离以及遮蔽物体法向量与光照入射角。最快的算法让三角形中的所有像素使用同样的亮度，但是这种方法无法生成平滑效果的表面。另外也可以单独计算顶点的亮度，然后绘制内部像素的时候对顶点亮度进行插值。速度最慢也最为真实的实现方法是单独计算每点的亮度。常用的浓淡模型有 Gouraud著色法 和 Phong著色法。

The fastest algorithms allow all pixels in the triangle to use the same brightness, but this method does not generate smooth surfaces. It can also calculate the brightness of the vertex separately, and then insert the brightness of the vertex when drawing internal pixels. source_text: 在1990年代晚期，EMS厂家经常在一些高成本地区来收购资产。EMS厂家更大程度上关注PCB的制造，而把系统装备的工作留给其他的OEM玩家。EMS公司只关注ICT行业的产品，而看不起这个行业之外的产品。在近些年，EMS玩家开始把生产制造转移到低成本的地理位置；并且开始拥抱非传统ICT工业，包含消费电子，工业电子，医疗与仪器；并且增强了垂直行业的能力，工作内容也扩展到设计和ODM含系统装配，测试，交付与物流，维保，网络服务，软件和半导体设计与客户服务。

source_text: 碳纳米管具有一些特殊的电学性质。常用矢量Ch表示碳纳米管上原子排列的方向，其中，记为(n,m)。a1和a2分别表示两个基矢。(n,m)与碳纳米管的导电性能密切相关。对于一个给定(n,m)的纳米管，如果有2n+m=3q（q为整数），则这个方向上表现出金属性，是良好的导体，否则表现为半导体。对于n=m的方向，碳纳米管表现出良好的导电性，电导率通常可达铜的1万倍。取决于其方向性，碳纳米管可用来制作半导体芯片中的导线和晶体管，有望得到更大的开通电流和更快的速度，可用于替代硅芯片，但该技术仍在研究中。
target_text: Carbon nanotubes have some special electrical properties. A common vector, Ch, indicates the direction in which the carbon nanotubes are arranged atoms, in which it is recorded as (n,m). A1 and a2 respectively indicate two main objects. (n,m) are closely related to the conductivity of carbon nanotubes. For a given (n,m) nanotube, if there is 2n+m=3q (q integer), this direction is metal and is a good conductor, otherwise it is semiconductor. In the direction of n=m, the carbon nanotubes display good conductivity, usually up to 10,000 times that of copper. Depending on their orientation, carbon nanotubes can be used to produce guidance lines and crystal tubes in semiconductor chips, which are expected to yield greater open currents and faster speeds, which can be used to replace silicon chips, but the technology is still under study.
title: 量子线

source_text: 智能ABC输入法（又稱作标准输入法）是运行于Microsoft Windows之下的汉语拼音输入法软件。智能ABC可以纯拼音输入，也可以音形码输入。智能ABC因捆绑于Microsoft Windows简体中文版操作系统而一举成名，曾经是中国大陆使用人数最多的输入法软件。此软件是北京大学教授朱守涛发明的，开发于北京大学科技开发部。智能ABC的最新版本为5.23。
target_text: The smart ABC input method (also known as the standard input method) is a Chinese spelling input software run under Microsoft Windows. source_text:

source_text: 在计算机图形学中，深度缓冲是在三维图形中处理图像深度坐标的过程，这个过程通常在硬件中完成，它也可以在软件中完成，它是可见性问题的一个解决方法。可见性问题是确定渲染场景中哪部分可见、哪部分不可见的问题。画家算法是另外一种常用的方法，尽管效率较低，但是也可以处理透明场景元素。深度缓冲也称为Z缓冲。
target_text: In computer graphics, the depth buffer is the process of processing image depth coordinates in three-dimensional graphics, which is usually done in hardware and can be done in software, which is a solution to the problem of visibility. Visibility is a question of determining which part of the rehearsing scene is visible and which part is invisible. Painter algorithms are another common method and, although less efficient, can also deal with the transparency element. The depth buffer is also called a Z buffer.
title: 深度缓冲

source_text: 在数据库系统中，一个事务是指：由一系列数据库操作组成的一个完整的逻辑过程。例如银行转帐，从原账户扣除金额，以及向目标账户添加金额，这两个数据库操作的总和，构成一个完整的逻辑过程，不可拆分。这个过程被称为一个事务，具有ACID特性。ACID的概念在ISO/IEC 10026-1:1992文件的第四段內有所說明。
target_text: In the database system, a service is a complete logical process consisting of a series of database operations. For example, bank transfers, deductions from the original account, and additions to the target account, the sum of the two database operations, constitute a complete logical process that is not split. This process is referred to as a service with the ACID characteristics. The concept of ACID is described in the fourth paragraph of the ISO/IEC 10026-1:1992 document.
title: ACID

source_text:
四大特性
原子性（）：一個事务（transaction）中的所有操作，或者全部完成，或者全部不完成，不会结束在中间某个环节。事务在执行过程中发生错误，会被回滚（Rollback）到事务开始前的状态，就像这个事务从来没有执行过一样。即，事务不可分割、不可约简。
一致性（）：在事务开始之前和事务结束以后，数据库的完整性没有被破坏。这表示写入的资料必须完全符合所有的预设约束、触发器、级联回滚等。
事務隔離（）：数据库允许多个并发事务同时对其数据进行读写和修改的能力，隔离性可以防止多个事务并发执行时由于交叉执行而导致数据的不一致。事务隔离分为不同级别，包括未提交读（Read uncommitted）、提交读（read committed）、可重复读（repeatable read）和串行化（Serializable）。
持久性（）：事务处理结束后，对数据的修改就是永久的，即便系统故障也不会丢失。
target_text: Four main characteristics: Atomism (i.e., all operations in a transaction are completed, or are not completed at all, and do not end at some point in the middle. Errors in the execution of a transaction are rolled back (Rollback) to a state before the start of the transaction, as it has never been done. Consistency (i.e., the integrity of the database has not been compromised before and after the start of the transaction. This means that the information written must be in full conformity with all predefined constraints, triggers, cascades, etc.
title: ACID

source_text:
历史
Keynote是苹果电脑CEO 史蒂夫·乔布斯在为Macworld Conference and Expo和其他苹果公司的活动中主题演讲使用的演示软件。这个软件后来公开发售，Keynote 1.0版本的售价是99美元，为了与其他演示软件竞争，矛头直指微软的办公软件PowerPoint。与PowerPoint不同，Keynote支持几乎所有的图片字体，界面和设计也更图形化，可以用来制作更好的幻灯片。由于Keynote使用OS X内置的Quartz等图形技术，他可以很容易的制作幻灯片。另外，Keynote还有真三维转换，比如在切换幻灯片的时候使用旋转立方体方式。
target_text: Keynote is the presentation software used by the Apple computer CEO Steve Jobs for Macworld Conference and Expo and other Apple companies’ activities. The software was later publicly released, and Keynote version 1.0 was sold at a price of $99, targeting Microsoft's office software PowerPoint to compete with other demonstration software. Unlike PowerPoint, Keynote supports almost all graphic fonts, and interfaces and designs are more graphical and can be used to make better slides. Keynotes, using graphic techniques such as Quartz, which is embedded in OSX, makes it easy to make slides.
title: Keynote

source_text:

target_text: History Pages on the OS X system is the successor to Apple’s multifunctional office software package. As early as 2003, there was an online stream of information that Apple would produce a new text processor to replace AppleWorks, and that the name of the new package would most likely be "iWorks" or "iWork". Many of McKinta’s computer users expect the new program to be available in 2004, but Apple’s CEO Steve Jobs didn’t release iWork’05 and iLife’05 until early 2005.

source_text: 逗号分隔列（CSL）是一种数据格式，起初在最古老的简单电脑中被称为逗号分隔值（CSV）。在个人电脑（当时更普遍地被称为“家用电脑”）产业，一个常见的应用是，小企业使用模板和邮件列表生成推销邮件。CSL/CSV被用来作为简单的数据库。一些早期的软件应用，比如文字处理器，允许一系列“变量数据”在两个文件之间被合并：一个是模板文件，一个是包含姓名、地址和其它数据字段的CSL数据库。许多应用程序仍然有这种能力。
target_text: Comma separator (CSL) is a data format, initially called comma separator (CSV) in the oldest simple computer. In the personal computer industry (then more commonly referred to as “home computers”), a common application is that small businesses use templates and mailing lists to generate sales mail. CSL/CSV is used as a simple database. Some early software applications, such as word processors, allow a series of “variable data” to be merged between two files: a template file and a CSL database containing names, addresses and other data fields.
title: 逗号分隔值

source_text: 逗号分隔列过去和现在都被用于在两个不同架构的机器之间交换数据库信息。纯文本的CSV文件大幅避免了不兼容性，比如字节顺序和字长。这些文件大部分是可读的，所以在没有完美的文档或通讯的情况下仍然很容易处理。常规功能CSV格式最好被用来表现记录集合或序列，其中的每条记录都有完全相同的字段序列。这相当于关系数据库中一个单一的关系，或者典型的电子表格中的数据（虽然不能计算）。
target_text: Comma partitions have been and are used to exchange database information between machines with two different structures. The CSV files in plain text have significantly avoided incompatibility, such as byte order and word length. Most of these documents are readable, so they can still be easily processed in the absence of a perfect file or communication. The conventional CSV format is best used to show a record collection or sequence, each of which has exactly the same field series. This is equivalent to a single relationship in a relationship database, or data in a typical spreadsheet (although it cannot be calculated).
title: 逗号分隔值

source_text: 如前所述，包含多个关系的数据库不能导出为单一的CSV文件。最多，只能添加更多的标识约定，例如标识和分隔不同的关系。这种标识并不难于设计和实现，但是因为没有这方面的约定，所以基本不具备可移植性。同样地，CSV本身不能表达分层级的或面向对象的数据库或其它数据。这是因为每一条CSV记录都应当有同样的结构。CSV因此基本不适用于文档，比如由HTML、XML或者其它的标记语言或文字处理技术创建的。
target_text: As noted earlier, a database containing multiple relationships cannot be exported as a single CSV file. At the most, only more marking protocols can be added, such as marking and separation of relationships. Such markings are not difficult to design and implement, but because there is no such agreement, they are largely non-viable. Similarly, the CSV itself cannot express a hierarchical or object-oriented database or other data. This is because every CSV record should have the same structure. The CSV is thus largely inappropriate for documents, such as those created by HTML, XML or other marking language or word-processing techniques.
title: 逗号分隔值

source_text: 字段会变化的统计数据库往往有着类似关系的结构，但是会有一些字段组是可重复的。例如，健康数据库如，对于一名给定的父母会为每个孩子重复一些问题（也许直到某个确定的最大的孩子数目）。统计分析系统往往包含可以“旋转”这类数据的工具：例如，一条包含5个孩子信息的“父母”记录，可以被分解为5条单独的记录，每条记录包含（a）一个孩子的信息，和（b）一份所有未指定孩子的信息的拷贝。CSV可以用“横的”或“竖的”形式来表达这类数据。
target_text: The statistical database, where the fields change, tends to have a structure of similar relationships, but there are fields that can be repeated. For example, a health database, for example, repeats questions for each child for a given parent (perhaps until the number of children identified as the largest). Statistical analysis systems often contain tools that can “rotate” such data: for example, a “parent” record containing information on five children can be broken down into five separate records, each containing (a) information on a child, and (b) a copy of all information on an unspecified child.
title: 逗号分隔值

source_text: 在计算机科学术语中，CSV文件可以被认为是一个“平面文件数据库”。基本规则及举例存在许多描述“CSV”格式的非正式文件。IETF RFC 4180（如上所述）定义了格式“text/csv”互联网媒体类型，并已注册于IANA。另一个相关规范由提供。提供了一个概述，说明了在最广泛使用的应用程序中所使用的变体，并解释了CSV怎样才能最好地被使用和支持。
target_text: In computer science terms, the CSV document can be considered a “plane file database”. The basic rules and examples are many non-papers describing the “CSV” format. IETF RFC 4180 (as described above) defines the type of Internet media in the format “text/csv” and is registered with IANA. Another relevant norm is provided. An overview is provided of the variations used in the most widely used applications and explains how CSV can best be used and supported.
title: 逗号分隔值

source_text: 这些和其它“CSV”规范及实现的典型规则如下：CSV是一种数据格式，它有被逗号字符分隔的字段/列和以换行结束的。CSV文件不要求特定的字符编码、字节序或行结束符格式（某些软件不支持所有行结束变体）。一条记录结束于行结束符。然而，行结束符可能被作为数据嵌入到字段中，所以软件必须识别被包裹的行结束符（见下述），以便从可能的多行中正确组装一条完整的记录。
target_text: These and other CSV norms and typical rules for realization are as follows: CSV is a data format with fields/columns separated by comma characters and ends with line breaks. The CSV file does not require a specific character encoding, byte sequence or line ender format (some software does not support all line end variants). A record ends with the line end. However, the line ender may be embedded in the field as data, so the software must recognize the packaged line ender (see below) in order to correctly assemble a complete record from possible multiple lines.
title: 逗号分隔值

source_text: 应用程序支持CSV文件格式非常简单，被几乎所有的电子表格和数据库管理系統支持。许多编程语言都有可利用的库来支持CSV文件。许多实现都支持变换字段分隔字符和一些包裹约定以最大化接收者处理数据的机会，尽管使用最简单的约定是最安全的。
target_text: Applications support CSV files in a very simple format, supported by almost all spreadsheets and database management systems. Many programming languages have available libraries to support CSV files.
title: 逗号分隔值

source_text: 中国互联网络信息中心（，缩写为），是经中华人民共和国国务院主管部门批准，于1997年6月3日成立的互联网管理和服务机构。中国互联网络信息中心成立伊始，由中国科学院主管、中国科学院计算机网络信息中心（CNIC）实际运行；2014年末，改由中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室（国家互联网信息办公室）主管；2019年，改由工业和信息化部主管。現總部位於北京市中关村南四街4号中国科学院软-{件}-园1号楼。
target_text: China ' s Internet Information Centre (NCIC) was established on 3 June 1997 with the approval of the competent authorities of the State Council of the People’s Republic of China. The Internet Information Centre was established at the beginning of its operation by the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the Computer Network Information Centre of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CNIC); at the end of 2014, it was placed under the authority of the Central Committee for Cyber Security and Informatization (the National Internet Information Office); in 2019, it was placed under the authority of the Ministry of Industry and Informatics.
title: 中國互聯網絡信息中心

2008年，CNNIC收回被搶注的奧運冠軍域名，被回收者表示不服。
2009年12月9日，CNNIC被中国中央电视台《焦点访谈》曝光对.cn域名管理不善，致使色情网站可以轻而易举地更换域名。12月11日晚，CNNIC发出公告，公告暗指从2009年12月14日9时起，禁止个人注册CN域名。2010年1月底，CNNIC要求所有cn域名提交个人身份证复印件，由于没有出台适当的隐私保护条例，遭cn域名持有者抵制，不得已将个人身份证信息提交的最后的期限推迟到3月15日。但是提交信息的并不多。
target_text: On December 9, 2009, CNNC was exposed in China’s Central Television Focus to mismanagement of the .cn domain name, which made it easier to change the domain name. On the evening of December 11, CNNC announced that it had blocked the registration of individuals from December 14, but that it had not postponed until the end of the month.

source_text: “画家算法”表示头脑简单的画家首先绘制距离较远的场景，然后用绘制距离较近的场景覆盖较远的部分。画家算法首先将场景中的多边形根据深度进行排序，然后按照顺序进行描绘。这种方法通常会将不可见的部分覆盖，这样就可以解决可见性问题。
target_text: The " Painter Algorithm" means that a simple-headed painter first draws a distant scene, and then uses the drawing of a distant scene to cover a distant part. The painter algorithm first sorts the polygon of the scene according to depth, and then describes it sequentially. This method usually covers the invisible part, so that it solves the problem of visibleness.
title: 画家算法

source_text: 一些基本的画家算法实现方法也可能效率很低，因为这将使得系统将可见多边形集合中的每个点都进行渲染，而没有考虑这些多变性在最终场景中可能被其它部分遮挡。这也就是说，对于细致的场景来说，画家算法可能会过度地消耗计算机资源。
target_text: Some basic painter algorithms may also be inefficient because they allow the system to render every point in the visible polygon pool without taking into account that these variability may be overshadowed by other parts of the final scene. That is, for a detailed scenario, painter algorithms may overspent computer resources.
title: 画家算法

source_text: 人们有时候也使用逆向画家算法进行处理，这种算法首先绘制距离观察者较近的物体，已经进行绘制的部分不再进行其它的绘制过程。在计算机图形系统中，这种方法由于无需根据光照、纹理等参数计算被较近物体遮挡的远处物体的颜色，所以效率非常高。但是，这种方法也有许多与普通画家算法同样的问题。
target_text: In computer graphic systems, this method is very efficient because it does not need to calculate the colour of the distant object that is shielded by nearer objects, such as light, texture, etc.; however, it has the same problems as common painters.
title: 画家算法

source_text: 画家算法的这些缺陷导致了深度缓冲技术的发展，深度缓冲技术可以看作是画家算法的一个发展，它根据逐个像素的信息解决深度冲突的问题，并且抛弃了对于深度渲染顺序的依赖。即使在这样的系统中，有时也使用画家算法的变体。由于深度缓冲实现通常是基于硬件中的固定精度深度缓冲寄存器，因此舍入误差就会带来一些显示问题，即在多边形连接的地方会出现重叠或者间隙。为了避免这种问题，一些图形处理引擎使用了“过度渲染”的方法，即根据画家算法的顺序绘制两个多边形中受影响的边界。这也就是说有些像素如同在画家算法中那样实际上绘制了两次，但是由于图像中只有很少的一部分才做这样的处理，因此对于性能的影响很小。
target_text: These deficiencies in the painter ' s algorithms have led to the development of deep buffer technology, which can be seen as a development in the painter ' s algorithm, which solves deep conflicts based on information per pixel, and abandons the reliance on deep refractorial sequences. Even in such systems, changes in the painter ' s algorithms are sometimes used. Since deep buffers are usually based on fixed precision depth buffers in hardware, there are some problems with input errors, i.e. overlaps or gaps in polygonal connections. To avoid such problems, some graphic processing engines use the "over-rew" method, that is, drawing boundaries affected in two polygons according to the sequence of painter ' s algorithms. That is to say, some pixels have actually been drawn twice, as in painter ' s algorithms, but there is little impact on sexuality because only a small part of the image is treated as such.
title: 画家算法

source_text: 量子点（，縮寫為 QD）是把激子在三个空间方向上束缚住的半导体纳米结构。这种约束可以归结于静电势（由外部的电极，掺杂，应变，杂质产生），两种不同半导体材料的界面（例如：在自組量子点中），半导体的表面（例如：半导体纳米晶体），或者以上三者的结合。量子点具有分离的量子化的能谱。所对应的波函数在空间上位于量子点中，但延伸于数个晶格周期中。一个量子点具有少量的（1-100个）整数个的电子、電洞或電子電洞对，即其所带的电量是元电荷的整数倍。

The quantum dots have a separate numeric nucleic spectrum. The corresponding wave function is located in space in a quantum point, but extends to several crystal cycles. A quantum dot has a small number of electronics, electrical holes or electron holes, i.e., the amount of electricity it carries is a full number of metacharges.

source_text: 小的量子点，例如胶体半导体纳米晶，可以小到只有2到10个纳米，这相当于10到50个原子的直径的尺寸，在一个量子点体积中可以包含100到100,000个这样的原子。自组装量子点的典型尺寸在10到50纳米之间。通过光刻成型的门电极或者刻蚀半导体异质结中的二维电子气形成的量子点横向尺寸可以超过100纳米。将10纳米尺寸的三百万个量子点首尾相接排列起来可以达到人类拇指的宽度。

The typical size of self-assembly dot dots is between 10 and 50 nanometers. source_text: 这种方法生长出的量子点长在另一种半导体上，很容易与传统半导体元件结合。另外由于没有有机配体，磊晶量子点的电荷传输效率比胶体量子点高，并且能级也比胶体量子点更容易调控。同时，也具有表面的缺陷少等优点。然而，由于化学气相沉积和分子束磊晶都需要高真空或超高真空，因此相比于胶体量子点，磊晶量子点的成本较高。
target_text: This method produces quantum points that grow on another semiconductor, which can easily be combined with traditional semiconductor components. In addition, in the absence of an organic formulation, the charge transfer efficiency of the crystal point is higher than that of the glue, and the ability level is easier to regulate than that of the glue. At the same time, it also has the advantage, for example, that there are few defects on the surface. However, since both chemical gas phase deposition and molecular beam crystals require high or very high vacuums, the cost of the crystal point is higher than that of the glue.
title: 量子点

source_text: 广度优先搜索算法（，縮寫：BFS），又譯作寬度優先搜索，或橫向優先搜索，是一種圖形搜索演算法。簡單的說，BFS是從根節點開始，沿着树的宽度遍历树的节点。如果所有节点均被访问，则算法中止。广度优先搜索的实现一般采用open-closed表。作法BFS是一種暴力搜索算法，目的是系統地展開並檢查圖中的所有節點，以找尋結果。換句話說，它並不考慮結果的可能位址，徹底地搜索整張圖，直到找到結果為止。BFS並不使用經驗法則演算法。
target_text: Broadly prioritized search algorithms (BFS), translated into width first, or horizontally, is a graphical search algorithm. Simplely, BFS is a node that runs through trees from the root node. If all nodes are visited, the calculation is aborted. Wide priority search is generally achieved using the Open-closed table. The practice BFS is a violent search algorithm that aims to spread all the nodes in the system and check all the nodes in the map in order to find the results. In other words, it does not consider the possible location of the result, searching the entire map at the bottom until the result is found. BFS does not use empirical methods to calculate the result.
title: 广度优先搜索

source_text:
最佳解
若所有邊的長度相等，廣度優先搜索演算法是最佳解——亦即它找到的第一個解，距離根節點的邊數目一定最少；但對一般的圖來說，BFS並不一定回傳最佳解。這是因為當圖形為加權圖（亦即各邊長度不同）時，BFS仍然回傳從根節點開始，經過邊數目最少的解；而這個解距離根節點的距離不一定最短。這個問題可以使用考慮各邊權值，BFS的改良演算法成本一致搜尋法來解決。然而，若非加權圖形，則所有邊的長度相等，BFS就能找到最近的最佳解。
target_text: The best solution is that, if all sides are equal in length, the widest priority search algorithm is the best solution -- that is, the first solution it finds, which must be the lowest number of edges from the root node; but for the general picture, BFS does not necessarily return the best solution. This is because BFS still returns from the root node (i.e., the length of each side) through the lowest number of edges; and the distance from the root node is not necessarily the shortest. This question can be solved by using a search method that takes into account the margin value of the BFS ' s improved algorithms. However, if it does not add rights, the BFS will be able to find the most recent solution.
title: 广度优先搜索

source_text:
應用
廣度優先搜索演算法能用來解決圖論中的許多問題，例如：尋找圖中所有連接元件（Connected Component）。一個連接元件是圖中的最大相連子圖。
尋找連接元件中的所有節點。
尋找非加權圖中任兩點的最短路徑。
測試一圖是否為二分圖。
（Reverse）Cuthill–McKee演算法尋找連接元件
由起點開始，執行廣度優先搜索演算法後所經過的所有節點，即為包含起點的一個連接元件。
target_text: A wide-range first search algorithm can be used to solve many of the problems in the theory, such as finding all the connecting components in the map (Conneced Component). A connected component is the largest connected sub-figure in the map. Finds all the nodes in the connected widgets. Finds the shortest path of any of the two points in the non-associated map. Tests whether a single image is a two-point map. (Reverse) Cuthell-McKee algorithm seeks the connected elements from the start point, starting with all the nodes that have passed since the extension priority search algorithm, which is a connecting component that contains the starting point.
title: 广度优先搜索

source_text:
啟發式演算法
電腦科學的兩大基礎目標，就是發現可證明其執行效率良好且可得最佳解或次佳解的演算法。而啟發式演算法則試圖一次提供一个或全部目標。例如它常能發現很不錯的解，但也沒辦法證明它不會得到較壞的解；它通常可在合理時間解出答案，但也沒辦法知道它是否每次都可以這樣的速度求解。
target_text: The two basic goals of computer science are to find an algorithm that can prove its performance to be efficient and can be best or sub-optimal. And the inspired algorithms try to provide one or all of them at a time. For example, it often finds very good answers, but it does not prove that it will get worse answers; it usually solves them in a reasonable time, but it does not know whether it can always solve them at this pace.
title: 启发式算法

source_text: 有時候人們會發現在某些特殊情況下，啟發式演算法會得到很壞的答案或效率極差，然而造成那些特殊情況的資料結構，也許永遠不會在現實世界出現。因此現實世界中啟發式演算法很常用來解決問題。啟發式演算法處理許多實際問題時通常可以在合理時間內得到不錯的答案。
target_text: Sometimes people find that, in certain special circumstances, the inspired algorithms get very bad answers or very inefficient ones, but the data structures that create them may never appear in the real world. So in the real world, the inspired algorithms are often used to solve problems. The inspired algorithms usually get good answers within a reasonable time when they deal with many practical problems.
title: 启发式算法

source_text:
啟發式演算法與最短路徑問題
所謂的最短路径問題有很多種意思，在這裡啟發式指的是在一個搜尋樹的節點上定義的函数，用於評估從此節點到目標節點成本最小的路徑。啟發式通常用於資訊充份的搜尋演算法，例如最好优先貪婪演算法與A*。最好优先貪婪演算法會為啟發式函數選擇最低代價的節點；A*則會為選擇最低代價的節點，此是從起始節點到目前節點的路徑的確實代價。如果是可接受的（admissible）意即未曾付出超過達到目標的代價，則A*一定會找出最佳解。
target_text: Apocalyptic algorithms and shortest path questions have many meanings, the shortest path question being the function defined in a search tree node, which is used to evaluate the least costly path from this node to the target node. An inspirational is usually used for search algorithms that are highly informative, such as the best preference for greed algorithms and A*. It is better to give priority to greed algorithms to select the lowest price for the enlightenment function; A* is the node for the lowest price, which is the exact price of the path from the starting node to the current node. If an acceptable (admissible) means that the target has not been exceeded, then A* will find the best solution.
title: 启发式算法

source_text: 任何的搜尋問題中，每個節點都有個選擇以及到達目標的深度，一個毫無技巧的演算法通常都要搜尋個節點才能找到答案。啟發式演算法藉由使用某種切割機制降低了分支因子（）以改進搜尋效率，由降到較低的。分叉率可以用來定義啟發式演算法的偏序关系，例如：若在一個節點的搜尋樹上，的分叉率較低，則。啟發式為每個要解決特定問題的搜尋樹的每個節點提供了較低的分叉率，因此它們擁有較佳效率的計算能力。
target_text: In any search problem, each node has a choice and the depth of the target reached, and an unskilled algorithm usually searches for a node to find the answer. Initiating algorithms reduce the branch factor(s) by using a cut system to improve search efficiency from lower to lower. For example, if a node search tree is lower, the node provides a lower cut-off rate for each node to solve a particular problem, so that they have a more efficient calculation.

source_text:
找尋新的啟發式演算法
如何找到一個分叉率較少又通用的合理啟發式演算法，已被人工智慧社群深入探究過。他們使用幾種常見技術：部分問題的解答的代價通常可以評估解決整個問題的代價，通常很合理。例如一個10-puzzle拼盤，解題的代價應該與將1到5的方塊移回正確位置的代價差不多。通常解題者會先建立一個儲存部份問題所需代價的模式資料庫（pattern database）以評估問題。
target_text: The search for a new start-up algorithm, how to find a rational start-up algorithm with a lower forklift rate and a more general application, has been explored in the artificial intelligence community. They use a few common techniques: the price of answers to some of the questions is usually reasonable to assess the cost of solving the whole problem. For example, a 10-puzzle puzzle, the cost of solving the problem should be similar to the cost of moving one to five squares back to the right place.
title: 启发式算法

source_text:
控制系统
在控制技术方面，韶山9型电力机车采用微机控制及逻辑控制单元（LCU）技术，用以替代传统的继电器有触点控制电路，使逻辑控制由软件来完成，从而减少机车布线，简化了控制系统的设计。韶山9型电力机车的控制系统是在韶山8型、韶山7D型电力机车的基础上发展而成，当操作机车时司机指令传送到逻辑控制单元，由逻辑控制单元进行逻辑判断，并向微机系统输出指令，由微机系统执行机车的特性控制。除此之外，微机系统和逻辑控制系统并具有与微机显示屏的通信功能，通过三者互相配合，机车可以实施恒流准恒速控制特性控制、制动系统的恒制动力控制、防空转及防滑行控制、轴重转移补偿控制、空电联合制动控制、列车供电控制、故障诊断与故障记录等功能。从2004年开始，韶山9型电力机车开始陆续加装由广州铁路科研所开发的车载自动过分相系统，通过安装地面信号感应器、信号处理装置，并对机车的微机控制系统软件进行升级，使机车过分相时能够自动分合主断路器。
target_text: In terms of control technology, the control system of the Kishan 9 electric motor vehicle was developed on the basis of the Sakayama 8 and 7D electric motor vehicle, which, when operated, transmits the driver's instructions to the logical control unit, is logically judged by the logical control unit and gives instructions to the micromechanic system for the control of the characteristics of the motor vehicle, which is carried out by the microcomputer system and is equipped with communication functions in conjunction with the microfiche screen. In addition, the micromechanical system and the logical control system are equipped with a communications function that reduces the layout of the motor vehicle and streamlines the design of the control system.
title: 韶山9型电力机车

source_text: 南京大学计算机科学与技术系是中国信息科学技术研究与教育的重镇，也是中国计算机科学与技术的重要开拓者，前身是建系于1978年的计算机科学系，1993年正式更名为计算机科学与技术系。其学科“计算机科学与技术”是国家一级重点学科，学科所属的两个二级学科：“计算机软件与理论”、“计算机应用技术”也均为国家重点学科。
target_text: The Faculty of Computer Science and Technology of Nanjing University is a major pioneer in information science and technology research and education in China. source_text:
历史概要
南京大学是中国最早从事计算机教学和科研的单位之一，计算机教学与研究起步于1958年。1960年成立计算技术专业，徐家福主持成功研制了中国教育部部属高校自行研制的第一台计算机和中国第一个高级语言编译程序。1978年国内政治动乱结束，正式成立南京大学计算机科学系，1992年改为南京大学计算机科学与技术系。
1981年，南京大学计算机学系设立中国最早的计算机软件博士点，之後培养了中国第一位计算机软件博士。1983年成立了当时中国高校唯一的计算机软件研究所。
target_text: The University of Nanjing was one of the first institutions in China to engage in computer teaching and research, and computer teaching and research started in 1958. In 1960, when the Computer Science Department of Nanjing University was established, Xu Jiafu led the successful development of the first computer developed by the Chinese Ministry of Education and the first Chinese high-level language compiler. In 1978, the Department of Computer Science of Nanjing University was formally established, and in 1992 it became the Faculty of Computer Science and Technology of Nanjing University.
title: 南京大学计算机科学与技术系

source_text: 几何处理，亦称网格处理，是一个以应用数学、计算机科学、工程学等领域理论为基础，以设计高效获取、重建、分析、处理、模拟及传输复杂三维模型算法为目标的快速成长的新兴研究领域。作为计算机图形学的分支之一，几何处理关注对几何形体本身的建模，处理，分析及应用，常见操作包括表面重建，噪点过滤，几何分析，形状简化以及交互设计。在概念与方法层面上，几何处理可以被理解为信号处理（一维）和图像处理（二维）的三维类比。
target_text: Geometric processing, also known as grid processing, is a rapidly growing field of research based on theory in the fields of applied mathematics, computer science, engineering, and the design of efficient acquisition, reconstruction, analysis, processing, simulation and transmission of complex three-dimensional model algorithms. As one of the branches of computer graphics, geometric processing is concerned with modelling, processing, analysis and application of geometry itself. Common operations include surface reconstruction, noise filtering, geometry, shape simplification and interactive design. At the conceptual and methodological levels, geometry processing can be understood as a three-dimensional analogy between signal processing (one-dimensional) and image processing (two-dimensional).
title: 几何处理

source_text:
法律问题
大部分视频和音频格式都能通过FFmpeg项目的libavcodec函数库原生支持。对于那些没有开源解码器的格式，MPlayer使用二进制的函数库。它能直接使用Windows的DLL。专有的CSS解析软件和相关格式使MPlayer成为被众多开放源代码播放器所使用的后端。过去，MPlayer曾经包括OpenDivX，一个不兼容GPL的解码器。这已经被删除，使MPlayer成为完全的自由软件。但是在自由软件中使用专有的解码器仍然是影响FFmpeg、MPlayer以及其他相关软件的潜在问题。
target_text: Legal issues Most video and audio formats are supported from the libavcodec functions library of the FFmpeg project. For formats that do not have open source decoding, MPlayer uses a binary version of the function library. It uses Windows DLL directly. The proprietary CSS decomposition software and related formats make MPlayer a backend used by many open source players. In the past, MPlayer used to include OpenDivX, a non-compatible GPL decoding decoding device. This has been deleted, making MPlayer a fully free software. But the use of proprietary decoding devices in free software remains a potential problem affecting FFmpeg, MPlayer, and other related software.
title: MPlayer

source_text: 如上所述，计算机处理是用来将原始数据（每个镜子位置对应的光强）转换为期望的结果（每一波长的光强）。所需的这一过程其实就是叫傅里叶变换的常见的代数方法。（正是为什么这被称为“傅里叶变换光谱学”的缘故）。原始数据有时候也叫干涉图样。因为目前的计算机设备成为必备条件，并且具有分析极少量样品的光的能力，这一技术经常利于样品制备的不同方面的自动化。样品得以更好的保存并且结果也更容易去复刻。这两个优点都是很重要的，比如未来有可能会卷入法律诉讼的测试情形，像那些牵涉药品试样的情况。
target_text: As noted above, computer processing is used to convert raw data (the light power corresponding to each mirror position) into desired results (the light power of each wavelength). The process required is actually a common algebra method called Fourier Conversion. (It is precisely why this is called the “Furiette spectrometry”). The original data are sometimes called interferometry. Because current computing equipment is a necessary condition and has the ability to analyse the light of very few samples, this technology often benefits the automation of different aspects of sample preparation.
title: 傅里叶变换光谱学

source_text: 桶排序（Bucket sort）或所謂的箱排序，是一個排序演算法，工作的原理是將陣列分到有限數量的桶裡。每個桶再個別排序（有可能再使用別的排序演算法或是以遞迴方式繼續使用桶排序進行排序）。桶排序是鴿巢排序的一種歸納結果。當要被排序的陣列內的數值是均勻分配的時候，桶排序使用線性時間（）。
target_text: The drum sorting (Bucket sort) or so-called box sorting is a sorting algorithm that works on the basis that the arrays are assigned to a limited number of drums. Each drum is sorted again (it is possible to use a different sorting algorithm or to continue to sort the drums in a sequential manner). The drum sorting is an attribution of the doves sorting. When the values in the array to be sorted are evenly distributed, the drum sorting uses linear time.
title: 桶排序

source_text:
動態規劃的算法
一開始，假定真的想知道的是乘完矩陣所需的最小成本，或算術運算的最小量。若只有兩個矩陣相乘，則只會有一種方法去乘它們，所有其最小成本為乘積的成本。一般地，可以用下列的遞迴演算法求出最小成本：取得矩陣的序列且將其分成兩個子序列。
找出乘完每一子序列的最小成本。
將成本加起來，並加上兩個結果矩陣相乘的成本。
在每一矩陣序列可分開的位置運作，並取其最小值。
target_text: At the outset, it is assumed that what really wants to know is the minimum cost of going through the matrix, or the minimum amount of arithmetic operation. If only two arrays are multiplied, there is only one way to go by them, with all the minimum cost being the cost of a multiplier. Generally, the lowest cost can be achieved by going through the following algorithms: taking the sequence of the matrix and dividing it into two subserieses. Find the minimum cost of going through each sequence. Add the cost to the cost, plus the cost of multiplying the two result arrays.
title: 矩陣鏈乘積

source_text:
alpha-beta 剪枝法
最先電腦圍棋也試圖用類似處理西洋棋的演算法——alpha-beta 剪枝法，即一般認為的暴力搜尋法，但成長非常慢。1986年，應昌期懸賞100萬美金，徵求可以打敗人類的圍棋軟體，並以15年為期限，但沒有任何人拿走獎金。到了20世紀末，這類程式表現最好的是陳志行製作的手談，其宣稱可以接近業餘初段，至少與低段職業差距9子以上，其他如GNU Go更是只有業餘5~10級左右。
target_text: At the end of the 20th century, the first computer chess game tried to use algorithms similar to those used to deal with chess — alpha-beta wiring — which is generally thought to be violent search methods, but it grew very slowly. In 1986, a $1 million reward was paid for the current period, demanding a chess software that could defeat humans, and a 15-year period, but no one took the prize. By the end of the 20th century, the best of these programs were written hand-by-hand talks, which claimed to be close to the first part of a career, at least 9 or more, and others, such as GNU Go, were in the range of 5-10 grades.
title: 计算机围棋

source_text:
编程语言选择设计哲学Minimax 树搜索蒙特卡罗方法Knowledge-based 系统机器学习電腦圍棋程序的竞赛历史
第一個電腦圍棋競賽是由USENIX贊助，在1984年到1988年間舉行。宏碁電腦公司與應昌棋圍棋基金會從1986年開始，聯合舉辦電腦圍棋競賽，獲得冠軍的程式，可以挑戰職業棋士，獲勝獎金美金一百萬元。有效期至2000年。
target_text: The first computer chess competition, which was sponsored by USENIX and was held between 1984 and 1988, was designed by the philosophy of Minimax Tree Searching for the Montecalo Method Knowledge-Based System Machine to learn computer chess procedures. The macro computer company and the Chess Foundation have been co-organizing computer chess competitions since 1986 to win a championship program that can challenge professional chess professionals and win a million dollars in winning money.
title: 计算机围棋

source_text:
矢量图形是计算机图形学中用点、直线或者多边形等基于数学方程的几何图元表示的图像。矢量图形与使用像素表示图像的位图不同。综述
所有的现代计算机显示器都要将矢量图形转换成栅格图像的格式，包含屏幕上每个像素数值的栅格图像保存在内存中。
target_text: Vector graphics are images in computer graphics that are represented by geometrical graphs based on mathematical equations such as points, straight lines or polygons. Vector graphics are different from bitmaps using pixels for images. An overview of all modern computer monitors is required to convert vector graphics into a grid image format that contains a grid image of each pixel value on the screen.
title: 矢量图形

source_text: 我们可以在任意几何空间构建任意維度物体的几何模型。在计算机图形学领域大量使用着二维几何模型和三维几何模型。二维几何模型在计算机印刷和工程制图领域有重要的应用，而三维几何模型在计算机辅助设计、计算机辅助制造以及地质建模等领域都有着很关键的应用。
target_text: We can construct geometric models of any dimension in any geometric space. Two-dimensional geometry models and three-dimensional geometry models are used extensively in computer graphics. Two-dimensional geometry models have important applications in computer printing and engineering mapping, while three-dimensional geometry models have critical applications in computer-assisted design, computer-assisted manufacturing and geological modelling.
title: 几何模型

source_text: 几何模型通常与用算法隐式定义形状的过程模型和面向对象模型有所不同，它也与数字图像和立体模型不同，并且与用隐模型表示的数学模型如任意多项式的零集也有所不同。但是，这些区别可能会经常变得不太明显：例如，几何形状可以用面向对象编程中的对象来表示；数字图像也可以解释为一组正方形颜色的组合；象圆这样的几何形状也可以用数学方程来表示。另外分形物体的建模经常要同时使用几何模型与过程模型技术。
target_text: Geometric models are often different from process and object-oriented models using algorithmic implicit definitions of shapes, as well as digital images and stereo models, and from mathematical models expressed in hidden models, such as any zero set of multiple models. However, these differences may often become less obvious: for example, geometric shapes can be expressed as objects in object programming; digital images can also be interpreted as a combination of square colours; geometric shapes such as circles can also be expressed in mathematical equations. Modelling of fractal objects often uses geometric models and process modelling techniques simultaneously.
title: 几何模型

source_text: 计算机辅助制造（英文：Computer-aided manufacturing，缩写：CAM）是工程师大量使用产品生命周期管理计算机软件的产品元件制造过程。计算机辅助设计中生成的元件三维模型用于生成驱动数字控制机床的计算机数控代码。这包括工程师选择工具的类型、加工过程以及加工路径。
target_text: Computer-assisted manufacturing (English: Computer-aided manufacturing, Abbreviation: CAM) is a product component manufacturing process in which engineers use product life-cycle management computer software extensively. The three-dimensional model of the component generated in the computer-assisted design is used to generate computer numerical control codes that drive the digital control bed. This includes the type of tool that the engineer selects, the process and the process path.
title: 计算机辅助制造

source_text:
综述
有些计算机辅助制造与電腦輔助設計集成，譬如MASTERCAM等。每一个计算机辅助制造软件首先都要解决 CAD数据交换的问题，因为生成数据的 CAD 系统就像文字处理软件那些经常按照它自己的专有格式保存数据。通常需要電腦輔助設計操作员将数据输出成通用的数据格式，2D平面如DXF及DWG等；3D曲面則以IGES或者STL為主要選擇。一般而言，只要CAD在繪製時所使用的單位與计算机辅助制造軟體相同，通常都不需要再进行编辑，所以可以直接採用，较为简单。
target_text: In summary, some computer-assisted manufacturing and computer assistive devices are integrated, such as MASTERCAM. Each computer-assisted manufacturing software first solves the problem of CAD data exchange, because CAD systems that generate data are like text-processing software that often save data according to its own proprietary format. Computer-assisted design operators are usually required to produce data into general data formats, such as DXF and DWG; 3D curves are based on IGEs or STL. Generally, as long as the units used by CAD in the production are the same as the computer-assisted manufacturing software, there is usually no need for editing, so it can be used directly and simply.
title: 计算机辅助制造

source_text: 计算机辅助制造软件的输出结果通常是結構較简单的"G代碼"程式(.NC)，當加工為2D平面加工時，G代碼程式內容會較簡單易懂(因其絕大部分均為兩軸定位)，然而，當加工為3D曲面，G代碼程式會變的較為龐大，而且也較難解讀。當计算机辅助制造軟體轉出G代碼程式後，會使用直接数字控制（DNC）程序将它传送到加工機控制器上，目前亦有可將G代碼程式儲存於記憶卡中，在插入加工機控制器所配置的記憶卡插槽中讓控制器讀取。
target_text: The output of the computer-assisted manufacturing software is usually a simpler "G-ID" program (.NC) which, when processed to 2D plane level, is easier to understand (because most of it is located in two axes), but when processed to 3D, the G-code program becomes more extensive and difficult to read. When the computer-assisted manufacturing software is transferred out of the G-code program, the direct digital control (DNC) program is used to transmit it to the processor controller, and now the G-code program can be stored in the memory card, allowing the controller to read it in the memory card slot that is configured for insertion into the processor controller.
title: 计算机辅助制造

source_text: 尽管长期以来人们一直梦想计算机辅助制造软件能够独立运转，然而，無論再先進的计算机辅助制造軟體，在沒有技術成熟的人員使用下，均極為容易造成後續加工上的失誤 (斷刀、過切等)，因此它仍然需要知识与技能都很丰富的操作员來進行操作與設定，譬如：刀具的選擇、加工的深度、加工的方式等等。
target_text: Despite the long-held dream that computer-assisted manufacturing software can operate independently, no matter how advanced computer-assisted manufacturing software can be, it is extremely easy to cause errors in subsequent processing (blash, overcutting, etc.), and therefore still needs to be operated and configured by knowledgeable and skilled operators, such as the choice of knives, the depth of processing, the way in which they are processed, etc.
title: 计算机辅助制造

source_text:
在最佳的情況下，计算机辅助制造軟體操作人員最好與數控機床操作人員相同，這樣的配置，加工失誤的機率會降到最低。历史

source_text: GNU bison（Bison意为犎牛；而Yacc与意为牦牛的Yak同音）是一个自由软件，用于自动生成语法分析器程序，实际上可用于所有常见的操作系统。Bison把LALR形式的上下文无关文法描述转换为可做语法分析的C或C++程序。在新近版本中，Bison增加了对GLR语法分析算法的支持。GNU bison基本兼容Yacc，并做了一些改进。它一般与flex一起使用。
target_text: GNU bison (Bison means yak; Yacc is like Yak meaning yak) is a free software for the automatic generation of syntax analyser programs, which can actually be used in all common operating systems. Bison converts the context of LALR into a non-syntax description into a C or C++ program for syntax analysis. In the latest version, Bison adds support to the GLR syntax analysis algorithm. GNU bison is basically compatible with Yacc and has made some improvements. It is generally used with flex.
title: GNU bison

source_text: GMAT的计量与词汇部分都是机考选择题，并根据考生的答题水平做出调节。在计量与词汇部分的开始，考生会被给予中等难度的问题。如果回答正确，计算机会提高问题难度；反之亦然。这种调节会一直伴随着整个答题过程，直到该部分结束。计算机会根据考生水準即时做出评价，并给出每部分的原始分值。
target_text: The measurement and vocabulary part of the GMAT is a question of chance selection and is adjusted according to the number of questions that the candidates answer. At the beginning of the measurement and vocabulary section, the examiner is given a medium difficulty question. If the answer is correct, the computer increases the difficulty of the question; vice versa. The reconciliation will be accompanied by the entire question-and-answer process until the end of the section.
title: GMAT

source_text:
分析性写作
分析性写作由一道30分钟的作文题组成，要求考生对论点进行分析，指出论点背后的推理逻辑，并对其进行批判。论文会被打出两个独立分数，其平均数为考生的写作成绩。分数之一是计算机打分，另一个则是GMAC的审阅在对计算机打分不知情的情况下进行评价。自动计分程序会检查50中语法结构、语言特点，包括观点的组织、语言应用、论点分析。如果两个计分相差超过1分，另一位资深审阅会进行最后决断。
target_text: Analytical writing consists of a 30-minute essay that requires the examiner to analyse the arguments, indicate the reasoning behind them, and criticize them. The papers are given two independent scores, the average of which is the result of the testee's writing. One score is a computer score, the other is a GMAC review that is evaluated without knowledge of the computer. The automatic scoreter examines the syntax structure in 50, the linguistic characteristics, including the organization of the point of view, the use of the language, and the analysis of arguments.
title: GMAT

source_text: 成绩分布呈钟形曲线，标准差约为100点，意味着68%的考生成绩在400到600分之间。最终成绩不单是根据考生回答的最后问题而得出的(即问题的难易程度随着计算机的调整而做出改变)。分数的算法相对复杂。考生可能会在中途答错问题，而计算机则将其记为异常。如果考生在开头就答错题，这并不意味着他会跌到低谷。
target_text: The result distribution is a bell curve, with a standard difference of about 100 points, which means that 68% of the candidates are between 400 and 600 points. The final result is not based solely on the final question answered by the candidate (i.e. the difficulty of the question changes with the computer). The score is a relatively complex calculation. The examiner may answer the wrong question in the middle and the computer records it as an anomaly.
title: GMAT

source_text: 两值之间的线性插值基本运算在计算机图形学中的应用非常普遍，以至于在计算机图形学领域的行话中人们将它称为 lerp。所有当今计算机图形处理器的硬件中都集成了线性插值运算，并且经常用来组成更为复杂的运算：例如，可以通过三步线性插值完成一次双线性插值运算。由于这种运算成本较低，所以对于没有足够数量条目的光滑函数来说，它是实现精确快速查找表的一种非常好的方法。
target_text: Linear plug-in values between two values are basically used in computer graphics to the extent that they are called lerp in computer graphics. All of today's computer graphics processors' hardware is integrated into linear plug-in operations and is often used to form more complex calculations: for example, a double-line plug-in function can be performed through a three-step plug-in value. Given the low cost of such calculation, it is a very good way to achieve a smooth function that does not have a sufficient number of entries.
title: 线性插值

source_text: 材质贴图中，双线性插值也叫双线性过滤或者双线性材质贴图。图像的双线性插值放大算法中，目标图像中新创造的象素值，是由源图像位置在它附近的2*2区域4个邻近象素的值通过加权平均计算得出的。双线性内插值算法放大后的图像质量较高，不会出现像素值不连续的的情况。然而此算法具有低通滤波器的性质，使高频分量受损，所以可能会使图像轮廓在一定程度上变得模糊。
target_text: Bilinear plug-in values are also called bilinear filters or bilinear material tabs. In the bilinear plug-in algorithm of the image, the newly created pixel values in the target image are derived from a weighted average value of four adjacent pixels located in the area of 2*2 adjacent to the source image. The bilinear plug-in algorithm is of high quality and does not result in inconsistent pixel values. However, this algorithm has the character of a low-line filter, which causes damage to high frequency fractions, and may result in a certain blurring of the image profile.
title: 双线性插值

source_text: 低介电常数材料（low-K材料）是当前半导体行业研究的热门话题。通过降低集成电路中使用的介电材料的介電係數，可以降低集成电路的漏电电流，降低导线之间的电容效应，降低集成电路发热等等。低介电常数材料的研究是同高分子材料密切相关的。传统半导体使用二氧化硅作为介电材料，氧化硅的介電係數约为4。真空的介電係數为1，干燥空气的介電係數接近于1。
target_text: Low-media constant material (low-K material) is the hot topic of the current semiconductor industry study. By reducing the number of intermediates used in integrated circuits, it can reduce the leakage of electricity from integrated circuits, reduce the electrical effect between conductors, reduce heat from integrated circuits, and so on. The study of low-media constant materials is closely related to high-molecular materials. The traditional semiconductor uses silicon dioxide as a medium, and the power source for silicon oxidation is about 4.
title: 低介电常数材料

source_text:
概述
在电子技术不断发展的今天，微电子工业一直以来仍旧基本保持着摩尔定律的正确性。为了提高集成电路的性能和速度，越来越多，越来越小的晶体管被集成到芯片中。随着这种小型化的趋势，芯片中不同层导线之间的距离也随之减小。用作导线之间绝缘层的二氧化硅（SiO2）由于厚度的不断缩小使得自身电容增大。这种电荷的积聚将干扰信号传递，降低电路的可靠性，并且限制了频率的进一步提高。为了解决这个问题，微电子工业将应用低介电常数材料代替传统的二氧化硅绝缘材料。
target_text: To improve the performance and speed of integrated circuits, more and more, smaller transistors are integrated into chips. With this tendency of miniaturization, the distance between different layers of fuses in the chip is reduced. Silicon dioxide (SiO2) used as the insulation layer between the fuses increases its voltage due to increasing thickness. The accumulation of this charge will disrupt signal transmission, reduce circuit reliability, and limit further increases in frequency. To address this problem, the microelectronic industry will use low-media constants to replace traditional silicon dioxide insulation materials.
title: 低介电常数材料

source_text: C是Windows API（Win32）的主要编程语言，在该API的文档中所公开的函数和数据结构均以该语言进行了描述。但是，如果某种编程语言能够处理（明确定义的）低级数据结构，并能按照规定进行调用与回调，那么其编译器或汇编器也可以调用Windows API。类似地，在历史上Windows API也由多种语言进行了开发。尽管C不是面向对象的编程语言，但Windows API和Windows都具有面向对象的特性；同时，也有许多面向对象语言的包装类和扩展（如微软基础类库MFC、可视化组件库VCL、GDI+等）使这种面向对象的结构更加清晰。例如，Windows 8提供的Windows API和WinRT API就是用C++实现的，并且在设计上也是面向对象的。
target_text: C is the main programming language for Windows API (Win32), and the functions and data structures published in the API document are described in that language. However, if a programming language can handle low-level data structures (clearly defined) and can be called and returned as required, its compilers or compilers can also call Windows API. Similarly, Windows API has been developed in a variety of languages. Although it is not an object-oriented programming language, Windows API and Windows have object-oriented features; at the same time, there are many type of packaging and extension for object-oriented languages (e.g. Microsoft Basic Bank MFC, Visualized Component Bank VCL, GDI+, etc.) that make this object-oriented structure clearer. For example, Windows API and WinRT API provided by Windows 8 have been achieved by C++ and are designed to be object-oriented.
title: Windows API

source_text: 全国计算机等级考试（英文：National Computer Rank Examination，简称 NCRE）是中华人民共和国国家教育委员会（现教育部）于1994年推出的主要针对非计算机专业学生及从业人员的-{zh-hans:计算机; zh-hant:電腦;}-能力考试，共分4级。包括计算机一级考试、计算机二级考试、计算机三级考试、计算机四级考试，考试有。全国计算机等级考试采用全国统一命题与考试的形式。每年安排4次考试，分别是3月，6月，9月和12月，其中3月和9月开考全部级别，6月和12月开考计算机一级和二级的科目。
target_text: The national computer level examination (English: National Computer Rank Examation) was introduced in 1994 by the National Education Council of the People's Republic of China (now the Ministry of Education) as the {zh-hans: Computers; zh-hant: Computers;}-Competence Examinations, with a total of four levels. These include the computer level I examination, computer level II examination, computer level III examination, computer level IV examination, and so on. The national computer level examination takes the form of a unified national title and examination. Four examinations are arranged each year, in March, June, September and December, of which all grades are opened, in March and September, and in June and December, in computer level I and II subjects.
title: 全国计算机等级考试

source_text:
考试内容与证书分级
计算机等级考试证书分为四个级别，从一级到四级代表从计算机使用的能力从普及到应用层次。每一级又分为不同方面的考核科目，所发证书也会注明所考科目，考生可以自行选择所需要的科目。NCRE-1
一级包括MS Office、WPS Office、Photoshop和网络安全素质教育（2018年新增）共四个科目，考试时间均为90分钟，考察考生计算机的基本知识和基本应用能力。
target_text: Each level is divided into different subjects, and the certificates issued also indicate the subjects to be examined and the candidates can choose the subjects they need. The NCRE-1 level includes MS Office, WWPS Office, Photoshop and Cyber Security Quality Education (new in 2018) for a total of four subjects of 90 minutes each.
title: 全国计算机等级考试

source_text:
NCRE-2
二级分三大部分，分别是语言程序设计、数据库程序设计和办公软件应用，共有九个科目，考试时间均为120分钟。考察考生对计算机语言与基础程序设计能力，可选择语言程序设计和数据库程序设计；或考察计算机应用知识及办公软件的高级应用能力。
target_text: The second stage of NCRE-2 is divided into three major sections, namely, language program design, database program design and office software applications, with nine subjects of 120 minutes ' duration.
title: 全国计算机等级考试

source_text:
计算机等级考试大纲NCRE-4
四级的考试包括：网络工程师、数据库工程师、软件测试工程师、信息安全工程师与嵌入式系统开发工程师五个科目。是全国计算机考试最高等级。
获取证书时候必须先取得NCRE-3证书。发展
自1994年开考以来，NCRE每年参考人数逐年递增，至2021年底，累计考试人数超9700万、获证人数近3500万。NCRE也会随着计算机技术的发展调整考试大纲和科目。
target_text: The NCRE-4 Level IV examination programme includes five subjects: network engineers, database engineers, software test engineers, information security engineers, and embedded systems development engineers. The highest level of the national computer examination is that the certificate must be obtained before the NCRE-3 certificate is obtained.
title: 全国计算机等级考试

source_text:
影响
因为此考试和学位挂钩，很多中国大学生在毕业之前就通过了这个考试。很多人也把获得全国计算机等级考试证书作为在职培训的一部分。伪造全国计算机等级考试证书的情况也时有发生。通常而言，学校对计算机相关专业的考生不做硬性要求，但是会对其他专业考试或考证有要求。
target_text: Since this examination is linked to a degree, many Chinese students pass it before graduation. Many also use the National Computer Level Examination Certificate as part of in-service training.
title: 全国计算机等级考试

source_text:
批评
计算机等级考试从二级开始就要求应试人员掌握编程技术，但是这和全国计算机技术与软件专业技术资格（水平）考试、国家信息化工程师认证考试等考试的内容重叠。而实际上，参与考试的主要是非计算机专业人员。另外，计算机等级考试的考题更新缓慢。在2002年下半年，DOS才被取消，QBASIC和FOXBASE在2005年仍列入考试内容。
target_text: Criticisms of computer-grade examinations, which require candidates to have programming skills from the second level, overlap with national examinations for computer technology and software technical qualifications (levels), and national tests for the certification of information engineers. In practice, the majority of non-computer professionals participate in the examinations. In addition, the examination questions for computer-level examinations are being kept up to date. DOS was cancelled only in the second half of 2002, and QBASIC and FOXBASE were included in the examinations in 2005.
title: 全国计算机等级考试

source_text:
新冠肺炎疫情期间
由于受到新冠肺炎疫情波及影响，原定于2020年6月份在重庆市举行的计算机等级考试被迫取消，改为与9月份的计算机等级考试合并考试。目前9月份的计算机等级考试已如期进行中。根据各地区的计划而不同，开考日期从9月27日至9月29日之间波动。
target_text: During the new coronary pneumonia epidemic, due to the impact of the new coronary pneumonia epidemic, the computer grade test, scheduled for June 2020 in Chongqing City, was cancelled and changed to a combination with the September computer grade examination. The September computer grade examination is now on schedule.
title: 全国计算机等级考试

source_text: 机器人世界杯（RoboCup）是一个国际合作项目，為促进人工智能、机器人和相关领域。它为人工智能机器人研究提供了广泛的技术标准问题，能够被综合和检验。该机器人项目的最终目标是:到2050年，开发完全自主仿人机器人队，能赢得对人类足球世界冠军队。为了真正作为一个团队进行机器人足球比赛，必须包含各种技术，包括：智能体自主设计、多智能体协作、策略获取、实时推理、机器人和传感器融合。機器人世界盃中还提供了软件平台进行软件方面在機器人世界盃中的研究。
target_text: RobotCup is an international cooperative project to promote artificial intelligence, robotics, and related fields. It provides a wide range of technical standards for artificial intelligence research, which can be integrated and tested. The ultimate goal of the robotics project is to develop a fully autonomous human robotic team that will win the world championship of human football by 2050.
title: 机器人世界杯

source_text: 特点桥接器在功能上与集线器等其他用于连接网段的设备类似，不过后者工作在物理层（OSI模型第1层）。网桥能够识别数据链路层中的数据帧，并将这些数据帧临时存储于内存，再重新生成信号作为一个全新的数据帧转发给相连的另一个网段（network segment）。由于能够对数据帧拆包、暂存、重新打包（称为存储转发机制 store-and-forward），网桥能够连接不同技术参数传输速率的数据链路，如连接10BASE-T与100BASE-TX。数据帧中有一个位叫做FCS，用来通过CRC方式校验数据帧中的位。网桥可以检查FCS，将那些损坏的数据帧丢弃。网桥在向其他网段转发数据帧时会做冲突检测控制。网桥还能通过地址自学机制和过滤功能控制网络的流量，具有OSI第2层网络交换机功能。这称为transparent bridge，由DEC在1980年代发明。其机制是网桥内部有一个数据库，最初没有数据。当网桥从一个网段收到一个数据帧，就会在数据库中登记（或者更新）数据帧的源地址属于这个网段，并检查数据包的目的地址。如果目的地址在数据库中属于另外一个网段，则网桥向该网段转发该数据帧；如果目的地址在数据库中没有记录，则网桥向除了源地址所在之外的其他所有网段转发（flood）该数据帧。桥接器仅仅在不同网络之间有数据传输的时候才将数据转发到其他网络，不是像集线器那样对所有数据都进行广播。对于以太网，“桥接”这一术语正式的含义是指符合IEEE 802.1D标准的设备，即“网络切换”。
target_text: The feature bridge connector is functionally similar to other equipment used to connect segments of the network, although the latter works on the physical level (OSI model level 1). The network bridge is able to identify data frames in the data chain layer and temporarily store them in memory, reproducing the signal as a completely new data frame to another connected section of the network (network security). Since it is possible to disassemble the data frame, temporarily store, repackage (known as Store-and-forward), other equipment used to connect to the network, the network can connect the data speed of different technical parameters (e.g., 10 BASE-T with 100 BASE-TX). One of the data frames is called FCS, which is used to verify the data frame through the CRC.

历史
1964年，美国航空航天局结构动力学研究计划的年度审查发现，研究中心正分别开发针对自身需求的结构分析软件。审查建议应当使用单一的通用软件取而代之。由此成立了一个专责委员会。委员会认定没有一份现成的软件能够满足他们的要求。他们建议成立一个合作项目来开发这个软件并创建了概述该软件功能规范。
target_text: In 1964, the annual review of the NASA Structural Dynamics Research Program found that the research centre was developing structural analysis software tailored to its needs. The review recommended that it should be replaced by a single generic software. A dedicated committee was formed. The committee concluded that none of the available software could meet their requirements. They suggested a cooperative project to develop the software and created a functional code outlining the software.
title: NASTRAN

source_text: 编写NASTRAN软件应用程序是为了帮助设计更有效的空间飞行器，如航天飞机。1971年，美国航空航天局技术利用办公室向公众发布NASTRAN。NASTRAN的商业应用帮助了对任何尺寸、形状或目的弹性结构行为的分析。例如，汽车行业用其设计前悬架系统和转向拉杆。该软件也可用于轨道和机车、桥梁、发电厂、摩天大楼和飞机的设计。据估计，1971年至1984年NASTRAN节省了7.01亿美元的成本。NASTRAN于1988年入选美国航天基金会的空间技术名人堂，这是获此殊荣的第一项技术之一。
target_text: The NASTRAN software application was developed to help design more effective space vehicles, such as the Space Shuttle. In 1971, NASA Technical Use Office released NASTRAN to the public. The commercial application of NASTRAN helped to analyse any sized, shape or purpose-oriented elastic structural behaviour. For example, the automobile industry used its pre-design hangar system and diversion. The software could also be used for orbiting and engine, bridge, power plant, skyscraper building, and aircraft design. It was estimated that between 1971 and 1984 NASTRAN saved $701 million. NASTRAN was selected as one of the first technologies to be awarded to the Space Technology Hall of the Space Foundation of the United States in 1988.
title: NASTRAN
