source_text: 国际会计准则第38号（IAS 38）无形资产是国际会计准则之一，簡稱：IAS 38，生效始自1999年7月1日，目的是統一按標準化編寫财务报表。IAS 38规范无形资产的会计处理。不包括金融资产、矿产权、保险合同、租赁、雇员福利、及其他條號會計准則規範的無形資產。IAS 38提及的无形资产，可以是计算机软件、產品推廣時付出的广告、研究及开发成本等。它是由企业控制的、预期將来會產生經济利益流入企业的资源。例如名店的商譽。无形资产應當在其使用年限内系统地摊銷。
target_text: IAS 38 (IAS 38) Intangible Assets is one of the International Accounting Standards (IAS), briefly known as IAS 38, which came into force on 1 July 1999 and is designed to produce financial statements on a standard basis. IAS 38 regulates accounting for intangibles, excluding intangibles, financial assets, mineral rights, insurance contracts, leases, employee benefits, and other accounting standards. IAS 38 refers to intangible assets, which can be computer software, advertising, research and development costs incurred in product promotion, etc., which are controlled by an enterprise and which are expected to generate financial benefits that flow into the enterprise’s resources. For example, business reputation. Intangible assets should be systematically amortized over their useful years.
title: 国际会计准则第38号

source_text:
BREW的優點
下列是 BREW 與 J2ME的比較。brew 有絕對的實力來對抗 j2me，從遊戲軟體的開發角度來看，BREW有許多的優點。
The BREW API 在支持電話上遠超過 J2ME API。
API較J2ME簡潔有力。
圖形開发更容易，BREW 2.0 可以直接存取螢幕緩衝區。
J2ME phones 經常有二進位碼大小的限制 (128KB is common)。BREW目前無此限制。
BREW是更底層的技術，加上和CDMA 的完美結合，使BREW擁有了更快的反應速度。
BREW 應用程式可以是物件導向程式設計（Object-oriented programming）。在 J2ME 裡過多的類別會造成檔案大小的負擔，一般被鼓勵以C語言的撰寫方式。此外，由於非原始狀態的型別（non-primitive types）使得J2ME 的陣列看起來更像類別（classes）。基於這個理由，J2ME仍常使用原始型態（primitive types）的平行陣列。
BREW的开发优势
对于运营商而言，BREW技术与网络完全无关。这意味着它可以完全平等地应用于所有领先的无线技术之中。
对于设备制造商而言，BREW应用运行环境可以同移动设备闪存和RAM中的处理芯片紧密集成，从而实现广泛适用性、软件开发变得更加顺畅，效率得到提升。
对于应用开发商而言，BREW执行平台基于普及型编程语言C/C＋＋，这种语言拥有庞大的用户群，他们只需掌握很少的移动电话知识即可实现BREW支持。
3G平台EVDO的推广也为BREW带来了新的机会.
BREW平台提供了一系列规范的服务接口，简化和规范了基于BREW的应用开发。
BREW平台版本也在不断的演进1.x->2.x->3.x->4.x->BMP
BREW平台作为一个承上启下的关键中间层，对上层BREW应用屏蔽了底层提供服务的平台差异。

source_text: 在計算機科學中，垃圾回收（，縮寫為GC）是指一種自動的記憶體管理機制。当某个程序占用的一部分内存空间不再被这个程序访问时，这个程序会借助垃圾回收算法向操作系统归还这部分内存空间。垃圾回收器可以减轻程式員的負擔，也減少程序中的错误。垃圾回收最早起源于LISP语言。目前許多語言如Smalltalk、Java、C#、Go和D语言都支援垃圾回收器。
target_text: In calculator science, recycling (screwed to GC) is an automatic memory management system. When a program does not access a portion of the memory that it occupies, the program returns it to the operating system with a waste recovery algorithm. The garbage recycler reduces the burden on the programmer and also reduces the error in the process. Waste recycling originated first in the LISP language. Many languages, such as Smalltalk, Java, C#, Go and D, currently support waste recyclers.
title: 垃圾回收 (計算機科學)

source_text: 跟踪收集器近现代的垃圾回收实现方法，这种算法会定期遍历它管理的内存空间，从若干根储存对象开始查找与之相关的存储对象，然后标记其余的没有关联的存储对象，最后回收这些没有关联的存储对象占用的内存空间。回收算法基于其标记和回收行为，又分为若干细致方法。
target_text: Tracking the collector's approach to modern waste recovery is a method that regularly travels through the memory space it manages, starting with a number of storage objects, and then tags the remaining unconnected objects and eventually recovers the memory space occupied by those unconnected. The recovery algorithm is based on its tagging and recovery behaviour and is divided into a number of detailed methods.
title: 垃圾回收 (計算機科學)

source_text:
在机器学习中，-{zh-cn:支持向量机; zh-tw:支援向量機; zh-hk:支援向量機;}-
（-{zh-cn:台湾称支援向量機; zh-tw:中國大陸稱支持向量机}-，，常简称為SVM，又名支援向量网络）是在分类与迴歸分析中分析数据的監督式學習模型与相关的学习算法。给定一组训练实例，每个训练实例被标记为属于两个类别中的一个或另一个，SVM训练算法建立一个将新的实例分配给两个类别之一的模型，使其成为非概率线性分类器。SVM模型是将实例表示为空间中的点，这样映射就使得单独类别的实例被尽可能宽的明显的间隔分开。然后，将新的实例映射到同一空间，并基于它们落在间隔的哪一侧来预测所属类别。
target_text: In machine learning, - {zh-cn: Support vector machine; zh-tw: Support vector machine; žh-hk: Support vector machine;} (- {zh-cn: Taiwan call support vector machine; žh-tw: China Mainland call support vector machine, commonly referred to as SVM, commonly known as SVM and known as the Support vector network) is a monitoring study model for analysing data in classification and regress analysis. A set of training examples is given, each marked as one or the other in two categories, and the SVM training algorithm establishes a model that allocates new examples to one of the two categories, making it a non-probability line classification. The SVM model is to identify the example as a point in space, so mapping the examples of the individual categories is separated as widely as possible.
title: 支持向量机

source_text: 弗拉基米尔·瓦普尼克在1963年提出的原始最大间隔超平面算法构造了一个线性分类器。而1992年，伯恩哈德·E·博瑟（Bernhard E. Boser）、伊莎贝尔·M·盖昂（Isabelle M. Guyon）和瓦普尼克提出了一种通过将（最初由Aizerman et al.提出）应用于最大边界超平面来创建非线性分类器的方法。 所得到的算法形式上类似，除了把点积换成了非线性核函数。这就允许算法在变换后的特征空间中拟合最大间隔超平面。该变换可以是非线性的，而变换空间是高维的；虽然分类器是变换后的特征空间中的超平面，但它在原始输入空间中可以是非线性的。
target_text: Vladimir Wapnik, in 1963, proposed a linear categorisation of the original maximum-level hyper-altitude algorithm. In 1992, Bernhard E. Boser, Isabel M. Guyon and Vapnik proposed a method of creating non-linear classifiers by applying them (initially proposed by Aizerman et al.) to the largest border hyper level.

title: 微软亚洲研究院

source_text: 高校与合作微软亚洲研究院内设学术合作部通过多种形式的项目和活动，帮助提升亚太地区高校和科研机构的信息科学技术学科基础研究水平和人才培养质量。为亚太地区信息产业整体实力尤其是人在微软亚洲研究院与中国高等学校合作的历程中，“长城计划”的签署、实施是重要的历程碑事件。2002年6月，中华人民共和国教育部与微软公司签署了《教育部与微软公司合作备忘录》，共同启动了旨在帮助提升中国高校计算机基础研究水平和人才 培养质量的“长城计划”。作为“长城计划”的具体实施单位，微软亚洲研究院与国内多所高校开展了系统的、有针对性的合作项目。此后，双方分别于2005年 10月、2008年11月、2011年10月和2015年4月，四次续签了合作备忘录，共同开展了“长城计划”第二期、第三期、第四期和第五期的合作。在教育部的大力支持和各高校 的积极参与配合下，“长城计划”得以顺利实施并取得良好的效果。微软亚洲研究院围绕人才培养、科研合作、课程建设及学术交流四条主线，深化与国内高校、科 研机构的合作，积极为提升中国计算机基础研究水平和人才培养贡献力量。
target_text: In June 2002, the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China signed the Memorandum of Cooperation between the Ministry of Education and Microsoft Corporation, which jointly launched the Great Wall Programme to help raise the level of basic computer research and human resources in high schools in China, and to develop the quality of information science and technology subjects. As a practical implementation unit of the Long City Programme, the University has carried out systematic and targeted cooperation projects with a number of higher educational institutions in the country. Since then, the Great Wall Project has been successfully implemented. In October 2005, November 2008, October 2011 and April 2015, the Ministry of Education and Microsoft Corporation have signed a Memorandum of Cooperation, which has jointly launched the Long City Plan II, III, IV and V, which aims to help upgrade the quality of computer research in high schools in China.
title: 微软亚洲研究院

source_text: 学术交流：秉承“身在微软，服务中国”的宗旨，微软亚洲研究院以“架起中外学术交流的桥梁”为己任，组织各种大型活动推动中国学术界与国际学术界的交流合作， 邀请到包括图灵奖获得者、微软内部的知名科学家等在内的中外计算机界知名学者与中国高校的师生进行对话，旨在为中国地区的IT院系搭建与亚太同行交流合作的平台，给广大师生带来最前沿的计算机技术和理念，提高中国的科研水平和人才素质，以实现区域的共同发展。
target_text: Academic exchange: In keeping with its purpose to “be in Microsoft to serve China”, the Microsoft Asia Research Institute, with its mandate “to build bridges for academic exchanges between China and beyond”, organizes major events to promote exchanges and cooperation between Chinese academia and international academia, and invites prominent scholars from the Chinese and foreign computer communities, including the Turing Prize laureates, prominent scientists in Microsoft, etc., to engage in a dialogue with teachers and students at Chinese higher education institutions with the aim of creating a platform for exchange and cooperation with their counterparts in Asia and the Pacific in order to bring the most cutting edge of computer technology and ideas to a wide range of teachers and students, and to improve China's scientific research and human skills in order to achieve common development in the region.
title: 微软亚洲研究院

source_text: 课程建设：课程建设是高校教师最为关注的教育环节，微软亚洲研究院注重因材施教，以人才培养为导向，设计了一系列项目与教师进行合作。为促进高校课程建设和优质教学资源共享，研究院联合三十余所高校推出了云计算教学项目；微软研究员义务在高校和《学科前沿讲习班》授课，为师生带来最前沿的研究课题和国际化的研究视野；研究院启动了软件人才培养计划，开设了新技术课程，并举办师资培训班，助力中国的软件人才培养。
target_text: Curriculum-building: Curriculum development is the most important educational component for higher education teachers, and the Microsoft Asia Institute has focused on the development of talent through the development of skills and has designed a series of projects in collaboration with teachers. To promote curriculum development and the sharing of quality teaching resources at higher education institutions, the Institute has launched a project on cloud computing teaching in more than 30 higher education institutions; Microsoft researchers are obliged to teach at higher education institutions and at the front-line workshops in disciplines, bringing the most cutting-edge research topics and internationalizing research horizons to teachers and students; the Institute has launched a software talent development programme, introduced new technology courses and conducted teacher training courses to support software talent development in China.
title: 微软亚洲研究院

source_text: 由于很多成人网站都在使用.com/.net/.info之类的域名，所以家长很难区分哪些网站是有益或有害的。.xxx的申请目的为更容易的区分成年网站并且可以加强家长控制功能。2000年和2004年ICM Registry两次递交.xxx顶级域名申请，但遭到政客和保守团体的强烈反对。家庭研究理事会曾发起宣传运动，声称.xxx域名将让色情行业渗透进互联网；而色情行业也反对，认为这会导致审查和迫害。ICANN在2008年拒绝了申请，认为设立.xxx域名所要承担的互联网执法和管理职能超出了它的职权范围。 2010年ICM Registry再次递交申请，并于6月正式获得ICANN批准，原定於2011年初开始使用，但在10年12月卻決定押後推出。2011年3月18日终于正式批准。
target_text: Since many adult websites are using domain names such as.com/.net/.info, it is difficult for parents to distinguish which sites are useful or harmful. xxx applications are intended to make it easier to distinguish between adult websites and to enhance parental control functions. In 2000 and 2004, ICM Registry submitted two applications for Xxx top-level domain names, which were strongly opposed by politicians and conservative groups. The Family Research Council launched an information campaign claiming that .xx domain names would allow the sex industry to infiltrate the Internet; while the sex industry objected that this would lead to censorship and persecution.
title: .xxx

source_text:
行列式的计算
计算行列式的值是一个常见的问题。最简单的方法是按照定义计算或按照拉普拉斯公式进行递归运算。这样的算法需要计算次的加法，复杂度是指数函数。在实际的计算中只能用于计算阶数很小的行列式。注意到拉普拉斯公式的性质，如果一行或一列里面有很多个0，那么就可以把行列式按这一行或一列展开，这时数值为零的系数所对应的代数余子式就不必计算了，因为最后要乘以0，这样就可以简化计算。然而更加简便的算法是利用高斯消去法或LU分解法，把矩阵通过初等变换变成三角矩阵或三角矩阵的乘积来计算行列式的值。这些算法的复杂度都是级别，远远小于直接计算的复杂度。
target_text: The simplest way to calculate the column value is to calculate it by definition or in accordance with the La Plass formula. Such algorithms need to calculate the number of additions, and complexity is an index function. The actual calculation can only be used to calculate the number of steps in a very small array. Note the nature of the La Plass formula, and if there are many zeros in a row or column, then it can be carried out in this row or column, so that the number zero corresponds to the an algebraic side of the coefficient, which is easier to calculate by multiplying it by zero. However, the simpler method is to calculate the value of the array by using the Gaussian dissipation method or LU partition method, using primary switching to a triangle or a mixture of the matrix. These algorithms are complex, far less straightforward than directly calculated.
title: 行列式

source_text: 如果一个算法可以在时间内算出矩阵乘法，那么可以构造出一种时间内的行列式求值算法。这说明求矩阵的行列式的值和矩阵的乘法有相同的复杂度。于是，通过分治算法或者其它的方法，可以达到比更好的结果。比如，存在复杂度的行列式求值算法。
target_text: If an algorithm is able to calculate the array multiplier over time, then it is possible to construct a time-bound column value algorithm. This indicates the same complexity as the array value for the array. So, by partitioning algorithms or other methods, better results can be achieved. For example, there is a hierarchy for complexity.
title: 行列式

source_text: 其它设计脑机接口算法和系统来解码神经元信号的实验室包括布朗大学的John Donoghue、匹兹堡大学的Andrew Schwartz、加州理工的Richard Anderson。这些研究者的脑机接在某一时刻使用的神经元数为15-30，比Nicolelis的50-200个显著要少。Donoghue小组的主要工作是实现恒河猴对计算机屏幕上的光标的运动控制来追踪视觉目标。其中猴子不需要运动肢体。 Schwartz小组的主要工作是虚拟现实的三维空间中的视觉目标追踪，以及脑际接口对机械臂的控制。. 这个小组宣称，他们的猴子可以通过脑机接口控制的机械臂来喂自己吃西葫芦。 Anderson的小组正在研究从后顶叶的神经元提取前运动信号的脑机接口。此类信号包括实验动物在期待奖励时所产生信号。
target_text: Other laboratories that design brain interface algorithms and systems to decode neuron signals include John Donoghue of Brown University, Andrew Schwartz of Pittsburgh University, and Richard Anderson of Caltech. These researchers use 15-30 neurons at some point, which is significantly less than the 50-200 of Nicolellis. The Donoghue team is mainly working to track visual targets by controlling the movement of river monkeys to the cursor on computer screens.
title: 脑机接口

source_text:
细胞培养物的脑机接口
细胞培养物的脑机接口是动物（或人）体外的培养皿中的神经组织和人造设备之间的通讯机制。
这方面研究的焦点是建造具有问题解决能力的神经元网络，进而促成生物式计算机。
研究者有时在半导体晶片上培养神经组织，并且从这些神经细胞记录信号或对其进行刺激。这类研究常称为“神经电子学”（Neuroelectronics）或“神经芯片”（Neurochips）。1997年，加州理工Jerome Pine和Michael Maher的团队最先宣称研制成功神经芯片。
该芯片集成了16个神经元。
target_text: Research focused on building a network of neurons capable of solving problems, thus contributing to biocomputers. Researchers sometimes develop neurosynthesis on semiconductor crystals, and record or stimulate signals from these neurons.
title: 脑机接口

source_text: 2003年，美国南加州大学的Theodore Berger小组开始研制能够模拟海马体功能的神经芯片。该小组的目标是将这种神经芯片植入大鼠脑内，使其称为第一种高级脑功能假体。他们之所以选择海马体作为研究对象，是因为其高度有序的组织以及丰富的研究文献。海马体的功能与记忆生成和长期记忆有关。
target_text: In 2003, the Theodore Berger team of the University of Southern California began to develop neural chips capable of simulating the function of the seahorse. The group's goal was to implant the neural chip into the brain of the rat, calling it the first advanced brain function. They chose the seahorse because of its highly structured organization and rich research literature. The function of the seahorse is related to memory generation and long-term memory.
title: 脑机接口

source_text:
中文上网官方版软件是中国互联网络信息中心（CNNIC）开发的互联网辅助软件。軟件開發單位宣稱，該軟件作用為體現中文網站域名的重定向，但該軟件因被指為屬流氓軟件而惹來爭議。通用网址
通用网址是CNNIC将非域名中文重定向到网站域名的应用层技术，中文上网官方版軟件，據官方說法，是该技术的唯一实现。
target_text: The Chinese Internet official version of the software is an Internet-enabled software developed by the China Internet Information Centre (CNNIC). The software development unit claims that the software serves as a reorientation of the domain name of the current Chinese site, but the software is controversial because it is referred to as a hooligan software.
title: 中文上网官方版软件

source_text:
负面评价
有报道和网民投訴指出，軟件具有在用戶不经意時偷偷安裝在系統內的功能，屬於流氓軟件。
由于该软件的強行安裝、惡意綑綁、阻止卸载等表現，一度被北京市网络行业协会列入10款流氓軟件名单并勒令整改。
而CNNIC則起訴防毒軟件360安全衛士的北京三际无限网络科技有限公司，指斥該公司扣帽子，「捏造合法软件使用病毒技术的消息」，並認為防毒軟件公司不能把它列作流氓軟件。
北京三际无限网络科技有限公司的發言人指責，CNNIC打着官方的旗号，混淆軟件與中文域名之區別，令公眾誤以為國家發展中文域名，就等於支-{}-持該軟件。
target_text: As a result of the software’s aggressive installation, maligning, and blocking of unloading, the Beijing City Network Industry Association was once placed on a list of 10 hooligan software and ordered to be corrected. CNNIC, which sued the 360 security guard of the anti-drug software, accused the company of taking a hat, “build information about the use of viral technology by legitimate software,” and argued that the anti-drug software company could not list it as a hooligan software.
title: 中文上网官方版软件

source_text: 编写这些软件工具的若干工作小组于2000年4月28到29日参加了在加州理工学院（California Institute of Technology）举行的ERATO分子生物学软件平台会议。他们取得了一个共识，即为了更好地交换信息，所有的组件必须以相同的格式来进行对模型的描述。会议决定采用XML作为描述模型的编码语言，因为这时XML语言因可能被采用为因特网数据标准而得到了人们的注意。
target_text: A number of working groups that prepared these software tools participated in the ERATO Molecular Biology Platform at the California Institute of Technology on 28 and 29 April 2000. There was a consensus that, in order to better exchange information, all components had to be described in the same format. It was decided to use XML as the coding language for the descriptive model, as the XML language had received attention at that time because it might be used as an Internet data standard.
title: 系统生物学标记语言

source_text:
紧接着，Kitano小组为作为体系组成部分的软件Systems Biology Workbench (SBW) 和作为模型描述格式的SBML语言制定了最初的规范和方案。本语言目的SBML有如下三个主要的目的：使得软件工具之间可以通用而不必重写模型；
使得模型用一种统一的格式发布和共享，这样其他研究者们可以在不同的软件环境中打开模型；
确保模型被某个软件创建之后在该软件的整个生命周期中都可用。
target_text: Immediately thereafter, the Kitano group developed the initial specifications and programmes for the software Systems Biology WorldBench (SBW) as part of the system and for the SBML language as a model description format. The purpose of this language SBML has three main objectives: to make software tools common without having to rewrite models; to make models available and shared in a uniform format so that other researchers can open models in different software environments; to ensure that models are available throughout the life cycle of a software once it is created.
title: 系统生物学标记语言

source_text: SBML可以编码由生化分子及其相互反应而成的生化反应网络组成的模型。一个重要的原则是，该模型可被分解成明确标记的组成元素，而且元素的集合可比拟成对反应方程式的一种精细的再现；而这种再现并非直接将模型映射为一组（微分）反应方程式的集合或其它对模型的精细解释。这种分解在元素组成上是明确的而在大体模型框架上是模糊的，这种特性使得软件工具易于进行对模型的解释，并把SBML格式转换成任意的、在软件内部实际使用的格式。
target_text: SBML can encode a model made up of biochemical molecules and their response networks. An important principle is that the model can be decomposed into clearly marked constituent elements, and that the aggregation of elements is comparable to a fine re-emerging of the formulated reaction equations, which does not directly map the model into a set of (micro) response equations or other fine interpretations of the model. This breakdown is clear in the composition of the elements and vague in the general model framework, which makes it easier for software tools to interpret the model and convert the SBML format into an arbitrary format that is actually used within the software.
title: 系统生物学标记语言

source_text: 支持SBML的软件包应该能读出使用SBML的模型描述文件，并将它转换成软件的内部格式以进行对模型的分析。例如，某个软件包可能提供通过构造反应网络中的（微分）方程式来进行模型仿真的功能，进而可对方程式进行数值的时程积分（numerical time integration），以进行对模型动力学特性的研究。又如另一种情况，某个软件包可能会构造一种离散的随机模型，并使用动态的[蒙特卡洛法]进行对模型的仿真（如[Gillespie算法]）。
target_text: The software package supporting SBML should be able to read the model description file using SBML and convert it into an internal format of the software for model analysis. For example, a package may provide modelling simulations (micrometric) equations in the tectonic response network, which in turn allow the other program to perform a numerical time component (numerical time integration) to study model dynamics. In another case, a package may construct a discrete random model and imitate the model using a dynamic [Monter Carlo method] (e.g. [Gillespie algorithm]).
title: 系统生物学标记语言

source_text:
歷史
在历史上，批处理广泛使用于大型计算机。由于这种级别的计算机非常昂贵且操作十分複雜，運行程序需要專門的操作員處理。在大量用戶時，用戶需要把程序交給操作員，來日再去取結果。另外一个原因是，在早期的电子计算机上，终端设备界面（以后发展到图形用户界面）的交互程序尚未推广。
target_text: Historically, batch processing has been widely used in large computers. Because computers at this level are very expensive and complex to operate, operating procedures need to be handled by a dedicated operator. When there are a large number of users, users need to turn the program over to the operator to pick up the results in the next day. Another reason is that, on an early computer, interactive programs for terminal device interfaces (and later developed into graphical user interfaces) have not been promoted.
title: 批处理任务

source_text:
基尼系数算法争议
2002年在接受光明日报采访时，厉以宁教授给出了一个适用于中国的基尼系数的算法。他说：“中国目前处于体制转轨过程中，并且是个二元经济的国家，城市和农村的经济结构不同，生活方式的差别很大，不能笼统地用基尼系数来说明问题。我认为，按中国现阶段城乡二元经济的情况来分析，可以先算出两个基尼系数：一个是城市的基尼系数，另一个是农村的基尼系数。然后再用加权平均方法算出一个基尼基数。”通过他的算法，中国的基尼系数从0.40以上被大幅降低到“0.32－0.35之间”。
target_text: The Gini coefficient algorithm was disputed in 2002 when Professor Ning gave an estimate of the Gini coefficient applicable to China in an interview with the Light Daily newspaper. He said: “China is currently in the process of institutional re-orbiting and is a dual economy, with different economic structures in urban and rural areas, and very different lifestyles, and the Gini coefficient cannot be described in general terms. I think that two Gini coefficients, one urban and one rural and the other rural, can be calculated first, based on China’s current stage of dual economy, and then a Gini base is calculated using a weighted average method.” Through his calculations, China’s Gini coefficient was significantly reduced from more than 0.40 to “0.32-0.35”.
title: 厉以宁

source_text: 应用材料公司（；、）簡稱應材，是全球最大的半导体制造设备和服务供应商。主要产品为芯片制造相关类产品，例如原子层沉积、物理气相沉积、化学气相沉积、电镀、侵蚀、离子注入、快速热处理、化学机械抛光、测量学和硅片检测等，並包含配套的軟件、質檢服務提供給营运客戶，例如晶圓廠與屏幕工廠的各式半導體製造商。
target_text: Applied Materials Corporation (;) short-forms are the largest semiconductor manufacturing equipment and service provider in the world. The main product is the manufacture of related class products for chips, such as atomic layer deposition, physical gas phase deposition, chemical gas phase deposition, electroplating, erosion, ion injection, rapid thermal processing, chemical machine polishing, metrology and silicone testing, and includes supporting software, quality services to operating customers, such as semiconductor manufacturers in crystal mills and screen mills.
title: 应用材料

source_text: 应用材料公司同時是研發型機構，历年来每年的研究经费达到约10亿美元。据 Bloomberg数据，2018年全球五大半导体设备制造商分别为應用材料（AMAT）、艾司摩爾（ASML）、東京威力科創（TEL）、泛林集团（Lam Research）、科磊（KLA），这五大半导体制造商在2018年以其领先的技术、强大的资金支持占据着全球半导体设备制造业超过70%的份额。2019年7月1日應用材料以約2500億日圓（23.1億美元）收購日本半導體設備公司Kokusai Electric。
target_text: Applied Materials is also a hairdresser, with research spending of about $1 billion a year over the years. 英国码的算法 英国码采用的是设定4英寸为0号，楦底脚长的号差是1/3英寸。即每增加一个号码，楦底长度增加1/3英寸，直至
13号为童段，往上增加一个号码为1号，然后再从1号开始至13号设置为男段。所以英国码的计算方式如下
码数=3*（楦底长度-4英寸） 童段算法
码数=3*（楦底长度-4英寸）-13 成人段算法。
target_text: The English code is based on a four-inch zero, with a one-third-inch difference in the base foot. For each additional number, the base length is increased by one third, until the 13th number is a child segment, adding a number to the 13th number, and then setting the English code from 1st to 13th as a male segment. So the English code is calculated as follows: code = 3* (bottom length-4 inches) child segment algorithm = 3* (bottom length-4 inches)-13 adult segment algorithms.

高斯模糊（英语：Gaussian Blur），也叫高斯平滑，是在、以及等图像处理软件中广泛使用的处理效果，通常用它来减少图像雜訊以及降低细节层次。这种模糊技术生成的图像，其视觉效果就像是经过一个半透明屏幕在观察图像，这与镜头焦外成像效果散景以及普通照明阴影中的效果都明显不同。高斯平滑也用于计算机视觉算法中的预先处理阶段，以增强图像在不同比例大小下的图像效果（参见尺度空间表示以及尺度空间实现）。
从数学的角度来看，图像的高斯模糊过程就是图像与正态分布做卷积。由于正态分布又叫作“高斯分布”，所以这项技术就叫作高斯模糊。图像与圆形方框模糊做卷积将会生成更加精确的焦外成像效果。由于高斯函数的傅立叶变换是另外一个高斯函数，所以高斯模糊对于图像来说就是一個低通滤波器。
target_text: Gaussian Blur is also used in the pre-processing phase of computer visual algorithms to enhance image effects in different scales (see scale space expression and metaspace realization). From a mathematical point of view, image obscurity is a curved process between image and normal distribution. This technology is called Gaussian blurry because the regular distribution is also called “high-mass distribution” . Images and bloated blobs will produce a more precise amplitude effect.
title: 高斯模糊

source_text: 在软件工程中，主动记录模式（active record pattern）是一种架构模式，可见于在关系数据库中存储内存中对象的软件中。它在Martin Fowler的2003年著《企业应用架构的模式》书中命名。符合这个模式的对象的接口将包括函数比如插入、更新和删除，加上直接对应于在底层数据库表格中列的或多或少的属性。
target_text: In software engineering, the active record-keeping mode is a structure model that can be found in software that stores objects in memory in a relationship database. It is named in Martin Fowler's 2003 Model of Enterprise Application Structures. The interfaces for objects that fit this model will include functions such as insertion, updating and deletion, plus attributes that correspond directly to more or less of the properties listed in the bottom database table.
title: 主动记录

source_text: 主动记录模式是访问在数据库中的数据的一种方式。数据库表或视图被包装入类。因此，对象实例被连结到这个表格的一个单一行。在一个对象建立之后，在保存时将一个新行增加到表格中。加载的任何对象都从数据库得到它的信息。在一个对象被更新的时候，在表格中对应的行也被更新。包装类为在表格或视图中的每个列都实现访问器方法或属性。
target_text: The active recording mode is a way to access the data in the database. The database table or view is packaged. Therefore, the object example is linked to a single row in the table. After an object is created, a new row is added to the table when saved. Any object loaded receives information from the database. The corresponding row in the table is updated when an object is updated. The packing group is the accessor method or attribute for each column in the table or view.
title: 主动记录

导体、半导体和绝缘体
价带与导带重叠区域的大小与原子间距离rd，并且同轨道能级有关。如果rd较大，或轨道能级较大，则重叠区域小，甚至没有重叠、形成能隙Eg。金属的导电性取决于其价带和导带之间自由流动的电子。这样，大重叠区域的金属就具有很好的导电性，进而具有较好的金属性。如果价带和导带之间的能隙较小，则电子只有在受外部能量（以热量等形式）激发的情况下才有可能从价带流动到导带。这些具有较小Eg的材料被称作是半导体。如果Eg足够大，则在通常状态下，电子从价带到导带的流动就小得可以忽略，这些材料被称作是绝缘体。
target_text: The conductor, semiconductor, and insulation belts are associated with the size of the overlap zone and the distance between the atoms rd and the orbital energy level. If the rd is large, or the orbital energy level is large, the overlap area is small, and there is no overlap, or even a gap between the Eg. The conductivity of metals depends on the electronics that move freely between the price belt and the conductor. In this way, the metals in the large overlap area are well conductive and thus better metal. If the gap between the price belt and the belt is small, the electronics can move from the price belt to the conductor only if they are motivated by external energy (in heat, etc.). These materials with smaller EGs are called semiconductors. If Eg is large enough, the flow of electronics from price to the conductor is generally negligible, and these materials are called insulations.
title: 價帶

source_text: qmail是一个运行于类Unix操作系统下的邮件传送代理软件，它的作者是丹尼爾·伯恩斯坦（Daniel J. Bernstein）。它是一个用来代替UNIX下Sendmail软件的邮件传送程序。qmail是面向安全而设计的，作者曾经悬赏500美元来找出qmail的安全漏洞，但是直到2006年，还是没有人能领取这笔奖金。qmail的主要竞争对手是Exim以及Postfix。与它的竞争对手不同的是，Qmail已经许多年没有更新了，用户已经习惯于通过第三方的插件及补丁来使qmail增加新的功能。
target_text: qmail is a mail transfer agent software operating under a type of Unix operating system, authored by Daniel J. Bernstein. It is a mail transfer program that replaces the UNIX Sendmail software. qmail is designed for security. The author once offered $500 to find a security gap in qmail, but no one was able to receive the bonus until 2006. qmail’s main competitors are Exim and Postfix. Unlike its competitors, Qmail has not been updated for many years and users are used to adding new functions to qmail through third party plugins and patches.
title: Qmail

纽约计算科学中心（NYCCS），建立与2007年，是石溪大学与布鲁克黑文国家实验室共同创建的。它的核心是一台被称为“蓝色基因”的超级计算机，由两部分组成：蓝色基因L与蓝色基因P。在2008年的超级计算机运算能力排行榜上，蓝色基因L排名第17，蓝色基因P排名第75。蓝色基因超级计算机的总峰值计算性能为103.22万亿次浮点运算（万亿次浮点运算每秒）
。
target_text: The New York Center for Computing Sciences (NYCCS) was created in 2007 by the University of Stone Creek in conjunction with the Blackweyne National Laboratory in Brook. Its core is a supercomputer called the Blue Genome, which consists of two parts: the Blue Genome L and the Blue Genome P. In 2008, the Blue Genome L ranked 17th and the Blue Genome P 75th. The total peak computing capability of the Blue Gene Supercomputer is 103.22 trillion floats (100 million floats per second).
title: 石溪大学

source_text: 为了理解神经系统，人们需要把从分子到细胞、从系统到生物体等各种不同层次学科的研究相互联系起来，这些学科包括遗传学、蛋白质组学、系统生物学、神经科学、认知科学、语言学、心理学、人类学，等等。虽然人们对于脑研究的事实和数据的积累已经很迅速也很深入了，但是我们对这些数据的理解深度还很有限。同样地，过去几十年以来计算机科学业已取得了巨大的进展，但是人类最先进的计算机系统在处理现实世界的一些任务时还比不上所谓的简单生物，例如蚂蚁和蜜蜂。无论从实践的角度还是从概念的角度看，神经科学相关的生命科学（例如神经科学、神经行为学、心理学、语言学、哲学等）与信息科学及其相关学科（例如计算机科学、数学、统计学、物理学、电子工程学和神经机器人学）之间都有很多互相联系的地方。
target_text: In order to understand the nervous system, one needs to link research at various levels, from molecules to cells, from systems to organisms, such as genetics, proteomics, system biology, neuroscience, cognitive sciences, linguistics, psychology, anthropology, etc. Although the accumulation of facts and data on brain research has been rapid and deep, our understanding of these data is limited. Similarly, great progress has been made in computer science over the past decades, but some of the most advanced computer systems in humans are not comparable to so-called simple organisms, such as ants and bees, in dealing with the real world. From a practical and conceptual perspective, life sciences related to neuroscience (e.g. neuroscience, neurobetics, psychology, linguistics, philosophy, etc.) have many links to information science and its related disciplines (e.g. computer sciences, mathematics, statistics, physics, electronic engineering and neurorobots).
title: 神经信息学

命名
Bonjour在2002年8月作为Mac OS X v10.2一部分发布的时候，原来的名字是"Rendezvous"，在法语中意思是“约会”。在2003年8月27日，TIBCO软件公司声称这个名字已经是他们的注册商标 自1994年起TIBCO软件公司已经有一个商用软件集成产品名叫面市，该公司称试图和苹果公司商讨此事但无果而终。2004年7月，苹果公司和Tibco发布和解方案，此前广有传闻称新名字可能是OpenTalk，但是最后没被采用（可能是由于类似和）。在2005年4月12日，苹果公司宣布Rendezvous改名为Bonjour,，仍是一个法语词汇。
target_text: When the name Bonjour was published in August 2002 as part of Mac OS X v10.2, the original name was "Rendezvous", which in French means "date." On 27 August 2003, TIBCO Software claimed that the name was their registered trademark. Since 1994, TIBCO Software has had a commercial software integration product called the Face Market, which it claimed tried to discuss the matter with Apple, but failed to achieve results. In July 2004, Apple and Tibco issued a settlement programme, following rumours that the new name might be OpenTalk, but was not finally adopted (possibly because of similarity). On 12 April 2005, Apple announced that Rendezvous had changed its name to Bonjour, still a French term.
title: Bonjour

source_text:
系統架構
S60是由一组开发类库和一系列标准程序组成，其中包含移动电话、个人信息管理（PIM）工具以及Helix（）多媒体播放器组件。S60平台的建立目的是为移动电话厂商带来功能强大而全面的大屏幕彩屏手机，更常见的说法是智能手机。开发S60平台的软件，可以使用众多厂商的不同智能手机开发标准和开发工具，比如Java语言（MIDP）、C++、Python语言（）。S60平台的一个重要特点是，在购买S60平台的手机之后，用户仍然可以安装其他第三方软件。
target_text: System architecture S60 consists of a set of development libraries and a series of standard programs, including mobile phones, personal information management (PIM) tools and Helix() multimedia player components. The S60 platform was created to provide mobile phone manufacturers with powerful and comprehensive large screen screen screen phones, more commonly known as smart phones. The software developed for the S60 platform allows the development of standards and development tools using the different smartphones of many manufacturers, such as Java, C++, and Python. An important feature of the S60 platform is that after purchasing S60 mobile phones, users can still install other third-party software.
title: Series 60

source_text: Vim是从vi发展出来的一个文本编辑器。其代码补完、编译及错误跳转等方便编程的功能特别丰富，在程序员中被广泛使用。和Emacs并列成为类Unix系统用户最喜欢的编辑器。Vim的第一个版本由布萊姆·米勒在1991年发布。最初的简称是Vi IMitation，随着功能的不断增加，正式名称改成了Vi IMproved。现在是在开放源代码方式下发行的自由软件。
target_text: Vim is a text editor developed from vi. The user-friendly programming features of code completion, compilation and error jumping are particularly abundant and are widely used among programmers. Emacs is also listed as the favorite editor for a class of Unix system users. The first version of Vim was released in 1991 by Brem Miller. The initial acronym is Vi Development, which changed its official name to Vi IMproved as the functionality continues to grow. It is now a free software available under the open source mode.
title: Vim

source_text: 網路介面控制器（，NIC），又稱网络接口控制器，网络适配器（network adapter），网卡（network interface card），或區域網路接收器（LAN adapter），是一块被设计用来允许计算机在计算机网络上进行通讯的计算机硬件。由于其拥有MAC地址，因此属于OSI模型的第2层。它使得用户可以通过电缆或无线相互连接。每一个网卡都有一个被称为MAC地址的独一无二的48位序列号，它被写在卡上的一块ROM中。在网络上的每一个计算机都必须拥有一个独一无二的MAC地址。没有任何两块被生产出来的网卡拥有同样的地址。这是因为电气电子工程师协会（IEEE）负责为网络接口控制器销售商分配唯一的MAC地址。
target_text: The network interface controller (NIC), also known as the network interface controller, network adapter, network interface card, or district network receiver, is a computer hardware designed to allow computers to communicate on the computer network. Since it has an MAC address, it is the second floor of the OSI model. It allows users to connect by cable or wireless. Each network card has a unique 48-bit serial number called the MAC address, which is written in a ROM on the card. Each computer on the network must have a unique MAC address. None of the two cards produced has the same address. This is because the Association of Electrical and Electronic Engineers (IEEE) is responsible for allocating the single MAC address to the seller of the network interface controller.
title: 网卡

source_text: 网卡以前是作为扩展卡插到计算机总线上的，但是由于其价格低廉而且以太网标准普遍存在，大部分新的计算机都在主板上集成了网络接口。除非需要多接口，否则不再需要一块独立的网卡。甚至更新的主板可能含有内置的双网络（以太网）接口。
target_text: The card was previously inserted into the computer bus as an extension card, but because of its low cost and the prevalence of the Ethernet standard, most of the new computers are integrated into the network interface on the main board. Unless multiple interfaces are required, a separate net card is no longer needed. Even the updated main board may contain built-in two-network (Ethernet) interfaces.

source_text: 赛风（），民间早期译作白凤或彩虹，是一款使用安全通信和混淆技术（VPN、SSH以及HTTP代理）来突破网络审查的自由及开放源代码软件。Psiphon集中管理分布在全球数千台的代理服务器，采用面向性能的单跳和多跳架构。Psiphon是专门为那些被认为是“互联网的敌人”的国家的用户提供支持。代码库由Psiphon, Inc.开发和维护。该公司的运营旨在帮助互联网用户安全地绕过政府用于对互联网审查的内容过滤系统和技术。
target_text: Chai Feng, an early civilian translation into Phoenix or Rainbow, is a free and open source software that uses secure communication and confusion technologies (VPN, SSH, and HTTP agents) to break through web censorship. Psiphon centrally manages thousands of proxy servers around the world, using performance-oriented single and multiple jump structures. Psiphon is dedicated to supporting users in countries considered “enemy of the Internet.” The code library is developed and maintained by Psiphon, Inc.. The company operates to help Internet users safely bypass government content filtering systems and technologies used for Internet censorship.
title: 賽風

source_text: Psiphon最初的概念是设计一个易于使用且轻量级的互联网代理，可以由个人计算机用户安装和操作，然后给身处在互联网被审查的国家的朋友和家人提供私人连接。根据Nart Villeneuve的说法“这个想法是让（用户）在他们的计算机上安装它，然后通过他们知道最安全的方式将该环境的位置传递给过滤国家的人们。 我们正在努力建立的是相互了解的人之间的信任网络，而不是人们可以利用的大型技术网络。”Citizen Lab于2006年12月1日以开源软件的方式发布Psiphon 1.0。
target_text: Psiphon’s original idea was to design an easy-to-use and lightweight Internet agent that could be installed and operated by personal computer users and then provide personal connections to friends and families in countries under Internet censorship. According to Nart Villeneuve, “the idea is to let (users) install it on their computers and then pass the location of the environment to the people who filter the country in the safest way they know.

source_text:
Psiphon 1
Psiphon 1 的工作原理由以下三步构成：
生活在被网络审查的国家或地區的服务提供者在自己的电脑上安装赛风软件，使该电脑成为“赛风服务节点”（psiphonode），通過互联网提供代理访问服务。
赛风软件会生成一个网址、用户名、密码。服务提供者以某种安全的方式（如电话、信件、电子邮件等），将该网址、用户名和密码告诉处于严格网络监控的国家或地区中的赛风用户。
赛风用户连接到互联网后访问该网址，浏览器会提示输入用户名及密码。输入之后，赛风用户的电脑即可通过赛风服务节点访问任意网站。由于连接协议为“https”，因此在审查者的眼中，赛风用户访问任何网站的行为，都只是以加密的形式访问了赛风服务节点，因此较难以被发现和拦截。
target_text: Psiphon 1 Psiphon 1 works for the following three-step basis: A service provider living in a country or region under web censorship installs a winding software on its own computer, making it a Piphonode, which provides proxy access via the Internet. The winding software generates a web site, user name, password. The service provider gives the site, user name, and password to wind users in a secure way (e.g. telephone, mail, e-mail, etc.) in a country or region that is under strict web surveillance.
title: 賽風

source_text:
Psiphon 3
Psiphon 3使用VPN, SSH和HTTP还有socks进行代理，用户直接运行软件即可，赛风的服务器均有可信的证书来保证用户能连接到正确的服务器，赛风在多个国家或地区设置了服务器，目前赛风其服务器所在主要服务商为Linode、DigitalOcean、1and1等。被封锁状况中国
从2017年起，Amazon S3服务部分IP地址在中国大陆被屏蔽，因此中国大陆的Psiphon用户在初次连接时可能无法正常获取服务器列表。
较新版本的移动端软件提供NFC功能，可以让能够连接的用户帮助不能连接的用户寻找服务器。
target_text: Psiphon 3 Psiphon 3 uses VPN, SSH and HTTP and socks as agents, so that the user can run the software directly. Wind servers have credible certificates to ensure that users can connect to the right server. Wind sets up servers in several countries or regions. The main servers where the servers currently operate are Linode, DigitalOcean, 1and1. From 2017 onwards, Amazon S3 service IP addresses have been blocked in mainland China, so Psiphon users in mainland China may not be able to access the server list properly at the time of initial connection.
title: 賽風

source_text: 在数值分析中，数值稳定性是一种希望得到的数值算法特性。根据算法的不同，稳定性的精确定义也有所不同，但是都与算法的精确性与正确性相关。理论上有些计算下可以用多种代数上等价的理想实数或者复数算法来实现，但是实际上由于不同的数值稳定性可能会得到不同的结果。数值稳定性的一项任务就是选择強健（robust，即有良好数值稳定性）的算法。
target_text: In numerical analysis, numerical stability is a desired numeric feature. The precise definition of stability varies depending on the algorithm, but is related to the accuracy and correctness of the algorithm.
title: 数值稳定性

source_text: 假设要用数值算法解决的问题是用函数将数据映射到解，通常算法的结果会与“真”解有一定的偏差。误差的来源主要有舍入误差、以及数据误差。算法的「前向误差」是结果与真解之间的差别，即。「后向误差」是满足的最小，也就是说后向误差说明算法的所解决的问题。前向误差和后向误差通过条件数发生关系：前向误差的幅度最多是条件数乘以后向误差的幅度。
target_text: Assuming that a numerical algorithm solves the problem by using a function to map the data to a solution, the result of the algorithm will normally be a deviation from the " true " interpretation. The source of error is mainly a rounding error and a data error. The " forward error " of the algorithm is the difference between the result and the true one, i.e. the " backward error " is the smallest satisfaction, i.e. the backward error explains the problem that the algorithm solves. The forward error and the backward error are correlated with the number of conditions: the front error is at best the range of the condition multiplied later.
title: 数值稳定性

source_text: 在许多情况下，需要考虑相对误差而不是绝对误差。如果对于任意的输入来说后向误差都很小，那么算法就是「后向稳定」的。当然，“小”是一个相对的概念，需要根据所用的场合进行定义。通常要求误差要与处于同一数量级，或是略大一些。通常数值稳定性的定义是使用一个包括了前向误差与后向误差的更加宽泛的概念，称为「混合稳定性」。按照这个概念，如果一个算法是稳定的，那么存在使得与都很小。因此，后向稳定算法永远是稳定的。
target_text: In many cases, there is a need to consider relative error rather than absolute error. If backward error is small for any given input, the algorithm is “backward stability”. Of course, “small” is a relative concept that needs to be defined on the basis of the context in which it is used.
title: 数值稳定性

source_text: 如果算法的前向误差除以条件数得到的结果很小，那么这个算法就是「前向稳定」的。这就意味着如果一个算法的前向误差与后向稳定算法的误差幅度类似那么就是前向稳定的。数值微分方程的稳定性上面的定义在截断误差不重要的情况下是很确切的。在微分方程等另外一些场合中，则需要另外的数值稳定性定义。
target_text: If the pre-alignment error of the algorithm is divided by a very small number of conditions, then the algorithm is “forward stability.” This means that if the forward error of an algorithm is similar to the margin of error of the backward-stabilization algorithm, then it is for future stability. The definition of stability of the numerical differential equation is precise in cases where the cut error is not important. In other cases, such as the differential equation, another definition of numerical stability is needed.
title: 数值稳定性

source_text: 在数值偏微分方程中另外一种数值稳定性的定义。如果随着步长逐渐趋近于零，偏微分方程的数值解仍然保持有界，那么这个算法就是稳定的。表明如果算法是一致稳定的，那么这个算法就会收敛。有时候将考虑在内来实现稳定性。数值扩散是一个数学术语，它保证舍入误差以及其它误差在计算的过程中逐渐散去，而不会累积起来越变越大。
target_text: Another definition of numerical stability in the numeric fraction equation. If the numeric solution of the numeric equation remains stable as the length of the step approaches zero, the algorithm is stable. It shows that if the algorithm is consistent and stable, the algorithm will shrink. It will sometimes be taken into account to achieve stability. Numerical diffusion is a mathematical term that guarantees that rounding errors and other errors will gradually dissipate in the calculation process and not accumulate more.
title: 数值稳定性

source_text:
数据流编程
LabVIEW编程语言，也被称为G语言，是一种数据流编程语言。程序员通过绘制导线连接不同功能的节点，图形化的程序框图（LV源代码）结构决定程序如何执行。这些线传递变量，所有的输入数据都准备好之后，节点便马上执行。这可能出现同时使用多个节点的情况，G语言天生地具有并行执行能力。内置的调度算法自动使用多处理器和多线程硬件，可以跨平台地在可运行的节点上复用线程。
target_text: Data stream programming LabVIEW programming language, also known as G language, is a data stream programming language. The programmer determines how the program will be executed by drawing guide lines that connect different function nodes, and a graphical program frame (LV source code) structure. These lines transmit variables, all input data are ready, and the node will be executed immediately. This may occur when multiple nodes are used simultaneously, and G language is naturally capable of parallel execution.
title: LabVIEW

source_text: 图形化的方法还允许非程序员通过拖放虚拟化形式的VI的方法来生成程序，控制他们已经熟悉的实验室设备。在LabVIEW编程环境下，借助已经提供的大量例程和文档，可以很容易地创建小型应用程序。这是好的一方面。编写复杂的算法或大规模的代码時，程序员需要对LabVIEW特殊的语法具有广泛的了解，并且通晓LabVIEW内存管理的拓扑结构。最先进的LabVIEW开发系统提供了创建独立应用程序的可能性。此外，还可以创建分布式应用，通过客户机/服务器模式进行通信。由于G语言天生的并行性特性，这很容易实现。
target_text: A graphical approach also allows non-programmers to generate programs by dragging and dragging virtual form VI and controlling the laboratory equipment they are already familiar with. In the LabVIEW programming environment, small applications can be easily created, using the large number of routines and files already available. This is a good aspect. When complex algorithms or large-scale codes are developed, programmers need to have a broad understanding of LabVIEW ' s special syntax and know the top-down structure for management of LabVIEW memory. The most advanced LabVIEW development system offers the possibility of creating independent applications. In addition, distributed applications can be created to communicate through the client machine/server mode. This is easily achieved because of the inherent parallelness of G-language.
title: LabVIEW

source_text: 1983年12月28日，物理学家杨振宁向中国领导人邓小平表示“国外认为，搞软件15—18岁较有利”。1984年2月16日，邓小平参观上海市展览馆举办的十年科技成果展。邓小平在观看过计算机演示后指出“计算机的普及要从娃娃做起”。同年，中国计算机学会(CCF)创办全国青少年计算机程序设计竞赛(NOI)。当年参加竞赛的人数超过8000人。中共中央领导王震出席了首届竞赛颁奖大会，并对此项活动给予了充分肯定。
target_text: On December 28, 1983, Physicist Yang Zhening said to Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping, “Foreignly, it is better to have software between the ages of 15 and 18.” On February 16, 1984, Deng Xiaoping visited a 10-year science and technology exhibition at the Shanghai Exhibition. Deng Xiaoping, after watching a computer demonstration, said, “The spread of computers begins with dolls.” In the same year, the Chinese Computer Society (CCF) launched the National Youth Computer Program Design Competition (NOI). The competition was attended by more than 8,000 people.
title: 全国青少年信息学奥林匹克联赛

source_text:
宗旨
NOIP是一项面向中国(含陆港澳)中学生的信息学竞赛和普及活动。CCF官方称NOIP的宗旨是“旨在向那些在中学阶段学习的青少年普及计算机科学知识；给学校的信息技术教育课程提供动力和新的思路；给那些有才华的学生提供相互交流和学习的机会；通过竞赛和相关的活动培养和选拔优秀计算机人才”。NOIP的官方定义是“课外性质的因材施教活动”“在业余时间自愿参加”，目的是“在更高层次上推动(信息学技术)普及”。但事实上，NOIP的专业性比较强，在学习深度、时间、参加者素质上有较高的要求，远非“业余时间参加的课外活动”。
target_text: The purpose of NOIP is to promote computer science among young people studying at the secondary level; to give impetus and new ideas to the information technology education curriculum in schools; to provide talented students with opportunities to interact and learn from each other; and to develop and select excellent computer talent through competitions and related activities. The official definition of NOIP is “extracurricular material teaching activities” “voluntarily taking part in spare time”, the purpose of which is “promotion of universal access to computer science (information technology) at a higher level.” In fact, NOIP is more specialized and requires a higher degree of study, time and quality than “extracurricular activities involving amateur time”.
title: 全国青少年信息学奥林匹克联赛

source_text:
竞赛内容
2022 年之前，NOIP 的参赛者可以选择使用C、C++、Pascal三种编程语言之一，初赛不同语言考题不同，复赛试题相同。具体的内容则在竞赛大纲中体现。2016年11月1日，中国计算机学会发布通知：2020年开始，除NOIP以外的NOI系列其他赛事（包括冬令营、CTSC、APIO、NOI）将不再支持Pascal和C语言；从2022年开始，NOIP竞赛也将不再支持Pascal语言。即从NOIP 2022开始，NOI系列的所有赛事将全部取消Pascal语言。在无新增程序设计语言的情况下，NOIP系列赛事自2022开始将仅支持C++语言。
target_text: Prior to 2022, NOIP participants were given the option to use one of the three programming languages, C, C++, Pascal, different languages for the first competition and the same test for the resumption of the competition. The specific content was reflected in the outline of the competition. On 1 November 2016, the Chinese Computer Society issued a notice that beginning in 2020, the NOI series (including the Winter Camp, CTSC, APIO, NOI) would no longer support Pascal and C; starting in 2022, the NOIP competition would no longer support Pascal. That is, starting with NOIP 2022, all NoI series events would eliminate Pascal. In the absence of any new programming language, the NOIP series would support only C++ languages.

source_text:

中国计算机学会于2019年8月16日在其官网及中国信息学奥林匹克官网发表公告声称，“由于某种原因”，全国信息学青少年奥林匹克联赛从2019年起暂停举行。中国计算机学会于2020年1月21日在中国信息学奥林匹克官网发表公告声称，“由于CCF将可能获得有关部门的经费资助，CCF决定恢复全国青少年信息学奥林匹克联赛NOIP”。
target_text: On 16 August 2019, the Chinese Computer Society issued a communiqué on its official network and the Chinese Information Society Network, stating that the National Information Youth Olympic Games had been suspended since 2019 for “some reason.” On 21 January 2020, the Chinese Computer Society issued a communiqué on the China Information Society Network, stating that “as the CCF would likely receive funding from the relevant authorities, the CCF decided to resume the National Youth Information Olympic Games NOIP”.

source_text:
色彩同步实用工具（ColorSync Utility）是苹果电脑公司出品的Mac OS X操作系统中的一个系统工具，用于进行设备的色彩管理。用户的各种设备，包括扫描仪、数码相机、显示器和打印机等等，通过Mac OS X 中的设备注册数据库实现统一管理。设备一连接到系统，至少一个成像设备的配置文件就由设备注册数据库进行自动登记。设备注册数据库中的文件可以被数字工作流程中的程序识别并使用。
另外这个工具还包括一个内部计算器，可以将色彩在RGB, CMYK和一些其他色彩系统之间转换，还提供“拾色器”界面，让用户在屏幕上选取颜色。
target_text: The colour synchronization utility (ColorSync Utility) is a system tool in the Mac OS X operating system produced by Apple Computers, which is used for color management of equipment. The user ' s various devices, including scanners, digital cameras, monitors and printers, are managed uniformly through the equipment registration database in Mac OS X. Once the device is connected to the system, at least one image device configuration file is automatically registered by the equipment registration database. The files in the equipment registration database can be identified and used by the program in the digital workflow. This tool also includes an internal calculator that converts colours between RGB, CMYK and some other colour systems.
title: 色彩同步实用工具

source_text: 易通卡（）是新加坡的非觸式智能卡系統，模式類似香港八達通及臺北悠遊卡，初期同樣利用索尼的FeliCa晶片完成微付款交易。2001年推出初期，該系統主要用作支付公共交通的車資。截至2005年，易通卡發行量為800萬張，每日處理400萬宗交易。在2008年，易通卡改用新加坡政府制訂的非接觸式電子錢包應用標準（）架構，與深圳通及廣深鐵路快通卡一樣，使用由中國大陸握奇數據系統有限公司开发的TimeCOS®FLY操作系统，用德國英飛凌芯片的新卡，原本使用的FeliCa晶片卡已於2009年10月31日起停用。
target_text: The ItoC (ItoC) is Singapore's non-touch smart card system. In 2008, the ItoC card was replaced by the Singapore Government's standard for the use of non-touchable electric wallets () in Hong Kong, which used the same way as the Sony FeliCa chip to complete the micro-payment transaction. In the early stages of its launch in 2001, the system was used mainly to pay for public transport. By 2005, the ItoC issued 8 million cards and processed 4 million transactions per day.
title: 易通卡

source_text:

2012年11月5日，新加坡易通私人有限公司與嶺南通公司就新加坡和廣東省兩地智能卡商談合作事宜，傾向於粵新兩地推出使用由中國大陸握奇數據系統有限公司开发的TimeCOS®FLY操作系统，用德國英飛凌芯片卡以「一卡一芯雙錢包」(人民幣／新幣)模式的聯名卡，並就相關的合作意向、推進思路等達成共識，推出聯名卡「一通粵新」，將於2016年10月對外發行。可在廣東省使用嶺南通卡範圍和新加坡使用，是全球首張跨國合作開發的交通智能卡。
target_text: On November 5, 2012, Singapore ' s Illustrates Ltd. and Xiannanton Ltd. negotiated cooperation on smart cards in Singapore and Guangdong Province, preferring to launch a new version of the TimeCOSÇFLY operating system developed by China China ' s China Continents Data Systems Ltd., using the German English Flying Chip card as a joint card in the "one-core double-money bag/new currency" model, with a shared understanding of the related cooperative intent and thrust, and a joint "one-size-fits-all" card, to be launched in October 2016. The Tiannam Tungca perimeter and Singapore are the first traffic smart cards to be used in Guangdong Province and are the first to be developed in a collaborative manner across the globe.

source_text: 在计算机科学以及其它领域中，最小权限原则是要求计算环境中的特定抽象层的每个模組如进程、用户或者计算机程序只能访问当下所必需的信息或者资源。赋予每一个合法动作最小的权限，就是为了保护数据以及功能避免受到错误或者恶意行为的破坏。
target_text: In computer science and elsewhere, the principle of minimum competence requires that each module in a particular abstract layer of the computing environment, such as process, user, or computer program, has access only to the information or resources that are necessary at the moment. The minimum authority given to every legal action is to protect the data and function from error or malice.
title: 最小权限原则

source_text:
最小权限原则也称为最少权限原则。历史
这个原则大约在1970年代中期开始出现，人们通常认为Peter J. Denning的“容错操作系统”一书，是这个概念的首次提出者，实际上，在当时许多论文中，已经用其它不同名字提到了这个原则，如Saltzer与Schroeder的计算机系统信息保护。Saltzer与Schroeder的原始表述是
系统的每个程序或者用户应该使用完成工作所需的最小权限工作。
target_text: The principle of minimum competence is also referred to as the principle of minimum competence. History began to emerge in the mid-1970s, and Peter J. Denning's book of “wrong-forwarding operating systems” was generally seen as the first author of the concept, and in fact it was mentioned in many of the papers at that time under other different names, such as the computer system information protection of Saltzer and Schroeder.
title: 最小权限原则

source_text: 如今，LCD显示的可靠性已足以让“玻璃”显示成为关键备份。但这只是表面因素。显示系统负责检查关键的传感器数据，这些数据能让飞机在严苛的环境里安全的飞行。显示软件是以飞行控制软件同样的要求开发出来的，他们对飞行员同等重要。这些显示系统以多种方式确定高度和方位，并安全方便地将这些数据提供给机组人员。
target_text: Today, the LCD shows sufficient reliability to make the glass display a key backup. But this is just a surface factor. It shows that the system is responsible for checking critical sensor data, which allow aircraft to fly safely in a harsh environment. It shows that software is developed with the same requirements as flight control software, which are equally important for pilots.
title: 航空电子

source_text:
飞机管理系统
飞行管理系统出现在20世纪70年代，在原有的自动导航及通信控制及其他电子系统的技术上发展起来的。柯林斯(Collins)和霍尼韦尔(Honeywell)公司分别在其参与研发的麦道和波音飞机上率先引入集成的飞行管理系统。随着技术的进步，飞行管理系统的重要性不断提高，成为飞机上最重要的人机交互接口。集成了飞飞行控制计算机，导航及性能计算等功能。中央计算机加上显示和飞行控制系统，这三个核心系统使飞机上的所有系统（不仅仅是航电系统）更易于维护，更易于飞行，更安全。
target_text: The flight management system appeared in the 1970s and was technologically developed in the old automated navigation and communications control and other electronic systems. Collins and Honeywell, respectively, pioneered the introduction of integrated flight management systems on the Maddo and Boeing aircraft in which they were engaged. As technology advances, the flight management system has grown in importance, making it the most important human interface on board the aircraft. It has been integrated into flight control computers, navigation and performance computing functions. The central computer, together with the display and flight control systems, makes all systems on board of the aircraft (not only the navigational systems) easier to maintain, easier to fly and safer.

source_text:
深度优先搜索
深度优先搜索沿着树的最大深度方向生成节点并与目标节点进行比较，只有当上次访问的节点不是目标节点，而且没有其他节点可以生成的时候，才转到上次访问节点的父节点，然后搜索该节点的其他子节点。因此深度优先搜索也称为回溯搜索。它既不是完备的，也不是最优的。有时候，某些特定的问题会产生大量重复的节点。例如“八数码”问题就是这样的，当每次运用向上、向下、向左、向右移动空格的算符时，可能产生与已经产生的节点重复的节点。当再次搜索到这个重复节点时，由于应用的算符基本一致，还会产生重复，所以为了节约时间和存储空间，往往在深度优先算法中设立一个机制，用来删除这些重复的节点，以提高效率。
target_text: Deep priority search The depth priority search generates nodes along the maximum depth direction of the tree and compares with the target node. Only when the last node visited is not the target node and there are no other nodes that can be generated will it be transferred to the parent node of the last visited node and then search for the other subnodes of the node. So the depth priority search is also called backtrace search. It is neither complete nor optimal.

source_text: 在计算机学中，反射式编程（）或反射（），是指计算机程序在运行时（）可以访问、检测和修改它本身状态或行为的一种能力。用比喻来说，反射就是程序在运行的时候能够“观察”并且修改自己的行为。要注意术语“反射”和“内省”（）的关系。内省（或称“自省”）机制仅指程序在运行时对自身信息（称为元数据）的检测；反射机制不仅包括要能在运行时对程序自身信息进行检测，还要求程序能进一步根据这些信息改变程序状态或结构。
target_text: In computer science, reflective programming () or reflective () refers to the ability of a computer program to () access, detect and modify its own state or behaviour while it is in operation. As a metaphor, reflectiveness is the ability of the program to “observ” and modify its own behaviour when it is in operation. Note the relationship between the term “reflection” and “intra-provincial” (). Inner-provincial (or “self-consumption”) mechanisms refer only to the detection of its own information (known as metadata) when the program is in operation. Reactivation mechanisms include not only the ability to detect the program's own information when it is in operation, but also the ability of the program to change its state or structure further on the basis of that information.
title: 反射式编程

source_text: 在类型检测严格的面向对象的编程语言如Java中，一般需要在编译期间对程序中需要调用的对象的具体类型、介面（interface）、資料成員（fields）和方法的合法性进行检查。反射技术则允许将对需要调用的物件的訊息检查工作从编译期间推迟到运行期间再现场执行。这样一来，可以在编译期间先不明确目标物件的介面（interface）名称、字段（fields），即物件的資料成員（成员变量）、可用方法，然后在运行根据目标物件自身的訊息决定如何处理。它还允许根据判断结果进行实例化新物件和相关方法的呼叫。
target_text: In strictly object-oriented programming languages such as Java for type testing, the legitimacy of the specific type of object, interface, data members (fields) and methods that need to be called on in the process is generally checked during the compilation. The reflective technology allows for the transmission of information on objects that need to be called to be postponed from the compilation period to the running period. This allows the translation to be preceded by an unclear description of the interface name, field (fields), i.e., data members (member variables), available methods, and then to decide how to deal with the object ' s own message. It also allows the call to exemplify the new object and associated methods based on the results of the translation.
title: 反射式编程

source_text:
历史背景
早期计算机的原生汇编语言本质上就具有反射特性。因为这些最初架构可以通过定义指令作为数据及使用自修改代码来编程，实现反射功能是很平常的。编程发展到使用编译型高级语言如Algol、Cobol、Fortran和包括Pascal和C在内的很多其他语言时，自修改代码等实践很大程度上消失了，直到将反射特性内建入类型系统的高级编程语言出现后才再次提供了反射功能。Lisp语言家族以具有同像性作为标志性特征，可以认为具有反射性。
target_text: Historical background The original compilation language of the early computer is essentially reflective. These initial structures can be programmed by defining instructions as data and using self-modified codes, which are common. When programming is developed to use advanced compiled languages such as Algol, Cobol, Fortran and many other languages, including Pascal and C, practices such as code modification have largely disappeared, and reflective functions have been re-established only after the advanced programming language that has built the built-in system into the reflective feature has emerged.
title: 反射式编程

source_text:
优点
支持反射的语言提供了一些在早期高级语言中难以实现的运行时特性。
可以在一定程度上避免硬编码，提供灵活性和通用性。
可以作为一个頭等物件发现并修改源代码的结构（如代码块、类、方法、协议等）。
可以在运行时像对待源代码语句一样动态解析字符串中可执行的代码（类似JavaScript的eval()函数），进而可将跟class或function匹配的字符串转换成class或function的调用或引用。
可以创建一个新的语言字节码解释器来给编程结构一个新的意义或用途。
target_text: You can find and modify the structure of the source code (e.g. code blocks, classes, methods, protocols, etc.) as a first-level object. You can dynamically interpret the executable code in a string (e.g. JavaScript's eval() function) at the time of operation, and then convert a string that matches a class or function to a class or function call or reference. You can create a new language byte interpreter to give a new meaning or purpose to the programming structure.
title: 反射式编程

source_text:
劣势
此技术的学习成本高。面向反射的编程需要较多的高级知识，包括框架、关系映射和对象交互，以实现更通用的代码执行。
同样因为反射的概念和语法都比较抽象，过多地滥用反射技术会使得代码难以被其他人读懂，不利于合作与交流。
由于将部分信息检查工作从编译期推迟到了运行期，此举在提高了代码灵活性的同时，牺牲了一点点运行效率。
target_text: As the concept of reflection and syntax are more abstract, excessive abuse of reflective technology makes the code difficult for others to read and to cooperate and communicate. As part of the information check process is postponed from compilation to operation, this is at the expense of a little operational efficiency, while increasing the flexibility of the code.
title: 反射式编程

source_text: 在計算複雜性理論，一個被稱為線性時間或 Ο(n)時間的演算法，表示此演算法解題所需時間與輸入資料的大小成正比，通常以n表示。換句話說，執行時間與輸入資料大小為線性比例。例如將一列數字加總的所需時間，正比於串列的長度。然而實際情況常有差距，真實的執行時間很可能與預期的比率相差甚大，尤其在n的值很小時。在技術討論時，在足夠大的量n之下演算法的執行時間從到（a、ｂ為正實數）時，就可稱線性時間。詳情請看大O符號。
target_text: In terms of calculating complex theories, an algorithm called linear time or n time means that the amount of time needed to solve the algorithm is proportional to the size of the data entered, usually expressed as n. In other words, the amount of time spent on running and the size of the data entered is a linear ratio. For example, the length of time taken to add a column to the total is longer than in the series. However, there is often a gap, and the real time spent on running is likely to be quite different from the expected rate, especially in n hours. In technical discussions, the amount of time spent on performing the algorithms at a sufficient n is the amount (a.b. is true).
title: 線性時間

source_text: 某些排序演算法可以在特殊的資料結構及排列下擁有線性時間的效率。但在一般情況下以比較元素大小來排序的演算法，最多只能到達Ο(nlog(n))。最低限度複雜性的證明已被小O符號含括；通用排序演算法被認為是Ω(n log(n))。另外，要找到一個集合中最大的元素是 Ω(n)，因為演算法必須至少比較過（n-1）次才能找到最大元素。
target_text: Some sorting algorithms can have linear time efficiency under special data structures and arrangements. But in general, a sorting algorithm that compares the size of an element can only reach (nlog (n)). The proof of minimum complexity is covered by the little O sign; the universal sorting algorithm is considered to be the first (n log (n)). Moreover, the biggest element in a collection must be (n) because the algorithm has to compare at least (n-1) to the maximum element.
title: 線性時間

source_text: -{zh-hans:计算机科学家;zh-hant:資訊科學家}-認為多項式時間是快的，而其他類型的計算時間是慢的。指數時間因此被認為是慢的類型。有很多演算法計算時間慢過多項式時間，因此被稱為超多項式時間，但又快過指數時間，也因此又被稱為次指數時間，它們也被認為是慢的演算法。此類問題中最著名的便是整數分解。
target_text: - {zh-hans: Computer scientists; zh-hant: Information scientists} - Thinks that multiple types of time are fast, while others are slow to calculate. Indicator time is thus considered to be a slow type. There are many algorithms that are too slow to calculate, so they are described as excessive, but faster, and thus are called sub-indicators. They are also considered to be slow. The most famous of these questions is the integer breakdown.
title: 指數時間

source_text: 模板方法模型是一種行為設計模型和设计模式。模板方法（template method）是一個定義在父類別的方法，负责处理流程、算法的不变部分。模板方法會调用多個定義在父類別的其他工具方法（helper method），而這些方法是算法的可变部分，有可能只是抽象方法並沒有實作。模板方法僅決定這些抽象方法的執行順序，這些抽象方法由子類別負責實作，並且子類別不允許覆盖模板方法（即不能重写处理流程）。
target_text: Template approach is a behavioral design model and design model. Template approach is a parent-specific approach that deals with the constant parts of processes and algorithms. Template approach calls for many other tools that define parent-specific methods (helper method), and these methods are variable elements of algorithms that may be abstract and not implemented. Template approach only determines the sequence of these abstract methods, which are implemented by sub-categories and which do not allow overlaying the template method (i.e. cannot rewrite the process).
title: 模板方法

source_text: 列维和从大众传播的思考方法来考虑CI，集中网络信息及通信技术的能力去提高社区知识库。他们认为，这些通讯工具可以使人类既方便又快速地进行互动、分享与合作（Flew 2008）。随着互联网的发展和广泛使用，对于那些以社区为基础的论坛，例如维基百科，为它们做贡献的机会大于以往任何时候。通过对数据库的集体访问，以及允许他们“利用蜂巢”，这些计算机网络给与参与用户存储和检索知识的机会（Raymond 1998; Herz 2005 in Flew 2008）。对于人和计算机所组成的群体，在的研究人员，他们研究和探索这些群体所具有的集体智慧。
target_text: As the Internet evolves and becomes widely used, community-based forums, such as Wikipedia, have greater opportunities to contribute to them than ever before. Through collective access to databases and by allowing them to “use the beehives”, these computer networks provide opportunities to store and retrieve knowledge with the users involved (Raymond 1998; Herz 2005 in Flew 2008). For the groups of people and computers, researchers in the field study and explore the collective wisdom of these groups.
title: 集體智慧

source_text: 也许我们可以得出这个信息皮层和互联网之间的相似之处。在1995年，该网络被互联网协会定义为“……全球信息系统……提供、使用或使得可以访问，或公开或私下，高级别的服务在通信和相关基础设施上分层”（Leiner et al. 2003），因而我们能够理解它是怎样适合于成为这个“皮层”的。自从1950年代后期它开始发展，而直到1991年WWW（万维网）出现时才得以形成信息皮层。在2005年，全世界有多达1,018,057,389个互联网用户（CIA 2008）。这么多的用户访问互联网只能意味着一件事——彼此间的深刻理解以及知识的协作。互联网是一个信息和通讯的工具，无论是调查股市或名人八卦网站，人类主要对信息共享感兴趣，而互联网则服务于这一目的。
target_text: In 1995, the network was defined by the Internet Association as “the global information system ... provides, uses, or makes accessible, or public or private, high-level services stratification over communication and related infrastructure” (Leiner et al. 2003), so we can understand how it fits into this “skinner.” Since the late 1950s, it began to develop, but was not able to form an information layer until the World Wide Web (WWW) appeared in 1991. In 2005, there were as many as 1,018,057,389 Internet users worldwide (CIA 2008).
title: 集體智慧

source_text: 1986年，把细胞凋亡、并行分布式处理、群体选择以及超有机体的概念结合在一起，以形成一个关于集体智慧如何工作的理论。后来，在计算机生成的的“复杂适应性系统”和“遗传算法”（由约翰·霍兰德所开创的概念）方面，他又进一步表明该怎样来解释集体智慧，例如那些竞争的细菌菌落和竞争的人类社会。
target_text: In 1986, the concepts of cell failure, parallel distribution, group selection, and superorganism were combined to form a theory of how collective wisdom works. Later, with respect to computer-generated “complex adaptive systems” and “genetic algorithms” (concept created by John Hollande), he further demonstrated how collective wisdom should be interpreted, such as competing bacteria and competing human societies.
title: 集體智慧

source_text: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李，作为万维网的开发者，他建造该网络的目标是为了促进全球范围内的信息交流与发布。之后，他的老板开创了可供免费使用的WWW技术。在90年代初，互联网的潜力仍然没有被利用，直到90年代中期，由高级研究计划署（ARPA）的负责人Dr. J.C.R. Licklider所提出的“临界质量”，它需要互联网更加方便、实用。因此可以说，集体智慧背后的动力是信息与通信的数字化。这是因为，超链接的存在使得搜索和创建网站、网页变得更容易，而知识则能够在短短的几分钟之内被建立。
target_text: Tim Burners-Lee, as the developer of the World Wide Web, built the network to promote information exchange and dissemination worldwide. After that, his boss created a free-of-charge WWW technology. In the early 1990s, the potential of the Internet remained untapped, until the mid-1990s, when Dr. J.C.R. Licklider, the head of the Advanced Research Program (ARPA), presented a “critical quality” that needed to be made more accessible and practical.
title: 集體智慧

source_text: 对于学习者产生的背景，在互联网上也许可以发现最好的例子，一群协作的用户将知识集中起来，进而形成一个共享的智能空间。随着互联网的发展，作为一个共享的公共论坛，因而有了集体智慧的概念。与以往任何时候相比，互联网的全球易用性和可用性使更多的人发表他们的想法，以及去访问这些协同的智能空间。（Flew 2008）
target_text: As the Internet evolves as a shared public forum, the concept of collective wisdom emerges. The global accessibility and availability of the Internet enables more people to publish their ideas than ever before, as well as to access these synergetic spaces. (Flew 2008)
title: 集體智慧

source_text: 新媒体经常与集体智慧的提高与增强联系在一起。新媒体能够轻松地存储和检索信息，这主要通过数据库和互联网来实现。而对它来说，这允许它被毫无困难地共享。因此，通过与新媒体的互动，知识很容易在信息来源之间传递，进而导致一种形式的集体智慧。交互式新媒体的使用，特别是互联网，促进了在线互动以及在用户之间的知识传播。
target_text: New media are often linked to the enhancement of collective wisdom. New media can easily store and retrieve information, mainly through databases and the Internet. For it, this allows it to be shared without difficulty.
title: 集體智慧

source_text: 在道德范围内对人工智能的严厉批评有可能促进集体的智慧建设方法，诸如和盖亚假说。它们是否可以称之为集体智慧系统，这是一个开放性的问题。有的人，例如比尔·乔伊，只是想避免任何形式的自治的人工智能，似乎愿意从事严格的集体智慧工作，以消除任何可能的对AI的定位。
target_text: Severe criticism of artificial intelligence in a moral context has the potential to promote collective intelligence-building methods, such as the Gaea hypothesis. Whether they can be called the collective intelligence system is an open question. Some, such as Bill Joy, simply want to avoid any form of artificial intelligence of self-government and seem willing to work strictly on collective intelligence to remove any possible positioning for AI.
title: 集體智慧

source_text: 新科技对细胞迁移研究起到了极大的推动作用。科学家通过ECIS技术（；電子細胞基質阻抗判斷）可以观察到细胞在传统细胞培养甚至是液体环境中的移动行为。根据ECIS技术观测细胞电学参数的能力，ECIS技术还可以量化测量肿瘤细胞迁移过程中细胞层形态变化。同样是在肿瘤研究领域，ATIM（Fluorescence- Assisted Transmigration Invasion and Motility Assay，荧光协助转移侵入和运动分析法） 提供了快速定量细胞侵入（細胞從一個區域進入另一區域）的更好方法，允许检测大量样品和不同条件下时间依赖性侵入。更重要的是，这一系统可以方便地通过在多孔膜上增加胞外基质的厚度来监测细胞侵入结构的深度。韩国延世大学的朴宗哲和朴峰珠则发展出一套细胞跟踪系统。它是由计算机辅助的时间流逝显示微观复制系统，其中有影象形成过程软件，其程序编制含有自动影象分析和自设计CO2微小细胞培育器，它的功能是在一个倒置显微镜平台上，对于细胞迁移进行迅速而精确的分析，从而形成對於细胞的培育。目前已知他们运用这一计算机辅助系统计算了外细胞间质（ECMs）覆盖-{表}-面的细胞迁移过程。
target_text: Also in the field of cancer research, the ATIM (Fluorence-Asisted Transmation Invasion and Movement Asay, fluorescent aiding transfer intrusion and motion analysis) provides a better method of moving cells in traditional cell culture and even in a liquid environment. source_text: 在计算机编程中，单元测试（）又称为模块测试 ，是针对程序模块（软件设计的最小单位）来进行正确性检验的测试工作。程序单元是应用的最小可测试部件。在过程化编程中，一个单元就是单个程序、函数、过程等；对于面向对象编程，最小单元就是方法，包括基类（超类）、抽象类、或者派生类（子类）中的方法。
target_text: In computer programming, unit testing () is also called module testing, which is the test of correctness for the application module (the smallest unit of software design). The application is the minimum testable component. In process programming, one unit is the single program, function, process, etc.; for object-oriented programming, the smallest unit is the method, including the method in the base (super), abstract, or derivative (subcategory).
title: 单元测试

source_text: 每个理想的测试案例独立于其它案例；为测试时隔离模块，经常使用stubs、mock或fake等测试马甲程序。单元测试通常由软件开发人员编写，用于确保他们所写的代码符合软件需求和遵循开发目标。它的實施方式可以是非常手動的（透過紙筆），或者是做成構建自動化的一部分。
target_text: Each ideal test case is independent of other cases; for the purposes of testing the isolation module, the stubs, mocks, or fakes are often used to test the vests. The module test is usually developed by software developers to ensure that the code they write meets the requirements of the software and follows the development objectives. It can be implemented in a very manual way (through pens) or as part of a built-up self-contained process.
title: 单元测试

source_text: 分离接口和实现因为很多类会引用其它类，对这个类的测试经常会要求测试其它的类。一个最普遍的例子是依赖于数据库的类：为了测试它，测试人员通常编写代码去操作数据库。这是不对的，因为单元测试不应超出待测试的类边界。作为替代，软件开发人员应创建一个数据库连接的抽象接口，然后实现这个接口的模拟对象。通过对代码所需附件的抽象（临时降低了网状的耦合效应），这些独立程序单元较前者更能被完整测试。高质量的代码单元也可提供更好的可维护性。
target_text: Separate interfaces and achieve because many classes refer to other categories, the testing of which often requires testing of other categories. One of the most common examples is the category that relies on databases: to test it, testers usually prepare codes to operate the database. This is wrong, because unit testing should not exceed the class boundaries to be tested. Instead, software developers should create an abstract interface for database connections, and then achieve their analog objects. These stand-alone program modules are more fully tested than the former.
title: 单元测试

source_text: 测试不可能發現所有的程序错误，单元测试也不例外。按定义，单元测试只测试程序单元自身的功能。因此，它不能發現集成错误、性能问题、或者其他系统级别的问题。单元测试结合其他软件测试活动更为有效。与其它形式的软件测试类似，单元测试只能表明测到的问题，不能表明不存在未测试到的错误。
target_text: Tests are unlikely to detect all program errors, and unit tests are no exception. By definition, unit tests only test the program's own functionality. Therefore, they cannot detect integration errors, performance problems, or other system-level problems. Unit tests are more effective when combined with other software test activities. Similar to other forms of software tests, unit tests can only indicate detected problems and do not show that there are no untested errors.
title: 单元测试

source_text: 软件测试是一个组合问题。例如，每一个布尔型的决断语句需要至少两种测试：一个返回真，一个返回假。因此，针对每行书写的代码，程序员通常需要写3至5行的测试代码。這很明顯地很花時間而且對此的投入可能並不值得。也有些問題是根本不能簡單地檢測出來的——例如具不確定性的或牽扯到多線程的問題。此外，替單元測試寫的程式碼可能就像要測試的程式碼一樣有程序錯誤。佛瑞德·布魯克斯在人月神話一書中舉例說明：「絕對不要帶兩個計時器去海邊。最好總是帶一或三個」。意味著，如果兩個計時器互相衝突的話，你該怎麼知道哪個是對的？为了获得单元测试的好处，在软件开发过程中应形成一套严格纪律意识。仔细保留记录是必要的，不仅仅只保留执行的测试，也包括保留对应的源码和其它软件单元的变更历史。即，使用版本控制系统是必要的。如果后续版本不能通过一个以前测试通过的单元测试，版本控制系统可以提供对应时间段对源代码所做的变更清单。
target_text: Software testing is a combination of questions. For example, every boolean sermon requires at least two tests: one for real and one for fake. Thus, for every book code, programmers usually have to write three to five lines of test code. This is clearly time-consuming and the input may not be worthwhile. There are also questions that can never be easily detected — for example, uncertainty or multi-twice problems. In order to obtain the benefits of unit testing, a strict sense of discipline may be created in software development. Careful record-keeping is necessary, not only for the tests to be performed, but also for the history of changes in the corresponding source code and other software units.
title: 单元测试

source_text: 极限编程创建单元测试用于测试驱动开发。首先，开发人员编写单元测试用于展示软件需求或者软件缺陷。因为需求尚未实现或者现有代码中存在软件缺陷，这些测试会失败。然后，开发人员遵循测试要求编写最简单的代码去满足它，直到测试得以通过。
target_text: Exceeding-programming module testing is used to test-driven development. First, developers prepare module testing to demonstrate software needs or software defects. These tests fail because demand is not met or there are software deficiencies in existing codes. Then developers follow test requirements to prepare the simplest code to satisfy it until the test is passed.
title: 单元测试

source_text: 系统中大多数代码都经过单元测试，但并非所有代码路径都必需单元测试。极限编程强调“测试所有可能中断”的策略，而传统方法是“测试所有执行路径”。这使得极限编程开发人员比传统开发少写单元测试，但这并不是问题。不争的事实是传统方法很少完全遵循完整地测试所有执行路径的要求。极限编程相互地认识到测试很少能完备（因为完备测试通常需要昂贵的代价和时间消耗，意味着不经济），提供了如何有效地将有限资源集中投入可花费的代价到问题关键的导引。
target_text: Most of the codes in the system are tested in units, but not all of the code paths need to be tested in units. Extremist programming emphasizes the strategy of “testing all possible interruptions”, whereas the traditional method of “testing all execution paths” is “testing all execution paths.” This leaves the maximum programmer with fewer unit tests than traditional development, but it is not a problem. The fact is that traditional methods rarely fully follow the requirements of complete testing of all execution paths. Extremist programming recognizes that testing is rarely complete (as full testing usually requires expensive costs and time consumption, meaning uneconomical) and provides a key guide to how effectively to concentrate the costs of limited resources on the issue.
title: 单元测试

source_text: 系统测试是将需测试的软件，作为整个基于计算机系统的一个元素，与计算机硬件、外设、某些支持软件、数据和人员等其他系统元素及环境结合在一起测试。在实际运行（使用）环境下，对计算机系统进行一系列的组装测试和确认测试。系统测试的目的在于通过与系统的作比较，发现软件与系统定义不符合或与之矛盾的地方。
target_text: System testing is a combination of software to be tested as an element of a computer-based system as a whole, with other system elements and environments, such as computer hardware, externalities, certain support software, data and people. In an operational (use) environment, computer systems are tested for a series of assembly and validation tests.
title: 系统测试

source_text:
回归测试过程
识别出软件中被修改的部分
从原基线测试用例库「T」中，排除所有不再适用的测试用例，确定对新版本依然有效的测试用例，建立新的基线测试用例库「TN」
依据一定的策略从TN中选择测试用例测试被修改的软件
如果必要，生成新的测试用例集「T1」，用于测试TN无法充分测试的软件部分
用T1执行修改后的软件
target_text: Identification of modified parts of the software from the original baseline test library " T " , exclusion of all non-applicable test cases, determination of test cases that are still valid for the new version, establishment of a new baseline test case library "TN " , selection of modified test instance software from TN based on a certain strategy, generation of a new test case collection " T1 " , if necessary, to test parts of the software that can not be fully tested by TN, implementation of modified software using T1
title: 回归测试

source_text: 几乎所有的数码相机都可以根据自动或拍照前手动设定的白平衡、色彩饱和度、对比度、清晰度等设置，将来自传感器的图像处理成JPEG格式。创建RAW格式的相机同样会把上述设置保存到RAW文件里，但暂不依据这些设置处理图片。这样，摄影师就需要另行处理该图像。因此，RAW格式通常只用于原本就需要用计算机额外处理的情况。然而，RAW格式比JPEG有众多的优势，如：更高的图像质量。因为所有的计算（如伽玛校正 ，去马赛克 ，白平衡， 亮度 ，对比度，等等......）用于生成像素值（对于大多数图像的RGB格式）进行一步的基础数据，由此产生的像素值将更加准确，并表现出以下的色调分离 。绕过相机内不受欢迎的处理步骤，例如锐化和降噪通常使用一种有损压缩格式（虽然现在提供一种无损JPEG压缩）保存JPEG图像。RAW格式是典型的无压缩或使用无损压缩，即相机在拍摄中得到的数据不会产生任何损失，相机记录下什么，RAW格式就记录什么。更精细的控制。RAW转换软件，允许用户操纵更多的参数（如亮度 ，白平衡， 色调 ，饱和度，等等。）和更大的可变性这样做。白点，例如，可以设置为任意值，如“日光”或“白炽灯”不只是离散的预设值。用户通常可以看到预览的同时，调整这些参数。
target_text: Almost all digital cameras can also be created by processing images from sensors into JPEG formats, depending on the white balance, color saturation, contrast, clarity, etc. set manually before automatic or photo-taking. Cameras that create RAW formats will similarly save the above settings into RAW files, but will not process images based on them. In this way, photographers will need to process the images separately. The RAW format will normally be used only in cases where computer extra processing is required. However, RAW formats have many advantages over JPEG, such as: higher image quality. All calculations (e.g. gamma correction, demarcation, white balance, brightness, etc.) will be used to generate pixel values (for most images RGB formats), and the resulting pixels will be more accurate and reflect the following modifiable processing steps within the camera, such as sharpening and downs.

飞行管理系统（，缩写FMS）是一种计算机化的航空电子部件，主要用于商用或公务航空器上，用于辅助飞行员管理导航、飞行计划、飞行控制等方面的工作。组成
飞行管理系统主要由以下四方面的部件组成：
飞行管理计算机（FMC）
自动驾驶（AFS）
导航系统，包括惯性导航系统（INS）和全球定位系统（GPS）

target_text: The flight management system (FMS) is a computerized electronic aviation component, used primarily on commercial or service aircraft, to assist pilots in the management of navigation, flight planning, flight control, etc. It consists of four main components: the flight management computer (FMC) autopilot (AFS) navigation system, including the inertial navigation system (INS) and the Global Positioning System (GPS) electronic flight instrument system (EFIS)
title: 飞行管理系统

source_text:
飞行管理计算机
飞行管理计算机是整个系统的核心，相当于整个系统的大脑。它的主要功能包括：
通过显示飞行员预先编制的飞行路线，以及数据库中的其他相关信息，如标准离场和进近程序，给出实際的水平导航信息。这些信息和飞机目前位置信息组合一起，形成移动式地图显示。
计算性能数据，预测垂直飞行轨迹。以飞机重量、成本指数和巡航高度为基础，辅以预测风速，飞行管理计算机可以计算出一条最省油的垂直飞行路径。自动飞行系统与纵向和横向导航都接通的情况下，自动飞行系统就可以遵循这条路径控制飞行。
target_text: Flight management computer flight management computer is the core of the system, which is equivalent to the brain of the system. Its main functions include: giving actual horizontal navigation information by displaying the pilot ' s predefined flight path, as well as other relevant information in the database, such as standard off-site and proximity procedures. Together with the aircraft ' s current position information, this information is a mobile map display. Computing performance data, predicting vertical flight tracks. Based on aircraft weight, cost index and cruise altitude, the flight management computer can calculate a vertical flight path that is the most oil-efficient.
title: 飞行管理系统

source_text:
自动飞行系统
如果将飞行管理计算机比喻为这个系统的大脑的话，那么自动飞行系统就相当于这个系统的四肢了。它负责执行飞行管理系统给出的飞行指令。自动飞行系统由自动飞行指引系统和自动油门（如果有的话）组成，在自动导航和自动油门接通的情况下，它们就相当于飞机的四肢。只有在纵向导航模式和横行导航模式同时或部分接通的情况下，自动飞行系统才完全或部分地使航空器沿着飞行管理计算机指定的路径飞行。
target_text: Automated flight systems, if the flight management computer is compared to the brain of the system, would be equivalent to the limbs of the system. It would be responsible for carrying out the flight instructions given by the flight management system. Automated flight systems consist of automated flight guidance systems and automatic gas gates, if any, which, in the case of automatic navigation and automatic oil gates, are equivalent to the limbs of an aircraft. Only in cases where vertical navigation patterns and horizontal navigation patterns are simultaneously or partially connected would an automated flight system wholly or partially fly an aircraft along the path specified by the flight management computer.
title: 飞行管理系统

source_text: FirstPacket是nVIDIA針對网络優化的一種技術。傳統的网卡驅動程式並不能有效分配資源。例如有一部電腦，同時執行FTP和網上遊戲程式。傳統的驅動程式并不知道各软件对网络的需求量，所有软件对网络的请求权限是一樣的。這就造成遊戲不能暢順執行，因為FTP服務是持续传输的，需要較多网络資源；而網上遊戲服務是斷续传输的。通过FirstPacket技術，网络卡驅動程式就能控制資源的分配。在不妨碍FTP的传输的前提下，在適當的時候將网络資源分配給斷续传输的網上遊戲服務。縱使FTP传输速率會降低，但兩個网络服務都能暢順執行。隨著多核心處理器的推出，系統能執行更多网络服務，FirstPacket技術就能更有效分配网络資源。
target_text: FirestPacket is a technique that nVIDIA uses for network excellence. The traditional web card driver does not distribute resources efficiently. For example, there is a computer that carries out FTP and web games simultaneously. The traditional driver does not know the network requirements for individual software, and all software requests for network privileges are the same. This makes the game unsatisfied, because the FTP service is continuous and requires more network resources; and the web game service is intermittent. Through the FirstPacket technology, the network card driver controls the distribution of resources.
title: NVIDIA FirstPacket

source_text: 量子傅立葉變換（quantum Fourier transform）是一種離散傅立葉變換，將原式分解成更為簡單的多個么正矩陣的積。利用這般的分解方式，離散傅立葉變換可以用作量子電路，其包含了多個哈達瑪閘與受控移相閘。量子傅立葉變換在量子演算法中有多處應用，以其可提供相位估算步驟的理論基礎，在一些演算法中佔核心地位，例如用在做質因數分解的秀爾演算法（Shor's algorithm）、順序發現(order finding)演算法以及隱子群問題（hidden subgroup problem）。
target_text: Quantum Fourier transform is a dissipation of Fouriersform, which divides the original into a more simple array of squares. Using this sort of decomposition, the dissociation of Fouriers changes can be used as a quantum circuit, which includes multiple Hadamas and controlled transfers. Quantified Four leaves changes are used in many applications in quantum algorithms to provide a theoretical basis for a step-by-step estimation and to take a central position in some algorithms, such as the shor's algorithm, the order finding of sequence algorithms, and the question of subgroups (hidden subgroup problem).
title: 量子傅立葉變換

source_text:
分辨其意義
如何分辨出廢話自然是一個問題，在通訊時，有意義的我們稱之為訊號(signal)，無意義的則稱為噪音(noise)。密碼學家設計了許多算法來分辨一句话是否有意义，這类算法通常去分析文字中的重複。在有意義的發言中，句子由詞組成，而詞是語言中最小的單位。如果只是亂數的將文字和標點排在一起的話，則不會有這特性。Zipf's Law則是設法以數學分析這種重複，密碼學家則選擇其他方法去分析。
target_text: Distinguishing the meaning of the word is a problem, of course, and in communication, what we call meaningful is the signal (signal) and meaningless is the noise (noise). The cryptographer has designed a number of algorithms to determine whether a sentence is meaningful, which usually analyses repetitions in the text. In meaningful statements, sentences are composed of words, but the word is the smallest unit in the language. If only randomly queues words and labels together, there is no such feature. Zipf's Law is designed to analyse such repetitions mathematically, and the cryptographer chooses other ways to analyse them.
title: 廢話

target_text: Another algorithm called Mad Libs is to create meaning by inserting names, verbs, etc. in pre-designed sentence frames. The nouns, verbs, etc. can be processed again with Mad Libs algorithms to increase the complexity of sentences. Racter is using this algorithm. But it is important to note that the books published by Racter have been shown to have been processed.

source_text: 信息系统投入使用后，医嘱等信息被存入计算机，尽管仍有打印页装订到病案中，但查看纸面信息的人越来越少。综合上述情况，从总趋势上不难看出，通过病案保管的患者信息占患者总信息的比例正在迅速变小，在一个不太久的未来，纸病历必然会失去其存在意义。其次，交通的发达，使人们的地域观念减弱。医疗体制改革，使患者可以选择多家医院就诊。一个人可以在北京的东城或西城的不同医院看病，也可能在深圳、西安的医院看病。采用纸病历，任何一家医院想全面得到其它医院关于某个病人的病历资料都是十分困难的。这种困难不仅限于形式，不同医院的检查结果、习惯用语、质控标准等，其它医院的医生基本上无从获知。电子病历可以全面管理各种信息资料。可以集中管理，也可以分散管理并在理论上收集完整的各种分散管理的资料。例如一位患者做CT检查，他在做检查时，放射科的医生可以即刻看到其影象，主管医生则可以通过电子病历系统在病房同时观看，但此时由于放射科医生尚未给出诊断报告，相关影象资料主要保管在放射科。当诊断做出后，相关资料通过计算机网络自动传入电子病案室永久保存，此时主管医生能体会的只是内容的不同，具体资料位于何处，不需要也不必关心。

source_text: 安全增強式Linux（SELinux，Security-Enhanced Linux）是一个Linux内核的安全模组，其提供了访问控制安全策略机制，包括了强制访问控制（Mandatory Access Control，MAC）。SELinux是一组内核修改和用户空间工具，已经被添加到各种Linux发行版中。其软件架构力图将安全决策的执行与安全策略分离，并简化涉及执行安全策略的软件的数量。SELinux的核心概念可以追溯回美国国家安全局（NSA）的一些早期项目。
target_text: The security enhancement Linux (SELinux, Security-Enhanced Linux), a security module for the Linux inner core, provides a mechanism for access control security strategy, including mandatory access control (Mandatory Access Control, MAC). SELinux is a set of kernel modifications and user space tools that have been added to various Linux releases. Its software architecture seeks to separate security decision-making from security strategy implementation and streamline the number of software related to security strategy implementation. The core concept of Selinux can be traced back to some early projects of the National Security Agency (NSA).
title: 安全增强式Linux

source_text: SELinux代表了多个可能解决限制安装软件活动的方法之一。另外一个受欢迎的替代品被称为AppArmor，它在（SLES）、OpenSUSE和其他Linux平台中可用。AppArmor原初是作为现不存在的平台组件之一开发的。由于AppArmor和SELinux大相径庭，它们产生了两种完全不同的软件访问限制软件。虽然SELinux重新提出了特定的概念以提供更丰富的策略选择表达集，但AppArmor通过扩展用于自主访问控制级的特定相同自主访问控制管理语言设计来简化其使用。
target_text: Selinux represents one of the many possible solutions to limiting the installation of software. Another popular alternative is known as AppArmor, which is available in SLES, OpenSUSE and other Linux platforms. AppArmor was originally developed as one of the non-existent platform components. Because of the great differences between AppArmor and Selinux, they have produced two distinct software access restrictions. While Selinux has reintroduced specific concepts to provide a richer set of policy options, AppArmor has simplified its use by expanding the design of the specific same autonomous access control language for autonomous access control at the control level.
title: 安全增强式Linux
