source_text: Apache 软件基金会是一个分散管理的开源社区。ASF开发的软件遵循Apache许可证条款，并且是一种非copyleft形式的自由及开放源代码软件(FOSS)。Apache 项目的特点包括了协作性、基于共识的开发流程和开放实用的软件许可，也就是说，它允许免费接收软件的开发人员在非自由条款下进行重新分发。每个项目都从项目的积极贡献者中自主选举一组技术专家团队进行管理。ASF遵循精英政治，这意味着基金会只授予成员资格给已经为Apache项目做出积极贡献的志愿者。ASF被认为是第二代开源组织，因为他们提供的商业支持没有供应商锁定的风险。
target_text: The Apache Software Foundation is a decentralized open-source community. The software developed by the ASF follows the Apache licensing terms and is a free and open-source software (FOSS) that is not in the form of capyleft. The features of the Apache project include collaborative, consensus-based development processes and open-use software licences, that is to say, it allows developers of software to receive software free of charge for redistribution under non-free terms. Each project is managed by a team of technical experts from among the active contributors to the project. The ASF follows elite politics, which means that the Foundation grants membership only to volunteers who have already contributed actively to the Apache project.
title: Apache软件基金会

source_text:
ASF的目标包括：为从事 Apache 项目的志愿者提供法律保护以防止Apache品牌名称被其他组织未经许可使用。ASF每年还会举办多次ApacheCon会议并介绍Apache项目与相关技术。发展历史
Apache软件基金会正式创建于1999年，创始团队自称“Apache组织”。“Apache组织”在1999年以前就存在，由一群开发爱好者们构成。他们在美国国家超级计算机应用中心开发的NCSA HTTPd的基础上，开发与维护了一个叫Apache的HTTP服务器。
target_text: The objectives of the ASF include providing legal protection to volunteers working on the Apache project against the unauthorized use of the Apache brand name by other organizations. The ASF also organizes several Apache Con meetings each year and introduces the Apache project and related technologies. The Foundation for the Development of History was formally created in 1999, with its founding team calling itself the “Apache” organization. “Apache” existed before 1999, and was composed of a group of developers. They developed and maintained an HTTP server called Apache, based on the NCSA HTTPd developed by the National Supercomputer Applications Centre of the United States.
title: Apache软件基金会

source_text: 最初NCSA HTTPd服务器由开发，但是开发者逐渐对这个软件失去了兴趣，不再提供技术支持服务。因为此软件的功能强大，而代码可以自由下载修改与发布，一些爱好者与用户开始自发参与。他们探讨并分发自己修改后的软件版本，不断地改善其功能。为了更好进行沟通，Brian Behlendorf建立了一个邮件列表，用于这个社区的技术交流，把代码重写与维护的工作有效组织起来。这些开发者们逐渐地把他们这个群体称为“Apache组织”，把这个经过不断修正并改善的服务器软件命名为Apache服务器（Apache Server）。
target_text: Initially, the NCSA HTTPd server was developed, but the developers were losing interest in the software and no longer providing technical support services. Because of the software's robust functionality, the code was freely downloaded and released, and some fans and users started to participate spontaneously. They explored and distributed their own version of the modified software, constantly improving its functionality. To better communicate, Brian Behlendorf created a mailing list for technology exchange in the community, effectively organizing the rewriting and maintenance of the code.
title: Apache软件基金会

source_text: 后来由于商业需求的不断扩大，以Apache HTTP服务器为中心，启动了更多的与Apache项目并行的项目，比如mod perl、PHP、Java Apache等等。随着时间的推移、形势的变化，Apache软件基金会的项目列表也不断更新变化中——不断的有新项目启动，项目的中止以及项目的拆分与合并。比如一开始，Jakarta就是为了发展JAVA容器而启动的Java Apache项目，后来由于昇陽電腦的建议，项目名称变为Jakarta。但当时该项目的管理者也没有想到Jakarta项目因为JAVA的火爆而发展到如今一个囊括了众多基于JAVA语言开源软件子项目的项目。以至后来，不得不把个别项目从Jakarta中独立出来，成为Apache软件基金会的顶级项目，Struts项目就是其中之一。
target_text: As a result of growing commercial demand, more parallel projects with the Apache project, such as Mod perl, PHP, Java Apache, and others, were launched, centred on the Apache HTTP server. Over time, the situation has changed, and the list of projects of the Apache Software Foundation is constantly being updated - new projects are starting, the project is being suspended, and the project is being split and merged. For example, Jakarta started with the Java Apache project to develop the JAVA container, and later became Jakarta as a result of the solar computer proposal.
title: Apache软件基金会

source_text:
组织构成
Apache 软件基金会(ASF)的董事会负责根据章程管理和监督组织的业务和事务。这包括了公司资产的管理（资金、知识产权、商标和支持设备），任命总裁和管理 ASF 核心业务的公司官员，以及为Apache各项目的利益分配公司资源。每个 Apache 项目的技术决策权都分配给其独立的项目管理委员会；每个项目是由各自的贡献者制定发展方向，而不是董事会。董事会每年由全体ASF成员选举产生。
target_text: The organization’s board of directors, which comprises the Apache Software Foundation (ASF), is responsible for managing and overseeing the organization’s operations and affairs in accordance with its charter. This includes the management of corporate assets (funds, intellectual property rights, trademarks and support equipment), the appointment of the Managing Director and corporate officials managing the ASF’s core business, and the allocation of corporate resources to the benefit of each Apache project. Technical decision-making authority is assigned to its independent project management committee; each project is directed by its contributors, not by a board of directors.
title: Apache软件基金会

source_text: 模拟计算机（），是计算机的一种形式，它使用电子的，机械的或液压的量等物理现象的不断变化的方面来模拟所要解决的问题。 相反，数字计算机象征性地表示不同数量，因为它们的数值发生了变化。 由于模拟计算机不使用离散值，而是使用连续值，所以过程不能像精确等同那样可靠地重复进行，就像它们可以使用图灵机一样。 与数字信号处理不同，模拟计算机不受量化噪声的影响，但受模拟噪声的限制。
target_text: Unlike digital signal processing, analog computers are not affected by quantitative noise, but by analogue noise.

source_text: 模拟计算机广泛用于当时数字计算机缺乏足够性能的科学和工业应用中。 模拟计算机可能具有非常广泛的复杂性。 计算尺和诺谟图是最简单的，而海军枪炮控制计算机和大型混合数字/模拟计算机是最复杂的。过程控制和保护继电器系统使用模拟计算来执行控制和保护功能。

target_text: Academic contributions began semiconductor research in 1953, which successfully introduced the crystal-chip electrons theory of thin-film light conductors, making a major contribution to the technological development of China’s early semiconductor devices. There was an in-depth study of the MOS structure and the physics of the Si/Sio2 interface. In 1965, research on integrated circuits began. In the 1980s, the development of successful VLSI chips, such as 2KEPROM, 16K-bit SRAM, and 16-bit microprocessors, was sponsored.
title: 李志堅 (電子學家)

source_text: 2000年5月23日，比利在接受一个电台访谈时透露出碎南瓜打算在年末解散的计划。同时，乐队在录音室里又录制了一张新专辑《Machina II/The Friends and Enemies of Mordern Music》，乐队原本建议維京唱片将该专辑在互联网上供所有购买了《Machina/The machines of God》的听众免费下载。但是这一计划遭到了公司的拒绝，于是乐队决定独立发行这张唱片，同时将唱片的内容全部以mp3的形式公开在互联网上供所有人免费下载。这一举动很快又掀起了一场话题讨论。
target_text: On May 23, 2000, in an interview with a radio station, Billy revealed plans to dismantle pumpkins by the end of the year. At the same time, the band recorded in the studio a new album, Machina II/The Friends and Enemies of Mordern Music, which was originally proposed for the Viking record to be available on the Internet for free download by all listeners who purchased Machina/The Machines of God.
title: The Smashing Pumpkins

source_text: 一开始唐·埃斯特利奇的小组曾经考虑使用IBM 801处理器以及在约克城高地（Yorktown Heights）的IBM研究实验室为该处理器发展的操作系统。801处理器比英特尔的Intel 8088处理器的功能至少强一个数量级，其操作系统比最后入选的微软的DOS操作系统至少先进数年。忽略IBM内部的解决方法使得小组避免了许多可能推延其日程的内部程序过程，大大地降低了其工作困难。但是这个决定的最后对IBM的影响是非常深远的。
target_text: At first, Don Estelic’s team considered operating systems developed for the processor using the IBM 801 processor and the IBM Research Laboratory in Yorktown Heights. The 801 processor had at least one level of functionality higher than the Intel 8088 processor in Intel, and its operating system was at least several years advanced than the last-selected Microsoft DOS operating system. The neglect of solutions within IBM had made it possible for the team to avoid many internal procedural processes that might delay its agenda, greatly reducing its working difficulties. But the final effect of the decision on IBM was very far-reaching.
title: IBM PC

source_text: 最初的IBM个人电脑的ROM里装有Microsoft BASIC。其彩色图形适配器可以使用普通的电视机作为图像输出设备，或者使用单色显示适配器和5151型单色荧光屏。标准存储器是卡式录音带，软盘驱动器可以另外附加，不能使用硬盘。它只有五个扩展槽，使用IBM元件的话最高内存量为256kB，64kB在主机板上，额外的内存可以通过装三块64kB的扩展板装上。微处理器是Intel 8088，执行频率为4.77MHz。通过使用NEC V20作为处理器可以稍微提高其处理速度。通过添加Intel 8087辅助处理器可以提高其数学处理能力。IBM出售的PC一般事先装好了16kB或64kBRAM（采用9、36或16kBDRAM芯片）。后来推出的IBM 5161扩展外壳允许装更多RAM以及装硬盘。最初的IBM PC对于家用市场来说太昂贵，但是在企业中却出其不意地非常成功。IBM PC XT是专门为企业用发展的高级机器。它有8个宽展槽和一块10MB硬盘。64kB DRAM出产后它的主机板可以携256kB内存，后来的模型甚至可以扩展到640kB。一般它出售时装MDA适配器。处理器依然是4.77MHz的Intel 8088，其扩展总线依然是8位的ISA。1984年8月宣布的IBM PC AT使用Intel 80286处理器（一开始6MHz），它的总线是16位的ISA，还有一块20MB的硬盘。1986年引入使用8MHz的较快的型号。IBM试图将它引入多用户电脑市场，但是它主要被需要高速度的电脑用户使用。一开始AT非常不稳定，其主要原因是软件和硬件的不兼容，尤其是其内部的20MB硬盘有问题。当时有人认为IBM的硬盘驱动器是罪魁祸首，也有人认为其硬盘的硬件有问题。
target_text: The initial IBM personal computer ROM contains Microsoft BASIC. Its colored graphic adapter can be used as an image output device using a general television set of 64kB, or a monocolour display adapter and a 5151 mono-colour fluorescent screen. The standard memory is a card tape, and the disk drive can be additionally attached to the hard disk. It has only five extension tanks, with an IBM component with a maximum internal stock of 256kB, 64kB on the mainframe, with additional storage on a three-kHHB8 extension board. The microprocessor is Intel 8088, with an implementation frequency of 4.77 MHz. The use of NEC V20 as a processor can be accompanied by additional hard disks. It can improve its mathematical processing capability by adding the Intel 8087 assistive processor.
title: IBM PC

source_text: 第二代IBM PC PS/2分25型和30型两个模型，模型内各系列以其时钟频率区分。所有IBM PC的软件互相之间兼容，不过并非所有的软件均能够在所有的机器上运行。有些程序的时间控制是专门为一定速度的机器写的。旧程序无法应用新的、高分辨率的显示标准的优点。
target_text: The second generation IBM PC PS/2 has two models of 25 and 30, in which the series is distinguished by their clock frequency. All IBM PC software is compatible with each other, although not all are capable of running on all machines. Some program time controls are specially designed for machines at a certain speed. The old program cannot apply the advantages of new, high-resolution display standards.
title: IBM PC

source_text: 机械式和液压式飞行操纵系统重量较大，需要使用滑轮和曲柄系统仔细布置穿过整个航空器的飞行操纵线系。这两个系统经常需要冗余备份装置，这又进一步增加了重量。此外，这两个系统对处于变化中的空气动力环境只能提供有限的补偿能力，失速、螺旋以及人机耦合振荡等一些危险的飞行特性仍有可能发生。因为这些飞行特性取决于飞机的空气动力和结构特性而非控制系统本身。然而通过使用计算机和电子连接，设计者能够降低航空器重量并提高可靠性。同时使用计算机还可以预防上述危险的飞行特性。
target_text: The heavy weight of mechanical and hydraulic flight manipulation systems requires the use of slider and curved systems to carefully install flight-wiring systems that pass through the aircraft as a whole. These systems often require redundant backup devices, which in turn increase their weight. Moreover, the systems provide only limited compensation for the changing aerodynamic environment, and some dangerous flight characteristics, such as speed loss, spiral and human coupling oscillation, may still occur. These flight characteristics depend on the aerodynamic and structural properties of the aircraft rather than on the control system itself. By using computer and electronic connections, however, designers can reduce the weight of aircraft and increase reliability.
title: 飞行控制系统

source_text: 舉例來說，「判定給定的自然數是否為質數」是一個決定性問題。另一個具體的例子是：「給兩個數字 x 與 y，x 是否可以整除 y？」，此問題依據其 x 與 y 的值可回答是或否。以演算法形式給出的解決決定性問題的方法稱為決策程式（）。對決定性問題「給兩個數字 x 與 y，x 是否可以整除 y？」決策程式將確定 x 是否整除 y。一種這樣的演算法是長除法，如果餘數為 0，則原決定性問題的答案為「是」，否則為「否」。若某決定性問題可以被一些演算法所解決，則稱此問題可決定（）。
target_text: For example, "whether the natural number given is the prime number" is a decisive question. Another specific example is whether "give two numbers x and y, x can be eliminated y?" The question is answered yes or no according to the value of x and y. The solution to a decision in the form of an algorithm is called a decision-making procedure (. If a decision-making question is resolved by a number of algorithms, give two numbers x and y, x can be eliminated y?) the decision-making option will determine whether x is eliminated y. One such calculation is a long-term method, and if the remaining number is 0, the original decision-making question is answered as yes or no. If a decision-making question is resolved by some algorithm, the question is called as a decision-making question ().
title: 決定性問題

source_text: 这里值得重视的是sRGB的设计与当时（1996年）不算理想色彩空间的CRT显示器相匹配。当时大量的专业或者个人电脑软件，使用8位深度的图像文件，并且不经转换就在8位／通道的显示器上显示。许多时髦的非CRT硬件，如LCD、数码相机以及打印机，尽管本身并不生成sRGB曲线，但是都带有补偿电路或者软件以遵循这个标准。在一些高端的专业设备上可能并不遵循这个标准。因此，我们可以假定任何不带颜色配置表或者其它信息的8位图像文件、8位图像API或者设备接口，都处于sRGB色彩空间。
target_text: What is worth noting here is that the SRGB design matched the CRT monitors that were not the ideal colour space at the time (1996). There was a lot of professional or personal computer software, using eight-bit depth image files, and showing them on the eight-bit/channel monitors without conversion. Many of the fashionable non-CRT hardware, such as LCD, digital cameras, and printers, did not produce a sRGB curve per se, but they had either a compensatory circuit or software to follow the standard. This might not be followed on some high-end professional equipment. So we can assume that any eight-digit image file, eight-digit image API or device interface, without colouring a table or other information, is in the SRGB colour space.
title: SRGB色彩空间

source_text: 用其它色彩空间生成的用于因特网的图像在使用合适的图像编辑软件进行编辑的时候可以将它们转换成sRGB，这些软件有Corel Paint Shop Pro以及Adobe Photoshop等等。尽管最初的非sRGB文件可以保存并转换为sRGB，但是由于这个转换过程可能会丢失图像信息，所以建议保存为另外的文件以保存原始的非sRGB图像文件。
target_text: Images generated from other colour spaces for the Internet can be converted to sRGB when edited using the appropriate image editing software, such as Corel Paint Shop Pro and Adobe Photoshop. Although the original non-sRGB files can be saved and converted to sRGB, since this conversion process may lose image information, it is recommended that they be saved as separate files to save the original non-sRGB image files.
title: SRGB色彩空间

source_text: 法国国立计算机及自动化研究院，法文为 Institut national de recherche en informatique et en automatique (简称INRIA)，其重点研究领域为计算机科学，控制理论及应用数学。该研究院於1967年在巴黎附近的罗克库尔创立。INRIA是世界著名的科研机构，其科研实力在世界大学和科研机构的计算机领域中排名前列。在2019年世界顶尖计算机与机器学习学术会议NeurIPS中，Inria的论文录取数在全球大学与科研机构中排名第12位，欧盟区域内第1位。
target_text: The French National Institute of Computers and Automation, in French as the Instituto national de recherche en informatique et en automatique (INRIA), focused on computer science, theoretical control and applied mathematics. The Institute was founded in 1967 in Rockcourt, near Paris. INRIA is the world ' s leading scientific research institution in the computer field of universities and scientific institutions. In the 2019 NeurIPS, the world ' s leading computer science and machine learning academic conference, Inria ranked 12th in global universities and scientific institutions and first in the European Union region.
title: 法国国家信息与自动化研究所

source_text: Tango桌面计划致力于为用户提供更为一致的图形界面体验。而波特兰计划是为了让独立软件提供者更容易移植桌面应用到不同的Linux桌面，该计划的目标是使软件开发者不必过多考虑发行版的桌面环境，从而开发出更通用的Linux桌面应用，正如Microsoft Windows和Mac OS X的桌面应用一样，而不是更面向某一特定的桌面环境，比如KDE或GNOME。
target_text: The Tango Desktop Plan is aimed at providing users with a more consistent graphic interface experience. The Portland Plan is designed to make it easier for independent software providers to apply desktops to different Linux desktops. The objective of the plan is for software developers to develop more generic Linux desktop applications, as is the case for Microsoft Windows and Mac OS X, rather than more oriented towards a particular desktop environment, such as KDE or GNOME.
title: 波特兰计划

target_text: Many companies that focus on CAD data conversion provide data formats for converting a CAD data format into another CAD system. These systems have their own pre-processed intermediate format, and some systems can also review data during the conversion. Some can work alone, while others need to install two CAD packages for reading and writing data on the same machine because of the programming interface of the CAD system.

source_text:
飞机通信寻址与报告系统机载设备由一个终端和一个路由器组成。终端是ACARS消息下传的起点和上传的终点。MU/CMU是一个路由器。它的功能是通过空地网络提供最便捷的下传路由。大多数情况下，MU/CMU也作为AOC消息的终端使用。
典型的终端系统有飞行管理系统，数据链打印机，维护计算机，还有驾驶舱终端。其应用包括：
FMS - 发送飞行计划更改请求，位置报告等。接收清场及控制塔台指令。
打印机 - 定位并自动打印一条上传消息。
维护计算机 - 下载诊断消息。在一些系统里，地面工程师甚至可以通过数据链消息引导飞行员进行空中故障分析及排除。
客舱终端 - 通常用于空中乘务员和有特定需求的乘客之间的交流，通知分发餐饮以及登机门变更等。
target_text: In most cases, MU/CMU is also used as a terminal for AOC messages. Typical terminal systems include flight management systems, data chain printers, maintenance of computers, and cockpit terminals. Applications include: FMS - sending flight plan change requests, location reports, etc., receiving clearance and control tower instructions. Printers - positioning and automatically printing an upload message. Maintenance of computers - downloading diagnostics. In some systems, ground engineers can even direct pilots to air failure analysis and removal through data chain messages.
title: 飞机通信寻址与报告系统

source_text: 行動硬碟（）也就是可攜式儲存裝置，原是用於筆記型電腦的專用小型硬碟，由於其輕便、易於攜帶的特色，也用於不同電腦之間傳送文件。另外普通的電腦硬碟通過硬碟盒或其他轉換接口設備，也能做到行動硬碟的效果。通常采用USB接口与计算机连接，现也有以eSATA、USB 3.0（A/B以及最新的C型）、ThunderBolt（MiniDP、USB-C連接埠）接口与计算机接入的。
target_text: Operational hard disks (i.e. portable storage devices), which are designed for laptop computers and which are easy to carry, as well as for the transport of documents between different computers. Common computer hard disks can also be used for mobile hard disks through hard disks or other switching interfaces. USB interfaces are usually used to connect to computers, and interfaces with computers are now available in eSATA, USB 3.0 (A/B and the latest C), ThunderBolt (MiniDP, USB-C connect ports).
title: 移动硬盘

source_text: 蛋白质微阵列（，亦称为蛋白质芯片）是一种高通量方法，用于跟踪蛋白质的相互作用和活性，并确定它们的功能，并大规模确定的功能。 它的主要优势在于可以并行跟踪大量蛋白质。 该芯片由载玻片、硝酸纤维素膜、珠子或微量滴定板等支持表面组成，捕获蛋白阵列结合到该支持表面上。通常用荧光染料标记的探针分子被添加到阵列中。 探针和固定化蛋白质之间的任何反应都会发出荧光信号，激光扫描仪可以读取该信号。蛋白质微阵列是快速、自动化、经济且高度灵敏，消耗少量样品和试剂。
target_text: The main advantage of the protein microbarrel (also known as the protein chip) is that it is a high flux method for tracking the interaction and activity of proteins and for determining their functions and for determining large-scale functions. source_text: 高级内容访问系统（）是内容分发、数字版权管理标准，用来限制访问和复制光盘DVD内容。该规范于2005年4月公开发布，该标准已被用作HD DVD和Blu ray Disc（BD）的访问限制方案。它是由AACS授权管理开发有限责任公司（AACS LA）开发。这个公司包括迪士尼、英特尔、微软、松下、华纳兄弟公司、IBM、东芝和索尼等公司。AACS一直是一个“临时协议”，因为最终的规范（包括拷贝管理规定）尚未最后确定。自从2006年后，几个AACS解密密钥已被从软件播放器中提取并公布在网上，导致破解者可以使用未授权的软件解密内容。
target_text: The advanced content access system () is content distribution, digital copyright management standards, which are used to restrict access to and reproduction of DVD content. The regulation was published publicly in April 2005 and has been used as a HD DVD and Blue Ray Disc (BD) access limitation programme. It was developed by AACS Limited Liability Corporation (AACS LA). This company includes Disney, Intel, Microsoft, Matsu, Warner Brothers, IBM, Toshigi and Sony. The AACS has been a “provisional agreement” since the final regulation (including copy management provisions) has not yet been finalized. Since 2006, several AACS decryption keys have been extracted from software players and posted online, leading to the use of unauthorised software decrying content by crackers.

source_text: 关联规则学习（）是一种在大型数据库中发现变量之间的有趣性关系的方法。它的目的是利用一些有趣性的量度来识别数据库中发现的强规则。 基于强规则的概念，Rakesh Agrawal等人引入了关联规则以发现由超市的POS系统记录的大批交易数据中产品之间的规律性。例如，从销售数据中发现的规则 {洋葱, 土豆}→{汉堡} 会表明如果顾客一起买洋葱和土豆，他们也有可能买汉堡的肉。此类信息可以作为做出促销定价或产品-{zh-cn:植入;zh-tw:置入;}-等营销活动决定的根据。除了上面中的例子以外， 关联规则如今还被用在许多应用领域中，包括、入侵检测、及生物信息学中。与相比，关联规则学习通常不考虑在事务中、或事务间的项目的顺序。

source_text:
定义
“聚类(clustering)”的概念不能精确定义，这也是为什么聚类算法众多的原因之一。 聚类问题的共同点就是有一组数据对象。 然而，不同的研究人员采用不同的聚类模型，并且对于这些聚类模型中的每一个，可以再给出不同的算法。 而且不同算法发现的“类（簇）”在其属性上往往会有很大差异。 理解这些“聚类模型”是理解各种算法之间差异的关键。 典型的聚类模型包括以下几种：
target_text: The notion of “clustering” cannot be defined precisely, and this is one of the reasons why there are many kinds of cluster algorithms. The common denominator of cluster issues is that there is a set of data objects.
title: 聚类分析

source_text: 连通性模型：例如，层次聚类基于距离连通性构建模型。质心模型：例如，k-means 算法用单个均值向量表示每个类。分布模型：聚类过程使用统计分布建模，例如期望最大化算法使用的多元正态分布。密度模型：例如，DBSCAN 和 OPTICS 将聚类定义为数据空间中相连接的密集区域。
target_text: Connectivity models: For example, layers are based on distance connectivity construction models. Quality models: for example, the k-men algorithm uses individual mean vectors for each class. Distribution models: cluster processes use statistical distribution modelling, for example, multiple normal distributions expected to be maximized. Density models: for example, DBSCAN and OPTICS define clusters as connected dense areas in data space.
title: 聚类分析

source_text: 子空间模型：在双聚类（也称为共聚类或双模式聚类）中，聚类是用聚类成员和相关属性建模的。组模型：这些算法不为其结果提供改进的模型，只提供分组信息。基于图的模型：团(clique)，即图中节点的子集，子集中的每两个节点都由一条边连接，可以被认为是聚类的原型形式。 与 HCS 聚类算法一样，放宽完全连通性的要求（一部分边可能会丢失）被称为”准团”。
target_text: Subspatial models: In two clusters (also referred to as conglomerates or bimodal clusters), clusters are modeled using cluster members and associated attributes. Cluster models: these algorithms do not provide improved models for their results, but only group information. Models based on graphs: groups (clique), a subset of nodes in graphs, each of which is connected by one side and can be considered as a prototype form of clusters. Like HCS cluster algorithms, easing the requirement of complete connectivity (some of which may be lost) is referred to as a “sub-group”.
title: 聚类分析

source_text: 没有客观上“正确”的聚类算法，但正如人们所指出的，“聚类在观察者的眼中”。除非你有喜欢一个聚类模型而不是另一个的数学原因，通常需要通过实验选择最适合特定问题的聚类算法。为一种模型设计的算法通常会在包含完全不同类型模型的数据集上失败。 例如，k-means 无法找到非凸簇。
target_text: There is no objective "right" cluster algorithm, but, as has been pointed out, "clusters are in the eyes of the observers." Unless you like a cluster model rather than another mathematical reason, it is usually necessary to try to select a cluster algorithm that is best suited to a particular problem. The algorithms designed for a model typically fail on data sets that contain completely different types of models.
title: 聚类分析

source_text:
连通性聚类
基于连通性的聚类，也称为层次聚类，其核心思想是对象与附近对象的相关性高于与较远对象的相关性。 这些算法根据它们的距离将“对象”连接起来形成“簇”。 集群可以主要通过连接集群各部分所需的最大距离来描述。 在不同的距离，会形成不同的聚类，这可以用树状图表示，这解释了通用名称“层次聚类”的来源：这些算法不提供数据集的单一分区，而是提供广泛的层次结构 在一定距离处相互合并的簇。 在树状图中，y 轴标记集群合并的距离，而对象沿 x 轴放置，这样集群就不会混合。
target_text: These algorithms link “objects” to more distant objects depending on their distance. Clusters can be described mainly through the maximum distance required to connect each part of the cluster. At different distances, they form different clusters, which can be expressed in tree charts, which explain the source of the generic name “hierarchical clusters”: these algorithms do not provide a single partition of the datasets, but rather a broad layer structure that combines one another at a certain distance.
title: 聚类分析

source_text: 已知优化问题本身是 NP问题（NP困 难），因此常用的方法是只搜索近似解。 一个特别著名的近似方法是 Lloyd 算法， 通常简称为“k-means 算法”（尽管另一个算法引入了这个名称）。 然而，它确实只能找到局部最优值，并且通常会使用不同的随机初始化运行多次。 k-means 的变体通常包括这样的优化，例如选择多次运行中的最佳者，但也将质心限制为数据集的成员（k-medoids），选择中位数（k-medians 聚类），不太随机地选择初始中心（ k-means++) 或允许模糊聚类分配 (fuzzy c-means)。
target_text: One particularly well-known approximation method is the Lloyd algorithm, commonly referred to as the “k-mens algorithm” (although this name has been introduced by another algorithm). However, it does find only the best local value, and often runs several times using different random initializations. K-mens variants typically include such optimization, such as selecting the best person in multiple operations, but also limiting the quality to the members of the dataset (k-medouds), selecting the median (k-medians cluster), choosing the initial centre (k-méans+) or allowing the blurring cluster distribution (fuzzy c-mens).
title: 聚类分析

source_text: 大多数 k-means 类型的算法都需要预先指定聚类的数量 - k，这被认为是这些算法的最大缺点之一。 此外，算法更喜欢大小大致相似的簇，因为它们总是会将对象分配给最近的质心。 这通常会导致错误地切割集群边界（这并不奇怪，因为该算法优化的是集群中心，而不是集群边界）。
target_text: Moreover, algorithms prefer roughly similar sizes, as they always assign objects to the nearest quality. This usually leads to the wrong cutting of cluster boundaries (not surprisingly, because the algorithm optimizes cluster centres rather than cluster boundaries).
title: 聚类分析

source_text: DBSCAN 和 OPTICS 的主要缺点是它们期望某种密度下降来检测簇边界。 例如，在具有重叠高斯分布（人工数据中的常见用例）的数据集上，这些算法生成的聚类边界通常看起来很随意，因为聚类密度不断降低。 在由高斯混合组成的数据集上，这些算法几乎总是优于能够精确建模此类数据的 EM 聚类等方法。
target_text: For example, in data sets with overlapping Gaussian distributions (commonly used in manual data), these algorithms often generate cluster boundaries that appear randomly, because of decreasing concentration. In data sets made up of Gaussian blends, these algorithms are almost always preferable to methods such as EM clusters, which can accurately model such data.
title: 聚类分析

source_text: 数据聚类算法可以分为结构性或者分散性。结构性算法利用以前成功使用过的聚类器进行分类，而分散型算法则是一次确定所有分类。结构性算法可以从上至下或者从下至上双向进行计算。从下至上算法从每个对象作为单独分类开始，不断融合其中相近的对象。而从上至下算法则是把所有对象作为一个整体分类，然后逐渐分小。
target_text: The grouping of data algorithms can be structured or dispersed. Structural algorithms use previously successfully used clusters to classify, while the decentralized algorithms determine all classifications at once. Structural algorithms can be calculated from the top to the bottom or from the bottom to the bottom. Bottom to the top algorithms integrate objects that are close to each object from the bottom to the bottom.
title: 聚类分析

source_text: 分散式聚类算法，是一次性确定要产生的类别，这种算法也已应用于从下至上聚类算法。基于密度的聚类算法，是为了挖掘有任意形状特性的类别而发明的。此算法把一个类别视为数据集中大于某阈值的一个区域。DBSCAN和OPTICS是两个典型的算法。许多聚类算法在执行之前，需要指定从输入数据集中产生的分类个数。除非事先准备好一个合适的值，否则必须决定一个大概值，关于这个问题已经有一些现成的技术。
target_text: The decentralized cluster algorithm is a one-time determination of the categories to be generated, and this algorithm has also been applied to the bottom-up cluster algorithm. A cluster algorithm based on density is invented to dig out categories with any shape characteristics. This algorithm considers a category as an area where data concentration is greater than a certain threshold. DBSCAN and OPTICS are two typical algorithms. Before many cluster algorithms are implemented, it is necessary to specify the number of classifications generated from input data concentration. Unless a suitable value is prepared in advance, a generic value has to be determined, and there are already some off-the-shelf techniques on this issue.
title: 聚类分析

source_text:
概念聚类分散性聚类K-均值法及衍生算法K-均值法聚类K-均值算法表示以空间中k个点为中心进行聚类，对最靠近他们的对象归类。例如：数据集合为三维，聚类以两点：X =(x1, x2, x3),Y =(y1, y2, y3)。中心点Z变为Z =(z1, z2, z3)，其中z1 = (x1 + y1)/2，z2 = (x2 + y2)/2，z3 = (x3 + y3)/2。算法归纳为（J. MacQueen, 1967）：

任意产生k个聚类，然后确定聚类中心，或者直接生成k个中心。
对每个点确定其聚类中心点。
再计算其聚类新中心。
重复以上步骤直到满足收敛要求。（通常就是确定的中心点不再改变。）

source_text: 表现层状态转换（英语：，縮寫：REST）是博士于2000年在他的博士论文中提出来的一种万维网软件架构风格，目的是便于不同软件/程序在网络（例如互联网）中互相传递信息。表現層狀態轉換是根基於超文本傳輸協定（HTTP）之上而確定的一組約束和屬性，是一種設計提供全球資訊網絡服務的軟體構建風格。符合或相容於這種架構風格（簡稱為 REST 或 RESTful）的網絡服務，允許用戶端發出以統一資源標識符存取和操作網絡資源的請求，而與預先定義好的無狀態操作集一致化。因此表現層狀態轉換提供了在互聯網絡的計算系統之間，彼此資源可交互使用的協作性質（interoperability）。相對於其它種類的網絡服務，例如SOAP服務，則是以本身所定義的操作集，來存取網絡上的資源。
target_text: Performance-level change (English: Acronym: REST) is a Web-based software architecture style proposed by a doctor in his doctoral dissertation in 2000 to allow different software/procedures to transmit information to one another on the web (e.g. the Internet). Performance-level change is a set of bindings and attributes that are based on the hypertext transfer protocol (HTTP) and is a software architecture designed to provide global information network services. Consistency with or compatibility with the network service (known as RRT or RESTful) allows users to send one source-of-source access to and operation of network resources, but consistent with predefined innocuous operations.
title: 表现层状态转换

由于线性方程组的求解是一个非常普遍的问题，在多年的科学与工程实践中，科学家和工程师们积累很多高效率的线性方程组求解器，例如：LAPACK、BLAS等。这些软件中，许多可以可以在NetLib 免费获得。LAPACK和BLAS在大多数Linux的发行版本中都已经预装。目前LAPACK有Fortran（包括90和77版本）、C、C++等几个语言的版本。利用LAPACK和BLAS中的子程序，Matlab 对这些线性方程组求解器进行封装。用户不需要选择求解器的类型和问题的类型，Matlab可以根据对矩阵的分析自动选择合适的求解器。
target_text: Since the resolution of linear equations is a very common problem, scientists and engineers have accumulated a number of efficient linear equation solvers in many years of scientific and engineering practice, such as: LAPANK, BLAS, etc. Many of these software are available free of charge in NetLib. Using the subsystems in LAPACK and BLAS, Matlab covers these linear equation solvers. 20世纪末，因为在光通讯方面拥有的绝对优势，由互联网热潮导致的互联网建设狂潮使得很多公司纷纷到北电下订单。2000年，其网络设备销售额由90年代中期的100亿美元达到了登峰造极的300亿美元，这样的订单数量使得北电在短期内积累了大量财富，并促使北电四处收购其他公司。紧接着，互联网的泡沫来临，数万家互联网公司一夜之间倒闭，他们不肯履约的订单导致了北电总价值超过40亿美元的产品积压，而电信运营商不再像以前那样大举购买设备，这些事件使得北电遭受了极大损失。

主要特性
文本存储：DokuWiki通过txt文件存储页面，不需要数据库。
版本控制：DokuWiki存储每一个Wiki页面的所有版本，允许用户比较当前版本和任何历史版本。使用了和MediaWiki类似的差异引擎（比较版本间的差异的软件）。通过计时锁定机制，可以防止不同用户编辑同一个页面时产生冲突。2012年1月发布的新版中，加入了媒体文件版本控制。
访问控制：访问控制可以通过用户管理程序完成，用户管理程序允许定义用户和用户组，以及定义访问控制列表，其中管理员用户可以定义页面和名字空间级别的权限。
插件：DokuWiki具有一个通用的插件接口，这个接口简化插件的开发和维护的过程。目前已经有超过100个可用的插件。管理员用户在插件管理程序的帮助下可以很容易地集成和管理这些插件。
模板：Wiki的外观可以自定义。开发社群已经提供了许多不同的模板。
国际化和本地化：DokuWiki全面支持Unicode（UTF-8），所以可以显示如中文，泰文或希伯来文等语言。目前DokuWiki的界面已经有约40种语言。
缓存：DokuWiki存储Wiki页面渲染后的的输出，以减少服务器的负载。
全文检索：DokuWiki集成有一个索引搜索引擎，用户可以在Wiki上搜索关键字。
没有所見即所得的编辑器：DokuWiki不提供所见即所得的编辑器，但有提供编辑工具条和预览。

source_text: Internet协议IPv4，ICMP，UDP以及TCP都使用同样的16位反码检验和算法。虽然大多数计算机缺少“循环进位”硬件，但是这种额外的复杂性是可以接受的，因为“对于所有位（bit）位置上的错误都是同样敏感的”。 在UDP中，全0表示省略了可选的检验和特性。另外一种表示：FFFF，指示了0的检验和。 （在IPv4中，TCP和ICMP都强制性地规定了检验和，而在IPv6中可以省略）。
target_text: The Internet protocol IPv4, ICMP, UDP, and TCP all use the same 16-digit antitrust tests and algorithms. Although most computers lack “circle introspection” hardware, this additional complexity is acceptable because “the error on all bits of position is equally sensitive.” In UDP, full zero enumerates the optional tests and characteristics. Another expression is: #, the 0 tests and. (In IPv4, TCP and ICMP are mandatory for testing and certification, while in IPv6, it can be omitted.)
title: 有符號數處理

Drafts and working papers should not be considered as officially published standards.

source_text: 网络附接存储（，缩写：）是一种文件级（与块级存储相对）的计算机数据存储服务器，它连接到计算机网络，并提供对异构网络用户的数据访问。它专门用于通过其硬件、软件或配置来提供文件服务。它通常作为专门制造的专用计算机设备制造。 NAS系统是包含一个或多个通常排列成逻辑存储器、冗余存储器或RAID存储驱动器的网络设备。NAS消除了从网络上的其他服务器提供文件服务的负担，它们通常使用网络文件共享协议（如NFS、SMB或AFP）提供对文件的访问。作为一种在多台计算机之间共享文件的便捷方法，NAS设备从1990年代中期开始开始流行起来。与同样提供文件服务的通用服务器相比，专用网络附加存储的潜在优势包括更快的数据访问、更简单的管理和简单的配置。
target_text: The NAS system is a network device that contains one or more of the most commonly arranged logical storages, redundant storages, or RAID storage drives. NAS removes the burden of providing document services from other servers on the network, which usually provide access to documents using network document sharing protocols (e.g. NFS, SMB or AFP). As an easy method of sharing documents between multiple computers, NAS equipment has become popular since the mid-1990s. The potential advantages of dedicated network additional storage include faster access to data, simpler management and simpler configurations compared to common servers that provide the same documentation services.
title: 网络附接存储

生平

He worked nine years at Sun Microsystems, left in senior management positions, partnered with BEA Systems Ltd. in 1995 and served as president, chief executive officer and chairman of the board of directors of the company. source_text: ZigBee协议是由ZigBee联盟制定的无线通信标准，该联盟成立于2001年8月。2002年下半年，英国Invensys公司、日本三菱电气公司、美国摩托罗拉公司以及荷兰飞利浦半导体公司共同宣布加入ZigBee联盟，研发名为“ZigBee”的下一代无线通信标准，这一事件成为该技术发展过程中的里程碑。ZigBee联盟现有的理事公司包括BM Group，Ember公司，飞思卡尔半导体，Honeywell，三菱电机，摩托罗拉，飞利浦，三星电子，西门子，及德州仪器。ZigBee联盟的目的是为了在全球统一标准上实现简单可靠、价格低廉、功耗低、无线连接的监测和控制产品进行合作，并于2004年12月发布了第一个正式标准。
target_text: The ZigBee agreement, a wireless communication standard developed by the ZigBee Alliance, was established in August 2001. In late 2002, British Invensys, Mitsubishi Electric, Japan, Motorola, United States, and Philips Halfconductor, Netherlands, jointly announced their participation in the ZigBee Alliance, which developed the next generation of wireless communication standards called “ZigBee,” a milestone in the development of the technology. The ZigBee Alliance’s existing governing companies, including BM Group, Ember, Fascar Semiconductor, Honeywell, Mitsubishi Electrics, Motorola, Philips, Tristar Electronics, Siemens, and German state instruments, were designed to cooperate on simple, low-cost, low-cost, wireless surveillance and control products for global harmonization of standards, and issued the first formal standard in December 2004.
title: ZigBee

source_text:
所有的颜色表示都转换成一种内部的色彩表示，这个变换过程是完全可逆的，因此使用合适的不同量化器可以实现有损或者无损数据压缩。压缩算法
JPEG XR使用一个可逆的色彩空间变换、一个可逆的重叠双正交变换以及一个非算数熵编码机制，这样可以非常高效地保存高频率的图像数据，使得这个算法能够在高压缩率的情况下保持很好的图像质量。JPEG XR按照16x16的块处理图像。
target_text: All colour expressions are converted into an internal colour expression, which is completely reversible, so a suitable different quantifyer can achieve either impaired or non-destructive data compression. The compression algorithm JPEG XR uses a reversible colour space transformation, a reversible double-orthodox conversion and a non-calculating entropy encoded mechanism that allows very efficient preservation of high-frequency image data, allowing the algorithm to maintain a good image quality with a high compression rate. JPEG XR processes images according to 16x16 blocks.
title: JPEG XR

source_text: 如果申请专利的化合物包括几个马库什群组，则其包括的可能的化合物数量也许会非常大。没有哪个专利数据库能产生所有可能的排列并且为它们进行索引。专利研究者在寻找特定的化学药品，以试图找到所有具有包括该化学药品的马库什结构的专利，即使这些专利的索引不包括适合的特定的化合物的时，会有这样的问题。这就是为什么能够寻找化学子结构的数据库是不必可少的原因。
target_text: If the patented compounds include several groups of Markushes, the number of possible compounds may be very large. No patent database produces all possible rankings and indexes for them. Patent researchers are looking for specific chemicals to try to find all patents with the Makush structure, including that chemical, even if the indexes do not include specific compounds.
title: 权利要求

source_text:
互聯網訂餐
2015年起，部分铁路局与网络平台合作，推出利用互联网订餐的服务。重庆客运段、西安客运段推出微信订餐服务。上海铁路局华铁旅服于2017年1月13日正式上线饿了么App，在运行初期可以提供共25趟列车。2017年7月17日，27个于各省会及计划单列市所在地的车站开始试点G/D/C字头动车组列车互联网订餐服务，乘客可通过中国铁路客户服务中心网站或手机客户端预订沿途车站餐厅供应的社会品牌餐食，此类餐食预订服务于2018年1月18日增加沿线车站地方特产预订功能，订餐时限由2小时缩短为1小时。2020年9月10日，南京站开始对普速旅客列车提供互联网订餐服务。
target_text: On 17 July 2017, 27 stations in the provincial capitals and in the planned city of single-barrel began piloting the G/D/C front-loaded train order service, and passengers were able to book social brand meals via the China Railway Clients Service Centre ' s website or mobile phone clients. The reservation service increased the local speciality booking function along the station by 18 January 2018, with a reduced duration of 2 hours to 1 hour.
title: 鐵路便當

source_text: 在2011年2月8日发布的安全公告KB967940中,微软对Windows自动运行功能进行了最新升级，限定Windows XP、Windows Server 2003、Vista和Windows Server 2008平台上的自动运行功能仅支持CD和DVD媒体。当用户使用包含autorun.inf文件的USB设备、网络共享或其它非CD/DVD媒体时，系统不会执行自动运行。安装此次更新后，当插入USB设备时，用户不会收到程序安装的提示对话框，用户需要手动打开文件夹找到安装文件，然后双击安装软件。不过，在连接至计算机时，有些USB的固件会让系统将其识别为CD，那么本次针对AutoRun的升级就对它们无效了。
target_text: In a security bulletin, KB967940, issued on 8 February 2011, Microsoft updated the Windows Automated Operation functionality, limiting the automatic running functionality on Windows XP, Windows Server 2003, Vista and Windows Server 2008 platform to support only CD and DVD media. When users use USB devices, network sharing or other non-CD/DVD media containing autorun. When this update is installed, the user will not receive a hint dialogue box for program installation, and the user will manually open the folder to find installed files and then double-click to install the software. However, when connecting to a computer, some USB solids will allow the system to recognize them as CDs, and this upgrade to AutoRun will not be effective.
title: AutoRun

source_text:
履历
托尼1973年出身于芝加哥，在圣地亚哥州立大学获计算机科学学士学位，斯坦福大学获计算机科学硕士学位。曾在美國海軍陸戰隊服役，接受侦查狙击、监控与目标获取训练。拥有中尉军衔，在进入反恐局前是一名系统分析师。家庭
托尼的妻子是他在反恐局的同事米歇尔·戴斯勒（Michelle Dessler）。
target_text: Born in Chicago in 1973, Tony was awarded a bachelor's degree in computer science at Santiago State University and a master's degree in computer science at Stanford University. He served in the United States Marine Corps and was trained to detect snipers, monitor and target acquisition.
title: 東尼·艾美達

source_text: 2011年，ARM的客户报告79亿ARM处理器出货量，占有95%的智能手机、90%的硬盘驱动器、40%的数字电视和机上盒、15%的微控制器、和20%的移动电脑。在2012年，微软与ARM科技生产新的Surface平板电脑，AMD宣布它将于2014年开始生产基于ARM核心的64位元服务器芯片，2016年，日本富士通公司宣布“京”超级计算机的後繼機種将采用ARM架构，該超級電腦於2019年5月定名為「富岳」，2020年6月於TOP500奪冠。
target_text: In 2011, ARM clients reported the arrival of 79 billion ARM processors, with 95% of smart phones, 90% of hard drive drives, 40% of digital televisions and machine boxes, 15% of microcontrols, and 20% of mobile computers. In 2012, Microsoft and ARM technology produced a new Surface tablet, and AMD announced that it would start producing 64-bit microchips based on the ARM core in 2014. In 2016, Japan's Fujito Corporation announced that the ARM successor to the “Kyo” supercomputer would be introduced to the ARM architecture, which was named “Fu” in May 2019 and won in June 2020 at TOP 500.
title: ARM架構

source_text: 電子遊戲：在電子設備平台上運行的交互游戏。單機遊戲（Single-player game）：一般指僅一台設備獨立運作的電子遊戲或電腦遊戲。網路遊戲：又稱線上遊戲，簡稱網遊，指通過互聯網提供的遊戲產品和服務。主機遊戲：以電視屏幕為顯示器，在電視上進行交互的電子遊戲。掌機遊戲：便攜的小型專門遊戲機上運行的電子遊戲。客户端网络游戏：簡稱端遊，指通过客户端软件进行的网络游戏。家庭游戏机：提给游戏娱乐内容，以家庭成员为主要游戏对象，以家居环境为场合，以电视为输出对象的专门计算设备。手機遊戲：又称手持移动端游戏，简称手游，在手持移动终端上运行的电子游戏。网页游戏：简称页游，通过网页浏览器运行，不需要安装任何客户端软件的电子游戏。2D游戏：使用二维交互方式，通常无法切换视角的电子游戏。3D游戏：使用空间立体技术实现操作的电子游戏。3A游戏：高成本、高体量和高质量的电子游戏。回合制游戏：游戏角色在游戏中相互交替操作的电子游戏。即时制游戏：游戏参与者在游戏中各自操作，结果即时展现的电子游戏。動作遊戲（Action Game，簡稱ACT）：玩家控制的遊戲角色，能做出移動、攻擊、閃避等反應動作，強調玩家的反應能力和手眼協調能力的電子遊戲。競技遊戲：在遊戲平台上的對戰遊戲，如射擊、策略等電子遊戲。
target_text: Electronic game: An interactive game running on an electronic design platform. A single game (Single-player game): is generally a stand-alone video game or computer game. A network game: also a cable game, short-title webwalking, is a specialized computing device provided through the Internet. A home game: an interactive video game with a television screen. A hands-on game: an electronic game running on a mobile terminal.
title: 電子遊戲術語列表

source_text:
法律用语
游戏批准文号：又称游戏批文号，指根据中国大陆相关规定，经相关部门审核发布，批准游戏上线运营的批准文件号。
国际标准书号：简称ISBN，是國際通用的圖書或獨立出版物代碼，也適用於電子遊戲出版。
游戏版号：指中国大陆主管部分批准相关游戏出版运营的批文号，包括游戏的批准文号和国际标准书号。
增值电信业务经营许可证（Internet Content Provider License，简称ICP）：根据《互联网信息服务管理办法》规定，中国大陆对提供互联网信息服务的供应商实行许可证制度，是游戏上线运营的必须资质之一。
防沉迷措施：中华人民共和国为了防止未成年人沉迷网络游戏而要求游戏开发营运商设计并运用的一套措施。
屏蔽词：又称过滤词，在网络游戏中屏蔽显示的词汇。
健康游戏忠告（Healthy Gaming Advice，简称HGA）：中国大陆规定游戏出版物需要在显著的位置标示的标语：「抵制不良游戏，拒绝盗版游戏。 注意自我保护，谨防受骗上当。 适度游戏益脑，沉迷游戏伤身。 合理安排时间，享受健康生活。」。
target_text: International standard number: ISBN, an international graphic or stand-alone publication code, also suitable for electronic video games. Game number: The People’s Republic of China partially approves the approval of a batch number for the publication of related games, including the approval of games and international standard number. Value-added telecommunications business licence (Internet Consult Provider License, or ICP): The licensing system for providers of Internet information services under the Internet Information Service Management Scheme is one of the required qualifications for the operation of online games.
title: 電子遊戲術語列表

source_text:
捐獻
文鼎科技於1999年捐贈了四套字型予開源軟件社群：文鼎PL细上海宋（繁體Big5碼）、文鼎PL中楷（繁體Big5碼）、文鼎PL简报宋（簡體GB碼）、文鼎PL简中楷（簡體GB碼，即是繁簡宋楷齊備）。後經加入點陣字及改進成uming及ukai，已包括在各大Linux發行版。这些字体所用的《文鼎公众授权书（1999年版本）》獲自由软件基金会承认为自由软件许可。
target_text: In 1999, literature donated four sets of fonts to open-source communities: PL-Shanghai (Big 5 Code), PL-L-L-L (Big 5 Code), PL-P-L-P-L-P-L-P-L-L-L-L-L-L-L-L-L-L in 1999, which was later added to the list and adapted to uming and ukai, which were published in Linux, the Free Software Foundation recognized as free software.
title: 文鼎科技

source_text: 卡巴斯基于1965年出生在苏联新罗西斯克，1987年毕业于密码学、电信与计算机科学研究所，获得数学工程与计算机技术学位。1989年，他工作的电脑感染了，于是他开发了一个程序将其成功删除，这引起了他对IT安全领域的兴趣。在他的帮助下，卡巴斯基实验室通过安全研究和销售产品不断成长。他在2007年成为卡巴斯基实验室首席执行官并担任至今。
target_text: Cabas obtained a degree in mathematics engineering and computer technology based on his birth in 1965 in neo-Rosisk, the Soviet Union, and in 1987 he graduated from the Institute of cryptology, Telecommunications and Computer Science. In 1989, the computer he worked on was infected, and he developed a program to remove it, which raised his interest in the area of IT security. With his help, the Kabaski Laboratory grew up through safety research and the sale of products. He became Chief Executive Officer of the Kabaski Laboratory in 2007 and has served as Chief Executive Officer of the Kabaski Laboratory to date.
title: 尤金·卡巴斯基

source_text: 卡巴斯基16岁进入由俄罗斯军方和克格勃赞助的密码学、电信与计算机科学研究所，开始了为期5年的学习（当时，俄罗斯最负盛名的几个数学学校都由克格勃赞助）。他于1987年毕业，获得数学工程和计算机技术学位。毕业后，卡巴斯基在苏联军方担任软件工程师。1987年，他在克格勃度假区舍维尔斯寇叶（Severskoye）遇到了后来成为其第一任妻子的娜塔莉亚·卡巴斯基。
target_text: Kabaski began five years of study at the age of 16 at the Institute of cryptology, Telecommunications and Computer Science, sponsored by the Russian military and the KGB (when several of Russia's most famous mathematics schools were sponsored by the KGB). He graduated from his degree in mathematics engineering and computer technology in 1987. After graduation, Kabaski worked as a software engineer in the Soviet military. In 1987, he met Natalia Kabaski, later his first wife, in the KGB resort, Severskoye.
title: 尤金·卡巴斯基

source_text:
创立
尤金·卡巴斯基对IT安全的兴趣始于1989年，在为国防部工作时，他的电脑被感染。在研究了病毒的工作原理后，他编写了一个程序将其删除。后来，他不断发现新的病毒并开发反制软件，以此为爱好。早期的卡巴斯基反病毒软件只有40个病毒定义，主要给朋友使用。
target_text: The creation of Eugene Kabasky's interest in IT security began in 1989, when his computer was infected while working for the Ministry of Defence. After studying the working principles of the virus, he developed a program to remove it. Later, he discovered new viruses and developed anti-commodity software as a hobby. Early Kabaski anti-virus software had only 40 definitions, mainly for friends.
title: 尤金·卡巴斯基

source_text: 1991年，卡巴斯基的服役期提前结束，他离开国防部，去了一家私营公司KAMI的信息技术中心工作，以便全力投入他的防病毒产品的开发。他和同事改进了软件，于1992年发布为一个名为Antiviral Toolkit Pro的产品。起初，每月大约有10个客户购买软件，客户主要是乌克兰和俄罗斯的公司，他每月能赚100美元。卡巴斯基未来的妻子娜塔莉亚·卡巴斯基当时在KAMI和他是同事。
target_text: In 1991, Kabaski ended his tour of duty early, leaving the Ministry of Defence and working at an information technology centre in a private company, KAMI, in order to devote himself fully to the development of his antiviral products. He and his colleagues improved the software and published it in 1992 for an Antiiviral Toolkit Pro. Initially, about 10 clients purchased the software each month, mainly Ukrainian and Russian companies, and he was able to earn $100 a month.
title: 尤金·卡巴斯基

source_text: 1994年，德国汉堡大学在对杀毒软件的竞争分析中把卡巴斯基的软件列为第一名。这使得卡巴斯基有了更多来自欧洲和美国的业务。3年后，卡巴斯基与妻子和朋友创立了卡巴斯基实验室。娜塔莉亚任CEO，尤金为研究主管。次年，CIH病毒（又名切尔诺贝利病毒）为卡巴斯基的反病毒产品创造了契机，卡巴斯基称这是当时唯一可以清除此病毒的软件。据《连线》报道，“他们的软件当时十分先进”。例如，它是第一个允许内网安全软件的用户观察恶意软件在隔离的沙箱中运行的软件。
target_text: Three years later, Kabaski and his wife and friends created the Kabaski Laboratory. Natalia became CEO, Eugene as research director. The next year, the CIH virus (also known as the Chernobyl virus) created an opportunity for Kabaski’s anti-viral products, which Kabaski called the only software available at the time. According to Wireline, “their software was very advanced at the time.” For example, it was the first user to allow inner web security software to observe malware operating in isolated sandboxes.
title: 尤金·卡巴斯基

source_text: TechWorld报道，公司不愿解决索赔很可能是因为尤金“只是讨厌”专利巨魔。他在个人博客中称这些人为“寄生虫”和“IT诈骗者”。卡巴斯基自己是多项专利的共同作者，其中一项是一个基于约束和属性的安全系统，用于控制软件的组件交互。截至2012年，卡巴斯基一直致力于软件开发，以保护發电厂等关键基础设施免受网络战的损害。他每年都会举办一个新年派对，邀请约1500名嘉宾，并在有异国风情的地方举办卡巴斯基会议。
target_text: TechWorld reports that the company’s unwillingness to resolve its claim is probably due to Eugene’s “just hateful” patented giants. He describes these people as “philosophies” and “IT fraudsters” in his personal blog. Kabaski himself is a co-author of several patents, one of which is a binding and attribute-based security system that controls the interface of software components. As of 2012, Kabaski has been working on software development to protect critical infrastructure, such as power plants, from cyberwarfare.
title: 尤金·卡巴斯基

source_text: 在Stuxnet蠕虫攻击事件后，卡巴斯基提出互联网需要更多的监管与规定。其中一个想法是让互联网的部分区域匿名，而更安全的区域需要用户身份验证。例如，核电厂的网络可以经数字护照验证身份后才能访问。他认为目前匿名性的主要受益者是网络犯罪分子和黑客。
target_text: In the wake of the Stuxnet worm attack, Kabaski suggested that the Internet needed more regulation and regulation. One idea was to keep parts of the Internet anonymous, while safer areas needed user identification. For example, the network of nuclear power plants could be accessed only with digital passports.
title: 尤金·卡巴斯基

source_text: 卡巴斯基说互联网上的匿名者可以通过代理保护自己，由负责任的国际机构维护一组在线身份对应现实身份的记录。一些安全专家认为包含互联网用户真实身份的集中数据库将是“隐私灾难，对小偷极具吸引力。”《世纪报》称它“听起来有点太接近‘老大哥’方案，让人不舒服”，《连线》报道卡巴斯基的观点与俄罗斯政府的政策高度一致。
target_text: Some security experts believe that a centralized database containing the true identity of Internet users would be “privileged, attractive to thieves.” According to The Times, it “sounds a little too close to the Big Brother program, which makes it uncomfortable,” and reports that Kabaski’s views are highly consistent with the Russian government’s policy.
title: 尤金·卡巴斯基

source_text: 因为卡巴斯基的论点，许多组织一直在考虑减少隐私以提高安全性。在Slashdot的采访中，卡巴斯基说互联网应该分为三个区域：红色区域用于投票、网上银行和其他需要互联网ID的“关键交易”；灰色区域的网站访问可能只需要验证年龄而非身份；绿色区域用于博客、新闻和“与你的言论自由有关的一切”。他提出红色网站的“特殊代理”，只有在可疑不法行为的情况下才允许披露用户的身份。
target_text: Many organizations have been considering reducing privacy to improve security because of Kabaski’s argument. In Slashdot’s interview, Kabaski said that the Internet should be divided into three regions: red areas for voting, online banking and other “key transactions” requiring Internet IDs; grey areas for website access may only need to verify age rather than identity; green areas for blogs, news and “everything related to your freedom of expression”. He proposed a “special agent” for red sites, which would allow the identity of users to be disclosed only in cases of suspected wrongdoing.
title: 尤金·卡巴斯基

source_text: 多執行緒（），是指从软件或者硬件上实现多个线程并发执行的技术。具有多线程能力的计算机因有硬體支援而能够在同一时间执行多於一个线程，进而提升整体处理效能。具有这种能力的系统包括对称多处理机、多核心处理器以及芯片级多处理（Chip-level multithreading）或同时多线程（Simultaneous multithreading）处理器。
target_text: Multiconductor () is a technology that allows multiple threads to be performed and executed from software or hardware. Computers with multiline capabilities can perform more than one thread at the same time because they are supported by hardware, thus increasing overall processing efficiency. Systems with this capability include Chip-level multidisciplinary processors and chip-level multiple processing processors or Simultaneous multithreading processors.
title: 多线程

source_text: 软件多线程。即便处理器只能运行一个线程，操作系统也可以通过快速的在不同线程之间进行切换，由於时间间隔很小，来给用户造成一种多个线程同时运行的假象。这样的程序运行机制被称为软件多线程。如微软的Windows作业系统和Linux就是在各个不同的執行緒间来回切换，被称为单人多工作业系统。而DOS这类文字介面作业系统在一个时间只能处理一项工作，被视为单人单工作业系统。
target_text: Even if the processor can only run a thread, the operating system can create a false image of multiple threads running simultaneously by fast switching between different threads, with very small time intervals. The program running mechanism is referred to as the software multiwidth. The Microsoft Windows operating system and Linux are going back and forth between different executors, known as single-person multiworking systems. The DOS text interface system can only handle one job at one time and is considered a single-working system.
title: 多线程

source_text: 除此之外，许多系统及处理器也支持硬件多线程技术。对称多处理机（SMP）系统具有多个处理器，所以具有真正的同时执行多个线程的能力；CMP技术通过在一块芯片上集成多个核心（Core）也具有真正的多线程能力；CMT技术则稍有不同，有的是依靠硬件执行线程切换来获得多线程能力，操作系统不再负责线程切换，因而这部分开销可以减少甚至消除，这方面典型的例子是Sun的UltraSPARC T1，它同时综合了CMP和CMT。微軟的Windows 2000以後的作業系統皆支援多執行緒與超執行緒技術。
target_text: In addition to this, many systems and processors support hardware multiline technology. SMP systems have multiple processors, so they have real capabilities to perform multiple threads simultaneously; CMP technologies have real multiline capabilities by integrating multiple cores (Core) on a chip; CMT technologies are slightly different, with hardware execution lines switching to acquire multiline capabilities, and operating systems are no longer responsible for linear transitions, so that these costs can be reduced or even eliminated, as exemplified by Sun ' s UltrasPARC T1, which combines CMP and CMT. Microsoft Windows ' business systems since 2000 support multi- and ultra-exercise technologies.
title: 多线程

source_text: RTLinux通过硬件和操作系统间的中断控制来支持硬实时（确定性）操作。进行确定性处理所需要的中断由实时核心加工，其他中断被送往非实时操作系统。操作系统运行为低优先级线程。先进先出管道（FIFOs）或共享内存可以被用来在操作系统和实时核心之间共享数据。
target_text: RTLinux supports hard real-time (sure) operations by breaking controls between hardware and operating systems. The interruptions required for deterministic processing are processed in real-time cores, while other interruptions are sent to non-real-time operating systems. The operating system operates as a low-priority line.
title: RTLinux

source_text: 主從式架構通过不同的途径应用于很多不同类型的应用程序，最常见就是目前在因特网上用的网页。例如，当你在维基百科阅读文章时，你的电脑和网页浏览器就被当做一个客户端，同时，组成维基百科的电脑、数据库和应用程序就被当做服务器。当你的网页浏览器向维基百科请求一个指定的文章时，维基百科服务器从维基百科的数据库中找出所有该文章需要的信息，结合成一个网页，再发送回你的浏览器。
target_text: For example, when you read an article in Wikipedia, your computer and web browser are treated as a client, while the computers, databases and applications that make up Wikipedia are used as servers. When your web browser requests a specified article in Wikipedia, the Wikipedia server identifies all the information needed for the article from the Wikipedia database and combines it into a web page and sends it back to your browser.
title: 主從式架構

source_text:
特征
主從式架構意图提供一个可伸缩（）的架构，借此网上的计算机或者处理过程是一个客户端或者服务器。服务器软件一般，但不总是，运行在强大的专用商业计算机上。另一方面，客户端一般运行在普通个人电脑或者工作站上。服務端的特徵：被動的角色（從）。
等待來自用戶端的请求。
處理请求並傳回結果。
target_text: Characteristics The main configuration is intended to provide a scalable () architecture whereby the computer or process on the Internet is a client or server. Server software is common, but not always, on a powerful dedicated commercial computer. On the other hand, the client usually runs on a normal personal computer or workstation. Service-end features: moving role (from). Waiting for a request from a client. Process requests and return the results.
title: 主從式架構

source_text: 数据库管理系统（，缩写：DBMS） 是一种针对对象数据库，为管理数据库而设计的大型电脑软件管理系统。具有代表性的数据管理系统有：Oracle、Microsoft SQL Server、Access、MySQL及PostgreSQL等。通常資料庫管理師會使用資料庫管理系統來建立資料庫系統。现代DBMS使用不同的数据库模型追踪实体、属性和关系。在个人电脑、大型计算机和主机上应用最广泛的数据库管理系统是关系型DBMS（relational DBMS）。在關係型數據庫中，用二维表格表示数据库中的数据。这些表格称为关系。
target_text: The database management system (Abbreviation: DBMS) is a large computer software management system designed for the purpose of managing the database. The representative data management systems are: Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, Access, MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc. The database manager usually uses a database management system to build a database system. Modern DBMS uses different database models to track entities, attributes and relationships. The most widely applied database management system on personal computers, large computers and mainframes is the relationship DBMS (relational DBMS).
title: 数据库管理系统

source_text: 在OpenVPN中，如果用户访问一个远程的虚拟地址（属于虚拟网卡配用的地址系列，区别于真实地址），则操作系统会通过路由机制将数据包（TUN模式）或数据帧（TAP模式）发送到虚拟网卡上，服务程序接收该数据并进行相应的处理后，会通过SOCKET从外网上发送出去。这完成了一个单向传输的过程，反之亦然。当远程服务程序通过SOCKET从外网上接收到数据，并进行相应的处理后，又会发送回给虚拟网卡，则该应用软件就可以接收到。
target_text: In OpenVPN, if a user visits a remote virtual address (a series of addresses that belong to the virtual network card, as distinct from the real address), the operating system sends the data package (TUN mode) or the data frame (TAP mode) to the virtual network card via a routed mechanism, and the service program receives the data and processes it accordingly and sends it off the Internet via SOCKET. This completes a one-way transmission process, and vice versa. When the remote service program receives the data from the offline network via SOCKET and processes it and sends it back to the virtual network card, the application can receive it.
title: OpenVPN

source_text:
功能与端口
OpenVPN所有的通信都基于一个单一的IP端口，默认且推荐使用UDP协议通讯，同时也支持TCP。IANA（Internet Assigned Numbers Authority）指定给OpenVPN的官方端口为1194。OpenVPN 2.0以后版本每个进程可以同时管理数个并发的隧道。OpenVPN使用通用网络协议（TCP与UDP）的特点使它成为IPsec等协议的理想替代，尤其是在ISP（Internet service provider）过滤某些特定VPN协议的情况下。
OpenVPN连接能通过大多数的代理服务器，并且能够在NAT的环境中很好地工作。
服务端具有向客户端“推送”某些网络配置信息的功能，这些信息包括：IP地址、路由设置等。
OpenVPN提供了两种虚拟网络接口：通用TUN/TAP驱动，通过它们，可以建立三层IP隧道，或者虚拟二层以太网，后者可以传送任何类型的二层以太网络数据。
传送的数据可通过LZO算法压缩。 但傳輸時使用lzo壓縮將遭受VORACLE威脅而暴露傳輸資料，官方預設不使用也不建議開啟此功能。
' 安全性
OpenVPN与生俱来便具备了许多安全特性：它在用户空间运行，无须对内核及网络协议栈作修改；初始完毕后以chroot方式运行，放弃root权限；使用mlockall以防止敏感数据交换到磁盘。
target_text: All communications of the functionality and port OpenVPN are based on a single IP port, defaulting and recommending UDP communications, and supporting TCP. The IANA (Internet Associated Numbers Authority) has assigned the official port of OpenVPN to 1194. The OpenVPN version of each process can manage several simultaneous tunnels at the same time. The OpenVPN uses the features of the General Network Protocol (TCP and UDP) to make it an ideal alternative to IPs, especially when the ISP (Internet service protocol) filters some specific VPN protocols. The OpenVPN connection can work well in the NAT environment. The service has the capability to “pull” some network information, including: IP addresses, circuits to set up, etc.
title: OpenVPN

source_text: 在计算机网络中，TUN与TAP是操作系统内核中的虚拟网络设备。不同于普通靠硬件网络适配器实现的设备，这些虚拟的网络设备全部用软件实现，并向运行于操作系统上的软件提供与硬件的网络设备完全相同的功能。TAP等同于一个以太网设备，它操作第二层数据包如以太网数据帧。TUN模拟了网络层设备，操作第三层数据包比如IP数据封包。
target_text: In the computer network, TUN and TAP are virtual network devices in the system. Unlike devices that are normally made from hardware network adapters, all of these virtual network devices are performed by software and provide software operating on the operating system with the same functionality as hardware network devices. TAP is equivalent to an Ethernet device that operates a second layer of data packages like Ethernet. TUN simulates a network layer of equipment and operates a third layer of data packages such as IP data envelopes.
title: TUN与TAP

source_text: 字組長度在计算机结构和操作的多个方面均有体现。電腦中大多数寄存器的大小是一个字长。電腦处理的典型数值也可能是以字长为单位。CPU和内存之间的数据传送单位也通常是一个字长。还有在内存中用于指明一个存储位置的地址也经常是以字长为单位的。
target_text: The word length is reflected in many aspects of the structure and operation of the computer. The size of most of the memory is a word length. The typical values processed by the computer may also be word length. The data transfer unit between the CPU and the memory is also usually a word length. Also, the address used in the memory to indicate a storage location is often word length.
title: 字 (计算机)

source_text: 整数–计算机处理的整数值通常可以有若干种不同的长度，但是其中总有一种正好是该构架的字长。如果有的话，其他的整数长度很可能是字长的倍数或分数。小尺寸的整数尺寸通常是为了提高存储效率；当它被载入处理器时，它经常被转换成字长尺寸的形式。
target_text: Integer-computer-processed integer values can usually be of several different lengths, but one of them is the exact length of the frame. If there is one, the other integer length is likely to be a multiplier or fraction of the word length. Small integer dimensions are usually designed to improve storage efficiency; when it is loaded into the processor, it is often converted into a word-length form.
title: 字 (计算机)

source_text: 浮点数–计算机处理的浮点数通常是一个字长或字长的倍数。地址–计算机处理的存储器地址必须有足够的尺寸，以便可以表示需要的数值范围，但是又不能过大。经常使用的尺寸是字，不过也可以是字的倍数或分数。寄存器– 处理器寄存器根据它要处理的数据类型被设计成适当的尺寸，例如：整数、浮点数、地址。许多计算机构架使用“通用”寄存器，它们可以存储任何类型的数据，可以允许存储哪怕是最大的数据类型。它们的尺寸通常是其构架的字长。
target_text: The floating point number – the floating point number processed by the computer is usually a multiplier of a word or word length. The address – the memory address processed by the computer – must be of sufficient size to indicate the range of values required, but not too large. The size often used is a word, although it can also be a multiplier or fraction of a word. The sender – the processor – is designed to fit the type of data it is meant to process, such as integer, float number, address. Many computer structures use “general” depositors, which can store any type of data and allow the storage of even the largest type of data. Their size is usually the word length of their structure.
title: 字 (计算机)

source_text: 编址单位–在一个给定的构架中，连续的地址值对应连续的存储器单位；该单位就是编址单位。在大部分计算机中，这个单位或者是一个字符（例如：字节）或者是一个字（少部分计算机也使用位（bit）编址单位）。如果单位是字，那么用指定长度的地址就可以访问较大数量的存储空间。另一方面，如果单位是字节，那么就可以访问单个的字符（i.e. selected during the memory operation）。
target_text: Address unit - In a given frame, the continuous address value corresponds to the continuous memory unit; this unit is the address unit. In most computers, this unit is either a character (e.g. bytes) or a word (a few computers also use bit). If the unit is a word, a larger amount of storage space can be accessed with a specified length address. On the other hand, if the unit is bytes, a single character (i.e. singled during the medium operation) can be accessed.
title: 字 (计算机)

source_text:
字长的选择
在设计计算机时，字长的选择是非常重要的。设计上的考虑倾向于为特定的用途（如地址）设定特定的位长。然而，出于经济的考虑，又应该仅使用一种尺寸，或者很少的几种与基本尺寸成倍数或分数（约数）关系的尺寸。这个首选的基本尺寸就成为该构架的字长。
target_text: The choice of word length is very important when designing a computer. Design considerations tend to set a specific bit length for a specific use (e.g. address). However, for economic reasons, only one size should be used, or very few dimensions should be associated with the base size by multiples or fractions (approx.). The preferred basic size becomes the word length of the frame.
title: 字 (计算机)

source_text:
随着IBM360系统的引入——该系统使用8位字符，并支持大小写字母——标准的字符（确切地说：字节）尺寸也转变成为8位。从那以后，字长也自然变成了8的倍数，16、32、64位字长被广泛使用。各种字长的架构
早期的计算机设计中包括可变字长设计。在这类设计中，数字操作数没有固定的长度，它们通过检查某个特殊字符来判断是否结束。这样的机器使用BCD编码表示数字，例如IBM 702、IBM 705、IBM 7080、IBM 7010、UNIVAC 1050、IBM 1401和IBM 1620。
target_text: With the introduction of the IBM360 system, which uses eight-digit characters and supports case letters, the standard character (exactly: bytes) has also been converted to eight. Since then, word length has naturally become eight times, with 16, 32, 64-digit lengths widely used. Various word lengths of structure early computer designs include variable long-term designs. In such designs, the number of digital operations has no fixed length and they judge whether to end by checking a particular character. Such machines use BCD codes to indicate numbers, such as IBM 702, IBM 705, IBM 7080, IBM 7010, UNIVAC 1050, IBM 1401 and IBM 1620.
title: 字 (计算机)

source_text:
字和字节编址
字长对计算机构架的存储器模式有很大的影响。特别是：通常选择字作为存储器的编址方案，所谓存储器编址方案就是地址码能够指定的最小存储单位。In this approach，編號相鄰的記憶體字組，其位址編號相差一。在计算机中这样很自然，因为它通常总是要处理以字为单位的数据（或者是以字的倍数）。并且具有让指令可以使用最小的长度来指定一个地址的优点，这样，就可以减少指令长度或者可以定义更多的指令条数。
target_text: Words and byte addresses The size of the word has a significant impact on the memory mode of the computer architecture. In particular: the usual choice of words as a storage option, the so-called storage option, is the minimum storage unit that the address code can specify. In this application, the next-to-neighbour memory group has a different address number. It is natural in a computer because it usually deals with data in words (or multiples of words). It also has the advantage of allowing a command to specify an address using a minimum length, which reduces the length of the command or defines the number of more commands.
title: 字 (计算机)

source_text: 当计算机很大的工作量是用来处理字节时，通常定义字节作为地址编址单位要比字更好。这样做字符串中的单个字符可以通过地址直接指定。当然，一个字仍然可以被地址访问，但是比起字编址方案，它的地址将使用更多的位数。在这种组织结构中，字长需要被定义为字符长度的整数倍。这种编址方案在IBM 360中被使用，此后即变成计算机设计中最普遍的方案。
target_text: When a computer has a large workload to handle bytes, it is usually better to define bytes as the address unit than words. To do so, a single character in a string can be specified directly by the address. Of course, a word can still be accessed by the address, but its address will be more numerous than the word-setting option. In this organizational structure, word length needs to be defined as the integer of the character length. This is used in IBM 360, and then becomes the most common option in computer design.
title: 字 (计算机)

source_text:
2的幂
数据常常要占用不同大小的存储空间，例如，有些数值比其他的数值要求有更高的精度。通常使用的长度是编址单位（以字为单位编址或以字节为单位编址）的倍数，这个倍数常常是的2的幂。这样做是比较便利的，因为这样的话，将一个处理对象在数组中的索引值转化为这个处理对象的地址只需要进行一个移位操作（这在硬件上只需要进行布线的变化）而不需要进行乘操作。某些时候这样的做法还可以避免除操作。因此，一些现代计算机设计使用的字长（或者其他的操作数）是2的幂乘以字节尺寸。
target_text: The data often take up storage space of different sizes. For example, some values require more precision than others. The usually used is a multiple of the number of address units (in words or by bytes), which is often two. This is easier because, in this case, the conversion of the index value of a processed object in a array into an address of the processed object requires only one movement (which requires only a change in the layout of the hardware) and no multiplication. In some cases, this can be avoided. Thus, some modern computer designs use two hyphenics (or other operations) to the size of the byte.
title: 字 (计算机)

source_text:
字长家族
随着计算机设计日益复杂，一个单一字长的核心作用在计算机架构中已经不那么重要。虽然硬件有能力支持更宽的数据类型，但是在扩展处理器性能时，市场却有强大的压力要求新产品保持向后兼容。因此，在一个新构架的向后兼容的设计中，核心的字长不得不与原始机型的字长共存。原始的字长在未来设计中保持可用，这就构成了字长家族的基础。
target_text: As computer design becomes more complex, the central role of a single word length is less important in the computer architecture. While hardware has the ability to support a broader type of data, there is strong pressure in the market to expand processor performance to require that new products remain backward-compatible.
title: 字 (计算机)

source_text: 因此，今天我们看到的计算机体系结构更多的是基于一个有联系的、类似的字长家族，而不是一个单一的字长体系结构。这些尺寸以整因子（integral factors）——通常是2的幂——互相关联。直接将它们中的任何一个尺寸定义为该系统的字长是武断的，因为这些尺寸的设计可能是因为这一系列体系构架的发展的历史原因，而不是体系自己的最新设计中的特性。
target_text: So the computer architecture we see today is more based on a connected, similar long-word family, rather than on a single long-word structure. These dimensions are linked by the integral factors – usually the twigs of 2. It is arbitrary to define any of them directly as the length of the system, because they may be designed for historical reasons of the development of a series of architectures rather than for the features of the system’s own latest design.
title: 字 (计算机)

source_text:
Dword和Qword
在计算机科学中, dword（双倍字）是一种数据单位，它是字的二倍或者说是qword的一半。在具有16位字长的x86平台上，dword数据单位具有32位长度。qword（四倍字）是一种大小是字长的四倍的数据单位。在通用的x86平台上，该单位的数据具有64位，因为x86系统的字定义为16位（不论实际的机器上工作在那个基本位长上的）
target_text: In computer science, Dword and Qword are data units that are twice or half of qwords. On platforms with 16-digit lengths, dword data units have 32-digit lengths. qword (four-fold) is a data unit that is four times the size of a word length. On the universal x86 platform, the data for this unit is 64-digit, because the word for the x86 system is defined as 16-digit (whether the actual machine works on that base length).
title: 字 (计算机)

source_text: 定朔是古代中国阴阳历中，确定每月第一天（初一、朔）的一种计算方法，与平朔相对。这种算法的原则是，将太阳的黄经和月的黄经一致的当天作为每月的初一。因此这种算法考虑了太阳运行和月球运行的不均等性，将含有真正新月（“朔”）的当天作为每月的开始。古六曆至隋大業曆採平氣平朔。唐戊寅元暦採平氣定朔後因連四大月改回平朔，麟德曆用進朔避連四大月。元授時曆棄進朔採定朔，至明大統曆大致採平氣定朔。清時憲曆（於順治二年頒行）後採定氣定朔。
target_text: This calculation takes into account the imbalance between the operation of the Sun and the operation of the Moon, which will be the beginning of the real new month (“Shaw”) as the monthly start of the month. The six-month calendar to the Quantium calendar allows for a levelling-up of the atmosphere. Tang Quan Quan Quan Quan Quantue has changed to the Quantue calendar for a four-month period, and Qin Quantage has been replaced by four-month Qing Quantue Quantue Quantue calendar for a four-month period.
title: 定朔

source_text:
關聯式資料庫管理系統（，縮寫為RDBMS）是管理关系数据库的数据库管理系统。关系数据库是將数据间的关系以数据库表的形式加以表达，并将数据存儲在表格中，以便于查询。特色
创建多个关系表来存入信息
提供一种通用的交互式查询语言
可以通过多表关系来查询数据
将系统自身的信息也提供为一个表或目录，称为系统表，用于交互查询。
target_text: The database management system for managing relationships is the joint database management system (redbMS). The relationship database is a database in which relationships between data are expressed in the form of a database table and the data are stored in a table to facilitate queries. Features create multiple relationship sheets for posting information Provides a common interactive query language For searching data through multiple tabulations Provides information on the system itself to a table or directory called a system table for interactive queries.
title: 關聯式資料庫管理系統

source_text:
交叉编译器和源代码至源代码编译器不同，交叉编译器用于二进制代码的跨平台软件开发，而源到源编译器是将某种编程语言的程序源代码作为输入，生成以另一种编程语言构成的等效源代码的编译器，但两者都是编程工具。使用
交叉编译器的基本用法就是将构建环境与目标环境分开。常在下面几种情况中使用：
target_text: Cross compilers and source-to-source compilers differ, and cross compilers are used for the development of binary-coded cross-platform software, whereas source-to-source compilers use the program source code in one programming language as input to generate equivalent source code in another programming language, both of which are programming tools. The basic use of cross- compilers is to separate the construction environment from the target environment.
title: 交叉編譯器

source_text:
嵌入式电脑。这种设备的资源有限，举例来说：微波炉有一个非常小的计算机来读取其触摸板和门传感器，并向数字显示器和扬声器提供输出，以控制用于烹饪食物。这台计算机不足以运行编译器，文件系统或开发环境，因为调试和测试需要更多的嵌入式系统资源，使得在目标机上编译变得更不可能。采用交叉编译，在资源足够的机器上完成构建工作，就可以解决这个问题。
编译多个目标库。举个例子，一个公司可能希望支持不同版本或不同种类的操作系统，有了交叉编译，便可以为每个目标设置一个编译环境进行编译。如：在Windows中为底层构造完全不同的Linux编译程序；在电脑上为移动端操作系统构建程序。
在服务器上编译。类似于在多个机器进行编译，一个复杂的编译可能会涉及到许多的编译操作，可以将这些编译操作放到空闲的机器上执行，无论其底层硬件或其运行的操作系统版本如何。
引导一个新平台（）。在为新平台开发软件，或者开发/使用未来平台的仿真器时，则使用交叉编译器来编译必要的工具，如操作系统和本机编译器。
target_text: Embedded computers. For example, the microwave has a very small computer to read its touch pads and door sensors and provide outputs to digital displays and loudspeakers to control cooking food. The computer is not enough to run a compiler, file system, or development environment, because debugging and testing require more embedded system resources, making it more impossible to compile on target machines. The problem is solved by using cross-compilation, which is done on machines with sufficient resources.
title: 交叉編譯器

source_text: Cray T3E是Cray公司1995年发布的第二代大规模并行超级计算机系统。如同它的上一代产品Cray T3D一样，它是使用了3D torus互联网络的一种分布式内存架构的机器。T3E最早使用DEC的Alpha 21164 (EV5)作为处理器，具有8到2176个处理单元（PE）。每个处理单元具有64 MB到2 GB的DRAM和一个具有六个方向的、每个方向的有效带宽为480 MB/s的路由单元。T3E不同于其它的很多MPP系统，比如T3D等，它使用了完全自主的分布式操作系统UNICOS/mk和一个集成到torus网络中的 GigaRingI/O子系统，用以连接网络、磁盘和磁带I/O。
target_text: Cray T3E is a second-generation, large-scale parallel supercomputer system released by Cray in 1995. Like its last-generation product Cray T3D, it is a machine that uses a distributed memory structure of the 3D torus Internet. T3E was the first to use Alpha 21164 (EV5) of DEC as a processor with 8 to 2176 processing units (PE). Each processing unit has 64 MB to 2 GB DRAMs and an effective bandwidth of 480 MB/s in six directions. T3E, unlike many other MPP systems, such as T3D, uses a fully autonomous distributed operating system, UNICOS/mk, and a GigaRingI/O subsystem integrated into the Torus network, to connect networks, disks and tape I/O.
title: Cray T3E

source_text: 罗伯特·泰潘·莫里斯（，），網路代號rtm，美国程序員、計算機科學家與企業家。现在是麻省理工学院教授。于2019年当选为美国工程院院士。1988年了創造互联网上的第一隻電腦蠕蟲程序，散布在互联网後，造成多個電腦系統癱瘓，因此被定罪。他曾創辦Viaweb，也是Y Combinator的共同創辦人之一。
target_text: Robert Tepan Morris (,), Internet code name rtm, an American programmer, computer scientist and entrepreneur. He is now a professor at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. He was elected to the United States College of Engineering in 2019. He was convicted of creating the first computer worm on the Internet, spreading it on the Internet in 1988 and causing multiple computer system paralysis. He was one of the co-authors of Y Combinator.
title: 罗伯特·泰潘·莫里斯

source_text:
常用方法
exploit－利用已知漏洞事先設計好的程式，对相应的目标进行溢出攻击。
数据包嗅探－一個可以擷取 数据包 封包资料的程式，可用于截取在電腦或網路中傳輸的密碼或其他資料。
Rootkit－Rootkit技术一是病毒、木马用来保护自己免被杀软杀掉的一种操作系统底层技术

木马－可以用来留下后门，或者是用于密码窃取，远程控制等

target_text: The Rootkit-Rootkit technique is a virus, a wooden horse used to protect itself from murder at the bottom of an operating system, social engineering-social engineering is a discipline that uses human weaknesses to obtain or exploit important information. The wooden horse - used to leave behind doors, or to steal passwords, remote control, etc. The virus-computer virus is a self-recordable program.
title: 黑客 (计算机安全)

source_text: 最早的僵尸网络出现在1993年，在IRC聊天网络中出现。1999年后IRC协议的僵尸程序开始大规模出现。曾有一个新西兰19岁的骇客控制了全球150万台计算机，中国唐山的骇客也控制了6万台中国的计算机对某音乐网站进行分布式拒绝服务（DDoS）攻击，造成该网站不论将服务器转移到台湾还是美国都无法正常提供服务，损失上百万元人民币，河北唐山黑客的僵尸网络规模也是中国目前为止最大的，目前这两位黑客均已被逮捕。
target_text: The earliest zombie network appeared in 1993, in the IRC chat network. After 1999, the IRC program began to appear on a massive scale.
title: 殭屍網絡

source_text:
分布式拒绝服务攻击是僵尸网络最常见的用途之一：在这种攻击中，多个系统向一台计算机/服务提交尽可能多的请求，使其超载，阻止其为合法请求提供服务。谷歌欺诈专员Shuman Ghosemajumder表示，由于僵尸网络变成了一种服务，这类导致主要网站中断的攻击将继续、定期发生。
间谍软件是一种向其创建者发送用户活动信息（通常是密码、信用卡卡号和其他可以在黑市上出售的信息）的软件。对机器人“牧人”来说，位于公司网络内的被入侵机器可能更有价值，因为通常可以通过此类机器获得公司的机密信息。例如Aurora僵尸网络就是针对大型企业的攻击，意在窃取敏感信息。
target_text: Distributed denial-of-service attacks are one of the most common uses of zombie networks: in such attacks, multiple systems submit as many requests as possible to a computer/service to overload it and prevent it from serving a legitimate request. Google Fraud Commissioner Shuman Ghosemajumder states that such attacks, which interrupt the main web site as a result of a service, will continue on a regular basis.
title: 殭屍網絡

source_text: 破解芯片泛指解除數碼版權管理系統的裝置，最常用於遊戲機之上，用以解除廠家對遊戲的版權限制。這些芯片一經安裝後，除了可讓用戶使用非官方的遊戲及程式外，亦容許用戶使用盜版遊戲，因而在多個國家均引起版權爭議。「破解芯片」一詞在英語中稱作「Modchip」，含有「修改（modify）機內功能」的意義，故安裝這種芯片的行為有時也被稱為「改機」。「Modchip」一詞目前為加拿大Modchip Inc.的註冊商標。
target_text: Dismantling chips generally refers to removing devices from digital copyright management systems, most commonly on games, to remove copyright restrictions on games by manufacturers. Once installed, these chips, in addition to allowing users to use unofficial games and programs, allow users to use pirated games, thus causing copyright disputes in many countries. The word "definishing chips" is called "Modchip" in English, with the meaning of "modify" and is sometimes referred to as "changed" the behaviour of such chips. The word "Modchip" is currently used as the registration label for "Modchip Inc." in Canada.
title: 破解芯片

source_text: 美國：美國《數字千年版權法》（DMCA）指破解芯片屬違法，但認為芯片本身是中立的載體，當中的破解軟件才屬違法。2003年初，iSONEWS.com公司因出售載有Xbox破解程式的芯片而被美國聯邦調查局搜查；現時美國多間公司只出售空白的破解芯片，而不在其EEPROM內預載破解版權保護的程式。2006年，芯片軟件供應商Divineo被娛樂軟件協會（Entertainment Software Association；ESA）索償，最終被美國地方法院勒令賠償375萬美元予該協會。
target_text: US: U.S. Digital Millennium Rights Act (DMCA) refers to chip cracking as illegal, but believes that chip itself is a neutral carrier, and that cracking software is illegal. In early 2003, iSONEWS.com was searched by the US Federal Bureau of Investigation for selling chips with an Xbox breakout program; now several US companies are selling blank crack chips instead of pre-loading programs protected by their EPROM. In 2006, the chip provider, Divineo, was ordered by the Entertainment Software Association; ESA) to award $3.75 million to the United States local court.
title: 破解芯片

source_text: 德国：在德国，拥有破解芯片是合法的。但是破解芯片需要安装特定软件，而这些软件是侵犯游戏机生产厂家的著作权的。用户安装破解芯片后，不再享有维修保护的权利。如果出售的破解芯片的BIOS的功能超出能够启动非官方的游戏及程序（Homebrewed Software），那么销售即是违法的。游戏机生产厂家对在德国境内的破解芯片销售商一直在进行紧密的跟踪；不过，如果销售的BIOS是空的，他们对此还没有采取法律行动。但是，一旦BIOS被加载能够启动盗版复制品的违法程序，则有可能受到法律追究。另外，销售商的违法程序的加载一般很难被游戏机生产厂家证明，而且通常加载是用户自己进行的。
target_text: Germany: In Germany, crack chips are legal. But crack chip manufacturers need to install specific software that violates the copyrights of gamemaker producers. Users no longer have the right to maintenance protection when they install crack chipes. Sales are illegal if BIOS, the sold chip, is more than capable of initiating unofficial games and programs (Homebrewed Software).
title: 破解芯片

source_text: 台灣：台灣著作權法於西元2004年9月1日修正時，在美國經貿諮商期盼下，增訂第3條第1項第18款「防盜拷措施」之定義:「指著作權人所採取有效禁止或限制他人擅自進入或利用著作之設備、器材、零件、技術或其他科技方法。」並於同法第80條之2規定，對於著作權人所採取禁止或限制他人擅自進入著作之防盜拷措施，未經合法授權不得予以破解、破壞或以其他方法規避之。進一步地，對於破解、破壞或規避防盜拷措施之設備、器材、零件、技術或資訊，未經合法授權不得製造、輸入、提供公眾使用或為公眾提供服務。因此，由上可知可分成(1.)個人自行安裝破解芯片的破壞規避行為，僅有民事賠償責任而無刑事責任，但取締極為困難，因為保護智慧財產權的警方專隊或是著作權人，除非有地方法院開立之搜索票，否則均無法進入私人住宅搜證。(2.)個人或商家對外提供破解芯片給公眾使用或提供改裝服務(俗稱的代客改機)，則會有民事賠償責任和刑事責任。在刑事責任方面，依同法第96條之1規定，可處一年以下有期徒刑、拘役，或科或併科新臺幣2萬元以上25萬元以下罰金。
target_text: Taiwan: When the Taiwan Copyright Act was amended on September 1, 2004, article 3, section 1, section 18, of the “Standard Protection Measures” was added, with the expectation of American dealers, to the definition of “the effective prohibition or restriction of unauthorized access to, or use of, works, equipment, parts, technologies or other scientific and technological methods taken by copyright holders.” And article 80, section 2, of the same law stipulates that, in the case of copyrightists who take measures to prevent torture that prohibit or restrict the unauthorized access of others to their writings, article 3, section 1, “Torture Prevention Measures” may not be broken, destroyed or otherwise avoided without legal authorization.
title: 破解芯片

source_text: 第五代遊戲機的特式是採用光碟作為媒體，但早年的3DO及Mega CD並無在光碟上加入防燒錄裝置，用戶毋須改機即可使用非正版光碟。1994年至1995年，SEGA Saturn和PlayStation遊戲機推出，首次加入防盜版裝置，結果催生了破解芯片的出現。當時PlayStation的破解芯片需要焊接在底板之上；後期發展至只需直接在該遊戲機後的接駁口，插入一個破解裝置，即可使用非正版遊戲。此後，GameShark等公司亦發表一批換碟機制，只要用特定光碟啟動遊戲系統，亦可使用非正版遊戲。
target_text: In 1994-1995, the SEGA Saturn and PlayStation games were launched, and for the first time they joined the anti-piracy devices, prompting the emergence of a crack chip. At that time, PlayStation’s decomposition chip needed to be welded above the bottom; later, only a breakup device needed to be inserted directly at the end of the game to insert a breakup device.
title: 破解芯片

source_text:
經過近十年發展後，每當有新的遊戲機推出，破解芯片亦緊隨發行。2006年底，任天堂發表第七代遊戲機Wii時，一款名叫WiiNinja的芯片隨即在翌年1月26日發表，CycloWiz在同月29日跟進推出，2月2日WiiKey上市，2月18日WiiXT亦上市。風險
完成改機之後，衍生的風險包括：
主機本身立即喪失原廠保固及售後服務。
升級遊戲程式或主機程式時，主機有容易故障的可能。
target_text: At the end of 2006, when Nintendo released its seventh-generation game, Wiii, a chip named WiiiNinja was released on January 26, CycloWiz followed it on January 29, WiiKey on February 2, and WiiiXT on February 18. The risks that flowed from the conversion include the immediate loss of the mainframe itself to secure and post-sale services.
title: 破解芯片

source_text:
例子
假設一架747-400客機在成田國際機場進場時遇上低能见度天氣:
进近塔台會許可飛行員截获跑道16R航向道和下滑道。
飛行員對导航计算机作出截获跑道16R的ILS信号的指令
當机场塔台許可着陆後，飛行員再通報使用CAT III(三類)儀器降落，也就是代表了他們會使用自動降落。
起落架差不多觸地時，飛機上的儀器靠測距儀和无线电高度表得知了飛機已到了跑道接地区(touchdown zone)，而調整落地姿态，平飄(Flare)。同時，自動導航计算机隨機選擇大約觸地位置來減低對跑道的損害。
接地後，飛行員會打開引擎反推，自動煞車和自動減速板打開。飛行員會關掉自動導航電腦，自動降落過程完成。
如果系統正常處於ARM模式，當ILS接收器檢測到航向道時，自動著陸系統模式將變為“LOCALIZER CAPTURE”。飛控計算機將飛機變成航向道並沿航向道飛行。一種典型的進場方式是讓飛機進入“下滑道下方”（垂直引導），這樣飛機將沿著航向道飛行（與跑道中心線對齊），直到檢測到下滑道。此時，自動著陸模式將變為 CAT III，飛行器將由飛行控制計算機沿航向道和下滑道光束飛行。

source_text: 深度优先搜索算法（，）是一种用于遍历或搜索树或图的算法。这个算法会尽可能深地搜索树的分支。当节点v的所在边都己被探寻过，搜索将回溯到发现节点v的那条边的起始节点。这一过程一直进行到已发现从源节点可达的所有节点为止。如果还存在未被发现的节点，则选择其中一个作为源节点并重复以上过程，整个进程反复进行直到所有节点都被访问为止。。
target_text: A depth-priority search algorithm (i.e.) is an algorithm used to go through or search trees or drawings. This algorithm searchs branches of trees as deep as possible. When the edge of node v is searched, the search goes back to the starting point of the edge of the discovery node v. The process continues until all the nodes that have been found to reach the source node. If there are nodes that are not found, select one of the nodes and repeat the process as a source node, and the whole process is repeated until all nodes are visited.
title: 深度优先搜索

source_text: 深度优先搜索是图论中的经典算法，利用深度优先搜索算法可以产生目标图的拓扑排序表，利用拓扑排序表可以方便的解决很多相关的图论问题，如无权最长路径问题等等。因发明“深度优先搜索算法”，約翰·霍普克洛夫特与罗伯特·塔扬在1986年共同获得计算机领域的最高奖：图灵奖。
target_text: A deep priority search is the classic algorithm in the graph. Using a deep priority search algorithm can produce a high-stamp sorting table for the target map, and using a high-stamp sorting table can easily solve a number of related graphic problems, such as the lack of rights to the longest path. As a result of the invention of the “deep priority search algorithm”, John Hopcroft and Robert Tayan jointly received the highest prize in the field of computers in 1986: the Turing Award.
title: 深度优先搜索

source_text: 在微软windows操作系统中，index.dat是一个由Internet Explorer和资源管理器创建的文件。这个文件的功能就像一个数据库，随系统启动。它的功能在于收集个人信息，就像网址，搜索字符串，和最近打开的文件。它的职责就像数据库中的索引。简单来说，当IE开启自动完成，每一个浏览过的网址将被收录进index.dat，IE浏览器据此匹配用户输入的字符。index.dat也同样存在于IE的历史纪录，缓存，和cookies.
target_text: In the Microsoft Windows operating system, index.dat is a file created by the Internet Explorer and resource manager. This file functions as a database, starting with the system. It functions as a personal information collection, like a web site, searching for strings, and recently opened files. Its duties are like an index in a database. In short, when IE turns on auto-completed, each visited site is recorded in index.dat, the IE browser matches the characters entered by the user.
title: Index.dat

source_text: 提示：.dat是一个很常见的扩展名（甚至是不可读文件或者是非文本文件），所以你可能会遇到一个index.dat文件，但它并不是IE浏览器和windows的一部分。争论互联网隐私团体指出Windows操作系统使用index.dat收集信息侵犯了个人隐私，主要的抱怨是index.dat不容易删除，因为开机后它们总是被使用（经常是资源管理器），同时，当文件增大到80MB以上后，浏览速度将明显变慢。
target_text: Nintendo:.dat is a very common extension (even non-readable or non-text-based document), so you may encounter an index.dat file, but it is not part of the IE browser and windows. The Internet privacy groups argue that the use of index.dat by Windows operating systems to collect information violates personal privacy. The main complaint is that index.dat is not easy to remove because they are always used (often as resource managers) when it is started, and that when documents grow to over 80 MB, the speed of browsing will be significantly slower.
title: Index.dat

source_text: 另一个争论是操作系统给了用户一种错误的感觉，当用户清空了缓存，临时文件夹，历史纪录文件夹。index.dat仍旧收集了所有浏览过的网址和cookies和一些临时文件，一些人最终发现是index.dat的问题。然而，微软发言人说通过系统进入安全模式，index.dat可以被高级用户删除。因为操作系统在安全模式不使用index.dat，删除按钮或者deltree命令可以删除index.dat，
target_text: Another argument is that the operating system gives users a sense of error when the user empties the cache, temporary folders, and historical records folders. index.dat still collects all the websites and cookies that have been viewed and some temporary files, and some eventually find that the problem is index.dat. However, Microsoft spokesman said that using the system to access security mode, index.dat can be deleted by advanced users. Because the operating system does not use index.dat in security mode, delete buttons or deltre commands can delete index.dat.
title: Index.dat
