source_text: XMM-牛顿卫星重3.8吨，长10米，太阳能电池帆板展开后宽16米。卫星上搭载的主要科学仪器有：3台掠射式X射线望远镜，每个望远镜由58个套筒组成，采用沃尔特Ⅰ型构造，最大的一层直径为70厘米，焦距为7.5米，总接收面积达到4,300平方厘米，是由意大利科学家制造的。三台欧洲光子成像照相机（），工作能段为0.2-12keV，位于X射线望远镜的焦平面上，用于X射线成像、X射线测光和中等分辨率分光。其中两台为（金属氧化半导体）照相机，由7块不共面的芯片组成，另一台为照相机，由12块共面的芯片组成。
target_text: The XMM-Newton satellite weighs 3.8 tons, 10 metres long, and the solar panel is 16 metres wide. The main scientific instruments on board the satellite are three predatory X-ray telescopes, each consisting of 58 cylinders, using a Walter I configuration with a maximum diameter of 70 centimetres and a focal length of 7.5 metres, with a total receiving area of 4,300 square centimetres, which is manufactured by Italian scientists. Three European photo-imaging cameras () with a working capability of 0.2-12keV are located on the focal plane of the X-ray telescope and are used for X-ray imaging, X-ray detection and medium resolution. Two of them are (metal oxidation semiconductors) cameras, consisting of seven unfaced chips and one is a photographic camera consisting of 12 co-surface chips.
title: XMM-牛顿卫星

source_text: 肯尼斯·蓝·汤普逊（，），小名肯·汤普逊（），美国计算机科学学者和工程师。駭客文化圈子通常称他为“ken”。在贝尔实验室工作期间，汤普逊设计和实现了Unix操作系统。他创造了B语言——C语言的前身，而且他是Plan 9操作系统的创造者和开发者之一。2006年，汤普逊进入Google公司工作，与他人共同设计了Go语言。他與丹尼斯·里奇同為1983年圖靈獎得主。
target_text: Kenneth Blue Thompson (,) Little Ken Thompson, an American computer science scholar and engineer. The hacker culture community usually calls him "ken." During his work at Bell Labs, Thompson designed and implemented the Unix operating system. He created B-C, and he was one of the creators and developers of Plan 9 operating systems. In 2006, Thompson entered Google and worked with others to design the Go language.
title: 肯·汤普逊

source_text: 1960年，他就讀加州大學柏克萊分校，主修電氣工程，1966年取得了電子工程碩士學位。他的导师是美國数学家、计算机科学家埃尔温·伯利坎普。1966年，肯·汤普逊加入贝尔实验室。他參與了貝爾實驗室與麻省理工學院以及通用電氣公司聯合開發的Multics系统項目。在开发Multics系统期间，汤普逊创造了Bon编程语言。与此同时，他又编写了一个名为“Space Travel”的游戏。后来貝爾實驗室撤出了Multics計劃。为了能够继续玩游戏，汤普逊只好找到一台老式PDP-7機器，重寫了他的「Space Travel」遊戲。
target_text: In 1960, he went to the University of California, Berkeley, where he majored in electrical engineering, where he obtained a bachelor's degree in electronic engineering in 1966. His mentor, Erwin Burlicamp, an American mathematician, computer scientist. In 1966, Ken Thompson joined Bell's lab. He was part of the Multiics system project, developed by the Bell Laboratory in association with the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and General Electrics. During the development of Multicris, Thompson created the Bon programming language. At the same time, he prepared a game called Space Travel.
title: 肯·汤普逊

source_text: 在把游戏移植好之后，汤普逊又着手把自己的工具扩充成完备的操作系统。他和丹尼斯·里奇带领一些贝尔实验室的成员在PDP-7上面进行开发工作，实现了文件系统、进程、设备文件、命令行解释器和一些小的工具程序等。1970年，在布萊恩·柯林漢的建议下，这个系统命名为“Unix”，与“Multics”名字相对应。在完成Unix系统开发的基本工作之后，汤普逊觉得Unix系统需要一个系统级的编程语言，于是创造了B语言。后来里奇在B语言的基础上创造了C语言。
target_text: After the game was transplanted, Thompson began to expand his tools into a complete operating system. He and Dennis Rich led some of the members of Bell's lab to develop the PDP-7 system, which enabled document systems, processes, device files, command-line interpreters, and some small tool programs. In 1970, at Brian Colinham's suggestion, the system was named “Unix”, corresponding to the “Multics” name. After completing the basic work of Unix, Thompson felt that the Unix system needed a system-level programming language, which created the B language.
title: 肯·汤普逊

source_text: 肯·汤普逊和贝尔实验室的共同制作了下棋机器，汤普逊负责软件部分。汤普逊还编写了生成国际象棋残局走法的程序，即。对于所有只剩4到6步的残局，只要程序从数据库中找到了棋谱那么就可以给出“完美”解法。后来他在国际象棋专家的帮助下发布了程序生成结果。
target_text: Ken Thompson and Bell's lab co-produced a chess machine, and Thompson was responsible for the software component. Thompson also developed a program to generate chess remnants, i.e., for all those left with only four to six steps left, a "perfect" solution could be given as long as the program found it in the database.
title: 肯·汤普逊

source_text: 1983年，因“发展了通用操作系统的理论，特别是实现了Unix操作系统”，汤普逊和里奇共同获得了图灵奖。他的演讲以《Reflections on Trusting Trust》（反思对信任的信任）为题。文中提到的向编译器植入的后门后来被人们称为“Thompson hack”，对计算机安全领域产生了重要影响。因为在Unix系统和C语言方面做出的贡献，他们二人在1990年共同获得了，在1997年获得了计算机历史博物馆研究员奖，又在1999年4月27日获得了由美国总统比尔·克林顿颁发的。
target_text: In 1983, Thompson and Richie jointly received the Turing Award for “the development of the theory of a universal operating system, in particular the Unix operating system.” His presentation focused on Reforms on Trust (reflection of trust). The back door to the compiler referred to in the paper was later referred to as “Thompson hack”, which had an important impact in the area of computer security. As a result of their contribution to the Unix system and the C language, both of them jointly received the 1990 Computer History Museum Fellow Award and, on 27 April 1999, was awarded by the President of the United States, Bill Clinton.
title: 肯·汤普逊

博物馆
阿姆斯特丹大学还拥有五个博物馆。包括阿拉德·皮尔逊博物馆，它收藏着公元前4000年到公元500年之间的来自古埃及，古希腊，近东和意大利中部的文物；大学博物馆，收藏与展示1632年成立到至今的阿姆斯特丹大学的历史；Vrolik博物馆，存放着解剖学，动物学和致畸标本；J.A.多特蒙德博物馆收藏者公元前3000到至今的呈现在西方书写历史的展览；阿姆斯特丹大学计算机博物馆里面有显示在电子计算机制造出来之前，过去的计算机是如何工作和计算的。阿姆斯特丹动物学博物馆收集了数百万用于科学研究贝壳，昆虫，哺乳动物，鸟类，鱼类和其他动物的标本。
target_text: The Museum of Amsterdam also has five museums. These include the Arad Pearson Museum, a collection of antiquities from ancient Egypt, ancient Greece, the Near East and central Italy between 4,000 B.C. and 500 B.C.; the University Museum, a collection and display of the history of the University of Amsterdam, which was founded in 1632 to date; the Vrolik Museum, a collection of anatomy, zoology and malformation specimens; the exhibition of the collectors of the J.A. Dotmond Museum, from 3,000 to the present, in the history of writing in the West; and the Computer Museum of the University of Amsterdam, which shows how computers worked and calculated in the past before electronic computers were made. The Amsterdam Museum of Animalology collects millions of specimens for scientific research on shells, insects, mammals, birds, fish and other animals.
title: 阿姆斯特丹大学

source_text: 半导体探测器以半导体作为探测设备，当X射线入射到探测器上，就会产生一个电子空穴对。其特点是能量分辨率和探测效率较高，但是不能做得很大。随着现代技术的发展，设备应用于X射线探测。1993年发射的日本ASCA卫星是首个应用CCD设备进行X射线成像的天文卫星。闪烁探测器通过荧光的方式探测X射线或者带电粒子，主要由闪烁体、光电倍增管等组成。常见的闪烁体有，用它作成的闪烁探测器也被称为探测器。
target_text: The semiconductor detector uses semiconductor devices, and when X-rays enter into the detector, an electronic cave pair is created. It is characterized by more energy resolution and efficient detection, but it cannot be done much. As modern technology develops, the equipment is applied to X-ray detection. The Japanese ASCA satellite, launched in 1993, is the first astronomical satellite to use CCD devices for X-ray imaging. The flash detector detects X-rays or electrical particles by fluorescent means, consisting mainly of flashers, photo-electric multipliers, etc.
title: X射线天文学

source_text: 比起其它桌面出版软件来，Publisher在历史上一直不受高端商务打印商店欢迎。它只能用于Windows，而业界占相当份额的系统运行的是苹果公司的Mac OS X。Publisher定位于入门级的应用软件造成了很多的问题，比如在服务提供商的电脑上没有相应字体和嵌入对象等等（虽然Publisher提供了可以把相关联的文件压缩成一个自释放应用程序的工具）。许多高端特性，比如透明化、对象阴影、slugs、路径文本、内嵌的PDF输出等等，或者没有完全实现，或者干脆没有。但最近的一些版本有了很大的提高，开始关注色彩分离以及正确地处理彩色输出。Publisher 2007还包含了期待已久的特性，可以输出商业出版品质带内嵌字体的PDF格式，作为选件可以从微软网站下载。
target_text: Publisher has historically been unwelcome to high-end commercial printing shops, compared to other desktop publishing software. It can only be used in Windows, where the industry has a significant share of the system run by Apple's Mac OS X. Publisher's access-level application has caused a number of problems, such as the absence of appropriate fonts and embedded objects on the service provider's computer (although Publisher has provided tools to compress the associated files into a self-release application). Many high-end features, such as transparency, object shadow, slugs, path text, embedded PDF output, etc., are either not fully realized, or simply not. But some recent versions have improved significantly, and have begun to focus on color separation and the proper treatment of colour exports.
title: Microsoft Publisher

source_text: 通常，系统由软件部分和硬件部分组成，系统的一部分功能由软件实现，而另一部分功能则由硬件实现。早期的系统比较简单，系统工程师将准备设计的系统划分为软件部分和硬件部分，分别由软件工程师和硬件工程师进行设计、仿真、实现和改进，最后再将软件部分和硬件部分结合起来形成系统。软件工程师使用C和C++等程序设计语言，因为这些语言专长于描述串行执行的程序，用来仿真软件部分；而硬件工程师则使用VHDL和Verilog等硬件描述语言，因为这些语言专长于描述并行运行的硬件，用来仿真硬件部分。但是，随着电子系统的不断发展，系统结构越来越复杂，系统元件也越来越多，这就要求系统工程师在先期划分软件和硬件时，就对整个系统性能有很好的了解和掌握，以便更好地划分软件和硬件，减小设计中不必要的失误所带来的损失和风险。SystemC也就由此孕育而生，因为它能够满足对软件和硬件协同仿真的需求。
target_text: As a rule, the system consists of software components and hardware components, while part of the system functions are performed by software, while the other part functions are performed by hardware. Early systems are simpler, systems engineers divide the systems prepared to be designed into software parts and hardware components, which are designed, imitated, implemented and improved by software engineers and hardware engineers, respectively, and eventually combine the software components and hardware components into systems. Software engineers design languages using programs such as C and C++, which are specialized in describing the programs executed by serials and are used to imitate the software components; and hardware engineers using hardware such as VHDL and Verilog to describe the language that describes the hardware that operates in parallel, which is used to imitate the hardware components. However, as electronic systems evolve, the structure of the system becomes more complex and the system elements more numerous, which requires system engineers to have a good understanding and mastery of the entire system, to better delineate the software and hardware, and to mitigate the losses and risks associated with unnecessary errors in the design.
title: SystemC

source_text: 工厂方法模式可以用于测试驱动开发，从而允许将類別放在测试中。举例来说，Foo这个類別创建了一个Dangerous对象，但是Dangerous对象不能放在自动的单元测试中（可能它需要访问产品数据库，而这个数据库不是随时能够访问到的）。所以，就可以把Dangerous对象的创建交由Foo類別的一个方法（虚函数）createDangerous完成。为了测试，再创建一个Foo的一个子類別TestFoo，重写createDangerous方法，在方法中创建并返回一个FakeDangerous（Dangerous的子類別），而这是一个模拟对象。这样，单元测试就可以使用TestFoo来测试Foo的功能，从而避免了使用Dangerous对象带来的副作用。
target_text: Plant methodology models can be used to test drivers for development, allowing classes to be tested. For example, the Foo category creates a Dangerous object, but the Dangerous object cannot be placed in automatic unit testing (perhaps it needs access to the product database, which is not readily accessible). So, the creation of the Dangerous object can be done by a method (false function) different from Foo. To test, a new Foo subcategory, TesteFoo, rewrite the new versionDangerous method, creating and returning a FakeDangerous (Dangerous subcategory) in the method, which is a simulation object. In this way, the Unit Test can use TestFoo to test Foo functions, thus avoiding the side effects of the use of Dangerous objects.
title: 工厂方法

source_text: OpenVZ是基于Linux内核的操作系统级虚拟化技术。OpenVZ允许物理伺服器运行多个操作系统，該技術常用於虚拟专用伺服器（VPS，Virtual Private Server）。與VMware這種虛擬機和Xen這種硬體輔助虛擬化技術相比，OpenVZ的主机与客户系统都必须是Linux（雖然在不同的虛擬環境裡可以用不同的Linux發行版）。但是，OpenVZ聲稱這樣做有性能上的優勢。根据OpenVZ網站的說法，使用OpenVZ與使用獨立的实体伺服器相比，性能只會有1-3%的損失。
target_text: OpenVZ is based on Linux’s system-level virtualization technology. OpenVZ allows physical servers to run multiple operating systems, which are commonly used in virtual private servers (VPS, Virtual Private Server). Compared to VMware’s virtual and Xen’s hardware-assisted virtualization technology, OpenVZ’s mainframe and client systems must be Linux (although different Linux releases can be used in different virtual environments). However, OpenVZ claims that this is a performance advantage.
title: OpenVZ

source_text: Efficeon改善了許多Crusoe的缺點，整體表現比Crusoe大致上增強了兩倍，另外對比相同的處理技術其芯片尺寸比奔騰4與奔騰M均更為小型；在兩個處理器均為1 MB L2緩衝記憶體時Efficeon的芯片尺寸在90 nm工藝下為 68 mm²，比在90 nm工藝下為112 mm²的奔騰4小40%。銷售一種特殊熱度範圍產品的想法一般不會受大多數評論者所理解，他們往往不管功耗或其應用而將Efficeon與x86領域的微處理器進行對比，其中一個這樣的例子就是批評Efficeon的效能明顯落後於英特爾的奔騰M (Banias)與超微的移動速龍XP。
target_text: Efficeon has improved many of Crusoe’s flaws, and the overall performance has been roughly twice as much as Cruse, and the chip size of the same processing technique is smaller than Bent 4 and Bent M. Both processors compared Efficeon’s microprocessors to Efficeon’s microprocessors in the 1 MB L2 buffer memory with 68 mm2 under 90 nm, 40% less than the helium of 112 mm2 under 90 nm. The idea of selling a special thermal appliance product is not usually understood by most commentators, who often compare Efficeon’s microprocessors with the x86 domain, regardless of its use or use, and one such example is the criticism of Efficeon’s effectiveness, which apparently fell behind the English Run M (Banias) and the ultra-minal moving XP.
title: 全美達

source_text:
Windows NT 4.0中支持的最大内存（RAM）为 4 GB，这是纯32位x86操作系统最大的理论值。相比之下，Windows 95无法在内存超过约480 MB的计算机上启动。与以前的NT版本一样，4.0版可以在多个处理器架构上运行。然而，Windows 95-{只}-能在x86平台上运行。版本工作站版
Windows NT 4.0工作站版（Workstation），設計目標為通用的商業桌面作業系統。以穩定的純32位元作業環境為宣傳，快速的在目標市場中獲得成功地位。
target_text: The largest memory (RAM) supported in Windows NT 4.0 is 4 GB, which is the largest theoretical value of a pure 32-bit x86 operating system. By contrast, Windows 95 cannot be activated on a computer that contains more than 480 MB. As in the previous NT version, version 4.0 can run on multiple processor structures. However, Windows 95-{only} can run on X86 platforms. The Workstation version Windows NT 4.0 is designed as a generic commercial desktop system.
title: Windows NT 4.0

source_text: Windows NT 3.1是微软开发的用于服务器和商业的32位操作系统，是Windows NT产品线的第一代产品，于1993年7月27日发布。Windows NT 3.1是一个完全重新设计的操作系统。它不仅能够在多种处理器架构上运行，还提供比之前基于MS-DOS的Windows版本更高的安全性和稳定性。Windows NT最开始计划是OS/2 3.0，由微软和IBM联合开发的操作系统的第三版。出于多种原因，包括1990年Windows 3.0的市场成功，微软决定推进Windows的开发，IBM独自继续对OS/2的开发。
target_text: Windows NT 3.1, a 32-bit operating system developed by Microsoft for servers and commerce, was released on 27 July 1993 as the first generation of Windows NT product lines. Windows NT 3.1 is a fully redesigned operating system that not only operates on multiple processor structures, but also provides greater security and stability than the earlier version of Windows based on MS-DOS. Windows NT was originally planned as OS/2.3.0, the third version of the operating system developed jointly by Microsoft and IBM. For a number of reasons, including the 1990 Windows 3.0 market success, Microsoft decided to move the Windows development forward and IBM alone continued to develop OS/2.
title: Windows NT 3.1

source_text:
作为NT OS/2
由于使用MS-DOS作为IBM PC 兼容机的实际操作系统，微软在个人电脑市场上占据了主要地位，而（在Dynamical Systems Research被收购后加入微软）发现了主要的两个对微软垄断的威胁：一方面，RISC架构的新处理器被证明比运行MS-DOS和Unix的同等英特尔处理器更强大；另一方面，Unix是一个支持多处理器和网络的跨平台多任务操作系统系列。虽然程序需为每个单独的Unix衍生版本调整使Unix的广泛使用受阻，但比尔·盖茨认为类Unix操作系统与RISC处理器的结合可能是一种市场威胁，促使微软需要开发一种能在多种架构上运行的“ Unix杀手”（Unix killer）。
target_text: As NT OS/2 with the use of MS-DOS as a practical operating system for IBM PC compatible machines, Microsoft dominates the personal computer market and (incorporated into Microsoft after the acquisition of Dynamical Systems Research) has identified two major threats to Microsoft monopoly: on the one hand, the new RISC architecture processor has proved stronger than the same Intel processor that operates MS-DOS and Unix; on the other hand, Unix is a multi-platform multitask operating system series that supports multiprocessors and networks. While the process needs to be adjusted for each separate Unix derivative version, Bill Gates believes that the integration of the generic Unix operating system with the RISC processor may be a market threat, prompting Microsoft to develop a “Unix Killer” (Unix killer) that can operate on multiple structures.
title: Windows NT 3.1

source_text: 该操作系统最初计划作为OS/2 3.0开发，OS/2是微软和IBM联合开发的操作系统。虽然OS/2最初打算接替MS-DOS，但它未获得商业上的成功。新操作系统的设计目标是可以移植到不同的处理器平台，并支持多处理器系统，而当时很少有操作系统能做到这一点。为了面向企业市场，该操作系统还支持网络、POSIX标准，以及符合标准的安全平台；这将要求操作系统是具有权限框架的多用户系统并具有审计安全相关事件的能力。
target_text: The operating system was originally planned to be developed as OS/2 3.0, and OS/2 was a combined Microsoft and IBM operating system. Although OS/2 was originally intended to take over from MS-DOS, it was not commercially successful. The new operating system was designed to allow for the portability of different processor platforms and to support multiprocessor systems, which were rarely available at the time. To be able to do so, the operating system also supported networks, POSIX standards, and a safety platform that met the standards, which would require the operating system to be a multi-user system with a framework of competencies and to have the ability to audit safety-related events.
title: Windows NT 3.1

source_text: 为此，微软开始为非x86处理器开发和测试他们的新操作系统：英特尔的模拟器版本。微软将其操作系统代号命名为NT OS/2，也是暗指芯片的代号“N10”（英文读作“N-Ten”）。 DEC先发制人地起诉微软，声称他们从MICA窃取了用于新操作系统的代码。在庭外和解中，微软同意使NT OS/2与DEC的Alpha处理器兼容。
target_text: To this end, Microsoft began to develop and test their new operating system for non-x86 processors: the Intel Simulator version. Microsoft named its operating system code NT OS/2 and the code N10 (read “N-Ten”) for the implicit chip. DEC pre-emptively sued Microsoft, claiming that they had stolen code from MICA for the new operating system. In an out-of-court settlement, Microsoft agreed to make NT OS/2 compatible with the DEC's Alpha processor.
title: Windows NT 3.1

source_text:
作为Windows NT
基于MS-DOS的Windows 3.0于1990年5月发布后，取得了异常的成功，随之微软的市场策略转变削弱了其与IBM的合作关系——IBM希望微软专注于以OS/2为主要平台的开发，而不是围绕Windows建立他们未来的业务。由于这些不确定因素，用户和开发者不清楚该适应Windows还是OS/2（操作系统在API上的不兼容放大了这种情况），同时微软也因同时开发多个操作系统而资源耗尽。1990年8月，作为对Windows 3.0流行的回应，NT OS/2团队决定重新设计操作系统以使用Windows API的扩展的32位接口（即Win32）。Win32保留了Windows使用的熟悉的16位API体系，这将使开发者可以轻松地将他们的软件为新平台适配，同时保持与现有Windows软件的兼容性。
target_text: As a result of these uncertainties, users and developers do not know whether to adapt to Windows or to OS/2 (which is magnified by the incompatibility of operating systems on the API), while Microsoft’s market strategy shifts have weakened its partnership with IBM – which wants Microsoft to focus on the development of OS/2 as the main platform rather than building their future business around Windows. In response to Windows 3.0 the NT OS/2 team decided in August 1990 to re-engineer the operating system to use Windows API’s extended 32-bit interface (i.e. Win32). Winin32 retained the 16-bit API system used by Windows, which would allow developers to easily adapt their software to the new platform while maintaining compatibility with existing Windows software.
title: Windows NT 3.1

source_text: 1991年10月，Windows NT在COMDEX上首次公布。为确保利用Windows NT的软件在其发布时（计划于1992年末发布）可用，微软还向出席的选定的开发人员分发了32位软件开发工具包。这次展示得到了正面回应；《个人电脑杂志》称 Windows NT 是“操作系统的现代改造”，但同时声称，最终版本不太可能保留承诺的向下兼容性。1992年3月，微软还发布了Win32s，为了开发针对该平台优化的软件，还允许Windows 3.1与Windows NT程序部分兼容。
target_text: In October 1991, Windows NT was first published on COMDEX. To ensure that Windows NT software was available at the time of its release (planned for release in late 1992), Microsoft also distributed 32 software development toolkits to selected attendees. The demonstration received a positive response; Windows NT, according to the Personal Computer Journal, was “modernizing the operating system” but claimed that it was unlikely that the final version would retain the downside compatibility of the commitment. In March 1992, Microsoft also released Win32s, allowing Windows 3.1 to be compatible with Windows NT to develop software to optimize the platform.
title: Windows NT 3.1

source_text: 在1992年6月的微软Win32专业开发者大会上，展示了在x86和MIPS处理器上运行的Windows NT，同时还提供了Windows NT的测试版和更新的开发工具包。同时，微软宣布了其用于Windows NT的SQL Server产品的新版本；Unix供应商担心该软件可能成为影响Unix系统市场份额的杀手级应用。NT的内存使用也引起了关注；当时的大多数计算机都配备4 MB的RAM，而NT建议使用16 MB。由于当时RAM成本高昂，批评者认为其高系统要求可能会影响Windows NT的销售和使用。通过诸如分页之类的方法减少其内存使用量的措施也已采取。
target_text: At the Microsoft Win32 Professional Developmenters Conference in June 1992, Windows NT, which operated on X86 and MIPS processors, was presented with a test version of Windows NT and an updated development toolkit. At the same time, Microsoft announced a new version of its SQL Server product for Windows NT; Unix suppliers were concerned that the software could be a killer-level application affecting the market share of Unix systems.
title: Windows NT 3.1

source_text: 微软于1992年10月开始发布NT的公开测试版，一个月后，在COMDEX上举行了一场主要关于Windows NT第三方软件的演讲。NT的最终预发布版本于1993年3月发布，同时公布了服务器版本Windows NT，Windows NT with LAN Manager。尽管其稳定性和性能有所提高，但仍有人担心该操作系统可能会发布未成品或进一步推迟到1993年。
target_text: Microsoft began issuing a public test version of the NT in October 1992 and, a month later, a lecture was given at COMDEX, mainly on Windows NT third-party software. The final pre-release version of NT was released in March 1993 and the server version Windows NT with LAN Manager was published. Despite its increased stability and performance, there are concerns that the operating system may publish unfinished products or further delay to 1993.
title: Windows NT 3.1

基于一般教育机构的需要与资源，创立一个适合于学校使用的Linux发行版

使用开放软件和廉价的老旧硬件以节省成本
将软件文档翻译成所有在挪威受到官方支援的语言，包括书面挪威语、新挪威语、和萨米语等三个语言，以达成信息技术基础设施的本地化

target_text: In computer programming, the entry point is the place where the first instruction is implemented in the program and where the command line parameters are accessed. source_text: Apple標準鍵盤苹果电脑使用的键盘与普通PC的有些许差异，比如1980年代麥金塔電腦的键盘上有“苹果键”，上面标有标志，后来苹果键被“command⌘”键代替。用法通常，键盘被用来输入文本到文本编辑器、文字处理器或者其他文本工具。现在的电脑把解释键值转换的工作交给了软件。键盘给每一个物理的键定义了对应的键值，然后将所有的输入报告给控制软件，由软件决定相应的输出。
target_text: The keyboards used by Apple's standard keyboards differ somewhat from those used by ordinary PCs, for example, in the 1980s, when the keyboards of McKinta's computers were marked with " apple keys " , which were replaced by "command keys " . Usually, the keyboards are used to enter text into text editors, text processors, or other text tools. The computer now assigns the interpretation of key conversions to the software. The keyboard defines the corresponding key values for each physics key and then gives all input reports to the control software, which determines the corresponding output.
title: 电脑键盘

source_text: 在市场学术语中，杀手级应用（Killer application）是指一个极具价值的计算机程序或服务，其具有较强的吸引力或必要性，而消费者愿意为这个程序或服务购买特定硬件、软件产品、操作系统产品或服务等。换言之，消费者购买了相关硬件，很可能只是为了运行这项应用，是故，杀手级应用能有效提高其所运行平台的销量。
target_text: In market terminology, Killer application refers to a highly valuable computer program or service that is more attractive or necessary and for which consumers are willing to purchase specific hardware, software products, operating system products, or services. In other words, consumers purchase the hardware, probably just to run the application.
title: 杀手级应用

source_text: 下载者（Downloader）是一类计算机病毒程序，按照国际上的病毒命名惯例为“Trojan-Downloader”一类，这类木马程序的主要内容为：指引中毒用户的计算机到黑客指定的url地址去下载更多的病毒文件并运行，使得黑客获得更大操作权限，为黑客后门技术的基础。一般这类病毒体大小在几百字节到几KB之间，比一般的木马程序要小的多。
target_text: The downloader (Downloader) is a type of computer virus, called “Trojan-Downloader” according to international virus naming practices. The main elements of such a carousel program are: to guide a poisoned user's computer to download more virus files and run them at a url address designated by hackers, which gives hackers greater operational access and provides the basis for hacking backdoor technology.
title: 下载者

source_text: -{zh-cn:接口描述语言;zh-tw:介面描述語言}-（Interface description language，缩写IDL），是用来描述软件组件介面的一种计算机语言。IDL通过一种獨立於編程語言的方式来描述接口，使得在不同平台上运行的对象和用不同语言编写的程序可以相互通信交流；比如，一个组件用C++写成，另一个组件用Java写成。
target_text: - {zh-cn: interface description language; zh-tw: interface description language} - (Interface description language, acronym IDL) is a computer language used to describe software component interfaces. The IDL describes interfaces by means of a stand-alone programming language that allows objects running on different platforms and programs written in different languages to communicate with each other; for example, one component is written in C++ and the other in Java.
title: 接口描述语言

source_text: IDL通常用于远程调用软件。在这种情况下，一般是由远程客户终端调用不同操作系统上的对象组件，并且这些对象组件可能是由不同计算机语言编写的。IDL建立起了两个不同操作系统间通信的桥梁。在IDL基础上开发出来的软件系统有Sun的ONC RPC，The Open Group的分散式運算環境，IBM的，Object Management Group的CORBA，和SOAP（用于Web service）。
target_text: IDL is usually used for remote calls of software. In this case, the object components on different operating systems are typically called by remote customer terminals and may be produced in different computer languages. IDL builds bridges between two different operating systems. The software systems developed on the IDL basis are Sun's ONC RPC, The Open Group's decentralized operation environment, IBM, Object Management Group's CORBA, and SOAP (for Web service).
title: 接口描述语言

source_text: 在编程语言中，文字表示的字符串的意思，这个些字符串被允许或者用来定义基本类型的（Basistypen）（比如说，整数，浮点数，字符串等等）。它们没有被标记，但是却在某些情况下被植入编程源中。文字只能在右边的表达法（比如说在一个指示性运算符或者函数论证的右边）中出现。绝大多数情况下，文字被归入常量或者指称为文字常量，因为两者相对于变量和运行时间来讲是相对不变的。常量在严格的意义上来讲就是其赋值不变的表达因子，也就是说，指称在源代码中可以经常应用的唯一的对象，而不是将相同的文字重复给出。
target_text: In programming language, the text indicates the meaning of the string, which is allowed or used to define the basic type (Basistypen) (e.g., integer, floating points, strings, etc.). They are not marked, but in some cases are embedded in the programming source. Text can only appear in the expression on the right (e.g., on the right side of an indicative operator or on the right side of a function argument). In most cases, text is classified as constant or is referred to as a text constant, because they are relatively constant relative to the variable and the time of operation. The constant is, in the strict sense of the term, the expression factor of its attribution, i.e., the sole object that is alleged to be frequently applied in the source code, rather than repeating the same text.
title: 文字 (数理逻辑)

source_text:
Praat语音学软件，原名Praat: doing phonetics by computer，通常简称Praat，是一款跨平台的多功能语音学专业软件，主要用于对数字化的语音信号进行分析、标注、处理及合成等实验，同时生成各种语图和文字报表。背景概要命名
Praat（国际音标 或）在荷兰语中是说话或交谈的意思，而doing phonetics by computer即使用计算机研究语音学。作为软件的名称，常被称作Praat语音学软件。
target_text: Praat Voice Software, originally named Praat: doing phonetics by compute, commonly known as Praat, is a multifunctional voice software specialized, cross-platform, used mainly for the analysis, labelling, processing and synthesis of digital voice signals and the production of various speech charts and text statements. The background profile is named Praat (international voice tags) or is meant to speak or talk in Dutch, while doing phonetics by computer uses a computer to study voice science. As the name of the software, it is often called Praat voice software.
title: Praat语音学软件

source_text:
版本
Praat最早的版本发布于1993年。起初用户还无法自由地下载使用，但从2003年6月5日的4.1版起，作者取消了专门的授权并开放了绝大部分源代码。进一步，从2004年3月4日的4.2版起，作者开放了全部源代码，使Praat成为采用GNU通用公共许可证授权的开源软件。作者会时常发布修订版本，消除旧的故障，增添新的功能。2007年12月10日发布了5.0版。
target_text: The earliest version of Praat was released in 1993. Initially, users were unable to download it freely, but since version 4.1 of 5 June 2003, the author cancelled the special authorization and opened most of the source code. Further, starting with version 4.2 of 4 March 2004, the author opened up all the source code, making Praat open-source software authorized by the GNU General Public Licence.
title: Praat语音学软件

source_text:
Praat目前支持在多种计算机平台上运行，包括：
Macintosh
Windows
Linux，FreeBSD
SGI，Solaris，HPUX
作者为以上平台的用户提供已编译好的目标文件。高级用户还可以在其他操作系统平台上修改并编译源代码后运行Praat程序。Praat能够在图形和命令行两种用户界面下运行，但两种界面的目标文件（可执行文件）各自独立，以Windows版为例，即分为praat.exe和praatcon.exe两个可执行文件，其中后者只能通过命令行方式从控制台调用。
target_text: Praat currently supports the operation of multiple computer platforms, including: Macintosh Windows Linux, FreeBSD SGI, Solaris, HPUX authors provide compiled target files for the users of these platforms. Advanced users can also run Praat programs by modifying and compiling source codes on other operating system platforms. Praat can run under two user interfaces: graphics and command lines, but the target files (executables) of each interface are separate, using Windows versions as an example, i.e. two executable documents: Praat.exe and Praatcon.exe, which can only be called from the control table by command lines.
title: Praat语音学软件

source_text:
用途概述
Praat的主要功能是对自然语言的语音信号进行采集、分析和标注，并执行包括变换和滤波等在内的多种处理任务。作为分析结果的文字报表和语图，不但可以输出到个人计算机的磁盘文件中和终端的显示器上，更能够输出为精致的矢量图或位图，供写作和印刷学术论文与专著使用。
target_text: The main function of Praat is the collection, analysis and labelling of voice signals in natural languages and the execution of multiple processing tasks, including transformation and filtering. As a result of the analysis, text sheets and speech charts can be exported not only to disk files on personal computers, but also to end-of-end monitors, and more to fine vector or bitmap, for use in writing and printing academic papers and monographs.
title: Praat语音学软件

source_text:
其他功能
Praat还具有许多其他功能，包括：
语音实验：嗓音分析、多重强迫选择实验、滤波、声源滤波合成、发音合成等。
辅助教学：前馈神经网、优选论学习等。
统计分析：主成分分析、多维量表、判别分析等。
其中某些功能的提供与软件作者的研究兴趣有关（例如“优选论学习”），很多不相关的用户可能不会用到。
target_text: Other functions Praat also have a number of other functions, including: speech experiments: voice analysis, multiple forced selection experiments, filtering, synthesizing of sound sources, pronunciation, etc. Assisting teaching: pre-feed neurological webs, optimising studies, etc. Statistical analysis: primary composition analysis, multi-dimensional tables, differential analysis, etc. The availability of some of these functions is related to the research interests of software authors (e.g., “optimistic learning”), and many unrelated users may not be used.
title: Praat语音学软件

source_text:
优点
可以免费获得而无需购买（因为是开源软件）。
无需安装即可运行（但严格地说，还不是绿色软件）。
支持多种操作系统平台。
支持用脚本宏命令和插件（plug-in）扩展和简化操作。
专业功能强大而完备。
高级用户可以按需修改源代码并重新编译，从根本上扩充原有功能。
附有详细的手册文档。
target_text: Advantages are available free of charge (because they are open source software). They can run without installation (but, strictly speaking, they are not green software). Supports multiple operating system platforms. Supports the expansion and simplification of operations with script macro commands and plugins (plug-in).
title: Praat语音学软件

source_text:
缺点
分析程序采用的某些数字信号处理算法仍然不尽如人意，会不可避免地造成迷惑人的假象或产生难以解释的结果。
不能直接访问某些常用音频和图像文件格式，如WMA格式；对MP3格式的支持也仅限读取（软件许可证方面的原因）。
由于最初并不是在Windows平台下开发的，用户界面的设计和某些操作习惯可能会让Windows用户感到不便，比如没有鼠标右键菜单，键盘按键名称也是Macintosh机器的。
目前尚无除英语以外其他语言的版本，部分用户可能会遇到语言障碍。
尚未全面支援Unicode。档案名称如果包含汉字，在Praat对象窗口中会被底线取代。在TextGrid对象中如果输入汉字，屏幕上会显示乱码（但所储存文本仍旧正常，只是显示不出来）。标注时所使用的国际音标字型为SIL Doulos IPA 1993，而非SIL推荐的Unicode 字型。
target_text: Some of the digital signal processing algorithms used by the analysis program are still unsatisfactory and inevitably lead to confusing images or hard-to-explain results. There is no direct access to some of the commonly used audio and image file formats, such as WMA; support for MP3 formats is limited to reading only (in terms of software licences). Since the files are not originally developed under Windows platforms, the design of the user interfaces and certain operating habits may cause problems for Windows users, for example, without the right mouse menu, the keyboard keys name is a Macintosh machine.
title: Praat语音学软件

source_text:
影响
尽管还存在一些缺点和不足，毕竟瑕不掩瑜，Praat已成为全世界实验语音学、心理语言学、语言教学、语言调查、自然语言处理等相关领域的高校教师、学生和其他研究人员普遍选用的专业软件。
Praat的普及，终结了从事实验语音学特别是声学语音学研究必须依赖价格昂贵的实验仪器的时代，许多语音学实验室不再使用各种陈旧的语图仪，而仅仅配置有安装了Praat等软件的个人计算机和灵敏的麦克风作为必备的器材。
部分Praat高级用户公开发布自己编写的脚本甚至插件，其中不乏实用性较高者，既扩充了软件的功能，也扩大了影响。
在中国大陆：尽管只有英语版本可用，许多高校的教师在语音学等相关课程上用Praat进行教学演示，在研究工作中自己使用并鼓励学生克服语言障碍学习掌握Praat的基本功能。越来越多的学术论文和专著当中可以见到用Praat生成的语图和文字报表。不过，总体而言，了解并能够用好这一工具的专业人士还比较少。
target_text: The popularization of Praat has ended the era in which experimental speech studies, especially acoustics, must rely on expensive laboratory instruments, and many speech labs no longer use old speech drawings, but are equipped with personal computers and sensitive microphones installed with Praat software as essential devices. Some high-level Praat users publicly publish their own scripts and even illustrations, which expand the functionality and influence of the software, although only the English version is available, many high-school teachers use Praat in related courses, such as speech studies, and use themselves in research and encourage students to overcome language barriers to acquire Praat’s basic functions.
title: Praat语音学软件

source_text:
参考书目
专门介绍Praat使用方法的著作，在世界范围内也并不多见。在中国大陆，有些语音学研究者也作有非正式出版的讲义，而正式出版的学术专著也可能特辟章节简单讲解，列举如下（按出版日期先后排序）：
Praat语音软件使用手册／熊子瑜（2004年现代语音学暑期讲习班课程讲义，有电子版）
语音特征分析和Praat软件的使用／熊子瑜（2005年现代语音学暑期讲习班课程讲义，有电子版）
语言、语音与技术／王士元，彭刚著．－上海：上海教育出版社，2006年8月（中国当代语言学丛书，ISBN 7-5444-0714-4）——第十二章，Praat简介
target_text: Bibliography The literature devoted to the methods used by Praat is not widely available worldwide. In mainland China, some speech researchers also give lectures on non-formal publications, while the officially published academic monographs may also present brief chapters, as listed below (in order of date of publication): Praat voice software manual/ Bear Yo (in the course of the modern voice school summer workshop in 2004, with electronic versions); speech characterization analysis and use of Praat software/ Bear Yoyo (in the course of the modern voice school summer workshop in 2005, with electronic versions); Language, voice and technology/Standard Won, Penang: Shanghai Education Press, August 2006 (China's contemporary language series, ISBN 7-5444-0714-4) - Chapter XII, Prat Introduction

source_text: 传输线（transmission line）是电子工程中的专用电缆或者其他结构，用于传输无线电频率的交流电流，也就是说，电流的频率高到一定程度时必须考虑它们波的性质。传输线一般用于连接发送器与接收器的天线，传输有线电视信号，中继电信交换中心之间的路由呼叫，计算机网络连接以及高速计算机数据总线。
target_text: Transferwires (transmission line) are specialized cables in electronic engineering or other structures used to transmit the communication currents of radio frequencies, that is, the nature of their waves must be taken into account when the frequency of the current is high to a certain degree. Transmission lines are usually used to connect the sender to the receiver's antenna, transmit cable television signals, route calls between relay telecentres, computer network connections and high-speed computer data main lines.
title: 传输线

source_text: 虚拟终端機（）是在个人电脑上虚拟的一个终端以及为此目的而写的软件。虚拟终端的目的是达到个人电脑及其用户能够与大型计算机的连接。一般来说需要连接的大型计算机是IBM的大型计算机或者所谓的超小型计算机（过去往往是迪吉多的VAX）。
target_text: Virtual terminals () are a virtual terminal on personal computers and software written for this purpose. Virtual terminals are intended to reach the connections that personal computers and their users can make to large computers.
title: 虚拟终端

source_text: 虚拟终端使得个人电脑的用户可以直接使用他的个人电脑来与大型计算机联系，而不必使用专门的终端。通过虚拟终端的软件虚拟终端还可以扩展大型计算机的标准终端的功能，通过虚拟终端不但可以将个人电脑上的数据传递给大型计算机，而且还可以将大型计算机的数据传递给个人电脑，并在个人电脑上继续加工。
target_text: Virtual terminals allow users of personal computers to use their personal computers directly to connect to large computers rather than using specialized terminals. Virtual terminals of software can also expand the standard terminal function of large computers, which not only transmits data on personal computers to large computers, but also transmits data from large computers to personal computers and continues to process them on personal computers.
title: 虚拟终端

source_text: Microsoft Amalga或Azyxxi（发音： ah-ZIK-see）医疗（病历）数据库软件，是一种数据浏览引擎（外号：医院里的Google）。它采用多渠道获得并分析病人信息资料，用于辅助医疗人员的诊断和治疗。 信息的来源渠道包括（但不限于）扫描的病历，心电图记录，X射线，CT，MRI或其他影像学扫描记录，实验室检查结果，手术记录，大规模调查记录，以及病人联系信息。
target_text: Microsoft Amalga or Azyxi (pronunciation: ah-ZIK-see) medical (historic) database software, a data browse engine (example: Google in a hospital). It uses multiple channels to obtain and analyse patient information for use in assisting medical staff in diagnosis and treatment. Sources of information include (but are not limited to) scanned medical records, electrocardiogram records, X-rays, CT, MRI or other video scanning records, laboratory results, surgical records, large-scale investigation records, and patient contact information.
title: Microsoft Amalga

target_text: The optical amplifiers can generally be divided into fibre-optic amplifiers and semiconductor optical amplifiers. The fibre-optic amplifiers can also be divided into optic magnifiers, optic magnifiers, optic magnifiers, and Raman amplifiers. They have worked at 1550 nm wavelengths and have been widely used in the fibre-optic communications industry. The amplifiers can work at 1310 nm wavelengths, but are still in the laboratory research phase because the conversion efficiency is not ideal. Raman amplifiers are a new kind of magnifiers that have been commercialized in recent years, mainly in cases requiring distributional magnification. source_text: 系统F，也叫做多态lambda演算或二阶lambda演算，是有类型lambda演算。它由逻辑学家和计算机科学家独立发现的。系统F形式化了编程语言中的参数多态的概念。正如同lambda演算有取值于（rang over）函数的变量，和来自它们的粘合子（binder）；二阶lambda演算取值自类型，和来自它们的粘合子。作为一个例子，恒等函数有形如A→ A的任何类型的事实可以在系统F中被形式化为判断
target_text: System F, also known as multi-state lambda calculations or second-order lambda calculations, is a type of lambda calculations. It is independently discovered by logic scientists and computer scientists. System F forms the multi-state concept of parameters in programming languages. Just like the variables from which the lambda calculations have valued (range over) functions, and the glues from them, binder; second-order lambda calculations are of their own type and from their glues. As an example, the tangibles of a permanent function, such as A.I.A., can be formally transformed into judgements in system F.
title: 系统F

source_text: 用在编程语言中本文用的系统F版本是显式类型的，或邱奇风格的演算。包含在λ-项内的类型信息使类型检查直接了当。Joe Wells（1994）设立了一个"难为人的公开问题"，证明系统 F的Curry-风格的变体是不可判定的，它缺乏明显的类型提示。Wells的结果暗含着系统F的类型推论是不可能的。一个限制版本的系统F叫做"Hindley-Milner"，或简称"HM"，有一个容易的类型推论算法，并用于了很多强类型的函数式编程语言，比如Haskell和ML。
target_text: The system version F, which is used in programming language, is an obvious type, or a Quixian-style calculation. The type of information contained in the -item makes the type check straightforward. Joe Wells (1994) establishes a "discussed public question" that proves that the Curry-style variant of System F is non-determinable and lacks obvious type hints. The Wells results imply that the system F type inference is impossible. A restricted version of system F, called "Hindley-Miller", or "HM", has an easy type extrapolation method and is used in a number of powerful functional programming languages, such as Haskell and ML.
title: 系统F

source_text: 通过列出多位加法器各位的进位输出，可以发现高位的进位输出表达式（积之和式）涉及的变量更多，对应的逻辑电路连线会变得更复杂，而且在实际应用中会遭遇逻辑门的扇入问题。因此有必要对位数过高的全加器进行逻辑划分，如将六十四位全加器分为四个十六位超前进位加法器来实现（如右图）。多位二进制数加法器的标准芯片通常具有超前进位的组成形式，例如:7400系列的7483、74283芯片。

It is therefore necessary to logically divide the hyper-digital full-loader, for example by dividing the sixty-four full-digit adder into four sixteen super-forward additions (e.g., right graphs). Standard chips for multiple binary additions usually have a super-forward composition, such as 7483, 74283 chips in the 7400 series.

source_text: Multics，名稱來自於多工資訊與計算系統（）的縮寫，它是一套分時多工作業系統，是1964年由貝爾實驗室、麻省理工學院及美国通用电气公司所共同參與研發，并安裝在大型主機上。最后一个装有Multics的计算机已于2000年10月30日关闭。通过UNIX，几乎所有现代操作系统都深受Multics的影响，无论是直接 （Linux, OS X）或间接（Microsoft Windows）。
target_text: Multiics, an abbreviation from the Multi-Technology Information and Calculator system, is a timed multi-occupational system that was developed in 1964 and installed on a large mainframe by the Bell Laboratory, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and General Electric. The last computer with Multiics was shut down on 30 October 2000. Through UNIX, almost all modern operating systems are under the influence of Multiics, either directly (Linux, OS X) or indirectly (soft Windows).
title: Multics

靜態型別不同於動態型別。在靜態型別系統中，型別是與變數相連繫的名稱（通常是在声明時），而不是值（通常是在初始化時）。型別也可藉由編譯器來推斷。
通过语言定义，对型別约束违规的编译时间检查的托管要求。就是说，编译器确保操作只发生在对这个运算有效的操作数上。
型別安全；就是说，拒绝(在要么编译时间要么執行时间)尝试忽视資料型別的操作或函式呼叫。在更严格的设置下，通过证明进行性和藏存性来证明关于形式语言的型別安全。
禁止型別轉換。某個型別的值，不論是不是以顯式或隱式的方式，都不可轉換為另一個型別。
但是某些作者，把“强型別语言”称呼保留给省略隐式型別转换(就是说编译器为了利益编程者而插入的转换)的语言。对于这些作者，编程语言是强型別的，如果型別必须通过通常叫做“强制”的显式符号来转换。
無法規避型別系統。某些語言允許程式員取得值的表示法之下的東西（即位元模式），這有可能規避型別系統。
有复合型別的复杂而细致的型別系统。
資料物件中固定且不變的型別。给定資料物件的型別在这个物件的生命期内不改变。例如，类实例不可以改变它们的类。
在執行程式之前，強型別就保證了執行時期的程式行為，其以靜態分析或其它的機制提供。
target_text: In a static system, the type is the name associated with the variable (usually at the time of the statement), not the value (usually at the time of initialization). The type can also be deduced by the compiler. By language definition, the hosting requirement for the time of editing violations of the type is that the compiler ensures that the operation takes place only in the number of operations that are effective for this function. The type is secure; some authors, however, try to ignore (either compile or execute the time) the data type operation or the function call (usually at the time of the statement). Under more stringent settings, proof of the security of the form language is provided by proof of its integrity and storage.

入侵可以指未经许可而进入的各个领域、区域的事务或人的行为。在不同领域的含义有：
军事入侵，政治实体的一方武装进入另一方控制的领土，包括海、陸、空或三者的結合。入侵可能引发战争。
侵略战争，主要形式有武装入侵、政治干涉、经济迫害、文化渗透等方式。
生物入侵，在生物学领域，一种外来物种由于自然传播、人为引入而在新的地区造成繁衍失控，对其他物种可能造成灾难，稱為「入侵物種」。在微生物学领域，有害细菌、病毒在疫区的传播，对人类和其他生物界造成疾病或其他致命伤害。
网络入侵，信息网络方面，计算机病毒对计算机网络造成的破坏。
《全面入侵》，一部美国的科幻電視作品。
target_text: Invasion may take the form of armed invasion, political interference, economic persecution, cultural penetration, etc. Bioinvasion, in the biological field, where an alien species can thrive in new areas as a result of natural and man-made introduction, and may cause disaster to other species, known as “invasive species.” In the microbiology field, the spread of harmful bacteria, viruses in epidemic areas, causing disease or other lethal harm to humans and other biological communities.
title: 入侵

source_text: 1936年，圖靈發表的研究報告對計算機和電腦科學領域造成巨大衝擊，這篇報告主要是為了證明循環處理程式的死角，亦即停機問題的存在。圖靈也以演算法概念為通用計算機（純理論裝置）作出定義，後來稱為圖靈機，取代哥德爾漸趨累贅的通用語言。除了記憶體限制，現代電腦已經具備圖靈完全的條件，也就是說，現代電腦的演算法執行力已與通用圖靈機相當。記憶體限制有時也被視為一般用途電腦與特殊用途電腦的差別。
target_text: In 1936, the research report published by Turing had a huge impact on the computer and computer science fields, mainly to prove that there was a dead end to the recycling process, i.e., a stoppage problem. It was also defined by the concept of algorithms as a general calculator (a pure theoretical device), which was later called an engine to replace the growing common language of Godel. In addition to memory limitations, modern computers already have fully engineered terms, that is to say, that the algorithmic power of modern computers is comparable to that of a universal graphic machine.
title: 計算機硬體歷史

source_text: 在计算机科学中，一个桌面环境（Desktop environment，有时称为桌面管理器）是对桌面比擬的实现。它由多个软件组成。一个桌面环境中的软件共享同一个图形用户界面。在一个典型的桌面环境中，这些软件提供给计算机用户视窗，文件夹，工具栏，壁纸、图标以及像拖放等服务。不同桌面环境在设计和功能上的特性会赋予其与众不同的外观和感觉。
target_text: In computer science, a desktop environment (Desktop environment, sometimes called a desktop manager) is the realization of desktop simulations. It consists of several software components. Software in a desktop environment is shared with a graphical user interface. In a typical desktop environment, these software are provided to computer users with windows, folders, toolbars, wallpapers, icons, and services like drag-and-drop. Different desktop environments are designed and functionally unique to a different look and feel.
title: 桌面环境

source_text:
移民型
移民型的模拟中，參加者是从外部现实世界进入模拟的，類似於脑机接口，但形式不同。進入時，参加者透過意识上传技术将他们的意識置入虚拟人体中。模擬結束时，参加者的意識返回到外部世界的身体，從而獲得模拟中的记忆和经验。混合型
混合型模拟支持各种形式的意识。其中包括通过脑机接口進入的外部世界的参与者、移民，以及虚拟公民。电影《黑客帝国》就涉及到这种混合型模擬。外界不仅有具有肉体的人类心灵，还有计算机世界特有的独立软件程序，比如幹員。
target_text: In migration-type simulations, participants enter simulations from the outside real world, similar to brain interfaces, but in different forms. At the end of the simulation, participants put their consciousness into the virtual human body through conscious uploading techniques. At the end of the simulation, participants return their consciousness to the outside world and gain memory and experience in simulations. Mixed simulations support various forms of consciousness. They include participants from the outside world, immigrants, and virtual citizens who enter through brain interfaces.
title: 模擬實境

source_text: 鸽巢排序（Pigeonhole sort），也被称作基数分类，是一种时间复杂度为（大O符號）且在不可避免遍历每一个元素并且排序的情况下效率最好的一种排序算法。但它只有在差值（或者可被映射在差值）很小的范围内的数值排序的情况下实用。当涉及到多个不相等的元素，且将这些元素放在同一个「鸽巢」的时候，算法的效率会有所降低。为了简便和保持鸽巢排序在适应不同的情况，比如两个在同一个存储桶中结束的元素必然相等。
target_text: Pigeonhole sort, also known as the base classification, is the best sorting algorithm with time complexity (large o symbol) and efficiency in inevitable traveling through each element and sorting. It is only practical when values are sorted within a very small range of the margin (or can be mapped at the margin). When several different elements are involved and they are placed in the same "vevee nest", the efficiency of the algorithm is reduced. To ease and keep the doves sorted in a different situation, for example, two elements that end in the same bucket are necessarily identical.
title: 鸽巢排序

source_text: 我们一般很少使用鸽巢排序，因为它很少可以在灵活性、简便性、尤是速度上超过其他排序算法。事实上，桶排序较鸽巢排序更加的实用。鸽巢排序的一个比较有名的变形是吻合排序法（），它仅仅适用非常有限的题目，这个算法因在Programming Pearls一书中作为解决一个非常规有限集问题方法的例子而著名。
target_text: We usually rarely use doves to sort, because it can rarely be more flexible, simple, and especially faster than other sorting algorithms. source_text: 与之相对的，打印机的字体，如著名的Apple LaserWriter是基于PostScript Type 1轮廓，可以出色地输出任何大小的文字。轮廓字体通过一套描绘曲线的算式来创建每个字符或“字形”。使用算式，计算机可以绘制出一个“轮廓”形状，然后再“填充”进颜色（例如：黑色）从而打印出字符。这些算式可以按照比例进行缩放到任意大小，而与显示器和打印机的解析度无关。无论是打印到胶片，还是显示在屏幕上都具有同样的质量。该技术曾经是一个重要的发明，并由Adobe公司创始人开发推行，称为PostScript。但另一个难点是Type 1字体是加密过的，Adobe通过发售格式认证得到了相当可观的收入，所以他们也不想向苹果免费转让这个软件。
target_text: By contrast, printer fonts, such as the famous Apple LaserWriter, are based on the PortScript Type 1 contour, which allows excellent output of text of any size. The technology was an important invention that was developed by the founder of Adobe, known as PostScript.

source_text: A400M还运用了大量碳纤维复合材料，按结构重量计算达到了35%-40%。这些复合材料是由英国的GKN公司提供的，这也是空中客车公司首次在机翼、尾翼与操纵面上大规模使用复合材料。机翼的梁架与蒙皮都使用了复合材料，而且施工工艺也运用了许多自动化技术与计算机软件辅助，举例来说最短的一段梁架人工铺设需要180小时，而采用自动化技术后只需要90分钟。A400M的货舱舱门、起落架舱门、起落架整流罩以及起落架刹车等部件也使用了复合材料，4扇起落架舱门由于使用了复合材料每扇减轻了90千克的重量。

Minimax算法（亦稱 MinMax or MM）又名极小化极大算法，是一种找出失败的最大可能性中的最小值的算法。概述
Minimax算法常用于棋类等由两方较量的游戏和程序。该算法是一个零总和算法，即一方要在可选的选项中选择将其优势最大化的选择，另一方则选择令对手优势最小化的方法。而开始的时候总和为0。很多棋类游戏可以采取此算法，例如井字棋（tic-tac-toe）。
target_text: The Minimax algorithm (also known as MinMax or MM) is also a very small algorithm, which is the minimum of the most likely value for finding failure. The Minimax algorithm is often used for games and procedures with a two-rather balance, such as chess. The algorithm is a zero-sum algorithm, where one party chooses the option of maximizing its advantage among the optional options, while the other chooses the method of minimizing the advantage of its opponent. At the start, it is always zero. Many chess games can use this algorithm, for example, the tic-tac-toe.

source_text: 查尔斯·西蒙尼（，），生于匈牙利布达佩斯，原名西蒙尼·卡羅利（匈牙利语：），软件開發專家，曾任微軟公司的產品開發主任。西蒙尼是微软的早期员工之一，他曾在十多年间主持Microsoft Office各个部件程序的开发工作。坚持面向对象的软件开发运程，为Microsoft Office主宰世界市场立下汗马功劳。
target_text: Charles Simoni (,), born in Budapest, Hungary, was originally named Simone Carrolli (Hungarian:), a software developer and former director of Microsoft’s products. Simoni, one of Microsoft’s early employees, had been working on Microsoft Office components for more than a decade. He insisted on a target-oriented software development process, paying tribute to Microsoft Office’s dominance of the world market.
title: 查尔斯·西蒙尼

source_text: 1966年西蒙尼中学毕业后，他籍着开发程序编译器的工作经验在丹麦「A/S Regnecentralen」计算中心找到第一份工作。两年后，他用工作攒下的钱来到美国加利福尼亚州进入加大柏克萊分校学习工程應用数学及数理统计。1972年西蒙尼从加大毕业后，进入斯坦福大学研究生班学习深造计算机科学。在学习期间他还在施乐公司兼职工作。他在导师的指导下和公司同事合作开发出当时领先的可视见（WYSIWYG）文本编辑软件BRAVO。1977年他以优异成绩取得了斯坦福大学的博士学位。
target_text: After graduating from Simoni High School in 1966, he found his first job at the Danish "A/S Regnecentralen" computing centre on the basis of his experience in developing program compilers. Two years later, he went to California, United States of America, with the money he saved, to study mathematics and mathematical statistics for engineering. After graduating from the University of Stanford in 1972, Simoni went to a postgraduate class to study further computer science. He worked part-time at Xerox during his studies. He worked with company colleagues to develop the WYSIWYG text editing software, Bravo. He obtained a doctorate from Stanford University in 1977 with distinction.
title: 查尔斯·西蒙尼

source_text: 1981年，施乐的同事Metcalfe建议他向微软公司主席比尔盖茨写信毛遂自荐。盖茨很快就批准了西蒙尼的申请并重用他主持Multiplan软件的开发工作。Multiplan即Microsoft Excel的前身。西蒙尼成功地采用一项新设计准则使得Multiplan软件能在多个运行平台（又称操作系统）上工作。尽管后来微软的DOS操作系统迅速普及使得该软件可移植性意义相对不大，但是西蒙尼的创举令盖茨对他深为赏识，两人密切合作。
target_text: In 1981, Xerox's colleague Metcalfe advised him to write a letter to Bill Gates, Chairman of Microsoft. Gates quickly approved Simoni's application and re-used him to host the development of Multiplan software. Multiplan, the predecessor of Microsoft Excel, successfully introduced a new design code that enabled Multiplan to work on multiple operating platforms (also known as operating systems).
title: 查尔斯·西蒙尼

source_text: 西蒙尼还创导了「宏程序」（metaprogramme）与「宏程序员」（metaprogrammer）的概念，其目的在于增强对软件开发的管理，但比较鲜为人知。自八十年代至九十年代微软的蓬勃发展充分证明了西蒙尼的出色产品计划、项目计划与项目管理才能。盖茨则保证他成为世界上最高薪的软件开发人员。
target_text: Simone also introduced the concept of "metaprogramme" and "metaprogrammer" to enhance the management of software development, but it is less known. The boom in Microsoft from the 1980’s to the 1990’s is ample proof of Simone’s excellence in product planning, project planning, and project management.

source_text:
後果
内存泄漏会因为减少可用内存的数量从而降低计算机的性能。最终，在最糟糕的情况下，过多的可用内存被分配掉导致全部或部分设备停止正常工作，或者应用程序崩溃。内存泄漏帶來的後果可能是不严重的，有時甚至能够被常规的手段检测出来。在现代操作系统中，一个应用程序使用的常规内存在程序终止时被释放。这表示一个短暂运行的应用程序中的内存泄漏不会导致严重后果。
target_text: Finally, in the worst cases, excess available memory is allocated to stop all or part of the device from working or the application from collapsing. The consequences of the memory leak may be minor, sometimes detectable by conventional means. In a modern operating system, a routine in-house program used by an application is released. This means that a memory leak in a short-run application does not lead to serious consequences.
title: 内存泄漏

source_text:
在以下情況，内存泄漏后果较嚴重：
程序运行后置之不理，并且随着时间的流逝消耗越来越多的内存（比如服务器上的后台任务，尤其是嵌入式系统中的后台任务，这些任务可能被运行后很多年内都置之不理）；
新的内存被频繁地分配，比如当显示电脑游戏或动画视频画面时；
程序能够请求即使在程序终止之后也不会被释放的内存（比如共享内存）；
泄漏在操作系统内部发生；
泄漏在系统关键驱动中发生；
内存非常有限，比如在嵌入式系统或便携设备中；
当运行于一个程序终止时内存并不自动释放内存的操作系统（比如AmigaOS）之上时。
target_text: The consequences of RAM leaks are more severe in the following situations: Programs run out of context and consume more and more RAMs over time (e.g. back-office tasks on servers, especially in embedded systems, which may be ignored for many years after operation); New RAMs are frequently allocated, for example when computer games or animation videos are displayed; Programs can request RAMs (e.g. shared memory) that will not be released even after program termination; Leaks occur within the operating system; Leaks occur in the system's key drivers; Memory is very limited, for example, in embedded systems or portable devices; and Operating systems (e.g. AmigaOS) that do not automatically release memory when a program terminates.
title: 内存泄漏

source_text: 大多数的现代计算机操作系统都有存储在RAM芯片中主内存和存储在次级存储设备如硬盘中的虚拟内存，内存分配是动态的——每个进程根据要求获得相应的内存。存取活跃的页面文件被转移到主内存以提高存取速度；反之，存取不活跃的页面文件被转移到次级存储设备。当一个简单的进程消耗大量的内存时，它通常占用越来越多的主内存，使其他程序转到次级存储设备，使系统的运行效率大大降低。甚至在有内存泄漏的程序终止后，其他程序需要相当长的时间才能切换到主内存，恢复原来的运行效率。
target_text: Most modern computer operating systems have primary memory stored in RAM chips and virtual memory stored in sub-stores such as hard disks, where memory distribution is dynamic — each process is required to obtain the corresponding memory. Access to active page files is transferred to the main memory to increase the speed of access; conversely, access to inactive page files is transferred to sub-storage. When a simple process consumes a large amount of memory, it usually takes more and more of the master memory, transferring other programs to sub-storage, which significantly reduces the efficiency of the system's operations.
title: 内存泄漏

source_text: 一些多任务操作系统有特殊的机制来处理内存耗尽得情况，如随机终止一个进程（可能会终止一些正常的进程），或终止耗用内存最大的进程（很有可能是引起内存泄漏的进程）。另一些操作系统则有内存分配限制，这样可以防止任何一个进程耗用完整个系统的内存。这种设计的缺点是有时候某些进程确实需要较大数量的内存时，如一些处理图像，视频和科学计算的进程，操作系统需要重新配置。
target_text: Some multitask operating systems have special mechanisms to deal with memory depletion, such as random termination of a process (which may terminate some normal processes) or termination of the process that consumes the greatest memory (which is likely to cause a leak in memory). Others have memory allocation limits that prevent any process from consuming the memory of a complete system. The disadvantage of such design is that sometimes certain processes do require a larger amount of memory, such as some processes that process images, videos and scientific calculations, and the operating system needs to be reconfigured.
title: 内存泄漏

source_text: 如内存泄漏发生在内核，表示操作系统自身发生了问题。那些没有完善的内存管理的计算机，如嵌入式系统，会因为一个长时间的内存泄漏而崩溃。一些被公众访问的系统，如网络服务器或路由器很容易被黑客攻击，加入一段攻击代码，而产生内存泄漏。
target_text: Some systems that are accessible to the public, such as network servers or routers, are vulnerable to hacking, adding a code of attack and creating a memory leak.
title: 内存泄漏

由于英德地区的教师多年未加工资，人均工资不到一千一百元，收入不到当地公务员的一半，教师的生活窘困，每年还要上缴近二百元的订阅党报（《南方日报》《清远日报》）费用，上交几十元的护林防火费等，教师们不满的情绪堆积已久。继花都教师静坐之后，英德的教师亦用互联网BBS、博客、腾讯QQ和手机短信的方式联系，相约决定4月2日在英德市政府门口举行静坐活动。由于消息走漏，英德市当局火速采取镇压行动，利用下层领导层层整压。召开校长大会上时说“校长不得参加，参加就地免职”，“凡是参加静坐的教师就下岗或支教（调到没人愿意去的地方）！”；要求四月份，校长要每天向教育局领导汇报学校每一位教师的动向；教师发布在互联网的贴子全部删除。
target_text: Since teachers in the English and German areas have been unpaid for many years, earning less than $1100 per person, earning less than half of the income of local civil servants, teachers living in distress, paying nearly $200 a year for subscription newspapers (the South Daily newspaper), tens of dollars for forest fire protection, etc., the teachers have long been unhappy. After spending time with teachers in the English and German areas, the teachers in the English and German regions have been in touch with the Internet BBS, blogs, QQ bulletins and SMSs, and have decided to hold a sit-in at the entrance to the City of English and German on about 2 April.

The software will not only check system files, IIS web server, and its subproducts Microsoft SQL Server, and Microsoft Office macro settings. The latest version is 2.2. The MBSA was originally used to check whether there are security gaps on the computer.

source_text: 原定9月20日开始的倒计时演示测试很快推至25日，实际上27日晚才开始。截至10月2日又有两天浪费在各种延误上，10月4日发射倒计时经过各种延误终于进展至倒数45分钟。接下来又发生计算机故障，10月9日倒计时重置为发射前13小时。此后计算机及其他设备问题此起彼伏，发射组人员筋疲力尽宣布休息两天。10月13日实际耗时三周的测试结束，远超预期的一周左右。全世界都在关注此次火箭发射，航空航天局公关主任朱利安·谢尔向局长詹姆斯·韦伯转达媒体质疑：阿波罗四号会不会永远都飞不起来。经过激烈讨论，韦伯表示会在自认合适时宣布发射日期。

A computer malfunction followed, with the countdown on 9 October being set at 13 hours before the launch. After intense discussions, the launch team was forced to announce a two-day break. The actual three-week test ended on 13 October, well over the expected week.

source_text:
历史
ABAP作为一种面向特定应用的第四代编程语言最早在20世纪80年代开发。它原本是作为一种报表语言应用在SAP R/2上，这是一个帮助大型公司在大型机上建立原材料管理和财务会计管理商务应用的平台。ABAP本来也是德语Allgemeiner Berichtsaufbereitungsprozessor的缩写，意思是“通用报表预处理器”。ABAP第一次引入了“逻辑数据库”的概念，它在基本的数据库层提供了更高级的抽象。
target_text: History ABAP was first developed in the 1980s as a fourth-generation programming language for specific applications. It was originally used as a reporting language in SAP R/2, a platform to help large companies to establish commercial applications for raw material management and financial accounting management on large machines. ABAP was also an acronym in German for Allgemeiner Berichtsaufereitungsprozessor, meaning “general statement preprocessor”. ABAP first introduced the concept of “logic database”, which provides a more advanced abstraction at the basic database level.
title: ABAP

source_text: ABAP编程语言最初被SAP的开发者用于开发SAP R/3平台。但它也被设计让SAP的客户用于增强SAP的软件应用–客户可以用ABAP编程开发自定义的报表和界面。这个编程语言对于程序员来说很容易学习但并不是一个非程序设计人员可以直接使用的工具。编写ABAP程序需要良好的编程技巧和关系数据库方面的知识，如果知道面向对象设计的概念更好。
target_text: The ABAP programming language was initially used by SAP developers to develop SAP R/3 platforms. It was also designed for SAP clients to enhance SAP software applications - clients can develop custom reports and interfaces using ABAP programming. This programming language is easy for programmers to learn but is not a tool for non-programmers to use directly.
title: ABAP

source_text: 虽然SAP最早于1992年就发布了R/3，但ABAP现在仍可以用于为R/3系统编写程序。在20世纪90年代，随着计算机硬件的发展，越来越多的SAP的应用软件和系统都用ABAP来实现。一直到2001年，几乎所有的基本功能都是由ABAP编程实现的。在1999年，SAP在发布R/3 4.6版的同时也发布了一个对ABAP的面向对象扩展，叫做ABAP Objects。
target_text: Although SAP issued R/3 as early as 1992, ABAP is now available for programming R/3 systems. In the 1990s, with the development of computer hardware, more and more SAP applications and systems were implemented using ABAP. Until 2001, almost all basic functions were programmed by ABAP. In 1999, SAP also released an object-oriented extension to ABA, known as ABAP Objects.
title: ABAP

source_text:
ABAP程序运行在哪里?
所有的ABAP程序都驻留在SAP数据库里。他们不像Java或者C++程序那样存储在一个单独的外部文件里，在数据库里所有的ABAP代码都以两种形式存在：可以用ABAP workbench查看和编辑的源代码和由ABAP运行环境载入和解释的“编译”代码（技术上更精确地说是“产生”代码）。当一段ABAP源代码第一次被调用时会隐含的进行代码产生。如果稍后源代码改变了或者程序访问的对象改变了（比如数据库的表添加了新的字段），产生代码就会自动重新产生。
target_text: All ABAP programs are stored in the SAP database. They are not stored in a separate external file like Java or C++, and all ABA codes in the database exist in two forms: the source code, which can be viewed and edited by ABAP workbnch, and the "compose" code (which is technically more accurately "created" ). When an ABA source code is first called, the code that is implied is generated. If the source code changes later, or the object that the program has accessed (e.g. a new field has been added to the database table), the resulting code is automatically regenerated.
title: ABAP

source_text: ABAP程序在运行时系统（SAP核心的一部分）的控制下运行在SAP应用服务器里。运行时系统负责处理ABAP语句，控制显示的逻辑序列和响应事件（比如，用户按一下屏幕上的一个按钮）。ABAP运行时系统的一个关键组件是数据库接口，它把ABAP的数据库无关语句（“开放SQL”）变成底层数据库管理系统可以理解的语句（“本地SQL”）。数据库接口处理ABAP程序和关系数据库之间所有的通信；它也有一些其他的作用，比如把经常访问的数据缓存到应用服务器本地的存储器里。
target_text: The ABAP program runs under the control of the running time system (part of the SAP core) on the SAP application server. The running time system handles the ABA statement and controls the indicated logical sequence and response event (e.g. the user presses a button on the screen). A key component of the ABA running the time system is the database interface, which transforms the ABAAP database into an irrelevant statement (“open SQL”) for the bottom database management system (“local SQL”). The database interface processes all communications between ABA programs and relationship databases; it also has a number of other functions, such as storing frequently accessed data into the local memory of the application server.
title: ABAP

source_text:
SAP系统和部署方案
所有的SAP数据和软件都存在／运行于SAP系统的环境中。这个系统包括一个中心关系数据库和一个或多个访问该数据库里的数据和程序的应用服务器（“实例”）。一个SAP系统至少包括一个实例，但可以更多，主要看大小和性能上的需求。在一个多实例系统中，负载平衡机制来保证负载比较平均的分摊到各个可用的应用服务器上。
target_text: SAP systems and deployment programmes include all SAP data and software in the SAP environment. The system consists of a central relationship database and one or more application servers ("examples") that access data and programs in the database. A SAP system includes at least one example, but more, depending on the size and performance requirements. In a multi-species system, the load balancing mechanism ensures that loads are distributed evenly among the various available application servers.
title: ABAP

source_text: Web应用服务器有三层组成：数据库层，应用层和表现层。这些层可以在同一台或不同的物理机器上运行。数据库层包括关系数据库及相关软件。应用层包括系统的实例。所有应用相关的过程，包括业务事务和ABAP开发，都运行在应用层。表现层处理和系统的用户之间的交互。对ABAP应用服务器的在线访问可以通过专用图形接口SAPGUI或者浏览器进行。
target_text: The Web application server consists of three layers: the database layer, the application layer, and the performance layer. These layers can be run on the same or different physical machines. The database layer includes the relationship database and related software. The application layer includes examples of the system. All the processes associated with the application, including business services and ABAP development, are running on the application layer. The performance layer processing and interaction between users of the system. Online access to the ABAA application server can be done through a dedicated graphic interface SAPGUI or a browser.
title: ABAP

source_text: 在六、七十年代，各家计算机公司的各个型号的计算机，有着千差万别的浮点数表示，却没有一个业界通用的标准。这给数据交换、计算机协同工作造成了极大不便。IEEE的浮点数专业小组于七十年代末期开始酝酿浮点数的标准。在1980年，英特尔公司就推出了单片的8087浮点数协处理器，其浮点数表示法及定义的运算具有足够的合理性、先进性，被IEEE采用作为浮点数的标准，于1985年发布。而在此前，这一标准的内容已在八十年代初期被各计算机公司广泛采用，成了事实上的业界工业标准。加州大学伯克利分校的数值计算与计算机科学教授威廉·卡韩被誉为“浮点数之父”。
target_text: In 1980, Intel launched the single 8087 floating point processor, which indicated that the method and definition were sufficiently rational and sophisticated to be applied by IEEE as a floating point standard, which was published in 1985. Previously, the content of the standard was widely used by computer companies in the early 1980s and became a de facto industry standard. William Kahan, a computer science professor at the University of California’s Berkeley campus, was called “the father of the floating point.”
title: IEEE 754

source_text:
在数据库应用中的三值逻辑
数据查询语言 SQL 实用了三值逻辑，作为处理字段内容值為 NULL的一种方式。最初使用 NULL值的意圖来表示在数据库中缺失数据，即假設現實中有值存在，但該值當前並未記錄在數據庫中；注意缺失的值不同于数值零，或长度為零的空字串值，这两者都表示已知的值。SQL 使用 Kleene K3 邏輯的通用片段，僅限於 AND，OR 和 NOT表。在 SQL中 NULL 值應被解釋為未知(UNKNOWN)。若以 NULL 與欄位值做關係比較，包括和另一個 NULL的比較，結果都是狀態為未知的。然而，這種語義選擇在某些集合操作中被放棄了，例如，UNION 或 INTERSECT，其中 NULL 被視為彼此相等。批評者斷言，這種不一致的性質剝奪了 SQL在處理 NULL 時直觀的語義。例如，考虑下列 SQL表达式：
target_text: The three-value logic data query language SQL in the database application uses a three-value logic as a way to process the field content value as NULL. The original use of NULL values is intended to indicate missing data in the database, i.e. NUL values are assumed to exist in reality, but have not been recorded in the database before; notice that missing values are different from zero values or empty string values with zero length, both of which are known as known values. SQL uses the generic segment of Kleene K3 logic, limited to AND, OR and NOT tables. The NUL values in SQL should be explained as unknown (UNKNOWN). If NUL is compared to column values, including the comparison with another NULL, this is an unknown situation. However, this synonym has been abandoned in some assembly operations, such as the UNION or INTERSET tables.
title: 三值逻辑

遭监管部门查处

source_text: 与其他BOINC项目一样，Rosetta@home使用志愿者的计算机中空闲的进程资源来执行单独的单元计算。计算结果会被发送到项目的中央服务器，经验证後存入数据库中。这个项目是跨平台的，支持多种不同的软件和硬件环境。用户可通过Rosetta@home的屏幕保护程序观看正在自己计算机上进行的蛋白质结构预测的情况。
target_text: Like other BOINC projects, Rosetta@home uses free process resources from volunteer computers to carry out separate cell computing. The results are sent to the central server of the project, where empirical certificates are posted in the database. This project is cross-platform and supports a variety of software and hardware environments. Users can view the protein structure predictions that are being made on their own computers through Rosetta@home screen savers.
title: Rosetta@home

source_text:
计算平台
Rosetta@home应用程序和BOINC均支持Microsoft Windows、Linux、苹果机和Android平台。（BOINC还可在更多平台上运行，如FreeBSD。）参与Rosetta@home的客户端计算机需要有一个时钟频率至少达到500兆赫的中央处理器、400MB空餘的硬盘空间、512MB的物理内存，以及因特网连接。截至2021年5月1日，Rosetta应用程序的最新版本号是4.20，在Android平台上应用程序的最新版本号是4.20。用户的BOINC客户端与位于华盛顿大学的Rosetta@home服务器端之间使用标准HTTP（80端口）进行通信，HTTPS（443端口）用于密码交换。BOINC客户端使用1043和31416端口进行远程和本地控制，这两个端口可能需要在防火墙中被设置为“解除封禁”才可被使用。包含蛋白质数据的工作单元由服务器分配给志愿者的计算机（客户端），然后客户端对所分配得到的任务进行蛋白质预测运算。为了避免重复的预测，每个工作单元会得到一个初始的随机种子。这使得每个预测具有独一无二的沿蛋白质能量图景（energy landscape）的下降轨道。对于给定的蛋白质能量图景，Rosetta@home的结构预测近似为整体极小值。这个整体极小值代表该蛋白质的能量最佳构造，即它的自然态。
target_text: The platform Rosetta@home application and BOINC both support Microsoft Windows, Linux, Apple and Android platforms. (BOINC can also operate on more platforms, such as FreeBSD.) The client computer involved in Rosetta@home needs a central processor with a clock frequency of at least 500 MHz, 400 MB spare hard disk space, 512 MB physical memory, and Internet connection. By 1 May 2021, the latest version of the Rosetta application is 4.20, and the latest version of the application on the Android platform is 4.20.) The user's BOINC client is required to communicate between the Rosetta@home server end of Washington University using the standard HTTP (80th port), the HTTPS (443nd end) is used for crypto exchange. The BOTC client uses the latest version of the remote version of the remote and local control and the latest version of the application is 4.20.
title: Rosetta@home

source_text: 与所有其他BOINC项目类似，Rosetta@home利用客户端空闲资源，在后台执行。执行过程可能发生在用户登录操作系统之前或之后。当其他应用程序需要时，Rosetta@home会释放资源，因此不会影响用户对计算机的正常使用。为了使计算机的功耗或者放热降到最低，用户可以自行指定Rosetta@home使用CPU资源的最大比例。此外，Rosetta@home每天最多运行次数，以及更多选项也都可以通过用户的账户选项来进行设置。
target_text: Similar to all other BOINC projects, Rosetta@home uses client-end idle resources for back-office execution. The execution process may occur before or after the user logs into the operating system. If other applications are needed, Rosetta@home releases resources and therefore does not affect the user ' s normal use of computers. In order to minimize the use of computers or heat, users can themselves specify the maximum proportion of Rosetta@home ' s CPU resources. Moreover, Rosetta@home ' s maximum number of times a day, as well as more options, can be set through the user ' s account options.
title: Rosetta@home

source_text: Rosetta@home网络所使用的Rosetta软件最早用Fortran编写，后改用C++重新编写，以利于进一步的开发。新版本于2008年2月8日发布，实现了面向对象。Rosetta代码由Rosetta Commons开发。这个软件对学术使用免费，对制药公司则收取费用。项目意义通过一系列的基因组测序计划，科学家能够判定许多种在细胞内发挥作用的蛋白质的氨基酸序列或者一级结构。为了更好地了解蛋白质的功能，以及向合理化药物设计提供辅助，科学家们需要知道蛋白质的三维三级结构。
target_text: Rosetta software, used by Rosetta@home, was first developed in Fortran and then reformulated in C++ for further development. The new version was released on 8 February 2008 and became object-oriented. Rosetta code was developed by Rosetta Commons. The software is free for academic use and charged to pharmaceutical companies. Through a series of genome sequencing programmes, scientists are able to determine the amino acid sequence or level-I structures of many proteins that function in cells. To better understand the function of proteins, and to provide support for the rational design of drugs, scientists need to know the three-dimensional structure of proteins.
title: Rosetta@home

source_text: 蛋白质的三维结构目前主要通过X射线晶体学或核磁共振技术来进行实验确定。这个过程十分耗时，例如可能花费数星期或者几个月才能首次研究出如何使一种蛋白质结晶；而成本又非常高，每种蛋白质耗费约10万美元。更重要的是，发现新序列的速度远超确定结构的速度：美国国家生物技术信息中心非冗余蛋白质数据库中存在的超过740万个蛋白质序列中，仅有不到5.2万已被确定结构并被存入蛋白质数据库中。Rosetta@home的一个主要目标是在显著降低时间和金钱成本的情况下，预测蛋白质结构，并且达到与现有实验方法同样的精度。Rosetta@home还开发了确定膜蛋白（如G蛋白偶联受体）结构和对接的方法。膜蛋白是现代药物设计的主要目标，但通过X射线晶体学、核磁共振等传统技术却极难获得其结构。
target_text: More importantly, the three-dimensional structure of the proteins is found to be experimentally determined mainly through X-ray crystallization or nuclear magnetic resonance technology. This process is time-consuming, for example, it may take weeks or months to develop for the first time how to crystallize a protein; and it is very costly, with each protein costing approximately $100,000. More importantly, the speed of discovery of the new sequences is much faster than the speed of determining the structure: of more than 7.4 million protein sequences in the NBC database, less than 52,000 have been identified and placed in a protein database. One of the main objectives of Rosetta@home is to predict the structure of the proteins, with a significant reduction in time and money costs, and to achieve the same precision as that of existing experimental methods.
title: Rosetta@home

source_text:
RosettaDock
RosettaDock在2002年CAPRI实验时作为贝克实验室的蛋白质-蛋白质对接预测算法被添加到Rosetta软件套装中。在那次实验中，RosettaDock对化脓性链球菌毒素A和T细胞受体β链的对接做出了高精度预测，对一种猪的α淀粉酶与相应骆驼抗体的复合体做出了中等精度预测。尽管RosettaDock方法只在七种可能中给出两种可接受精度的预测，这已经足以让它在那届CAPRI实验中名列19个预测方法中的第7位。
target_text: Rosetta Dock Rosetta Dock was added to the Rosetta software package as a protein-protein docking prediction algorithm for the Baker Laboratory during the 2002 CAPRI experiment. In that experiment, Rosetta Dock made high-precision predictions for the caustic streptococcal toxin A and the t-cell receptor beta chain, with medium-precision predictions for a pig's alpha-depressant enzyme and the corresponding camel resistance complex. Although the RosettaDock method gave only two acceptable accuracy predictions out of seven possible scenarios, this was enough for it to rank 7 out of 19 predictions in the CAPRI experiment.
title: Rosetta@home

“显卡门”事件
2008年夏，世界最大的显示芯片厂商英伟达（NVIDIA）爆发大面积显示芯片质量问题。而此时的神舟回应媒体称旗下使用问题芯片的笔记本电脑“未发现异常”。。但之后的一至两年内，不断有用户向神舟售后部门报修自己显卡出问题的笔记本计算机。而神舟对故障机仅予维修而拒绝更换部件，导致故障无法得到彻底解决，屡修屡坏。并且神舟没有就此显卡事件对受影响用户作任何官方的声明，此事件导致神舟电脑的名誉受到极大影响。

source_text: Wireshark（导线鲨鱼，旧称 Ethereal，空灵）是一个开源的网络数据包分析器，可实时从网络接口捕获数据包中的数据。它尽可能详细地显示捕获的数据以供用户检查它们的内容，并支持多协议的网络数据包解析。Wireshark 适用于 Windows 和 UNIX 操作系统。它可被用于检查安全问题和解决网络问题，也可供开发者调试协议的实现和学习网络协议的原理。
target_text: Wiresark is an open-source network data package analyser that captures data from web interfaces in real time. It displays the data captured in as much detail as possible for users to check their content and supports multi-agreement web data wrapping. Wiresark applies to Windows and UNIX operating systems. It can be used to check security issues and solve network problems, and it can also be used for developers to debug protocols to achieve and learn the principles of network protocols.
title: Wireshark

source_text:
在 GNU 通用公共许可证的保障下，用户可免费获得软件与源代码，并拥有对源代码修改及定制的权利。發展簡史
1997年底，密苏里大学堪萨斯城分校的毕业生杰拉德·康姆斯（Gerald Combs）在一家小型的互联网服务供应商上班，他需要一个工具以追踪网络问题并了解更多网络知识，于是开始编写 Ethereal 软件。
target_text: Under the GNU General Public Licence, users have free access to software and source code and the right to modify and customize the source code. In late 1997, Gerald Combs, a graduate of the Kansas City branch of the University of Missouri, worked in a small Internet service provider who needed a tool to track network problems and learn more about the network, and began to develop Etheal software.
title: Wireshark

source_text: Camfrog是一款由Camshare LLC开发的即时聊天工具，允许来自世界各地的用户播放自己的音频和视频。这个软件允许 超过1000人的用户在一个即时的视频会议环境下聊天。Camfrog允许用户使用"Camfrog Server"软件搭建自己的视频聊天室。有许多聊天室是无声的聊天室，大多数活耀的聊天室是手语聊天室。也有聋人也在一般分类里面搭建自己的聊天室。聋人通过手语通过视频在Camfrog上面聊天。
target_text: Camfrog is an instant chat tool developed by Camshare LLC that allows users from all over the world to play their own audio and video. This software allows users of more than 1,000 to chat in an instant videoconferencing environment. Camfrog allows users to build their own video chat rooms using the Camfrog Server software. Many chat rooms are silent chat rooms, most live chat rooms are sign language chat rooms. Deaf people also build their own chat rooms in the general classification. Deaf people chat on Camfrog via video.
title: Camfrog

source_text: 软件的特点就是比较具有国际性，可以找到很多不同的国家和语言的聊天室，和不同国家和语言的网友聊天。这对于喜欢学习外语的用户来说是非常好的一个软件。聊天的形式比较像中国大陆的一些聊天室，既可以语音和视频的同时也可以一般打字。在Skype里面的聊天室只能进行语音聊天，不能多人视频也不能打字，相比之下，Camfrog和中国大陆用户的聊天室聊天习惯更相似。
target_text: The feature of the software is that it is more international in that it can find chat rooms in many different countries and languages, as well as chat rooms in different countries and languages. This is a very good software for users who like to learn foreign languages. Chat is more in the form of chat rooms in mainland China, which can be typed with both voice and video. The chat rooms in Skype can only have voice chats, not multiple video and not typing, compared with Camfrog and the chat rooms of mainland Chinese users.
title: Camfrog

source_text:
架构
SAP Web应用服务器的架构可以分为五层：
表现层：在表现层，用户接口可以使用JSP，BSP或者Web Dynpro技术来开发。下面的业务层通过Java或ABAP程序来提供业务内容。
业务层：业务层包括一个通过J2EE认证的运行时环境来出来从ICM传来的请求然后动态产生一个应答。业务逻辑可以用ABAP或者基于J2EE标准的Java来实现。开发人员实现了业务逻辑后可以用J2EE环境的EJB来持续化这些业务逻辑。开发人员还可以访问运行在ABAP环境里的应用的业务对象以从他们的业务逻辑和持续化中获益。
集成层：本地的集成引擎是SAP Web应用服务器的一个完整组成部分，可以实现和SAP XI的即时连接。本地的集成引擎提供信息服务，可以实现连接到SAP XI上个组件之间的信息交换。
连接层：因特网通信管理器（ICM）把用户接口的请求发送到表现层并提供一个单一的框架来处理使用多种不同通信协议的链接。现在，可用的模块有HTTP，HTTPS，SMTP，SOAP，FastCGI。
持久化层：持久化层支持数据库无关操作和弹性事务处理。业务逻辑可以完全不考虑底层数据库和操作系统来开发。对开放标准的支持也使数据库无关成为可能。数据库接口保证从ABAP环境里通过Open SQL进行的数据访问都是经过优化的。SAP还推出了Open SQL对Java的支持，为应用开发人员提供了多种标准API，如SQLJ。其他技术，比如JDO和CMP EJB，或者直接使用JDBC API访问都是支持的。
target_text: The architecture of the SAP Web application server can be divided into five layers: Performance layer: The user interface can be developed using JP, BSP, or Web Dynpro technology in the performance layer. The following level of operations can provide business content through Java or ABAP programs. Business layer: The business layer includes a request coming out of the ICM through the J2EE certified operating environment and then dynamically produces an answer. The business logic can be achieved by AAP or Java based on J2EE standards. The development of the business logic can be sustained by EJB in the J2EE environment. The developers can also access the business objects operating in the ABA environment to benefit from their business logic and sustainability.
title: SAP Web应用服务器

ACM软件系统奖（ACM Software System Award）是美国计算机协会（ACM）颁发的一项奖项，它授予对技术概念和商业接受度方面产生了持久影响的软件系统的开发者或机构。该奖始于1983年，每年颁发一次，目前奖金已达3.5万美元，由IBM公司提供赞助。計算機協會
1983年建立的獎項
計算機科學獎項
target_text: The ACM Software Systems Award (ACM Software System Award) is an award awarded by the American Computer Association (ACM) to developers or institutions of software systems that have had a lasting impact on technological concepts and commercial acceptance.
