source_text: 在计算机科学领域来说，尤其是在网络领域，会话（，Microsoft Windows譯作工作階段、連線階段）是一种持久网络协议，在用戶端（或用户代理）和服务器端之间建立关联，从而起到交换数据包的作用机制，session在网络协议（例如telnet或FTP）中是非常重要的部分。在不包含對談層（例如UDP）或者是无法长时间驻留對談層（例如HTTP）的传输协议中，對談的维持需要依靠在传输数据中的高级别程序。例如，在浏览器和远程主机之间的HTTP传输中，HTTP cookie就会被用来包含一些相关的信息，例如session ID，参数和权限信息等。
target_text: In the area of computer science, in particular, meetings (e.g. Microsoft Windows translates sessions, links) are a permanent network protocol that links client (or user agent) and server end, thus serving as a mechanism for the exchange of data packages, and the session is a very important part of the network protocol (e.g. telnet or FTP). In transmission protocols that do not include conversation layers (e.g. UDP) or that do not allow long-term presence of conversation layers (e.g. HTTP), the maintenance of conversations depends on high-level procedures in transmission data. For example, in HTTP transmissions between browsers and remote hosts, HTTP cookies are used to include relevant information, such as session ID, parameters and access information.
title: 会话 (计算机科学)

source_text: TCP 会话通常是通过子进程和（或）多线程在软件中实现的，当计算机建立或者加入一个会话时即创建一个新的进程或线程。HTTP 会话通常不会针对每个会话创建一个线程，而是由一个储存每个会话状态信息的数据库实现的。使用多线程或者多进程的方式带来的好处是降低了软件的复杂度，因为每个线程或者进程都单独具备自己的历史信息并且封装了变量。而这样做的劣势是带来了大量系统资源的开销，而且会话会因为系统的重启而被打断。
target_text: The TPCP session is usually done in the software through sub-processes and/or multiple threads, creating a new process or thread when a computer creates or joins a session. The HTTP session usually does not create a thread for each session, but rather is done by a database that stores information on each session state. The benefits of using multiple threads or multiple processes are reduced software complexity, as each thread or process has its own historical information and covers variables.
title: 会话 (计算机科学)

source_text: 当客户端在多个服务器调取数据时，保持對談状态的一致性是需要注意的，客户端需用同时保持和某一个主机的连接，或者多个服务器端需要共享一个储存對談信息的文件系统或者数据库。否则，当用户在一个新的而不是一开始保存對談信息的主机上提交访问请求的时候，主机会因为无法获知原来主机的對談的访问状态而产生问题。
target_text: When a client retrieves data on multiple servers, maintaining consistency in conversational status requires attention, and the client needs to maintain a connection to a host at the same time, or multiple servers need to share a file system or database that stores conversational information. Otherwise, when a user files a request for access on a new, rather than an initial, host that saves the conversational information, the main opportunity is problematic because the original host has no access status to the conversation.
title: 会话 (计算机科学)

source_text: 行動聯網裝置（Mobile Internet Device，簡稱MID，又譯移动互联网设备）是英特尔在2008年英特爾科技論壇大会上提出的一种电脑概念，为英特尔所设计的UMPC类型草图，但英特尔称这个设计是UMPC的进化品。英特尔将MID定义为一种体积小于笔记本电脑、但大于手机的移动互联网装置，实际上其概念很接近、甚至可以说等同于个人数码助理。
target_text: The action network device (Mobile Internet Device, also known as MID, which translates mobile Internet devices) is a computer concept put forward by Intel at the 2008 Intel Science Forum, a sketch of the UPPC type designed for Intel, but Intel calls the design an evolutionary version of the UPMC. Intel defines the MID as a mobile Internet device smaller than a laptop, but larger than a mobile phone, which is actually very close to, if not equal to, a personal digital assistant.
title: 行動聯網裝置

source_text: Screen2EXE 是一款用于屏幕录像制作的免费软件。Screen2EXE仅支持输出EXE后缀的可执行文件录像，不支持输出使用编码的AVI文件。本身使用的是称为"SSCV2"的编码方式，输出1024 x 768尺寸，1分钟长屏幕录像大约需要0.1MB~2MB。由StepOK团队开发，该小组之前曾推出S-Demo，也是一款屏幕录像软件，不过由于其市场定位问题，销售成绩不佳，但广泛流行于黑客圈中，用于入侵演示录像的制作。
target_text: Screen2EXE is a free software for screen video production. Screen2E only supports the production of exeXE-suffixed executables and does not support the production of coded AVI files. It uses a coded method called "SSCV2" for the output of 1024 x 768 dimensions, which requires about 0.1 MB~2MB per minute of long-screen footage. The S-Demo, which was developed by the StepOK team, was also a screen video software, but because of its market positioning problems, was sold poorly, but is widely used in hacking circles for the production of invasive demonstration videos.
title: Screen2EXE

source_text:
生平
1994年，他和谭咏文曾是挪威电信（现已更名为Telenor）的研究小组成员，当时他们开发了一个名为MultiTorg Opera的浏览器软件，後来Telenor终止了这一项目，但在1995年，他与谭咏文获得了软件的持有权，与其他人等一同创立了浏览器巨头Opera软件公司，并任首席执行官至2004年。在Opera软件公司的办公地点迁移到奥斯陆时，公司的员工数已超过了500人。
target_text: In 1994, he and Tan Ying were members of a research team in Telecommunications Norway (now known as Telenor), when they developed a browser software called MultiTorg Opera, which was later terminated by Telenor, but in 1995 he acquired software ownership with Tan Ying Wen, created the browser giant Opera Software Company and served as CEO until 2004. When Opera Software moved to Oslo, the company had more than 500 employees.
title: 盖尔·伊瓦尔绥

source_text: FonePlus为微软于2006年7月份发布，接近与电脑的手机电脑。有报道称，FonePlus为OLPC的杀手之一。由于微软官方并没有公布详细信息，有部分人士认为，FonePlus应属于超级移动电脑之一。FonePlus也是微软“廉价电脑”的计划之一。目前可以确定的是操作系统应该为Windows家族的Windows CE操作系统。FonePlus含有类似OLPC的外接电视、键盘以及类似于笔记本电脑的设备。
target_text: FonePlus was released by Microsoft in July 2006, close to the computer's mobile computer. It was reported that FonePlus was one of the killers of OLPC. Since Microsoft officials did not publish detailed information, some thought that the FonePlus should belong to one of the supermobile computers. OnePlus is also one of Microsoft's “Affordable Computers.” It is now certain that the operating system should be the Windows CE operating system of the Windows family. OnePlus contains external television, keyboards, and laptop-like devices similar to OLPC.
title: FonePlus

source_text: 在好友“鎚頭”神秘死去之後，ARC士兵“五號”進行了調查，並發現了一枚隱藏的生物芯片被放置在克隆人體內——自他們還處於幼年就已如此。而卡米諾醫療專家娜拉·塞聲稱芯片完全無害，只是為了製約克隆人防止他們不可預料的暴力行為。五號對此有不同意見，他說服了絕地大師莎克·蒂，允許他向最高議長帕爾帕廷直陳意見，為自己辯護……
target_text: After the mysterious death of a friend, the ARC soldier, No. 5, conducted an investigation and discovered that a hidden biochip had been placed in the cloned human body -- since they were still young -- and Camino medical expert Narra Se claims that the chip was completely harmless, only to create a contract to clone people to prevent their unexpected acts of violence. The ARC soldier, No. 5, disagreeed with the Jedi master, Sark Ti, and allowed him to speak to the Supreme Chancellor, Palpatine, to defend himself.
title: 克隆战争

source_text: 在计算机科学中，指称语义（）是通过构造表达其语义的(叫做指称(denotation)或意义的)数学对象来形式化计算机系统的语义的一种方法。编程语言的形式语义的其他方法包括公理语义和操作语义。指称语义方式最初开发来处理一个单一计算机程序定义的系统。后来领域扩展到了由多于一个程序构成的系统，比如网络和并发系统。
target_text: In computer science, synonyms are alleged to be a method of formalizing the semantics of computer systems through the construction of mathematical objects that express their synonyms (known as denuitation) or meaning. Other methods of semantics in programming languages include semantic and operational semantics. Semantic approaches were initially developed to deal with a single computer program definition.
title: 指称语义

source_text:
在建模有局部变量的程序的时候事情变得更加困难。一种途径是不在使用域，转而把类型解释为从世界的范畴到域的范畴的函子。程序被指示为在这些函子之间的自然连续函数。数据类型的指称很多编程语言允许用户定义递归数据类型。例如，数的列表的类型可以指定为
datatype list = Cons of (Nat, list) | Empty.
本节只处理不能变更的泛函数据类型。常规编程语言将典型的允许这种递归列表的元素被变更。
target_text: One way to do this is not to use the domain and instead to interpret the type as a function of the universe from the world to the domain. The program is instructed to be a natural continuous function between these messages. Many programming languages of data types refer to data types that allow users to define the recalibration of data types. For example, the type of list of numbers can be assigned to datape list = Cons of (Nat, list). This section only deals with general message data types that cannot be changed.
title: 指称语义

source_text: 一些研究者开发了多态性的域理论模型。其他研究者还在构造性集合论内建模了参数化多态。详情可见下面列出的教科书。一个新近研究领域已经涉及了基于编程语言的对象和类的指称语义。受限复杂性的程序的指称语义随着基于线性逻辑的编程语言的开发，指称语义已经被给予了线性使用(参见 证明网、一致空间)和多项式时间复杂性的语言。
target_text: Some researchers have developed multi-state domain theory models. Others have also modeled the parameterized multi-states within the tectonic conglomerates. Details can be found in the textbooks listed below. A new area of study has addressed the alleged semantics of objects and categories based on programming language.
title: 指称语义

source_text: 这个开放问题在1990年代随着博弈语义和涉及逻辑关系的技术的发展基本解决了。 详情请参见PCF语言。源到源转换的指称语义把一个程序语言转换成另一个语言经常是有用的。例如一个并发编程语言可被转换成进程演算；高级编程语言可以被转换成字节码(实际上，常规指称语义可以被看作把编程语言解释成域的范畴的内部语言)。
target_text: This openness problem was largely resolved in the 1990s with the development of creative semantics and technologies involving logical relationships. See, for more details, the PCF language. The source-to-source alleged synonym is often useful in converting one programme language into another. For example, a co-programming language can be converted into process calculations; and advanced programming languages can be converted into bytes (in practice, conventional synonyms can be seen as internal languages that interpret programming language into domains).
title: 指称语义

source_text:
依据 Clinger [1981]:
“常规顺序编程语言的形式语义通常自身可以被解释为提供了一个(不充分)的这个语言的实现。虽然形式语义不必须总是提供这种实现，相信语义必须提供一个实现导致了关于并发语言的形式语义的混淆。当编程语言的语义中的无界非确定性被称为蕴涵了这个编程语言不可能被实现被提出的时候这种混淆是明显痛苦的。”
target_text: According to Clinger (1981): “The formal synonym of a conventional sequenced language can normally itself be interpreted as providing a (inadequate) realization of that language. While formal semantics must not always provide such realization, it is believed that semanticity must provide a realization that leads to confusion of semantics of the semantic form of simultaneous language. This confusion is obvious when it is described in the semantic sense of programming language as implying that the programming language cannot be presented.”
title: 指称语义

source_text:
同其他计算机科学领域的联系
某些指称语义的著作把类型解释为域理论意义上的域，因而可以被看作模型论的分支，导致了同类型论和范畴论的联系。在计算机科学内与抽象释义、程序验证和函数式编程有联系，参见函数式编程语言中的单子(monad)。特别是，指称语义使用了续体(continuation)来依据函数式编程语义表达顺序编程中的控制流。
target_text: Links to other areas of computer science Some alleged semantic writings interpret types as domains in the theoretical sense of domain, and can therefore be seen as branches of modelling theory, leading to linkages between typology and domain theory. In computer science, there is a connection with abstract interpretation, program validation and function programming, see monad in the functional programming language. In particular, the semantic approach is based on the control flow in the functional programming sequence.
title: 指称语义

source_text: 马尔蒂瓦克（），是美国科幻作家艾萨克·阿西莫夫在其作品中虚拟的一台超级电子计算机。根据阿西莫夫的自传，这个名字是仿自早期计算机的名字UNIVAC，不过他早期也曾声称这个名字的意思是：“许多真空管”。在其晚期作品九个明天中“终极问题”一文中，又说词尾“AC”是模拟计算机（Analog Computer）的缩写。
target_text: Martiwake () is a virtual supercomputer in the work of U.S. science-fiction writer Isaac Asimov. According to Asimov's autobiography, this name is a copy of the early computer's name UNIVAC, although he claimed earlier that it meant “many vacuum tubes.” In his late production of nine tomorrow's “final problem”, the end “AC” is an abbreviation of Analog Computer.
title: 马尔蒂瓦克

source_text: 在電腦程式設計中，作用域（scope，或譯作有效範圍）是名字（name）与实体（entity）的绑定（binding）保持有效的那部分计算机程序。不同的编程语言可能有不同的作用域和名字解析。而同一语言内也可能存在多种作用域，随实体的类型变化而不同。作用域类别影響變量的绑定方式，根據語言使用靜態作用域還是動態作用域变量的取值可能会有不同的結果。
target_text: In computer program design, the fields of action (scope, or translation into a valid range) are those parts of the computer program where the name (name) and entity (entity) binding (binding) are valid. Different programming languages may have different fields of use and name interpretation. There may also be multiple domains in the same language, depending on the entity ' s type. The type of fields influences how variables are tied, and the take-off of either static or dynamic area variables based on language may have different results.
title: 作用域

source_text: 半導體製程是被用于制造芯片，一种日常使用的电气和电子器件中集成电路的处理工艺。它是一系列照相和化学处理步骤，在其中电子电路逐渐形成在使用纯半导体材料制作的晶片上。硅是今天最常用的半导体材料，其他还有各种复合半导体材料。从一开始晶圓加工，到芯片封装測試，直到出货，通常需要6到8周，并且是在晶圓廠內完成。
target_text: The semiconductor process is used to manufacture chips, a process of integrating circuits in the electrical and electronic devices that are used on a daily basis. It is a series of photo and chemical processing steps in which electronic circuits develop on crystals made using pure semiconductor materials. Silicon is the most commonly used semiconductor material today, with a variety of composite semiconductor materials. It takes six to eight weeks from the beginning of crystalworking to the core sealing test until delivery, and is usually done in crystal mills.
title: 半导体器件制造

source_text:
晶圓典型的晶片是用极度纯净的硅以柴可拉斯基法、泡生法等方式长成直径的单晶圆柱锭（梨形人造宝石）。这些硅碇被切成晶片大约0.75毫米厚并抛光為非常平整的表面。一旦晶圓准备好之后，很多工艺步骤对于生产需要的半导体集成电路是必要的。总之，这些步骤可分成四组：
前端工艺
后端工艺
测试
封装
target_text: The crystal is typically a single crystald cylindrical accelerator (a pear man-made gem) with an extremely pure silicon that grows in diameter in the form of tactile silicon. These silicons are sliced to a very flat surface of about 0.75 mm thick and thick. Once the crystal is ready, many process steps are necessary for the production of the semiconductor integrated circuits. In short, these steps can be divided into four groups: front-end process, back-end process testing, sealing.
title: 半导体器件制造

source_text:
历史
当线宽远高于10微米时，纯净度还不像今天的器件生产中那样至关紧要。但随着器件变得越来越集成，無塵室也变得越来越干净。今天，工廠內是加壓过滤空气，来去除哪怕那些可能留在晶片上并形成缺陷的最小的粒子。半导体制造產線裡的工人被要求穿著無塵衣来保护器件不被人类污染。
target_text: Today, the factory is pressurized to filter air to remove even the smallest particles that may remain on the chip and create defects. Workers in semiconductor manufacturing lines are required to wear dustless clothes to protect the device from human pollution.
title: 半导体器件制造

source_text: 半导体生产商的领袖大都在全世界拥有產線。英特尔，世界最大的生产商之一，以及在美其他顶级生产商包括台积电（台湾）、三星（韩国）、德州仪器（美国）、超微半导体（美国）、聯电（台灣）、东芝（日本）、NEC电子（日本）、意法半导体（欧洲）、英飞凌（欧洲）、瑞萨（日本）、索尼（日本），以及恩智浦半导体 （欧洲）在欧洲和亚洲都有自己的设备。
target_text: Intel, one of the world’s largest producers, as well as other top producers in the United States, include Taiwan, Samsung (Korea), Texas instruments (U.S.A.), Ultra Micro Semiconductor (U.S.), Union Power (Taiwan), Toshiba (Japan), NEC Electronics (Japan), Isosan Semiconductor (Europe), English Flying (Europe), Reza (Japan), Sony (Japan), and Eun Ji Pu Semiconductor (Europe) have their own equipment in Europe and Asia.
title: 半导体器件制造

source_text: 计算机术语“透明”可能指客观存在并且运行着但是我们看不到的特性。即它客观存在，但对于大多数、特定类别的开发人员而言是不需要了解的东西，这就是计算机学中所指的透明。换种说法，透明就是一个黑盒，你只需要应用它给出的接口，而不需要了解其内在机理。
target_text: The computer term “transparency” may refer to a feature that exists objectively and runs but is not visible to us. That is, it exists objectively, but it does not need to be understood for most, for particular categories of developers, which is what transparency means in computer science. In other words, transparency is a black box, and all you need to do is apply the interfaces that it gives, and not the underlying mechanisms.
title: 透明

source_text:
基于公开密钥加密算法的身份验证
基于公开密钥加密算法的身份验证是指通信中的双方分别持有公开密钥和私有密钥，由其中的一方采用私有密钥对特定数据进行加密，而对方采用公开密钥对数据进行解密，如果解密成功，就认为用户是合法用户，否则就认为是身份验证失败。
target_text: Authentication based on a public key encryption algorithm means that each of the parties to the communication holds, respectively, a public key and a private key, whereby one of the parties uses a private key to encrypt a particular data, while the other party uses a public key to declassify the data, and if the decryption succeeds, the user is deemed to be a legitimate user, otherwise the authentication fails.
title: 身份验证

source_text: 这些限制是通过法律或者技术上的手段实现的，有时这两种手段被同时采用。最常见的技术限制方式是保留能够被大家读懂的源代码，而只发布只有计算机才能读懂的程序（如二进制格式）。法律上的限制包括使用版权（附带软件许可证）和专利。这些程序的源代码往往被其持有者视为商业机密。如果第三方要查看源代码时，往往需要签署保密协议。
target_text: These limitations are achieved through legal or technical means, sometimes both of which are used simultaneously. The most common technical restrictions are to retain source codes that can be understood by everyone, and to publish only programs that can be read by computers (e.g. binary formats). Legal limitations include the use of copyrights (accompanied software licences) and patents. The source codes of these procedures are often treated as commercial secrets by their holders.
title: 专有软件

source_text:
与商业化的关系
专有软件并不等同于商业软件。专有软件和自由软件都可以免费或者收费分发。它们之间的区别在于：专有软件的所有者可以决定是否可以分发该软件，以及费用的数额；而自由软件可以被任何持有者随意分发，相关的复制以及服务费用也可自行决定。
target_text: The difference between proprietary and free software can be distributed free of charge or at a fee. The owner of proprietary software can decide whether the software can be distributed and the amount of the cost, while free software can be distributed at will by any holder, and the related reproduction and service costs can be left to itself.
title: 专有软件

source_text:
字面和法律含义
从字面上讲，“所有权”在法律上指软件的所有者可以规定使用者可以对软件做哪些事情。专有软件的所有者并不需要自己“专有”该软件，只要不公布源代码，通过发布编译过的程序，大众软件和在许可证保护下的软件都能够成为专有软件。
target_text: Literally and legally, “ownership” means, literally, that the owner of the software can legally specify what the user can do about the software. The owner of the proprietary software does not need its own “proprietary” software, as long as the source code is not published, and both popular software and software protected by the licence can become proprietary by publishing the compiled program.
title: 专有软件

source_text:
支-{}-持意见
微软公司是商业专有软件的支-{}-持者，它认为用户为软件支付的费用可以增加软件的研发资金。它声称，软件的每个拷贝收取的费用使得软件开发的收益最大化。据称专有软件比自由软件带动了更多的商业活动，当有市场收入時更是如此。
target_text: Microsoft, the owner of commercial proprietary software, believes that user fees for software can increase the cost of software development. It claims that fees charged for each copy of software maximize the benefits of software development. Proprietary software is said to generate more business activity than free software, especially when there is market revenue.
title: 专有软件

source_text: 如果在软件中发现问题时，软件所有者已经消失，或者他们决定停止或减少软件的生产或支持，都能够让用户陷入不利和无助的境地。由于业务问题，软件所有者可能无法改进或支持软件。软件的老版本的支持已经到期，却没有其它的软件供应商提供支持。
target_text: If problems are detected in the software, the owner of the software disappears, or they decide to stop or reduce the production or support of the software, they can put the user at a disadvantage and helplessness. Because of business problems, the owner of the software may not be able to improve or support the software. The support of the old version of the software has expired without the support of other software providers.
title: 专有软件

source_text: 剧情中假想的加利福尼亚州索萨利托“鲸类生物学会”实际上是在蒙特瑞湾水族馆拍摄的，而在旧金山市的金门公园的情节则实际上是在洛杉矶的维尔·罗杰斯州立历史公园拍摄的。在电影的开头，一台Amiga计算机作为道具成为了斯波克使用的一台瓦肯超级计算机。这可从屏幕上显示出的Amiga的“Garnet”字体看出来：这个字体在屏幕上显示出斯波克正在学习的信息。
target_text: The hypothetical Sosalito Cetacean Biology Society in California was actually filmed at the Monterey Bay Aquarium, while the plot at Golden Gate Park in San Francisco was actually filmed at Vel Rogers State History Park in Los Angeles. At the beginning of the film, an Amiga computer became a Vulcan supercomputer used by Spock as a prop. This can be seen from the Amiga "garnet" font on the screen: this font shows on the screen what Spok is learning.
title: 星际旅行IV：抢救未来

source_text: 薄膜电阻(sheet resistance)，又被称为方阻，具有均匀厚度薄膜电阻的量度。通常被用作评估半导体掺杂的结果。这种工艺的例子有：半导体的掺杂领域（比如硅或者多晶硅），以及被丝网印刷到薄膜混合微电路基底上的电阻。薄膜电阻的概念与电阻或者电阻率相对，可直接用四端點測量技術测量法（也称为四点探针测量法）或范德堡法来测量。
target_text: The membrane resistance (sheet resistance), also referred to as rectangular resistance, has the measure of uniform thickness of the membrane resistance. It is usually used as an assessment of semiconductor mixing. Examples of this process are: semiconductor mixing (such as silicon or multi-crystal silicon) and resistance on the base of the membrane hybrid microcircuit. The membrane resistance concept can be measured directly by four-end measurements (also known as four-point probe measurements) or the van derburg method.
title: 薄膜电阻

The Bates Curve was originally developed using the Decastrio algorithm in 1959 to find the Bates Curve in a way that stabilizes values.

source_text: 在不同的操作系统中，空格键有不同的用处，如和其他键组合使用可以关闭当前的视窗等。在电脑游戏和其他应用程序中，空格键通常会被定义成快捷键，如跳起等。在视频播放软件裡，空格键通常被定义成暂停和继续播放。在注音輸入法中，當字的聲調為一聲時，空格鍵即代表要輸入聲調為一聲的字。
target_text: Space keys have different uses in different operating systems, such as the use of other combinations to close the current window. In computer games and other applications, space keys are usually defined as shortcuts, such as jump-ups. In video-playing software, space keys are usually defined as pauses and continues to play. In a note type, when a word is typed as a sound, the empty key represents a word that you want to type as a sound.
title: 空格键

source_text:
在半导体或带绝缘子中，费米能级被带隙所围绕，称为带隙（以将其与带结构中的其他带隙区分开）。带隙以上的最接近的带称为导带，带隙下方的最接近的带称为价带。 “价带”之类的名称类似于化学，因为在半导体（和绝缘体）中，价带是由价轨道构成的。
在金属或半金属中，费米能级在一个或多个允许带的内部。在半金属中，该带通常被称为“导带”或“价带”，这取决于电荷传输是更类似于电子的还是类似于空穴的，类似于半导体。然而，在许多金属中，这些带既不像电子一样也不像空穴一样，通常是由价态轨道组成的，因此通常被称为“价带”。 金属的能带结构中的能隙对低能物理并不重要，因为它们与费米能级相距太远。
target_text: In semiconductors or insulations, the Femi energy level is surrounded by a lacuna, known as a lacuna (to separate it from other lacunas in the structure). The nearest belt above the lacuna is called a conductor belt, and the nearest belt below the lacuna is called a price belt. The name “price belt” is similar to that of chemistry, because in semiconductors (and insulations) the price belt is made up of price orbits. In metals or semimetals, the Femi energy level is inside one or more permitted belts. In semimetals, the belt is commonly referred to as a “guiding belt” or “price belt”, depending on whether the transmission of the charge is more similar to electronics or to caves, similar to semiconductors. However, in many metals, these belts are neither electronic nor like caves, usually composed of valoric orbits, and are therefore often referred to as “priced” and therefore not important for low-energy physics because they are too far away from the pivots.
title: 能带结构

source_text: 《可汗怒吼》是第一批采用电子图像与计算机绘图来加快制片进度的电影之一。计算机图形公司“埃文与萨瑟兰”（Evan and Sutherland）制作了进取号荧屏上显示的矢量图以及用于影片开头字幕的群星背景。 工业光魔在这部电影中达成了一大技术成就：他们制作的创世装置改造贫瘠行星的影像，是电影史上第一段完全利用计算机生成图形技术制作的影像。 对该镜头的最初设想，只是将放在密封舱里的石头变成花朵的实验性动画。 但韦耶建议将这段影像拓展为在一颗行星上发生的创世效果。派拉蒙赞同这一更引人注目的表现方式，并希望它的表现方式能不同于传统的动画。 在阅读了卢卡斯电影公司计算机绘图部门提交的一份研究报告后，韦耶将这一任务交给了他们。绘图团队在动画的细节部分下了不少功夫；有一位艺术家还特意确保了太空中星体的真实性——影像中的太空背景几乎完全与距地数光年的一颗恒星处看到的背景相契合。动画师们希望这段动画能为他们的工作室赢得商业机遇。
target_text: In this film, the Industrial Light Demon has achieved a great deal of technological achievement: the creation of images of poor planets by their creative devices was one of the first films to use electronic images and computer mapping to accelerate the production of graphic images. The original idea of the image was that the stone in the sealed chamber would only be an experimental animation that would turn into a flower.
title: 星际旅行II：可汗怒吼

source_text: 在关系数据库，数据库表，又稱表格，是一系列二维数组的集合，用来代表和储存数据对象之间的关系。表是构成表空间的基本结构，由区间构成。它由纵向的-{zh-hant:行;zh-hans:列;}-和横向的-{zh-hant:列;zh-hans:行;}-组成，例如一个有关作者信息的名为authors的表格中，每个-{zh-hant:行;zh-hans:列;}-包含的是所有作者的某个特定类型的信息，比如“姓氏”，而每-{zh-hant:列;zh-hans:行;}-则包含了某个特定作者的所有信息：姓、名、住址等等。
target_text: In the relationship database, the database table, also referred to as the table, is a collection of two-dimensional arrays used to represent and store the relationship between data objects. The table is the basic structure that makes up the table space and is made up of compartments. It consists of vertical -- {zh-hant: rows; zh-hans: columns;} -- and horizontal --{zh-hant: column; zh-hans: rows;} -- comprising, for example, each -- zh-hant: row; zh-hans: column;} -- containing a particular type of information for all authors, such as a " last name" and each -- zh-hant: column; zh-hans: row;} -- containing all the information of a particular author: surname, name, address, etc.
title: 数据库表

source_text:
历史
Doug Cutting在1999年编写了Lucene，他是一位資深的全文索引及檢索專家，曾經是V-Twin搜索引擎的主要開發者，後來在Excite擔任高級系統架構設計師，目前從事於一些互联网底層架構的研究。他貢獻出Lucene的目標是為各種中小型應用程式加入全文檢索功能。Lucene最初可以从SourceForge网站的主页下载，它于2001年9月加入Apache软件基金会的Jakarta开源Java产品家族，并于2005年2月成为独立的顶级Apache项目。Lucene这个名字是Doug Cutting妻子的中间名，也是她外祖母的名字。
target_text: In 1999, Doug Cutting produced Lucene, a resourceful full-text indexer and search specialist who was the main developer of the V-Twin search engine and who became a high-level system designer in Excelte, currently working on some of the bottom layers of the Internet. His aim was to add a full-text search function to a variety of small and medium-sized applications. Lucene was originally downloaded from the home page of SourceForge, which joined the Jakarta Open Source Java family of the Appache Software Foundation in September 2001 and became an independent Apache project in February 2005. Lucene is the middle name of Doug Cutting’s wife and her grandmother’s name.
title: Lucene

source_text: 戈德堡和他的学生研究出供给、固定、抓取和装配的新算法。算法着重于最低限方法，寻求最简单的传感及复杂性。戈德堡的博士论文研究出第一个定向（供给）多边形部件的算法，并且证明该算法可以用来定向包括轴向对称部件在内的任何部件。他还申请到了运动柔韧夹具的专利权。这是一种新的机器人夹具，它不需传感即可被动地安全抓牢部件。戈德堡在2005年当选为电气和电子工程师协会（）院士，他参与创办了IEEE自动化科学与工程学报，他的研究工作共荣获六项美国专利。
target_text: Goldberg and his students have developed new algorithms for supply, fix, capture, and assembly. The algorithm focuses on minimum methods, seeking the simplest sense and complexity. The doctoral dissertation in Goldberg studied the first algorithm for directional (supply) polygonal components and proved that the algorithm could be used to target any component, including an axle symmetry components. He also applied for patenting of motion-resilient clamps.
title: 肯·戈德堡

source_text: 戈德堡开发的第一个机器人网络界面（1994年8月）让他享有盛誉。他随后的研究项目——遥控花园允许远程访问者通过互联网来浏览花园、为花园浇水及在花园中播种。遥控花园在艺术电子中心的大厅中连续在线运行九年。戈德堡是在网络化遥控机器人领域的领先的科研工作者，并研究出一系列学术合作遥控系统，如“遥控执行者”。在这个系统中，远程参与者们通过互联网指导远程执行者进行移动。
target_text: His first robotic network interface (August 1994) was developed in Goldberg. His subsequent research project, the remote garden, allowed remote visitors to browse gardens through the Internet, water them and sow them in gardens. The remote garden operated online for nine consecutive years in an art electronics centre lobby. Goldberg was a leading researcher in the field of networked remote robotics and developed a series of academic collaborative remote control systems, such as “telecontrol executives”. In this system, remote participants directed remote operators to move via the Internet.
title: 肯·戈德堡

source_text: 砷化鎵（化學式：GaAs）是鎵和砷兩種元素所合成的化合物，也是重要的IIIA族、VA族化合物半导体材料，用來製作微波積體電路、紅外線發光二極體、半导体激光器和太陽電池等元件。GaAs化合物半导体特别适合应用于无线通信中的高频传输领域，现在越来越多被应用于射频前端器件，这是因为GaAs化合物半导体电子迁移率比传统的硅快，且具有抗干扰、低噪声与耐高电压、耐高温与高频使用等特性，在4G与5G时代有高度需求。
target_text: Arsenic platinum (chemical: GaAs) is a compound synthesized by two elements: titanium and arsenic. It is also an important semiconductor material for the IIIA, VA compounds, which is used to produce components such as microwave block circuits, infrared light diodes, semiconductor lasers and solar batteries. GaAs semiconductors are particularly suitable for use in high frequency transmissions in wireless communications and are now increasingly used in radio frequency front enders because GaAs compounds have semiconductor electronic transport rates faster than traditional silicons and have high demand in the 4G and 5G erases, as they are resistant to interference, low noise and high voltage, high temperature and high frequency.
title: 砷化鎵

source_text: 低级语言（），是计算机科学相关的术语，指的是一类電腦程式語言。該類程式語言之所以被稱為低階（低级），是因为它很少提供或不提供计算机的指令集体系结构——也就是语言映射中与处理器指令紧密相关的命令或函数。“低级”一词是指其和机器语言之间很少或根本不存在一定程度的抽象，因此低级语言有时被描述为“接近硬件”。用低级语言编写的程序往往是相对不可移植的。
target_text: Low-level languages () are terms associated with computer science and refer to a type of computer program language. The language is called low-level (low-level) because it rarely provides or does not provide a computer's command collective structure — that is, orders or functions in the language map that are closely related to the processor's instructions. The term “low-level” means that there is little or no abstraction between it and the machine language, so lower-level languages are sometimes described as “close to hardware”.
title: 低级语言

source_text: 低级语言可以在没有编译器或解释器的情况下转换为机器码——第二代编程语言使用称为汇编器的简单处理器——并且生成的代码直接在处理器上运行。使用低级语言编写的程序可以运行速度非常快，而占用的内存较少。相应的，高级语言中的等效程序可能效率较低并使用更多内存。低级语言尽管在代码层面上很简单，但由于程序员必须记住许多技术细节，因而难以使用。相比之下，高级编程语言将计算机体系结构的执行语义与程序规范隔离开来，这简化了开发。
target_text: Low-level languages can be converted to machine codes without compilers or interpreters — second-generation programming languages use simple processors called compilers — and the resulting codes run directly on processors. Programs written in lower-level languages run very fast, while less memory is occupied. Correspondingly, equivalent programs in advanced languages may be less efficient and more memory used. Lower-level languages, though simple at the code level, are difficult to use because programmers must remember many technical details. In contrast, advanced programming languages segregate computer architecture implementation semantics from procedural norms, which simplify development.
title: 低级语言

source_text: 大多數的DVD播放機只會有一個區域碼，大多數的美國八大影業成員發行的DVD-Video只會有一個區域碼。但是，有些DVD-Video會有兩個以上的區域碼（例如第一區至第三區）。另外，有些非美國八大影業成員發行的DVD-Video沒有區域碼。若想用只有一個區域碼的DVD播放機或光驱播放其他區域碼的DVD-Video，則必須透過破解芯片、软件破解（如早期版本的VLC多媒體播放器）或用遙控器輸入一些按鍵來解除DVD播放機本身的區域限制，也有厂商生产了能播放所有区域DVD的影碟机。DVD光碟機通常可重設DVD區域碼5次，完成第5次後即固定區域碼而無法再重設。
target_text: Most DVD players will have only one area code, and most of the eight leading American film crews will have only one area code. However, some DVD-Video will have more than two area codes (e.g., regions I to III). In addition, some non-United States eight film players will have no area code for DVD-Video. If DVD players with only one area code, or DVD-Video with a photo-drive, most of the eight major American cinematographs will have only one area code, then they will have to decipher the chip, break the software (e.g., an early version of the VLC Multimedia player) or enter remote controls to remove the area limits of the DVD players themselves.
title: DVD區域碼

source_text: 並非所有的金属-半导体接面都是具有整流特性的，不具有整流特性的金属-半导体接面則稱為欧姆接触。整流属性決定於金属的功函、固有半导体的能隙，以及半导体的掺杂類型及浓度。在設計半导体器件時需要對肖特基效应相當熟悉，以確保不會在需要歐姆接觸的地方意外地產生肖特基势垒。
target_text: Not all of the metal-semiconductor interfaces are of an orthopaedic nature, and the metal-semiconductor interfaces are called Om. The orthopaedic properties determine the function of the metal, the energy gaps of the inherent semiconductor, and the types and concentrations of the semiconductor. The semiconductor devices need to be designed in such a way that they are familiar with the Schottsky effect so as to ensure that they do not unexpectedly create the chortsky base where Om is required.
title: 肖特基势垒

source_text: 20世纪90年代前后，储存于计算机上的字形数据库逐渐约定俗成地被英语使用者称为“computer font”，虽然“font”在排印学与书法领域的原意和这里所用的并不是非常吻合。对于“computer font”中的“font”，中国大陆和台湾香港翻译不同，分别为计算-{}-机“字体”和电-{}-脑“字型”。随着可缩放的矢量电脑字体的出现，“字型”与“字体”之间的界限也逐渐模糊。
target_text: Before and after the 1990s, the typographical database stored on computers became popularly known by English users as “computer font”, although the original meaning of “font” in the field of typology and book law did not coincide very well with that used here. For “font” in “compute font”, the difference between mainland China and Taiwan Hong Kong translates to calculate--mechanical “ fonts” and electric-{}-cerebral fonts, respectively. As scalable vector fonts appear, the distinction between “fables” and “ fonts” is becoming blurred.
title: 字体

source_text: 由于蘋果公司和微软的操作系统支持平台相关字体中的不同字符集，因此一些代工厂以不同的方式使用专家字体。 这些字体包括Macintosh或Windows计算机上缺少的字符，例如： 分数，连字或一些重音字形。 无论使用哪种操作系统，目标都是将整个字符集交付给客户。
target_text: Because Apple and Microsoft operating systems support different character sets in the platform-related fonts, some generations use specialist fonts in different ways. These fonts include characters missing on Macintosh or Windows computers, such as: fractions, hyphenation, or some type of accent. Whatever operating system is used, the goal is to deliver the entire character set to the client.
title: 字体

source_text: 到20世纪70年代中期，所有主要的字体技术和所有字体都在使用：凸版印刷；连铸机；照相排版；计算机控制的照排机；和最早的数字排字机 - 具有原始处理器和陰極射線管输出的大型机器。 从20世纪80年代中期开始，随着数字排版的发展，用户几乎普遍采用美式拼写“字体”，这主要是指包含可缩放轮廓字体的计算机文件（字体），以几种常见格式之一。 某些字体，如Verdana，主要用于显示器。
target_text: By the mid-1970s, all major font techniques and all fonts were in use: contemplation printing; concret casting machines; photographic layout; computer-controlled cabling machines; and the earliest digital typewriters - large machines with raw processors and cathode tubes. Since the mid-1980s, as digital layouts developed, users have almost universally used American spelling, which refers mainly to computer files ( fonts) containing scalable contour fonts, in one of several common formats. Some fonts, such as Verdana, are used mainly for displays.
title: 字体

source_text: 当使用轮廓字体时，光栅化例程（在应用程序软件，操作系统或打印机中）渲染字符轮廓，解释向量指令以确定哪些像素应为黑色，哪些像素为白色。在诸如激光打印机和高端发布系统中使用的高分辨率下，光栅化是直截了当的。对于计算机屏幕，每个单独的像素可以表示易读和难以理解的字符之间的差异，一些数字字体使用字体微调来制作小尺寸的可读位图。
target_text: When contour fonts are used, the rastering routine (in application software, operating systems, or printers) rewrites the character contour, explaining vector commands to determine which pixels should be black and which pixels are white. In high-resolution settings such as laser printers and high-end distribution systems, the rasterization is straightforward. For computer screens, each individual pixel can represent a difference between an easy-to-read and hard-to-understand character, and some digital fonts make small-size readable bitmap using font fine-tuning.

source_text:
软件技术
1999年2月8日，VMware展示了它的第一个x86虚拟化产品“VMware虚拟平台”（VMware Virtual Platform），此产品建立在创建者早期在斯坦福大学的研究基础之上。VMware在1998年10月提交了对这一技术的专利申请，并于2002年5月28日被授予。VMware与类似的x86虚拟化软件必须使用十分复杂的技术来获得并虚拟运行一些指令，这些技术被IBM的IBM_System/370 以及摩托罗拉的MC68020等原生可虚拟化的架构远远超出。
target_text: On 8 February 1999, VMware presented its first X86 virtualized product, VMware Virtual Platform (VMware Virtual Platform), based on the founder’s earlier study at Stanford University. VMware submitted a patent application for this technology in October 1998 and was awarded on 28 May 2002. VMware and similar X86 virtualized software must use highly sophisticated technologies to obtain and virtualize instructions that are well beyond the original virtualization structures of IBM IBM_System/370 and MC68020 in Motorola.
title: X86虚拟化

source_text: Kevin Lawton启动了Plex86项目（原来叫作“freemware”）来创建应用于x86虚拟化的自由软件。此项目已经改变了原有的目的，现在只支持Linux作为客操作系统；然而在这之前，Lawton发表了一篇论文《使用虚拟化技术在一台IA-32 PC上同时运行多个操作系统》，作出了对x86架构虚拟化困难的分析以及提出了一些解决这些困难的技术。
target_text: Kevin Lawton launched the Plex86 project (formerly called “freemware”) to create free software for X86 virtualization. The project has changed its purpose and now supports Linux only as a passenger operating system; however, Lawton has previously published a paper, “The use of virtualization technology to run multiple operating systems on an IA-32 PC”, produced an analysis of the difficulties of virtualization of the x86 architecture and proposed techniques to address those difficulties.
title: X86虚拟化

target_text: Intel Virtualization Technology (INT) is a virtual technology developed by Intel Technology, which can use IVT for system-based operating systems, virtual hardware devices (VMM, Virtual Machine Monitor) for virtual machine operating systems. These technologies were previously implemented through software on VMware and Virtual PC, while hardware support on IVT can accelerate the implementation of such software.
title: X86虚拟化

source_text: 在线仿真器（，简称：）是调试嵌入式系统软件的硬件设备。嵌入式系统开发者要面对一般软件开发者所没有的特殊问题，因为嵌入式系统往往不像商业计算机那样具有键盘、显示屏、磁盘機和其他各种有效的用户界面和存储设备。在线仿真器通过处理器的额外辅助功能，使系统在不失去其功能的情况下，提供调试功能。历史上，由于处理器能力有限，这通常意味着将其处理器临时更换成一个硬件仿真器。硬件仿真器是普通处理器的特制版本，内部设有多种额外的调试信号，以便提供处理器内部状态的信息。
target_text: Online emulators (hereinafter:) are hardware devices for debugging embedded system software. Embedding system developers face special problems that do not exist for general software developers, as embedded systems often do not have keyboards, display screens, disks and a variety of other effective user interfaces and storage devices as commercial computers do. Online emulators provide debugging functions without losing their functionality through additional support to processors. Historically, limited processing capacity usually means that their processors are temporarily replaced with a hardware emulator. Hardware emulators are unique versions of normal processors, with multiple additional debugging signals in-house to provide information on the status of the processors.
title: 在线仿真器

source_text:
优势
几乎所有的嵌入式系统都由相互独立但又相互依赖的硬件和软件组成。通过在线仿真器，可以在软件真正将要运行的硬件上运行和调试。同时，通过原码级调试（Source Level Debug, 程序员可以看到运行的源代码）和单步调试（程序员可以一步一步的运行程序寻找错误），程序员可以方便的分离出错误代码。
target_text: Almost all embedded systems are made up of separate but interdependent hardware and software. Online emulators make it possible to run and debugger the hardware that the software is actually about to run. At the same time, the programmer can easily separate the error code through the source level debug (the programmer can see the source code running) and one-step debugging (the programmer can track the error step by step).
title: 在线仿真器

source_text: 根網域名稱服务器（，簡稱「根域名服务器」）是互联网域名解析系统（DNS）中最高级别的域名服务器，负责返回顶级域的权威域名服务器地址。它们是互联网基础设施中的重要部分，因为所有域名解析操作均离不开它们。由于DNS和某些协议（未分片的用户数据报协议（UDP）数据包在IPv4内的最大有效大小为512字节）的共同限制，根域名服务器地址的数量被限制为13个。幸运的是，采用任播技术架设镜像服务器可解决该问题，并使得实际运行的根域名服务器数量大大增加。截至2023年6月，全球共有1719台根域名服务器在运行。
target_text: Root domain name servers (simplely called Root Domain Name Servers) are the highest-level domain name servers in the Internet domain name resolution system (DNS) and are responsible for returning the top-level domain's authoritative domain server addresses. They are an important part of the Internet infrastructure, as all domain name resolution operations cannot be separated. There are 1719 root domain name servers operating globally as of June 2023.
title: 根網域名稱伺服器

source_text: 在1978年，外接式的5¼英寸软驱－Disk II被用以储存及恢复数据，代替原来的录音带。它需要接在一张控制卡上，而控制卡则需插在扩充槽上（通常是第6个槽（PR#6））。这个由史蒂夫·沃茲尼克创造的Disk II介面被认为是工程上的极品，因为它的组成零件相当便宜。 在其他控制器需要大量芯片以在磁盘旋转时同步数据输入、输出、使读写头能正确寻轨及将数据编码转换成磁力信号时，沃茲尼克发明的控制器只需要少量的芯片。Apple DOS使用软件来执行这些操作。该控制器使用的Group Code Recording比更常使用的MFM方式使得以软件实现上述功能更加容易。最后，少量芯片的使用让Disk II成为第一种个人电脑用户负担得起的软驱。由此并引发了一些其他影响。沃茲的方案使专有软件开发者可以利用改变低阶扇区格式或使磁头跨越轨道以达成防拷保护。但不可避免地，其他公司最后开始贩卖可以破解保护的软件。另一个沃茲尼克的优势使他可以忽略Shugart的第0轨侦测器。当操作系统想要去第0轨时，控制器就移到下一个较低号的轨，并继续做直到不能再移动为止：这被假定是第0轨。这个被称为"重校准"的操作会造成很大的噪音（高速机械震动），这常使Apple II的新手感到恐惧。
target_text: In 1978, the external version of the Disk II interface, created by Steve Woznik, was considered to be the most expensive piece of engineering work because its components were quite cheap. When a large number of chips were needed to synchronize data entry, output, right-tracking of the reading head and conversion of the data code into a magnetic signal, the control device invented by Voznik needed only a small amount of chips. The software was used by Apple Dos to carry out these operations (usually the sixth slot (PR#6). The version of the software used by the control device, Group Code Recording, was used to make it easier for software to perform the functions described above. Finally, the use of a small chip enabled Disk II to become the first user of a personal computer to track and convert the data code into a magnetic signal.
title: Apple II

source_text: 其文字与图像系统却使用了在当时已属过时的连接方式（扫描线资讯存储于内存中不连续的部份），据说是沃茲尼克认为这样可以节省一个芯片－以软件计算或做扫描线寻址会比另加硬件控制更便宜。类似地，在高分辨率图像模式中，颜色由画素位置决定，因此可由软件控制，节省了转换芯片的费用。
target_text: The text and image system, which used outdated connections at the time (scanline information is stored in a non-continuous part of the memory), is said to have been considered by Woznik to save a chip – which would be cheaper to calculate or search for a scanning line in software than in additional hardware controls. Similarly, in high-resolution image patterns, colours are determined by the location of the sketches and can therefore be controlled by software, resulting in savings in the cost of switching the chips.
title: Apple II

source_text: Apple II的设计哲学概念可从其声音电路看出。Apple II使用一个切换电路，其仅能透过内置喇叭发出单音。Apple II未使用声音合成芯片。所有其他的声响（包含双、三及后来的四声音乐、音频范例回放与语音合成）需由技巧高超的软件在适当的时间发出声音。苹果公司于Apple II上应用专用声音芯片是将近十年后的事了。类似的技术亦应用在录音带存储系统上：录音带输出的原理与喇叭一样，输入则是一个简单的零交叉（zero-crossing）侦测器－由一个相对粗糙（1位元）的音频数码化器支持。ROM内的代码则用以编／解码这些由录音带输入／输出的信号。（参见Frequency shift keying）
target_text: The design philosophy of Apple II can be seen in its sound circuits. Apple II uses a switch circuit that can only give a single voice through a built-in speaker. Apple II does not use sound synthesis chips. All other sound sounds (including two, three, and later four music, audio example playback and voice synthesis) need to be sounded at the right time by highly skilled software. Apple uses a dedicated sound chip on Apple II almost 10 years later. Similar technology is applied in tape storage systems: the sound tape output principle, like the trumpet, is supported by a simple zero cross (zero-crossing) detector supported by a relatively crude audio digitizer (one-bit).
title: Apple II

source_text: 沃茲尼克的开放式设计与Apple II的多个扩充槽使它得以借由大量的第三方装置以扩充其功能。在當時有許多Apple II 週邊卡 如 序列控制器，高階顯示控制器，記憶體擴充卡，硬碟及網路組件可供系統運用。 還有模擬卡，如Z80卡可以使Apple II切换至Z80 处理器并运行多种在CP/M操作系统下开发的软件，包括dBase II数据库与WordStar文书处理软件。（在1980年代中期，运行CP/M的机器中，有一半以上是装了Z80模拟卡的Apple II。）另外亦有一种可以运行OS-9 Level One的6809卡。Mockingboard 音效卡（魔音卡）以其簡單的音樂合成及文字-語音轉換的功能大幅地改善了Apple 音效能力。而各种Apple II加速卡则能将速度提升2至4倍。
target_text: Woznik’s open design and Apple II’s multiple extended slots enabled it to expand its functionality by using a large number of third-party devices. There were a number of Apple II sidecards, such as serial controllers, high-level display controllers, memory extension cards, hard disks, and network components for the system. There was also a simulation card, such as Z80, which enabled Apple II to switch to Z80 processors and run a variety of software developed under the CP/M operating system, including dBase II and WordStar processing software. (In the mid-1980s, more than half of the machines running the CP/M were Apple II with Z80 Simulators.) There was also a 6809 card that could run OS-9 Level One.
title: Apple II

source_text: 1983年，Apple IIe的发表接续了Apple II+。它是一款较便宜但功能更强大的机器，采用了较新的芯片以减低成本并添加新功能。例如可显示大小写字母及有64KB内存。IIe的内存被设置成如同48KB的Apple II Plus加装语言卡。这款机型没有插槽0，但有一个提供所有实际使用的附加插槽3－在Apple II+里通常给80列卡使用。附加槽可以插入一张1KB内存卡以激活80列显示。该卡只包含内存，其硬件与固件支持内置于Apple IIe，使其亦能兼容较旧的Videx-style卡，即使它们的低阶细节相当不同。一种"扩充80列卡"则能将总内存提升至128KB。在装有语言卡的情况下，80列卡中的内存"盖过"主内存，使其相较于运行软件，更适合做为数据存储，而实际上，与Apple IIe一起推出的ProDOS操作系统会在开机时自动将该内存当做虚拟磁盘。第三方厂商的内存卡稍后更能将主内存提升至1MB。1K 80列卡亦提供了一新的图形显示模式－双倍低分辨率模式（80×48 像素），而扩充80列卡则提供了两种－双倍低分辨率和双倍高分辨率（560×192 像素）。这两种模式相较于标准低分辨率（40×48）与高分辨率（280×192）模式，其水平分辨率皆提升至双倍。在高分辨率模式下的颜色数量亦从6色提升至15色。第一批Apple IIe不能使用双倍高分辨率模式。然而，这两种模式皆未被内置的BASIC直接支持，因此用户们必须依靠大量的POKE与CALL指令或组合语言编程或某些工具软件以使用这些显示模式。

source_text: IIe是所有Apple II系列产品中最热销的，且被认为是Apple II产品线中的"黑马"。它也是苹果电脑家族中最"长寿"的--在接近11年的制造、贩售期间只有微小的改变。在那段期间，有两种经过重大改变的机型－加强型IIe（四颗具同样功能的芯片－包括一颗改进过的处理器－65C02－被应用在后期的IIc上。）及白金IIe（应用了与当时苹果电脑其他产品相合的机箱颜色及附加九宫格数字键。）一部有128KB内存的白金版IIe可以被认为是运行大部份于约1988年后推出的Apple II软件的基本要求。
target_text: IIe is the hottest product in all Apple II series and is considered to be the black horse in the Apple II product line. It is also the longest life in the Apple computer family -- with only minor changes during the 11 years of manufacture and sale. During that period, there were two major changes in the type IIe - the enhanced version (four chip with the same function - including an improved processor - 65C02 - applied to the later version of IIc.) and platinum IIe (using the color of the box that matched the other products of the apple computer at the time and the nine-megagram digital key attached to it.) A white gold version II, with 128 KB, can be considered the basic requirement to run a large part of the Apple II software that was launched after 1988.

source_text: 1990年，Apple IIe卡上市－它是麦金塔LC产品线的扩充卡。本质上，它就是缩小版的Apple IIe（使用Apple IIGS的Mega II芯片），它能让麦金塔电脑透过硬件模拟方式运行8位元Apple IIe软件（但视频显示是透过软件模拟，而其有时会较Apple IIe慢）。当在Apple II模式时，有许多LC的内置周边设备如内存、3½"软驱、AppleTalk网络和硬盘等可以被Apple IIe卡"借用。然而，IIe卡不能运行16位元的Apple IIGS软件。加装IIe卡的麦金塔LC的目的是为了接替在学校与家庭中使用的Apple IIGS，这也可能是一已被内部人员证实的新型Apple IIGS开发计划被取消而未能上市的原因。
target_text: In 1990, Apple II was listed as an extended card for the McKinta LC line. In essence, it is a reduced version of Apple IIe (using the Apple IIGS-Mega II chip), which allows McKinta computers to run eight-bit Apple II software through hardware simulations (but the video shows that it is simulated through software, which is sometimes slower than Apple IIe. In Apple II, many of the LC's built-in peripheral equipment, such as memory, 31⁄2 'soft drive, AppleTalk network and hard disks, can be borrowed by Apple IIC. However, IIeca cannot run 16-bit Apple IIGS software. The purpose of the McKell Tower LC is to replace Apple IIGS, which is used in schools and households, and this may be the reason why a new Apple IIGS development programme, which has been validated by in-house personnel, has been cancelled.

source_text: 最早的Apple II是以录音带做为存储媒介。依循Commodore Datassette生产线的录音机从未被生产出来。苹果公司在一些早期的文件中建议使用Panasonic RQ309。一开始，苹果公司与许多第一方程序开发员开发存储于录音带上的软件，但在Disk II上市后，基于录音带的软件基本上就从市场上消失了。

source_text: 今日，各种型式、型号的Apple II模拟器被推出。它们可以在Mac OS X、Linux、Microsoft Windows与其他操作系统上运行Apple II软件。在因特网上亦有许多可免费下载的磁盘映像。AppleWin与MESS被认为是兼容性最好的两款模拟器。MESS模拟器可以纪录并回放每次的模拟进程。 Home Action Replay Page (HARP)则可以让用户保存他们最喜欢的操作与游戏纪录。然而，许多模拟器不能运行储存在有防拷保护之媒体上的软件，或只能运行受到简单保护的软件，除非它被破解（移除防拷保护）。在Apple II的全盛时期，即有不少利用商业软件Copy II+破解的盗版软件广为流传（该软件原本的目的为"为受保护的软件创建合法副本备份"）。这些软件至今仍有一部份可被取得，然而使用这些软件的合法性是受争议的（参见DMCA）为此，Lost Classics Project应运而生－为了那些希望可以正大光明使用这些软件的用户们。他们的目的是说服Apple II软件的版权持有者同意免费释出、流传这些软件。在他们的努力下，至今已有一定数量的软件被释出。

source_text: Apple II系列电脑对科技产业及日常生活产生了巨大影响。Apple II是第一部许多人皆见过的电脑，其价位也是许多中产阶级家庭可以负担得起的。其普及性造就了整个电脑游戏与教育软件业的荣光，并同时带起了文书处理器与打印机的市场。第一个商用微电脑「杀手级应用」软件是VisiCalc－最早的试算表软件，而它最早是设计给Apple II运行的。许多商业用户为了使用VisiCalc而购买Apple II，因为那是当时唯一的试算表软件。苹果公司在家用市场的成功激起了其在家用电脑的竟争对手－如VIC-20 (1980)与Commodore 64（1982，其估计有1700至2500万部的销售量）。透过低价销售策略，它们将电脑推广至另外数千万的家庭用户，并与苹果公司一同瓜分市场。
target_text: The Apple II series of computers has had a huge impact on the technology industry and everyday life. Apple II is the first computer that many people have ever seen, and the price is affordable for many middle-class households. Its popularization has made the entire computer game and educational software industry proud, and has brought with it a market for paper processors and printers. The first commercial microcomputer "killer" software is VisiCalc - the first trial balance software that was designed to run for Apple II. Through a low-cost marketing strategy, many commercial users buy Apple II for Visic, which was the only trial table software available at the time. Apple’s success in the market has stimulated competition between home computers, such as VIC-20 (1980), and Comodore 64 (1982, estimated at 17 to 25 million sales).
title: Apple II

source_text: 1990年10月到12月，路易斯安那州什里夫波特编程厂商软盘自称“深邃想法”（）的员工小组正创作《指挥官基恩》系列首部《》。小组由程序员约翰·罗梅洛和约翰·卡马克、设计师汤姆·霍尔、美工阿德里安·卡马克和经纪人杰伊·威尔伯（）组成，专为Gamer's Edge游戏订阅服务和开发游戏。游戏于12月经共享软件发行商Apogee Software发行后，一行人计划离开软盘公司，自立门户。当时他们的上司、Softdisk老板艾尔·威克韦斯（）听闻一行人的计划并使用公司资源开发游戏，找到他们。小组已经在他们工作用计算机上开发了游戏，不仅在办公室里加班加点，还趁着周末把计算机带到约翰·拉马克家中。小组毫不掩饰他们的秘密。经过几个星期的谈判，小组同意为Gamer's Edge打造系列游戏，每两个月一款。
target_text: From October to December 1990, a team of employees from the Shreveport programming firm in Louisiana, calling themselves Deep Thoughts, was working on the first part of the series. The group was composed of programmers John Romero and John Carmack, designer Tom Hall, engineer Adrian Carmack, and broker Jay Wilbur. The team had developed a video game on their computers, not only to work in the office, but also to bring the computer to John Lamarc on weekends without concealing their secrets. After weeks of negotiations, the group agreed to create a series of games for Gamer's Edge.
title: 德軍總部3D

source_text: Ideas from the Deep如今正式成立为id Software，将有些原型概念用在了他们自己的游戏上面。阿德里安·卡马克用这些点子推动他偏爱的黑暗艺术风格，约翰·卡马克则开始试验直到那时专属《银河飞将》（1990年）等大部分的三维计算机图形。卡马克发现这主要是源於个人电脑的限制，需要计算的表面数量過多，以三维形式展示快速动作游戏有困难。1991年间，他尝试限制计算机需要展示的可能表面，使用仅在平坦网格上的墙壁，而非任意形状或角度的关卡。他还另辟蹊径，凭着打造需展示的图像，仅运算玩家眼前的表面，不运算玩家周遭的整个区域。经过六个星期的研发，卡马克利用动画动态二维精灵呈现敌军，打造了基本的三维游戏引擎。Id Software之后把引擎用在1991年4月软盘公司游戏《》，当中玩家驾驶坦克穿过彩色平面墙壁，射杀核子怪兽。1991年秋，团队搬到威斯康星州麦迪逊时，威尔伯离巢，但他已经完成了《》的大部分引擎工作，而卡马克決定開發由的电子角色扮演游戏《地下创世纪：冥河深渊》裡的一項特色。《地下创世纪》打算抛开《盘旋坦克》平面墙壁和简陋灯光的限制，展示材质贴图映射的三维画面。卡马克认为他可以添加材质贴图，而不会牺牲引擎的速度或像《地下创世纪》那样大大增加系统需求，于是便为了软盘公司于1991年11月发行的另一款游戏《》花了六个星期时间增强了《盘旋坦克三维》的引擎。
target_text: Ideas from the Deep is now officially set up as id Software, using some of the original concepts on their own games. During 1991, Adrian Carmack used these points to drive his preferred dark art style, and John Carmack began to test most of the three-dimensional computer graphics until then. Carmack found that it was mainly a personal computer limitation, and that it was difficult to calculate the number of surfaces that had to be counted. In 1991, he tried to limit the possible surface that computers needed to display, using only the walls on the flat grid, rather than a cut-off in random shape or angle. He also built the image that needed to be displayed, and did not account for the entire area in front of the home. After six weeks of research, Carm used the dynamic two-dimensional elves to create an enemy and built a basic three-dimensional game engine.
title: 德軍總部3D

source_text: 影響《德军总部3D》因确立了流派中备受期待的快节奏动作和技术实力，大大推动流派的普及，被尊称为三维射击游戏，尤其是第一人称射击游戏的“祖师爷”。尽管之前也有射击计算机游戏，但他们一般是清版射击游戏，而《德军总部3D》将市场重心转向了第一人称射击游戏。这也要归功于共享软件分发在那时被证实是一种严肃且有利可图的商业策略。《电子游戏和计算机娱乐》（）于1992年9月声称该游戏“证明了共享软件的存在”，《计算机游戏世界》（）也在1993年7月称游戏“几乎仅凭一己之力”证明了共享软件作为发行手段的可行性，为其他第一人称射击游戏共享软件掀起风浪。之前规模较小的二维游戏相比，游戏高收益致使Apogee和其他共享游戏产业转投规模更大的开发团队，开发三维游戏。开发过程中，id带着达成协议的目标，接触了业界大公司雪乐山及其多个榜样的老板。观看了《指挥官基恩》和《德军总部3D》的早期版本，总裁出资250万美元买下id oftware，把它改成内部的开发工作室。团队对协议感到振奋，但访问雪乐山时着实感受到两家公司之间的文化大冲突，犹豫着要不要同意。罗梅洛在交易中提出预付10万美元现金，而不是单独接受雪乐山的股票支付，试探威廉姆斯的真诚度。
target_text: 3D, which influenced the German headquarters, by establishing the fast-paced movement and technological strength of the flute, greatly promoted the spread of the flute, known as the 3D shooting game in September 1992 and, in particular, the “grandfather” of the first-person shooting game. Despite the fact that there were previously shooting computer games, they were generally clean shooting games, while the German headquarters 3D turned the focus of the market to the first-person shooting game. This was also due to the fact that the share software distribution proved to be a serious and profitable business strategy. The video games and computer entertainment () claimed in September 1992 that the game “proveded the existence of shared software”, the Computer Game World () called the game “almostly one-by-one” in July 1993, proved the feasibility of sharing software as a means of distribution, and the share of the shooting game turned into a wave.

source_text: 愛達·勒芙蕾絲的筆記以字母A-G編序。在筆記G中，她描述了以分析機計算白努利數的演算法。後世認為這是第一個公開發表，為供電腦實作的演算法。愛達·勒芙蕾絲也因此被認為是第一個電腦程式設計師。可惜分析機最後還是沒有做出來，她的程式也無法測試。
target_text: Edda Lovelace's notes are organized in the letters A-G. In her notes G, she describes the calculation of white nuley numbers by an analyst. Later on, it is considered to be the first public publication to be used as an algorithm for computers. As a result, Aida Lovelace is considered to be the first computer programmer. Unfortunately, the analyser did not work and her program could not be tested.
title: 愛達·勒芙蕾絲

source_text: 史蒂芬·沃爾夫勒姆在自費出版的Idea Makers一書中，為勒芙蕾絲的貢獻辯護。雖然在勒芙蕾絲的筆記之前，巴貝奇的確私下為分析機寫過很多的算法，沃爾夫勒姆說「但它們和艾達的伯努利數算法比起來，複雜度—或簡潔度—都無法相提並論。巴貝奇協助艾達撰寫筆記，也加了註解，但艾達才是作者。」沃爾夫勒姆認為，艾達的貢獻在淬鍊巴貝奇的概念，「清楚呈現抽象的機器運作，這是巴貝奇做不到的。」
target_text: Stephen Wolfram, in a self-published book of Idea Makers, defends Lovelace's contribution. Even though before Lovelace's notes, Babeche did write a lot of calculations for the analyser in private, Wolflem said, "But neither they nor Ada's Bernoli algorithms can be compared to each other, with complexity – or simplicity. Babeche helped Ada write his notes, with comments, but Ada was the author." Volflem argued that Aida's contribution to the concept of Kibabaki, "is clear about abstract machine operations, which Babeche couldn't do."
title: 愛達·勒芙蕾絲

source_text: 殭屍電腦（），簡稱「殭屍（）」，又称「肉雞」（諧音「肉機」）或「傀儡機」，是指接入互联网受恶意软件感染后，受控于黑客的电脑。其可以随时按照黑客的（C&C, command and control）指令展开拒绝服务（DoS）攻击或发送垃圾信息。通常，一部被侵佔的電腦只是殭屍網路裡面眾多中的一个，會被用來去運行一連串的或遠端控制的惡意程序。一般電腦的擁有者都沒有察覺到自己的系統已經被「殭屍化」，就仿佛是没有自主意识的僵尸一般。
target_text: Zombie computers ("zombies") or "porks" or "puppets" are computers that are controlled by hackers after access to the Internet has been infected by malicious software. They can attack or send refuse-of-service information at any time as ordered by hackers (C&C,command and control). Usually, an occupied computer is only one of many in the zombie network and will be used to run a series of or remote controlled malpractices.
title: 殭屍電腦

source_text: 僵尸主机可以用来进行分布式拒绝服务攻击，就是同时利用大量计算机有组织地冲击目标网站。大量互联网用户同时向网站伺服器发出请求，以使网站崩溃，阻止正常用户访问。 有一个变种称为分布式服务恶化，是对网站的温和反复冲击，由僵尸主机脉冲式进行，目的是使受害网站变慢而非崩溃。这种策略之所以有效，是因为集中的冲击可以迅速检测、应对，但脉冲式冲击所产生的网站速度减慢能数月甚至数年不被发现。
target_text: The Zombie Host can be used for distributed denial-of-service attacks, using a large number of computers to hit the target site in an organized manner. A large number of Internet users simultaneously request web servers to crash the site, preventing regular users from accessing it.
title: 殭屍電腦

source_text:
科研重点
凯泽斯劳滕工业大学的科研和教学方向与实践紧密相联，同工业界密切合作，在大学内成立了一系列的研究所，也吸引了一大批的工业企业在大学附近驻扎。德国人工智能科研中心、德国弗劳恩霍夫协会（Fraunhofer-Institut）实验软件工程研究所、工程数学和经济数学研究所与凯泽斯劳滕工业大学合作紧密，并以获得国际声誉。凯泽斯劳滕工业大学还在校内设立了专利信息中心，作为德国专利商标局在莱茵兰-普法尔茨州授权的合作单位，支持对大学的科研成果进行工业转化。
target_text: In close cooperation with industry, a number of institutes have been set up within the University, and a large number of industrial enterprises have been placed in the vicinity of the University. The German Centre for Artificial Intelligence Research, the German Fraunhofer-Institute for Experimental Software Engineering, the Engineering Mathematics and Economic Mathematics Institute, in cooperation with the Kaisers Lautem Industrial University, have also been established as a cooperative unit authorized by the German Patent Mark Office in the Land of Rhineland-Pfalts to support the industrial transformation of the research results of the University.
title: 凯撒斯劳滕工业大学

source_text: 数据分析的基本出发点是通过傅立叶变换（例如应用快速傅立叶算法）将这个时间序列转换到频域。但由于随机噪声的存在，分析这些数据时需要考虑到其不确定性，这需要用到概率論。对于概率存在两种诠释：和贝叶斯概率，引力波信号的数据分析一般也分为相应的方法，其中对应频率概率的最常见的分析方法叫做。在通信工程中，模式匹配算法是辨识信号的常用算法，它的基本思路是将信号模板（已知信号）和观测结果（未知信号）进行互相关运算，然後从观测结果中找到信号模板是否存在。对于波形能够得到准确预知的引力波信号，这种算法理论上是可行的。
target_text: The basic starting point for data analysis is the conversion of the time series to the frequency range through Fourier variants (e.g. application of fast Fourier algorithms). Because of the presence of random noises, these data need to be analysed taking into account their uncertainty, which requires probabilities. There are two interpretations of probabilities: and Bayes' probabilities, and data analysis of gravitational signals is generally divided into corresponding methods, the most common method of analysis of frequency probabilities being called. In communications engineering, mode matching algorithms are common algorithms for identifying signals, the basic idea being that signal templates (known signals) and observed results (unknown signals) are interoperable, and that signal templates are found to exist from observed results.
title: 引力波天文学

source_text: 乌尔姆大学先后开设了理论医学、物理学、数学、化学、临床医学、生物学、经济数学、牙医学、经济物理学、经济学、经济化学、电子学、计算机科学、工程学等专业。如今的乌尔姆大学拥有自然科学、工程学和计算机科学、数学和经济学以及传统医学等4大类学科。乌尔姆大学的经济数学于1977年最早开设经济数学专业，该专业在德国排名第一，是唯一开设德国精算协会（Die deutsche Aktuarvereinigung (DAV)）课程的大学。随着国际化的潮流，乌尔姆大学语言中心为各个专业方向的学生提供多种外语的语言培训。
target_text: Ulm University has four major disciplines: theoretical medicine, physics, mathematics, chemistry, clinical medicine, biology, economic mathematics, dental medicine, economic physics, economics, economic chemistry, electronics, computer science, engineering, and so on. Today, Ulm University has four major disciplines: natural sciences, engineering and computer sciences, mathematics and economics, and traditional medicine. Ulm University’s Economic Mathematics programme, ranked first in Germany in 1977, is the only university where the German actuarial association (Die deutsche Aktuarvereinigung (DAV)) is taught.
title: 乌尔姆大学

source_text: 特别是在工程领域，乌尔姆大学重点在能量转换与储存技术，现代通信技术，系统技术和微电子技术，纳米电子的研究项目中的智能和可靠的技术系统。这是一般与工业合作伙伴进行的活动。也有很多的信息系统在今天的移动社会。在计算机科学，人机交互领域的研究，电子学习和神经计算机科学特别值得一提的。在计算机科学领域的创意元素，包括在媒体，计算机科学系已崭露头角.在这里，生物研究集中在分子生物学和生理学，遗传学以及生物多样性和生态学。化学的研究专注于功能性材料（如生物，纳米材料和能源材料）分析，电化学和理论支持。其中一个焦点在于应用可再生能源和能源存储。物理研究的焦点在于量子物理/量子信息系统以及生物物理学和凝聚态材料领域，这包括纳米系统。其由化学部门和合作研究中心开展研究。数学和经济在乌尔姆形成独特的组合，特别强调电子商务和应用程序包中的定量方法，例如，金融和保险业。在数学研究的重点在于在工业和商业的数学应用，分析和代数/理论计算，特别是关于通信技术的应用。中央经济研究的主题是金​​融和保险，以及会计和审计。
target_text: In particular, in the field of engineering, Ulm University focuses on energy conversion and storage technologies, modern communication technologies, systems and microelectronics, intelligent and reliable technological systems in research projects in nanoelectronics. This is an activity carried out with industrial partners in general. There are also a number of information systems in mobile society today. In computer science, research in the area of human interaction, e-learning and neurocomputer science is particularly noteworthy. Creative elements in computer science, including in the media, computer science departments ... Bioresearch focuses on molecular biology and physiology, genetics, and biodiversity and ecology. Research in chemistry focuses on the analysis of functional materials (e.g., biology, nanomaterials and energy materials), electrochemistry and theoretical support. One focus in mathematics research is on the application of renewable energy and energy storage.
title: 乌尔姆大学

source_text: 2010年4月11日，Twitter吸纳了软件开发者Atebits，这位软件开发人员已经开发出了获得Apple设计大奖的Twitter客户端Tweetie，这款软件包含iPhone版本和Mac版本。后来这款软件改名为Twitter并作为官方程序免费开放下载，适用于iPhone、iPad以及Mac平台。 从2010年9月到10月，Twitter公司开始推出全新的“New Twitter”，这是Twitter网页版的全新版本。其中全新设计包括可以在每条消息内通过点击消息内所包含的链接就可以直接观看各种多媒体而无需离开Twitter站点，所支持的站点链接包括Flickr和YouTube。同时新的设计还包括全新的页面布局：将类似“@Mentions”和“Retweets”之类的全部移到了Twitter消息的上部，并且每一页的上端都会有一个浮动条，可以给用户提供包括登出等功能的链接。在2010年11月，官方已经确认新版的Twitter已经提供给所有的用户了。
target_text: On April 11, 2010, Twitter absorbed software developer Atebits, a software developer who has developed Tweetie, a Twitter client who has won the Apple Design Award. The software contains iPhone and Mac versions. The software was later renamed Twitter, which is a free and open download for iPhone, iPad, and Mac platforms as an official program.
title: Twitter

source_text:
消息发布与管理
以Twitter为服务基础有许多软件和工具可以用于发布消息、监控内容等，这其中包括Twitvid（用于视频分享）、 TweetDeck、Salesforce.com、HootSuite以及Twitterfeed.只有不到一半的消息是通过网站本身发出的，大部分用户更习惯于使用第三方软件进行消息发布等操作（此结论由Sysomos基于5亿条推文分析得到）。
target_text: News release and management Twitter services are based on a number of software and tools that can be used to publish news, monitor content, etc. These include Twitvid (for video sharing), TweetDeck, Salesforce.com, HootSuit and Twitterfeed. Less than half of the news is sent through the website itself, and most users are more accustomed to publishing messages using third-party software (the conclusion is based on 500 million tweets analysis by Sysomos).
title: Twitter

source_text: 后来经查明，这次攻击是针对在2008年南奥塞梯战争一周年纪念日时一名支持格鲁吉亚的Twitter用户的，而非是针对网站本身。2009年9月22日：Twitter网站的消息总量超过了32位计算机运算时最大的无符号整数值（总共有4,294,967,296条消息），一些第三方应用软件再一次无法正常工作。2009年12月17日：Twitter网站被黑客攻击，网站的欢迎页面被替换成一张绿色旗帜图像，并且写有“该站点已被伊朗网络军攻击”。但是黑客与伊朗之间并没有任何联系。2010年6月-7月：Twitter在这段时间的2010年世界杯足球赛期间曾经有相当高的服务拒绝率（10%-20%），同时服务响应的延迟也有所增加。2010年11月：一部分用户遇到了服务错误，当他们登录到自己的账户的时候，看到的却是大鲸鱼的错误页面。这些账户并不是被锁定的账号，同时使用者依旧可以看到回复自己的消息并可以发表内容，但是时间线以及其它功能则出现不正常。2013年8月27日：Twitter出現宕机，疑似遭到黑客组织“叙利亚电子军”的攻击，该组织表示对此事负责。此外，纽约时报、赫芬顿邮报等几家媒体的网站均遭到该组织的攻击。
target_text: The attack was later identified as targeting a Twitter user who supported Georgia on the first anniversary of the 2008 South Ossetian war, rather than the website itself. September 22, 2009: Twitter’s total amount of information exceeded the unsigned integer value of 32 computers (a total of 4,294,967,296) and some third-party applications were again unable to work. December 17, 2009: The Twitter site was hit by hackers, its welcome page was replaced by a green flag image, and it was written that “the site has been attacked by Iranian cyber troops.” But the accounts were not locked, and the users could still see their news coming back. June-July 2010: Twitter had a high rate of denial of services during the 2010 World Cup event (10-20%), while delays in responding were also increasing. November 2010: some users encountered service errors, and when they entered their accounts, they saw a wrong page by large whales.
title: Twitter

source_text: 在模式识别领域中，最近鄰居法（KNN算法，又譯K-近邻算法）是一种用于分类和回归的無母數統計方法，由美国统计学家伊芙琳·费克斯和小約瑟夫·霍奇斯于1951年首次提出，后来由扩展。在这两种情况下，输入包含中的k个最接近的训练样本。在k-NN分类中，输出是一个分类族群。一个对象的分类是由其邻居的“多数表决”确定的，k个最近邻居（k为正整数，通常较小）中最常见的分类决定了赋予该对象的类别。若k = 1，则该对象的类别直接由最近的一个节点赋予。
target_text: In the area of model identification, the recent neighbourhood approach (KNN algorithm, translated into K-neighbor algorithms) is an unquantifiable statistical method for classification and return, first proposed in 1951 by American statisticians Evelyn Fix and Joseph Hodges Jr. In both cases, enter the nearest K-based training sample. In the K-NN classification, the output is a classed group. The classification of an object is determined by the “majority vote” of its neighbour, and the most common classification of the K-neighbors (k is a positive whole, usually smaller). If k = 1, the category of the object is assigned directly by a recent node.
title: K-近邻算法

source_text: 在k-NN回归中，输出是该对象的属性值。该值是其k个最近邻居的值的平均值。最近鄰居法採用向量空間模型來分類，概念為相同類別的案例，彼此的相似度高，而可以藉由計算與已知類別案例之相似度，來評估未知類別案例可能的分類。K-NN是一种，或者是局部近似和将所有计算推迟到分类之后的。k-近邻算法是所有的机器学习算法中最简单的之一。
target_text: In k-NN returns, the output is the attribute value of the object. This value is the average of the values of its recent neighbours. The recent approach uses vector space models to classify cases of the same type, with the concept of similarity among them, and allows for the evaluation of possible classifications of unknown types of cases by calculating similarities to known ones. K-NN is either a partial approximation and deferment of all calculations to post-classification. k-near algorithms are one of the simplest of all machine learning algorithms.
title: K-近邻算法

source_text: 无论是分类还是回归，衡量邻居的权重都非常有用，使较近邻居的权重比较远邻居的权重大。例如，一种常见的加权方案是给每个邻居权重赋值为1/ d，其中d是到邻居的距离。邻居都取自一组已经正确分类（在回归的情况下，指属性值正确）的对象。虽然没要求明确的训练步骤，但这也可以当作是此算法的一个训练样本集。
target_text: It is useful to measure the weight of a neighbour, whether classified or returned, so that the weight of a closer neighbour is greater than that of a distant neighbour. For example, a common weighting formula is to assign a weight of 1/d to each neighbour, with d being the distance from the neighbour. The neighbour is taken from a group of objects that have been correctly classified (in the case of a return, the attribute value is correct).
title: K-近邻算法

source_text: k-近邻算法的缺点是对数据的局部结构非常敏感。K-平均算法也是流行的机器学习技术，其名稱和k-近邻算法相近，但兩者没有关系。数据标准化可以大大提高该算法的准确性。算法训练样本是多维特征空间向量，其中每个训练样本带有一个类别标签。算法的训练阶段只包含存储的特征向量和训练样本的标签。
target_text: The weakness of the k-neighbor algorithm is that it is highly sensitive to the local structure of the data. The K-average algorithm is also a popular machine learning technique, the name of which is similar to the k-neighbor algorithm, but it has nothing to do with either. Data standardization can greatly improve the accuracy of the algorithm. The algorithm training sample is a multi-dimensional spatial vector with each training sample with a class label. The algorithm ' s training phase contains only features vectors stored and labels of the training sample.
title: K-近邻算法

source_text: 一般情况下，将欧氏距离作为距离度量，但是这是只适用于连续变量。在文本分类这种离散变量情况下，另一个度量——重叠度量（或海明距离）可以用来作为度量。例如对于基因表达微阵列数据，k-NN也与Pearson和Spearman相关系数结合起来使用。通常情况下，如果运用一些特殊的算法来计算度量的话，k近邻分类精度可显著提高，如运用大间隔最近邻居或者邻里成分分析法。
target_text: As a rule, E-Low is used as a measure of distance, but this is only for continuous variables. In the case of text classification of a discrete variable, another measure - an overlap measure (or a sea-light distance) - can be used as a measure. For example, K-NN is also used in conjunction with the Pearson and Spearman coefficients for genetic expression. Normally, the accuracy of k-neighbor classification can be significantly improved if special algorithms are used to calculate measurements, such as using the nearest neighbour or neighbourhood composition analysis at large intervals.
title: K-近邻算法

source_text: 噪声和非相关性特征的存在，或特徵尺度与它们的重要性不一致会使K近邻算法的准确性严重降低。对于选取和缩放特征来改善分类已经作了很多研究。一个普遍的做法是利用进化算法优化功能扩展，还有一种较普遍的方法是利用训练样本的互信息进行选择特征。
target_text: The existence of a noise and non-relevance feature, or the fact that the characteristic scale is not consistent with their importance, would significantly reduce the accuracy of K-neighborial algorithms. Much research has been done to improve classification by selecting and scaling characteristics.
title: K-近邻算法

source_text:
属性
原始朴素的算法通过計算测试点到存储样本点的距离是比较容易实现的，但它属于计算密集型的，特别是当训练样本集变大时，计算量也会跟着增大。多年来，许多用来减少不必要距离评价的近邻搜索算法已经被提出来。使用一种合适的近邻搜索算法能使K近邻算法的计算变得简单许多。
target_text: The original plain algorithm is relatively easy to achieve by calculating the distance from the test point to the storage point, but it is more computing-intensive, especially when the training sample aggregates are larger. Over the years, many of the near-neighbour search algorithms used to reduce unnecessary distance evaluation have been proposed. The use of a suitable near-neighbour search algorithm can make the calculation of the K-neighbour algorithm much simpler.
title: K-近邻算法

source_text:
近邻算法具有较强的一致性结果。随着数据趋于无限，算法保证错误率不会超过贝叶斯算法错误率的两倍。对于一些K值，K近邻保证错误率不会超过贝叶斯的。决策边界
近邻算法能用一种有效的方式隐含的计算决策边界。另外，它也可以显式的计算决策边界，以及有效率的这样做计算，使得计算复杂度是边界复杂度的函数。
target_text: As the data tend to be unlimited, the algorithm ensures that the error rate does not exceed twice that of the Bayesian algorithm. For some K values, the K-neighbor guarantees that the error rate does not exceed that of the Bayers.
title: K-近邻算法

source_text:
连续变量估计
K近邻算法也适用于连续变量估计，比如适用反距离加权平均多个K近邻点确定测试点的值。该算法的功能有：
从目标区域抽样计算欧式或马氏距离；
在交叉验证后的RMSE基础上选择启发式最优的K邻域；
计算多元k-最近邻居的距离倒数加权平均。
target_text: The continuous variable estimate of K-neighbors also applies to continuous variable estimates, such as the application of the anti-distance weighted average of multiple K-neighbors to determine the value of the test point. The function of the algorithm is: to calculate the distance of Euros or Marxes from a sample of target areas; to select the best inspirational K-neighbour on the basis of RMSE after cross-checking; and to calculate the multiple k-neighbour ' s inverted average.
title: K-近邻算法

source_text:
發展
然而k最近鄰居法因為計算量相當的大，所以相當的耗時，Ko與Seo提出一演算法TCFP（text categorization using feature projection），嘗試利用來降低與分類無關的特徵對於系統的影響，並藉此提昇系統效能，其實驗結果顯示其分類效果與k最近鄰居法相近，但其運算所需時間僅需k最近鄰居法運算時間的五十分之一。
target_text: However, most recently, k-neighboring methods have been quite time-consuming because of the size of the calculations, and Ko and Seo have proposed an algorithm, TCFP, to try to use to reduce the impact on the system of non-classical features and, by doing so, to improve system effectiveness, the results of which show that the sorting effect is similar to that of the recent k-neighborship method, but that it takes only one-fifth of the most recent roundup time.
title: K-近邻算法

source_text: 克勒默先是在德国联邦邮政中央通讯实验室的一个半导体研究小组工作，并自称为是一个“应用理论学者”。1954年他前往美国，工作于普林斯顿大学和帕罗奥图的多家研究机构，1968年至1976年任科罗拉多大学博尔德分校（University of Colorado at Boulder，科罗拉多州博尔德县）电子工程系教授。1976年，克勒默说服圣塔芭芭拉加利福尼亚大学的电子和计算机工程系，将有限的项目资金用于刚刚形成的化合物半导体技术，而不是投资发展主流的硅技术，这一决定使得圣塔芭芭拉加利福尼亚大学占据了这一领域的领导地位。
target_text: Klemmer first worked as a semiconductor research team at the Federal Post Central Communications Laboratory in Germany and called himself an “Applied Theory Scholar” in 1954. He travelled to the United States to work at several research institutes at Princeton University and Palooto, and was a professor at the University of Colorado, Borde, from 1968 to 1976, at the Faculty of Electronic Engineering (University of Colorado at Boulder, Borde County, Colorado). In 1976, Klemer persuaded the Faculty of Electronics and Computer Engineering of the University of California, Santa Barbara, to use limited projects for the newly developed semiconductor technology of compounds, rather than investing in the development of mainstream silicon technology, a decision that led to the assumption of leadership in this field by the University of California, Santa Barbara California.
title: 赫伯特·克勒默

source_text:
研究
克勒默的研究领域在当时都不是热门的，但却在几年后显现出其重要性。他在1950年代中期指出使用半导体异质结构能够大大提高各种半导体元件的性能，并提出了可以实现吉赫（GHz）级频率的异质结二极管的概念。1963年又提出了双异质结构激光的概念，这是半导体激光的基础和核心技术。这两个概念远远超出了当时的研究水平，直至1980年代取向附生技术发展后才得以大量应用，并成为主流。克勒默2000年所获得的诺贝尔物理学奖可以追溯到这些早期的论文，它们使得1980年代成为了“异质结构的时代”，异质结构继续主导着化合物半导体，这不仅仅包括激光和发光二极管，还包括集成电路，并且威胁到了硅制集成电路技术的主流地位。
target_text: The research area of Klemmer was not hot at the time, but showed its importance several years later. He pointed out in the mid-1950s that the use of semiconductor heterogeneous structures could significantly improve the performance of various semiconductor components, and proposed the concept of heterogeneous diodes that would achieve the GHz-level frequency. The concept of dual heterogeneous structure lasers, which is the foundation and core technology of semiconductor lasers, was introduced in 1963. These two concepts went far beyond the level of research then and were applied and mainstreamed until the 1980s, when the technologies of appliance were developed. The Nobel Prize for Physics, obtained by Klemer in 2000, traced back to these early papers, which made the 1980s an “era of heterogeneous structures”, and the heterogeneous structures continued to dominate the semiconductors of compounds, which included not only lasers and luminous diodes, but also integrated circuits, and threatened the mainstreaming of silicon integrated circuit technology.
title: 赫伯特·克勒默

source_text: 克勒默来到圣塔芭芭拉加利福尼亚大学后，将研究重心从理论转移到了实验领域，1970年代末成为分子束外延（MBE）研究领域的先驱。他先是制造和研究了新的合成材料，如磷化镓（GaP）和硅基层上的砷化镓，1985年后又将注意力集中到合成材料砷化铟（InAs）, 锑化镓（GaSb）和锑化铝（AlSb），并将基础研究和未来元件开放相结合，其中一项重要的研究课题是超导半导体混合结构，砷化铟-锑化铝材料由超导铌电极连结，可以促使半导体内的超导。另一个研究方向是强电场下半导体内电子的传输，电子在偏能带中振荡，这种结构适合于做振荡器，通常称为Bloch振荡器，可以达到太赫兹（THz）级的频率。
target_text: When Klemmer arrived at the University of California in Santa Barbara, he shifted the focus of research from theoretical to experimental areas, and in the late 1970s became a pioneer in the field of molecular beam extension (MBE) research. He first manufactured and studied new synthetic materials, such as phosphorus (GaP) and silicon-based arsenicized americium, and then, after 1985, focused attention on the transfer of synthetic materials to the InAs (InAs), antimony (GaSb) and aluminum (AlSb), which are suitable for oscillators, commonly known as the Bloch Respirators, which can reach the frequency of the ultra-hertz (THz) class.
title: 赫伯特·克勒默

source_text:
Metadata和架构
JSON文本的官方媒体类型是双引号，这一点在大多数现代的安装中都采用了这种类型。由于传统原因，许多服务提供商、浏览器、服务器、Web 应用程序、库、框架和API也支持非官方的 MIME 类型 或内容类型。值得注意的例子包括谷歌搜索API，雅虎，脸书的API，Lift，和Dojo Toolkit。JSON 架构指定一种基于 JSON 的格式，用于定义用于验证、文档和交互控制的 JSON 数据的结构。它为给定应用程序所需的 JSON 数据以及如何修改该数据提供协定。JSON架构基于XML架构（XSD）中的概念，但基于JSON。与在 XSD 中一样，相同的序列化/反序列化工具可用于架构和数据，并且它是自描述的。它在IETF的互联网草案中指定，目前为2020-12年草案，于2021年1月28日发布。有几个验证器可用于不同的编程语言，每个验证器都有不同程度的一致性。标准文件扩展名为 .json。JSON 标准不支持对象引用，但存在基于 JSON 的对象引用的 IETF 草案标准。
target_text: For traditional reasons, many service providers, browsers, servers, Web applications, libraries, frameworks, and API also support unofficial mimetypes or content types. Notable examples include Google Search API, Yahoo, Facebook API, Lift, and Dojo Toolkit. The JSON structure designates a JSON-based format to define the structure of JSON data for validation, documentation and interactive control. It also provides an agreement on how to modify the data for the specified application. The JSON structure is based on the concept of the XML structure (XSD), but based on JSON. The same serialization/reverse tool as in XSD is available for architecture and data and is self-described.
title: JSON

source_text: 資料庫理論（Database theory）指資料庫與資料庫管理系統的相關理論與研究。数据管理方面的理论涵盖其他领域，如查询语言的基础、計算複雜性和查询的、、理论、、并发控制和数据库恢复基础、、时间数据库与、，管理和，以及Web数据。大多数研究工作，传统上都基于关系模型，因为关系模型通常被认为是最简单和最基础的模型。其他数据模型的相应结果，例如面向对象或，或者最近的图形数据模型和XML，通常可以从关系模型的结果中推导出来。
target_text: Database theory (Database Theory) refers to database theory and research related to database management systems. The theory of data management covers other areas, such as the basis for querying languages, calculating complexity and querying, theory, simultaneous development control and database recovery, time database, management, and Web data. Most research work is traditionally based on relationship models, since relationship models are usually considered to be the simplest and most basic models.
title: 資料庫理論

2002年，来自Weizmann Institute of Science的研究者公开了一种由DNA分子和酶，而不是硅组成的计算机器。 2004年3月28日，Weizmann Institute的Ehud Shapiro, Yaakov Benenson, Binyamin Gil, Uri Ben-Dor,和Rivka Adar在自然杂志上发表文章称，他们实现了一种整合了输入输出的DNA计算机，理论上可以实现细胞内的癌症诊断，并释放抗癌药物。DNA分子由四种碱基组成，通过酶改变他们的排列可以进行计算。 2004年，英国科学家成功的在一小团DNA中存储了大量文件，并成功读取。
target_text: In 1997, computer scientists Mitsunori Ogihara and Biologist Animesh Ray put forward a method for evaluating combined logical circuits and sketched the method for their realization. In 2002, researchers from Weizmann Institute of Science published a computer made up of DNA molecules and enzymes, rather than siliconsics. On 28 March 2004, Ehud Shapiro of Weizmann Institute, Yaakov Benson, Binyamin Gil, Uri Ben-Dor, and Rivka Adar, published articles in Nature magazine, stating that they had achieved a combination of imported DNA computers, which could theoretically lead to cancer diagnosis in cells, and to the release of anti-cancer drugs.
title: DNA運算

source_text:
算法
在一个阶数为的图中，可能成为哈密顿路径的顶点序列最多有有!个（在完全图的情况下恰好为!个)，因此暴力搜索所有可能的顶点序列是非常慢的。
一个早期的在有向图上寻找哈密顿环的算法是Martello的枚举算法
由Frank Rubin
提供的搜索过程将图的边分为3种类型：必须在路径上的边、不能在路径上的边和未定边。在搜索的过程中，一个决策规则的集合将未定边进行分类，并且决定是否继续进行搜索。这个算法将图分成几个部分，在它们上问题能够被单独地解决。
target_text: An early algorithm for looking for the Hamilton rings on a chart is Martello’s catalog. The search process provided by Frank Rubin divides the edges of the map into three types: it must be on the edge of the path, it cannot be on the edge of the path, and it is not on the edge of the path and it is open. In the search process, a decision-making rule pool will be classified undecided and it will be decided whether to continue the search.
title: 哈密顿路径问题

source_text: Andreas Björklund通过容斥原理将哈密尔顿环的计数问题规约成一个更简单，圈覆盖的计数问题，后者可以被通过计算某些矩阵的行列式解决。通过这个方法，并通过蒙特卡洛算法，对任意阶图，可以在O(1.657n)时间内解决。对于二分图，这个算法可以被进一步提升至o(1.415n)。对于最大度小于等于3的图，一个回溯搜索的方法可以在 O(1.251n)时间内找到哈密顿环。
target_text: Andreas Björklund, through the apprehensive principle, has defined the issue of Hamilton Ring counting as a simpler, rounded counting problem, which can be solved by calculating the arrays of certain matrices. Through this method, and through the Monte Carlo algorithm, any schematic can be resolved within the time frame of O (1.657n). For binary drawings, the algorithm can be further upgraded to o (1.415n). For maps with a maximum size of less than 3, a backtrace search method can be found within the time frame of O (1.251n).
title: 哈密顿路径问题

For example, the Windows operating system developed by Microsoft: Opens this computer (my computer, my computer), double-clicks on Disk C to enter the root directory of Disk C. source_text: 在类UNIX操作系统中，每个进程都有自己的根目录。对于大多数进程，这与系统的实际根目录相同，但可以通过调用chroot系统命令调用来更改它。这通常用于创建隔离环境以运行需要传统库的软件，有时还可以简化软件安装和调试。 Chroot并不意味着用于增强安全性，因为内部的进程可以透过第二次chroot来获得足够权限，逃出chroot的限制。FreeBSD提供了一个更强大的jail()系统调用，它支持操作系统层虚拟化，并且还用于安全目的，以限制进程可以访问文件系统层次结构的一个子集的文件。
target_text: In the UNIX operating system, each process has its own root catalogue. For most processes, this is the same as the actual root directory of the system, but it can be changed by calling the chroot command. This is usually used to create isolation environments to run software that requires a traditional library, and sometimes to simplify software installation and debugging. Chorot does not mean that it is used to enhance security, because internal processes can get enough access through a second chroot to escape the chroot constraint. FreeBSD provides a stronger Jail () system call, which supports the virtualization of the operating system layer and is also used for security purposes to limit the process ' s access to a subset of the structure of the file system.
title: 根目录

大Θ符号在计算机科学中有着广泛的应用。它可以用来分析算法的运行时间复杂度。例如，对于一个排序算法，如果它的运行时间复杂度为 Θ(nlogn)，则表示这个算法的运行时间随着输入数据规模的增长而呈现出 nlogn 的增长趋势。注意事项
大Θ符号经常被误用。有的作者可能会使用大O符号表达大Θ符号的含义。因此在看到大O符号时应首先确定其是否为误用。
target_text: The application of high-yield symbols has a wide range of applications in computer science. It can be used to analyse the running-time complexity of algorithms. For example, for a sorting algorithm, if the running-time complexity is nlogn, it means that the running-time of the algorithm shows a growing trend of nlogn as the size of the input data increases. Note that the big-comming symbol is often misused. Some authors may use the large-O symbol to express the meaning of the large-concentration symbol.
title: 大Θ符号

source_text:
属性数据库格式所使用的.dbf文件基于一个比较古老的dBase标准。这种数据库格式天生有许多限制，例如：
无法存储空值。这对于数量数据来说是一个严重的问题，因为空值通常都用0来代替，这样会歪曲很多统计表达的结果。
对字段名或存储值中的Unicode支持不理想。
字段名最多只能够有10个字符。
最多只能够有255个字段。
只支持以下的数据类型：浮点类型（13字节存储空间），整数（4或9字节存储空间），日期（不能够存储时间，8字节存储空间）和文本（最大254字节存储空间）
浮点数有可能包含舍入错误，因为它们以文本的形式保存。
target_text: The .dbf files used in the attribute database format are based on an older dBase standard. This database format is inherently limited, for example: empty values cannot be stored. This is a serious problem for quantitative data, since empty values are usually replaced by zero, which distorts the results of many statistical expressions. Unicode supports the ideal for field names or storage values. Field names can have only 10 characters. At most, there are 255 fields. Only the following types of data are supported: floating point types (13-bit storage space), integer (4 or 9-bit storage space), date (not able to store time, 8-bit storage space) and text (minimum 254-bit storage space) floating points may contain default errors because they are stored in text form.
title: Shapefile

source_text: 從廣義的角度看，密碼分析這個詞語有時也泛指繞開某個密碼學算法或密碼協議的嘗試，而不僅僅是針對加密算法。但是，密碼分析通常不包括並非主要針對密碼算法或協議的攻擊。儘管這些攻擊方式是計算機安全領域裡的重要考慮因素，而且通常比傳統的密碼分析更加有效。
target_text: From a broad perspective, password analysis sometimes refers to attempts to circumvent a cryptographic algorithm or a password agreement, rather than simply to encryption algorithms. However, password analysis usually does not include attacks that are not primarily directed at password algorithms or protocols. Although these attacks are important considerations in the computer’s safe domain, they are often more effective than traditional password analysis.
