source_text: 卡恩對於密碼分析所作的論斷也許還為時過早。不安全的密碼並沒有絕跡，美國國家情報機構的密碼分析方法也沒有公開過。在學術界，新的密碼在不斷地被設計出來，也經常地被破解。1984年， 分組密碼被一種唯密文攻擊破解。1998年，原本提出來要取代DES標准加密算法的分組密碼 ，也因為被學術界發現了很多類似而且實際可行的攻擊而消亡。在工業界，很多密碼也被發現有漏洞。例如，在手機中使用的A5/1，A5/2以及算法，用一般的計算工具可以在幾小時、幾分鐘內，甚至是實時地被破解。2001年，用來保護無線Wi-Fi網絡的有線等效加密協議（或稱無線加密協議，即WEP）也可以用相關鑰匙攻擊來破解。
target_text: In 1984, the component code was decoded by a classified attack. In 1998, it was proposed to replace the DES sub-coded encryption algorithm, which was discovered by the academic community with a number of similar and feasible attacks. In the industrial world, many of the codes were discovered to be flawed. For example, the A5/1, A5/2 and algorithms used on mobile phones could be broken in hours, minutes, or even in real time.
title: 密码分析

source_text: 在攻擊中，通過觀察或研究目標系統，多少會獲得關於這個系統的信息。隨著能夠獲得信息多少的假設不同，密碼分析的方法也不盡相同。在密碼分析中最基本的一點，就是假設攻擊者能夠知道系統所用的算法。這也就是「敵人了解系統」的所謂柯克霍夫原則。這個假設在實際中是合理的。從古至今，有無數的秘密算法最後終為人所知，而其途徑多種多樣，包括間諜，叛變，以及逆向工程。在一些不多見的情況下，密碼機也能夠通過純粹的推演而被重建。例如德國的洛侖茲密碼機（Lorenz Cipher）和日本的PURPLE密碼機，以及其它很多經典密碼。
target_text: In an attack, information about the system is obtained more or less through observation or research of the target system. The method of password analysis varies according to how much information can be obtained. The most basic aspect of password analysis is that the attacker can assume that the algorithm used by the system is known. This is what the Enemy understands the system. This hypothesis is valid in practice. From ancient times, there are countless secret algorithms that are known, and that have many different paths, including spies, defections, and reverse engineering. In some rare cases, the cryptography can also be reconstructed through pure advances. For example, Germany’s Lorenz Cipher and Japan’s PURPLE cryptographs, and many other classic codes.
title: 密码分析

source_text: 顯然，這些不同種類的攻擊在實際中可能出現的機會也大不相同。儘管有些攻擊比其它的較為常見，密碼學家在設計算法時通常會采取保守的方式看待安全問題，總是假設最壞的情形。理由是，如果一個算法連不現實的攻擊都可以承受，那麼它自然也可以抵抗實際可行的密碼分析。
target_text: Although some attacks are more common than others, cryptographers tend to look at security in a conservative way when designing algorithms, often assuming the worst. The reason is that, if an algorithm is not even capable of an actual attack, it will naturally be able to resist a practical code analysis.
title: 密码分析

source_text:
完全破解 -- 攻擊者獲得秘密鑰匙。
全局演繹 -- 攻擊者獲得一個和加密和解密相當的算法，儘管可能並不知道鑰匙。
實例（局部）演繹 -- 攻擊者獲得了一些攻擊之前並不知道的明文（或密文）。
信息演繹 -- 攻擊者獲得了一些以前不知道的關於明文或密文的香農信息。
分辨算法 -- 攻擊者能夠區別加密算法和隨機排列。
target_text: Completely deciphering - the attacker was given a secret key. Global play-- the attacker was given an algorithm equivalent to encryption and declassification, although the key may not be known.
title: 密码分析

source_text: 有人建议在RSA密码系统的钥匙生成算法中，模数应该是两个强素数之积。这样，如果用来分解就会变得不可行。由于这个原因，ANSI X.31标准要求，在为基于RSA的数字签名算法生成钥匙的时候，必须用强素数。但是，强素数并不能保证n在用其它更新的算法来分解时也一样难以分解。例如和普通数域筛选法。考虑到为了生成强素数需要用去更多的时间，RSA Security目前并不建议在钥匙生成算法中使用强素数。Rivest和Silverman 也给出了类似但更细致的论述。
target_text: It was suggested that in the RSA cryptographic system key generation algorithms, the modulus should be the sum of two strong numbers. Thus, it would not be feasible to decompose. For this reason, the ANSI X.31 standard requires that the key must be created for RSA-based digital signature algorithms using strong numbers. However, the numeric weights do not guarantee that n is equally difficult to decompose with other updated algorithms. For example, the numeric filtering method is common. Considering that more time is needed to generate strong numbers, RSA Security does not currently recommend the use of strong elements in key generation algorithms.
title: 强素数

source_text: NTP意图将所有参与计算机的协调世界时（UTC）时间同步到几毫秒的误差内。它使用的修改版来选择准确的时间服务器，其设计旨在减轻可变造成的影响。NTP通常可以在公共互联网保持几十毫秒的误差，并且在理想的局域网环境中可以实现超过1毫秒的精度。不对称路由和拥塞控制可能导致100毫秒（或更高）的誤差。
target_text: The NTP is intended to synchronize the time of all UTCs involved in a computer to a few milliseconds of error. It uses a modified version to select the exact time server, which is designed to mitigate the variable effects. The NTP can usually maintain scores of milliseconds of error on the public Internet and can achieve more than one millisecond accuracy in the ideal local area network environment. Asymmetric route and congestion control can lead to a 100 millisecond (or more) error.
title: 網路時間協定

source_text: 1979年，网络时间同步技术在纽约的上于运行在跨大西洋卫星网络的互联网服务上公开演示，这可能是该技术的首次公开演示。该技术后在1981年互联网工程笔记（IEN）173中描述，并根据RFC 778文档开发为一个公开协议。该技术首先被部署在一个本地网络，作为Hello路由协议的一部分，并在（一个用于网络原型的实验操作系统，已运行多年）中实现。
target_text: In 1979, the Internet time-synchronization technology was publicly demonstrated in New York on the Internet service operating on the Transatlantic Satellite Network, possibly for the first time. The technology was then described in the Internet Engineering Note (IEN) 173 of 1981 and developed as a public agreement on the basis of RFC 778 files. The technology was first deployed in a local network as part of the Holo route protocol and was realized (a pilot operating system for the prototype of the network, which has been in operation for many years).
title: 網路時間協定

source_text: 现在还有其他的相关网络工具。这包括Daytime和Time协议用以记录事件时间，以及互联网控制消息协议和IP时间戳选项（RFC 781）。更多完整的同步系统，虽然缺乏NTP的数据分析和时钟规律算法，包括Unix守护进程timed在内的软件其使用选举算法为所有客户端指定服务器。以及数字时间同步服务（Digital Time Synchronization Service，DTSS）使用类似构NTP阶层模型的服务器层次结构。
target_text: There are other related web tools. These include Daytime and Time protocols to record incident time, and Internet-controlled messages protocols and IP time stamp options (RFC 781). More complete synchronization systems are available, although NTP data analysis and clock pattern algorithms are lacking, and software, including Unix daemed, uses election algorithms to assign servers to all clients. And Digital Time Synchronization Service, DTSS uses server hierarchys similar to the NTP class model.
title: 網路時間協定

source_text: 1985年，NTPv0被实现于Fuzzball和Unix，文档化于RFC 958的NTP数据包头、和往返延迟和偏移计算都被留存至NTPv4。尽管当时可用的计算机和网络相对较慢，但在跨大西洋链路上也取得了优于100毫秒的精度，在以太网网络上准确度为几十毫秒。1988年，一个更完整的NTPv1协议规范及相关的算法发表在RFC 1059。它利用了RFC 956的文献中的实验结果和时钟滤波算法，并是第一个描述客户端-服务器和對等網路模型的版本。1991年，NTPv1架构、协议和算法通过在发布的一篇文章得到了工程学界的更广泛关注。
target_text: In 1985, NTPv0 was achieved in Fuzzball and Unix, and the NTP data packets in RFC 958 were retained, together with time delay and deviation calculations, to NTPv4. Although the computers and networks available were relatively slow at the time, they were also better than 100 milliseconds in the transatlantic chain, with an accuracy of dozens of milliseconds in the Tainet network. In 1988, a more complete NTPv1 regulation and associated algorithms were published in RFC 1059. It used the experimental results and clock filter algorithms in the RFC 956 literature and was the first version to describe client-server and peer models. In 1991, NTPv1 architecture, protocols and algorithms received wider attention from the engineering community through an article published.
title: 網路時間協定

source_text:
阶层0（Stratum 0）
这些是高精度计时设备，例如原子鐘（如铯、铷）、GPS时钟或其他無線電時鐘。它们生成非常精确的信号，触发所连接计算机上的中斷和时间戳。阶层0设备也称为参考（基准）时钟。
阶层1
这些与阶层0设备相连、在几微秒误差内同步系统时钟的计算机。阶层1服务器可能与其他阶层1服务器对等相连，以进行完整性检查和备份。它们也被称为主要（primary）时间服务器。
阶层2
这些计算机通过网络与阶层1服务器同步。提供阶层2的计算机将查询多个阶层1服务器。阶层2计算机也可能与其他阶层2计算机对等相连，为对等组中的所有设备提供更健全穩定的时间。
阶层3
这些计算机与阶层2的服务器同步。它们使用与阶层2相同的算法进行对等和数据采样，并可以自己作为服务器担任阶层4计算机，以此类推。
target_text: Class 0 (Stratum 0) These are high-precision clocks, such as atomic clocks (e.g. caesium, thongs), GPS clocks or other wireless clocks. They generate very precise signals that trigger the break-up and time stamp on the connected computer. Class 0 devices are also referred to as reference (base) clocks. Class 1 are connected to class 0 devices, which are synchronized with clocks in the synchronous system within a few seconds. Class 1 servers may be connected to one server in order to perform completeness checks and backups. They are also referred to as primary (primary) time servers.
title: 網路時間協定

source_text: 阶层的上限为15；阶层16被用于标识设备未同步。每台计算机上的NTP算法相互构造一个贝尔曼-福特算法最短路径生成树，以最小化所有客户端到阶层1服务器的累积往返延迟。时间戳NTP使用64位元的时间戳，其中32位元表示秒，32位元表示秒的小数，给出一个每232秒（136年）才会翻转的时间尺度，理论分辨率2−32秒（233皮秒）。NTP以1900年1月1日作为開始時間，因此第一次翻转将在2036年2月7日发生。
target_text: The upper limit of the class is 15; class 16 is used for the marking device without synchronisation. The NTP algorithm on each computer constructs one of the shortest paths of the Belman-Fort algorithm to produce a tree to minimize the accumulated time lag for all clients to the level 1 server. The time stamping NTP uses a time stamp of 64 bits, of which 32 bits is for seconds, 32 bits is for seconds, gives a time scale that can be reversed every 232 seconds (136), and the theoretical resolution 2−32 seconds (233 ps). NTP uses 1 January 1900 as the starting time, so the first conversion will take place on 7 February 2036.
title: 網路時間協定

source_text:
参考实现
NTP参考实现连同协议的开发已持续发展了20多年。随着新功能的添加，向后兼容性仍保持不变。它包含几个敏感的算法，尤其是时钟规律，在同步到使用不同算法的服务器时可能会发生错误。该软件已移植到几乎各个计算平台，包括个人计算机。它在Unix上运行名为的守护进程，或在Windows上运行为一个Windows服务。支持参考时钟，并且以与远程服务器相同的方式对偏移进行过滤和分析，尽管它们通常更频繁地轮询。
target_text: The NTP reference achievement, along with the development of the protocol, has been continuously developed for more than 20 years. With the addition of new features, backward compatibility remains unchanged. It contains several sensitive algorithms, especially clock patterns, which can be wrong when synchronizing to servers using different algorithms. The software has been migrated to almost every computing platform, including personal computers. It runs a daeming process on Unix or a Windows service on Windows. It supports reference clocks and filters and analyses deviations in the same way as remote servers, although they are often asked more frequently.
title: 網路時間協定

source_text: 历史2001年天堑在线在网易免费空间上线，天堑在线是一个软件下载网站，这个网站被认为是cnBeta的前身。2003年6月开始筹备cnBeta，7月20日 网站试运行，8月1日 网站正式投入运营。网站的新闻系统最初基于PHPNuke内容发布程序，自称“国内第一家采用索引方式运作的全中文计算机软硬件资讯站”。2003年，cnBeta与“星秀StarShow”论坛合并。2005年，cnBeta曾试点推出网络杂志《BetaMagazine》，但是因为人手缺乏，又出现稿件荒，准备明显不足，这份杂志只是昙花一现，出了份试刊号就停工了。2005年11月23日，cnBeta表示，与国外同类型站点 WinBeta 确立了友好合作关系，互建内容合作关系，并且WinBeta为CB开设了irc专用通道。2006年，cnBeta在网站里推出总结每周新闻与访客优秀评论的电子期刊《倍速周刊》（前身为张小璐的综述《本周》），后更名为《七日谈》。杂志坚持了大约半年时间，网站改版后首页优秀评论 功能取代了七日谈的评论采集，失去了最有特色的组成部分，《七日谈》也随之停刊。2006年12月，cnBeta传媒组织成立。2007年4月开始，一套新的新闻编辑系统应用到cnBeta，这套系统不再开源，而是由个人承担制作。2007年11月12日，cnBeta推出七日谈：图说七日Alpha1，内容为编辑LonelyJames根据近期网友精彩评论所绘漫画。之后陆续推出数期，并向网友“无奖-{zh-hans:征; zh-hant:徵;}-图”。2010年6月4日，cnBeta部份關閉了新聞評論系統，完全關閉評論的新聞會顯示「評論已關閉」，部份關閉的新聞評論會在回覆後顯示（以前的評論是不須回覆便能顯示的）。
target_text: In 2003, cnBeta joined the StarShow forum, a software download site that was considered to be cnBeta's predecessor. Preparations began for cn Beta, which was piloted on 20 July, and the website was officially launched on 1 August. The news system of the site was initially based on the PHPNuke content release program, which identified itself as “the Chinese-wide computer hardware information station operating in an indexed format.” In 2003, cn Beta merged with the “StarShow” forum. In 2005, cnBeta piloted the web journal, “BetaMagazine”, was launched on a pilot basis; in 2005, the website was launched on a pilot basis; it was launched on a pilot basis on a pilot basis; it was launched on a pilot basis on a pHNuke.
title: CnBeta.COM

source_text:
问题和假设
分布式系统中的节点通信存在两种模型：共享内存（Shared memory）和消息传递（Messages passing）。基于消息传递通信模型的分布式系统，不可避免的会发生以下错误：进程可能会慢、被杀死或者重启，消息可能会延迟、丢失、重复。在最普通的 Paxos 场景中，先不考虑可能出现「消息篡改」（即拜占庭错误的情况）。Paxos 算法解决的问题是在一个可能发生前述異常（即排除消息篡改之外的其他任何異常）的分布式系统中，如何對某個值的看法相同，保证無論發生以上任何异常，都不会破坏决议的共識機制。一个典型的场景是，在一个分布式数据库系统中，如果各节点的初始状态一致，每个节点都执行相同的操作序列，那么他们最后能得到一个一致的状态。为保证每个节点执行相同的命令序列，需要在每一条指令上执行一个「共识算法」以保证每个节点看到的指令一致。一个通用的共识算法可以应用在许多场景中，是分布式计算中的重要问题。因此从20世纪80年代起对于共识算法的研究就没有停止过。
target_text: Questions and hypotheses Node communications in the distributed system have two models: Share memory and message distribution. The following errors are inevitable in the distribution system based on the message transfer model: process may be slow, killed or restarted, information may be delayed, lost or repeated. A typical setting is a distributed database system where, if the initial state of the various nodes is consistent, each node will implement the same sequence of operations (i.e. the Byzantine error), they will end up with a consistent state of affairs. For each node to implement the same order sequence, there is a need to implement a "consensual algorithm" at each direction to ensure that there is no common understanding of the resolution. One typical scenario is a distributed database system in which, if the initial state of the nodes is consistent, each nodes will be able to perform the same sequence of operations.
title: Paxos算法

source_text: 为描述Paxos算法，Lamport虚拟了一个叫做Paxos的希腊城邦，这个岛按照议会民主制的政治模式制订法律，但是没有人愿意将自己的全部时间和精力放在这种事情上。所以无论是议员，议长或者传递纸条的服务员都不能承诺别人需要时一定会出现，也无法承诺批准决议或者传递消息的时间。但是这里假设没有拜占庭将军问题（Byzantine failure，即虽然有可能一个消息被传递了两次，但是绝对不会出现错误的消息）；只要等待足够的时间，消息就会被传到。另外，Paxos岛上的议员是不会反对其他议员提出的决议的。
target_text: To describe the Paxos algorithm, Lamport is a virtual Greek city state called Paxos, which has enacted laws in accordance with the political model of parliamentary democracy, but no one is willing to focus their entire time and effort on such matters. So neither a member of parliament, nor a Speaker, nor a messenger who sends a note, can promise that people will show up when they need it, or that they will approve a resolution or pass a message.
title: Paxos算法

source_text: Multi-PaxosPaxos的典型部署需要一组连续的被接受的值（value），作为应用到一个分布式状态机的一组命令。如果每个命令都通过一个Basic Paxos算法实例来达到一致，会产生大量开销。如果Leader是相对稳定不变的，第1阶段就变得不必要。 这样，系统可以在接下来的Paxos算法实例中，跳过第1阶段，直接使用同样的Leader。
target_text: The typical deployment of Multi-PaxosPaxos requires a continuous set of accepted values (value) as a set of commands to be applied to a distributed state machine. If each command is consistent through an example of a basic Paxos algorithm, substantial costs are incurred. If Leader is relatively stable and constant, stage 1 becomes unnecessary.
title: Paxos算法

source_text:
处理历史
贵屿大约在1995年开始接收电子废物，慢慢吸引了地方农民为处理场堆填该等废料，估计有15万工人在贵屿从事相关工作。每个工人平均每日只有15美元的工资，每日平均工作10小时。处理废物的手法也十分原始。工人通常会对电路板进行加热，以清除表面芯片并接合物，再烧熔电线等物料提炼出铜，并将强酸倒入河岸淋洗芯片，提出内在的金，或扫走打印机墨盒的调色剂。
target_text: The handling of e-waste began around 1995, and local farmers are slowly being attracted to fill up the waste for the disposal yard, with an estimated 150,000 workers working in the area. The average wage per worker is only $15 a day, and the average work time is 10 hours a day. The methods used to treat the waste are also primitive. Workers usually heat circuit boards to remove surface chips and bind them, to extract copper from material such as smelting wires, and to pour acid into the river bank to wash chips, to propose inside gold, or to remove the coloring agent from printer cartridges.
title: 贵屿镇

source_text:
產生方法
一般的做法是對用戶輸入的密碼進行雜湊演算，例如MD5或DES演算法。其中用戶密碼只取前8位以防止過長的密碼使演算法佔用太多時間。然後再於雜湊演算時加入鹽（salt），而鹽是由系統管理員指定或隨機產生的，目的是為了加強加密的隨機性。最後與用戶名合併並顯示出來。
target_text: The method of generation is typically a complex calculation of user-input passwords, such as MD5 or DES algorithms. The user passwords are used only for the top eight to prevent excessive passwords from taking too much time into the algorithms. Then add salt (salt) to the accounting exercise, which is designated or produced randomly by system administrators to enhance the randomness of encryption.
title: Tripcode

source_text: 随着频率的快速提升，功耗就是一个不得不忽视的问题。在上一代的长寿Socket 370插座上，没有任何一款功率高于35W的处理器，而在NetBurst架构下，特别是该架构的最后一款核心Prescott上，功耗动辄上百瓦。这样的情况一方面给个人消费者在选购装配计算机时，为挑选合适的电源和散热系统增添了麻烦，另一方面也为一些计算机集群工作的单位企业增添了额外的能源支出。在同一时期，对手AMD的能耗控制却把握的比较好，也导致了一些Intel的客户开始流失、
target_text: With the rapid increase in frequency, power consumption is a problem that has to be ignored. On the old generation Socket 370 plugs, there is no single handler with a power of more than 35W, while under the NetBurst structure, especially the last core of the structure, Prescott, the power is hundreds of watts. This situation, on the one hand, increases the difficulty of selecting suitable power sources and heat distribution systems for individual consumers when they choose to buy and assemble computers, and, on the other hand, adds additional energy costs for some units working in the computer cluster. During the same period, the energy consumption control of the rival AMD has become more secure, and has also led to the loss of some Intel clients.
title: MoDT

source_text: 由于简谱在中国使用较为广泛，市面上存在的大部分简谱编辑排版软件都是中文界面的软件，它们大多提供“所见即所得”的操作界面。这些软件大都只支援简谱排版，不能进行五线谱和简谱的混合排版，但中有一个插件可以实现简谱与五线谱的混合排版。線上網頁編輯軟體有「簡單有譜」。在GNU LilyPond中，也可以通过一些技术性的手段，排版出简谱样式的乐谱。
target_text: As the spectrum is more widely used in China, most of the spectral editing layouts that exist on the market are Chinese-language interfaces, most of which provide `as-you-go-as-you-go' interfaces. Most of these software support spectral layouts and cannot be combined with spectrals, but there is a plugin in which a mix of spectrals and spectrals can be achieved. The online web editing software has `simple recipes'. In GNU LilyPond, it is also possible to type spectral styles by some technical means.
title: 簡譜

source_text: 日益进步的计算机科学也加快了测试密码的速度。2007年8月，公司发明了使用普通的繪圖卡反向计算密码的技术并开始使用，随后在美国申请了专利。2010年，使用GPGPU使得破解密码的速度提升。2011年，商业产品也宣称他们可以在一台普通的桌上型電腦上使用高階的GPU来每秒测试高达2,800,000,000个密码，这样的设备可以在一天之内破解一个由10个字母组成的密码。並且可以并行在多台计算机上进行处理来提高速度。
target_text: In August 2007, the company developed and started to apply for patents in the United States, using generic graphic card reverse computing codes. In 2010, the use of GPSPU increased the speed of password cracking. In 2011, commercial products also claimed that they could test up to 2,800,000,000 passwords per second using high-level GPUs on a common desktop computer, a device that could decipher a code of 10 letters in one day. And that could be processed in parallel with multiple computers to increase speed.
title: 密码强度

source_text:
保护用户密码
通常，计算机用户被建议“不要在任何地方因任何原因写下密码”或“不要在不同的帐号使用同一个密码”。实际上，一个计算机用户通常有十几个受密码保护的帐号，并使用同一个密码。而那些试图使用不同密码的用户往往由于密码太多，而记不清哪个帐户和哪个密码相对应。2005年的一次安全会议上，来自微软的一个专家提出：“我认为密码策略应改为你可以写下你的密码。我有68个不同的密码，如果我不允许将他们写下来，我将怎么办？我不得不使用同样的密码”。比较好且实际的建议是在一个低安全性的帐号（如bbs）使用简单的密码，在高安全性的程序（例如：網路銀行）使用强密码。
target_text: As a rule, computer users are advised not to write passwords anywhere for any reason or to “do not use the same password in different accounts”. In fact, a computer user usually has more than a dozen password-protected accounts and uses the same password. Those who try to use different passwords often have too many passwords to remember which account corresponds to which password. At a 2005 security meeting, an expert from Microsoft suggested: “I think the password strategy should be you can write your password. I have 68 different passwords. If I do not allow them to write down, what am I going to do? I have to use the same password.” Better and practical advice is to use simple passwords in a less secure account (e.g. bbs) and strong passwords in high-security programs (e.g. Internet banks).
title: 密码强度

source_text: Group Shot是一款由微软研究院推出的图像处理软件。这款软件仍在升级中，最新版本号为1.03。Group Shot的开发目的基于一个常见的事实，即多人的合影照片可能由于其中的一个或几个人闭眼或者表情不够好而不可用。Group Shot可以通过前后多张合影照片而合成出一张“完美”的，事实上却不存在的合影照片。
target_text: Group Short is an image-processing software that was launched by Microsoft Institute. The software is still being upgraded, with the latest version being 1.03. Group Short was developed on the basis of the common fact that multi-person photos may not be available because one or more of them were closed or their faces were not good enough. Group Shot can synthesize a “perfect” picture through multiple photos, but in fact they do not exist.
title: Group Shot

target_text: Pico is one of the three most common text-processing software in the Unix operating system, with text editing, search, spell-checking, document browsing and paragraph alignment features, suitable for the efficient editing of small documents. The extension code for symbol sequences on the source alphabet is obtained by connecting the code string. This is a short example before giving a mathematically accurate definition.

source_text: 前缀代码是具有“前缀属性”的代码：系统中不存在作为集合中任何其他有效代码字的前缀（开始）的有效代码字。霍夫曼编码是最知名的用于导出前缀码的算法。即使代码不是由霍夫曼算法产生的，前缀代码也被广泛称为“霍夫曼代码”。前缀代码的其他示例是国家呼叫代码、ISBN 的国家和出版商部分，以及 UMTS WCDMA 3G 无线标准中使用的辅助同步代码。
target_text: The prefix code is a code with "prefix properties": there are no valid prefix (start) in the system as any other valid code in the collection. The Hoffman code is the most well-known algorithm used to export prefixes. Even if the code is not derived from the Hoffman algorithm, the prefix code is widely referred to as "Hoffman Code". Other examples of prefix codes are the country call code, the ISBN country and publisher section, and the auxiliary synchronization code used in the UMTS WDCMA 3G wireless standard.
title: 代码

技术细节
最初，海盗湾运行在四台Linux服务器的Hypercube开源Web服务器上。2005年6月1日，海盗湾更新了其网站，以减少带宽使用量（据连线网报道，海盗湾的四个网络服务器中，每一个每一毫秒都会收到2个以上的HTTP请求）；同时优化网站前端，创建更加用户友好的用户界面。该网站现在前端运行于Lighttpd和PHP上，数据库后端采用MySQL，两个站内搜索使用，使用Memcached缓存SQL查询和PHP会话，在Lighttpd运行Varnish cache以缓存静态内容。截至2008年9月，Pirate Bay已拥有31个专用服务器，包括9个动态Web前端，一个数据库，两个搜索引擎和八个Tracker服务器。
target_text: Initially, the Pirate Bay operated on four Linux servers, the Hippercube Open Source Web server. On 1 June 2005, the Pirate Bay updated its website to reduce bandwidth usage (as reported by Wirenet, more than two HTTP requests per millisecond for each of the four pirate Bay network servers); while optimizing the front end of the site to create a more user-friendly user interface. The site now operates on Lighttpd and PHP. The site operates at the front end of the database using MySQL, at the back end of the database, for use in two stations, using the Memcached cache SQL query and the PHP session, and operates Varnish cache at Lighttpd to keep quiet. As of September 2008, Pirate Bay had 31 dedicated servers, including nine dynamic Web front end, one database, two search engines and eight Tracker servers.
title: 海盜灣

target_text: On 17 April 2009, the Swedish court in Stockholm sentenced the four founders of the Pirate Bay to one year ' s imprisonment for violation of copyright and a fine of approximately SEK 30 million. On 10 December 2014, the server on the Pirate Bay website was seized by the Swedish police and closed down the site. On 1 February 2015, the Swedish court re-opened the site. In May 2015, the Swedish court ordered the Pirate Bay to hand over its name, Piratebay.se. In early February 2017, the Swedish court issued a ruling ordering local Internet providers to block the Pirate Bay for the next three years. In late June 2017, the EU court ruled that Internet providers had an obligation to restrict access to the Pirate Bay to users at the request of copyright owners. In September 2017, the Dutch Supreme Court ruled that local Internet service providers and, within 10 days, a full-fledged {}-screened pirate Bay website.
title: 海盜灣

source_text: 电机工程学的基础是物理学和数学，这两个基础学科帮助工程师获得电系统工作情况的定量、定性描述。如今，大多数工程学科都涉及计算机的使用，计算机辅助设计在电系统的设计和测试中亦十分普遍。尽管如此，对于工程师来说，拟定最初想法仍然是至关重要的。
target_text: Electrical engineering is based on physics and mathematics, two basic disciplines that help engineers obtain quantitative and qualitative descriptions of how the system works. Most engineering disciplines today deal with the use of computers, and computer-assisted design is common in the design and testing of electrical systems.
title: 電機工程學

source_text: 微电子器件的制造工艺流程需要对硅（在高頻率場合則需要用到砷化镓、磷化铟（indium phosphide）等化合物半导体）晶圆进行物理、化学加工，以使之可以提供理想的電荷傳輸與电流控制（在微电子学中，并非越高越好）。在研究这些制造工艺时，需要许多化学、材料科学方面的知识，而且必须考虑电子在低特征尺寸下的量子力学效应。基础的半导体器件包括二极管、双极性晶体管、金屬氧化物半導體場效電晶體和金属半导体场效应管等。
target_text: The manufacturing process of microelectronics requires the physical and chemical processing of the crystal circle of silicon (in a high-frequency field, the use of compounds such as aluminum arsenic, phosphorus (indium phothide) etc.) so that it can provide the desired charge transfer and electrical flow control (not as high as possible in microelectronics). In studying these manufacturing processes, much chemical and material scientific knowledge is needed, and the quantitative force effect of the electrons under low characteristic sizes must be taken into account. The basic semiconductor units include diodes, bipolar crystal tubes, metal oxide semiconductor crystals and metal semiconductor power tubes.
title: 電機工程學

source_text: 数字信号处理能够在现场可编程逻辑门阵列、特殊應用積體電路、微处理器上获得实现。在许多现代电子系统與電子產品內部都可以找到專具数字信号处理器功能的集成电路，如標準清晰度电视、高清晰度电视、無線電與行動通信器件、高保真音響設備、杜比聲音降躁演算法、全球移动通信系统行動電話、數位音訊播放器、攝影機與數位照相機、汽車控制系統、靜音耳機、數位頻譜分析儀（spectrum analyzer）、智慧火箭導航、雷達、各種各樣的圖像處理、視訊處理（video processing）、語音處理等等。
target_text: Digital signal processing can be done on field-programmable logical door arrays, special applications block circuits, microprocessors. Integrated circuits dedicated to digital signal processor functions can be found in many modern electronic systems and inside electronic products, such as standard clarity television, high-resolution television, radio and mobile communication devices, high-fibre sound system, Dooby voice modem algorithms, global mobile communications system mobile phone calls, digital audio players, cameras and digital cameras, car control systems, silent earphones, digital channel analysers (spectrum alyzer), intelligent rocket navigation, radar, image processing of all kinds, video processing, audio processing, etc.

source_text: 计算机工程主要是指计算机和计算机系统的设计。它包含了计算机硬件、便携式电子产品、超级计算机等的设计。计算机工程还涉及了硬件系统的软件。然而，计算机工程通常不涉及那些与硬件关联较小的应用软件设计，那些部分通常被视为软件工程的范畴。随着计算机工程的发展，特殊應用積體電路和系统芯片等集成电路的集成规模不断提高，功能也不断增强。
target_text: Computer engineering refers mainly to the design of computers and computer systems. It contains the design of computer hardware, portable electronic products, supercomputers, etc. Computer engineering also involves software for hardware systems. However, computer engineering usually does not involve the design of applications that are less related to hardware, which are usually considered to be the scope of software engineering. As computer engineering develops, integrated circuits such as special application blocks and system chips are increasing in size and functionality.
title: 電機工程學

source_text: 集成电路的规模自出现始，就在不断增大。目前，超大规模集成电路的设计、仿真、验证都逐渐得到电子设计自动化工具的支持。设计师现在可以专注于构建电路系统的逻辑功能，而在计算机辅助下完成布线、布局、版图方面的繁琐任务。主流的硬件描述语言（如Verilog和VHDL）的功能使设计人员能够以类似计算机编程的方式来完成复杂硬件电路的设计。计算机工程专业的从业者需要有良好的电子学基础，同时还应该具备一定的计算机操作和程序设计能力。
target_text: The size of integrated circuits has been increasing since their inception. Currently, the design, simulation, and validation of super-large integrated circuits are being supported by electronic design automation tools. Designers can now focus on building the logic of circuit systems and, with computer-assisted wiring, layout, layout.
title: 電機工程學

source_text: Rootkit（也稱隱匿軟件）是指主要為隱藏其他程式进程的軟體，可能是一種或以上軟體的組合；廣義而言，Rootkit也可視為一項技術。今天，Rootkit一词更多指偽裝成驱动程序载入到操作系统内核中的恶意软件，其代码在特权模式运行，能造成意外危险。Rootkit最初用於善意用途，但駭客後來也用Rootkit入侵和攻擊他人的電腦系統，電腦病毒、間諜軟體等也常用Rootkit來隱藏蹤跡，大多數防毒軟體已將Rootkit歸類為有害的惡意軟體。Linux、Windows、Mac OS等作業系統都有機會成為Rootkit的受害目標。
target_text: Rootkit (also known as hidden software) refers to software primarily designed to hide other program processes, which may be a combination of one or more software; generally, Rootkit can also be considered a technique. Today, the term Rootkit refers more to malware that is disguised as a driver that is loaded into the nuclear system of the operating system and whose code runs in privileged mode, creating an unexpected risk. Rootkit is initially used in good faith, but hackers later use Rootkit to invade and attack other computer systems, computer viruses, spy software, etc. Rootkit, and most anti-drug software has classified Rootkit as a harmful malware. Linux, Windows, Mac OS, etc., all have the opportunity to become victims of Rootkit.
title: Rootkit

source_text: 现代操作系统的应用程序不能直接存取硬件，而是调用操作系统提供的接口来使用硬件，操作系统依赖内核空间来管理和调度这些程式。内核空间由进程管理（负责分配Cpu时间）、文件存取（把设备调配成文件系统，并提供一致的接口供上层程序调用）、安全控制（负责强制规定各进程的具体权限和单独的内存范围，避免各进程间起冲突）和内存管理（进程运行时负责分配、使用、释放和回收内存资源）四大部分组成。内核是种数据结构，Rootkit技术修改这些数据结构来隐藏其它程式的进程、文件、网络通讯和其它信息（比如注册表和可能因修改而生成的系统日志等）。例如，修改操作系统的EPROCESS链表结构可达到隐藏进程的效果，挂钩服务调用表可以隐藏文件和目录，挂钩中断描述符表则可监听键盘击键等。Rootkit至今仍然是发展中的技术领域。
target_text: Modern operating system applications do not have direct access to hardware, but call on the interfaces provided by the operating system to use hardware, and the operating system relies on kernel space to manage and schedule these programs. The inner nuclear space is managed by process management (in charge of assigning Cpu time), document access (inputing the equipment into a file system and providing consistent interfaces for upper-level application), security control (in charge of imposing specific rights and separate memory ranges for each process, avoiding conflicts between processes) and memory management (in which the process operates with responsibility for allocating, using, releasing and recovering memory resources). The inner core is a data structure in which the Rootkit technology adapts the data structure to hide the processes of other programs, documents, network communications and other information (e.g. registration forms and system logs that may be generated as a result of modifications), for example, modification of the EPROCES chain structure of the operating system can achieve the effects of hidden processes, linking the service tables can hide files and catalogues, and connecting the description sheets can listen to keyboards, etc.
title: Rootkit

source_text: 被電磁脈衝打击的电器件经受从外沿上的暂时电子破坏直到近中心的过压摧毁。现代半导体器件，特别是基于MOS技术的那些器件（例如商用计算机）由于瞬变高压而最易损坏。地面长线路（例如电传输线）充当電磁脈衝的巨大天线。因此，电源传输网络与通訊网络是极易损坏的。它们很可能被電磁脈衝所摧毁。任何含半导体的电子设备包括机载平台的系统都可能被电磁脉冲关闭或烧毁，除非该系统采用笨重而昂贵的电磁屏蔽、良好设计的滤波器和仔细接地等措施来加以完全保护。核武器空爆产生的电磁脉冲是一种极有效的区域武器。毫无疑问，它将破坏城市基础设施。
target_text: Electrical devices that are hit by an electromagnetic pulse are subject to temporary electronic damage from the outside to near-centre overstretch. Modern semiconductor devices, especially those based on MOS technology (e.g. commercial computers), are the most vulnerable to damage due to instantaneous high voltage. Long ground lines (e.g. electrical transmission lines) act as a huge antenna for electromagnetic impulses. Thus, power transmission networks and communication networks are extremely vulnerable. They are likely to be destroyed by electromagnetic impulses. Any electronic equipment containing semiconductors, including on-board platforms, may be shut down or burned down by electromagnetic pulses, unless the system is fully protected by such measures as thick and expensive electromagnetic shielding, well-designed filters, and carefully connected sites.
title: 电磁脉冲

source_text:
图书馆及计算机资源
南岸大学拥有两座图书馆：分别位于主校园和建筑环境学院内。专业图书馆包括工程、计算机、教育、科学、商业、以及法律图书馆。校内图书馆共有藏书超过300，000册、期刊超过30，000种。该校新建的学习资源中心于1996年投入使用，其先进程度在全英首屈一指，将该校推向了“信息高速公路”的前沿。此学习资源中心有600个工作站，学生可以通过宽带无线网络与外部的数据库、国际互联网或者联合学术网络联网，从中获取信息。
target_text: The University of the South Coast has two libraries: one at the main campus and one at the Academy of the Architectural Environment. Specialized libraries include engineering, computers, education, science, commerce, and law libraries. The library contains more than 300,000 books and more than 30,000 periodicals. The new learning resource centre of the University, which became operational in 1996, is one of the most advanced in the United Kingdom, moving the school to the frontier of the Information Highway.
title: 倫敦南岸大學

source_text: 数据库规范化，又称正规化、标准化，是数据库设计的一系列原理和技术，以减少数据库中数据冗余，增进数据的一致性。关系模型的发明者埃德加·科德最早提出这一概念，并于1970年代初定义了第一范式、第二范式和第三范式的概念，还与Raymond F. Boyce于1974年共同定义了第三范式的改进范式——BC范式。
target_text: Database standardization, also known as formalization, standardization, is a series of rationales and techniques for database design to reduce data redundancy in the database and improve data consistency. The innovator of the relationship model, Edgar Cod, first proposed this concept and defined the first, second and third paradigms in the early 1970s, together with Raymond F. Boyce in 1974 defined the third paradigm of improvement - the BC paradigm.
title: 数据库规范化

source_text: 除外还包括针对多值依赖的第四范式，连接依赖的第五范式、DK范式和第六范式。现在数据库设计最多满足3NF，普遍认为范式过高，虽然具有对数据关系更好的约束性，但也导致数据关系表增加而令数据库IO更易繁忙，原来交由数据库处理的关系约束现更多在数据库使用程序中完成。
target_text: These include, among other things, the fourth paradigm for multiple-value dependency, the fifth paradigm for connecting to the fifth paradigm, the DK paradigm and the sixth paradigm. The database is now designed to meet up to 3NF, and the paradigm is generally considered to be too high and, although it is more binding on data relationships, it also leads to an increase in data relationship tables that makes the database IO more busy, and the relationships that were originally referred to the database are now more complete in the database usage process.
title: 数据库规范化

source_text:
總則及附則
根據公約對「博客」的定義，「是指互联网服务提供者提供给用户的自主网络空间，包括文字、图片、音视频等形态」。就此，所有為網民提供博客服務的供應商，「应当遵循文明守法、诚信自律、自觉维护国家利益和公共利益的原则」。公約的组织实施及解釋權均由中国互联网协会负责，並於公約公布當日起施行。
target_text: In this regard, all providers of blogging services to online users "shall be guided by the principles of civility, integrity, self-discipline, and self-serving national and public interest". The organization of the treaty and its interpretation are the responsibility of the Chinese Internet Association, and will be implemented as soon as the treaty is published.
title: 博客服务自律公约

source_text:
服務協議及實名注冊
在第八条規定，「博客服务提供者应当与博客用户签订服务协议，要求博客用户自觉履行服务协议」，而這一點其實亦是服務供應商在得以簽署公約前的條件之一。至於服務協議的內容，亦在第九條加以規範，必須包括下列內容：
博客用户保证自觉遵守国家有关互联网信息服务的法律、法规，文明使用网络，不传播色情淫秽信息以及其他违法和不良信息；
博客用户保证不传播侮辱或贬损其他民族、种族、不同宗教信仰和文化传统的信息；
博客用户保证不传播造谣、诽谤信息以及其他虚假信息，不传播侵害他人合法权益的信息；
博客用户保证不传播侵害他人知识产权的信息；
博客用户保证对跟贴内容进行有效监督和管理，及时删除违法和不良跟贴信息；
博客用户保证不利用博客传播计算机病毒等恶意程序，不危害他人计算机信息安全。
對於「拒绝签订服务协议的，博客服务提供者有权拒绝为其提供博客服务」。而一旦「博客用户违反服务协议的」，「博客服务提供者应当及时予以督促改正」，甚至「直接删除相关违法和不良信息内容」或「停止为其提供博客服务」。
target_text: As for the content of the service agreement, it must include the following: “Blog users should ensure that they are consciously complying with national laws, regulations, civilized use of Internet information services, and that they do not disseminate pornographic and other illegal and undesirable information; Blog users should ensure that they do not disseminate information that insults or demeans other peoples, races, different religious beliefs and cultural traditions;
title: 博客服务自律公约

source_text:
公约的执行
第三章「倡议」所有博客服务提供者「需签署並实施公约」，「並自觉接受有关政府部门的业务指导」、「自觉接受社会公众的监督」，以「增强自律意识，促进博客服务健康发展」。而作為公約的執行機關中国互联网协会則會定期公布签约单位的名单。而根據第二章第八條有關「与博客用户签订服务协议」的規定，所有未能在公約實施前與用博客用戶簽訂有效服務協議之服務供應商，「应当从本公约发布生效之日起补充签订服务协议」。一旦有服務供應商違反公約，「並造成不良影响的」，中国互联网协会將會「视不同情况给予警示或向社会公布」。
target_text: Under Chapter III of the Initiative, all bloggers' service providers "require to sign and implement the Convention," "under the operational guidance of the relevant government departments" and "under the supervision of the public at large" in order to "enhanced self-regulation and promote the healthy development of blogging services". The Internet Association of China, as a public authority, regularly publishes the list of signatories.
title: 博客服务自律公约

source_text: -{zh-cn:三维计算机图形软件;zh-tw:3D電腦繪圖軟體}-是用于创造三维電腦成像的软件。這類軟體時常用在制作電影和電子遊戲上，而本条目只涵盖部分此類的软件。注意大多数三维软件包还包括针对建筑和高端的专用插件，但上万美元的价格只有制作公司才使用。更大的制作公司通常花费巨额资金制作专用软件以配合这些软件运行。
target_text: - {zh-cn: three-dimensional computer graphics software; zh-tw: three-D computer graphics software} - is a software used to create three-dimensional computer images. This software is often used to produce films and video games, whereas this entry covers only some of these software. Note that most three-dimensional software packages also include dedicated plugins for buildings and high-ends, but the cost of tens of thousands of dollars is only used by producing companies.
title: 三维计算机图形软件

source_text:
文件格式
支持三维图形的文件有很多种类，例如，Wavefront .obj文件和DirectX .x文件。每种文件类型一般都倾向于有自己独特的数据结构。每种文件格式都可以通过它们各自的应用程序来访问，如DirectX文件和Quake。另外，也可以通过第三方独立程序访问文件，或通过手动反编译。
target_text: File formats Documents that support three-dimensional graphics are of many kinds, such as Wavefront.obj files and DirectX.x files. Each file type generally tends to have its own unique data structure. Each file format can be accessed through their own applications, such as DirectX files and Quake. Alternatively, it can be accessed through an independent third-party process or through manual reverse editing.
title: 三维计算机图形软件

source_text: 建模三维建模软件是一类用于制作三维模型的三维计算机图形软件。这类软件的单个程序被称为建模应用程序或建模器。三维建模软件允许用户通过其三维网格创建和改变模型。用户可以增加、减少、拉伸和以其他方式改变网格，以满足他们的愿望。模型可以从不同的角度观察，通常同时展示出来。模型可以旋转，视图可以放大或缩小。
target_text: Modelling three-dimensional modelling software is a three-dimensional computer graphic software used to make three-dimensional models. Individual programs of this type are known as modelling applications or modelling machines. The three-dimensional modelling software allows users to create and change models through their three-dimensional grids. Users can increase, reduce, stretch and otherwise change the grid to meet their wishes. Models can be seen from different angles, usually at the same time. Models can be rotated and views can be scaled up or narrowed.
title: 三维计算机图形软件

source_text: 三维建模软件可以将模型导出到文件中，只要元数据兼容，就可以将其导入其他应用程序。许多建模器允许自定义的和插件，因此它们可以用其他应用程序的原始文件格式读写数据。大多数三维建模器都包含一些相关的功能，如光线追踪器和其他渲染方法以及纹理映射。有些软件还包含支持或允许模型动画的功能。有些可能能够生成一系列渲染场景的全动态视频（即动画）。
target_text: The 3D modeling software allows models to be exported to a file, which can be imported into other applications as long as metadata are compatible. Many modelers allow custom and plugins, so they can read and write data in the original file format of other applications. Most 3D modelers contain related functions, such as a light tracker and other rendering methods, and texture mapping. Some software also contains features that support or allow model animations. Some may generate a full range of dynamic videos (i.e. animations) of rehearsing scenes.
title: 三维计算机图形软件

source_text:
计算机辅助设计(CAD)计算机辅助设计软件可能采用与三维建模软件相同的基本三维建模技术，但其目标不同。它们被用于计算机辅助工程、计算机辅助制造、有限元分析、产品生命周期管理、3D打印和计算机辅助建筑设计。补充性工具
制作完视频后，工作室再使用Adobe Premiere Pro或Final Cut Pro等中级程序，或、、Shake等高端程序来编辑或合成视频。软件通常被用于匹配现场视频和计算机生成的影片，随着摄像机的移动使两者保持同步。
target_text: Computer-assisted design (CAD) computer-assisted design software may use the same basic three-dimensional modelling technology as a three-dimensional modeling software, but it has different objectives. They are used for computer-assisted engineering, computer-assisted manufacturing, limited meta-analysis, product life-cycle management, 3D printing, and computer-assisted architecture design. After making the video, the studio uses intermediate programs such as Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, or high-end programs such as Shake to edit or synthesize the video.
title: 三维计算机图形软件

source_text: 使用实时计算机图形引擎来制作电影作品被称为machinima。开源软件Blender是开源的三维制作及处理软件，使用GNU通用公共许可证，其所提供的动画、建模、渲染和材质能与中高端的三维动画套件相比，如Maya、3ds Max和Cinema 4D。Wings 3D也是开源的，使用GNU通用公共许可证，与Blender相比使用更简单，但功能更少，适合于初学者使用。
target_text: A real-time computer graphic engine is used to produce films called machinima. Open-source software, Blender, is an open-source three-dimensional production and processing software, using GNU general public licences that provide animation, modelling, rendering and material energy compared to medium- and high-end three-dimensional animation packages, such as Maya, 3ds Max and Cinema 4D. Wings 3D is also open-source, using GNU general public licences that are easier to use than Blender, but less functional and suitable for initial scholars.
title: 三维计算机图形软件

source_text: 内存管理单元（，缩写为MMU），有时称作分页内存管理单元（，缩写为PMMU）。它是一种负责处理中央处理器（CPU）的内存访问请求的计算机硬件。它的功能包括虚拟地址到物理地址的转换（即虚拟内存管理）、内存保护、中央处理器高速缓存的控制，在较为简单的计算机体系结构中，負責总线的仲裁以及存储体切换（，尤其是在8位的系统上）。
target_text: Memory management module (MMU, acronym), sometimes referred to as page-by-page memory management module (PMMU, acronym). It is a computer hardware that handles memory access requests from the central processor (CPU). Its functions include the conversion of virtual to physical addresses (i.e. virtual memory management), memory protection, control of high-speed caches by central processors, and, in a simpler computer architecture, the arbitration of the bus and the transfer of storage (especially on 8-digit systems).
title: 内存管理单元

source_text: 有时，TLB或PTE会禁止对虚拟页的访问，这可能是因为没有物理随机存取存储器（）与虚拟页相关联。如果是这种情况，MMU将向CPU发出页错误（）的信号。操作系统(）将进行处理，也许会尝试寻找RAM的空白帧，同时建立一个新的PTE将之映射到所请求的虚拟地址。如果没有空闲的RAM，可能必须关闭一个已经存在的页面，使用一些替换算法，将之保存到磁盘中（这被称之为页面调度（）。在一些MMU中，PTEs或者TLB也存在一些缺点，在这样的情况下操作系统将必须释放空间以供新的映射。
target_text: In some cases, TLB or PTE would prohibit access to virtual pages, possibly because there is no physical random access memory () associated with virtual pages. If this is the case, MMU would send a signal of page error () to CPU. The operating system () would handle it and perhaps try to find a blank frame for RAM, while creating a new PTE map to the requested virtual address. In the absence of free RAM, it might be necessary to close an already existing page and use some replacement algorithms to save it on diskettes (referred to as page schedule). In some MMUs, PTEs or TLB also have some shortcomings, and in such cases the operating system would have to release space for a new map.
title: 内存管理单元

source_text:
益处
有些情况下，软件自身的错误可以引发页错误，这时内存管理单元可以检测到页错误，然后通知操作系统终止出错的程序。通常来说, 操作系统会为每个程序分配虚拟内存地址，而不会让程序直接访问物理内存。这种内存保护特性可以避免某个程序非法访问其他程序的虚拟内存空间。
target_text: In some cases, an error in the software itself triggers a page error, in which case the memory management module detects a page error and then informs the operating system that the error is terminated. Normally, the operating system assigns a virtual memory address to each program without giving the program direct access to physical memory. This memory protection feature avoids a program from illegally accessing the virtual memory space of other programs.
title: 内存管理单元

source_text: 1990年，中国首次为别国进行卫星商业发射，为美国休斯公司发射了亚洲一号卫星。张庆伟发挥其在计算机、英语方面的优势，在计算机上建立数学模型，并实施仿真，圆满完成了卫星入轨精度的控制工作，一举崭露头角。之后，张庆伟在长二捆火箭研发中，以同样的方法先后负责助推器分离过程分析和卫星整流罩平推分离试验两项攻关项目，均获得成功。因为其杰出贡献，张庆伟先后被提拔为高级工程师和主任设计师等职。1992年，张庆伟被派往日本国际空间大学进修半年。回国后，被任命为长二F火箭（航空航天部一院一部921工程）的副总设计师。
target_text: In 1990, China launched for the first time a commercial satellite launch for another country, launching the Asian-1 satellite for the United States company Hughes. Zhang Qingwei was promoted to the post of Senior Engineer and Director Designer for his outstanding contribution. In 1992, Zhang Qing Wei was sent to Japan’s International Space University for six months of training.
title: 张庆伟

source_text: 在多任务环境下，磁盘碎片的出现根本是不可避免的，而且碎片化的速度非常之快。操作系统的任务不是不负责任地给用户提供一个整理工具，而是应该在系统设计的时候消除碎片化对性能的伤害。比如Linux的块设备操作都要经过一个I/O调度层，通过在调度层中使用带有电梯算法的调度策略来消除碎片对性能的影响。
target_text: The task of the operating system is not to provide users with a sorting tool irresponsibly, but rather to eliminate the damage to performance caused by fragmentation when designing the system. For example, Linux's piece of equipment is operated through an I/O dispatch level to eliminate the impact of debris on performance by using a dispatch strategy with elevator algorithms in the dispatch level.
title: Ext3

source_text:
早期经历
乔伊的童年是在密歇根州的乡村长大的，在密歇根大学获得电气工程学士学位之后，于1979年在加州大学伯克利分校获得电气工程与计算机科学硕士学位。学生期间，他开发了BSD操作系统。其他人以BSD为基础发展出了很多现代版本的BSD，最著名的有FreeBSD、OpenBSD和NetBSD，苹果电脑的Mac OS X操作系统也在很大程度上基于BSD。1986年，乔伊因他在BSD操作系统中所做的工作获得了Grace Murray Hopper奖。
target_text: When he was a student, he developed the BSD operating system. Others developed a number of modern versions of BSD based on BSD, the most famous of which are FreeBSD, OpenBSD and NetBSD, Mac OS X operating system for Apple computers, also based to a large extent on BSD. In 1986, Joey won the Grace Murray Hope Award for his work in the BSD operating system.
title: 比尔·乔伊

source_text:
除了BSD之外，他引人注目的贡献还包括TCP/IP、vi、NFS和C shell，如今这些软件都已经广泛的使用在Solaris、BSD、GNU/Linux等操作系统中，而且开放源代码给其他人无偿使用、改进，为自由软件的发展作出了极大的贡献。Sun
1982年，Joy作为联合创始人和首席科学家参与了Sun微系统公司的成立，设计了Sparc微处理器，并将之前自己领导开发的BSD继续发展成为Solaris操作系统。另外，他还是Java和Jini的主要作者之一。
target_text: In addition to the BSD, his notable contributions include TCP/IP, vi, NFS, and C shell, which are now widely used in operating systems such as Solaris, BSD, GNU/Linux, and open source codes to others for free use and improvement, making a significant contribution to the development of free software. Sun, in 1982, Joy participated as a co-founder and chief scientist in the establishment of Sun Microsystems, designing the Sparc microprocessor and continuing to develop the BSD that he had previously developed as Solaris. He was also one of the leading authors of Java and Jini.
title: 比尔·乔伊

source_text: 达灵顿晶体管（），或称达灵顿对（）是电子学中由两个（甚至多个）双极性晶体管（或者其他类似的集成电路或分立元件）组成的复合结构，通过这样的结构，经第一个双极性晶体管放大的电流可以进一步被放大。这样的结构可以提供一个比其中任意一个双极性晶体管高得多的电流增益。在使用集成电流芯片的情况里，达灵顿晶体管可以使得芯片比使用两个分立晶体管元件占用更少的空间，因为两个晶体管可以共用一个集电极。达灵顿晶体管通常被封装在单一的芯片里，从外面看就像一个双极性晶体管。有时，集成电路芯片中会包含8个这样的结构方便使用。
target_text: The current magnified by the first bipolar transistor () can be further magnified by a complex structure in electronics consisting of two (or even more) bipolar transistors (or other similar integrated circuits or sub-components). Such a structure can provide a much higher current gain than any of the two bipolar transistors. In the case of integrated flow chips, the Dallington transistor can take less space than the use of two split transistors because two transistors can share one central electrode. The Dallington transistor is usually enclosed in a single chip, seen from the outside as a bipolar transistor. In some cases, the integrated circuit chips contain eight such structures for ease of use.
title: 达灵顿晶体管

source_text: 达灵顿晶体管常把两个分立的晶体管做成集成芯片的形式。在上图中，左边的晶体管Q1可以是低功率类型的，右边的Q2则需要高功率类型的。整个达灵顿结构的最大集电极电流IC(max)大约等于Q2的集电极电流。2N6282是一种典型的达灵顿结构集成芯片，内部包含了一个上文提到过的关断电阻，在IC等于10安培时具有2400的电流增益。
target_text: In the above figure, the transistor Q1 on the left can be a low-power type, while the Q2 on the right requires a high-power type. The largest CAD (max) in the entire Dallington structure is approximately equal to the C2 on the Q2. The N6282 is a typical Dallington structural integration chip that contains a decomposition barrier mentioned above, with an electric current gain of 2400 when IC is equivalent to 10 amperes.
title: 达灵顿晶体管

source_text:
第三代
2009年9月9日，苹果公司再次更新了iPod touch系列产品（2009年9月24日）。苹果仍然保留旧版的8G，未提供升级，但价格下降为199美元。同时将原先的16G和32G款式容量翻倍，价格维持不变。新款的touch将CPU提升为600Mhz，苹果宣称提升了50%的速度，并引入了OpenGL2.0。同时拆解显示其内置芯片支持FM与802.11n，只是苹果并未提供软件支持（类似旧款的蓝牙）。新款touch通过随机的带线控麦克风提供了语音控制与语音备忘录功能，同时这个麦克风也使得iPod touch可以使用skype等网络电话程序。在发布前网络上盛传新款将会带有摄像头功能，但发布会显示只有新款的nano具备了摄像头，但是有许多证据表明新款touch在设计时曾经加入摄像头并在后期取消。
target_text: The new touch raised the CPU to 600Mhz, with apples claiming a 50% speed increase and introduced OpenGL 2.0. At the same time, they deactivated their built-in chips to support FM and 802.11n, but apples did not provide software support (like the old bluetooth). The new touch provides voice control and voice memorandum functions through random wired microphones, while the microphone allows iPods touch to use network phone programs such as skype. The new tweets on the web before release would have a camera function, but the release would show that only the new Nano had a camera, but there was plenty of evidence that the new toouch had been added to the camera and cancelled at a later stage.
title: IPod touch

source_text: 在计算机科学中，扩充巴科斯-瑙尔范式（ABNF）是一种基于巴科斯-瑙尔范式（BNF）的元语言，但它有自己的语法和派生规则。ABNF的目的是提供一种用于描述双向通信协议的语言的形式系统。它是由第68号互联网标准 （"STD 68"，大小写样式按照原文）定义的，也就是RFC 5234，经常用于互联网工程任务组（IETF）通信协议的定义语言。
target_text: In computer science, the expansion of the Barcos-Nauer paradigm (ABNF) is a meta-language based on the Barcos-Nauer paradigm (BNF), but it has its own syntax and derivative rules. The aim of ABNF is to provide a formal system for describing the language of the two-way communication protocol. It is defined by Internet Standard 68 ("STD 68" with case styles in the original language), that is, RFC 5234, which is often used in the definition language of the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) communications protocol.
title: 扩充巴科斯范式

target_text: The RAW format, while providing more complete photographic information than the traditional format, such as JPEG, is not a single defined graphic format standard, so that every camera manufacturer can obtain its own standards for adapting the RAW format, e.g., good ownership of its own CRW, Nicon has NEF, which are broadly RAW, but not identical to each other, and in the worst case, only the camera vendor ' s own software can be opened up and converted into the previous graphic format, such as JPEG, and then export to some graphic processing software, such as PhotoShop, for example, for later leaching.

source_text: 不久之後，東尼被精神失衡的前情人凱西·戴爾 (Kathy Dare) 嚴重傷害。她在射中了他的軀幹中心，傷了他的脊椎，使他癱瘓。東尼接受了特殊手術，將神經芯片植入脊柱以恢復活動能力。但他不知道，神經芯片是一種秘密手段，通過它可以使人控制自己的身體。競爭對手馬爾斯雙胞胎(Marrs Twins)和他們的夥伴在後來被稱為“裝甲戰爭II”的陰謀中落後。在迪威特幾次測試操縱東尼成功後，東尼發現使用他的Encephalo Armor可以抵消迪威特的控制。作為回應，迪威特突然放棄了神經芯片的控制權，導致東尼的身體痛苦不堪。持續對抗這樣的痛苦導致東尼的身體受到巨大的神經損傷。東尼的神經系統繼續衰竭，他構建了一個由人工神經迴路組成的“皮膚”來輔助它。東尼開始駕駛並遙控鋼鐵人盔甲，但在面對沉默大師 (Masters of Silence) 時，遠程遙控鋼鐵人裝甲被證明不足對抗強大的敵人。東尼設計了一套更為全副武裝的新盔甲，即“可變威脅反應戰鬥服” (Variable Threat Response Battle Suit) 。最終，神經系統的損害對他變得過於龐大。東尼假裝死亡，他將自己置於假死狀態，羅德斯接管了斯塔克企業的運作和鋼鐵人的身分，儘管他使用了戰爭機器裝甲。東尼最終通過使用芯片創建一個全新的（人工）神經系統完全康復，並在新的裝甲中恢復為鋼鐵人。

source_text:
密度矩陣重整化群 (Density Matrix Renormalization Group)，簡稱DMRG，是一種數值演算法，於西元1992年由美國物理學家史提芬·懷特提出。
密度矩陣重整化群是用來計算量子多體系統（例如：Hubbard model、t-J模型、海森堡模型，等等）的一個非常精準的數值演算法，在一維或準一維的系統可以得到系統尺寸很大且很準確的計算結果，但是在二維的量子多體系統中卻很難達到所需要的精確度。目前此演算法仍無法計算三維的量子系統。
target_text: The density matrix is a very precise numeric algorithm used to calculate the quantum subsystems (e.g., Hubbard model, t-J model, Heisenberg model, etc.), which allows a system-sized and accurate calculation in one-dimensional or one-dimensional systems, but in two-dimensional quantum multibody systems it is difficult to achieve the required precision.
title: 密度矩陣重整化群

source_text:
一般的情況下，Lanczos 演算法需要一個初始的隨機向量。通過若干次迭代後，該向量收斂到基態。這說明算法的計算速度跟向量迭代到基態的次數有關。顯然，如果能找出一個跟基態非常接近的向量做初始的隨機向量，Lanczos 演算法的效率必然大大提高。史提芬·懷特在西元1996年提出：透過波函數轉換可將目前這次計算得到的基態，作為下一次Lanczos 演算法的初始向量。如此一來便加速對角化超塊的哈密頓算符所花的時間。
Lanczos 演算法中需要做被對角化矩陣和向量的乘積計算。該被對角化的矩陣往往非常大，直接列出該矩陣和做矩陣向量乘積會嚴重降低Lanczos 演算法效率。當該被對角化矩陣可以拆分為幾個小矩陣的直積之和時（DMRG所計算的格點系統往往有這種性質），可以無需直接寫出該矩陣而完成整個Lanczos 演算法。
在有對稱性的系統中有一些守恆的量子數，例如海森堡模型中的總自旋及其軸份量。若是已知基態的量子數則可針對系統的希爾伯特空間特定的量子數的子空間進行對角化。
如缺少上述的一些計算手段，DMRG可能難以完成對實際物理模型的演算。
target_text: In general, Lanczos algorithms require an initial random vector. After a number of alternations, the vector is captured to the base. This is the calculation speed associated with the next Lanczos algorithm. Clearly, if one can find a path very close to the base to the base, the efficiency of Lanczos algorithms will be greatly enhanced. Stephen White in 1996 suggested that the conversion of the wave function to the base of the current calculation, as the initial movement of the next Lanczos algorithm, would accelerate the amount of time spent on the capricious Hammington calculators. Lanczos algorithms would need to be extrapolated by the corner matrix and the vector of the vectors.
title: 密度矩陣重整化群

source_text: 另一方面，對於固定的常數，有高效算法判定交叉數是否小於。換言之，交叉數問題是的。但若不是常數，而是與輸入大小有關的函數，例如，則問題仍然很難。對於度數有界的圖，有高效的近似算法能夠近似計算交叉數。實務上，常使用啟發式算法，例如從空圖開始，逐條邊加入，使得每次產生的交叉數儘可能小。直線交叉數分布式计算計劃（Rectilinear Crossing Number project）使用了此類算法。
target_text: On the other hand, for fixed constants, there are efficient algorithms to determine whether cross-counts are smaller or not. In other words, cross-counting is a problem. But if it is not a constant, it is a function related to input size, for example, it is still difficult. For scale maps, there are efficient approximation algorithms that can approximate cross-counting. In practice, an enabling algorithm is often used, for example, starting with a sky map, to insert a paragraph by side, making the number of cross-counts generated at a time as small as possible. The straight-line cross-digital distribution scheme (Recticlinear Crossing Number project) uses this kind of calculation.
title: 交叉數

非线性编辑的优势
非线性编辑是相对传统上以时间顺序进行线性编辑而言，非线性剪辑提供了更灵活的影片编辑方式和简单项目管理等诸多的优点，特别是理论上素材质量不会损失的优点受到欢迎。另外，非线性编辑借助计算机来进行数字化制作，几乎所有的工作都在计算机里完成，不再需要那么多的外部设备，对素材的调用也是瞬间实现，不用反反复复在磁带上寻找，突破单一的时间顺序编辑限制，可以按各种顺序排列，具有快捷简便、随机的特性。
target_text: The advantage of non-linear editing is that non-linear editing offers many advantages, such as more flexible video editing and simple project management, relative to the traditional linear editing in chronological order, and is particularly welcome, especially since the theoretical quality of the material is not lost. In addition, non-linear editing uses computers to digitalize, almost all of the work is done in computers, so much external equipment is no longer needed, the call for the material is instantaneous, without back-to-back searches on the tape, breaking a single time-series editing limit, and can be arranged in a variety of order, with quick, easy and random features.
title: 非線性剪輯

source_text: 专业的编辑软件将剪接师的选择记录为“”，并能与其它编辑软件互换。能保存许多由原始素材文件产生的修改与变化，而不需要储存许多个複本，允许更灵活的编辑。它能通过改变编辑决定列表而改变切口和撤消前一步决定（不需要复制真实的影片数据）。当用上不同特效的时候，也不用担心因为重复编码而产生的画质损失。通过编辑决定列表，剪接师还可以在低分辨率的视频複本上工作。这使在普通个人计算机上快速剪接广播级或高清级的视频成为可能，即使计算机没有足够的能力实时处理如此高质量的高清数据。
target_text: Professional editing software records the selection of clippers as " and can be exchanged with other editing software. It saves many changes and changes from raw material files, without the need to store many duplicates and allows for more flexible editing. It changes the incision by changing the list of editorial decisions and undoes the previous step (there is no need to duplicate real video data). When using different effects, it does not have to worry about loss of graphic quality due to duplicate coding. By editing the decision list, the clipper can also work on low-resolution video copyings. This makes it possible to quickly cut broadcast- or high-cleaning-level videos on a normal personal computer, even if the computer does not have sufficient capacity to process such high-quality, high-quality, high-quality data in real time.

source_text: DOSBox是一款自由开源的模拟器，用于运行适用MS-DOS兼容操作系统的软件（主要是电子游戏）。它的最初版本于2002年发布。DOSBox支援许多IBM PC兼容的显卡和声卡，为原生的DOS程序提供执行环境，使这些程序可以正常运行于大多数现代计算机上的不同操作系统。DOSBox主要以C++编写，是以GNU通用公共许可证许可发布的自由软件。
target_text: DOSBox is a free-source simulator used to run software for MS-DOS compatible operating systems (primarily video games). Its original version was released in 2002. DOSBox supports many IBM PC-compatible graphics and sound cards to provide the implementation environment for the original DOS programs so that they can function properly on the different operating systems of most modern computers. DOSBox is mainly written in C++ and is a free software licensed by GNU General Public Licence.
title: DOSBox

source_text: DOSBox所运行的MS-DOS软件通常不能在现代计算机上直接运行，它们通常与现代的主流硬件和操作系统不兼容。DOSBox在模拟MS-DOS同时，还增加了一些可用特性，包括虚拟磁盘、点对点网络、對模拟畫面截图和录像。有些非官方的DOSBox变体，如DOSBox SVN Daum和DOSBox-X提供了更多的功能，比如即时存档、长文件名、中日韩语言支持等。有些遊戲開發商重新發行早期的DOS遊戲時，也會使用DOSBox，使其可以在现代计算机上运行。
target_text: The MS-DOS software run by DOSBox is usually not directly operational on modern computers, and they are often incompatible with modern mainstream hardware and operating systems. DOSBox simulates MS-DOS by adding a number of usable features, including virtual disks, point-to-point networks, screenshots of simulations and videos. Some unofficial DOSBox variants, such as DOSBox SVN Daum and DOSBox-X, provide additional functions, such as instant archiving, long file names, and Chinese-Japanese language support.
title: DOSBox

source_text: APC所有的UPS都同时提供了W和VA两种數值。当UPS厂家指出了额定W值，而没有标出功率因素和额定VA值，用户可以假定这是在功率因素为1时，W=VA，而实际上厂家指的是UPS额定VA值。实际对计算机负载W值为该标出值的60－70％，所以一个额定值为100W的UPS能驱动一个100W的灯泡，但只能驱动一个65W的计算机。
target_text: All UPS in APC provide both W and VA values. When UPS manufacturers indicate a rated W value, but do not identify a power factor and a rated VA value, users can assume that this is a power factor of 1, W=VA, whereas the manufacturer actually refers to a UPS rated VA value. The actual load W value for computers is 60-70% of that value, so a UPS with a rating of 100W drives a 100W light bulb, but only a 65-W computer.
title: 热设计功耗

source_text: 据英国广播公司报道，维基扫描器发现一些维基百科的编辑是使用迪堡公司、民主党国会竞选委员会和梵蒂冈的计算机做的。《泰晤士报》则报道，英国广播公司自己的一个互联网地址编辑了维基百科。英国广播公司在其部落格中承认了这个编辑，其中说：“一些例子的确不光彩。但是与这些不光彩相对的是许多许多没有异议的编辑。在这些编辑中，英国广播公司的人出于好意，添加了信息或者更改了细节。”

用户/节点（Peer），I2P网络中的其他计算机。I2P网络中的每台计算机都会共享带宽对拆分后加密的数据包进行路由及中转。隧道
每10分钟，用户的I2P路由就会与新的节点建立连接，将本机数据包与其他I2P节点中转的数据包一并通过这些隧道中转传递，令数据包最终到达最终的#目标。
target_text: Users/nodes Users/nodes (Peer), other computers in the I2P network. Each computer in the I2P network shares bandwidth for the routeing and transiting of split encrypted data packages. Every 10 minutes, the I2P route of the tunnel connects the user to the new node, and transmits the machine data package together with other I2P nodes and via these tunnels to the final # target.
title: I2P

source_text:
界面的标准
连接分机到PBX的介面包括：
POTS（简易老式电话系统）- 大部分家用的類比两线界面，实用、便宜，一般的标准類比电话都可以连接成为分机。也有用戶交換機專用的類比電話機，主要特徵是有轉接鍵、有避免回鈴的掛鉤延遲功能，甚至可以有類似專用話機的特殊功能鍵。
专用的- 生产商定义的协议，用戶交換機只能连接到生产商的设备上，好处是信息显示可见度更高，并且有更多特殊功能的选择，缺點是相容性差，電話機不能使用於其它用戶交換機。
DECT - 无绳电话的连接的一个标准。
网络协议- 如H.323、SIP。
连接PBX之间的界面包括：
专用协议 - 如果同时有几个不同厂家的PBX在使用，就需要使用标准协议。
QSIG - 是PBX内部之间的连接，通常使用T1或者E1实线电路。
DPNSS - 用来连接PBX和主干线，由英国电信制定，通常使用E1实线电路。
网络协议- 如H.323,SIP和IAX协议是以IP为基础的声音和视频的呼叫的方法。

The interface between the PBX and the other type-specific phone sets includes: A special protocol - if there are several different manufacturers using the PBX, the standard protocol is used. QSIG - is not an internal PBX connection, a standard IP1 or an EX1 feeder.

target_text: The development team for the shadow system came from mainland China, but, since Chinese users did not have the habit of buying the original version, piracy, and sharing software was so bad that the software they initially developed was available to foreign markets and did not have a Chinese version. After a while, the software gradually became visible in the user community, and China began to use it, but many people mistakenly assumed that it was a software developed by a non-China team.
title: 影子系统

source_text:
生物识别护照
2006年8月14日，美国国务院开始签发生物识别护照，它内置了一块射频识别（RFID）芯片，该芯片可存储护照持有人的相关个人信息（姓名、出生日期等）以及一张持有人的数码照片。芯片还保留了空间来存储一些额外的数据（例如指纹、虹膜扫描纪录）。
target_text: On August 14, 2006, the U.S. Department of State began issuing a biometric passport, which contains a radio frequency recognition (RFID) chip that stores the relevant personal information of the passport holder (name, date of birth, etc.) as well as a digital photograph of the holder. The chip also retains space to store some additional data (e.g. fingerprints, iris scanning records).
title: 美国护照

source_text: 芯片数据可以由阅读器扫描读出，这有助于加快入境处理进程。但是因为芯片无须插入阅读器也可以被读出数据，芯片数据可能被非法读取，这引起了对隐私的担心。类似收费公路上付费时使用的芯片，护照芯片可在接近阅读器时被读取。这一特性使得秘密读取芯片成为可能，例如政府可以藉此追踪个人行踪或是辨别一起罪案中的疑犯。
target_text: Chip data can be scanned by readers, which helps to speed up the process of entering the country. But because chips can also be read without having to be inserted into readers, chip data may be read illegally, raising privacy concerns. Like chips used on toll roads, passport chips can be read when approaching readers. This feature makes it possible to read chips in secret, for example, by which governments can track individuals or identify suspects in a crime.
title: 美国护照

source_text: 虽然护照的封面有特别保护，封面合上时数据读取变得很困难，而且芯片有接入控制和加密机制，但是当护照打开时这些特性都会失效，例如当护照放在旅馆、银行或者是一间网络咖啡屋使用的时候。国务院声称截至2006年底，所有新签发的常规护照将包括这种芯片，但实际上是自2007年8月起实行的。所有签发的非电子常规护照有效期均至2017年8月1日。2017年8月1日起，所有出境旅行均只承认电子护照。
target_text: Although the cover of the passport is specially protected, data access becomes difficult when the cover is closed, and the chip has access control and encryption mechanisms, these features will expire when the passport is opened, for example when the passport is in a hotel, bank, or an Internet café. The State Department claims that by the end of 2006, all new regular passports will include the chip, but have been in effect since August 2007. All non-electronic regular passports issued are valid until 1 August 2017.
title: 美国护照

source_text:
21版护照
美国国务院已宣布将于2021年3月起开始签发下一代护照。新版护照将在信息页上嵌入一个由聚碳酸酯涂层保护的数据芯片；这将有助于防止护照被弄湿和弯曲，此外，新版护照也增加了防盗功能，如果护照被盗，其内置芯片将防止小偷窃取个人信息和伪造身份。护照号码也将被激光切割成穿孔，通过页面逐渐变小。此外还包括其他一系列安全措施和艺术设计升级。
target_text: 21 versions of passports have been announced by the U.S. Department of State to begin issuing the next generation of passports in March 2021. The new version will embed a Pcarbonate coating-protected data chip on the information page; this will help to prevent the passport from getting wet and bent. In addition, the new version of passports will add anti-piracy features, and if the passport is stolen, its built-in chip will prevent petty theft of personal information and falsification of identity.
title: 美国护照

source_text:
美国生物识别护照
美国版的生物识别护照（也被称为“电子护照”）只在非接触式芯片中保有数字图片，这增加了安全级别，但还不如欧洲版本的复杂。但是，美国护照使用的芯片足够大（64KB）以便容纳政府将来可能要求新增的生物识别个人信息。美国国务院在2006年早期发放生物识别护照给政府官员和外交官，并在2006年8月14日于科罗拉多护照办事处发放普通生物识别护照。
target_text: US biometric passports (also known as “electronic passports”) contain digital images only in non-contact chips, which increases security levels but is less complicated than in the European version. However, US passports are sufficiently large (64KB) to accommodate additional biometric personal information that the government may require in the future.
title: 美国护照

source_text: 埃里克·马斯金（，），美国经济学家，曾任麻省理工學院和哈佛大學經濟學教授。2007年，埃里克·马斯金与里奥尼德·赫维克兹、罗杰·梅尔森因“机制设计理论”而获得诺贝尔经济学奖。此外，他的研究领域还包括软件专利。他认为软件是一种创新趋势连续性市场，软件开发者的工作要以前一个版本为基础。在这样一个市场上专利就如一堵墙，抑制创新而非刺激创新。
target_text: Eric Muskin (), an American economist, was a professor of economics at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Harvard University. In 2007, Eric Muskin received a Nobel Prize for Economics for “theory of the design of mechanisms.” Roger Melsen also studied software patents. Software is a continuous market for innovation, and software developers’ work is based on a previous version. source_text:
软件开发领域
在软件开发领域，一项绿地工程可能是在全新的环境内开发一个新系统，不需要考虑与其他系统，尤其是与老旧系统（）的集成问题。通常认为此类系统风险更高，因其经常是为新设施，新客户准备的，甚至连所有者都是新的。因此，敏捷软件开发常被认为是最好的开发手段，它主张通过开发具有完整功能的一小部分，并快速交付给外部或者内部客户并取得即时反馈来规避这些风险。
target_text: In the area of software development, a greenfield project may be the development of a new system in a completely new environment, without the need to consider integration with other systems, in particular with older systems (). Such systems are generally considered to be more risky, as they are often prepared for new facilities, new customers, and even owners. Thus, agile software development is often considered the best means of development, advocating the avoidance of these risks by developing a small fraction of the full functionality that is quickly delivered to external or in-house clients and obtaining immediate feedback.
title: 绿地工程

source_text: Apple II Plus有48KB内存，可借由能安装在第0槽的语言卡扩充至64KB。苹果所采用的6502微处理器支持最大64KB内存，而含有48KB内存的机器已达到此上限－因为包含另外的16KB只读内存（ROM）和I/O位址。因此，语言卡中的扩充内存可暂时“盖过”内置的ROM，并将代码读入该段内存，以使用ROM相同的方式使用它。借此，用户可将Integer BASIC从磁盘读入语言卡内存中，并使用DOS 3.3的INT和FP指令切换使用Integer BASIC或Applesoft BASIC“方言”，如同切换ROM扩充卡一般。若要使用苹果公司几乎于同一时间推出的两种编程语言－UCSD Pascal与FORTRAN 77编译器，语言卡也是必备配备。这些软件需在叫做UCSD-P系统的非DOS系统下运行，它有自己的磁盘格式，并包含一“虚拟机器”使其可以在多种不同硬件上运行。

Therefore, the extended memory in the language card can be temporarily “covered” by ROM, and the code can be read into this section to use it in the same way as the ROM. In this way, the user can read Integer BASIC from the disk into the memory of the language card and use the DOS 3.3 INT and the FP Directive to switch to the use of Integer BASIC or Applesof BASIC's “s” dialects, as in the case of the conversion of the GM's extended card, so that it can run its own two programming languages — UCSD Pascal — in the same way as the FORTRAN 77.

As to lower-case input, there is a “width Shift key modification” that is required to replace the Shift key because it is not possible to detect whether or not it is pressed.

source_text: 异质-{}-结（heterojunction）又称异质接-{}-面，是一种半导体的特殊pn結，由两层以上不同的半导体材料薄膜依次沉积在同一基座上形成，这些材料具有不同的能带隙，它们可以是砷化镓之类的化合物，也可以是硅-锗之类的半导体合金。半导体异质结构（heterostructure）的二极管特性非常接近理想二极管。另外，通过调节半导体各材料层的厚度和能带隙，可以改变二极管电流与电压的响应参数。半导体异质结构对半导体技术具有重大影响，是高频晶体管和光电子元件的关键成分。
target_text: Hexagen-{}-yungryunction, also known as heterojunction, is a semiconductor special pn knot, which is formed from two or more layers of semiconductor material, the films of which are in turn deposited on the same base, with different energy bands, which can be compounds such as arsenic, or semiconductor alloys such as silicon-silicon. The diode properties of the semiconductor heterostructure are very close to the ideal diode. In addition, by regulating the thickness and energy band gaps of the semiconductor material layers, it is possible to alter the response parameters of the diode currents and voltage. The semiconductor hemometric structures have a significant impact on semiconductor technology and are key components of the high frequency transist tubes and optical electronics.
title: 异质结

source_text: 异质结是两种不同半导体区域之间的接触面。不同于同质结，组成异质结的这些半导体的材料具有不同的带隙。在许多固态设备应用，如半导体激光器，太阳能电池和晶体管中，异质结通常有利于设计电子能带。尽管异质结和异质结构通常互换使用，但严格意义上在一个设备中将多个异质结合在一起的组合才能称为异质结构。由于要求每种半导体材料都具有不等带隙的要求不是非常严格，尤其是在小长度范围电子特性取决于空间特性。因此，一种更现代的定义是，异质结是任何两种固态材料之间的接触面，这些材料可以是金属，绝缘体，快速离子导体（fast ion conductor）和半导体材料的结晶和无定形结构。
target_text: In many solid-state equipment applications, such as semiconductor lasers, solar cells, and transistors, heterotyring is usually conducive to the design of electronic bands. Although heterolytic knots and heterostructures are commonly used interchangeably, combinations of multiple heterochemicals in a single device are called heterostructures. Since the requirement that each semiconductor material have varying margins is not very strict, especially in a small length range, depending on spatial properties. A more modern definition is therefore that heterotyring is the contact face between any of the two solid materials, which can be metal, insulated, fast ionconductor and semiconductor material.
title: 异质结

source_text:
第二次产业结构调整：进军通讯行业
20世纪60年代中后期，鲜京集团为了分散在能源、化工领域大规模投资的产业风险，经过反复研究论证将当时人们还很陌生的通讯行业定为21世纪重点发展产业。为进军通信产业，鲜京在1986年10月设立了美国当地法人。1988年，鲜京在世界率先推出手机业务服务，1994年6月收购韩国通讯后，一举成为韩国最大的通讯网络商。鲜京缔造了韩国第一代模拟移动通信的时代，开启了韩国移动通信服务的历史。1996年1月，鲜京在世界范围内首次成功实现了CDMA的商业化推广，顺利完成第二代移动通信的建设，奠定了其在世界通讯市场的领先地位，被誉为“CDMA之父”。1997年，鲜京集团在世界第三个开发出IMF-2000试验平台，用无线通信提供语音、光谱数据和图像传输的多媒体服务，并开始提供国际互联网和PC通讯对接的多媒体在线服务（Netsgo），实现了移动电话和无线寻呼的对接，从而形成互联网——PC通讯——移动电话——无线寻呼相互兼容和对接的多媒体综合服务系统。1998年，成立SK-telink 公司，开通了识别分码为“00700”的移动通讯国际电话业务，并成立生产移动通讯和多媒体终端机硬件产品的SK-teletch公司。。

source_text: 2003年，SK Global（贸易公司）1800亿韩圆巨额假账被曝光。同年6月13日，韩国法院裁定SK会长崔泰源以涉嫌幕后交易和商业欺诈被判处3年监禁。孙吉丞被判3年有期徒刑，缓期4年执行。此外，包括SK集团总经理金昌根在内的等其他8名SK高级职员，也分别被判2-4年有期徒刑，缓期3-4年执行。不过此次事件对SK的冲击并不像人们想象的那么大。在强有力的企业文化支撑下，SK集团又把生命科学作为下一代的核心产业。SK集团一直对医药领域抱有兴趣，SK旗下的鲜京制药是韩国最早的制药企业之一。1999年，SK集团开发出韩国新药一号钵复合抗癌制剂。此外，SK集团还研发出从银杏叶提取的改善血液循环的新药吉内欣（Ginexin）和无毒性止痛药特拉马多（Tramadol）。2000年，SK集团在上海设立生命事业部，2002年11月在上海张江高科技园区成立SK生命科学研究中心。2005年，SK集团收购了韩国第五大石油炼制公司“仁川制油”。2012年，SK收购知名半导体生产商“海力士”。2017年9月，SK海力士通过“韩美日联盟”成功收购日本东芝芯片业务，一跃成为继三星电子之后世界闪存领域的第二大企业。
target_text: In addition, eight other SK senior staff members, including SK Group General Manager Kim Changgen, were sentenced to two to four years' imprisonment and suspended for three to four years. However, the impact of the incident on SK was not as great as one would have thought. The SK Group, supported by a strong corporate culture, used life science as a core business for the next generation. The SK Group has been interested in the field of medicine for a four-year delay. The SK Group was one of Korea's first pharmaceutical companies. In 1999, SK Group developed Korea's new drug No. 1, a complex anti-cancer agent.

source_text:
衰败和拆除
20世纪末，互联网开始在中国特别是各高校普及，三角地的信息发布、交流功能渐渐被互联网所取代。源自北京大学的知名网络社区如一塌糊涂BBS、北大未名BBS等的综合信息发布看板皆以“三角地”为名。而原实体三角地的信息栏几乎完全被垃圾广告所充斥。2007年10月31日，三角地信息栏拆除，三角地此后仅仅作为一个地点而存在。2017年1月19日，在北京大学历史上有着重要地位的三角地，其地面建筑被拆除，改为草坪。
target_text: At the end of the twentieth century, the Internet began to spread in China, especially at higher educational institutions, and the triangulation of information distribution and communication functions in the triangle has gradually been replaced by the Internet. The integrated information distribution boards of well-known web communities from Beijing University, such as BBS, the North and Unnamed BBS, are known as “triangular areas.”
title: 三角地 (北京大學)

source_text: Apple III配有一组系统工具程序可达成系统重新设置及文件处理。另有一个名叫－Selector III－的程序则被设计成与系统工具组进行整合及可启动各种应用软件。然而，苹果公司最终决定取消其开发，而原开发工程师最终购买了贩售Selector II给Apple III用户以取得一些名义上的费用的权利。然而，Quark软件公司开发了竟争产品－Catalyst。其具有程序切换能力、较为粗糙的介面及能防拷保护功能，使软件公司可以授权用户从硬盘运行软件，而不用担心他们的软件被拷贝备份或被盗版。当苹果公司决定将Catalyst内置于他们的新硬盘产品－ProFile时，Quark为此庆贺－他们终于透过QuarkXPress成为APPLE的主要的软件供应商了。而Selector III的开发小组则宁静地解散了。
target_text: Apple decided, however, to cancel its development, and the original development engineer eventually purchased some nominal fee rights for Apple III users. However, Quark Software developed a competing product, Catalyst. Its program, which has a program-to-procedure, a rough interface and a copy-proofing function, allows software companies to authorize users to run software from hard disks without fear of copying or copying their software. When Apple decided to place Catalyst in their new hard disk product, ProFile, Qark celebrated that they had finally become the main software provider of APPLE through QuarkXPress.
title: Apple III

source_text: 有一个可能比Apple III机器本身可能更广为流传的奇闻：在一个技术支持电子公告板上，遇到某些问题的用户被指示要将主机抬起三英寸（7.6公厘）后摔下以将芯片重新"归位"。另一个问题是由于APPLE III的电路板采用了当时尚未成熟的"细线"布线技术，线路间的间隙相当窄。当芯片被"挤"在板上并大量焊接时，焊锡会滴落于不应被连接的电路间，将造成了严重的短路，使得需要耗费大量时间进行昂贵的检测与修理。后来苹果公司不得不重新设计了一片具更多层但采用标准间隙的电路板，该电路板是依照一设计师在一巨大的设计板上画出的设计图所制造，而不像之前的电路板是在昂贵的CAD-CAM系统上设计。
target_text: Another problem is that the APPLE III circuit board used the undeveloped "line" layout technology at that time, with a rather narrow gap between the circuits. When the chip is "squeezed" on the board and welded heavily, welding falls into unconnected circuits, creating a serious short circuit that takes a lot of time to conduct expensive testing and repair. Apple then had to redesign a more sophisticated circuit board, which was built according to a design map drawn by a designer on a huge design plate, unlike the previous one, which was designed on an expensive CAD-CAM system.
title: Apple III

source_text: 有许多原因造成Apple III商业上的失败。其售价3500美元远高于当时许多其他基于CP/M操作系统的商用电脑。Apple III的软件库也相当有限，且其虽然宣称兼容Apple II，但该模拟功能受到刻意的限制而无法使用高级的Apple II功能（特别是许多以PASCAL编写的Apple II软件需要的64KB或更高内存），因此其实用性受到限制。
target_text: There are many reasons for Apple III’s commercial failure. The sale cost is much higher than many other commercial computers based on the CP/M operating system at the time. Apple III’s software library is also quite limited, and while it claims to be compatible with Apple II, the simulation function is deliberately limited by the inability to use advanced Apple II functions (especially 64KB or higher memory required by many of the Apple II software produced in PASCAL) and its usefulness is therefore limited.
title: Apple III

source_text: 更重要的是，这款电脑深受各种软、硬件缺陷所苦。首次在苹果电脑系列中出现的实时时钟芯片也在经过长时间的使用后会突然失效。这个由美国国家半导体公司制造的芯片是个反复出问题的例子。半导体公司销售合同中给予经销商30天时间以退换有瑕疵部件，通常经销商被认为会在销售产品前会先进行测试，但实际上这不是必须做的。国家半导体公司一向来就有有意销售瑕疵品的恶名，他们赌可以在需要接受换货前能推出合格的新产品。这对于将此时钟芯片置于插槽中且具有大量维修设备的消费者来说并不是大问题。然而，苹果公司将时钟芯片直接焊在了电路板上，因此很难靠测试电路板找出故障芯片。最后，苹果公司不得不取消Apple III中的实时时钟以解决此问题，而不是更换一个可用的芯片。
target_text: More importantly, the computer suffers from a variety of soft and hardware defects. The real-time clock chips that appear for the first time in the Apple series suddenly fail after a long period of use. This chip, which is made by American semiconductor companies, is an example of a recurring problem. The semiconductor sales contract gives distributors 30 days to replace defective components.
title: Apple III

source_text: 另一个被广泛碰到的问题是，Apple III没有设计安装冷却风扇或设计散热孔，这是Steve Jobs为了求安静而要求的设计，因此许多Apple III皆附有散热槽，但由于Apple III使用了金属机箱，且所有的芯片都挤在一起，因此几乎完全无法散热，造成许多Apple III过热死机及硬件损坏的问题。有些用户称他们的Apple III因过热造成芯片脱离电路板、屏幕显示花屏的影像，或磁盘取出机器时呈"烤熔化"状态（这也是为什么现在很少有Apple III被保留下来）。
target_text: Another widely encountered problem is that Apple III does not design cooling fans or vents, which Steve Jobs requested for quiet, so many Apple IIIs are accompanied by radiators, but because Apple III uses metal machines and all chips are packed together, it is almost impossible to dissipate, causing problems with many Apple III superheat killers and hardware damage. Some users say that their Apple III has caused the chip to break out of the circuit board due to heat overheating, the image of the screen displaying the flower screen, or the "Bake Melting" state when the disk removes the machine (which is why few Apple III are retained today).
title: Apple III

source_text: 在数学和计算机科学中，半自动机或-act是幺半群在集合上的乘法性运算。从代数结构的观点来看，它非常接近于群作用的概念。从计算机科学的观点来看，它是只有输入没有输出的自动机。从范畴论的观点来看，作用是如范畴上的函子般重要。这个概念也叫做S-集合、M-集合、M-操作数、S-系统、S-自动机、转移系统、算子幺半群、变换半群或转移幺半群。本文力图表现出它们表示的是同一个概念，尽管在使用中有各种概念和术语的变体。
target_text: In mathematics and computer science, semi-self-motivated or-act is a multi-manufactured calculation of a confluence. From the point of view of algebraic structure, it is very close to the concept of group action. From the point of view of computer science, it is only a self-motivated input without output. From the point of view of the scope, it is as important as a letter in the context. The concept is also called S-assembly, M-assembly, M-operatives, S-systems, S-motivation, algorithms, half-groups or transfer. This paper seeks to show that they represent the same concept, although there are variations in the use of various concepts and terms.
title: 半自动机

source_text: 离子阱，又称离子陷阱，是一种利用电场或磁场将离子（即带电原子或分子）俘获和囚禁在一定范围内的装置，离子的囚禁在真空中实现，离子与装置表面不接触。应用最多的离子阱有“保罗离子阱”（即四极离子阱，沃尔夫冈·保罗）和彭宁离子阱。离子阱可以应用于实现量子计算机。传统计算机以电位的高低表示位元0和1，而量子计算机以粒子的量子力学状态，如原子的自旋方向等表示0和1，称为“量子位元”。离子阱利用电极产生电场，将经过超冷处理的离子囚禁在电场里，实现量子位元。
target_text: Ionium, also known as the ion trap, is a device that uses electric fields or magnetic fields to capture and imprison ion (i.e. electrical atoms or molecules) within a certain range. Ion imprisonment takes place in a vacuum and the ion does not interact with the surface of the device. The most applied ions are the “Paul ion ion plating” (i.e., the tetrapolar ion plating, Wolfgang Paul) and the Penning ion plating. The ion plating can be used to achieve quantum computers.
title: 离子阱

source_text:
技术资讯
受到厚爱的Adam一开始就有丰富的软件库。它是由ColecoVision转变而来，并兼容ColecoVision的软件和附件。当时很普遍的CP/M操作系统也是一种选择。消费者买到的是一套完整的系统：一台有64KB内存的电脑、录音机、信件品质的打印机及软件（包含Buck Rogers: Planet of Zoom游戏）。IBM PCjr当时的售价是669美元，但不付任何周边设备。至于Commodore 64，虽然主机售价仅约200美元，但在购买打印机、录音机或软驱及软件后，费用仍相当可观。
target_text: The popular CP/M operating system was also an option. Consumers bought a complete system: a computer with 64 KB memory, tape recorders, mail quality printers and software (including Buck Rogers: Planet of Zoom games). IBM PCjr sold $669 but did not pay for any peripheral equipment. As for Comodore 64, the cost of buying printers, recorders or soft drives and software was considerable, although the host price was only about $200.
title: Coleco Adam

source_text:
问题
Adam有以下幾個缺點：
Adam在开机时会产生强大的磁场，其足以破坏所有留在机内或主机旁之磁性媒体的数据。更糟的是，某些Coleco的说明书指示用户在开机前放入录音带－据推测这些说明书可能是在此问题被发现前印的。
由于Coleco应用了相当奇怪的设计－从打印机供应所有系统的电源，若是打印机故障，所有的系统都将无法作动。
与当时其他电脑不一样的是，Adam没有内建于ROM的BASIC编译器。它内建的是SmartWriter－"电子打字机"与文书处理器、EOS(Elementary Operating System)操作系统核心与8K OS-7 ColecoVision操作系统。SmartBASIC编译器另附于其专有的Digital Data Pack录音带格式媒体中。
若切换至文书处理模式，SmartWriter无法在不重开机的情况下切回打字机模式。
Adam的Digital Data Pack驱动器虽然比竟争对手的录音机更快，储存容量也更高，但较不可靠且仍无法与软驱的速度相比。Coleco最终推出了160K 5英寸软驱给Adam使用。
target_text: Unlike other computers at the time, Adam did not have a BASIC translator built in ROM. It was built in SmartWriter, an electronic typewriter, and a document processor, the EOS (Elementary Organization System) operating system at the core of the 8K OS-7 ColecoVision operating system, all systems would be inoperable.
title: Coleco Adam

source_text:
送餐
近几年越来越多的送餐场所提供外卖服务，买家首先通过电话或互联网与餐饮点联系。在许多国家包括澳大利亚、加拿大、印度、英国、美国和大多数欧盟国家您可以在线订购食物。然后您订单a) 买家自取，b) 餐厅送餐，c) 特殊服务送餐（“第三方”）。 上世纪80年代推动本业务领域发展进入新阶段的动力来自家用个人电脑的广泛使用。以及未来 — 移动设备的分布以及更进一步的专用移动应用程序。送餐专用软件确定快递员最高效路线、跟踪订单和送餐并执行其他功能。 自 2008 年以来卫星导航让客户有机会通过互联网实时跟踪快递员的当前位置。
target_text: You can order food online in many countries, including Australia, Canada, India, the United Kingdom, the United States, and most European Union countries. Then you order (a) buyers to take their own food, (b) restaurants to deliver meals, and (c) special services to deliver meals (“third parties”).
