source_text: 太陽光電系統，也稱為光生伏特，简称光-{}-伏（Photovoltaics；字源“photo-”光，“voltaics”伏特），是指利用光伏半导体材料的光生伏打效应而将太阳能转化为直流电能的设施。光伏设施的核心是太阳能电池板。目前，用来发电的半导体材料主要有：单晶硅、多晶硅、非晶硅及碲化镉等。由于近年来各国都在积极推动可再生能源的应用，光伏产业的发展十分迅速。
target_text: Solar photovoltaic systems, also known as photovoltaic volts (photovoltaics, photo-photos, volts), refer to facilities where solar energy is converted into direct current electric power using photovoltaic effects of photovoltaic semiconductor materials. The center of photovoltaic facilities is solar panels. Currently, semiconductor materials used to generate electricity are mainly monocrystal silicon, multi-crystal silicon, non-crystal silicon, and cadmium. As countries have been actively promoting renewable energy applications in recent years, the photovoltaic industry has developed very rapidly.
title: 太阳能光伏

source_text: 原理光生伏打效应（英语：Photovoltaic effect），簡稱為光伏效應，是指受光线或其他電磁輻射照射的半导体或半导体与金属组合的部位间产生電壓與電流的现象。最早于1839年由法国物理学家亞歷山大·愛德蒙·貝克勒爾发现。光伏组件由許多光伏電池互連组合而成，其效率描述了多少阳光被转化为电能。例如，一块效率为20％的面板在1000瓦的日照下，每小时它将产生200瓦时的电能。光伏组件的朝向会影响发电效率。
target_text: The principle of photovoltaic effects (English: Photovoltaic effect), called photovoltaic effect, is that a semiconductor or semiconductor or semiconductor irradiated by light or other electromagnetic radiation produces electrical pressure and currents between the parts of the metal mix. As early as 1839, it was discovered by French physicist Alexander Edmund Beckler. The photovoltaic component is a combination of many photovoltaic batteries, and its efficiency describes how much sunlight is converted into electricity. For example, a 20%-efficiency panel produces 200-watt-hour electric power per hour under 1,000-watt-hour sunlight. The direction of the photovoltaic component affects the efficiency of electricity generation.
title: 太阳能光伏

source_text: StarForce 是1998年 Protection Technology（星之盾科技）针对 Windows 平台设计的一款软件复制保护技术的商标，它获得了微软合作伙伴等级认证 并成为微软解决方案合作伙伴 和英特尔软件合作伙伴。它的主要保护方案是使用字节码封装可执行文件和DLL，并通过其虚拟机解释这些文件。尽管商标所有者 Protection Technology 声称 StarForce 很难被逆向工程所破解，但是通常使用该保护方案的游戏最终都会遭到破解。制作破解的难度与 StarForce 的版本及游戏开发者在可执行文件中应用的保护例程次数息息相关。
target_text: StarForce, a 1998 Protection Technology trademark for reproducing protection technology designed by Windows platform, was certified as a Microsoft partner and became a Microsoft Solutions partner and an Intel Software partner. Its main protection programme is the use of byte code to encapsulate enforceable files and DLLs and to explain them through its virtual machine. Although the trademark owner, Protection Technology, claims that StarForce is difficult to decipher, the game that usually uses the program will eventually be debunked. The difficulty of making debunks is related to the number of protection routines that StarForce versions and game developers apply in executable documents.
title: StarForce

source_text:

2006年1月30日，著名的博客提供商 Boing Boing 引用一些与保护系统有关的问题，包括磁盘驱动器性能退化、操作系统安全性和稳定性的减弱，声称 StarForce 是恶意软件。在过了一天后的 2006年1月31日，Boing Boing 收到了 StarForce 的一封电子邮件，威胁采取法律行动，并称该文章“充满侮辱、谎言、错误的指控和传言”。CNET 做了相似的事，并收到了相似的电子邮件。 不过，Protection Technologies 并未证实这些文章是恶意撰写的。
target_text: On January 30, 2006, Boing Boing, a well-known blog provider, cited a number of issues related to the protection system, including the deterioration of disk drive performance, the weakening of the security and stability of the operating system, claiming that StarForce was a malware. On January 31, 2006, Boing Boing received an e-mail from StarForce threatening to take legal action and stating that the article was “filled with insults, lies, false accusations, and rumours.”
title: StarForce

[fast progress/fast-re-retarding] (new) supports the use of the 3-speed [net-on-line] [net-on-line guide] to the web link to the official system (interpretation) and supports the use of the new version of the Internet-based software (additional version of the new version of the S-intellecturing system).
title: PlayStation Portable系統軟體

source_text: 中华人民共和国互联网建立于1994年，在三十年的发展裡，互联网已成为了中国大陆的一种新兴文化现象。中国互联网上的内容受到中国共产党和中华人民共和国政府机关的严格审查，也建立了国家级防火墙过滤国外网站。2008年12月，中国大陆地区成为拥有世界上第一大用户群体的互联网络。截至2022年12月，中国大陸网民规模达10.67亿人，互联网普及率为75.6%；中国大陸手机网民规模达10.65亿，网民中使用手机上网的比例为 99.8%。
target_text: In December 2008, mainland China became the world’s largest user group. As of December 2022, China’s mainland netizens reached 1,067 million people, with an Internet penetration rate of 75.6%; and China’s mainland mobile phone users reached 1,065 million, with 99.8% using mobile phones.
title: 中华人民共和国互联网

source_text: 在1990年代以前，中国大陸有关研究所和协会曾发过邮件到国外。第一种说法是1987年9月20日，在北京国际汉语教师协会的王运丰教授和西德卡尔斯鲁厄大学维尔纳·措恩教授的主导下，中国大陆与外界互联网建立了首个连接。而中國大陸第一封成功對外發出的電郵則是在1987年9月14日發出，內容為「Across the Great Wall, we can reach every corner in the world」（越過長城，走向世界每個角落）。第二种说法是1986年8月25日，高能物理所（IHEP）的ALEPH的成员单位组长吴为民，从北京发给ALEPH的领导——位于瑞士日内瓦西欧核子中心的诺贝尔奖获得者杰克·施泰因贝格尔的电子邮件是中国大陸第一封国际电子邮件。但由于吴的邮件不通过TCP/IP，因此严格来说不算接入互联网。
target_text: China’s first successful e-mail to the outside world was sent on 14 September 1987 by the “Acros the Great Wall, we can reach every coorner in the world” (by way of the Wall), under the leadership of Professor Wang Hongfoon of the Beijing International Association of Chinese Teachers and Professor Werner Thorne of the University of Cid Karlsruhe, China’s first Internet connection with the outside world. China’s first successful e-mail from China’s mainland was sent on 14 September 1987 to the leader of the Nobel Prize in the Western European Nuclear Center in Geneva, Jack Steinberg, an international e-mail from China.
title: 中华人民共和国互联网

source_text: 中国大陸最早接入互联网始于1994年5月17日，当高能物理所（IHEP）与美国斯坦福直線加速器中心（SLAC）建立的TCP/IP连接，为中国大陸接入互联网之始。1994年5月24日一条64K的国际专线从中华人民共和国国家计算机与网络设施（NCFC）通过美国Sprint公司连入互联网。但此时中国大陸仍没有互联网服务供应商。從1994年至1990年代，互联网仅用于商业、教育和一些政府部门，中國大陸互聯網主要依靠拨号上网的方式，高昂的電話費並非人人負擔得起。一些企業與學校機構此时已經組建了一系列的城域網或校園網，網民主要是IT人士、教師、學生。1990年代为中国大陸公用互联网的开始年代，中国大陸最早的互联网服务供应商为女创业家张树新成立的瀛海威时空，在北京于1995年9月30日在一台Intel 80486 90MHz电脑网络服务器上开始运营，到1996年8月，仅在北京已经拥有了6000名用户。作为中国大陸第一个互联网服务供应商，瀛海威比中国电信的ChinaNet还要早出现。中国大陸的公用互联网起步始于1997年后，但即使在1997年至1998年也仅是中国大陸互联网出现过的一次小兴起时期。截至2001年，中國大陸的互聯網用戶率為2.18%。其中65%的中国网民年收入超过6000元；相比之下，年收入低于6000元的用户占互联网用戶总數的15%。2000年後，寬帶網絡的出现以及后来價格開始下降，用戶接入數量開始快速攀升。一些大城市也開設網吧等的服務機構，加上網絡遊戲流行，令中國大陸互聯網迅速發展。
target_text: On May 24, 1994, an international line of 64K was built from the national computer and network facilities of the People’s Republic of China (NCFC) to the Internet via the United States’ Spring company. But at that time, there were no Internet service providers in China’s mainland. From 1994 to 1990 the Internet was used only for business, education, and some government departments, and the China Continental Interconnector Network, mainly by dial-up access to the Internet (SLAC), and the high telephone bill was not affordable for everyone. A series of urban or campus networks were set up on May 24, 1994, mainly for IT people, teachers, students.
title: 中华人民共和国互联网

source_text: 受到ICQ、Google、YouTube、維基百科等的啟發，中國大陸企業開始自行發展相關的產業。不過截至2007年，中國大陸各地互聯網發展並不平衡。北京當地有30.4%的居民接入互聯網，上海為28.7%，廣東為19.9%，而貴州為3.8%。當時北京网民占全国网民总数的12.39%，上海占8.98%，而中国西北部的西藏和青海省佔0.0%（幾乎為零）和0.31%。中国城市地区的互联网普及率为50%，而中国农村地区为18.5%。
target_text: China’s mainland companies began to develop their own related industries, inspired by ICQ, Google, YouTube, and Wikipedia. By 2007, however, China’s Internet development had been uneven across the mainland. 30.4% of the local population had access to the Internet in Beijing, 28.7% in Shanghai, 19.9% in Guangdong, and 3.8% in Guizhou, compared with 12.39% in Beijing, 8.98% in Shanghai, and 0.0% (nearly zero) and 0.31% in Tibet and Qinghai provinces in the northwest of China.
title: 中华人民共和国互联网

source_text: 2017年11月26日，中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《推进互联网协议第六版（IPv6）规模部署行动计划》，要求各地各部门贯彻落实。其中主要目标包括：到2018年末，IPv6活跃用户数达2亿，互联网用户中占比不低于20%；到2020年末，IPv6活跃用户数超过5亿，互联网用户中占比超过50%，新增网络地址不再使用私有IPv4地址；到2025年末，中国大陸IPv6网络规模、用户规模、流量规模位居世界第一，网络、应用、终端全面支持IPv6。
target_text: On 26 November 2017, the Central Office of the Communist Party of China and the Office of the State Council issued an action plan for the deployment of the sixth edition of the Internet Protocol (IPv6), which calls for follow-up by all sectors. The main objectives of the plan include: by the end of 2018, the number of IPv6 active users reached 200 million, with no less than 20 per cent of Internet users; by the end of 2020, the number of IPv6 active users exceeded 500 million, the number of Internet users exceeded 50 per cent, and the addition of additional Internet addresses eliminated private IPv4 addresses; and by the end of 2025, the size of the IPv6 network, the size of users and the volume of traffic in China's mainland was the highest in the world, with networks, applications and terminals fully supporting IPv6.
title: 中华人民共和国互联网

source_text: 基础资源截至2017年第三季度，光缆线路总长度达3606万公里，其中新建光缆线路564万公里，建设光缆长度保持较快增长态势。截至2017年第三季度，互联网宽带接入端口数量达到7.6亿个，比上年底净增7166万个。截至2017年第三季度，移动通信基站总数达604.1万个。其中3G/4G基站累计达到447.1万个，占比达74.0%。
target_text: By the third quarter of 2017, basic resources had reached a total length of 3.06 million kilometres of fibre-optic lines, of which 5.64 million kilometres of new fibre-optic lines had been created, and the construction length of fibre-optic cables had continued to grow at a faster pace. By the third quarter of 2017, the number of Internet broadband access ports had reached 760 million, a net increase of 71.66 million compared to the end of the previous year. By the third quarter of 2017, the total number of mobile communications base stations had reached 6.041 million.
title: 中华人民共和国互联网

source_text: 截至2017年12月，中国大陸域名总数同比减少9.0%，但“.CN”域名总数实现了1.2%的增长，达到2085万个，在域名总数中占比从2016年底的48.7%提升至54.2%；国际出口带宽实现10.2%的增长，达7,320,180Mbps；此外，光缆、互联网接入端口、移动电话基站和互联网数据中心等基础设施建设稳步推进。在此基础上，网站、网页、移动互联网接入流量与APP数量等应用发展迅速，均在2017年实现显著增长，尤其是移动互联网接入流量自2014年以来连续三年实现翻番增长。中国大陸网民规模达7.72亿。
target_text: By December 2017, the total number of domain names in China's mainland had decreased by 9.0 per cent over the same period, but the total number of domain names in “.CN” had grown by 1.2 per cent, to 2.08 million, up from 48.7 per cent at the end of 2016 to 54.2 per cent; the international export bandwidth had increased by 10.2 per cent, to 7,320,180 Mbps; and infrastructure such as fibre cables, Internet access ports, mobile phone base stations and Internet data centres had progressed steadily. On that basis, applications such as websites, web pages, mobile Internet access traffic and the number of APPs had grown rapidly, with significant increases in 2017, in particular the doubling of mobile Internet access traffic for three consecutive years since 2014.
title: 中华人民共和国互联网

source_text: 中国大陆用户的互联网体验与其所用运营商有一定关系，民间将宽带运营商分为三级。一级宽带运营商包括中国电信、中国联通及中国移动，这三家运营商拥有全国性的骨干网且网内资源丰富，能提供较好的网络质量但是收费相对较高。二级、三级运营商诸如鹏博士、长城宽带等需要向以及运营商购买带宽资源以实现互联网接入，这类运营商收费较低，但是为了节约成本，其网速及稳定性相对较差，具体表现为使用实际带宽小于销售时的宣传，使用下载软件没有速度或者被劫持到自家的缓存服务器、玩网络游戏延迟较高且不稳定、连接境外服务时速度慢或无法访问等。
target_text: The Internet experience of users in mainland China has some relevance to the operators they use, and the private sector divides broadband operators into three levels. The first level of broadband operators includes China Telecom, China Connect, and China. The three operators have a national backbone network and are rich in resources, providing better network quality but are relatively expensive.
title: 中华人民共和国互联网

source_text:
互联网企业
截至2017年12月，中国大陸境内外上市互联网企业数量达到102家，总体市值为8.97万亿人民币。中国大陸网信独角兽企业总数为77家，其中北京的独角兽企业数占比为41.6%，上海的独角兽企业占比为23.4%。截至2017年6月，中国大陸拥有人工智能企业592家，占全球总数的23.3%。
target_text: As of December 2017, the number of Internet companies listed in China and abroad reached 102, with a total market value of RMB 8.97 trillion. The total number of China's mainland Internet LICORNE enterprises was 77, of which 41.6 per cent were in Beijing and 23.4 per cent in Shanghai. As of June 2017, China's mainland had 592 artificial intelligence enterprises, or 23.3 per cent of the global total.
title: 中华人民共和国互联网

source_text: 随着中国大陸互联网的发展，电子邮件、BBS等传统互联网络应用逐渐减少，搜索引擎、即时通信等基础网络应用趋向饱和，移动商务类应用发展迅速，网络支付使用率增长迅速。此外，网络炒股成为网民投资焦点，由于股市带来的用户分流，使得网络余额理财类应用的使用率增长出现停滞。
target_text: With the development of the Internet on China’s mainland, traditional Internet applications, such as e-mail, BBS, and other basic network applications, such as search engines and instant communications, are becoming saturated, mobile business applications are developing rapidly, and the use of network payments is growing rapidly. In addition, webinars have become the focus of investment by the Internet, with the diversion of users from the stock market stagnating the use of network balance management finance applications.
title: 中华人民共和国互联网

source_text:
法律規管
2017年9月国家互联网信息办公室推出《互联网群组信息服务管理规定》規管即時通訊群組和聊天室等。當月《检察日报》採訪了国家行政学院教授杨小军的看法，「杨小军也认为，管理责任并非上述一些网友所理解的『让群主也要承担群成员违法违规的责任』，在互联网群组中不只有群主一个责任主体，还有群主、参与人（发言人）、网络平台提供商、相关主管部门这四个主体共同参与，才有互联网及其群组的发展进步；同样，四个主体也分别承担相应责任」、「对于一些网友列举出群主需要对群成员的信息发布和传播行为而承担的诸多民事、行政乃至刑事责任，杨小军明确表示了反对：『这个观点实际上是让群主一人负担所有人的责任，甚至把管理部门的责任都归到群主身上。这既不客观，也不可能』」；報導又採訪中国政法大学教授王卫国，「有网友戏称通过司法考试才敢当群主。有的群主对法律法规不是很熟悉，那么其对群成员的信息交流是否违反法律法规该如何判断、管理呢？王卫国表示，这还是网友对管理责任的过大理解。实际上，群主只要根据一般人的判断，认为群成员的表达明显不妥时，给予提示、禁止，就算是已经尽到管理责任了。对于比较专业化的问题，法律法规不可能赋予群主过度的责任。」
target_text: In September 2017, the National Internet Information Office introduced the Regulations on the Management of Information Services for Internet Groups, which regulate the development of the Internet and its clusters, among others. The Journal of Public Prosecutions interviewed the view of Yang Xiaojun, a member of the National School of Administration, that "the Yang Xiaojun also believes that the management responsibility is not `the responsibility of the group', as understood by some of the above-mentioned online users, to make the group members responsible for the violations of the law', that not only the group owner, but also the group owner, the participant (speaker), the provider of the Internet platform, and the four relevant authorities, together, are responsible for the development of the Internet and its groups; similarly, the four subjects are each responsible for the management of the group, and that "there are many civil, administrative and even criminal responsibilities for the publication and dissemination of the information of the group' cited by some of their friends.
title: 中华人民共和国互联网

source_text: 2022年8月1日起，收紧对用户和平台控制的《互联网用户账号信息管理规定》開始實行。根據該規定，互联网个人用户注册、使用账号信息，含有职业信息的，应当与个人真实职业信息相一致；互联网信息服务提供者为互联网用户提供信息发布、即时通讯等服务的，应当进行真实身份信息认证；应当对互联网用户在注册时提交的和使用中拟变更的账号信息进行核验。互联网服务提供商在账号信息页面展示互联网用户账号的互联网协议地址归属地信息。
target_text: As of 1 August 2022, the Internet User Account Information Management (ICF) Regulations for user and platform control have been tightened. According to this regulation, Internet users register, use account information, which contains professional information, and should be consistent with personal real professional information; Internet Information Service Providers (ISPs) certify real identity information for Internet users providing information distribution, instant messaging, etc.; Internet users should verify account numbers to be changed in their registration and use. Internet service providers display Internet Protocol addresses on account information pages that belong to the Internet user account number.
title: 中华人民共和国互联网

source_text: 网络审查中华人民共和国政府对中国大陆的互联网进行了审查。审查包括了一系列的行政手段和技术手段。在防火长城技术的支持下，部分例如Google、Facebook、YouTube等网站在中国大陆均无法正常访问。香港、澳门作为中华人民共和国的特别行政区，不受中國大陸网络审查的限制，与除中国大陆以外的其他地区之间的网络连接不会受防火长城影响。
target_text: Some websites, such as Google, Facebook, YouTube, and others, are not normally accessible in mainland China. Hong Kong and Macao, the special administrative region of the People’s Republic of China, are not subject to censorship by China’s mainland network, and connectivity to areas other than mainland China is not affected by fire safety.
title: 中华人民共和国互联网

source_text: Crypton Future Media成立之初是从事音频软件的进口贸易，之后在本土提供手机铃声分发的服务中接触到生产手机音频芯片的日本乐器公司雅马哈，之后雅马哈与Crypton合作推出了由前者开发的第一款Vocaloid的女性日语歌声库《Vocaloid Meiko》，他们曾考虑在包装封面上像那些印着相应实物图像的音色库一样印上真人图像，但在多次讨论后决定印上年轻女性的漫画插图，这名人物手握麦克风动作活泼，他们希望能给用户带来动感和节奏感，这种创新的决策奏效了，购买《Vocaloid Meiko》的消费者不仅包含好奇的和初学的计算机音乐用户，还有喜欢动漫的人，之后他们合作的第一款Vocaloid的男性日语歌声库《Vocaloid Kaito》也延续了这种设计，Crypton找到札幌当地的插画师川崎贵司（）给《Vocaloid Kaito》创作人物插图，并且《Vocaloid Kaito》没有像《Vocaloid Meiko》那样是取自配音员的名字来命名，而是在互联网上募集到「Kaito」的名称，被选中的原因是不仅方便外国人阅读，并且与「Meiko」的构词搭配。曾经第一款男性日语歌声库有两部候选者，日本歌手風雅直人录制的歌声库和日本歌手比山貴咏史（）录制的歌声库，前者被选中后，后者则经过重新开发后被交由日本软件公司制造成《》发行。
target_text: The Japanese music company Yamaha, which produced audio chips for mobile phones, was contacted in its home-grown service to provide cell phone bell distribution, and the Japanese music bank, Vocaloid Meiko, which was developed by the former, launched in cooperation with the Japanese music bank Vocaloid, was conceived to print real images on the wrapping cover like those of the audio library with the corresponding physical images, but after many discussions, it was decided to print cartoon illustrations of young women, which it was hoped would give users a sense of movement and rhythm. The decision to do so was successful, and the customers of the Vocaloid Meiko had not only curious and early-school computer music users, but also people who liked to use them, who had been working with Vocaloids, the reason for which they had been able to develop their own songs, and the reason for which they had been able to do so was that they had been called "Vocalo Kaitos" , which had been used by the Japanese cartoonist, which had been given the name of Kíto Kídstostos, which had been read by the Japanese owner, and had been given the "Vi
title: Kaito

source_text:
派生版本国际版
Opera公司开发的多国语言的国际版本，使用的官方服务器位于欧洲和美国，可自由访问世界互联网上的所有网站。该版本也是唯一支援Android、黑莓和Palm的Opera Mini版本。由于2009年11月21日北京时间0:45以前，国际版可以浏览被中国大陆防火长城封锁的网站，因此这个浏览器曾经在中国手机互联网用户中非常受欢迎。
target_text: The international version of the international version of the derivative version of the Opera, developed by the company, is an international version of the multinational language, with official servers located in Europe and the United States, with free access to all websites on the world's Internet. It is also the only version of the Opa Mini that supports Android, BlackBerry, and Palm. The international version was very popular among Chinese Internet users because it had access to websites that had been blocked by the Great Fire Safety Wall on mainland China by 00:45 Beijing time on 21 November 2009.
title: Opera Mini

source_text:
粗衬线字体也常用于打字机，最着名的是Courier，这种传统意味着许多用于计算机和编程的等宽文本字体都是粗衬线设计。歷史
當印刷材料開始蓬勃發展時，印製廣告、海報和傳單等需要新的字體的輔助，文生·費金斯（Vincent Figgins）在1815年和1817年首次應用粗襯線體「Antique」在商業用途上。
target_text: Crude line fonts are also often used in typewriters, most well known as Courier, a tradition that means that many broad text fonts for computers and programming are designed in rough line design. source_text: 群发邮件由向一个相同的邮件地址发送大量重复的邮件组成。这种类型的电邮炸弹的设计很简单，但极其简单也意味着垃圾邮件过滤器可以非常容易地检测它们。使用群发邮件的电邮炸弹通常是使用僵尸网络进行DDoS攻击来执行，僵尸网络是指受恶意软件危害并在攻击者控制下的计算机的分层网络。与垃圾邮件的使用类似，攻击者指示僵尸网络发送数百万甚至数十亿电子邮件，但与正常的的僵尸网垃圾邮件不同，这些电子邮件都只针对一个或几个攻击者希望淹没的地址。这种形式的电邮炸弹与其它DDos洪水攻击的目的相似。由于攻击目标通常是处理企业网站和电邮账号的专用主机，因此这种类型的攻击对于主机的两种服务都具有破坏性。
target_text: Mass e-mails consist of large numbers of duplicate mail sent to the same mail address. This type of e-mail bomb is simple, but extremely simple and means that spam filters can detect them very easily. E-mail bombs using mass e-mails are usually carried out with a DDoS attack using a Zombie network, which refers to a layered network of computers that is damaged by malicious software and controlled by the attackers. Similar to spam, the attackers instruct zombie networks to send millions or even billions of e-mails, but unlike normal zombie web spams, these e-mails target only one or several of the attackers who wish to drown.
title: 电邮炸弹

source_text: ZIP炸弹是邮件轰炸的变种。在大多数商业邮件服务器开始使用防病毒软件检查邮件并过滤某些恶意文件类型之后，EXE，RAR，Zip，7-Zip，邮件服务器软件随后被配置为解压缩档案并检查其内容。一个突破这种解决方案的新想法是组成一个巨大的文本文件“炸弹”，例如，只包含重复数百万次的字母z。这样的文件将被压缩成一个相对较小的存档，但是它的解包（特别是早期版本的邮件服务器）会使用更多的处理服务，这可能导致拒绝服务。ZIP或.tar.gz文件甚至可以包含自身的副本，如果服务器检查嵌套的归档文件，则会导致无限递归。
target_text: ZIP bombs are a variant of mail bombings. After most commercial mail servers began to use anti-virus software to screen mail and filter certain malicious file types, EXE, RAR, Zip, 7-Zip, the mail server software was then configured to decompress files and check their contents. A new idea to break through this solution is to form a huge text file, “bombs”, for example, containing only millions of letters z. The document will be compressed into a relatively small archive, but its unpackage (especially the early version of the mail server) will use more processing services, which may lead to denial of services. ZIP or.tar.gz files can even contain their own copies, and if the server checks the embedded archive files, it will lead to an unlimited reversal.
title: 电邮炸弹

source_text: 然而，施耐爾（現在）認為他自己早期成果的背後隱藏的人用問題（people problem），證明當時只是天真的、僅僅只合乎數理、如同躲在象牙塔一樣毫無鴻觀的作品。在《應用密碼學》一書中指出，正確的建置密碼學演算法即可達到安全性與機密性，書中所介紹的各種協定將能確保資訊安全；然而，他當時卻沒顧慮到未來可能遭遇到的問題。施耐爾認為當時由數理證明所提出的安全保證，在實務的應用上達不到實際的安全等級。他在《祕密與謊言》（Secrets and Lies）裡描述道，即使一家公司使用最通行的RSA密碼學演算法來保護這家公司的資料，卻不假所思的將金鑰（用來加/解密、簽署數位資訊的機密資料）交給一位無法信任的員工，或讓員工將金鑰在一台不可靠的電腦上使用；結果將是資訊安全蕩然無存。因此，一個真正的安全資訊應該整體佈局於軟體、硬體、網路、人、財務與企業活動。施耐爾（現在）著手教育人們去建置一整個安全系統，並與尼爾斯·弗格森（Niels Ferguson）一同完成他的新書《實用密碼學》（Practical Cryptography）。

沿革
雲端運算是继1980年代大型计算机到客户端-服务器的大转变之后的又一种巨变。用户不再需要了解“云”中基础设施的细节，不必具有相应的专业知识，也无需直接进行控制。云计算描述了一种基于互联网的新的IT服务增加、使用和交付模式，通常涉及通过互联网来提供动态易扩展而且经常是虚拟化的资源。

source_text: 互联网上汇聚的计算资源、存储资源、数据资源和应用资源正随着互联网规模的扩大而不断增加，互联网正在从传统意义的通信平台转化为泛在、智能的计算平台。与计算机系统这样的传统计算平台比较，互联网上还没有形成类似计算机操作系统的服务环境，以支持互联网资源的有效管理和综合利用。在传统计算机中已成熟的操作系统技术，已不再能适用于互联网环境，其根本原因在于：互联网资源的自主控制、自治对等、异构多尺度等基本特性，与传统计算机系统的资源特性存在本质上的不同。为了适应互联网资源的基本特性，形成承接互联网资源和互联网应用的一体化服务环境，面向互联网计算的虚拟计算环境（Internet-based Virtual Computing Environment，iVCE）的研究工作，使用户能够方便、有效地共享和利用开放网络上的资源。
target_text: The computing resources, storage resources, data resources and applications assembled on the Internet are increasing as the size of the Internet expands, and the Internet is moving from traditional communication platforms to general, intelligent computing platforms. Compared to traditional computing platforms such as computer systems, the Internet has not yet developed a service environment similar to that of computer operating systems to support the efficient management and integrated use of Internet resources. The mature operating system technology in traditional computers is no longer suitable for the Internet environment, because of the fundamental characteristics of Internet resources, such as autonomous control, self-equivalency, hemispheric multiscales, which are fundamentally different from the resource characteristics of traditional computer systems. In order to adapt to the basic characteristics of Internet resources, to create an integrated service environment for Internet resources and Internet applications, research on the virtual computing environment for Internet computing (Internet-based Digital Contracting Environment, iVCE) enables users to easily and effectively share and utilize resources on open networks.
title: 雲端運算

source_text: 从应用视角上，iVCE以新型的资源管理模型，为终端用户提供了组织、共享和管理资源的方式和机制，以支持互联网资源的有效共享和综合利用。从开发视角上，iVCE是互联网新型应用的软件开发平台，提供了与资源管理模型一致的程序设计模式与运行支撑，能方便、快捷地帮助开发人员构造面向互联网的应用系统。从系统视角上，iVCE包括了支持iVCE资源管理模型的程序设计语言，网络延迟探测、支持网络资源按需聚合和协同的虚拟节点、资源聚合管理、资源协同管理、虚拟网络内存、虚拟网络外存和虚拟执行网络等基础服务，以及iVCE应用管理与运行支撑环境。
target_text: From an application perspective, iVCE provides end-users with ways and mechanisms to organize, share and manage resources to support the effective sharing and integrated use of Internet resources. From a development perspective, iVCE is the software development platform for new Internet applications, providing program design models and operating support consistent with the resource management model, which can easily and quickly help develop people to construct Internet-oriented applications. From a system perspective, iVCE includes the procedural design language that supports the iVCE resource management model, network delayed detection, support of network resources for virtual nodes of convergence and synergy, resource pooling management, resource co-management, virtual network memory, virtual offline and virtual implementation networks, and basic services such as iVCE application management and operation support environments.

If the data themselves have some sort of cluster structure, the number of overlaps required for consolidation is usually very small, and the number of overlaps after a few overlaps is minimal. For these reasons, the Lloyds algorithm is generally considered to be almost linear in its complexity in practice.

source_text:
更多的讨论
使得k-均值算法效率很高的两个关键特征同时也被经常被视为它最大的缺陷：
聚类数目k是一个输入参数。选择不恰当的k值可能会导致糟糕的聚类结果。这也是为什么要进行特征检查来决定数据集的聚类数目了。
收敛到局部最优解，可能导致“反直观”的错误结果。
target_text: More discussion has resulted in two key features that make the k-parity algorithm efficient at the same time being often seen as its biggest flaw: the number of groups k is an input parameter. The selection of an inappropriate k value may lead to a bad cluster result. That is why a profile check is used to determine the number of clusters in the data set.
title: K-平均算法

source_text:
k-均值算法的一个重要的局限性即在于它的聚类模型。这一模型的基本思想在于：得到相互分离的球状聚类，在这些聚类中，均值点趋向收敛于聚类中心。
一般会希望得到的聚类大小大致相当，这样把每个观测都分配到离它最近的聚类中心（即均值点）就是比较正确的分配方案。
target_text: An important limitation of the k-parity algorithm is its cluster model. The basic idea of the model is that it receives separate spherical clusters, in which the mean points tend to converge in the cluster center. The expected clusters are roughly the same size, so that each observation is assigned to the nearest cluster centre (i.e., the mean points) which is the correct distribution formula.
title: K-平均算法

source_text:
相关应用
k-均值聚类（尤其是使用如Lloyd's算法的启发式方法的聚类）即使是在巨大的数据集上也非常容易部署实施。正因为如此，它在很多领域都得到成功的应用，如市场划分、机器视觉、 地质统计学、天文学和农业等。它经常作为其他算法的预处理步骤，比如要找到一个初始设置。
target_text: The application of k-average clusters (especially those using inspirational methods such as Lloyd's algorithms) is very easy to deploy even on large data sets. That is why it has been successfully applied in many areas, such as market segmentation, machine vision, geostatistics, astronomy and agriculture. It is often used as a pre-processing step for other algorithms, such as finding an initial setting.
title: K-平均算法

source_text: k-均值起源于信号处理领域，并且现在也能在这一领域找到应用。例如在计算机图形学中，色彩量化的任务，就是要把一张图像的色彩范围减少到一个固定的数目k上来。k-均值算法就能很容易地被用来处理这一任务，并得到不错的结果。其它得向量量化的例子有非随机抽样，在这里，为了进一步的分析，使用k-均值算法能很容易的从大规模数据集中选出k个合适的不同观测。
target_text: In computer graphics, for example, the colour-quantified task is to reduce the colour range of an image to a fixed number of k. The k-average algorithm can be easily used to handle the task and get good results. Other examples of vector-quantifiable are non-random samples where, for further analysis, the k-average algorithm can easily select a suitable K-different observation from a large data set.
title: K-平均算法

source_text:
在聚类分析中，k-均值算法被用来将输入数据划分到k个部分(聚类)中。
然而，纯粹的k-均值算法并不是非常灵活，同样地，在使用上有一定局限（不过上面说到的向量量化，确实是一个理想的应用场景）。特别是，当没有额外的限制条件时，参数k是很难选择的（正如上面讨论过的一样）。算法的另一个限制就是它不能和任意的距离函数一起使用、不能处理非数值数据。而正是为了满足这些使用条件，许多其他的算法才被发展起来。
target_text: In cluster analysis, the k-average algorithm is used to divide input data into k-parts (clusters). However, the pure k-average algorithm is not very flexible, and, similarly, there are limits to its use (although the vector quantification mentioned above is indeed an ideal application scenario). In particular, when there are no additional limitations, the parameter k is difficult to select (as discussed above). Another limitation of the algorithm is that it cannot be used in conjunction with arbitrary distance functions and cannot process non-numeric data.
title: K-平均算法

source_text:
特征学习
在（半）监督学习或无监督学习中，k-均值聚类被用来进行特征学习（或字典学习）步骤。基本方法是，首先使用输入数据训练出一个k-均值聚类表示，然后把任意的输入数据投射到这一新的特征空间。
k-均值的这一应用能成功地与自然语言处理和计算机视觉中半监督学习的简单线性分类器结合起来。在对象识别任务中，它能展现出与其他复杂特征学习方法（如自动编码器、受限Boltzmann机等）相当的效果。然而，相比复杂方法，它需要更多的数据来达到相同的效果，因为每个数据点都只贡献了一个特征（而不是多重特征）。
target_text: Characteristic learning In (semi)supervised learning or unsupervised learning, the k-average cluster is used as a feature learning (or dictionary) step. The basic approach is to first train a k-means cluster with input data, and then to project any input data into this new feature space. The k-average application successfully combines with a simple linear classification of natural language processing and computer visual semi-supervised learning. In object identification tasks, it displays the same effect as other complex characteristics learning methods (e.g., automatic encoder, restricted Boltzmann machines, etc.). However, it requires more data to achieve the same effect than in complex methods, since each data point contributes only one feature (rather than multiple characteristics).
title: K-平均算法

source_text:
与其他统计机器学习方法的关系
k-均值聚类，以及它与EM算法的联系，是高斯混合模型的一个特例。很容易能把k-均值问题一般化为高斯混合模型。另一个k-均值算法的推广则是k-SVD算法，后者把数据点视为“编码本向量”的稀疏线性组合。而k-均值对应于使用单编码本向量的特殊情形（其权重为1）。
target_text: The relationship with other statistical machine learning methods k-average cluster, and its connection to the EM algorithm, is an exception to the Gaussian hybrid model. It is easy to generalize the k-average issue into a Gaussian hybrid model. Another extension of the K-SVD algorithm is the k-SVD algorithm, which treats data points as a thinly linear combination of “coded primary vectors”.
title: K-平均算法

source_text:
Mean Shift 聚类
基本的Mean Shift聚类要维护一个与输入数据集规模大小相同的数据点集。初始时，这一集合就是输入集的副本。然后对于每一个点，用一定距离范围内的所有点的均值来迭代地替换它。与之对比，k-均值把这样的迭代更新限制在（通常比输入数据集小得多的）K个点上，而更新这些点时，则利用了输入集中与之相近的所有点的均值（亦即，在每个点的Voronoi划分内）。还有一种与k-均值类似的Mean shift算法，即 似然Mean shift，对于迭代变化的集合，用一定距离内在输入集中所有点的均值来更新集合里的点。Mean Shift聚类与k-均值聚类相比，有一个优点就是不用指定聚类数目，因为Mean shift倾向于找到尽可能少的聚类数目。然而，Mean shift会比k-均值慢得多，并且同样需要选择一个“宽度”参数。和k-均值一样，Mean shift算法有许多变体。
target_text: The basic Mean Shift Cluster uses the same data point set as the size of the input data set. At the beginning, the collection is a copy of the input set. At each point, the k-average is replaced by the average value of all points within a range of distances. In contrast, the k-average limits such replacements to K-points (often much smaller than the input datasets) and, when updating these points, uses the same value for all points close to the concentration (i.e., the Voronoi divide at each point). There is also a Mean Shift algorithm similar to the k-average, i.e., the Meanshift method, which is similar to the average value, which is likely to find as few clusters as possible.
title: K-平均算法

source_text:
双向过滤
k-均值算法隐含地假设输入数据的顺序不影响结果。双向过滤与k-均值算法和Mean shift算法类似之处在于它同样维护着一个迭代更新的数据集（亦是被均值更新）。然而，双向过滤限制了均值的计算只包含了在输入数据中顺序相近的点，这使得双向过滤能够被应用在图像去噪等数据点的空间安排是非常重要的问题中。
target_text: The two-way filtering k-average algorithm implicitly assumes that the order in which the data are entered does not affect the outcome. The two-way filtering is similar to the k-average algorithm and the Mean shift algorithm in that it also maintains an iterative updated data set (also updated by the mean). However, the two-way filter limits the calculation of the mean value to the point where the order of the input data is similar, so that the two-way filter can be applied to the spatial arrangement of data points such as image noise.
title: K-平均算法

硬盘盒有壳体，数据接口转换芯片组，数据线，与电源部分构成。
壳体——为硬盘或者光驱提供物理上的保护，如减震，防尘，屏蔽电磁干扰等

数据线——由芯片组决定接口，如Firewire/IEEE 1394，并口，或是最流行的USB。
电源——对于2.5寸硬盘来说，更多选择从USB口取电；而3.5寸硬盘不得不增加一个外部电源适配器，提供硬盘需要的Molex接口供电。

source_text: 上线时间（Uptime）是指某时间段内计算机或通信系统正常工作的总时长。 与上线时间相反的是宕机时间或下线时间（Downtime），宕机时间是指某时间段内计算机或通信系统不能正常工作宕机的总时长。上线时间是用来衡量计算机或通信系统稳定性的重要指标之一。
target_text: Uptime refers to the total duration of normal work of a computer or communication system during a given period of time. Contrary to uptime, it refers to Downtime, which means the total duration of a computer or communication system that cannot function properly during a given period of time.

source_text: 高级配置与电源接口（，縮寫：ACPI），是1997年由英特尔、微软、东芝共同提出、制定的操作系统電源管理、硬體組態介面，是一种開放标准，取代了進階電源管理、多處理器規範、規範。2000年8月康柏和凤凰科技加入，推出 ACPI 2.0规格。2004年9月惠普取代康柏，推出 ACPI 3.0规格。2009年6月16日則推出 ACPI 4.0规格。2011年11月23日推出ACPI 5.0规格。由于ACPI技术正被多个操作系统和处理器架构采用，该规格的管理模式需要与时俱进。2013年10月，ACPI的推广者们一致同意将ACPI的属有归到UEFI论坛。今后新的ACPI规格将由UEFI论坛制定。ACPI定義了系統韌體（BIOS或UEFI）和作業系統之間的硬體抽象介面。
target_text: Advanced configurations and power interfaces (ACPI, ACPI) were introduced in 1997 by Intel, Microsoft, and Toshiba, together with an operating system power management, hard set interface, an open-source standard that replaced advanced power management, multiprocessor regulations, and regulations. Conpar and Phoenix technologies joined in August 2000, introducing ACPI 2.0 specifications. In September 2004, Hewlett-Packard replaced the ACPI 3.0 specifications. The ACPI 4.0 specifications were launched on 16 June 2009. The ACPI 5.0 specifications were introduced on 23 November 2011.
title: 高级配置与电源接口

source_text:
各个状态的定义如下所示：
C0是正常工作状态，当处理器处于这种状态下的时候，它能正常处理指令。
C1（通常称为Halt），拥有最短的唤醒时间，这个延时必须短到操作系统软件使用CPU的时候不会考虑到唤醒时间方面的因素。一些处理器，比如Pentium 4、酷睿，支持C1E（Enhanced C1 state）。
C2 (通常称为Stop-Clock)，这个状态下处理器维持着所有的软件所见的状态信息，但是需要更长的时间来恢复到C0。这个状态下情况最坏的硬件唤醒时间是由ACPI固件提供，并且操作系统可以利用这些信息来决定是采用C1而不是C2状态，C2比C1更省电。
C3 (通常称为Sleep)，相比C1和C2更省电了。这个状态下情况最坏的硬件唤醒时间是由ACPI固件提供，并且操作系统可以利用这些信息来决定是采用C2而不是C3状态，当处于C3状态时，处理器缓存保留了所有的状态信息，但是忽略所有的侦听。操作系统负责保证缓存数据的一致性。
附加的C-State由處理器廠商來定義，如Intel Haswell處理器最多有C10。
target_text: The definition of each state is as follows: C0 is a normal working state, and when the processor is in this state, it is able to handle the instructions properly. C1 (commonly known as the Halt) has the shortest awakening time, which must be provided by the ACPI solidity, and the operating system can use this information to determine that C1 instead of C2 state, C2 is less expensive than C1 state. C3 (commonly known as Sleep), this processor maintains the information that all software sees, but takes longer to restore to C0. The worst recovery time is provided by the ACPI solidity, and the operating system can use this information to determine that C1 instead of C2 state, C2 is less expensive than C1 state-of-the-state data.
title: 高级配置与电源接口

source_text: 在操作系统中使用虚拟内存，每个进程会认为使用一块大的连续的内存。事实上，每个进程的内存散布在物理内存的不同区域。或者可能被调出到备份存储中(一般在硬盘)。当一个进程请求自己的内存，操作系统负责把程序生成的虚拟地址，映射到实际存储的物理内存上。操作系统在分页表中存储虚拟地址到物理地址的映射。每个映射被称为分页表项（page table entry，PTE）。
target_text: Using virtual memory in an operating system, each process is considered to use a large continuous memory. In fact, the memory of each process is dispersed in different areas of physical memory. It may be transferred to a backup storage (usually on a hard disk). When a process requests its own memory, the operating system is responsible for mapping the virtual address generated by the program to the physical memory that is actually stored. The operating system stores a virtual address to the physical address in a pagesheet. Each map is called a page sheet item (pagetable entry, PTE).
title: 分頁表

source_text:
分页表类型
有一些不同的分页表类型，适合不同应用场景。本质上，准系统分页表必需存储虚拟地址，物理地址排在之后，还有一些可能的地址空间信息。倒排分页表
倒排分页表(IPT)被认为是一个标准RAM的TLB的off-chip扩展。不同于一个真实的分页表，IPT不需要处理所有当前映射。操作系统要准备处理丢失，就像mips风格的软件填充TLB。
target_text: In essence, the quasi-system sheet must store virtual addresses, with physical addresses next to them, and some possible address space information. The reverse-page table, inverted-page table (IPT), is considered to be a standard RAM TLB extra-chip extension. Unlike a real sheet, IPT does not have to process all of the current mapping. The operating system is prepared to handle the loss, like the mips-style software filling TLB.

变压器非晶合金结构特点
利用导磁性能突出的非晶合金，来用作制造变压器的铁芯材料，最终能获得很低的损耗值。但它具有许多特性，在设计和制造中是必须保证和考虑的。主要体体现以下几个方面：
非晶合金片材料的硬度很高，用常规工具是难以剪切的，所以设计时应考虑减少剪切量。
非晶合金单片厚度极薄，材料表面也不是很平坦，则铁芯填充系数较低。
非晶合金对机械应力非常敏感。结构设计时，必须避免采用以铁芯作为主承重结构件的传统设计方案。
为了获得优良的低损耗特性，非晶合金铁芯片必须进行退火处理。
从电气性能上。为了减少铁芯片的剪切量，整台产品的铁芯由四个单独的铁心框并列组成，并且每相绕组是套在磁路独立的两框上。每个框内的磁通除基波磁通外，还有三次谐波磁通的存在，一个绕组中的两个卷铁芯框内，其三次谐波磁通正好在相位上相反，数值上相等，因此，每一组绕组内的三次谐波磁通向量和为零。如一次侧是D接法，有三次谐波电流的回路，当在感应出的二次侧电压波形上，就不会有三次谐波电压的分量。
target_text: The main features are: the rigidity of non-crystal alloy material, which is difficult to cut by conventional means, should be designed in such a way as to reduce the cut-off volume; the thinness of the non-crystal alloys, which is not very flat on the surface of the material; the iron core filling factor, which is very sensitive to the mechanical stress; it must be designed in such a way as to avoid the traditional design of the iron core as the main weighting structure; in order to obtain good low-depletion properties, the non-crystal alloy metal chip must be repulsed; it should be designed in such a way that, in order to reduce the cut-off of the iron chip, the iron core of the entire product is not very flat, and the iron core is made up of four separate steel frames and a low filling factor, each of which has a high sensitivity to the mechanical pressure.
title: 非晶合金变压器

source_text: OLE DB（Object Linking and Embedding, Database，对象链接嵌入数据库，有时亦写作OLEDB或OLE-DB）是微软为以统一方式访问不同类型的数据存储设计的一种应用程序接口，是一组用组件对象模型（COM）实现的接口，而与对象连接与嵌入（OLE）无关。它被设计成为ODBC的一种高级替代者和继承者，把它的功能扩展到支持更多种类的非关系型数据库，例如可能不支持SQL的对象数据库和电子表格（如Excel）。
target_text: OLE DB (Object Linking and Embedding, Database, Object Links embedded in a database, sometimes written as OLEDB or OLE-DB) is an application interface for Microsoft to access different types of data storage designs in a uniform manner, a set of interfaces realized by component object models (COM) and not related to object connections to embedded (OLE). It is designed to be an advanced alternative to and successor to ODSC, extending its functionality to support a wider range of non-relationship-type databases, such as object databases and spreadsheets (e.g. Excel) that may not support SQL.
title: OLE DB

source_text: OLE DB用一组抽象概念（包括数据源、会话、命令和行集）将数据的存储从需要访问数据的应用中分离出来。这是因为不同的应用需要访问不同数据类型和数据源，但是并不需要了解具体如何使用特定技术的方法访问这些数据。OLE DB在概念上分为了消费者和提供者。消费者是那些需要访问数据的应用程序，提供者是实现了那些接口并将数据提供给消费者的软件组件。OLE DB是微软数据访问组件（MDAC）的一部分。MDAC是一组微软技术，以框架的方式相互作用，为程序员开发访问几乎任何数据存储提供了一个统一并全面的方法。OLE DB的提供者可以用于提供像文本文件和电子表格一样简单的数据存储的访问，也可以提供像Oracle、SQL Server和Sybase ASE一样复杂的数据库的访问。OLE DB同样可以提供对层次类型的数据存储（如电子邮件系统）的访问。
target_text: OLE DB uses an abstract set of concepts (including data sources, conversations, commands and rows) to separate data storage from applications requiring access to data. This is because different applications require access to different data types and sources, but there is no need to know how to access these data using specific techniques. OLE DB is conceptually divided into consumers and providers. Consumers are applications that require access to data, and the providers are software components that achieve interfaces and make the data available to consumers. OLE DB is part of the Microsoft Data Access Component (MDAC). MDAC is a group of Microsoft technologies that interact in a framework that provides a uniform and comprehensive approach to programmers developing access to almost any data storage. OLE DB providers can provide simple data storage access like text files and spreadsheets, as well as access to sophisticated databases like Oracle, SQL Server and Sybase.
title: OLE DB

对象数据库包含4类对象：
blob （-{zh-cn:二进制大对象;zh-tw:二進位大型物件}-）是使用zlib压缩算法对一个文件的内容压缩后的结果。Blobs没有保存文件名、时间戳或其他元数据。git将其存储在位于隐藏的.git/objects文件夹中。文件的名称为使用SHA-1哈希函数对原文件内容生成的哈希值。这些对象文件称为Blob，每次将新文件添加到存储库时会创建Blob对象。

target_text: The object database contains four categories of objects: blob (-{zh-cn: binary large objects); zh-tw: binary large objects} --) is the result of compressing the contents of a document using the zlib compression algorithm. Blobs does not keep file names, time stampes or other metadata. Git stores them in a hidden .git/objects folder. The file is named Hashi values generated from the original file using the SHA-1 Hashi function. The object file is named Blob, and each time a new file is added to the repository, it creates a Blob object. Tree objects correspond to the file directory.

source_text:
编程
在编程这一阶段里，电子控制器把数据载入至存储器中。数据的每一个单元是一个用来表示当前时刻信号幅度的二进制数。存储器中这些数据的排列（数组）构成一张振幅表，表示每一时刻当前波形的振幅。举个例子，在一张振幅表中，前一半的数全为0，后一半全为波形振幅的最大值（100%），这些数据就表示“方波”了。任何波形都可以通过简单地改变这些数据来产生。
target_text: In the programming phase, the data are entered into the memory by the electronic controller. Each cell of the data is a binary number used to indicate the signal range at the current time. The array of data in the memory form an amplitude table indicating the amplitude of the current wave form at each time. For example, in an amplitude table, the first half is zero, and the second half is the maximum wave amplitude value (100%), which means "square wave". Any wave form can be produced by simply changing the data.
title: 直接数字合成

source_text:
实际执行中通常在32位的相位累加器和相位自增中设置查找表在大小为2的n次方。通常计数器的高位8或10比特用作查找表的索引（查找表的大小通常为256或1024）。剩余的低位比特可被作为参数或索引，用来窜改查找表中邻近的数据。经常用线性插值法来实现。频率源通常由一个1MHz至100MHz的晶振产生。
最高频率产生的方式取决于查找表的大小和（频率源的）频率。为了能产生清晰的波形，（查找表中）必须拥有最少的采样点。如果相位自增幅度太大，计数器阅遍查找表太快从而导致输出信号的失真。
DDS的实现有软件与硬件两种。由于DDS的实时性，软件的实现通常只用于声音频率的产生。
target_text: In practice, 32-bit phase amplifiers and phase self-increments are usually set up with a search table at a size of 2 n. The highest frequency is generated by the size of the search table and the frequency (of the frequency source). In order to produce a clear wave form, a minimum sampling point (of the search table) is required. If the phase is too large, the arrays look at the table too quickly to see the data adjacent to the table, which leads to a loss of output signals. DDS is achieved by both software and hardware. Because of the real-time nature of the DDS, software realization is usually used only to produce sound frequencies.
title: 直接数字合成

source_text: EMV是國際金融業界對於智慧與可使用晶片卡的POS終端機及自動櫃員機（ATM）等所制定的标准。EMV智慧卡（也称为IC卡）的信息储存在集成电路中而非过去的磁条里，但大部分EMV卡背也有可以向下兼容的磁条。芯片可以和插入式读卡器交换数据，非接触式智能卡还可以使用射频识别（RFID）技术在一定范围内交换数据。符合EMV标准的支付卡叫做芯片卡。
target_text: The EMV is a standard set by the international financial industry for intelligence and the use of transistors, such as the POS terminal and the ATM. The EMV smartcard (also known as the IC card) is stored in integrated circuits rather than in past magnets, but most EMV cards have magnetic bars that can be compatible down. Chips can exchange data with inserted card readers, and non-contact smart cards can exchange data using radio frequency recognition (RFID) techniques. The payment card that meets the EMV criteria is called a chip card.
title: EMV

target_text: Arsenicization is a gray and black semiconductor, with a molecular formula of Cd3As2. Its energy gap is 0.14 eV, which is narrower than the other semiconductors. The crystalline construction is a quadrant crystalline system. It has a very high rate of electronic transport, which is a N-module semiconductor, and is used as an undeterminate semiconductor. Cadmium arsenicification has a dynamic effect and is used in far-infrared sensors and pressure sensors. It can also be used to create magnetic resistance and optical detectors.

source_text:
相关项目
该项目有很多相关子项目：
Beyond Linux From Scratch（BLFS）标准LFS仅仅安装了足够让系统启动的基本软件，以及使新系统能够编译新软件包的开发工具。BLFS包括了更多的软件包，且都有相应指导。
Cross Linux From Scratch（CLFS）为需要进行交叉编译（即在一个平台上编译另一个平台的代码）的用户提供指导，正式版本为1.0，另有两个变种
CLFS Sysroot 采用Sysroot的方法来进行编译，好处是软件包的编译次数可以减少，坏处是不能支持在编译后对软件进行测试，必须要启动到目标平台上才能测试。
CLFS Embedded 一般用于极小系统以及嵌入式系统。为此，它使用uclibc而不是一般LFS使用的glibc。
该项目已停止维护，其官网已无法访问
Automated Linux From Scratch（ALFS）标准LFS只是一本书，用户需要根据书上的指引下载软件包并手动输入指令进行编译。ALFS子项目提供了把这一切自动化的脚本。
Hardened Linux From Scratch（HLFS）这个子项目致力于打造在安全性上无懈可击的Linux系统。
Hints收集一些解释性、增强性的文档，以协助用户
LiveCD利用LFS的方法生成可以自行启动并安装了足够软件的CD，可以用来在空机器上安装LFS，或者直接在其上运行应用，已经停止维护
Patches由于软件之间的依赖关系，在升级软件包之后可能会导致LFS的过程出现故障。Patch项目致力于研究最新版本的软件之间的互动，并提供一些补丁修复这些故障。
除此之外，该项目另有一个名为CBLFS（Community Driven BLFS）的项目，该项目实际是一个Wiki网站，依靠网友的自发贡献来提交各种软件包的安装方式。

target_text: In addition to biology, the theory of co-evolvement was initially a biologic concept, but it has been extended to other fields of study. The algorithm for co-evolvement is an algorithm used to generate and optimize artificial life, cascading learning and machine learning. This algorithm was proposed and implemented by Daniel Hillis and Karl Sims, among others. source_text:
历史
1990年代， UUID 原本是用于阿波羅電腦的网络计算系统，后被用于开放软件基金会的分散式運算環境。分散式運算環境UUID的初始设计基于网络计算系统UUID，其设计受 Domain/OS 中定义和使用的（64位）唯一标识符的启发，这是一个也由 阿波羅電腦 设计的操作系统。后来，微軟視窗平台采用分散式運算環境设计作为全局唯一标识符（GUID）。
target_text: In the 1990s, UUID was originally used as a network computing system for Apollo computers and was subsequently used for the decentralized operating environment of the Open Software Foundation. The initial design of the decentralized UUID environment was based on a network computing system, UUID, inspired by the unique identifier (64-bit) defined and used in Domain/OS, an operating system that was also designed by Apollo computers.
title: 通用唯一识别码

source_text: 时间戳的是这样计算的：自公曆首次於天主教會和教皇國以外的地方使用的日期，也就是协调世界时（UTC）1582年10月15日午夜算起，每經過100納秒時間戳加1。RFC 4122声明时间值在公元3400年左右算術溢位，取决于所使用的算法，代表此 60-bit 时间戳是有符号数量。但是，某些软件（如libuuid库）将时间戳视为无符号，把溢位時間推遲至公元5236年。ITU-T Rec. X.667所定義的溢位時間為公元3603年。
target_text: The time stamp is calculated as follows: the date used for the first time in the calendar outside the Catholic Church and the Pope, i.e., at midnight on 15 October 1582 at the time of world harmonization (UTC), is added to each 100 ns. RFC 4122 states that the time value of the calculation overflows around 3400 A.C. depending on the calculation used, the 60-bit time stamp represents a number of symbols. However, some software (e.g., the Libuid Library Library) treats the time stamp as unsigned, delaying the spill time to 5236 A.D. The spill time specified in ITU-T Rec. X.667 is 3603 A.D.
title: 通用唯一识别码

source_text: 在计算机科学中，软件事务内存（，縮寫為STM），又譯為交易記憶體，軟體交換式記憶體，是一种并发控制机制，模拟数据库事务的機制，控制在并行计算时对共享内存的访问控制。它是锁的一种替代机制。在STM中，一个事务指的是一段读、写共享内存的代码。这些读写操作在逻辑上是一个独立的单元，其中间状态对于其它的事务而言，是不可见的。
target_text: In computer science, the memory of software services (as initialized as STM) is translated into a transaction memory, a software exchange memory, a parallel control mechanism that simulates the mechanism of database services and controls access to shared memory during parallel calculations. It is an alternative to locks. In STM, one of these transactions refers to a code that reads and writes shared memory. These reading and writing operations are logically a stand-alone unit, in which the interstellar state is not visible for other matters.
title: 软件事务内存

source_text: 理论上，在最糟糕的情况下，当n个并发事务同时运行，他们需要n倍的内存和处理器，实际的需要取决于具体的实现细节（比如说一个事务可以尽早的失败以避免后续额外的开销）。在某些应用场景下，基于Lock机制的算法会比基于STM机制的算法更好。概念上的优势和劣势
target_text: Theoretically, in the worst-case scenario, when n parallels run simultaneously, they need a n-fold memory and processor, and the actual need depends on the details of the achievement (e.g. a transaction can fail as early as possible to avoid additional costs). In some applications, a Lock-based algorithm would be better than an STM-based algorithm.

source_text: 大多数ISP必须使用BGP来与其他ISP建立路由连接（尤其是当它们采取多宿主连接时）。因此，即使大多数互联网用户不直接使用它，但是与7号信令系统——即通过PSTN的跨供应商核心响应设置协议相比，BGP仍然是互联网最重要的协议之一。特大型的私有IP网络也可以使用BGP。例如，当需要将若干个大型的OSPF（开放最短路径优先）网络进行合并，而OSPF本身又无法提供这种可扩展性时。使用BGP的另一个原因是其能为多宿主的单个或多个ISP（RFC 1998）网络提供更好的冗余。
target_text: Most ISPs have to use BGP to establish route connections with other ISPs (especially when they have multiple host connections). Thus, even if most Internet users do not use it directly, BGP remains one of the most important Internet-related protocols compared to the BGP system 7 – a cross-supplier core response setting protocol through PSTN. A very large private IP network can also use BGPs. For example, when a number of large OSF (openest path preference) networks need to be merged, and the OSF itself cannot provide this expansion. Another reason for using BGP is that it can provide better redundancy for multiple host individual or multiple ISP (RFC 1998) networks.
title: 边界网关协议

source_text:
历史
BGP是为了取代外部网关协议（EGP）协议而创建的，其允许运行一个完全分散的路由系统，从ARPANET模型的核心路由系统过渡到包括NSFNET骨干网及其相关区域网络的分散系统。这使得互联网成为一个真正的分权制度。自1994年以来，第四版的BGP在互联网上使用，所有以前的版本现在都已过时且不可用。第4版中主要的增强功能是通过支持无类别域间路由和路由聚合来减少路由表的大小。第4版（BGP-4）是在早期的 RFC 1771 第4版的基础上编纂，通过20多个草案修改，最终在2006年1月通过，形成 RFC 4271。RFC 4271 版本纠正了一些错误，澄清模糊之处，带来了更接近工业级应用标准的RFC行业惯例。
target_text: The historical BGP was created to replace the External Gateway Protocol (EGP) agreement, which allows for the operation of a completely decentralized route system, from the core route of the ARPANET model to a decentralized system that includes NSFNET backbone networks and their associated regional networks. This makes the Internet a truly decentralized system. Since 1994, the fourth edition of BGP has been used on the Internet, and all previous versions are now obsolete and not available. The main enhancements in Release 4 have been to reduce the size of the route chart by supporting inter-area routers without category and integration by route. Version 4 (BGP-4) has been compiled on the basis of the early version 4 of the RFC 1771, which was revised through more than 20 drafts and finally adopted in January 2006, resulting in RFC 4271. RFC 4271 has corrected errors, clarified ambiguities and introduced RFC industry practices closer to the application criteria at the industrial level.
title: 边界网关协议

source_text:
BGP配置错误事件
BGP配置对于互联网流量路由至关重要，配置错误，经过BGP的自动扩散，会导致互联网流量紊乱甚至中断。
AS 7007事件
2018年11月14日，尼日尼亚互联网服务商MainOne由于配置错误，将直连Google的网络路由泄漏到中国电信的网络，然后通过中国电信的BGP传播到其他ISP中，导致一部分北美连接Google服务的流量通过迂回的AS路径传输。MainOne其后承认出现错误。
2019年6月6日，甲骨文的一名安全分析师发现瑞士資料中心托管商Safe Host的AS泄露了7万个路由记录到中国电信的网络，并通过中国电信的BGP传播，导致部分欧洲的互联网流量绕进了中国电信的网络，这个配置错误至少延续了2个小时。
2019年6月25日，美国互联网运营商Verizon将其客户Allegheny Technologies泄漏的来自DQE Communications BGP优化器的路由传播到其他ISP中，导致北美部分地区的流量通过DQE Communications传输，导致网络瘫痪。
2021年Facebook當機事件：2021年10月4日，由于配置错误，Facebook的DNS权威服务器地址通过BGP撤销，导致用户和Facebook的其他服务的服务器无法根据DNS获得相应的服务器地址，导致Facebook的网络服务中断了6~7小时。
target_text: On 14 November 2018, as a result of an error in the configuration of BGP’s faulty incident, BGP configuring to other ISPs resulted in some North American traffic connected to Google’s service being transmitted via a bypassed AS route. Mainone subsequently admitted an error. On 6 June 2019, an Oracle security analyst discovered that the Swiss data centre’s host, Safé Host, had leaked 70,000 routes from the network that had been recorded in China’s telecommunications network and, through the BGP of China’s telecommunications, the flow of Internet traffic to other ISPs, leading to at least two hours of error in the transmission of some North American traffic to the Chinese telecommunications network.
title: 边界网关协议

source_text: 该片于2001年3月上映。Linux的崛起让微软倍感压力，时任微软首席执行官史蒂芬·鲍尔默2001年6月1日在接受《芝加哥太阳报》专访时表示：“是的，（Linux 和开源软件运动）是一个竞争者。它迫使我们创新。它使得我们需要证明我们交付的产品的价值。这本身是健康的。问题在于政府资助了开源工作。政府应当资助所有人都能够得到的工作。而开源对于商业公司不可用。开源许可证（指GPL）使得你使用了任何的开源软件，你必须让你的软件的其余部分也开源。如果政府想把什么放到公有领域，那么它应当这么做。Linux不属于公有领域。从知识产权的角度来看，它是一种癌症，它附着在它所接触的一切事物上。这就是这个许可证的工作方式”。
target_text: The film was released in March 2001. Linux’s rise put pressure on Microsoft’s CEO, Stephen Bormer, who was interviewed in the Chicago Sun on 1 June 2001 and said, “Yes, the Linux and Open Source Software Campaign are competitors. It compels us to innovate. It makes us have to prove the value of the products we deliver. It is healthy. The problem is that the government finances open-source work. The open-source software is not available to all. The open-source software (known as the GPL) makes you use any open source software, and you have to open up the rest of your software. If the government wants to put what is in the public domain, it should do so. Linux is not in the public domain. From the intellectual property perspective, it is a cancer, and it is attached to everything it has come into contact with.

source_text:
电池与半导体器件
1901年爱迪生使用一氧化镍作为阴极，铁为阳极，发明了镍铁电池。在镍镉电池刚发现的时候，也是使用一氧化镍作电极，但由于低温性能不好和制造成本较高，现在已经逐渐被锂电池取代了。但近来，一氧化镍的p型半导体（表面含有多余正离子）特性开始引起研究者的注意，当一氧化镍吸附气体或外加电场后，其表面的镍离子数目发生变化，从而改变一氧化镍的导电性和颜色，因此一氧化镍薄膜可以被用于制造电阻型半导体气敏元件和电致变色(electrochromic)器件。
target_text: Batteries and semiconductor devices in Edyson in 1901 used nickel monoxide as a cathode, iron as an anode, and invented nickel iron batteries. When nickel cadmium batteries were discovered, nickel monoxide was also used as an electrode, but it has been gradually replaced by lithium batteries because of poor cryogenic performance and high manufacturing costs. Recently, however, nickel monoxide type p semiconductor (surface containing excess nuclei) characteristics began to draw the attention of researchers to changes in the number of nickel ions on the surface of nickel monoxide adsorbing gas or extra electric fields, thereby changing the conductivity and colour of nickel monoxide, so that nickel monoxide thin film can be used to manufacture electrically-resistive semiconductor gas-sensitive components and electro-transformation (electrochromic) devices.
title: 一氧化镍

source_text: 先进先出算法（FIFO）替换掉进入组内时间最长的缓存块。最久未使用算法（LRU）则跟踪各个缓存块的使用状况，并根据统计比较出哪个块已经最长时间未被访问。对于2路以上相联，这个算法的时间代价会非常高。对最久未使用算法的一个近似是非最近使用（NMRU）。这个算法仅记录哪一个缓存块是最近被使用的。在替换时，会随机替换掉任何一个其他的块。故称非最近使用。相比于LRU，这种算法仅需硬件为每一个缓存块增加一个使用位（use bit）即可。
target_text: First, the FIFO replaces the cache that has been in the group for the longest time. For the longest time, the non-use of the algorithm (LRU) tracks the use of each of the caches and compares statistically which one has not been visited for the longest time. For links to more than two paths, the time cost of the algorithm is very high. An approximation of the non-recent use (NMRU) of the oldest unused algorithm. This algorithm records only which of the caches is recently used. In the case of replacement, any other block is randomly replaced.
title: CPU缓存

source_text: 第一，引入虚拟地址的一个重要原因是在软件（操作系统）级进行页面保护，以防止进程间相互侵犯地址空间。由于这种保护是通过页表和翻译旁视缓冲器（TLB）中的保护位（protection bit）实现的，直接使用虚拟地址来访问数据等于绕过了页面保护。一个解决办法是在缓存失效时查看TLB对应表项的保护位以确定是否可以加载缺失的数据。
target_text: First, an important reason for introducing virtual addresses is page protection at the software (operational system) level to prevent inter-processes from encroaching on address space. Since this protection is achieved through the protection position (protection bit) in the page sheet and the translator's visual buffer, direct access to the data via a virtual address is a circumvention of page protection. One solution is to look at the protected position of the TLB corresponding table item at the time the cache fails to work to determine whether missing data can be loaded.
title: CPU缓存

source_text: 第三，别名问题（Alias）。由于操作系统可能允许页面别名，即多个虚拟页面映射至同一物理页面，使用虚拟地址做标签将可能导致一份数据在缓存中出现多份拷贝的情形。这种情况下如果对其中一份拷贝作出修改，而其他拷贝没有同步更新，则数据丧失整合性，导致程序错误。有两个解决办法：（1）硬件级反别名。当缓存载入目标数据时，确认缓存内没有缓存块的标签是此地址的别名。如果有则不载入，而直接返回别名缓存块内的数据。（2）页面着色（Page Coloring）。这种技术是由操作系统对页面别名作出限制，使指向同一页面的别名页面具有相同的低端地址。这样，只要缓存的索引范围足够小，就能保证在缓存中决不会出现来自不同别名页面的数据。
target_text: Third, aliases (Alias). Since the operating system may allow a page alias, that is, multiple virtual page maps to the same physical page, labeling using a virtual address may result in multiple copies of a data in a cache. If one copy is modified in this case and the other copies are not updated in a synchronized manner, the data loses integration, leading to a procedural error. There are two solutions: (1) the hardware level reverse name. When the cache contains the target data, the tag confirming that there are no caches in the cache is the alias of the address. If it is not loaded, then the data in the alias is returned directly to the cache. (2) The colour of the page (Page Coloring). This technique is a restriction by the operating system on the name of the page, which gives the same low address to the other page pointing to the same page.
title: CPU缓存

source_text:
减少命中时间虚索引、实标签缓存
理论上，完全使用虚拟地址可以获得更快的缓存访问速度，因为这样仅在缓存失效时才会进行地址翻译。但是，如前所述，这种纯虚地址缓存由于绕开了操作系统对进程访问地址的软件控制，会存在不少问题。为了能接近虚缓存的访问速度，又能避开虚缓存带来的种种问题，引入了所谓虚索引、实标签缓存（virtually indexed, physically tagged）。这种结构的缓存可以令地址翻译和缓存查询并发进行，大大加快了缓存的访问速度。详见地址翻译一节。
target_text: The theory is that full use of a virtual address can provide faster speeds of access to the cache, because it only translates to the address when the cache fails. But, as noted earlier, this virtual address cache can be problematic by circumventing the software controls of the operating system on process access to the address. In order to be able to approach the speed of access to the cache, and avoid the problems posed by the cache, the so-called virtual index, virtual indexed, physical tagged has been introduced.
title: CPU缓存

source_text:
小而简单的缓存
由于电路延迟很大程度上取决于存储芯片的大小，所以可考虑使用较小容量的缓存以保证最短的访问周期。这么做的另一个好处是，由于一级缓存足够小，可以把二级缓存的全部或部分也集成到CPU芯片上，从而减少了二级缓存的命中时间。
target_text: A small and simple cache, because circuit delays depend to a large extent on the size of the memory chip, could be considered to use a smaller-capacity cache to ensure the shortest access period. Another advantage of this is that, as the first-level cache is small enough, all or part of the second-level cache can be integrated into the CPU chip, thereby reducing the lifetime of the second-level cache.
title: CPU缓存

source_text: 有些BitTorrent客户端用户下載完成后就關掉下载任务，全过程只提供了较少量数据给其他用户。为尽量避免这种行为，在非官方BitTorrent协议中存在超级种子的算法。这种算法对文件发布者的种子文件有要求。文件发布者可以分几步发布文件，发布者不需要一次提供文件所有内容，而是慢慢开放的下载内容的比例，延长下载时间。此时，速度快的人由于未下载完必须提供给他人数据，速度慢的人有更多机会得到数据。
target_text: Some BitTorrent client downloads after they have been done, and the whole process provides only a small amount of data to other users. To avoid this, there is a superseed algorithm in the unofficial BitTorrent protocol. This algorithm requires seed files from file publishers. File publishers can publish documents in a few steps, and publishers do not need to provide all the contents of the document at once, but rather the proportion of downloads that are slowly open, increasing the download time.

source_text: Google（中文譯名：-{zh-cn:谷歌;zh-tw:谷歌／科高;}-）是总部位于美国加州山景城的跨國科技公司，為Alphabet（字母控股）的子公司，业务范围涵盖互联网广告、互联网搜索、云计算等领域，开发并提供大量基于互联网的产品与服务，其主要利润来自Ads和AdSense等广告服务。Google由在斯坦福大学攻读理工博士的拉里·佩奇和谢尔盖·布林共同创建，因此两人也被称为“”。
target_text: Google (Chinese: - {zh-cn: Google; h-tw: Google/cogau;}-) is a multinational technology company based in Mountview, California, United States of America. It is a subsidiary of Alphabet (A letter-held) that develops and delivers a large number of Internet-based products and services in the areas of Internet advertising, Internet search, cloud computing, and whose main profit is from advertising services such as Ads and AdSense. Google was created by Larry Peach and Sergei Blin of the University of Stanford, so they are also referred to as “.”
title: Google

source_text: Google自创立起开始的快速成长同时也带动了一系列的产品研发、并购事项与合作关系，而不仅仅是公司核心的网络搜索业务。Google公司提供丰富的线上软件服务，如雲端硬碟、电子邮件，包括、以及在内的社交网络服务。Google的产品同时也以应用软件的形式进入用户桌面，例如网页浏览器、图片整理与编辑软件、即时通讯工具等。另外，Google还进行了移动设备的操作系统以及操作系统的开发。其安卓系统至今为止仍是移动端的主要操作系统之一。硬件系列方面，則有Google Pixel手機及平板電腦，穿戴裝置如Google Pixel Watch及Google Pixel Buds等。
target_text: Google’s rapid growth since its creation has also led to a series of product research and development, mergers and acquisitions, and partnerships, not just web search operations at the company’s core. Google provides a wealth of online software services, such as cloud hard disks, e-mails, including social networking services. Google’s products are also entering user desktops in the form of application software, such as web browsers, photo collation and editing software, and instant communication tools. Google has also developed operating systems for mobile devices, as well as operating systems.
title: Google

source_text: 除了收购的方式以外，Google也积极地与其他公司或组织进行合作，从科研到商业广告，都是开展合作所涉及的领域。2005年，Google与美国国家航空航天局艾姆斯研究中心合作建设了用于囊括了大规模数据管理、纳米技术、分布式计算、航空航天产业等科研项目的场所，占地约93000平方米。 2005年10月，Google与Sun Microsystems交换并分享了各自的技术。 Google也和AOL及时代华纳达成商业伙伴关系，以增强各自视频搜索服务的质量。 2005年，Google与微软、诺基亚、爱立信联手，为顶级域名.mobi融资。而后Google启动了Adsense for Mobile，开拓移动广告市场。2006年，新闻集团旗下的福克斯互动媒体同Google达成一份9亿美元的协议，Google为社交网站MySpace提供搜索与广告业务。 2007年，Google与34家手机制造商、芯片制造商、软件开发商和电信运营商一同创建了开放手机联盟，开发Android系统与苹果iOS、微软Windows Phone等移动平台竞争。
target_text: In addition to the modalities of the acquisition, Google actively cooperated with other companies or organizations, from research to commercial advertising. In 2005, Google partnered with the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) Ames Research Centre to build sites for large-scale data management, nanotechnologies, distribution calculations, aerospace industries, etc., covering some 93,000 square metres of land. In October 2005, Google exchanged and shared their own technologies. Google and AOL and Time Warner also entered into a business partnership to enhance the quality of their video search services. In 2005, Google collaborated with Microsoft, Nokia and Ericsson to finance top-level domain names.
title: Google

source_text: Google搜索是Google公司重要也是最普及的一项功能，是多个国家内使用率最高的互联网搜索引擎。根据2009年11月公布的市场统计，Google在美国搜索引擎市场上占有率为65.6%。 Google抓取数十亿的互联网网页，因此用户能通过搜索关键词等操作较为轻松地获取想要搜寻的信息。除了最基本的文字搜索功能之外，Google搜索还提供至少22种特殊功能，如同义词、天气预报、时区、股价、地图、地震数据、电影放映时间、机场、体育赛事比分等。Google搜索在搜索与数字相关的信息时又会有另一些特殊功能：如单位换算、货币换算、数字运算、包裹追踪、地区代码。同时，Google也为搜索页面提供语言翻译功能。2011年，Google先后推出语音搜索和图片搜索。
target_text: Google search is an important and most popular feature of Google’s Internet search engine. According to market statistics published in November 2009, Google has 65.6% access to billions of Internet pages in the United States search engine market, making it easier for users to access the information they want to search by searching keywords. In addition to the most basic text search functions, Google also offers at least 22 special features, such as terminology, weather forecasting, time zones, stock prices, maps, seismic data, film screening times, airports, sports competitions, etc. Google search has other special features when searching for digital-related information: unit translation, currency conversion, digital computing, package tracking, and area code.

source_text: 2007年，Google正计划开发自己的移动设备与苹果的iPhone竞争的报道逐渐浮出水面。后来证实该项目名为Android，并非手机的名称，而是一款移动设备的操作系统。Android于2005年被Google收购，并发展为Apache许可证下的开源项目，同时Google为开发者们提供了软件开发工具包以便开发出在Android手机上运行的应用，并拉拢了世界上多家手机制造商、电信运营商、软件开发商等，组建了开放手机联盟以共同开发Android系统。 2008年9月，T-Mobile发布第一款运行Android系统的手机G1（HTC dream的T-Mobile定制版）。 2010年1月5日，Google公司发布自有的一款手机，名为Nexus One。在2010年第四季度的分析报告中，Android被列为全世界最畅销的智能手机操作系统。
target_text: In 2007, Google was planning to develop its own mobile equipment in competition with Apple's iPhone. It was later confirmed that the project was known as Android, not as a mobile phone, but as an operating system for mobile devices. Android was acquired by Google in 2005 and developed as an open source project under the Apache licence, while Google provided developers with software development toolkits to develop applications operating on Android's mobile phone and to bring together the world's many mobile phone manufacturers, telecommunications operators, software developers, etc. Android was listed in the fourth quarter of 2010 as the world's most popular smart mobile phone operating system.
title: Google

source_text: Android有着数目庞大的应用软件，得以大大扩充其系统功能。目前，能在Android上运行的应用软件超过了75万种，并仍处于高速增加的过程中。Google Play是Google运营的电子应用软件商店，但用户也可以从第三方下载与安装软件。开发者们主要用Java语言编写软件，并通过Google开发的Java库来使应用软件适配系统。

target_text: Google launched the Google News Service in 2002. On February 7, 2006, Venton Sev, one of the inventors of the Internet Protocol (IP), as well as the Vice-President of Google and the “Chief Internet Commissioner” said in Congress: “To allow broadband operators to control what people see on the Internet or do what fundamentally undermines the principles of network neutrality that have brought so much success to the Internet.”
title: Google

source_text: 在2010年的Techonomy大会上，施密特预测“实名而非匿名”是引领因特网前进的要素：“在一个充满不同步威胁的世界裡，若没有方法可以辨认你是谁将会很危险。我们需要为人们提供一个实名验证的服务。政府也需要它。”“如果我看了足够多关于你的消息和所在位置，我们就能用人工智能预测你要去哪里。给我们你的14张照片，我们就能辨别出你。你想你没有14张照片在互联网上？实际上在你的Facebook照片裡就有！”
target_text: At the 2010 Techonomy Congress, Schmidt predicted that “the real name, not the anonymous” was the key to leading the Internet forward: “In a world full of unsynchronous threats, it would be dangerous if there was no way to identify who you were. We need to provide people with a proven service. The government also needs it.” “If I see enough information about you and where you are, we can predict where you're going with artificial intelligence. Give us your 14 pictures, and we can identify you. Do you think you don't have 14 photos on the Internet?
title: Google

source_text: TOM-Skype，是TOM集团旗下北京讯能网络有限公司TOM在线和Skype于2004年11月在中国大陆联合推出的Skype中国大陆版即时通讯软件。从2007年开始，访问Skype官方网站skype.com的大陆用户会被重定向至Tom版Skype网站skype.tom.com。截至2007年6月底，TOM-Skype注册用户已经突破4200万，超越美国成为Skype全球最大的市场。TOM在线也为中国大陆用户推出了几款仅能在TOM-Skype使用的中国大陆特别优惠卡和电话月费计划（如Skype国内卡，国际版Skype无法使用）。然而，TOM-Skype由于其含有文字审查过滤系统，故该版本软件的安全性和隐私性一直备受诟病。2013年11月20日，微软与TOM集团终止合作。
target_text: Tom-Skype, an online live communication software for Skype mainland China, launched jointly in mainland China in November 2004 by TOM-Skype Ltd. and Skype. Since 2007, mainland users accessing Skype official website skype.com will be redirected to the Tom version of Skype website skype.com. By the end of June 2007, TOM-Skype registered users had broken out by 42 million, surpassing the United States as Skype’s largest global market.
title: TOM-Skype

source_text:
Skype公司的反应
Skype指TOM-Skype，在2006年已經按照中华人民共和国政府的规定，使用文本过滤器来监控敏感信息。不过包含敏感关键字的信息会在客户端被丢弃，故对用户的隐私并无威胁。不过，TOM-Skype后来在未经Skype同意的情况下擅自改变了该过滤器的功能，存储了部分用户的信息。随后，Skype的总裁Josh Silverman在Skype官方网志上发表声明，表示自己公司很“无辜”和“无奈”。他又指出这份报告只涉及用户有使用TOM-Skype软件来进行文本通信的情况。如果双方都使用来自官方网站Skype.com的软件，那么不会受到任何影响。最后，Skype作出了道歉声明。
target_text: Skype’s response to Skype refers to TOM-Skype, which in 2006 used text filters to monitor sensitive information, as prescribed by the Government of the People’s Republic of China. However, the information containing sensitive keywords is discarded on the client’s side, thus not threatening the privacy of users. ToM-Skype, however, later changed the filter’s functionality without Skype’s consent, storing some user’s information. Subsequently, Josh Silverman, the CEO of Skype, made a statement on Skype’s official web site, stating that his company was “innocent” and “unhelpful”. He added that the report concerned only users using the TOM-Skype software for text communications.
title: TOM-Skype

source_text:
开发历史
20世纪90年代末期，Intrinsic Graphics开发了一个3D游戏软件库。为了演示他们的产品，他们开发了一个可以放大旋转的三维地球模型。这是Google地球的技术原型。在1999年，Intrinsic创立了Keyhole公司，该公司由领导。约翰·汉克表示，他创立这个公司的灵感来源于尼尔·斯蒂芬森的小说《》中的一个“虚拟地球”。Keyhole开发了一种向客户端传输大型地图数据库的技术，并从NASA、地方政府和其他商业公司获取了最初的卫星地图数据。之后，Keyhole利用这些技术和数据，开发了“Keyhole EarthViewer”，这个软件能将卫星和航拍图片无缝拼接在3D地球模型上。但由于互聯網泡沫的影响，Keyhole在成立之初就遇到了资金枯竭的问题。
target_text: In the late 1990s, Intrinsic Graphics developed a 3D software bank. To demonstrate their products, they developed a three-dimensional Earth model that magnified the rotation. This is the technological prototype of Google Earth. In 1999, Intrinsic created Keyhole, a leading company. John Hank said that he was inspired by a "virtual Earth" in Neil Stephenson's novel. Keyhole developed a technology for transmitting large map databases to clients and obtained initial satellite map data from NASA, local governments and other business companies.
title: Google地球

source_text:
Google Earth Studio
Google Earth Studio是一个基于浏览器的动画制作软件，可以模拟航拍视角，为3D城市模型录制视频。Google Earth Studio的界面类似于主流的非线性视频编辑软件，具有完整的时间线和关键帧编辑功能。用户可以将镜头推远或拉近，或环绕某个物体拍摄，也可以自行设定飞行路线，将镜头从一个物体转移到另一个物体来拍摄。此工具并不能导出完整视频，只能以PNG格式导出所有帧。
target_text: Google Earth Studio Earth Studio is an animation software based on browsers that simulates the aerial view and records videos for 3D city models. Google Earth Studio has a similar interface to the mainstream non-linear video editing software, with complete timelines and key frame editing. Users can drive the camera further or close, or circle an object, or set their own flight route, moving the camera from one object to another. This tool does not export the full video, but only all frames in PNG format.
title: Google地球

source_text:
软件问题
2009年，安裝Google地球的新版本時，會自動下載Google提供的軟件升級程序。如果后台没有运行此更新程序，Google地球将无法运行。《连线》杂志认为，未经用户同意的自动更新会给用户的计算机安全带来风险，而且使用付费网络自动下载更新会带来不必要的流量消耗。
target_text: In 2009, when a new version of Google Earth is installed, the software upgrades provided by Google will automatically be downloaded. If the update is not run from the backstage, Google Earth will not be able to run. Wire magazine argues that automatic updates without user consent pose a risk to the user ' s computer security, and that automatic downloads of updates using fee-based networks will result in unnecessary traffic consumption.
title: Google地球

source_text: Google地球使用的演算法將眾多衛星圖片以計算拼接方式形成大圖，有時造成影像錯位和扭曲效果。如2019年7月初，網上有傳聞通过Google衛星圖指出三峽大壩發生變形並有可能潰壩。其後三峽集團澄清，表示大壩運行正常，指出Google衛星圖並非由衛星直接拍攝，而是基於一系列演算法處理形成，因此在顯示某些場景時會出現偏差。
target_text: The algorithms used by Google have created large maps of multisatellite images to calculate the puzzle, sometimes resulting in image mispositions and distortions. For example, in early July 2019, there were rumours on the Internet that, through Google's satellite map, there had been a change in shape of the three canals and that there was a risk of evaporation. The latter three groups clarified that the dam was running normally, noting that Google satellite maps were not directly taken by the satellite, but were based on a series of algorithms, which led to deviations in the presentation of certain scenarios.
title: Google地球

source_text:
歷史
1902年，京师大学堂设数学物理部，这是中国数理学科高等教育的开端。
1913年，北京大学设物理门（后改名为物理系），这是中国最早的物理学本科专业。
抗战时期，由北京大學、清華大學、南開大學三校在昆明成立的西南联合大学的物理系里培养了李政道、杨振宁、朱光亚、邓稼先等一大批杰出的科学家。
1952年，全国范围院系调整后，原北大、清华、燕京大學三校物理精英合并成新的北京大学物理系，聚集了饶毓泰、周培源、叶企孙、王竹溪、胡宁、黄昆、褚圣麟、虞福春、杨立铭、李宪之、谢义炳等一大批中国物理界的领军人物，北京大学物理系成为中国高校中实力最强的物理重镇。
1955年，设中国高校第一个核科学专业--物理教研室，后更名为原子能系和技术物理系。
1956年，与复旦大学、南京大学、厦门大学、吉林大学联合在北大创办了中国第一个半导体物理专业。
1956年，建立中国第一个地球物理专业。
1959年，从北京大学物理系分出了地球物理系和无线电系。
20世纪70年代，物理系半导体物理专业部分人员与其他系教师共同新建了中国第一个计算机系微电子专业。
2001年5月，北京大學在原物理系、技术物理系核物理专业、重离子物理研究所、地球物理系的大气物理与气象专业、天文系的基础上，成立了物理学院。
target_text: In 1913, the Faculty of Physics of Beijing University (later renamed the Faculty of Physics) of the University of Beijing, Qinghua University, and the School of Physics of the University of South China, three of which were founded in Kunming’s Faculty of Physics, trained Li Jiao, Yang Zhening, Juoyana, Shei Bing, and the Faculty of Physics of China’s Physics Department. In 1952, the Faculty of Physics of Beijing University integrated the Physics elites of the former Beijing University into the new Physics Faculty of Beijing.
title: 北京大學物理學院

source_text:
中國大陆
可以考证的人肉搜索，最早起源于2006年2月天涯虚拟社区之“娱乐八卦”论坛对著名网络名人“毒药”的调查。当时在各大网上社区广泛流传“毒药”为高官许世友，数名天涯网友对“毒药”发起了互联网上首次基于互联网搜索引擎的人肉搜索活动，从此彻底改写了互联网匿名的历史，造成了巨大影响。
target_text: In mainland China, a testable human body search originated in a survey of famous Internet celebrity “toxics” by the Entertainment Gossip Girl Forum of the virtual community in February 2006. At that time, “toxics” were widely circulated in large online communities as high-ranking friends, and several of them launched the first Internet-based human body search campaign for “toxics” – the first ever Internet-based search engine – which completely recasts the history of Internet anonymity and has had a huge impact.
title: 人肉搜索

source_text:
学术造诣
1982年5月，波许在布朗大学获得计算机科学学士学位，1988年又在卡内基梅隆大学获得计算机科学哲學博士学位。1988年至1997年在弗吉尼亚大学工程及应用科学学院担任计算机科学助理教授及副教授。1997年回到母校卡内基梅隆大学计算机科学学院任副教授。1998年同Don Marinelli一起创建了卡内基梅隆大学娱乐技术中心，并担任中心主任一职。2000年升任计算机科学、人机交互及设计教授。
target_text: In May 1982, Posh obtained a bachelor ' s degree in computer science from Brown University and in 1988, he obtained a doctorate in philosophy in computer science from Carnegie Melon University. He was an assistant professor and associate professor in computer science from 1988 to 1997 at the Faculty of Engineering and Applied Sciences of the University of Virginia. He returned to the Faculty of Computer Sciences of Carnegie Melon University at the Mother ' s School in 1997 as an associate professor. In 1998, Don Marinelli created and held the post of Director of the Centre for Leisure Technology at Carnegie Melon University. He was promoted to the post of Professor of computer science, human interaction and design in 2000.
title: 兰迪·波许

source_text:
2007年，波许获得了美国计算机协会（ACM）颁发的Karl V. Karlstrom杰出教育家奖，以及美国计算机协会计算机科学教育专业组（ACM SIGCSE）杰出贡献奖，同年他成为美国计算机协会资深会员（ACM Fellow）。匹兹堡市议会宣布2007年11月19日为“兰迪·波许博士日”。与癌症抗争
2006年，波许被诊断患有晚期胰腺癌。次年8月，他被告知可能仅剩3到6个月的生命，于是他举家从宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡迁回弗吉尼亚州切萨皮克。
target_text: In 2007, Posh won the Karl V. Karlstrom Award for Distinguished Educators, awarded by the American Computer Association (ACM), and the ACM SIGCSE Award for Distinguished Contribution, the same year he became a senior member of the American Computer Association (ACM Fellow). The Pittsburgh City Council declared 19 November 2007 as “Dr. Randy Bosch Day.” In 2006, Bosch was diagnosed with late pancreas cancer. In August of the following year, he was told that only three to six months of his life were left, and that he moved home from Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, to Chesapeake, Virginia.
title: 兰迪·波许

source_text: 卡内基梅隆大学校长杰瑞德·柯亨高度赞扬了波许的人格，称他对学校和教育的贡献非凡出众，并且宣布学校将在计算机科学系和艺术中心之间架设一座以波许命名的天桥，以纪念波许对连接计算机科学和艺术设计两个学科的贡献。波许在布朗大学时的导师安迪·范·丹也发表演讲，赞扬波许的对抗癌症的勇气和非凡的领导才能，称他行为楷模。
target_text: The Rector of Carnegie Mellon University, Jared Cohen, praised Boh for his remarkable contribution to school and education, and announced that the school would build a bridge between the Faculty of Computer Sciences and the Arts Center named Boh, in memory of Bohhi’s contribution to connecting the two disciplines of computer science and art design. The mentor of Bohshi at Brown University, Andy Van Dan, also made a speech in which he praised Boh’s courage and remarkable leadership in fighting cancer, calling him a model of behaviour.
title: 兰迪·波许

source_text: B树（），是一种在计算机科学自平衡的树，能够保持数据有序。這種資料結構能夠讓查找數據、顺序访问、插入數據及刪除的動作，都在對數時間內完成。B树，概括来说是一个一般化的二元搜尋樹（binary search tree）一個節點可以拥有2个以上的子节点。与自平衡二叉查找树不同，B树适用于读写相对大的数据块的存储系统，例如磁盘。B树减少定位记录时所经历的中间过程，从而加快存取速度。B树这种数据结构可以用来描述外部存储。這種資料結構常被應用在数据库和文件系统的实现上。
target_text: B tree () is a self-balancing tree in computer science that keeps the data in order. This data structure allows the search for data, sequential access, insertion and deletion actions to be completed within log time. B tree, in summary, is a general binary search tree with more than two sub-points. Unlike a self-balanced two-fork search tree, B tree is suitable for a storage system that reads and writes relatively large data blocks, such as disks. B tree reduces the intermediate process experienced in positioning records, thereby increasing the speed of access. B tree is a data structure that can be used to describe external storage. This data structure is often used in databases and file systems.
title: B树

source_text:
提升查找的索引
较大程度上的提升是通过索引来做到的。在上面的例子中，初始磁盘读取从2个因素限制了查找范围。这基本上可以通过创建一个辅助索引来改善，这个索引包含每块磁盘块上的首笔记录（有时称为稀疏索引）。这个辅助索引可能只有原始数据库的1%大小，但是它可以更快速地被检索。在辅助索引中查找入口可以告诉我们在主数据库中要读取哪一块;查找辅助索引之后，我们只需要读取主数据库中的特定的某一个磁盘分块——通过一次磁盘读取开销。索引可以提供10,000入口，所以，这样最多需要14个比较级。就像主数据库，辅助索引中最后6个左右的比较级可能在相同的磁盘分块上。索引可以在大约8次磁盘读取中完成查找，目标记录会在9次磁盘读取后获得。
target_text: Uplifting the search index is done to a greater extent through the index. In the above example, the initial disk reading limits the search by two factors. This can be improved basically by creating an auxiliary index, which contains the first record of each disk block (sometimes called a thin index). This index may be only 1% of the size of the original database, but it can be retrieved more quickly. The search entrance in the auxiliary index can tell us which of the main database we want to read; after searching for the auxiliary index, we just need to read a particular disk section in the main database -- a single disk section that we can charge through a single disk. The index can provide a 10,000 entry, so a maximum of 14 comparative levels is required. Like the primary database, the last six or so comparable levels in the index may be found in the same disk block. The index can be searched in about eight diskettes, and the target record will be obtained after nine disks.
title: B树

source_text:
插入和删除带来的麻烦
如果数据库不会改变，那么编制索引就很简单，而且索引永远不需要改变。如果他们会改变，那么管理数据库及其索引就变得非常麻烦。从数据库中删除记录不会引起太大问题。索引可以保持不变，记录只需要标记为已删除。数据库仍然保持有序状态。如果会有很多删除，之后查找和存储就不再那么高效了。
target_text: If the database does not change, then indexing is simple. If they change, managing the database and its indexes becomes very cumbersome. Removing records from the database does not cause much problems. Indexes can remain unchanged, and records just need to be marked as deleted. Databases remain in an orderly state. If there will be many deletions, finding and storing them will be less efficient.
title: B树

source_text:
另外，B树通过保证内部节点至少半满来最小化空间浪费。一棵B树可以处理任意数目的插入和删除。B树的弊端
除非完全重建数据库，否则无法改变键值的最大长度。这使得许多数据库系统将人名截断到70字符之内。
（其他关联数组的实现，例如三元搜索树或者开散列哈希表，可以动态适应任意长度的键值）。
target_text: In addition, B Tree minimizes space waste by ensuring that internal nodes are at least half full. A B Tree can handle any number of insertions and deletions. B Tree malpractices cannot change the maximum length of key values unless the database is fully reconstructed. This allows many database systems to cut off names to 70 characters. (Other associated arrays, such as three-dollar search trees or a hash al-Hashi watch, can be dynamically adapted to the key values of any length.)
title: B树

source_text: 法国国立波尔多高等电子、计算机信息、通信、数学与机械学院（）是一所以培养法国优秀电子工程，计算机与信息技术，通信工程，机械建模高科技人才的公费制工程师学校。学校以其优秀的计算机，电子，通信，信号处理及机械建模方面的优势，吸引了许多研究人员，公司，和服务性行业的目光。有很多公司和研究所和学院在以上方面有合作关系。由于越来越多的法国公司需要技术方面的人才，学校的合作项目也逐年扩大。
target_text: The French National Institute of Higher Electronics, Computer Information, Communication, Mathematics and Mechanics (ABEM) is a school of publicly-funded engineers that trains high-tech French talent in electronic engineering, computer and information technology, communications engineering, mechanical modelling. The school’s advantages in computer, electronics, communications, signal processing and mechanical modelling attract many researchers, companies, and service industries.
title: 国立波尔多高等电子、计算机信息与无线电通信学院

source_text:
学院的授课制度
法国国立波尔多高等电子、计算机信息与无线电通信学院的学生（国外交流学生除外），大多通过参加Concours Communs Polytechniques（法国理工科大学校竞考的一种，参加竞考必须参加2年的理工科预科学习）的途径进入学校。但是只有约80%的学生可以参加第三年的学习。其余的学生会被淘汰，进入普通大学学习。
三年学业的课时总量为2000小时左右。（包括授课、习题课、上机课和工程制作）
学生可以在第三年到其在法国本土或国外的合作学校学习以获得双文凭。
学校主导教育思想为“模块化，个性化，专业化”。
每个学期的课程都被设置在6个不同的板块。课程大多为必修，单个板块不通过，可以参加学校安排的补考，如果补考不过，则不能进入下一阶段的学习。学生通过这样的课程设置达到自我激励的目的。每个系院每年平均都有45%以上的学生需要通过补考，进入下一阶段的学习。（校方数据：2005年~2008年）
target_text: The Institute's teaching system is based on the French State Institute of Higher Electronics, Computer Information and Radiocommunications (with the exception of foreign exchange students), most of which are admitted to schools by participating in the Concours Compuns Polytechniciques (a competition for two years of pre-scientific studies in French polytechnics) in the third year. The school leads the idea of “moduleization, individualization, specialization” in each course.
title: 国立波尔多高等电子、计算机信息与无线电通信学院

source_text:
学生人数
1995年开始，学校搬入新的教学楼，与此同时迎来学生人数大幅增长。
1995年，学校在校学生人数为433人。
1998年，学校在校学生人数为546人。
2004年，学校在校学生人数为710人。
2006年9月，学校在校人数为807，其中一年级人数达到285人。
2006年同年，有250名学生获得学校颁发的工程师文凭，其中电子系90人，计算机系80人，通信系55人，网络信息系统系25人。大量数据表明，学校已经成为了ENSI中第二大，阿基坦地区最大的工程师大学校。
target_text: In September 2006, the number of students in schools was 807, of whom 285 were in the first grade. source_text: 化学文摘社（，简称CAS）位于美国俄亥俄州哥伦布，是美国化学会的一个分支机构，负责整理并发行化学文摘及其相关产品。化学文摘社提供世界上最大的公开披露的化学相关信息的数据库，并且提供相关的文献检索软件为用户提供原始文献和专利的链接。尽管不同的数据库及检索工具有不同的名称，它们通常被统称为“化学文摘”。
target_text: CAS, located in Columbus, Ohio, United States, is a branch of the United States Chemical Council, which collates and distributes the CAS and its related products. CAS provides the world's largest publicly disclosed database of chemical-related information and provides relevant literature search software that provides links to original literature and patents for users. Although different databases and search tools are known by different names, they are commonly referred to as “chemical digests”.
