source_text: 拜耳斯坦数据库（Beilstein database，亦被译为“拜尔斯坦”）是重要的化学数据库之一，以有机化学资料见长。它分为拜耳斯坦文摘数据库和拜耳斯坦有机化学结构及数据两部分，涵盖自1771年起的超过2百万条化学相关文献，收录有1千万余种物质和1千万余条化学反应。数据库的前身是俄国人弗里德里希·拜耳斯坦于1881年创办的“拜耳斯坦有机化学手册”。2007年开始，由愛思唯爾出版集团下属的位于德国法兰克福的Elsevier Information System GmbH负责维护，随后爱斯唯尔将其与盖墨林数据库整合入Reaxys。
target_text: The Beilstein database (also translated as “Bailstein”) is one of the important chemical databases that has been expanded by organic chemical information. It is divided into the Bayerstein Digest database and the Bayerstein Organic Chemical Structure and Data section, covering more than 2 million chemical-related literatures since 1771, containing more than 10 million substances and more than 10 million chemical reactions. The database is preceded by the “Bailstein Manual on Organic Chemistry” founded in 1881 by the Russian Friedrich Baerstein. Starting in 2007, Elsevier Industry GmbH, a subsidiary of the Ethhil Publishing Group in Frankfurt, Germany, was maintained, and Esquire subsequently integrated it into the Reaxys database.
title: 拜耳斯坦数据库

source_text:
简史
1862年，弗里德里希·拜耳斯坦开始编撰有机化学手册。
1981年，拜耳斯坦有机化学手册第一版第一卷发行，次年第二卷发行。
1896年起，德国化学会（Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker）接手第四版编辑工作，1918年起陆续发行第四版。
1951年起，马克斯-普朗克学会成立拜耳斯坦有机化学文献学会，继续第四版的编辑出版工作。
1983年，拜耳斯坦学会开始建设贝尔斯坦数据库。
1991年，拜耳斯坦化学数据光盘发行，同年，AutoNom自动系统命名软件和CrossFire数据库检索软件问世。
1998年，拜耳斯坦有机化学手册停止发行，第四版最终包含503卷，共440,814页。随后的更新完全在拜耳斯坦数据库中进行，由爱思唯尔的子公司Elsevier MDL维护。
2007年，爱思唯尔获得数据库的所有权，由于Elsevier MDL被转售于美国的赛美科技（Symyx），数据库由Elsevier Information System维护。
target_text: In 1951, the Max Planck Society began the production of a manual on organic chemistry, and continued the production of the fourth edition. In 1983, the Bayersan Society began the construction of the Belstein database, which was maintained by Elsevier MDL, a subsidiary of Esquire.
title: 拜耳斯坦数据库

source_text: A*搜索算法（A* search algorithm）是一種在圖形平面上，有多個節點的路徑，求出最低通過成本的演算法。常用於遊戲中的NPC的移動計算，或网络游戏的BOT的移動計算上。该算法综合了和Dijkstra算法的优点：在进行启发式搜索提高算法效率的同时，可以保证找到一条最优路径（需要评估函数满足单调性）。
target_text: A* search algorithm (A*search algorithm) is a path on a graphical plane, with multiple nodes, to find the lowest pass cost algorithm. It is often used in the movement calculations of NPCs in the game, or BOTs in the network game. The algorithm combines the advantages of the Dijkstra algorithm: while conducting enlightening searches to increase the efficiency of the algorithm, it ensures that an optimal path is found (needs to assess the function to satisfy the single tone).

source_text: 通常，在接收到来自外围硬件（相对于中央处理器和内存）的异步信号，或来自软件的同步信号之後，處理器將會进行相应的硬件／软件处理。发出这样的信号称为进行中断请求（interrupt request，IRQ）。硬件中断导致处理器通过一个執行資訊切换（context switch）来保存执行状态（以程序计数器和程序状态字等寄存器信息为主）；软件中断则通常作为CPU指令集中的一个指令，以可编程的方式直接指示这种執行資訊切换，并将处理导向一段中断处理代码。中断在计算机多任务处理，尤其是即時系统中尤为有用。这样的系统，包括运行于其上的操作系统，也称“中断驱动”（interrupt-driven）。
target_text: Normally, when an asymmetric signal from peripheral hardware (as opposed to central processors and memory) is received, or from a synchronized signal from the software, the processor performs the corresponding hardware/software processing. The signal sent is referred to as an interrupt request (interrupt request, IRQ). The hardware interruption leads the processor to preserve the state of execution (based on memory information, such as the application counter and the program status type); the software interruption is usually a central command of the CPU command, direct instructions for the transfer of the executable information in a programmed manner and directs the processing to an interrupted processing code. Interruption is particularly useful in computer multitask, especially instantaneous systems. Such systems include operating on their operating systems, also known as “interrupt-driven” (interrupt-driven).
title: 中斷

source_text: 中断是用以提高计算机工作效率、增强计算机功能的一项重要技术。最初引入硬件中断，只是出于性能上的考量。如果计算机系统没有中断，则处理器与外部设备通信时，它必须在向该设备发出指令后进行忙等待（），反复轮询该设备是否完成了动作并返回结果。这就造成了大量处理器周期被浪费。引入中断以后，当处理器发出设备请求后就可以立即返回以处理其他任务，而当设备完成动作后，发送中断信号给处理器，后者就可以再回过头获取处理结果。这样，在设备进行处理的周期内，处理器可以执行其他一些有意义的工作，而只付出一些很小的切换所引发的时间代价。後用于CPU外部与内部紧急事件的处理、机器故障的处理、时间控制等多个方面，并产生通过软件方式进入中断处理（软中断）的概念。
target_text: Interruption is an important technology used to improve the efficiency of computer work and enhance computer functionality. The initial introduction of hardware interruptions is based only on performance considerations. If the computer system is not interrupted, the processor communicates with external equipment, it must wait after instructions have been given to the equipment () to repeat the questioning of whether the device has completed the operation and returned the result. This has resulted in a significant waste of processors. After the introduction of the interruption, the processor can return to other tasks immediately after the request for the equipment has been sent, and when the equipment has completed its operation, the break signal is sent to the processor, who can turn back to the treatment. In this case, the processor can perform other meaningful tasks during the processing cycle of the equipment, with only a small time cost of switching.
title: 中斷

source_text: 边沿触发中断不会遭受状态触发中断在共享中断引脚时所遇到的问题。低优先级设备的服务可任意推迟，而CPU仍会收到高优先级设备的中断请求。一个即便是频繁发生的伪中断也不会影响正常设备的中断请求。但是，边沿触发中断容易丢失，特别是当中断被有意屏蔽时。在不引入锁存器的情况下，在屏蔽时段发送的中断信号不可恢复。在早期的计算机系统中因为中断丢失而导致处理不能继续的情况时有发生。现代中断硬件多包含有一个或一组中断状态锁存器，用以暂存一逝而过的中断请求。在对边沿触发中断硬件进行编程时，应检查这些中断状态寄存器以确保请求事件不会丢失。

The service of low-priority equipment can be postponed at will, while CPU still receives a request for interruptions in high-priority equipment. A false interruption, even if it occurs frequently, does not affect a request for interruptions in normal equipment. But, in the case of interruptions, especially when they are intentionally blocked. Without the introduction of locks, an interruption signal sent during the shielding period cannot be restored.
title: 中斷

source_text:
系统时钟通过一个计数器（多基于某种振动频率）定期向CPU发出中断，CPU通过专门的时钟中断处理程序来保持计时。现代操作系统对系统时钟的另一个主要应用是为进程切换提供时机。一旦时钟中断發生，程序计数器会被自动压栈，而此时操作系统就有机会将程序状态及内存映像转存至别处，并调用进程调度程序来选择下一个进程，并将其进程状态，包括程序计数器，导入寄存器。这样下一个程序就可以运行。应注意进程调度程序的调度时机不止于时钟中断。
磁盘中断标识某个磁盘设备完成了数据的发送／接收。磁盘中断發生后，等待这个中断的进程可以（但未必，这取决于进程调度程序当时的判断）继续执行。
断电中断指示计算机能源即将丧失，计算机可以相应中断程序作有序的关机处理。
target_text: The system clocks regularly interrupt the CPU by means of a counter (mostly on the basis of a vibration frequency) and the CPU by means of a special time clock interrupts the process process. Another major application of the modern operating system to the system clock is to provide the time for process switching. Once the clock breaks, the program counters are automatically crushed, and the operating system has the opportunity to store the program state and memory image elsewhere, and to call the process scheduler to select the next process, including the program counter, and to import it into the memory. The next program can operate. It should be noted that the process scheduler has more than the clock to stop. The disk break marks that a disk device completes the transmission/receipt of data.
title: 中斷

source_text:
架構
CAN是一个用于连接电子控制单元（ECU）的串行总线标准。电子控制单元有时也被称作节点。CAN网络上需要至少两个节点才可进行通信。节点的复杂程度可以只是简单的输入输出装置，也可以是包含有CAN交互器并搭载了软件的嵌入式元件。节点还可能是一个网关，允许普通计算机通过USB或以太网端口与CAN网络上的装置通信。
target_text: Structure Can is a string bus standard used to connect to the electronic control unit (ECU). The electronic control module is sometimes called node. At least two nodes on the CAN network are required to communicate. The complexity of the node may be simple input output devices, or it may include embedded components with CAN interactives and with the software. The node may also be a gateway that allows ordinary computers to communicate with the CAN network via USB or by way of an ultranet port.
title: 控制器區域網路

source_text:

target_text: The company owns a patent for the technology, and manufacturers of microprocessors compatible with CAN are required to pay licensing fees to Bo, which are usually added to the chip price and passed to the customer. Manufacturers that produce custom-made applications of CAN-compatible (ASICs) or field-programmable logical arrays (FPGA) modules are required to pay for CAN agreement licences.

source_text:
特征的定义
至今为止特征没有万能和精确的定义。特征的精确定义往往由问题或者应用类型决定。特征是一个数字图像中“有趣”的部分，它是许多计算机图像分析算法的起点。因此一个算法是否成功往往由它使用和定义的特征决定。因此特征检测最重要的一个特性是“可重复性”：同一场景的不同图像所提取的特征应该是相同的。
target_text: The precise definition of features is often determined by the problem or the type of application. Characteristics are a “interesting” part of a digital image, which is the starting point for many computer image analysis algorithms. Thus, the success of an algorithm is often determined by the characteristics it uses and defines. So one of the most important features of a feature test is “repeatability”: different images of the same scene should produce the same characteristics.
title: 特征检测

source_text: 特征检测是图像处理中的一个初级运算，也就是说它是对一个图像进行的第一个运算处理。它检查每个像素来确定该像素是否代表一个特征。假如它是一个更大的算法的一部分，那么这个算法一般只检查图像的特征区域。作为特征检测的一个前提运算，输入图像一般通过高斯模糊核在尺度空间中被平滑。此后通过局部导数运算来计算图像的一个或多个特征。
target_text: Characteristic detection is a primary calculation of image processing, which means that it is the first calculation of an image. It examines each pixel to determine whether it represents a feature. If it is part of a larger algorithm, the algorithm usually only examines the characteristic area of the image. As a precondition for feature testing, the input image is usually smoothed in the scale space through Gaussian fumigation of the core. It then calculates one or more features of the image by local conductivity.
title: 特征检测

source_text: 有时，假如特征检测需要许多的计算时间，而可以使用的时间有限制，一个高层次算法可以用来控制特征检测阶层，这样仅图像的部分被用来寻找特征。由于许多计算机图像算法使用特征检测作为其初级计算步骤，因此有大量特征检测算法被发展，其提取的特征各种各样，它们的计算复杂性和可重复性也非常不同。
target_text: Sometimes, if feature testing takes a lot of time to calculate, and the time available is limited, a high-level algorithm can be used to control the identity detection class, so that only parts of the image are used to look for features. As many computer image algorithms use feature testing as their initial step, a large number of feature detection algorithms have been developed, their different characteristics are extracted, and their computational complexity and replicability are very different.
title: 特征检测

source_text: 边缘指组成两个图像区域之间边界（或边缘）的像素。一般一个边缘的形状可以是任意的，还可能包括交叉点。在实践中边缘一般被定义为图像中拥有大的梯度的点组成的子集。一些常用的算法还会把梯度高的点联系起来来构成一个更完善的边缘的描写。这些算法也可能对边缘提出一些限制。
target_text: Margins refer to pixels that make up the boundary (or edge) between two image areas. The shape of a margin can be arbitrary and may also include intersections. In practice, the edge is generally defined as a subset of points with a large gradient in the image. Some of the commonly used algorithms also link points with a high gradient to form a better profile of the edge. These algorithms may also suggest limits on the edge.
title: 特征检测

source_text: 角指图像中点似的特征，在局部它有两维结构。早期的算法首先进行边缘检测，然后分析边缘的走向来寻找边缘突然转向（角）。后来发展的算法不再需要边缘检测这个步骤，而是可以直接在图像梯度中寻找高度曲率。后来发现这样有时可以在图像中本来没有角的地方发现具有同角一样的特征的区域。
target_text: Angular means the middle feature of the image, which has a two-dimensional structure at the local level. Early algorithms first test the edges and then analyse the direction of the edges to find the edges suddenly turning (the angles). The later developed algorithms no longer need to test the edges for this step, but can search directly for a high curvature in the image gradient.
title: 特征检测

source_text: ReadyBoost 是 Windows Vista 中引入的新技术，在继 Windows Vista 的下一代操作系统 Windows 7 中，同样包含了这项技术，它利用了闪存随机读写及零碎文件读写上的优势来提高计算机系统性能，同時也是下一代闪存硬盘的临时替代品。这项技术目前仅支持 USB 2.0 或更高版本接口的 USB 闪存驱动器以及计算机内置读卡器中的闪存。具体要求是，4K 随机读取的速度大于 3.5 M/s，512K 随机写入的速度大于 2.5 M/s。
target_text: ReadyBoost is a new technology introduced in Windows Vista, which is also included in Windows 7, the next generation operating system of Windows Vista, which uses the advantages of flash random reading and writing and fragmentary document reading and writing to enhance computer system performance and is also a temporary replacement for the next generation flash hard drive. This technology currently only supports flash drive in USB 2.0 or higher interfaces, as well as in computer-based card readers. The specific requirement is that 4K random readings are faster than 3.5 M/s, 512 K random write faster than 2.5 M/s.
title: ReadyBoost

source_text: 删除快捷方式完全不会影响被链接到的目标。如果删除了目标，则会使快捷方式失效。由于快捷方式可以使用相对路径或绝对路径，因此移动快捷方式或目标可能导致快捷方式失效，也可能不会有影响。在某些Windows操作系统（包括但不限于Windows XP、Windows Vista）中，操作系统会对文件路径的改变作一定程度的自动处理，使得快捷方式将在大多数情况下能保持有效：当快捷方式指向的目标失效而目标被移动过时，系统将自动修改快捷方式的目标到新的位置。
target_text: Deleting the shortcuts does not in any way affect the connected target. If the target is deleted, the shortcuts fail. As the shortcuts can use relative or absolute paths, moving the shortcuts or targets may or may not render the shortcuts ineffective. In some Windows operating systems (but not limited to Windows XP, Windows Vista), the system automatically handles changes in the path of the document, making the shortcuts effective in most cases: when the shortcut targets fail and the target moves out of date, the system automatically changes the objectives of the shortcuts to a new location.
title: 符号链接

source_text:
电子邮件管理员自动化技术
现在有大量的应用软件，电器，服务和软件系统可以供给电子邮件管理员使用，以减少在其系统和邮箱垃圾邮件的负荷。一般来说，这些能直接在大部分垃圾邮件的SMTP连接阶段尝试拒绝（或“阻拦”）。如果它们接受信息，它们通常会再进一步分析这些内容 - 并可能决定“隔离”任何已列为垃圾邮件。
target_text: E-mail administrator automation technology now has a large number of applications, appliances, services and software systems that can be used by e-mail managers to reduce the load of spam in their systems and mailboxes. Generally, these can be rejected (or “stopped”) directly during the SMTP connection phase of most spam. If they receive information, they usually analyse the content further - and may decide to “segregate” any already classified spam.
title: 反垃圾邮件技术

source_text: FreeDOS（曾叫做Free-DOS和PD-DOS）是一个在IBM PC兼容机下运行的操作系统。FreeDOS由许多不同的独立程序组成，这些程序就是整个FreeDOS项目中的“包”。它主要通过OP来提供磁盘访问和文件系统，以及部分内存管理，但是没有默认的GUI（尽管FreeDos 0.9及以上版本推荐使用OpenGEM）。FreeDOS支持老式和新式PC，以及嵌入式系统。像MS-DOS一样，它可以从软盘、硬盘以及ROM启动。 与MS-DOS不同的是，它支持从CD-ROM安装，并且人们可以自由地创建属于自己的定制发行版，而不用为再发行支付使用费。FreeDOS是自由且开源的，遵守GNU（GPL）。但是在其"util"部分中，FreeDOS也包含专有软件，例如。
target_text: FreeDOS (formerly known as Free-DOS and PD-DOS) is an operating system run under IBM PC compatible machines. FreeDOS consists of a variety of stand-alone programs that are "packages" in the entire FreeDOS project. Unlike MS-DOS, which supports the installation of diskettes and file systems and partial memory management, there is no default GUI (although FreeDOs 0.9 and above recommend OpenGEM). FreeDOS supports old and new PCs and embedded systems.
title: FreeDOS

source_text: 软件即服务（，缩写：SaaS，发音：或），亦可称为“按需即用软件”（即“一经要求，即可使用”），它是一种软件交付模式。在这种交付模式中，软件仅需通过网络，不须经过传统的安裝步骤即可使用，软件及其相关的数据集中托管于云端服务。用户通常使用精简客户端，一般即经由网页浏览器来访问、存取软件即服务。SaaS 最大的特色在于软件本身并没有被下载到用户的硬盘，而是存储在提供商的云端或者服务器。相较于传统软件需要花钱购买和下载，软件即服务只需要用户租用软件，在线使用，不但大大减少了用户购买风险, 也无需下载软件本身，无设备要求的限制。
target_text: Software is a service (abbreviation: SaaS, pronunciation: or), or what may be termed “software on demand” (i.e., “available on demand”), which is a software delivery model. In this mode of delivery, software needs to be used only through the network, without traditional installation steps, and software and related data are hosted centrally in cloud-side services. Users usually use a streamlined client, typically access to software through web browsers. The greatest feature of SaaS is that the software itself is not downloaded to the user's hard disk, but stored on the provider's clouds or servers.
title: 软件即服务

source_text: 对于许多商业应用来说，软件即服务已经成为一种常见的交付模式。这些商业应用包括会计系统、协同软件、客户关系管理、管理信息系统、企业资源计划、开票系统、人力资源管理、内容管理、以及服务台管理。软件即服务已经被吸纳进所有领先的企业级软件公司的战略中。这些公司的最大的卖点之一就是通过将硬件和软件维护及支持外包给软件即服务的提供者，来降低信息技术（Information Technology，简称IT）成本。
target_text: For many commercial applications, software, i.e. services, has become a common mode of delivery. These commercial applications include accounting systems, collusive software, customer relationship management, management information systems, enterprise resource planning, billing systems, human resources management, content management, and help desk management. Software, i.e., services, has been incorporated into the strategy of all leading enterprise-level software companies. One of the biggest sales points of these companies is to reduce the cost of information technology (IT) by outsourcing hardware and software maintenance and support to software, i.e. service providers.
title: 软件即服务

source_text: 根据一份高德纳集团（Gartner Group，也称顾能集团）的评估，软件即服务的销售在2010年达到了100亿美元，并且曾被预计在2011年要达到121亿美元，比2010年上升20.7%。高德纳集团估计，到2015年，软件即服务的收入将会超过它的2010年的收入的2倍以上，并且达到预计的213亿美元。客户关系管理系统持续成为软件即服务的最大市场。在客户关系管理市场中的软件即服务曾被预测会从2010年的32亿美元上升到2011年的38亿美元。
target_text: According to an assessment by the Gartner Group, also known as Gretner Group, the sale of software, i.e. services, reached $10 billion in 2010 and was projected to reach $12.1 billion in 2011, an increase of 20.7 per cent over 2010, which estimates that software, i.e. services, will earn more than twice its 2010 revenue by 2015 and reach the projected $21.3 billion. CRM continues to be the largest market for software, i.e. services. software in the CRM market was projected to increase from $3.2 billion in 2010 to $3.8 billion in 2011.
title: 软件即服务

source_text: “软件即服务”（SaaS）的术语被认为是云计算的命名法的一部分，还有IaaS、PaaS、（DaaS）都被认为是云计算的学术名称。历史商业应用的集中式托管可以追溯到20世纪60年代。从那一年代开始，IBM和其他大型電腦提供商提供了常被称为分时系统和公共事业计业务。这种服务包括从他们在世界各地的数据中心向银行以及其他大型组织提供计算能力及数据库存储。
target_text: The term "SaaaS" is considered to be part of the naming method for cloud computing, as well as academic names for Iaas, PaaS, and DaaS. Central hosting for historical commercial applications dates back to the 1960s. Since that time, IBM and other large computer providers have provided what is often called time-series systems and public utility accounting operations.
title: 软件即服务

source_text: 20世纪90年代期间，互联网的扩张使应用服务提供商作为新型集中式计算提供者而兴起。应用服务提供商向商业组织提供托管的服务，并管理专门的商业应用，目的在于通过集中式管理，以及解决方案提供商在特定商业应用上的专业化，来降低花销。
target_text: During the 1990s, the expansion of the Internet led to the emergence of applications service providers as new centralized computing providers. Applied service providers provide hosting services to commercial organizations and manage specialized commercial applications with the aim of reducing costs through centralized management and the specialization of solution providers in specific commercial applications.
title: 软件即服务

source_text:
软件即服务实质上扩展了应用服务提供商（ASP）模式的思想。然而，术语“软件即服务”常常被用于更特定的环境：
虽然大多数最初的应用服务提供商聚焦于管理和托管第三方独立软件供应商的软件，但到了2012年，软件即服务提供商通常开发和管理他们自己的软件。
虽然许多最初的应用服务提供商提供更传统的、需要在用户的个人电脑上安装软件的客户机-服务器应用，当代的软件即服务解决方案绝大多数依赖于万维网，并且仅仅需要一个互联网浏览器即可使用。
尽管大多数最初的应用服务提供商所使用的软件架构必须要求为每个商业组织维持一个该应用的独立实例，但到了2012年，软件即服务解决方案通常使用一个多租架构，在这种架构中，应用为多个商业组织和用户提供服务，并相应地将它的数据进行分区。
target_text: While most of the original application service providers focused on managing and hosting software from third-party independent software providers, by 2012 the software service providers usually developed and managed their own software. While many of the original application service providers provided more traditional client-server applications that required software to be installed on the user’s personal computer, modern-day software solutions relied overwhelmingly on the World Wide Web and were available only with an Internet browser.
title: 软件即服务

source_text:
定价
与大多通常以直接用费以及一个可选的持续收取的支撑费用的方式作为永久许可证销售的数传统软件不同，软件即服务提供商一般地使用一个签约费用来给应用定价，最常见的是一个月费或年费。因此，软件即服务的初装费用通常比同等的企业软件要便宜。软件即服务供应商通常基于一些用量参数来为他们的应用定价，例如使用该应用的用户数量（座位数）。然而，因为在一个软件即服务环境中，客户数据存在于软件即服务供应商，提供商也可按事务、事件或其他单位的值收费。
target_text: Pricing Unlike the number of traditional software that is often sold as a permanent licence in the form of direct usage fees and an opting-in support fee, the software provider generally uses a contracting fee to price the application, most often a monthly or annual fee. Thus, the initial cost of software, i.e. services, is usually cheaper than the same enterprise software. Software, i.e., service providers, usually price their applications on the basis of a number of quantitative parameters, such as the number of users using the application (number of seats). However, since in a software, i.e., service provider, customer data is available in a service environment where the software is located, the provider can also charge the value of the service provider according to the service, event or other unit.
title: 软件即服务

source_text: 在一个多租环境中的相对低廉的用户服务开通（亦即设立一个新的客户），使得一些软件即服务供应商得以用基本功能免费的模式来提供应用。在这种模式下，一个拥有有限功能或范围的服务是免费可用的，增强的功能或更大的范围则是要收费的。其他一些软件即服务应用则对用户完全免费，而收入则产生于变通的来源例如广告。
target_text: A relatively low-cost user service in a multi-rent environment (i.e., a new client) allows some software providers to offer applications on a cost-free basic function model. In this model, a service with a limited function or range is available free of charge, with enhanced functionality or greater. Other software applications are completely free of charge to users, while income arises from alternative sources, such as advertising.
title: 软件即服务

source_text: 软件即服务的增长的一个关键驱动力就是软件即服务供应商提供一个与驻场软件具有竞争力的价格。这与传统的关于外包信息技术系统的理念是一致的，它包括将规模经济应用到应用运营上，即一个外部的服务提供商可能有能力提供更好、更便宜、更可信赖的应用。
target_text: A key driver of software, i.e. service growth, is that the service provider provides a price that is competitive with on-site software. This is consistent with the traditional concept of outsourcing information technology systems, which includes the application of economies of scale to application operations, where an external service provider may be able to provide better, cheaper and more trustworthy applications.
title: 软件即服务

source_text:
架构
绝大多数软件即服务解决方案都是基于一个多租架构的。依靠这个模式，应用的一个单一的版本，以及一个单一的配置（硬件、网络、操作系统）被用于所有客户（“租户”）。为了支持可扩展性，应用被安装在多台机器上（被称为水平扩展）。在一些情况下，应用的第二个版本被装好，并提供给精心挑选的客户，让他们访问预发布的应用的版本（例如一个试商用版本，即beta版本）用于测试目的。这与传统软件形成对比。对于传统软件来说，软件的多个物理副本被安装在大量的客户现场。这些物理副本的每一个都有可能是不同的版本，并且有不同的配置，并且常常经过定制化。
target_text: The majority of software, i.e. service solutions, are based on a multi-rental structure. With this model, a single version of the application and a single configuration (hardware, network, operating system) are used for all customers (“renters”). To support expansion, applications are installed on multiple machines (referred to as horizontal extensions). In some cases, the second version of the application is packed and provided to carefully selected customers to access the version of the pre-issued application (e.g. a trial commercial version, a Beta version) for testing purposes. This contrasts with traditional software. For traditional software, multiple physical copies of the software are installed in a large number of client sites. Each of these physical copies can be different versions and have different configurations and are often customized.
title: 软件即服务

source_text:
在一些特定的例外情况下，软件即服务解决方案不使用多租技术，或使用其他技术诸如虚拟化，来替代多租户技术，高费效比地来管理大量的客户多租户技术对于软件即服务来说是否是一个必需的组件，目前仍是一个争论的话题。。特征
由于并非所有的软件即服务应用都开放所有的功能特性，下面的这些是许多软件即服务应用的常见的特征：
target_text: In some specific exceptions, software, i.e., service solutions, does not use multiple rental technologies or other technologies, such as virtualization, to replace multitenant technologies, and cost-effective management of a large number of customer multitenant technologies is a necessary component for software, i.e. services, is still a subject of debate. Since not all software, i.e. service applications, are open to all functional features, these are common features of many software, i.e. service applications:
title: 软件即服务

source_text:
配置和定制化
软件即服务应用支持类似传统意义上所说的应用“定制化”。换句话说，与传统的企业软件类似，一个单独的客户可以更改配置选项的设置（也称“参数”），这些设置影响它的功能以及界面外观。对于配置选项，每个客户可能拥有他自己的设置（或：参数值）。基于一系列的预定义的配置选项，应用可以被定制化到他所被设计到的程度。
target_text: Configures and customizes software, i.e. service applications, to support " customization " of applications similar to those traditionally defined. In other words, like traditional enterprise software, a single client can change the configuration options ' settings (also referred to as " parameters " ), which affect its function and its interface appearance. For configuration options, each client may have his own settings (or: parameter values). Based on a series of predefined configuration options, the application can be customized to the extent to which he is designed.
title: 软件即服务

source_text:
为什么采用SaaS
软件市场和技术前景的几个重要变化，促进了软件即服务解决方案的接纳和增长：
应用对基于万维网的用户界面的不断增长的使用，以及联合就践行——例如网上设计的激增，持续地降低了对于传统客户端-服务器应用的需要。因此，传统软件供应商在基于胖客户端的软件上的投资变成了劣势（它必须要持续的支持），打开大门迎接新的软件供应商来提供一个用户体验，被认为更“入时”。
万维网协议栈（HTML、JavaScript、CSS、HTTP）的标准化，网站开发作为一个实践不断增长的流行程度，以及像Ruby on Rails这样的Web应用框架的引入和无处不在，逐渐地降低了开发新的软件即服务解决方案的花费，并使得新的解决方案提供商提供有竞争力的解决方案成为可能，挑战着传统的供应商。
因特网宽带接入（broadband Internet access）上的持续突破，使得远程集中式托管的应用提供能与驻场软件可相提并论的速度成为可能。
HTTPS作为万维网协议栈（web stack）的一部分，它的标准化提供了普遍适用的轻量级安全保障的，对于日常应用来说足够了。
轻量级集成协议，例如REST和SOAP的引入和广泛接受，使得软件即服务应用（存在于云中）和内部应用在广域网上与其他软件即服务应用之间的经济适用的集成成为可能。
target_text: As a result, the investment of traditional software providers in software based on fat clients has become a disadvantage (which requires sustained support), opening doors to new software providers to provide a more “time-to-time” experience.” The standardization of the web protocol (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, HTTP) and its growing popularity as a practice, as well as the introduction and vapidness of web applications such as Ruby Railways, gradually reducing the cost of developing new software, or service solutions, and making new solutions available to provide a more competitive solution to provide a more “time-to-time” view.

target_text: Some of the challenges in adopting SaaS have delayed the speed at which the software is accepted and prevented its use in certain cases: because the data is stored on the server of the supplier, data security is a problem. source_text:
增量LDA
要实现典型的LDA技术前提是所有的样本都必须提前准备完毕。但有些情况下，没有现成的完整数据集或者输入观察数据是流的形式。这样，就要求LDA的特征提取有能力随着观察新样本的增加而更新LDA的特征，而不是在整个数据集上运行算法。例如，在移动机器人或实时脸部识别等实时应用中，提取的LDA特征能随着新观察值实时更新是非常重要的。这种能够通过简单观察新样本来更新LDA特征的技术就叫做增量LDA算法，在过去二十年里，它已经被广泛的研究过。 Catterjee和Roychowdhury提出了一种增量自组织LDA算法来更新LDA特征。 另外，Demir和Ozmehmet提出利用误差改正和赫布学习规则的线上本地学习算法来更新LDA特征。 最后，Aliyari等人提供了快速增量LDA算法。
target_text: In real-time applications such as mobile robots or real-time face recognition, it is important that the LDA feature is updated in real time with the new observation values. In some cases, the technology that can update the LDA feature by simply looking at new samples is called the incremental LDA algorithm, which has been widely studied over the past two decades.
title: 線性判別分析

source_text:
胜任力可以分为以下几种类型：
组织胜任力：组织的使命、愿景、价值、文化和核心胜任力，它们设置了组织的基调与上下文，决定组织做事的风格（是客户驱动，还是积极承担风险，还是技术领先）。
核心胜任力：组织特有的能力或技术专长。核心胜任力（例如使组织在市场上获得竞争优势的技术、方法、战略或流程）将组织与其竞争对手区分开来。组织的核心胜任力是组织的战略优势。
技术胜任力：取决于不同的职位，在做出雇佣决定时需要小心权衡技术与绩效技能。如果组织倾向于纯粹基于技术能力来招聘或提升员工，而不顾其他方面的胜任力，这样的组织很有可能遇到绩效相关的问题（例如，过于重视软件设计能力而忽视客户关系管理能力，会使软件企业遭遇交付困难）。
行为胜任力：个体绩效胜任力比组织胜任力来得更具体，它们定义了特定上下文中可度量的行为，从而验证个体员工的专业技能水平、以及是否适任某一职位。
职能胜任力：特定于职位的胜任力，通常涉及具体的技术或操作（例如“备份数据库”就是一种职能胜任力）
管理胜任力：管理胜任力描述了构成个体员工管理潜力的属性与能力。与“领导特质”不同，“管理特质”只要有适当的培训与资源支持就可以习得。
target_text: There are several types of competencies: Organizational competence: organizational mission, vision, values, culture and core competencies, which set the tone and context of the organization and determine the style of the organization's work (customer-driven, active risk-taking, or technological leadership); Core competence: Organizational specific competencies or technical expertise. Core competencies (e.g. technology, methods, strategies or processes that enable the organization to achieve competitive advantages in the market) distinguish the organization from its competitors. Organizational core competencies are organizational strategic advantages. Technical competence: Depending on the position, employment decisions need to be made with care to weigh technical and performance skills against what can be done in the context of a given context. If the organization tends to recruit or upgrade staff based solely on technical skills, regardless of other competencies, such organizations are likely to experience performance-related problems (e.g., over-emphasis on software design while neglecting the customer relationship management capacity, which can lead to delivery difficulties for software enterprises). Behaviable: Individual performance competencies are more specific than organizational competencies, and they define the level of technical skills that can be used in a given context, and thus to validate the position.
title: 工作能力

target_text: Squashfs are designed specifically for the general use of read-only filesystems, which can be used either as backup data or on systems resource-stressed computers. source_text: 大连软件园（）位于中国辽宁省大连市西南部郊区，是大连高新技术园区的一部分。三面有山环绕，其余一面临海，地势起伏。自1998年创建以来，大连软件园已经成为国内多家大中型IT企业的基地。大连是中国11个软件产业基地以及五个软件出口基地之一。已有超过300家公司进驻大连软件园，其中包括32家世界500强公司。
target_text: Dalian Software Park, located on the south-west outskirts of Dalian City, Liaoning Province, China, is part of Dalian High Technology Park, which is surrounded by mountains, the rest facing the sea, and the terrain is up and down. source_text: 互联网的历史最早可追溯到1960年代初期，其起源于信息论与当时提出的对计算机网络的设想，这个设想的目标是建立一个能使不同计算机的用户互相进行通信的网络，对它的研发则是源于美国对建立和互连计算机网络的研究与开发，这个过程还涉及到了国际合作，特别是与来自英国和法国的研究人员的合作。在经过多年多个不同阶段的发展过后，这些努力与设想最终发展成了今时今日的互联网。
target_text: The history of the Internet, dating back to the early 1960s, originated in the theory of information and in the idea of a computer network, the goal of which was to create a network that would allow users of different computers to communicate with each other, and its development and development in the United States, which involved international cooperation, particularly with researchers from the United Kingdom and France. After many years of different stages, these efforts and ideas eventually developed into the Internet today.
title: 互联网历史

source_text: 于1969年10月正式投入运行的阿帕网是早期的计算机网络之一，其由DARPA研发，是世界上第一个运营的数据包交换网络，后来成为互联网最主要的前身，1974年，DAPRA的罗伯特·卡恩和斯坦福大学的文頓·瑟夫共同开发了TCP/IP协议，定义了在电脑网络之间传送信息的方法。1983年1月1日，阿帕网将其网络核心协议由网络控制程序改变为TCP/IP协议。后来，阿帕网使用的技术（如TCP/IP协议）成为了以后互联网的核心。它采纳的徵求修正意見書过程，一直是发展互联网协议与标准所使用的机制，至今仍在发挥着作用。
target_text: The Appa Network, which became fully operational in October 1969, was one of the early computer networks developed by DARPA, the world’s first operating data package exchange network, and became the leading precursor to the Internet. In 1974, Robert Kahn of DAPRA and Venton Sef of Stanford University jointly developed the TCP/IP protocol, defining the method of transmitting information between computer networks. On 1 January 1983, the Appa Network changed its network core protocol from a network control program to a TCP/IP protocol. Subsequently, the technology used by the Apanet (e.g. the TCP/IP protocol) became the core of the Internet.
title: 互联网历史

source_text:

target_text: The integration of computer networks and the formation of the global Internet have played an important role in the selection of computer network technology programmes, the establishment of Internet protocols and standards by the Internet Engineering Working Group established in 1986 and the Internet Association established in 1992. The launch of the world’s first web browser and the first web server by Tim Bernard Lee, a member of the European Nuclear Research Organization, at the end of 1990, contributed to the creation of the World Wide Web, leading to the rapid development of Internet applications.

source_text:
互联网与电子商务、网络文化的发展
在互联网出现之前，电子数据交换已经被一些企业采纳作为一种商务手段，但应用范围比较有限。互联网的迅速发展和普及，使企业与企业之间、企业与消费者之间的各种新的商务模式成为可能。尽管经历了2000年代初期的互联网泡沫，随着互联网用户的增加，互联网在现代经济生活中正发挥着日益重要的作用。

This process is sometimes referred to as "characterizing " . source_text: 这种度量方法也有一些缺陷。对于包含不同取值个数的类别特征，随机森林更偏向于那些取值个数较多的特征，partial permutations、growing unbiased trees可以用来解决这个问题。如果数据包含一些相互关联的特征组，那么更小的组更容易被选择。与最近邻算法的关系Lin和Jeon在2002年指出了随机森林算法和K-近邻算法(-NN)的关系。 事实证明，这两种算法都可以被看作是所谓的“加权邻居的方案”。这些在数据集上训练的模型通过查看一个点的邻居来计算一个新点的预测值，并且使用权重函数对这些邻居进行加权:
target_text: This measurement method is also flawed. Lin and Jeon, in 2002 pointed out the relationship between random forest algorithms and K-neighbor algorithms (-NN). Both algorithms can be seen as so-called “weighted neighbourhood programmes”. source_text:
學習演算法
根據下列演算法而建造每棵樹：
用N來表示訓練用例（样本）的個數，M表示特征数目。
输入特征数目m，用于确定决策树上一个节点的决策结果；其中m應远小於M。
從N個訓練用例（样本）中以有放回抽样的方式，取樣N次，形成一个训练集（即bootstrap取樣），並用未抽到的用例（样本）作預測，評估其誤差。
對於每一個節點，隨機選擇m個特征，决策树上每个节点的决定都是基于这些特征确定的。根據這m個特征，計算其最佳的分裂方式。
每棵樹都會完整成長而不會剪枝（Pruning，這有可能在建完一棵正常樹狀分類器後會被採用）。
target_text: Learning algorithms Each tree is constructed on the basis of the following algorithms: N for the number of training cases (samples), M for the number of characteristics.m for the number of features, m for the determination of the decision results for a node on the decision tree, m for which m should be much smaller than M. For each node, decisions on each node are based on these characteristics. Based on this m feature, each tree is counted as the best way to split.

source_text: 个人门户即以个人为中心的互联网入口网站，它提供给用户能够自定义连向其它内容的路径，使用者将各种应用程序、数据和互联网资源集成到一个信息管理平台，并以用户个性化的页面布局呈现出来。此类服务大多由AJAX技术实现，以减少操作难度，增加用户使用的便捷性。

source_text: 功能个人门户系统被设计成可以使用大量“中间件”来实现多种不同功能，增加删除这些组件非常灵活，易于优化、丰富系统功能。个人门户系统基本具有以下几点功能：RSS订阅。应该是最优的信息获取渠道，直接获得不同信息发布源里有价值的内容，集中规划管理，同时避开了网页打开慢、打开多个网页等麻烦。e-mail登陆，要求支持多个流行电子信箱，如163，sina，yahoo等。E-mail是互联网最基本的应用，是日常工作行程安排的依据，将多个e-mail服务集成到一个功能模块上，统一管理每日收发的电子邮件。可存储图片，音乐，文件到网上的空间。将重要的东西存储到网上专业管理的服务器，不仅易于与朋友分享，而且方便不同机器间的更换，避免遭受恶意攻击带来的损失。书签。将互联网上发现的有用资源用书签标记下来统一管理，用于以后查阅或与朋友分享。搜索集合。搜索引擎是互联网的另一个基础应用，全球90%以上的人都在使用搜索引擎，集成后的搜索引擎方便使用者在不同搜索结果间比较筛选出满意的网站。Blog。网络日志是用户记录日常点滴的心情笔记，也是对外发表文章的表达工具，个人门户集成博客功能为用户提供一个用文字表现自我的窗口。时间管理或日程管理，使用者每天打开浏览器首页就可看到预先在个人门户设置好的本日、本周或本月的行程安排。

source_text: 机器学习模型的典型产出过程是由机器学习算法在训练集上进行训练，希望得到的模型能够在训练过程中不可见的验证集上表现良好。过拟合现象发生在使用违反奥卡姆剃刀原则的模型或算法时：当引入相较数据集而言过多的参数时，或使用相较数据集而言过于复杂的模型时。
target_text: The typical output process of a machine learning model is the training of machine learning algorithms at the training set, and the desired model is capable of performing well in a test set that is not visible during the training process. Elaboration occurs when models or algorithms that violate the Ocam Razor principles are used: when too many parameters are introduced than data sets, or when models that are too complex for data sets are used.
title: 過適

source_text: 概括地说，机器学习算法在已知数据上很精确但在新数据上不精确的情形，可以称之为过拟合。人们可以这样在直觉上理解过拟合：「过去的经验可被分为两个部分：与将来有关的数据、与将来无关的数据（噪声）」。在其他条件都相同的情况下，预测的难度越大（不确定性越高），则过去信息中需要被当做噪声忽略的部分就越多。问题的难点在于，如何确定哪些数据应当被忽略。
target_text: In summary, if machine learning algorithms are accurate in the known data but inaccurate in the new data, they can be called hypes. One can intuitively understand them as: "The past experience can be divided into two parts: data related to the future, data not related to the future (noise). The more difficult it is to predict (the more uncertainty is) in other cases, the more information in the past needs to be ignored. The difficulty is how to determine which data should be ignored.
title: 過適

source_text: 機器學習試圖去建造一個可以學習的演算法，用來預測某個目標的結果。要達到此目的，要給於學習演算法一些訓練样本，样本說明輸入與輸出之間的預期關係。然后假设學習器在预测中逼近正确的结果，其中包括在訓練中未出現的样本。既然未知状况可以是任意的結果，若沒有其它額外的假設，這任務就無法解決。這種關於目標函數的必要假設就称为歸納偏置（Mitchell, 1980; desJardins and Gordon, 1995）。
target_text: Mechanical learning attempts to build an algorithm that can be studied to predict the results of a target. To achieve this, some training samples are given to learn the algorithm, which describes the expected relationship between input and output. Then assumes that the learner is approaching the correct results in its predictions, including samples that do not appear in the training. Since the unknown can be arbitrary, the task cannot be solved without additional assumptions. The necessary hypothesis for the target function is referred to as inclusion bias (Mitchell, 1980; desJardins and Gordon, 1995).
title: 歸納偏置

source_text:
OS/2
在1.2及以后的OS/2版本中，出现了带有扩展属性的高性能文件系统构想的设计，并且DOS的FAT文件系统对其向后兼容。为了确保与其他使用FAT文件系统的操作系统兼容，OS/2属性保存在根(root)路径下的一个"EA DATA. SF"文件中。当支持扩展属性的操作系统管理磁盘时，该文件通常是不可见的，然而可以自由地被例如DOS的系统操作。带有扩展属性的文件或目录在文件内使用一个或多个簇。首次使用的簇的逻辑编号以两个先前未使用字节的方式保存在该文件或路径的路径条目里。这两个字节在FAT32文件系统中另有他用，因此OS/2扩展属性不能保存在FAT32文件系统中。
target_text: OS/2 In versions 1.2 et seq., the design of a high-performance file system with extended properties has emerged and the DOS FAT file system is compatible with it backwards. To ensure compatibility with other operating systems using the FAT file system, the OS/2 attribute is stored in an "EA DATA. SF" file under the root (root) path. When operating systems that support extended attributes manage disks, the document is often invisible, but is free to be operated by systems such as DOS. Documents or directories with extended attributes use one or more columns in the file. The logic numbers of the first series are saved in two path entries in which the file or path was not previously used. The two bytes are also used in the FAT32 file system, so the OS/2 extension properties cannot be stored in the FAT32 file system.
title: 扩展文件属性

target_text: It can be said that with the increasing diffusion and maturity of information technologies, such as computers and the Internet, humankind has entered a post-information era. source_text: 在计算机网络中，路由表（routing table）或称路由择域信息库（RIB, Routing Information Base），是一个存储在路由器或者联网计算机中的电子表格（文件）或类数据库。路由表存储着指向特定网络地址的路径（在有些情况下，还记录有路径的路由度量值）。路由表中含有网络周边的拓扑信息。路由表建立的主要目标是为了实现路由协议和静态路由选择。
target_text: In the computer network, the router (routing table) or router selection database (RB, Roading Information Base) is a spreadsheet (file) or class database stored in routers or networked computers. The router holds a path to a particular network address (and, in some cases, a path router measure). The router contains top-down information around the network. The main objective of the router set up is to achieve route selection by protocol and static route.
title: 路由表

source_text:
功能
在路径选择的过程中，主机和路由器的决策是由一个叫路由表的路径数据库辅助决定的。路由表在路由器内部。根据路由协议，主机也可以拥有用于选择最佳路径的路由表。主机路由表是互联网协议中可选的，像已经过时了的IPX协议。各种路由表：
网络路由：一个在网络中有特定网络ID的路由（路径）
主机路由：一个有特定网络地址（网络ID和主机ID）的路由。主机路由允许智能化的路由选择。主机路由通常用于创建用于控制和优化特定网络通信的定制路由。
默认路由：一个当别的路由在路由表中未被找到的时候使用的路由。如果一个路由器或终端系统（如装有Microsoft Windows和Linux的个人电脑），找不到到达目的地的路由时就会使用默认路由。
target_text: In the process of path selection, the host and router decision-making is determined by a path database supported by a path chart called the router. The router is inside the router. Under the route protocol, the host can also have a route chart used to select the best path. The host route chart is optional in the Internet protocol, as in the case of an outdated IPX protocol. Various routes: Network route: a router (path) with a specific network ID in the network: a router with a specific network address (network ID and host ID). The main route is a path that allows intelligent route selection. The main route is usually used to create a custom route for controlling and optimizing a particular network communication. Default route: a route that is used when another route is not found in the road map. If a router or terminal system (e.g. a personal computer with Microsoft Windows and Linux) is found, the default route route is used when it is not possible to reach the destination.
title: 路由表

source_text:
缺点
写出的软件非常容易被误识别为恶意软件，最新版本作出了改进，但仍然常被识别为恶意软件。
代码不可由第三方编辑器进行编辑，只能通过官方开发环境进行编辑。
不原生支持 COM 组件的 IUnknown 接口，需经由其他方法调用。
程序外部数据结构无法识别。不支持将 dll 返回值、参数、取地址的子程序参数，视为一个自定义结构。只能是文本、整数、字节数组，解决方法是 api 操作内存解析。
不支持 x86_64 程序的编译。
没有异常处理功能。
ide 调试仅拥有单步，watch 窗口，调试语句，断点。
官方库更新缓慢，社区已知的一些崩溃等问题。
易语言程序的执行方式类似于 VB6 的本机代码。除了逻辑、比较、算术等一系列基本操作外，其他操作，包括外部函数调用、内存操作等，都由系统支持库充当中介完成。因而执行效率比 C/C++ 等语言低。
正版调试免费，编译需收费，费用为 618 元/套。
非自由软件，与其他语言不同，编译器为私有。
target_text: The external data structure of the program cannot be identified. The sub-programming of dll returns values, parameters, addresses is not supported. The easy language application is treated as a self-defined structure. The solution is only api operation memory solver, which is not supported by a third-party editor, and can only be edited through an official development environment. The X86_64 application is not supported. There are no abnormal processing functions.
title: 易语言

source_text: 需要注意的是，在日文表记时，拨音独立使用假名ん，因此在传统日本音韵学中根据“一假名对一拍”的原则，拨音也独立算成一拍（一个音节），所以对于一般日本人来说 あん/an/ 是两个音节，发音时值是两拍。加上前述元音长音也算作一拍的原则，日语的音节算法和现代语音学的算法有很大差异。如外来语“汉堡包”ハンバーガー(hanbaga)，一般日本人会认为是六个音拍（ha, n, ba, a, ga, a;其中的n和表示长音a分别独立算一拍），虽然在语音学角度上看只有han-ba-ga三个音节。
target_text: It is important to note that, when writing in Japanese scripts, sound dialling is independent of pseudonyms, so that in traditional Japanese rhymes, according to the principle of “one name to one”, the dialling is also counted as a single beat (one syllable), so for ordinary Japanese /an/ is two syllables, the pronunciation value is two. Adding to the principle that the first metagram is also counted as a single beat, the Japanese sonic method and modern speech algorithms are very different. For example, the foreign language “Hamburgbaga” is considered by Japanese to be six syllables (ha, n, ba, a, ga, a; n and longa are counted separately), although there are only three han-ba-ga syllacs in speech science.
title: 日語音系

source_text:
特征
Pyramid是极简主义的跨平台web框架。它不预定持久化方式，可以通过SQLAlchemy集成于SQL数据库或集成于二者，还有其他NoSQL数据库比如CouchDB。Pyramid允许开发者使用正则表达式定义映射到对象的路由。同样跟从框架Zope，Pyramid允许层级对象遍历，这里URL的每个部份都是包含其他对象的对象，这种方式类似于文件系统中的文件夹。
target_text: Characteristic Pyramid is an ultra-simplified cross-platform web framework. It is not intended to be sustainable, either through SQLAlchemy integrated into SQL databases or into both, or through other NoSQL databases, such as CouchDB. Pyramid allows developers to use regular expression definitions to map the path to objects. Similarly, Zope, Pyramid allows hierarchical objects to travel through objects, and here each part of the URL is objects containing other objects, similar to folders in file systems.
title: Pylons

target_text: OpenCV, fully known as Open Source Computer Vision Library, is a cross-platform computer visual library. OpenCV was initiated and developed by Intel and was developed with a BSD licence, which can be used free of charge in the commercial and research fields. OpenCV can be used to develop real-time image processing, computer visualization, and mode identification programs.
title: OpenCV

source_text:
自适应的项目管理
以下是一些Scrum的通用实践：
客户成为开发团队中的一部分。（例如客户肯定对开发的结果真正感兴趣。）
和所有其他形式的敏捷软件过程一样，Scrum有频繁的包含可以工作的功能的中间可交付成果。这使得客户可以更早的得到可以工作的软件，同时使得项目可以变更项目需求以适应不断变化的需求。
开发团队经常评估风险并制定缓解计划。在每一个阶段根据承诺进行风险缓解，监测和管理（风险分析）。
计划和模块开发要保持透明，让每一个人知道谁负责什么，以及什么时候完成。
参与者要经常开会以跟踪项目进展 – 平衡的（发布，客户，员工，过程）仪表板更新 – 利益所有者更新。你必须拥有预警机制，例如在可能延期交付时提出警告。
不要隐藏问题。认识到或说出任何没有预见到的问题并不会受到惩罚。
在工作场所和工作时间内必须全身心投入。– 完成更多的工作并不意味着需要工作更长时间。
target_text: As in all other forms of agility software processes, Scrum has frequent intermediate deliverables that include workable functions. This allows clients to have early access to workable software, while allowing projects to change their project needs to adapt to changing needs.
title: Scrum

source_text:
Scrum在其他领域的应用
虽然Scrum最初只应用于软件开发，它也可以被成功地应用于其他产业。现在Scrum通常被认为是一种用于开发任何产品或管理人和工作的迭代式的，增量的过程。Scrum用于产品开发
将Scrum应用于产品开发是在《新新产品开发游戏》 第一次提出，之后野中郁次郎和竹内弘高合著的《创造知识的企业》（牛津大学出版社，1995年）进行了详细的阐述。今天Scrum被用于开发金融产品，互联网产品，以及医药产品。
target_text: Scrum applications in other areas, although originally used only for software development, can also be successfully applied to other industries. Scrum is now commonly considered an iterative, incremental process for the development of any product or manager and work. Scrum uses product development. Scrum uses Scrum to apply Scrum to product development was first proposed in New Product Development Game, followed by Yujiro Nobu and Hiroshi Takechi, Knowledge-Creating Enterprises (Oxford University Press, 1995). Scrum is used today to develop financial products, Internet products, and pharmaceutical products.

source_text: Ohad Rodeh在2007年的USENIX提出的原始方案指出，广泛用作数据库的磁盘数据结构的B+树不能有效地实现基于写时复制的快照，因为它的叶子节点是连接在一起的：如果一个叶子被写时复制，它的兄弟节点和父节点也必须如此，以及它们递归的兄弟和父节点，直到整个树被复制。他建议使用一个修改过的B树（没有叶子链接），并且每个树节点都有一个引用计数，但是存储在一个专门的自由映射结构中，并且对树的平衡算法进行了一定的放松，使它们对写时复制友好。结果将是一个适合高性能对象存储的数据结构，可以执行写时复制快照，同时保持良好的并发性。
target_text: The original scheme proposed by Ohad Rodeh in 2007 in USENIX states that B+ trees, which are widely used as disk data structures for databases, cannot effectively achieve a snapshot based on copying when writing, because their leaf nodes are connected: if a leaf is copied when written, so must its brother nodes and father nodes, as well as their descending brother and father nodes, until the whole tree is copied. He proposes to use a modified B tree (there is no leaf link) and each node has a reference count, but stored in a special free-map structure and relaxes the balance of the tree to make them write friendly.
title: Btrfs

source_text: 除了安全因素，相比起拼接字符串的SQL语句，参数化的查询往往有性能优势。因为参数化的查询能令不同的数据通过参数到达数据库，从而共用同一条SQL语句。大多数数据库会缓存解释SQL语句产生的字节码而省下重复解析的开销。如果采取拼接字符串的SQL语句，则会由于操作数据是SQL语句的一部分而非参数的一部分，而反复大量解释SQL语句产生不必要的开销。
target_text: In addition to security factors, parametric queries tend to have a performance advantage over SQL statements that spell strings. Because parameterized queries allow different data to reach the database through parameters, they share the same SQL statements. Most databases save costs by interpreting the bytes generated by SQL statements. If SQL statements that spell strings are used, there is an unnecessary cost of interpreting SQL statements repeatedly and repeatedly.
title: 參數化查詢

source_text: 实体类型是多个类型字段的聚合，每个字段映射到数据库的特定列，可以包含来自多个物理表的信息。实体类型可以彼此有关系，且独立于物理模式内的关系。相关的实体可以通过字段的名字表示这种关系，以代替从数据库的列获取值，通过这种字段可以遍历相关的实体，返回一个实体或实体集合。
target_text: The entity type is the aggregation of multiple types of fields, each of which is mapped to a specific column in the database, which can contain information from multiple physical tables. The entity type can be related to each other and is independent of the relationship within the physical mode. The entity concerned can indicate the relationship by using the name of the field as a substitute for obtaining values from the column in the database, through which it can travel through the entity concerned and return to an entity or entity pool.
title: Entity Framework

source_text: 计算机图形学领域中，着色器（）是一种计算机程序，原本用于进行图像的浓淡处理（计算图像中的光照、亮度、颜色等），但近来，它也被用于完成很多不同领域的工作，比如处理CG特效、进行与浓淡处理无关的、甚至用于一些与计算机图形学无关的其它领域。
target_text: In the area of computer graphics, the colourer () is a computer program that was originally used for light processing of images (calculating light in images, brightness, colour, etc.), but it has also recently been used to complete many different areas of work, such as processing CG special effects, performing non-smoking treatments, and even in some other areas not related to computer graphics.
title: 着色器

source_text: 使用着色器在图形硬件上计算渲染效果有很高的自由度。尽管不是硬性要求，但目前大多数着色器是针对GPU开发的。GPU的可编程绘图管线已经全面取代传统的固定管线，可以使用着色器语言对其编程。构成最终图像的像素、顶点、纹理，它们的位置、色相、饱和度、亮度、对比度也都可以利用着色器中定义的算法进行动态调整。调用着色器的外部程序，也可以利用它向着色器提供的外部变量、纹理来修改这些着色器中的参数。
target_text: A colorer is used to calculate a high degree of freedom in graphic hardware. Although not a mandatory requirement, most colorers are currently developed for GPU. GPU programming lines have completely replaced traditional fixed tubes and can be programmed using the colourer language. Pixels, caps, textures that make up the final image, and their location, colour, saturation, brightness, and contrast can be dynamically adjusted using algorithms defined in the colourer. The external application of the colourer can also use the external variables it provides to the colourer to modify parameters in these colourers.
title: 着色器

source_text: 随着图形处理器的进步，OpenGL和Direct3D等主要的图形软件库都开始支持着色器。第一批支持着色器的 GPU 仅支持像素着色器，但随着开发者逐渐认识到着色器的强大，很快便出现了顶点着色器。2000年，第一款支持可编程像素着色器的显卡 Nvidia GeForce 3（NV20）问世。Direct3D 10 和 OpenGL 3.2 则引入了几何着色器。
target_text: As graphic processors advance, major graphic software repositories such as OpenGL and Direct3D begin to support colourers. The first GPUs that support colorers support only pixel colourers, but as developers become aware of the power of colorers, the top colorers quickly emerge. In 2000, the first item, Nvidia GeForce 3 (NV20), which supports programmed pixels, was launched. Direct3D 10 and OpenGL 3.2, introduced geometric colourers.
title: 着色器

source_text:
编程
用于编写着色器的编程语言取决于目标环境。官方的OpenGL和OpenGL ES着色语言是OpenGL着色语言，也称为GLSL，官方的Direct3D着色语言是高级着色器语言，也称为HLSL。Cg是英伟达开发的第三方着色语言，可输出OpenGL和Direct3D着色器；然而，自2012年以来，它一直被弃用。苹果发布了自己的着色语言，称为Metal着色语言，作为Metal框架的一部分。
target_text: Programming The programming language used to write colorers depends on the target environment. The official OpenGL and OpenGL ES colour language is the OpenGL colour language, also known as the GLSL, and the official Direct3D colour language is the advanced colourer language, also known as the HLSL. Cg is the third-party colour language developed by Weidelda and can produce OpenGL and Direct3D colourers; however, it has been abandoned since 2012. Apple has published its own colour language, known as Metall colour language, as part of the Metal framework.
title: 着色器

title: 最邻近搜索

source_text:
方法
最邻近搜索问题有若干种解决方案，这些算法的优劣决定于他们求解的时间复杂度和用来查找的数据结构的空间复杂度。一种通常的说法表述为“維數災難”（curse of dimensionality），指对于在大维数的欧几里得空间里用最邻近搜索的话，无法找到多项式的算法和多对数的查找时间。
target_text: There are a number of solutions to the question of the closest search, and the advantages and disadvantages of these algorithms are determined by the time complexity of their resolution and the spatial complexity of the data structure used to find them. One of the common expressions is "curse of distress" , which means that multiple algorithms and multiple logarithms of search times cannot be found for the most adjacent search in large-dimensional Euros.
title: 最邻近搜索

source_text:
近似最邻近查找
在一些应用中指需要有个对最邻近的猜测。这种情况下，我们可以用一个不保证能每次都返回绝对正确的最近点的算法，用来提高运算速度或节约存储空间。常常这样的算法大都能找到正确的最近点，但这大大取决于采用点集的分布。
target_text: In this case, we can use an algorithm that doesn't guarantee that every time we return to the exact nearest point to increase the speed of the calculation or save the storage space. Often, this algorithm can find the right nearest point, but it depends heavily on the distribution of the points.
title: 最邻近搜索

source_text: “在互联网上，没人知道你是一条狗”（）是一句互联网上的常用语，因为《纽约客》1993年7月5日刊登的一则由创作的漫画标题而变得流行。这则漫画中有两条狗：一条坐在计算机前的一张椅子上，与坐在地板上的另一条狗说出了漫画的标题：“在互联网上，没人知道你是一条狗”。时至2000年，这一漫画是《纽约客》中被重印最多的一则漫画，施泰纳因为此漫画的重印而赚取了超过50,000美元。
target_text: “On the Internet, no one knows that you are a dog” is a common term on the Internet, because the New Yorker published on 5 July 1993 a comic book title that became popular. There are two dogs in the cartoon: a chair in front of a computer and a dog on the floor who says the title of the comic: “On the Internet, no one knows that you are a dog.” By 2000, the cartoon was the most reprinted cartoon in New Yorker, and Steiner earned over $50,000 for reprinting it.
title: 在互联网上，没人知道你是一条狗

source_text: 漫画家彼得·施泰纳自从1980年开始就为《纽约客》创作。他说道，这则漫画一开始没有吸引太多的注意，但后来却有了它自己的“生命”。施泰纳觉得，这就和创建了表情符号的人一样。实际上，当创作漫画的时候施泰纳对互联网没什么兴趣，尽管他有一个在线的帐号。他回忆道，当时并没有在漫画上加什么“深层”的意义，只是在用一种“编写标题”方式来创作罢了。
target_text: The cartoonist Peter Steiner has been writing for the New Yorker since 1980. He said that the comic book did not attract much attention at first, but had its own “life.” Steiner felt that it was the same as the person who created the emoticons. In fact, when it was written, Steiner was not interested in the Internet, although he had an online account.
title: 在互联网上，没人知道你是一条狗

source_text:
作为对互联网隐私的评论
这则漫画体现了一种对互联网的理解，强调用户能够以一种不透露个人信息的方式来发送或接受信息的能力。劳伦斯·莱西格认为这是因为TCP/IP协议不强迫用户提供自己的身份证明，尽管用户本地的互联网接入点（如某些大学）可能要求用户实名上网，尽管这样，用户的信息也是由本地互联网接入点保管，不作为在互联网传输信息的一部分。
target_text: As a comment on Internet privacy, the cartoon reflects an understanding of the Internet, emphasizing the ability of users to send or receive information in a way that does not disclose personal information. Lawrence Lacig argues that this is because the TCP/IP protocol does not oblige users to provide their own identity documents, although local Internet access points (e.g. some universities) may require users to access the Internet by their own names, even though the user information is also kept by local Internet access points and is not part of the transmission of information on the Internet.
title: 在互联网上，没人知道你是一条狗

source_text:
作为对互联网社会学的评论
一项由莫拉翰-马丁和舒马赫（Morahan-Martin and Schumacher）在2000年做出的关于互联网使用的复杂性的研究讨论了这个现象，他们认为表示计算机屏幕前的自己的身份的能力可能是上网的复杂性体现之一。这一常用语可以用于“表示赛博空间将会是自由化的，因为性别、种族、年龄、外貌，甚至于‘狗性’都可以不提供，甚至可以编造或者创造性地夸张这些属性，以达到合法或非法的目的”，这是对Usenet的关键人物约翰·吉尔摩1996年的理解的共鸣。这一短语同时暗示了“计算机扮装”的可能，一个用户可以将自己装扮成不同性别、年龄、种族等等。在另一个层次上，“狗装扮自己的自由，是一种‘升级’为一种特权成员的自由，比如狗可以将自己升级为能够访问互联网的人类计算机用户。”在2007年，这则漫画被用于描述一个17岁的网站创建者是怎样被误认为是一个富有经验的专业互联网使用者，另外作为WikiScanner，能够将维基百科的匿名编辑与拥有该IP地址的企业联系起来的一个程序的隐喻。这可能还与使用互联网于恋童有一定的相关性。
target_text: As a comment on Internet sociology, a study by Morahan-Martin and Schumacher in 2000 on the complexity of Internet use discussed this phenomenon, suggesting that the ability to express their identity before computer screens might be one of the complex manifestations of Internet access. This term could be used to “show that Cyberspace will be liberalized, because the freedom of a dog to dress itself is a freedom to “upgrade” to a privileged member, such as the ability of a dog to upgrade itself to a human computer user who can access the Internet, for legitimate or illegal purposes.” In 2007, the cartoon was used to describe how a 17-year-old website creator was mistakenly perceived as a professional Internet user with experience, age, race, and so on.
title: 在互联网上，没人知道你是一条狗

source_text:
影响
这则漫画引出了阿伦·大卫·珀金斯的《没人知道我是一条狗》的上映。这一剧集围绕着六个不同的人展开，他们在现实生活中无法与其他人很好地交流，却因为匿名性，在互联网上找到了社会化的勇气。1995年时，比尔·盖茨支付了200美元的版权费，在他的《未来之路》中使用这一漫画。
target_text: Influences have led to the screening of Alan David Perkins' "Noone Knows I'm a Dog." The episode was organized around six different people, who could not communicate well with others in real life, but found the courage to socialize on the Internet because of anonymity. In 1995, Bill Gates paid $200 for his copyright, which he used in his Way of the Future.
title: 在互联网上，没人知道你是一条狗

source_text:
许多抵御中间人攻击的技术基于以下认证技术：
公钥基础建设
在PKI方案中，主要防御中间人攻击的方案就是PKI的相互认证的机制。使用这样的机制并由应用程序验证用户，用户设备验证应用程序。但在某些流氓应用的情况下，这不是很有用，所以需要注意对流氓软件应与正规软件进行区分。
更强力的相互认证，例如：
密钥（通常是高信息熵的密钥，从而更安全），或
密码（通常是低的信息熵的密钥，从而降低安全性）
延迟测试，例如使用复杂加密哈希函数进行计算以造成数十秒的延迟；如果双方通常情况下都要花费20秒来计算，并且整个通讯花费了60秒计算才到达对方，这就能表明存在第三方中间人。
第二（安全的）通道的校验
一次性密码本可以对中间人攻击免疫，这是在对一次密码本的安全性和信任上建立的。公钥体系的完整性通常必须以某种方式得到保障，但不需要进行保密。密码和共享密钥有额外的保密需求。公钥可以由证书颁发机构验证，这些公钥通过安全的渠道（例如，随Web浏览器或操作系统安装）分发。公共密钥也可以经由Web在线信任进行在线验证，可以通过安全的途径分发公钥（例如，通过面对面的途径分发公钥）。
target_text: Many technologies to resist attacks by intermediaries are based on the following authentication techniques: Public key infrastructure, in the PKI program, where the primary defense agent attack is the PKI mutual authentication mechanism. Using such mechanisms and using the application to validate users, the user device validates applications. This is not useful in some hooligan applications, so attention needs to be paid to the distinction between hooligan software and formal software.
title: 中间人攻击

target_text: Formatting is done in a DOS environment, where there are a variety of software to perform formatting operations, and the system usually provides a command line interface formatted software, "Format " , in the form of an external command. The Format command parameters include disks that will be formatted, as well as other secondary parameters, such as the size of the basket, the formatting of the file system, etc. The Format command usually reads: Format X: (X is a disk that wishes to be formatted, and replaces X to C if you want to format C. 历史
早期的计算机软件都是用汇编语言直接编写的，这种状况持续了数年。当人们发现为不同类型的中央处理器（CPU）编写可重用软件的开销要明显高于编写编译器时，人们发明了高级编程语言。由于早期的计算机的内存很少，当大家实现编译器时，遇到了许多技术难题。
target_text: History, early computer software is written directly in compilation languages, a situation that continues for several years. target_text: In machine learning problems, a “natural state” (possibly an infinite distribution) needs to be studied in a limited sample of data on high-dimensional features (where each feature can take a range of possible values), requiring a significant number of training data to contain some sample combinations. source_text: PyPy（）是一种Python编程语言实现，可用于替代CPython（它是标准实现）。PyPy通常运行得比CPython更快，因为PyPy是一种即时编译器，而CPython是一种解释器。多数Python代码可以很好的运行在PyPy之上，除非代码依赖于CPython扩展，它们在运行于PyPy的时候，要么不工作要么招致一些开销。PyPy在内部使用叫做元跟踪的技术，它将解释器变换成。因为解释通常比编译器要容易写，但运行得更慢，这种技术可以更容易的产生出编程语言的高效实现。PyPy的元跟踪工具链叫做RPython。
target_text: PyPy() is a Python programming language that can be used to replace Cython (which is standard realization). PyPyPy usually runs faster than Cython, because PyPy is an instant compiler, and Cython is an interpreter. Most Python codes can operate well above PyPyPy unless the code relies on Cython extensions, and they either do not work or incur some expense when they run on PyPy. PyPyPy uses a metatrack technology internally, which changes the interpreter. Because interpretation is usually easier to write than an interpreter, but it works more slowly, it can be more easily efficient in producing programming languages. PyPyPyPy is called Rython.

source_text:
工作原理
要了解Gnutella网络是怎样工作的，先设想一个大的由用户（称为“节点”）组成的环，每个节点都有Gnutella客户端软件运行。当初始启动时，客户端软件必须进行自举（Bootstrapping）并找到至少一个其它节点，有多种不同的方法可以达到这一功能，包括软件内置的一组正在工作的已经存在的地址列表，Web缓存的已知节点更新（称为GWebCaches ）, UDP服务器缓存以及IRC。一旦连接上，客户端就会请求一张活动地址列表。
target_text: To understand how the Gnutella network works, a large ring consisting of users (known as " nodes " ), each node is run by a Gnutella client. When initial start-up, the client ' s software must be self-inflicted (Bootstrapping) and find at least one other node, and there are a number of different ways to achieve this function, including a list of already existing addresses that are working in the software, a list of known node updates of Web caches (known as GWebCaches), a UDP server cache, and an IRC. Once connected, the client will request a list of active addresses.
title: Gnutella

在制作Web应用程序时，有几种定位移动设备的方法：
响应式网页设计可用于制作网络应用程序 - 无论是传统网站还是单页应用程序，都可以在小屏幕上查看，并且可以很好地与触摸屏配合使用。
渐进式网页应用程序是常规网页或网站和移动应用程序的混合体。
原生应用程序或“移动应用程序”直接在移动设备上运行，就像常规软件应用程序直接在台式计算机上运行一样，而无需Web浏览器（并且可能不需要Internet连接）; 这些通常是用Java（Android设备）或Objective C或Swift（用于iOS设备）编写的。最近，像React Native，Flutter和Xamarin这样的框架允许使用不同于每种标准本地语言的语言来开发所有平台的本地应用程序。
混合应用程序在本地应用程序中嵌入移动网站，可能使用混合框架（如 Apache Cordova 和 Ionic 或 Appcelerator Titanium）。这允许使用网络技术进行开发（并且可能直接复制来自现有移动网站的代码），同时还保留原生应用的某些优点（例如，直接访问设备硬件，离线操作，应用商店可见性）。

The original or “mobile applications” operate directly on mobile devices, just as conventional software applications operate directly on desktop computers without Web browsers (and may not be connected); these are usually written using Java (Android devices) or Objective C or Swift (for iOS devices). Recently, frameworks such as React Native, Flutter and Xamarin allow the development of local applications for all platforms in languages different from each standard local language. Mixed applications are embedded in local applications without Web browsers (and may not be needed); these are often made using hybrid frameworks (e.g. Apache Cordova and Ibjectoric C or Appicator Titutum), which allow the use of software that is not available (e.g., direct-widing), which allows the use of software that can be used (e.g., direct-widing), and which can also be used (e.g., direct-widing), and which can be used (e.g., direct-widing, from existing software applications, which can also be used, using

source_text:
历史
在较早的网络架构（如客户机 - 服务器）中，应用程序的处理负载在服务器上的代码和本地安装在每个客户机上的代码之间共享。换句话说，一个应用程序有自己的预编译客户端程序作为其用户界面，必须分别安装在每个用户的个人电脑上。升级到应用程序的服务器端代码通常还需要升级到安装在每个用户工作站上的客户端代码，这增加了技术支持成本并降低了生产力。此外，应用程序的客户端和服务器组件通常都与特定的计算机系统结构紧密相连，操作系统并将它们移植到其他操作系统对于除了最大的应用程序之外的所有操作系统而言都是非常昂贵的 （现在，用于移动设备的本地应用程序也受到一些或所有上述问题的困扰。）
target_text: In earlier network structures (e.g. client-server), applications are shared between the code that handles loads on the server and the code that is installed locally on each client. In other words, an application has its own pre-compiler client program as its user interface, which must be installed on each user ' s personal computer. Server end codes that are upgraded to the application usually need to be upgraded to the client code that is installed at each user ' s workstation, which increases technical support costs and reduces productivity. In addition, applications ' clients and server components are usually closely linked to specific computer system structures, and operating systems and transplanting them to other operating systems are very expensive for all operating systems except the largest ones. (Now, local applications for mobile devices are also affected by some or all of the above-mentioned problems.)
title: 网络应用程序

source_text: 相反，网页应用程序使用由各种网页浏览器支持的标准格式（如HTML和JavaScript）编写的网页。网页应用程序可被视为客户端 - 服务器软件的特定变体，其中客户端软件在使用诸如HTTP的标准程序访问相关网页时被下载到客户端机器。每次访问网页时都可能会发生客户端网页软件更新。在会话期间，网页浏览器解释并显示页面，并作为任何网页应用程序的通用客户端。
target_text: Instead, web applications use web pages in standard formats supported by various web browsers (e.g. HTML and JavaScript). Web applications can be considered client-server software-specific variants in which client-end software is downloaded to a client-end machine when using standard programs such as HTTP to access relevant web pages. Client-end web-page software updates are likely to occur every time a page is visited. During a session, the web browser explains and displays the page and serves as a generic client for any web-based application.
title: 网络应用程序

source_text:
结构
应用程序通常被分成称为“层”的逻辑块，其中每个层被分配一个角色。传统的应用程序只包含一层，它驻留在客户端机器上，但是网页应用程序本身就是一种n层的方法。尽管可能有许多变化，但最常见的结构是三层应用程序。按照最常见的形式，这三个层次按顺序被称为呈现，应用和存储。网页浏览器是第一层（呈现），引擎使用一些动态的网页内容技术（如ASP，CGI，ColdFusion，Dart，JSP / Java，Node.js，PHP，Python或Ruby on Rails）是中间层（应用程序逻辑），数据库是第三层（存储）。 Web浏览器发送请求到中间层，它通过使查询和更新对数据库服务他们，并生成用户界面。
target_text: Structures Applications are usually divided into logical blocks called " layers " , each of which is assigned a role. Traditional applications contain only one layer, which is located on the client-end machine, but web applications are in themselves a n layer approach. While there may be many changes, the most common structure is three layers of applications. In the most common form, the three layers are referred to sequentially as presentation, application and storage. The web browser is the first level (presentation). The engine uses dynamic web content technology (e.g. ASP, CGI, ColdFusion, Dart, JSP/Java, Node.js, PHP, Python or Ruby on Rails) as the middle level (application logic), and the database is the third level (storage). The Web browser sends requests to the middle level, which uses a number of dynamic web content technologies (e.g. ASP, CGI, ColdFusion, Dart, JSP/Java, Node.js, PHP, Python or Ruby on Rail).
title: 网络应用程序

source_text: 对于更复杂的应用程序，三层解决方案可能不足，使用n层方法可能会有所帮助，其中最大的好处是将驻留在应用程序层上的业务逻辑划分为更细粒度模型。另一个好处是可以通过提供易于使用的界面来访问数据，添加一个集成层，将数据层与其他层分开。例如，客户端的数据将被通过调用一个 "list_clients()" 函数，而不是直接使一个SQL查询针对数据库上的客户端表访问。这样可以替换底层的数据库，而不会对其他层进行任何更改。
target_text: For more complex applications, three-tier solutions may be inadequate and the use of the n-layer approach may be helpful, with the greatest benefit being the division of business logic in the application layer into a more fine particle size model. Another benefit is that data can be accessed by providing easy-to-use interfaces, adding an integrated layer that separates the data layer from the other layers. For example, client-based data will be accessed by calling a "list_clients()" function, rather than directly directing an SQL query to a client list on the database. This will replace the bottom database without any changes to the other layers.
title: 网络应用程序

source_text: 有一些人将Web应用程序视为两层架构。这可以是一个“聪明”的客户端，执行所有的工作，并查询一个“愚蠢的”服务器，或一个“愚蠢的”客户端，依靠一个“聪明的”服务器。客户端将处理表示层，服务器将具有数据库（存储层），业务逻辑（应用层）将在其中一个或两个上。虽然这增加了应用程序的可伸缩性，并将显示和数据库分开，但它仍然不允许真正的图层专业化，所以大多数应用程序将超过这个模型。
target_text: Some view the Web application as a two-tiered architecture. This can be a “smart” client, performing all of the work, and searching for a “smug” server, or a “smug” client, relying on a “smart” server. The client will process the signal layer, the server will have a database (storage layer), and the business logic (application layer) will be on either or both. While this increases the flexibility of the application and separates the display from the database, it still does not allow for a true layer specialization, so most applications will exceed the model.
title: 网络应用程序

source_text:
商业用途
应用软件公司正在形成的战略是提供对以前作为本地应用程序分发的软件的网络访问。根据应用程序的类型，可能需要开发一个完全不同的基于浏览器的界面，或者仅仅调整现有的应用程序以使用不同的演示技术。这些程序允许用户每月或每年支付使用软件应用程序的费用，而无需将其安装在本地硬盘驱动器上。遵循这一战略的公司被称为应用服务提供商（ASP），而ASP在软件行业中正受到越来越多的关注。
target_text: Applied software companies are developing a strategy to provide web access to software previously distributed as local applications. Depending on the type of application, a completely different browser-based interface may need to be developed, or only existing applications may be adapted to use different presentation techniques. Users are allowed to pay monthly or annual fees for the use of software applications without having to install them on local hard drives. The company that follows this strategy is known as ASP, which is receiving increasing attention in the software industry.
title: 网络应用程序

target_text: The cloud computing model Web application is software or service (SaaS). There are enterprise applications that provide fixed or related costs to the enterprise as SaaS. Other Web applications are free of charge and usually generate revenue from advertisements displayed in the Web application interface. The development of a Web application often uses open source software simplifications, such as Django, Ruby on Rails or Symfony called Web application frameworks. These frameworks facilitate rapid application development, allowing the development team to focus on the unique parts of its application without solving common development problems, such as user management.

source_text: Perlin噪声（Perlin noise，又稱為柏林噪声）指由Ken Perlin发明的自然噪声生成算法，具有在函数上的连续性，并可在多次调用时给出一致的数值。 在电子游戏领域中可以透过使用Perlin噪声生成具连续性的地形；或是在艺术领域中使用Perlin噪声生成图样。由于Perlin本人的失误，Perlin噪声这个名词现在被同时用于指代两种有一定联系的的噪声生成算法。这两种算法都广泛地应用于计算机图形学，因此人们对这两种算法的称呼存在一定误解。下文中的Simplex噪声和分形噪声都曾在严肃学术论文中被单独的称作Perlin噪声。
target_text: Perlin noise (Perlin noise, also known as Berlin noise) refers to natural noise generation algorithms invented by Ken Perlin, which have continuity in function, and which can be used several times to give consistent values. In the field of video games, it is possible to generate continuous terrain through the use of Perlin noise; or to use Perlin noise in the field of art. As a result of Perlin’s own fault, the term Perlin noise is now used as a proxy for two associated noise generation algorithms. Both algorithms are widely applied to computer graphics, so there is some misunderstanding as to the name of both algorithms.

软件应用
包括IBM和微软在内的大公司也在研究和开发文本挖掘方法和软件，以进一步实现文本挖掘和分析过程的自动化；而搜索和索引领域的一些公司也在研究和开发文本挖掘方法和软件，以改善其结果。在公共部门内，许多努力集中在开发跟踪和监测恐怖活动的软件上。对于研究而言，Weka软件（见后文“软件和应用”部分）是科学界最受欢迎的选择之一，它对初学者来说是一个很好的入门点。对于Python程序员来说，为更加普遍的目的有一个优秀的工具包，叫做。对于更高级的程序员，还有库，它专注于基于词嵌入的文本表示。
target_text: Software applications Large companies, including IBM and Microsoft, are also researching and developing text- excavating methods and software to further automate text- excavating and analytical processes; while some companies in the search and indexing field are also researching and developing text- excavating methods and software to improve their results. In the public sector, many efforts have focused on developing software to track and monitor terrorist activities. For research, Weka software (see the “software and applications” section below) is one of the most popular options for the scientific community, and it is a good entry point for starters. For Python programmers, there is an excellent toolkit for more general purposes, called. For more senior programmers, there is a repository that focuses on text expression based on embedded terms.
title: 文本挖掘

source_text:
影响
直到最近，网站最常使用的是基于文本的搜索，它只能找到包含用户给定的特定单词或短语的文件。现在，通过使用语义网，文本挖掘可以根据意义和上下文（而不仅仅是某个特定的词）来寻找内容。此外，文本挖掘软件可以被用来建立有关特定人物和事件的大型信息档案。例如，可以根据从新闻报道中提取的数据建立大型数据集，以促进社会网络分析或反情报工作。实际上，文本挖掘软件的作用类似于情报分析员或研究图书管理员，尽管分析的范围更有限。文本挖掘也被用于一些电子邮件的垃圾邮件过滤器，作为确定可能为广告或其他不需要的材料的信息的一种方式。文本挖掘在确定金融方面发挥着重要作用。
target_text: Until recently, the site most frequently uses text-based searches, and it can only find documents containing specific words or phrases from users. Text-digging can now be found by meaning and context (not just a particular word) through the use of semantic webs. Moreover, text- excavating software can be used to create large information files about specific persons and events. For example, large data sets can be created based on data extracted from news stories to facilitate social network analysis or counterintelligence. In practice, text-digging software functions similar to intelligence analysts or research librarians, albeit more limited in scope. Text-digging is also used in some e-mail spam filters as a way to identify information that may be useful for advertising or other unwanted materials. Text-digging plays an important role in determining finance.
title: 文本挖掘

target_text: Canonical Ltd. is a private company founded by South African entrepreneur Mark Sholworth, primarily to promote open source software projects. Canonical is registered in the Isle of Man and its employees are spread around the world. Its main offices are located in London, and its branches are located in Boston, São Paulo, Montreal, Shanghai, Taipei and Isle of Man. Canonical supports and creates several projects, mainly free/open source software (FOSS) or tools to improve free software developers and contributors.

source_text:
业务计划
在2008年5月接受衛報采访时，马克·沙特尔沃思说，Canonical公司的商业模式主要是基于软件的服务，并解释说，Canonical还不能收支平衡，仍需要持续的投资。马克还说，我们认为软件的未来就是不需要授权的，人们可以在第一时间免费得到他们想要的软件，公司依赖软件的服务盈利，这是未来的发展趋势。
这个战略类似于Red Hat在20世纪90年代的经营战略。
target_text: In an interview with the Guardian in May 2008, Mark Saurworth said that Canonical’s business model was primarily software-based and explained that Canonical was not yet even-handed and still required sustained investment. Mark also said that we thought that the future of software was non-authorized, that people could get what they wanted free of charge at the first minute, and that the company’s reliance on software for its services was a future development similar to Red Hat’s business strategy in the 1990’s.

source_text:
继续教育学院（民航英语培训中心）
继续教育学院(民航英语培训中心) 是中国民航飞行学院成人高等教育和继续教育的管理机构，主要负责学历教育、非学历教育、民航英语培训和相关考试的组织管理。下设：学历教育部、民航专业培训部、民航英语教学部、办公室。学院分设四川广汉校本部、德阳校区两个教学基地。办学类型分为四大板块：成人学历教育（含自考）；民航职业技术教育；继续教育与岗位技能培训；民航英语培训与测试。在办学形式上，拥有成人高考、自考、成人脱产和岗位培训等。在办学层次上，具有专科、本科、专升本等。在专业设置上，有飞行技术、空中交通管理、民航运输、航空维修工程管理、空中乘务、航空服务、商务英语、计算机应用技术、会计、工商企业管理等12个专业；在技能培训方面，开展有航线执照理论培训、大学生改航空机务维护培训、空中乘务理论礼仪培训、ICAO英语培训等34种各类中短期培训班。同时，负责民航管制员英语等级测试、全国公共英语等级考试、全国计算机等级考试等工作。
target_text: The College of Continuing Education (the English-language training centre for civil aviation) is the regulatory body for adult higher education and continuing education at the Chinese Civil Aviation Institute and is responsible for the organization of academic, non-academic, civil aviation English-language training and related examinations. There are: the Ministry of Education for Education, the Ministry of Professional Training for Civil Aviation, the English-language teaching department for civil aviation, and offices. The College is divided into four main educational establishments: adult education (including self-testing); vocational technical education for civil aviation; continuing education and job skills training; training in English language training and testing in civil aviation. In the form of training, there is an adult advanced examination, self-study, adult exit and job training. At the school level, there are specialized, undergraduate, specialized promotion training. At the professional level, there are flight technology, air traffic management, civil aviation transport, aviation maintenance engineering engineering management, air service, aviation service, commercial English technology, computer application technology, accounting, business enterprise management, etc.
title: 中国民用航空飞行学院

source_text: ROT13是它自己本身的逆反；也就是說，要還原ROT13，套用加密同樣的演算法即可得，故同樣的操作可用再加密與解密。該演算法並沒有提供真正的密碼學上的保全，故它不應該被套用在需要保全的用途上。它常常被當作弱加密範例的典型。ROT13激勵了廣泛的線上書信撰寫與字母遊戲，且它常於新聞群組對話中被提及。
target_text: ROT13 is its own inverse; that is, it is possible to restore the original ROT13 by using the same encryption algorithm, so that the same operation can be re-encrypted and decrypted. The algorithm does not provide real password protection, so it should not be used for purposes that need to be preserved. It is often used as an example of weak encryption. ROT13 inspires extensive online letter writing and letter games, and it is often mentioned in news group conversations.
title: ROT13

source_text: ROT13並不意圖用在重視機密性的場合。固定位移的使用意味著該加密實際上並沒有金鑰，而且解碼不需要對ROT13實際上的使用有較深了解。即使沒有ROT13使用的知識，該演算法也相當容易透過頻率分析破解。正因為其完全不適合真正的機密用途，ROT13已經變成了一種警句，用來影射任何顯著的弱加密體-{系}-；例如批評家可能會這樣說：「56位元DES這些日子以來只比ROT13要好一點。」另外，作為對真正術語像“雙重DES”的嘲諷，半路殺出的術語“雙重ROT13”、“ROT26”、“2ROT13”、以及玩笑性質的學術論文「關於2ROT13加密演算法」 都閃爍著幽默的心思。因為套用ROT13到已經加密過的ROT13文字，將會打回原形；也就是說，ROT26等於沒有加密。延伸下去，三重ROT13（用來取笑其對比的 3DES）等同於1次ROT13而已。
target_text: ROT13 does not intend to use it for the purpose of critical cryptography. The use of fixed bit shift means that the encryption does not actually have a key, and decoding does not require a better understanding of ROT13 actually. Even without knowledge of ROT13, the algorithm can easily be deciphered by frequency analysis. Just because it is totally inappropriate for real classified uses, ROT13 has become a warning phrase, which is used to insinuate any apparent weak encryption -- {system}; for example, critics may say that "56 DESs these days are better than ROT13." Also, as a mockery of the authentic technical expression ROT13, which has been encrypted to ROT13, the half-circuited medium is "double ROT13", ROT26, 2 ROT13, and the joker theory that "retacts 2 ROT13" and "T" are not used as an extension of ROT3 (which is used as an extension of ROT3).
title: ROT13

不同的金属导体（或半导体）具有不同的自由电子密度，当两种不同的金属导体相互接触时，在接触面上的电子就会扩散以消除电子密度的差异，在两块金属的另两个端点形成稳定的电压，电子的扩散速率与接触区的温度成正比。由此产生的电压通常每开尔文温差只有几微伏。
而不同溫度的相同金屬（或半导体）也具有不同的自由电子密度，所以只要维持金属兩端的温差，也能使电子持续扩散，在金属的两个端点形成稳定的电压。
target_text: Different metal conductors (or semiconductors) have different free electrons, and when two different metal conductors are exposed to each other, the electrons spread over the surface to eliminate differences in electron density, creating a stable voltage at the other two endpoints of the two metals, which is proportional to the temperature of the area of contact. The resulting voltage is usually only a few microvolts per Kelvine. The same metal (or semiconductors) with different temperatures also have different free electrons, so maintaining temperature differentials at both ends of the metal can also sustain the electron diffusion and create stable voltage at the two end points of the metal.
title: 熱電效應

source_text: 不同的金属與半导体具有不同的（所产生赛贝克效应大小不同），半導體與金屬的主因略有不同。半导体在不同的溫度下具有不同的载流子密度，當單一半导体兩端具有溫度差時，載子會扩散以消除密度的差异，因而造成電動勢。兩端的温度相差越大，则产生的赛贝克电位差越大。而金屬的自由电子密度與費米能階幾乎不會隨溫度改變，因此金屬的赛贝克效应遠小於半導體。金屬的赛贝克效应由電子的平均自由程來決定。若平均自由程隨溫度上升，則熱端的自由電子有較高的機會向冷端移動，此時的塞貝克係數為負值。反過來說，若電子的平均自由程隨溫度上升而下降，則冷端的自由電子有較高的機會流向熱端，塞貝克係數為正值。

Semiconductors have different current densitys at different temperatures, and when the single half-conductor has a temperature differential, the load spreads to eliminate the difference in density, resulting in electric power. The difference in temperature between the two ends is the greater the difference in the level of Saber power. source_text: Elk Cloner是第一个已知被广泛传播的计算机病毒。当时15岁的高中生为Apple II操作系统写了这个病毒，该病毒被存储在软盘上。当计算机启动感染了Elk Cloner的软盘，这个病毒开始作用，并随后将它自己拷贝到任何被访问的未感染的软盘中。因为那时的计算机有两个软盘驱动器，并因为磁盘经常在朋友之间传递，这个病毒就被频繁地复制。在被感染后，计算机每被启动50次，就会显示以下文字：
target_text: Elk Cloner was the first computer virus that was known to be widely disseminated. At that time, 15-year-old high school students wrote the virus for the Apple II operating system, which was stored on diskettes. When the computer started to infect Elk Cloner's diskette, the virus started working and then copied itself into any uninfected disk that was visited. Because the computer then had two disk drives, and because the disk was often transmitted among friends, the virus was reproduced frequently.
title: Elk Cloner
