source_text: 社會學（）起源於19世紀末期，是一門研究社會的學科。社會學使用各種研究方法進行實證調查和批判分析，以發展及完善一套有關人類社會結構、社會行動或社會關係的知識體系，並會運用這些知識，以尋求或改善社會福利、深入社會與公眾進行對話與溝通、將人類從不平等及壓迫的物質條件下解放出來，等等為目標。
target_text: Sociology (which began at the end of the 19th century) is a study of society. Sociology uses a variety of research methods for empirical investigation and critical analysis to develop and refine a system of knowledge about human social fabric, social action or social relations, and uses it to seek or improve social well-being, engage in social dialogue and communication with the public, free human beings from inequality and oppression, etc.
title: 社会学

source_text: 社會學的研究範圍廣泛，包括了由微觀社會學層級的機構或人際互動，至宏觀社會學層級的社會系統或結構，社會學的本體有社會中的個人、社會結構、社會變遷、社會問題和社會控制，因此社會學通常跟經濟學、政治學、人類學等學科並列於社會科學領域之下。社會學在研究題材上或研究法則上均有相當的廣泛性，其傳統研究對象包括了社會階層、社會階級、社會流動、社會宗教、社會法律、越軌行為等，而採取的模式則包括定性和定量的研究方法。由於人類活動的所有領域都是由社會結構、個體機構的影響下塑造而成，所以隨著社會發展，社會學進一步擴大其研究重點至其他相關科目，例如醫療、護理、軍事或刑事制度、網際網路等，甚至是例如科學知識發展在社會活動中的作用一類的課題。另一方面，社會科學方法的範圍也越來越廣泛。在20世紀中葉以來多樣化的語言、文化轉變也同時產生了更多更具詮釋性、哲學性的社會研究模式。然而，自20世紀末起的科技浪潮，也為社會學帶來了嶄新的數學化計算分析技術，例如個體為本模型和社交網路。
target_text: Social sciences are often shaped by economics, politics, anthropology, and social sciences. There is a fairly broad spectrum of research subjects or research laws, ranging from social systems or structures at the micro-social level to social systems or structures at the macro-social level, to qualitative and quantitative research methods such as social, social structures, social change, social problems and social control. All domains of human activity are shaped by the influence of economics, politics, anthropology, etc. The social sciences have expanded their research to other subjects, such as medicine, culture, military or criminal system, Internet, etc. All fields of human activity have been shaped by the influence of social fabrics, institutions, etc. So social sciences have expanded their research to other subjects, such as medicine, discipline, military or analysis, social networks, and even the role of science and technology in social science, such as the use of science and technology in social science.
title: 社会学

source_text: 因其興起的歷史背景，社會學研究的重心很大一部份放在現代性社會中的各種生活實態，或是當代社會如何形成演進以至今日的過程，不但注重描述現況，也不忽略社會變遷。社會學的研究對象範圍廣泛，小到幾個人面對面的日常互動，大到全球化的社會趨勢及潮流。家庭、各式各樣的組織、企業工廠等經濟體、城市、市場、政黨、國家、文化、媒體等都是社會學研究的對象，而這些研究對象的共通點是一些具有社會性的社會事實。雖然「社會性」的定義在不同學派之間仍有爭執，但社會事實外在於個人，且對個人的行為跟認知有影響，這一點是大致上為社會學者所共同接受的。
target_text: As a result of its historical background, sociology has focused much of its attention on the realities of life in contemporary societies, or on how the present generation has evolved so far, not only describing the current situation, but not ignoring social change. Social studies have a wide range of views, small enough for the day-to-day interaction of several people, and have grown to the realities and trends of globalization. Families, organizations, businesses, economics, cities, markets, political parties, the State, culture, the media, etc. are social studies, and the common denominators of these studies are socio-social facts.
title: 社会学

source_text:
概观
在19世纪初期，孔德認為過去神學及崇尚武力的社會慢慢消失，以理性、科學、工業為主的年代正在抬頭，兩者之間的衝突正是社會動盪的源頭。在社會制度轉變的時期，這種過渡性的衝突及混亂是無可避免。在舊制度消失前，人們無法體驗新制度，往往需要多次社會轉變才能改組社會。社會學就是針對社會改組的問題（現代性）而發展成為一門社會科學。涂爾幹學派的社会学家不但希望了解什么使得社会团体聚集起来，更希望了解社会瓦解的发展过程，從而作出“糾正”。糾正的觀念並不暗示社會學家預設一個「正確社會」的模板。涂爾幹本人都不認為有一個終極的、完美的社會可以參考。簡單來說，當一群人互動形成一個穩定的參考架構，運行良久，對他們來說就是「常態」。當社會制度問題積累下來，此一穩定狀態被打破，形成混亂，即上述所謂「瓦解」時，就形成病態。因此涂爾幹認為，社會學家職責在於找出一個社會的「日常常態」，如此才能確定出「病態」的判斷標準。社會學家需要不斷觀察與分析，不是找出模板，宣稱終極事實就結束。
target_text: At the beginning of the 19th century, Kondell thought that the atheistic and violent societies of the past were slowly disappearing, and that the conflict between the two was the source of social change. In times of social transformation, this excess conflict and chaos could not be avoided. Before the old system disappeared, one could not experience a new system, and it often took a number of social changes to transform society. Social scientists were developing into a social science in a time of rationality, science, and industry.
title: 社会学

source_text: 相反地，法兰克福学派的社會學家並不探索對糾正社會的方法。因為他們認為對社會病疾提出的糾正方案，往往是以一個小群體的觀念強加到絕大多數人的身上，這不但解決不了問題，還會使問題加重。20世紀初，如霍克海默與阿多諾等人，受到上一代如韋伯與齊美爾學說影響，加之參考馬克思理論，針對現代社會與資本主義制度產生悲觀看法，其中尤其看到社會雖然高度分工，卻也產生生活的分裂化。尤其是在藝術文化領域，大量複製技術的出現，造成藝術精神的喪失。法蘭克福第二代哈伯瑪斯繼承上述觀點，並參照美國结构功能主义與符号互动论、歐陸的現象學等，提出溝通行動論，與第一代悲觀觀點不同，認為必須致力建構一個可溝通的社會，才是悲觀現代性的出路。而上述的觀念，類似社會衝突論，知名人士如達倫道夫，也是以馬克思對社會階級分析為主，認為社會有掌握資源的階級，以及受統治的階級，惟不同的是，馬克思認為資產階級握有生產工具，無產階級因無工具而受宰制，需要反抗革命，觀點較屬於政治經濟學，但衝突論者，結合韋伯對階層──加入社會地位等角度，認為社會不平等，源自多方面，不只經濟不平等。
target_text: At the beginning of the 20th century, socialists such as Hoxheimer and Adorno, who were influenced by the previous generation, such as Weber and Chimere, added to the theory that the modern society and the capitalist system had a pessimistic view, especially that society had a high degree of division of labour, but also divided life. In particular in the realm of artistic culture, the emergence of a large number of replicas had led to the loss of the art spirit.
title: 社会学

source_text: 今天，社會學家對社會的研究包括了一系列的從宏觀結構到微觀行為的研究，包括對种族、民族、阶级和性别，到細如家庭結構个人社会关系模式的研究。社會學系分成更多更細的研究方向，包括像犯罪和离婚，在微觀方面例如有人與人之間的關係。一些社會學家使用定量研究的方法从数量上来描述一个社会总体结构，以此来研究可以预见社会变迁和人们对社会变迁反应的定量模型。这种由拉扎斯费尔德倡导的研究方法，现在是社会学研究中的两个主要方法论之一。社会学研究方法的另外一个主要流派是定性研究，包括歷史社會學、参与观察、深度访谈、专题小组讨论等收集资料的方法，以及基于扎根理论、内容分析等定性资料的分析及歸納方法。从事定性分析的社会学家相信，这是一种更好的方法，因為这可以加強理解“离散”性的社会和独特性的人文。这种方法从不寻求有一致观点，但却可以互相欣赏各自所采取的独特方式并互相借鉴。主流的观点认为，定量和定性这两种研究方式是互补的，而不是矛盾的。涂爾幹與韋伯都強調兩者的重要性──亦即從主觀（質化）與客觀（量化）交錯研究，到後來的象徵互動派大師布魯默相當強調質化的影響力。
target_text: Today, sociologists use quantitative research to describe a society as a whole in quantitative terms. This research, promoted by Lazasfeld, is now one of the two main approaches in sociological research. Another major source of sociology research is qualitative research, including historical sociology, participation in observation, in-depth interviews, panel discussions, etc., which collects information, for example, in the context of microscopic relationships between people and people. Some sociologists use quantitative research to describe a society as a whole in quantitative terms, in order to look at quantitative models that can predict social change and people’s reactions to social change. This research, promoted by Lazasfeld, is now one of the two main approaches in sociological research.
title: 社会学

source_text:
社會學的角度
社會學的角度就是讓我們通過社會學看事物的方法去認識自己及分析社會。其中兩種比較著名的社會學角度就是「社會學的想像力」(Sociological Imagination)及「破解謎思」(Debunking)。
「社會學的想像力」由賴特·米爾斯所創，其主要意思是指我們可以透過「社會學的想像力」去了解社會。
target_text: The sociology perspective, the sociology perspective, allows us to understand ourselves and to analyse society through the sociology approach. Two of the more famous sociology perspectives are the Social Imagination and the Debunking. "Sociology Imagination" was created by Wright Mills, which means that we can understand society through the "sociology imagination."

source_text: 至於「破解謎思」是彼得·柏格的概念。他指出了「社會學的意識中是存在著一種揭穿真相、破解謎思的動機」。這句話指出了社會學家是關注所有的人類活動，但他們關注的層面並不是一般人所關注的事實之表面，而是以一個質疑的心態去思考及破解一件事情的謎思。
target_text: As for cracking the puzzle, he pointed out that "the idea of sociology is that there is an incentive to uncover the truth and crack the puzzle." This said that sociologists are concerned with all human activity, but that the level of attention they focus on is not the face of the fact that ordinary people are concerned with, but rather the idea of thinking about and deciphering a thing with a skeptical mind.
title: 社会学

source_text:
起源
人类对社会变化发展的整体研究源远流长，社会学的逻辑和理念早在其形成学科基础之前就已经出现。对社会的分析和研究基本上是源于西方文化、哲学思想的长年累积，并至少在早于柏拉图时代之前产生。而更加正规的社会统计调查的起源更可以追溯到至少早在1086年的“末日审判书”。另一方面，在中世纪的伊斯兰社会也有早期社会学的踪影，不少研究均指出历史上第一位社会学家，是一位十四世纪来自北非的阿拉伯学者——伊本·赫勒敦，其最著名的著作《历史绪论》首次介绍了有关社会凝聚力和社会冲突议题的社会科学理论。到了十七世纪，以笛卡儿为代表的理性主义者即注意到科学拥有发现真理的能力，而开始尝试运用科学方法来研究社会现象。
target_text: At least in the 17th century, the rationalists, represented by Dictes, took note of the ability of science to discover the truth and began to use scientific methods to study social phenomena.
title: 社会学

source_text: 社会学一词的英语“sociology”（或“sociologie”），是由拉丁语“socius”（同伴）、“-ology”（研究），和希腊语“λόγος”（即“lógos”，意指字词、知识）组合而成，这个名称最早由法国散文家埃马纽埃尔-约瑟夫·西哀士（1748年—1836年）在一份当时未公开的手稿中创造。至1838年，法国科学哲学家奧古斯特·孔德（1798年—1857年）正式确立了“社会学”一词。孔德在初期曾使用“社会物理学”（social physics）一词，但后来被别人挪用，其中包括著名的比利时统计学家朗伯·阿道夫·雅克·凱特勒。孔德寄望通过对社会领域整体的科学认识，而令历史学、心理学和经济学形成一体化，社会学正式由此而生。
target_text: The term sociology, “sociology” (or “sociologie”) was first created in an unpublicized manuscript. By 1838, the term “sociology” was formally established by the French scientific philosopher Auguste Condé (1798-1857), and by the Greek “sociology” (i.e., “lógos”, meaning words, knowledge). Condé used the term “social physics” at an early stage, but was later embezzled by others, including the famous Belgian statistician Lambert Adolf Jacques Keitler.
title: 社会学

source_text: 社会学作为一门独立的学科确立于十九世纪中叶，其出现并非历史的偶然，而是与剧烈的社会变迁引起的社会运行状态失调有着密切的关系。自十八世纪末开始，先后发生了两次来自欧洲的大革命，第一次是以1789年法国大革命为标志的政治思想大革命，另一次是从英国开始、一直扩展到欧洲和美国的工业革命，这两件重大事件使西方社会发生了根本性转型。资本主义确立后，一方面生产力得到突飞猛进的发展，令社会的经济基础、思想观念和政治制度都发生重大变化；另一方面，社会运行也暴露出许多不协调因素，如周期性经济危机、失业、犯罪等。对于这些问题，传统方法和原有科学体系无法作出满意的解释和回答，于是社会学作为一门不同于其他社会科学的独立新学科便应运而生。
target_text: Since the end of the eighteenth century, there have been two major revolutions from Europe, the first of which was marked by the French Revolution of 1789, and the second by the industrial revolution, which began in the United Kingdom and has been extended to Europe and the United States, which brought about a fundamental transformation in Western society. After the establishment of capitalism, on the one hand, the rapid evolution of productivity has led to significant changes in the economic base, mindsets and political systems of society; on the other hand, the social functioning has revealed many incoherent factors, such as cyclical economic crises, unemployment, crime, etc.
title: 社会学

source_text: 孔恩德所身处的年代适逢法国大革命之后的持续动荡，他认为社会上的各种弊病和问题可以透过社会学实证主义消除，这是在其著作《实证哲学教程》、《实证主义概论》（A General View of Positivism）中明确提出的一个认识论模式。他相信在人类知识发展“三阶段律”（Law of three stages）中，在继神学阶段和形而上学阶段（或称玄学阶段）之后，实证阶段将占据最终的位置，也是他最重视的部分。孔德認為過去神學主导及崇尚武力的社會会慢慢消失，以理性、科學、工業為主的年代正在抬頭，兩者之間的衝突正是社會動盪的源頭。在社會制度轉變的時期，這種過渡性的衝突及混亂是無可避免的。在舊制度消失前，人們無法體驗新制度，往往需要多次社會轉變才能改組社會。社會學就是針對社會改組問題（現代性）而發展成為一門社會科學，它在社会转型中产生，以解决社会运行和发展中的不协调因素，以寻求社会良性运行和协调发展的规律为内容，并且将这条主线贯穿于整个社会学发展历史。
target_text: In the “Three Stages” of Human Knowledge Development, he believed that after the period of theological and physical schooling (or the theoretical stage), the practical phase of the society would take its final place and be the most important part of his sociological empiricalism. In his book, the Academy of Empirical Philosophy, the A Generalory of Evidence, the Age of Socialism, the Age of rationality, Science, Industry, and so on, the conflict between the two is the source of social dynamics. At a time when the social system has been transformed, it is inevitable that this excessal conflict and chaos will take place after the period of theological and physical schooling (or the theoretical phase), and that it will be the most important part of his work.
title: 社会学

source_text: 总体而言，1830年代到19世纪末叶普遍被视为西方社会学的创立时期。这一时期的社会学特点是：（一）与哲学关系密切；（二）受实证主义思潮影响极大；（三）创立社会学的目的在于维护协调现存的社会关系。此时期以孔德和英国哲学家赫伯特·斯宾塞为主要代表。孔德认为，社会学是研究社会秩序和社会进步的科学。整个社会和自然界是建立在协调一致的基础之上，这就是社会秩序；社会变迁中旧的社会秩序被新的社会秩序所取代，成为社会进步。斯宾塞则把社会变迁论运用于社会学研究，他认为社会是一个有机体，社会进化和生物进化遵循着同一条规律，具有人类社会等同有机生物的含义，因此他的理论被称为社会有机论。1874年，斯賓塞编写了历史上首本以社会学为名的书籍——《社会学研究》（The Study of Sociology）。
target_text: In general, the period from the 1830s to the end of the nineteenth century was widely regarded as the time of the creation of Western sociology. The sociological characteristics of this period were: (i) close ties with philosophy; (ii) highly influenced by empirical thinking; and (iii) the creation of sociology with the aim of preserving the reconciliation of existing social relations. The period was mainly represented by Condé and British philosopher Herbert Spencer, who, according to Kondé, was the science of social order and social progress. The social and natural world was based on a coherent foundation, which was the social order; the social order was replaced by a new social order in which the social order was transformed into social progress. Spence applied social change to sociological research, which considered society to be an organism, social evolution and biological evolution to follow the same pattern, with the meaning of organic life as human society, so his theory was referred to as the social organic theory.
title: 社会学

source_text: 当时孔德和马克思双方均提出在欧洲实现工业化和世俗化之后，发展一种科学上合理的社会制度，但同时马克思又否定了以孔德为首的社会学实证主义。在孔德提出社会学构想的同时，马克思在《1844年经济学哲学手稿》中已经形成了新的唯物主义历史观。马克思认为人与自然界的关系是以劳动为中介的，他从经济学上分析了在生产资料私有制度下，人的劳动本性异化的表现，提出了劳动的解放将标志着人性的复归和社会的人性化，从而使对资本主义的经济学批判转入到在社会学上关于资本主义对人限定的地位的批判。马克思唯物史观社会学的产生，使社会学在本质上变成为批判的、革命的科学，与孔德强调秩序、均衡，目的在于维护和改良现存制度的实证主义社会学形成鲜明的对立。这也是马克思本人一直拒绝把自己的社会理论称为“社会学”的基本原因，直至二十世纪初列宁才明确把马克思的社会理论称之为马克思主义社会学，使之为早期社会学的重要支柱之一。二十世纪著名哲学家以赛亚·伯林也认为，马克思可以被视为“真正的现代社会学之父”。
target_text: Condé and Marx both proposed the development of a scientifically sound social system after the industrialization and secularization of Europe, while Marx rejected the sociological empiricalism headed by Condé. Conduced by his sociological vision, Marx has developed a new materialistic historical perspective in the 1844 Economics Philosophy Manual. Max argued that the relationship between humans and nature was labour-mediated, and that his economic analysis of the physical alienation of human beings under the private system of production resources and his presentation of the liberation of labour would mark the return to human nature and the humanization of society, thus shifting the criticism of the economics of capitalism to the social studies of the defined position of capitalism in humans. It was only at the beginning of the twentieth century that the social theory of Marx was explicitly called the social theory of Marxist, the revolutionary science, and the Kong emphasis on order and balance, with the aim of preserving and improving the realistic sociology of the existing system, was one of the fundamental arguments that Max himself had refused to refer to his social theory as “sociology” and that the social philosophy of the early days had become one of the twentieth century.
title: 社会学

source_text: 十九世纪末期开始，社会学开始蓬勃发展，归功于法国社会学家爱米尔·涂尔干出版大量社会学研究专著，为社会学的规范化和科学化奠定坚实基础，并为确立社会学的学科地位作出重大贡献。他一生致力推动社会学发展，将源自孔德的实证主义发展成实际社会研究的基础。1895年，涂尔干在法国波尔多大学创立欧洲首个社会学系，并出版影响后世的重要著作《社会学方法的规则》，为社会学确立有别于其他社会科学学科的独立研究对象，即社会事实。涂尔干认为，一切社会的观念都具有无形的强制力，塑造人们的意识。人类大多数的意向不是个人自己生成的，而是在外界的引导、熏陶和压迫下形成的。社会事实无法用生理学、心理学或其他研究个体的方法来解释，而必须用社会学的方法、观点解释。至1896年，涂尔干又创办《社會學年鑒》（L'Année Sociologique）期刊，以刊登、传播他与学生的研究成果。在1897年出版的《自杀论》中，他以罗马天主教教徒和新教教徒人口自杀率的差异为例，引证社会学角度和心理学、哲学角度在分析社会事实上的区别，另外此著作也进一步发展结构功能主义理论。对涂尔干来说，社会学可以被形容为：
target_text: At the end of the nineteenth century, sociology began to flourish, thanks to the publication of numerous sociology studies by French sociologist Emile Durgan, which laid a solid foundation for the normative and scientificization of sociology and contributed significantly to the establishment of the scientific status of sociology. He devoted his life to promoting sociological development by developing empiricalism as a basis for real social research. In 1895, the first sociology department in Europe was created at the University of Bordeaux, France, and by the publication of a major book, the Rules of Sociological Methods, which influenced later life, which established an independent research subject of sociology as distinct from other socioscience disciplines, namely, social facts.
title: 社会学

source_text: 踏入20世纪，社会学的学术地位迅速提高，欧洲各地的大学相继成立社会学部。英国第一个社会学系在1904年创建于伦敦政治经济学院，这里也是英国社会学杂志的创刊地。1907年起，英国第一位社会学教授伦纳德·特里劳尼·霍布豪斯开始在伦敦大学担任社会学讲师。1909年，德国社会学家斐迪南·滕尼斯和马克斯·韦伯共同成立，随后，韦伯又在1919年于德国慕尼黑大学设立德国首个社会学系，并首次提出了反实证主义社会学的理念。在1920年于波兰创立波兰首个社会学系。1923年，法兰克福大学设立了社会研究院（Institut für Sozialforschung）。
target_text: In the 20th century, the academic status of sociology rose rapidly, with universities throughout Europe forming a Department of Sociology. The first Department of Sociology in England was founded in 1904 at the London School of Political Economy, which was also the founder of the British Journal of Sociology. Since 1907, the first professor of sociology in the United Kingdom, Leonard Trirony Hobhaus, began to be a lecturer in sociology at the University of London. In 1909, German sociologist Ferdinand Tennis and Max Weber, were founded together, followed by Weber ' s first German sociology department at the University of Munich, Germany, in 191919, and introduced the concept of anti-evidence social science for the first time. In 1920, the first Polish sociology department was established at the University of Frankfurt (Instituto für Sozialforschung).
title: 社会学

source_text: 与此同时，美国在社会学方面也有长足的发展。美国社会学家威廉·格雷厄姆·萨姆纳于1875年在耶鲁大学开始教授名为“社会学”的课程。1890年2月，法兰克·威尔森·布莱克默（Frank Wilson Blackmar）在美国堪萨斯大学设立“社会学元素”（Elements of Sociology）课程，并延续至今。1892年，芝加哥学派的代表人物——阿尔比昂·伍德伯里·斯莫尔（Albion Woodbury Small），在芝加哥大学创立社会学系。社会心理学始创者之一的喬治·賀伯特·米德，于密歇根大学任教时遇到查理斯·霍顿·库利和约翰·杜威；米德和杜威两人在1894年转往芝加哥大学任教，这使得社会心理学、象徵互動論（symbolic interactionism，或称符號相互作用論）获得极大的发展。1895年，阿尔比昂·W·斯莫尔创办美国首份社会学学术期刊——美国社会学杂志（American Journal of Sociology）。1905年，美国社会学协会（American Sociological Association，ASA）成立，并成为现今世界上规模最大的社会学家学会。深受涂尔干和马克斯·韦伯思想所影响的美国社会学者塔尔科特·帕森斯，一生致力推动社会学的专业化以及在美国的发展。受地理和历史因素影响，相比起欧洲的经历，美国社会学的发展在历史上较少受到马克思主义的影响，这个文化传统一直延续至今，而美国社会学更着重统计学上的研究方式。
target_text: In February 1890, Frank Wilson Blackmar introduced the “Sociology Elements” course at the University of Kansas, and continues to this day. In 1892, the representative of the Chicago school, Albion Woodbury Samall, started a course on “Sociology” at Yale University. In February 1890, Frank Wilson Blackmar, one of the founders of social psychology, was taught by Charles Horton Couli and John Duwey at the University of Michigan, and was transferred to the University of Chicago in 1894, leading to the development of social psychology, symmetry, or symmetry, or the greatest interaction in the history of the University of Chicago.
title: 社会学

source_text: 在中国，上海沪江大学于1913年创立中国大学第一个社会学系（该系在1952年并入华东师范大学），开设包括人类学、理论与应用社会学、社会调查与社会问题以及公民学在内的诸多课程，之后在1917年设立的沪东公社则是中国第一个大学社会学实验基地，被视为中国社会工作服务的前身。
target_text: In China, the first Faculty of Sociology of the University of China was founded in 1913 at the University of Shanghai (which was integrated into the University of Chinese Teachers in 1952) and offers a number of courses, including anthropology, theoretical and applied sociology, social investigation and social issues, and civics, and the subsequent establishment in 1917 of the Kundong Commune, the first university of China to be considered a precursor to social work services in China.
title: 社会学

source_text: 总体而言，社会学形成学术规模的成长期大约处于19世纪末到20世纪30年代。社会学的发展历程可以被看作为对例如工业化、城市化、世俗化等现代性问题的积极回应，或是对社会理性化（rationalization）的理解和反思。在社会学创始初期这段时期期间，社会学领域在欧洲大陆占据主导地位，并与英国的人类学和统计学遵循着类似的发展轨迹、举头并进；但踏入二十世纪以后情况开始逆转，越来越多的社会学家活跃在所谓的“盎格鲁势力范围”（Anglosphere），即以英语为主的地区。与此同时，社会学确立自己的研究范围和方法，独立的学科体系基本形成，而研究范围越来越具体化和专门化。很少早期的社会学家会限定于特定、狭隘的研究主题，例如经济学、法学、心理学、哲学等理论相关领域也是其关注范围。自社会学在十八世纪奠基以来，社会学的认识论、方法、研究架构等一直经历着扩展和分歧，形成百家争鸣的情况。
target_text: During the initial period of sociological science, the sociology field dominated the European continent and followed a similar development trajectory and convergence with the anthropology and statistics of the United Kingdom; but after the twentieth century, the situation began to reverse, with an increasing number of sociologists active in the so-called “Anglophere” (Anglosphere), an area dominated by the English language. At the same time, sociology has established its own research scope and methodology, with independent scientific systems largely formed, and its scope has become more specific and specialized. Very few early sociologists have been confined to specific, narrow subjects of study, such as economics, jurisprudence, psychology, philosophy, and other theoretically related areas, which are also of concern.
title: 社会学

source_text: 这一时期形成了以埃米尔·涂尔干为代表的实证主义路线，以马克斯·韦伯为代表的反实证主义路线和以美国芝加哥学派为代表的社会调查的传统的社会学研究局面。涂尔干的社会学理论以社会关系和社会团结为主线展开，坚持社会唯实论和社会整体观，主张在社会整体层次上进行实证性研究。同时他还对社会反常现象和社会偏离行为产生兴趣。韦伯则是倾向于个体主义，即主张对特定的社会行动和社会现象背后的个人动机及隐藏的秘密进行解释。他试图验证任何社会现象背后都有一种无形的、精神的力量在支撑。
target_text: During this period, the evidence-based approach, represented by Emile Durgan, was developed, using the anti-evidenceist route represented by Max Weber and the traditional sociological study by the United States of America’s Chicago school of thought. The sociological theory was based on social relations and social solidarity, based on social theory and social solidarity, and advocated empirical research at the level of society as a whole. At the same time, he was interested in social anomalies and social deviations.
title: 社会学

source_text:
当代社会学
当代社会学的发展时期大致从20世纪40年代至今。这一时期的特点是：
第二次世界大战后，西方社会学得到前所未有的发展，其重心从欧洲转移到美国
理论多元化，学派林立，观点分歧
分科化，社会学与其他社会科学的渗透加强，分科社会学种类增多
方法科学化，计算机的广泛运用，大大加快了资料处理速度，使社会学的研究更准确、快速、规范
target_text: Contemporary sociology The period of development of contemporary sociology from the 1940s to the present is characterized by the unprecedented development of Western sociology in the aftermath of the Second World War, the shift in focus from Europe to the United States of America, the pluralism of theory, the learning of Paring, the divergence of views, the fragmentation, the intensification of the penetration of sociology and other social sciences, the growing variety of sociology, the scientificization of methods and the widespread use of computers, which have greatly accelerated the processing of information and made sociological research more accurate, rapid and normative.
title: 社会学

source_text: 社会学理论经过一百多年的发展，尽管存在着缺乏完整的理论构架和很多彼此矛盾的方面，但已经成为成熟丰富且脉络清晰的理论体系，其中很多理论都有着鲜明的实践指向并在现实生活中发挥了有益的作用。也有很多理论虽然现在还很抽象概要，但也不乏启发性的地方。依照发展程度和时间顺序，社会学理论一般分作古典社会学理论、现代社会学理论和当代社会学理论。
target_text: After more than a hundred years of development, and despite the lack of a complete theoretical framework and many contradictory aspects, sociology has become a mature and well-structured system of theory, many of which have a clear practical orientation and have played a useful role in real life. There are also many theories that, while still abstract, are not without inspiration. In accordance with the degree of development and chronological sequence, sociology is generally divided into classical sociology, modern sociology and contemporary sociology.
title: 社会学

source_text: 古典社会学理论很大程度上是一些著名社会学家的理论，也就是说这一时期的社会学理论还缺乏完备的理论流派，单个社会学家的理论就能代表这一流派的特征。所以，人们在阐述这一阶段的理论的时候，多是介绍某几个社会学家的理论成果。不过这样的弊端也显而易见，单个社会学家理论成果对整个理论体系的代表在一些情况下过于勉强。所以，通过对其特征的归类和总结，将其归纳为以下四个理论框架。这样一来在对这一时期的理论有较为明晰的认识之后，又能与下一阶段的流派分类衔接。但要对各个理论有深入的了解，还是要回到这些社会学家身上。
target_text: The classical sociology theory is, to a large extent, the theory of some prominent sociologists, that is to say, the sociology of this period lacks a full spectrum of theory, and the theory of individual sociologists represents the characteristic of this school. So, most of the time when this phase of theory is described, the theoretical results of certain sociologists are presented. But it is also obvious that the theoretical results of individual sociologists are, in some cases, too reluctant to represent the system as a whole. So, by categorizing and summarizing their characteristics, they are grouped into the following four theoretical frameworks.
title: 社会学

source_text: 结构功能主义，研究社会结构如何构造，以满足由一个至高共享的规范体系所限定的各项功能的要求，和社会结构中各部分的功能和影响。社会被看做是一个有机统一的整体，人被看作是社会整体的一部分，是宗教和文化的遵奉者，没有社会和道德方面的支持就难以生存。涂尔干的社会团结和社会分工论、斯宾塞社会进化论在这个领域的建树都尤为突出。
target_text: Structural functionalism, examining how social structures are constructed to meet the requirements of functions defined by a top-sharing normative system, and the functions and influences of different parts of the social fabric. Society is seen as an organically integrated whole, where people are seen as part of society as followers of religion and culture, and cannot survive without social and moral support.
title: 社会学

source_text: 冲突论，也称批判理论，通过对社会物质发展的考察，对照人类社会的演进，探析出两者之间的紧密联系，从而得出人和社会是社会历史发展的产物，是具体历史社会情境中的产物，并被其所在的社会经济和历史方面的定位任意摆布、操纵和扭曲，使他们真实的自我发生畸变，进而产生持续的矛盾冲突体，反过来这样的冲突又推动着社会的发展。马克思的批判结构主义是这一方面的集大成者。
target_text: Conflict theories, also known as critical theories, reveal the close connection between the two by examining the physical development of society, in relation to the evolution of human society, in order to make it clear that human beings and society are the product of the development of social history, the product of specific historical social situations, and are arbitrarily manipulated, manipulated and distorted by their socio-economic and historical orientations, leading to real self-deforms, which in turn give rise to continuing conflict, which in turn drives the development of society. Marx’s critical structuralism is the confluence of this aspect.
title: 社会学

source_text: 交换理论，建立在个体功利主义的基础上，通过对个人利益的计算和实现手段的考察来解释人的行为，社会现象被还原为始终处于理性利益计算之中的个人。霍曼斯的行为主义交换论，布劳的结构交换论和艾默森的社会交换网络分析都对理解这一理论范式有很大裨益。
target_text: The theory of exchange, based on individual utilitarianism, interprets human behaviour through the examination of the means of calculating and realizing individual interests, and social phenomena are reduced to individuals who are always in the calculation of rational interests. The behaviourist exchange of Homans, the structural exchange of Burau, and the analysis of Emerson’s social exchange network are of great benefit to the understanding of this theoretical paradigm.
title: 社会学

source_text: 建构理论，将人看作是能动的社会建构者，人有资格，也有能力积极主动地创造或建构着社会，而人类的理性始终有着重要的指导作用。他将社会行为的理解置于对个人和主体间的意义和动机的理解。韦伯的理解社会学，齐美尔的形式社会学以及随后一系列学者构建的符号互动论，虽然看上去彼此差异很大，但质性方法论和对能动性的承认将其联系到了一起。
target_text: He places the understanding of social behaviour in the sense of meaning and motivation between the individual and the subject. Webb understands sociology, Zimmer ' s form sociology, and the symmetry of symbols constructed by a series of scholars that, while apparently very different from one another, relate to qualitative methodological theory and recognition of dynamism.
title: 社会学

source_text: 经过古典阶段的积淀，社会学理论摆脱了对哲学和其他社会科学的依赖，真正走上了特色鲜明的学科发展之路。现代社会学理论在取得重大发展的同时，其中的古典社会学理论影子依然清晰可见，这也说明二者的延续性和承袭性。事实上，现代与古典的阶段划分并非是界限分明的，二者除代表性人物和理论流派之外，都存在不少的交集。社会学理论在古典时期的四个理论框架，在此有不断的丰富和发展，随着特征差异增大，这些流派又不断分化，形成新的框架体系。
target_text: As a result of the classical phase, the sociological theory has moved away from its dependence on philosophy and other social sciences and has truly embarked on a path of distinctive academic development. While modern sociological theory has developed, its classical sociological shadow is still visible, indicating the continuity and inheritance of both. In fact, the modern-class phase is not clearly defined, and there is a great deal of convergence between the two, with the exception of representative figures and theoretical schools.
title: 社会学

source_text: 社會学理論當中常常用一些抽象和甚至複雜理論框架來解釋和分析社會樣式和宏觀社會結構。社會学理論總跟經典的學科有一個令人不安的關係，就是大部分的重要社會學家從未擔任大學職務。現今社會理論被認為社會學分支，涉足多個科學區域譬如人類學、經濟、神學、歷史等等。第一種社會理論幾乎跟社會學同時誕生。社會學之父——孔德創立第一社會理論——社會演化理論。在19世紀，三大社會理論分別是社會進化論、社會週期論和馬克思主義的歷史唯物主義。雖然它們現在被認為是過時，但是它們卻產生了新理論，像社会积淀论、新進化論、現代化的社會生物學、後工業化的社會理論及多邊理論。跟实验性的自然科學不同，社會理論家很少使用自然科學方法及其他事證方式來證明論點。反而，他們面對非常大型的社會走勢時候都使用一些假說。可是，這些假說需要很長的時間來證明。這正是反對者所批評的重點。對於解構主義者及後現代主義者，他們更質疑所有的研究及方法都是錯誤地承襲下來，很多時候，社會理論被認定為不可證明的。实际上，社会实践是检验社会学说的唯一标准。社会学说在社会实践中产生，在社会实践中检验，在社会实践中发展。
target_text: Social theory is now perceived as a branch of sociology, with many scientific areas such as anthropology, economics, theology, history, and so on. The first sociology is almost the same as the second sociology. The first sociology, the first sociology, the social theory of the post-industrialization, the social evolution theory. In the 19th century, the three major socionomies were the historical theory of social evolution, social chronology, and Marxism. They are now regarded as outdated, but they have new theories, such as socialism, new evolutions, sociobiology of modern times, post-industrial social theory, and multiple theories.
title: 社会学

source_text:
古希腊
发生在古希腊社会剧烈的社会转型，促使当时的思想家们不得不认真思考人以及有人组成的群体的问题，黄金时代的提出就是这样一个例子。当时的思想家对于奴隶制度的黑暗也甚为愤慨，但苦于没有更好的制度来替代，对人类命运的发展趋势也难以把握，于是追述往昔，希望回到奴隶制形成之前的社会，恢复人在社会中的尊严。
target_text: An example of this was the Golden Age, when thinkers were forced to think seriously about the human being and the group that formed it. The thinkers were also outraged at the darkness of slavery at the time, but suffering from the absence of a better system to replace it and the uncertainty of the course of human destinies. They then recounted the past, hoping to return to the society that existed before slavery and to restore the dignity of the human person in society.
title: 社会学

source_text: 其中两位哲人的社会思想尤其能说明问题。柏拉图眼中的人类社会是有机统一的，国家的各个组成部分组成了国家的功能，也从属于整体的调配，社会是一个分工的和不平衡的统一体。圣贤（哲学王）则是居于社会最顶端掌控国家机器的最佳人选，因为他有足够多的经验和知识，能够超越具体部分的利益，实现整个社会的最大福祉。在柏拉图看来，私有财产和家庭这样分散且独立的因素应该为社会整体的发展发挥自己的作用。亚里士多德与此相反。在《政治学》中一系列对人类社会和国家的看法虽然还较为混沌，但其中的社会学思想却是显而易见的，他就认为社会各个部分的独立要素在构成社会整体的同时，也能保持各自的独立性。他指出，社会起源于人的社会本性，即人有集合为群体的本能，但复杂、且异常分化的社会并非由个人组成的，它是建立在一个个群体的基础上，这样有相应的功能和财产的共同体最终组成了社会。
target_text: In Plato’s view, the human society, which is so fragmented and independent, should play its part in the development of society as a whole. By contrast, Aristotle, which has a rather mixed view of human society and the State, has a social philosophy that is obvious, and believes that the independent elements of the various parts of society can maintain their independence while forming the whole of society. He points out that the social nature of society is one of which is human, that is, a society in which people are brought together, but in which complex and abnormally divided societies are not made up of individuals.
title: 社会学

source_text: 社会契约论是这一时期最重要的社会思想，诞生于与教权和王权思想斗争中，由此发展出来的一种契约义务和社会关系结构的世界观，成为社会学起源的直接动因之一。由“天赋人权”为逻辑起点，从而推演出社会发展的趋势，是从自然状态向社会状态的不断演进，人们相互订立契约、建立国家来保障自己天赋之权，并由此发展对私有财产、自由、平等和享乐权利的认识。同时，众多思想家中还有很多对于人类社会的洞见都对之后的社会学思想产生重要影响。
target_text: Social contract theory is one of the most important social ideas of this period, born in the struggle against the ideas of dogma and monarchy, which has led to the development of a world view of contractual obligations and the structure of social relations as a direct motivation for the origins of sociology. The tendency to move from “natural human rights” as a logical starting point to social development is to evolve from a natural state to a social state, whereby people enter into contracts with each other, build State to guarantee their natural rights, and thus develop an understanding of private property, freedom, equality, and the right to enjoy.
title: 社会学

source_text: 孟德斯鸠关于自然地理条件对社会、国民心态影响的论述，及由此发展的历史演进理论，合同三权分立学说共同构成了他的社会整体论。伏尔泰的自然法权论则是在寻找符合人自然本性的社会立法原则。狄德罗的小康社会思想，让-雅克·卢梭关于社会发展阶段的思想，休谟关于权威对社会影响的观点，亚当·斯密研究的关于商业社会中产生社会分化的命题，福格森关于市民社会的研究，圣西门在工业社会方面的研究以及对实证主义的运用等等，都是这一时期的思想家们对社会思想发展的重要贡献。
target_text: Montesquieu’s discussion of the impact of natural geographical conditions on society, on national mentality and on the historical evolution of this development, the contractual three-power separation doctrine, together, constitutes his social cohesion. Voltaire’s natural jurisprudence is about finding principles of social legislation that are consistent with the nature of the human person. Didro’s social thinking, Jean-Jacques Rousseau’s ideas on the stage of social development, Jomud’s views on the impact of authority on society, Adam Smith’s study of social divisions in commercial society, Ferguson’s study of civil society, St. Simón’s research on industrial society and the application of empiricalism, among others, are important contributions of thinkers to the development of social thinking during this period.
title: 社会学

source_text:
社會研究方法
社會研究主要有“定性研究”和“定量研究”两大类。會用各種方法搜集經驗實證，包括問卷、面談、參與者觀察及統計研究。历史社会学研究属于定性社会研究方法。同样的，社会学与人类学学科的交融催生越来越多社会学家运用民族誌的方法对现代社会进行研究。
target_text: There are two main categories of social studies: “Qualitative studies” and “Quantitative studies” . Various methods are used to collect empirical evidence, including questionnaires, interviews, participant observations and statistical studies. Historical sociological research is a qualitative social research method. Similarly, the convergence of sociology and anthropology has led to an increasing number of sociologists studying modern societies using ethnologic methods.
title: 社会学

source_text: 不同的方法所面對的困難是它們都根據研究員各自採納的理論基礎來解釋及了解社會。作為功能主義者，艾彌爾·涂爾幹喜歡以社會大規模結構來解釋任何東西。如果他是符號互動者，他便專注人們如何理解別人。馬克思主義者或新馬克思主義者把什麼都化作階級鬥爭。現象學家只是思考大眾對現實如何建立自己的意義。當各方都面對現實社會問題時，常常爭論誰對誰錯，而實際上會把不同方法學結合。
target_text: The difficulty of different approaches is that they all explain and understand society according to the basis of the theory that the researchers themselves have adopted. As a functionalist, Emile Durant likes to explain anything in a broad social context. If he is a symbol interactive, he focuses on how people understand others.
title: 社会学

source_text: 一般觀點將社會學區分為宏觀或微觀兩類，認為分析單位如國家發展，就屬於前者；分析個人精神與家庭等，較屬於後者。這是相當僵化的解決看法。事實上，所謂微觀並非依照研究單位的規模看，微觀較屬於處理社會學基本原型的東西，更觀察在不同單位之間的互動，事實上，在企業之間、乃至於國家之間，也可以視為是一個個個體，研究他們之間的互動關係，以微觀方式處理之，諸如用象徵互動論、現象學方法等。
target_text: The general view divides the sociology into two categories: macros and microscopic, considering that analytic units, such as national development, belong to the former; an analysis of individual spirituality and family, and so on. This is a rather rigid solution. In fact, the so-called microscopic approach is not based on research units, but rather on what deals with basic models of sociology, and more on interactions between different units. In fact, it can also be seen as an individual entity, both between firms and even between countries, to study the interaction between them, and to deal with it in a microscopic way, such as through the use of pictomy, typologies, et cetera.
title: 社会学

source_text:
近年來，網際網路成為新的社會學的研究旨趣，如陳德維所言：
它是研究工具。例如網上問卷調查代替紙張問卷。
它成為討論平臺。
它本身是研究課題。互聯網的社會學研究網上社區、虛擬社區。
因為互聯網而產生社會組織上的改變，例如由工業社會轉型到知識社會的大型社會改變。
target_text: In recent years, the Internet has become the focus of new sociological research, as Chen Dewey has said: it is a research tool. For example, it is a web-based inquiry instead of a paper-based questionnaire.
title: 社会学

source_text: 一般歐美注意到網際網路的問題，較傾向從媒介角度出發，認為它不僅是一個溝通工具而已，更在於改變人們互動的模式，一如20世紀以前，貨幣出現連帶影響人們的現代都會生活等；或像古騰堡印刷術在歐洲蓬勃之後，對歐洲知識與教育等面向的改變。
target_text: In general, Europe and the Americas are aware of the problem of the Internet, preferring to start from a media perspective, thinking that it is not just a communication tool, but rather a change in the way people interact with each other, as was the case before the 20th century, when the currency had a connection to the modern times that affected people, or as in the case of Gutenberg printing, a change in orientation towards knowledge and education in Europe after the European boom.
title: 社会学

source_text:
社會學與其他社會科學
社會學家研究時常常分析群體，如社会阶级、社會組織、宗教組織、政治組織及商業組織。他們研究社會群體間的互動、跟蹤源頭及發展過程、分析群體活動對各個成員的影響。社會學家關心社會群體的特徵、群體間或成員間的互動影響及社會特徵（例如：性別、年齡、阶级、種族）對日常生活所帶來的效果。這些社會研究結果能夠協助教育家、立法者、行政人員、社工等解決社會問題並制定公共政策。大部分的社會學家都有多項專長，例如社會組織、社會分層及社會流動、種族關係、教育、家庭、社會心理學、城市、農村、政治及比較社會學、性別角色及關係、人口地理學、老年學、犯罪心理學及社會學應用。近年来，很多社会学家也开始研究性别、阶级和种族相结合而产生的种种社会不平等问题。.
target_text: Socialists often analyse the effects on everyday life of social groups, such as social classes, social groups, religious organizations, political organizations, and business organizations. They study social interactions, follow up on sources and developments, and analyse the impact of group activities on individual members. Socialists are concerned about the characteristics of social groups, the interactions between groups and members, and the effects of social characteristics (e.g. gender, age, class, race, etc.). These social studies help educators, legislators, administrators, social workers, etc. to solve social problems and formulate public policies.
title: 社会学

source_text: 今天，社會學研究人類組織、社會群體、社會互動等等都使用大量比較方法。社會學的發展對其它科學帶來額外的需求，這對研究現代工業社會是十分重要。近年，得到了人類學的啟示，加速了對多元文化及多元國民的研究。另一方面，社會學朝著微社會結構發展，例如：種族、社會階級、性別及家庭。因為有很多罪案發生、家庭問題產生了很大的社會壓力，急需要社會學來尋找解決方法。
target_text: Today, sociology researches human organizations, social groups, social interactions, etc., all use a lot of methods of comparison. The development of sociology has created an extra demand for other sciences, which is important for the study of modern industrial societies. In recent years, it has been inspired by anthropology, which has accelerated research on multiculturalism and diversity.
title: 社会学

source_text: 社會學家透過定性研究和定量研究來研究社會關係以預測社會變動。他們希望透過質性研究，如面談及小組討論，對社會運作有更深入的理解。有些社會學家正辯論着從中作出平衡填補兩者之間的空隙。例如：定量研究描述大型社會現象，而定性研究描述個人如何理解大型社會現象。在二十世紀早期，社會學家及心理學家曾對工業社會作出研究，對人類學作出了貢獻。要留意一點的是人類學家都曾對工業社會作出研究。今天社會學及人類學主要分別在於研究不同的理論和方法而不是對象。
target_text: In the early twentieth century, sociologists and psychologists studied the industrial world and contributed to the human sciences. It was important to note that anthropology was studied by humanists. Today sociology and anthropology are mainly distinguished from research on different theories and methods rather than on each other.
title: 社会学

source_text: 社會生物學是綜合社會學及生物學的一門新科學。雖然它很快獲得接受，但仍然有很多爭論的地方因為它嘗試使用進化及生物過程來解釋社會行為及結構。社會生物學家常被社會學家批評過份倚賴基因對行為的影響。社會生物學家卻說在自然之間和哺育存在一個複雜關係。故此社會生物學跟人類學、動物學、進化心理學有密切關係。這仍然是其他科學所不能接受的。一些社會生物學家像Richard Machalek要求使用社會學來研究非人類社會。
target_text: Social biology is a new science for sociology and biology. While it is quickly accepted, there is still much controversy because it tries to use evolution and biology to explain social behaviour and structure. Social biologists are often criticized by sociologists for the effects of genetic dependence on behavior. Social biologists argue that there is a complex relationship between nature and breastfeeding.

source_text: 信息科学（Information science），旧称情报学（漢語中的日語借詞），主要是指以信息为研究对象，包含資訊的分析、收集、分類、處理、儲存、檢索、傳播和保護。從發展脈絡來看，信息科學與計算機科學、心理學、科技和情報機構有相當的關聯，但是信息科學還包括了檔案學、圖書資訊學、博物館學、認知科學、商業、法律、語言學、管理學、數學、哲學、公共政策和社會科學等各個領域，是以扩展人类的信息功能为主要目标的一门综合性学科。
target_text: Information science, formerly referred to as intelligence (Japanese in Chinese), refers mainly to information research and includes information analysis, collection, classification, processing, storage, detection, transmission and protection. Information science and computer science, psychology, technology and intelligence institutions are quite relevant in the context of development, but it also includes archives, graphics and information technology, museum science, recognition, commerce, law, linguistics, management, mathematics, philosophy, public policy and social science, among others, as an integrated subject with the main objective of expanding the information function of humankind.

source_text: 生物學（；；德語：；法語：；）或稱生物科學（）、生命科學（），是自然科學的一大門類，由經驗主義出發，廣泛研究生命的所有方面，包括生命起源、演化、分佈、構造、發育、功能、行为、與環境的互動關系，以及生物分類學等。現代生物學是一個龐大而兼收並蓄的領域，由許多分支和分支學科組成。然而，儘管生物學的範圍很廣，在它裡面有某些一般和統一概念支配一切的學習和研究，把它整合成單一的、連貫的領域。在總體上，生物以細胞作為生命的基本單位，基因作為遺傳的基本單元，和進化是推動新物種的合成和創建的引擎。今天人們還了解，所有生物體的生存以消耗和轉換能量，調節體內環境以維持穩定的和重要的生命條件。生物學分支學科被研究生物體的規模所定義，和研究它們使用的方法所定義：生物化學考察生命的基本化學；分子生物學研究生物分子之間錯綜複雜的關系；植物學研究植物的生物學；細胞生物學檢查所有生命的基本組成單位，細胞；生理學檢查組織，器官，和生物體的器官系統的物理和化學的功能；進化生物學考察了生命的多樣性的產生過程；和生態學考察生物在其環境如何相互作用。最終能夠達到治療診斷遺傳病、提高農作物產量、改善人類生活、保護環境等目的。
target_text: Biosciences (; German: ; French: ); or biosciences (), life sciences () are a major category of natural sciences. However, there are some general and traditional concepts that govern all aspects of life, including the origin of life, evolution, distribution, construction, growth, function, behaviour, interaction with the environment, and biocollage. Modern biology is a vast and inclusive domain, made up of many branches and branches of science. However, there are some general and traditional concepts that govern learning and research in all aspects of life. In general, biology is the basic unit of life, genes are the basic unit of heritage, and evolution is the basic engine of synthesis and creation of new species, made up by many branches and branches of science.
title: 生物学

source_text: 细胞學说認為細胞是生物的基本單位，而且所有生物都是由一至多個細胞以及細胞分泌的物質組成（例如外骨骼）。所有細胞都是由其他細胞藉由细胞分裂的方式產生。多細胞生物一開始是從一個受精卵的單一細胞開始，再漸漸分裂為各個細胞，而細胞也是許多的基本單位.。此外，細胞之間能量轉移的現象稱為代謝，而細胞包含的遺傳資訊（DNA），在細胞分裂時也會傳遞給其他的細胞。
target_text: Cell theory suggests that cells are the basic unit of the organism, and that all organisms are made of more than one cell and the material of the secretion of the cells (e.g. external bones). All cells are produced by other cells in a way that is divided by cells. Multi-cell organisms start with a single cell of an ovated egg, gradually split into cells, and cells are many basic units. Moreover, the phenomenon of energy transfer between cells is described as a proxy, while cells contain genetic information (DNA) that is transmitted to other cells when cells split.
title: 生物学

source_text: 目前已有壓倒性的證據支持演化的真實性，學界普遍認為演化是事實，而不僅僅是理論或假說，對於演化論的真確性，存在有強烈的科學共識，演化以外任何關於物種起源或人類起源的學說，目前都不獲支持。絕大多數的科學社群和學術團體，都認為演化論是唯一能完全滿足在生物學、古生物學、分子生物學、遺傳學、人類學及其他各領域中所觀察到的現象的理論。一項在1991年所作的蓋洛普民調顯示，只有大約5%的科學家（包括生物學領域以外的其他科學家）認為自己是創造論者。截至目前為止，沒有任何反對演化論且經過科學方面同行審查的論文，名列科學與醫學期刊搜尋引擎PubMed當中。
target_text: There is now overwhelming evidence in support of the truth of evolution, and evolution is widely perceived as a fact, not just a theory or fiction, but a strong scientific consensus about the truth of the theory of evolution. There is currently no support for any theory other than evolution about the origin of species or human origins. Most scientific communities and academic communities believe that evolution is the only theory that is fully satisfied with the reality observed in biology, palaeology, molecular biology, genetics, anthropology, and other domains.
title: 生物学

source_text: 基因是生物體遺傳的基本單位，基因對應一特定區域的DNA，以特定方式影響生物的某一部位或某一機能。從細菌到動物的所有生物體都有同様複製DNA，並依此產生蛋白質的能力。細胞將DNA的基因轉錄為對應的核糖核酸（RNA），然後核糖體將RNA轉譯為一串由胺基酸組成的蛋白質。由RNA轉換為胺基酸的遺傳密码在大部份生物中是相同的，但有些生物仍有少許差異。例如若將人類對應胰島素的DNA放在植物中，也可以產生胰島素。
target_text: Genetics are the basic unit of biological heritage, where genes respond to DNA in a given area and affect a particular part of the organism or function in a particular way. All organisms from germs to animals have the ability to copy DNA and produce proteins accordingly. Cells convert DNA to a corresponding nucleic acid (RNA), and the nucleic material converts RNA into a set of proteins made of amino acids. The passivation code from RNA to amino acid is the same in most organisms, but some organisms still have a few differences. For example, when human DNA for insulin is placed in plants, insulin can also be generated.
title: 生物学

source_text:
體内平衡()：平衡是一個開放系統可以藉由許多彼此相關機制的動態平衡調整，使得其內在情形維持在穩定的狀態。所有的生物，不論是單細胞或是多細胞生物，都有體内平衡的機制。
一系統若要維持動態平衡，並且有效的進行調整，需要有能力偵測擾動，並且針對擾動進行回應。生物系統在偵測到擾動後，一般會利用負回授的方式回應。也就是藉由調整系統的條件，設法降低擾動的影響。就像若動物體內血糖濃度過低時，會釋放胰高血糖素增加血糖一様。
target_text: (ii) Internal balance (: Balance is an open system that can be adjusted by many interrelated mechanisms to maintain a stable state of mind. All organisms, whether single or multi-cell organisms, have a mechanism of internal balance. If one system is to maintain a dynamic balance, and if it is to be adjusted effectively, it needs the ability to detect and respond to disturbances.

一个活的生物體的生存依赖于能量的连续输入。生物體是靠化學反應來從食物中提取能量，才能維持身體機能，並建立新的細胞。在上述反應中，組成食物化學物质的分子扮演两个重要角色。第一，這些分子中有些可以藉由生物體內的化學反應產生能量。第二，有些則可以組成生物分子中的新的分子结构。
target_text: Energy, the survival of a living organism, depends on continuous input of energy. The organism is a chemical reaction that extracts energy from food to maintain the body function and to create new cells. In these responses, molecules that form the food chemical material play two important roles. First, some of these molecules can generate energy from chemical reactions in the organism. Second, some can form new molecular structures in the biomolecular molecules.

负责引进能量到生态系统的生物被称为生产者或自养生物。几乎所有的这些生物體最初都从太阳吸取能量。研究概況

Almost all of these organisms initially extract energy from the sun. Research shows that biologists generate a lot of research from many towards organisms. source_text: 生物學本身不斷的快速發展，與其他學科的關聯整合也越來越多。一大原因是分子生物學在近代突飛猛進，終於導致人類基因序列定序基本完成。由此，為了解讀巨大数量的基因資訊，促成了基因组學。為了探究基因和蛋白質的交互作用，開創出蛋白質组學。這些新的研究領域幫助解決疾病、糧食、環境生態等問題。其眾多的研究資訊和积累海量研究数据則需要新的電腦演算法來處理。
target_text: The rapid development of biology itself, and the increasing integration with other sciences. A major reason for this is that molecular biology has developed dramatically in recent times, leading to a near complete sequence of human genetic sequences.

source_text: 结构分子生物學是在分子水平的生物學研究。该领域与生物學的其他领域重叠，特别是遺傳學和生物化學。分子生物學主要关注的是理解一个细胞内的各种系统的相互之间的相互作用，包括DNA，RNA和蛋白质的合成和學习这些相互作用如何被调节。
target_text: Structural molecular biology is biological research at molecular level. This area overlaps with other areas of biology, in particular genetics and biochemistry. Molecular biology is primarily concerned with understanding the interactions between systems within a cell, including DNA, RNA and protein synthesis and learning.
title: 生物学

source_text: 细胞生物學研究细胞的结构和生理學特性，包括它们的行为，相互作用和环境。解剖學考虑的是宏观结构的形式，例如器官和器官系统。遺傳學是研究基因、遺傳和生物體的变异的科學。生理演化分類與命名分類：生物學對物種的分類，由上而下有 8 個層級。任一物種同時在這 8 個層級有其位置和名稱。
target_text: Cell biology studies the structure and physiological properties of cells, including their behaviour, interactions and environment. Anatomy considers the form of macrostructures, such as organs and organ systems. Genetics is the science of genetic, genetic and biological variability. Physiological evolution and naming classification: biobiology is classified from top to bottom with eight layers. Any species has its location and name at the same time in these eight layers.
title: 生物学

source_text: 雙名法是學名的命名方法，英文為 Binomial Nomenclature。它給每個物種訂立兩個文字，前字是該物種的屬（genus）名，後字是它的種小名 (種加詞)，兩者合為種名。除了前字須首字母大寫，其餘字母都要小寫。一般使用拉丁文，或以其他語言詞作語源，再加上拉丁化後綴。例如中國近來發現的恐龍，有些學名是用中文拼音做語源的。
target_text: The two-name method is the naming of the name. The English word is Binomial Nomenclature. It assigns two words to each species, the first of which is the name of the species (genus), the last of which is its nickname (a word added), and the second of which is the same name. In addition to the first letter, the rest of the letters are underwritten.
title: 生物学

source_text: 有些物種因為環境隔絕或發生突變，必須再往下細分出亞種（subspecies）。為了方便區別，科學界給亞種設計一套 三名法，英文為 Trinomial Nomenclature。生态和环境生态學研究生物与其环境之间的相互关系的科學。环境包括生物环境和非生物环境，生物环境是指生物物种之间和物种内部各个體之间的关系，非生物环境包括自然环境：土壤、岩石、水、空气、温度、湿度等。
target_text: For ease, the scientific community has designed a set of three laws for Asians, in Trinomial Nomenclature. The ecological and environmental ecology studies the science of the interrelationship between life and its environment. The environment includes the living environment and the non-living environment, which refers to the relationship between biological species and individual bodies within the species. The non-living environment includes the natural environment: soil, rock, water, air, temperature, humidity, etc.
title: 生物学

source_text: 研究方法生物學家对于生命现象的研究通常采用观察和实验的方法，通常这两种方法是一起使用的。观察是按生物的物理性状来描述生物的状况。通常是先对其外形及行为进行观察和描述，再把生物體解剖借助光學仪器对其内部结构进行观察。观察是多种多样的，有个體的观察也有群體的观察；有静态的观察也有动态的观察；有相同种类的观察也有不同种类的对比观察。实验是人为地改变一些条件来观测生物的变化和反应，以探究生命内在的因果关系，是认识生命活动的方法。实验方法是人为地干预、控制所研究的对象，并通过这种干预和控制所造成的效应来研究对象的某种属性。17世纪前后生物學中出现了最早的一批生物學实验，如英国生理學家威廉·哈维关于血液循环的实验，扬·巴普蒂斯塔·范·海尔蒙特关于柳树生长的实验等。到了19世纪，物理學、化學比较成熟了，生物學实验就有了坚实的基础，因而首先是生理學，然后是细菌學和生物化學相继成为明确的实验性的學科。19世纪80年代，实验方法进一步被应用到了胚胎學，细胞學和遺傳學等學科。
target_text: Research methods biologists usually use observation and experimental methods for the study of life phenomena. Observation is a way of describing the state of life by the physical form of life. It is usually done first by observing and describing its appearance and behaviour, and then by using optical instruments for the observation of its internal structure. Observations are diverse, with observations from one body to another; static observations are also observed dynamically; and there are different kinds of comparative observations of the same kind of observation. Experiments are artificially changing conditions for observing changes and reactions to life’s intrinsic causality. In the 19th century, the method of experimenting is artificial intervention, controlling the objects studied, and, by the effects of such intervention and control, it has a certain properties of the objects studied. First, there are the first biological experiments in biology before and after the 17th century, such as that of the British physiologist William Harvey on the blood cycle, and the experiments of Jan Baptista van Halmont on the growth of life. In the 19th century, physics, chemistry, chemistry, chemistry, chemistry, chemistry, biology, etc.
title: 生物学

source_text: 系统的方法：系统科學源自对还原论、机械论反省提出的有机體、综合哲學，从克洛德·贝尔纳与揭示生物的稳态现象、诺伯特·维纳与的控制论到卡尔·路德维希·冯·贝塔郎非的一般系统论，最早建立的是系统心理學，系统生态學、系统生理學等先后建立与发展，20世纪70-80年代系统论与生物學、系统生物學等概念发表。从克劳德·香农的信息论到伊利亚·普里高津的耗散结构理论，将生命看作自组织化系统。细胞生物學、生化与分子生物學发展，曼弗雷德·艾根提出细胞、分子水平探讨的理论。
target_text: Systemic approach: Systemic science is derived from organics, integrated philosophy, from Claude Bernard and the discovery of biological steady state phenomena, Norbert Weiner and control theory to general systemic theory of Carl Ludwig von Betaromfi, the earliest of which was the establishment and development of system psychology, system ecology, system physiology, etc., and the publication of concepts such as system theory and biology in the 1970s and 1980s, system biology and systematic biology. From Claude Shannon's infomatics to the theory of dissipation of Ilya Prigazin, life is seen as a self-organizing system. Cell biology, biochemistry and molecular biology are developed, and Manfred Eagan proposes the theory of cellular and molecular levels.
title: 生物学

source_text: 尽管我们近几十年来对于生命的基本过程的认识取得了的深刻进步，一些基本的问题仍然没有得到解决。例如，在生物學的主要未解决的问题之一是性别的主要自适应功能，和特别是在真核生物中它的关键过程，减数分裂和同源重组。一种观点认为，性别主要是发展成为一个适应增加遺傳多样性（请参阅参考资料如）。另一种观点认为，性别是一种适应于生殖细胞系DNA促进准确的DNA修复，并且增加遺傳多样性主要是可能是从长远来看是有用的一个副产品。（参见有性生殖的演化）。
target_text: Despite the profound progress we have made in recent decades in understanding the basic processes of life, some fundamental problems remain unresolved. One of the major unresolved issues in biology, for example, is the primary self-adaptation function of gender, and its key processes, especially in real nuclear organisms, the reduction of fragmentation and homogeneity. One view is that gender has evolved primarily into an adaptation to increased genetic diversity (see, for example, references). Another view is that gender is an accurate DNA restoration adapted to the DNA of the reproductive cell line, and that increasing genetic diversity is mainly a by-product that may be useful in the long term. (See evolution of sexual reproduction.)
title: 生物学

source_text: 心理學研究涉及意识、感覺、知覺、認知、情绪、人格、行為和人際關係等眾多領域，影響其他學科的發展，例如：教育学、管理學、传播学、社会学、经济学、精神病学、统计学、以及文學等等。心理學一方面嘗試用大腦運作來解釋個体基本的行為與心理機能，同時，心理學也嘗試解釋個體心理機能在社會行為與社會動力中的角色。心理學家從事基礎研究的目的是描述、解釋、預測和控制行為。應用心理學家還有第五個目的——提高人類生活的品質。這些目標構成了心理學事業的基礎。
target_text: Psychology, on the one hand, attempts to use brainwork to explain the basic behavior and psychoactivity of a body, and, on the other hand, the role that a psycho-psychological machine can play in social and social dynamics. Psychologists study at the root to describe, explain, anticipate and control behavior. Psychologists have a fifth purpose: to improve the quality of human life.
title: 心理学

source_text: 有些領域的心理學家為了研究人類的行為，會對動物進行實驗，以推測環境、生理（如：大腦損傷、運動是否能增加多巴胺等）以及一些特定因素所產生的影響。心理學家也會使用核磁共振、斷層掃描、及發展較成熟的問卷調查等方式來研究人類的心理。有時會有腦部部分損傷的病人，他們也藉由觀察這些人的腦部活動，去了解腦袋各部位的功能為何。
target_text: Some field psychologists, in order to study human behavior, experiment with animals to see the effects of the environment, biology (e.g. brain damage, sports to increase dopamine, etc.) and specific factors. Psychologists also study human psychology by using magnetic resonance, fault scans, and the development of more mature questions. Sometimes patients with partial brain damage, they also look at the brain activities of these people to see what the functions of their heads are.
title: 心理学

source_text: 1890年，威廉·詹姆斯将心理学定义为“心理生活的科学，包括心理现象和心理状态”。几十年来，这个定义一直广为流传。然而，这一含义受到了一些激进行为主义者的质疑，尤其是约翰.B.沃森等激进行为主义者。沃森在1913年的宣言中将心理学定义为获取对控制行为有用的信息。同样，自从詹姆斯定义了它，这个词更强烈地暗示了科学实验的技术。
target_text: In 1890, William James defined psychology as “the science of psychological life, including psychological phenomena and psychological states.” This definition has been widely circulated for decades. However, this meaning has been questioned by some radicals, especially such as John B. Watson.
title: 心理学

source_text: 早期的心理學研究是属于哲学的范畴，称为哲學心理學。哲學心理學的研究可以追溯到埃及、希腊、印度和華夏等古代文明。中國古代認為人的性情思想是由一定的器官承擔的，並且其活動會在器官上反映出來，如「心之官則思」（《孟子》），「人精在腦」、「頭者神之所居」（《春秋元命苞》）。「神形合一」、「形神相印」等思想在《黃帝內經》等涉及醫學心理的著作中有很多闡述和應用。柏拉圖提出過二元並存的理念，有人认为亚里斯多德《论灵魂》是西方最早的一部论述心理学思想的著作。經由長久的演變，慢慢地產生各式各樣不同的學科，包括了現在人所了解的心理學。
target_text: Early psychological studies are in the realm of philosophy, known as Philosophy. Philosophy studies date back to ancient civilizations such as Egypt, Greece, India, and Warsaw. China’s ancient belief that the idea of human sexuality is carried by certain organs and that its activities are reflected in organs, such as “the mind of the officials”, “the brain”, “the head of God’s mind” (the “Kind of the Spring Autumn”).
title: 心理学

source_text: 虽然心理学实验可以追溯到阿拉伯学者海什木的著作《光学》（1021年）Bradley Steffens (2006). Ibn al-Haytham: First Scientist, Chapter 5. Morgan Reynolds Publishing. ISBN 978-1-59935-024-0.不过，心理学作为一门独立的学科是开始于1874年，那一年，德国的生理學家威廉·馮特發表兩冊的心理學教科書——《生理心理學的原理》（Grundzüge der physiologischen Psychologie；Principles of Physiological Psychology）——，在序言裡大膽宣稱：「要建立一個新的科學領域」；冯特也因此被称为“心理学之父”。1875年，莱比锡大学聘馮特為教授；1879年，他在莱比锡大学建立世界第一个专门的心理实验室，吸引了來自世界各地的學生。10餘年後，也就是1890年代，美國各大學風起雲湧地仿傚此舉，建立數十座心理學實驗室，尤其1892這一年就成立了20座，這一年也是美國心理學會的成立年。通常将1874年作为科学心理学诞生的时间，这一时间比许多自然科学脱离哲学而形成独立学科的时间为晚。冯特也是第一个把自己称为心理学家的人。其他早期而重要的心理學家包括艾賓浩斯等。19世纪末、20世纪初，西格蒙德·弗洛伊德的精神分析学派兴起。

Morgan Reynolds Publishing. ISBN 978-1-59935-024-0, psychology, as an independent discipline, began in 1874, when Wilhelm Feng, a physiologist from Germany, published a two-year psychological teaching book, The Principles of Psychiatry (Grundzüge der physiologisen Pschologie; Principles Physiological Psychology) in 1879, he created the first university of psychology in the world, which was founded in 20 years, and also known as “A new scientific field” in the preamble; Vonte was called “The Father of Psychology” in 1875, the first university of psychology to become a professor; and the first university of psychology in 1879, which was created by the University of Leipsi.

source_text:
构造主义
德国心理学家威廉·冯特被认为是将实验引入心理学研究的人，被誉为“实验心理学之父”。1879年，他在莱比锡大学建立了第一个心理学实验室。冯特着重于将心理分解成为基本的元素，这是由于当时化学的进步，后者在分析物质元素与结构上取得突破。虽然冯特自己不是构造主义者，他的学生愛德華·B·鐵欽納成为了构造主义的思想家，与机能主义者对立。鐵欽納是美国早期心理学家的重要人物。
target_text: In 1879, the German psychologist William Vonter was recognized as the “father of experimental psychology” who introduced the experiment into psychology. He set up the first psychology laboratory at Leipzig University. Von Tte focused on decomposing psychology as a fundamental element because of chemical advances at the time, which led to a breakthrough in the analysis of material elements and structures. Although Von Tte himself was not a tectonicist, his student, Edward B. Tiepiner, became a tectonic thinker, opposed to a mechanic.
title: 心理学

source_text: 机能主义相对于结构主义而生，并受到美国哲学家、科学家、心理学家威廉·詹姆士影响颇多。詹姆士认为心理学应该有实用价值，心理学家应该找到有益於人的科学方式。他的著作《》于1890年出版，其中有许多铺垫性问题，为后续科学家提供了方向。其他主要机能主义者包括约翰·杜威和。
target_text: Activism was born in relation to structuralism, and was influenced by American philosophers, scientists, and psychologists, William James. James believed that psychology should be of practical value, and that psychologists should find scientific ways to benefit people. His book, published in 1890, included a number of paving issues that provided direction for follow-up scientists.
title: 心理学

source_text: 其它19世纪的杰出人物有德国心理学家赫尔曼·艾宾浩斯，他是研究記憶实验的先驱，在柏林洪堡大學创立了学习与遗忘的量化模型。苏俄心理学家伊万·彼得罗维奇·巴甫洛夫，他在对狗进行实验时发现了“古典制約”，并将其应用与人类。自二十世纪50年代起，冯特、詹姆士、艾宾浩斯与其他实验心理学家们所发展的实验技术方向更加趋向研究認知——关注信息以及信息处理——最终演化为认知科学中的一部分。在早些时候，这被视为“革命性”的发展
target_text: Other prominent figures in the 19th century include German psychologist Herman Ebinhous, who pioneered the study of memory experiments and created a quantitative model of learning and oblivion at Humboldt University in Berlin. Soviet psychologist Ivan Petrovich Pavlov, who discovered the “classical pact” when experimenting on dogs, applied it to humans. Since the 1950s, the experimental techniques developed by Von T., James, Ebinhous and other experimental psychologists have become more research-oriented -- attention to information and its processing -- eventually evolved into part of cognitive science. Earlier, this was seen as a “revolutionary” development.
title: 心理学

source_text: 奥地利医生西格蒙德·弗洛伊德自十九世纪90年代开始研究精神分析学，直到自己1939年去世为止。精神分析学是一种研究意识、解释经历的方法；是一种关于人类行为的理论系统；是一种针对心理、情绪的治疗方法，特别是对潜意识中的冲突进行心理治疗。弗洛伊德的精神分析中的很多理论基于解释法、内省法以及临床观察。精神分析法广为流传，因为它的研究对象涉及性别、压抑、心理发展中的潜意识等。这些问题在当时都被列为社会禁忌，弗洛伊德则提供了催化剂，使得问题可以在正式社交中得以公开讨论。在临床上，弗洛伊德是自由联想的先驱，他对释梦治疗也很有研究。
target_text: Austrian doctor Sigmund Freud began his research on psychoanalysis in the 1990s until he died in 1939. Psychoanalysis was a method of researching consciousness, explaining experience; a theoretical system of human behaviour; a psychological, emotional, and, in particular, psychotherapy of conflict in the subconscious. Many theories in Freud's psychoanalysis were based on interpretation, internal justice, and clinical observation. The psychoanalysis was widely disseminated, as it dealt with gender, depression, mental development, etc.. At that time, they were classified as social taboos, while Freud provided a catalyst that allowed the issue to be discussed openly in a formal social setting. In clinical terms, Freud was a pioneer of free association, and he was also a researcher of interpretation.
title: 心理学

source_text: 弗洛伊德对瑞士精神科醫師卡尔·荣格的影响很大，后者的分析心理学与深度心理学互补。20世纪中叶心理学者们研究精神分析、心理学、精神病治疗、以及哲学。这些著名的学者包括爱利克·埃里克森、梅兰妮·克莱因、唐纳德·威尼科特、卡伦·霍妮、埃里希·弗罗姆、約翰·鮑比、以及弗洛伊德的女儿安娜·弗洛伊德。在整个二十世纪里，精神分析衍生出不同的分支学派，它们中很多被划分为新弗洛伊德学派。
target_text: Freud has a strong influence on the Swiss psychiatrist, Carl Jung, whose analytical psychology is complementary to deep psychology. Psychologists in the mid-20th century studied psychoanalysis, psychology, psychiatric therapy, and philosophy. These eminent scholars include Eric Erikson, Melanie Klein, Donald Winnicott, Karen Horne, Eric Freud, John Bobby, and Floyd’s daughter, Anna Freud.
title: 心理学

source_text: 精神分析及其治疗受到诸多人士的批评，如心理学家汉斯·艾森克、以及哲学家卡尔·波普尔。波普尔是位科学哲学家，认为精神分析作为科学是错误的，，而艾森克则称精神分析原理与实验数据不符。到二十世纪末，美国高等院校心理学院变得更加倾向于实证主义，将弗洛伊德理论边缘化，并蔑称其为“干瘪老死”的历史古董。与此同时，研究人员在神经精神分析领域上维护弗洛伊德的科学立场，而其它人文学科学者们则固守弗洛伊德“根本不是科学家，而是个...詮釋者。”
target_text: Psychiatry and its treatment have been criticized by many, such as the psychologist Hans Eisenke and the philosopher Carl Popper. Pope is a scientific philosopher who thinks psychoanalytics are wrong as science, while Eisenke claims that psychoanalytical principles are inconsistent with experimental data. By the end of the twentieth century, the College of Psychology at American institutions of higher learning became more pro-ficient, marginalizing the Freud theory, and stigmatizing it as a historical antique called “dry death.” At the same time, researchers defended Freud’s scientific position in the field of neuropsychological analysis, while other humanistic scientists insisted that Freud “not at all a scientist, but a liberator”.
title: 心理学

source_text: 在整个20世纪的上半叶，行为主义学派支配了当时的心理学，其主张心理学是：“寻求理解特定的环境刺激如何控制特定类型的行为”。其主张心理学应分析先行的环境条件，即在行为之前出现、而且为一个机体产生反应或抑制反应提供活动场所的条件。因此，他们把行为反应看做是机体理解、预测和控制的行为，并因此做出相应的结果。基于对实验和变量的严格控制和强调，行为主义学对后来的心理学研究有着重要的影响。其代表人物為史金納，然而其對於內在的認知歷程是存而不論，近期流行的認知主義則是重視之前忽視的內在認知歷程，代表人物有皮亞杰、米勒、西蒙等。
target_text: Throughout the first half of the twentieth century, the behaviouralist school dominated the psychology of the time, which argued that it was “seeking to understand how particular types of behaviour are controlled by particular environmental incentives”. It argued that psychology should analyse the pre-existing environmental conditions, i.e., the conditions that existed before the act, and that it provided a space for a reaction or inhibition of the reaction of an organism. Thus, they viewed the behavioral reaction as an organic understanding, prediction and control act, and therefore produced the corresponding results. On the basis of strict control over experiments and variables, behaviouralism had an important impact on subsequent psychological research. Its representative is Mr. Skinner, yet its inherent recognition of the history is indifferent.
title: 心理学

source_text: 二十世纪50年代，在行为主义与精神分析的影响下，人本心理学应育而生。应用现象学、交互主体性、第一人称视角，人本主义试图捕捉整个人——而不是人格或认知的一部分。人本主义心理学关注人类独特问题的基础，例如个人的自由意志、成长、自我实现、认同、死亡、孤独、自由与。人本过程的特点在于它关注主观臆想、拒绝宿命、着重成长的积极性而不是病理因素。一些人本学派的奠基人，如美国心理学家亚伯拉罕·马斯洛，创立了需求层次理论；卡爾·羅哲斯，创立了個人中心治療。在此之后，正面心理学剖析了人本主义，对其更进一步的科学分析。
target_text: In the 1950s, human psychology was born under the influence of behaviouralism and psychoanalysis. Applying phenomena, interactive subjectivity, first-person perspectives, humanism tried to capture the whole human being — not part of personality or perception. Humanist psychology focused on the basis of unique human problems, such as the free will of the individual, growth, self-fulfilment, identity, death, isolation, freedom and association. The human process was characterized by its focus on subjective assumptions, rejection of destiny, growth-oriented motivation, rather than pathological factors.
title: 心理学

source_text:
沃尔夫冈·苛勒、马科斯·韦特墨、科特·考夫卡三人联合创立了完形心理学派。这种心理研究建立在个人经历为一整体的观点上。对应物质的分子结构，这种观点于十九世纪晚期在德国、奥地利产生。完形心理学没有将思维、行为分解成为细小的元素，而是坚持经验作为整体的重要性，认为总体不同于部分相加的和。
完形心理学不应与的相混淆，后者只在外表上与完形心理学有关联。
target_text: Wolfgang Caughley, Marcos Wetmore, and Kurt Kaufka have jointly created a complete psychology school. This psychological study is based on a holistic view of individual experience. The molecular structure of the corresponding substance, which emerged in Germany and Austria in the late nineteenth century, did not make thought, behavior, and behavior a minor element, but rather insisted on the importance of experience as a whole, considering it to be generally different from the sum of parts.
title: 心理学

source_text: 存在主义心理学不同于其它人本学派，即人性中立视角、对焦虑的积极观点等。存在主义心理学注重于人文主题，如死亡、自由意志、意义，并认为意义可以被神话、或是讲述方式改变。对于死亡及未来的真实性，通常会鼓励人们接受自由意志，尽管令人焦虑。
target_text: The existenceist psychology is different from other humanist schools, that is, a human-neutral perspective, a positive view of anxiety, and so on. The existenceist psychology focuses on human subjects, such as death, free will, meaning, and believes that meaning can be changed by myths, or by the way they are told.
title: 心理学

source_text: 奥地利存在主义精神病医生、大屠杀幸存者维克多·弗兰克从集中营中吸取教训，总结出不同版本的存在主义治疗法，这种方法着重于存在主义，不同于阿德勒的尼采主义的权力意志或弗洛伊德的快乐原则。瑞士精神分析学家路德维希·宾斯万格，美国心理学家喬治·亞歷山大·凱利和梅（May）、弗兰克尔（Frankl）一道，也被认为是存在主义学派学者。
target_text: The Austrian presenceist psychiatrist Victor Frank, a Holocaust survivor, drew lessons from the concentration camps, drawing different versions of the survivalist therapy, which focuses on existenceism, unlike the power will of the Nietzsche of Adler or the Freud principle of happiness. Swiss psychoanalyst Ludwig Binswang, together with American psychologists George Alexander Kelly and May, Frankl, are also considered to be survivalist scholars.
title: 心理学

source_text: 诺姆·乔姆斯基在批评行为学概念中的“刺激”、“相应”、“强化”时，触发了一场心理学“认知革命”。乔姆斯基辩称这种观点会以一种肤浅、模糊的方式应用到复杂的人类行为中，特别是在语言习得的领域上。有一种假定认为人类天生拥有一种“内在的”语言习得机能，然而对于行为主义来说，这个问题在于所有行为，包括语言在内，都必须通过学习和强化来获得。社会学习理论家，如阿尔波特·班杜拉称儿童的生活环境有助于行为的改良。
target_text: Nom Chomsky, in criticizing the behavioural concept of “stimulation”, “comparable” and “enhanced” has triggered a psychological “cognitive revolution.” Chomsky argues that this view can be applied to complex human behaviors in a superficial and ambiguous way, especially in areas of language acquisition. There is a presumption that human beings are born with the ability to learn an “inherent” language, but for behaviouralism, the problem is that all behaviour, including language, must be learned and strengthened.
title: 心理学

source_text: 认知心理学认为隐蔽的心理活动应该使用科学的方式进行研究，心理学家创立了两种概念：阈下刺激物与内隐记忆，对应精神分析的潜意识或行为学的偶然形成行为。行为主义元素与认知心理学被整合成为认知行为疗法的基础。这种心理治疗由美国心理学家阿尔伯特·艾利斯和精神病学家亚伦·T·贝克创立而成。认知心理学与其它学科，如精神哲学、计算机科学、神经科学，一道被归入的上层学科认知科学。
target_text: Cognitive psychology believes that hidden psychological activity should be studied in a scientific way, and psychologists have created two concepts: bottom-stamp irritants and invisibility memory, subconscious or random behavioral behavior in response to psychoanalysis. Behavioral elements and cognitive psychology have been integrated into the basis of cognitive behavior therapy. This psychotherapy was created by American psychologists Albert Ellis and psychiatrist Aaron T. Baker. Cognitive psychology, along with other disciplines, such as psychophilosophies, computer science, neuroscience, and top-level cognitive science.
title: 心理学

source_text: 生物心理学或行为神经科学从生物角度研究行为和心理过程。生物心理学中有不同的专业分支。例如，生理心理学运用动物模型，特别是老鼠，来研究神经、基因、细胞机能在学习、记忆、恐惧中产生的作用。神经心理学家利用神经成像工具研究神经与人类心理活动之间的关系，認知神经科学家使用心理测评来进行科学研究，如大脑损伤带来认知缺失的程度与表现形式。
target_text: Biopsychology or behavioral neurosciences study behavioral and psychological processes from a biological perspective. There are different professional branches in biopsychology. For example, biopsychology uses animal models, especially rats, to study the role that neuroses, genes, cellular machines can play in learning, memory, and fear. Neuropsychologists use neural imaging tools to study the relationship between neurological and human psychoactive activities, recognizing that neuroscientists use psychological assessments for scientific research, such as the extent and manifestations of cognitive deficiency caused by brain damage.
title: 心理学

source_text: 临床心理学的研究与应用包括理解、预防、缓解心理痛苦与紊乱，促进心理健康和个人成长。虽然临床心理学家也会参与研究、教学、咨询、出庭作证、程序编订与管理，但该分支的中心是心理测评与治疗。一些临床心理学家会着重于对脑损伤的病人进行临床监护，这一领域被称为。在许多国家里，临床心理学是受到管制的心理健康专业。
target_text: The research and application of clinical psychology includes understanding, prevention, mitigation of psychological pain and disorders, and promotion of mental health and personal growth. While clinical psychologists are also involved in research, teaching, counselling, testifying in court, programming and management, the focus of the branch is psychological evaluation and treatment.
title: 心理学

source_text: 临床心理学家所做的努力受到诸多治疗方案的影响，所有方案都包括专业人士与患者（通常是个人、夫妻、家庭、或小群体）之间的正式关系。不同的治疗实践方案与不同的理论观点相互关联，采用不同的流程来建立治疗组合、探究心理病因、鼓励新的方法来思考、感受、行动。四大治疗理论观点包括、认知行为治疗、存在—人本主义治疗和。目前有趋势表明一部分心理家正在努力整合各个治疗派系，特别是在对文化、性别、精神、性取向的理解加深的情况下，这个趋势更加显著。在丰富的研究成果下，有证据表明各大治疗派系的效果趋于等同，并共享相同的基础元素，可以形成强大的心理治疗组合。正因为如此，更多的心理学培训课程采取了。Palmer, S.; Woolfe, R. (eds.) (1999). Integrative and eclectic counselling and psychotherapy. London: Sage.
target_text: The efforts of clinical psychologists are influenced by a number of treatment programmes, all of which include formal relationships between professionals and patients (usually individuals, couples, families, or small groups). Different treatment practices are linked to different theoretical perspectives, using different processes to create treatment combinations, explore the causes of mental illness, encourage new approaches to thinking, feeling, and acting. Four treatment theories include, cognitive behavioral treatment, presence - humanistic treatment and others.
title: 心理学
