認知心理學研究心理活動中的認知。知覺、注意、理智、思維、解題、記憶、學習、語言、情緒都在它的研究領域之中。經典認知心理學與認知主義學派有相互聯繫，根據機能主義與實驗心理學，認知主義支持心理信息處理模型。
target_text: The Strup effect points to the colour of the text, and the first group is much simpler than the second group. Acceptive psychology studies knowledge in psychological activities.
title: 心理学

source_text: 在更廣域的層面上，認知科學是一種跨學科範疇，包括認知心理學、認知神經科學、人工智能、語言學、人機互動、計算神經科學、數理邏輯與人類學。計算機常被用於模擬這類實驗現象。 計算機模擬為研究思維的功能組織提供了工具，神經系統科學則為大腦活動提供了度量衡。
target_text: At a broader level, the recognition of science is a cross-disciplinary model, including cognitive psychology, cognitive neuroscience, artificial intelligence, linguistics, human interaction, computational neuroscience, mathematical logic, and anthropology. Calculator simulations are often used to simulate this kind of experiment.
title: 心理学

source_text: 比较心理学指对非人类动物的科学研究，特别是与系统发展史、适应值、行为发展相关的领域。在此领域的研究讨论许多问题，使用许多不同的方式，探索不同物种的行为，从昆虫到灵长类动物。比较心理学与其它研究动物行为的学科，如动物行为学有紧密联系。比较心理学的研究有时会给人类行为研究带来启发，但是有时两者的关联却十分矛盾，例如艾德華·威爾森所提出的社會生物學。动物模型常常被用来研究与人类行为相关的神经处理过程，例如在認知神經科學就常常应用动物模型。
target_text: Comparative psychology refers to scientific research on non-human animals, particularly in areas related to the history of system development, adaptive values, and behavioural development. Research in this area discusses many problems, using many different ways, to explore the behaviour of different species, from insects to primates. Comparative psychology is closely linked to other disciplines that study animal behaviour, such as animal behavior. Comparative psychology sometimes inspires human behavior research, but sometimes the correlation between the two is quite contradictory, such as sociobiology, as presented by Edward Wilson.
title: 心理学

source_text: 发展心理学着重于人类意志在毕生当中的发展过程，试图理解人们在世界中如何意识、理解、行动，并且研究这些现象是如何随着年龄而改变的。这些研究可能会着重于认知、感情、道德、社交、神经的发展。研究人员在探究儿童案例时使用一系列特殊的方式，以使得观察在自然的环境中进行，或是干脆与他们在实验中进行互动。这些实验常常以游戏或是活动的方式呈现，既好玩，又有科学意义；研究人员甚至设计出非常灵巧的方式以研究婴儿的心理活动。在研究儿童心理之余，发展心理学家也会研究人类毕生的老化过程，特别是在某些时段的快速转变（例如青少年和老年）。发展心理学家设计了一整套心理学理论来支持他们的研究。
target_text: The development of psychology focuses on the evolution of human will throughout its life, trying to understand how people are aware, understand, act in the world, and how these phenomena change with age. These studies may focus on cognitive, emotional, moral, social, and neurological development. Researchers in child cases use a range of special ways to allow observations to take place in a natural environment, or simply interact with them in experiments. Experiments are often presented in games or activities, with both fun and scientific significance; researchers are even devising very clever ways to study the psychological activities of infants. In addition to studying children’s psychology, development psychologists also study the lifelong ageing of human beings, especially at some times (e.g. adolescents and older persons).
title: 心理学

source_text: 教育心理学是研究人类在教育过程中的学习、效率、授课心理以及学校作为一个组织的社会心理。儿童心理学家，如利維·維谷斯基、讓·皮亞傑、杰罗姆·布鲁纳、伯纳德·罗斯金(Bernard Luskins)等人对教授方式与教学实践都有重要影响。在许多国家里，教育心理学都是教师的必修课。
target_text: Educational psychology is a study of human learning, efficiency, teaching psychology, and the socio-psychology of schools as an organization. Child psychologists, such as Levy Wigowski, Jean Piaj, Jerome Bruner, Bernard Luskins and others, have important implications for teaching methods and teaching practices.
title: 心理学

source_text: 演化心理学从现代演化观点来研究心理的特质理论——例如记忆、知觉、语言等。它试图去探究是何种人类心理特征在适应进化，即，作为自然选择和性选择的功能产品。演化心理学家认为在人类先祖生活的环境下，心理适应的演化解决了呈周期性出现的问题。通过研究心理特质的演化及其适应性功能，演化心理学为其它心理学领域提供了最为近似的发展性解释（即演化心理学专注于终极问题、或问“为什么”，而不是近似的、或问“如何”）。
target_text: Evolutive psychology studies the ethos of psychology from a modern evolutionary point of view – memory, consciousness, language, etc. It attempts to find out what human psychology is evolving, that is, as a functional product of natural and sexual selection. Evolved psychology believes that, in the context of the life of human ancestors, the evolution of psychological adaptation solves the problem of cyclicality. Evolved psychology provides the most recent developmental explanation for other areas of psychology (i.e. evolutionary psychology focuses on the ultimate question, or “why”, rather than “how”).
title: 心理学

source_text: 工业——组织工業與組織心理學(I–O)应用心理学概念与方法优化工作场所的人类潜能。作为I–O的分支，人事心理学应用心理学原理与方法对员工进行筛选与评估。I–O的另一分支组织心理学研究工作环境与管理风格对工作积极性、成就感和生产力的影响效果。
target_text: Industry - organises industrial and organizational psychology (I-O) applying concepts and methods of psychology to optimize the human potential of the workplace. As a branch of I-O, personnel psychology uses psychological principles and methods to screen and evaluate employees.
title: 心理学

source_text: 人格心理學关注个人持续性的行为、思想、情绪——这些被称作是人格。人格理论因学派不同而有所不同，他们就潜意识的作用及儿时经历的重要性有不同的假设。根据弗洛伊德，人格是基于本我、自我与超我之间的互动而产生的，此即所謂的精神分析學派。与之相反，特质理论则尝试使用离散统计数据来进行研究，所提出的特质种类也大有千秋。早期的汉斯·艾森克模型提出人格由三种基本特质组成：外向性与内向性、神经质、。雷蒙德·卡特尔则提出了16条人格特征。如今，人格维度模型受到越来越多的重视，例如。目前集大成的為社會認知學派，其實最初稱為社會學習論，是從行為學派作為延伸：人格的形塑就是人與人、環境的互動所學習到的行為，而後美國心理學家班杜拉從中把行為學派的理論更加擴大，加入了人的內在活動─認知成分，形成了社會認知理論。
target_text: Personal psychology, on the other hand, attempts are made to use discrete statistics for research and to present a wide variety of traits. The earlier Hans Eisenke model proposes three basic traits: outward and inward sex, neurological properties, and Raymond Cartel's 16 personality features. Today, the personality dimension model is increasingly valued, for example, as a social recognition school, which was originally called a sociology school, and as an extension from a behavioural school of thought: the ethos of the human personality is a cross-fertilization of humans and people, the environment and the environment, and the American psychologist Bandura has developed social understanding.
title: 心理学

source_text: 社会心理学研究人类彼此之间的看法以及它们是如何产生联系的，社会心理学家研究课题包括他人对个体行为的影响（例如：从众、說服）、信仰的建立、态度、或更大層面來說，不只人與人之間的互動，也有人與一個群體的互動等，就像刻板印象的建立與強化，會引起之後的歧視行為，就是一個經典的例子。将认知心理学与社会学的元素联系在一起，试图理解人们如何处理、记忆、扭曲社会信息。群体动力学研究揭示领导能力、交流及其他的本质及其优化潜质。近些年来，许多社会心理学家对內隱態度、、个人与社会价值互动所致行为倍感兴趣。因此，对人类社会的研究可以发现导致心理紊乱的潜在原因。一些被应用到心理紊乱的社会学概念包括社会角色、病人角色、阶层、生活事件、文化、迁移等等。
target_text: Social psychology researches how people perceive each other and how they relate to each other. Social psychology studies include the influence of others on individual behaviour (e.g. from crowds, persuasions), the building of beliefs, attitudes, or, more broadly, the interaction not only between people, but also between people and a group, such as stereotypes, which may lead to subsequent discrimination, a classic example of which is the association between cognitive psychology and sociology, which attempts to understand how people deal with, remember, and distort social information. Group dynamics research reveals the essence of leadership, communication and other attributes and their potential for optimization. In recent years, many social psychologists have been interested in internal secrecy, behaviour resulting from personal and social values interaction.
title: 心理学

source_text: 正向心理學從馬斯洛的人本主義心理學衍生而來。正向心理學運用實驗科學手法，研究人類的快樂與力量。與傳統臨床心理學不同，正向心理學關注健康人的保健。目前，正向心理學的介入已獲得了一些實驗性的肯定。在2010年《臨床心理學評論》（Clinical Psychological Review''）中發表了一篇特刊，報導使用一些正向心理學中性格強項（Character Strengths and Virtues）的介入方法，例如：紀錄兩個星期內的三件好事和物理形式的感恩表達（如：擁抱等），有助提生活滿意度。另外，正念療法（Mindfulness-based stress reduction，MBSR）也被證明是治療抑鬱症的有效方法。然而，對於介入的效果來講還需要進一步的研究。正向心理學介入仍然有局限性，但是他們的效果被認為高於安慰劑，特别是對於身體形象缺失者有更好的效果。
target_text: A special issue was published in the 2010 Cultural Psychiatry Review', reporting on the use of experimental science techniques to study human happiness and strength. Unlike traditional bed psychology, attention is being paid to the health of healthy people, for example: a record of three positive and physical forms of appreciation (e.g. hugging), which helped to raise awareness of life. In addition, the Mindful-Bassed Stress Reaction was shown to be an effective method of healing depression.
title: 心理学

source_text:
研究方法
心理学研究倾向于折衷主義，即从其他领域汲取知识以帮助理解、解释心理现象。另外，心理学家大量使用了查尔斯·桑德斯·皮尔士的三段论：演绎、归纳、溯因。由于常常使用，心理学家也会依靠归纳逻辑来对问题进行解释。例如，演化心理學家尝试利用适者生存来解释心理特质——如记忆、知觉、语言等，即这些功能是自然选择或性选择的产物。
target_text: Research methods Psychologists tend to seek compromise, i.e. to draw knowledge from other fields to help understand and interpret psychological phenomena. Moreover, psychologists make a great deal of use of Charles Sanders Piers' three theories: contemplation, contemplation, retroactivity. Psychologists, because of their frequent use, also rely on contemplation logic to explain problems. Evolutive psychologists, for example, try to use the survival of the right person to explain psychological traits — memory, consciousness, language, etc. — that these functions are the product of natural or sexual choices.
title: 心理学

source_text: 心理学家会展开基础研究来进一步理解心理学的某一领域，或是进行应用研究来解决临床、工作场所等其它问题。硕士级别的临床专业会同时教授学生研究方式与循证实践。心理学专业协会也会协助设立规范标准，如道德、培训、研究方式、专业操作等。另外，根据不同的国家和地区，心理服务或“心理学家”这一职称受到相应法律的规范，从事对外服务的心理学家也常常被要求取得从业执照。
target_text: Psychologists carry out basic research to further understand one area of psychology, or apply research to address other clinical and workplace problems.
title: 心理学

source_text: 根據理論或觀察作出假設，在控制實驗情境中各種情況下操縱自變量觀察因變量的結果。對結果進行統計分析，控制無關變量產生的效果後檢驗假設，並進行推論：自變量是否對因變量產生效果，即自變量和因變量間是否有因果關係（一般找出兩者的相關度，然後再證實因果關係）。亦會根據數據分析，找出兩者的相關係數，然後判斷是否有研究價值。
target_text: Based on theory or observation, it is assumed that, in controlling the circumstances of the experiment, the result of the variable is manipulated to observe the result of the variable. The results are analysed to control the effects of the unrelated variable, and it is assumed that the self-variant has an effect on the variable, i.e. whether there is a causal relationship between the variable and the variable (generally the correlation between the two, then the link of the cause and effect is confirmed). On the basis of the data analysis, it is also possible to identify the correlation between the two, and then determine whether there is a value in the study.
title: 心理学

source_text: 以人类为对象的实验受到了一些管制，例如必须征得被实验对象的同意、保证自愿参与的原则。二战后，为避免类似纳粹滥用实验的事件再度发生，纽伦堡守则被制定实施。不久，许多国家（和科学机构）接收了《赫爾辛基宣言》。在美国，卫生院于1966年设立了伦理审查委员会，于1974年编订了(HR 7724)。上述所有法案都提倡研究人员在实验前获得参与对象的许可。一系列具有影响力的事件导致了法案的修订，如麻省理工学院与傅娜学院进行的反射性同位素研究，沙利度胺丑闻，威洛布鲁克肝炎实验，以及斯坦利·米尔格拉姆对权威的测试实验等。
target_text: Human-oriented experiments are regulated by, for example, the principle that consent must be obtained from the subject of the experiment and that voluntary participation must be guaranteed. After World War II, the Nürnberg Code was developed and implemented to avoid a recurrence of Nazi-like abuses. Soon after, many countries (and scientific institutions) received the Helsinki Declaration. In the United States, the Health Council established the Ethics Review Commission in 1966 and prepared it in 1974 (HR 7724).
title: 心理学

source_text: 动物学习实验对于研究人类心理学有很重要的辅助作用，例如知觉、感情、学习、记忆等等。十九世纪90年代，俄罗斯心理学家伊万·彼得罗维奇·巴甫洛夫利用狗的实验来展示经典条件反射。非人类动物如灵长类、猫、狗、鸽子、鼠以及其它啮齿类动物常常被应用于心理实验中，特別是行為心理學的研究。理想状态中，实验控制组一次只给出一个自变量，以显明它对因变量的作用。这些在实验室里可以得到最为近似的结果。与之相反，人类的生存环境与基因环境差异太大，变量太多，以至于在人群中难以控制重要的变量数据。当然，把动物实验的结果往人类身上生搬硬套是明显不可取的。动物实验会受相关約束，需要遵守心理學會所定的道德原則。
target_text: In the 1990s, Russian psychologists, Ivan Petrovich Pavlov, used dog experiments to demonstrate classic conditions of reflection. Non-human animals, such as primates, cats, dogs, pigeons, rats, and other rodents, were often used in psychological experiments, especially behavioral psychology. Ideally, the experimental control team gave only one self-variancies at a time to make clear its role in the variables.
title: 心理学

source_text: 心理質性研究方式包括訪談法、觀察法等。克雷斯維爾(Creswell，2003)定義了五項主要的質性研究，包括敘述、現象學、民族誌、案例分析和基礎理論。質性研究員有時會努力豐富解釋，或是對符號的批判、主觀經驗或社會結構。類似的解釋或批判觀點會被應用與“定量研究”，如埃里希·弗羅姆的或斯坦利·米爾格拉姆的權力屈服實驗。
target_text: Psychophysical studies include interview, observation, etc. Creswell (2003) defines five major qualitative studies, including narratives, visuals, ethnic journals, case analysis, and underlying theories. Qualitative researchers sometimes work hard to explain, or criticize symbols, views, or social structures. Similar interpretations or critiques are applied and “quantified studies” such as those by Erich From or by Stanley Millgram.
title: 心理学

source_text: 心理定量研究常常利用統計學來測試假說。設計定量研究常常包括實驗、准實驗、橫斷設計、病例對照研究和縱貫研究。實驗構造中的度量與操作定義也是十分重要的。統計方式包括皮爾遜積矩相關係數、方差分析、線性回歸、Logit模型、結構方程建模、等級線性模型等。
target_text: Psychological quantitative studies often use statistics to test hypotheses. Design quantitative studies often include experiments, quasi-experiments, transversal designs, case-recording studies, and vertical studies.
title: 心理学

source_text: 该研究旨在回答个人的想法、感受、行为，被称之为“描述性研究”。描述性研究的取向可以是定量的、也可以是定性的。“定性研究”是描述性研究中着重于对发生事件的观察、描述，目的在于捕捉每日行为的一点一划，并期望在粗略实验中遗失的现象中重新得到发现或理解。
target_text: The purpose of the study is to answer the individual's thoughts, feelings, behaviour, and what is referred to as “descriptive research”. The orientation of descriptive research can be quantitative or qualitative. “Qualitative research” is a descriptive study that focuses on the observation, description of events that occur, with the aim of capturing a fraction of daily behaviour, and expects to be rediscovered or understood in phenomena lost in rough experiments.
title: 心理学

source_text: 正如珍·古道尔的研究包括观察黑猩猩的社交、家庭那样，心理学家通过观察人类社会、专业、家庭来进行研究。有时，参与者会察觉到自己受到监视，有时候则相反。但无论如何，在观察研究正在进行时，研究人员必须保证遵循严格的道德准则，不能做出有悖伦理的尝试。
target_text: As Jane Goodall’s research includes observing chimpanzees’ social, family, psychologists conduct research by observing human society, profession, and family. Sometimes, participants perceive themselves to be under surveillance, and sometimes vice versa.
title: 心理学

source_text: 心理学上，统计调查可被用来度量态度、特质，监视情绪的改变，检查试验的效度，以及其它相关研究项目等等。心理统计员可以使用传统纸张、电话、电子邮件、或是目前流行的网络等，围绕主题制定好问卷，按一定比例进行人群调查、随机调查、重点调查、抽样调查。类似的调查方式也被用于其它应用场所，如临床评估、人事评估等。
target_text: Psychologically, statistical surveys can be used to measure attitudes, traits, monitor emotional changes, examine the effects of experiments, and other related research projects. Psychostatisticians can use traditional paper, telephones, e-mails, or networks that are currently popular, to develop questionnaires around the subject and to conduct population surveys, random surveys, priority surveys, sample surveys, etc.
title: 心理学

source_text:
发展心理学的研究設計
主要分為三種
橫向設計(cross-sectional design)：在同一時間下調查不同年齡層的受試者在某個特質或是行為上的表現。
優點：省時省力，較縱貫研究省時且能較快速取得研究結果，沒有樣本流失的問題。
缺點：存在同辈效应（cohort effect），也即年龄差异不完全由年齡变化所导致，有可能也受到了外在環境，例如不同年代群体的不同生活經驗的影響。
纵向设计(longitudinal design)：在不同時間追蹤同一群被试在某特質或行為上的表現。
優點：較能避免同辈效應，也即不會受到不同年代群体间存在的差異的影響，可以从中了解到个体发展的数据。
缺點：費時費力，所要花費的時間成本相當的高，且會有被试样本流失的問題而可能產生混淆影响；所得研究结果可能只适用随该研究长大的特定年代、特定环境下的被试。
序列设计(sequential design)：又称交叉聚合设计(cross-sequential method)，是同時採用橫向設計和縱向設計的方法。
優點：資料比上述兩種方法豐富，可控制同辈效应所造成的變異。
缺點：和縱向研究一樣有被试樣本流失的問題，較橫斷研究費時費力，可能會產生練習效应。
target_text: Longitudinal design (longitunal design): tracking the performance of a group of people tested on a particular feature or course of action at different times. Goodness: avoiding peer-to-peer effects, that is, not being affected by differences between groups of different ages, may also be influenced by data on individual developments, such as the cost of time spent, the cost of time spent, the cost of time spent, the cost of which is high, and the cost of which is likely to be lost;
title: 心理学

source_text: 档案研究法：是指依据一定目的收集大量现有资料，通过分析找出某些现象与心理之间关系的一种度.档案研究法有广义和狭义之分，广义的档案研究法除了传统的参考资料还包括视听影像资料，狭义的档案资料包括报纸、杂志、会议记录、政府公文、个人书信等文字材料。档案研究法的使用能弥补其他一些研究方法的不足，但有其缺点，需要视情况而定。
target_text: The Archival Research Act: refers to the collection of a large amount of available information for a certain purpose, the analysis of which reveals the extent to which certain phenomena are related to psychology. The Archival Research Act is broadly and narrowly defined. In addition to traditional references, the Archival Research Act includes audio-visual material, which in a narrow sense includes printed material such as newspapers, magazines, meeting records, government correspondence, personal letters, etc. The Archival Research Act can be used to compensate for deficiencies in other research methods, but its shortcomings need to be determined on a case-by-case basis.
title: 心理学

source_text:
批评理论
对研究的批评常常包括指责心理学是“软”科学。科学哲学家托马斯·库恩的1962批判中暗示心理学仍处在前范式形态，缺乏像成熟的化学、物理学那样的支撑性理论。由于心理学的一些领域依赖于问卷调查之类的研究方式，批评家们认为心理学不够客观。其它观点认为心理学家所研究的人格、思维、情绪不可能被直接测量，其结果不过是调查对象的主观报道。
target_text: Criticism often includes criticism of psychology as “soft” science. The scientific philosopher Thomas Cowen’s criticism of 1962 suggests that psychology is still in the vanguard pattern, lacking supportive theories like mature chemistry and physics.
title: 心理学

source_text: 另一些批评家则认为统计假说被误用。一些研究记录表明心理学家常常混淆统计的显著性差异与实践之间的关系，而前者在实践上常常无关紧要。這種辩论時長发生在心理学界内部，例如实验室研究人员与从事实践的临床医生之间的争执等。
target_text: Some research records show that psychologists often confuse the obvious differences in statistics with practice, which is often irrelevant in practice. Such debates often take place within the psychological community, such as disputes between laboratory researchers and practitioners.
title: 心理学

source_text:
实践
有的观察者发现了某些理论与实践上的冲突——例如，一些临床实践没有理论支持。批评家们认为越来越多的心理培训课程没有足够的科学依据。一些质疑者认为，像“婴儿孤独症協助性溝通”；被用于记忆恢复的塑身锻炼；再生疗法等，虽然十分风行，但却令人怀疑，而且可能有害健康。
target_text: In practice, some observers have found certain theoretical and practical conflicts — for example, some clinical practices have no theoretical support. Critics have argued that the increasing number of psychological training courses is not scientifically sound. Some questioners have argued that, for example, “baby autism is helpful communication”; plastic exercise used for memory restoration; and regenerative therapy, which, despite its prowess, is questionable and potentially harmful to health.
title: 心理学

source_text:
斯坦利·米尔格拉姆的米爾格倫實驗使得参与者饱受折磨，挑战了科学实验的道德底线。实验研究参与对象会在多大程度上违背自己意愿执行规定行为。
二十世纪70年代，哈里·哈洛在威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校利用猕猴进行了“绝望”实验，遭到谴责。实验利用动物来模拟抑郁症。哈洛设计出了一种“强暴架”，利用对母猕猴行为的干扰进行研究。1974年，美国文学评论家写道：“哈里·哈洛跟他同事几十年折磨着非人类灵长实验品，证明了我们都早已知道的——社交生物会因社交纽带的损害而被损害。”他写道哈洛对他研究的伦理道德没有任何评论。
target_text: In the 1970s, Harry Hallow was condemned for using monkeys to “dry” at Madison University in Wisconsin. The experiment used animals to simulate depression.
title: 心理学

source_text:
WEIRD偏差
1959年，统计学家西奥多·斯特林（Theodore Sterling）计算發现97%的心理实验支持了它们最初的假设，暗示了偏差存在的可能。与之类似，贾内尔（Fanelli， 2010)发现91.5%的精神/心理研究得到了证明，所得出的问题（阳性结果）是空间或地球科学的5倍大。贾内尔认为较“软”科学的研究人员就他们的意识与潜意识中的偏差缺乏束缚。
target_text: In 1959, the statisticians Theodore Sterling calculated that 97% of their psychological experiments produced supported their initial assumptions, suggesting the possibility of bias. Similarly, Fanelli 2010 found that 91.5% of mental/psychological research had proven that the problem (positive results) was five times greater than that of space or Earth science.
title: 心理学

source_text:
2010年，一组研究人员公布了心理研究中的系统性实验对象偏差WEIRD (「西方地区、受过良好教育、工业化的、富有、民主的」；"Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich and Democratic")。虽然全球范围内之后1/8的人属于WEIRD范畴，但实验人员称心理学60–90%的实验在WEIRD对象上进行。报告显示，在上，WEIRD对象与部落对象的实验结论差异巨大。研究领域
心理学所包含的研究领域甚为宽广，并使用许多不同的方法来心理过程与行为。心理学主要分为理论心理学和应用心理学两大领域，其下又可分为许多次领域，例如教育心理学、变态心理学、管理心理学等。
target_text: In 2010, a group of researchers published WEIRD (“Western region, well-educated, industrialization, rich and democratic”; Western, Economic, Industrialized, Rich and Democratic”). While one-eighth of the post-global population fell within the scope of WEIRD, the experimenters claimed that 60-90% of the experiments in psychology were carried out on WEIRD objects. The report showed that, above all, there was a wide range of research in the field of psychology and the use of many different methods for psychological processes and behaviour. Psychology was divided mainly into theoretical and applied psychology, and could be divided into many sub-areas, such as educational psychology, psychosis, management psychology, etc.
title: 心理学

source_text: 理论心理学：与应用心理学相对，包括用于学术研究目的的变态心理学、生理心理学、认知心理学、比较心理学、发展心理学、健康心理学、人格心理学、社会心理学等。进化心理学：是对所有心理学的一种整合尝试，提供了简练的方式来解释各门心理学中观测到的各种现象及理论。異常心理学：是对異常行为的研究，以描述、预报、解释和矫治功能的变态模式。異常心理学的研究应用于临床心理学，以治疗心理疾病的患者。生理心理学：基于生理组成结构而进行的研究，其中主要包括人脑等。认知心理学：所谓认知，指在获取知识过程中进行的各种心理活动，主要包括知觉，记忆，言语，思维等，即通常所谓的认识过程。积极心理学：积极心理学从20世纪里重点关注快乐和满足的人本主义心理学中找到根源。比较心理学：是研究动物行为进化的基本理论，和不同进化水平的动物的各种行为特点的心理学分支。它对哲学认识论具有重要意义，比较心理学的研究还能为生产实践和生物医学研究提供动物行为进化方面的基础科学知识。发展心理学：主要研究人類由出生至死亡時的人格發展過程，艾瑞克森把人格發展分為8個階段，並認為每個階段的人都會面對不同的人格發展的障礙，如處理得好便能順利發展，如處理不好便會形成焦慮及各樣問題。
target_text: Psychiatry: a study of anomalous behavior that describes, predicts, interprets and corrects patients. Psychology research is applied to clinical psychology to treat patients with mental disorders. Psychology: studies based on the physical composition of the structure, which include, inter alia, the human brain. Csythology: so-called cognitive, which refers to the various psychological activities that take place in the acquisition of knowledge, mainly knowledge, memory, speech, thought, etc., provide a simple way of interpreting the phenomena and theories observed in all psychology. Active psychology: active psychology is a study of the aberrations of the 20th century focusing on happy and satisfying humanist psychology. Comparative psychology: studies of the basic theories of animal behaviour evolution and the various components of the behavioural characteristics of different animals.
title: 心理学

source_text: 人格心理学：研究行为、思维和情绪的模式，通常称为个体的人格。定量心理学：在心理学研究中应用数学模型和统计学模型，以及将统计学方法用于分析、解释行为数据。心理统计学：是心理学中对知识、能力、态度和人格特征等进行心理测量的理论和技术，主要与教育、人格和临床心理学有关。数学心理学则与实验和认知、生理心理学关系密切。社会心理学：探討社會與認知歷程對於個體知覺他人，影響他人及聯繫他人的方式如何產生作用的科學性研究，以心理学、社会学相关理论为基础的社会科学。臨床心理学：是讨论人類非正常行為，通过临床观察探討這些行為的論據，評估，分類，治療，預防以及科學研究的心理學分支學科。教育心理学：研究人类如何在教育情境下进行学习、教育性干预的效果、教学的心理学、作为组织的学校的社会心理学。利維·維谷斯基、让·皮亚杰和杰罗姆·布鲁纳等儿童心理学家的研究成果在教学方法和教育实践领域已经产生了重大影响。健康心理学：是心理学理论与研究在健康、疾病与卫生保健领域的应用。不过临床心理学关注与心理健康和神经学疾病，健康心理学则在更大范围内关注健康行为，包括健康饮食、医生-患者关系、病人对健康知识的理解。工业与组织心理学：主要研究組織心理，目的也是為了進步利用、管理，達至組織的目標。
target_text: Personal psychology: The study of behavioral, mindsetal and emotional patterns, usually referred to as individual personality. Quantitative psychology: the application of mathematical and statistical models in psychology research, and the use of statistical methods for the analysis and interpretation of behavioural data. Psychosocial psychology: the theory and technique of psychological measurement of knowledge, abilities, attitudes and personality characteristics in psychology, mainly related to education, personality and clinical psychology. Mathematical psychology is closely related to experiments and cognitive and physiological psychology. Social psychology: the study of social and cognitive history of how a person learns about others, influences others and the way they communicate with others, is based on the social sciences based on psychology and socio-psychology, based on the theory of psychology and socio-psychology.
title: 心理学

source_text: 学校心理学：主要研究的是学生在学校学习、教师教学过程中的心理和规律。这门学科在解决学习问题和教育困难时有显著功效。社區心理學：主要關注個人與社區、社會的相互關係，並透過合作性的研究與行動，以及預防、賦權、社會改變等介入，有效提昇個人安適、幸福感與生活品質。兒童心理學：主要關注兒童的心理,認知發展及成長，並因應理論探討兒童有心理障礙時應如何處理。超個人心理學：專長於跨越自我層面的心靈研究、跨越個人領域的心理學，和人性在靈性方面的層面。音樂心理學：主要關注音樂與人的各種心理現象的相互關係，解釋人由原始（初生）到高級的音樂經驗和音樂行為的心理學。
target_text: School psychology: The main study is the psychological and physical aspects of learning in schools, teaching by teachers. This discipline has a significant impact in solving learning problems and educational difficulties. Community psychology: focuses on the interaction of individuals with communities, society, and through cooperative research and action, prevention, empowerment, social change, etc., effectively promotes personal well-being, well-being and quality of life. Child psychology: focuses on the psychology of children, recognizes the development and growth of children, and explains how children are treated when they have mental disorders.
title: 心理学

source_text: 測繪學研究測定和推算地面幾何位置、地球形状及地球重力場，据此測量地球表面自然物体和人工设施的幾何分布，编制各种比例尺地图的理論和技术的学科。测绘学的研究对象是地球的形态、位置、重力分布等地理空间信息，因而测绘学可认为是地球科学的一个分支学科。近年来，测绘学的研究对象还从地球表面扩大到了地外空间及地球内部构造等领域。
target_text: Mapping studies determine and extrapolate the geometry of the Earth’s surface, the shape of the Earth and the Earth’s gravitational field, thus measuring the geometric distribution of natural objects and artificial facilities on the Earth’s surface, and the theoretical and technical disciplines for the production of various scale maps. Surveying is aimed at geospatial information such as the shape, location, gravity distribution of the Earth, so mapping can be considered a branch of the Earth’s science. In recent years, mapping has also expanded from the Earth’s surface to areas such as outer space and intra-Earth tectonics.
title: 测绘学

source_text: 在世界上古史时代，就有利用測繪學治理尼罗河泛滥后農田邊界的說法。公元前7世纪，管仲在其所著《管子》一書中已收集了早期的地圖27幅。公元前5世纪至3世纪，中国已有利用磁石制成最早的指南工具“司南”的記载。公元前2世纪，在《史记·夏本纪》中就记载有大禹治水时“左准绳，右规矩”，说明当时已经有简单的测绘活动。
target_text: In the ancient times of the world, there are theories about the use of mapping to govern the agricultural frontier in the post-Niro River. In the seventh century B.C., an early map was collected in his book Pipeline. In the fifth to third centuries B.C., China used magnets to make the first guidance tool, “Shunan.” In the second century B.C., the “left line, right rule” in the history of Shizuru was documented when the water was being administered, indicating that simple mapping activities were already in place at that time.
title: 测绘学

source_text: 测绘学研究的是地球，而人类对地球形状的认识也出于不断的变化中。最初人们认为地球乃“天圆地方”，直到公元前6世纪毕达哥拉斯和公元前4世纪亚里士多德提出了“地圆说”。公元前3世纪，埃拉托斯特尼在亚历山大进行观测日影，推算出了子午圈的长度以及地球的半径，证实了地圆说，而该种方法则是“弧度测量”的初始形式。17世纪末，牛顿和惠更斯从力学原理出发，认为地球是两极稍扁的椭球形，称“地扁说”。18世纪中期法国科学院在南美洲和欧洲进行的弧度测量证实了“地扁说”。19世纪，随着测量得来的数据，拉普拉斯和高斯相继指出，地球并非为完美的椭球。1873年，利斯汀提出了大地水准面的概念，以与包围地球的静止海面重合的一个重力等位面表示地球的形状。1945年，莫洛坚斯基利用地球重力测量数据，才确定了地球的真实形状。
target_text: In the third century BC, Elatosny's observation of the solar shadow in Alexandria established the length of the midday circle and the Earth's radius, confirming the original form of the Earth's radians. At the end of the 17th century, Newton and Huegens came up with the concept of the Earth's surface, which, from the mechanics, considered the Earth to be a slightly flat elliptical shape, known as the Earth's flat-footed ellipse. In mid-1845, the French Academy of Sciences, using the Earth's gravitational measurements, determined the true shape of the Earth by using Earth's gravity data, as measured in the nineteenth century.
title: 测绘学

source_text:
测绘仪器的变革
测绘学所依仗的工具是测绘仪器，因此测绘学的发展离不开测绘工具的革新。早期的测绘使用的是简单的绳尺、矩尺等，17世纪望远镜发明，测绘工具开始变革。1617年，威理博·斯涅尔发明了“三角测量法”，开创了角度测量。1730年，西森研制出测角用经纬仪。地理大发现开始后，许多国家研究出了海上测定经纬度的仪器以定位船只。19世纪50年代，洛斯达首创摄影测量法。20世纪以后，随着飞机的发明，出现了航空摄影测绘地图的方法。人造卫星升空后，卫星定位技术（GPS）和遥感技术（RS）得以广泛应用，这与地理信息系统技术（GIS）合称“3S技术”。
target_text: In 1617, Willibo Snell invented a "triangular surveying" that opened up angle measurements. In 1730, Cissón developed an angle measurement instrument for longitudes. Following the beginning of the geological discovery, many countries developed instruments for the determination of latitudes at sea to locate ships. In the 1950s, Los das, the first photogrammetry method was developed. After the discovery of aircraft, the method of mapping aerial photography was developed. After the rise of artificial satellites, satellite positioning techniques (GPS) and remote sensing techniques (RS) were widely applied, which were called “3S techniques” in conjunction with GIS.
title: 测绘学

source_text:
學科分支
大地測量學是一门量测和描绘地球表面的学科，也包括确定地球重力场和海底地形。
摄影測量學是研究利用被摄物体影像来重建物体空间位置和三维形状技术的学科。
地圖（制图）學是研究地图的理论、编制技术与应用方法的科学。
工程測量學是研究工程建设和自然资源开发中进行测量工作的理论。
海洋測繪学是以海洋和海底为对象进行测量和编制海图的理论。
测量数据处理是研究如何消除各种误差并判定精度，如何处理分析各种形式的测量数据进行合理预报等的数学手段。
target_text: Geodesy is a discipline in measuring and depicting the Earth’s surface, including the determination of the Earth’s gravitational field and the topography of the seabed. Photographic metrology is a discipline in the use of images of captured objects to re-establish the space position of objects and the technology of three-dimensional shapes.
title: 测绘学

source_text:
超文本传输协议的统一资源定位符将从因特网获取信息的五个基本元素包括在一个简单的地址中：
传送协议
层级URL标记符号（为「//」，固定不变）
访问资源需要的凭证信息（可省略）
服务器（通常为域名，有时为IP地址）
端口号（以數字方式表示，若為預設值可省略）
路径（以「/」字元區別路徑中的每一個目錄名稱）
查詢（GET模式的表單參數，以「?」字元為起點，每個參數以「&」隔開，再以「=」分開參數名稱與資料，通常以UTF-8的URL編碼，避開字元衝突的問題）
片段（以「#」字元為起點）
target_text: The five basic elements of a unified resource locator for a hypertext transfer protocol that will receive information from the Internet are included in a simple address: Transfer Protocol Level URL tags (for '/', fixed) Documentary information needed to access the resource (cancellable) Server (usually domain name, sometimes IP address) Port number (expressed in numerical terms, if default value can be omitted) Path (see list parameter for each directory path in the '/' character field) Query (beginning in the GET mode, starting with '?' character, separating each parameter by ' &', separating the parameter name and data by '= ', usually avoiding the question of a meta-conflict using the URL code of UTF-8) Segment (begining with '#' character)
title: 统一资源定位符

source_text: 由于超文本传输协议允许服务器将浏览器-{zh-tw:重導向;zh-cn:重定向}-到另一个网页地址，因此许多服务器允许用户省略网页地址中的部分，比如「www」。从技术上来说这样省略后的网页地址实际上是一个不同的网页地址，浏览器本身无法决定这个新地址是否通，服务器必须完成-{zh-tw:重導向;zh-cn:重定向}-的任务。
target_text: Since the hypertext transfer protocol allows the server to redirect the browser - {zh-tw: redirection; zh-cn: redirection} - to another web address, many servers allow users to omit parts of the web address, such as " www " . Technically, the omitted web address is actually a different web address, the browser itself cannot decide whether the new address is going to work, and the server must complete the task -- {zh-tw: redirection; zh-cn: redirection}.
title: 统一资源定位符

source_text: 計算（）是一種將「單一或多個的輸入值」轉換為「單一或多個的結果」的一種思考過程。計算的定義有許多種使用方式，有相當精確的定義，例如使用各種算法進行的「算术」，也有較為抽象的定義，例如在一場競爭中「策略的計算」或是「計算」兩人之間關係的成功機率。
target_text: Calculating () is a process of thinking that transforms "one or more inputs" into "one or more outcomes". There are many ways in which calculations are defined, and there are fairly precise definitions, such as "calculations" using various algorithms, and more abstract definitions, such as the chances of success of a relationship between "measurement of strategy" or "calculation" in a competition.
title: 计算

source_text:
將7乘以8（7x8）就是一種簡單的算術。利用布莱克-斯科尔斯模型來算出財務評估中的公平價格（fair price）就是一種複雜的算術。從投票意向計算評估出的選舉結果（民意調查）也包含了某種算術，但是提供的結果是「各種可能性的範圍」而不是單一的正確答案。字源
計算的英文Calculation，字源來自，意為碎石，用來計算數目用的小石頭，它譯為，之後成為。在英文中，還有另一個字Computation，也被譯為計算。這兩個字在中古時代被分開。
target_text: Seven times eight (7x8) is a simple calculation. Using the Black-Skols model to calculate the fair price in the financial evaluation is a complicated calculation. The election results (opinion surveys) from voting intention calculations also contain some sort of calculation, but the results are "ranges of possibilities" rather than a single correct answer. The word source is Calculation, which is used as a stone to calculate numbers, which translates into, and then becomes, a small stone. In English, there is another word called Computation, which is also translated into calculations.
title: 计算

source_text: 数据结构可透过程式语言所提供的数据类型、引用及其他操作加以实现。一个设计良好的数据结构，应该在尽可能使用较少的时间与空间资源的前提下，支援各種程式執行。不同种类的数据结构适合不同种类的应用，部分資料結構甚至是為了解決特定問題而設計出來的。例如B树即為加快樹狀結構存取速度而設計的資料結構，常被應用在資料庫和檔案系統上。
target_text: The data structure can be achieved through the type of data, references and other operations provided in the program language. A well-designed data structure should support the application of various programs with as little time and space resources as possible. Different types of data structures are suitable for different types of applications, some of which are designed to solve particular problems. Tree B, for example, is a data structure designed to speed up access to tree structures, often used in databases and file systems.
title: 数据结构

source_text: 克利斯登·奈加特是丹麦奥胡斯大学的教授（1975年—1976年），并且随后成为挪威奥斯陆大学的教授（1977年兼职，1984年—1996年全职）。他在奥尔胡斯和奥斯陆大学的工作包括系统开发和计算机技术对社会的影响方面的研究与教学，这些工作为日后称为系统开发中的斯堪的纳维亚学派奠定了基础。斯堪的纳维亚学派的工作与参与式开发（Participatory Design）的领域密切相关。1987年他成为美国帕洛阿托的斯坦福大学的访问教授，施乐帕洛阿尔托研究中心的访问学者，以及苹果公司的高级技术小组的顾问与讲师。
target_text: Kristen Niigat was a professor at the University of Aarhus in Denmark (1975-1976) and subsequently became a professor at the University of Oslo in Norway (part-time, 1977, 1984-1996 full-time). His work at the University of Aarhus and Oslo included research and teaching on the social impact of systems development and computer technology, which laid the foundation for what will be known as the Scandinavian school of learning in systems development. The work of the Scandinavian school was closely related to the field of participatory development (Participatory Design). In 1987, he became a visiting professor at Stanford University in Palo Ato, United States, visiting scholar at the Schlepalo Alto Research Centre, and consultant and lecturer at the senior technical team of Apple.
title: 克利斯登·奈加特

source_text: 2001年11月他与奥利-约翰·达尔一起获得了電機電子工程師學會（IEEE,Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers）的約翰·馮諾依曼獎，并评价：“奖予他们在设计和实现SIMULA67时引入的概念，这些概念是面向对象技术的基石。”2002年2月他又一次与奥利-约翰·达尔一起获得了美國計算機協會（ACM）的图灵奖，并评价：“奖予他们在设计编程语言SIMULAI和SIMULA67时产生的基础性想法，这些想法是面向对象技术的肇始。”
target_text: In November 2001, he received, together with Ollie-John Dhar, the John Von Neumann Prize for Electrical Engineers (IEEE, Institute of Electric and Electronics Engineers) and evaluated: “The prize awarded them for designing and implementing the concepts introduced in SIMULA67, which are the cornerstone of target-oriented technology.” In February 2002, he received, together with Ollie Dhar, the Turing Award for the American Computer Association (ACM), and evaluated: “The prize gave them the basic ideas that emerged when designing programming languages such as SIMULAI and SIMULA67, which were the beginnings of target-oriented technology.”
title: 克利斯登·奈加特

source_text: 克利斯登·奈加特一直活跃于挪威政坛。在1960年代中后期，他是挪威左翼非社会主义政党Venstre的执行委员会成员，该党战略委员会主席。1972年挪威公民投票决定是否成为欧洲共同市场组织成员。在此前炽热的政治斗争中，他为协调青年组织而工作，大多数青年组织反对挪威加入欧洲共同市场组织，最后他们获得胜利。1971年—2001年克利斯登·奈加特是工党成员，并成为该党科学研究政策委员会的成员。
target_text: Kristen Niigat has been active in Norwegian politics. In the late 1960s, he was a member of the executive committee of the left-wing non-socialist party Venstre, the party’s strategic committee. In 1972, the Norwegian referendum decided whether to become a member of the European Common Market Organization.
title: 克利斯登·奈加特

source_text: 在1996年—1997年间克利斯登·奈加特为致力于成立欧洲反对马斯特里赫特条约运动（TEAM-The European Anti-Maastricht Movement）而担任协调员。欧洲反对马斯特里赫特条约运动是一个反对欧洲经济与货币联盟（Economic Monetary Union）和马斯特里赫特条约的国际组织间的协调网络。欧洲反对马斯特里赫特条约运动成功地于1997年3月3日建立起来。
target_text: The European Movement against the Maastricht Treaty is a network of coordination among international organizations against the European Economic and Monetary Union and the Maastricht Treaty. The European Movement against the Maastricht Treaty was successfully established on 3 March 1997.
title: 克利斯登·奈加特

source_text: Self语言，是一种基于原型的面向对象的程序设计语言，也是一个集成开发环境和运行环境，由David Ungar和Randy Smith，最初在1986年于施乐帕罗奥多研究中心设计。Self语言在Smalltalk的基础上，采用“槽”取代了“变量”，从而彻底体现了一切都是对象的风格。在实现Self系统的过程中，设计研究人员发展出了一种动态自适应编译技术。
target_text: The Self language, which is a prototype-based, object-oriented programming language, is also an integrated development environment and operating environment, originally designed by David Ungar and Randy Smith at the Schlepparodo Research Centre in 1986. The Self language replaces the "variable" with the "hull" based on Smalltalk, thus fully reflecting the style of everything. In the process of achieving the Self system, the design researchers developed a dynamic self-adaptation compilation technique.
title: Self

source_text:
简介
Self语言把在概念上精简Smalltalk作为设计原则。它在把消息作为最基本的操作的同时，取消了类的概念，只有对象的概念。它把对象的特性，理解为获取或更改特性的这两种方法，从而把特性的概念简化为方法，并且通过消息来读槽和写槽的方式，取代了变量及其赋值。Self提出了特质的概念，用实现了委托。
target_text: The Self language uses conceptual streamlining of Smalltalk as a design principle. It removes the concept of class as the most basic operation of the message, but only the concept of object. It streamlines the concept of identity into a method by understanding the characteristics of the object as the two methods of acquiring or changing it, and replaces the variable and its assigned value by reading and writing slots through the message.
title: Self

source_text: 尽管Self系统一次运行在一个进程中，但实际上可以分成两个部分：Self虚拟机和Self世界。Self世界是一个Self对象库，Self对象包括数据对象和方法对象，方法对象的代码部份，是用一种指令非常简单的字节码表示的，字节码由Self虚拟机来解释。当Self程序从终端、文件或者图形用户界面输入到系统之中时，Self系统把源程序解析转化为Self世界里的对象。
target_text: Although the Self system operates in a process at a time, it can actually be divided into two parts: the Self Virtual Machine and the Self World. The Self World is a Self Object Library, and the Self Object includes data objects and methodological objects, and the code part of the method object is expressed in a very simple byte code for a command, which is explained by the Self Virtual Machine. When a Self program is entered into the system from a terminal, file or graphical user interface, the Self System interprets the source program into a Self World object.
title: Self

source_text: 动态自适应编译技术的采用，提高了Self代码的执行效率。对经常执行的方法，虚拟机将进一步把字节码转化为本机代码。Self虚拟机还提供了一些可供调用的，用来实现算术运算、对象复制、输入输出等。Self还拥有一个图形用户界面Morphic，Self的编程环境，也是基于Morphic来实现的。Self在精简语言概念的同时，也把大量的工作转交给环境来处理，语言中的反射机制也同环境密切相关。
target_text: The introduction of dynamic self-adaptation compilation techniques has increased the efficiency of the implementation of the Self code. For frequently implemented methods, the virtual machine will further convert the byte code into the home code. The Self virtual machine also provides a number of dialysis, object replication, input output, etc. The Self also has a graphical user interface Morphic, Self programming environment, which is also based on Morphic. Self, while streamlining the language concept, also transfers a large amount of work to the environment, and the reflection mechanism in the language is closely linked to the environment.
title: Self

source_text: Self的发展基本已经停滞，但在发展Self过程中探索出的一些技术，在其他的系统中得到了应用。在Self的实现中采用的各种编译优化技术，直接导致了Java Hotspot虚拟机的产生；在Smalltalk的一个实现Squeak中，采用了Self图形用户界面Morphic的设计方案，放弃了Smalltalk-80中采用的MVC的方案。Self是对JavaScript编程语言设计有最主要影响者之一。
target_text: Self’s development has largely stalled, but some of the technologies explored in the development of Self have been applied in other systems. The various compilation optimization techniques used in Self’s realization have directly led to the creation of the Java Hotspot virtual machine; in Smalltalk’s realization of Squeak, the design of the Self GUI Morphic has abandoned the MVC used in Smalltalk-80. Self is one of the most important contributors to JavaScript programming language design.
title: Self

source_text: 这个例子展示了这种方式的一个问题：Bob的汽车，恰巧是一个跑车，在任何意义上都不能装载和运送建材，但这是建模Vehicle所必须拥有的能力。通过从Vehicle建立特殊化的子类，可产生一个更有用的模型；比如建立跑车类SportsCar和平板卡车类FlatbedTruck。只有FlatbedTruck的实例需要提供“运送建材”的机能；SportsCar的实例不适合这种工作，它只需要“快速行驶”。但是，这种深入建模在设计期间，需要更多的洞察力，洞察那些可能只在引起了问题时才显现出的事情。
target_text: This example illustrates one of the problems of this approach: Bob's car, which happens to be a running car, cannot be loaded and transported in any sense, but it is the capability required to model Vehicle. By creating a special subcategory from Vehicale, a more useful model can be created; for example, the SportsCar Peaceboard truck type FlatbedTruck. Only the example of FlatbedTruck requires the ability to deliver “building materials”; and the case of SportCar is not suitable for this kind of work, and it simply needs to be “fast-tracked.” But, during the design, such in-depth modelling requires more insight, and insight into what may only emerge as a result of the problems that arise.
title: Self

source_text: 这个问题是在原型（prototype）这个概念背后的动机因素之一。除非你能必然性的预测出一组对象和类，在遥远未来时所要有的品质，你不能恰当的设计好一个类的层级。程序最终需要增加行为，实在是太频繁了，而系统的很多节段将需要重新设计或重新构建，来以不同的方式迸发出对象。早期的面向对象语言如Smalltalk的实验，显示出这种问题反反复复的出现。系统趋向于增长到一定程度后，就变得非常僵化，因为在编程者的代码下的深层的基本类，简直就像是逐渐变成了一个“错误”；没有变更原来的类的容易方式，就会出现严重的问题。
target_text: The problem is one of the motivational factors behind the concept of prototype. Unless you can necessarily predict a set of objects and classes, and the qualities that you need in the distant future, you cannot properly design a class hierarchy. The process eventually needs to increase behaviour too often, and many sections of the system will need to be redesigned or reconfigured to reach the target in a different way. Early subject-oriented language, such as the Smalltalk experiment, shows that the problem is recurring.
title: Self

source_text: 动态语言如Smalltalk，允许通过周知的按照类的方法进行这种变更；即通过改变类，基于它的对象就可以改变它们的行为。但是，进行这种变更必须非常小心，因为基于相同类的其他对象，可能把它当作“错误行为”：“错误”经常是依赖于场景的，这是问题的一种形式。进一步的说，在静态语言如C++中，这里的子类可以从超类分别的编译，对超类的变更实际上可以破坏预编译的子类方法；这是脆弱基类问题的另一种形式，也是的一种形式。
target_text: Dynamic languages, such as Smalltalk, allow for such changes to be made through a well-known class-by-class approach; i.e., by changing a class, it is possible to change their behaviour on the basis of its object. However, such changes must be carried out with great care, since, on the basis of other objects of the same class, they may be treated as “misconduct”: “mistakes” often depend on the scene, which is a form of the problem. Further, in static languages, such as C++, the sub-category here can be compiled separately from the super-category, which can actually undermine the pre-assembled sub-category approach; this is another form of the fragile sub-category and one of the same.
title: Self

source_text: 在Self和其他基于原型的编程语言中，消除了在类和对象之间的这种二元性。不再有基于某种“类”的一个对象“实例”，在Self中，你可以复制一个现存的对象，并改变它。故而Bob's car可以通过制作现存的Vehicle对象的复本来建立，并增加“快速行驶”方法，建模它恰好是一辆保时捷911的事实。
target_text: In Self and other prototype-based programming languages, this duality between classes and objects is eliminated. There is no longer an "examples" of objects based on a "class" and, in Self, you can copy an existing object and change it. Bob's car can, therefore, model the fact that it is a 911 pedagogic machine by making the restoration of an existing Veheckle object and adding a "fast-tracking" method.
title: Self

source_text: 主要用来制作复本的基本对象叫做“原型”。这种技术被称为是一种非常简化的机制。如果一个现存的对象或对象的集合，被证明是个不适当的模型，编程者可以简单的建立有正确行为的一个修改的对象，并转而使用它。使用现存对象的代码不会改变。
target_text: The basic object used to produce a copy is called a prototype. This technology is described as a very simplified mechanism. If a collection of existing objects or objects is shown to be an inappropriate model, the programmer can simply create a modified object with the right behaviour and switch to it. The code of the existing object will not change.
title: Self

source_text:
语法和语义
下面简要描述Self语言的语法和语义。对象
（literal）包括：数、用'包围起来的字符串对象，块和一般的对象。对象文字用圆括号来界定。在圆括号内，对象描述构成自竖杠|界定的一个槽列表，随后是在这个对象被求值时要执行的代码。例如：
(| 槽1. 槽2 | 一些代码 )
target_text: Syntax and semantic: A brief description of the syntax and semantics of the Self language is given below. Object (literal) includes: number, string objects surrounded, blocks, and general objects. Object text is defined in parentheses. In brackets, object descriptions constitute a list of slots defined by the bar, followed by the code to be executed when the object is called for. For example: (Base 1. slot 2  some codes)

source_text:
槽（slot）是名字-值对，槽包含到其他对象的引用。槽列表由点号分隔的（可以为空的）一序列的槽描述符组成。在槽列表结束处的点号是可选的。槽描述符（descriptor）有两种：
槽 <- 表达式，指示将指名的数据槽初始化为求值表达式的结果，它有相同名字附加冒号的包含赋值原语的赋值槽，这两个槽对应于其他语言中的一个读写变量。
槽 = 表达式，指示将指名的数据槽初始化为求值表达式的结果，这个槽对应其他语言的一个只读变量。
target_text: Slot (slot) is a reference to name-to-value, and the slot contains references to other objects. The slot list consists of a series of slot descriptors separated by a dot number (which can be empty). The dot number at the end of the slot list is optional. The slot descriptor has two types: slot < - an expression that indicates the initialization of a data slot named as an expression of value, and it has a sink with a colon attached to the same name containing the original attribute, which corresponds to one of the reading and writing variables in the other languages. Slot = an expression that indicates the initialization of the named data slot as a result of the desired expression, which corresponds to a read-only variable in the other languages.
title: Self

source_text:
在Self中没有单独的赋值运算。其他面向对象语言中的访问子方法对应数据槽，变异子方法对应赋值槽。假如myPerson对象中有个叫做name的数据槽，则通过，可返回在这个槽中的值；如果它有对应的赋值槽name:，则通过，可设置数据槽name的值为'foo'。任何槽都可以通过增加星号后缀，来制成父槽。星号不是槽名字的一部份，在将名字与消息进行匹配时候忽略它。例如一个初始化了的可变的点可以定义为：
(| parent* = traits point.
x <- 3 + 4.
y <- 5.
|)
target_text: There is no separate assignation in Self. The access sub-method corresponds to the data chute in other object-oriented languages, and the variation sub-method corresponds to the attribution chute. If there is a data chute called Name in myPerson objects, the value in this chute can be returned; if it has a corresponding assigned slot name, the value of the data chute is `foo'. Any chute can make a parent chute by adding an asterisk suffix. The asterisk is not a part of the asterisk, and it can be ignored when matching a name with a message. For example, an initial variable point can be defined as: ( parent* = tripits point. x <- 3 + 4. y < 5.)

source_text: 一个对象的代码是以点号分隔的一序列的表达式。尾随的点号是可选的。每个表达式有一系列的消息发送和文字组成。在一个对象的代码中最后的表达式，可以前导着指示返回的^算符。一个真正的空对象，指示为(| |)或简单的()，它根本不接收任何消息。

The last expression in the code of an object can lead to arithmetic of instructions to return. A true empty object is indicated as () or simply (), and it does not receive any information at all.

source_text: 组合可以通过使用圆括号来进行强制。在缺乏明确组合的情况下，一元消息具有最高优先级，其次是二元消息，而关键字消息最低。一元消息从左至右复合。二元消息对于同一个算符从左至右结合，例如3 + 4 + 7被解释为(3 + 4) + 7，而对于不同的算符没有结合性，例如3 + 4 * 7是非法的，而必须显式的写为要么(3 + 4) * 7要么3 + (4 * 7)。

In the absence of a clear combination, the message of the dollar has the highest priority, followed by the message of the binary, while the message of the key word is the lowest. The message of the dollar is combined from the left to the right. The message of the binary is interpreted from the left to the right, for example, 3 + 4 + 7 is interpreted as (3 + 4) + 7, while there is no combination of the different algorithms, such as 3 + 4 * 7 is illegal, and must be written in an overt form either (3 + 4) * 7 or 3 + (4 * 7).

如果一个槽包含一个方法，在求值这个槽来响应发来的消息的时候，这个方法对象被（clone），从而新建它的一个活动（activation）对象，它包含这个方法的参数槽和局部槽；复制体的self父槽，初始化为这个消息的接收者；复制体如果有参数槽，将它们初始化为实际参数；在这个新的活动对象的上下文中，执行这个方法的代码。例如计算点的加法的一个方法：
(| + arg = ( (clone x: x + arg x) y: y + arg y )
|)

(| + = (| :arg | (clone x: ((x + (arg x)))) y: ((y + (arg y))) ).

这里出现了三个隐含接收者一元消息clone、x和y。

作为语法约定，参数名字可以直接写在槽名字中对应关键字之后，它不再带有前缀冒号，从而隐含的声明参数槽。例如下面的方法定义：

一个块文字定义两个对象：一个块数据对象，和它包围的一个块方法对象。

source_text: 在理论上，所有Self对象都是独立实体，Self既没有类也没有元类。对任何特定对象的变更，都不影响任何其他对象，但是在某些情况下，却需要它们有关联。正常的一个对象，只能理解对应于它的局部槽的消息，但拥有一个或更多的指示父（parent）对象的槽，对象可以将任何自身不理解的消息，委托（delegate）给父对象。
target_text: In theory, all Self objects are independent entities, and Self has neither a class nor a metatype. Any change in a given object does not affect any other object, but in some cases it is required to be connected. A normal object can only understand the information that corresponds to its local slots, but has one or more slots that indicate to its parent that the object can entrust to its parent any information that it does not understand.
title: Self

source_text:
Self采用这种方式，处理在基于类的语言中使用继承来担负的责任。委托还可以用来实现一些特征，比如命名空间和词法作用域。通过下面的例子展示委托与传统的类的不同之处：
myObject parent: someOtherObject.
这个句子通过改变与叫做parent的父槽关联的值，在运行时间改变myObject的“类”。不同于继承或词法作用域，委托对象可以在运行时间修改。
target_text: Self uses this approach to deal with the responsibility of using inheritance in class-based languages. Commissions can also be used to achieve features such as naming space and word-law domains. The difference between commission and traditional classes is illustrated by the following example: myObject parent: someotherObject. This sentence changes myObject's "class" at running time. Unlike inheritance or word-law domains, the client can change it at running time.
title: Self

source_text: 例如，假定在一个简单的账簿应用中，定义了一个对象叫做“银行帐号”（bank account）。通常建立的这个对象，具有内部的方法，比如说“存款”（deposit）和“取款”（withdraw），和任何它所需要的数据槽，比如说“余额”（balance）。这只是一个原型，它只在使用方式上特殊，因为它恰好是一个全功能的银行帐号。
target_text: For example, it is assumed that in a simple book application, an object is defined as a bank account. This object is usually created with internal methods, such as “deposit” and “withdraw” and any data chute it needs, such as “balance” and “balance”. It is only a prototype, which is unique in the way it is used, as it happens to be a fully functional bank account number.

target_text: But the more commonly used solution is to first create a simple object called its unique object, which contains items normally related to a class. In this example, a “bank account” will have no deposit and withdrawal methods, but will be entrusted to a parent. In this way, many copies of the object of the bank account can be produced, but we can change the behaviour of all of them by changing the slots in the particular object that it has commissioned.

source_text:
环境
Self的一个特征，是它基于了早期Smalltalk系统所用的某种虚拟机系统。就是说，程序不是像C语言中那样的独立实体，而是需要它们的整体内存环境来运行。这要求应用程序被装载入保存内存的（chunk）之中，这叫做“快照”或。这种方式的缺点，是映像有时很大并且笨重；但是调试一个映像，经常被调试一个传统程序要简单，因为运行时状态更容易检查和修改。在基于源代码和基于映像的开发之间的不同，是类似于在面向类的和面向原型的面向对象编程之间的区别。
target_text: One feature of the environment Self is that it is based on some kind of virtual machine system that was used in the early Smalltalk system. That is, the program is not an independent entity as in the C language, but requires their entire memory environment to run. This requires applications to be loaded into the memory preservation (chunk) that is called a “sclipshot” or something. The disadvantage of this approach is that the image is sometimes big and heavy; but a debug of an image is often simple, because it is easier to test and modify a traditional program because it operates at a time. The difference between source code-based and image-based development is similar to the difference between object-oriented programming in a class-oriented and a prototype-oriented way.
title: Self

source_text: 此外，环境是为了让在系统之中的对象能快速和可持续的变更而定制的。重新构建一个“类”设计，就像从现存的祖先拖动出来方法放入新造的之中一样容易。简单任务像测试方法，可以通过制作复本来处理，拖动方法进入这个复本，接着变更它。不同于传统系统，只有变更了的对象有新代码，不需要重建任何东西来测试它。如果这个方法有效，可以简单的把它拖动回祖先之中。
target_text: Moreover, the environment is custom-made to allow rapid and sustainable changes to objects in the system. Reconstructing a "class" design is as easy as dragging from an existing ancestors into a new creation. A simple task, like a test method, can be used to reprocess, drag into this copy and change it. Unlike a traditional system, only a changed object has a new code, and nothing needs to be rebuilt to test it. If it works, it can simply drag it back to its ancestors.
title: Self

source_text:
性能
Self的VM实现的性能，在某些测试之中大约是优化的C程序速度的一半。这是通过即时编译技术达到的，它是在Self研究中首创并改进的，能够使高级语言表现得这么好。垃圾收集
Self的垃圾收集器使用分代垃圾回收，它按年龄分离对象。通过使用内存管理系统记录页面写，可以维护一个写屏障。这个技术给出了卓越的性能，尽管在运行一些时间之后，出现完全的垃圾收集，要花相当可观的时间。
target_text: The performance of Velf's VM is about half the speed of the optimized C program in some tests. This is achieved through instantaneous compilation technology, which was first created and improved in the Self study, and allows advanced languages to perform so well. Waste collection in Self uses intergenerational waste recycling, which separates objects by age. A writing barrier can be maintained by using the memory management system to record pages.
title: Self

source_text:
优化
运行系统选择性的扁平化调用结构。这给出适当的自身提速，但允许了对不同调用者类型的类型信息和多版本的代码的大量缓存。这去除了对做很多方法查找的需要，并允许条件分支语句和硬编码调用被插入，这经常能给出类似C语言的性能，而又不失去语言层面的通用性，但要建立在完全的垃圾收集系统之上。
target_text: Optimizes a selective flat-level call structure for running systems. This gives an appropriate boost to itself, but allows for a large cache of type information and multiple versions of codes for different types of callers. This allows, in addition to the need to do many methods of searching, the insertion of conditional branch statements and hard code calls, which often gives performance similar to that of the C language without losing linguistic universality, but is based on a complete garbage collection system.
title: Self

source_text: 到1991年9月，Linux内核版本 0.01 在芬兰大学和研究网络（FUNET）的FTP服务器（ftp.funet.fi）上发布。它有10,239行代码。在1991年10月，0.02版本的内核发布了。1991年12月，0.11版本的内核发布。由于它可以由运行相同内核版本的计算机编译，因此该版本是第一个 Linux 内核。当托瓦茲于1992年2月发布0.12版本时，他采用了 GNU 通用公共许可证（GPL），而不是以前的自行起草的许可证，原先的许可证不允许商业再分发。
target_text: By September 1991, the Linux kernel version 0.01 was published on the FTP server (ftp.funet.fi) of the Finnish University and Research Network (FUNET). It had 10,239 lines of code. In October 1991, the kernel was released in version 0.02. In December 1991, the kernel was released in version 0.11. Since it could be compiled by computers running the same kernel version, the version was the first Linux kernel.
title: Linux内核

source_text: Linux不是微内核架构的事实曾经引起了林納斯·托瓦茲与安德鲁·斯图尔特·塔能鲍姆之间一场著名的争论。1992年在Usenet討論群組comp.os.minix開始了一場網路論戰，討論的主題在於作業系統架構的選擇。稍後一些著名的駭客也加入討論，如大衛·米勒、曹子德。這場辯論影響了Linux核心的設計走向。塔能鲍姆認為Linux内核採用的宏内核已經過時了，應該採取比較先進的微內核架構，引起了林納斯的反擊。
target_text: The fact that Linux is not a micronuclear structure has given rise to a well-known controversy between Linus Tovaz and Andrew Stewart Tacanbaum. In 1992, the Usenet discussion group comp.os.minix started an online debate on the choice of the operating system. Later, some famous hackers, such as David Miller and Cao Zde, joined the discussion. This debate influenced the design of Linux’s core.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 在2006年5月9日，这个主题被重新审视，并且在2006年5月12日塔能鲍姆写了一份立场声明。架构Linux是一个单体内核，支持真正的抢占式多任务处理（于用户态，和版本2.6系列之后的内核态）、虚拟内存、共享库、、共享写时复制可执行体（通过）、内存管理、Internet协议族和线程等功能。
target_text: On May 9, 2006, the subject was revisited and a position statement was written on May 12, 2006 in Talent Baum. The structure Linux is a single-body core that supports real-occupancy multitask processing (in user-state, and post-version 2.6 kernel), virtual memory, shared library, shared writing, copying executables (through), memory management, Internet community and thread.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 设备驱动程序和内核扩展运行于内核空间（在很多CPU架构中是ring 0），可以完全访问硬件，但也有运行于用户空间的一些例外，例如基于FUSE/CUSE的文件系统，和部分UIO。多数人与Linux一起使用的图形系统不运行在内核中。与标准单体内核不同，Linux的设备驱动程序可以轻易的配置为内核模块，并在系统运行期间可直接装载或卸载。也不同于标准单体内核，设备驱动程序可以在特定条件下被抢占；增加这个特征用于正确处理硬件中断并更好的支持对称多处理。出于自愿选择，Linux内核没有二进制内核接口。
target_text: Device drivers and kernel extensions operate in kernel space (Ring 0 in many CPU structures), with full access to hardware, but with some exceptions operating in user space, such as FUSE/CUSE-based document systems, and part UIO. Most people use graphic systems with Linux not operating in kernels. Unlike the standard sheet core, Linux's equipment driver can easily be configured as an kernel module and can be directly loaded or offloaded during the system's operation. Unlike standard kernels, equipment drivers can be seized under certain conditions; adding this feature is used to properly process hardware interruptions and better support symmetric multi-processing.

source_text:
編程語言
Linux是用C語言中的GCC版（這種C語言有對標準C進行擴展）寫的，還有幾個用組合語言（用的是GCC的"AT&T風格"）寫的目標架構短段。因為要支持擴展的C語言，GCC在很長的時間里是唯一一个能正确编译Linux的编译器。有許多其他的語言用在一些方面上，主要集中在內核構建過程中（這裡指從源代碼創建可啟動鏡像）。包括Perl、Python和多種腳本語言。有一些驅動可能是用C++、Fortran或其他語言寫的，但是這樣是強烈不建議的。
target_text: The programming language Linux is written in the GCC version of the C language (this is an extension of the standard C language) and in several other combination languages (the "AT&T style" of the GCC). To support the expanded C language, the GCC is the only compiler that can correctly compile Linux for a long time. There are a number of other languages that focus in some respects on the internal construction process (which refers to the creation of activated mirrors from the source code). These include Perl, Python and multiple script language. Some of the drives may have been written in C++, Fortran or other languages, but this is highly undesirable.

source_text: 自从2010年，已经开始进行使用Clang建造Linux内核的努力，Clang是一个可作为替代的C语言编译器；截止2014年4月12日，官方内核几乎可以完全用Clang编译。致力于这个目标的计划叫做“LLVMLinux”，得名于Clang所基于的LLVM编译器下部构造。LLVMLinux不意图复制Linux内核或LLVM，因此它是由最终提交给上游计划的补丁构成的一个元计划。使Linux内核可以用Clang编译最大的好处是比GCC有更快的编译速度，内核开发者可以得益于由此而来的更快的工作流程。
target_text: Since 2010, efforts have been under way to build Linux kernels using Clang, an alternative C-language compiler; as of April 12, 2014, official kernels can almost exclusively be compiled by Clang. The plan for this goal is called LLVMLinux, which is known as the lower structure of the LLVM editor based on Clang. LVMLinux does not intend to replicate Linux kernels or LLVM, so it is a meta-plan that is ultimately submitted to the upstream plan. The greatest benefit to enable Linux kernels to be compiled by Clang is that they can be compiled at a faster rate than GCC, and their developers can benefit from the resulting faster work processes.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 接口符合标准是Linux内核内部的普遍策略。另一个规则是Linux内核主线不接受只由专有用户空间软件使用的内核模块。内核至用户空间API源代码可移植性确保符合标准的C程序可以在符合同样标准的任何系统上编译和运行。Linux内核开发、GNU C函数库和相关的实用工具致力于追随POSIX和单一UNIX规范。是内核的系统调用接口。
target_text: The interface meets the standard is a common strategy within the Linux kernel. Another rule is that the Linux kernel main line does not accept kernel modules that are used only by proprietary user space software. The kernel to user space API source code portability ensures that the C program that meets the standard can be compiled and run on any system that meets the same criteria. Linux kernel development, GNU C functions library and related practical tools are dedicated to following POSIX and a single UNIX code.

source_text:
内核内API在不同子系统间使用了数个内核内部API。其中一些是跨越多个发行版保持稳定的，另一些则不然。对于内核内API不作担保。维护者和贡献者可以在任何时候增加或变更它们。内核内API的例子包括针对下列类别设备驱动程序的软件框架/API：

target_text: API inside the kernel uses several intranuclear APIs across different subsystems. Some of them are stable across multiple distributions, others are not. There is no guarantee for API inside the kernel. Maintainers and contributors can add or change them at any time. Examples of API inside the kernel include the software framework/API:Video4Linux for video capture hardware.
title: Linux内核

source_text: Linux内核提供在特定条件下的抢先式调度。直到内核版本2.4，只有用户进程是抢先式的，就是说除了时间片用尽，在用户模式下执行的当前进程，如果有更高态优先级的进程进入TASK_RUNNING状态，它就会被中断。自从2.6系列Linux内核，增加了中断执行内核代码的任务的能力，但不是对于内核代码的所有段落。
target_text: The kernel of Linux provides pre-emptive dispatch under certain conditions. Until kernel version 2.4, only the user process is pre-emptive, that is to say, the current process implemented in the user mode, except when the time sheet is exhausted, would be interrupted if a process with a higher state priority entered the TASK_RUNNING state. Since the kernel of the 2.6 series Linux, it has increased the ability to abort the task of performing the kernel code, but not all the paragraphs of the kernel code.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 通过使用实时Linux内核补丁PREEMPT_RT，可以支持对关键段落、中断处理器和“中断禁用”代码序列的完全抢先。 实时Linux内核补丁部分地集成入主线内核已经带给它一些功能。抢先机制改善延迟、增进响应性，并使得Linux更加适合桌面和实时应用。老版本内核有所谓的，用于锁定粒度为整个内核的同步，它最终由Arnd Bergmann在2011年移除了。
target_text: By using a real-time Linux kernel patch PREEMPT_RT, it can support complete pre-emption of key paragraphs, break processors, and “interrupted” code sequences. Real-time Linux kernels have been partially integrated into the main line. The pre-emptive mechanism improves delay, enhances responsiveness, and makes Linux more suitable for desktop and real-time applications.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 在Linux上，oops即Linux内核的行为不正确，并产生了一份相关的错误日志。许多类型的oops会导致内核错误，即令系统立即停止工作，但部分oops也允许继续操作，作为与稳定性的妥协。这个概念只代表一个简单的错误。当内核检测到问题时，它会打印一个oops信息然后杀死全部相关进程。oops信息可以帮助Linux内核工程师调试，检测oops出现的条件，并修复导致oops的程序错误。
target_text: On Linux, oops, or Linux kernel, behaved incorrectly and produced a related error log. Many types of oops cause kernel errors, i.e. the system to stop working immediately, but parts of oops also allow to continue operating as a compromise with stability. This concept represents only a simple error. When the kernel detects a problem, it prints a oops message and then kills all related processes. oops information helps Linux kernel engineers to debug, detect conditions in oops and fix the procedural error that led to oops.
title: Linux内核

source_text:
安全
计算机安全是一个非常公众化的主题，关系到Linux内核，因为大量在内核中的错误可能成为潜在的安全漏洞，是否允许提升权限漏洞或拒绝服务攻击源漏洞。在过去的几年中，许多这样的缺陷被发现，并在Linux内核中被修补好。新的安全功能被继续实现，以解决在Linux内核中的电脑不安全问题。
target_text: Security, computer security, is a very public subject related to the Linux kernel, because a large number of errors in the kernel may be a potential security gap, allowing for increased access gaps or denials of service attacks. In the past few years, many of these flaws have been detected and repaired in Linux kernels. New security functions continue to be implemented to address computer insecurity in Linux kernels.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 批評者指責內核開發人員，稱他們掩蓋（至少並未公佈）安全漏洞。2008年，作為回應，Torvalds稱：「個人認為，安全漏洞只是『正常的漏洞』。這些漏洞我並不去掩蓋，不過我不認為應當把它們特殊化，更不認為應該追蹤並公示它們……我不理會整個安全團隊，原因之一就是，我認為這些漏洞不僅美化還鼓勵了錯誤的行為。這令安全人員成了『英雄』，就猶如不修補正常漏洞的人就不值一提似的。而事實上，所有無聊的正常漏洞極為重要，僅僅因為它們實在太多了。我不認為該美化和關心那些嚴重的安全漏洞——它們並不及那些由死鎖造成的隨機嚴重崩潰來得更特殊。」
target_text: In response, Torvalds stated that, in 2008, the individual thought that the security breach was only a "normal breach." I didn't think they should be specialized, let alone tracked and publicized. I don't think that they should be tracked. I don't care about the entire security team, for one reason that I don't think that they simply glorify and encourage wrong behavior. This makes the security guard a hero, just like those who don't fix the normal gap. In fact, all boring normal loopholes are so important, just because they are too many. I don't think it's about beauty and concern about the serious security gaps — they're not more special than those that are caused by death locks.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 如2012年五月，SYSRET指令被發現在AMD和英特爾處理器間在實現方面有差異，這個差異在Windows、FreeBSD、XenServer和Solaris這些主流作業系統會導致漏洞。2012年六月，Linux核心中該問題已被修復。2021年，來自明尼蘇達大學的研究人員，曾藉由貢獻修補程式至Linux核心的名義，利用修補程式導入臭蟲或漏洞，以觀察Linux核心社群的反應，再度故技重施時，被發現後封鎖了所有來自該大學的貢獻，與移除過去該大學曾經貢獻的程式碼。
target_text: For example, in May 2012, the SYSRET directive was found to be different in the implementation of the AMD and Intel processors, a gap created by mainstream systems such as Windows, FreeBSD, XenSver, and Solaris. In June 2012, the problem was repaired at the heart of Linux. In 2021, researchers from the University of Minnesota, using the repair program to the core of Linux, used it to channel bugs or bugs to observe the reactions of the Linux core community, were found to be re-enacting and later blocked all contributions from the University and removed the programs that the University had previously contributed.
title: Linux内核

source_text:
开发者社区
截止2007年，内核开发已经从20位最活跃开发者写80%的代码转变为顶端30人写30%的代码，而顶端开发者花费更多的时间审核变更。 开发者还可以按从属关系来归类；在2007年，顶端类属是“不知名”而顶端公司是Red Hat，它占有12%的贡献，而知名业余爱好者占3.9%。 在2007年中所做内核变更已经由超过1900位开发者提交。一般假定Linux内核开发者社区由5000或6000名成员组成。
target_text: By 2007, kernel development had changed from 80% for 20 of the most active developers to 30% for 30% at the top, while kernel developers had spent more time reviewing changes. Developers could also be classified by affiliation; in 2007, the top class was “unknown” and the top company was Red Hat, with 12% of its contribution, compared to 3.9% for famous amateurs, and the kernel changes made in 2007 were submitted by more than 1900 developers.
title: Linux内核

source_text:
开发过程与模式
一个想要对 Linux 内核进行修改的开发者一般就从对那个修改的开发和测试开始着手。接下来的过程取决于变化的重要程度，及修改该变更的子系统数量是由单个还是多个修补程序组成。如果仅仅是修改了由单个维护人员维护的单个子系统，那么这些修改的补丁代码就直接通过Cc中某个邮件列表发送给相关的维护人员。邮件列表的阅读者和子系统的维护人员将检查补丁代码并提供反馈。一旦审查过程完成，维护者接受他内核代码树中的补丁。如果这些更改被认为是够重要的错误修复，那么包含这些修补程序的拉取请求（pull request）将在几天内发送给Linus。否则，将在下一个合并窗口时向Linus发送拉取请求。合并窗口通常会持续两周，并在之前的内核版本发布后立即启动。
target_text: The process and mode of development, a developer who wants to modify Linux kernels, usually starts with the development and testing of that modification. The process that follows depends on the magnitude of the change and whether the number of subsystems that modify the change is made by individual or multiple fixes. If only the individual subsystems maintained by individual maintainers are modified, then the modified patch code is sent directly to the relevant maintainer via a Cc mailing list. Readers of the mailing list and maintainers of subsystems will check the patch code and provide feedback. Once the review process is completed, the maintainer will accept the patch in his inner kernel tree. If these changes are considered to be important enough to repair the error, the pull request (pull request) containing them will be sent to Linus in a few days. Otherwise, the pull request will be sent to Linus at the next consolidation window.
title: Linux内核

source_text: Linus Torvalds拥有对Linux内核能够接受哪些更改和谁可以成为维护者的最终决定权。内核维护者在他们自愿放弃之前将维持他们的角色。目前，没有任何已知的内核维护者被要求退出。此外，还没有一个内核维护者因与其他维护者的交互风格的因素而受到Linus批评的例子。这为维护者提供了宽松的社区空间。虽然内核开发社区的文化多年来有所改善，但曾有一段时间它的声誉很糟糕。认为自己遭受了不公正对待的开发者可以向Linux基金会的技术专家委员会报告。尽管如此，一些社区成员仍然不认同现在的讨论氛围。
target_text: Linus Torvalds has the ultimate decision as to what changes the kernel can accept and who can be a defender of Linux. The kernels will maintain their role until they voluntarily give up. There is currently no known kernel defenders being asked to withdraw. Moreover, there is no case where kernel defenders have been criticized by Linus for interacting with other defenders.
title: Linux内核

source_text:
同 Linux 发行版的关系
大多数Linux用户运行一个由他们 Linux 发行版提供的内核。一些发行版搭载的是 Linux 的通用内核（也就是 “vanilla”或“stable”）版本。不过，一些Linux内核发行商（如Red Hat和SUSE）会维护他们自己的内核分支。这些发行商分支的内核版本通常相对于稳定版本（vanilla）而言更新的速度更慢一些，但是同样会包括所有相关的稳定版本分支的补丁。此外，他们同时也会增添一些新特性和对新硬件的支持，而这些支持是这些发行商分支基于的稳定分支所不包括的。
target_text: Most Linux users run a kernel provided by their Linux releases. Some distributions are backed by Linux's generic kernel (i.e. “vanilla” or “table”) versions. However, some Linux kernel distributors (e.g. Red Hat and SUSE) maintain their own kernel branches. The kernel versions of these issuers' branches are usually less up-to-date than the stable version (vanilla), but they also include patches of all relevant stable version branches. In addition, they add new features and support for new hardware, which are not included in the stable branch on which these issuers' branches are based.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 重新开发的估价按照传统商业软件开发的方式，重新开发Linux 2.6.0内核的估计代价将是6.12亿美元（4.67亿欧元、3.94亿英镑），以2004年的COCOMO人月估计模型.在2006年，欧盟资助的一项研究表明，重新开发Linux 2.6.8以后的内核，代价是8.82亿欧元（11.4亿美元、7.44亿英镑）。截至2011年1月4日，使用当前的代码行（LOC）和大卫·惠勒的计算工资数，这将花费约30亿美元（约22亿欧元），才能够重新开发Linux的内核。
target_text: In 2006, an EU-funded study showed that the redevelopment of Linux after 2.6.8 was at a cost of €882 million ($1.14 billion, £744 million). As of 4 January 2011, the calculation of salaries using the current code line (LOC) and David Wheeler would cost approximately $3 billion (approximately €2.2 billion) to re-develop Linux’s inner core.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 旧计划（1.0和2.6版之间)，版本的格式為A.B.C，其中A,B,C代表：A大幅度转变的内核，这是很少发生变化，只有当发生重大变化的代码和核心发生才会发生，在历史上曾改变两次的内核：1994年的1.0及1996年的2.0； B是指一些重大修改的内核，内核使用了传统的奇数次要版本号码的软件号码系统（用偶数的次要版本号码来表示稳定版本）；C是指轻微修订的内核，这个数字当有安全补丁，bug修复，新的功能或驱动程序，内核便会有变化。自2.6.0（2003年12月）发布後，人们认识到，更短的发布周期将是有益的。自那时起，版本的格式為A.B.C.D，其中A,B,C,D代表：A和B是无关緊要的，C是内核的版本，D是安全补丁。
target_text: The old plan (between Versions 1.0 and 2.6) was in the form of A.B.C., of which A.B.C., C. represented: A significantly transformed kernel, which was rarely changed, only if the code and core of the major changes occurred and had changed the kernel twice in history: 1.0 in 1994 and 2.0 in 1996; B. referred to a number of major modifications to the software number system that used the traditional odd version of the required number (the stable version is represented by the secondary version of the even number); C referred to the slightly modified kernel, which was changed when there was a secure patch, bug repair, new functionality or driver. Since the release of 2.6.0 (December 2003), it was recognized that a shorter release cycle would be useful. Since then, the format of the version had been A.B.C.D., of which A.B.C.D., D. represented: A and B were irrelevant, C was the inner core version and D was a secure patch.
title: Linux内核

source_text:
GPL第三版
Linux 内核明确地仅发表在 GNU 通用公共许可证（GPL）第二版下，而不向被许可方提供选择“任何更高版本”的选项（这是常见的 GPL 扩展）。关于如何轻松地改变许可证以使用后来的 GPL 版本（包括第3版）以及这种更改是否合乎需要，存在着相当多的争论。 托瓦茲本人在版本2.4.0的发布中明确指出，他自己的代码仅在版本2下发布。然而，GPL的条款规定，如果没有指定版本，那么可以使用任何版本；并且艾伦·考克斯指出，很少有其他 Linux 贡献者指定了特定版本的 GPL。
target_text: The third version of the GPL, Linux kernel, is clearly published only under the second edition of the GNU General Public Licence (GPL), without providing the licensee with the option of choosing “any higher version” (which is a common extension of the GPL). There is considerable debate about how to easily change the licence to use the later version of the GPL (including version 3) and whether such changes are desirable. Tovaz himself made it clear in the release of version 2.4.0 that his own code was published only under version 2. However, the GPL clause provides that, if no specified version is available, any version can be used; and Alan Cox points out that very few other Linux contributors have specified a specific version of the GPL.
title: Linux内核

source_text: 2006年9月，对29位关键内核程序员的调查显示其中的28位更倾向于使用 GPL 第二版（GPLv2）而非当时的 GPL 第三版（GPLv3）草案。 托瓦茲评论说：“我认为一些外界人士......相信我才是那个古怪不合群的人，因为我这么大张旗鼓地不做 GPLv3 的忠实粉丝。”这些高水平的内核开发者就大众媒体对 GPLv3 的反对发表了评论，其中包括林納斯·托瓦茲本人、葛雷格·克羅哈曼和安德鲁·莫顿。他们提到有关DRM/、专利及“附加限制”的条款，并警告GPLv3对“开源宇宙”的巴尔干化。决定不采用 GPLv3 作为 Linux 内核许可证的托瓦茲在几年后重申了他的批评。
target_text: In September 2006, a survey of 29 key nuclear programmers showed that 28 of them preferred to use GPL version 2 (GPLv2) rather than the then GPL version 3 (GPL) draft. “I think some outsiders believe that I am the weirdest fan of the GPLv3 because I am such a big fan.” These high-level kernel developers commented on the mass media' opposition to GPLv3, including Linus Tovaz himself, Greg Crohaman and Andrew Morton. They referred to the provisions on DRM/propriate and “additional restrictions” and warned GPLv3 against the Balkanization of the “open-source universe.” Tovaz, who decided not to use GPLv3 as a Linux inner nuclear licence, reiterated his criticism several years later.
title: Linux内核

source_text:
韌體爭議
許可證爭議的一個重點是Linux使用韌體二進位包以支援某些硬體裝置。理察·馬修·斯托曼認為這些東西讓Linux某部份成為非自由軟體，甚至以此散佈Linux更會破壞GPL，因為GPL需要完全可獲取的原始碼。林纳斯·托瓦兹及Linux社群中的領導者，支持較寬鬆的許可證，不支持理察·馬修·斯托曼的立場。社群中的Linux-libre提供完整的自由軟體韌體。
target_text: Richard Matthew Storman believes that these things make some parts of Linux a non-free software, even spreading it to Linux is more damaging to the GPL, because the GPL needs a fully accessible source code. Linus Tovaz and Linux leaders support a more liberal license and do not support Richard Matthew Storman’s standing. Linux-libre in the community provides a complete freeware.
title: Linux内核

source_text:
載入式核心模組許可證
另一個爭論點，就是載入式核心模組是否算是智慧財產權下的衍生創作，意即LKM是否也受GPL約束？托瓦茲本人相信LKM僅用一部分「公開」的核心介面，因此不算衍生創作，因此允許一些僅有二進位包裹的驅動程式或不以GPL宣告的驅動程式用於核心。但也不是每個人都如此同意，且托瓦茲也同意很多LKM的確是純粹的衍生創作，也寫下「基本上，核心模組是衍生創作」這樣的句子。另一方面托瓦茲也說過：
target_text: Another argument is whether the loaded core module is a derivative of intellectual property rights, meaning that the LKM is also bound by the GPL? Tovaz himself believes that LKM uses only part of the "public" core interface, and is therefore not derivative, allowing some drivers with only a binary package or not announced by the GPL to be used at the core. But not everyone so agrees, and Tovaz agrees with many of the pure derivatives of LKM, and writes the phrase "essentially, the core module is derivative." Tovaz, on the other hand, also says:
title: Linux内核

source_text: 在2003年3月，SCO Group對IBM提告，聲稱IBM將一些在SCO智慧財產權許可證保護下的Unix原始碼植入Linux中，破壞了SCO給予IBM的原始碼使用許可權。另外SCO也發出一大堆存證函給許多公司，警告他們在沒有SCO許可權的情況下使用了Linux，此舉可能導致侵犯智慧財產權，並且以起訴為手段對個別使用者施壓。SCO也同時對Novell、戴姆勒克萊斯勒（DaimlerChrysler，在2004年7月被部份駁回）以及AutoZone提出告訴，且被Red Hat與其他反對SCO論點的公司反告。2007年8月24日，聯邦法院審理SCO對Novell案（SCO v. Novell），法院認定Novell才是Unix商標的合法擁有者，而不是SCO。2010年3月20日，美国联邦第十巡回上诉法院宣判，Novell才是UNIX與UnixWare商標的合法擁有者。此項判決宣布後，已進入破產保護程序的SCO公司，決定停止繼續提出訴訟。
target_text: In March 2003, SCO Group filed a complaint against IBM, claiming that IBM had implanted some of the Unix original codes under SCO intellectual property rights licence in Linux, destroying the original code that SCO had given to IBM. In addition, SCO sent a large number of certificates to companies warning them that they had used Linux without SCO rights, which could lead to infringement of intellectual property rights, and pressure on other users by way of a lawsuit. In the same time, SCO also filed a ruling in the Novall, Daimler Chrysler, which was partially dismissed in July 2004, and AutoZone, which was told by Red Hat and other companies opposed to SCO’s argument, that SCO had been ordered by the United States Court of Appeal to declare that it had been the legitimate owner of the Novakler Crysler, rather than the owner of the U.S.I.I.O., and that it had been ordered by the United States Court of Appeals in August 2007.
title: Linux内核

source_text:
生平
托瓦兹出生于芬兰赫尔辛基市。父亲尼尔斯·托瓦兹是一名活跃的电台记者，母親安娜·托瓦兹（Anna Torvalds）也是一名記者。祖父奥勒·托瓦兹（Ole Torvalds）是一名詩人和记者。外祖父是芬兰第一批统计学教授。芬兰统计学会设立Leo Törnqvist Award，授予在颁奖之前的两年内杰出的统计学硕士学位完成者。林纳斯·托瓦兹在11岁时，应其外祖父要求用BASIC语言编写一些统计学方面的小程序，这是他编程经历之始。
target_text: His grandfather, Ole Torvalds, was a poet and journalist. His grandfather was the first Finnish professor of statistics.
title: 林纳斯·托瓦兹

source_text: 1988年，他進入赫尔辛基大学計算機科學系。1989年，他進入芬蘭陸軍新地区旅，服11個月的，軍階為少尉，主要服務於計算機部門，任务是弹道计算。服役期间，购买了安德鲁·斯图尔特·塔能鲍姆所著的教科書及minix原始碼，开始研究作業系統。1990年，他退伍後回到大學，開始接觸Unix。1991年8月25日，在網路上發布了Linux內核的原始碼。1994年3月14日发布了1.0版本。
target_text: In 1988, he entered the Faculty of Calculator Science at the University of Helsinki. In 1989, he entered the New District Brigade of the Finnish Army for 11 months, with the rank of Lieutenant, serving mainly in the computer department, with the task of ballistics. During his service, he purchased the teaching books and Minix original code, written by Andrew Stewart Tamanbaum, and began researching the operating system. In 1990, he returned to university and began contacting Unix. On 25 August 1991, the original code of Linux was posted on the Internet.
title: 林纳斯·托瓦兹

source_text: 1996年，自赫爾辛基大學硕士畢業，学位论文是《Linux: A Portable Operating System》。在拜訪全美達公司之後，托瓦兹決定接受他們的聘用，並移居美國加州。自1997年2月，至2003年6月之間，托瓦茲都在全美達公司服務，參與該公司晶片的code morph技術研發。在1997年至1999年間，主要投入86open計劃。1999年，Red Hat及VA Linux這兩間公司，決定將他們公司的股票期权一部份贈與托瓦茲，以感謝他的貢獻。同年，在這兩間公司的股票在市場公開發行之後，托瓦茲的財產估計為2,000萬美元。
target_text: From February 1997, until June 2003, Tovaz was involved in the development of the company’s code morph technology. Between 1997 and 1999, it was invested mainly in the 86pen project. In 1999, Red Hat and VA Linux decided to pay a portion of their stock options to Tovaz to thank him for his contribution. In the same year, after the company’s stock was publicly launched in the market, Tovaz’s property was estimated at $20 million.
title: 林纳斯·托瓦兹

source_text: 2003年，為了專心於Linux內核的發展，從全美達公司辭職，受聘于開源碼發展實驗室（OSDL），擔任Linux内核的主要維護者。2004年6月，托瓦茲全家移居奧勒崗州Dunthorpe，接近於開源碼發展實驗室的總部所在地Beaverton。2005年，為了管理Linux內核的原始碼，開發了Git。2007年1月22日，自由標準組織與開源碼發展實驗室合併，成立了Linux基金會。Linux基金會提供薪水及各種協助，以支持托瓦茲繼續投入Linux內核的開發工作。
target_text: In June 2004, the Tovaz family moved to Dunthorpe, Oregon, near Beaverton, the headquarters of the Open Source Development Laboratory. In 2005, Git was launched to manage the original code of Linux. On January 22, 2007, the Freedom Standards Organization joined the Open Source Development Laboratory to set up the Linux Foundation.
title: 林纳斯·托瓦兹

source_text:
行事風格
托瓦兹坚持开放源代码信念，并对微软等对手的FUD战略大为不满。例如，在一封回应微软资深副总裁克瑞格·蒙迪批评开放源代码运动破坏了知识产权的电子邮件中，托瓦兹写道：“我不知道蒙迪是否听说过艾萨克·牛顿爵士？他不仅因为创立了经典物理学而出名，也还因为说过这样一句话而闻名于世：‘我之所以能够看得更远，是因为我站在巨人肩膀上的緣故。’”托瓦兹又说道：“我宁愿听牛顿的也不愿听蒙迪的。他（牛顿）虽然死了快300年了，却也没有让房间这样地臭气熏天。”
target_text: "I don't know if Monty has heard of Sir Isaac Newton? He's famous not only for creating classic physics, but also for saying that he's famous: "I can see much further because I'm on the shoulders of giants." Tovaz added: "I'd rather listen to Newton than to Monty."
title: 林纳斯·托瓦兹

source_text: 林纳斯在网上邮件列表中也以火暴的脾气著称。例如，有一次与人争论Git为何不使用C++开发时与对方用“放屁”（原文为“bullshit”、“BS”）互骂。他更曾以“一群自慰的猴子”（原文为“OpenBSD crowd is a bunch of masturbating monkeys”）来称呼OpenBSD团队，因為林纳斯認為軟體一般性的錯誤比安全漏洞來的要多，而資訊安全人士因為找到漏洞而成為英雄，而忽略了一般性軟體錯誤的修補，並認為OpenBSD團隊過度重視安全性忽略其他部分。
target_text: Linus was also known for his violent temper in the online mailing list. For example, there was a debate about why Git used “bulshit” (originally known as “bullshit” or “BS”) when using C++ development. He used “a bunch of masturbating monkeys” (originally known as “OpenBSD crowds”) to refer to the OpenBSD team because Linus thought that software was more common than security loopholes, while information security people became heroes because they found loopholes and ignored general software errors, and thought that the OpenBSD team was overlooking security and neglecting other parts.
title: 林纳斯·托瓦兹

千禧技术奖
2012年4月20日，托瓦兹获得当年的千禧技术奖。该奖被普遍形容为相当于在技术领域的诺贝尔奖。学术
在1997年，在芬兰赫尔辛基大学计算机科学系，托瓦兹接受了他的硕士学位（Laudatur级）。两年后，他在斯德哥尔摩大学接受名誉博士学位，并在2000年在他的母校获得了同样的荣誉。
target_text: In 1997, at the Faculty of Computer Sciences of the University of Helsinki, Finland, Tovaz received his master ' s degree (Laudatur level). Two years later, he received his doctorate in honour at Stockholm University and received the same honour at his mother ' s school in 2000.
title: 林纳斯·托瓦兹

在2005年8月，托瓦兹获得里德学院的獎。工业界

source_text:
他第一次实际的使用电脑是高中年代在IBM纽约科学中心。他在1970年的夏天高中毕业后被雇用在Fortran写一个数值分析程序。他在几周后完成了这项任务，然后他用这个夏天剩余的休息时间在APL上写了一个文本编辑器以及IBM System/360上PL/I编程语言的预处理器。哈佛大学和麻省理工学院
作为哈佛大学1970年秋季的一年级学生，斯塔曼以Math 55的表现而闻名，他很高兴的回忆到：「我一生中第一次觉得我在哈佛找到了一个家。」
target_text: He actually used his computer for the first time in high school at the IBM Science Center in New York. He was hired to write a numerical analysis program in Fortran after graduating from high school in the summer of 1970. After a few weeks, he finished his job and used the rest of the summer to write a text editor on the APL and a preprocessor for IBM System/360 PL/I programming language. Harvard and Massachusetts Polytechnics, as first-year students at Harvard University in the fall of 1970, were famous for the performance of Math 55, and he was pleased to recall that, for the first time in my life, I found a home at Harvard.
title: 理查德·斯托曼

source_text: 他开始在麻省理工学院担任杰拉德·杰伊·萨斯曼的研究室助理,在1977年与萨斯曼发表了一篇名为dependency-directed backtracking的关于 AI truth maintenance system的论文。这篇论文是对約束滿足問題智能回溯的早期研究。截至2009年，斯托曼和萨斯曼介绍的技术仍然是智能回溯中最通用和最强大的解释。有关（）的技术也在该论文中被提及。
target_text: He began to work as a research assistant at the MIT, Gerald Jay Sasman, and published a paper with Sasman in 1977 on AI truth materialization system. As of 2009, the technology presented by Storman and Susman was still the most common and powerful interpretation of intelligent regression.
title: 理查德·斯托曼

source_text:
争议
2019年，由於其在MIT計算機科學與人工智慧實驗室的邮件列表中，在对杰弗里·爱泼斯坦案和馬文·閔斯基的关联的表述中的用词隐含对在馬文·閔斯基面前受害少女受迫表现为自愿且未受馬文·閔斯基虐待，這些言論在網路上引起某些人不滿，斯托曼遂宣佈辞去麻省理工CSAIL的职位以及自由软件基金会主席一职。2021年3月底，理查德·斯托曼宣布回歸自由軟件基金會董事會。
target_text: In 2019, as part of its mailing list at the MIT Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, the words used in its representation of the link between the Jeffrey Eppstein case and Marvin Schonsky implied that the forced treatment of a girl victim in front of Marvin Schonsky was voluntary and not abused by Marvin Schonsky, which caused some dissatisfaction on the Internet, and that Storman announced his resignation from the post of CSAIL in MIT and as President of the Free Software Foundation. At the end of March 2021, Richard Storman announced his return to the Board of Directors of the Free Software Foundation.
title: 理查德·斯托曼
