source_text: 世界当处在坏劫时开始毁坏，由火、水、风三大灾依次破坏。火灾时七轮太阳当空，欲界与色界初禅天悉烧成灰烬；水灾时雨水、“沸灰”（猶如硫酸可腐蝕）不断，洪水泛滥，二禅天悉被浸没；风灾时巨风旋刮，三禅天悉被飘散。四禅天以上则不受影响，而二禪天的光音天则不被火灾影响。当火灾开始时，众生见到大灾现前，悉皆忏悔过往恶业，开始修十善，因善业故悉皆往生到光音天。成劫时，世界初成，自三禅天而下次第生成，直至器世间成立风、水、金三元素（轮），于金轮上生成须弥山、七金山、四大部洲等。光音天人依次下生到各界，最後至人间。
target_text: The world began to be destroyed when it was devastated by three major disasters, fire, water, and wind. Seven rounds of the sun became empty at the start of the fire, and the world became ash from the beginning of the earth; rain, “boiling” (as sulfur acid rots) continued to flood, floods were flooded and the world was immersed; the wind was torn apart during the disaster, and the wind was dissipated. More than four monsoon days were not affected, while the light day of the second day was not affected by the fire. When the fire began, people saw the disaster, they confessed to the evil business, began to practice 10 good things, and for good deeds were born to the day of light. The world began to rise from the day three to the day, and the next came from the day, until the wind, water, gold and three elements (wheels) were formed in the world, and the golden wheels produced mountains, seven golden mountains, four continents, and so forth.

source_text: 最初，下生人间的天人尚有神通，可以飞天。因共业现前，地上自然长出叫「地肥」的味美之物，有人食之而喜，常来採食，故这些人身体逐渐粗厚，不复光明，神通消失，不再如天人以喜悦意念为食，而必须以地肥为食，久後面目變醜；有的光音天则因食用较少，仍保持天人的模样。这样就有了美醜之分，并有了嫉妒心和傲慢心。此後，地肥逐渐消失，地上又生出粳米，人们便以粳米为食。时间一长，有些欲望較重之人转生爲女身，人间又有了男女之分，且男女间产生情欲。開始人们厭惡情愛之事，但凡有行慾者，人共驅逐，被逐者三個月過後才能返回群體中；後來，縱慾者漸多，人們建築房屋以為遮蔽，不令人看見，女人此時開始懷孕，人類出生的方式從自然化生變為懷孕胎生。人类越生越多，粳米不够採食，人們爭相囤积，粳米變少，地上生出了糠秕之米。人們為了長久有米可食，便劃分田產用於種植。又有人蓄藏销售，有人抢夺，而必须靠义人裁断，另一些看到人性變惡生出厭離心，便出家修禪，也有不坐禪而喜好傳講經典，祭祀天地者。於是就有了商人、农人、長老、祭司等職業之別（经中用印度种姓来表述，当为譬喻），又由此成立王室和国家。又因为人类造业反復，又有了畜生道、饿鬼道、地狱道的生成。至此，世界终成。

source_text: 上座部佛教《巴利律藏》記載佛宣說論藏，巴利經藏記載佛世有「阿毘達磨、阿毘毘奈耶」的說法，小部本生經記載菩薩曾經追隨憍陳如佛、弗沙佛、迦葉佛出家學習論藏阿毘達磨，菩薩成佛後第四七日後花了七天在菩提樹之西北方的「寶之家」思考論藏阿毘達磨的內容。學術界對早期集結是否包括論藏並無定論。多數學者認為，阿毘達磨是對經藏教義的逐步發展，解釋，進一步闡述，組織和系統化。經律中「阿毘達磨」經常與「阿毘毘奈耶」一起出現，但這個術語並不一定指現在標準化的論藏。學術界普遍認為初期佛教典籍可能包含了佛陀的話，也有學者主張其大部份內容是佛陀的話。

source_text: 廣義的佛教典籍包含了注疏、佛教史傳、佛教目錄、佛教著作等多方面內容，中國將這樣的佛教廣義佛教經典的匯總成為「大藏經」，或一切經。藏傳佛教將經典劃分為甘珠爾、丹珠爾兩部。南傳佛教則使用三藏的名稱。由於在稱呼上各地不同，所指也有微妙差別，所以在翻譯上中國習慣使用《大藏經》翻譯其他系統佛教的經典，如稱呼南傳佛教經典為《巴利大藏經》等，而歐美學界經常使用三藏的稱呼（也有采用日文「大藏經」的音譯稱呼者，但相對較少）。在佛典中明確說明，佛陀允許弟子使用方言傳授佛法和記誦經典。學術界對於佛經歷史版本的研究，著重於佛經在流傳中的變化，以及哪些是佛陀時代的教法，哪些是後來的發展。

信徒与称谓信徒分類

source_text: 百科全书（）是概要介绍人类全部知识或某一特定领域或学科的工具书或摘要（）。百科全书按照字典顺序或专题类别划分条目。百科全书条目比大多数詞典中的词条更长、更详细。一般来说，不同于专注于词汇的语言学信息（如其意思、发音、用法和语法形式）的词典词条，百科全书条目侧重于条目标题中命名的主题的事實信息。
target_text: Encyclopaedia () is a tool or summary outlining the totality of human knowledge or a particular field or discipline (). Generally speaking, they are different from dictionaries focusing on the linguistic information of the vocabulary (such as its meaning, pronunciation, usage and grammatic form), and Encyclopaedia entries focus on factual information on the subject named in the heading of the entry.

source_text:
词源
“”一词最早出自希腊语“”（拉丁轉寫：enkyklios，意为“循环的，周期性，平常的”）和“”（paideia，指“教育”）。含义是“普通教育，从字面上说就是一个想接受通才教育的人所应该学习的艺术和科学知识”。古罗马学者昆体良在其《演说术教程》（）中用该词表示综合教育。在抄录过程中谬传为新拉丁语词，随后又进入英语，最先记载於1531年。在新拉丁语中该词被选中作为一本覆盖各科知识的参考著作的书名。这个詞首次出現在一般文學作品的記錄見於1532年法國作家弗朗索瓦·拉伯雷的《巨人傳》，仍然是教育之意。1559年保罗·斯卡利杰在巴塞尔出版的《百科全书，或神与世俗学科知识》（Encyclopaedia seu orbis disciplinarum tam sacrarum quam prophanarum epistemon）中首次使用“百科全书”作为书名。但是这本书知者甚少，因此也有人认为是拿骚的阿斯特德（Johann Heinrich Alsted）在1630年出版的《七卷本简明百科全书》（Encyclopaedia, Septem Tomis Distincta）是第一个把“百科全书”用作书名的書籍。
target_text: The word “” was originally used in the Greek language: Enkyklios, meaning “cycle, cyclical, ordinary” and “paideia,” meaning “general education, literally an art and scientific knowledge that should be studied by those who want to receive general education.” An ancient Roman scholar, Quin, used the term as a comprehensive education in his Lectures (the Latin version of the transcription: Enkyklios, then in English, first in 1531. The term was chosen as a reference book covering various subjects.

source_text: 中国的百科全书是20世纪初由西方引进。中华民国大陸時期时的学者李煜瀛是最早进行西方百科全书研究之人。关于百科全书的名称，他在《世界学典书例答问》中说：“四十年前煜首译‘encyclopedia’为‘百科类典’，后中国因受《四库全书》命名的影响，改译为‘百科全书’。近二世纪专科的encyclopedia出版颇多，在中文有《中国文学百科全书》等。文学本百科中之一科，固然其中亦可析为多科，然于一科之名下，复系以‘百科’二字，终觉不甚妥当。且‘全书’二字，在中文易与‘四库全书’之丛书式的全书相混，不足表示其为另一书体，故煜后又改译为‘学典’。‘学典’，即拉丁文‘’（英法文略同），有‘所讲的学术环绕在内’之意。后凡包括一切学术在内一呈显知识世界且多系按辞典次序排列的书，每用此词以构成其书名，于是此词成为书体之一种。”

source_text:
百科全书型的作品在人类历史上并不少见，古羅馬瓦洛《學科要義九書》（Disciplinarum libri IX）和《聖俗事物古蹟》（Antiquitates rerum humanarum et divinarum）、羅馬時代老普林尼《博物志》皆為西方具有百科性質之著作。中世纪
中世纪时的百科全书大多是修道院的神父们编写的教科书性质的大部头作品。到了后期，百科全书的编纂受到培根科学分类法的影响，书的作者也逐渐演变成多人合作的形式。
target_text: Encyclopedia works are not uncommon in the history of mankind. The ancient Romano book Disciplinarum Libri IX and the Entiquitates rerum humanarum et divinarum are all encyclopedia writings of the West. Most of the encyclopedias of the Middle Ages are books of the nature of textbooks written by priests in monasteries. At a later stage, the encyclopedia has been influenced by the taxonomy of bacon science, and its authors have evolved into forms of collaboration among many people.
title: 百科全书

source_text: 中世紀有法國神學家編撰的《世界寶鑑》（Imago mundi）、聖依西多祿編著的《詞源》、博韦的樊尚（）編著的《大寶鑑》（），其中大寶鑑是18世紀前世界上最大的百科全書，共有80卷。但直到16世纪的西方，才开始出现“百科全书”这个名词。最早将“百科全书”用于书名的，是德国人，在巴塞爾出版。17-18世紀培根所著的《偉大的復興》（Instauratio magna）影響了後世百科全書的分類和篇纂。
target_text: In the middle of the century, French theologians wrote The World Treasure (Imago Mundi), San Isidón (The Source of Words), Bovey's Mandarin, the world's largest encyclopedia of the 18th century, with 80 volumes. But it was not until the 16th century in the West that the term “encyclopedia” began to appear. The first to use the Encyclopedia as a book name, it was the Germans who published it in Barcelona.
title: 百科全书

source_text: 最著名的早期百科全书要屬法国的《百科全书，或科学、艺术和工艺详解词典》，由达朗贝尔和狄德罗编写，并于1772年完成，共28卷，71, 818条条目，2,885张插图。也因此狄德罗被称为现代百科全书之父。而在此前比较受欢迎的一部百科全书——英国的伊弗雷姆·钱伯斯的《百科全書：或藝術與科學通用字典》则开创了百科全书的“参见”系统。法国19世纪后出版的拉鲁斯百科全书系列影响颇大。
target_text: The most famous Encyclopaedia of the Early Encyclopaedia, or Exercising Dictionary of Science, Arts and Crafts, prepared by Darangbel and Diedro, completed in 1772 with 28 volumes, 71, 818 entries, 2,885 illustrations. It is therefore also called the father of the modern Encyclopaedia.
title: 百科全书

source_text: 18世纪法国学者阿莱兹（）在1766年编纂出版了一部4.5x7.5英寸的袖珍本《小百科全书》（），是当时最小的百科全书。《大不列颠百科全书》最早时也十分朴素：从1768年到1771年只出版了三卷。19世纪德国的布罗克豪斯开创了社交词典派百科全书，其编纂方法影响了欧洲很多国家百科全书的编写。此外，德国比较有名的百科全书还有《迈耶百科词典》和《赫德尔大百科全书》。
target_text: The 18th-century French scholar ALEZ (ALEZ) compiled and published in 1766 a 4.5x7.5-inch pocketbook, the smallest encyclopedia at the time. The British Encyclopaedia was also simple at its earliest: only three volumes were published from 1768 to 1771. In 19th-century Germany’s Brookhouse created an encyclopedia of social dictionaries, which influenced the preparation of encyclopedias in many European countries. In addition, Germany’s more famous encyclopedia also includes the Mayer Encyclopedia and the Hedel Encyclopedia.
title: 百科全书

source_text: 俄国19世纪的百科全书受到德国布罗克豪斯的影响就很大。1891年加尔别尔出版公司出版了8卷本《布罗克豪斯百科全书》的俄文版《案头百科词典》，后几经改变成为《格拉纳特百科词典》。1890-1907年俄国印刷业者艾弗隆与德国布罗克豪斯合作推出了《布罗克豪斯-艾弗隆百科词典》，共82卷和4卷补编，由俄国学者撰写。
target_text: The Russian Encyclopedia of the 19th century was strongly influenced by Brokerhouse, Germany. In 1891, Galbelle published eight volumes of the Encyclopaedia of Brokerhouse, the Russian edition of the Encyclopaedia of Headline Encyclopaedia, which was changed to the Granat Encyclopaedia. In 1890-1907, Efraim, a Russian printer, in cooperation with Brookhouse, Germany, launched the Brokerhouse-Evron Encyclopedia, with 82 volumes and 4 supplements by Russian scholars.
title: 百科全书

source_text: 意大利的现代百科全书以《意大利百科全书》为代表。其他还有《UTET百科大词典》和《伊诺第百科全书》。西班牙的百科全书历史只有100多年，比较出名的有《欧美插图大百科全书》，《萨尔瓦特百科词典》、《拉沃尔百科全书》以及《里亚尔普百科全书》。随着百科全书的发展，现代百科全书具有完备的检索系统，包括索引、参见和分类系统等，条目内容更加趋向于图文并茂，计算机的应用则使百科全书更加方便检索和查阅。
target_text: Italy’s modern encyclopaedia is represented by the Italian Encyclopaedia. There are also the UTET Encyclopedia and the Encyclopedia of Encyclopaedia of Encyclopedia of Encyclopaedia of Encyclopaedia of Entire Encyclopaedia of Encyclopaedia of Encyclopaedia of Spain. Spain’s encyclopaedia of Encyclopaedia of Encyclopaedia is only 100 years old.
title: 百科全书

source_text: 中国古代的类书是一种百科全书式的资料汇编。第一部類書《皇覽》是西元220年魏文帝主編，已散失。歷代的類書還有杜公瞻《編珠》、歐陽詢《藝文類聚》（100卷）、虞世南《北堂書鈔》、徐堅《初學記》、李昉奉宋太宗之命而主編之《太平御覽》、1267年南宋王應麟編《玉海》，共240卷。明朝初期的《永樂大典》共有22937卷，另說22877卷，被认为是最早的接近现代意义上的百科全书，但大部分已散失。清朝康熙開始，由陳夢雷編《古今圖書集成》，到了雍正初年，又由蔣廷錫繼續。民國初年陸爾奎的《辭源》是中國第一部現代的百科辭典。1930年，楊家駱編輯《中國學術百科全書》。
target_text: China’s ancient books are an encyclopedia collection. The first book, The Royal Book, was written by the Emperor of Wei Wei Wen, in 220, has been dissipated. It has also been written in the early editions of Ming Dynasty with 22937 volumes, or 22877 volumes, considered to be the first near-modern encyclopaedia, but most of them have been dissipated. At the beginning of Qing Hong Xi’s Qin Xi’s Qin Xin Xiangue book, which was written by Chen Xiao Lei’s Quantue, and at the beginning of the year, it was written by the Emperor Yuhai in 1267, and continues with a total of 240 volumes.
title: 百科全书

source_text: 中華人民共和國成立後，1978年至1993年耗時15年編寫了《中國大百科全書》，全套共分74冊，涵蓋66個學門領域，8萬多個條目。其总编辑姜椿芳也被认为是中国现代百科全书的奠基人。1981年，中華民國出版了《中華百科全書》，總計十冊，分三十八種類別，約一萬五千餘條條目。
target_text: After the founding of the People’s Republic of China, the Chinese People’s Republic took 15 years from 1978 to 1993 to compile the Chinese Encyclopaedia, a total of 74 volumes, covering 66 academic fields and more than 80,000 articles. The editor-in-chief, Jiang Xiaofan, is also considered the founder of China’s modern Encyclopaedia. In 1981, the Chinese People’s Republic published the Chinese Encyclopaedia, a total of 10 volumes in 38 different categories, about 15,000 articles.
title: 百科全书

source_text: 19世纪编成的类书《古今要览稿》已经具有近代百科性质，1914年完成的《古事类苑》则更加接近于百科全书。1916年後有現代的百科出現，《广文库》可能是第一部，其后三省堂出版了《日本百科大辞典》10卷。此后还有《大百科事典》、《國民百科大辭典》（18-{卷}-）、《世界大百科事典》、《不列顛國際大百科事典》、《兒童世界百科》（17-{卷}-）、《阿波羅百科事典》(3-{卷}-) 、和漢三才圖會（105卷81冊）等。
target_text: The book of the 19th century, Ancient Today's Exposition, is of a recent encyclopedia, and the Ancient Monument, which was completed in 1914, is closer to the encyclopedia. After 1916, there were modern encyclopedias, the Hiroshima Library could be the first, followed by the publication of 10 volumes of the Japanese Encyclopaedia by three provincial capitals. These were followed by the Encyclopedia of the Encyclopaedia of the University, the National Encyclopaedia of the National Encyclopedia (18-volta) and the Universal Encyclopaedia of the United Kingdom, the International Encyclopedia of Britain and Northern Ireland, the Encyclopedia of the World's Children (17-), the Apollo Encyclopedia (3-) and the Han Trinity (105-vol. 81).
title: 百科全书

source_text: 阿拉伯世界的第一部百科全書是《傳統菁華》（，），由伊拉克的伊本·古泰拜（，Ibn Qutaybah，826年-889年）主編，後由伊本·阿卜德改編為《珠練》。975年至997年，波斯學者花剌子模（，）編了《科學之鑰》。其后一个宗教团体精诚兄弟会编著了一本《精诚兄弟会典》。13世纪时埃及历史学家阿尔努韦利（al-Nuwairi）用20年时间编成《文化智慧之的》。
target_text: The first encyclopaedia in the Arab world was “Traditional Fineness” (,), edited by Ibn Qutaybah, 826-889 of Iraq, and later renamed by Ibn Abd as “Juldry.” From 975 to 997, Persian scholars made up the Keys of Science.
title: 百科全书

source_text:
现代阿拉伯百科全书发端于19世纪黎巴嫩学者布斯塔尼（，Butrus al-Bustani）与其儿子编写的《百科全书》。阿伯特·里哈尼的《阿拉伯百科全書》於1955年出版，單卷本。体例
在古代，类似百科全书的著作可以由一个人全部编辑完成。但是到了现代，由于知识大爆炸，一个人或几个人已经不可能完成一部规模浩大的百科全书的编纂工作。这样就需要制定体例，确定编纂的准则，以解决众多编纂者之间的矛盾。
target_text: The modern Arabic Encyclopaedia was developed by the nineteenth-century Lebanese scholar Butrus al-Bustani and his son, The Encyclopedia of the Arabic Encyclopaedia, published in 1955 in a single volume by Albert Rihani. In ancient times, works similar to the Encyclopedia of the Arabic Encyclopaedia could be fully edited by one individual.
title: 百科全书

source_text: 百科全书的体例包括许多方面。包括条目名称设计、条目编写提纲、撰稿人书写格式、配图要求、外文书写和翻译规则、成书格式等。其中《苏联大百科全书》是现有百科全书中体例最为详尽的一部，其第三版的编写体例周详而细致，十分全面，总共折合汉字有20万字上下。例如医学大类下分疾病条目、病理学条目、治疗方法条目、药物类条目、药剂类条目、医疗器械条目、疗养地条目、医疗机械条目、医学职业条目等。
target_text: The encyclopaedia is the most detailed of the existing encyclopaedias. The third edition of the Encyclopaedia is detailed and detailed, with a comprehensive total of 200,000 characters. For example, medical sub-diseases, pathology, treatment methods, pharmaceutical, pharmaceutical, pharmaceutical, medical instruments, therapeutic fields, medical machinery, medical occupations, etc.
title: 百科全书

source_text:
与其他工具书的区别
百科全书不同于词典等其他的工具书。词典等是对词语条目进行释义，而百科全书是对条目作知识的介绍。因此百科全书比其他工具书使用更多的图像来辅助知识的介绍。而且百科全书对条目的阐释也比其他工具书详细，常需要分成许多的小标题。
target_text: Unlike other toolbooks, encyclopaedia is different from other toolbooks. Dictionarys, for example, interpret words, while encyclopaedia is an introduction to knowledge. The encyclopaedia therefore uses more images than other toolbooks to support the introduction of knowledge. And the encyclopaedia interprets entries in greater detail than other toolbooks, often with many subheadings.
title: 百科全书

The modern encyclopedia of Western encyclopaedia is mostly organized in alphabetical order.
title: 百科全书

source_text: 百科全书的条目包括标题、正文内容和图表等。在百科全书的编纂中，条目的命名非常重要。好的命名应该便于检索，有学者认为条目应该都是独立的主题，应以方便读者的检索为准则。另外，条目的主题应该是客观形成的，而不是人为拟定的。例如海湾战争是客观存在的事实，而“狗的神话”则是人为拟定的主题
target_text: Encyclopedia entries include titles, textual contents, charts, etc. In encyclopedia, the naming of entries is very important. Good naming should be easy to retrieve, and some scholars believe that entries should be independent and guided by reader-friendly access. Also, the subject matter of the entries should be objective, not artificial. For example, the Gulf War is an objective fact, while the myth of a dog is an artificial one.
title: 百科全书

source_text:
百科全书条目的选择有一些共通性的原则：
独立主体原则：主体应该是相对独立的，就像我们去一个公司办事，我们先想到的是公司的名称、地址，而不是其中的某个部门。
客观形成原则：这个主题应该是人们在了解，改造世界的过程中客观形成，为人所熟知，而不是人为拟定的。如创世神话是一个客观存在的神话题材类型，但是“狗的神话”就是一个人为概括的主题。因此缺少公认的规范性和确定性。
单一主题原则：如“时间和空间”是两个主题，应该分设。
准确性原则：条目的名称应该准确的表明条目的主题。
通用性原则：应该使用规范的或约定俗成的名称。
名词性原则：条目名称应该是名词性的，静止的。如“解放海南岛”应该改成“海南岛战役”
简要性原则：如使用“唐诗”，而不用“唐代诗歌”。
非研究原则：百科全书不是研究论文。
非应用原则：百科全书不是为了指导具体的应用。
target_text: The choice of encyclopedia entries is based on some common principles: the principle of independence: the subject should be relatively independent, like when we go to a company, where we first think of the company’s name, address, rather than one of its sectors. The principle of objectivity: the subject should be understood, objectively formed, understood, rather than artificially formulated, in the process of transforming the world. The myth of creation is an objective myth, but “the myth of dogs” is a general theme.
title: 百科全书

source_text: 百科全书的分类结构以及不断更新的特点使它非常适合在线或-{zh-hans:断线; zh-hant:離線;}-的电脑格式。随着信息技术的发展，大多数主要的百科全书现在都已经不同程度的电子化了。基于光碟（CD、DVD等）出版物拥有携带方便、成本低廉的优点，同时电子百科全书还可以包含各种传统媒体无法承载的多媒体格式，例如动画、音像或视像。概念有关联的文章之间的相互动态链接也是一个重要的优势。在线的百科全书则拥有动态的优点：新的信息几乎可以立即被呈现，而不用等到下一次的出版。
target_text: The encyclopedia structure and the updated features make it well suited to online or {zh-hans: offline; zh-hant: offline;}-computer formats. With the development of information technology, most major encyclopedias are now electronic to varying degrees. Publications based on CDs (CDs, DVDs, etc.) have the advantage of being easily portable and inexpensive, while e-encyclopedia can also contain multimedia formats that traditional media cannot carry, such as animations, audio-visuals or videos.
title: 百科全书

source_text: 利用国际互联网来编写一部免费百科全书的构想则在20世纪90年代初被提出。这些活动的一个分支是旧版本的百科全书的电子化。1995年1月，古登堡计划开始出版《大不列颠百科全书》1911年第11版的ASCII版本，但是由于方法上的分歧，在第一卷出版后整个计划就终止了。2002年，另一方出版了整套28卷的1911年版《大不列颠百科全书》电子版，发表在1911 Encyclopedia Britannica网站上；版本中加入了版权声明，但是该声明應無法律效力。其他的电子化计划则出版了许多其他的百科全书，例如由基督教经典图书馆出版的电子Easton圣经辞典（1981年）。
target_text: The idea of using the Internet to produce a free encyclopedia was put forward in the early 1990s. One branch of these activities was the electronicization of the older encyclopaedia. In January 1995, Gutenberg planned to begin publishing the ASCII version of the English Encyclopaedia of 1911, but the entire plan ended after publication of volume I owing to methodological differences. In 2002, the other party published an electronic version of the English Encyclopaedia, a complete of 28 volumes, published on the 1911 Encyclopedia of Great Britain website; a copyright statement was included in the version, but it should have no legal effect. Other e-learning programmes published many other encyclopaedias, such as the eEston Bible dictionary published by the Christian Classic Library (1981).
title: 百科全书

source_text: 另一个更有趣的分支则是编写全新的、自由免费的百科全书。1991年，討論群組alt.fan.douglas-adams的参与者开始了一个以出版真正的《银河系漫游指南》（The Hitchhiker's Guide to Galaxy）百科全书的计划。该百科全书是出现在道格拉斯·亚当斯（Douglas Adams）的小说中的一个虚构的百科全书。该计划就是星系指导计划（Project Galactic Guide）。尽管最初的宗旨是百科全书只能包括真实的条目，但之后政策改变，允许并鼓励半真实及虚构的条目出现。星系指导计划包含了超过1700条条目，但从2000年起就没有新条目加入。
target_text: In 1991, the participants in the discussion group alt.fan.dougrams-adams started a plan to publish the real Hitchhiker's Guide to Galaxy encyclopaedia. The encyclopedia is a fictional encyclopedia in a novel by Douglas Adams. Although the original aim was that the encyclopedia should include only real entries, subsequent policy changes allowed and encouraged semi-real and fictitious entries.
title: 百科全书

source_text: 2001年初，基于Wiki技术的互联网百科全书维基百科上线，这是一个自由、多语言的百科全书协作计划。维基百科创立之后，取得了迅猛的发展，目前已跻身世界流量前十大网站之列，是当前最为成功的网络百科全书计划。同时Wiki技术亦为人熟知，并为其他网络百科全书计划所使用和借鉴。
target_text: At the beginning of 2001, the Wiki technology-based Encyclopedia of the Internet was launched as a partnership for free, multilingual encyclopedia. Following its creation, Wikipedia has developed rapidly and is now one of the top 10 web sites in the world, the most successful online encyclopedia program.
title: 百科全书

source_text: 数学家是指一群對數學有深入了解的人士，并且將其知識運用於其工作上（特別是解決數學問題）。數學家專注於數、數據、邏輯、集合、結構 (數學)、空間、變化。專注於解決純數學（基础数学）領域以外的問題的數學家稱為應用數學家，他們運用他們的特殊數學知識與專業的方法解決許多在科學領域的顯著問題。因為專注於廣泛領域的問題、理論系統、定點結構。應用數學家經常研究與制定數學模型。
target_text: Mathematicians are a group of people who have an in-depth understanding of mathematics and use their knowledge for their work (especially to solve math problems). Mathematics focus on numbers, numbers, logic, aggregation, structure (mathematics), space, and variability. Mathematicians who focus on problems outside the realm of pure mathematics (basic mathematics) are called appliance mathematicians, who use their special mathematical knowledge and expertise to solve many of the obvious problems in science.
title: 数学家

source_text:
數學家的工作
所謂的數學研究工作，不僅是瞭解及整理已知的結果，還包含著創造新的數學成果與理論。會強調這點是因為許多人誤解數學是一個已經被研究完的領域。事實上，數學上還有許多未知的領域和待解決的問題，也一直有大量新的數學成果發表。這些數學成果有些是新的數學知識，有些是新的應用方式。
所以心算家、珠算家不是數學家，數學家也不見得能夠快速的做出各種計算。
target_text: The work of mathematicians, not only in understanding and collating known results, but also in creating new mathematical results and theories, will be emphasized by the fact that many people misunderstand that mathematics is an area that has already been studied. In fact, there are many unknown fields and problems to be solved in mathematics, and there have been a lot of new mathematical results.
title: 数学家

source_text:
動機
數學家通常在數論、拓撲學、近世代數、微分拓撲、泛函分析等領域進行研究工作。數學的多數問題來自數學本身，其它一些則來源於理論物理；除此以外，尚有少量問題來源於經濟學、決策（games），以及計算機科學。某些數學問題僅僅是因為解決它們的困難而提出的。
target_text: Motivators, mathematicians, usually do research in fields such as mathematics, pebbles, recent generations, mini-pumps, and pan-letter analysis. The majority of math problems come from mathematics itself, and some others from theoretical physics; apart from this, there are a few problems that come from economics, decision-making, and computer science. Some math problems are simply due to solving their difficulties.
title: 数学家

source_text: 數學與自然科學的差異在於，自然科學中的物理理論是通過實驗測試的，而數學語句則是由數學證明支撐的，而這些證明可以被數學家“客觀”地加以驗證。如果數學家相信（通常是因為其某些特例已在某種程度上得到證實）某一語句為真，但該語句尚未被證明為真或證明為假，則稱該語句為猜想，而非一個已被證明為真的定理。
target_text: The difference between mathematics and natural science is that physics in natural science is tested through experimentation, and mathematical language is supported by mathematical proof that can be tested “observable” by mathematicians. If a mathematician believes that (often because some of its exceptions have been proven to some extent) a phrase is true, but it has not yet been proven true or proven false, it is called guesswork, not a theory that has been proven to be true.
title: 数学家

source_text: 即使是在理論物理學中，一旦人們發現了有關物理世界的新的信息，其理論就有可能發生改變。相比之下，數學則以另一種方式改變：新觀點並非否定舊觀點，而是被用來將既有的觀念推廣，以便解釋更多現像。例如，單變量微積分被推廣為多變量微積分，再被推廣為流形上的分析。代數幾何從經典到現代形式的發展便是一個極好的例子：觀點發生重大的轉變，而既有的證明則絲毫沒有因此受到影響。
target_text: Even in theoretical physics, when new information about the physical world is discovered, the theory is likely to change. By contrast, mathematics changes in another way: the new view is not to deny the old view, but is used to spread the existing one in order to explain more. For example, one-size-fits-all is promoted as a multivariant fraction, and then as a flow analysis. The development of intergenerational geometry from the classic to the contemporary form is an excellent example: the point of view is changed dramatically, and the established evidence is not affected by it.
title: 数学家

source_text: 儘管一個定理一旦被證明就永遠是正確的，我們對一個定理的真正意義的理解之深度，則是伴隨著圍繞著該定理的數學理論的進步而增長的。一旦一個定理的使用範圍被擴大，數學家們便感到它被更好地理解了。例如，關於非零整數對素數模同余的費馬小定理被推廣到關於不可逆數對非零整數模同余的歐拉定理，後者又被推廣為有限群的拉格朗日定理。
target_text: Even though a theory can always be right once it is proved, the depth of our understanding of the true meaning of a theory increases with the progress of the mathematical theory surrounding it. Once the use of a theory is expanded, mathematicians feel that it is better understood. For example, the minior of a millet about the same number of non-zero logarithms has been pushed to the Euraan equation about the same number of non-reversible and non-zero integer numbers, and later to LaGrand’s theory of a limited group.
title: 数学家

source_text: 数学家也是满怀感情的，如欧拉，他是历史上最多产的数学家。他有13个孩子，他喜欢把最年幼的孩子放在膝上，而其他的孩子则围着他到处玩耍，正是这样的情况下，他创造并记载了许多伟大的想法，撰写了大量的书籍和论文，泽被后世。约翰·冯·诺伊曼，现代计算机和博弈论之父。他凭借自己照相存储器般的记忆力，身临其境地向未婚妻历数巴黎的风景名胜，最终赢得了芳心。
target_text: Mathematicians are emotional too, such as Ola, the most productive mathematician in history. He has 13 children, who likes to put the youngest on their knees, while other children play around him. In that context, he has created and documented many great ideas, written a great number of books and papers, and Xa has been left behind. John von Neuman, the father of modern computers and games. With his own photographic memory, he finally won his heart in Paris as his fiancé.

source_text: 数学中也充满了悲剧。纳什—《美丽心灵》中主人公的原型，常年生活在幻想的孤独和烦躁中，老年时因为读博士期间的几篇论文而获得了诺贝尔奖，最终得到人们的认可。其实他在纯数学上许多工作要更加深刻和具有开创性。维纳，著名的维纳随机过程，一个少年天才和数学巨匠。正是他父亲造就了维纳的天才，同时也完全摧毁了他儿子的自信。

source_text:
泛型
泛型，或参数化类型，是被C#支持的.NET 2.0特性。不同于C++模版，.NET参数化类型是在运行时被实例化，而不是编译时，因此它可以跨语言，而C++模版却不行。C#泛型类在编译时，先生成中间代码IL，通用类型符号T只是一个占位符；在实例化类时，根据实际数据类型代替T并由即时编译器（JIT）生成本地代码，其中使用了实际的数据类型，等同于用实际类型写的普通的类。

Unlike the C++ template, the .NET parameterization type is exemplified at the time of operation rather than at the time of compilation, so that it can be transliterated, but not the C++ template. At the time of compilation, the C# translator is the intermediate code IL and the generic type symbol T is only a placeholder; in the case of an executory class, the local code is created by replacing T with an instant compiler (JIT) based on the actual data type, using the actual data type, which is equivalent to the generic category written in the actual type.

source_text: 在程序执行时，.Net Framework将中间代码翻译成为二进制机器码，从而使它得到正确的运行。最终的二进制代码被存储在一个缓冲区（Buffer）中。所以一旦程序使用了相同的代码，那么将会调用缓冲区中的版本。这样如果一个.Net程序第二次被运行，那么这种翻译不需要进行第二次，速度明显加快。
target_text: When the program is implemented, ...Net Framewerk translates the intermediate code into a binary machine code so that it can be properly run. The final binary code is stored in a buffer zone (Buffer). So once the program uses the same code, the version in the buffer zone will be called. So if a.Net program is running again, the translation will not need to be made a second time and the speed will increase significantly.
title: C♯

source_text:
实现
微软正在引领开源参考 C# 编译器和工具集的开发。 第一个编译器 Roslyn编译成中间语言（IL），第二个编译器 RyuJIT， 是一个 JIT（即时）编译器，它是动态的，进行动态优化并编译将 IL 转换为 CPU 前端的本机代码。 RyuJIT 是开源的，用 C++ 编写。 Roslyn 完全是用 托管代码 (C#)编写的，已经开放并且功能以 API 的形式出现。因此，它使开发人员能够创建重构和诊断工具。 官方实现的两个分支是 .NET Framework（闭源，仅限 Windows）和 .NET Core（开源，跨平台）；它们最终融合为一个开源实现：.NET 5.0。 在 .NET Framework 4.6 中，新的 JIT 编译器取代了前者。
target_text: Microsoft is leading the development of the open source reference C# compiler and tool set. The first compiler Roslyn is translated into the intermediate language (IL), and the second compiler RyuJIT is a dynamic JIT (immediate) compiler, which is dynamic, dynamically optimizes and compiles IL as a host code at the front end of the CPU. RyuJIT is open-sourced, written by C++. Roslyn is entirely based on the host code (C#) and is already open and functional in the form of API. Thus, it enables developers to create re-structure and diagnostic tools. The two branches that are officially realized are .NET Framework (closed source, only Windows) and .NET Core (open source, cross platform); they are eventually integrated into an open source: .NET 5.0. In .NET Framewerk 4.6, the new JIT editor has replaced the former.

source_text: C语言于1969年至1973年間，為了移植與開發UNIX作業系統，由丹尼斯·里奇與肯·汤普逊，以B语言为基础，在贝尔实验室設計、开发出來。二十世纪八十年代，C语言应用日渐广泛。為了避免各開發廠商用的C語言的語法產生差異，美國國家標準局為C語言訂定了一套完整的國際標準語法，稱為ANSI C，作為C語言的標準。与此同时，国际标准化组织也接受该标准为国际标准。因此，ANSI C也同时被称为ISO C。二十世纪八十年代至今的有关程式開發工具，一般都支持符合ANSI C的語法。
target_text: From 1969 to 1973, for the purpose of transplanting and developing the UNIX production system, the C language was designed and developed by Dennis Rich and Ken Thompson, based on the B language, at Bell Laboratories. In the 1980s, the C language was used more widely. In order to avoid differences in the syntax of the C language used in commercial development plants, the United States National Bureau of Standards had developed a complete set of international standard syntaxes for the C language, known as ANSIC, as a standard for the C language. At the same time, the International Organization for Standardization accepted the standard as an international standard.
title: C语言

source_text:
概述
与ALGOL一族的大多数过程式编程语言类似，C語言是一個有結構化程式設計、具有变量作用域（variable scope）以及遞迴功能的程序式語言。其采用的静态类型系统可以防止无意的程序设计操作。C语言中所有的可执行代码都被包含在子程序（函数）裡。其傳遞參數均是以值傳遞（pass by value），另外也可以傳遞指针（a pointer passed by value）。C语言是自由形式语言，即其源代码的缩进并不影响程序的功能，而是使用分号作为语句的结尾，花括号来表示代码块。
target_text: Similar to most process programming languages of the ALGOL community, the C language is a program language with structured program design, variable domain (variable scope) and relay functions. The static type systems used prevent unintended program design operations. All executable codes in the C language are included in sub-procedures (functions). The transport parameters are in value transfer (pass by value) and can also be passed by pointer (a pointer by value). The language is a free form language, i.e. the indentation of its source code does not affect the function of the program, but uses a semicolon as the end of the sentence, which uses brackets to indicate the code block.
title: C语言

source_text: 由于C语言的语言规模较小，若干高层的机制需要使用定义的函数来提供。比如，C语言并没有直接处理复合对象（例如字符串、集合、列表、数组等）的操作，也没有对于存储器分配工具和内存回收工具的直接定义，同时也本身不具有输入和输出以及文件访问的方法。然而，用户定义的函数和C语言标准库中的函数为这些高层的机制提供了可能性。
target_text: Because of the small language size of the C language, several high-level mechanisms need to be provided with defined functions. For example, the C language does not directly handle composite objects (e.g. strings, pools, lists, arrays, etc.), nor does it directly define storage allocation and memory recovery tools, nor does it itself have the means to enter and output and access documents. However, the user-defined functions and the functions in the C language standard library provide the possibility for these high-level mechanisms.
title: C语言

source_text:
基本数据类型包括字符、整型和浮点数等。另外也有派生的各种数据类型，如指针、数组、结构和联合。
部份的变量類型可以轉換，例如整數型和字符型变量。
透過指標（pointer），C語言可以容易的對記憶體進行低階控制。
不同的變數類型可以用結構体（struct）組合在一起。
具有基本的控制流：语句组、条件判断、多路选择、循环等。
函数可以返回各种数据类型的值，并且都可以递归调用。每次调用函数会重新创建变量。
C语言只有32個保留字（reserved keywords），使变量、函數命名有更多彈性。
编译预处理（preprocessor）讓C語言的編譯更具有彈性。
target_text: Basic data types include characters, integers, floats, etc. There are also derived types of data, such as needles, arrays, structures, and combinations. Some variable types can be converted, such as integer and character-type variables. Through pointers (pointer), C language can easily provide low-level control of memory. Different variable types can be combined with structures (struct). There are basic control streams: statement groups, condition judgements, multi-circuit selections, loops, etc. The function returns values of various data types and can be used backwards.
title: C语言

source_text: 20世纪70年代，肯·汤姆森为了使其设计的Unix系统更加高效，使用B语言的变种（即C语言）在DEC PDP-7计算机上重写了Unix。C语言中许多重要概念来源于BCPL语言，其对C语言的影响也间接地来源于B语言。在1978年，丹尼斯·里奇和布萊恩·柯林漢合作出版了《C程序设计语言》第一版，事实上即为K&R C标准。1983年，为了制定一个独立于具体机器且无歧义的C语言标准，美国国家标准协会成立了一个委员会，并在1988年完成了该标准的制定，即ANSI C。此标准同时被国际标准化组织所采纳，也被称作ISO C。
target_text: In the 1970s, Ken Thomson rewritten Unix on the DEC PDP-7 computer in order to make the Unix system that he designed more efficient, using variants of the B language (i.e., the C language). Many important concepts in the C language originated in the BCPL language, and their effect on the C language was indirectly derived from the B language. In 1978, Dennis Reich and Brian Collins worked together to publish the first edition of the " C programming language " , which is in fact the K&R C standard. In 1983, the National Standards Association of the United States set up a committee to develop a standard, ANSI C, independent of a specific machine and without discrimination, and in 1988 completed the development of the standard, which was also adopted by the International Organization for Standardization (ISOC).
title: C语言

source_text: C语言的形式文法由国际标准化组织所制定。C语言的源代码包含声明和函数定义。函数定义又包含声明和语句。声明可以定义一个新的类型，比如结构（struct）、联合（union）和枚举（enum），也可以为变量赋予类型和预留内存。复合语句由一对花括号包含，可以使得几个语句从文法上变成一个语句。
target_text: The formal syntax of the C language is developed by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO). The source code of the C language contains statements and function definitions. The function definition also contains statements and statements. A declaration can define a new type, such as structure, association, and emulation (enum), or it can give and reserve memory for variables. A composite statement is contained in brackets, which allows several words to be transformed from syntax to syntax.
title: C语言

source_text:
内存管理
C语言的特色之一是：程序员必须亲自处理内存的分配细节。语言不负责内存边界检查，这是因为在运行时进行内存边界检查会造成性能问题，与UNIX哲学不符。此特性容易导致缓冲区溢出问题。然而，部分编译器（如英特尔编译器）会出于安全性的考量，提供方法以进行运行时内存边界检查。
target_text: One of the features of RAM C is that the programmer must personally handle the RAM allocation details. The language is not responsible for RAM because carrying out RAM at the time of operation would cause performance problems and would be inconsistent with UNIX philosophy. This feature can easily cause buffer zone spillover problems. However, some compilers (e.g. Intel compilers) will provide methods for RAM at the time of operation for security reasons.
title: C语言

source_text:
大多数C语言实现使用栈（Stack）来保存函数返回地址／栈帧基址、完成函数的参数传递和函数局部变量的存储。然而，在部分极特殊的平台上，使用栈并不能获得最大效率。此时的实现由编译器决定。
如果程序需要在运行的过程中动态分配内存，可以利用堆（Heap）来实现。
target_text: Most C languages achieve the use of stacks to save the function to return the address/base address, the parameter transfer of the completed function, and the storage of the local variables of the function. However, in some very special platforms, the use of stubs does not maximize efficiency. The achievement at this point is determined by the compiler. If the program needs to be dynamically assigned memory during the running process, it can be achieved by using stacks (Heap).
title: C语言

source_text:
静态分配
如果一个变量声明为全局变量或者是函数的静态变量，这个变量的存储将使用静态分配方式。静态分配的内存一般会被编译器放在数据段或代码段来存储，具体取决于实现。这样做的前提是，在编译时就必须确定变量的大小。
以IA32的x86平台及gcc编译器为例，全局及静态变量放在数据段的低端；全局及静态常量放在代码段的高端。
target_text: Static distribution If a variable declares a global variable or a static variable for a function, the variable will be stored using static distribution. The memory of the static distribution will normally be stored by the compiler in a data segment or code segment, depending on how it is done. This is done on the premise that the size of the variable must be determined at the time it is compiled. For example, the IA32 x86 platform and the gcc compiler, the global and static variables are placed at the lower end of the data segment; the global and static constants are placed at the upper end of the code segment.
title: C语言

source_text:
自动分配
函数的自动局部变量应该随着函数的返回会自动释放（失效），这个要求在一般的体系中都是利用栈（Stack）来满足的。相比于静态分配，这时候，就不必绝对要求这个变量在编译时就必须确定变量的大小，运行时才决定也不迟，但是C89仍然要求在编译时就要确定，而C99放松了这个限制。但无论是C89还是C99，都不允许一个已经分配的自动变量运行时改变大小。
target_text: Automatically assigns the function's auto-local variable should be automatically released (failure) as the function returns. This requires that it be met in the normal system by using the Stack. This time, when compared to static distribution, there is no absolute requirement that the variable be big when compiled, and not too late when running, but C89 still requires that it be determined when compiled, and C99 relaxes the limit. But neither C89 nor C99 allows an assigned automatic variable to change its size when running.
title: C语言

source_text:
所以说C函数永远不应该返回一个局部变量的地址。要指出的是，自动分配也属于动态分配，甚至可以用alloca函数来像分配堆（Heap）一样进行分配，而且释放是自动的。动态分配
还有一种更加特殊的情况，变量的大小在运行时有可能改变，或者虽然单个变量大小不变，变量的数目却有很大弹性，不能静态分配或者自动分配，这时候可以使用堆（Heap）来满足要求。ANSI C定义的堆操作函数是malloc、calloc、realloc和free。
target_text: So function C should never return the address of a local variable. It is pointed out that automatic distribution is also dynamic distribution, even as the alloca function is used for distribution as the Heap, and the release is automatic. There is also a more exceptional case of dynamic distribution where the size of the variable may change when it is running, or where the number of variables is flexible and cannot be static or automatically distributed, using stacks (Heap) to meet the requirements. The stacking functions defined by ANSIC are melloc, calloc, realloc and free.
title: C语言

source_text: 許多語言都有自動源代碼檢查及審計工具，C語言也有類似工具，像是Lint。可以在程式剛寫好時用Lint找出可能有問題的程式，通過Lint後再用C編譯器進行編譯，許多編譯器也可以設定是否要針對一些可能有問題的程式碼提出警告。MISRA C是一套針對嵌入式系統的法則，可主要也是避免一些可能有問題的程式碼。
target_text: Many languages have automatic source-IDs and screening tools, and C-languages have similar tools, such as Lint.
title: C语言

target_text: In 1974, then C replaced B, and in another internal memorandum from the Bell Laboratory, Programmeing in C: A Tutorial, Colinham again prepared a Helle World program in C as an example of teaching. This program was inherited by him and Dennis Ritchie in 1978 in the "C Program Design Language " : main() {printf("ello, world\n");} In the previous example, the function defined where the program started. Its subject consists of a phrase, i.e., the reference to the function, meaning "print formatting" (print formatted). This function will allow the output of the program to pass on any content to it by parameters, which is a string in this case.
title: Hello World

source_text: 自此，Hello World成為了電腦程序員學習新的程式語言的傳統。但是，也有些人認為 hello, world 的字串早於1966年的BCPL語言出現的時候已經出現。雖然相關的字詞確實在發明者記錄的文件出現，但是可以肯定的是，Hello World在當時確實没有流行。因此，人們公認為布萊恩·柯林漢是令该字串走進公眾目光的人。
target_text: Since then, Hello World has become the tradition for computer programmers to learn new programming languages. However, there are also those who believe that hello, world's string had appeared before the BCPL language appeared in 1966. Although the relevant word did appear in the documents recorded by the inventor, it is certain that Hello World was not popular at the time.
title: Hello World

source_text:
對電腦文化的影響
Debian以及系统的進階包裝工具當中包含了「hello, world」安裝工具。用戶只需要於終端（Linux 系統的Terminal）輸入「apt-get install hello」便能夠安裝此工具及其相關部件。雖然看似沒用，但卻可作為測試工具使用。同時，這亦能夠向新用戶展示安裝工具的方法。對開發者來說，這個工具展現了建立.deb安裝工具的方法。這個工具，連同GNU Hello便成為了撰寫GNU程式的教學軟件。
target_text: The impact on computer culture of Debian and the system’s progressive package tool includes a "ello, world" installation tool. For developers, this tool shows how to create a.deb installation tool. This tool, together with GNU Hello, is a software tool for learning to write GNU programs.
title: Hello World

source_text: 在计算机科学和信息论中，数据压缩或者源编码是按照特定的编码机制用比未经编码少的数据位元（或者其它信息相关的单位）表示信息的过程。例如，若将「compression」编码为「comp」，则这篇文章可以用较少的数据位元表示。常見的例子是ZIP文件格式，此格式不仅仅提供压缩功能，还可作为归档工具（Archiver），能够将许多文件存储到同一个文件中。
target_text: In computer science and informatics, data compression or source coding is the process of using data bits (or units associated with other information) that are less numerous than uncoded in a given encoded mechanism. For example, if "compression " is coded as " comp " , this article can be expressed with fewer data bits. A common example is the ZIP file format, which not only provides compression, but can also be used as an archiving tool (Archiver) to store many files in the same file.
title: 数据压缩

source_text: 可利用資料的一致性（可用信息熵，entropy來表示），規則性，與可預測性去實現資料壓縮。人類最先發展的壓縮技術實為自然語言，一般來說，若可以用比較精簡的自然語言來描述一樣事物，那麼也就越能夠對這樣事物做壓縮。資料越一致，亦代表其統計特性越集中。以影像壓縮為例，其集中代表有傅立葉變換的時域及頻域，直方圖，特徵值。
target_text: Consistency of data (which can be expressed by information entropy, entropy), discipline, and predictability are used to realize data. Humans’ first-developed condensation techniques are natural languages. In general, if they can describe the same thing in a simpler natural language, they can be compressed. The more consistent the data is, the more concentrated their statistical characteristics.
title: 数据压缩

source_text: 非破壞性資料壓縮的壓縮率不足以處理龐大體積的音視頻數據，但如果允许一定程度的保真度损失，那么还可以实现进一步的压缩。例如，人们看图画或者电视画面的时候可能并不会注意到一些细节并不完善。同样，两个音频录音采样序列可能听起来一样，但实际上并不完全一样。破壞性資料壓縮在可以接受或無法察覺的情況下使用较少的位数表示图像、视频或者音频。
target_text: The compression of non-destructive data is not sufficient to deal with large volumes of audio and video data, but further compression can be achieved if a certain level of certainty is allowed. For example, people may not notice that some details are not perfect when looking at drawings or television images. Similarly, two audio recording sampling sequences may sound the same, but not exactly the same. Disruptive data compression uses fewer digits to indicate images, videos or audio in situations that are acceptable or undetectable.
title: 数据压缩

source_text: 由于可以帮助减少如硬盘空间与连接带宽这样的昂贵资源的消耗，所以压缩非常重要，然而压缩需要消耗信息处理资源，这也可能是费用昂贵的。所以数据压缩机制的设计需要在压缩能力、失真度、所需计算资源以及其它需要考虑的不同因素之间进行折衷。
target_text: Compression is important because it can help to reduce the consumption of expensive resources, such as hard disk space and connection bandwidth, but it may also be expensive to consume information processing resources. The data compression mechanism will need to be designed in a way that balances the compression capacity, the lack of authenticity, the computational resources required, and other factors that need to be taken into account.
title: 数据压缩

source_text: 对于任何形式的通信来说，只有当信息的发送方和接受方都能够理解编码机制的时候压缩数据通信才能够工作。例如，只有当接受方知道这篇文章需要用汉语字符解释的时候这篇文章才有意义。同样，只有当接受方知道编码方法的时候他才能够理解压缩数据。
target_text: For any form of communication, compressed data communications can only work if both the sender and the recipient of the information understand the encoded mechanism. For example, the article is meaningful only if the recipient knows that it needs to be interpreted in Chinese characters. Similarly, he can understand the compressed data only when the recipient knows the encoded method.
title: 数据压缩

source_text: 对于视频和音频数据，只要不损失数据的重要部分一定程度的质量下降是可以接受的。通过利用人类感知系统的局限，能够大幅度的节约存储空间并且得到的结果质量与原始数据质量相比并没有明显的差别。这些有损数据压缩方法通常需要在压缩速度、压缩数据大小以及质量损失这三者之间进行折衷。
target_text: For video and audio data, it is acceptable not to lose a certain amount of quality reduction in important parts of the data. By using the limitations of human perception systems, there is no significant difference between the saving of storage space and the quality of the results obtained, on the one hand, and the quality of the original data, on the other.
title: 数据压缩

source_text: 在有损音频压缩中，心理声学的方法用来去除信号中听不见或者很难听见的成分。人类语音的压缩经常使用更加专业的技术，因此人们有时也將“语音压缩”或者“语音编码”作为一个独立的研究领域与“音频压缩”区分开来。不同的音频和语音压缩标准都属于音频编解码范畴。例如语音压缩用于因特网电话，而音频压缩被用于CD翻录并且使用MP3播放器解码。
target_text: In damaging audio compression, psychoacoustic methods are used to remove non-heard or hard-to-heard components of signals. Human voice compression often uses more specialized techniques, so that “voice compression” or “voice encoding” is sometimes distinguished from “audio compression” as a separate area of research. Different audio and voice compression standards fall within the scope of audio decoding. For example, voice compression is used for Internet phones, while audio compression is used for CD recoupling and MP3 players decoding.
title: 数据压缩

source_text: 压缩的理论（它与算法信息论密切相关）以及率失真理论，这个领域的研究工作主要是由美國學者克劳德·香农（Claude Elwood Shannon）奠定的，他在二十世纪四十年代末期及五十年代早期发表了这方面的基础性的论文。Doyle和Carlson在2000年写到数据压缩“是所有的工程领域最简单、最优美的设计理论之一”。密码学与编码理论也是密切相关的学科，数据压缩的思想与统计推断也有很深的渊源。
target_text: In 2000, Doyle and Carlson wrote that data compression “is one of the simplest and most beautiful design theories in all engineering fields.” The cryptography and coding theory are also closely related disciplines, and the idea of data compression is deeply rooted in statistical extrapolation.
title: 数据压缩

source_text:
Lempel-Ziv（LZ）压缩方法是流行的无损存储算法之一。DEFLATE是LZ的一个变体，它针对解压速度与压缩率进行了优化，虽然它的压缩速度可能非常缓慢，PKZIP、gzip以及PNG都在使用DEFLATE。LZW（Lempel-Ziv-Welch）是Unisys的专利，直到2003年6月专利到期限，这种方法用于GIF图像。另外值得一提的是LZR （LZ-Renau） 方法，它是Zip方法的基础。LZ方法使用基于表格的压缩模型，其中表格中的条目用重复的数据串替换。对于大多数的LZ方法来说，这个表格是从最初的输入数据动态生成的。这个表格经常采用霍夫曼编码维护（例如SHRI、LZX）。
目前一个性能良好基于LZ的编码机制是LZX，它用于微软公司的CAB格式。
target_text: The Lempel-Ziv (LZ) compression method is one of the most popular loss-free storage algorithms. DEFLATE is a variant of LZ, which optimizes the decompression speed and compression rate, although it may be very slow, with PKZIP, gzip and PNG using DEFLATE. The LZW (Lempel-Ziv-Welch) is a patent for Unisys until June 2003, when the patent expires, which is used for GIF images. It is also worth mentioning the LZ (LZ-Renou) method, which is the basis for the Zip method. The LZ method uses a compressed model based on tables, in which entries are replaced by duplicated data chains. For most LZ methods, the form is produced from the initial input data dynamics. This form is often maintained by Hoffmann codes (e.g. SHRI, LZX).
title: 数据压缩

source_text: 最好的压缩工具将概率模型预测结果用于算术编码。算术编码由芬蘭信息理論學家Jorma Rissanen发明，并且由Witten、Neal以及Cleary将它转变成一个实用的方法。这种方法能够实现比众人皆知的哈夫曼算法更好的压缩，并且它本身非常适合于自适应数据压缩，自适应数据压缩的预测与上下文密切相关。算术编码已经用于二值图像压缩标准JBIG、文档压缩标准DejaVu。文本输入系统Dasher是一个逆算术编码器。
target_text: The best compression tool uses probabilistic model predictions for arithmetic coding. Arithmetic coding has been developed by the Finnish information scientist Jorma Rissanen and transformed by Witten, Neal, and Cleary into a practical method. This method can achieve a much better compression than is known in the Hafman algorithm and is itself well suited to self-adaptation data compression, and self-adapted data compression predictions are closely related to context. Arithmetic coding has been used for two-value image compression standard JBIG, document compression standard DejaVu.
title: 数据压缩

source_text:
JPEG（使用离散余弦变换、量化、哈夫曼编码的图像压缩）
MPEG（广泛使用的音频及视频压缩标准族，视频压缩使用离散余弦变换以及运动补偿预测）
MP3（MPEG-1标准中用于声音及音乐压缩的部分，使用子带、MDCT、感知模型、量化以及哈夫曼编码）
WMA（WMV音频编码规范中的一部分，使用MDCT、感知模型、低位元率量化、量化以及哈夫曼编码）
Vorbis（类似于AAC的基于DCT的音频编解码，为了避免专利问题而设计）
JPEG 2000（使用小波、量化、熵编码的图像压缩）
TTA（使用线性预测编码，用于无损音频压缩）
FLAC（用于无损音频压缩的线性预测编码）
ATRAC（Adaptive Transform Acoustic Coding，自適應聽覺轉換編碼）為SONY公司於1992年所開發之音訊有損數據壓縮技術，也是相關技術名詞之總稱。
target_text: MP3(MPEG-1 standards used for voice and music compression, using subbands, MDDTs, perception models, quantifications and Hafman codes as part of WMA (WMV audio code code), using MDDT, sensory models, low-bitrate quantification, quantification and Haftman code) Vorbis (a similar AAC-based CDT audio code decoding, designed to avoid patent problems), JPEG 2000 (using small wave, quantification, entropy code compressed images) TTA (using linear prediction codes for undamaged audio compression) FTAC (a linear prediction code for undamaged audio compression) ATRAC (Adaptive Transform Autostem Code) has also been used as an administrating technology for SNY in 1992.
title: 数据压缩

source_text: 鋰（；；源于，转写为「Lithos」，直譯「石頭」），是化學元素，化學符號，原子序为3，原子量為。中文名源于“Lithos”的第一音节发音“里”，而且是金属，在左方加上部首“钅”。鋰是軟的銀白色鹼金屬。三粒电子中两粒分布在K层，另一粒在L层。锂是碱金属中最轻的一种。锂常呈+1或0氧化态，是否有-1氧化态則尚未证实。但锂和其化合物并不像其他的碱金属那么典型，锂的电荷密度很大并且有稳定的氦型双电子层，使锂易极化其他分子或离子，自己却不易受到极化。这点影响到它和其化合物的稳定。
target_text: The Chinese name is derived from the first syllable pronunciation of the “Lithos” and is metal, with the headlines added to the left. It is a soft silver white platinum. Two of the three electrons are located in the K layer and another in the L layer. Lithium is the lightest of the alkali metals. Lithium is often in the +1 or 0 oxidation state, and whether there is a 1 oxidation state has not been confirmed. However, lithium and its compounds are not typical of other alkali metals. Lithium has a very dense charge and has a stable helium binary layer, which makes it easy to polarize other molecules or ions. This affects the stability of the lithium and its compounds.
title: 锂

source_text: 在標準條件，它是最輕的金屬和最輕的固體元素。同其他鹼金屬，鋰很活潑和易燃，應儲存在礦物油中。切割時展現出金屬光澤，但水氣會快速潮解之，變成暗銀灰色，接著變成黑色的氧化物。它不以元素狀態存在自然界，而只能於（通常是離子）偉晶岩礦物等化合物中出現，它們曾是鋰的主要來源。由於其離子的溶解度，它存在於海水中並通常從鹽水中獲得。從氯化鋰和氯化鉀的混合物中電解分離鋰金屬。
target_text: In standard terms, it is the lightest metal and the lightest solid element. It is the most active and flammable in mineral oils, as well as other titanium metals. It displays the metal light when cut, but the water is rapidly dissipated and turned into dark silver gray, followed by black oxides. It does not exist in the natural state of elements, but is found in compounds such as (usually ion) crystalline rock minerals, which were the main source of the platinum. Because of the solubility of its ion, it is found in sea water and usually in salt water.
title: 锂

source_text: 在自然界發現的兩種穩定同位素有所有穩定核素中每粒核子的結合能，鋰原子核處於不穩定狀態。核的性質相對不穩定，鋰在太陽系的含量排名第26。由於以上因素，鋰在核物理學具重要用途。1932年鋰原子向氦的核分裂是第一次完全人為的核反應，而氘化鋰用作熱核武器的燃料。
target_text: The two stable isotopes found in nature have a combination of all stable nuclides per nuclide, and the cytonuclear core is in an unstable state. The nuclear mass is unstable, ranking 26th in the solar system. source_text: HTTP是一个客户端（用户）和服务端（网站）之间请求和应答的标准，通常使用TCP协议。通过使用網頁浏览器、网络爬虫或者其它的工具，客户端发起一个HTTP请求到服务器上指定端口（默认端口为80）。我们称这个客户端为用户代理程式（user agent）。应答的服务器上存储着一些资源，比如HTML文件和图像。我们称这个应答服务器为源服务器（origin server）。在用户代理和源服务器中间可能存在多个「中间层」，比如代理伺服器、网关或者隧道（tunnel）。
target_text: HTTP is the standard for requests and responses between a client (user) and a service (website), usually using the TPCP protocol. By using web browsers, web reptiles or other tools, the client initiates a HTTP request to specify an port on the server (default port 80). We call this client a user agent. The answer server contains resources such as HTML files and images. We refer to this answer server as the source server (origin server). There may be multiple `intermediaries' between the user agent and the source server, such as proxy servers, gateways or tunnels (tunnel).
title: 超文本传输协议

source_text:
通常，由HTTP客户端发起一个请求，建立一个到服务器指定端口（默认是80端口）的TCP连接。HTTP服务器则在那个端口监听客户端的请求。一旦收到请求，服务器会向客户端返回一个状态，比如"HTTP/1.1 200 OK"，以及返回的内容，如请求的文件、错误消息、或者其它信息。请求方法
HTTP/1.1协议中共定义了八种方法（也叫“动作”）来以不同方式操作指定的资源：
target_text: Normally, the HTTP client initiates a request to create a TCCP connection to the server's specified port (the default is 80 port). The HTTP server listens to the client's request at that port. Once a request is received, the server returns a state to the client, such as "HTTP/1.1,200 OK" and the returned content, such as requested documents, error messages, or other information. The request method HTTP/1.1 protocol defines eight methods (also called "actions") to operate the specified resource in different ways:
title: 超文本传输协议

source_text: GET向指定的资源发出「顯示」请求。使用GET方法應該只用在讀取資料，而不应当被用于产生「副作用」的操作中，例如在网络应用程序中。其中一个原因是GET可能会被網路爬蟲等随意访问。参见安全方法。浏览器直接发出的GET只能由一个url触发。GET上要在url之外带一些参数就只能依靠url上附带querystring。HEAD與GET方法一樣，都是向服务器发出指定资源的请求。只不过服务器將不傳回資源的本文部份。它的好處在於，使用这個方法可以在不必传输全部内容的情况下，就可以获取其中「關於該資源的y資訊」（元資訊或稱元資料）。POST向指定资源提交数据，请求服务器进行处理（例如提交表单或者上传檔案）。数据被包含在请求本文中。這個請求可能会建立新的资源或修改現有资源，或二者皆有。每次提交，表单的数据被浏览器用编码到HTTP请求的body里。浏览器发出的POST请求的body主要有两种格式，一种是application/x-www-form-urlencoded用来传输简单的数据，大概就是"key1=value1&key2=value2"这样的格式。另外一种是传文件，会采用multipart/form-data格式。采用后者是因为application/x-www-form-urlencoded的编码方式对于文件这种二进制的数据非常低效。PUT向指定资源位置上传其最新内容。DELETE请求服务器删除Request-URI所标识的资源。TRACE回显服务器收到的请求，主要用于测试或诊断。OPTIONS這個方法可使服务器傳回該资源所支持的所有HTTP请求方法。用'*'來代替資源名稱，向Web服务器发送OPTIONS请求，可以测试服务器功能是否正常運作。CONNECT
target_text: GET sends a " Show" request to the specified resource. The use of the GET method should only be used to read the data to the server. It should not be used to produce the "W" component of the resource, for example, in web applications. One of the reasons is that GET may be randomly accessed, such as Internet reptiles. See the security method. The direct release of GET from the browser can only be triggered by a url. Some of the parameters on the GET outside the url can only be handled by querystring on the url. The HEAD and GET method, like the GET method, should be used to send the requested resource to the server. The server will use the "Y information about the resource without having to transmit the full content" (meta information or metagrams).
title: 超文本传输协议

source_text: 方法名称是区分大小写的。当某个请求所针对的资源不支持对应的请求方法的时候，服务器应当返回状态码405（Method Not Allowed），当服务器不认识或者不支持对应的请求方法的时候，应当返回状态码501（Not Implemented）。HTTP服务器至少应该实现GET和HEAD方法，其他方法都是可选的。当然，所有的方法支持的实现都应当符合下述的方法各自的语义定义。
target_text: The method name is case-sensitive. When the resource for which a request is directed does not support the corresponding request method, the server should return the status code 405 (Method Not Allowed) and the status code 501 (Not Implemented) should be returned when the server does not know or does not support the corresponding request method. The HTTP server should at least achieve the GET and HEAD methods, and other methods are optional. Of course, all methods should support the achievement in accordance with the semantic definitions of the following methods.
title: 超文本传输协议

source_text:
安全方法
对于GET和HEAD方法而言，除了进行获取资源信息外，这些请求不应当再有其他意义。也就是说，这些方法应当被认为是“安全的”。
客户端可能会使用其他“非安全”方法，例如POST，PUT及DELETE，应该以特殊的方式（通常是按钮而不是超链接）告知客户可能的后果（例如一个按钮控制的资金交易），或请求的操作可能是不安全的（例如某个文件将被上传或删除）。
target_text: In the case of GET and HEAD methods, these requests should have no other meaning than to conduct access to resource information. That is, they should be considered “safe.” Clients may use other “non-safe” methods, such as POST, PUT and DELETE, and should inform customers in a special way (usually buttons rather than hyperlinks) of possible consequences (e.g. financial transactions controlled by a button), or the operation of the request may be unsafe (e.g. a document will be uploaded or deleted).
title: 超文本传输协议

source_text: 假如在不考虑诸如错误或者过期等问题的情况下，若干次请求的副作用与单次请求相同或者根本没有副作用，那么这些请求方法就能够被视作“冪等(idempotence)”的。GET，HEAD，PUT和DELETE方法都有这样的幂等属性，同样由于根据协议，OPTIONS，TRACE都不应有副作用，因此也理所当然也是幂等的。
target_text: If the side effects of several requests are the same as a single request or have no side effects at all, without taking into account such issues as error or expiry, the request methods can be considered as “idempotence”. The GET, HEAD, PUT and DELETE methods all have such attributes, as well as the fact that neither OPTIONS, TRACE, nor therefore, as agreed, should have side effects.
title: 超文本传输协议

source_text: 假如一个由若干请求组成的请求序列产生的结果，在重复执行这个请求序列或者其中任何一个或多个请求后仍没有发生变化，则这个请求序列便是“幂等”的。但是，可能出现一个由若干请求组成的请求序列是“非幂等”的，即使这个请求序列中所有执行的请求方法都是幂等的。例如，这个请求序列的结果依赖于某个会在下次执行这个序列的过程中被修改的变量。
target_text: If the result of a request sequence of several requests does not change after repeated execution of the request sequence or of any one or more of those requests, the request sequence is “like.” However, there may be a request sequence of several requests that is “non-like” even if all execution methods in the request sequence are similar. For example, the result of the request sequence depends on a variable that will be modified during the next execution of the sequence.
title: 超文本传输协议

source_text:
對照表版本
超文本传输协议已经演化出了很多版本，它们中的大部分都是向下兼容的。在RFC 2145中描述了HTTP版本号的用法。客户端在请求的开始告诉服务器它采用的协议版本号，而后者则在响应中采用相同或者更早的协议版本。HTTP/0.9
已过时。只接受GET一种请求方法，没有在通讯中指定版本号，且不支持请求头。由于该版本不支持POST方法，因此客户端无法向服务器传递太多信息。
target_text: The hypertext transfer protocol has evolved many versions, most of which are compatible downwards. The use of the HTTP version number is described in RFC 2145. The client informs the server at the start of the request, while the client uses the same or earlier version of the protocol. HTTP/9 is outdated. Only the request method of the GET is accepted, no version number is specified in the newsletter, and the request head is not supported. Since the version does not support the POST method, the client cannot transmit much information to the server.
title: 超文本传输协议

source_text:
HTTP/1.0
这是第一个在通讯中指定版本号的HTTP协议版本。HTTP/1.1
默认采用持续连接（Connection: keep-alive），能很好地配合代理服务器工作。还支持以管道方式在同时发送多个请求，以便降低线路负载，提高传输速度。HTTP/1.1相较于HTTP/1.0协议的区别主要体现在：
缓存处理
带宽优化及网络连接的使用
错误通知的管理
消息在网络中的发送
互联网地址的维护
安全性及完整性
target_text: HTTP/1. This is the first version of the HTTP protocol to specify a version in the newsletter. HTTP/1.1 defaults to use continuous connectivity (Connection: keep-alive) to work well with the proxy server. Support is also given to sending multiple requests simultaneously in a piped manner in order to reduce the load of lines and increase the speed of transmission. The difference between HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/1.0 is mainly that: Cache processing; bandwidth optimization; and use of network connections; management of bug notifications; sending messages in the network to maintain the security and integrity of Internet addresses.
title: 超文本传输协议

source_text:
状态代码的第一个数字代表当前响应的类型：
1xx消息——请求已被服务器接收，继续处理
2xx成功——请求已成功被服务器接收、理解、并接受
3xx重定向——需要后续操作才能完成这一请求
4xx请求错误——请求含有词法错误或者无法被执行
5xx服务器错误——服务器在处理某个正确请求时发生错误
target_text: The first number of the status code represents the type of current response: 1xx message - the request has been received by the server and continues to process 2xx successfully - the request has been successfully received by the server, understood, and accepted 3xx redirection - a follow-up action is required to complete the request 4xx request error - the request contains a word error or cannot be executed 5xx server error - the server made an error while processing a correct request
title: 超文本传输协议

source_text: 虽然 RFC 2616 中已经推荐了描述状态的短语，例如"200 OK"，"404 Not Found"，但是WEB开发者仍然能够自行决定采用何种短语，用以显示本地化的状态描述或者自定义信息。持續連線在HTTP 0.9和1.0中，TCP連線在每一次請求/回應對之後關閉。在HTTP 1.1中，引入了保持連線的機制，一個連接可以重複在多個請求/回應使用。持續連線的方式可以大大減少等待時間，因為在發出第一個請求後，雙方不需要重新執行TCP交握程序。
target_text: Although RFC 2616 has recommended phrases describing the state, such as "200 OK", "404 Not Found", WEB developers are still able to decide what phrases to use to display localized state descriptions or custom information. In HTTP 0.9 and 1.0, TCP links are closed after each request/reaction. In HTTP 1.1, a mechanism to maintain a connection is introduced that can be repeated in multiple requests/reactions.
title: 超文本传输协议

source_text: HTTP 1.1還改進了HTTP 1.0的頻寬。 例如，HTTP 1.1引入了分块传输编码，以允許傳遞內容可以在持續連線上被串流傳輸而不必使用到緩衝器。HTTP管道允許客戶端在收到每個回應之前發送多個請求，進一步減少用戶感受到的滯後時間。協議的另一個補充是字節服務，允許客戶端請求資源的某一部份，伺服器僅回應某資源的指明部分。
target_text: HTTP 1.1 has also changed the bandwidth of HTTP 1.0. For example, HTTP 1.1 has introduced a block transfer code to allow content to be transferred in a continuous line without having to use a buffer. The HTTP conduit allows clients to send multiple requests before each response is received, further reducing the user ' s post-discovery time. Another supplement to the agreement is the byte service, which allows clients to request a certain part of the resource, and the server only responds to the specified part of the resource.
title: 超文本传输协议

source_text: 在HTTP1.0，单一TCP连接内仅执行一个“客户端发送请求—服务器发送应答”周期，之后释放TCP连接。在HTTP1.1优化支持持续活跃连接：客户端连续多次发送请求、接收应答；批次多请求时，同一TCP连接在活跃（Keep-Live）间期内复用，避免重复TCP初始握手活动，减少网络负荷和响应周期。此外支持应答到达前继续发送请求（通常是两个），称为「流线化」（stream）。
target_text: In HTTP1.0, only one " Client Send Request-Service Send Response" cycle is implemented within a single TCP connection, after which the TCP connection is released. HTTP1.1 optimizes support for continuous active connectivity: the client sends multiple requests over time, receives responses; the same TCP connection is reused during the period between active (Keep-Live) and avoids the initial TCP handshake activity and reduces network loads and response cycles. In addition, support is provided to continue sending requests (usually two) until the response arrives, called "streaming" (streaming).
title: 超文本传输协议

source_text: 當微軟準備開發一種新的編成工具的時候，第一決定就是利用最搶手的VB6來進行修改，或者就是重新組建工程開發新工具。微軟後來開發了 VB 的繼任者 Visual Basic .NET，同時也是 .NET 平台的一部分。VB.NET 編成語言是一種真正的物件導向編成語言（VB4-VB6 祇能稱為基於對象而不是物件導向，最明顯的特徵就是 VB4-VB6 都不支持類的繼承），和傳統 Visual Basic 並不完全兼容。
target_text: When Microsoft prepares to develop a new tool, the first decision is to use the most powerful VB6 to modify it, or to reassemble the new tool. Microsoft has developed VB's successor, Visual Basic.NET, which is also part of the .NET platform. VB.NET is a language that is a real object-guided (VB4-VB6 can be described as based on object orientation rather than object orientation, and the most obvious feature is that VB4-VB6 does not support inheritance), and the tradition of Visual Basic is not fully compatible.
title: Visual Basic

source_text: VB 的中心思想就是要便于程序员使用，无论是新手或者专家。VB 使用了可以简单建立应用程序的 GUI 系统，但是又可以开发相当复杂的程序。VB 的程序是一种基于窗体的可视化组件安排的联合，并且增加代码来指定组建的属性和方法。因为默认的属性和方法已经有一部分定义在了组件内，所以程序员不用写多少代码就可以完成一个简单的程序。过去的版本里面 VB 程序的性能问题一直被放在台面上讨论，但是随着计算机速度的飞速增加，关于性能的争论已经越来越少。
target_text: The central idea of VB is to make it easier for programmers to use, be they new recruits or experts. VB uses GUI systems that can easily create applications, but can develop rather complex programs. VB programs are a combination of form-based visual components and add codes to specify the attributes and methods of formation. Since the default properties and methods are already partially defined in components, programmers can complete a simple program without having to write many codes. The performance of VB programs in previous versions has been discussed on the table, but as computer speed increases, there has been less debate about performance.
title: Visual Basic

source_text: 窗体控件的增加和改变可以用拖放技术实现。一个排列满控件的工具箱用来显示可用控件（比如文本框或者按钮）。每个控件都有自己的和事件。默认的属性值会在控件创建的时候提供，但是程序员也可以进行更改。很多的属性值可以在运行时候随着用户的动作和修改进行改动，这样就形成了一个动态的程序。举个例子来说：窗体的大小改变事件中加入了可以改变控件位置的代码，在运行时候每当用户更改窗口大小，控件也会随之改变位置。在文本框中的文字改变事件中加入相应的代码，程序就能够在文字输入的时候自动翻译或者阻止某些字符的输入。
target_text: The additions and changes to the form control can be achieved by drag-and-drop techniques. A toolbox to align the full control is used to display the available control (e.g. text frames or buttons). Each control has its own and event. The default attribute value is provided when the control is created, but the programmer can change it. Many attribute values can be changed as the user moves and changes. For example, when the form changes its size, the code can change the control position, and whenever the user changes the window size, the control changes the position. Adds the corresponding code when the text changes in the text box, the program can automatically translate or block the input of certain characters at the time the text is entered.
title: Visual Basic

source_text: VB 的程序可以包含一个或多个窗体，或者是一个主窗体和多个子窗体，类似于操作系统的样子。有很少功能的对话框窗口（比如没有最大化和最小化按钮的窗体）可以用来提供弹出功能。VB 的组件既可以拥有用户界面，也可以没有。这样一来服务器端程序就可以处理增加的模块。
target_text: VB programs can contain one or more forms, or a main form and multiple sub-forms, similar to the operating system. There are very few dialogue box windows (e.g. those that do not maximize or minimize buttons) that can be used to provide pop-up functions. VB components can have user interfaces or not. This allows server-end programs to handle additional modules.
title: Visual Basic

source_text: VB 使用引用计数的方法来进行垃圾收集，这个方法中包含有大量的对象，提供基本的面向对象支持。因为越来越多组建的出现，程序员可以选用自己需要的扩展库。和有些语言不一样，VB 对大小写不敏感，但是能自动转换关键词到标准的大小写状态，以及强制使得符号表入口的实体的变量名称遵循书写规则。默认情况下字符串的比较是对大小写敏感的，但是可以关闭这个功能。
target_text: VB uses the citation count method for waste collection, which contains a large number of objects and provides basic object-oriented support. source_text: 微軟（）是源自美國的跨國科技公司，於1975年由比爾·蓋茲與保羅·艾倫創立，總部位於美國华盛顿州的雷德蒙德，與亞馬遜、蘋果、谷歌、Meta並列為五大科技巨擘。其中為研發、製造、授權及提供廣泛的電腦軟體服務為主要業務，最為著名且暢銷的產品是Microsoft Windows作業系統及Microsoft Office辦公軟體，其它子公司如Xbox遊戲業務等也都十分地著名。
target_text: Microsoft, an inter-national technology company originating in the United States, was founded in 1975 by Bill Gates and Paul Allen, based in Redmond, Washington, D.C., with Amazons, Apples, Google, Meta, and five major technology giants. source_text: 微软公司是由比爾·蓋茲和保羅·艾倫在1975年创立的。他們是小時候認識的朋友及高中同學，並對電腦編程充滿激情。他們利用他们的演講技能，意圖追求成功。1975年1月，MITS公司发售了Altair 8800大眾化微電腦和遙測系統，这令他們注意到，可以編寫一個BASIC直譯器賺錢。他們致電給Altair 8800的發明者（MITS），提出在該系統中執行BASIC。MITS公司表示感興趣，并要求艾倫和蓋茲進行示範。之後MITS公司聘請艾倫為Altair進行模擬器的開發工作，而蓋茲則開發直譯器。他们的工作十分出色，1975年3月MITS公司同意出售Altair BASIC。他們順利賺了第一桶金，於是蓋茲離開哈佛大学，並搬到MITS在新墨西哥州阿布奎基的總部。1975年4月4日，微軟正式成立，蓋茲為微軟執行長。他在1995年《財富》雜誌的一篇文章中回憶，原名“Micro-Soft”是艾倫想出來的，之後更改為“Microsoft”。在1977年8月，公司和日本ASCII雜誌簽署了一個協議，成立了其首個國際辦事處“ASCII Microsoft”。在1979年1月，公司搬遷到在華盛頓州貝爾維尤的新辦公室。

source_text: 微軟在1980年開發了UNIX作業系統業務，叫做Xenix，並聘用聖克魯茲作業改編該作業系統以應用於不同操作平台。發表後受到歡迎，並鞏固了公司的霸主地位。1980年11月，微軟獲得了IBM公司的合同，這筆交易中，微軟要提供CP/M作業系統給即將到來的IBM個人電腦。但微軟沒有時間開發一個全新的系統，於是微軟從收購了86-DOS，並將它更名為MS-DOS，并授權給IBM使用；之後，IBM将自己获得的版本更名為PC-DOS，并安装在1981年8月發布的IBM PC上，但微軟仍保留了MS-DOS的所有版權。當時，因為IBM有PC-DOS的版權，所以其它公司无法在非IBM硬件上运行这一系统。但由於微軟仍握有MS-DOS的所有版權，微軟除了授權該軟體給IBM使用外，還與其他OEM廠商談判，將經過更改後的MS-DOS系統安裝到这些非IBM新電腦上。加上各種因素，微軟最終成為了領先的個人電腦作業系統的系統供應商。從此在非IBM硬體上便可運行微軟更改後的MS-DOS系統，从而完全改變了當時的電腦業的規則和生態。微軟在1983年擴大業務，發布微軟滑鼠，並成立微軟出版社進入新的市場。但不幸的是，保羅·艾倫患上霍奇金病，于同年二月向微軟辭職。

source_text:
一些觀察家聲稱，微軟作為一個壟斷企業令其競爭對手處境窘困：
一方面，競爭對手不願意承認微軟的壟斷地位。因為在一個被壟斷的市場，只有一家產品或服務的提供商。因此對競爭對手而言，將微軟稱為壟斷者會將自己置於一個失敗者的境地：這樣做等於是否定了自己的存在，或否定了自己能夠生存、競爭的能力。
另一方面，競爭對手又希望將微軟比作壟斷企業，因為這樣做會給自己帶來好處。首先，這有可能導致市場管理者（政府）的介入。其次，被看作是「落水狗」的微軟競爭對手有可能在公共關係上取勝，以刺激銷售。
target_text: Some observers claim that Microsoft, as a severing enterprise, is in a difficult position for its competitors: on the one hand, competition does not want to recognize the weak status of Microsoft. There is only one provider of goods or services in a broken market. So, for competitors, it would be possible for them to put themselves in the position of a loser: it would be tantamount to denying their existence or their ability to survive or compete.

source_text: 也有人批評微軟的商業策略是「擁抱再擴充」（）策略。批評者認為微軟試圖在開放、已確立的標準之上加入專利功能，最終達到利用其市場優勢來控制「擴充」的標準。有些人將這種策略稱之為「擁抱、擴充再消滅」（）。2004年3月，微軟公司因違反歐盟公平競爭法，被歐盟委員會要求向競爭對手提供包括視窗作業系統源代碼在內的必要技術資訊，並被處以近5億歐元的罰款，創下歐盟罰款的最高紀錄。
target_text: Microsoft's business strategy has also been criticized for its "embracing re-enhancement" strategy. Critics argue that it seeks to add a proprietary function over open, well-established standards, eventually reaching the standard of using its market advantage to control "enhancement." Some refer to it as "hubing, magnification, re-elimination." In March 2004, as a violation of the European Union's fair play, Microsoft companies were asked by the European Commission to provide competitionrs with the necessary technical information, including the source code of the Windows system, and were fined close to 500 million euros to create the highest record of European Union fines.

source_text: 批評及爭議Facebook創辦人馬克·祖克柏出生時（1984年5月14日）被稱為「第二蓋茲」，自2002年（18歲）就拒絕微軟，他哈佛大學時代就成立了社群網路服務Facebook。微軟入駐Facebook以來，對與微軟有關的照片來發送。Windows Phone自Windows 10推出以來，行動作業系統的後續系統為Windows 10 Mobile，但由於种种原因發生爭議。2014年9月23日，微軟宣布將自家旗下的网盘品牌OneDrive的免費用戶永久儲存空間上調至15GB，使用備份照片可再次獎勵15GB。但此前尚未註冊的用戶於2015年12月31日將會縮減至5GB，Office365的訂閱用戶不能繼續保持無限儲存空間。Microsoft程式的終端使用者授權協定經常被嚴厲批評。
