source_text: 病原体可以快速地进化和调整，来躲避免疫系统的侦测和攻击。为了能够在与病原体的对抗中获胜，生物体进化出了多种识别和消灭病原体的机制。就连简单的单细胞生物，如细菌，也发展出了可以对抗噬菌体感染的酶系统。一些真核生物，例如植物和昆虫，从它们古老的祖先那里继承了简单的免疫系统。这些免疫机制包括抗微生物多肽（防御素）、吞噬作用和补体系统。包括人类在内的有颌类脊椎动物则发展出更为复杂多样的防御机制。
target_text: Pathogens can rapidly evolve and adapt to avoid detection and attacks by the immune system. To win against them, organisms have evolved a variety of mechanisms for identifying and eliminating pathogens. Even simple single-cell organisms, such as bacteria, have developed enzyme systems that can combat bacterial infections. Some real nuclear organisms, such as plants and insects, have inherited simple immune systems from their ancient ancestors.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 典型的脊椎动物免疫系统由多种蛋白质、细胞、组织和器官所组成，它们之间相互作用，共同构成了一張精细的动态网络。除了“固有免疫”（又称“先天免疫”）外，脊椎动物的免疫系统具有复杂的免疫应答，可以通过不断地适应来更有效地识别特定的病原体，这种适应过程被定义为“适应性免疫”或“获得性免疫”。针对特定的病原体的初次入侵，免疫系统中的T細胞能够产生具免疫记忆的记忆T细胞；当该种病原体再次入侵时，这种记忆就可以使免疫系统迅速作出强化的免疫应答（即“适应性”）。免疫系统的记忆B细胞也有免疫记忆，能在病原体再次入侵时，迅速产生IgG抗体。而适应性免疫正是疫苗注射能够产生免疫力的生物学基础。
target_text: The typical vertebrate immune system is composed of multiple proteins, cells, tissues and organs, which interact together to form a fine dynamic network. In addition to “inherent immunity” (also known as “innate immunisation”), the immune system of vertebrates has complex immune responses, which can be more effective in identifying specific pathogens through continuous adaptation, which is defined as “adaptive immunization” or “Accessary immunity.” For the first invasion of a given pathogen, the T cells of the immune system can produce an immunological memory of T cells; when the pathogen is re-invasive, this memory enables the immune system to rapidly intensify its immune response (i.e., “adaptation”). The immune system also has an immune memory of B cells, which can rapidly produce IgG resistance when the pathogens re-invacate.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 免疫系统的紊乱会导致多种疾病的产生。免疫系统的活力降低就会发生免疫缺陷，进而导致经常性和致命的感染。免疫缺陷可以是遗传性疾病，如重症聯合免疫缺陷；也可以由药物治疗或病菌感染引发，如艾滋病就是由于艾滋病毒感染而引发的适应性免疫缺陷综合症。另一方面，免疫系统異常会将正常的组织作为入侵者而进行攻击，从而引起自体免疫疾病。常见的自体免疫疾病包括慢性甲状腺炎、类风湿性关节炎、第一型糖尿病和全身性紅斑性狼瘡。
target_text: Disruptions in the immune system can lead to multiple diseases. Deficiencies in the immune system can occur, leading to recurrent and fatal infections. Immunisation deficiencies can be genetic diseases, such as severe co-immun deficiency; they can also be caused by drug treatment or bacterial infections, such as AIDS, which is an adaptive immuno-deficiency syndrome caused by HIV infection. On the other hand, the immune system is often attacked by normal organizations as invaders, leading to autoimmune diseases. Common autoimmune diseases include chronic thyroid, rheumatological arthritis, type 1 diabetes and all-round redweed wolf.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
历史
人们对于免疫系统的认知来自于免疫学的发展。免疫学是一门研究免疫系统的结构与功能的学科。它发源自医学和对疾病免疫的原因的早期研究。目前已知的最早提及“免疫”这一现象是在公元前430年爆发的雅典大瘟疫期间；古希臘歷史學家修昔底德发现在上一次瘟疫中得病的人在瘟疫再次爆发时不会再染病。但这一现象的原因却一直不为人所知。直到18世纪，皮埃爾·莫佩爾蒂用蝎毒做实验发现某些狗和小鼠对毒素产生了免疫。随后，路易斯·巴斯德将这一发现连同其他对适应性免疫的报道进一步扩展，发展出了疫苗，并提出了。巴斯德的理论挑战了当时流行的致病理论，如瘴氣致病論。1891年，羅伯·柯霍首次确定微生物是传染病的罪魁祸首，他也因此获得了1905年的诺贝尔奖。1901年，发现黄热病病毒后，病毒被确定是人类疾病的一种致病原。
target_text: History has led people to understand the immune system. Immunization is an early study of the structure and functioning of the immune system. It originated in medicine and early studies of the causes of immunisation. The first known phenomenon was “immunization” during the Athens plague, which broke out in 430 B.C.; ancient Greek historians had discovered that those who had been infected in the last plague would not become sick again. But the cause of this phenomenon was unknown. Until the 18th century, Pierre Mopelti experimented with scorpion to find certain dogs and mice immune to toxins.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 通过研究体液免疫和细胞免疫，免疫学在19世纪末得到了长足的发展。其中，保罗·埃尔利希和伊利亚·梅契尼可夫作出了重要贡献：前者建立了来解释抗原-抗体反应的特异性，为了解体液免疫奠定了基础；后者则是细胞免疫的奠基者。两人也因为他们在免疫学上的成就而分享了1908年的诺贝尔医学或生理学奖。
target_text: In the late 19th century, immunology developed considerably through the study of body fluid and cellular immunisation. Paul Ellich and Ilya Mechinikov made important contributions: the former established the speciality to explain antigen-antibody reactions and laid the foundation for liquid disassembly immunisation; the latter was the cornerstone of cellular immunisation. They also shared the 1908 Nobel Prize for Medicine or Physiology for their immunology.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
免疫系统的组成
免疫系统由免疫器官（脾脏、骨髓、胸腺、淋巴结、扁桃体等）、免疫细胞（淋巴细胞，吞噬细胞等）以及免疫分子（淋巴因子、免疫球蛋白、溶菌酶等）组成。製造免疫細胞的器官
製造免疫細胞的器官是指能够实现免疫功能的器官和组织，是免疫细胞发生、定居和发挥效应的场所。按功能的不同可以分为中枢免疫器官和外周免疫器官。
target_text: The immune system consists of immune organs (spleen, bone marrow, glands, lymphs, tonsils, etc.), immune cells (lymphocytes, digestive cells, etc.) and immune molecules (lymphotons, immunoglobin, soluble enzymes, etc.). The organs of the immune cells are organs and tissues capable of achieving immune functions and are sites where immune cells are present, settled and effective.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
骨髓是造血组织，也是免疫细胞的产生的场所。造血干细胞是骨髓中的原始细胞，能够分化成各种成熟的血细胞。免疫细胞中的淋巴细胞（T细胞与B细胞）的发育前期是在骨髓内完成，另外B细胞分化为浆细胞后，也回到骨髓，并在这里大量产生抗体。同时骨髓也生产其他重要的免疫细胞，包括粒细胞，自然杀伤细胞、未成熟胸腺细胞等。
胸腺
target_text: The bone marrow is a blood tissue and the site where immune cells are produced. Blood stem cells are original cells in bone marrow, which can be divided into mature blood cells. The lymphocytes (T and B cells) in immune cells are pre-developed within the bone marrow, while B cells are divided into magma cells and return to the bone marrow, where a large number of antibodies are produced. The bone marrow also produces other important immune cells, including particle cells, natural killer cells, immaturous breast cells, etc.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 胸腺的主要功能是生产成熟T细胞。不成熟的淋巴T细胞在骨髓中产生，随后迁移到胸腺，受到胸腺激素的誘導，成為成熟但還沒有免疫功能的T细胞，再把它們送到脾臟、淋巴系统和其他器官，讓它們在那裡受胸腺激素的影響進一步成熟，隨時準備抵抗各種對人體有害的敵人。胸腺激素還能提高淋巴细胞的防禦能力，誘導淋巴B细胞成熟。
target_text: The main function of the prostate is to produce mature T-cells. The immature lymphatic T-cells are produced in the marrow of the bone, then move to the prostate, lured by thymus hormones, become mature but unimmunised T-cells, then send them to the spleen, lymphoid system and other organs, where they are further matured by the effects of thymus hormones and are prepared to resist all kinds of enemies that are harmful to the human body at any time. Proton hormones can also increase the anti-negative capacity of lymphocytes and induce lymphob B cells to mature.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
淋巴结是淋巴T细胞和淋巴B细胞定居的场所，T细胞占淋巴结内淋巴细胞总数的75%，B细胞约占25%。人体分布着大约500-600个淋巴结，广泛的分布在非黏膜部位的淋巴通道，是主要的外周免疫器官。在身体浅表区域，淋巴主要分布在颈部、腋窝、腹股沟等处。在身体内部内脏区域，主要分布在器官门，沿血管分布。当抗原入侵机体通过淋巴液流入淋巴结时，抗原会被淋巴结表面的DC细胞（树突状细胞）捕获，并提呈给TH细胞（辅助性T细胞），诱发T细胞和B细胞活化、增殖，发挥免疫效应，清除入侵的病原微生物、毒素等有害物质。淋巴结中的淋巴细胞可以通过淋巴管，胸导管进入血液，清除血液中的异物，随后返回到淋巴结。
脾
target_text: The lymph nodes are the site of settlement of the lymph T and lymph B cells, which account for 75% of the total number of lymphocytes in lymph lymph lymphocytes and 25% of the B cells. The human body is distributed about 500-600 lymph nodes, which are widely distributed in the non-cocomide part of the lymph route, which is the main external immune organ. In the shallow regions of the body, the lymphs are mainly located in the neck, the armpit, the abdominal groves, etc. The internal organs of the body are distributed mainly within the organ gates, along the blood vessels. When the antigen invaders enter the lymphoric fluid into the lymphore, the antigens are captured by the DC cells on the lymphoric surface (tree-like cells) and presented to the TH cells (suppletural T cells), induce T-cells and B cells to active growth, immunizing, removing harmful substances such as invasive pathogenic micro
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
脾在胚胎时期具有造血功能，脾窦中存有大量血液以供机体调节血量。淋巴细胞成熟后在脾中定居。其中淋巴B细胞在淋巴细胞中占60%，淋巴T细胞占40%。与淋巴结一样，脾也是人体免疫应答发生的场所。同时体内约90%血液需要流经脾脏，脾脏可以清除血液中的病原体以及衰老的血细胞。
黏膜相关淋巴组织
target_text: Spleen is capable of producing blood during embryonic periods, and there is a lot of blood in the spleen to regulate blood. The lymph cell matures and settles in the spleen. Sixty percent of the lymphocytes are lymphocytes and 40 percent of the lymphocytes are lymphocytes. Like lymphs, the spleen is the place where the human immune response takes place. At the same time, about 90 percent of the blood in the body needs to flow through the spleen, which removes the pathogens in the bloodstream, as well as the aging blood cell.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 黏膜相关淋巴组织（Mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue，简称MALT)，位于消化道、呼吸道、泌尿生殖道等人体各种黏膜组织中，由黏膜表皮细胞下方的淋巴小结以及表皮细胞之间的微皱褶细胞（M细胞）组成。黏膜层淋巴组织充满淋巴细胞，如：T细胞和B细胞，还有浆细胞和巨噬细胞，每个黏膜层淋巴组织都正好位于抗原需要通过的黏膜上皮处。比如说肠道上的MALT，当微皱褶细胞（M细胞）同时存在时，微皱褶细胞（M细胞）从肠道内捕捉抗原并传递给淋巴组织。
target_text: The mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue, known as MALT, is located in various mucous tissues of the human body, such as digestive tracts, respiratory tracts, urinary tracts, and consists of lymphatic lymphocytes (M cells) on the lower side of the membrane membrane and between the membrane cells. The membrane lymbranes are filled with lymphocytes, such as T- and B cells, as well as plasma cells and megaphages, each of which is located right on the top of the membrane that the antigens are required to pass. For example, MALT on the intestinal tract, when microfractine cells (M cells) are present, the microfraught cells (M cells) capture antigens from the intestinal tract and pass them to the lymphoma tissue.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
分层防御
免疫系统通过特异性不断增加的分层防御来保护生物体免受感染。简单说来，就是第一层物理屏障（如表皮）可以防止病原体，如细菌和病毒进入生物体内。如果病原体通过了这层障碍，那么紧接着先天性免疫系统就会产生迅速但非特异性的免疫反应。先天性免疫系统存在于所有的动植物中。如果病原体再次成功地逃过先天性免疫反应，脊椎动物体内还有第三层保护，即适应性免疫系统（又被称为后天免疫系统），可以通过先天性免疫反应而被激活。在这一层防御中，免疫系统在感染过程中通过适应反应来改进对病原体的识别。在病原体被清除之后，这种改进后的免疫反应依然会以“免疫记忆”的方式得以保留；当再次感染该病原体时，适应性免疫系统就会利用“记忆”对其作出更为快速而强烈的免疫攻击。
target_text: When the pathogen passes this barrier, the immune system immediately follows the congenital immune system, which is quick but non-specific. The congenital immune system is present in all plants and plants. If the pathogen succeeds in escaping the congenital immune response, there is a third layer of protection in the vertebrates, namely, the adaptive immune system (also referred to as the acquired immune system), which can be activated by the congenital immune response. In this layer, the immune system improves the identification of the pathogen by adapting to the response. This improved immune response continues to be preserved in the form of “immunological memory” when the pathogen is removed.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 先天性和适应性免疫都依赖于免疫系统对自体和异体分子的区分能力。在免疫学中，自体分子是指生物体自身的组成物质，可以被免疫系统与外源物质区分开。相反地，异体分子是指被免疫系统识别为外源物质的分子。抗原就是一类异体分子，可以特异性地结合，从而引发免疫反应。
target_text: Both congenital and adaptive immunization depends on the ability of the immune system to distinguish between self and heterogeneous molecules. In immunology, self-molecular molecules are components of the organism itself, which can be distinguished by the immune system from external matter. On the contrary, heterogeneous molecules are molecules that are recognized by the immune system as external material. Antigens are a category of heterogeneous molecules that can be specifically combined to trigger an immune response.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
表层屏障
许多屏障可以保护生物体免受感染。这些屏障可分为机械、化学和生物学屏障。许多植物具有的蜡质叶面，昆虫所特有的外骨骼，蛋外层所包裹的膜和壳，以及脊椎动物的皮肤都属于机械屏障；这些机械屏障包裹住生物体，可以阻挡环境中的病原体入侵。但生物体不可能将自身完全隔离于生活环境之外，部分器官（如肺、肠和尿道）需要与外界环境进行频繁的物质交换，因此这些器官有其他的机械防御机制。例如，咳嗽和打喷嚏可以排出呼吸道中的病原体和刺激原；流泪和排尿可以将病原体排出体外；呼吸系统和尿道所分泌的粘液可以黏附和包裹入侵的微生物。
target_text: The surface barriers, many of which protect organisms from infection, can be divided into mechanical, chemical and biological barriers. Many plants have waxed leaves, insect-specific exoskeletal bones, films and shells wrapped in the outer layers of the eggs, and vertebrate skins, all of which are mechanical barriers; they contain organisms that can prevent pathogenic intrusion in the environment. But the organism cannot completely isolate itself from the living environment, and some organs (e.g. lung, intestinal and urinary) require frequent material exchange with the outside environment, so there are other mechanical defence mechanisms for these organs. For example, coughing and sneezing can exciterate pathogens and irritants in the respiratory tract; tear and urine can excrete pathogens from the body; and viscous from the respiratory system and urine are able to bind and package invasive microbes.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 化学屏障也可以保护生物体免受感染。皮肤和呼吸道能够分泌抗微生物肽，如β-防御素。而唾液、眼泪和奶水中含有的一些酶，如溶菌酶和，也具有抗菌作用。在生殖系统中，初潮之后的阴道酸性分泌物，以及精液中含有的防御素和锌，都可杀死病原体。另一个化学屏障的例子存在于胃中:胃酸和蛋白酶是抵抗病原体强有力的化学屏障。
target_text: Chemical barriers can also protect organisms from infection. Skins and respiratory tracts can secret anti-microbial peptide, such as beta-defensives. Some enzymes in saliva, tears and milk, such as soluble enzymes, also have anti-bacterial effects. In the reproductive system, post-tidal vaginal acid secretions, as well as precipitants and zinc contained in semen, can kill pathogens. Another example of chemical barriers is found in the stomach: stomach acids and protein enzymes are powerful chemical barriers against pathogens.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 在泌尿生殖系统和消化道中，片利共生的发挥着生物学屏障的作用；这些肠道菌在一定条件下可以通过改变周围环境条件，如pH或可利用的铁元素，来与食物中的病原体细菌竞争。这种竞争一定程度上抑制这些病原体的生长，降低了病原体引起疾病的可能性。由于抗生素能够非特异性地抑制细菌的生长，却不影响真菌；因此，口服抗生素可能导致真菌增生，而引发一些疾病，如阴道念珠菌症（由酵母感染所引起）。对于儿童的肠胃感染和细菌性肠胃炎、炎症性肠病、泌尿道感染及的初步研究表明，摄入消化道益生菌，如未经高温消毒的酸奶中所含的乳酸菌，有助于恢复消化道菌群的健康平衡。
target_text: In the urinary reproductive system and digestive tracts, symbiotic symbiotic plays the role of biological barriers; these intestinal bacteria can compete with pathogenic bacteria in food under certain conditions by changing the surrounding environmental conditions, such as pH or available iron elements. This competition limits the growth of these pathogens to a certain extent, reducing the likelihood of disease caused by them. As antibiotics are able to inhibit bacteria in a non-specific way, they do not affect fungi; oral antibiotics can therefore lead to fungi growth, leading to diseases such as vaginal ecstasy (caused by yeast infection). Initial studies of gastrointestinal infections and bacterial gastrointestinal inflammation, inflammation of urinary tract infections and infections in children show that digestive tracts, such as those contained in acid milk without high temperature disinfection, contribute to restoring the health balance of the digestive bacteria.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 成功突破表层屏障进入到生物体内部的微生物或毒素会遭遇到先天性免疫系统的识别和攻击。先天性反应通常是当入侵者为模式识别受体识别后被触发。模式识别受体是先天性免疫系统的关键分子，它们可以识别许多不同病原体中的保守组分，也可以识别发出警告信号的受损伤或受压细胞。先天性免疫对病原体的攻击是非特异性的，也就是说该系统是以一种通用的方式来对抗病原体。先天性免疫系统能够快速地对广泛的病原体入侵做出反应，但不能够对某一病原体产生持久的免疫。这一免疫系统是大多数生物体中的主要防御系统。
target_text: Microbes or toxins that successfully break through the surface barrier into the organism are exposed to the identification and attack of the congenital immune system. The congenital response is usually triggered when the invasive is in the form of recognition of the receptor. The mode of identification of the receptors is a key element of the congenital immune system, which can identify conservative components in many different pathogens, as well as damaged or pressured cells that give warning signals. The congenital immunisation attacks on pathogens are non-specific, which means that the system is a universal approach to the pathogen. The congenital immune system can react quickly to a wide range of pathogen invasions, but it is not capable of producing lasting immunisation of a particular pathogen.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 免疫系统对抗感染的第一步反应就是炎症反应。炎症的特点是红肿，这是因为炎症部位的血液流入量增加而引起。炎症是引发自类二十烷酸（eicosanoid）和细胞因子，这两类分子由受损或被感染的细胞所释放。类二十烷酸包括可以导致发烧和血管舒张（与炎症相关）的前列腺素和可以吸引特定白血球（如粒细胞）的白三烯。一般的细胞因子则包括负责白血球之间联系的白介素、促进细胞化学趋向性的趋化因子以及具有抗病毒作用（如关闭宿主细胞的蛋白质合成）的干扰素。此外，炎症反应还可能释放生长因子和细胞毒因子。所有这些细胞因子和其他相关化学物质将免疫细胞带到受感染部位，并且在消灭病原体后促进受损组织的复原。
target_text: The first response of the immune system to infection is inflammation. Inflammation is characterized by red swelling, which is caused by an increase in blood inflow in the inflammated parts of the disease. Inflammation is the triggering of cytochemical acid (eicosanoid) and cell factors, both of which are released by damaged or infected cells.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 补体系统是对入侵的外源细胞表面进行攻击的一种生化级联反应。这一系统包含了超过20种不同的蛋白质；这些蛋白质被称为“补体”，因为它们可以补充协助抗体来消灭病原体。补体是先天性免疫反应中主要的体液免疫组分。除了哺乳动物，许多物种，包括植物、鱼类，甚至一些无脊椎动物都具有补体系统。
target_text: The rehydration system is a biochemical cascade response to an attack on the surface of an invasive external cell. The system contains more than 20 different proteins; these proteins are referred to as “supplements” because they can supplement the antibodies to eliminate pathogens. The rehydration is the main body fluid component of the congenital immune response. With the exception of mammals, many species, including plants, fish, and even some invertebrates, have a rehydration system.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 人体内，补体系统的激活是通过补体与识别了病原体的抗体结合或与病原体微生物表面的多糖结合来完成。补体结合信号可以引发快速的免疫攻击反应。这种快速的反应是来源于对补体分子一系列的蛋白酶解所引起的结果。补体分子本身就是蛋白酶。在与微生物结合（初始信号）后，补体分子激活了自己的蛋白酶活性。被激活的补体分子通过酶解其它补体分子来激活它们，这一过程不断循环，被激活的补体分子快速增加。这就形成了一个催化级联反应，通过这种可调控的正反馈从而放大了初始信号。这一级联反应导致大量产生被酶解的多肽，这些多肽可以吸引免疫细胞、提高血管通透性以及附着在病原体表面（方便免疫系统识别）。补体分子的沉积也会破坏病菌的细胞膜，达到杀菌的目的。
target_text: In humans, the rehydration system is activated either by rehydration with antibodies that identify pathogens or by a combination of multiple sugars on the surface of the pathogen microorganisms. The rehydration signal triggers a rapid immune attack response. This rapid response is the result of a series of protein enzyme decompositions on the remedial molecules. The rehydration molecules are themselves protein enzymes. After integration with microbes (initial signals), the rehydrated molecules activate their protein enzyme activity. The activated rehydration molecules activate them through enzyme decomposition with other rehydration molecules, a process that circulates continuously, and the activated rehydration molecules rapidly increase.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 白血球（白细胞）以类似于独立单细胞组织的方式来工作，构成了先天性免疫系统的第二只手。先天性免疫白血球包括了吞噬细胞（巨噬细胞、中性粒细胞和树突状细胞）、肥大细胞、嗜酸性粒细胞、嗜碱性粒细胞以及自然杀伤细胞。这些细胞以接触攻击较大的病原体或吞噬并杀死较小的微生物的方式，来识别并消灭入侵物。自然杀伤细胞还是激活适应性免疫系统的重要介导物。
target_text: White blood cells (white cells) work in a manner similar to independent monocellular tissues, forming the second hand of a congenital immune system. Innate immunoglobin cells include ingestion cells (macro-eating cells, neutral particle cells and tree mutagenic cells), fat cells, acidic cellular cells, alkaline cellular cells, and natural killer cells. These cells identify and eliminate invasive substances by contacting larger pathogens or by ingestion and killing smaller microbes. Natural killer cells are also important guides for activating adaptive immune systems.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 吞噬作用是吞噬细胞通过包裹、吞噬病原体或颗粒的过程，也是细胞型先天性免疫的重要特征。吞噬细胞通常會在身體各處巡邏來搜尋病原體，但其也可以被細胞因子召喚到特定位置。病原體被吞噬細胞所吞噬後，被包裹在一種被稱為吞噬體的胞內囊體內；隨後吞噬體與溶酶体融合形成吞噬溶酶体。在吞噬溶酶体中，病原體被其中的消化性酶所殺死，或者被所釋放的自由基所殺死。吞噬作用的机制来源于细胞对于营养物质的摄取，但被吞噬细胞作为手段利用于吞噬病原体。吞噬作用可能是最古老的宿主防御形式，因为在无脊椎动物中也发现了吞噬细胞的存在。
target_text: The digestive effect is the process by which the cell consumes a pathogen or particle, and it is an important feature of the congenital immunisation of the cell type. In the digestive body, the cells usually search for the pathogen, but they can also be called to a specific location by cell factors. When the pathogen is swallowed by cells, it is wrapped in a intracranium known as the ingested body; it is then integrated with the soluble body into an absorbent enzyme. In the digestive body, the pathogen is killed by the digestive enzyme in it, or by the release of the free base. The mechanism is derived from cell intake of nutrients, but the ingestion cell is used as a means of ingestion of the pathogen. The ingestion effect may be the oldest form of host defenses, because the presence of the digestive cells has also been found in the invertebrates.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 巨噬细胞和噬中性顆粒白血球可以在体内寻找并攻击入侵的病原体。噬中性顆粒白血球通常存在于血液中，是数量最多的吞噬细胞，能够佔到血液中白血球总数的50-60%。在炎症发生的急性阶段，特别是细菌引起的感染，噬中性顆粒白血球可以快速移动到炎症发生处（又被称为趨化性），也是第一个到达患处的免疫细胞。巨噬细胞是多功能细胞，位于组织内，可生产非常多种类的化合物，包括各种酶、补体蛋白、调控因子（如干扰素1）。巨噬细胞具有“清道夫”的功能，能够清除机体内受损老化的细胞和细胞碎片。巨噬细胞也可以作为抗原呈递细胞，激活适应性免疫系统。
target_text: In acute stages of inflammation, especially bacteria-induced infections, the ingestion of white cells can move quickly to the place where the disease occurs (also known as mutagenicity) and to the first immune cell to reach the disease. The cell is a multifunctional cell, located in the tissue, which produces a very diverse range of compounds, including enzymes, refilled proteins, control factors (e.g., interferon 1) that have the function of “cleaners” and can remove old-age cells and cell fragments that are damaged in the machine. The cell can also act as an antigen delivery cell, activating an adaptive immune system.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 树突状细胞是一種吞噬细胞，主要位于与外界环境接触的组织内，包括皮肤、鼻腔、肺、胃以及小肠。这种免疫细胞的名字来源于它们与神经树突之间的相似性，都具有大量的突起状结构，但树突状细胞与神经系统并没有直接联系。由于可以将抗原呈递给T细胞（适应性免疫系统中的关键细胞之一），因此树突状细胞可以作为身体组织和免疫系统之间的联络橋梁。
target_text: The names of these cells are derived from the similarities between them and the neurosurgery, but the mutagenic cells are not directly linked to the nervous system. Because antigens can be transmitted to T-cells (one of the key cells in the adaptive immune system), the mutine cells can serve as a bridge between the body organization and the immune system.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 肥大细胞位于结缔组织和粘膜内，调控發炎反应。它们通常与过敏或全身性過敏性反應相关。嗜酸性和嗜碱性顆粒白血球类似于噬中性顆粒白血球；它们分泌化学物质来参与抵御寄生虫，也在过敏反应中发挥作用。自然杀手细胞并不直接攻击入侵者，却能够攻击并杀死肿瘤细胞和被病毒侵入的细胞。
target_text: Fat cells are located within the bonding tissue and mucous membrane to manage inflammation. They are usually associated with allergies or all-round allergie reactions. Acid and alkaline white blood cells are similar to a neutral white blood cell; they are secretive chemical substances that are involved in resistance to parasites and also play a role in allergies. Natural killer cells do not attack invaders directly, but can attack and kill tumor cells and virus-invasive cells.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 适应性免疫系统是从早期脊椎动物开始演化而来，可以提供更强的免疫应答和免疫记忆，使得每个病原体都可以通过特征性的抗原表位而被免疫系统“记住”。适应性免疫应答具有高度的抗原特异性，能够经一个被称为抗原呈递的过程来识别“非自身”抗原。抗原的特异性使得应答的产生更有针对性。而这种针对性的应答是由体内的免疫记忆细胞来实现的。如果一个病原体入侵机体超过一次，这些特异性的记忆细胞能够迅速地消灭这一病原体。
target_text: Adaptive immune systems have evolved from early vertebrates to provide stronger immune responses and immunological memory, allowing each pathogen to be “remembered” by a characteristic antigen profile. Adaptive immune responses have a high antigen properties that identify “non-self” antigens through a process known as antigen delivery. Antigen properties make the response more relevant. This specific response is done by internal immune memory cells.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
淋巴细胞
适应性免疫系统中的细胞被称为淋巴细胞，属于特殊类型的白细胞。B细胞和T细胞是主要的淋巴细胞，由骨髓中的造血干细胞分化而来。B细胞主要参与体液免疫，而T细胞则参与细胞免疫。B细胞和T细胞都携带能够识别特定靶标的受体分子。T细胞负责识别“非自身”靶标，如病原体，但需要抗原（病原体上的一些小片段）经处理并由一种被称为主要组织相容性复合体（MHC）的“自身”受体呈递之后才能实现。T细胞主要有两类：细胞毒性T细胞和辅助型T细胞。杀伤型T细胞只能识别由I型MHC分子呈递的抗原，而辅助型T细胞只能识别II型MHC分子呈递的抗原。这两种抗原呈递机制反映了两类T细胞所具有的不同作用。还有少量的T细胞属于第三类，即γδ T细胞，识别不结合MHC分子的完整抗原。
target_text: The cells of the lymphatic immune system are called lymphocytes, which are of a particular type of white cell. The B and T cells are the main lymphocytes, divided by stem cells in bone marrow. The B and T cells are mainly involved in body fluid immunisation, while the T cells are involved in cytotoxicity. The B and T cells carry receptors capable of identifying specific targets. The T cells are responsible for identifying “non-self” targets, such as pathogens, but require antigens (a few fragments of the pathogens) that are treated and transmitted by a “self” receptor known as the main tissue compatibility complex (MHC). There are also a small number of T-cells that belong to the third group, i.e. the T-cells and the auxiliary T-cells.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
胞毒T细胞
细胞毒性T细胞是T细胞中的一个亚群，能够杀死被病毒（或其他病原体）感染的细胞或者受损和失去功能的细胞。与B细胞类似，不同类T细胞能够识别不同的抗原。当其细胞表面的T细胞受体特异性地结合抗原，并与其他细胞表面的I型MHC分子共同形成复合物时，杀伤型T细胞就会被激活。对MHC-抗原复合物的识别是由T细胞表面的（CD8）来协助完成。而后，激活的T细胞会在整个身体内巡游来寻找是否有细胞表面带有这一抗原的I型MHC受体分子。一旦接触到这些细胞，T细胞就会释放细胞毒素，如穿孔素，能够在靶细胞的细胞膜上形成孔洞，从而杀死细胞。由T细胞分泌的另外一种毒素，颗粒溶素（一类蛋白酶），能够进入靶细胞并引发细胞凋亡。T细胞杀死受感染的宿主细胞对于防止病毒复制至关重要。同时对于健康细胞而言，不受控的T细胞将是十分危险的。因此，T细胞的激活受到高度调控，通常需要很强的MHC-抗原激活信号或者由辅助T细胞提供附加信号才能够激活T细胞。
target_text: T-cells are a sub-group of T-cells that can kill cells infected by viruses (or other pathogens) or damaged and dysfunctional cells. Similar to B-cells, different T-cells can identify different antigens. Once exposed to these cells, T-cells can release cell toxins, e.g. punctuates can form holes in the film of the target cell, thus killing the cells by another toxin of the T-cell secretion, a particle solubler (a type of protein enzyme), which can enter the target cell and trigger the death of the host cell.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 辅助型T细胞表达T细胞受体来识别结合在II型MHC分子上的抗原。同时，辅助型T细胞上的CD4分子作为辅助受体也参与结合MHC-抗原复合物，并招募T细胞内的其他分子来激活T细胞。与杀伤型T细胞相比，辅助型T细胞与MHC-抗原复合物的结合力较弱，这就意味着辅助型T细胞表面要有大量的受体（约200-300个）都结合上了MHC-抗原复合物才能够激活辅助型T细胞，而杀伤型T细胞只需要一个受体与MHC-抗原复合物结合就能被激活。辅助型T细胞的激活还需要抗原呈递细胞能够较长时间的参与。处于静止期的辅助型T细胞被激活后，会释放大量的细胞因子，从而影响许多类型细胞的活力。由辅助型T细胞所产生的细胞因子信号能够增强巨噬细胞的杀菌功能以及杀伤型T细胞的活力。除此之外，激活辅助型T细胞会导致T细胞表面分子（如CD154，CD40的配基）表达上调，为进一步激活生产抗体的B细胞提供额外的刺激信号。
target_text: Auxiliary T-cells express T-cell receptors to identify antigens associated with MHC-II molecules. At the same time, CD4 molecules on auxiliary T-cells are involved as auxiliary receptors in the MHC-antigen compound, and other molecules within the T-cells are recruited to activate T-cells. Compared to anti-personnel T-cells, the combined strength of assisted T-cells with MHC-antigen complexes is weak. This means that a large number of receptors (approximately 200-300) on the surfaces of assisted T-cells are combined to activate the MHC-antigen compound in order to activate the auxiliary T-cell, which requires only a receptor in combination with the MHC-antigen compound to activate the T-cell. In addition, the activation of assisted T-cell cells requires the long-term participation of the anti-transmission cell. When the auxiliary T-cell cells are activated, a large number of cells are released, thereby affecting the dynamism of many types of cells.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
γδ T细胞
γδ T细胞具有与一般T细胞不同的T细胞受体，同时带有自然杀伤细胞、杀伤型T细胞和辅助型T细胞的多种特性。γδ T细胞产生免疫反应的条件还不十分清楚。如同其他非典型的T细胞亚型，γδ T细胞的界定跨越了先天性和适应性免疫。一方面，由于可以通过T细胞受体的基因重排产生多样性的抗体并具有免疫记忆，γδ T细胞被认为是适应性免疫系统中的组分。另一方面，由于其表面的限制性T细胞受体或自然杀伤细胞受体可以作为模式识别受体来发挥作用，因此多种γδ T细胞也被归于先天性免疫系统的一部分。例如，大量的人源Vγ9/Vδ2 T细胞可以对微生物产生的分子迅速（几个小时之内）发生反应，表皮内的高度限制性Vδ1+ T细胞会对受损的表皮细胞发生快速反应。
target_text: T-cells  T-cells have a different T-cell receptor than the normal T-cells, with multiple properties of natural antigenesis cells, antikillers T-cells, and auxiliary T-cells. The conditions for immune reactions from T-cells are not clear. As with other atypical T-cell sub-types, the definition of T-cells cuts across congenital and adaptive immunity. On the one hand, T-cells are considered to be components of an adaptive immune system because of the diversity of antibodies that can be produced through the re-routing of the genes of the T-cell receptors. On the other hand, because their restricted T-cell receptors or natural anti-cell receptors on the surface can function as modes of identification of the receptors, multiple T-cells are also part of a congenital immune system. For example, a large number of human sources can react quickly to molecules produced by micro-organisms (in a few hours), with highly restrictive V-11 + T cells in the surface skin react rapidly to damaged surface cells.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
B淋巴细胞和抗体
B细胞通过其表面的抗体分子特异性结合外源抗原，从而识别病原体。所形成的抗原-抗体复合物被B细胞吞噬，这一抗原在细胞内被分解为肽段。随后B细胞将这些抗原性肽段通过其细胞表面的II型MHC分子呈递出来。这种MHC与抗原的组合吸引来合适的辅助型T细胞，而T细胞接着释放淋巴因子并激活B细胞。激活的B细胞开始分裂，所产生的子代细胞（浆细胞）分泌出数百万个能够识别该抗原的抗体拷贝。这些抗体在血浆和淋巴液内循环，结合到表达对应抗原的病原体上，被抗体所标识的病原体很快被补体系统或吞噬细胞所消灭。抗体也能够直接抵御（“中和”效应）病原体的入侵，通过与细菌毒素结合或与细菌和病毒表面受体（用于感染细胞）结合，来阻止病原体的感染。
target_text: B-lymphocytes and antibodies B cells identify pathogens through their surface antibody-specific combinations of antigens. The antigen-antibodies formed are swallowed by B-cells, which are decompositioned into platinum. B-cells then transmit these antigen Sections through their cell surfaces of type II MHC molecules. These MDCs attract appropriate auxiliary T-cells in combination with antigens, which then release lymphoids and activate B cells. The activated B-cells begin to split, resulting in the release of millions of antigen cells (mask cells) that can identify the antigens, either through a combination of bacterial toxins or through a combination of bacterial and lymphoric fluids, and are quickly eliminated by the antigens marked by the antigens, which are also directly resistant to infection, either by refilling the system or by digestive cells.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
其他适应性免疫系统
虽然适应性免疫系统中的经典分子（如抗体和T细胞受体）仅存在于有颌类脊椎动物，一种不同于经典分子的淋巴细胞衍生分子被发现存在于初等无颌类脊椎动物中（如七鰓鰻和盲鳗）。这些动物可生成大量被称为“可变淋巴受体”的分子，这些分子产生于少量（一到两个）基因，功能被认为接近有颌类脊椎动物中的抗原受体，以类似抗体的高度特异的结合方式来识别病原性抗原。
target_text: Other adaptive immune systems, although classic molecules in adaptive immune systems (e.g. antibodies and T-cell receptors) are present only in vertebras, a lymphatic cell derivative that is different from classical molecules is found to be present in primary vertebras (e.g. thips and blind eels). These animals can produce a large number of molecules known as “modifiable lymphatic receptors”, which are derived from a small number (one or two) of genes and are considered to be close to antigens in vertebrates, identifying pathogenic antigens in a highly specific combination similar to antibodies.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 当B细胞和T细胞被激活后，就会开始复制分裂以产生子代细胞，这些子代细胞中的一部分会成为长寿的记忆细胞，例如记忆B细胞、记忆T细胞、骨髓浆细胞（BMPC；区别于血循浆细胞 CPC，circulating plasma cells）。在动物的一生中，这些记忆细胞能够记住免疫系统所遇到的每一个特定的病原体，一旦再次接触到此病原体就会触发强烈的免疫反应。这便是“适应性”，因为机体的免疫系统能够以此对入侵病原体产生适应，从而随时准备着应对入侵者的挑战。免疫记忆可以分为短期被动记忆和长期主动记忆。
target_text: When B- and T-cells are activated, they begin to reproduce splits in order to generate generational cells, and a part of these generational cells becomes long-lived memory cells, such as memory B cells, memory T cells, bone marrow cells (BMPC; distinct from plasma cells, CPC, circulating Plasma cells). During an animal's life, these memory cells can remember every particular pathogen encountered by the immune system, triggering a strong immune response once again. This is “adaptation”, because the immune system of the organism can adapt to the invasive pathogens and thus be ready to respond to the invader's challenge. Immunization memory can be divided into short-term passive and long-term active memory.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
被动记忆
新生婴儿由于没有接触过病原体，因此特别容易发生感染。而母亲可以为婴儿提供多种被动免疫保护。在怀孕期间，一种被称为IgG的抗体从母亲体内直接通过胎盘进入胎儿体内，使得婴儿即使在出生时体内也具有高的抗体水平，并且与母体的抗原识别特异性保持一致。母乳或牛初乳也含有抗体，可以进入婴儿肠道来保护其免受细菌感染，直到新生儿能够自己产生抗体。无论是胎儿期还是婴儿发育早期，其体内的免疫都是被动免疫，因为其机体并没有产生任何记忆细胞或抗体，只是借用母体。这种被动免疫通常是短期的，持续时间从几天到几个月。在医学上，通过注射含丰富抗体的血清，能够将保护性被动免疫从一个个体人为地转移到另一个个体。
target_text: Passive memory Newborn infants are particularly vulnerable to infection because they have not been exposed to pathogens. During pregnancy, an antibody known as IgG enters the foetus directly through the placenta from the mother, allowing the baby to have a high antibody level even at birth and consistent with the antigen identity of the mother. Breast milk or first milk of a cow also contains antibodies that can enter the infant ' s intestinal tract to protect it from bacterial infection until the newborn is able to produce an antibody itself.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
主动记忆与免疫接种
长期主动记忆是通过感染而激活B细胞和T细胞来获得的。主动免疫也能够通过疫苗接种来产生。疫苗接种的原理是将来自病原体的抗原注入机体来刺激免疫系统，在不引起疾病的情况下引发免疫记忆。这一技术的成功在于它充分利用了免疫系统所具有的天然特异性和可诱导性。由于感染性疾病依然是导致死亡的主要原因之一，疫苗接种可以说是人类对免疫系统最有效的改造。
target_text: Active memory and immunization The long-term active memory is acquired through the activation of B and T cells by infection. Active immunization can also be produced through vaccination. The rationale for vaccination is to inject antigens from pathogens into the organism to stimulate the immune system, triggering immunological memory without causing disease. The success of this technique is that it takes full advantage of the natural peculiarities and induction of the immune system.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 多数病毒疫苗是基于毒性弱化病毒开发的，而许多细菌疫苗则是来源于微生物中的非细胞组分，包括无害的毒素组分。由于来自于非细胞性疫苗中的许多抗原无法有效地诱导适应性反应，多数细菌疫苗中还添加了免疫佐剂（能够激活先天性免疫系统中的抗原呈递细胞），从而最大化免疫原性。
target_text: Most virus vaccines are developed on the basis of less toxic viruses, while many bacterial vaccines are derived from non-cellular components in microbes, including harmless toxin components. Since many antigens from non-cellular vaccines cannot effectively induce adaptive reactions, most bacterial vaccines also add immunosulants (which can activate antigen delivery cells in congenital immune systems), thereby maximizing immunosynthesis.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
免疫功能低下
当免疫系统中的一个或多个组分失去活性就会造成免疫功能低下或免疫缺陷。一般而言生物體的免疫運作到足以產下子代的時間結束後就逐漸衰敗，免疫系統在有生殖力的期間會達到高峰，繁殖週期結束後就會下降，人体的免疫力是在50岁之后开始下降，出现，會引發癌症等一系列疾病，中年以後易得癌症，這就是原因之一。剔除年龄因素，在发达国家，肥胖、嗜酒和滥用药品都是导致免疫功能低下的因素。而在发展中国家，营养不良则是引起免疫功能低下的主因。饮食缺乏足够的蛋白质与免疫力低下密切相关，包括损害细胞介导免疫、补体活力、吞噬细胞功能、IgA抗体浓度以及细胞因子的产生。缺乏单个营养元素，如铁、铜、锌、硒、维生素A、C、E和B6，以及叶酸 （维生素B9），也能够降低免疫反应活力。此外，在发育早期，由于基因突变或者外科手术导致胸腺缺失，会引起严重的免疫力低下并且很容易感染疾病。
target_text: Immunisation is low when one or more components of the immune system lose activity, resulting in low immune function or deficiency. In general, the biological immune system is declining after the end of the period sufficient to produce the offspring, the immune system reaches a peak during reproductive periods, drops after the end of the reproductive cycle, the human immune system starts to decline after the age of 50, causes a series of diseases, such as cancer, and is prone to cancer in the middle of the year. Excluding the age factor, obesity, alcohol addiction and substance abuse are factors that contribute to the low immune function in developed countries. In developing countries, malnutrition is the main cause of the low immune function.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 与免疫功能低下对应的另一个极端是过度免疫反应，其同样会损害人体健康，造成自体免疫紊乱疾病。当免疫系统无法正确区分自体和异体抗原时，就会攻击自身部分机体。通常情况下，能够识别自身抗原的淋巴细胞在人体发育早期就会消失。位于胸腺和骨髓中的特异化细胞将自体抗原呈递给新生淋巴细胞，并将能够识别自体抗原的细胞消灭，从而阻止自体免疫。
target_text: Another extreme that corresponds to the low immune function is the excess immune response, which can also damage human health and cause autoimmune disorders. When the immune system fails to distinguish itself from antigens, it attacks parts of its own body. Usually, lymphocytes that can identify their antigens disappear early in human development. Feminized cells in the prostate and bone marrow transmit their own antigens to newborn lymphocytes and will be able to identify their own antigens, thereby preventing autoimmune.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
超敏反应是损害自身机体的免疫反应。按照超敏的反应机制和时程，可以分为四类（I-IV）。I型超敏反应是一种即时的、急性的反应，通常与过敏相关，症状多样，从轻微的不适到死亡都可能出现。I型超敏反应由免疫球蛋白IgE所介导，当与抗体相连时，能够触发肥大细胞和嗜碱性粒细胞的脱颗粒作用。当抗体结合到患者自身细胞的抗原上时，就会引起II型超敏反应，摧毁这些细胞。因此，这类反应又被称为抗体依赖（或细胞毒性）超敏反应，主要由IgG和IgM介导。
免疫复合物（包括抗原聚集体、补体蛋白、IgG以及IgM抗体）如果没有被及时清除，可能诱发III型超敏反应。IV型超敏反应又被称为细胞依赖型或延迟型超敏反应，通常发展2至3天后才产生症状。IV型超敏反应多出现于自体免疫和感染性疾病中，也出现于接触性皮炎。这类反应由T细胞、单核细胞及巨噬细胞所介导。
target_text: Hyper-asymptom reactions are immune reactions that damage their organisms. Four types (I-IV) can be divided according to the ultra-asymptomatic response mechanism and time frame. The type I hyper-asympirical reaction is an immediate, acute reaction, usually associated with allergies, with a variety of symptoms, from mild discomfort to death. The type I hyper-asymptom response is guided by immunoglobin Ige, which, when connected to the antibodies, triggers the de-particleization of the fat cells and the alkaline particle cells. When the antibodies are combined with the antigens of the patient ' s own cells, the type III super-asymptomatic reaction is associated with the destruction of these cells. Thus, the type IV hyper-asymptom response is also referred to as the cell-dependent or delayed hyper-asymptoms.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 多组分的适应性免疫系统很可能是从第一个脊椎动物开始出现的，因为无脊椎动物不能够产生淋巴细胞，也没有基于抗体的体液免疫反应。但许多物种都发展出了免疫机制，这些机制可能是脊椎动物免疫系统的前身。免疫系统甚至在构造上极为简单的生命形式中就已经出现。细菌就可以利用一种被称为“限制性修饰系统”的独特的防御机制来保护自身免受病毒的侵害（针对细菌的病毒被称为“噬菌体”）。原核生物也具有适应性免疫，主要是利用CRISPR序列保留过去接触过的噬菌体基因组中的基因片段，使得生物体可以通过RNA干扰的形式来阻止病毒在体内复制。
target_text: Multiple adaptive immune systems are likely to emerge from the first vertebrates, because invertebrates are unable to produce lymphocytes and have no antibodies-based liquid immune reactions. But many species have developed immune mechanisms, which may be the precursor of the vertebrate immune system. The immune system has emerged even in very simple forms of life.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 除了相对复杂的免疫系统外，生物体还进化出了多种多样的免疫机制。模式识别受体是几乎所有生物体都具有的能够识别病原体相关分子的一类蛋白质。抗菌肽（如防御素）是构成先天性免疫的重要组分，存在于所有动植物中，也是无脊椎生物中主要的免疫形式。多数无脊椎动物也具有补体系统和吞噬类细胞。核酶和RNA干扰通路广泛存在于真核生物中，被认为参与了针对病毒的免疫反应。
target_text: In addition to relatively complex immune systems, organisms have evolved a variety of immune mechanisms. Model identification of receptors is a group of proteins that can identify disease-related molecules in almost all organisms. Antibacterium (e.g. defensives) is an important component of congenital immunisation, present in all plants and plants, and the dominant form of invertebrates.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 不同于动物，植物体内缺少吞噬类细胞。因此，植物类免疫反应主要采用全身性的化学信号。单个植物细胞对病原体相关分子，如病原相关分子模式产生免疫反应。当植物的一部分被病原体侵染，植物体就会进行局部的超敏反应，使得侵染处的细胞迅速凋亡，以阻止病区向植物体的其他部分扩散。系统获得性抗性是另一类植物特有的防御反应，可以使整株植物抵抗某一类特定传染物。RNA沉默机制可以破坏病毒的复制，因此在这种全身性反应中尤为重要。
target_text: Unlike animals, plants have a lack of ingestion cells. Thus, plant-based immune reactions are mainly based on chemical signals of a systemic nature. Individual plant cells have immune reactions to pathogen-related molecules, such as the pathogen-related molecule model. When a part of a plant is infected with a pathogen, the plant body reacts with a partial hypersensitivity, causing the infested cell to collapse quickly in order to prevent the spread of the disease to other parts of the plant body.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 免疫系统另一个重要功能是发现和消灭肿瘤。肿瘤细胞会表达一些未在正常细胞中发现的抗原。对于免疫系统而言，这些肿瘤抗原是入侵者，它们的存在导致免疫细胞对肿瘤细胞进行攻击。肿瘤抗原来自于多个方面。有部分抗原是由致癌病毒所生成，如能够导致子宫颈癌的人類乳突病毒。有很多情况下，肿瘤抗原是生物体内自身蛋白，只是因为在正常细胞中的表达水平很低，而在肿瘤细胞中表达过高。例如，酪氨酸酶的高量表达会将特定的皮肤细胞（黑素细胞）转变为肿瘤，即黑色素瘤。还有一种可能的肿瘤抗原来源是通常在调控细胞生长和存活中发挥重要功能的蛋白质，它们在异常情况下却能够诱导癌症的产生，因此被称为原癌基因。
target_text: Another important function of the immune system is the discovery and elimination of tumours. Oncological cells express antigens that are not found in normal cells. For the immune system, these tumor antigens are invaders, whose presence causes immunocytes to attack tumor cells. The tumor antigens are produced in many ways. Some of the antigens are carcinogens, such as human emulsional viruses that can cause cervical cancer. In many cases, the tumor antigens are self-protein in organisms, simply because the level of expression in normal cells is low and they are overexpressed in tumor cells.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 免疫系统针对肿瘤的应答主要是利用杀伤型T细胞来摧毁异常细胞，有时候也需要辅助型T细胞的参与。类似于病毒抗原，肿瘤抗原的呈递也是通过I型MHC分子来进行，使得杀伤型T细胞能够将肿瘤细胞作为异常细胞进行识别。自然杀伤细胞也能够通过类似途径杀死肿瘤细胞，特别是当肿瘤细胞表面的I型MHC分子少于正常细胞的情况（这也是肿瘤细胞的普遍现象）。有时生成针对肿瘤细胞的抗体，也让补体系统也可以参与到消灭肿瘤的进程中。
target_text: The response of the immune system to tumours is mainly to destroy abnormal cells using lethal T-cells, sometimes with the participation of auxiliary T-cells. Similar to the virus antigens, the formulation of anti-cancer antigens is also carried out through the I-MHC molecules, which enable anti-cancer T-cells to be identified as abnormal cells. Natural killer cells can also kill tumor cells in a similar way, especially when I-MHC molecules on the surface of tumor cells are smaller than normal cells (which is also a common phenomenon in tumor cells).
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 一些肿瘤能够躲过免疫系统的监测，从而发展成为癌症。肿瘤细胞表面的I型MHC分子通常少于正常细胞，因此可以避免被杀伤型T细胞所发现。一些肿瘤细胞可以释放出一些因子来抑制免疫应答，如分泌能够降低巨噬细胞和淋巴细胞活性的细胞因子，转化生长因子-β。此外，针对肿瘤抗原的应答可能出现免疫耐受，使得免疫系统无法继续攻击肿瘤细胞。
target_text: Some tumors are able to escape surveillance of the immune system and thus develop into cancers. The I-MHC molecules on the surface of the tumor cells are usually smaller than normal cells, so they can avoid detection by lethal T-cells.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 矛盾的是，免疫系统中的巨噬细胞能够促进肿瘤生长。当肿瘤细胞释放出细胞因子并吸引巨噬细胞到肿瘤附近，巨噬细胞会合成细胞因子和生长因子，反过来促进肿瘤的生长。而且，肿瘤中的缺氧条件和巨噬细胞产生的细胞因子，会共同诱导肿瘤细胞来降低能够抑制转移的蛋白质的合成，从而促进癌细胞的扩散。
target_text: Paradoxically, macrophages in the immune system contribute to the growth of tumors. When tumor cells release cell factors and attract macrophages to the vicinity of the tumor, macrophages synthesize cell factors and growth factors, which in turn contribute to the growth of the tumor.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
生理调节
人体内的激素可以作为免疫调节剂，调控免疫系统的活力。例如，雌激素属于免疫激活剂，可以激活适应性免疫和先天性免疫一些自免疫疾病，如红斑性狼疮更容易发生于女性，常常出现于青春期女性（往往具有较高雌激素水平）。相反的是，雄激素则被认为具有免疫抑制作用。其他一些激素也可以调节免疫系统，特别是催乳素、生长激素和维生素D。有理论猜测人体激素水平随年龄增大而降低是导致老年人免疫力低的影响因素之一。不仅激素可以调节免疫系统，免疫系统反过来也可以调节部分激素，如甲状腺激素的活性。
target_text: Physiology Hormones within the human body can be used as immune regulators to regulate the dynamics of the immune system. For example, estrogens are immunogens that activate adaptive and congenital immune self-immunisation diseases, such as haemorrhage, which are more likely to occur in women and often in adolescent women (often at higher estrogen levels). On the contrary, male hormones are considered immune inhibitive. Other hormones can also regulate the immune system, especially emulsions, growth hormones and vitamin D. There are theoretical speculations that lowering levels of human hormones with increasing age is one of the factors that contribute to the low immunology of older persons. Not only hormones can regulate the immune system, but the immune system can in turn regulate the activity of parts of hormones, such as thyroid hormones.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 免疫系统与睡眠和休息之间也有紧密联系。睡眠剥夺会损害免疫功能。联系免疫系统与睡眠的是复杂的反馈网络，包括了一些细胞因子。例如，针对感染而产生的白介素1和肿瘤坏死因子-α，能够参与调控非快速动眼睡眠。因此，由感染引起的免疫反应可以导致睡眠周期的改变，包括非快速动眼期中的慢波睡眠。
target_text: There is also a strong link between the immune system and sleep and rest. Sleep deprivation undermines the immune function. The connection between the immune system and sleep is a complex feedback network, which includes a number of cell factors. For example, white-septo1 and cancer-negative cause of death -- alpha -- are able to participate in regulating non-fast-motion sleep. Thus, the immune response caused by the infection can lead to changes in the sleep cycle, including slow-wave sleep during the non-fast-motivated eye period.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
营养与饮食
如同其他体内系统，免疫系统的功能依赖于正常的营养供应。长期以来，人们已经形成共识，严重的营养不良会导致免疫缺陷。同样，营养过剩所引起的疾病，如糖尿病和肥胖症，能够破坏免疫功能。而中度营养不良以及缺乏特定微量元素和营养，也会减弱免疫应答。胎儿期营养缺乏甚至会导致终身免疫系统缺陷。
target_text: Nutrition and diet, like the rest of the internal system, the functioning of the immune system depends on normal nutrition supplies. There is a long-standing consensus that severe malnutrition can lead to immune deficiency. Similarly, diseases caused by overnutrition, such as diabetes and obesity, can disrupt the immune function.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 食物可以影响免疫系统。新鲜的水果、蔬菜和富含特定脂肪酸的食物可以帮助保持健康的免疫系统。在传统医学中，一些草药被认为可以激活免疫系统，如紫錐花、甘草、人参、黄芪、鼠尾草、大蒜、接骨木和牛膝草等，甚至蜂蜜；但还需要进一步的研究来了解它们的作用机制。
target_text: Food can affect the immune system. Fresh fruits, vegetables, and foods rich in specific fatty acids can help maintain a healthy immune system. In traditional medicine, some herbs are thought to activate the immune system, such as violets, licorice, thiram, sage, garlic, skeletal wood and cow knees, or even honey; but further research is needed to understand their functioning mechanisms.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 药用真菌，如香菇、灵芝、云芝、姬松茸和灰树花，可能具有上调免疫系统功能，得到了一些体内、体外及有限的临床研究结果的支持。而这些真菌中具有调控免疫功能的活性物质可能是一大类多糖，特别是β-葡聚醣和α-葡聚醣（如从香菇中提取的活性己糖相關化合物）。β-葡聚醣激活免疫系统的机制还不十分清楚。一种可能的机制是通过与在多种免疫细胞中表达的补体受体3（CD18）相互作用来影响免疫系统。其他免疫受体，如Toll样受体2，Dectin-1、乳糖神经酰胺（lactosylceramide）和也被发现能够接受来自β-葡聚醣的信号。
target_text: The drug fungi, such as mushrooms, Lindzis, Yunzi, gypsies, and grey bushes, may have an upscaling of the immune system, supported by some internal, in vitro, and limited clinical research. The active substances in these fungus that have a regulated immune function may be a large group of sugar, especially beta-plusomium and alpha-plupodium (e.g. active glucose-combined compounds extracted from mushrooms). The mechanism for activating the immune system is not yet clear. One possible mechanism is to affect the immune system by interacting with the receptor 3 (CD18) expressed in multiple immune cells.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 通过对免疫系统进行人工干预，一方面可以激活免疫防御来对抗容易躲过免疫系统的病原体，另一方面可以抑制由于自体免疫、过敏或器官移植所导致的不利的免疫反应。免疫抑制药可以用于控制自免疫紊乱或过度组装损伤引起的炎症反应，也用于抑制器官移植后的排斥反应。
target_text: Immunological inhibitors can be used to control inflammatory reactions caused by autoimmune disorders or overassembly damage, as well as to suppress exclusionary reactions after organ transplantation.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 消炎药常用于控制炎症作用。以糖皮质激素为代表的该类药物，疗效明显；然而由于它们会引起多种副作用（如中心肥胖、中暑、骨质疏松），治疗时的用量需要严格控制。低剂量的消炎药常常与细胞毒性或免疫抑制类药物（如氨甲蝶呤或硫唑嘌呤）联用。细胞毒性药物通过杀死快速分裂的细胞，如被激活的T细胞，从而抑制免疫反应的发生。但这种无区分的杀伤作用同样会破坏其他持续分裂的细胞，而损害相关器官组织，引起毒副作用。免疫抑制药物，如环孢素，可以通过抑制细胞信号转导通路来阻止T细胞对信号进行应答。
target_text: Inflammants are often used to control the effects of inflammation. The effects of this type of drug, represented by sugar cortex, are obvious; however, because of their multiple side effects (e.g., central obesity, heat, or osteoporosis), the amount of treatment needed to be strictly controlled. Low-dose antiinflammants are often associated with cell toxicity or immunosulfan (e.g., ammonium butterflies or sulphate). Cell toxicity drugs inhibit immune reactions by killing rapidly divided cells, such as activated T-cells.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
病原体对抗免疫系统的对策
任何病原体要成功存活，必须能够逃避宿主免疫系统的攻击。因此，病原体进化出了多种方法使得它们能侵染宿主而又不被免疫系统探测到和杀死。细菌经常能够分泌一些消化性酶（如）来降解并通过宿主细胞膜。也有一些细菌利用III型分泌系统将其针状结构插入宿主细胞膜，直接将自己的蛋白质(effectors)输入到宿主体内。而这些蛋白质可被用于关闭或激活宿主细胞的免疫系统。
target_text: In order for any pathogen to survive successfully, it must be able to escape the host's immune system. As a result, the pathogens have evolved in ways that allow them to infect the host without being detected and killed by the immune system. Bacteria are often able to separate digestive enzymes (e.g.) to degrade through the host cell membrane. There are also bacteria that use the third-style secretion system to insert their needle structure into the host cell membranes and directly input their proteins (effectors) into the host. These proteins can be used to shut down or activate the host cell's immune system.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 病原体逃避宿主先天性免疫系统的机制非常多样。一种常见的策略是躲藏在宿主细胞内部（又被称为胞内致病）。在胞内致病机制中，病原体主要躲在宿主细胞内度过其生命周期，从而避免直接接触免疫细胞、抗体和补体。例如，病毒、沙门氏菌（可引起食物中毒）以及真核类的寄生虫，包括疟原虫（疟疾）和利什曼原虫（利什曼病）。有一些病菌，如结核分枝杆菌，被包裹在一个保护性的胶囊内，可以防止被宿主内的补体所裂解。很多病原菌会分泌化合物来降低或误导宿主的免疫反应。还有的细菌可以生成生物膜来保护自身免遭免疫系统的攻击。这类生物膜出现在许多病菌感染中，如绿脓杆菌和伯克氏菌（感染特征为引起肺部的囊肿性纤维化）。其他一些细菌可合成菌体表面蛋白质，用于结合抗体，使抗体失效。这类的例子包括链球菌、金黄色葡萄球菌和消化链球菌。
target_text: A common strategy is to hide within host cells (also known as intrasynthetic disease). In intrasynthetic mechanisms, pathogens spend their life cycles mainly in host cells, thus avoiding direct exposure to immune cells, antibodies and rehydration. For example, viruses, salmonella (which can cause food poisoning) and parasites of the nuclear species, including falciparum (malaria) and leishmaniasis (Lishman disease). There are a number of pathogens, such as bacterium tuberculosis and bacterium (which is characterized as causing cystic fibrosis in the lung), that can be contained in a protective capsule. Many of the pathogens are used to reduce or mislead the host’s immune response.
title: 免疫系统

source_text: 病原体逃避适应性免疫系统的机制更为复杂。最简单的策略是快速改变自身非必要的抗体识别表位（位于病原体表面的氨基酸、糖类），同时隐藏必要的表位。这一机制被称为。一个典型的例子是HIV，病毒可进行快速突变，使得位于病毒包膜（包裹HIV病毒）的蛋白质处于不断地改变之中。这种高频率的抗原变异导致疫苗难以奏效。寄生虫布氏罗得西亚锥虫也采用了类似的策略，持续地变换表面蛋白质，频率快于抗体反应，使得抗体攻击失去目标。另一种常用的逃避机制是利用宿主自身的分子来蒙蔽抗体。例如，HIV病毒可以用宿主细胞的外层细胞膜构建包裹病毒体的囊膜。采用这种逃避机制的病毒使免疫系统难以将其识别为外源物质而进行消除。
target_text: The simplest strategy is to quickly change their non-essential antibody identification tables (amino acids, sugars, on the surface of the pathogens) while concealing the required profile. This mechanism is described as. One typical example is HIV, which allows rapid mutations of the virus, leaving the proteins in a viral film (a package of HIV virus) constantly changing. This high frequency of antigen mutation makes the vaccine ineffective. A similar strategy has been adopted by the parasitic dichotomy, which constantly alters the surface proteins, faster than the antibody response, making the antibody target unattended. Another common escape mechanism is the use of the host ' s own molecules to shield the antibodies. For example, the HIV virus can construct the capsules of the packaged virus with the outer cellular membranes of the host cell.
title: 免疫系统

source_text:
垃圾电邮的防制：
設置多重E-Mail：將重要的E-Mail只通知給認識的人，而與廠商交易、較危險的，則利用其他較不重要、不在意且較少使用、打開的信箱
少公布自己的E-Mail，甚至在自己的網站上，也應審慎斟酌，以其他方式告知
利用防制SPAM的軟體。此外，ISP亦有責任來阻斷其上的SPAM網站。
target_text: Set up multiple E-Mails: to communicate important E-Mails only to people who know each other, and to trade with manufacturers, who are more dangerous, to use other, less important, uninterested and less-used, open mailboxes to keep their E-Mail less public, even on their own websites, and to inform in other ways about the use of anti-SPAM software. In addition, ISPs are responsible for blocking their SPAM websites.
title: 垃圾電郵

source_text:
來源
“SPAM”最初是一個罐裝肉的牌子。對於這個牌子的名字來源有很多解釋，官方版本說它是“Specially Processed Assorted Meat”，特殊加工過的混合肉。這種SPAM在二戰後糧食短缺的歐美非常普及，1970年蒙提·派森中有個喜剧小品就叫Spam，劇中兩位顧客試圖點一份沒有SPAM的早餐，但却无法如愿。在互联网流行后，Spam被用來稱呼互聯網上遍布的垃圾郵件。
target_text: The source “SPAM” was originally a canned meat brand. There are many explanations for the name of the brand, the official version of which says it is a special processed mix of meat. This SPAM is very popular in Europe and America, where food shortages after World War II. In 1970, Monty Pearson had a comedy little item called Spam, and two guests tried a single breakfast without SPAM, but it was not possible to do so.
title: 垃圾電郵

source_text:
歷史
最早出現的濫發電子信息源自垃圾傳真（Spam Fax），至今許多商業機構每天仍然會收到大量廣告傳真。此外，近年垃圾電郵（Spam Email）的問題也相當嚴重，有調查報告指出，於用戶收到的電郵之中，平均有60%至90%均是垃圾郵件。這些垃圾郵件除了廣告以外，部分更包含詐騙內容，甚至包含了間諜軟體、木馬程序等，以盜取用戶的私人資料。
target_text: In addition, the problem of spam e-mails has been serious in recent years, and there have been reports that 60 to 90% of e-mails received by users are, on average, spams. In addition to the ads, some of these e-mails contain fraud, and even spy software, wooden horse programs, etc., to steal personal information from users.
title: 垃圾電郵

source_text: 在垃圾電子郵件出現之前，美國一位名為桑福德·華萊士（或稱Spamford或「垃圾福」）的人，成立了一間公司，專門為其他公司客戶提供收費廣告傳真服務，由於惹起接收者的反感，以及浪費紙張，於是美國立法禁止未經同意的傳真廣告。後來垃圾福把廣告轉到電子郵件，垃圾郵件便順理成章地出現。
target_text: Prior to the arrival of the spam e-mail, a company called Sanford Wallace (or Spamford or "Spamford") had been set up in the United States to provide a fee-paying advertising fax service to other company clients, in response to the revulsion of recipients and the waste of paper, and the legislation in the United States prohibited unconsensual fax advertising. The spam was then transferred to e-mail, and the spam appeared in an orderly fashion.
title: 垃圾電郵

source_text: 垃圾邮件一般具有批量发送的特征。内容包括赚钱信息、成人广告、商业或个人网站广告、电子杂志、连环信等。垃圾邮件可以分为良性和恶性的。良性垃圾邮件是各种宣传广告等对收件人影响不大的信息邮件。恶性垃圾邮件是指具有破坏性的电子邮件。
target_text: Spam is typically a mass delivery feature. It includes income-generating information, adult advertising, commercial or personal website advertising, electronic magazines, serial mail, etc. Spam can be classified as benign and malignant. Good spam is a message that has little impact on recipients, such as advertising.
title: 垃圾電郵

source_text: 一些有心人會從網上多個BBS論壇、新聞組等收集網民的電腦地址，再售予廣告商，從而發送垃圾郵件到該些地址。在這些郵件，往往可找到「從收信人的清單移除」的連結。當使用者依照連結指示去做時，廣告商便知道該地址有效，使用者便會收到更多垃圾郵件。
target_text: Some interested people collect Internet users' computer addresses from several BBS forums, news groups, etc., and sell them to advertisers, sending spam messages to those addresses. In these emails, links are often found to "remove from the recipient's list". When users follow the link instructions, the advertisers know that the address is valid, and users receive more spam.
title: 垃圾電郵

source_text: 隨著垃圾郵件的問題日趨嚴重，多家軟件商也各自推出反垃圾郵件的軟體。但「道高一尺，魔高一丈」，垃圾郵件的格式更加日新月異，以避過此類軟體的偵測。現時，多個國家已立法，試圖設法杜絕垃圾郵件。不少網絡服務供應商的服務政策也有包含反垃圾郵件，並設立用作投訴的電郵地址。也有一些網上團體，提供郵件分析及代客送往相關的ISP作出投訴的服務。

source_text: 由于英文文字是由26个字母排列组合而成的文字，因此可以简化输入步骤；相比较之下汉字则不能如此，从字形上汉字虽然可以拆解成不同的部分，但是被分成的部首或偏旁数量过多，这样不但不能达到简化输入的目的，反而显得更为繁琐。于是从汉字字音上去考虑，汉字输入被分成少量的语音元素组合排列，反而可以达到简化输入的步骤。因为是语音输入对汉字的读音必须清楚，某些生僻字或不知道汉字发音的则会很困难，这在一定程度上限制了汉字的输入。

「巰」（qiú）：氫（q-）、硫（-iú）

繁体字：由中國自古承襲演變的文字，優點是單一字內含意深遠，缺點則是筆畫較多，標準寫法的書體書寫速度较慢。
简化字：相對於傳統漢字，是簡化程度比較大的，廢除且合併了很多字，也簡併了很多的部件，優點是書寫容易、快速，缺點是有时难以精密用字，辨識困難，导致同义词增多，例如：「-{头发黑}-」，一般理解成「-{頭髮黑}-」，另一種則為「-{頭發黑}-」，且比起繁体字较失美观，因此在写书法时通常仍使用繁体字。

source_text: 稀有气体（），又称-{zh-cn:惰性气体;zh-tw:稀有氣體;zh-sg:稀有气体;}-、懶性氣體、鈍氣、贵气体等，是指在元素週期表中同屬第18族（舊稱ⅧA族）的化學元素。它们性质相似，在常温常压下都是无色无味的单原子气体，很难參與化学反应。天然存在的稀有气体有六种，即氦（He）、氖（Ne）、氩（Ar）、氪（Kr）、氙（Xe）和具放射性的氡（Rn）。而人工合成的（Og）原子核非常不稳定，半衰期極短，因此目前未能通過化學實驗來研究其性質。根据元素周期律，除了氖的反應活性最低外，其餘惰性氣體的反應活性隨著原子序的增大而漸高，因此估计鿫應比氡更活泼。而且，理论计算显示，鿫可能会非常活泼，以至于不一定能称为-{惰性}-气体。
target_text: Rare gases () – also known as {zh-cn: Inert Gases; zh-tw: Precious Gases; zh-sg: Precious Gases;}, Lazy Gases, Slugs, Precious Gases, etc., refer to chemical elements belonging to the 18th ethnic group (formerly known as the VIIIA) in the elemental chronology. They are similar in nature and are non-colourable single-atomic gases under constant temperature pressure, making it difficult to participate in chemical reactions. Six types of natural rare gases, i.e. helium (He), ne (Ne), zircon (Ar), Kr, Xe) and radioactivity (Rn), are expected to grow higher than the atomic sequence.
title: 稀有气体

source_text: 稀有气体的特性可以用现代的原子结构理论来解释：它们的最外电子层的电子已「满」（即已达成八隅体状态），非常稳定，极少參與化学反应，至今只成功制备出几百种稀有气体化合物。每种稀有气体的熔点和沸点十分接近，温度差距小于10 °C（18 °F），因此它们仅在很小的温度范围内以液态存在。
target_text: The properties of rare gases can be explained by modern atomic structure theory: their outermost electronic layers are “full” (i.e., they have achieved an eight-dimensional state), are very stable, are rarely involved in chemical reactions, and have so far succeeded in producing only a few hundred rare gas compounds. The melting and boiling points for each of these rare gases are very close, with temperature differences of less than 10 °C (18 °F), so that they exist in liquid form only within a very small temperature range.
title: 稀有气体

source_text: 经气体液化和分馏方法可从空气中获得氖、氩、氪和氙，而氦气通常提取自天然气，氡气则通常由镭化合物经放射性衰变后分离出来。稀有气体在工业方面主要应用在照明设备、焊接和太空探测。氦也会应用在深海潜水。如潜水深度大于55米，潜水员所用的压缩空气瓶内的氮要由氦代替，以避免氧中毒及氮麻醉的徵状。另一方面，由于氢气非常不稳定，容易燃烧和爆炸，现今的飞艇及气球都采用氦气替代氢气。
target_text: Gas liquefied and distilled methods can extract americium, americium, kryptonium and neptunium from air, while helium is usually extracted from natural gas, and radon is usually separated by radioactive decay of radon compounds. Rare gases are mainly used in industry for lighting, welding and space detection. Helium is also used in deep-sea diving. If dive depths are greater than 55 metres, the nitrogen in the compressed air bottle used by divers is replaced by helium to avoid oxygen poisoning and nitrogen anesthesia.
title: 稀有气体

source_text:
名稱
自從惰性氣體在十九世紀始為人知，其性質越趨透澈而多次改名。化學家最初認為它們很罕見，稱之為稀有-{}-氣體（rare gases）。不過，並非所有气体都很少見，這種說法只適用于部分气体。例如氬氣在地球大氣層的含量占0.9%，勝過二氧化碳；而氦氣在地球大氣層的含量確實很少，但在宇宙卻相當充沛，佔25%，僅次於氫。所以化學家又改稱惰性-{}-氣體（又稱鈍氣，inert gases），表示它們在普通环境不化学反应，不曾在自然出現過化合物。對於那些早期需藉由化合物來尋找元素的科學家來說，這些元素甚難尋找。不過，最近研究指出它們可以借助人工合成的方式和其他元素結合成化合物（此即稀有气体化合物），故最後改稱noble gas，這稱呼是由雨果·埃德曼於1898年所用的德语词Edelgas翻譯而來，表示它們极不活潑，难以反應，但並非不能產生任何化合物，类比于与极不活潑的惰性金属（noble metal）。
target_text: The name has been changed several times since the 19th century, when the inert gas was known to have a relatively small amount of helium, but in the universe it is quite abundant, with 25% next to helium. Thus, the chemicalist has changed its name to inertia {}- gasses (also known as sulfur, inert gasses), stating that they are not chemically reacting in the ordinary environment and that they have not appeared naturally in compounds. For scientists who need to use compounds to find elements at an early stage, these elements are hard to find, but recent studies have pointed out that they can use synthetic and other elemental synthetic compounds (i.e., rare gas compounds), and finally, noble gass, which cannot be used in 18-year-old German-based versions of the Edelb.
title: 稀有气体

source_text: 在中文譯名方面，兩岸三地有不同稱呼。中国大陆全国自然科学名词审定委员会於1991年公佈的《化学名词》中正式规定「noble gases」稱為稀有-{}-气体一词。香港教育局的《中學化學科常用英漢辭彙》稱「noble gases」為（高）貴-{}-氣體，而一般社會仍有使用惰性-{}-氣體的稱呼。而台灣方面，由國家教育研究院的國立編譯館建議常稱「noble gases」為惰性-{}-氣體，比較少用鈍氣（但審定高中以下化學課本統一使用鈍氣）、稀有-{}-氣體等，然而最近也有稱為-{zh-cn:高贵气体;zh-tw:高貴氣體; zh-hk:稀有氣體;zh-sg:高贵气体}-。

source_text: 1868年8月18日，皮埃尔·让森和约瑟夫·诺曼底·洛克伊尔在观测太阳的色球层时，发现一种发射光谱中有黄色谱线的物质，他们把该物质命名为“氦”（、），该词源自希腊语(ílios)，意为“太阳”。在他们之前，英国化学及物理学家亨利·卡文迪什已经在1784年在空气中发现一种微量的物质，其化学反应活性比氮气还低。一个世纪之后的1895年，瑞利勋爵比较空气中分离出的氮气和化学反应所产生的氮气，发现它们的密度有所不同。瑞利勋爵与伦敦大学学院的科学家威廉·拉姆齐合作，推测从空气提取的“氮气”与另一气体混合物。此后，他们通过实验顺利地分离一种新的元素：氩，此名称源自希腊语(argós)，意思为“不活跃”。由此发现，元素周期表上欠缺一整类的气体。在寻找氩气期间，拉姆齐重复美国地质学家希尔布兰德的实验，即把钇铀矿放在硫酸中加热，他通过此法成功的分离出氦气。1902年，德米特里·门捷列夫接受氦和氩元素的发现，并这些稀有气体纳入他的元素排列之内，分类为第0族，而元素周期表即从该排列演变而来。
target_text: On August 18, 18, 1868, Pierre Jansen and Joseph Normandy Locke, while observing the coloured layers of the Sun, discovered a substance with yellow spectra, which they named “helium” (ilios) in Greek, meaning “the Sun.” Prior to them, British chemists Henry Cavendish had discovered a trace in the air in 1784, with chemical activity lower than nitrogen. In 1895 a century later, Lord Riley compared nitrogen gas from air separations and chemical reactions, and found that the density of the substance was different. During the search, Lord Ridley worked with William Ramzi, a scientist at the University of London, presumably “nitrogen gas” from air and another gas mixture. They had successfully separated a new element in the air: the name of the Greek language (argós), which meant that it was not active.

source_text: 拉姆齐继续使用分馏法把液态空气分离成不同的成分以寻找其他的稀有气体。他于1898年发现三种新元素：氪、氖和氙。“氪”源自希腊语“(kruptós)”，意为“隐藏”；“氖”源自希腊语“(néos)”，意为“新”；“氙”源自希腊语“(xénos)”，意为“陌生人”。氡于1898年由弗里德里希·厄恩斯特·当发现，最初取名为镭放射物（radium emanation），但当时并未列为稀有气体。直到1904年才发现它的特性与其他稀有气体相似。1904年，瑞利和拉姆齐分别获得诺贝尔物理学奖和化学奖，以表彰他们在稀有气体领域的发现。瑞典皇家科学院主席西德布洛姆致词说：“即使前人未能确认该族中任何一个元素，却依然能发现一个新的元素族，这是在化学历史上独一无二的，对科学发展有本质上的特殊意义。”
target_text: Ramsey continues to use distillation to separate liquid air into different components in search of other rare gases. source_text: 稀有气体的发现有助于对原子结构一般理解的发展。在1895年，法国化学家亨利·莫瓦桑尝试將氟（电负性最高的元素）与氩（稀有气体）反应，但没有成功。直到20世纪末，科学家仍无法制备出氩的化合物，但这些尝试有助于发展新的原子结构理论。由这些实验结果，丹麦物理学家尼尔斯·玻尔於1913年提出，在原子中的电子以电子层形式围绕原子核排列，除了氦气以外的所有稀有气体元素的最外层的电子层总是包含8个电子。1916年，吉尔伯特·路易斯制定八隅体规则，指出最外电子层上有8个电子是任何原子最稳定的排布；此电子排布使它们不会与其他元素发生反应，因为它们不需要更多的电子以填满其最外层电子层。
target_text: The discovery of rare gases contributed to the development of general understanding of the atomic structure. By these experiments, Danish physicist Niels Boer proposed in 1913 that electrons in atoms should be placed around the atomic nuclear layer in electronic form, with all rare gas elements except helium always containing eight electrons. In 1916, Gilbert Lewis developed the Eight Body Rule, noting that eight electrons in the outermost electronic layer were the most stable of any atoms; this electronic fabric prevented them from reacting with other elements, as they did not need more electrons to fill their outer layers.

source_text: 自然存在与制备稀有气体在宇宙中的丰度随着原子序数的增大而降低。氦是宇宙中仅次于氢的最丰富的元素之一，质量分数大约为24%。宇宙中的大部分氦都是在太初核合成中形成的，但是由于恒星核合成中的氢的聚变，氦的数量仍在不断增加。地球上的丰度则完全不同，氦仅仅是大气中第三丰富的稀有气体。这种不同的原因是大气层中没有太初氦，因为氦的原子质量太小，无法被地球的引力场吸引在地球表面附近，因此會散逸至太空中。地球上的氦来自地壳中重元素（例如铀和钍）的α衰变，这样产生的氦往往积聚在天然气田中。另一方面，较丰富的氩来自于钾-40的β衰变。钾-40同样存在于地壳中，它衰變产生的氩-40是地球上最丰富的氩同位素，尽管它在太阳系中相当稀少。这个过程是钾氩测年法的理论基础。氙在大气中的丰度比预想的要低，这被称作“氙失踪问题”（）。有一种理论认为缺少的氙可能被限制在地壳的矿石中。二氧化氙发现后，有研究认为氙能取代硅酸中的硅从而固定在地壳中。氡在岩石圈中通过镭的α衰变生成。它会通过裂缝逸出石材进入建筑物，并在通风不佳的建筑物内积聚。因为氡的放射性很强，它对人体健康有很大的危害。估计仅在美国每年就有21000人死于氡引发的肺癌。
