target_text: Americium, americium, americium, americium and americium are obtained by using gas liquefied methods in the air, liquidizing the gases and distilling them according to the boiling point, separating the mixture into different fractions. Helium is usually extracted from natural gas, and radon can be separated from the products of radioactive decay of radon compounds. The price of rare gases depends on their natural abundance, so americium is the cheapest and most expensive. The table on the right gives the sale price of the rare gases that were tested in 2004 in the United States.
title: 稀有气体

source_text: 稀有气体的熔沸点非常低，是用途广泛的低温学工作介质。特别是沸点低达4.2K（−268.95 °C）的液氦可以用于冷却核磁共振成像和核磁共振波谱法所需的超导磁铁。尽管液氖的冷却温度没有液氦那么低，但是仍在低温学中广泛使用，因为它的制冷量是液氦的40倍、液氢的3倍。
target_text: The melting point for rare gases is very low, and it is a widely used cryogenic medium. In particular, liquid helium at a low boiling point of 4.2K (−268.95 °C) can be used as a superconductor magnet for cooling MRI imaging and MRI spectrometry. Although cooling temperatures are not as low as helium, they are still widely used in cryogenics, as it is 40 times more refrigerant than helium and three times hydrogen.
title: 稀有气体

source_text: 因为氦在液体尤其是脂质中的溶解度较低，它在潜水员的呼吸气体中代替了氮气。人受到类似于水肺潜水的压力时，气体会被血液和人体组织吸收，这会造成氮麻醉的严重后果。因为溶解度远比氮气小，少量的氦被带入细胞膜。而用氦代替呼吸混合气中的部分成分时（例如三混气和氦氧混合剂），潜入较深后上浮时的麻醉反应可以大大减轻。氦的低溶解性为减压病提供了很好的解决方案。由于溶解在体内的气体减少，上浮时由于减压而形成的气泡将大大减少。另一种稀有气体氩被视作水中呼吸器潜水最好的防水衣填充气体。氦也用作核反应堆中核燃料棒的填充气体。
target_text: Because helium is less soluble in liquids, especially in lipids, it replaces nitrogen gas in the breathing gas of divers. When people are under pressure similar to water lung diving, the gas is absorbed by blood and human tissue, which has serious consequences for nitrogen anesthesia. Because solubility is much smaller than nitrogen, a small amount of helium is brought into the membrane. When helium is replaced with some of the components of the respiratory mixture (e.g. a mixture of trifluoride and helium oxygen), an anaesthetic reaction can be significantly reduced when it reaches a deeper depth. Helium ' s low solubility provides a good solution for depressive disease.
title: 稀有气体

source_text: 稀有气体在许多场合中用于提供惰性气氛。氩在化学合成时常用于保护对氮气敏感的化合物。固态氩也用于研究活性中間體等非常不稳定的化合物，方法是在超低温下将其隔离在固态氩构成的基质中。氦是气相色谱法中的载色剂、温度计的填充气，并用于盖革计数器和气泡室等辐射测量设备中。氦和氩都用作焊接电弧的保护气和贱金属的焊接及切割的惰性保护气。它们在其他冶金过程和半导体工业中硅的生产中同样有着广泛应用。
target_text: Aphids are often used in chemical synthesis to protect nitrogen-sensitive compounds. Solid-state americium is also used to study highly unstable compounds, such as active intermediate bodies, by isolating them at ultra-low temperatures in the matrix of solid-state americium. Helium is the coloring agent in the gas chromatography, the filling of thermometers, and is used in radiometric equipment such as lidometers and bubble chambers. Helium and americium are also used to protect the protective gas and the welding and cutting of base metals from electric arcs. They are also widely used in other metallurgical processes and in the production of silicon in the semiconductor industry.
title: 稀有气体

source_text: 由于化学活性很低，稀有气体广泛的应用于照明领域。氩和氮的混合气体是白炽灯中填充的保护气。氪可降低灯丝的蒸发率而常用于色温和效率更高性能白炽灯，特别在卤素灯中可将氪与少量碘或溴的化合物混合充入。此外，在放电灯中填充不同的稀有气体，可以产生不同颜色的光，如霓虹灯中常见的氖灯。尽管称为氖灯，其中通常含有其他气体和磷，它们在氖发出的橙红色光的基础上加入了其他颜色。氙通常用于氙弧灯，因为它们的近连续光谱与日光相似。这种灯可用于电影放映机和汽车前灯等。
target_text: The mixture of americium and nitrogen is the protective gas filled in in incandescent lamps. Kryptonium can reduce the evaporation rate of the lamps and is often used in color-temperature and more efficient performance incandescent lamps, especially in halogen lamps, where it can be combined with a small amount of iodine or bromine compounds. Moreover, different rare gases can be filled with electrical discharge lamps, which can produce different colours, such as neon lamps. Although called neon lamps, which usually contain other gases and phosphorus, they add other colours on the basis of orange red light emitted by thorium.
title: 稀有气体

source_text: 稀有气体可用于准分子激光器，这是因为它们可形成短暂存在的电子激发态受激子（）。这些用于激光器的受激子可能是稀有气体二聚体，例如Ar2、Kr2或Xe2，更有可能是与卤素结合的受激子，例如ArF、KrF、XeF或XeCl。这些激光器产生波长较短的紫外线，其中ArF产生的紫外线波长为193纳米，而KrF为248纳米。这种高频率的激光使高精密成像成为现实。准分子激光有诸多工业、医药和科学用途。集成电路制造过程中的显微光刻法和微制造必须用到准分子激光。激光手术，例如血管再成形术和眼部手术也需用到准分子激光。
target_text: Rare gases can be used for quasi-molecular lasers because they can form short-lived electron excites (). These high-frequency lasers may be rare gas bins, such as Ar2, Kr2 or Xe2, which are more likely to be associated with halogens, such as ARF, KrF, XeF or XeCl. These lasers produce short wavelength ultraviolet rays, of which ARF produces an ultraviolet wavelength of 193 nm and KrF 248 nm. These high-frequency lasers make high-precision images a reality. Paramole lasers have a number of industrial, medical and scientific applications.
title: 稀有气体

source_text: 一些稀有气体有直接的医学用途，如：氦有时用于改善哮喘患者的呼吸；氙则因为在脂质中的高溶解度成为一种麻醉剂，比常用的一氧化二氮（俗称笑气）更为有效，且容易从体内排出而麻醉后苏醒也较快。氙在超极化核磁共振成像中用于拍摄肺的医学影像。具有强辐射性的氡只能微量制取，可用于放射线疗法。
target_text: Some rare gases have direct medical applications, such as helium, which is sometimes used to improve the breathing of asthma patients; and americium, which becomes an anesthetic because of its high solubility in lipids, is more effective than the commonly used nitrous oxide (commonly known as laughter) and easier to excrete from the body and wakes up faster after anesthesia. Amerium is used in ultra-polar MRI imaging to take medical images of the lungs.
title: 稀有气体

source_text: 大多數離子推進器以惰性氣體作為推進劑。由於離子推進器不是以化學反應驅動的，因此需要化學惰性的燃料來防止燃料與推進器上的任何其他物質發生不必要的反應，從而腐蝕機體，減短使用壽命，化學惰性的燃料也能避免對環境造成汙染。目前許多推進器都使用氙作為燃料，因為它的高原子序使其游離能很低，從而很容易電離。且氙在室溫下能夠以液態儲存，在推進器運作時可輕易轉化為氣體。然而，目前全球氙供應短缺且價格昂貴（2021年每公斤氙約3,000美元）。2018至2023年間，星鏈網路衛星上的霍爾效應推進器使用成本更低的氪作為燃料，之後星鏈衛星改用氬霍爾效應推進器以求更高的比衝。
target_text: Most of the ion thrusters use inert gas as a booster. Since the ion thruster is not driven by chemical reactions, chemical inert fuels are needed to prevent unnecessary reactions to fuel and any other material on the booster. However, global supply shortages and high prices (about $3,000 per kilogram in 2021) are currently being avoided. Hal effect on satellite network satellites are being used as fuel in 2018-2023.
title: 稀有气体

source_text:
气体放电发出的光的颜色取决于多个因素，包括：
放电参数（电流密度、电场和温度等的局部值——注意第一行中放电颜色的变化）；
气体纯度（少量杂质气体都可能影响颜色）；
放电管的材料（最后一行用厚家用玻璃制成的放电管会抑制紫外线和蓝光的产生）。
target_text: The colour of the light emitted by the gas discharge depends on a number of factors, including: Emission parameters (local values such as current density, field and temperature - noting changes in the colour of discharge in the first line); Gas purity (a small number of impurities may affect the colour); EOD material (the last line of discharge tubes made of thick household glass inhibits UV and blue light generation).
title: 稀有气体

source_text: 最明显的一个例子是Unix及类Unix系统，多个远程用户有权（如通过串行端口或Secure Shell）在同一时刻访问Unix Shell系统。另一个例子是在同一台机器上的多个终端上打开多个X Window会话——这也是一个使用瘦客户端的例子。类似的功能也在众多不属于类Unix系统的操作系统中可用，如Multics、VM/CMS、OpenVMS和多任务DOS.
target_text: The most obvious example is Unix and Class Unix, where multiple remote users have the right to access the Unix Shell at the same time (e.g. by serial port or Secure Shell). Another example is the opening of multiple X Windows sessions on multiple terminals on the same machine -- an example of a thin client. Similar functions are available in a number of unix operating systems that do not belong to the class, such as Multiics, VM/CMS, OpenVMS and multi-task DOS.
title: 多用户

source_text: Windows 3.1x需從MS-DOS操作系统執行。MS-DOS的文件管理程序被基于图标的程序管理程序（Manager）以及基于列表的文件管理程序（Winfile）取代，由此简化了程序的启动。控制面板作为系统设置的中心，包括了诸如界面颜色主题的有限控制功能。一些捆绑的应用程序也包括在Windows内，例如“-{zh-cn:写字板;zh-tw:小作家}-”、“计算器”等。
target_text: Windows 3.1x needs to be executed from the MS-DOS operating system. The MS-DOS file management program has been replaced by an icon-based program administration (Manager) and a list-based file management program (Windfile), thus simplifying the start-up of the program. The control panel serves as the centre of system settings, including limited control functions such as interface colour themes. Some bundled applications are also included in Windows, such as "-{zh-cn: writing board; zh-tw: little writer}, " calculator" etc.
title: Windows 3.1x

source_text: 在386增强模式中，如果DOS应用程序支持鼠标，则窗口化DOS应用程序可以让用户使用Windows鼠标指针操作程序中的菜单和其他对象。少数DOS应用程序（如Microsoft Word的最新版本）可以访问Windows剪贴板。Windows自身附带的驱动程序不能直接与DOS应用程序一起工作，并且鼠标等硬件需要在启动Windows之前加载DOS驱动程序。
target_text: In 386 enhancements, if DOS applications support the mouse, the window-based DOS application allows users to use the menus and other objects of the Windows mouse handler. A few DOS applications (e.g. Microsoft Word's latest version) can access the Windows clipboard. Windows' own spin-off driver cannot work directly with DOS applications, and hardware like the mouse will need to load the DOS driver before Windows is activated.
title: Windows 3.1x

source_text: Windows 3.1中的图标除了具有更详细的外观外还能够拖拽。假设文件与能够处理打印任务的应用程序（如文字处理器）相关联，则可以将文件拖拽到打印管理器图标上，该文件会由当前打印机打印。或者可以将文件拖拽出文件管理器并放到应用程序图标或窗口上进行处理。
target_text: The icon in Windows 3.1 can drag in addition to having a more detailed look. Assuming that a file is linked to an application that can handle printing tasks (e.g. a word processor), you can drag the file to the print manager icon, which is printed by the current printer. Alternatively, you can drag the file out of the file manager and put it on the application icon or window for processing.
title: Windows 3.1x

source_text:
架構
Windows 95的架构由Windows for Workgroups的386增强模式演变而来，旨在最大程度地兼容现有的MS-DOS和16位Windows程序与设备驱动程序，同时提供更稳定和更出色的系统性能。Windows 95的最低运作水平包括以32位保护模式运行的大量虚拟设备驱动程序（VxD）以及以虚拟8086模式运行的一个或多个虚拟DOS计算机。虚拟驱动程序负责处理物理设备（例如视频卡与网卡）、模拟虚拟机所使用的虚拟设备或提供各种系统服务。三个最重要的虚拟设备驱动程序分别是：
target_text: The structure of Windows 95 evolved from the Windows for Worldgroups 386 enhancement model, designed to maximize compatibility with existing MS-DOS and 16 Windows programs and equipment drivers, while providing more stable and superior system capabilities. Windows 95 operates at a minimum level that includes a large number of virtual device drivers (VxD) operating in 32-bit protective mode and one or more virtual DOS computers operating in virtual 8086 mode. Virtual drivers deal with physical equipment (e.g. video and web cards), virtual devices used in simulations of virtual machines, or systems services. The three most important virtual equipment drivers are:
title: Windows 95

source_text: 对物理媒体的访问请求被发送到输入/输出管理器，由其负责调度请求。每个物理介质都有自己的设备驱动程序：访问磁盘由端口驱动程序执行；访问SCSI设备则由在SCSI层上运作的微型端口驱动程序处理。端口与微型端口驱动程序绕过MS-DOS和BIOS，以32位保护模式执行读写操作，从而显着提高性能。若存储设备没有原生Windows驱动程序，或者设备被强制以兼容模式运行，则“实模式映射器”（Real Mode Mapper）可以通过MS-DOS访问此存储设备。
target_text: Access requests to physical media are sent to the input/output manager, who is responsible for dispatching requests. Each physical medium has its own device driver: access disk is executed by a port driver; access to SCSI devices is handled by a mini-port driver operating on the SCSI layer. Ports and mini-port drivers bypass MS-DOS and BIOS to perform reading and writing operations in 32-bit protective mode, thus making significant performance improvements. If there is no original Windows driver for storage, or if the device is forced to operate in compatible mode, the real model mapper (Real Mode Maper) can access the storage device via MS-DOS.
title: Windows 95

source_text: 32位Windows程序能够自行分配内存段，且内存段的大小可以任意调整。程序无法访问段外的存储区。 某个程序崩溃并不会使其他程序收到损坏。而在此之前，程序会使用固定的非独占64KB段。虽然64KB大小是DOS和Windows 3.x系统的严重障碍，但缺乏对排他性的保证是造成稳定性问题的原因，因为程序有时会彼此覆盖内存段。在Windows 3.x中，崩溃的程序会破坏其内存段周围的进程。
target_text: Thirty-two Windows programs are able to allocate their own RAMs, and the size of the RAMs can be adjusted at will. The program cannot access the storage areas outside them. A program crash does not cause damage to other programs. Until then, the program will use a fixed non-exclusive 64KB section. While the size of 64KB is a serious barrier to DOS and Windows 3.x, the lack of assurance of exclusivity is the cause of the problem of stability, because the program sometimes covers each other. In Windows 3.x, the crashing program disrupts the process around its RAM.
title: Windows 95

source_text: 在启动图形用户界面时，虚拟机管理器会接管与文件系统和磁盘相关的功能。MS-DOS本身被降级为16位设备驱动程序的兼容层。这与依赖于MS-DOS执行文件和磁盘访问的Windows早期版本形成对比（Windows for Workgroups 3.11在启用32位文件及磁盘访问时也能够在很大程度上绕过MS-DOS）。将MS-DOS保留在内存中允许Windows 95在合适的Windows驱动程序不可用时使用DOS设备驱动程序。Windows 95能够使用所有16位Windows 3.x驱动程序。
target_text: When the graphical user interface is activated, the virtual machine manager takes over functions associated with the file system and disk. MS-DOS itself is downgraded to the compatibility layer of the 16-digit device driver. This contrasts with the earlier version of Windows that relies on MS-DOS execution files and disk access (Windows for Worldgroups 3.11 can largely bypass MS-DOS when using 32 files and disk access). Keep MS-DOS in memory allows Windows 95 to use the DOS driver when the appropriate Windows driver is not available. Windows 95 can use all 16 Windows 3.x drivers.
title: Windows 95

source_text: 由于Windows 95基于DOS开发，Windows 95必须保持内部DOS数据结构与的数据结构同步。即使是原生32位Windows程序，启动程序时MS-DOS也会被短暂执行以创建称为“程序段前缀”的数据结构。MS-DOS甚至可能会在执行此操作时耗尽常规内存，从而阻止程序启动，而Windows 3.x首先在常规内存中分配固定段。由于内存段是固定分配的，Windows无法移动这些内存段，从而导致无法启动更多的程序。
target_text: Because Windows 95 is based on DOS development, Windows 95 must keep the internal DOS data structure synchronized with the data structure. Even with the original 32 Windows programs, MS-DOS will be executed briefly to create the data structure known as the Prefix to the program. MS-DOS may even run out of regular memory in order to prevent the program from starting, while Windows 3.x first assigns fixed segments to the conventional memory. Because the memory is assigned, Windows is unable to move the memory sections, making it impossible to start more programs.
title: Windows 95

source_text: 此外并在内存管理中，改进Windows 95在同一存储区段混合存放的16位与32位的程序码，易导致一个程序出错就会连带造成整个系统崩溃的问题。从Windows 98开始，存储管理上有革新的进步，即是将16位与32位程序码放在不同记忆体区段执行，一旦某一應用程序發生错误，可以单独关闭该程序，不影响整个系统持续正常的运作。
target_text: In addition, in memory management, improvements to the 16-32-digit combination of Windows 95 programs in the same storage area could easily lead to a program error that could lead to an entire system crash. Starting with Windows 98, there has been an innovation in storage management, i.e., the placement of 16-and-32-digit programs in different memory sections, which can be shut down separately, without affecting the system ' s continued normal functioning.
title: Windows 98

source_text: 从Windows 98开始的多任务操作系统，也与Windows 95的抢占式多任务处理有着完全不同的改善。它可以由使用者决定是平均分配系统资源进行多任务操作，或是将某一个较不急于达成、或完成时间较长的程式设为背景（后台）执行，高度增加了多任务的实用性。在Windows 98中，微软新增一个名为Windows Update的组件，此组件可以自动从微软官网下载系统的重大更新（2011年停止）。
target_text: The multitask operating system, which started with Windows 98, is also a completely different improvement from the Windows 95 occupation multitasking process. It can be decided by the user that the system ' s resources will be distributed evenly for multitasking operations, or that a program that is less hasty or has a longer time to complete will be implemented in a background (backstage) with a high degree of added multitasking utility. In Windows 98, Microsoft added a component called Windows Update, which can automatically download a major update of the system from the Microsoft web (stopped in 2011).
title: Windows 98

source_text:
Windows 98被人批评为没有足够的革新，第二版被批评不能在第一版的基础上自由升级，但这仅限于OEM版的98SE，只要是98SE正式销售版，依然可以從98第一版上进行直接升级。Windows 98的后续产品是Windows Me。產品生命週期
根据微软的消费者产品生命周期政策，对Windows 98的支持计划于2003年6月30日结束，然而，在2002年12月，微软将支持延长至2004年1月16日。2004年1月13日，以新兴市场的支持量为由，最终支持结束日期再次延长至2006年7月11日。
target_text: Windows 98 has been criticized for not having enough innovation, and the second edition has been criticized for not being able to upgrade freely on the basis of the first edition, but it is limited to OEM 98SE, which can still be upgraded directly from the first edition of 98. Windows 98 is followed by Windows Me. The product life cycle, based on Microsoft ' s consumer product life cycle policy, ended with support for Windows 98 on 30 June 2003, but in December 2002, Microsoft will extend its support until 16 January 2004. On 13 January 2004, the end date was extended again to 11 July 2006 on the basis of support from emerging markets.
title: Windows 98

source_text: Windows NT系列（包括Windows 2000、Windows XP等）的穩定性高於Windows 9x，當Windows NT出現致命錯誤而必須重新啟動時，會顯示BSoD畫面。BSOD画面上所显示的信息會有偵錯碼，例如：STOP: 0x0000004e，以及其簡短的錯誤訊息，用戶可以在微軟的技術支援網站 搜尋此偵錯碼出現時可能是什麼原因。但有時錯誤碼並不能讓使用者很快的找到導致藍白當機的原因，反而會误导用户，因此可能要以試誤法（trial and error）才能找出原因。
target_text: Windows NT series (including Windows 2000, Windows XP, etc.) have a higher level of stability than Windows 9x, and when Windows NT has a fatal error and must be restarted, BSOD is shown. The information shown on the BSOD image may be miscoded, for example: STOP: 0x00004e, and its short error message, and users may be able to search a Microsoft technology support site for the cause of the bug when it appears. But sometimes the wrong number does not allow users to quickly find the cause of the blue and white machine, it may mislead the user, and it may therefore be possible to find the reason in a trial error (trial and error).
title: 蓝屏死机

source_text: Windows 9x/ME發生之BSoD允许用户选择继续或者重新启动。但是，VxD一般不随便显示BSoD──它们一般只在一个不透過重新启动就无法修复的错误发生时才显示BSoD，因此当BSoD显示时，系统已经不稳定或死机。在Windows 9x時代，出现蓝屏的最常见原因是DLL-{zh-hans:地狱; zh-hant:衝突;}-，意即同一个DLL的多个版本造成的不兼容；当应用程序需要使用这些DLL时，Windows将它们载入到内存；如果替换了DLL，下一次应用程序载入DLL时它可能不是该应用程序所希望的版本，且这种不兼容性随着安装更多的新软件而增加。Windows NT系列的穩定性明顯優於Windows 9x，發生藍畫面死機的機率遠低於Windows 9x。
target_text: In Windows 9x/ME, BSOD allows users to continue or restart. However, VXD does not usually display BSOD - they usually show BSOD only when an error cannot be repaired without restarting, so when BSOD shows, the system is unstable or dead. In Windows 9x, the most common reason for the blue screen is DLL-{zh-hans: Hell; zh-hant: conflict;} - meaning incompatibility caused by multiple versions of the same DLDD; when applications need to use them, Windows loads them into memory; if the DL is replaced, it may not be the version that the application wants to have when the next application is on DL, and this incompatibility increases as more new software is installed.
title: 蓝屏死机

source_text: 蓝屏死机自Windows 1.0就已经存在。在Windows 1.x-2.x中，当Windows发现了版本过高的DOS系统时，它将会在继续启动前显示一个蓝底白字的界面“Incorrect DOS version”和一个列有内核模块及它们各自内存地址的列表。不过，这个蓝屏死机仍并非真正的系统错误；当真正的错误发生时，系统反而会锁死，或直接退出到DOS。Windows 3.0中设计了一个专门用来显示重要系统信息的对话框，这些信息通常会来自386增强模式下的驱动程序，或其他无法正常运行的程序。
target_text: The Blue Screen Killer has been in existence since Windows 1.0. In Windows 1.x-2.x, when Windows discovers an over-exploited DOS system, it will continue to display a blue bottom white interface, "Incorporate DOS Version" and a list of kernel modules and their respective memory addresses. However, the Blue Screen Killer is still not a real system error; when a real error occurs, the system is locked or exits directly to DOS. Windows 3.0 designs a dialogue box dedicated to displaying important system information, usually from drivers under the 386 enhanced mode, or other non-operational programs.
title: 蓝屏死机

source_text: 现在通常所说的蓝屏死机界面在Windows NT 3.1（Windows NT系列的首个系统，发布于1993年）中首次出现，并延续到了之后的所有Windows系统中。蓝屏死机界面通常由编写不良的驱动程序或故障的硬件引起，如内存故障、供电问题、过热或超出其规格限制的硬件。在Windows 9x的时代，系统内核中不完整的动态链接库或bug也会导致蓝屏死机。Windows 9x相比于后续的Windows版本，蓝屏死机非常常见。
target_text: The Blue Screen Killer interface, now commonly referred to, appears for the first time in Windows NT 3.1 (the first system in the Windows NT series, published in 1993) and continues into all subsequent Windows systems. The Blue Screen Killer interface is usually caused by poorly prepared drivers or malfunctioning hardware, such as kernel failure, power problems, overheating, or hardware exceeding its specifications. In Windows 9x, an incomplete dynamic link library or bug in the system’s nuclear system also leads to a blue screen deader. Windows 9x, compared to the subsequent Windows version, the Blue Screen Killer is very common.
title: 蓝屏死机

source_text: 蓝屏画面中显示的文本包括了错误码和它的名称（如“0x0000001E, KMODE_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED”），并在随后用括号括住四个与错误相关的值以方便维修。根据错误的不同，它可能还会显示问题发生的内存地址，以及在该地址下加载的驱动程序。此外，在屏幕的第二和第三部分可能还会分别显示所有已经加载的驱动程序和堆栈转储信息，而所给的驱动程序信息分为三列，每一列分别是驱动程序的基地址、驱动程序的创建日期和驱动程序的名称。
target_text: The text shown in the blue screen includes the error code and its name (e.g. “0x00001E, KMODE_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED”) and subsequently enclosed in brackets four values associated with the error for ease of maintenance. Depending on the error, it may also show the memory address where the problem occurred and the driver that was loaded under that address. In addition, the second and third parts of the screen may also show separately all loaded drivers and stacking information, while the driver information given is divided into three columns, each of which is the base address of the driver, the date of creation of the driver and the name of the driver.
title: 蓝屏死机

source_text: 默认情况下，Windows会在错误发生时创建一个内存转储文件，根据Windows版本的不同它可以小至64kB（小型转储），也可以大至RAM的完整复制（完全转储）。这个文件稍后可以使用调试器（一般是WinDbg）进行调试。调试器是进行堆栈追踪所必需的；并且由于蓝屏中的信息很有限，可能会造成误导或隐藏真正的原因，因此确定蓝屏的真正原因也需要它的参与。
target_text: By default, Windows creates a memory dump file at the time of the error, which can be as small as 64 kB (small as storage) or as large as the full re-storage of the RAM, depending on the Windows version. This document can be debuggered later (usually WinDbg). The debugger is necessary for stacking tracking; and because the information in the blue screen is limited, it may be misleading or hidden for real reasons, determining the true reason for the blue screen also requires its involvement.
title: 蓝屏死机

source_text: 在默认情况下，Windows XP被配置为只保存64kB的迷你转储文件，然后自动重启电脑。由于这一过程发生的非常迅速，蓝屏可能只会一闪而过甚至完全看不到，因此用户也很容易把它当作电脑随机重启的故障，直到重启完成后Windows提示刚刚曾发生过严重的错误。当然，可以通过关闭控制面板中“系统属性—高级—启动和故障恢复—系统失败”中的自动重启来达到显示蓝屏的目的。
target_text: By default, Windows XP is configured to save only the mini-repository file of 64kB, and then automatically reboot the computer. Because of the speed with which this process is taking place, the blue screen may only be flashed over or not at all, and users can easily use it as a random computer reboot failure until a serious error has just occurred after the restart has been completed.
title: 蓝屏死机

source_text: 蓝屏死机也可能由严重的引导加载程序错误引起。在该错误中，Windows由于存储驱动程序错误、文件系统损坏或其他类似的问题而无法访问引导分区。它的错误码是STOP 0x0000007B (INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE)。在这种情况下，Windows将不会保存任何内存转储文件。由于此时Windows无法从硬盘启动，因此要想修复这种错误就需要使用在Windows安装盘中所附带的工具。
target_text: The Blue Screen Killer may also be caused by a serious pilot loader error. In that error, Windows was unable to access the guide partition because of a storage driver error, file system damage or other similar problems. The error code was STOP 0x00007B (INACESSIBLE_BOT_DEVICE). In this case, Windows will not save any memory dump files. Since Windows could not start from a hard disk at this time, it would need to use the tool attached to the Windows installation disk to repair the error.
title: 蓝屏死机

source_text:
细节
在Windows Server 2012之前，蓝屏死机界面会显示一个大写的错误名称（例如APC_INDEX_MISMATCH）、一个十六进制的错误码（如0x00000001）和四个参数。一般的显示格式如下：根据错误码及其性质，参数可能会指出错误的原因和/或位置。此外，蓝屏界面上还会显示四段一般性的解释与建议，有时也会指出其他的技术信息，例如出错文件的名称和内存地址。
target_text: Details: Before Windows Server 2012, the Blue Screen Killer interface will display a capital error name (e.g. APC_INDEX_MISMATCH), a hexadecimal error code (e.g. 0x000001) and four parameters. The normal display format is as follows: depending on the error code and its nature, parameters may indicate the cause and/or location of the error. In addition, the Blue Screen interface will show four general explanations and recommendations, and sometimes other technical information, such as the name and memory address of the error file.
title: 蓝屏死机

source_text: 而随着Windows Server 2012的发布，蓝屏死机的界面大幅改动并删去了以上的所有信息，只留下了错误名称和一段简短的描述。Windows 8加入了一个哭脸的颜文字。不过，十六进制的错误码和参数仍然能在事件查看器和内存转储文件中被查询到。从Windows 10 版本 14393开始，增加了一个用于快速故障排除的二维码。
target_text: And with the release of Windows Server 2012, the blue screen interface significantly changed and deleted all of the above messages, leaving only the wrong name and a brief description. Windows 8 added a cry-faced text. However, hexadecimal error numbers and parameters can still be searched in the event viewer and memory transfer file. Starting with Windows 10 version 14393, a two-dimensional code for rapid failure resolution has been added.
title: 蓝屏死机

source_text:
名字由来
有说法认为，NT一名源自原NT首席领导者戴夫·卡特勒，曾经开发过OpenVMS系统的他将“VMS”一词，利用恺撒密码原理将每个字母向前递增一位，使之成为“WNT”。但NT的其中一名原设计师馬克·洛考夫斯基曾提到，NT一名源自该系统的目标处理器，代号为“N-Ten”的处理器。 在1998年比尔·盖茨的一次问答环节上，他透露“NT”一词曾经以逆向首字母缩略词的形式派生为“新技术”（New Technology）之意，但现已不再包含任何特定意义。尽管微软对于NT架构的系统产品仍描述为“基于NT技术构建”（台翻“NT技術平台”）（Built on NT Technology），但自Windows 2000之后基于NT架构的系统均抛弃了“NT”一词。
target_text: One of the NT’s original designers, Mark Lokovsky, mentioned that NT’s target handler, known as the “N-Ten” processor, originated from the former NT. In a question-and-answer session in 1998, Bill Gates revealed that the term “NT” had been given the meaning of “new technology” (New Technology) in the form of an abbreviation in reverse letters, but that it no longer had any specific meaning. Although Microsoft’s system product for NT architecture is still described as “building on the basis of NT technology” (the “NT technological platform”) (Built on NT Technology), the word “NT” has been abandoned since Windows 2000.
title: Windows NT

source_text: 截至2023年6月，用於個人電腦、平板電腦、智能手機和嵌入式設備的最新版本是Windows 11，版本22H2。用於服務器計算機的最新版本是Windows Server 2022，版本21H2。Windows的特殊版本也可以在Xbox視頻遊戲機上運行。版本歷史Windows可以指微软公司的某一个或全部操作系统产品，这些产品可以大致被分为以下几类：
target_text: As of June 2023, the latest version of Windows 11, version 22H2, for personal computers, tablet computers, smart phones and embedded devices. The latest version of the server computer is Windows Server 2022, version 21H2. The special version of Windows can also run on an Xbox video game. The version of Windows can refer to one or all of Microsoft's operating system products, which can be broadly grouped into the following categories:

source_text: Windows 2.0发布于1987年12月，相比于上一代更受欢迎。它对用户界面和内存管理等功能进行了多项改进。在Windows 2.03中窗口首度允许叠放，而这一改动也招来了苹果公司侵害其知识产权的诉讼。Windows 2.0中还引入了更复杂的快捷键和对扩展存储器的支持。除了完整的Windows外，有时也会有一些公司将自己的程序与仅运行时版的Windows集成在一起，使用户无需安装Windows就可以在MS-DOS上使用他们的程序。
target_text: Windows 2.0 was published in December 1987, which is more popular than the previous generation. It has made several improvements to user interfaces and memory management. The window is allowed to fold for the first time in Windows 2.03, and this change has also prompted Apple to sue for infringement of its intellectual property rights. Windows 2.0 has also introduced more complex shortcuts and support for extended storage. In addition to full Windows, there are sometimes companies that combine their programs with Windows, which is only running in time, so that users can use their programs on MS-DOS without installing Windows.
title: Microsoft Windows

source_text: Windows 3.0发布于1990年，极大地改进了外观设计，还增加了虚拟内存和VxD功能。Windows 3.0中，应用可以运行在保护模式下，访问高达几兆的内存而无需参与对虚拟内存的管理。Windows 3.0是微软首部取得广泛商业成功的产品，在首销的六个月中便卖出了两百多万份。Windows 3.1发布于1992年3月1日。1993年8月，Windows for Workgroups 3.11发布，这是一个支持点对点网络的特殊版本。
target_text: Windows 3.0 was released in 1990 with a significant improvement in physical design, with the addition of virtual memory and VXD functions. Windows 3.0 applications can run under a protective mode and access a few megagrams of memory without having to participate in the management of virtual memory. Windows 3.0 is a product of extensive commercial success for Microsoft First Division, with more than 2 million copies sold in the first six months of sales. Windows 3.1 was released on 1 March 1992. Windows for Worldgroups 3.11 was released in August 1993, a special version of the support point-to-point network.
title: Microsoft Windows

source_text: 在零售中，Windows XP分为两个主要的版本：家庭版（Home Edition）和专业版（Professional）。家庭版主要面向普通客户，而专业版面向商业客户和专业用户。之后也发行了媒体中心版（Media Center Edition，设计于家庭影院的电脑，拥有更强的影音功能）和平板电脑版（Tablet PC Edition，设计于可携带的平板电脑，支持手写笔输入等功能）。
target_text: In retail, Windows XP is divided into two main versions: Home Generation and Professional. Family editions are intended mainly for ordinary customers, whereas professional editions are intended for commercial customers and professional users. Media Center Edition, a computer designed for home cinemas, with a stronger audio and video function, and a tablet computer version (tablet PC Edition, designed for portable flatboard computers, support for handwritten pen entry, etc.).
title: Microsoft Windows

source_text: Windows 8在2012年10月26日发布，它呈现出了巨大的变化，包括现代UI（Modern UI）的引入、迎合触摸设备的磁贴化设计等。这些变化中包含了对开始菜单的重新设计，在其中微软使用了巨大的磁贴以方便平板电脑等设备的触摸，并且磁贴本身也可以用于快速呈现用户需要的信息。此外还诞生了Metro应用程序，它们与常规的应用在外观和设计上大相径庭。值得一提的是，Windows 8激进地将最低分辨率上调至了1024×768像素，这使得很多上网本无法运行Windows 8。
target_text: Windows 8 was released on 26 October 2012 and presents significant changes, including the introduction of modern UI (Modern UI) and the design of magnetic stickers for the touch-up device. These changes include the redesign of the start-up menu, in which Microsoft uses huge magnetic stickers to make it easier for devices such as tablets to touch, and the magnets themselves to quickly present the information needed by users. In addition, Metro applications were born, which are very different from conventional applications in appearance and design. It is worth mentioning that Windows 8 has aggressively moved the minimum resolution up to 1024 x 768 pixels, which makes it impossible for many webbooks to run Windows 8.
title: Microsoft Windows

source_text: Windows之起源，可追溯到多年前全錄公司所进行的研发工作。1970年，美国全錄公司成立了著名的研究机构帕羅奧多研究中心，主要从事區域網路、激光打印机、图形用户界面和面向对象技术的研究。全錄于1981年宣布推出世界上第一个商用的图形用户界面系统“Star 8010”工作站。但技术並未得到大眾的重视，也没有協助商业化的应用。
target_text: The origins of Windows date back to the research and development work carried out many years ago by the full company. In 1970, the U.S.-based company created a famous research institute, the Paloodo Research Centre, which focuses on regional networks, laser printers, graphical user interfaces, and object-oriented technology.
title: Microsoft Windows

source_text: 這時蘋果電腦的创始人之一的史蒂夫·乔布斯在参观全錄公司的帕羅奧多研究中心后认识到图形用户界面的重要性以及广阔的市场前景，便开始着手进行自己的图形用户界面系统研发工作。之後在1983年研发出第一个图形用户界面系统Lisa OS。不久，蘋果電腦又推出第二个图形用户界面系统System Software（現稱macOS），成為世界上第一个成功的商用图形用户界面系统。蘋果電腦在开发Macintosh时基於市场战略上的考虑，故意开发了只能在蘋果電腦上作运作的图形用户界面系统，但当时因為Intel x86微处理器芯片的IBM兼容電腦已渐露头角，因此就给了微软公司所开发的Windows生存空间和市场。
target_text: In 1983, Steve Jobs, one of the founders of Apple Computers, began to develop his own GUI system, recognizing the importance of graphical user interfaces and the vast market outlook, after visiting the Paloodo Research Center of the full company. The first GUI system, Lisa OS, was developed in 1983. Shortly after, Apple had launched its second GUI system, System Software (now MacOS), which was the first successful commercial GUI system in the world. The Apple computer, based on market strategy in developing Macintosh, deliberately developed a graphical user interface system that could only operate on an apple computer, but given that IBM compatible computers from Intel x86 microprocessor chips were beginning to show their head.
title: Microsoft Windows

source_text:
對中文的支援
早期IBM PC個人電腦並不支援中文處理，於20世紀80年代開始，由於個人電腦逐漸普及，台灣開始有公司為使用DOS作業系統的個人電腦，編寫能處理中文的外掛式中文系統，著名建基於DOS的中文系統有國喬中文系統、倚天中文系統、震漢中文系統等等。由於實際上是用擷取繪寫屏幕指令的方式，截取畫面上的文字，將兩個ASCII編碼改為以圖形顯示的大五碼中文字，導致中文文書處理相當複雜（例如換行、左右對齊）。再加上承繼自DOS的固定行列顯示、早期只能顯示16×15圖素的點陣字體，早期的中文系統只能算是勉強能於個人電腦上處理中文訊息。
target_text: Early IBM PC personal computers did not support Chinese processing. Since the 1980s, as a result of the gradual diffusion of personal computers, Taiwan began to have companies using the DOS production system for personal computers to compile and process Chinese-based installed Chinese-language systems, known as DOS-based Chinese-language systems, Chinese-language systems, Chinese-based systems, Chinese-language systems, Chinese-language systems, Chinese-language systems, and so on. Since in practice, screen-scripting instructions are used to capture graphic text, two ASC-II codes have been converted to medium-sized five-coded text in graphic form, resulting in complicated Chinese document processing (e.g., change of rows, matchmaking).
title: Microsoft Windows

source_text: 微軟不久便推出簡體中文版的Windows 3.11，奠定微軟於華文地區的主導地位。1994年12月8日，中华人民共和国电子部和微软签署《Windows 95中文版项目合作备忘录》。1995年9月20日，国家技术监督局标准化司、电子工业部计算机司和美国微软就Windows95中文版项目标准规范等有关事宜成合作协议。
target_text: On December 8, 1994, the Ministry of Electronics of the People’s Republic of China and Microsoft signed a memorandum of understanding on cooperation in the Chinese version of the Windows 95 project. On September 20, 1995, the Standards Division of the National Technical Supervisory Authority, the Computer Division of the Electronic Industry Department and Microsoft of the United States concluded a cooperation agreement on matters related to the standard specifications of the Windows 95 Chinese version of the project.
title: Microsoft Windows

source_text: 隨著繁體中文版（1995年11月）和簡體中文版的Windows 95推出，雖然同期倚天中文系統已支援SVGA模式以24×24圖素點陣字型顯示、使用平滑字型、圖龍字型列億、震撼中文系統已支援使用TrueType列印等改進，但各種基於DOS的中文系統，連同少數基於英文版Windows的中文套件，於Windows 95的普及下，很快便舉行告別式。
target_text: With the introduction of the Chinese version (November 1995) and the Chinese version of Windows 95 in plain Chinese, while SVGA models have been supported during the same period in displaying the SVGA model in 24-by- 24-thousand-point fonts, using smooth fonts, the Turone-type billion dollar, and the Chinese-sharp system has supported the use of TrueType printing, etc., the Chinese-language systems based on DOS, with a similar number of Chinese-language packages based on the English version of Windows, will soon be replaced by a different version of Windows 95.
title: Microsoft Windows

source_text: 早期的中文版Windows只對應該地區的中文編碼，如正體版Windows只支援大五碼中文，简体版Windows只支援GB2312中文。隨著以統一碼為基礎的NT核心流行，由Windows 2000開始，基本上已可在繁體中文版的Windows上處理簡體字（反之亦然）。當然，以大五碼或國標碼編寫的程式，於預設為另一方編碼（控制台內「地區及語言設定」）的Windows上運行仍會出現亂碼，此一現象只能期待統一碼完成取代各種區域性編碼後才可解決。
target_text: The early Chinese version of Windows only supports Chinese code for the local area, such as the original version of Windows, which supports only five yards of Chinese, and the French version of Windows, which supports only GB2312. With the NT core, which is based on a single code, starting with Windows 2000, it is essentially possible to process the short text on the popular Chinese version of Windows (and vice versa). Of course, programs written in large five yards or country codes, the defaulting of Windows on the other side code (control of the station's “district and language settings”), are still in disarray, a reality that can only be resolved when one code has been completed to replace the domain code for each region.
title: Microsoft Windows

source_text: DOS是單一使用者、單工的作業系統，擁有不可重入的基本核心函式（意即同時間只能有一個程式呼叫這些函式）。有一個例外的狀況，就是常駐程式（Terminate and Stay Resident，縮寫為TSR）。某些常駐程式允許使用者多工操作；然而此時仍有「核心不可重入」的問題：當一個行程（process）呼叫了作業系統核心中的服務函式（也就是系統呼叫）時，在這個呼叫結束之前，其他的行程絕對不能進行系統呼叫、打斷第一個行程。
target_text: DOS is a single user, a single-worker operating system, with basic core functions that cannot be re-entered (meaning that only one program can call these functions at the same time). One exception is the permanent system (TSR). Some frequent programs allow users to operate more often; however, there is still a problem of "core non-recoverable": when a process calls a service function (or system calls) in the core of the operating system, the other journeys are never allowed to call the system and interrupt the first trip before the call is over.
title: DOS

source_text: DOS透過批次檔（副檔名為.BAT）提供界面腳本的功能。這些檔案是純文字格式的，可以用任何的文字編輯器（像是edit.com）編輯。他們執行起來和編譯而成的程式沒有兩樣。檔案中的每一行都被視為命令來執行。批次檔也可以使用數個內部命令，例如goto和條件運算式。
target_text: DOS provides interface scripts through batch files (extended by .BAT). These files are in plain text format and can be edited by any text editor (e.g. edit.com). There are no two kinds of programs that they execute and compile. Each line in the file is treated as an order. The batch files can also use several internal commands, such as goto and condition algorithms.
title: DOS

source_text: DOS提供了簡單的硬體抽象層，讓程式員可以開發文字界面的應用程式；但這個硬體抽象層無法存取大部份的計算機硬體，像是顯示卡、印表機，或是滑鼠等。這使得程式員必須直接存取硬體，導致每個應用程式都有屬於自己的一組硬體週邊驅動程式。硬體製造商會將他們的硬體規格書釋出，以確保在受歡迎的應用程式中有它們的驅動程式。
target_text: DOS provides a simple hard abstract layer in which programmers can develop applications for text interfaces; but this hard abstract level does not have access to most computer hardware, such as display cards, printers, or mouse. This makes it necessary for programmers to have direct access to hardware, so that each application has its own set of hard-side drivers. Hardware manufacturers release their hard-form books to ensure that they have their drivers in the popular applications.
title: DOS

source_text: 裝置保留名稱在DOS中，有數個名稱保留給裝置使用，無法拿來當一般檔案的名稱（不管副檔名是什麼）；這些保留名稱是用來將應用程式的輸出傳送給硬體週邊用的。這樣的限制也影響到數個版本的Windows，在某些情況下甚至會造成當機和安全性弱點。其中一些保留名稱有：NUL:、COM1:或AUX:、COM2:、COM3:、COM4:、CON:、LPT1:或PRN:、LPT2:、LPT3:，以及CLOCK$。
target_text: The device retains the name in DOS and several names are reserved for the device, which cannot be used as the name of the general file (whatever the name of the file is); these reserved names are used to transfer the application output to the hardware side. Such limitations also affect Windows in several versions, and in some cases may even cause weaknesses in time and safety. Some of the reserved names are: NUL:, COM1: or AUX:, COM2:, COM3:, COM4:, CON:, LPT1: or PRN:, LPT2:, LPT3: and CLANK$.
title: DOS

source_text: 在DOS中，磁碟機是利用不同的字母命名的。標準的作法是保留「A」和「B」給軟碟機。若是系統只有一台軟碟機的話，DOS允許這台軟碟機同時使用這兩個代號，然後DOS會要求使用者更換磁片。這麼做可以讓使用者把檔案拷貝到不同的軟碟片上，或是執行某一片軟碟片上的程式，然後把資料檔案存放在另一片軟碟片上。最早硬碟的代號為「C」和「D」。在一台硬碟機上，DOS只允許一個活動分割區的存在。隨著支援的硬碟數量越來越多，磁碟代號的命名方法演變為：先將磁碟代號指派給每一顆硬碟機的活動主分割區，然後第二輪將代號指派給延伸分割區中的邏輯磁碟區，第三輪再把代號指定給非活動的主分割區。（前題是：它們存在，而且包含了DOS可以讀取的檔案系統。）最後，DOS才將代號指派給光碟機、RAM disk，以及其他的硬體。一般來說，磁碟代號都是依照驅動程式的載入順序，按字母順序指派的，但驅動程式也可以要求DOS指派不同的字母。例如網路磁碟機的驅動程式通常會指派最後的幾個字母。
target_text: In DOS, the disk is named by different letters. The standard is to keep "A" and "B" on another disk. The first hard disk is coded "C" and "D" on a hard disk. In a hard disk, DOS allows the software to use these two codes simultaneously, and the user is asked to change the disk. This allows the user to copy the file to a different disk, or to execute a program on a single disk, and then to store the data file on another disk. The first hard disk is coded "C" and "D" on a hard disk. On a hard disk, DOS allows only the existence of an active partition. As the number of supported hard disks grows, the name of the disk is changed as follows: first assigns the code to each disk, first to the main section of the drive, then the second is assigned to the drive block, then the third is assigned to the non-active main section.
title: DOS

source_text: 因為DOS的應用程式會直接使用這些磁碟代號（和Unix類系統使用／dev目錄的方法不同），因此若是新增了需要分配磁碟代號的硬體，可能會導致這些應用程式出錯。舉例來說：若是原本硬碟中的延伸分割區中存在邏輯磁碟區，此時新增一顆有主分割區的硬碟的話，由於主分割區擁有較高的分配優先權，所以原本硬碟的邏輯磁碟區的代號就會改變。此外，就算是新增一顆只有延伸分割區和邏輯磁碟區的硬碟，還是會影響到RAM disk及光碟機的代號。這個問題一直到9x系列的Windows都仍然存在；NT系列才有解決方案：磁碟代號會保留給已存在的磁碟機機，除非使用者手動更改。
target_text: As DOS applications use these disk codes directly (as opposed to the Unix system using/dev directories), they may be wrong if they add a new hardware that needs to be assigned to the disk code. For example, if there is a logical disk area in an extended partition of the original hard disk, then a new hard disk with a main partition will be created with a higher distribution priority in the main partition, so that the original hard disk will change the code of the logical disk. Moreover, even if a new hard disk with only an extended partition and a logical disk, it will affect the RAM disk and CD code. This problem continues to exist in Windows in the 9x series; the NT series has a solution: the disk proxy will be retained to an existing disk machine unless the user hands-on change.
title: DOS

source_text: 在1980年的時候，使用Intel 8088微處理器，開發出了他們的第一台微電腦。他們需要一套能夠在這台微電腦上使用的作業系統。在找一套能和相容的，一開始找上了微軟的執行長比爾·蓋茨（可能是因為當時微軟開發出了讓可以在Apple II上執行的，所以相信微軟擁有）。被轉介到，並且舉行了相關的會議。然而，關於的使用權的初次談判破裂了—因為希望以權利金的方式販售，但希望單一授權，並且將名稱改為。的創始人蓋瑞·基爾多拒絕簽約，因此放棄購買。
target_text: In 1980, an Intel 8088 microprocessor was used to develop their first microcomputer. They needed an operating system that could be used on this microcomputer. Looking for a compatible one, Bill Gates, the executive director of Microsoft, was first found (possibly because Microsoft had developed so that it could be executed on Apple II, so he believed in Microsoft). It was referred to, and a related meeting was held. However, the initial negotiations on the right of use broke down — because he wanted to sell it in the form of rights, but wanted a single grant, and then changed his name.
title: DOS

source_text: 微軟也將這套系統授權給數個電腦公司。這些電腦公司販售給他們的硬體使用的MS-DOS，有時使用他們自己的名稱。微軟後來要求他們使用MS-DOS這個名稱，除了IBM以外。IBM持續為IBM PC開發新版的PC-DOS。Digital Research查覺到IBM正在販售和CP/M很類似的作業系統（而且還跟當初IBM談判時堅持的名稱相同），於是揚言要提出法律訴訟。IBM以一項協議回應他們：IBM讓使用者可以自行選擇要使用PC-DOS還是CP/M-86（Kildall開發的8086版CP/M）。兩者相較，CP/M比PC-DOS貴上近200美元，銷售量也低。CP/M逐漸淡出，而MS-DOS和PC-DOS則成了PC和PC相容機的主力作業系統。
target_text: Microsoft also grants the system to a number of computer companies. These companies sell MS-DOS to their hardware, sometimes using their own names. Microsoft then requires them to use the name MS-DOS, with the exception of IBM. IBM continues to develop a new version of PC-DOS for IBMPC. Digital Research finds that IBM is being sold on a business system similar to CP/M (and with the same name that was maintained at the time of the IBM negotiations) and is threatening to file a legal action. IBM responds to them with an agreement: IBM allows users to choose whether to use PC-DOS or CP/M-86 (8086 CP/M from Kildale).
title: DOS

source_text: FreeDOS計劃開始於1994年6月26日。當天微軟宣佈他們將不再販賣MS-DOS，也不再提供支援。於是吉姆·霍尔張貼了一份宣言，宣佈要開發DOS的開放源始碼替代品。在幾個星期內，包括Pat Villani和Tim Norman的幾位程式員加入了這個計劃。他們利用共享他們撰寫或現有程式碼的方式，產生了核心、command.com命令直譯器（shell界面）以及核心公用程式。在歷經了數個版本的官方預覽版本之後，FreeDOS 1.0版在2006年9月3日正式發佈。使用FreeDOS不需支付任何的版權費用或權利金。
target_text: FreeDOS started on June 26, 1994. The day Microsoft announced that they would no longer sell MS-DOS or provide support. So Jim Hall posted a declaration to launch an open source alternative to DOS. Within a few weeks, several programmers, including Pat Villani and Tim Norman, joined the plan. By sharing their writings or existing code, they created a core, a command.com command translator (shell interface) and a core public utility.
title: DOS

source_text:
持續發展
有些電腦製造商（包括Dell和HP）會預載FreeDOS當作OEM作業系統出貨。有一套以GPL方式授權的DOS，名為NX-DOS，目前正在開發中。它是一套16位元的即時作業系統，擁有網路功能，可以從軟碟片開機，還有一個不太完整的USB驅動程式。NX-DOS專案從1992年就開始了，原本是個個人專案，在2005年的時候以GPL方式釋出。
target_text: Ongoing development Some computer manufacturers (including Dell and HP) have pre-screened FreeDOS as an OEM operating system. There is a GPS-licensed DOS, known as NX-DOS, which is currently being developed. It is a 16-bit real-time operating system with a network function that can be started from diskettes and a less complete USB driver. The NX-DOS project, originally a personal project, was released in 2005.
title: DOS

source_text: 由於Windows XP和Vista無法和純DOS相容，DOS模擬器在這些系統上也越來越流行。這些模擬器可以用來執行過去的老軟體或其他DOS軟體。其中一個最為知名的是DOSBox，主要的設計目標是在當前的作業系統上執行DOS的遊戲程式。在Microsoft Virtual PC下也可以執行DOS的應用程式，相容性比DOS模擬器好。使用者可以安裝合法的MS-DOS，然後除了那些最難對付的應用程式以外，絕大部份的DOS應用程式都可以在上面執行。
target_text: Since Windows XP and Vista are not compatible with pure DOS, DOS emulators are becoming more popular in these systems. These emulators can be used to run old or other DOS software. One of the most well-known are DOSBox, whose main design is to run DOS programs on the current production system. DOS applications can also be executed under Microsoft Virtual PC, with better compatibility than DOS emulators. Users can install legal MS-DOS, and then most DOS applications can be executed on top of the most difficult ones.
title: DOS

source_text: 為了提供對使用者更友善的操作環境，許多的軟體廠商紛紛推出各式各樣的檔案管理程式。這些程式通常使用選單及圖示做為界面。Microsoft Windows就是其中最有名的例子，最後發展成為完整的作業系統，取代DOS成了PC相容機上最受歡迎的作業系統。-{使用文字模式的使用者界面}-有：、、、Quarterdesk的，以及SideKick。使用图形用户界面的程式有：Digital Research的（最早是寫給CP/M用的）以及。
target_text: In order to provide a more user-friendly operating environment, many software manufacturers have launched a variety of file management programs. These programs usually use menus and icons as interfaces. Microsoft Windows is the most famous example of this, and eventually develops into a complete production system, replacing DOS as the most popular production system on a PC compatible machine.
title: DOS

source_text:
限制
DOS的架構有數項惱人的限制。最早的8088微處理器只能定址到1 MB的實體記憶體空間。由於附加的硬體裝置也必須映射到這段空間，因此最高可以使用的記憶體只有640 KB（被稱為「傳統記憶體」）。在DOS的結構上，640 KB被視為最大的記憶體空間，DOS無法定址更高的位址。早期避開這個問題的做法是使用擴展記憶體；80286出來之後，發展出了延伸記憶體。雖然這些技術提供了更多的記憶體應用程式，但應用程式仍必須從傳統記憶體開始執行，佔用640 KB中的部份空間。80386微處理器使用了重新設計的保護模式，應用程式可以透過DOS extender及DOS保護模式界面（DOS Protected Mode Interface，縮寫為DPMI）等技術使用額外的記憶體，也可以有多工的功能。
target_text: The original 8088 microprocessors can only be located in the physical memory space of 1 MB. Since additional hard devices must also be mapped into this space, the maximum available memory is only 640 KB (known as the "traditional memory”). In the DOS structure, 640 KB is considered the largest memory space, with no more address required by law. Early avoidance of this problem is the use of extended memory; 80286 has led to the development of extended memory. While these techniques provide more memory applications, they still have to be applied from the traditional memory, using some of the 640 KB spaces. 80386 microprocessors use re-designed protection models, applications can extend beyond the DOS Extender and DOS Protection Mode interface (DOS Protected Mode interface), and so on.
title: DOS

source_text: DOS還有硬碟分割區大小的限制。造成這個問題的原因有兩個。首先，許多DOS類的作業系統只支援到FAT16，而FAT16在設計上就不支援超過2.1 GB的硬碟分割區。另外，DOS存取硬碟的方式是透過INT 13這個中斷呼叫，然後往下再利用CHS系統對應到磁碟上的資料。在這個架構下，作業系統只能看到8 GB的硬碟空間。比較新的作業系統使用軟體的方式（例如：32位元磁碟存取）存取硬碟。
target_text: DOS also has a limit on the size of hard disk partitions. There are two reasons for this problem. First, many DOS-type production systems support only FAT16, while FAT16 is not designed to support harddisk partitions that exceed 2.1 GB. Also, DOS access to hard disks is through INT 13, and then uses the CHS system down to match data on disks. In this setup, the operating system can only see 8 GB hard disk spaces.
title: DOS

source_text: Windows 2000引入了NTFS 3.0、加密文件系统、動態邏輯磁碟管理。相比Windows NT 4.0，Windows 2000通过辅助技术改进了对殘障人士的支持。另外增加了对語言和地區設定的支持。服务器版本具有附加功能，最引人注目的是活动目录的引入，在随后的几年中成为商业场景中广泛使用的目录服务。
target_text: Windows 2000 introduced NTFS 3.0, encryption file system, dynamic logic disk management. Windows 2000 improved support for persons with disabilities through assistive technology. Support for language and local settings was also increased. The server version has additional features, most notably an activity directory, which became a widely used catalogue service in business scenes over the next few years.
title: Windows 2000

source_text: 引入了一種旨在保護關鍵系統文件的新功能，稱為 Windows 文件保護。這通過防止除 Microsoft 操作系統更新機制以外的程序（例如 Package Installer、Windows Installer 和其他更新組件）修改它們來保護關鍵的 Windows 系統文件。系統文件檢查器實用程序使用戶能夠手動掃描所有受保護系統文件的完整性，並可選擇修復它們，方法是從存儲在單獨的“DLLCACHE”目錄中的緩存或從原始安裝媒體中恢復。
target_text: A new feature designed to protect key system files, called Windows file protection, has been introduced. This prevents them from modifying key Windows system files by means of programs other than Microsoft operating system updates (e.g. Package Installer, Windows Installer and other updates). The system file checker user is able to manually scan the integrity of all protected system documents and can choose to repair them by saving them from storage in a single "DLLCACHE" directory or recovering them from original installed media.
title: Windows 2000

source_text:
Microsoft 認識到嚴重錯誤（藍屏死機或停止錯誤）可能會導致需要持續運行的服務器出現問題，因此提供了一個系統設置，允許服務器在發生停止錯誤時自動重新啟動。還包括一個選項，可以將前 64 KB 內存轉儲到磁盤（用於調試目的的最小內存量，也稱為 minidump）、僅轉儲內核內存或轉儲內核內存。將內存的全部內容寫入磁盤，並將此事件發生在 Windows 2000 事件日誌中。為了提高運行 Windows 2000 的服務器的性能，Microsoft 讓管理員可以選擇為後台服務或應用程序優化操作系統的內存和處理器使用模式。 Windows 2000 還在操作系統中引入了核心系統管理和管理功能，如 Windows Installer、Windows Management Instrumentation 和 Windows 事件跟踪 (ETW)。
