target_text: Microsoft recognizes that a serious error (blue screen deader or stop error) may cause problems with the server that needs to continue running. It provides a system setup that allows the server to restart automatically when a stop error occurs. It also includes an option to store the former 64 KB memory to disk (the smallest memory available for the purposes of the test, also known as minidump), re-storage kernel memory or re-storage kernel memory. Writes all the contents of the memory to disk diskettes and to do it in Windows 2000 event journal. To improve the performance of the Windows 2000 server, Microsoft allows managers to choose the mode of use of memory and processors for back-office services or applications. Windows 2000 has also introduced core system management and management features into the operating system, such as Windows Install, Windows Mandage Instaction, and Windows News. To improve the performance of the Windows 2000 server service, it allows managers to track back-office services or the use of the program 's language-based software and NTLMS.
title: Windows 2000

source_text: Windows 2000是高度模組化的系統，系統中包含了兩個層次：使用者模式和核心模式。使用者模式顧名思義代表了使用者程式在這個模式中執行，-{只}-能存取部份的系統資源。核心模式則可以存取所有的系統資源，包含了記憶體和外部的設備。使用者模式執行程式是透過“Executive”的介面來執行，而Executive本身是位於核心模式，因此可以存取到各種系統資源。
target_text: Windows 2000 is a highly modular system with two layers in it: the user mode and the core model. The user mode is representative of how the user program operates in this mode, and {only} - the system resource that allows access to parts of the system. The core mode provides access to all system resources, including memory and external devices. The user mode application is executed through an "Executive" interface, and Executive itself is in the core mode and is therefore accessible to all systems.
title: Windows 2000

source_text: Windows 2000可以通过多种方法部署。它可以通过传统媒介（如CD）或通过共享文件夹安装到服务器上。安装可以选择手动安装或无人值守。手动安装时，管理员必须指定配置选项。无人值守安装则是通过填写了所有选项的应答文件或INI文件形式编写的预定义脚本。应答文件可以手动创建，也可以使用图形安装管理器创建。之后Winnt.exe或Winnt32.exe程序使用该应答文件来自动安装。无人值守安装可以使用微软系统配置管理器，通过可引导光盘执行；可以通过系统准备工具（Sysprep）执行；可以通过使用/syspart开关的Winnt32.exe程序执行；或者通过（RIS）执行。Windows 2000中也引入了可集成（slipstream）一个服务包到原来的操作系统安装文件。
target_text: Windows 2000 can be deployed in a variety of ways. It can be installed on the server either by traditional media (e.g. CD) or by sharing folders. The installation of a manual installation can be selected or unattended. The administrator must specify configuration options when manually installed. Unattended installation is a predefined script prepared by filling all options in answer or INI files. The answer document can be created manually or by a graphical installation manager. The answer file can then be automatically installed using the Winnt.exe or Winnt32.exe application. The unattended installation can be implemented using a Microsoft system configuration manager, which can be implemented through a guided CD-ROM; can be implemented through system readiness tools (Sysprep); can be implemented through Winnt32.exe application using/syspart switch; or can be implemented through a graphical installation manager.
title: Windows 2000

source_text:
安全性
2002 年 10 月，Microsoft 委託 IDC 確定 Windows 2000 上企業應用程序的總擁有成本 (TCO) 與 Linux 上相同應用程序的 TCO。 IDC 的報告基於對 104 家北美公司的 IT 主管和經理的電話採訪，他們確定了他們在文件、打印、安全和網絡服務的特定工作負載中使用什麼。 IDC 確定，Windows 2000 的 TCO 優於 Linux 的四個領域（對於一個平均 100 名員工的組織來說，在五年內）是文件、打印、網絡基礎設施和安全基礎設施。然而，他們確定 Linux 在 Web 服務方面比 Windows 2000 具有更好的 TCO。報告還發現，最大的成本不是軟件和硬件的採購，而是人員成本和停機時間。雖然該報告在 IT 基礎設施停機期間應用了 40% 的生產力因素，但認識到員工並非完全沒有生產力，但它沒有考慮停機時間對企業盈利能力的影響。該報告指出，Linux 服務器的計劃外停機時間少於 Windows 2000 服務器。它發現與 Windows 2000 服務器相比，大多數 Linux 服務器每台服務器運行的工作負載更少，而且受訪企業中沒有一家使用 4 路 SMP Linux 計算機。該報告也沒有考慮特定的應用服務器——需要低維護並由特定供應商提供的服務器。該報告確實強調 TCO 只是考慮是否使用特定 IT 平台的一個因素，並且還指出，隨著管理和服務器軟件的改進和更好地打包，所顯示的整體情況可能會發生變化。
target_text: In October 2002, Microsoft commissioned IDC to determine the total cost of the Windows 2000 business application (TCO) and the same application on Linux. The IDC report was based on a telephone interview with the manager and manager of the IT of 104 North American companies, who identified what they used in a specific load of documentation, printing, security, and network services. IDC determined that the TCO of Windows 2000 was better than the TCO of Linux than the TCO of Linux and that the TCO of Windows 2000 was better than the TCO of Linux (for an organization of an average of 100 staff members, within five years) was a document, printing, network infrastructure and safety base. However, they determined that Linux had a better TCO than Windows 2000 of services.
title: Windows 2000

source_text:
源代码泄露事件
2004年2月12日（或者之前），發生部分Windows 2000和Windows NT 4.0的源代碼在網絡上洩漏的事件。這次泄漏源后来追踪到，一个伙伴。微軟發表以下的聲明：
微軟的原始碼既受版权保护，又作为商业机密受到保护。任何公佈、傳播、下載或者使用這些洩漏的原始碼都是非法的。
儘管微軟發出警告，但是這些洩漏的原始碼已在文件共享网络上广泛传播，甚至在2004年2月16日還有從洩漏的原始碼中發現Internet Explorer的安全漏洞。
target_text: The source code leak occurred on (or before) February 12, 2004, with some of the Windows 2000 and Windows NT 4.0 source codes leaking on the Internet. The leak was later traced to a partner. Microsoft issued the following statement: Microsoft source code is both copyright-protected and protected as a commercial secret.
title: Windows 2000

source_text: NTFS（），是Microsoft公司开发的专用文件系统，从Windows NT 3.1开始成为Windows NT家族的默认文件系统。NTFS取代FAT（文件分配表）和HPFS（高性能文件系统）并进行一系列改进成为更加完善的安全系统，例如增强对元数据的支持，使用更高级的数据结构以提升性能、可靠性和磁盘空间利用率，并附带一系列增强功能，如访问控制列表（ACL）和文件系统日志。
target_text: NTFS(), a dedicated file system developed by Microsoft, has been the Windows NT 3.1 default file system for the Windows NT family since its inception. NTFS replaces FAT (file allocation table) and HPFS (high-performance file system) with a series of improvements to become a better security system, such as enhancing support for metadata, using more advanced data structures to enhance performance, reliability and disk space utilization, with a series of enhancements, such as access control lists (ACL) and file system logs.
title: NTFS

source_text:
可伸缩性
理论上，NTFS卷的最大容量为264-1簇。在Windows XP专业版中，由于分区表限制，实际实现的最大容量为232-1簇。例如，在当簇的从大小为64 KiB时，Windows XP的NTFS卷的最大容量为256 TiB减去64 KiB；而当簇大小为默认的4 KiB时，卷最大容量将变为16 TiB减去4 KiB（但这都超过了Windows XP SP1对磁盘容量的128 GiB限制）。由于主引导记录（MBR）分区表最大支持单个分区容量为2 TiB，因此如果要创建超过2 TiB的NTFS卷，必须要使用动态卷或者GPT卷。注意：微软默认的引导程序必须使用UEFI和64位操作系统才能从GPT卷引导系统。
target_text: In Windows XP, for example, the maximum capacity of Windows XP NTFS volume is 256 Tib minus 64 KiB; when the default size is 4 KiB, the maximum volume will be 16 Tib minus 4 KiB (but this exceeds Windows XP SP1's 128 GiB limit on disk capacity). Because of the lead record (MBR) partition table's maximum support for individual Divisional capacity of 2 Tib, it will be necessary to use dynamic or GPT volume to create NTF volumes exceeding 2 TiB. Note: Microsoft default guidance procedures will have to use UEFI and 64-digit operating systems to direct the GPT volume system.
title: NTFS

source_text:
日志
NTFS是一个日志文件系统，使用NTFS日志（$Logfile）记录卷更改元数据。这是NTFS一个非常关键的功能（FAT/FAT32不提供此项功能），可确保其内部的复杂数据结构（如比较重要的如卷分配图、磁盘碎片整理API产生的数据转移操作、MFT（主文件表）记录的更改情况（包括移动MFT记录中存储的变长属性和属性表等））和索引（在目录和安全描述符中使用）即使在系统崩溃后仍然能保证一致性，而当在卷被重新加载后，可以非常容易地回滚这些关键数据的意外修改。
target_text: The log NTFS is a log file system that uses the NTFS log ($Logfile) to record changes in metadata. This is a very critical function of NTFS (FAT/FAT32 does not provide this function) to ensure that its internal complex data structure (e.g., a more important volume allocation map, a data transfer operation generated by API for disk debris consolidation), changes recorded by MFT (the master file sheet) (including variable properties stored in mobile MFT records and attribute tables, etc.) and index (used in catalogues and security captions) can ensure consistency even after the system collapse and, when reloaded, it is very easy to roll back unexpected changes to these key data.
title: NTFS

source_text: USN日志是一项系统管理功能，用于记录卷中所有文件、数据流、目录的内容、属性以及各项安全设置的更改情况。应用程序可以利用日志追踪卷的更改。对于非系统卷，可以选择打开或关闭日志。当添加一个新卷后，默认情况下日志功能处于打开状态。
target_text: The USN log is a system management function that records changes in all files, data streams, directory contents, properties, and security settings in the volume. Applications can track changes in the volume by using the log. For non-system files, you can choose to open or close the log. When a new volume is added, the log function is opened by default.
title: NTFS

source_text:
硬链接
硬链接可用于将不同的文件名直接关联到同样的文件内容。硬链接类似于目录连接，但必须引用到文件。硬链接只能连接到同一个卷内的文件，因为每个卷拥有自己的主文件表（MFT）。硬链接有自己的元数据，因此如果更改某个硬链接的文件大小或尺寸，其他硬链接在被打开前可能不会自动更新这些信息。
target_text: Hard Link Hard Links can be used to directly connect different filenames to the same file content. Hard Links are similar to directory connections, but must be referenced to files. Hard Links can only connect to files in the same volume, because each volume has its own master file sheet (MFT). Hard Links have their own metadata, so if you change the file size or size of a hard link, other hard links may not automatically update this information before it is opened.
title: NTFS

source_text: 硬链接原本用于支持Windows NT的POSIX子系统。Windows使用硬链接实现对8.3文件名的支持。操作系统需要该功能，因为有些古老的应用程序只能使用短文件名。NTFS将会为文件和目录创建额外的NTFS记录，但他们将总是自动同步更新（常规硬链接并不会同步更新）。NTFS文件系统限制单个文件只能关联到1024个硬链接。
target_text: Hard links are used to support Windows NT's POSIX subsystem. Windows uses hard links to support 8.3 filenames. The operating system needs this function, as some of the old applications only use short filenames. NTFS will create additional NTFS records for files and directories, but they will always be updated automatically (the conventional hard link will not be updated simultaneously). The NTFS file system limits individual files to only 1,024 hard links.
title: NTFS

source_text: NTFS流从Windows NT 3.1开始被引入，起初设计目的是为了Services for Macintosh（SFM）能够正确存储Macintosh的资源分岔。现在的Windows服务器已经不再包含此功能，但很多第三方的Apple归档服务（AFP）产品（例如Group Logic的ExtremeZ-IP）仍然会继续使用可选数据流。Internet Explorer和其它一些浏览器会在从网络上下载的文件中添加一个非常小的可选数据流，用于标记它们来自于外部网站（表示可能会存在安全风险），用户在打开这些文件前系统将会显示一个确认提示。当用户表示不希望再次看到这个确认对话框的时候，这个可选流将会从下载的文件中被直接删除。
target_text: The NTFS stream, introduced from Windows NT 3.1, was originally designed to allow the Statistics for Macintosh (SFM) to correctly store the resources of Macintosh. The Windows server now no longer contains this feature, but many third-party Apple Archiving Service (AFP) products (e.g. Group Logic's ExtremeZ-IP) will continue to use optional data streams. Internet Explorer and some other browsers will add a very small optional data stream to the files they download from the web to mark them from an external site (showing that there may be a security risk), and the user will display a confirmation hint before opening these files. When users have indicated that they do not want to see this confirmation dialogue box again, the optional stream will be deleted directly from the downloaded document.
title: NTFS

source_text: 可选数据流不会显示在Windows资源管理器中，也不会算入查看文件属性时显示的文件大小。如果将文件复制到FAT格式的磁盘、附加到电子邮件、上传到网站，或者移动到任何其它不支持可选流的位置上时，则只有主数据流会被保留下来，其它可选流将被全部丢弃，因此使用可选流来保存重要数据很可能会发生意外。Microsoft提供了一个叫作Streams的工具，用户可以使用这个工具查看卷中的可选流。从Windows Powershell 3.0版本开始，以下cmdlet支持对可选数据流进行操作：Add-Content、Clear-Content、Get-Item、Out-String、Remove-Item，以及Set-Item。
target_text: Selectable data streams do not appear in Windows resource managers, nor do they count the size of the files shown when viewing file properties. If files are copied to the FAT format disk, attached to e-mail, uploaded to the website, or moved to any other location that does not support optional streams, only the main data streams will be retained and all other optional streams will be discarded, so it is likely that there will be an accident using an optional stream to save important data. Microsoft provides a tool called Streams, which users can use to view optional streams in the files. Starting with Windows Powershell version 3.0, the following cmdlet supports the operation of optional data streams: Add-Content, Clear-Conent, Get-Item, Out-String, Remove-Item, and Set-Item.
title: NTFS

source_text: 有些媒体播放器也尝试使用可选数据流记录多媒体文件的自定义元数据，用于管理媒体文件。MPEG、OGG等格式通常在文件内签入信息标签记录媒体信息，但不是所有格式都支持这种设计，而使用可选数据流的好处正是他不会影响文件本身的内容。在Windows中注册外壳扩展程序后，系统就可以解析这些数据，然后可以在Windows资源管理器的信息栏中显示它们。但大部分媒体播放器还是选择使用独立数据库而非可选数据流来保存这些信息，因为可选数据流可能带来一些其它问题，一个典型问题是文件上的信息对于所有用户都可见并且是共享的，因此使用可选数据流将无法根据不同用户的安全设置和喜好进行分别管理和保护。
target_text: Some media players also try to use optional data streams to record custom metadata of multimedia files to manage media files. MPEG, OGG, etc. formats usually record media information in files, but not all formats support this design, and the benefit of using optional data streams is that he does not influence the content of the files themselves. With the registration of shell extensions in Windows, the system can interpret the data and then show them in the Information Bar of Windows resource managers. But most media players choose to use independent databases rather than optional data streams to preserve the information, since the optional data streams may pose other problems. A typical problem is that information on documents is visible to all users and shared, so using optional data streams will not be managed and protected separately according to the security settings and preferences of different users.
title: NTFS

source_text: 闪存设备（如固态硬盘）没有传统硬盘的磁头移动延迟，因此对此类设备，磁盘碎片的影响非常有限。具有快速多处理器系统的用户可以通过压缩应用程序文件和数据以提升速度并降低磁盘空间使用率。请注意，使用Sandforce控制器的SSD本身也会压缩数据，但文件系统压缩会导致传输的数据量变少，因此I/O负载会降低。
target_text: Flash storage devices (e.g. solid hard disks) have no traditional hard disk head move delay and therefore have very limited impact on disk fragments for such devices. Users with fast multiprocessor systems can boost speed and reduce disk space usage by compressing application files and data. Please note that SSD using Sandforce controller will also compress data itself, but file system compression will reduce the amount of data transmitted, resulting in lower I/O loads.
title: NTFS

source_text: 数据压缩的最佳目标是内容具有重复性、很少写入、通常顺序访问，并且尚未被压缩过的文件。例如，日志文件就是一种理想的压缩目标。压缩系统引导时需要使用的文件，如驱动程序、NTLDR、winload.exe，或者BOOTMGR，会导致系统无法正确启动。不过在较新版本的Windows系统中，重要的系统文件会被禁止压缩。
target_text: The best target for data compression is a document whose content is repetitive, rarely written, usually sequentially accessed, and which has not yet been compressed. Log files, for example, are an ideal compression target. Documents that need to be used to guide compressed systems, such as drivers, NTLDR, winload.exe, or BOOTMGR, can cause the system to fail to start properly. But in a more recent version of Windows, important system files are prohibited from compressing.
title: NTFS

source_text: 对于压缩文件的读写绝大部分时候是透明的，但Microsoft建议避免对服务器系统或者通过网络共享的远程配置文件进行压缩，因为这可能增加处理器的负担。Microsoft建议不要压缩超过30MB的文件，因为这可能会产生性能问题。由于压缩文件会产生很多碎片，因此磁盘碎片整理过程通常需要花费更长时间。
target_text: While most of the time when compressed files are read and written is transparent, Microsoft proposes to avoid compressing server systems or remote configuration files shared through the network, as this may increase the burden on processors. Microsoft suggests not to compress files that exceed 30MB because this may cause performance problems. Because compressed files generate a lot of debris, disk fragmentation usually takes longer.
title: NTFS

source_text:
卷影复制
卷影复制（VSC）服务通过将新改写的数据复制到卷影（写入时复制）来保存NTFS卷上的文件和文件夹的历史版本。当用户请求恢复文件的早期版本时，旧的文件数据将会覆盖新数据。该功能也使得数据备份程序可以存档当前系统正在使用的文件。对于负载较重的系统，Microsoft建议将卷影副本设置到单独的磁盘上，以减小系统主要卷的I/O负载。
target_text: Volume copy Volume Copy (VSC) service saves historical versions of files and folders on NTFS files by copying newly rewritten data to the scroll (copy when written). When the user requests to restore an earlier version of the file, the old file data will cover the new data. This feature also allows the data backup program to archive the files currently in use in the current system. For load-heavy systems, Microsoft suggests that a copy of the scroll be placed on a separate disk to reduce the I/O load of the main volume of the system.
title: NTFS

source_text:
Windows Vista通过持久卷影副本实现系统还原和先前的版本功能。但旧版本的操作系统加载NTFS卷时，由于其无法识别持久卷影副本的数据格式，这些副本将被删除。事务
在Windows Vista中，应用程序可以使用事务NTFS（Transactional NTFS，TxF）将一系列对文件的更改归组到一个事务中。事务能够确保所有更改要么同时生效，要么同时作废，并能确保在事务提交完成前，其它应用程序无法无法检测到其中的更改。
target_text: Windows Vista achieves system restoration and previous version functions through persistent copying. However, when an older version of the operating system loads a NTFS volume, these copies will be deleted because they cannot recognize the data format of a persistent copy. In Windows Vista, the application can use the service NTFS (Transactional NTFS, TxF) to group a series of changes to documents into a single transaction. The transaction can ensure that all changes take effect or are cancelled at the same time, and ensure that other applications cannot detect changes before the transaction is submitted.
title: NTFS

source_text: 该技术使用和卷影复制类似的技术（也即写入时复制）以确保在事务不成功时，被改写的数据可以安全地回滚。通用日志文件系统的日志将记录下尚未成功提交或者已经提交但尚未完全生效的事务（常见原因是事务的某个参与者在提交过程中系统意外崩溃）。
target_text: The use of the technology and copying of similar techniques (i.e., copying at writing) ensure that the rewritten data can safely roll back when the matter is not successful. The logs of the common log file system will record transactions that have not been successfully submitted or that have been submitted but have not yet become fully effective (often because of an accidental breakdown of the system during the submission process by one of the participants).
title: NTFS

source_text: 事务NTFS并不要求事务是本机NTFS卷的文件操作，可以包含在其它位置的任意事务数据或操作，例如对其它卷、本地注册表、SQL数据库中、系统服务或者远程服务中的事务修改。所有这些事务使用Windows系统中的“分布事务协调器（DTC）”服务在网络级别协调所有参与者，以确保所有参与者都能接收到同样的提交状态，并传输所有经过确认的更改。分布式NTFS事务的一个典型例子是可以以事务方式创建一个网络级别的分布式文件系统，并且每个客户端都保留每个文件的准确的脱机缓存。
target_text: The service NTFS does not require that the transaction be a file operation of the current NTFS volume, which can include data or operations on any matter at any other location, such as changes in other volumes, local registration forms, SQL databases, systems services or remote services. All of these services are coordinated at the network level using the Windows service DTC to ensure that all participants receive the same submission status and transmit all confirmed changes. A typical example of distributed NTFS services can be the creation of a network-level distributed file system in a business-like manner, and each client retains an accurate decouple for each file.
title: NTFS

source_text: 第一个列表被称为自主访问控制列表（DACL），用于描述是否允许或禁止特定的用户或用户组进行特定的操作（如读取、写入、执行或删除）。例如，“C:\Program Files”文件夹可能被设定为允许所有用户读取并执行，但只有具有管理员权限的用户才能修改其内容。Windows Vista为DACL增加了强制访问控制功能。DACL是Windows Vista及后续操作系统的用户账户控制功能的主要检查点。
target_text: The first list, known as the AutoAccess Control List (DACL), is used to describe whether specific users or user groups are allowed or prohibited to perform specific operations (e.g. to read, write, execute or delete). For example, the “C:\Program Files” folder may be set to allow all users to read and execute, but only users with administrator privileges can modify its content. Windows Vista adds a mandatory ACL to DACL. DACL is the main checkpoint for Windows Vista and the user account control function of the follow-up operating system.
title: NTFS

source_text: 第二个列表被称为系统访问控制列表（SACL），用于描述对文件或文件夹的特定行为是否应当被审核，以及在操作成功后是否应当记录操作。例如，企业可能会对高度敏感的文件开启审核功能，这样管理员就可以了解到是否有人尝试删除或复制这些文件，以及他们的操作是否成功完成。
target_text: The second list, referred to as the System Access Control List (SACL), is used to describe whether particular behaviors with respect to documents or folders should be reviewed and whether operations should be recorded after the operation has been successful. For example, an enterprise may open an audit function for highly sensitive documents so that managers can know whether any attempts have been made to delete or copy them and whether their operations have been successfully completed.
title: NTFS

source_text: EFS使用对称密钥（也被称为“文件加密密钥（FEK）”）加密文件，这比起使用非对称密钥加密在加密和解密大量数据时消耗的时间较少。该对称密钥使用一个和请求加密文件的用户相关的公钥加密文件的内容，加密后的数据储存在被加密文件的可选数据流中。当需要解密文件时，文件系统使用用户的密钥解密储存在文件头中的对称密钥，然后使用该对称密钥解密文件。这些操作在文件系统级别完成，因此对用户来说是透明的。为了处理用户丢失密钥的情况，加密文件系统中还支持多个附加解密密钥，因此除用户外，授权过的恢复代理也能访问数据。NTFS提供的加密和压缩功能是互相排斥的——如果同时希望加密和压缩，则NTFS文件系统级别只能打开其中一种功能，另一种功能需要使用其它第三方工具完成。
target_text: EFS uses symmetric key encryption (also referred to as “document encryption key” (FEK)) to encrypt files, which takes less time than using asymmetric key encryption to encrypt and decipher large amounts of data. The symmetric key is used to encrypt the contents of a public key encrypting file associated with the user requesting the encrypting file, and the encrypted data is stored in an optional data stream of encrypted files. When decrypting files is required, the file system uses the user's key decrypting stored in the symmetric key on the head of the document, and then uses the symmetric key decrypting file. These operations are performed at the file system level and are therefore transparent to the user. In order to process the loss of the key, the encryption system also supports multiple additional decryption keys, so that the authorized recovery agent can access data in addition to the user.
title: NTFS

source_text: 该功能从NTFS v3开始可用。该功能可以在用户空间中为文件或目录添加一个关联的重解析点属性。当对象管理器（请参见Windows NT线执行）解析文件系统名称并遇到重解析点属性时，它将“重新解析”名称，具体做法是：Windows会将需要重解析的名称传递给已经加载的所有文件过滤驱动程序，每个过滤驱动程序都会检查重解析数据并判断自己是否和该重解析点相关联。如果某个过滤驱动程序判定自己匹配该重解析点，则它将拦截这次文件系统调用，然后执行对应的特定功能。重解析点是实现卷加载点、目录连接、分层存储管理、本机结构存储，以及单实例存储等功能的基础。
target_text: This function is available from NTFS v3. The function can add a related re-resolution point attribute to a file or directory in the user ' s space. When the object manager (see Windows NT line execution) parses the name of the file system and encounters a re-resolution point attribute, it “reconstructs” the name by: Windows will need to transmit the recalibrated name to all file filter drivers that have been loaded, each filter driver will check whether it is associated with the recalibration data and determine whether it is associated with the recalibration point. If a filter driver determines that it matches the recalibration point, it will intercept the file system and then perform the corresponding specific function. The re-dissecting point is the basis for achieving the file load point, directory connection, layer management, memory of the body structure, and a single example storage function.
title: NTFS

source_text: 当卷被加载到另一个卷的某个目录时，该目录原来的内容将无法访问，而被新加载的卷中的内容所代替。被加载的卷仍然可以继续拥有独立的卷标。NTFS文件系统不允许卷之间相互加载。卷加载点可以是永久的，也可以是非永久的。前者在系统重启后会自动加载，而后者需要手动重新加载。
target_text: When the volume is loaded into a directory of another volume, the original contents of the directory will not be accessible and will be replaced by the contents of the newly loaded volume. The loaded volume will still be able to continue to hold separate labels. The NTFS file system will not allow the volume to be loaded between each other. Volume loading points may be permanent or non-permanent. The former will automatically be loaded after the system is restarted, while the latter will need to be manually reloaded.
title: NTFS

source_text:
目录连接
类似于卷加载点，但目录连接的连接目标是文件系统中的某个其它目录。例如，目录C:\exampledir带有一个目录连接属性，连接到D:\linkeddir。当用户级别的应用程序访问时，NTFS将自动把所有引用重定向到D:\linkeddir。目录连接功能在概念上类似于Unix的目录符号链接，但符号链接可以连接到任何目标，而NTFS目录连接只允许连接到目录。
target_text: Directory Connections Similar to Volume Load Points, but directory connections are connected to one of the other directories in the file system. For example, directory C:\exampledir has a directory connection property connected to D:\linkeddir. When user-level applications are accessed, NTFS automatically redirects all references to D:\linkeddir. The directory connection function is conceptually similar to the Unix directory symbol link, but the symbol link can be connected to any target, while the NTFS directory connection only allows connection to the directory.
title: NTFS

source_text: 目录连接可以在控制台中通过命令MKLINK /J连接名目标目录创建，使用RMDIR连接名删除。目录连接是永久性的，如果在客户端访问服务器的目录连接，则操作系统会使用被链接的目录所属的系统（或域）的安全设置。但连接本身可能拥有独立的安全设置，并且删除一个目录连接不会同时删除目标目录。
target_text: Directory connections can be created on the console by commanding MKLINK/J to connect to the target directory and deleted using RMDIR connections. Directory connections are permanent, and if you access the server ' s directory connections at the client ' s end, the operating system uses the secure settings of the system (or domain) to which the linked directory belongs. However, the connection itself may have a separate security setting, and the deletion of a directory connection does not remove the target directory at the same time.
title: NTFS

source_text: 有些目录连接是Windows Vista系统创建的，用于保持和早期版本的Windows的兼容性，例如系统驱动器中的Documents and Settings文件夹会被连接到同一个卷中的Users物理目录上。这些目录默认情况下是隐藏的，并且进行相关的安全设置，因此Windows资源管理器不允许外壳或者大部分应用程序直接打开它们，这样的设置可能是为了防止用户发现两个看上去相同的文件夹，然后错误地删除其中的某一个。默认情况下只有本机的SYSTEM账户或者的Administrators用户组成员可以访问这些目录，这是考虑到这些账户安装软件的权限，而安装时可能会产生兼容性问题。
target_text: Some catalogue connections are created by Windows Vista and are used to maintain compatibility with earlier versions of Windows, such as the Documents and Settings folders in the system drive that are connected to the Users physical directory in the same volume. These directories are hidden by default and associated security settings are performed, so Windows resource managers do not allow the outer shell or most applications to open them directly, possibly to prevent users from discovering two folders that look the same and then wrongly delete one of them. By default, only members of the SYSTEM account or Administator group of users on the system can access these directories, given the authority to install the software for these accounts, which may create compatibility problems.
title: NTFS

source_text: 目录连接属于软链接（即使目标目录已经被删除，他们也仍然存在），使用一种类似符号链接的方式工作（只不过对于目标位置和类型有额外的限制），但NTFS文件系统对它们进行特殊优化，解析更快，相比于之后提出的NTFS 符号链接，目录连接的开销更小，且可以在服务器端解析，因此可以在远程共享目录中使用它们。
target_text: Directory connections are soft (even if the target directory has been deleted, they still exist) and work in a similar way (only with additional limitations on the location and type of target), but NTFS file systems optimize them in a special way, parsing them faster, with less cost for directory connections than the NTFS symbols that were subsequently presented, and can be interpreted on the server end, so that they can be used in the remote shared directory.
title: NTFS

source_text: 符号链接可以链接到文件（使用MKLINK符号链接目标文件名创建），也可以链接到目录（使用MKLINK /D符号链接目标目录创建）。和Unix符号链接不同的一点是，NTFS符号链接在创建的时候就要决定目标类型（目录或文件），但创建符号链接的时候并不需要目标已经存在或可以访问，在访问时才会实际检查可访问性。NTFS在访问符号链接时也会检查目标的类型，由于NTFS不允许在任何位置有目录和文件同名，因此如果目标名称存在但是类型不正确，系统也会返回一个找不到目标的错误。
target_text: Symbolic links can be linked to a file (created using the MKLINK symbol link to the target filename) or to a directory (created using the MKLINK/D symbol link link to the target directory). Unlike the Unix symbol link, the NTFS symbol link determines the target type (director or file) when it is created, but does not require that the target already exists or is accessible, and physical accessibility is checked when it is accessed. NTFS also examines the type of target when accessing the symbol link, and since NTFS does not allow directory and file identical names in any location, if the target name exists but the type is incorrect, the system will also return an error where the target cannot be found.
title: NTFS

source_text: 符号链接也可以引用远程主机上的共享文件夹或者其中的文件、子文件夹。但目标并不会被立即加载，而是在应用程序使用OpenFile()或者CreateFile() API请求打开目标的时候才加载到系统中。符号链接是永久的（重新启动后仍然保留在对应的卷上），可以在命令行或者脚本中使用DEL符号链接删除它们。
target_text: Symbol links can also refer to the shared folders on the remote host or to the files and subfolders contained therein. However, the target will not be loaded immediately, but only when the application uses OpenFile() or CreateFile() API to request the opening of the target. Symbol links are permanent (stay on the corresponding volume after restart) and can be deleted by using the DEL sign link in the command line or script.
title: NTFS

source_text:
分层存储管理（HSM）
分层存储管理是一种转移一定时间不用的文件到价值更低的储存介质中的方法。当文件再次被访问时，文件上的重解析点将判定文件需要被使用，并将文件从储存介质中恢复出来。分层存储不但可以节省存储开销，也可以提高操作系统的数据读写和运行效率。
target_text: Layer storage management (HSM) is a method of transferring time-consuming files to lower-value storage media. When a file is again accessed, the resolution point on the file determines that the file needs to be used and that the file is recovered from the stored medium. Layer storage not only saves storage costs, but also improves the data reading, writing and running efficiency of the operating system.
title: NTFS

source_text:
本机结构存储（NSS）
本机结构存储是一种已经被Microsoft终止使用的ActiveX文档存储技术。这项技术允许ActiveX文档使用和ActiveX内部的多流格式相同的方式进行储存。操作系统会加载一个NSS文件过滤驱动程序，可以在应用程序使用文件时透明地处理多流格式。当NSS文件被传输到非NTFS格式的磁盘卷上时，文件内部的多个流将被合并转换为一个流。
target_text: This technology allows the activeX document to be stored in the same way as the multiple-flow format within the activeX. The operating system will load an NSS file filter driver that can handle the multi-flow format transparently when the application uses files. When NSS files are transferred to diskettes other than NTFS formats, multiple streams within the file will be converted into a stream.
title: NTFS

source_text: 分布链接跟踪功能允许应用程序跟踪被重命名或者移动到同一计算机、域或工作组的其它卷中的文件、快捷方式和OLE链接。跟踪功能由一个系统服务提供，使用存储在元文件中的对象标识符（OID）索引实现。当应用程序请求跟踪某个文件或目录后，跟踪服务将会创建对象的OID项并指向目标。在一个NTFS v3上执行文件重命名、复制或移动操作时，也会同时复制对象的OID，这样跟踪服务就可以有效地寻找到目标。
target_text: Distributed link tracking allows applications to track files, shortcuts and OLE links that are renamed or moved to other volumes of the same computer, domain or working group. The tracking function is provided by a system service using the object identifier (OID) index stored in the meta-file. When an application requests to track a file or directory, the tracking service will create the object ' s AID entry and point to the target. When executing a renaming, copying or moving operation on an NTFS v3, the object ' s AID will also be copied at the same time, so that the tracking service can effectively find the target.
title: NTFS

source_text:
单实例存储（SIS）
当若干个不同目录中存有内容相同的文件时，单实例存储允许将相同文件归并到一个单一文件中，并将所有文件引用到实际的文件上。单实例存储功能包含一个用于管理复制、修改和归并文件的文件系统过滤器和一个用于搜索需要归并的相同文件的用户空间服务（“groveler”）。单实例存储提出时的主要针对目标是远程安装服务器，这些服务器上往往拥有若干个包含大量相同文件的安装镜像，单实例存储可以将它们统一起来，因而节省需要占用的总尺寸。和硬链接不同的一点是，在SIS下，每个文件在逻辑上仍然是独立的，更改被合并为单个文件的任意其中一个文件都不会影响其它文件，而是会取消对该文件的合并并产生一个新的副本。不过新文件不会立即写入到硬盘，NTFS使用类似于写入时复制的技术，在文件最终需要保存时才执行复制。
target_text: Single instance storage (SIS) when several different directories contain documents with the same content, the single instance storage allows the same documents to be grouped together into a single file and all documents to be quoted on the actual document. The single instance storage feature contains a file system filter for managing copying, modifying and consolidating the file, and a user-space service for searching for the same file that needs to be merged (“groveler”). The primary objective of the single example storage is to install servers remotely, often with several installed mirrors containing a large number of the same documents, so that the single example storage can unify them, saving the total size that needs to be occupied. Unlike the hard link, under SIS, each document remains logically independent, changing any one of the documents that is merged into a single document will not affect the other documents, but will cancel the consolidation of the document and produce a new copy.
title: NTFS

source_text: 内部实现在内部，NTFS使用B+树索引文件系统数据。这种数据结构的方式实现比较复杂，但能够在大多数情况下提高文件的查找速度。文件系统日志用于确保文件的元数据完整，不存在孤立的文件内容。相比于FAT文件系统，NTFS文件系统的可靠性更高。NTFS允许对名称（包括文件名称、流名称、索引名称等）使用除了0x0000以外的任意16位值序列进行编码。这意味着支持NTFS支持UTF-16码位，但文件系统并不会检查某个UTF-16序列是否有效（也即允许NTFS内部任意16位整数序列，不受Unicode标准的限制）。
target_text: Internally, NTFS uses B+ Tree Indexing File System data. This data structure is complicated, but in most cases increases the search speed of the files. The file system logs are used to ensure the metadata integrity of the files and there are no isolated file contents. The NTFS file system is more reliable than the FAT file system. NTFS allows the encoding of names (including file names, stream names, index names, etc.) using any 16-bit series other than 0x000. This means supporting NTFS in supporting the UTF-16 code, but the file system does not check the validity of a UTF-16 sequence (i.e. allowing any 16-digit integer sequence within NTFS, not subject to Unicode criteria).
title: NTFS

source_text:
主文件表（MFT）
在NTFS中，所有文件数据——文件名、创建日期、访问权限（使用访问控制列表（ACL）实现），以及内容——都作为元数据储存在主文件表中。这种抽象的实现方式能够大大简化为文件系统添加功能的成本。例如，Active Directory（活动目录）服务可以很容易在文件系统中为文件添加索引字段。这种设计方式也使得Everything或者Ultrasearch一类的软件可以不依赖于Windows Search实现对文件和文件夹名称的实时搜索。
target_text: In NTFS, all file data - filename, date of creation, access rights (with access control list (ACL)) and content - are stored as metadata in the master file list. This abstract approach can be significantly simplified to add functional costs to the file system. For example, the Active Directory (activity directory) service can easily add index fields to documents in the file system. This design also allows software such as Engineering or Ultrasearch to do real-time search of files and folder names without relying on WindowsSearch.
title: NTFS

source_text:
元文件
NTFS包含若干用于定义和组织文件系统的文件。总体来说，这些文件中的绝大多数结构和其它用户文件类似（只有“$Volume”比较特殊），但不能被文件系统客户端直接访问。这些元文件为定义文件、备份文件系统的关键数据、缓存文件系统的更改、管理空闲空间的分配、满足BIOS的要求、跟踪坏扇区单元，以及储存安全信息和磁盘空间使用情况等等多种不同需求提供支持。
target_text: The metadata NTFS contains a number of files used to define and organize file systems. Overall, most of these documents are similar to other user files (only “$Volume” is special), but cannot be accessed directly by file system clients. These metadata are supported by a variety of different needs, such as defining files, key data for backup file systems, changes to cache file systems, managing the allocation of free space, meeting BIOS requirements, tracking bad fan units, and storing secure information and disk space usage.
title: NTFS

source_text: Windows对这些元文件的处理方式较为特殊，直接由NTFS.SYS进行处理，因此难以直接查看，需要使用特殊工具进行提取。从Windows 7开始，NTFS驱动程序完全阻擋了用户访问权限，任何尝试访问元文件的请求都会直接进入蓝屏死机界面。微软“OEM支持工具”中的“nfi.exe（NTFS文件扇区信息实用工具）”是一个可查看这些文件的工具l.liru，要查看“$MFT”的内容，只需使用下列命令行：nfi.exe c:\$MFT。另一个绕过操作系统保护限制的方法是使用7-Zip文件管理器工具并输入低级NTFS路径\\.x:\，此时将会出现三个新的文件夹：$extend、$[DELETED]以及[SYSTEM]。这个操作可以用于任何可移动设备，但如果需要访问当前活动分区，则需要进入离线模式（也即WinRE）。
target_text: Windows handles these meta-files in a special way, directly by NTFS.SYS, which makes it difficult to view them directly and requires special tools to extract them. Starting with Windows 7, the NTFS driver has completely blocked user access, and any request to try to access the meta-file will enter directly into the blue screen dead-screen interface. In Microsoft's OEM support tool, “nfi.exe” (NTFS sector information utility) is a tool that allows access to these documents.l.liru, which uses the following command lines: nfi.exe c:\mFT. Another method of bypassing the operating system is to use the 7-Zip file manager tool and enter the low-level NTFS path\\x:\, at which time three new folders will be available: $extend, $ [DELETED] and [SYSTEM].
title: NTFS

source_text:
从MFT到属性、属性表和流
对于每个MFT记录所描述的文件或目录，都有一个线性存放的流描述符（也即属性）存储区，被打包后存放在一个变长记录（也即属性表）中，然后使用额外的填充符填充以满足MFT记录的1Kib对齐要求。这部分数据完整地描述了和文件相关联的所有数据流。注意此处的“流”和文件数据流不是一个概念，而是所有数据信息的统称。
target_text: From MFT to properties, attribute tables and streams, for each file or directory described in the MFT record, there is a linear stream descriptor (i.e. properties) storage area, which is packed and stored in a variable record (i.e. properties table) and then filled with additional fillers to meet the 1kib alignment requirements of MFT records. This part of the data describes all data streams associated with the file in a complete way. Note that the " current " and the file data stream here are not a concept but a generic description of all data information.
title: NTFS

source_text: 每个流（或称属性）本身包含如下数据：类型（内部通常存储为一个固定长度的整数或者一个描述符，但通常开发应用程序开发时调用FileOpen()或者FileCreate() API时会使用等效的标识符来代表它）、流名称（可选，注意和文件名没有任何关系），以及数据（可选，但大部分流具有数据）。对于NTFS而言，文件的主数据（也即文件内容）、目录的索引信息、文件的可选数据流、以及文件的所有属性，处理方式都是完全相同的，他们都是属性表中的某个属性而已。
target_text: Each stream (or attribute) itself contains the following data: the type (which is usually stored internally in an integer of a fixed length or a descriptor), but typically the application is developed using an equivalent identifier to represent it using FileOpen() or FileCreate() API, the current name (optional, note and file name have no relation), and the data (optional, but most flow has data). For NTFS, the main data of the document (i.e., the contents of the document), index information of the directory, the optional data stream of the document, and all attributes of the document are treated in exactly the same way, and they are all attributes in the attribute table.
title: NTFS

source_text: 对于每个MFT中描述的文件（或非常驻的流描述符存储区，此概念请参考下文），每种流描述符（使用流类型+流名称联合区分）必须唯一。此外，NTFS还对于描述符有一些用于排序的约束要求。NTFS预定义了一种称为“空流”的类型，用于在流存储区中表明流描述符的结尾。空流必须是每个存储区中的最后一个流描述符，所有之后的剩余空间都将被忽略，只包含填充字节（用于满足MFT的记录尺寸要求或者非常驻流存储区的簇尺寸要求）。对于每个MFT记录，某些类型的流必须存在，例外是整个记录只有一个空流表示该记录未使用。这里的“某些”具体指的是包含时间戳和其它单比特（Bit）的属性的“标准属性”，这种属性的长度和格式是固定的，这是为了兼容DOS或者Windows 95/98管理的FAT/FAT32文件。某些类型的流不能包含名称，必须是匿名的。这里的“某些”包括标准属性、NTFS的“文件名”流，以及“短文件名”流（注意如果该文件无需考虑对DOS应用程序的兼容性，则“短文件名”流并不一定出现）。有些时候文件也可能只包含“短文件名”而没有“文件名”，这时候短文件名会代替文件名显示在资源管理器的“文件名”一栏中。即使流存储区中包含有“文件名”流，也并不表示文件一定会出现在文件系统中。要显示文件，该项目还必须要进入卷上的某个目录的索引表。
target_text: For each document described in the MFT (or non-resident stream description repository, the concept is referred to below), each stream descriptor (using the stream type + stream name combined) must be unique. NTFS also has some binding requirements for sorting. NTFS predefined a type of profile as “air stream” that is used to indicate the end of the current descriptor in the stream storage area. The air stream must be the last stream descriptor in each repository (or the non-resident current description area, where all remaining space will be ignored) and will contain only the fill-in by type (the log size requirements for MFT or the size requirements for the non-relocation storage area). For each MFT record, there must be only one stream indicating that the record is not used. The “some” here refers to a “standard attribute” that contains the attributes on the time stamp and the bits of the document that appear in the stream file (the “S-to-S” file may also contain the “S-to-to-S” file, and the “S-to-to-to-to-to-to-to-to-to-to-
title: NTFS

source_text: 注意目录的索引表中除了记录该文件的MFT记录编号外，也对文件单独提供一份MFT记录、安全描述符、属性表等，因此理论上单个文件可以被多个目录“硬链接”多次，并且在每个目录中显示为不同的名称。表示文件数据的默认数据流的流类型为$DATA，该数据流没有名称。可选数据流使用同样的流类型，但必须具有流名称。目录的默认数据流和文件的情况不同，目录的数据流（存放文件的索引表）不是匿名的，NTFS会通过目录的数据流的名称（如在NTFS 3以上版本中为“$I30”）来表明目录索引的格式。
target_text: Note that the index table of the table of contents, in addition to recording the MFT record number of the document, provides a separate MFT record, security description, attribute table, etc. to the document, so that, in theory, individual files can be " hard-linked " to multiple directories and appear as different names in each directory. The default data stream type for the file data is $DATA, which has no name. The selected data stream uses the same flow type, but it must have a flow name. The default data stream and the file of the directory are different, the data stream of the directory (the index table for which the file is stored) is not anonymous, and NTFS will indicate the format of the index through the name of the directory ' s data stream (e.g. " $I30 " in NTFS 3 and above).
title: NTFS

source_text:
常驻文件和非常驻文件
为了优化小数据文件的资源占用并降低I/O负荷，在流描述符和文件数据大小总和不超过单个MFT最大记录大小时，NTFS会直接将数据放入流描述符区域中（通常情况下，MFT中数据流的内容是实际文件数据锁在的簇的列表）。此类直接将数据存入MFT的文件被称计算机取证工作者称为“常驻数据”。常驻文件允许的数据量受到文件其它信息占用的流描述符大小的影响，通常一个没有可选数据流、文件名不长且无特殊ACL设置的文件允许存放700到800个字节。
target_text: In order to optimize the resource occupancy of small data files and reduce the I/O load, NTFS will directly place data in the flow description area (usually the data stream in the MFT is a list of boxes in which actual data are locked). Such files that place data directly in MFT are referred to as “resident data” by the computer forensics. The amount of data allowed in the permanent files is affected by the size of the flow description that other information is occupied by the document, and usually 700 to 800 bytes are allowed to be stored in a file that has no optional data stream, no file name and no special ACL setting.
title: NTFS

source_text:
某些流描述符（如上文提到的首选文件名、基本文件属性，以及下文所述的非常驻流主分配表）必须以常驻形式存在。
启用NTFS加密的流、稀疏数据流，以及压缩数据流无法常驻。
非常驻流的分配图格式和文件是否为稀疏文件有关。对目前版本的NTFS而言，如果某个非常驻数据流被转换为稀疏流，将无法还原为非稀疏格式，因此该文件将无法重新常驻，除非将流完全截断并且丢弃整个稀疏分配图。
如果一个非常驻数据流碎片太多，以至于在MFT记录中无法放下整个分配图，则分配图本身可能也会被存放到一个非常驻流当中，而文件本身只包含一个小型常驻数据流，其内容是标识非常驻分配图所在的簇的位置。
如果一个文件的流太多（包括可选数据流、扩展属性、安全描述符等），流描述符无法完整放入MFT中，则NTFS也会建立一个非常驻数据流，用于存放必须常驻的流之外的其它流描述，该数据流使用和MFT一样的格式，但不再有空间尺寸限制。
target_text: For the current version of NTFS, if a non-resident data stream is converted into a thin stream, it will not be possible to restore the non-hidden format, unless the flow is completely cut off and the entire distribution map is discarded. If a non-resident data stream is too large to leave the entire distribution map in MFT records, the map itself may be stored in a very resident stream, while the document itself contains only a small resident data stream, marking the location where the distribution map is located.
title: NTFS

source_text:
机会锁
机会锁（Oplock）允许网络客户端改变对文件或数据流的缓存策略，以便于增强性能或降低网络占用。机会锁应用到文件某个打开的流上，不影响同一个文件的其它流。机会锁可以用于在后台透明访问文件。如果没有其它进程访问服务器文件，网络客户端可以避免向文件写入数据；而如果没有其他进程正在写入数据，客户端可以缓存即将读取的数据。
target_text: Oplock allows a network client to change the cache policy for a file or data stream in order to enhance performance or reduce network occupancy. The opportunist lock is applied to an open stream of a file and does not affect other streams of the same file. The opportunist lock can be used for transparent access to files on the backstage. If no other process has access to the server file, the network client can avoid writing data to the file; and if no other process is in the process of writing the data, the client can cache the data to be read.
title: NTFS

source_text:
等级2（共享）：多个读取，不可写入（也即读缓存）。
等级1（独占）：任意缓冲方式的独占访问（也即读写缓存）。
批量锁（也是独占的）：在服务器上打开流，在客户端关闭流（读、写和句柄缓存）。
过滤锁（也是独占的）：当其它程序尝试访问流时，应用程序和系统过滤器可以放弃该锁（读写缓存，从Windows 2000开始受支持）
target_text: Level 2 (shared): Multiple readings, which cannot be written (i.e. read caches). Level 1 (exclusive): exclusive access to any buffer (i.e., read-write caches). Bulk locks (also exclusive): open currents on the server and close currents on the client (reading, writing and sentence handle caches). Filter locks (also exclusive): applications and system filters can drop the lock when other applications try to access the stream (read-write caches, supported from Windows 2000)
title: NTFS

source_text: 由于历史原因，不支持NTFS的Windows使用本地时区作为时间戳，而目前版本的Windows对非NTFS分区也是用此方式进行处理。这意味着当文件在NTFS和非NTFS分区间进行移动时，操作系统需要实时转换时间戳。如果某些文件移动时处于夏令时，而某些文件处于标准时间，则可能移动后的时间可能会产生歧义，特别是当执行时间正好在时制转换前后时，用户可能会看到一小时的时间差。基于不同地区的不同夏令时规则，在任意12个月中，可能会产生最多4个小时的永久时间戳错误。
target_text: For historical reasons, Windows, which does not support NTFS, uses the local time zone as a time stamp, and the current version of Windows deals with non-NTFS partitions in this way. This means that when documents move between NTFS and non-NTFS divisions, the operating system needs a real-time conversion time stamp. If some documents move at summertime while some documents are at standard time, there may be confusion about the time they move, especially when the execution time is right before and after the time conversion, users may see a one-hour time difference. Depending on the different summer time rules in different regions, a permanent time stamp error of up to four hours may occur in any 12 months.
title: NTFS

source_text:
互操作性
NTFS具体的内部实现细节属于商业秘密，这给第三方开发者制作NTFS文件系统处理程序带来很大的困难。Microsoft Windows
尽管绝大多数NTFS版本的绝大部分都完全向前以及向后兼容，但在旧版本的Microsoft Windows加载新版本的NTFS卷仍然会产生不少技术问题。这种问题往往来自于同一台计算机的多重启动功能，或者使用移动硬盘设备传输文件。
target_text: The interoperability of NTFS-specific internal details is a commercial secret, which makes it very difficult for third-party developers to produce NTFS file-processing procedures. While the vast majority of Microsoft Windows versions are fully forward-to-back compatible, there are still a number of technical problems associated with the loading of new versions of NTFS files in the old Microsoft Windows version. Such problems often arise from multiple start-up functions of the same computer, or the use of mobile hard disk devices to transmit files.
title: NTFS

source_text:
Mac OS X
Mac OS X 10.3及后续版本包含对NTFS格式分区的只读支持。基于GPL授权的NTFS-3G也可以通过用户空间文件系统在Mac OS X上使用并读写NTFS分区。NTFS-3G的开发团队还提供一个性能更好的商业版本，名称为“Tuxera NTFS for Mac”。 Paragon Software Group也出售可执行读写操作的驱动程序，名称为“NTFS for Mac OS X”，部分希捷（Seagate）硬盘包含该组件。Mac OS X 10.6和后续版本中包含有本机NTFS的写入支持，默认情况下此功能未激活，可以通过特定方法打开。但有用户报告此功能不稳定并会导致内核错误，可能这也是该功能未启动或者被宣告的原因之一。
target_text: Mac OS X Mac OS X 10.3 and subsequent versions contain read-only support for the NTFS format partition. NTFS-3G, based on the GPL, can also use and read and write the NTFS partition on the Mac OS X user space file system. The NTFS-3G development team also provides a better commercial version called “Tuxera NTFS for Mac.” Paragon Software Group also sells a driver for reading and writing operations called “NTFS for Mac OS X”, which may be one of the reasons why the functionality has not been activated or announced. Mac OS X10.6 and subsequent versions contain written support for the machine NTFS, which could be opened by default.
title: NTFS

source_text: 请注意，上面所有三个用户级别驱动程序（NTFSMount、NTFS-3G以及Captive NTFS）都基于用户空间文件系统（FUSE）实现的，该系统是一个用于在用户空间和内核代码间通讯以获取或保存数据的Linux内核模块。上面所有的驱动程序（除了Tuxera NTFS和Paragon NTFS for Linux）都是以GPL的方式开源的。由于NTFS内部结构非常复杂，内置的2.6.14内核驱动程序和FUSE都不允许修改被认为是不安全的卷，以避免发生数据丢失。
target_text: Note that all three above user-level drivers (NTFSMount, NTFS-3G, and Captive NTFS) are based on the User Space File System (FUSE), a Linux kernel module used to communicate between user space and kernel code to obtain or save data. All above drivers (except Tuxera NTFS and Paragon NTFS for Linux) are sourced in a GPL format. Due to the complexity of the NTFS internal structure, the built-in 2.6.14 internal kernel driver and FUSE are not allowed to modify volumes considered unsafe to avoid data loss.
title: NTFS

source_text:
调整大小
有许多第三方工具可以安全地重新调整NTFS分区的大小。在Windows Vista中，Microsoft添加收缩和扩展分区的功能，但该功能非常有限，因为该功能无法整理页面文件碎片或者标记为不可移动的文件，因此限制对分区的收缩能力。取消页面文件重新启动或使用第三方的工具进行磁盘碎片整理也许能改善收缩效果。
target_text: Resize Many third-party tools can safely resize the NTFS partitions. In Windows Vista, Microsoft adds the function of the contraction and extension partitions, but this function is very limited because it is not able to sort page file fragments or mark them as non-movable files, thus limiting the contraction capacity of the partitions. Disableing page files from restarting or using third-party tools for disk debris sorting may improve the contraction effect.
title: NTFS

source_text: Emacs（，源自Editor MACroS，宏编辑器），是一个文本编辑器家族，它具有可扩展性，使用者以程序员和其他以技术工作为主的计算机用户為主。最初由理查德·斯托曼於1975年在MIT协同蓋伊·史提爾二世共同完成。这一创意的灵感来源于TECO宏编辑器TECMAC和TMACS，它们是由蓋伊·史提爾二世、、李察·格連布勒、Charles Frankston等人编写的宏文本编辑器。
target_text: Emacs (from Editor Macros, Macro Editor) is a text editor family that is scalable and whose users are predominantly programmers and other technocrat-oriented computer users. This idea was originally carried out in 1975 by Richard Storman in collaboration with Guy Steel II. The idea was inspired by TEDCO Macro Editors TECMAC and TMACS, which are macro text editors by Guy Steel II, Richard Glymbler, Charles Frankston and others.
title: Emacs

source_text: 这一新版的TECO立刻在AI实验室流行开来，并且很快积累起了大量自定义的宏，这些宏的名字通常就以“MAC”或者“MACS”结尾，意为“宏”（macro）。两年后，蓋伊·史提爾二世承担起统一当时存在的各种键盘命令集的工作。史提爾和斯托曼经过一夜奋战，最终由斯托曼完成了这一任务，包括一套扩展和注释新的宏包的工具。这个完成的系统被称作EMACS，代表“Editing MACroS”，也代表“E with MACroS”。
target_text: Two years later, Guy Steel II took over the task of unifying the sets of keyboard commands that existed at the time. After a night-long struggle, Stømmen and Storman eventually completed the task, including an extended and annotated package of tools. The completed system was known as “Editing MACRROS” and “E with MACRROS.”
title: Emacs

source_text: GNU Emacs后来被移植到了Unix系统上。它比Gosling Emacs拥有更多的的功能，尤其是它有一个真正的Lisp作为扩展语言。结果，GNU Emacs很快就取代了Gosling Emacs，成为Unix系统上預設的Emacs编辑器。到1999年为止，GNU Emacs的开发工作基本是在封闭的情况下进行。这种开发方式在《大教堂和市集》中被称为“大教堂模式”。从那以后，GNU Emacs项目建立了公共开发邮件列表和匿名CVS代码访问，开发工作在一个CVS代码仓库中进行。2008年，Emacs开始使用Bazaar进行版本控制。
target_text: As a result, GNU Emacs quickly replaced Gosling Emacs as the default editor of Emacs on Unix. By 1999, the development of GNU Emacs was largely conducted under closed conditions. This development was called the “Church Model” in the Cathedrals and Markets. Since then, the GNU Emacs project has established a public development mailing list and anonymous CVS code access, which was developed in a CVS code warehouse. In 2008, Emacs began to use the Bazaar version for control.
title: Emacs

source_text: 除上述编辑器以外，还有很多不基于GNU Emacs的编辑器，有些项目的目标是创建一个精简版的Emacs。在1980年代，GNU Emacs只能在很高端的电脑上运行，这就为精简版的Emacs实现的出现奠定了基础。还有一些Emacs变种是为了克隆一个完整的Emacs，但是使用不同的Lisp方言或者其他的编程语言。比如：
target_text: In addition to the above-mentioned editors, there are many editors that are not based on GNU Emacs, some of which aim to create a streamlined version of Emacs. In the 1980s, GNU Emacs was able to operate only on high-end computers, which laid the groundwork for the emergence of a streamlined version of Emacs. There are other Emacs variants designed to clone a complete Emacs, but using different Lisp dialects or other programming languages, for example:
title: Emacs

source_text:
版权
Emacs的版权遵从GNU通用公共许可证，赋予他人自由地对包括C和Lisp在内的Emacs源文件进行修改和再发行的权利。较早版本的GNU Emacs文档是在一种点对点（ad-hoc）的许可下发布的，要求所有修改过的副本都要包含某些特定的文字。例如，GNU Emacs的用户手册中必须包含如何获得GNU Emacs的说明，以及理查·史托曼的文章——《GNU宣言》。作为较早版本的GNU Emacs的分支，XEmacs的手册也采用相同的使用许可。较新版本的GNU Emacs文档则采用《GNU自由文档许可证》，以使用“不变段落”（"invariant sections"）的形式包含有同样的文本，并且要求这些文档自我声明为“GNU手册”（GNU Manuals）。
target_text: The copyright of the copyright Emacs is subject to the GNU General Public Licence, which grants others the freedom to modify and reissue the Emacs source documents, including C and Lip. The earlier version of the GNU Emacs document was issued under a licence from a point-to-point (ad-hoc) and requires that all revised copies contain certain specific text. For example, the GNU Emacs user manual must contain a description of how to obtain GNU Emacs and Richard Storman's article - the GNU Declaration. As an earlier version of GNU Emacs, the XEmacs handbook also uses the same licence.
title: Emacs

source_text: GNU Emacs几乎所有的功能都可以定制，有的可以通过C语言实现，有的可以通过一个Lisp的方言——Emacs Lisp来实现。在Lisp环境中，变量和子程序可以在不重新编译/启动Emacs的前提下被修改。Emacs用户可以根据自身的需要和偏好对编辑器进行定制。强大而自由的个人定制功能是Emacs受到广泛欢迎的重要原因之一。定制Emacs主要有三种方法：
target_text: Almost all functions of GNU Emacs can be customized, some in C, some in a Lisp dialect, Emacs Lip. In the Lip environment, variables and sub-procedures can be modified without recompiling/starting Emacs. Emacs users can customize editors according to their own needs and preferences. Strong and free personal customization is one of the important reasons that Emacs is widely welcomed. There are three main ways to customise Emacs:
title: Emacs

source_text:
语法高亮（“font lock”）：对源文件文本中的关键字、注释加以不同的字体和颜色（“faces”）。
自动缩进，用来维护文件的格式一致。
自动插入文件所需要的结构元素，如空格、换行以及括号。
特殊的编辑命令，比如跳转到函数的开头或者结尾，或者（在类似于XML的标记语言中）验证文档还有插入关闭标签。
target_text: Syntax Highlighting (“font lock”): Different fonts and colours for key words, notes, in source file text (“faces”). Automatic indentation is used to maintain the same format for files. Automatically inserts the structural elements required for a file, such as spaces, line breaks, and brackets. Special editorial commands, such as jumping to the beginning or end of a function, or (in XML-like tag language) authentication documents also have a closing tag.
title: Emacs

source_text: Emacs支持对多种文字的文本编辑，加上对多种字符集、字母系统、书写系统，以及不同文化的书写习惯都提供了支持，使得世界上大多数语言的使用者都能通过Emacs进行文本处理。Emacs还能通过调用诸如Aspell这样的外部程序，实现多种语言的拼写检查。GNU Emacs 24添加了对双向文字的支持。
target_text: Emacs supports text editing for multiple text sets, along with support for multiple character sets, alphabets, writing systems, and cultural writing habits, enabling most language users in the world to process text through Emacs. Emacs can also achieve spell-checking for multiple languages by calling external programs like Aspell. GNU Emacs 24 adds support for two-way text.
title: Emacs

source_text: 使用Emacs命令在普通的编辑模式下，GNU Emacs和其他文本编辑器一样，允许用户通过按下键盘上的键插入其相对应的字符，也可以使用键盘上的方向键来移动光标。使用各种修饰键（如[Ctrl]、[Alt]、[Shift]等）和其它的普通键配合可以调用Emacs Lisp函数和宏。某些GNU Emacs命令会调用外部程序，比如使用Aspell进行拼写检查或者使用GCC进行程序编译，解析被调用的外部程序的输出，并将结果显示出来。习惯IBM Common User Access的用户可以使用“cua-mode”，“cua-mode”曾经是一个第三方插件，从GNU Emacs 22开始被包含在Emacs中。
target_text: Using Emacs commands in normal editing mode, GNU Emacs, like other text editors, allows users to insert their corresponding characters by pressing the key on the keyboard or using the direction keys on the keyboard to move the cursor. Use various modifiers (e.g. [Ctrl], [Alt], [Shift], etc.) and other general key combinations can call Emacs Lips functions and macros. Some GNU Emacs commands call external programs, such as spell-checking using Aspell or programming using GCC to interpret the output of the external program that is being called, and show results. IBM Common User Access users can use “cua-mode”, which used to be a third-party plugged from GNU Emacs 22, which began to be included in Emacs.
title: Emacs

source_text: 下表给出了一些基本命令。[Ctrl]键以大写C表示，[Meta]键[Alt]键以大写M表示。注：中文系统C-[空格]一般为系统输入法，可使用C-@代替。小缓冲Emacs使用“小缓冲”（通常在最下面一行）显示信息提示以及输入命令和命令参数。在合适的情况下，小缓冲支持使用制表键或空格键补全。每个frame只有一个小缓冲。
target_text: The following table gives some basic commands. The [Ctrl] key is in upper case C, while the [Meta] key is in upper case M. Note: Chinese system C-[space] is generally a system input method and can be replaced by C-@. Small buffer Emacs displays information tips (usually in the bottom row) and input commands and command parameters. In appropriate cases, a small buffer supports the use of tabulators or spacebars. There is only one small buffer for each flame.
title: Emacs

source_text: Emacs将文本存放在缓冲区中。用户可以创建新的缓冲区，也可以关闭不需要的缓冲区，Emacs可以同时存在很多缓冲区。大部分的缓冲区的文本来自文本文件，用户可以编辑缓冲区的内容，并且保存到磁盘上。缓冲区也可以保存临时文本，比如“help”库显示的文档字符串。
target_text: Emacs stores the text in the buffer zone. Users can create new buffer zones or close buffer zones that they do not need, and Emacs can have many buffer zones at the same time. Most of the text of the buffer zone comes from text files, and users can edit the contents of the buffer zone and save them on disk.
title: Emacs

source_text:
使用 ergoemacs-mode 定制键盘布局。
定制键盘布局，使Ctrl和大寫鎖定键交换位置。其他相似的方法包括将大写锁定键定义为Ctrl，或交换Ctrl和Meta键。
god-mode 可以让 Emacs 不用修饰键就触发命令。
使用 evil-mode，一个高级的 Vim 模拟层。
Emacs有一个内置的“Viper-mode”，允许用户使用vi的键绑定来进行基本的文本编辑，而使用Emacs本身的键绑定来进行更高级的操作。
让一个更容易按的键（如空格键）拥有多种功能，当那个键和其他键一起按下时，功能为Ctrl键的。
使用语音输入控制Emacs。
很多软件，如xwrits，可以提醒用户进行定期的休息。
target_text: Use ergoemacs-mode custom keyboard layouts. Custom keyboard layouts allow Ctrl to switch to upper-case lock keys. Other similar methods include defining the upper-case lock key as Ctrl, or exchanging Ctrl and Meta keys. God-mode allows Emacs to trigger commands without modifiers. Use evil-mode, an advanced Vim simulation layer. Emacs has a built-in “Viper-mode”, allowing users to use vi-key bindings to perform basic text editing, while using Emacs' own key bindings for more advanced operations.
title: Emacs

source_text: 硬件方法包括使用特殊的键盘，如Kinesis键盘的修饰键放在大拇指很容易按到的位置，或者微软自然键盘，它的修饰键对称的放置在键盘的两边，并且可以使用手掌按下。脚控踏板也是一种方法。如果使用普通鍵盤，可以在按Ctrl組合鍵時手掌下移，用無名指擊Ctrl，或者直接以小指掌骨压下Ctrl，以規避小指過度利用。
target_text: Hardware methods include the use of special keyboards, such as modifier keys on the Kinesis keyboard where they can easily be pressed, or Microsoft natural keyboards, where the modifier keys are symmetrically placed on both sides of the keyboard and can be pressed with the palm of the hand. Footboard is also a method. If you use a normal keyboard, you can move it under the hand when you press the Ctrl group key, hit Ctrl without a name, or press Ctrl directly with a little finger to avoid overuse.
title: Emacs

source_text: “Emacs小拇指”是近些年才出现的。在Emacs诞生时，键盘的Ctrl键非常大，并且在空格键的旁边，使用大拇指很容易按。Vim 的拥护者经常以Emacs小拇指作为切换编辑器的原因，虽然有些 Vim 用户（因为相似的原因）也会交换模式转换键和大小写转换键的功能。注：本文第一部分，部分引用自遵守GFDL的《Emacs用户指南》汉译版
target_text: "Emacs' thumbs" emerged in recent years. When Emacs was born, the Ctrl key on the keyboard was so large that it was easy to use the thumb next to the spaces. Vim supporters often used the Emacs thumb as a reason to switch the editor, although some Vim users (for similar reasons) also exchanged mode conversion keys and case conversion keys.
title: Emacs

source_text: 协调世界时（，，简称UTC）是最主要的世界時間標準，其以原子时的秒长为基础，在时刻上尽量接近于-{zh-tw:格林威治標準時間;zh-hk:格林威治標準時間;zh-mo:格林威治標準時間;zh-cn:格林威治标准时间;}-。台灣採用CNS 7648的《資料元及交換格式–資訊交換–日期及時間的表示法》（與ISO 8601類似）稱之為「世界協-{}-調時間」；中華人民共和國採用ISO 8601:2000的国家标准GB/T 7408-2005《数据元和交换格式 信息交换 日期和时间表示法》中則称之为「协调世-{}-界时」。
target_text: UTC is the most important world time standard, based on the seconds of atom time, as close as possible at the moment as - {zh-tw: Greenwich Standard Time; zh-hk: Greenwich Standard Time; zh-mo: Greenwich Standard Time; zh-cn: Greenwich Standard Time;}-. Taiwan uses the Data Metameter and Exchange Format - Exchange Information Exchange - Timing and Time Expressions (like ISO 8601) as "World Compact--Changing Time"; and the People ' s Republic of China uses ISO 8601:2000 National Standard GB/T 7408-2005 Data Matrical and Exchange Format Information Exchange Dates and Time Expressions, known as "Harmonizing Times of the World--Way Times".
title: 协调世界时

source_text: 协调世界时是世界上调节时钟和时间的主要时间标准，它与0度经线的平太阳时相差不超过1秒，并不遵守夏令时。协调世界时是最接近格林威治标准时间（GMT）的几个替代时间系统之一。对于大多数用途来说，UTC时间被认为能与GMT时间互换，但GMT时间已不再被科学界所确定。
target_text: UTC time is considered to be interchangeable with GMT time for most uses, but GMT time is no longer determined by the scientific community.
title: 协调世界时

source_text: 协调世界时（UTC）正式形成于1963年国际无线电咨询委员会的374号建议中，该建议由多国时间实验室共同提出。人们对该时间系统进行过数次调整，直到1972年引入了闰秒机制，调整工作得以简化。也有很多人提议用一个没有闰秒的时间系统来替换掉协调世界时，但目前尚未就此达成一致。
target_text: The UTC was formalized in 1963 in recommendation 374 of the International Radio Advisory Committee, which was co-sponsored by the Multinational Time Laboratory. The time system was modified several times until 1972, when the snippet mechanism was introduced and the adjustment was simplified.
title: 协调世界时

source_text:
现行的协调世界时根据国际电信联盟的建议《Standard-frequency and time-signal emissions》(ITU-R TF.460-6)所确定。UTC基于国际原子时，并通过不规则的加入闰秒来抵消地球自转变慢的影响。闰秒在必要的时候会被插入到UTC中，以保证协调世界时（UTC）与世界时（UT1）相差不超过0.9秒。縮寫
協調世界時的縮寫為UTC。國際電信聯盟希望協調世界時能夠在所有語言有單一的縮寫。英語和法語區的人同時希望各自的語言縮寫－CUT和TUC能夠成為國際標準，結果最後妥協使用UTC，這個縮寫跟從世界時變種（UT0、UT1、UT2、UT1R等等）的縮寫模式相似。
target_text: When the UTC is based on international atoms, and offsets the slow transformation of the Earth by adding irregular seconds. When necessary, it is inserted into the UTC to ensure that the UTC is no more than 0.9 seconds apart from the World Hour (UT1). The acronym for the World Convergence is UTC. The ITU hopes that the world will be aligned with one another in all languages. People in the English and French communities hope that their respective language acronyms, CUTs and TUCs, will become international standards, and eventually use UTC, which is similar to the abbreviation pattern used to follow the evolution from the world (UTO, UT1, UT2, UT1R, etc.).
title: 协调世界时

source_text:
机理
协调世界时把时间分为天、小时、分钟和秒。通常，天是使用格里历（公历）定义的，但也能使用儒略日。每天包含24小时，每小时包含60分钟。一分钟通常有60秒，但加入了随机的闰秒后，一分钟可能是61秒或59秒。因此，在UTC系统的时间尺度中，秒和比秒小的单位（毫秒、微秒等）其长度是固定的，但是对于分钟和比分还大的单位（小时、天、周等），其长度是可变的。国际地球自转服务组织（IERS）做出插入闰秒的决定，并至少在加入前6个月发布在该组织的“公告C”中 。闰秒是无法提前很早预知的，因为地球的自转速率是不可预测的。
target_text: Time is divided into days, hours, minutes, and seconds in a coordinated world. Days are usually defined using the Grill (circle) but also Julian days. 24 hours a day, 60 minutes an hour. 60 seconds a minute, but a minute may be 61 seconds or 59 seconds after a random glitch. Thus, in the time scale of the UTC system, seconds and units smaller (ms, microseconds, etc.) are fixed, but their length is variable for minutes and larger units (hours, days, weeks, etc.). IERS makes a decision to insert seconds, which are published at least six months before joining.
title: 协调世界时

source_text: 几乎所有的UTC天都包含 86,400 SI秒，即每分钟正好有60秒。然而，由于一个平太阳日比 86,400 SI秒稍微长一些，偶尔会有一个UTC天的最后一分钟被调整为61秒。多出的这一秒被称为闰秒，它体现了上一闰秒后比平太阳日多出来的全部时长（大约每天2毫秒）。一个UTC天的最后一分钟也可以是59秒，以此来适应地球自转得更快的情况，但是这样的可能性很小，至今还没有出现过。UTC天的长度不规则意味着带小数的儒略日和UTC时间不能很好的对应。
target_text: Almost all UTC days contain 86,400 SI seconds, or exactly 60 seconds per minute. However, because a normal sun day is a little longer than a 86,400 SI second, occasionally the last minute of a UTC day is adjusted to 61 seconds. The extra second is called scaffolds, and it reflects the entire time (about 2 milliseconds per day) of a single UTC day longer than a flat sun day. The last minute of a UTC day can also be 59 seconds to adjust to a more rapid rotation of the Earth, but that is a very small possibility that has not yet occurred. The length of UTC days means that a small number of Julians and UTC times cannot correspond well.
title: 协调世界时

source_text: 为了保证协调世界时很接近世界时UT1，UTC从基于TAI的线性方程转变成另一方程时，偶尔会出现不连续点。这些不连续点以闰秒的形式体现出来，这些不连续点就是造成了UTC天的长度不规则的闰秒。IERS规定不连续点仅出现在6月或12月底，但也有规定将3月或者9月作为备选 。国际地球自转服务组织(IERS)跟踪并公布UTC时间和世界时的差别，即DUT1 = UT1 - UTC，另外，IERS也负责引入不连续的闰秒来保证它们的时间差DUT1在±0.9秒之间。
target_text: In order to ensure that UT1 is close to the world at the time of harmonization, there are occasional incoherent points when UTC moves from a linear equation based on TAI to another. These incoherent points appear in the form of chronology, which results in irregular lengths of UTC days. IERS provides for discontinuity in June or December only, but also for March or September as an alternative. IERS tracks and publicizes the difference between UTC time and the world, that is, DUT1 = UT1-UTC, and IERS is responsible for introducing non-continuous chutes to ensure that they have DUT1 time lags of ~0.9 seconds.
title: 协调世界时

source_text: 如果查询不到描述两UTC时刻之间闰秒数量的列表，就不可能计算出这段时间内的精确时差。相应的，计算出一段以未来时刻为终点的时间间隔的时差也是不可能的，因为其中可能包含了数量不定的闰秒(比如，“现在”和“2099-12-31 23:59:59”之间有多少TAI秒)。因此，许多要求长期(多年)高精度测量的科学应用使用TAI来代替UTC时间。TAI也经常被用在不能处理闰秒的系统中。GPS时总是恰好比TAI时落后19秒(TAI时和GPS时都不受UTC中引入的闰秒影响)。
target_text: Correspondingly, it is also impossible to calculate a time difference that ends with a time interval of the future, since it may include an indeterminate number of seconds (for example, the number of TAI seconds between “now” and “2099-12-31:23:59:59). Thus, many scientific applications that require long-term (multi-year) high-precision measurements use TAI to replace UTC time. TAI is also often used in systems that cannot handle stubby seconds. GPS times are always 19 seconds behind TAI times (TAI and GPS times are not affected by the seconds introduced in UTC).
title: 协调世界时

source_text:
历史
国际原子时的误差为每日数纳秒，而世界时的误差为每日数毫秒。对于这种情况，一种称为协调世界时的折衷时标于1972年面世。为确保协调世界时与世界时相差不会超过0.9秒，在有需要的情况下会在协调世界时内加上正或负闰秒。因此协调世界时与国际原子时之间会出现若干整数秒的差别。位于巴黎的国际地球自转事务中央局负责决定何时加入闰秒。
target_text: To ensure that the world is not more than 0.9 seconds apart from the world time, plus positive or negative seconds when the world is coordinated, if needed. So there will be a number of integer seconds between world coordination and international atomic time. The International Earth Transfer Central Bureau in Paris decides when to add seconds.
title: 协调世界时

source_text: 1884年，在华盛顿召开了国际子午线会议(International Meridian Conference)，英国格林尼治皇家天文台的当地平太阳时被指定为通用日，以午夜零时作为当天的起点。这种规定符合民用格林尼治时间(GMT)，民用GMT自1847年起就在大不列颠岛使用。相比之下，天文GMT开始于当天午夜后12小时的中午，直到1925年1月1日都是如此。与之相反，航海GMT开始于当天午夜前12小时的中午，至少到了1805年英国皇家海军还在使用，航海GMT在其他地方又被使用了更长的时间，因为1884年的国际子午线会议提到了它。1884年，有三分之二的图表和地图使用格林尼治子午线(Greenwich Meridian)作为它们的本初子午线(Prime Meridian)。1928年，国际天文联合会(International Astronomical Union)引入了世界时(UT)的概念来指代GMT，UT的一天开始于GMT的午夜。直到20世纪50年代，广播时间信号都是以世界时UT為準，因此也以地球的自转為準。
target_text: In 1884, the International Midday Conference was held in Washington, D.C., and, on the contrary, the local sun of the British Royal Greenwich Observatory was designated as General Day, starting at midnight and starting at midnight. This is consistent with the Civil Greenwich Time (GMT), which has been used in Great Britain since 1847. In 1884, two-thirds of the charts and maps used the Greenwich Midday Line until January 1st, 1925. Conversely, the navigation of the GMT began at noon, 12 hours before midnight, and was used by the Royal British Navy in 1805.
title: 协调世界时

source_text: 1955年，铯原子钟的发明，提供了一种比天文观测更稳定且更方便的授时机制。1956年，美国国家标准局(U.S. National Bureau of Standards)和美国海军天文台(U.S. Naval Observatory)开始研究以原子频率為準的时间尺度。到了1959年，这些时间尺度被用来生成WWV时间信号，并通过广播它们的无线电台广为人知。1960年，美国海军天文台、英国格林尼治皇家天文台以及英国国家物理实验室(UK National Physical Laboratory)协调了它们的无线电广播，由此时间的步长和频率的变化得到了协调，这样产生的时间尺度也被正式命名为“协调世界时”。
target_text: In 1955, the invention of the caesium atom clock provided a more stable and convenient timing mechanism than astronomical observations. In 1956, the United States National Standards Office (U.S. National Bureau of Standards) and the United States Naval Observatory (U.S. Naval Observatory) began researching time scales based on atomic frequencies. By 1959, these timescales were used to generate WWV time signals and were well known by broadcasting their radio stations. In 1960, the United States Naval Observatory, the British Royal Greenwich Observatory and the United Kingdom National Physics Laboratory coordinated their radio broadcasts.
title: 协调世界时

source_text: 1958年，将新确立的铯原子跃迁频率和历书秒联系起来的数据被公布 。当历书秒在支配太阳系行星和卫星运动的定律中充当自变量时，历书秒这种时间间隔可以使得这些定律能够准确预测太阳系中天体的观测位置。在观测精度允许的范围内，历书秒的长度是一定的，就像原子秒一样。这次公布的数据使得原子秒的某一长度值可以妥善地用于天体运动定律中。
target_text: In 1958, data linking the newly established frequency of caesium leaps to calendar seconds were published. When book seconds act as self-variant in the laws governing planets and satellite movements of the solar system, the time interval of book seconds allows these laws to accurately predict the observational position of celestial bodies in the solar system. To the extent permitted by the accuracy of observations, the length of book seconds is certain, as in the case of atomic seconds. This published data allows a certain length of atomic seconds to be properly used in the law of celestial motion.
title: 协调世界时

source_text: 1961年，国际时间局开始在国际上协调不同的UTC时间( 但是直到1967年国际天文学联合会才采用“协调世界时”这个命名 ) 。从那以后，每几个月就会出现时间跳跃的情况，频率的改变发生在每年的年末。每次跳跃都使时间增加100毫秒，这种UTC时间旨在能和世界时UT2保持很近似。
target_text: In 1961, the International Bureau of Time began to coordinate different UTC times at the international level (but it was not until 1967 that the International Astronomical Union adopted the name “Harmonizing the Time of the World”). Since then, there has been a time jump every few months, with a change in frequency occurring at the end of each year. Each jump increases the time by 100 milliseconds, and this UTC time is intended to be very similar to the time of the world when UT2.
title: 协调世界时

source_text: 1967年，国际单位制秒根据铯原子钟产生的频率被重新定义，这样定义的秒实际上和历书时的秒长度一样。这个频率就是1958年以来暂时用于TAI时间的频率。很快人们发现让不同长度的UTC秒和SI秒并存于TAI中是不对的。人们认为，时间信号保持在一个恒定的频率会更好，而那个频率应该和SI秒相符合。因此，有必要依赖于时间跳跃来保持时间信号和世界时UT很接近。人们在一个被称为“跳跃原子时”(SAT)的服务中尝试了这项实验，SAT时的秒长和TAI时的秒长一致，另外SAT使用了长度为200毫秒的时间阶跃来保持其和世界时UT2的同步。
target_text: In 1967, international unit seconds were redefined on the basis of the frequency generated by caesium atom clocks, which is actually the same as the length of the seconds in the books. This frequency is the frequency that has been temporarily used for TAI time since 1958. It was quickly discovered that it would be wrong to keep UTC seconds and SI seconds of different lengths in TAI. Time signals are thought to be better at a constant frequency, which should match SI seconds. It is therefore necessary to rely on time jumps to keep time signals close to world time UTs. This experiment has been tried in a service called “Stomping at the Atom” (SAT), where the seconds are consistent with the seconds in TAI, and where SATs use 200 milliseconds to keep their synchronity with world time UT2.
title: 协调世界时

source_text: 在UTC以及SAT系统中进行频繁的时间跳跃并不令人满意。1968年，G. M. R. Winkler以及铯原子钟的发明人Louis Essen，各自独立地提出时间阶跃的长度应仅为1秒。连同UTC的秒长应和TAI的秒长一致的观点，这样的系统最终得到了认可。UTC时间的最后一次不规则时间跳跃发生在1971年底，其长度为0.107758TAI秒，因此UTC时间1972年1月00:00:00恰好等于TAI时间的1972年1月00:00:10，这样一来UTC和TAI之间的时间差就被调整为了整数秒。同时，UTC时间每秒的变化和TAI的变化精确地一致。另外，UTC时间也开始在时刻上更接近UT1而非UT2。一些报时信号开始播报UT1和UTC之间的修正值DUT1，来满足那些需要比当前UTC更接近UT1的应用。
target_text: In 1968, the inventors of G.M.R. Winkler and cesium Atomic Clocks, Louis Essen, each independently, suggested that the length of the time leap should be only one second. The system was finally recognized, together with UTC seconds and TAI seconds, which were consistent. The last irregular time jump in UTC time took place at the end of 1971, with a length of 0.10758 TAI seconds, so that UTC time at 00:00:00:00 is exactly equal to TAI time at 00:10 January 1972, so that the difference in time between UTC and TAI is adjusted for full seconds. At the same time, UTC time is exactly the same as the change in TAI. In addition, UTC time is starting to come closer to UT1 instead of UT2.
title: 协调世界时

source_text:
日常使用
如果本地時間比UTC時間快，例如中国大陸、香港、澳门、臺灣、蒙古国、菲律宾、新加坡、马来西亚、澳大利亚西部的時間比UTC快8小時，就會寫作UTC+8，俗称东八区。相反，如果本地時間比UTC時間慢，例如夏威夷的時間比UTC時間慢10小時，就會寫作UTC-10，俗称西十区。极地
所有经线都在南极和北极汇聚，所以任何时区都可以在南极和北极使用。实践中，极地探险家和科学家只需选择最方便的时区即可。
target_text: On the other hand, if local time is faster than UTC time, e.g. China mainland, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, Mongolia, Philippines, Singapore, Malaysia, and Western Australia are eight hours faster than UTC time, it will be written as UTC+8, commonly known as East Eight. On the other hand, if local time is slower than UTC time, e.g. Hawaii is 10 hours later than UTC time, it will be written as UTC-10, commonly known as the Western Ten.
title: 协调世界时

source_text: Office最初是一个推广名称，出现于1990年代早期，指一些以前曾单独发售的软件的合集。当时主要的推广重点是：购买合集比单独购买要省很多钱。最初的Office版本包含Word、Excel和PowerPoint。「专业版」包含Microsoft Access，Microsoft Outlook 当时不存在。随着时间的改變，Office应用程序逐渐整合，共享特性，例如：拼写和语法检查、OLE数据整合和VBA脚本语言。微软目前将Office延伸作为一个开发平台，可以藉由專用商店下載第三方軟體搭配使用。
target_text: Office was originally a promotional name that appeared in the early 1990s, referring to a combination of software that had previously been sold separately. The main promotional focus at that time was the purchase of a combined collection, which saved a lot of money over individual purchases. The original version of Office included Word, Excel and PowerPoint. The " Professional version " included Microsoft Access, Microsoft Outlook, which did not exist at the time. Over time, Office applications were gradually integrated and shared features, such as spelling and syntax checks, OLE data integration and VBA script languages. Microsoft was currently extending Office as a development platform that could be used as a combination of specialized store downloads of third-party software.
title: Microsoft Office

source_text: Forth是1960年代末期，由查理斯·摩爾发展出来在天文台使用的電腦自動控制系統及程序设计语言，允许使用者很容易組合系統已有的簡單指令，定义成為功能较复杂的高階指令。由於其結構精簡、執行快速、操作方便，廣為當代天文學界使用。八十年代以後，有愛用者成立Forth Interest Group在世界各地推廣，並陸續在各类计算机上建立Forth系統及標準的语言。
target_text: Forth was the end of the 1960s, when Charles Moore developed the language of automatic control systems and program design for use at the Observatory, allowing users to easily integrate the simple instructions that already exist in the system and define them as more sophisticated high-level instructions. As a result of its simplicity, speed and ease of operation, it was widely used by the contemporary astronomical community. After the 1980s, users created the Forth Interest Group to promote worldwide and continue building the Forth system and standard language on various computers.
title: Forth

source_text:
简介
Forth以可延伸的词典为核心，采用以堆栈为基础的高度模块化结构，是一种将解译器和编译器合并运用的双态系统。使用FORTH，可在编译过程中检测差错，并且逐步扩充编译程序代码。利用標準Forth所写的程序几乎不必大修改，就能在各类计算机运作；甚至在特別设计的电脑上可以完全放棄组合语言，直接由Forth转化成机器语言，就好像现代的Java虚拟机。同时，使用者也可以把自己定义的运算功能加入编译器中，使Forth语言更有弹性。
target_text: Introduction Forth is centred on an extended dictionary, using a highly modular structure based on stacking, a two-state system that combines decouplers and compilers. Using FORTH, errors can be detected in the compilation process, and the code of the compiler can be gradually expanded. Using standard Forth-written programs, it can operate on a variety of computers almost without major modifications; even specially designed computers can completely abandon the combination language and convert it directly from Forth to the machine language, as if it were a modern Java virtual machine. At the same time, users can add their defined computing functions to the compiler, making the Forth language more flexible.
title: Forth

source_text: 用Forth的“追随者”的话来说，Forth是一种“人机一体”的语言。在程序员的意识中必须要有一台逻辑上的机器（可能是实际的芯片，也可能是虚拟机）。这台机器拥有两个堆栈（数据堆栈和返回堆栈），一个词典（在Forth中的词（word）对应于高级语言的函数或者子程序，若干的词构成词典。）一个内部解释器和一个外部解释器。
target_text: Forth is, in Forth's word, the language of “one human being”. There must be a logical machine in the programmer's consciousness (possibly a real chip or a virtual machine). The machine has two stacks (data stacks and return stacks), a dictionary (the word in Forth corresponds to a function or sub-procedure in a higher language, and a number of words make up a dictionary.) An internal interpreter and an external interpreter.
title: Forth
