Other possible UMTS applications include music downloads and video phones. Wireless access to 5M Hz is a mode of reuse supported by 3.84M Chips: FDD, TDD high-speed transmission in support of multimedia operations at least 2Mbit/s indoor walk environment at least 384Kbit/s outdoor vehicle environment at least 144Kbit/s
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 简单的说，UMTS结合了W-CDMA的空中接口（移动电话和基站的空中通信协议）、GSM系统的移动应用核心部分（MAP，Mobile Application Part）（此协议提供从用户或者到用户的呼叫路由功能），以及GSM的语音编码算法例如自适应多速率（AMR）和加强全速率（EFR）（它们定义了将语音数字化、压缩、编码的方法）。换言之，W-CDMA（依照IMT-2000的定义）只是一个空中接口，而UMTS才是一个用于3G全球移动通讯的完整协议栈，可用来代替GSM。然而，实际上也经常将W-CDMA作为所有采用该空中接口的3G标准族的总称，包括UMTS，FOMA和J-Phone。
target_text: Simply put, UMTS combines the W-CDMA air interface (air communications protocols for mobile phones and base stations), the core part of the GSM mobile application (MAP, Mobile Application Part) (which provides a call route function from or to the user), and the G-M voice coding algorithms, such as self-adaptation multi-speed (AMR) and enhancement of the full speed (EFR) (which define ways to digitize, compress and encode speech). In other words, W-CDMA (as defined by IMT-2000) is only an air interface, whereas UMTS is a complete protocol for 3G global mobile communications that can be used as a substitute for GSM. However, the W-CMMA is also often used as an umbrella for all 3G standard households using the air interface, including UMTS, FOMA and J-Phone.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 与其它W-CDMA变种一样，UMTS使用一对5 MHz信道，上行信道在1900 MHz附近，下行信道在2100 MHz附近。相比之下，CDMA2000则可在每个方向上使用一个或多个1.25 MHz信道，因此UMTS常因为它的高带宽需求而受到批评。UMTS原先规定的频段为上行1885-2025 MHz，下行2110-2200 MHz。目前的频段分配可参见。对现有的GSM营運商有一个简单但比较昂贵的升级到UMTS的方案：大部分现有的基础设施可以维持原状，但是获得频段授权和在现有基站塔上完成UMTS覆盖的费用可能极其高昂。
target_text: Like other W-CDMA variants, UMTS uses a 5-to-MHz channel, with an upper-line channel near 1900 MHz and a lower-row channel near 2100 MHz. By contrast, MMA2000 can use one or more 1.25 MHz-channels in each direction, so the UMTS is often criticized for its high bandwidth needs. The UMTS previously prescribed frequency range is up to 1885-2025 MHz, down to 2110-2200 MHz. The current frequency distribution is available. There is a simple but more expensive upgrading programme for existing GSM operators to UMTS: most existing infrastructure can be maintained, but the cost of obtaining frequency-level authorization and completing UMTS coverage on existing base towers may be extremely high.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: UMTS与GSM的一个主要的差别是由无线接口等构成的通用无线接入网（GRAN），它能够联入不同的骨干网络，如英特网、ISDN、GSM或者UMTS网络。GRAN包含OSI模型的低三层（物理层、数据链路层、网络层）。网络层（OSI 3）协议包括RRM协议（RRM），它负责管理移动设备与固定网络之间的承载信道，并完成切换功能。
target_text: A major difference between UMTS and GSM is the Universal Wireless Access Network (GRAN), consisting of wireless interfaces, etc., which can be connected to different backbone networks, such as the Internet, ISDN, GSM or UMTS network. GRAN contains the three lower layers (physical layer, data link layer, network layer) of the OSI model. The Network Layer (OSI 3) agreement includes the RRM protocol, which manages the carrying channel between the mobile device and the fixed network and completes the switching function.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 历史上，欧洲电信标准委员会（ETSI）在GSM之后就开始研究其3G标准，其中有几种备选方案是基于直接序列扩频分碼多工的，而日本的第三代研究也是使用宽带分碼多工技术的，其后以二者为主导进行融合，在3GPP组织中发展成了第三代移动通信系统UMTS(或稱UTRA)，并提交给国际电信联盟（ITU）。
target_text: Historically, the European Telecommunication Standards Commission (ETSI) began to study its 3G standard after GSM, with several options based on direct sequence-extension code multi-working, while Japan ' s third-generation study, which was also based on broadband-coded multi-working technology, was subsequently integrated and led to the development of a third-generation mobile communications system, UmTS (or UTRA) in 3GP organizations, which was submitted to the International Telecommunication Union (ITU).
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text:
国际电信联盟最终接受UMTS作为IMT-2000 3G标准的一部分。误解
W-CDMA名字跟CDMA很相近，同时W-CDMA跟CDMA关系也很微妙。两者都基于码分多址技术，都使用了美国高通（Qualcomm）的部分专利技术。一般认为W-CDMA的提出是部分厂商为了绕开专利陷阱而开发的，其方案已经尽可能地避开高通专利。
target_text: The International Telecommunication Union finally accepted the UMTS as part of the IMT-2000 3G standard. Misunderstanding the W-CDMA name is very similar to the CDMA, and the W-CDMA relationship with the CDMA is delicate.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 在移动电话领域，术语CDMA指代属于第二代移动电话的几种相关技术，包括码分多址扩频复用技术，以及美国高通（Qualcomm）开发的包括cdmaOne（IS-95）和CDMA2000（IS-2000）的CDMA标准族。在Qualcomm为IS-95协议使用它之前，CDMA复用技术已经存在了很长时间。然而，由于采用CDMA复用方法是IS-95协议区别于当时的GSM（采用TDMA）等其它协议的主要特徵，现在通常将该协议也称为CDMA。
target_text: In the area of mobile phones, the term CDMA refers to several related technologies that belong to the second generation of mobile phones, including multi-site extended frequency reuse technology, and the cdmaone (IS-95) and CDMA2000 (IS-2000) standard family developed in the United States by Qualcomm. The CDMA reuse technology existed for a long time before it was used by the IS-95 agreement. However, because the use of the CDMA reuse method was the main feature of the IS-95 agreement as distinct from other agreements such as the then GSM (the adoption of TDMA), it is now commonly referred to as the CDMA.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: W-CDMA属于第三代移动电话技术，它也使用CDMA的复用技术而且它跟Qualcomm的标准也很相似。但是W-CDMA不仅仅是复用标准。它是一个详细的定义移动电话怎样跟基站通讯，信号怎样调制，数据帧怎么构建等的完整的规范集。W-CDMA可以使用非成对或者成对频段，虽然所有当前W-CDMA设备（例如FOMA and UMTS）使用两个5MHz频段，一个用于上行一个用于下行。更多信息请参看扩频。
target_text: W-CDMA is a third generation mobile phone technology, which also uses CDMA reuse technology and is similar to the standard of Qualcomm. But W-CDMA is not just a standard for reuse. It is a complete set of norms that define how mobile phones communicate with base stations, how signals are modulated, how data frames are constructed, etc. W-CDMA can use non-combined or paired bands, although all current W-CMMA devices (e.g. FOMA and UMTS) use two 5 MHz bands, one for up-line and one for downline. For more information, please refer to the expanded frequency.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text:
競爭的標準
各式各樣的互聯網接入服務系統的存在提供寬帶高速接入網絡。這些措施包括WiMAX技術和 HiperMAN 。UMTS-TDD的優點是能夠使用運營商的現有的UMTS/GSM基礎設施，如果它有一個，它包括的UMTS模式優化的電路交換應，例如，運營商希望提供電話服務。UMTS-TDD的表現也更加穩定。但是，UMTS-TDD的deployers往往監管問題，利用一些服務的UMTS兼容性提供。例如，UMTS-TDD的頻譜在英國不能用來提供電話服務，但監管機構OFCOM正在討論的可能性，從而使其在未來的某一時刻。少數經營者考慮的UMTS-TDD的已經現有的UMTS/GSM基礎設施。
target_text: The advantage of UMTS-TDD is that it can use the existing UMTS/GSM infrastructure of the operators. For example, the UMTS-TDD channel cannot be used in the United Kingdom to provide telephone services, but the regulatory structure OFCOM is discussing the possibility of providing telephone services, for example, from a time to time. The UMTS-TDD performance is also more stable. However, the UMTS-TDD depooyers often monitor problems, using the UMTS compatibility of some services. For example, the UMTS-TDD channel is not available in the United Kingdom to provide telephone services, but the regulatory structure OFCOM is discussing the possibility of doing so at some point in the future.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 该标准是中国大陆地区制定的3G标准。1998年6月29日，中国大陆地区原邮电部电信科学技术研究院（现大唐电信科技股份有限公司）以信威通信的SCDMA技术为基础，向ITU提出了该标准，并且顺利通过成为IMT2000 3G系统的一个标准。在3GPP R99之后的版本，TD-SCDMA实现了与原西门子所研究的TD-CDMA的高层融合，结合SCDMA的智能天线、上行同步、和软件无线电（SDR, Software Defined Radio）等技术，成功克服了TD-CDMA技术不能用于宏蜂窝组网的缺陷，原因是通过GPS同步和特殊时隙，实现了全网同步解决了切换的问题，虽较TD-CDMA系统的特殊时隙配置固定化，却获得了宏网组网能力。
target_text: On 29 June 1998, the Telecommunication Science and Technology Institute of the former Ministry of Telecommunications and Telecommunications of mainland China (now Grand Tang Telecommunications and Technology Inc.) presented the standard to ITU on the basis of the SCDMA technology for communications based on the authority, and successfully adopted it as an IMT2000 3G standard. In its version after 3GP R99, TD-SCDMA achieved high-level integration with the TD-CDMA studied by the former Siemens, successfully overcoming the shortcomings of the TD-CDMA technology that could not be used in the Hornet Network (SDR, Software Defined Radio), because of the simultaneous resolution of the conversion problem through the GPS sync and special time gaps, although it was more firmly positioned with the special time frame of the TD-CDMA system, it acquired the capacity of the Network.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text:
技术特点
TD-SCDMA在频谱利用率、对业务支持具有灵活性、频率灵活性及成本等方面有独特优势。TD-SCDMA由于采用时分双工，上行和下行信道特性基本一致，因此，基站根据接收信号估计上行和下行信道特性比较容易。因此，TD-SCDMA使用智能天线技术有先天的优势，而智能天线技术的使用又引入了SDMA的优点，可以减少用户间干扰，从而提高频谱利用率。 TD-SCDMA还具有TDMA的优点，可以灵活设置上行和下行时隙的比例而调整上行和下行的数据速率的比例，特别适合因特网业务中上行数据少而下行数据多的场合。但是这种上行下行转换点的可变性给同频组网增加了一定的复杂性。TD-SCDMA是时分双工，不需要成对的频带。因此，和另外两种频分双工的3G标准相比，在频率资源的划分上更加灵活。
target_text: TD-SCDMA has a unique advantage in frequency spectrum utilization, flexibility in business support, frequency flexibility, and cost. TD-SCDMA also has the advantage of having a flexible ratio of up-and-down timescales in TDMA, which makes it easier for the base station to estimate up- and down-row-broadness characteristics based on the receipt of signals. Thus, TD-SCDMA has a priori advantage in using smart antenna technology, while the use of smart antenna technology has the advantage of introducing SDMA to reduce inter-user interference and thus increase spectrum utilization. TD-SCDMA also has the advantage of having a more flexible ratio of up-and-down data rates compared to the 3G standard for two-frequency jobs.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 但是，由于时分双工体制自身的缺点，TD-SCDMA被认为在终端允许移动速度和小区覆盖半径等方面落后于频分双工体制。同时由于其相对其他3G系统的窄带宽，导致出现扰码短，并且扰码少，在网络侧基本通过扰码来识别小区成为了理论可能。现以仅仅只能通过9个频点来做小区的区分，每个载波仅1.6M带宽，导致空口速率远低于W-CDMA和CDMA2000。根据实际测试，中国移动部署的TD-SCDMA网在网络速度、稳定性方面较W-CDMA网和CDMA2000网为差。
target_text: However, due to its own shortcomings, TD-SCDMA is considered to be lagging behind the FSM in terms of end speed of permitted movement and area coverage radius. At the same time, because of its narrow bandwidth vis-à-vis other 3G systems, there are short disturbance codes and fewer jamming codes, which make it theoretically possible to identify districts on the side of the network basically by jamming codes.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text:
目前中国移动有以下频段资源可用于TD-SCDMA网：关键技术
联合检测
智能天线
上行同步
软件无线电
无线资源管理網絡試驗和商用概况
2005年，第一个TD-SCDMA试验网依托重庆邮电大学无线通信研究所，在重庆进行第一次实际入网实验。2006年，羅馬尼亞建成了TD-SCDMA試驗網。
target_text: In 2005, the first TD-SCDMA pilot network, based on the University of Wireless Communications Research Institute at Chongqing University, carried out its first actual Internet access experiment in Chongqing. In 2006, Romania completed the TD-SCDMA test network.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 2007年，韩国最大的移动通信运营商SK电讯在韩国首都首尔建成了TD-SCDMA试验网。同年，歐洲第二大電信運營商法國電信建成了TD-SCDMA試驗網。2007年3月，中移动对8个城市建设TD－SCDMA商用网络进行招标，预计投资267亿元。2007年10月，日本电信运营商IP Mobile原本計劃建設並運營TD-SCDMA網絡，但該公司最終受限於資金困境而破產。
target_text: In 2007, the country’s largest mobile telecommunications operator, SK Telecom, built the TD-SCDMA pilot network in Seoul, the capital of Korea. In the same year, the second largest telecom operator in Europe, France, built the TD-SCDMA pilot network. In March 2007, China moved to bid eight cities to build the TD-SCDMA commercial network, with an estimated investment of 26.7 billion yuan. In October 2007, the Japanese telecommunications operator, IP Mobile, planned to build and operate the TD-SCDMA network, but the company was eventually cut off by financial difficulties.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 2007年11月，重庆建成了全国第一个TD-SCDMA试验网。2008年1月，中国移动在中国北京、上海、天津、沈阳、广州、深圳、厦门、秦皇岛市建成了TD-SCDMA试验网；中国电信集团公司在中国保定市建成了TD-SCDMA试验网；原中国网络通信集团公司（现中国联合网络通信集团有限公司）在中华人民共和国山东省青岛市建成了TD-SCDMA试验网。
target_text: In January 2008, China moved to Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin, Shenyang, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Xiamen and Qin Royal Island in China; the China Telecommunications Group Corporation completed the TD-SCDMA test network in Pao Ding City in China; and the former China Cybercommunications Group (China United Networking Group Ltd.) established the TD-SCDMA test network in Qingdao, Shandong Province, People ' s Republic of China.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 2008年4月1日，中国移动在中国北京、上海、天津、沈阳、青岛、广州、深圳、厦门、秦皇岛和保定等10个城市启动TD-SCDMA社会化业务测试和试商用。截止2008年年末，在中国使用TD-SCDMA网络的3G手机用户已达到41.9万人。但是TD-SCDMA手机放号首日即出现诸多问题，如网络建设尚未完善、功能尚未全部开发等，因而不少手机用户仍然持观望态度。
target_text: On 1 April 2008, China moved to 10 cities in China, including Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin, Shenyang, Qing Island, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Xiamen, Qin Emperor Island, and Paul. As of late 2008, there were 419,000 mobile phone users using the TD-SCDMA network in China.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 2008年9月，中国普天信息产业集团公司为意大利的一家通信公司MYWAVE建设了TD-SCDMA试验网，该网络于9月12日建成并开通；从建设工程仅为11天推算，应为小型企业网。2009年1月7日，中国政府正式向中国移动颁发了TD-SCDMA业务的经营许可，中国移动也已经开始在中国的28个直辖市、省会城市和计划单列市进行TD-SCDMA的二期网络建设，预计于2009年6月建成并投入商业化运营。该公司计划到2011年，TD-SCDMA网络能够覆盖中国大陆100%的地市。
target_text: In September 2008, the China General Tian Information Industry Group Inc. built and opened the TD-SCDMA pilot network for a communications company, Mywave, in Italy, on 12 September; the network was based on 11 days of construction work and should be a small-scale enterprise network. On 7 January 2009, the Chinese Government officially issued an operating licence for TD-SCDMA operations to China, and China ' s movement has begun the second phase of the TD-SCDMA network in China ' s 28 municipalities, provincial capitals and single-plan cities, which is expected to be completed and commercialized in June 2009. By 2011, the company plans to cover 100 per cent of China ' s mainland cities.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text:
政治支持
国务院，发改委，工信部等政府官员在产业论坛，国际会议等各种场合表达了政府对TD技术的支持愿望. TD技术也被列为863项目，发改委“十五”产业化项目等各种政府项目中.同时中国政府为了扶植TD，打压竞争标准，刻意推迟3G牌照发放. 2003年期间，中国政府警告TD相关设备商，运营商在公开场合谈论。 2004年，中国政府向TD联盟划拨7亿元专项资金. 2006年，中国政府出手制止运营商的WCDMA建设，要求运营商"积极建设"TD网.在多个政府工作报告中, TD（"第三代移动通信"）被认作重大自主创新项目. 2008年国务院同意发放3G牌照后，工信部立意对TD的产业化，应用进行"扶持".2009年2月多个部委发布了包括将TD产品纳入《政府采购自主创新产品目录》等“六大扶持政策”。 2005年，温家宝作出行政指示，督促政府发展TD。 2009年，温家宝在考察中兴通讯时将TD技术评价为"创新"，并认为其给"中国企业和中国人民""赢得了尊严". 2008年张德江表示"发展TD是国家意志"。2010年，张德江表示"要坚定不移地支持做大做强TD". 2011年张德江在肯定中移动的TD实践时，同时代表党中央，国务院对TD的进一步发展做出期望.
target_text: In 2004, the Chinese Government allocated 700 million yuan in earmarked funds to the TD Coalition. In 2006, the Chinese Government put an end to the CCDMA construction of operators, calling on operators to "actively build" the TD network. In a number of government work reports, the Chinese Government recognized TD ("Moved Communications of the Third Generation") as a major autonomous innovation project. In 2008, after the State Council agreed to issue 3G licences, the Ministry of Trade and Finance warned of the industrialization of TD and the operators to talk in public.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text:
3G外置调制解调器
使用一个3G路由器，PCMCIA卡或者USB卡，用户就可以享用3G波段的服务，而选择那一种类型的電腦（如桌上型電腦或PDA）是没有关系的。调制解调器自己带有软件，所以在短时间内上网对操作者来讲没有任何技术上的要求。目前有很多手机经具备了3G的能力，和蓝牙2.0技术结合起来，用户可以使用带蓝牙的筆記型電腦与手机相连，再连接到网络。这个时候手机就可以看作是一个路由器，不过和笔记本之间是通过蓝牙协议而不是TCP/IP协议。
target_text: The 3G external modem, using a 3G router, PCMCIA or USB card, allows users to access the 3G band, and the choice of the type of computer (e.g. a desktop computer or a PDA) is irrelevant. The modem itself has software, so there is no technical requirement for operators to access the Internet within a short period of time. There are many mobile phones that are equipped with 3G capabilities, combined with bluetooth 2.0 technology, so that users can connect to the cell phone using a bluetooth laptop and then connect to the network. Cell phones can be considered a router at this point, but there is no TCP/IP protocol between the notebooks.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text:
互操作性和全球漫游
在空中接口层，UMTS兼容GSM。尽管市场上现在的UMTS手机都是UMTS/GSM双模手机，但是他们都能在纯GSM的网络中很好的工作。如果一个UMTS用户漫游到没有UMTS覆盖的地方，他的手机会自动切换到GSM模式。如果用户在通话中漫游出了UMTS覆盖范围，那么电话将会切换到有GSM覆盖的区域去。普通GSM手机不能在UMTS网络使用。
target_text: Interoperability and global roaming on the air interface level, UMTS compatible GSM. Although the current UMTS cell phones on the market are both UMTS/GSM double-models, they can all work well in a network of pure GSMs. If a UMTS user roams to a place not covered by UMTS, his hands are automatically switched to GSM mode. If a user walks out of the UMTS coverage during a call, the phone will switch to an area covered by the GSM. Normal GSM phones cannot be used on the UMTS network.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 沃达丰－日本（前身 J-Phone）有一个使用W-CDMA并兼容UMTS的3G网络。这使得UMTS成为真正的全球无线标准。当前的全球无线标准，GSM适用于除了日本和韩国以外多数国家。NTT DoCoMo的3G网络，FOMA，同样使用W-CDMA。然而NTT DoCoMo拥有AT&T无线实验室18的股份原来还持有3UK20的股份。这些在国外的资本为未来的全球漫游解决方案提供一个测试平台。（到2004年12月）
target_text: Vodafone-Japan (former J-Phone) has a 3G network using W-CDMA and compatible UMTS. This makes UMTS a truly global wireless standard. The current global wireless standard, GSM, applies to most countries except Japan and Korea. NTT DoComo's 3G network, FOMA, also uses W-CDMA. However, NTT DoComo owned 18 shares in the AT&T wireless laboratory, which used to hold 3UK20 shares.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 在美国，由于现存的对频率使用的限制只是运营商AT&T无线的网络只能在1900 MHz频段。 为美国市场设计的UMTS手机跟其他区域的有所区别，这也反映了当前美国的GSM手机和GSM网络使用不同与其他国家的状况。尽管联邦通讯委员会（FCC）已经决议允许附加2100 MHz频段给UMTS，但是大多数获得UMTS授权的运营商好像打算放弃承担保证实现全球漫游的责任。
target_text: The UMTS mobile phone designed for the US market differs from other regions, which also reflects the current situation with other countries. Although the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has decided to allow 2100 MHz frequency bands to be attached to UMTS, most operators authorized by the UMTS seem to be prepared to give up their responsibility to ensure that global roaming takes place.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text:
频谱分配
超过120份许可证已经颁发给全世界的运营商（截至2004年），特别是基于GSM的无线访问技术W-CDMA。由于技术还在不断的完善中，所以政客过于仓促的卖出许可，成百上千亿美元的许可证费用流入公共预算。 仅仅在德国，许可证费用就高达508亿欧元。运营商被期望在2005年开始从这些许可盈利。
target_text: Spectrum distribution More than 120 licences have been issued to operators worldwide (as of 2004), especially the wireless access technology W-CDMA based on GSM. As technology continues to improve, politicians rush to sell licences, with hundreds of billions of dollars of licence fees flowing into the public budget.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 實際運營情況世界上第一個UMTS網路2001年在馬恩島由Manx Telecom投入運營。下一個網路簡稱行動运营商3，2003年在英國啟動。3是一個從3G網路成長起來的原屬於和記黃埔（現在是合作夥伴）的运营商。它很快就要在全球啟動其他UMTS網路（2004年12月）包括 澳大利亞、奧地利、丹麥、香港、以色列、義大利、葡萄牙、愛爾蘭共和國和瑞典。大多數西歐GSM运营商均升級到UMTS，因為它比較接近於GSM2G標準。
target_text: The first UMTS network in the world was launched by Manx Telecom on the Isle of Man in 2001. The next network, known as Operation Operator 3, was launched in England in 2003.3 It is a 3G network that grew up as an original and now cooperative partner. It will soon be launching other UMTS networks globally (December 2004), including Australia, Austria, Denmark, Hong Kong, Israel, Italy, Portugal, Ireland, and Sweden. Most Western European GSM operators are upgraded to UMTS, as it is closer to the GSM2G standard.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 大多数欧洲GSM运营商计划未来某个时间推出UMTS服务，尽管有几个已经把此服务提到日程上来，有一些甚至从2003年底就开始运营UMTS网络。沃达丰於2004年2月在欧洲多个UMTS网络投入运行。沃达丰还打算在其他國家（包括澳大利亚及新西兰）建设UMTS网络。AT&T无线（现被Cingular收购，并沿用AT&T品牌）在一些城市开通了UMTS。尽管因为公司兼并使得网络建设进度被延迟，但Cingular已宣布计划在2005年与HSDPA一起部署W-CDMA。
target_text: Most European GSM operators plan to launch the UMTS service at some point in the future, although several have already brought it on the agenda, and some have even started operating the UMTS network since the end of 2003. Vodafone became operational in February 2004 on several UMTS networks in Europe. Vodafone is also planning to build the UMTS network in other countries, including Australia and New Zealand.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 运营商開始銷售整合3G和Wi-Fi服務的流動互聯網產品。筆記本電腦用戶可以買到他們提供的UMTS Modem，還有用戶端軟體用於自動探測網路狀態，以便在有Wi-Fi訊號時自動從3G網路切換。起初Wi-FI被認為是3G的一個競爭對手，但是現在不得不承認，运营商為了提供比單純UMTS更有競爭力的產品，他們必須擁有或者租用別人的Wi-Fi網路。
target_text: Operators have started selling mobile Internet products that integrate 3G and Wi-Fi services. Users of laptop computers can buy the UMTS Modem that they provide, as well as client software that automatically explores the state of the network in order to switch automatically from the 3G network when there is a Wi-Fi signal. Wi-Fi was initially seen as a 3G competition, but now it has to be admitted that operators must own or rent someone else’s Wi-Fi network in order to provide more competitive products than a single UMTS.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 多数北美GSM运营商已接受EDGE作为过渡至3G的临时解决方案。 AT&T无线2003年本国范围内开始运行EDGE，Cingular 也在本国内运行，T-Mobile美国 计划全美范围提供EDGE。Rogers Wireless在2003年晚期开始在加拿大范围内投入运行EDGE服务。EDGE的好处是它有效利用现有GSM频段而且兼容现有GSM手机，并提供相对于UMTS更好的信号覆盖能力，作为W-CDMA网络的有益补充。EDGE为GSM运营商与CDMA2000竞争提供了一个短期的升级途经。
target_text: Most North American GSM operators have accepted EDGE as an interim solution for transition to 3G. AT&T Wireless began running EDGE in the country in 2003, and Cingular is also operating in the country, and T-Mobile USA plans to provide EDGE on a US-wide basis. Rogers Wireless began running EDGE services in Canada late in 2003.

source_text:
早期运营商面对的问题：
由于3G手机耗电量大幅增加，使得电池增大，相较于2G手机重量增加较多，待机时间减短。
若要完美实现UMTS的VOD功能，每100米要设立一个基站。在都市区域经济上可行，在人口较少的郊区和乡下不可行。
来自Wi-Fi寬頻網路的竞争，未來可能有来自WiMAX早期版本的競爭。
客户缺少对3G业务的需求。
target_text: Problems faced by early operators: As a result of the significant increase in power consumption of 3G mobile phones, batteries have increased by more weight than 2G mobile phones, and waiting times have been reduced. To achieve the UMTS VOD function perfectly, a base station has to be set up every 100 meters.
title: 通用移动通讯系统

source_text: 手机耗电量随着新器件的开发得到缓解。而且随着越来越多用户的使用，已经能接受3G手机2天左右的待机时间，并且年轻人对于3G业务的需求增多，特别是在线视频等业务，客观上缓解了3G业务需求不足的冲击；反而是需要Wi-Fi來緩解3G頻寬供不應求的問題。由于UMTS升级到HSPA+或者将来的LTE业务，以及WIMAX向4G发展，早期版本的WIMAX业务（主要是IEEE 802.16e）在大多数区域并未对UMTS造成冲击。
target_text: Cellular power consumption has eased with the development of new devices. And, as more and more users are using, 3G phones have been accepted for about two days, and the demand of young people for 3G operations has increased, particularly in the case of wire and video, which objectively mitigates the impact of the 3G business deficit; instead, Wi-Fi is needed to ease the problem of 3G bandwidth supply. With the upgrade of UMTS to HSPA+ or future LTE operations, as well as the development of WIMAX to 4G, the earlier version of WIMAX operations (mainly IEEE 802.16e) does not have an impact on UMTS in most regions.

source_text: 2003年4月1日－株式会社史克威尔（Square Co., Ltd）和株式会社艾尼克斯（Enix Corporation）合并为史克威尔艾尼克斯。2003年7月22日－史克威尔艾尼克斯总部迁址东京涩谷代代木。整合目黑區的舊史克威爾本部，以及出版事業部的本部機能。2004年3月－史克威尔艾尼克斯为加强无线市场，购得UIEvolution。2005年1月－史克威尔艾尼克斯在华全资子公司史克威尔艾尼克斯（中国）互动科技有限公司成立。官方略稱是SE中国。2005年8月22日－史克威尔艾尼克斯宣布，开始收购电子游戏开发与发行商太東。该公司以街机市场，如太空侵略者和泡泡龙系列而知名。本次收购是史克威尔艾尼克斯为踏入欠缺的街機事業领域所做的布石。2005年9月28日－太東收购完成。2006年9月5日－史克威尔艾尼克斯被控违反和智冠科技（）的合约。2007年12月－UIEvolution从史克威尔艾尼克斯中分离，成为独立公司。2008年8月29日－史克威尔艾尼克斯计划，以购买30%股票，计223亿日元的方式，善意收购特库摩。2008年9月4日－在特库摩拒绝收购议案后，史克威尔艾尼克斯撤销提议。2008年10月1日，史克威尔艾尼克斯转换为控股公司，易名为史克威尔艾尼克斯控股。同时，游戏、内容和出版业转移给分拆的史克威尔艾尼克斯，并和控股共享相同的企业领导与办公室。2009年2月12日－史克威尔艾尼克斯控股宣布以8430万英镑（每股32镑）收购Eidos Interactive的控股公司Eidos plc。Eidos是负责出版古墓丽影系列、刺客任務系列、杀出重围系列、神偷系列和凯恩的遗产系列的英国出版商。

source_text: 2009年4月22日－Eidos收购完成。2011年11月22日－宣布成立史克威爾艾尼克斯蒙特利爾。2013年10月8日－宣布Square Enix Collective計畫開始，將協助獨立遊戲開發者的遊戲開發與遊戲發行。2014年9月19日－宣布成立神羅科技公司，投入雲端事業活動。2015年3月－解散印尼子公司PT.SQUARE ENIX SMILEWORKS。2015年6月16日－位于日本东京的旗下新工作室Tokyo RPG Factory投入运营。2016年1月－因資金週轉不靈而解散神羅科技。2017年2月20日－宣布成立新工作室Studio Istolia，由原万代南梦宫的游戏制作人马场英雄负责。2017年5月－史克威尔艾尼克斯宣布将出售此前一直负责《刺客任務系列》的丹麦工作室IO Interactive。2018年3月27日－宣布成立新工作室Luminous Productions，由田畑端擔任COO 兼工作室代表。2018年8月－宣佈與騰訊達成戰略結盟，成立子公司。2019年5月－史克威尔艾尼克斯关闭开发工作室Studio Istolia，负责人马场英雄稍早前也从史克威尔艾尼克斯离职。2022年5月－史克威尔艾尼克斯宣布将史克威尔艾尼克斯欧洲旗下的晶体动力、Eidos蒙特利尔、史克威爾艾尼克斯蒙特利爾等工作室和《古墓丽影》、《神偷》、《杀出重围》等系列IP出售给拥抱者集团，交易金额约3亿美元。2023年2月－史克威尔艾尼克斯宣布将子公司Luminous Productions并入集团内部。2023年5月1日－子公司Luminous Productions并入史克威尔艾尼克斯内部，继承所有业务。2023年6月－桐生隆司就任社长。

source_text:
合併
史克威尔艾尼克斯由史克威尔和艾尼克斯合并而成。艾尼克斯为存续公司，与史克威尔在2003年4月1日正式合并。史克威尔的普通股以0.85:1的比率与艾尼克斯的普通股兑换。当时史克威尔艾尼克斯职员中，80%为原史克威尔雇员。合并后，原史克威尔社长和田洋一获任新公司社长，原艾尼克斯社长本多圭司担任副社长。艾尼克斯创办者福岛康博现为名誉会长，是公司最大的股东。
target_text: In April 1, 2003, the company was formally merged with the company. The regular stock of Shkewell was converted at 0.85:1 with the normal stock of Akewell. 80% of the staff at the time was former Schkewell's employee. After the merger, the former Chief of Skewell and Mr. Tanichi became the president of the new company, and the former President of Anicks was Vice-President Ben Doguey. The founder of Anicks, Kenbo Fukushima, is now the Honorary President and the company's largest shareholder.
title: 史克威尔艾尼克斯

source_text: 對此一般看法是，在電影事業失敗的史克威爾的所做的救濟措施，不過艾尼克斯也被傳出招牌遊戲勇者鬥惡龍系列未發售的該年度營業額減半等收益的不安定面，出版事業牽扯上「御家騷動」而衰退，《勇者鬥惡龍》系列以外的遊戲知名度過低等問題存在；此外艾尼克斯的影響力強在亞洲，史克威爾則在北美、歐洲，在海外事業上做互補與調整發售時程使最终幻想系列和勇者鬥惡龍系列避免衝突同來確保收益等；為準備迎接線上遊戲、行動遊戲的時代，將兩社的內容資產做有效運用以期加倍效果。时任社長和田洋一称「展望將來，為了生存下來而做的積極性合併」。

source_text:
商业模式
史克威尔艾尼克斯的商业模式围绕“多形态内容”理念，即一个系列不局限于游戏，而会以多种媒体形式推出作品。这一战略的先例是《钢之炼金术师》连载漫画，它已改编为两部动画、两部电影、数部小说及电子游戏。旗下跨媒体项目还有最终幻想VII补完计划、伊瓦莉斯联盟、新的水晶故事 最终幻想、玛娜世界和代码世纪。和田洋一对此表示：“似乎这很难撞大运。一旦我们撞上，我们将尽可能得到所有的高利润”。
target_text: The business model of Skevell Aenix revolves around the concept of “multiform content”, that is, a series that is not limited to games, but is presented in a variety of media formats. The precedent of this strategy is the serial comics of the Steel Alchemist, which has been converted into two animations, two films, several novels and video games. The cross-media project under the banner has the ultimate fantasy VII completion plan, the Ivalis Alliance, the new Crystal Story, the ultimate fantasy, the Mana World, and the code century.
title: 史克威尔艾尼克斯

source_text: 在《最终幻想VII》取得成功后，史克威尔艾尼克斯采用了其设计模式作为标准流程：首先构建情节、角色与概念艺术，随后创作战斗系统、场景地图和过场动画。过去，史克威尔艾尼克斯一般不使用其他公司的引擎，宁愿从头开始编程或自己搭建引擎（如兼容多平台的水晶工具和夜光引擎）。但现在改变了做法，多款游戏都采用了Epic Games授权的虚幻引擎，如2007年的《最后的神迹》。
target_text: After the success of Final Imagination VII, Skwell Aenix adopted its design model as a standard process: building the art of plot, role and concept, followed by the creation of combat systems, scene maps, and animations. In the past, Skwell Ainix did not usually use the engines of other companies, preferring to start programming from scratch or to build his own engines (e.g., multi-platform crystals and night-light engines). But now that practice has changed, many games have adopted the false engine mandated by Epic Games, such as the Last Mystery of 2007.
title: 史克威尔艾尼克斯

source_text:
和索尼的Greatest Hits模式类似，史克威尔艾尼克斯有时会为达到特定销量水平的游戏推出以Ultimate Hits为标签的廉价版。开发单位现今
2019年4月，史克威尔艾尼克斯对开发部门进行了调整和整合，目前分为5个开发事业本部。历史
2003年，史克威尔艾尼克斯开发成员组织为八个史克威尔和两个艾尼克斯。第五开发业务部在大阪和东京皆设有办公室。
target_text: Similar to Sony’s Greatest Hits model, Skwell Aenix sometimes presents a cheap version of the Ultimate Hits labeled for a game that reaches a certain level of sales. The developers are now restructuring and integrating the development sector in April 2019, which is now divided into five development departments.
title: 史克威尔艾尼克斯

source_text: 据前社長和田洋一称，至少到了2007年3月，开发部门已经不以开发业务部系统的方式组织。职员现在以项目制系统的结构组成。目前，负责新的水晶故事 最终幻想、纷争 最终幻想和王国之心系列的团队被统称为第一制作部，然而第二和第三制作部并不存在。目前的第一制作部，是由2010年秋，史克威尔艾尼克斯东京和大阪开发工作室合并而成。
target_text: According to the former President and Yoichi Tana, by March 2007 at least, the development department was no longer organized in a way that developed the Department of Operations system. The staff now consists of the structure of the project-based system. Currently, the team responsible for the new crystal story series, the ultimate illusion, the final illusion and the Kingdom’s heart series, is referred to collectively as Production Department No. 1, whereas Production Department No. 2 does not exist.
title: 史克威尔艾尼克斯

source_text: 史克威尔艾尼克斯主要集中于电子游戏。在其资产中，最终幻想系列是最为畅销的产品，截至2011年6月已在全球售出1亿份。史克威尔艾尼克斯的勇者斗恶龙系列被视作在日本最畅销的游戏之一，新作在发行时往往都会成为最畅销作品。系列已经售出超过5,700万套，其中约5,240万在日本，约290万在北美，约170万在欧洲。近年来，史克威尔的王国之心系列（和迪士尼合作开发）也开始流行。
target_text: Among its assets, the ultimate fantasy series is the best-selling product, with 100 million copies sold worldwide as of June 2011. The Strangled Dragons series of Scowle-Annix is considered one of the best-selling games in Japan, and the new ones are often the best-selling ones when they are released. More than 57 million copies have been sold, of which 52.4 million are in Japan, 2.9 million in North America, and 1.7 million in Europe.
title: 史克威尔艾尼克斯

source_text: 2003年上半年，史克威尔艾尼克斯美国子公司为勇者斗恶龙注册“Dragon Quest”商标，并不再使用“Dragon Warrior”——此游戏1989年在北美使用“Dragon Warrior”，是为了避免和已歇业公司TSR的《DragonQuest》产生商标冲突。2004年5月，史克威尔艾尼克斯公布和索尼在线娱乐间的协议，负责《无尽的任务2》的日本发行权。在电子游戏机第七世代中，史克威尔艾尼克斯在三个平台都发行重要系列的新作，包括在PlayStation 3和Xbox 360上的《最终幻想XI》，以及Wii上的《勇者斗恶龙X》。史克威尔艾尼克斯还为掌上游戏机开发作品，包括Game Boy Advance、任天堂DS、PlayStation Portable、任天堂DS和PlayStation Vita。此外他们还为Microsoft Windows系统个人电脑，以及各种移动电话发布新游戏。史克威尔艾尼克斯手机游戏在可以在一些欧洲国家的沃达丰网络上使用，包括爱尔兰、英国、西班牙和法国。史克威尔艾尼克斯有27个游戏获选登上《Fami通》杂志的“史上100大游戏”，其中7个游戏列入前十，包括获得首位的《最终幻想X》。
target_text: In the first half of 2003, Scroll Einix’s U.S. subsidiary registered the “Dragon Quest” trademark for brave fighters, and no longer used the “Dragon Warior” game, which used the “Dragon Warior” in North America in 1989 to avoid a trademark conflict with TSR’s “Dragon Quest” in May 2004. In the seventh generation of video games, Skwell Einix published an agreement with Sony on-line entertainment, Japan’s power of distribution of the Unfinished Task 2 logo.
title: 史克威尔艾尼克斯

source_text: 在PlayStation 3上市建立之前，史克威尔艾尼克斯副社长佐佐木通宏称，“我们不希望PlayStation 3成为惨败者，因此我们想要支持他们，但是我们也同样不希望他们完胜，因此我们不会过多的支持”。史克威尔艾尼克斯在2007年继续重申，他们专注于多平台发行，允诺更多支持多平台比日本更为普及的北美和欧洲游戏市场。在2008年，原PlayStation 3独占发行的《最终幻想XIII》将在Xbox 360平台发行消息公布时，他们多平台开发的兴趣变得明显。
target_text: Before PlayStation 3, Vice-President Sasaki of Skevell Aenix said, “We don't want PlayStation 3 to be the loser, so we want to support them, but we also don't want them to win, so we won't give them too much.” In 2007, Skevell Aenix continued to reiterate their focus on multiplatforms, promising more support for multiplatforms than Japan’s more popular North American and European games markets. In 2008, the original PlayStation 3 exclusive version of The Final Imagination XIII was published on Xbox 360 platforms, and their interest in multiplatform development became apparent.
title: 史克威尔艾尼克斯

source_text: 2008年，史克威尔艾尼克斯和Gas Powered Games宣布合作制作《最高指挥官2》。2008年7月8日，史克威尔艾尼克斯发行首个iPod游戏《》。史克威尔艾尼克斯还在同年制作一系列名为“Pure Dreams”儿童游戏。其致力于创作适合孩童的游戏。该品牌正计划制作更多的游戏。Pure Dreams仅完成前两部作品，《史努比DS 去见史努比和他的伙伴们》（2008年10月9日在日本发行）和《企鹅家族的美妙狂欢节》（2008年11月6日在日本发行）。《堡壘》是史克威尔艾尼克斯最终幻想系列一衍生游戏的开发代号。其原设想为设定于架空世界伊瓦莉斯的动作游戏，并准备发行于Xbox 360、PlayStation 3和Microsoft Windows平台。尽管官方从未宣布，但在原开发商GRIN关闭后，原开发团队从成员和电子游戏产业来源透漏这一信息。种植开发的除了该游戏还有，《高地人：游戏》、《扣扣棋》、《衰落：旧金山》、《疯人院大战》、《地下墓穴》和《空降计划》。
target_text: On July 8, 2008, the first iPod game was launched by Skewer Aix and Gas Powered Games. In the same year, Skewer Aenix also produced a series of children's games called "Pure Dreams." The brand was working to create more games for children. The Pure Dreams was only planning to complete the first two. source_text: 系统科学是指从系统的角度观察研究客观世界的一門学科。「系统」指的是由相互联系、相互作用的要素（或部分）组成的具有一定结构和功能的有机整体；准确来说，「要素」加上「结构」等於「系统」。研究的领域横跨自然科学與社会科学，却除去其中较为狭窄的物理、生物、心理、经济意义，而把研究重心放在探究各个系统的本质规律上。系统科学主要研究系统的要素（或元素）、结构、系统的行为（性质）。
target_text: Systemic science refers to a discipline that looks at the objective world from a systematic point of view. "Systems" refer to an organic whole of structures and functions consisting of interrelated and interacting elements (or parts); "Elements" and "Structures" are, to be precise, equivalent to "Systems." Research cuts across natural and social sciences, but removes the narrower physical, biological, psychological, and economic aspects of them, while focusing on the nature of the systems.
title: 系统科学

source_text: 对于生命与非生命，一般人都有种直观的感觉能区分它们的不同。前者是开放系统，需要不断和环境交换能量和信息才能存在，而后者的稳定需要和环境的隔绝，方能保持其独立性，比如纯净的氧气，一旦释放到空气中，立刻和其他气体混合。因此，生命与非生命存在明显的差异。热力学物理学家布里渊提出负熵对应信息的概念、信息论是组织化的度量，奥地利理论物理学家薛定谔著的《生命是什么？─活细胞的物理学观》提出生命的负熵原理，普利高津从物理化学提出能量耗散结构的自组织理论，从而架构了物理学与生物学的理论桥梁。

著名科学家钱学森提出系统科学的层次模型，其详细分类如下：
第一层：系统观。次是系统学，它是系统科学的基本理论。这是系统的哲学和方法论的观点，是系统科学通向马克思主义哲学的桥梁和中介；
第二层：技术科学层次。有运筹学、系统理论、控制论、信息论等，是系统工程的直接理论；
第三层：工程技术层次。系统工程、自动化技术、通信技术等，这是直接改造自然界的。
target_text: China's leading scientist, Moneyson, proposes a hierarchy of systems science, which is classified in detail as follows: first level: systems perception. source_text: 阿诺德·勋伯格（，；），奥地利裔美国作曲家、音乐理论家、教师、作家和画家。他被广泛认为是20世纪最有影响力的作曲家之一。他与德国诗歌和艺术的表现主义运动有关，并是第二维也纳乐派的领导人。作为一位犹太作曲家，勋伯格受到纳粹党的迫害，他的作品被定为颓废音乐，被禁止出版。他于1933年移民到美国，并于1941年成为美国公民。
target_text: Arnold Hümberg (;), an Austrian American composer, musical theorist, teacher, writer and painter. He was widely recognized as one of the most influential composers of the twentieth century. He was associated with the German movement of poetry and artistic expression and leader of the second Vienna band. As a Jewish composer, Hemberg was persecuted by the Nazis and his work was classified as lame music and banned from publishing. He emigrated to the United States in 1933 and became an American citizen in 1941.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 在职业生涯的早期，勋伯格以同时延展了传统上对立的勃拉姆斯–瓦格纳德国浪漫主义风格而闻名。后来，他的名字成为了无调性创新的代表（尽管勋伯格本人讨厌这个术语），这成为了20世纪古典音乐最具争议的特征。在1920年代，勋伯格发展了十二音技法，这是一种影响深远的作曲方法，用于操纵半音音階中的所有十二个音符的有序序列。他还创造了这一术语，并成为第一位接纳发展动机却不依赖于中心主旋律乐思的现代作曲家。
target_text: During the early days of his career, Hemberg was known for his traditional antiquated Brams-Wagner German romantic style. Later, his name became the representative of untangled innovation (though Hemberg himself hated the term), which became the most controversial feature of classical music in the twentieth century.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 勋伯格也是一位有影响力的作曲教师；他的学生包括阿尔班·贝尔格、安东·韦伯恩、汉斯·艾斯勒、埃贡·韦勒斯、尼科斯·斯卡尔科塔斯，以及后来的約翰·凱吉、卢·哈里森、厄尔·金、罗伯托·格哈德、、、等著名音乐家。勋伯格的许多实践，包括形式化的作曲方法和公开邀请听众进行分析思考的习惯，在20世纪的前衛音乐思潮中都有所呼应。他对音乐史和美学的时常引发争议的观点对许多重要的20世纪音乐学家和评论家至关重要，包括狄奧多·阿多諾、和，以及钢琴家阿图尔·施纳贝尔、鲁道夫·塞尔金、和格连·古尔德。
target_text: Henberg is also an influential composer; his students include Alban Berg, Anton Webern, Hans Esler, Egon Welles, Nikos Scalcotas, and later John Cage, Lou Harrison, Earl King, Roberto Gerhard, and other famous musicians. He has many practices, including formalised methods of work and an open invitation to listeners to analyse and think, echoed in the pre-twentieth-century wave of musical thinking. His often controversial views about musical history and aesthetics are crucial to a number of important 20-century musicians and commentators, including Diodore Adolfo, and piano musicians Atul Schnebel, Rodolphe Selkin, and Glenn Gould.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 阿诺德·勋伯格出生于維也納的利奥波德城（早期是一个犹太人聚集区）的一个中下层的犹太家庭中，具体地址是上多瑙大街5号。他的父亲塞缪尔（Samuel）是匈牙利塞切尼人，后来搬到波佐尼（普雷斯堡，那时是匈牙利王国的一部分，现在是斯洛伐克的布拉迪斯拉发），再后来搬到维也纳，是一位鞋店老板；他的母亲保琳·勋伯格（Pauline，原姓纳霍德，Nachod）来自布拉格，是钢琴教师。勋伯格基本上是自学成才的，他只师从作曲家亚历山大·冯·策姆林斯基学习过对位法，策姆林斯基后来成为他的第一个妻兄。
target_text: Arnold Hümberg, born in Leopold, Vienna (early a ghetto of Jews), was a middle-level Jewish family with address No. 5 Upper Danube. His father, Samuel, was a Hungarian Séchénier, who then moved to Pozoni (Presburg, which was part of the Kingdom of Hungary and is now Bratislava, Slovakia) and then to Vienna, where he was a shoe shop owner; his mother, Pauline Nachod, was from Prague; he was a piano teacher.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 在二十多岁时，勋伯格通过给轻歌剧配器谋生，同时创作了自己的作品，如弦乐六重奏《升华之夜》（1899年）。后来他又创作了这首作品的管弦乐版本，成为他最受欢迎的作品之一。理查德·施特劳斯和古斯塔夫·馬勒都认识到勋伯格作为作曲家的重要性；施特劳斯是在接触到勋伯格的《古雷之歌》之后，马勒则是在听到一些勋伯格早期作品后。
target_text: At the age of 20, Henberg made a living by giving light opera instruments and made his own work, such as String Six, The Night of Uplifting (1899). Later, he created the orchestra version of this work, which became one of his most popular. Richard Strauss and Gustave Maller both recognized the importance of Henberg as a composer; Strauss was in contact with Hemberg’s Guray Song, and Mahler was in the wake of hearing some of Heungberg’s early work.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 1909年后，施特劳斯在自己的作品中转向了更为保守的风格，对勋伯格的音乐产生了质疑。马勒则将勋伯格视为自己的门徒，并继续支持他，即使勋伯格的音乐风格发展到了马勒无法理解的程度。马勒对于自己离世后谁会照顾勋伯格感到担忧。最初鄙视和嘲笑马勒音乐的勋伯格，在听到马勒的第三交响曲时发生了改变，他将其视为一部天才之作，并将马勒“形容为圣人”。
target_text: After 1909, Strauss turned to a more conservative style in his work, questioning Hemberg's music. Mahler saw Hemberg as his disciple and continued to support him, even though Hemberg's style of music had grown beyond his comprehension. Mahler was worried about who would take care of Hemberg after he left. The first scorned and mocked Hemberg was changed when he heard Mahler's third symphony, which he saw as a genius and described Mahler as “a saint”.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 1898年，勋伯格改信基督教，加入信義宗。根据麦克唐纳（2008年，93页）的说法，这部分是为了加强他对西欧文化传统的依恋，部分是为了在“反犹主义重抬头时期”自卫的手段。1933年，在长时间的沉思后，他重新归回犹太教，因为他意识到“他的种族和宗教传统是不可逃避的”，并且要明确地站在反对纳粹主义的一边。他晚年时自认为犹太教信徒。
target_text: In 1898, Hemberg converted to Christianity and became a believer. According to McDonald (2008, p. 93), this was partly to strengthen his attachment to Western European cultural traditions and partly to the means of self-defence in the “era of anti-Semitism.” In 1933, after a long period of reflection, he returned to Judaism, because he realized that “his ethnic and religious traditions are inescapable” and had to stand explicitly against Nazism.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 1901年–1914年：无调性实验1901年10月，勋伯格与指挥家和作曲家亚历山大·冯·策姆林斯基的妹妹玛蒂尔德·策姆林斯基（Mathilde）结婚，他从1894年开始师从亚历山大。勋伯格和玛蒂尔德共有两个孩子，格特鲁德（1902年–1947年）和乔治（1906年–1974年）。格特鲁德于1921年与勋伯格的学生费利克斯·格赖斯勒（Felix Greissle）结婚。
target_text: 1901-1914: In October 1901, Henberg married the commander and composer Alexander von Tsimlinski's sister, Mathilde, who started in 1894 with Alexander. Henberg and Mathilde had two children, Gertrude (1902-1947) and George (1906-1974). Gertrude married Hemberg's student Felix Greissle in 1921.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 在1908年夏季，勋伯格的妻子玛蒂尔德离开他数月，与一位年轻的奥地利画家（后来在玛蒂尔德回到婚姻后于同年11月自杀）发生了关系。这一时期标志着勋伯格作品的明显变化。在妻子离开期间，他创作了《你靠在一棵银柳树上》（），这是他改编自德国神秘主义诗人施特凡·格奥尔格同名诗集的套曲《》（，作品15）中的第13首。这是他的第一首完全没有调参照的作品。
target_text: During the summer of 1908, Hemberg’s wife, Mathilde, left him for several months and had a relationship with a young Austrian painter who later committed suicide in November of the same year after Mathilde returned to marriage. This period marked a clear change in Hemberg’s work. During his wife’s departure, he created “You lean on a silver willow tree” () which was the thirteenth in a set of poems he adapted from the book of the German mystic poet Stefan Georg (, work 15). This is his first piece that has no reference at all.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 同样在这一年，勋伯格完成了他最具革命性的作品之一，。前两个乐章，虽然在色彩上是半音阶的，但使用了传统的调号。最后两个乐章再次采用格奥尔格的诗歌，融入了女高音的声部，打破了之前弦乐四重奏的惯例，并大胆地削弱了与传统音调之间的联系。两个乐章都以主音和弦结束，这部作品并非完全无调性。
target_text: Also in the same year, Hemberg completed one of his most revolutionary works, the first two, although coloured in half-syllables, used traditional hymns. The last two, again using Georgi ' s poems, were integrated into the soprano ' s vocal section, breaking the previous string quartet practice and boldly weakening the link with the traditional tone. The two pieces ended with the lead and the string, and the work was not completely unchallenged.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 在1910年夏天，勋伯格写了他的《和声学》（），这本书至今仍然是最有影响力的音乐理论著作之一。从1911年左右开始，勋伯格属于一个由、法兰兹·威尔佛、和埃尔泽·拉斯克-许勒尔等艺术家和知识分子组成的圈子。1910年，他遇到了，当时是一位在德国工作的英国音乐记者。克拉克成为他唯一的英语学生，后来作为BBC的制作人，他负责介绍许多勋伯格的作品以及勋伯格本人到英国（还有韦伯恩、贝尔格等人）。
target_text: In the summer of 1910, Höngberg wrote his book " And Acoustics " , which remains one of the most influential musical theories ever. From around 1911, Hengberg belonged to a circle of artists and intellectuals, including Franz Wilford and Elze Rask-Huller. In 1910, he met, at the time, a British music journalist working in Germany. Clark became his only English-speaking student, later as a producer of the BBC, and was responsible for introducing many of Herberg ' s works, as well as Hengberg himself to England (and Webern, Berg, etc.).
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 他在这个无调或泛调的时期的另一部重要作品是《》（，作品21），于1912年问世，这是一部非常有影响力的表现主义歌曲套曲，改编自比利时-法国诗人诗歌的德语译版。该作品采用了言唱技巧（），即介于戏剧式朗诵和歌唱之间的声音，为女声和五名乐手（长笛（兼任短笛）、单簧管（兼任低音单簧管）、小提琴（兼任中提琴）、大提琴、钢琴）而作。器乐组合现在通常被称为。
target_text: Another important piece of his work during this untangled or generalist period was " (work 21), born in 1912, a very influential displayist song set, adapted from the German translation of the Belgian-French poetic poems. The work used the sung technique (i.e., the voice between the dramatic recitation and the singing) for women ' s voices and for five musicians (the flute (who also plays the flute), the clarine (who also plays the bass), the violin (who also acts as the center violin), the cello, the piano). The instrument combination is now commonly referred to.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 1907年起的维也纳音乐学院院长威廉·博普（Wilhelm Bopp）希望摆脱罗伯特·富克斯和所代表的陈旧保守学术环境。在考虑了许多候选人之后，他于1912年向勋伯格和弗朗兹·施雷克尔提供了教学职位。当时勋伯格住在柏林。他并没有完全与维也纳音乐学院断绝联系，在一年前曾教过一门私人理论课。他认真考虑了这个提议，但最终拒绝了。之后他写信给阿尔班·贝尔格，将他的决定主要归因于“对维也纳的厌恶”，也同时认为这个选择经济上可能是错误的，但他对自己的决定感到满意。几个月后，他写信给施雷克尔，表示对他来说接受教学职位可能也是个错误的想法。
target_text: The Dean of the Vienna Academy of Music, Wilhelm Bopp, since 1907, wanted to get rid of Robert Fux and the old conservative academic environment that he represented. After considering many candidates, he offered a teaching position to Hemberg and Franz Schrecker in 1912. He lived in Berlin at that time. He had not completely severed his ties to the Vienna Academy of Music, teaching a private theory a year earlier. He considered the proposal carefully, but eventually rejected it.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 第一次世界大战给他的发展带来了危机。当他42岁时，兵役打乱了他的生活。他无法持续、不受打扰地工作，结果留下了许多未完成的作品和未发展的“开端”。有一次，一位上级军官问他是否“就是臭名昭著的勋伯格”，勋伯格回答说：“报告，先生，是的。没有人想要成为他，有人必须成为他，所以我成了他。”据諾曼·莱布雷希特说，这是指勋伯格作为“者”的明显“命运”。
target_text: The First World War put his development in crisis. When he was 42, military service disrupted his life. He was unable to work continuously and undisturbed, leaving behind many unfinished works and undeveloped “starts”. On one occasion, a superior officer asked him whether he was “the infamous Homberg”, and he said, “Report, sir, yes. No one wanted to be him, and no one had to be him, so I became him.” According to Norman Lebrecht, this was the obvious “fate” of Hemberg as “the man”.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 勋伯格将德国对法国的攻击与他对颓废的资产阶级艺术价值观的攻击进行了比较，乐评人亚历克斯·罗斯称其为“战争病态行为”。1914年8月，在谴责比才、斯特拉文斯基和拉威尔的音乐时，他写道：“现在是清算的时候！现在我们将把这些平庸的庸俗艺术商人（kitschmongers）奴役起来，教育他们崇敬德国精神，崇拜德国神。”
target_text: Hemberg compares the German attack on France with his attack on the depraved bourgeois artistic values, which Alex Ross, the music critic, described as “war pathological acts.” In August 1914, in condemning the music of Biter, Stravinsky and Lawell, he wrote: “It is time to settle! Now we will enslave these mediocre art traders (kitschmongers) and teach them to worship the German spirit and worship the German God.”
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 当代作曲家与公众之间关系的恶化导致他在1918年在维也纳成立了。他试图提供一个论坛，以便现代音乐作品能够经过精心准备和排练，并在受到时尚和商业压力影响的条件下仍得到适当的演出。从成立到1921年因经济原因结束为止，该协会向付费会员呈现了353场演出，有时每周一场。在最初的一年半中，勋伯格没有让自己的任何作品被演出。协会音乐会的听众而是听到了斯克里亚宾、德彪西、马勒、韦伯恩、贝尔格、雷格等20世纪音乐早期的重要人物的复杂当代作品。
target_text: The deterioration in the relationship between contemporary composers and the public led him to set up in Vienna in 1918. He tried to provide a forum in which modern musical works could be carefully prepared and rehearsed and could still be properly performed under the influence of fashion and commercial pressure. From its inception until the end of 1921, the Association presented 353 performances, sometimes once a week, to its paying members. During the first year and a half, Hemberg did not let any of his works be performed.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 后来，勋伯格发展出最有影响力的十二音作曲方法，该方法在法语和英语中被和于1947年被称为序列音乐。这种技术被他的许多学生采用，他们构成了所谓的第二维也纳乐派学派。他们包括安东·韦伯恩、阿尔班·贝尔格和汉斯·艾斯勒，他们都受到勋伯格的深刻影响。他出版了多本书，从他著名的《和声学》到《音乐作曲基础》（）等，其中许多仍在印刷并被音乐家和新作曲家使用。
target_text: Later, Hemberg developed the most influential 12-song method, known in French and English as serial music in 1947. This technique was used by many of his students, who formed the so-called second Viennaist school of music. They included Anton Webern, Alban Berg and Hans Esler, all of whom were deeply influenced by Hemberg. He has published many books, ranging from his famous “Assonics” to “The Basis of Music” (), many of which are still being printed and used by musicians and new composers.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 目前对我来说，更重要的是人们理解我的老作品……它们是我后期作品的自然前兆，只有那些理解和领会了这些作品的人才能对后期作品有一个超越时尚基本要求的理解。我并不把成为音乐妖怪（bogey-man）看得那么重要，而是成为一个真正继承了正确认知的优秀传统的自然延续者！
target_text: For me now, what is more important is that people understand my old work ... they are a natural premonition of my later work, and only those who understand and appreciate it can understand it beyond the basic requirements of fashion. I do not see it as important to be a music monster-man, but rather as a natural successor to a truly good tradition that has inherited the right understanding.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 1924年费卢西奥·布索尼去世后，他曾担任柏林作曲大师班的主任。次年，勋伯格被正式任命为该职位，但由于健康问题，直到1926年才能就任。在这个时期，他的著名学生包括作曲家罗伯托·格哈德、尼科斯·斯卡尔科塔斯和。1930年的六部男声合唱作品（作品35）的第4、第6首标志着勋伯格回归调性，其他曲目则采用了十二音技法。
target_text: After the death of Felucio Busoni in 1924, he was the director of the Berlin Maestro Class. The following year, Hemberg was officially appointed to the post, but could not take up his post until 1926 because of health problems. During this period, his famous students included composer Roberto Gerhard, Nikos Skalcotas and others. The fourth and sixth parts of the 1930 man-sung work (work 35) marked the return of Hemberg to the tone, while the other songs used the 12-sonic technique.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 他在美国的第一份教职是在马尔金音乐学院（波士頓大學）。他后来搬到洛杉矶，在南加州大学和加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校任教，两所学校后来都在各自的校园内命名了一座音乐建筑为勋伯格音乐厅。他于1935年被任命为加州大学洛杉矶分校的访问教授，这是在洛杉矶爱乐乐团的音乐总监兼指挥奥托·克伦佩勒的推荐下实现的。第二年，他晋升为教授，年薪5100美元，这使他在1936年或1937年的五月份购买了洛金汉姆北街116号的一座西班牙复兴风格的房屋，靠近加州大学洛杉矶分校。这个地址正对着秀兰·邓波儿的房子，且他在那里结识了同为作曲家的（也是网球搭档）乔治·格什温。勋伯格一家雇佣了家政人员，并开始举办每周日下午的聚会，后来以出色的咖啡和维也纳糕点而闻名。经常光顾的客人包括克伦佩勒（自1936年4月起私下向勋伯格学习作曲）、埃德加·瓦雷兹、、、恩斯特·托赫，有时还有和彼得·罗等著名演员。此时，作曲家、和好莱坞管弦乐编曲家也在勋伯格那里学习。
target_text: His first post in the United States was at the Markin School of Music (Boston University). He moved to Los Angeles, where he worked at the University of Southern California and the University of California at Los Angeles, where both schools later named a music building as the Humberg Hall. In 1935, he was appointed visiting professor at the University of California at Los Angeles, where he learned about George Gershwin, who was a composer (also a tennis partner). In the second year, he was promoted to a professor with an annual salary of $5,100, which enabled him to buy a Spanish Renaissance House in May 1936 or 1937 at the University of Southern California at 116 Lokingham North Street, which was close to the University of California at Los Angeles.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 他在那里度过了余生，但最初并不想安定。大约在1934年，他申请了悉尼的和声和理论教师职位。院长因他是犹太人且持有“现代主义思想和危险倾向”而拒绝了他。勋伯格也曾一度考虑移民新西兰。他的秘书和学生（也是勋伯格岳母亨丽埃特·科利施的侄子）出生于维也纳但在1935年至1947年期间居住在新西兰，且勋伯格从小就对岛屿和尤其是新西兰充满了迷恋，可能是因为该国发行的美丽的邮票。
target_text: He spent the rest of his life there, but didn't want to settle at first. In 1934, he applied for Sydney's voice and theory teacher position. The Dean rejected him because he was Jewish and possessed a “modernist ideology and dangerous tendencies”. Hemberg also considered migrating to New Zealand at one time. His secretary and students (also the nephew of Hemberg's mother Henriette Corisch) were born in Vienna but lived in New Zealand between 1935 and 1947, and he became obsessed with the island and New Zealand in particular from an early age, probably because of the country's beautiful stamps.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 在这一最后时期，他创作了几部重要的作品，包括小提琴协奏曲（作品36号，1934/36年）、为合唱和管弦乐团而作的《誓约》（Kol Nidre，作品39号，1938年）、《拿破仑·波拿巴颂》（Ode to Napoleon Buonaparte，作品41号，1942年）、（作品42号，1942年），以及献给大屠杀受害者的纪念作品《》（作品46号，1947年）。他未能完成自己的歌剧《摩西与亚伦》（1932/33年），该作品是最早完全采用十二音技法创作的歌剧之一。除了十二音音乐，勋伯格在最后一个时期还回归了调性，创作了G大调弦乐组曲（1935年）、（作品38号，始于1906年，于1939年完成）、D小调宣叙调变奏曲（作品40号，1941年）。在这个时期，他的著名学生包括约翰·凯奇和卢·哈里森。
target_text: During this last period, he produced several important works, including the violin concert (work No. 36, 1934/36), the vow of Kol Nidre (work No. 39, 1938), Ode to Napoleon Buonaparte (work No. 41, 1942), (work No. 42, 1942), and the memorial to the victims of the Holocaust (work No. 46, 1947), which he failed to complete his opera Moses and Aaron (1932/33), which was one of the first musicals to be fully inspired by the 12th technique. In addition to the 12th music, Hemberg returned to tune in the last period, and he created the G-string group (1935) (work No. 38, which began in 1906 and was completed in 1939), and D-mitigation reverbing (work No. 40, 1941).
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 勋伯格迷信的性格可能触发了他的死亡。他有十三恐懼症，据他的朋友卡蒂娅·曼（Katia Mann）所说，他害怕自己会在13倍数的年份去世。这可能始于1908年，当时他创作了歌曲循环《悬园之书》中的第十三首歌曲。他对自己1939年的六十五岁生日非常恐惧，以至于一位朋友邀请作曲家兼占星师为勋伯格制作了天宫图。鲁迪亚接受了邀请，并告诉勋伯格这一年很危险，但不致命。
target_text: He had 13 phobias, and, according to his friend Katia Mann, he feared that he would die in a 13-fold year. This could have started in 1908, when he wrote the thirteenth song in a loop of the Book of the Orchard. He was so scared of his sixty-fifth birthday in 1939 that a friend invited composer and astrologer to make a map of the sky for Hemberg. Rudia accepted the invitation and told Hemberg that the year was dangerous but not fatal.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 然而，在1950年，也就是他的76岁生日那一年，一位占星师给勋伯格写了一张便条，警告他这是一个关键的年份：7 + 6 = 13。这使得作曲家感到震惊和沮丧，因为在那之前，他只担心13的倍数，从未考虑过将自己年龄的位数相加。他于1951年7月13日星期五的午夜前不久去世。勋伯格整天都躺在床上，生病、焦虑和沮丧。他的妻子格特鲁德在隔天给她的妹妹奥蒂莉（Ottilie）发去一封电报，报告阿诺德于晚上11点45分去世，离午夜还有15分钟。在一封于1951年8月4日写给奥蒂莉的信中，格特鲁德解释道：“大约十二点前一刻，我看了看钟，对自己说：再过十五分钟，最糟糕的就过去了。然后医生叫我去。阿诺德的喉咙咯咯作响了两次，他的心脏有一次有力的跳动，那就是结束了。”
target_text: However, in 1950, the year of his 76th birthday, an astrologer wrote a note to Huntberg warning him that it was a crucial year: 7 + 6 = 13. This shocked and frustrated the composer, because before that, he was only worried about 13 times his age and never considered adding it to his number. He died shortly before midnight on Friday, 13 July 1951. He was lying in bed all day, sick, anxious and depressed. His wife, Gertrude, sent a telegram to her sister, Ottilie, reporting that Arnold died at 11:45 p.m., 15 minutes before midnight. In a letter addressed to Otiri on 4 August 1951, Gertrude explained: “About 12 a.m., I looked at the clock and said to myself: 15 minutes later, the worst was over. Then the doctor asked me to go.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 勋伯格在现代艺术音乐曲目中的重要作品跨越了50多年的时间。传统上，它们被分为三个时期，但鉴于这些时期内的音乐十分多样，不存在严格的划分。他十二音阶时期“代表着一系列风格统一的作品”这一想法“没有得到音乐证据上的支持”，而重要的音乐特征，尤其是与动机发展有关的特征，则完全超越了这些界限。
target_text: Hemberg's important work in modern art music music has gone over a period of more than 50 years. Traditionally, they have been divided into three periods, but given the diversity of music in these periods, there is no strict division. The idea that his 12-story period “represents a series of homogenous works” “does not enjoy the support of musical evidence”, while important musical features, especially those related to motivational development, completely transcend these limits.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 第一个时期是1894年至1907年，它与19世纪末的高度浪漫主义作曲家以及诗歌和艺术中的“表现主义”运动有关。第二个时期是1908年至1922年，以放弃调性中心为特征，这一举措通常被描述为“自由无调性”，尽管并非由勋伯格本人提出。第三个时期从1923年开始，以勋伯格发明的“十二音技法”作曲方法为开端。勋伯格最著名的学生汉斯·艾斯勒、阿尔班·贝尔格和安东·韦伯恩在智力和审美转变的每个阶段都忠实地跟随勋伯格，尽管在实验和方法上有相当大的变化。
target_text: The first period, from 1894 to 1907, was associated with the highly romantic composers and the “expressionist” movement in poetry and art at the end of the nineteenth century. The second period, from 1908 to 1922, was characterized by the abandonment of the centres of moderation, a move often described as “free disharmony”, although not by Hümberg himself. The third period began in 1923 with the method of singing “the 12-sonic method” invented by Hemberg. Hemberg’s most famous students, Hans Esler, Arban Berg and Anton Webern, followed Hemberg faithfully at every stage of intellectual and aesthetic transformation, despite considerable changes in experiments and methods.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 从世纪之交左右创作的歌曲和弦乐四重奏开始，作为作曲家的勋伯格的关注点使他在同行中独树一帜，因为他的手法同时呈现了勃拉姆斯和瓦格纳的特点，而对于大多数同时代的听众来说，这两者被认为是南辕北辙、代表着德国音乐传统中互不相容的方向。例如，勋伯格的《六首歌曲》（作品3号，1899-1903年），展示了一种保守的调性组织清晰性，典型地体现了勃拉姆斯和马勒的特点，反映出对平衡的乐句和不受干扰的调性关系等层次结构的兴趣。然而，这些歌曲还探索了异常大胆的偶发半音，力求达到瓦格纳式的动机再现方法，即“表现”而非简单的重复。
target_text: Starting with songs and string quartets written around the turn of the century, Hemberg, as the composer's focus, made him unique among his peers, because his tactics present the characteristics of Brams and Wagner, which for most of the simultaneous audiences are considered to be the opposite of the opposite in Germany's musical tradition. For example, Hemberg's Six Songs (Cook No. 3, 1899-1903) show the clarity of a conservative modulation that typically reflects the characteristics of Brams and Mahler, reflecting an interest in the balanced choreography and non-disturbed tone of the hierarchy. However, they also explore unusually bold myths and seek to achieve the Wagner motive, i.e., “expression” rather than simple repetitions.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 这些方法的综合在他的《升华之夜》（作品4号，1899年）中达到了巅峰，这是一部为弦乐六重奏而创作的标题作品，发展出了几个独特的类似“主导动机”的主题，每个主题都覆盖而又从属于前一个。在整个作品中持续存在的唯一动机元素是那些不断溶解、变化和重新组合的元素，这是一种主要在勃拉姆斯的音乐中出现的技巧，勋伯格称之为“”。勋伯格在这部作品中的手法同时以两种方式组织；既呈现出瓦格纳式的动机思想叙事，又体现出勃拉姆斯式的动机发展和音调连贯性的方式。
target_text: The combination of these methods reached its peak in his "Night of Highness" (work No. 4, 1899), a title written for the string six, which developed several unique themes similar to the "dominant motivation" that were covered and subordinated to the former. The only motivational elements that persisted throughout the work were those that continued to dissolve, change, and regroup, a technique that had appeared mainly in Brams' music, which Hemberg called “.” Hemberg's techniques in this work were organized in two ways at the same time; they presented both Wagner-style ideological narratives and a Brams-style approach to motivational development and tone coherence.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 勋伯格从1908年开始的音乐实验以各种方式探索传统音调或调性中心的缺失。他的第一部明确无调性的作品是（作品10号），带有女高音独唱。这部作品的最后乐章没有调号，标志着勋伯格与七声调和的正式分离。这个时期的其他重要作品包括他的歌曲循环《》（1908-1909年），他的《》（作品16号，1909年），颇具影响力的《》（作品21号，1912年），以及他的歌剧《》（作品17号，1909年）。

His first unmistakable work was (work No. 10) with a soprano solo. The final piece of the work was not remixed, marking the official separation of Heungberg from the seven. Other important pieces of the period included his song cycle (1908-1909), his " 16, 1909), his influential " 21, 1912 " and his opera " 17, 1909 " .

source_text: 然而，调性中心的缺乏或传统的不协和-协和关系构建的紧迫感可以追溯到他的（作品9号，1906年），这部作品以全音音阶、四度和声的调性发展以及它引发的动态、不寻常的合奏关系、戏剧性的中断和不可预测的器乐组合而著称；许多这些特征成为了20世纪音色导向的室内乐美学的典型特征。

title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 在1920年代初，勋伯格致力于发展一种能够使音乐织体更简单、更清晰的秩序方式。这导致了“以只与彼此相关的十二个音符进行作曲的方法”，其中八度音阶内的十二个音高（在作曲中并未实现）被视为相等，没有任何一个音符或音调被赋予古典和声中所占据的重要性。他认为这一理论的重要性等同于物理中阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦的相对论的地位。勋伯格在与朋友散步时以他典型的方式宣布了这一发现，当时他说：“我已经做出了一个发现，它将确保德国音乐在未来一百年中仍占主导地位。”这个时期的作品包括《为乐团而作的变奏曲》（作品31号，1928年）；伴奏音乐《》（作品34，1930年）；《钢琴作品》（作品Op. 33a/b号，1931年）以及钢琴协奏曲（作品42号，1942年）。人们普遍认为勋伯格作曲方法严谨，但他对这种技巧的使用因每个独立作品的要求而各不相同。因此，他未完成的歌剧《摩西与亚伦》的结构与他的《为小提琴与钢琴而作的幻想曲》（作品47号，1949年）不同。
target_text: At the beginning of the 1920s, Hürnberg was committed to developing an orderly way that would make the music fabric simpler and clearer. This led to “the method of composing with only 12 notes of relevance to each other”, in which 12 audio highs (not realized in the song) within the eight-degree hierarchy were considered equal, and no single note or tone was assigned to the importance of classical and vocal discourse. He considered that the importance of this theory was equal to that of Albert Einstein’s relativity in physics. He announced this discovery in his typical way, when he said: “I have made an discovery that will ensure that German music will remain dominant for the next 100 years.” The work of this period included the musical tunes for the orchestra (31, 1928), which was not performed; the musical companions (34, 1930); the piano works (op. 33a/b, 1931) and the piano concerts (works 42, 1942), which were widely regarded as such, but the use of that technique was different from the musical composition of the opera of the opera (49, which had been written by the opera 47, which was different from his own version).
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 然而，他的许多作品并未受到良好的评价。他的第1室内交响曲在1907年的首演没有引起多少轰动。然而，当它于1913年3月31日在“”上再次演奏时（该音乐会还包括贝尔格、韦伯恩和策姆林斯基的作品），“在热烈的掌声中可以听到门钥匙尖锐的声音，而在第二层包厢，那天晚上的第一场斗殴刚刚开始。”在音乐会的后半段，在演奏贝尔格的《》时，由于勋伯格中断演出并威胁称警察会抓捕闹事者，冲突完全爆发。
target_text: However, many of his works were not well evaluated. His first room symphony in 1907 did not cause much excitement. However, when it played again on March 31, 1913 (the concert also included work by Berger, Webern and Tsimlinski), “the sharp sound of the key was heard in a warm applause, while the first fight of the night just began in the second compartment.” In the second half of the concert, the conflict broke out in the second half of the concert, during the performance of Berger's "Berberg" and threatened that the police would arrest the spoilers.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 根据伊森·海莫（Ethan Haimo）的说法，由于他新体系的“真正革命性质”，一些早期作家关于这一体系的“规则”和“例外”的错误信息与勋伯格音乐的最重要特点“几乎毫不相关”，加上作曲家的神秘主义和他的草图和手稿直到1970年代末才广泛流传，理解勋伯格的十二音作品一直很困难。在他的一生中，他“遭受了各种批评和谩骂，即使回顾起来也令人震惊”。
target_text: According to Ethan Haimo, due to the “genuine revolutionary nature” of his new system, the “rules” and “exceptions” of some of his early writers were “never relevant” to the most important features of Hemberg's music, and the mysticism of the composers and his sketches and manuscripts were not widely disseminated until the late 1970s, and it was difficult to understand the 12-sounding work of Hemberg. During his life, he “had been subjected to various criticisms and insults, even when recalled as shocking”.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 勋伯格的十二音序列作曲技术在20世纪中后期成为美国和欧洲音乐家中最核心和有争议的问题之一。从1940年代开始，持续到今天，诸如皮埃尔·布莱兹、卡尔海因茨·施托克豪森、路易吉·诺诺和米尔顿·巴比特等作曲家已将勋伯格的遗产推向越来越激进的方向。美国的主要城市（如洛杉矶、纽约和波士顿）曾经有过历史性的勋伯格音乐演出，拥护者包括纽约的巴比特和法籍美国指挥家兼钢琴家。勋伯格的学生在美国的重要大学中担任有影响力的教职，例如在南加州大学、加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校和加州艺术学院；理查德·霍夫曼（Richard Hoffmann）在欧柏林音乐学院；在哥伦比亚大学；以及和厄尔·金（Earl Kim）在哈佛大学。与勋伯格有关的音乐家对美国当代音乐演奏实践产生了深远影响（例如，、和在新英格兰音乐学院；和在）。在欧洲，、和对将勋伯格的音乐遗产向德国和奥地利以外地区传播发挥了可观的影响。勋伯格的学生和助手后来成为音乐教授，还指挥过瑞士罗曼德管弦乐团演奏三部“杰作”勋伯格作品的录音，该录音于2013年末在他去世后发布。这份录音中包括多伊奇对每首乐曲的简短讲解。
target_text: From the 1940s onwards, leading writers such as Pierre Blaise, Carl Heinz Stokehausen, Luigi Nono and Milton Babbitt have moved the legacy of Hemberg to an increasingly radical direction. Major cities in the United States (such as Los Angeles, New York and Boston) have had a historic Hemberg musical performance, with supporters including New York's Babbit and the French American Commandor and Pianist. Hemberg students have held influential teaching positions in major universities in the United States, such as the University of Southern California, the University of California's Los Angeles campus and the California Institute of Arts; Richard Hoffmann at the Oberlin Academy of Music; and at Columbia University and Earl Kim at Harvard University.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 批评在1920年代，恩斯特·克热内克批评了一种未具名的当代音乐门派（可能指勋伯格及其门徒），称其为“坐在工作室里根据自己凭空发明的规则写下音符的个体的自我满足”。勋伯格对这一言论感到冒犯，并回应说克热内克“恨不得自己的听众只有娼妓”。
target_text: In the 1920s, Ernst Ksenek criticized an unnamed contemporary music community (possibly known as Hürnberg and his disciples) as “self-satisfaction of an individual sitting in a studio writing notes in accordance with rules that he himself invented in vain”. Hemberg offended this statement and responded by saying that Kwenek “he hates his own audience only prostitutes”.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 指出，鉴于勋伯格的生活环境，人们通常是在为他的作品进行“辩护”而非真正倾听，而且很难脱离其周围的意识形态体验它。理查德·塔鲁斯金断言，勋伯格犯了一种所谓“创作谬误”的错误，即认为艺术作品中最重要的（或者唯一重要的）是创作过程、作曲家的创造力，而听众的愉悦不应是作曲家的主要目标。塔鲁斯金还批评了以勋伯格对其他艺术家的影响衡量他作为作曲家的价值的方法、对他技术创新的过誉、以及将评价局限于结构和工艺，而贬低其他方面为庸俗的做法。
target_text: It was pointed out that, given the circumstances in which Heungberg lived, it was often “defend” his work rather than really listening, and it was difficult to get away from the ideological experience around it. Richard Taruskin asserted that Hengberg had made a mistake of considering that the most important (or only important) in the work of art was the creative process, the creative power of the composer, and that the pleasure of the audience should not be the main objective of the composer.
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 根据本·厄尔（Ben Earle）2003年的研究，尽管勋伯格受到专家的崇敬，并在大学课程中被传授给“数代学生”，但他并不受大众喜爱。尽管进行了超过四十年的推广，并出版了“专门向非专业观众解释这些困难曲目的书籍”，但“现在可以放心地说，试图推广这类音乐的努力（尤其是在英国）已经失败了。”
target_text: According to Ben Earle's 2003 study, Hemberg was not popular, although he was honoured by experts and taught in university courses to “intergenerational students.” Despite more than 40 years of promotion and publication of “books explaining these difficult songs to a non-professional audience”, “it is now safe to say that attempts to promote such music, especially in the United Kingdom, have failed.”
title: 阿诺德·勋伯格

source_text: 在勋伯格同代作曲家、同样具有开创性的作曲家德彪西的2018年的传记中，对“一个创作艺术家无法既激进又受欢迎”的观点提出了质疑。沃尔什得出结论：“勋伯格可能是现代历史上第一个‘伟大’的作曲家，他的音乐在他出生近一个半世纪后仍未进入标准曲目。”
target_text: In the 2018 biography of Hemberg's co-constituent composer and equally groundbreaking composer De Bosy, he questioned the view that “a creative artist cannot be both radical and popular.” Walsh concluded that “Hemberg may be the first `great' composer in modern history, whose music has not yet reached the standard tune nearly a century and a half since his birth”.

source_text: 个性和音乐外的兴趣勋伯格是能力颇高的画家，他的作品与弗兰茨·马尔克和瓦西里·康定斯基的作品一起展出，他们是表现主义团体青骑士的成员。他三分之二的画作都在1908年至1910年期间创作，其中包括65幅油画。他对系列电影很感兴趣，保罗·布勒（Paul Buhle）和大卫·瓦格纳（David Wagner）将这归功于这些电影的左翼编剧——鉴于勋伯格称自己是从“资产阶级”转变而来的君主主义者，这个说法有些奇怪。

在制定计算机网络标准方面，起着重大作用的两大国际组织是：國際電信聯盟電信標準化部門，与国际标准组织（ISO），虽然它们工作领域不同，但随着科学技术的发展，通信与信息处理之间的界限开始变得比较模糊，这也成了國際電信聯盟電信標準化部門和ISO共同关心的领域。1984年，ISO发布了著名的ISO/IEC 7498标准，它定义了网络互联的7层框架，也就是开放式系统互联参考模型。
target_text: The two major international organizations that play a major role in the development of computer network standards are the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) Telecommunication Standardization Department, which, unlike the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), has begun to blur the boundaries between communication and information processing as science and technology evolves. This is also an area of common interest for the ITU Telecommunication Standardization Department and ISO. In 1984, ISO published the famous ISO/IEC 7498 standard, which defines the seven-storey framework for network connectivity, the Open System Interconnectivity Reference Model.
title: OSI模型

source_text: 應用層（Application Layer）是使用者真正與電腦溝通的點，這一層只有在真正需要存取網路才有作用。以網路瀏覽器(IE，Interner，Explorer)為例，您可以從系統中移除諸如TCP/IP，NIC卡等網路元件，但仍舊可以使用IE來檢視原生的HTML檔案。不過如果您想要檢視那些必須使用HTTP來擷取遠端HTML檔案，或是利用FTP或TFTP抓取檔案時，事情就會一片混亂。這是因為IE或其他瀏覽器在回應這類請求時，會試圖存取[應用層]。基本上，[應用層]會扮演真正的應用程式與下一層之間的介面，讓應用程式能夠穿越協定堆疊向下傳送資訊。這其實不算是分層式結構的一部分，因為瀏覽器不是真的位於[應用層]內，但它會在必須處理遠端資源時，與[應用層]即其相關協定介接。 [應用層]還要負責辨識及確認可用的通訊夥伴，做好通訊準備，並驗證指定通訊類型是否能得到足夠的資源。這些任務非常重要，因為電腦應用有時需要的不只是桌面上的資源。通常會將幾個網路應用的通訊元件結合起來，例如:•網路瀏覽•檔案傳輸•電子郵件•開啟遠端存取•網路管理活動•客戶端/伺服器處理•資訊搜尋。
target_text: In the case of Internet browsers (IE, Interner, Explorer), you can remove web components such as TCP/IP, NNIC cards from the system, but IE can still be used to view the original HTML file. But if you want to view those that must use HTTP to access the remote HTML file, or FTTP to retrieve the file, this will be a mess. This is because IE or other browsers, when responding to this request, will try to store [the user base]. Basically, [the application level] will play a real appliance with the next level of activity, allowing the appliance to pass the information through the remote HTTP message, or using the TFTP to retrieve the file, it will not be part of the component structure, because the IE or other browser does not have a real access to it.

source_text: 資料連結層（Data Link Layer）負責網絡尋址、錯誤偵測和改錯。當表頭和表尾被加至數據包時，會形成資訊框（Info Box）。數據鏈表頭（DLH）是包含了實體位址和錯誤偵測及改錯的方法。數據鏈表尾（DLT）是一串指示數據包末端的字符串。例如以太網、無線局域网（Wi-Fi）和通用分組無線服務（GPRS）等。

source_text:
环境科学为跨学科领域专业，既包含像物理，化学，生物，地质学，地理，资源技术、工程的科学，也含有像资源管理和保护，人口统计学，经济学，政治和伦理学等社会科学。环境科学包含了影响人类和其他有机体的周边环境的学科。自然与人类资源是相互依赖的，其中一方所作出的任何动作，正确或错误，都会对另外一方产生影响。此学科年代较短，直到20世纪60年代才成为正式学科。1960年，Rachael Carson具有里程碑意义的生态学著作《寂静的春天》出版，使环境类主题成为热点，就像1969年在美国加利福尼亚州的圣巴巴拉海滩的井喷溢油事故，以及同年发生在俄亥俄州克利夫兰市的凯霍加河着火事件，都使公众对环境运动的关心度上升，从而开创了环境研究这一新学科领域。環境科學直到1960年和1970年間，才廣泛地活躍於科學研究領域的主要原因有：
需要一組強大的多樣性學問的團隊來分析複雜的環境問題。
建立一系列環境保護的法律，需要精確的環境研究草案。
民眾通過生活中的種種問題逐漸認識到，大家需要一個解決環境問題的方案。
target_text: Environmental science is a field of interdisciplinary specialization, both physics, chemistry, biology, geology, geography, resource technology, engineering, and social science such as resource management and protection, demographics, economics, politics and ethics. Environmental science encompasses disciplines that affect the surrounding environment of humans and other organisms. Natural and human resources are interdependent, and any action, correct or erroneous, by one of them will affect the other. This discipline was only relatively young in 1960, until the 1960’s, when Rachel Carson’s landmark ecological work, The Silent Spring, was published.
title: 环境科学

source_text: 在宏观上，环境科学要研究人与环境之间的相互作用、相互制约的关系，要力图发现社会经济发展和环境保护之间协调的规律；在微观上，要研究环境中的物质在有机体内迁移、转化、蓄积的过程以及其运动规律，对生命的影响和作用机理，尤其是人类活动排放出来的污染物质。
target_text: At the macro level, environmental sciences look at the interactions and constraints between people and the environment, seeking to identify patterns of coordination between socio-economic development and environmental protection, and at the microlevel, at the process of transport, transformation, accumulation and movement of materials in the environment, at the effects on life and at the mechanisms of functioning, especially pollution from human activities.
title: 环境科学

source_text:
环境科学要探索全球范围内的环境演化规律；人类活动与自然生态之间的关系；环境变化对人类生存的影响；以及区域环境污染的防治技术和管理措施。学科构成
大气科学主要研究地球的大气层，尤其是它和其他系统之间的相互关系。大气科学包含了对气象学，温室气体现象，空气污染物的大气扩散模式，与噪音污染有关的传声现象，甚至是光污染的研究。
target_text: Environmental science explores global patterns of environmental evolution; the relationship between human activity and natural ecology; the impact of environmental change on human survival; and regional environmental pollution prevention techniques and management measures. The discipline consists of atmospheric science, which focuses on the interrelationships between the Earth’s atmosphere, particularly with other systems. Atmospheric science encompasses research into meteorology, greenhouse gas phenomena, atmospheric diffusion patterns of air pollutants, and noise related phenomena, even light pollution.
title: 环境科学

source_text: 以全球变暖现象为例，物理学家建立了大气环流和红外无线传输的计算机模型，化学家对大气中的化学物质及发生的化学反应进行了研究，生物学家分析了动植物对二氧化碳变化的积极作用，一些如气象学家和海洋学家的专家则加深对大气动力学的理解。
target_text: Using global warming as an example, physicists have developed computer models of atmospheric circulation and infrared wireless transmission, chemists have studied chemical substances in the atmosphere and the chemical reactions that occur, biologists have analysed the positive effects of fauna and flora on CO2 change, and some experts, such as meteorologists and marine scientists, have deepened their understanding of atmospheric dynamics.
title: 环境科学

source_text: 环境化学是环境科学的化学研究分支学科，其理论研究领域包括土壤污染和水污染。分析主题包括土壤中化学物质的降解，在不同阶段的迁移，举例来说，含有溶剂的湖泊蒸发了后，溶剂散发在空气中，就会成为空气污染物。除此以外，化学物质还会影响生物群。
target_text: Environmental chemistry is a branch of chemical research in environmental sciences, and the theoretical areas of study include soil and water pollution. The topics of analysis include degradation of chemical substances in soil, transport at different stages, for example, when solvent-containing lakes evaporate in air, and so on, chemical substances also become air pollutants.
title: 环境科学

source_text: 例如一个泄漏的化学溶剂罐掉入某类濒临灭绝的两栖动物栖息的土壤里，如果要获得此处土壤的污染程度以及该溶剂在土壤中的分布状况，可采用电脑模型法。之后化学家可以根据测定的土壤类型描述该化学溶剂的分子结构，生物学家可以研究该化学溶剂对其他生物的影响，包括土壤节肢动物、植物以及作为此类濒危两栖动物食物的池塘居生物。
target_text: For example, a leaking chemical solvent tank falls into the soil of a group of amphibians at risk of extinction, and if the extent of the contamination of the soil and the distribution of the solvent in the soil is to be obtained, a computer-based model can be used. Then the chemists can describe the molecular structure of the chemical solvent based on the measured soil type, and biologists can study the effects of the chemical solvent on other organisms, including soil arthropods, plants, and pond-dwelling organisms that serve as food for such endangered amphibians.
title: 环境科学

source_text: 生态学，是指运用相关领域的环境科学知识对生态系统进行分析，而生态系统被不只一个应激源影响。举例来说，备受推崇的工业发展引起的水污染和空气污染会影响入海口的某些物种，而生态学可以用来检测这些变化。据此研究，生物学家将能够详细描述动植物群，化学家研究如何使含有污染物的水源流经沼泽，物理学家可以预测大气放射污染，而地理学家则可以帮助我们认识沼泽土壤和海湾的泥浆。
target_text: Ecology refers to the use of environmental scientific knowledge in relevant areas to analyse ecosystems, which are affected by more than one stress source. For example, water pollution and air pollution caused by highly respected industrial development can affect certain species entering the sea, and ecology can be used to detect these changes. On this basis, biologists will be able to describe fauna and flora in detail, chemists will be able to study how water sources containing pollutants can flow through swamps, physicists can predict atmospheric radiation pollution, and geologists can help us to understand the slurry of swamp soils and bays.
title: 环境科学
