target_text: The Environmental Protection Agency of England and Wales (formerly the Office of the Acting Prime Minister) was established in 1996 as a public agency for the protection and improvement of the environment, with regulations placed on local community and government websites. Under the Environment Act 1995, EPA was created as an independent agency and works closely with the British government to enforce environmental regulations.
title: 环境科学

source_text: 环境科学家监测环境质量、解释人类活动对陆地生态系统和水生生态系统的影响，并制定战略来恢复生态系统。此外，环境科学家们还帮助规划、发展、建设建筑物、运输通道、以及保护水资源的设施，考虑高效、有益的土地利用规划。由于环境科学跨学科的性质，专业的团队间通常共同合作进行环境研究或发布环境影响评估。还有一些专业的组织协调发动开展環境科學研究并帮助进行不同学科间的联系与交流。
target_text: Environmental scientists monitor the quality of the environment, explain the impact of human activities on terrestrial and aquatic ecosystems, and develop strategies to restore ecosystems. In addition, environmental scientists help to plan, develop, build buildings, transport corridors, and facilities for the protection of water resources, taking into account efficient and beneficial land-use planning. Due to the interdisciplinary nature of environmental science, professional teams usually cooperate in environmental research or in the issuance of environmental impact assessments.
title: 环境科学

source_text: 機械工程是眾多工程學科中範圍最廣的一科。任何現代產業和工程領域都需要應用機械，例如：農業、林業、礦業等需要農業機械、 林業機械、礦業機械；冶金工程和化學工程需要冶金機械、化工機械；紡織和食品加工業需要紡織機械、食品加工機械；水利、土木建築、道路和橋梁等工程需要工程機械；電力工程需要電力機械；交通運輸業需要各種車輛、船舶、飛機等；各種商品的計量、包裝、儲存、裝卸需要各種相應的工作機械。
target_text: Mechanical engineering is one of the most extensive subjects in many engineering disciplines. Any modern industry or engineering field requires machinery, such as: agricultural, forestry, mining, etc., which requires agricultural machinery, forestry, mining machinery; metallurgical and chemical engineering, which requires metallurgical machinery, chemical machinery; textile and food processing, which requires knitting machines, food processing machines; water, civil construction, roads and bridges, which requires engineering equipment; electrical engineering, which requires electrical machinery; transport, which requires vehicles, ships, aircraft, etc.; and computing, packaging, storage, and unloading of commodities, which requires machine tools for various types of equipment.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 各個工程領域的發展都要求機械工程有與之相適應的發展，都需要機械工程提供所必需的機械。某些機械的發明和完善，又導致新的工程技術和新的產業的出現和發展，例如：大型機械的成功製造，促成了電力系統的建立；火車的發明導致了鐵路工程和鐵路事業的興起；內燃機、燃氣輪機、火箭發動機等的發明和進步以及船舶、飛機和航空器的研製成功導致了航海工程、航海事業、航空工程和航空事業的興起；高壓設備（包括壓縮機、反應器、密封技術等）的發展導致了許多新型合成化學工程的成功。機械工程就是在各方面不斷提高的需求的壓力下獲得發展動力，同時又從各個學科和技術的進步中得到改進和創新能力。
target_text: Developments in every engineering field require appropriate developments in mechanical engineering and the necessary machinery to be provided by mechanical engineering. The invention and refinement of certain machinery has led to the emergence and development of new engineering techniques and new industries, such as: the successful construction of large-scale machinery, which has led to the creation of electrical systems; the development of trains, which has led to the emergence of railway engineering and railways; the development and advancement of internal combustion engines, gas turbines, rocket engines, etc.; the successful development of ships, aircraft and aircraft; the emergence of marine engineering, navigation, aviation engineering and aviation industries; and the development of high-pressure equipment (including compressors, reactors, seals, etc.), which has led to the success of many new synthetic engineering projects.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 幾千年前，人類已創製了例如用於穀物脫殼和粉碎的臼和磨，用來提水的桔槔和轆轤，裝有輪子的車，航行於江河的船及其槳、櫓、舵等。所用的動力，從人自身的體力，發展到利用畜力、風力和水力。所用材料從天然的石、土、木、皮革，發展到人造材料。最早的人造材料是陶瓷。製造陶瓷器皿的陶車，已是具有動力、傳動和工作三個部分的完整機械。
target_text: Thousands of years ago, humans created, for example, molten molten and grinded with grains to remove shells and shredded moltens and mounds to lift water, with wheels and wheels to sail the ships of rivers and their oars, rudders, etc. The force used, from the strength of the humans themselves, to the use of animals, wind and water. The material used was developed from natural stones, earth, wood, leather to man-made materials. The first man-made material was ceramics.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 人類從石器時代進入銅器時代，再進而到鐵器時代，用以吹旺爐火的鼓風器的發展起了重要作用。有足夠強大的鼓風器，才能使冶金爐獲得足夠高的爐溫，才能從礦石中煉得金屬。在中國公元前1,000～前900年就已有了冶鑄用的鼓風器，並漸從人力鼓風發展到畜力和水力鼓風。
target_text: Humans have played an important role in the development of the drums used to blow fire from the stone age into the copper age to the iron age. There are enough powerful drums to warm the furnaces high enough to extract the metal from the minerals. There were smelting drums in China 1,000 to 900 B.C.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 早在公元前，中國已在指南車上應用複雜的齒輪系統，在被中香爐中應用了能永保水平位置的十字轉架等機件。古希臘已有圓柱齒輪、圓錐齒輪和蝸杆傳動的記載。但是關於齒輪傳動瞬時速比與齒形的關係、齒形曲線的選擇，直到17世紀之後方有理論闡述。手搖把和踏板機構是曲柄連杆機構的先驅，在各文明古國都有悠久歷史，但是曲柄連杆機構的形式、運動和動力的確切分析和綜合，則是近代機械學的成就。
target_text: Already before the C.W., China had applied complicated gear systems in its steering vehicles, using cross-crossings that could last forever, etc., in the cranium furnaces. In ancient Greece, cylinders, rotor wheels and poles have been recorded. But the choice of dents to move gears at an instant speed compared to teeth, the choice of dents until the 17th century was justified. Hand-rolling and pedal structures are the precursor to the curved poles, with a long history in ancient civilized countries, but the exact analysis and alignment of the shape, motion and dynamics of the rotor is the achievement of recent mechanics.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 15－16世紀以前，機械工程發展緩慢。但在以千年計的實踐中，在機械發展方面還是積累了相當多的經驗和技術知識，成為後來機械工程發展的重要潛力。17世紀以後，資本主義在英、法和西歐諸國出現，商品生產開始成為社會的中心問題。許多高才藝的機械匠師和有生產觀念的知識分子致力於改進各產業所需的工作機械和研製新的動力機械──蒸汽機。18世紀後期，蒸汽機的應用從採礦業推廣到紡織、麵粉、冶金等行業。製作機械的主要材料逐漸從木材改用更為堅韌，但難以用手工加工的金屬。機械製造工業開始形成，並在幾十年中成為一個重要產業。機械工程通過不斷擴大的實踐，從分散性的、主要依賴匠師們個人才智和手藝的一種技藝，逐漸發展成為一門有理論指導的、系統的和獨立的工程技術。機械工程是促成18－19世紀的工業革命以及資本主義機械大量生產的主要技術因素。
target_text: Since the 17th century, capitalism has emerged in the United Kingdom, France, and Western Europe, and commodity production has become a central problem for society. Many highly talented mechanics and intellectuals have been working to transform the tools and tools needed in industries, and to develop new power tools - steam machines.
title: 机械工程

source_text:
動力機械的發展
動力是發展生產的重要因素。17世紀後期，隨著各種機械的改進和發展，隨著煤和金屬礦石的需要量的逐年增加，人們感到依靠人力和畜力不能將生產提高到一個新的階段。在英國，紡織、磨粉等產業越來越多地將工場設在河邊，利用水輪來驅動工作機械。但當時已有一定規模的煤礦、錫礦、鋁礦、鐵礦、銅礦、銀礦、金礦礦井中的地下水，仍只能用大量畜力來提昇和排除。
target_text: The development of kinetic machinery is an important factor in the development of production. After the 17th century, with the evolution and development of various machines and the annual increase in the demand for coal and metal minerals, people felt that human and animal resources could not raise production to a new phase. In the United Kingdom, industries such as knitting, milling, etc. were increasingly positioned on the riverside, using water turbines to drive the machinery.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 在這樣的生產需要下，18世紀初出現了湯瑪斯·紐科門(Thomas Newcomen)的大氣式蒸汽機，用以驅動礦井排水泵。但是這種蒸汽機的燃料消耗率很高，基本上只應用於煤礦。1765年英國人瓦特發明了有分開的凝汽器的蒸汽機，降低了燃料消耗率。1781年瓦特又創製出提供迴轉動力的蒸汽機，擴大了蒸汽機的應用範圍。蒸汽機的發明和發展，使礦業和工業生產、鐵路和航運都得以機械動力化。
target_text: In the early 18th century, Thomas Newcomen’s massive steam engine was created to drive the water pump in the mine. But the fuel consumption rate of this type of steam engine is high, and it should be used mostly in coal mines. In 1765, the British Watt invented a steam engine with separate condensers, reducing the fuel consumption rate. In 1781, Vat created another steamer to provide reversion power, widening the scope of the steam engine’s applications. The design and development of the steam engine enabled the mining and industrial industries, railways and shipping to become mechanically dynamic.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 蒸汽機幾乎是19世紀唯一的動力源。但蒸汽機及其鍋爐、凝汽器、冷卻水系統等體積龐大、笨重，應用很不方便。19世紀末，電力供應系統和電動機開始發展和推廣。20世紀初，電動機已在工業生產中取代了蒸汽機，成為驅動各種工作機械的基本動力。生產的機械化已離不開電氣化，而電氣化則通過機械化才對生產發揮作用。
target_text: At the end of the 19th century, power supply systems and electric motors began to develop and expand. At the beginning of the 20th century, the motors replaced the steam engine in industrial production, making it an essential force to drive all kinds of work equipment.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 19世紀後期發明的內燃機經過逐年改進，成為輕而小、效率高、易於操縱、並可隨時啟動的原動機。它先被用以驅動沒有電力供應的陸上工作機械，以後又用於移動機械（如：拖拉機、堆高機、重機械）、車輛、飛機和船舶，到20世紀中期開始用於鐵路車輛。蒸汽機在汽輪機和內燃機的排擠下，已不再是重要的動力機械。內燃機和以後發明的燃氣渦輪發動機、噴氣發動機的發展，還是船舶、飛機、航天器等成功發展的基礎技術因素之一。
target_text: The inventors of internal combustion in the late 19th century have evolved year after year and become light, efficient, easy to manipulate, and can be activated at any time. They are first used to drive unelectrically supplied on-shore work machines, and then to move them (e.g. tractors, high-powered machines, heavy machinery), cars, aircraft and ships, starting in the middle of the 20th century with railway vehicles. The steam engine is no longer an important engine under engine and internal combustion.
title: 机械工程

source_text:
機械加工技術的發展
工業革命以前，機械大都是木結構的，由木工用手工製成。金屬（主要是銅、鐵）僅用以製造儀器、鎖、鐘錶、泵和木結構機械上的小型零件。金屬加工主要靠機匠的精工細作，以達到需要的精度。蒸汽機動力裝置的推廣，以及隨之出現的礦山、冶金、車輛、船舶、飛機等大型機械的發展，需要成形加工和切削加工的金屬零件越來越多，越來越大，要求的精度也越來越高。應用的金屬材料從銅、鐵發展到以鋼為主。機械加工包括鉗工、鑽床、車床、銑床、磨床、鋸床、沖床、刨床、模具、鑄造、鍛造、鈑金、焊接及熱處理等技術及其裝備，以及切削加工技術、刀具、量具等，得到迅速發展，保證了各產業發展生產所需的機械裝備的供應。
target_text: Metals (mainly bronze, iron) are used only to make small parts of instruments, locks, clocks, pumps and wooden machinery. Metal processing is mainly based on the precision of mechanics to achieve the required precision. The promotion of steam-powered devices and the accompanying development of large machines such as mines, metallurgy, cars, ships, aircraft, etc. require more and more metal parts to be shaped and slashed, more sophisticated and more demanding.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 簡單的互換性零件和專業分工協作生產，在古代就已出現。在機械工程中，互換性最早體現在亨利·莫茲利於1797年利用其創製的螺紋車床所生產的螺栓和螺帽。同時期，美國工程師伊萊·惠特尼用互換性生產方法生產火槍，顯示了互換性的可行性和優越性。這種生產方法在美國逐漸推廣，形成了所謂“美國生產方法”。
target_text: Simple interchangeable parts and a professional division of labour have been produced in ancient times. In mechanical engineering, the interchange was first produced by Henry Motzley in 1797, using the bolts and bolts that he created. Meanwhile, U.S. engineer Eli Whitney produced fireguns using interchangeable production methods, showing the feasibility and benefits of interchangeability.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 18世紀以前，機械匠師全憑經驗、直覺和手藝進行機械製作，與科學幾乎不發生聯繫。到18世紀－19世紀，在新興的資本主義經濟的促進下，掌握科學知識的人士開始注意生產，而直接進行生產的匠師則開始學習科學文化知識。他們之間的交流和互相啟發取得很大的成果。在這個過程中，逐漸形成一整套圍繞機械工程的基礎理論。
target_text: Before the 18th century, mechanics were almost unconnected with science with experience, intuition and crafts. By the 18th-19th century, with the emergence of a new capitalist economy, science-informed people began to pay attention to production, while direct producers began to learn science-cultural knowledge.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 動力機械最先與當時的先進科學相結合。蒸汽機的發明人T.薩弗里、瓦特應用了物理學家D.帕潘和J.布萊克的理論。在蒸汽機實踐的基礎上，物理學家S.卡諾、W.J.M.蘭金和開爾文建立起一門新的科學──熱力學。內燃機的最重要的理論基礎是法國的A.E.B.de羅沙在1862年創立的，1876年尼古拉斯·奧托(Nikolaus August Otto)應用羅沙的理論，徹底改進了他原來創造的粗陋笨重、噪聲大、熱效率低的內燃機而奠定了內燃機的地位。其他如：汽輪機、燃氣輪機、水輪機等都在理論指導下得到發展，而理論也在實踐中得到改進和提高。
target_text: The engine was first associated with the advanced science of the time. The inventors of the steam engine, T. Saffrey, and Watt, used the theories of the physicists D. Papan and J. Black. On the basis of the steam engine, the physicists S. Cano, W.J.M. Rankin and Kevin built a new science-thermology. The most important theoretical foundation of the internal combustion engine was the French A.E.B. DeRossa, founded in 1862, and Nikolaus August Otto, founded in 1876, used the theory of Rosa, which changed the status of the crude, loud, and inefficient internal combustion engine that he had created.
title: 机械工程

source_text:
現代
在工業革命以前，大多數的工程項目都限於軍事及城市發展。從事軍事方面的工程師負責研制戰爭工具和系統；從事城市發展的工程師則負責建築和地面設施。在十九世紀早期的英國，機械工程師成為新興的行業，負責提供工業用機械和推動機械所需要的動力。在1818年，首個專業土木工程師組織成立，而機械工程師亦相繼於1847年成立組織。
target_text: In the early nineteenth century, in the United Kingdom, mechanics became a new industry, providing the power needed for industrial and propulsion machinery. In 1818, the first specialized civil engineers were set up, and the mechanics were set up in 1847.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 20世紀中、後期，機械加工的主要特點是：不斷提高機床的加工速度和精度，減少對手工技藝的依賴；發展少無切削加工工藝；提高成形加工、切削加工和裝配的機械化和自動化程度。自動化從機械控制的自動化發展到電氣控制的自動化和計算機程序控制的完全自動化，直至無人車間和無人工廠；利用數值控制機床、加工中心、成組技術等，發展柔性加工系統，使中小批量、多品種生產的生產效率提高到近於大量生產的水平；研究和改進難加工的新型金屬和非金屬材料的成形和切削加工技術。
target_text: In the mid-20s and later years, the main features of mechanical processing were: constant improvement of the processing speed and accuracy of machines and reduction of reliance on handicrafts; development of minor processing techniques; improvement of the level of mechanical and self-motivation of plastic processing, cutting and assembly. Automation evolved from automation of mechanical control to complete automation of automation and computing procedures of electrical and gas control until unmanned vehicles and non-manufactured plants; development of flexible processing systems using digital control machines, processing centres, assembly techniques, etc., to increase the productivity of small and medium-sized, multi-manufactured products to near-manufactured levels; and research and adaptation of new forms of metal and non-metal materials that were difficult to process.
title: 机械工程

source_text:
機械工程師學會
世界上建立最早的機械工程學術團體是英國機械工程師學會IMechE，成立於1847年，第一任主席是鐵路機車發明家喬治·史蒂芬生。英國機械工程師學會的建立，標誌著機械工程已確立為一個獨立的學科，機械工程師被社會公認為受尊敬的職稱。
target_text: The first mechanical engineering community in the world was the British Mechanics Association, Imeche, founded in 1847, with the first president being George Stephenson, a railway car innovator. The British Mechanics Society was established to mark mechanical engineering as a stand-alone science, and the mechanics were recognized as respected by society.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 在此之前，從事機械製造、使用和修理的人，被稱為機器匠，社會地位不高。隨著機械製造作為一個獨立的工業部門日益發展，各國機械工程師學會紛紛建立，這在很大程度上反映了機械工業初創階段，企業主和技術人員要求自由開展學術交流、維護共同利益、爭取提高社會地位的共同願望。
target_text: Prior to that, those who made, used, and repaired machinery were called robotics and had a low social status. As machines developed as an independent industrial department developed, national mechanics were created, reflecting to a large extent the early stages of the engineering industry, business owners and technologists demanded a free opening of technology exchanges, the maintenance of common interests, and the pursuit of a common aspiration for social advancement.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 德國工程師學會(VDI)成立於1856年，主要活動範圍是機械工程。它在制訂指導性技術文件方面在全國處於領先地位。美國機械工程師學會(ASME)成立於1880年。它承擔美國機械工業標準的制訂工作。日本機械工程師學會(JSME)成立於1897年。印度機械工程師學會 成立於1920年。中華民國機械工程學會成立於1936年。
target_text: The German Engineering Society (VDI) was founded in 1856, and its main activity was mechanical engineering. It was a national leader in the design of guidance technology documents. The United States Association of Mechanical Engineers (ASME) was established in 1880. It carried out the contractual work of the American Mechanical Industry. The Japan Mechanics Association (JSME) was established in 1897. The Indian Chamber of Mechanical Engineers was established in 1920. The Chinese National Association of Mechanical Engineering was established in 1936.
title: 机械工程

source_text: 在組織建制方面，各國機械工程學會經過不同的探索，一方面建立專業分會或專業委員會，開展專業性學術活動，另方面建立地區分支機構，組織地區性學術活動。這種組織結構逐步發展成為各國機械工程學會共同的特點和傳統。隨著機械化向各工業部門延伸，領域不斷擴大，各國機械工程學會多是歷史悠久、規模最大、會員最多、活動範圍最廣的學術團體。
target_text: In terms of organization, the National Council of Mechanical Engineering has been exploring different ways to create specialized branches or boards of specialists, to develop specialized scientific activities, and to set up regional branches to organize regional sex activities. This structure has gradually evolved into a common feature and tradition in the National Council of Mechanical Engineering. As the system is extended to industry and industry, the territory continues to expand, and national engineering is the oldest, the largest, the largest, the largest, the largest, the largest, and the most extensive.

source_text: 機械工程的工作對象是動態的機械，意即它的工作情況會發生很大的變化。這種變化有時是隨機的而不可預見；實際應用的材料也不完全均勻，可能存有各種缺陷；加工精度有一定的偏差等等。與以靜態結構為工作對象的土木工程相比，機械工程中各種問題更難以用理論精確解決。因此，早期的機械工程只運用簡單的理論概念，結合實踐經驗進行工作。設計計算多依靠經驗公式；為保證安全，都偏於保守。結果，製成的機械笨重而龐大，成本高、生產率低、能量消耗很大。

source_text: 進入20世紀，又出現各種實驗應力分析方法。人們已能用實驗方法測出模型和實物上各部位的應力，在發現應力過高過低時，便可能作出必要的調整。20世紀後半葉，人們開始應用有限元法和電子計算機的迅速可靠的數值計算，對複雜的機械及其零件、構件進行力、力矩、力偶、應力、應變等的分析和計算。對於掌握有充分的實踐或實驗資料的機械或其元件，已經可以運用統計技術，按照要求的可靠度科學地進行機械設計，或者按機械的實際情況（實際的質量、實際的使用條件等）科學地判斷其可靠度和壽命。但在許多機械工程工作中，仍還應用一些經驗方法、經驗公式和經驗係數等，不過其中的科學成分在不斷增加，經驗成分則不斷減少。

source_text: 便携式网络图形（，PNG）是一种支持无损压缩的位图图形格式，支持索引、灰度、RGB三种颜色方案以及Alpha通道等特性。PNG的开发目标是改善并取代GIF作为适合网络传输的格式而不需专利许可，所以受广泛应用于互联网及其他方面上。PNG另一个非正式的名称来源为递归缩写：“PNG is Not GIF”。PNG的官方念法是“平”（英語IPA：；「平」是以國語發音），但是多数人是当成三个英文字母分开读。
target_text: Portable Network Graphics (PNG) is a graphic format that supports non-destructive compression, supports indexing, greyscale, RGB three colour options, and Alpha Channel features. PNG aims to improve and replace GIF as a suitable format for network transmission without patent permission, and is widely used on the Internet and elsewhere. Another informal PNG name source is the indentation: "PNG is not GIF". source_text:
特性

最高支持24位真彩色图像以及8位灰度图像。

支持图像亮度的Gamma校准信息。
支持存储附加文本信息，以保留图像名称、作者、版权、创作时间、注释等信息。

target_text: Features Support 256 colour palette technology to produce small volume files 24 true colour images and 8 grey-scale images. Support transparent/semi-transparent features of the Alpha channel. Support image brightness Gamma calibration information. Support the storage of additional text information to preserve image names, authors, copyrights, creation times, notes, etc. Support lossless compressions. Closer displays and flow readings are suitable for displaying the full picture after quick preview effects in network transmissions. Use CRC to prevent errors. The latest PNG standards allow multiple images to be stored in one file.
title: PNG

source_text:
儲存型別
PNG圖片主要由三種型別儲存
PNG 8: 圖片使用8 bits來儲存，可以用2的8次方大小個種類顏色來儲存一張黑白的圖片。也就是說PNG 8能儲存256种顏色，因為顏色少，檔案體積也非常小，一張圖片如果顏色簡單，將它設定成PNG 8的圖片是非常省空間合適的。
PNG 24: 圖片使用24bits來儲存，用三個8bits分別去表示 R（紅）、G（綠）、B（藍）三個通道(Channel)的數值。可以表達256乘以256乘以256=16777216種顏色的圖片，色彩豐富度更高，但相對的所佔用的空間也就更大了。
PNG 32: 圖片使用32bits來儲存，相當於PNG 24 加上 8bits的透明顏色通道，總共有R（紅）、G（綠）、B（藍）、A（透明）四個通道。圖片能表示的色彩跟PNG 24一樣多，並且還支援256種透明度，能讓圖片色彩更加豐富。
target_text: The PNG image is mainly stored in three different types of PNG 8: PNG 24: Images are stored in 24 bits, using three 8bits to separate R (red), G (green), B (blue) three channels (channel) to store a black and white image. This means that PNG 8 saves 256 colours because of its low colour and the size of the file is very small, and if the colour is simple, one image that sets it as PNG 8 is more colourful, but more space is available for the purpose. PNG 24: Pictures are stored in 24 bits, using three 8bits to separate R (red), G (green), B (blue) and the value of the three Channels (channel).
title: PNG

source_text:
壓縮方式
PNG圖片的壓縮主要分有兩個階段：
預解析（）
壓縮（）
由於壓縮方式主要由以上兩個階段構成，優化方向也對應著兩個階段。針對預解析階段做優化主要的選擇是去優化差分編碼器，讓編碼出的結果能出現盡可能多的零值或是相同的值。針對壓縮階段的優化則是找出更好的Deflate算法，以獲得更高的壓縮率。
target_text: The compression of PNG images is divided into two main stages: Parse () Compression () is made mainly of the above two stages, and the orientation is superior to the other two. The main option for refining the parse phase is to de-optimize the differential encoder so that the coding results can be as many zeros as possible or the same values. The advantage for parse segments is to find a better Deflate algorithm to achieve a higher compression rate.
title: PNG

source_text:
預解析
在這階段中，圖片會做先做些預處理，以利後續壓縮。 每次會處理圖片中某一行（）的數據，首先經過濾波器()來處理這些數據，每個像素點（）在不同通道中（ ex:RGB）的數值都會經過濾波器運算，然就得出的結果會交由差分處理器來重新計算通道中的數值。 差分處理器會將目前這個像素點上通道中的數值和之前或之上（EX：左邊上方）像素點做對比，根據差異進行差分編碼。若是相鄰的像素點在通道上的數值非常接近，就會得出很多1,0,-1這種很小的值。 整個prediction階段要做的事就是找到適合的差分編碼器，使得最終差分編碼的結果盡可能的都是重複很小或是零的值，這一階段的結果會影響到Compression階段中能實現的壓縮率。
target_text: Each time the data in a line (EX: Top Left) of the image is processed by filtering () to process the data, each pixel point (ex:RGB) will be measured by filters in different channels (ex:RGB) and the results will be recalculated by a differential processor. The difference processor will then compare the values in the current pixel channel with the first or the previous or upper (EX: Top Left) pixel point, with the differentials.
title: PNG

source_text:
壓縮
經過預解析階段之後，將編碼出的結果輸出給Deflate（是一種無損數據壓縮算法，同時使用了LZ77和Huffman Coding方法），由其執行真正的壓縮操作，在此階段會通過LZ77和Huffman Coding方法來對圖像進行編碼，最後將處理後的圖片結果保存。最終的壓縮率主要受到兩方面的影響:
預解析階段（）的處理結果：對於RGB通道數值相近的像素區域，也就是編碼結果有很多零值的區域，在壓縮階段得當的壓縮率會特別高，若是相鄰區域的顏色差異大，則壓縮效果就會大打折扣。
Deflate 每一行的匹配情形：在整個壓縮處理過程中都是以行（）為單位來進行處理。而在處裡數據的過程中，處裡的符號數被限制在3－258之間，換言之，最高的壓縮率可以達到1032:1，當出現的符號數小於3時，就可能會出現無法匹配的情況。因此圖片的寬度也會是一個可能影響最終壓縮效果的因素之一。
target_text: After a preconstructing phase, the result of the encoding is delivered to Deflate (a lossless data compression algorithm using LZ77 and Huffman Coding methods) for real compression, where the image is coded through LZ77 and Huffman Coding methods, and the result of the post-processing image is saved. The end-of-life compression rate is mainly affected by two aspects: The treatment of the predisposition phase: the pixmix area close to the value of the RGB channel, i.e., the area where the code results are many zero, is particularly high in the compression phase, and, if the color difference between the adjacent area is large, the impact of the compression will be significantly reduced.
title: PNG

source_text:
壓縮方案
PNG壓縮提供兩種壓縮方案
無損壓縮（）：數據經過壓縮之後，信息不受損失，能夠完全還原至壓縮前的模樣，通常此種壓縮方案的壓縮率有一定的限制。
有損壓縮（）：數據經過壓縮之後，信息數據會和原始數據不同，但僅限於些微差距，通常此種壓縮方案能提供非常高的壓縮率。
target_text: The compression program PNG provides two types of compression options without loss (: once the data have been compressed, the information is intact and can be fully restored to the pre-compression pattern, usually with a certain limit on the compression rate. After the compression, the information data will be different from the original data, but limited to a few minor differences, which usually provide a very high compression rate.
title: PNG

source_text:
有損壓縮方案
由於PNG原本的無損壓縮方案在壓縮率上有一定的限制，有些開源者無法接受既有的壓縮率，因此基於PNG原本的壓縮方式開發新的有損壓縮方案，在工程上與得到了一定的應用。例如 TinyPNG,根據官方公開的信息，其利用了Quantization的技術來實現提高壓縮率，通過合併相似的顏色將24位元的PNG圖片壓縮成更小的8位元圖片。其中更著名的PNG有損壓縮算法pngquant，在Github上有完整的開源代碼，同樣也是使用了Vector Quantization來減少圖片中顏色的種類，在矢量化過程中將像素點根據顏色相似程度進行分組，隨後組內的像素統計出一個中心顏色並將所有組內像素都替代為此中心顏色。矢量化會造成圖片失真，如何在壓縮率與圖片質量之間取得一個恰到好處的平衡點是個值得優化的方向。
target_text: For example, TinyPNG, which, according to official public information, uses the techniques of Quantization to achieve a real increase in the compression rate by collating 24-bit PNG images to a smaller eight-bit image with similar colours, uses the more famous PNG to develop a new corrosive compressor based on the original compression method and has a complete open source code on Github, and uses Vector Quantization to reduce the colours in the image, and uses a similar colouring of 24-bit PNG images to reduce them to a smaller eight-bit image. The more famous PNG to replace the central colour with a complete open source code on the Github, using Vector Quantization to reduce the colours in the image.

source_text:
与GIF相比
一般情况下将静态GIF图像无损转换为PNG后可以压缩率会略为提高（前提是同样采用8位索引模式）。
PNG可提供更大颜色深度的支持，包括24位（8位3通道）和48位（16位3通道）真彩色。加入Alpha通道后可进一步支持每像素64位的表示。
超过8位色深的PNG图像转换为GIF时，图像质量会由于分色（颜色数减少）而下降。
GIF原生支持动态图像，PNG只能通过非标准实现，在PNG的基础上另有发展出支持动画的APNG和MNG格式，但目前普及度不高。
PNG在IE6等旧代浏览器上的支持较差。
target_text: Compared to the GIF, a static GIF image can be converted without loss to PNG with a slightly higher compression rate (as long as the 8-digit index model is also used). PNG can provide greater colour depth support, including 24-bit (8-bit) and 48-bit (16-digit) colorful colour. Adding to the Alpha Channel will further support the representation of 64-digit pixels. When a PNG image of more than 8-bit depth is converted to GIF, image quality will decline as a result of colouring (reduced colours).
title: PNG

source_text:
与JPEG相比
JPEG可以对照片（或类似）图像生成更小的文件，这是由于JPEG采用了一种针对照片图像的特定有损编码方法，这种编码适用于低对比，图像颜色过渡平滑，雜訊多，且结构不规则的情况下。如果在这种情况下用PNG代替JPEG，文件尺寸增大很多，而图像质量的提高有限。相应的，如果保存文本，线条或类似的边缘清晰，有大块相同颜色区域的图像，PNG格式的压缩效果就要比JPEG好很多，并且不会出现JPEG那样的高对比度区域的图像失真。如果图像既有清晰边缘，又有照片图像的特点，就需要在这两种格式之间权衡一下了。JPEG不支持透明度。
target_text: JPEG can generate smaller files for photographs (or similar) as compared to JPEG, because JPEG uses a specific disabling coding method for photo images, which applies to low contrasts, image colour transitions smooth, multi-message and irregular structures. If PNG is used in this case to replace JPEG, the file size is much larger and the quality of the image is limited. Correspondingly, if the text is preserved, the edge of the line or similar is clear, and there is an image of a large area of the same colour, the compression effect of the PNG format is much better than JPEG, and there is no distortion of the image in a high contrast area such as JPEG. If the image has a clear edge and the characteristics of the photo image, it needs to be weighed between the two formats. JPEG does not support transparency.
title: PNG

source_text: 由于JPEG是有损压缩，会产生迭代失真，在重复压缩和解码的过程中会不断丢失信息使图像质量下降。由于PNG是无损的，保存将要编辑的图像来说更加合适。虽然PNG压缩照片图像也有效，但有专门针对照片图像设计的无损压缩格式，例如无损JPEG2000和DNG。总的来说这些格式都不能做到适用所有图像。对于将要发布的图像可以保存成JPEG，用JPEG编码一次不会造成明显的图像失真。
target_text: While PNG compressed photo images are also valid, there are non-destructive compressed formats designed specifically for photo images, such as JPEG 2000 and DNG. In general, none of these formats can be applied to all images. For images to be released to JPEG, there is no apparent loss of image.
title: PNG

source_text:
与JPEG-LS相比
是一个“几乎”无损压缩格式，相对于上面提到的有损JPEG压缩，它的知名度不高。它可以直接和PNG相比较，使用一组标准的测试图像。在Waterloo Repertoire ColorSet（一组标准测试图像）下，JPEG-LS通常表现要比PNG好10%-15%，但其中有一些图像PNG表现明显更好一些，大约50%-75%。所以，如果这两种格式都支持而且对图像文件大小很敏感的话，可以用这两种格式都试试，和图像数据本身有比较大关系。
target_text: Compared to JPEG-LS, it is a “nearly” non-destructive compression format, which is less visible than the above-mentioned harming JPEG compression. It can be directly compared to PNG, using a set of standard test images. Under Waterloo Reftoire ColorSet (a set of standard test images), JPEG-LS usually behaves 10-15% better than PNG, but some of the images PNG perform significantly better, about 50-75%. So, if both formats support and are sensitive to the size of the image file, they can be tested in both formats, which are more relevant to the image data itself.
title: PNG

source_text:
与TIFF相比
TIFF是一个相当多方案结合的格式。它广泛用作专业图像编辑软件之间图像交换的中间格式，因此它不断支援更多應用程式所需的功能，而对應用程式不关心的图像操作部分支援不多。这也意味着许多應用程式只能识别TIFF的一个子集，而产生更多的潜在混淆之处。
target_text: TIFF is a rather multi-programmed format compared to TIFF. It is widely used as an intermediate format for image exchange between professional image editing software, so it continues to support the functionality needed for more applications, with little support for image operations that the application does not care about. It also means that many applications can only identify one subset of TIFF and create more potential confusion.
title: PNG

source_text: 早期的浏览器不支援PNG图像；JPEG和GIF是主流图像格式。由于GIF的颜色深度限制，网页中的有颜色过渡的图像都是使用JPEG。不管怎样，JPEG压缩都会导致图像的轻微模糊。而PNG可以做到在相应颜色深度下的尽可能精确，同时保持图像文件不大。PNG已经渐渐成为一种对于小的梯度图像的较好的选择，众多浏览器都已经对PNG有了很好的支援。
target_text: Early browsers do not support PNG images; JPEG and GIF are mainstream image formats. Because of the GIF's colour depth limitations, the colour transition images on the web pages use JPEG. In any case, JPEG compression can lead to a slight blurring of the image. The PNG can be as accurate as possible at the appropriate colour depth while keeping the image file low. The PNG has gradually become a better choice for small gradient images, and many browsers are already well supported by PNG.
title: PNG

source_text: 沙雕是以沙做為材料的一種雕塑創作，通常在沙灘進行。沙雕起源于美国，20世纪初在佛罗里达州和加利福尼亚州海岸举行了各种沙雕竞赛和活动，艺术家从中学习了各种技巧和经验，并把它发展成为巨型雕塑。因和“傻屌”谐音，该词汇在中文互联网也被赋予了滑稽、搞笑和愚蠢的含义。

source_text: FC遊戲機，是任天堂生产、发行和销售的8位元第三世代家用游戏机日本版，官方名称为，俗稱「紅白機」，1983年7月15日在日本推出；欧美版名称为，俗稱「灰機」，1985年10月18日在美國推出。歐美版主機外型和使用的遊戲盒帶（卡匣），與日本版的紅白機完全不同。红白机是当时最畅销的游戏机，全球累计销量超过了6100万台。FC遊戲机出现對电子游戏产生了十分深远的影响，让美国电子游戏界从1983年的崩溃中恢复过来，也奠定了任天堂在当今游戏界的地位。其后续机种为1990年推出的超级任天堂。
target_text: The FC machine, the Japanese version of the 8-bit third-generation home game that was produced, distributed and sold in Nintendo, was officially known as the "Red White Machine", which was launched in Japan on 15 July 1983; and the American-American version, known as the "Gree Machine", which was launched in the United States on 18 October 1985. The European and American versions of the game box (Cat) are quite different from the Japanese version of the red and white machine. The red and white machine was the best-selling player at the time, with a cumulative global sales of more than 61 million. The emergence of the FC game has had a very profound impact on electronic games, restoring the American electronic game community from its collapse in 1983, and has also established the status of heaven in today's game world.
title: 红白机

target_text: In 1981, Nintendo planned to develop a card-based game machine, developed by the then Minister of Nintendo's Second Department, the code-named “GameCom”, which used 16 more advanced CPUs and accessories, such as keyboards and soft drives, but was rejected by the Yamada. source_text: 1983年7月15日，FC遊戲机在日本以14800日圓的价格发售，初期由于PPU设计问题导致主机在游玩部份游戏时发生死机情况，任天堂召回已经发售的主机并更换新的主板。此后主机人气飙升，并在1984年年底成为日本最畅销的游戏机。不久，任天堂总裁山内溥决定让Hudson Soft、南梦宫、太東、卡普空、Jaleco和科樂美六家软體开发商加入开发FC遊戲，獲当时业界称为“六大遊戲軟體商”。
target_text: On July 15, 1983, the FC machine was sold in Japan at 14,800 yen. Initially, because of PPU design problems, the mainframe was killed while playing part of the game, Nintendo recalled the host that had been released and replaced the new board. Since then, the host has soared and became Japan’s best-selling player at the end of 1984. Soon after Nintendo’s CEO, Hudson Soft, South Dream Palace, Taidong, Capo, Jaleco and Colomy, decided to include six software developers in the development of the FC game, known at the time as the Six Games.

source_text: 1985年，在歐美推出歐美版主機Nintendo Entertainment System，簡稱NES，俗稱灰機。主機外型和使用的盒帶（卡匣），與日本版的紅白機完全不同：NES外觀顏色以灰色為主，使用較大型的盒帶，插入盒帶的方式，採類似VHS錄影機的橫向水平推入式，而非紅白機的垂直插入式。此機曾長期是香港唯一的行貨任天堂主機。
target_text: In 1985, the U.S.-American host, Nintendo Enterprise System, was launched in Europe and America, popularly known as the NES, and popularly known as the Grey Machine. The host's outdoors and the boxes used (carats) are completely different from the Japanese version of the Red and White Machine: NES colours are mainly grey, use larger bands, insert boxes in a way that is similar to the horizontal thrust of VHS cameras, rather than the vertical insertion of red and white machines.

source_text: 2003年7月15日，FC遊戲机發售二十週年，任天堂宣佈同年9月25日，FC遊戲机正式停產。至此，FC/NES遊戲机於全世界已累計销售6000万部以上。如再加上其他廠商所仿製的未授權產品，其數量當不僅於此。至今台灣、香港、泰國、中國大陸甚至日本等地，仍然在製造FC遊戲机規格的相容品，或者是停產後持續的二手市場交易。
target_text: On July 15, 2003, in the 20th anniversary of the launch of the FC machine, Nintendo announced that on September 25th of the same year, the FC machine was officially shut down. As a result, the FC/NES machine has accumulated more than 60 million sales worldwide. This is more than the amount of unlicensed products produced by other manufacturers.
title: 红白机

source_text: 2007年11月，任天堂宣布不再維修已有24年歷史的FC遊戲机，正式終結了這部陪伴不少機迷成長的舊世代遊戲機的時代。結構FC遊戲机使用一顆理光製造的8位元2A03 NMOS处理器（基于6502中央處理器，但是缺乏BCD模式），PAL制式機型運行頻率為1.773447MHz，NTSC制式機型運行頻率為1.7897725MHz，主記憶體和顯示記憶體為2KB。
target_text: In November 2007, Nintendo announced that the 24-year-old FC machine would no longer be maintained, officially ending the age of the old game, which was accompanied by a number of fans. The FC machine uses an 8-bit 2A03 NMOS processor (based on a 6502 central processor, but lacks a BCD model) with a PAL-type running frequency of 1.773447 MHz and a NTSC-style operation frequency of 1.7897725 MHz, with a master memory and a memory display of 2KB.
title: 红白机

source_text: FC遊戲机使用理光開發的圖像控制器（PPU），有 2KB 的視訊記憶體，調色盤可顯示 48 色及 5 個灰階。一個畫面可顯示 64 個角色（sprites），角色格式為 8x8 或 8x16 個像素，一條掃描線最多顯示 8 個角色，雖然可以通過交替繪製角色超過此限制，但是會造成角色閃爍。背景僅能顯示一個捲軸，畫面解析度為 256x240 ，但因為 NTSC 系統的限制，不能顯示頂部及底部的 8 條掃描線，所以解析度剩下 256x224。
target_text: The FC game machine uses a photo-driven image controller (PPU) with a 2KB visual memory that displays 48 colours and 5 greyscales. A screen displays 64 characters (prites) in a role format of 8x8 or 8x16 pixels, and a scan line displays up to 8 characters, which can be overstretched by alternating drawing roles, but can cause a role to flash. Background shows only one scroll with a graphic resolution of 256x240, but only 256x224 because the NTSC system limits the top and bottom of the system, which does not show 8 scans.
title: 红白机

source_text: 从体系结构上来说，FC遊戲机有一个伪声音处理器（pseudo-Audiom Processing Unit，pAPU），在实际硬件中，这个处理器是集成在2A03 NMOS处理器中的。pAPU内置了2个几乎一样（nearly-identical）的矩形波通道、1个三角波通道、1个噪声通道和1个DPCM采样通道（預測編碼調製方式）。其中3個模擬聲道用於演奏樂音，1個雜音聲道表現特殊聲效（爆炸聲、槍炮聲等），DPCM通道则可以用来表現連續的背景音。
target_text: In terms of structure, the FC games have a pseudo-Audiom Processing Unit, pAPU, which is integrated in the actual hardware into 2A03 NMOS processors. The pAPU has two rectangular channels, a triangular channel, a noise channel and a DPCM sampling channel (predicting the mode of production). Three of the emulations are for music, one special sound (explosive sound, gunshot sound, etc.), and the DPCM channel can be used to perform a continuous background.
title: 红白机

香港
1986年底，當時新成立不久的西門玩具有限公司（Simon & Toys Company Limited）引入歐美版NES遊戲機在香港發售，以「任天堂家庭電腦遊戲機」命名，俗稱「灰機」。灰機曾長期是香港唯一的行貨任天堂家用遊戲機，提供和香港電視廣播制式一致的PAL制式訊號輸出，遊戲畫質良好。而日本版FC遊戲机，即俗稱「紅白機」，則未有代理引入香港，僅有日本水貨，因此僅有日本電視廣播制式的NTSC制式訊號輸出，與香港的PAL制式不一致。當時俗稱「國際線路」的多制式電視機尚未流行，基本上所有香港市面的電視機，即使是日本品牌，也只能接收PAL制式訊號。因此水貨商通常會私下改裝紅白機成PAL制式輸出，使之能以香港市面的PAL制式電視機遊玩，但質素甚差，畫面暗淡糢糊，且有斜紋、雜音等雜訊，且因頻率不同（香港PAL制式為50Hz，日本水貨紅白機即使改裝成PAL制式，仍為60Hz），個別電視機無法適應，就會出現畫面高速上下跳動，無法遊玩。
target_text: At the end of 1986, the soon-to-be-established Simon & Toys Company Limited introduced the European American version of the NES game machine in Hong Kong, known as the Nintendo Family Computer Game, known as the Grey Machine. The ash machine, which used to be Hong Kong’s only liner, used to be Hong Kong’s one-size-fits-all family gamer, provided a PAL signal that was produced in harmony with Hong Kong’s television broadcaster. The Japanese version of the FC game, commonly known as the “Red White Machine”, was not introduced in Hong Kong, but only Japanese water cargo, so that the NTSC, which is only broadcast on Japanese television, was produced in a way that is not consistent with Hong Kong’s PAL style.
title: 红白机

source_text: 灰機和紅白機使用的遊戲盒帶不同，灰機採用大型盒帶，俗稱「大帶」；紅白機採用小型盒帶，俗稱「細帶」。同一遊戲，「大帶」版本售價較貴，且「大帶」遊戲數量較少。故市面上出現一些接駁器配件（非官方配件），能把「細帶」「喬裝」成「大帶」，放到灰機遊玩，但有小部份遊戲不支援此方法。同時此舉使「金手指」導電觸片接觸位（connecting finger）增加，由只有「大帶」> 主機的一個接觸位，變成「細帶」> 接駁器 > 主機的兩個接觸位，容易增加故障機會。另，FC磁碟機由於只供日本國內市場（但香港市面同樣有日本水貨），設計上只考慮接駁紅白機，難以接駁灰機。
target_text: The ash machine and the red white machine use a different game box, using a large band, commonly known as the "big belt" ; the red machine uses a small band, commonly known as the "light belt". The same game, the "big belt" version of which is more expensive and the number of "largeband" games is smaller. The market has a number of appliances (non-official parts) that make it easier to use the "tailed" as a "big belt" and put it on the greyboard, but there are small games that do not support this method.

source_text: 因此，當時任天堂家用遊戲機的香港玩家，可謂兩難：如選擇香港行貨的灰機，則面對「大帶」售價較貴、遊戲數量較少、使用接駁器以「細帶」「喬裝」「大帶」則較易故障，且有小部份遊戲不支援，難以接駁FC磁碟機等問題，但遊戲畫質良好；如選擇日本水貨的紅白機，則優缺點相反，「細帶」售價較便宜、遊戲數量較多、易於接駁FC磁碟機，但遊戲畫質甚差，甚至可能有畫面高速上下跳動問題。
target_text: As a result, Hong Kong players who used the Nintendo home games at the time were in a difficult position: when they chose the ash machine for the goods in Hong Kong, they were faced with a more expensive sale, fewer games, the use of the shutter as a “single” and the “strap” as a “single” and a small part of the games were not supported to answer problems such as the FC drives, but the games were of good quality; when they chose the red and white machine for the goods in Japan, the opposite was true, the “strap” was cheaper, the number of games was more numerous, the FC was easier to access, but the games were of poor quality and might even have high-speed jump problems.

source_text: 1990年中，西門玩具有限公司才推出香港行貨版紅白機及FC磁碟機，以「任天堂紅白機第二代」及「任天堂磁碟機第二代」命名，提供畫質良好的PAL制式訊號輸出。惜為時已晚，當時紅白机已接近淘汰。不足半年後，1990年11月，任天堂已推出紅白機後繼機種：第四世代的超級任天堂。

Less than six months later, in November 1990, Nintendo had launched the Red White follow-up species: the fourth generation's Super Nintendo.

source_text: 同時，正版遊戲盒帶較昂貴，約一、二百多港元，促使盜版盒帶的市場。有商人推出改裝磁碟機的配件（內置轉換器和記憶體），把僅有盒帶，沒有正式的磁碟版本的遊戲（絕大部份盒帶遊戲並沒有正式的磁碟版本），複製數據至磁碟中，變成以磁碟遊玩。一張1M bit的遊戲需要一片磁碟，一款遊戲需要一至六張磁碟。該配件本身不能將盒帶數據轉換到磁碟，商人先以專用器材將盒帶數據轉換到磁碟，再將磁碟運到各零售店銷售，零售店再將磁碟複製，這些都屬盜版行為。顧客可以數港元購買一張已含有遊戲的磁碟（一張並非代表一款遊戲），在裝有改裝磁碟機上遊玩。以磁碟玩遊戲較盒帶的便宜很多，因而帶動紅白機的流行。當時香港盜版紅白機遊戲佔有率較正版的大。這是紅白機在香港的市場佔有率壓倒世嘉的其中一個原因。
target_text: At the same time, the original game box is expensive, amounting to about HK$1,200. A 1M bit game requires a disk, and a game requires between one and six disks. The piece itself cannot be converted to a disk, and the dealer first uses a special device to convert the tape into a disk, then sells the disk in retail stores, and then reproduces the disk in retail stores, which are stolen and turned into a disk.

source_text: Pascal，像今天的许多编程语言一样（但是不像C家族的绝大多数语言），允许任意层次的嵌套过程定义，也允许过程和函数内部的绝大多数种类的定义和声明。这使得一个非常简单和一致的语法，能让一个完整的program与一个单独的procedure或function语法上近似相同（当然除了关键字本身外）。
target_text: Pascal, like many programming languages today (but unlike the majority language of the C family), allows for a definition of the embedded process at any level, as well as definitions and declarations of the vast majority of categories within processes and functions. This makes a very simple and consistent syntax that makes a complete program almost identical to a separate procedure or function syntax (except, of course, the keyword itself).
title: Pascal語言

source_text:
实现
第一个Pascal编译器是在Zurich为CDC 6000系列大型计算机家族设计的。维尔特报道，在1969年第一次使用Fortran实现的尝试没有成功，由于Fortran不足以表达复杂的数据结构。第二次尝试以Pascal语言本身来制定，并在1970年代中期实施。由于许多Pascal编译器已类似地自托管，即编译器本身是以Pascal编写的，因此在新特性加入语言或编译器移植到一个新环境时编译器通常能重编译其本身。用C编写的GNU Pascal编译器是一个显著的例外。
target_text: The first Pascal compiler was designed in Zurich for the large computer family of the CDC 6000 series. Wilt reported that the first attempt to use Fortran in 1969 was unsuccessful, as Fortran was not sufficient to express a complex data structure. The second attempt was made in Pascal itself and was implemented in the mid-1970s. Since many Pascal compilers were similarly hosted, i.e., the compilers themselves were prepared in Pascal, the compilers were usually able to redecorate themselves when new features were added to the language or the compilers were transplanted into a new environment.
title: Pascal語言

source_text: 为了迅速地传播该语言，一个编译器“移植工具包”在Zurich产生，包括一个为“虚拟”堆栈机（即引导本身合理有效解释的代码）生成代码的编译器，一个解释这些代码的解释器——Pascal-P系统。虽然SC（堆栈计算机）代码的主要意图是在至少一个系统上编译成真实的机器代码，著名的UCSD实现使用它创建了解释性UCSD p-System。P-系统编译器被称作P1-P4，P1是来自于Zurich的第一个版本，P4是最后一个。
target_text: In order to spread the language quickly, a compiler, the Transplant Toolkit, was produced in Zurich, including a compiler that generates codes for the “virtual” stacker (i.e., guides to the code itself that is reasonably well explained), and an interpreter that interprets these codes, Pascal-P. Although the SC (store computer) code is primarily intended to be translated into the real machine code on at least one system, the famous UCSD has used it to create an explanatory UCSD p-System. P-System compiler is called P1-P4, P1 is the first version from Zurich and P4 is the last.
title: Pascal語言

source_text: P4编译器/解释器仍然可以在兼容最初Pascal的系统上运行和编译。然而，它本身只是Pascal语言的一个子集。接受全部Pascal语言和包含ISO 7185兼容性的一个P4版本创建了，称作P5编译器，它在源形式上可用。一个为IBM System/370大型计算机产生本地二机制代码的P4编译器版本由澳大利亚原子能委员会发布；缩写该委员会的名称后，它被称作“AAEC Pascal编译器”。从1975年6月起，一个包含编译器源代码和二机制代码，以及PDP-10主机运行时库文件的P4版本可以从这里下载。
target_text: P4 compiler/interpreter can still run and compile on a system compatible with the original Pascal. However, it is itself a subset of Pascal language. The acceptance of all Pascal languages and a P4 version containing ISO 7185 compatibility was created, known as the P5 compiler, which is available in source form. A P4 compiler for IBM System 370 large computers producing the local two-mechanical code was released by the Australian Atomic Energy Commission; it is called the “AAAEC Pascal compiler” after the initialization of the Commission. Since June 1975, a P4 version containing the compiler source code and the two-mechanical code, as well as the P4 version of the library document while the PDP-10 mainframe is running, can be downloaded from here.
title: Pascal語言

source_text: IP Pascal是一个使用Micropolis DOS的Pascal编程语言的实现，但是被迅速地移植到运行于Z80上的CP/M。在1994年它被移植动80386类型机器上，今天作为Windows/XP和Linux实现存在。在2008年，该系统达到一个新层次，该结果语言称作“Pascaline”（Pascal的计算器之后）。它包括对象，命名空间控制，动态数组和许多其它扩展，以及与C有相同功能和类型保护的通用特性。它仅是也兼容最初Pascal实现（作为ISO 7185的标准）的这样一个实现。
target_text: IP Pascal is the realization of a Pascal programming language using Micropolis DOS, but it was quickly transplanted to CP/M operating on Z80. In 1994, it was transplanted to 80386-type machines, and today it exists as Windows/XP and Linux. In 2008, the system reached a new level, the result being called “Pascaline” (after Pascal's calculator). It includes objects, naming spatial control, dynamic arrays and many other extensions, as well as common features with C that are protected by the same function and type. It is merely compatible with the original Pascal realization (as ISO 7185).
title: Pascal語言

source_text: 然而，Borland后来决定需要更多精细的面向对象特性，并在Delphi里使用Apple提议的Object Pascal草图标准作为基础重新开始。（该Apple草图仍然不是一个正式的标准。）Delphi编程语言的第一版相应地命名为Object Pascal。与老的OOP扩展相比较，主要的增加是基于参考对象模型，虚拟构建器和析构器，以及属性。几个其它编译器也实现了该方言。
target_text: Borland, however, later decided that more fine object-oriented features were needed, and started again in Delphi using the Apple-proposed Object Pascal sketch standard as a basis. (The Apple sketch is still not a formal standard.) The first version of the Delphi programming language is accordingly named Object Pascal. The main increase compared to the old OOP extension is based on reference object models, virtual builders and synthesitors, and attributes. Several other compilers also achieved the dialect.
title: Pascal語言

source_text: 每种类型（除了boolean）允许的值的范围是定义实现的。为一些数据转换提供了函数。为了将real转换成integer，下面的捨入函数可用：使用四捨五入取整的round和roundto（非标准）；分别向上和向下捨入的ceil和floor；向零舍入的trunc。注意在str和floattostr函数（非标准）中转换成十进制的输出，和write命令不使用银行家捨入。
target_text: The range of values allowed for each type (except boolean) is defined as being achieved. Some data conversion functions are provided. To convert real to integer, the following round-and-round functions are available: round and roundto (non-standard) round with rounding; ceil and floor, respectively, up and down; trunc, down to zero. Note that output (non-standard) in the Str and floatstar functions is converted to decimal, and the write command does not use bankers.

source_text:
File类型
正如上面的例子所示，Pascal的文件是组件序列。每个文件有一个用f^表示的缓冲变量。过程get（读）和put（写）移动到缓冲变量的下一个元素。引进了读，使得read(f, x)与x:=f^; get(f);相同。引进了写，使得write(f, x)与f^ := x; put(f);相同。打印的文字作为字符文件预定义了。当缓冲变量能用于检查下一个字符可用（读一个整数前检查一个数字）时，这个概念导致了早期实现的交互程序的严重问题，但是后来用“lazy I/O”概念解决了。
target_text: As the examples above show, Pascal's files are component sequences. Each file has a buffer variable expressed in fd. The processget (reading) and put (writing) moves to the next element of the buffer variable. Reads have been introduced so thatread (f, x) and x:=f; get (f); same. Writes have been introduced so that write (f, x) and f:=x; put (f); same. Printed text is predefined as a character file. When the buffer variable is used to check that the next character is available (checking a number before reading an integer), the concept leads to serious problems with the interactive process that was achieved at an early stage, but is later resolved with the concept of “lazy I/O”.
title: Pascal語言

source_text: 与许多以指针为特性的语言不同，Pascal只允许指针引用匿名的动态创建的变量，不允许引用标准的静态或本地变量。另外，指针是类型绑定的，即字符指针与整数指针是类型不兼容的。该净效果是Pascal指针是“安全的”，远离其它指针实现固有的类型安全问题。
target_text: Unlike many languages characterized by pointing, Pascal only allows finger references to dynamically created variables that are anonymous, and not to static or local variables of standard. In addition, the finger is type-bound, i.e. the character pointer is incompatible with the integer pointer. The net effect is that the Pascal pointer is “safe”, far from the type of safety inherent in the other pointer.
title: Pascal語言

source_text:
分号作为语句分割符
Pascal从ALGOL语言里吸纳了许多语言语法特性，包括使用分号作为语句分割符。这与其它诸如PL/I、C等的语言是不同的。它们使用分号作为语句终止符。正如上述例子演示的，记录类型声明、块或case语句的end关键字之前，repeat语句的until关键字之前，if语句的else关键字之前，不需要分号。
target_text: As a statement splitr, Pascal incorporates many linguistic syntax features from the ALGOL language, including the use of semicolons as statement splits. This is different from other languages such as PL/I, C. They use semicolons as statement terminations. As shown in the above-mentioned examples, before recording the end key of a type statement, block or case statement, before the unil key of the repeat statement, before the else key of the statement is required.
title: Pascal語言

source_text: ISO 7185被说成是对《用户手册和报告（Jensen和维尔特）》详述的维尔特的1974年语言的澄清，但是引人注意的是增加了作为标准级别1的“Conformant Array Parameters”，级别0是没有Conformant Array的数组。该增加是在C. A. R. Hoare的请求下，得到了维尔特赞同。该变动的原因是Hoare想创建数学算法库（NAG）的一个Pascal版本，该库最初用FORTRAN编写，发现如果没有允许变长数组参数的扩展就无法实现该库。出于同样的考虑，ISO 7185包含了指定过程和函数参数的参数类型的工具。
target_text: ISO 7185 was described as a clarification of the 1974 Wilt language as detailed in the User Manual and Report (Jensen and Vert), but it was interesting to note that the “Conformant Array Parameters” as standard level 1 had been added to the “Conformant Array Parameters” level 0, which did not have a array of Conformant Array. The increase was endorsed by Wilt at the request of C.A.R. Hoare. source_text: 家用游戏机（），简称家机或家用机，又称电视游-{}-戏机、電視遊-{}-樂器、有时也称家用主機或主机，是供居家娛樂的电子游戏设备。家用游戏机是电子游戏机的一种，通常属于私有财产，与公用的街边游戏机相对，但与街机不同的是，家机通常使用電視螢幕作為顯示器，并使用专门的游戏手柄进行操控。家机一般也包括便于携带的掌上游戏机在内，但一般不包括专门设计用于玩游戏的智能手机或电竞电脑。
target_text: Home games machines (), short-term home games or home games, also known as television shows - {} - theatres, television shows - {} - musical instruments, and sometimes also home hosts or hosts, are devices for home games. Home games are a type of video games machine, usually private property, as opposed to a public street game, but, unlike a street machine, are usually controlled using television screens as monitors and with a special game handle.
title: 家用游戏机

source_text: 由于家用机的市场价格在很多发展中国家仍然相对昂贵，很多地方有专门经营家机和掌机的商业场所，也有网咖会提供租玩家用机的服务。在日本，電視遊戲比電腦遊戲更為普遍，因为电视游戏價格更加便宜、遊戲軟體種類多、設計也較親切、容易上手。大多數人認為，電視遊戲比電腦遊戲更有可玩性。同一款遊戲，電視遊戲平臺版的銷量一般比電腦遊戲的銷量更高，受眾更廣。
target_text: In Japan, television games are more common than computer games, because television games are cheaper, more diverse in software, and more friendly and easy to handle. Most people think that television games are more fun than computer games.
title: 家用游戏机

source_text: 大部份亞洲地區近年來由于電腦網路遊戲的蓬勃發展，再加上電視遊戲的語言大多為針對日本當地設計，在日本以外的電腦遊戲比電視遊戲更為發達。随着智慧型手機大面积普及，手机端成為主流後，手機遊戲市場擠壓了原本電視遊戲的市場，主流開發商由過去的日本繼續主導外，而中國大陸、台灣、香港及韓國廠商也為主流。

source_text: 1977年初Atari成立了軟件研發部，專門開發主機的相關軟件。但由於管理不善，到1978年末，生產的80萬部主機只賣出了55萬部。這直接導致Atari創始人Bushnell離開了Atari。接任的為Atari帶來了現代化的管理手段，實施了一系列的市場宣傳活動。1979年Atari 2600成為最暢銷的聖誕禮物，當年銷量超過了100萬部。

source_text: 1982年Atari 2600達到了顛峰，銷量800萬部，資產從7500萬美元增長到22億美元，佔了華納收入的一半。然而著名的「Video Game Crash」(亞洲地區也稱為Atari Shock)也在此時發生。由於Atari對於第三方軟件開發商完全沒有控管，導致軟體數量暴增，劣質品在市面充斥，而Atari重金投注的電影「ET」遊戲版也劣評如潮；最關鍵的原因則是由於第三方的小廠不斷重複創業／倒閉的過程，零售商面對求償無門的大量庫存軟件，只能用不合理的低價清倉銷售，久而久之消費者對於合理價格的優質軟件也不再有興趣(或者說消費者認為不久的將來便會低價出清)，導致遊戲機市場完全崩潰，結束了這個世代跟Atari公司的一代江山(在歐美地區要一直到任天堂公司的NES主機推出後，家用遊戲機市場才開始復甦)。

source_text: 图灵奖对获奖者的要求极高，评奖程序也极严，一般每年只奖励一名计算机科学家，只有极少数年度有两名以上在同一方向上做出贡献的科学家同时获奖。2014年11月13日之前图灵奖由英特尔公司以及Google公司赞助，奖金为250,000美元。2014年11月13日，虽然英特尔退出赞助，Google反而将奖金提高到1,000,000美元，和诺贝尔奖奖金相近。
target_text: The Turing Award is extremely demanding for winners, and the award process is extremely rigorous, with only one computer scientist being awarded annually, and only a few more than two scientists who have contributed in the same direction have been awarded at the same time. By November 13, 2014, the Turing Award was sponsored by Intel and Google, with a bonus of $250,000. On November 13, 2014, in spite of Intel’s withdrawal, Google raised the bonus to US$ 1,000,000, close to the Nobel Prize prize.
title: 图灵奖

source_text: 电视（，簡稱：）这词语代表三种不同的涵义，如：连续动态的影像和聲音转换为电子訊號，并通过各种-{zh-tw:管道;zh-cn:渠道;}-传输电子訊号后，再將电子訊號还原为影像和聲音的技术，即电视技术；指接收这种电子訊號的设备，即可以接收并还原电子訊號为连续动态的影像和声音的装置，即电视机；一种社会文化现象，特指人群之间、人群与人之间使用电视作为传播载体进行訊息交流、訊息传播，即所謂的廣播过程，诸如电视节目的制作、电视訊號的传输、接收，以及观众对于电视节目内容的评判和反馈等的各个方面。制作电视播出内容的设施称为电视台。
target_text: Television (simple:) the term represents three different meanings, such as: continuous dynamic images and voices converted to electronic signals, and the use of television as a medium for communication, communication, communication, communication, and so-called publicity processes, such as television production, transmission of television signals, reception, and viewers’ evaluation and feedback of the content of television programmes.
title: 电视

source_text: 电视被世人公认为是20世纪的重要发明之一，至今仍是十分普遍的訊息傳播工具。隨著科技的進步，電視也在逐漸演化，例如智能電視與网络电视的面世。历史電視不是哪一個人的發明創造，而是一大群位於不同歷史時期和國度的人們的共同結晶。早在十九世紀時，人們就開始討論和探索將影像轉變成電子訊號的方法。1900年，“television”一詞就已經出現。
target_text: As technology advances, television has evolved, for example, in the presence of smart TV and Internet TV. History TV is not the creation of anyone, but the convergence of a large group of people from different historical times and countries.
title: 电视

source_text:
机械式电视
电视亦可理解为电子机械式电视（electromechanical television）。我们知道，电视画面的运动是利用了人类视觉的错觉，即可以将一些快速出现的静态的画面“合成”运动的、连续的画面。如何快速地还原这些静态画面，从而使人能够产生错觉，就会有两种方式。其中一种就是机械式的还原方式亦就是尼普科夫盘。俄裔德国科学家保罗·高特列本·尼普科夫早在1884年就提出並申請了世界上第一個機械式電視系統的專利，当时他只有23岁，还在德国读大学。经过研究他发现，如果把影像分成单个像点，就极有可能把人或景物的影像传送到远方。不久，一台叫作“电视望远镜”的仪器问世了。这是一种光电机械扫描圆盘，它看上去笨头笨脑的，但极富独创性。1884年11月6日，尼普科夫把他的这项发明申报给柏林皇家专利局。在他的专利申请书的第一页这样写道：“这里所述的仪器能使处于A地的物体，在任何一个B地被看到。”一年后，专利被批准了。这个专利中的尼普科夫盘据认为也是世界上第一个电视影像光栅。但是，尼普科夫本人从来也没有做出一个模型来证明他的设计。直到1907年，放大管（amplifier tube）技术的进步才证明他的这个系统的可行性。
target_text: Mechanical television can also be understood as an electromechanical television (eletromechanical television). We know that the motion of the television image was based on the illusion that the world's first mechanical television system had been introduced in 1884, and that he was 23 years old, still studying in Germany. Researching how to quickly restore these static images makes it possible to transmit images of humans or landscapes far away. One of the mechanical way is a nipkov dish. The Russian German scientist, Paul Gottreben Nipkov, presented and applied for the expertise of the world's first mechanical television system in 1884.
title: 电视

source_text: 1897年，德国物理学家卡尔·布劳恩发明了一种带荧光螢幕的阴极射线管。当电子束撞击时，螢幕上会顯示亮光。当时布劳恩的助手曾提出用映像管做电视的显示器，固执的布劳恩却认为这是不可能的。康斯坦丁·波斯基（Constantin Perskyi）在向1900年巴黎世博会提交的一篇论文中造出了television一词。波斯基的论文评估了机电技术的在当时的状况，并提到了尼普科夫等人的贡献。
target_text: In 1897, German physicist Karl Braun invented a cathode-ray tube with fluorescent screens. When the beams hit, the screens showed bright light. At that time, Braun’s assistant offered to use a video tube as a television monitor, and the stubborn Braun thought it impossible. Constantin Perskyi created the term television in a paper presented to the Paris Expo in 1900.
title: 电视

source_text: 1907年至1910年，波瑞斯·罗星（Boris Rosing）和他的学生弗拉基米爾·佐利金验证了在发射机中用快速转动的镜面扫描装置和在接收机中使用阴极射线管的电视系统。波瑞斯·罗星在1917年的“十月革命”中离开了人们的视线。而佐利金之后去了美国无线电公司（英語簡稱：RCA）　工作。他在那里建立了纯粹的电子式电视系统。不过，他的这个系统最终被认为是侵犯了费罗·泰勒·法恩斯沃斯（Philo Taylor Farnsworth）的专利}。
target_text: From 1907 to 1910, Boris Rossing and his student Vladimir Zolkin validated the use of a fast-moving mirror scanner in a transmitter and a television system using cathode ray tubes in a receiver. Boris Rothing left people’s eyes in the October Revolution of 1917.
title: 电视

source_text:
电子式电视
1911年，工程师艾伦·坎贝尔·斯文顿（Alan Archibald Campbell-Swinton）在伦敦发表演讲，同时在时代杂志中也被报道，描述了如何在发送端和接收端同时使用阴极射线管。在1920年代末，当机械式电视还在普遍使用的时候，发明家费罗·法恩斯沃斯和弗拉基米尔·佐利金分别已经在研究全电子式传输管的工作中。
target_text: In 1911, engineer Alan Archibald Campbell-Swinton spoke in London, and was also reported in Times magazine, describing the use of cathode ray tubes on both the sender and the receiving end. At the end of the 1920s, when mechanical television was still widely used, inventors Ferro Farnsworth and Vladimir Zulkin, respectively, were already working on full electronic transmission tubes.
title: 电视

source_text: 1923年，苏格兰发明家约翰·洛吉·贝尔德的一个朋友告诉他：“既然马可尼能够远距离发射和接收无线电波，那么发射影像也应该是可能的。”这使他受到很大启发。贝尔德决心要完成用电子訊號傳送影像。他变卖了仅有的一些财产，并收集大量资料，把所有时间都投入到研制电视上，完成了电视机的设计工作。贝尔德成功用电子訊號在螢幕上显示影像}。
target_text: In 1923, a friend of Scotland's inventor John Lodge Baird told him, “If Marconi is able to launch and receive radio waves remotely, it should also be possible to launch images.” This inspired him. Baird is determined to complete the transmission of images with electronic signals. He sells the only assets and collects a lot of information, spends all his time on television and completes the design of the TV set. Baird successfully displays images on the screen with electronic signals.
title: 电视

source_text: 俄裔美国科学家弗拉基米爾·佐利金同时也在实验阴极射线管来产生和显示影像。1923年在西屋电气公司工作期间，他研制了电子攝像管。但是在1925年的展示过程中，影像模糊不清，对比度很低，解析度差，而且影像是静止的。这种映像管没有走过实验阶段，但是美國無線電公司（获取了西屋电气公司专利权）相信法恩斯沃斯1927年影像分割器（Image Dissector）的专利条件过于宽泛，会排挤其他形式的电子成像技术。所以，RCA在获取了1923年弗拉基米爾·佐利金的专利应用之后，对法恩斯沃斯提出了「专利牴触」诉讼。美国专利办公室的检察官否决了1935年的决议，裁定法恩斯沃斯的发明优先于弗拉基米爾·佐利金（Vladimir Zworykin)。在1939年十月，RCA再次敗訴，但是他们还是希望能更进一步的生产商用电视机设备，RCA同意支付法恩斯沃斯一百万美元（在2006年等同于一千三百八十万美元）之外，在之后的10年期间内，使用法恩斯沃斯的专利，需要支付额外授权费用。1929年弗拉基米爾·佐利金又推出一个经过改进的模型，结果仍然不理想。RCA最终投资了5千万美元，1931年弗拉基米爾·佐利金终于制造出了摄影機攝像管。同年，进行一个完整的光电摄映像管系统的实地试验。在这次实验中，一个由240条扫描线组成的影像传送给4英里以外的一台电视机（使用镜子把9英寸显像管的图像反射到电视机前），成功使电视摄影与映像方式电子化。
target_text: The Russian-American scientist Vladimir Zolykin also created and displayed images by experimenting with cathode ray tubes. During his work at Western House Electric in 1923, he developed electronic video tubes, but during the 1925 exhibition, the images were vague, contrasted very low, the resolution was poor, and the images were still static. However, the U.S. Wireless Company (which acquired the right to patent Westhall Electric) was convinced that the Famesworth Video Splitter of 1927 was over-broad, crowding out other forms of electronic imaging technology. So, after acquiring the 1923 Vladimir Zulikin patent application, the RCA filed a patent-touch suit against Farnsworth. The U.S. Patent Office rejected the resolution of 1935, ruling that Farnsworth' invention would still have to be used for an additional video-telegram of 19 years, which would have cost Vladimir Zwrykin, and that it would have used an additional video-fiding device of 10 million dollars.
title: 电视

source_text: 第一个半机械式模拟电视系统在1925年10月2日被苏格兰人约翰·洛吉·贝尔德在伦敦的一次实验中“扫描”出木偶的影像看作是电视诞生的标志，他被称做“电视之父”。后来，他的这个系统被英国广播公司所採用。后來在1937年，英国广播公司终止使用这种技术。因为在那时电子式电视系统更受欢迎。
target_text: The first semi-mechanical analogue television system was “scanned” by the Scottish John Lodge Baird in an experiment in London on 2 October 1925 as a sign of television birth, and he was called the “father of television.” Later, his system was used by the BBC. Later, in 1937, the BBC discontinued the use of the technology.
title: 电视

source_text: 在1927年12月7日，費羅·法恩斯沃斯（Philo Farnsworth）在他的圣弗朗西斯科格林大街202号的实验室里，首次使用（Image Dissector）摄影管传送了第一个影像：一条简单的直线。1928年，法恩斯沃斯研制一套完整的系统给媒体进行演示，由电视传送一个动画影片。1929年，这个系统進一步被优化，去掉电动发电机，现在他的电视系统没有任何运动部件。同年，法恩斯沃斯使用他的电视系统传送首个直播人类影像：。
target_text: On 7 December 1927, Philo Farnsworth, in his lab at 202 St. Francisco Green Street, used the Image Dissector camera tube for the first time to transmit the first image: a simple straight line. In 1928, Farnsworth developed a complete system to show the media and transmit an animated video by television. In 1929, the system was further optimized to remove electric generators, and his television system now has no sports components. In the same year, Farnsworth used his television system to transmit the first live human image:
title: 电视

source_text: 1928年，“第五届德国广播博览会”在柏林开幕。博览会中电视第一次作为公开产品展出。有线的机械电视传播訊号的距离和范围非常有限，影像也相当粗糙，无法显示精细的画面。因为只有几分之一的光线能透过尼普科夫盘的孔洞，为得到理想的光线，就必须增大孔洞，但画面将十分粗糙。要提高影像的解析度，必须增加孔洞数目，但是，孔洞变小，能透过来的光线便会减少，影像便会模糊不清。机械式电视的这一缺陷导致这种技术被淘汰。
target_text: In 1928, the fifth German Radio Fair was opened in Berlin. Television was displayed for the first time as a public product. Wired mechanical television broadcast signals were very limited in distance and scope, and images were very rough and could not display fine images. Because only a fraction of the light could reach the desired light through the hole in the nipkov plate, the hole had to be increased, but the image would be rough. To improve the resolution of the image, the number of holes had to be increased, but the hole could be reduced by light, and the image could be blurred.
title: 电视

source_text: 1929年，英国广播公司允许贝尔德公司开展公共电视广播业务，1937年，英国广播公司停用这种技术。30年代以后，贝尔德又转向了彩色电视的研究。经过不断地改进设备提高技术，贝尔德研制的电视效果越来越好，引起了极大的轰动。后来成立了“贝尔德电视发展公司”。随着技术和设备的不断改进，贝尔德电视的传送距离有了较大的改进。
target_text: In 1929, the BBC allowed Baird to do public television broadcasting, and in 1937, the BBC shut down the technology. After the 1930s, Baird turned to color television research.
title: 电视

source_text: 1934年8月25日法恩斯沃斯在宾夕法尼亚州费城的富兰克林学会首次给全世界演示一套完整的全电子式电视系统。其他发明家之前只是展示了类似系统的部分功能，或者演示使用静态影像或者动态影片的电子系统。但是法恩斯沃斯是第一个把电子扫描式电视摄像机和电子扫描式电视接收机整合在一起，提供直播、动态、黑白图像的系统。不幸的是，他的摄像机需要很强的照明光线，所以他的工作被迫中断。
target_text: The Franklin Institute in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, on August 25, 1934 showed the world a complete electronic television system for the first time. Other inventors had previously only demonstrated some of the features of a similar system, or an electronic system using static or dynamic images. But Farnsworth was the first system to integrate electronic scanning television cameras and electronic scanning television receivers to provide live, dynamic, black and white images. Unfortunately, his camera needed strong lighting, so his work was interrupted.
title: 电视

source_text: 在英国，艾萨克·舒伯特（Isaac Shoenberg）使用弗拉基米爾·佐利金的想法开发了自己的马可尼-电磁干扰（Marconi-EMI）电子摄像管，这个设计构成了为BBC制造的摄像机的核心部件。使用这种摄像管，在1936年11月2日，一条405线的服务被架设在亚历山德拉宫的摄影棚内，由安装在维多利亚大厦顶上特殊制造的桅杆形天线进行广播。它暂时替隔壁的贝尔德机械式电视系统进行播出，但是它更可靠，也具备最佳解析度。而桅杆形的天线一直沿用至今。这台完全用电子式电视系统播放的节目，给人们留下了深刻的印象。同年德国柏林举行的奥林匹克运动会的报道，共使用了3台摄像机拍摄比赛情况。佐利金發明的全電子式攝像機，但這台機器體積龐大，它的一個1.6米焦距的鏡頭就重45公斤，長2.2米，被戲稱為電視大炮。这4台摄像机的影像訊号通过电缆传送到帝国邮政中心，图像信号在那里经过混合后，通过电视塔被发射出去。柏林奥运会期间，每天用电视播出长达8小时的比赛实况，共有16万多人通过电视观看了奥运会。
target_text: In the United Kingdom, Isaac Shoenberg developed his Marconi-electromagnetic interference (Marconi-EMI) electronic camera tube using the idea of a special mast-shaped antenna installed on the roof of the Victorian building, a design that formed the core of a camera made for BBC. Using this camera, on 2 November 1936, a 405-line service was installed in the studio of the Alexandra Palace, which was temporarily broadcast for the Berd mechanical television system next door, but which was more reliable and with the best resolution. The mast-shaped antenna continued to be used. The programme, which was broadcast exclusively on an electronic television system, was impressed. The Olympic Games in Berlin, Germany, were reported in the same year, and three cameras were used to film the competition.
title: 电视

source_text: 1939年，英国大约有2万个家庭拥有电视机，美国无线电公司的电视也在纽约世博览会上首次露面，开始第一次固定的电视节目演播。二战的爆发使得刚发展起来的电视的发展停滞了10年。战争结束后，电视工业又蓬勃发展起来，电视也迅速流行起来。1946年，英国广播公司恢复了固定电视节目，美国政府也解除了禁止制造新电视的禁令；电视工业便飞速发展起来。在美国，从1949年到1951年，不仅电视节目已在全国普遍播出，电视机的数目从1百万台升至1千多万台，成立了许多家电视台。幽默剧、轻歌舞、卡通片、娱乐节目和好莱坞电影常在电视中播出。
target_text: In 1939, there were some 20,000 families in the United Kingdom with television sets, and the television show of the United States Radio Corporation began its first regular television show at the New York World Expo. The outbreak of World War II halted the development of newly developed television for 10 years. The television industry grew again after the war, and television became popular. In 1946, the BBC resumed its stationary television programmes, and the United States Government lifted the ban on the production of new televisions; the television industry developed rapidly. In the United States, not only television programmes were aired throughout the country from 1949 to 1951, but the number of television sets rose from 1 million to 10 million, and many television stations were set up.
title: 电视

source_text: ，造出一台设备。这台设备用两个直径为1米的尼普科夫盘作为发射和接收訊号的两端，每个圆盘上有48个1.5毫米的小孔，能够扫描48行，用一个同步马达把两个圆盘连接起来，每秒钟同步转动10幅画面，图像投射到另一台接收机上。他们称这台机器为大电视。这台大电视的效果比贝尔德的电视要清晰许多。但从未进行过公开展示，因而他们的发明鲜为人知。
target_text: This device uses two nipkov discs with a diameter of 1 metre as the end of the launch and reception signal, with 48 1.5 mm holes per disk capable of scanning 48 lines, connecting two disks with one simultaneous motor, with 10 simultaneous images per second, and projecting images on another receiver. They call the machine a big television. The effect of this television is much clearer than that of Baird. But it has never been shown publicly, so their inventions are not known.
title: 电视

source_text: 1956年，，使电视技术前进了一大步。因最初制作电视节目一般采用两种方式。一种是用电视胶片把节目拍摄下来，冲洗，再通过电子扫描播出。采用这种方法的一个最大的缺陷，是无法进行电视节目的实况转播。另外一种是用摄影機直接把訊号传播出去。这虽然满足了那些希望目睹现场情景的观众的需要，但是它不能重放。录影机的出现改变了这种状况。
target_text: In 1956, a major step forward was made in television technology. There were two ways in which television programmes were originally produced. One was to film them, flush them, and then scan them electronically. One of the biggest flaws in this approach was that they could not be broadcast live. The other was to send the signal directly from the camera. This met the needs of viewers who wanted to see the scene, but it could not be repeated.
title: 电视

source_text: 1956年，美國Ampex公司推出 VRX-1000 商用錄影機，被電視行業採用，採用，以90度間隔安裝四個旋轉磁頭，每個磁頭各讀取寫入四分之一的圖像電信號在2英吋寬的磁帶，磁帶儲存來自四個磁頭匯聚電信號，存在因磁頭不同產生視頻圖像失真且接縫明顯的缺點。後來採用澤崎健一研發的螺旋掃描式磁頭，可以用一個磁頭在磁帶磁軌上無縫記錄影像。
target_text: In 1956, the American company Appex launched VRX-1000 commercial video recorders, which were used by the television industry to install four rotating magnetic heads in a 90-degree interval, with each magnetic head reading and writing a one-quarter-inch video with a tape stored from four magnetic head centralization signals, with obvious gaps in the creation of video images due to their different magnetic head. Then, using Kensaki's first-researched spiral magnetic head, one magnetic head can be used to record images without stitches on the tape track.
title: 电视

source_text: 1959年，日本東芝採用螺旋掃描式磁頭技術加上美國Ampex四磁頭錄影系統專利，推出商用磁帶錄影機，此時電視行業商用錄影機已統一技術規格，錄影帶可以互換播放。1972年，日本索尼公司推出規格錄影機，採用3／4英寸盒式磁带，根本上改变电视节目的制作方法，是世界上第一个专业彩色录影放映系统使用的盒式磁带。。
target_text: In 1959, when Toshiba introduced a commercial video recorder using a spiral-scanning magnetic technology plus a special feature of the American Ampex IV magnetic video system, a television commercial video recorder developed a technical code that allows video to be played interchangeably. In 1972, Sony Japan launched a protocol recorder using a 3/4-inch tape that fundamentally changed the way television programmes were produced, and was the first in the world to be used in a professional colour video show.
title: 电视

source_text: 电视技术的现状：当前电视技术的一个最明显的特征就是数字化，首先是节目制作数位化，1990年代末期，英国广播公司率先在全球建立起了“哥伦布”系统。这个系统使得BBC的电视节目储存、编辑、播出全面实现數位化，即非磁带化，从而极大地提高了BBC的工作效率，节省了制作成本。另外，现在的电视机构正在逐渐淘汰传统的模拟摄影機和錄影帶，取而代之的是数字攝影機和各种新兴的记录载体，这个变革大大改善了影像品質。其次，传输技术也多元化起来，除了传统的无线電波微波传输外，现在还有有线电视、卫星电视等传输方式。这些新兴的传输方式有效地减轻了訊号在传输过程中必然会产生的衰减现象，保证了较好的接收品質。最后是接收技术的數位化变革，影音品質提高和人機互動是数位化广泛推广带来的两个最大的好处。
target_text: One of the most obvious features of television technology today is digitalization, starting with the digitalization of programming, which in the late 1990s led the BBC to set up a global “Columbus” system. This system has enabled BBC television programming to be stored, edited, and broadcast to be fully digitalized, i.e. non-magnetized, thereby significantly increasing the productivity and saving production costs of BBC. Moreover, television institutions are now phasing out traditional analogue cameras and videotapes, replacing them with digital cameras and various emerging record carriers, which have significantly improved the quality of images.
title: 电视

source_text: 电视机的现状：在本世紀的电视机体积比起上世紀来小很多，儘管螢幕大小与体积成正比，而34英寸是这种技术所能够达到的最大极限，这显然与人们的需求背道而驰。于是，本世紀更多的显示器技术涌现出来，例如背投电视、液晶电视、等离子电视、LED电视等，伴随着电视制作和传输技术數位化，接收装置數位化也成为了必然，數位電視显示效果更好，功能也更多，甚至已经可以实现初步的人機互动。电视机的另一个趋势是智慧化趋势，即与其他电器的结合，特别是与电脑的结合，这将使得电视更加“聪明”具有更多的功能，从而突破电视的传统含义（参见“前景”）。
target_text: The current status of televisions: The size of televisions in this century is much smaller than in the last century, although the size of the screen is proportional to the size of the screen, and 34 inches is the maximum limit that this technology can reach, which is clearly contrary to the needs of the population. So, more display technology has emerged in this century, such as backdrop television, LCD TV, plasma TV, LED TV, etc., which, with the digitalization of television production and transmission technology, has become inevitable, with digital television showing better results, more functionality, and even initial human interaction. Another trend in televisions is the trend of intelligence, i.e., integration with other appliances, especially computers, which will make television “smarter” more functional, thus breaking the traditional meaning of television (see “foresight”).
title: 电视

source_text: 电视传媒，发展飞速，让人应接不暇，更加迷惑，电视传媒的两极化严重。诸如BBC、CNN等几家电视机构握有强大的话语权（参见“全球传播”），专业化程度加强，面对的受众面更加狭窄。电视新闻中，直播这一廣播技術被频繁使用，其旨在更加真实地还原新闻事件本身，经典案例：CNN的海湾战争报道。
target_text: Several television agencies, such as BBC and CNN, have a strong voice (see “Global Communications”) and become more specialized and have a narrower audience. In television news, the broadcast technology is frequently used to restore the story itself, the classic case of CNN’s Gulf War coverage.
title: 电视

source_text:
前景
電視節目製作的前進方向有兩個；一個是更加的真實化。即更加真實地還原事件本身。例如，CNN在新聞事件中大量的直播運用就是其中的一種體現。另一個是更加的戲劇化，例如，與CNN相對的福克斯娱乐集团 NEWS在其節目中就用大量戲劇化的語言來“渲染”美國對伊拉克的戰爭。當然，上述的這兩個方向只是兩種不同的節目製作方向，是歷來有之，只是近來特徵更為突出。而此外的現象還有，節目窄播化、頻道專業化等。
target_text: Foreground TV shows are produced in two directions: one is more authentic, i.e. more authentically restores the events themselves. For example, CNN uses a lot of live broadcasts in news events. The other is more dramatic, for example, the Fox Entertainment Group, which contrasts CNN, “rew” America’s war against Iraq in its programmes in dramatic terms.
title: 电视

source_text: 同时，在技术越来越先进的今天，电视作为一种工具正在更多地被国家所使用，现在国家实力已不仅仅限于经济、军事等这些传统“硬”实力的范畴，文化等软实力同样也要被考虑，因而电视被认为是提升一个国家软实力的很好工具，目前这种趋势正在愈演愈烈。
target_text: At the same time, television is being used more and more as a tool by the State today, and now that national power is not limited to the traditional “hard” strength of the economy, the military, etc., and soft power such as culture is equally taken into account, television is considered to be a good tool for upgrading a country's soft power, a trend that is increasing.
title: 电视

source_text: 电视是一种技术，也是一种文化，其文化层面当面临着其他新兴媒体，如私人的錄影設備或互联网上的串流媒體和影碟等的挑战时，影响力必然会像以前的电影、戏剧一样有所下降。但是电视作为一种技术将会有很大的发展，电视这种技术在未来将更加广泛地与其他技术结合，从而充分地方便人们的生活，例如最近电视技术和移动通信技术的结合就使得手机电视的提供率先在挪威成为可能，而另一方面電視台同樣加入其他媒體的發行競爭。而英国广播公司在几年前将电视技术和網路结合在一起，将其核心网站BBCi 变成了一个巨大的影像资料库，使其在互动能力上走在了世界媒体的前列。
target_text: Television is a technology, as well as a culture, whose cultural dimension, when faced with the challenges of other emerging media, such as private video-recording or Internet-based streaming media and DVDs, will certainly have the same impact as the previous films and dramas. But television, as a technology, will develop much more widely in the future in conjunction with other technologies to make people’s lives sufficiently accessible, such as the recent combination of television technology and mobile communication technology, which has made it possible to provide mobile television to take the lead in Norway and, on the other hand, television stations to join other media competitions.
title: 电视

target_text: In 1934, Sun Ming, an assistant at the Central University Institute of Science in Nanjing, developed China's first model television principles for video-recording, transmission, acceptance and broadcasting. Yang Jan identified “television” as the corresponding name in Chinese. In 1939, Sun Ming formally listed “television” as the thirteenth part of the “Microengineering” class at King Mai University, and “television” officially became a Chinese university programme.

source_text: 二進制（）在數學和數位電路中指以2為底数的記數系統，以2為基數代表系統是二進位制的。這一系統中，通常用兩個不同的數字0和1來表示。數字電子電路中，邏輯門直接採用了二進制，因此現代的計算機和依赖計算機的設備裡都用到二進制。每個數字稱為一個位元（二進制位）或比特（Bit，Binary digit 的縮寫）。
target_text: The binary system () refers to a two-digit system in mathematics and digital circuits, with a two-digit base representative system that is binary. In this system, two different numbers of 0 and 1 are usually used. In digital circuits, the logical door directly uses binary, so that modern computers and computer-dependent devices are used in binary. Each number is called a bit (binary bit) or bit.
title: 二进制

source_text:
历史
现代的二进制记数系统由戈特弗里德·莱布尼茨于1679年设计，在他1703年发表的文章《论只使用符号0和1的二进制算术，兼论其用途及它赋予伏羲所使用的古老图形的意义》出现。与二进制数相关的系统在一些更早的文化中也有出现，包括古埃及、古代中国、古印度以及太平洋島原住民文明。其中，古代中国的《易经》尤其引起了莱布尼茨的联想。
target_text: The modern binary system was designed in 1679 by Gottfried Lebnitz, who published an article in 1703 entitled "The use of binary arithmetic in symbols 0 and 1 and the meaning it gives to the ancient graphics used in voodoo" . The systems associated with binary numbers also appeared in some earlier cultures, including ancient Egypt, ancient China, ancient India, and the indigenous cultures of Pacific islands.
title: 二进制

source_text:
埃及
古埃及的计数员使用两种不同的系统表示分数，一是埃及分数（与二进制记数系统无关），二是荷鲁斯之眼分数（叫这个名字是因为很多数学史家相信这个系统所采用的符号可以排列成荷鲁斯之眼，但这一点有争议）。荷鲁斯之眼分数是用来表示分数数量的谷物、液体等的二进制记数系统，在这一系统下，以赫卡特为单位的分数值表示成1/2、1/4、1/8、1/16、1/32和1/64等二进制分数的和。 这一系统的早期形式可以在埃及第五王朝（约公元前2400年）的档案中找到，而发展完备的象形文字形式可追溯到埃及第十九王朝（约公元前1200年）。
古埃及做乘法的方式也与二进制数密切相关，约公元前1650年的莱因德数学纸草书中就能看到。这一计算方法中，要把1和乘数不断翻倍，按被乘数的二进制表示从左列选出相应的2的幂次，并将右列的数相加。
target_text: Egypt’s ancient Egyptian counter-measurers use two different systems to indicate scores: the Egyptian score (not related to the binary score system) and the Horus eye score (nameed because many mathematicians believe that the symbols used in the system can be placed in Horus’s eye, but this is controversial). The Holus eye score is the binary score system used to indicate the number of grains, liquids, etc., and, under this system, the binary score in Hekater’s unit is also closely related to the binary score, as can be seen in the Leinish sketch book of 1650 B. The early form of the system can be found in the archives of Egypt’s fifth dynasty (the year about 2400 B.C.), while the fully developed hieroglyph form can be traced to Egypt’s nineteenth dynasty (the year about 1200 B.C.).
title: 二进制

source_text:
印度
印度学者平甲拉（公元前两世纪左右）通过二进制方法来研究韵律诗。他的二进制中用到的是长短音节（一个长音节相当于两个短音节），有些像摩尔斯电码。与西方的位置表示法不同，平甲拉的系统中，二进制是从右往左书写的。太平洋島原住民文明
在法屬玻里尼西亞的曼格雷哇島，挪威卑爾根大學的人類學家Andrea Bender和Sieghard Beller發現，在曼格雷哇人的語言上，存在著一個似乎混合了十進位和二進位的數學系統。它先於西方幾個世紀，為首個在歐亞大陸之外發展出的二進位算法 。
target_text: In India, the Indian scholar Hincala (about two centuries B.C.) studied rhythmic poetry through a binary approach. His binary system uses long syllables (a long syllable is equivalent to two short syllables), some like Morse codes. Unlike the West, the binary system in Hincala is written from the right to the left.
title: 二进制

source_text:
莱布尼茨前的西方先驱
1605年，弗朗西斯·培根提出了一套系统，可以把26个字母化为二进制数。此外他补充道，这个思路可以用于任何事物：“只要这些事物的差异是简单对立的，比如铃铛和喇叭，灯光和手电筒，以及火枪和类似武器的射击声”。这对二进制编码的一般理论有重要意义。（参见培根密码）
target_text: In 1605, Francis Bacon, a former Western pioneer in Lebnitz, proposed a system that would convert 26 letters into binary numbers. Moreover, he added, the idea could be applied to anything: “as long as the differences between these things are simple opposites, such as bells and horns, lights and flashlights, and firings of firearms and similar weapons.” This is important for the general theory of binary codes.
title: 二进制

source_text:
莱布尼兹认为易经中的卦象与二进制算术密不可分。莱布尼兹解读了易经中的卦象，并认为这是其作为二进制算术的证据。作为亲华派，莱布尼兹关注易经，并饶有兴致地注意到它的卦象与从0到111111的二进制数字有某种对应，并认为这种对应反映了中国的重大成就中展现的他所崇尚的数学哲学。莱布尼兹首次接触到易经是在与法国耶稣会传教士白晋的联系中。白晋1685年作为传教士前往中国。
长期以来，人们对莱布尼茨发明二进制是否受到了伏羲八卦的影响争议颇多。认为莱布尼茨未受伏羲八卦影响独立发明二进制的理由主要是莱布尼茨在1679年（与白晋首次通信的二十多年）就撰写了“二的级数”（De Progressione Dyadica）一文；而目前有学者倾向于认为莱布尼茨二进制的体系确源于伏羲八卦图，原因在于1687年莱布尼茨看过柏应理的《这个哲学家孔子》，书中便有伏羲八卦次序图、方位图和周文王六十四卦图。此外，莱布尼茨还阅读过1660年斯比赛尔出版的《中国文史评析》，其中亦有对《易经》和八卦的介绍。
此外，莱布尼兹认为易经的卦象肯定了他所信仰的基督教的共相。一切数都可以用0和1创造出来，在莱布尼兹看来，这正象征了基督教《圣经》所说的上帝从“无”创造“有”（creatio ex nihilo）。
target_text: LeBoniz believes that the easy-to-life gossip is indistinguishable from binary arithmetic. Lebniz read the easy-to-life gossip as evidence of the second arithmetic arithmetic. As a pro-hwa, Lebniz is concerned about the easy-to-life as well as noting with interest that its gossip corresponds to binary figures from 0 to 1111, and considers that this corresponds to his mathematical philosophy, as manifested in China's major achievements. Lebniz first came into contact with the French Jesuit proselytist, Bazoron. Lebniz went to China as a proselytist in 1685.
title: 二进制

source_text: 1937年，克劳德·香农在麻省理工大学完成了其电气工程硕士学位论文，用继电器和开关实现了布尔代数和二进制算术运算。论文题为《继电器与开关电路的符号分析》（A Symbolic Analysis of Relay and Switching Circuits），其中香农的理论奠定了数字电路的理论基础。香农凭这篇论文于1940年被授予美国阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔协会美国工程师奖。哈佛大学的哈沃德·加德纳称，香农的硕士论文“可能是本世纪最重要、最著名的硕士学位论文”。
target_text: In 1937, Claude Shannon completed his master's degree in electrical engineering paper at the Massachusetts University of Technology, using relays and switches to achieve the Bore algebra and binary arithmetic calculations. The paper entitled A Symbolic Analysis of Relay and Switching Circuits, in which Shannon's theory laid the theoretical foundation for digital circuits. Shannon was awarded the Alfred Nobel Association American Engineer Award in 1940. Howard Gardner of Harvard University said that Shannon's master's thesis was “probably the most important and famous master's degree dissertation of the century”.
title: 二进制

source_text: 不同進位數转换十进制化为二进制整数部分，把十进制转成二进制一直分解至商數為0。讀餘數從下讀到上，即是二進位的整數部分數字。小数部分，则用其乘2，取其整数部分的结果，再用计算后的小数部分依此重复计算，算到小数部分全为0为止，之后读所有计算后整数部分的数字，从上讀到下。
target_text: Converts a decimal number to a binary integer part, converting a decimal into a binary integer and continuing to decomposition to zero. Read the rest from the bottom up, that is, the integer part of the binary integer. The decimal part is multiplied by two, the result of the integer part is taken, and the calculated decimal part is repeated accordingly until zero, after which all the calculated integer parts are read from the top to the bottom.
title: 二进制

source_text:
二进制化为八进制
把二进制化为八进制也不是很难，因为八进制以8为基数，8是2的幂（8=23），因此八进制的一位恰好需要三个二进制位来表示。八进制与二进制数之间的对应就是上面表格中十六进制的前八个数。二进制数000就是八进制数0，二进制数111就是八进制数7，以此类推。
target_text: It is also not difficult to convert the binary into the octal, because it is based on 8 and 8 on 2 (8 = 23), so one of the octadecimals just needs three binary bits. The correspondence between the octadecimal and binary numbers is the first eight of the hexadecimals in the table above. The binary number of 000 is the octal number 0, the binary number 111 is the octal number 7 and so on.
title: 二进制
