title: 浙江大学

source_text:
传统
1938年，时任国立浙江大学校长的竺可桢主持校务会议，提出以“求是”二字为国立浙江大学校训，并邀著名国学大师马一浮为校歌作词。校歌校歌《浙江大学校歌》原名《大不自多》，由国学家马一浮先生作词，国立中央音乐学院应尚能教授作曲。该校歌自定以来多有异议，集中于文言歌词且用典颇多，于学生理解不便。校长竺可桢认为歌词虽文理艰深，而其意甚深，故而沿用至今。
target_text: In 1938, the former president of Zhejiang National University, Shao Kei, presided over the school meeting, proposing the word “yes” for training at Zhejiang National School and inviting the famous Master of National Science, Ma, to write the school song. The school song, “The Big Bang”, was originally named “The Big Bang”, was written by Mr. Ma Yiu, who should be able to teach music at the National Central Music School.
title: 浙江大学

source_text:
校训“求是创新”。
起源：1938年，校长竺可桢主持校务会议正式确定“求是”为浙大校训。“求是”二字，取于王阳明“君子之学，唯求其是”一句，是本校前身“求是书院”传承至今的大学精神。且“求是”暗合英文“Truth”一词，意同“真理”，是为大学求学之目的，以为校训甚为恰当。由此，校长竺可桢定“求是”为校训，期许浙江大学学子可承续校风，并不忘为学之目的。
target_text: In 1938, the principal of the school presided over the school council and officially defined the term “yes” as a school instruction. The word “yes” is taken from Wang Yangming’s “gentlemen’s learning” and is based on the spirit of the university that has prevailed to this day in the school’s predecessor. And the word “yes” coincides with the English language “Truth” with the word “the truth” in order for the university to pursue its studies.
title: 浙江大学

source_text:
变迁：1988年，有感于当下社会将「求是」往往片面理解为「求实」，校长路甬祥在原校训“求是”二字后增补强调“创新”，以为新时期浙江大学校训。校名
现用校名为毛泽东寄浙江大学教授信封上的地址放大而成。校区现有玉泉、西溪、华家池、之江、紫金港、舟山、海宁、宁波等校区，在浙江省各地及北京、上海、郑州、三亚等地设有研究机构。
target_text: In 1988, there was a sense that the word “yes” was often interpreted in one-sided terms as “realistic”, and the principal added the word “innovation” to the original school's instruction, emphasizing “innovation” for the new era of Zhejiang University. The title of the school is now expanded by the address on the envelope of the University Professor of Sujiang, Mao Zedong. The campus now has research institutes in Yu Quan, Nishi River, Hua Jia Chiujiang, Zigang, Khaoyama, Heining and Ningbo, all over Zhejiang Province and in Beijing, Shanghai, Chungzhou and Sanya.
title: 浙江大学

source_text: 紫金港校区浙大主校区，位于杭州市西湖区余杭塘路866号，于2001年9月开工兴建，2002年10月启用，面积3200亩，也是浙江大学最大校区。二期西校区工程2700余亩，规划总建筑面积约120余万平方公尺，于2011年5月开工建设，并于2017年完工。2007年4月20日，浙江大学校部机关由玉泉校区迁往紫金港，紫金港校区正式取代玉泉成为浙大的主校区。
target_text: The Zhejiang main campus, located at 866 Hangang Road, West Lake District, Hangzhou City, was opened in September 2001 and opened in October 2002 with an area of 3,200 acres and the largest campus at Zhejiang University. The second phase of the West campus, with a planned total area of approximately 1.2 million square metres, began construction in May 2011 and was completed in 2017. On 20 April 2007, the headquarters of the Zhejiang main school was moved from the Yu Quan campus to the Yu Quan school complex, which officially replaced the Yu Quan main campus.
title: 浙江大学

source_text: 目前，入校新生往往分入求是学院，统一居住于紫金港校区。尚有不少学院高年级学生亦居住于此。紫金港校区学生住宿区共分七个学园，自东向西、自北向南分别名为“白沙”、“翠柏”、“青溪”、“丹阳”、“蓝田”、“紫云”、“碧峰”。因管理需要，青溪学园与丹阳学园已合并为丹阳青溪学园，简称丹青学园；紫云学园与碧峰学园已合并为紫云碧峰学园，简称云峰学园。
target_text: There are seven campuses in the Hong Kong campus from east to west, and from north to south, called “White Sha”, “Triber”, “Change Creek”, “Danyang”, “Slanda”, “Yungun” and “Bip Peak” respectively. As a result of management needs, the Green Creek School and the Tanyang School have been merged into the Tangyang School School, known as the Tangyang School; the Purple Cloud School and the Beak Peak School have been merged into the Huayung School.
title: 浙江大学

source_text: 进入大学正门，首先将面对两条宽阔的林荫道与之间的大草坪。林荫道一直延伸到背靠老和山的浙江大学图书馆本馆大楼前。林荫道的两侧是校区内的主要教学楼。校园内最大的塑像是毛泽东塑像，位于上述两条林荫道之间，距离正校门约200米。毛泽东塑像右手呈挥手状，目视远方，前有水泥平台，是大学生举行英语角和宣传活动的中心场所。位于毛泽东塑像后方，距离400米左右的图书馆前，立有浙江大学前校长、著名教育家竺可桢铜像。塑像人物一手撑手杖，一手挽着外套，神情自然地注视着校园。
target_text: The main entrance to the main university entrance will begin with the front lawn between the two broad shades. The shade has been extended to front of the library building of Zhejiang University, which relies on the old and mountains. The two sides of the shade are the main teaching buildings in the campus. The largest statues in the campus are the Mauser Tung statue, located about 200 metres from the main entrance between the two shades mentioned above. The Mouse Tung statue, with its right hand swings, looks far away, has a concrete platform, is the centre for English horns and promotional activities by university students. In front of the Mao Tse Tung statue, at about 400 metres from the back of the library, there is a pre-Rector of Zhejiang University, a famous educator, who has a bronze statue.
title: 浙江大学

source_text:
西溪校区
位于杭州市西湖区天目山路148号，因校区东面是西溪河，所以定名为西溪校区，为原杭州大学校址。杭州大学前身最早是创建于1897年的求是书院和育英书院，后来求是书院于1928演变为国立浙江大学，育英书院于1914年沿革为私立之江大学。1952年全国高等学校院系调整， 浙江大学文学院和理学院的一部分、之江大学文理学院与解放后创办的浙江师范专科学校、俄文专科学校合并，成为浙江师范学院。1958年该院又与新建的杭州大学合并，定名杭州大学。5月3日为校庆日。四校合并之后改为浙江大学西溪校区。校区占地总面积684亩，人文学院、传媒与国际文化学院、教育学院等3个学院所在地，分为南园和北园，环境优雅。
target_text: The Hangzhou University was first founded in 1897 as a law school and the Yung Ying School, which later became the State University of Zhejiang in 1928 and became the private University of the River in 1914. In 1952, the Faculty of Higher Education of Zhejiang University, part of the Faculty of Arts and Science of Zhejiang University, the Faculty of Arts of Zhejiang University and the post-liberation Zhejiang Teachers College, the Russian Institute of Special Studies, were merged into the Zhejiang Teachers College and the North School. In 1958, the School was merged with the newly established Hangzhou University, and became the University of Hangzhou.
title: 浙江大学

source_text:
华家池校区
位于杭州市江干区（现属上城区）凯旋路268号，原为浙江农业大学，位于旧杭州火车东站和原汽车东站附近，为国立浙江大学华家池校区原址，是今浙江大学历史最久的校区。校园自然环境优越，原为农业等学科研究所所在地，由于农学院整体搬迁到紫金港校区，所以该校区现为农耕文化展示区以及口腔医学中心、继续教育学院（远程教育学院教学基地和全国干部培训基地）。
target_text: The campus is the oldest campus of Zhejiang State University, located in Jianggan District, Hangzhou (now Upper Town District), at 268 Triumph Road, formerly Zhejiang Agricultural University, near the East Station of the Old Hangzhou Train and the East Station of the former Automobile. The campus has an excellent natural environment, formerly located at the Institute of Agricultural Studies and other academic institutions, and is now known as the Campus of Farming Culture Centre and the School of Continuing Education (the teaching base of the Institute of Distance Education and the National Training Base).
title: 浙江大学

source_text:
之江校区
位于杭州市西湖区之江路51号，该校区1952年前为之江大学校址。之江大学为一所教会学校，于1952年後被解散，部分院系并入浙江大学，成为浙江大学“三分部”，之江校区亦划归浙江大学管理。校区坐落于杭州钱塘江畔，六和塔边，占地650亩 。2001年以前为浙江大学本科基础部，大部分工科大一新生在此学习，之江校区容纳学生近3000人。2002年以后由于新校区紫金港校区的投入使用，之江校区成为沃森基因组科学研究院和浙大成人教育学院所在地。2007年9月8日上午，光华法学院在之江校区举行迁址仪式，整体迁入之江校区。之江校区亦成为光华法学院驻地。
target_text: It is located at 51 River Road, West Lake District, Hangzhou City, where it was located until 1952. The University of Gojiang, a church school, was dissolved after 1952. Some of it was integrated into Zhejiang University and became a “third branch” of Zhejiang University. It is also administered by Zhejiang University.
title: 浙江大学

source_text:
舟山校区
舟山校区位于浙江省舟山市定海区临城新区惠民桥区块，项目一期工程总建筑面积19万平方米，其中地上建筑达16.8万平方米，地下建筑面积2.4万平方米。校区主要建筑有体育中心、图书馆、国际交流中心、海洋科学实验室与综合办公楼等，还有操纵性水池、消声水池、港航大厅、基础实验室平台等总计约5万方实验室面积，二期将建设400米长的高速拖曳水池。2015年9月舟山校区建成，浙江大学海洋学院搬入该校区。
target_text: The main buildings are sports centres, libraries, international exchange centres, marine science laboratories and integrated office buildings, as well as manoeuvring reservoirs, dissipated water tanks, port halls, basic laboratory platforms, etc., totalling approximately 50,000 laboratory areas, with a total of 190,000 square metres of construction on the project ' s first stage, including 168,000 square metres of construction and 24,000 square metres of underground construction. The main buildings are sports centres, libraries, international exchange centres, marine science laboratories and integrated office buildings.
title: 浙江大学

source_text: 该校区为浙大与海外多所著名大学国际化联合办学的基地，将设立若干个中外合作办学机构、交叉研究中心和成果转化机构，与世界一流大学开展教育、科研和成果转化的合作。目前，浙江大学-帝国理工学院应用数据科学联合实验室、中国学中心、浙江大学爱丁堡大学联合学院和浙江大学伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳香槟校区联合学院已正式成立，国际校区于2016年9月正式开学。
target_text: The campus, which serves as a base for joint internationalization of Zhejiang and a number of well-known universities abroad, will establish a number of China-China cooperative institutions, cross-study centres and results-transformation institutions, in cooperation with world-class universities for education, scientific research and transformation of results. At present, the Zhejiang University-England Institute of Technology Joint Laboratory for Applied Data Sciences, the China Centre of Science, the Edinburgh University Joint College of Zhejiang University and the University of Zhejiang Joint School of Champagne College of the University of Illinois have been officially opened and opened in September 2016.
title: 浙江大学

source_text: 浙江大学是一所综合型、研究型大学，其学科涵盖哲学、经济学、法学、教育学、文学、历史学、艺术学、理学、工学、农学、医学、管理学等十二个门类。学校设有7个学部、36个专业学院（系）、1个工程师学院、2个中外合作办学学院、8家附属医院。拥有一级学科国家重点学科14个，二级学科国家重点学科21个。在「双一流」建设名单中，学校入选一流大学建设高校（A类），18个学科入选一流建设学科，居全国高校第三。
target_text: Zhejiang University is an integrated, research-based university with 12 disciplines in philosophy, economics, law, education, literature, history, art, science, engineering, agrology, medicine, management, etc. The school has 7 departments, 36 professional colleges (departments), 1 engineering college, 2 schools of co-operation between China and China, and 8 affiliated hospitals. There are 14 national priority subjects in first-level disciplines and 21 national priority subjects in second-level subjects.
title: 浙江大学

source_text: 浙江大学校友两院院士有200余人。2017届毕业生初次就业率达到97.22%，本科毕业生海内外深造率达到61.97%。近年来，学校发明专利授权数、权威学术期刊论文发表数、科研总经费等主要科研指标保持全国高校领先地位，在科学技术和人文社科领域取得丰硕成果。「十二五」以来，学校作为牵头单位获得国家科技进步特等奖1项、一等奖6项、二等奖37项；《中国历代绘画大系》、《中华礼藏》、敦煌学等文化传承创新成果在海内外产生广泛影响。
target_text: In recent years, key scientific indicators, such as the number of patents granted for school inventions, the number of papers published in authoritative academic journals, and the total funding of scientific research, have maintained a leading role in higher education throughout the country and have yielded fruitful results in the fields of science and technology and humanities. Since the Twelfth Five-Year Plan, schools have received one of the State's top prizes for scientific and technological progress, six of its first prizes and 37 of its second prizes as the lead agency; and the results of cultural heritage innovations, such as the Chinese Department of Painting, the Chinese Treasure, and the Chinese Talent, have had a wide impact, both within and outside the country.
title: 浙江大学

source_text:
学部、学院（系）

拥有14个一级学科国家重点学科，21个二级学科国家重点学科。重点学科数量在全国高校中排行第六位，主要分布在理、工、农、医领域。在“双一流”建设名单中，浙大有18个学科入选一流建设学科，居全国高校第三。
target_text: At Zhejiang University, there are seven faculties, consisting of 34 colleges, six faculties and one department of teaching and scientific research, with a total of 123 undergraduates. The State has 14 priority subjects at the first level and 21 priority subjects at the second level. The number of priority subjects is the sixth in the country's higher education institutions, mainly in the fields of science, engineering, agriculture and medicine.
title: 浙江大学

title: 浙江大学

source_text:
科研机构
拥有10个国家重点实验室，1个国家工程实验室（生物饲料安全与污染防控），4个国家专业实验室，9个教育部重点实验室。此外，还有6个国家工程（技术）研究中心、3个普通高等学校人文社科重点研究基地，以及中国西部发展研究院、工业技术研究院、加州国际纳米技术研究院、中国农村发展研究院、台州研究院、数学科学研究中心、求是高等研究院、国际创新研究院、国际电磁科学院分院、沃森基因组科学研究院、生命科学研究院、水环境研究院和可持续能源研究院共计13所独立研究院。
target_text: Scientific research institutions have 10 national priority laboratories, 1 national engineering laboratory (biofeed safety and pollution prevention), 4 national specialized laboratories and 9 Ministry of Education priority laboratories. In addition, there are six national engineering (technical) research centres, three general higher education schools with a focus on humanities research bases, as well as 13 independent institutes at the China Western Institute for Development Studies, the Institute of Industrial Technology, the International Nanotech Institute of California, the China Institute of Rural Development, the Taiwan State Institute, the Centre for Mathematical Science Research, the University of Higher Studies, the International Institute of Innovation, the branch of the International Electromagnetic Academy, the Watson Genetic Science Institute, the Life Sciences Institute, the Institute of Water Environment and the Institute of Sustainable Energy.

target_text: The Zhejiang University subsidiary secondary school is the only senior secondary school attached to Zhejiang University and one of the first priority provincial secondary schools in Zhejiang province. 優美优于丑陋。明瞭优于隐晦。
简单优于复杂。复杂优于凌乱。

可读性很重要。Python開發者的方法论是“用一種方法，最好是只有一種方法來做一件事”，显著不同于以Perl语言为代表的“不止一种方法去做一件事”風格。Python開發者在設計語言時，如果面臨多種選擇，一般會選擇明確没有或者很少有歧義的語法。
target_text: Python's approach is to “do one thing in one way, preferably one way”, which is significantly different from the “more than one” style, which is expressed in Perl's language. Python's creators, when designing a language with multiple options, usually chooses a syntax that is clear or rarely discriminatory.
title: Python

source_text: 范羅蘇姆认为ABC語言非常優美和强大，它没有取得成功的原因是不開放造成的，故而将Python本身設計為可擴充的。Python並不把所有的特性和功能都集成到語言核心，而是提供了豐富的API和工具，以便程式設計師能够輕鬆地使用Python、C语言、Cython來編寫擴充模組。Python还可以通过如标准库中的ctypes等，来提供C语言兼容数据类型，并访问动态链接库或共享库中的函数，从而对用其他語言編寫的程式進行集成和封裝。
target_text: Python does not integrate all features and functions into the core of the language, but provides a wealth of API and tools so that programme designers can easily use Python, C-language, and Cython to create extended modules. Python can also provide C-compatible data types, such as ctypes in standard libraries, and access to functions in dynamic links libraries or shared libraries, so that programs written in other languages can be compiled and sealed.
title: Python

source_text: Python為了讓程式碼具備高度的可閱讀性，在設計時盡量使用了其它語言常用的符號和英文單字。Python支持使用反斜杠作为行接续符，将多个物理行合成为一个逻辑行。在圆括号、方括号或花括号之中的表达式，可以分裂跨越多于一个物理行而不使用反斜杠，这被称为“隐式行接续”。注释开始于并非一部份的一个井号#，并结束于物理行结尾；注释标示逻辑行的结束，除非已受制于隐式行接续规则；注释在语法上被忽略。简单语句包含在一个单一的逻辑行之内，Python支持使用分号作为分隔符，将多个简单语句合并入语法意义上的一行之中。
target_text: Python, in order to make the code readable highly accessible, uses as much symbols as possible in other languages and English words in its design. Python supports the use of anti-slash as a follow-up, combining several physical lines into a logical line. Expressions in brackets, square brackets or brackets can divide over more than one physical line without using an anti-slash, which is referred to as a “hidden line succession”. The notes begin with a well # not part of it and end at the end of the physical line; they indicate the end of the logical line, unless they are subject to hidden line succession rules; the notes are ignored in the syntax. Simple words are contained in a single logical line, and Python supports the use of semicolons as a separator, combining several simple words into a line in the syntax sense.
title: Python

source_text: Python语法中的复合语句，包含（成组的）其他语句；它们以某种方式影响或控制这些其他语句的执行。Python的复合语句包含一个或多个子句（clause），子句构成自一个头部（header）和一个套件（suite）。特定复合语句的子句头部都在同样的缩排层级上，每个子句头部开始于一个唯一标识关键字，并结束于一个冒号。套件是这个子句所控制的一组语句，套件有两种形式，可以是与头部在同一行上的一个或多个由分号分隔的简单语句，它们跟随在这个头部的冒号之后；或者是在后续诸行上的一个或多个缩排的语句，只有这种套件形式可以包含嵌套的复合语句。
target_text: The phrases in Python ' s syntax contain other phrases; they influence or control the execution of these other phrases in one way or another. Python ' s composite phrase consists of one or more subterms (clause), which are made up of a head (header) and a package (suite). The head of a particular complex statement is at the same indentation level, and the head of each sentence starts with a single identification key and ends with a colon. The package is a set of phrases controlled by this sub-section, and the package may take two forms, either one or more semicolons separated from the head on the same line, which follow the colon of the head, or one or more acronyms in the subsequent rows, where only the package form of the package can contain embedded composite phrases.
title: Python

source_text:
縮排
Python語言遵循越位規則，利用縮排来形成语句套件，即语法意义上的块。连续诸行的缩排层级，被用来生成语法解析器才能见到的INDENT和DEDENT记号，二者的作用相当于C语言家族的花括号，或Pascal语言家族的关键字begin和end。增加縮排就生成INDENT记号，減少縮排就生成DEDENT记号。根據PEP 8的規定，使用4個空格來表示每級縮排。
target_text: The indentation of Python language follows the overstep rule and uses the indentation to form a statement package, i.e. a block in the syntax sense. The indentation levels of successive rows are used to generate the IDENT and DEDENT signs that can only be seen by a syntax solver, which is equivalent to the brackets of the C-language family, or the Pascal-language family key begin and end. The indentation creates the INDENT mark, and the reduction of the indent creates the DEDENT mark. According to the PEP 8, four spaces are used to indicate each level of the indents.
title: Python

source_text: tab字符（从左至右）被替代为1至8个空格，使得直到tab之前的诸字符加上这些替代空格的字符总数，是8的倍数（这意图同于Unix所用规则）。前导于第一个非空白字符的空格的总数，确定了这一行的缩排层级。缩排所用诸字符，不能使用反斜杠来拆分成多个物理行；直到第一个反斜杠之前的空白确定缩排层级。如果源代码文件混合了tab和空格，并且在这种方式下缩排的意义依赖于一个tab相当于多少个空格，则这种缩排因不一致性而被报错并拒绝。
target_text: Tab characters (left to right) have been replaced with one to eight spaces, making the number of characters up to Tab plus these replacement spaces a multiple of eight (which is intended to be the same as the rule used in Unix). The number of spaces leading to the first non-blank character determines the indentation of the line. The indents used in the indentation do not divide the physical lines by using an inverted bar; the indentation level is determined until the gap before the first inverted bar. If the source code file mixes Tab and spaces and the indentation in this way depends on how many spaces a tab corresponds to, the indent is wrongly stated and rejected for lack of consistency.
title: Python

source_text: 語句Python的语句包括简单语句：赋值语句，记号为等号=。赋值语句被用来将名字绑定（含重新绑定）到值，以及用来修改可变对象的特性或项目。Python还支持增广赋值语句，将一个二元运算和一个赋值语句合并成一个单一语句，例如x += 1。Python支持“序列解包”（sequence unpacking）：在等号左侧可以是一个表达式列表，其中每个表示式都可求值成能被赋值的东西（变量、可写特性等）；在等号右侧相应的是一个“可迭代”对象，它在被迭代时产生的值的数量，同于左手侧可写表达式的数量；赋值语句对这个对象进行迭代，将产生的每个值分别赋值给左侧对应的可赋值者。在等号右侧直接包装出序列解包所要求的元组，就形成了并行赋值，可以同时给多个变量赋值，还可以交换两个变量的值。语句，用来交互式的计算并写出一个值，或者用来调用一个过程（即返回无含义结果的函数），在Python中过程返回值None。global语句，是在整个当前代码块中成立的声明，它意味着随后列出的标识符被解释为全局变量。nonlocal语句，导致随后列出的标识符，提及在除了全局作用域之外的最近包围作用域中的先前绑定变量。type语句，介入于版本3.12，声明作为类型别名类型（typing.TypeAliasType）的实例的一个类型别名。pass語句，充当NOP，表示此行為空，不執行任何操作。assert語句，用於程式調適階段時測試執行條件是否滿足。continue语句，越过这次迭代并继续进行下个项目。break语句，从循环中跳出。
target_text: Python also supports the extension statement, which combines a binary and a attributed phrase into a single phrase, e.g. x + = 1. Python supports a “sequence unpackage” (sepaence unpacking): the equivalent is a list of expressions, each of which can be given value (variable, writeable, etc.); the equivalent of the equivalent is a “interpretable” object, the number of values that it produces when it is replaced is the same as the number of expressions on the left hand. Python supports a “sequence unpackage” (segrete unpacing): The value of each of the words is a list of words that can be given to the different types of variables that are removed from the other ones.

source_text: return语句，用来从函数返回值。当函数执行到return语句时，它会停止执行并将指定的值返回给调用者。raise语句，抛出一个异常。yield语句，使用它从一个生成器中返回一个值。在版本2.5之前，信息只能单向的从生成器传递出来。自此版本2.5，重定义yield为表达式，通过它的返回值将信息传递进入生成器函数中，从而能够支持协程功能。自从版本3.3，提供了yield from语句，含有这个语句的“委托生成器”将其部份运算委托给另一个“子生成器”，将传入信息递送给它并直接回传它产生的值。yield语句在语义上等价于加圆括号的yield表达式。版本3.4在异步I/O框架中扩展了基于生成器的协程，这个扩展自从Python 3.8已经被弃用。版本3.6介入了异步生成器。import语句，导入一个模块或包，它组合了两种操作，查找指名的模块，接着将找到的结果绑定到在局部作用域中的名字。导入语句有三种形式：import 模块名字 [as 别名]，找到一个模块，装载它，如果有需要的话初始化它；在这个导入语句出现的作用域的局部名字空间中，定义一个名字或一些名字。from 模块名字 import 定义1 [as 别名1], 定义2 [as 别名2], ...，找到、装载、必需时初始化一个模块；接着在局部名字空间中，增加到找到指名特性的引用。（这二个语句示例中的方括号表示其中内容为可选的。）from 模块名字 import *，在导入语句出现的作用域的局部名字空间中，绑定模块中定义的所有公开的名字。del语句，递归的进行删除。复合语句：

source_text: if語句，當條件成立時執行語句套件。它經常包含elif、else子句。while語句，當條件為真時，重複執行語句套件。for語句，遍历列表、字符串、字典、集合等迭代器，依次處理迭代器中的每個元素。match语句，用于模式匹配。語句，它经常包含except、else、finally子句，處理在程式執行中出现的異常情況。Python支持并广泛使用异常处理，作为检测错误状况和程序中其他“异常”事件的方式，并提倡在可能出现错误状况的任何时候都使用异常。习惯上访问一个文件或资源不在使用之前进行测试，而是先行尝试使用它，再捕获访问被拒绝引发的异常。with語句，把一块代码包裹在一个上下文管理器之内。它允许了资源获取即初始化（RAII）式行为，可替代常见的try/finally惯用法。Python使用with语句处理资源，在进入一个作用域的时候调用一个函数，而在离开它的时候调用另一个函数，例如：在一块代码执行之前获取一个锁，并且在此后释放这个锁；或事先打开一个文件，并且事后关闭它。class語句，是定义类的可执行语句。类的继承列表给出基础类列表，没有继承列表的类，缺省继承基础类object。类的套件接着在新的执行框架（frame）中执行，它使用新建的局部名字空间和原来的全局名字空间。当这个类套件完成执行之时，丢弃它的执行框架并保存它的局部名字空间。一个类对象接着被创建，其基础类采用继承列表，其特性字典采用保存的局部名字空间。

source_text: 类名字接着在原来的局部名字空间中，被绑定到这个类对象。def語句，是定義函數和方法的可执行语句。它的执行在当前局部名字空间中，将函数名字绑定到一个函数对象（对函数的可执行代码的包装器）。这个函数对象包含到当前全局名字空间的引用，作为调用这个函数时使用的全局名字空间。async def语句，用于协程函数定义。await表达式、async for语句和async with语句，只能用在协程函数的主体中。
target_text: class name is then bound to this class object in the original local name space. The def statement is an executable statement of the defined function and method. In the current local name space, the function name is tied to a function object (a packaging of the executable code for the function). This function object is included in the reference to the current global name space as the global name space to be used when calling for the function. The async def statement is used to define the serial function.
title: Python

source_text: 模块是包含Python定义和语句的一个文件，这个文件名字是模块名字附加上后缀.py；在一个模块中，模块的名字（作为字符串）可获得为全局变量__name__的值。内建globals()函数，返回实现当前模块名字空间的字典。内建dir()函数，在无参数时，返回在当前局部作用域内的名字列表；在有一个参数时，尝试返回这个对象的有效特性的列表。包（package）是可以包含子模块或递归的子包的模块。包在技术上是具有__path__特性的Python模块。可以将包视为文件系统上的目录，而将模块视为这种目录中的文件，但是包和模块不必然源自文件系统。
target_text: Module is a document that contains Python definitions and statements, a file name that is attached to the name of the module.py; in a module, the name of the module (as a string) can be obtained as the value of the global variable _name_. The globals() function is built in to return the dictionary that gives the current module name space. The in-built dir() function returns the list of names in the current local field when no parameter exists; and the list of valid properties of the object is attempted to return when there is a parameter. The package (package) can be a module that contains submodules or relay packages. The package is technically a Python module with __path_ characteristics. The package can be viewed as a directory on the file system and the module as a document in this directory, but the package and the module are not necessarily derived from the file system.
title: Python

source_text: Python程序构造自代码块。代码块是作为一个单元执行的Python程序文本。模块、函数主体和类定义都是块。交互式键入的每个命令都是块。脚本文件和脚本命令是代码块。__main__是顶层代码运行所在的环境。“顶层代码”是启动运行的首个用户指定Python模块。从命令行使用-m参数，作为顶层脚本运行的模块（作为模块__main__）也是代码块。此时__name__变量被设置为"__main__"，在这个模块中可籍此增加直接运行时候执行的代码。传递给内建函数eval()和exec()执行的字符串是代码块。
target_text: The Python program constructs its own code block. The code block is a Python program text that is executed as a unit. The modules, function subjects and class definitions are blocks. Each command entered interactively is a block. Script files and script commands are blocks. _main_ are the environment in which the top-level code runs. " Top-level code" is the first user to assign the Python module to start running. Using the command line-m parameter, the module that operates as a top-level script (as a module _main_) is also a code block.
title: Python

source_text: 在Python中赋值所进行的操作，是将一个名字绑定为到一个分立的动态分配的对象的一个引用。名字是通用的引用持有者，它不关联于一个固定的数据类型，但是，一个名字在给定时间，总是被绑定到有一个类型的某个对象上，这就是动态类型的特征。名字的存储位置不“包含”所指示的值，一个共同的值可以赋值给多个名字，一个名字在任何时候，都可以重新绑定到各种不同类型的对象上，包括字符串、过程、具有数据和方法的复杂对象等。
target_text: The operation of a value in Python is a reference that binds a name to a separate dynamic assigned object. The name is a generic reference holder, which is not associated with a fixed data type, but a name that is always tied to an object of a type at the given time, which is the characteristic of a dynamic type. The storage location of a name does not “include” the values indicated, a common value can be assigned to multiple names, and a name can at any time be rebound to a variety of different objects, including strings, processes, complex objects with data and methods, etc.
title: Python

source_text: 除了在块中出现的每个赋值语句或导入语句之外，下列构造也绑定名字：给函数的形式参数、类定义、函数定义、赋值表达式、在for语句头部中和各种as关键字之后的标识符目标（target），as关键字出现在import语句、with语句、except子句、except*子句和结构式模式匹配的as模式之中。如果一个名字绑定在一个块中，它是这个块的局部变量，除非被声明为nonlocal或global。如果一个名字绑定在模块层次，它是全局变量；模块代码块的变量，既是局部的也是全局的。如果一个变量使用在一个代码块中，却不定义在这里，它是自由变量。
target_text: In addition to each given or imported statement that appears in a block, the following constructions bind a name: form parameters for a function, class definitions, function definitions, attribute expression, identifier target (target) in the head of a for statement and after various ass keywords, as the key is found in an import statement, with statement, except sub-term, except* sub-term and structural mode matching ass mode. If a name is tied in a block, it is a local variable of the block, unless it is declared to be nonglobal or global. If a name is tied to a module level, it is a global variable; the variable of a module code block is both local and global. If a variable is used in a code block, it is not defined here as a free variable.
title: Python

source_text: 作用域定义一个名字在一个块中的可见性。如果一个局部变量被定义在一个块中，它的作用域包括这个块。如果这个定义出现在一个函数块中，作用域扩展到在所界定作用域内包含的任何块，除非所包含的块为这个名字介入了不同的绑定。当一个名字在一个代码块之中使用，它采用最近包围作用域来解析。对一个代码块可见的所有这种作用域的集合，叫做这个这个块的“环境”。如果一个名字绑定在一个块中，并且在其中于绑定之前就被使用，会导致一个错误。
target_text: The field of action defines the visibility of a name in a block. If a local variable is defined in a block, the field of action includes this block. If the definition appears in a function block, the field of action extends to any block contained in a defined field, unless the name is involved in a different binding. When a name is used in a code block, it uses the most recent encirclement field to interpret it. The collection of all this area of action visible in a code block is called the " environment " of this block. If a name is tied to a block and used before it is tied, it leads to an error.

The name is parsed in the top name space, first searching for the global name space, i.e. the name space of the module that contains the code block; there is no attempt to find the built-in name space, i.e. the name space of the module bultins. The global statement has the same field of action as the name binding operation in the same block. If a free variable's recently surrounded domain contains one of its global phrases, this free variable is considered global. The nonlocal phrase leads to the corresponding name, referring to the previous binding variable (i.e., in the recently surrounded function field.

source_text: 在Python中，由逗号,分隔的一组表达式，叫做表达式列表。Python为构造列表、字典或集合，提供了叫做“显示”的特殊语法，它们每个都有两种方式：包容内容要么显式列举出来；要么通过一组循环和过滤指令计算而来，这叫做“推导式”。列表显示是包围在方括号中的可以为空的一系列表达式，一个例子列表可写为[1,2,3]。字典显示是包围在花括号中的可能为空的一系列的键/数据项对。集合显示用花括号来指示，与字典显示的区别是缺少分隔键与值的分号。自从Python 3.5，增加了在表达式列表中的“可迭代解包”*，和在字典显示中的“字典解包”**。
target_text: In Python, a set of expressions separated by commas is called expression lists. Python provides a special syntax called "Showing" for construction lists, dictionaries or pools, each of which has two ways: inclusion is either explicitly listed; or is calculated by a set of loops and filter commands, which are called "promotable." The list shows a series of expressions surrounded in square brackets that can be empty, and the list of examples can be written [1,2,3]. The dictionary shows a series of keys/data entries that can be empty in brackets. The combination shows instructions in brackets, and the difference from the dictionary is the difference between the missing dividing key and the value. Since Python 3.5, the list of expressions has been expanded with the "interrogated package"* and the "verbal package"** in the dictionary.

source_text: 在Python中，加圆括号形式（parenthesized form），是包围在圆括号中的一个可选表达式列表。加圆括号的表达式列表产生的东西，就是这个表达式列表所产生的：如果这个列表包含至少一个逗号，它产生一个元组；否则它产生构成这个表达式列表的那个单一表达式。一个例子元组可写为(1,2,3)。元组不是圆括号形成的，而是使用逗号形成的，在没有歧义的情况下，元组的圆括号是可选的。空的圆括号对产生空元组对象。使用序列串接算符+来串接二个元组，产生包含给定元组二者的元素的一个新元组。
target_text: In Python, the bracketed form (parenthesized form) is a list of optional expressions that surrounds the brackets. The list of expressions in parentheses generates what is created by this list of expressions: if the list contains at least one comma, it produces a group; otherwise it produces the single expression that makes the list of expressions. An example is (1,2,3) when the arrays are not formed by brackets, but rather by commas, which, without any ambiguity, are optional. The blank brackets produce empty group objects. Using the serial number + to string two groups, they produce a new array of elements that contain both.

source_text: Python支持在序列对象（比如字符串、元组或列表）上的下标（subscription）表达式：a[索引]，和表达式：a[开始:停止]或a[开始:停止:步长]。下标索引是基于零的，负数是相对于结尾的。分片范围自从“开始”索引，直到但不包括“停止”索引。分片的第三个参数叫做“步长”（step）或“间隔”（stride），允许元素被跳过和用负数指示反向。分片索引可以省略，例如a[:]，这返回整个列表的一个复本。分片的每个元素都是的。
target_text: Python supports the subscript (subscription) expression on a sequence object (e.g. string, array or list): a [index], and expression: a [start: stop] or a [start: stop: step long]. The subscript index is based on zero and negative numbers are relative to the end. The split range has been " start " indexed since the beginning, but does not include " stop " indexes. The third parameter of the sub-section is called " step length " or " interval " (stride), allowing elements to skip and reverse with negative indicators. The sub-index can be omitted, e.g. a[:], which returns a copy of the entire list. Each element of the sub-section is all.

source_text: 自从Python 3.8，介入了赋值表达式，其记号是:=。它将一个表达式赋值给一个标识符，同时还返回这个表达式的值。赋值表达式在用作子表达式，即位于分片表达式、条件表达式、lambda表达式、关键字参数中的表达式和推导式中的if表达式之中，以及在assert和with语句之中的时候，必须围绕着圆括号。在它们可以使用的所有其他地方，包括在if和while语句之中，都不要求圆括号。
target_text: Since Python 3.8 has been involved in the attribute expression, which is marked as: =. It assigns an expression to an identifier and returns the value of the expression. The attribute expression is used as a sub-expression, i.e., an expression in the split expression, a conditional expression, a Rambda expression, a key word parameter, and an if expression in the key word, as well as in the assert and with phrases, it must be surrounded by brackets. source_text:
函数
Python的函数支持递归和闭包
，及其他头等函数特征，但不支持函数重载。Python的函数作为头等对象，具有和普通对象平等的地位。Python官方实现不提供尾调用优化或头等续体，吉多·范罗苏姆曾声称永远都不会加以支持，目前只有第三方库支持。Python可以在函数定义时，于形式参数序列中，指定形式参数的缺省值，即以param=value样式进行一次性初始化。形式参数在初始化之后，保持既有绑定；函数的后续调用，可继续对它进行访问或变更。为有缺省值的形式参数提供实际参数，在函数调用时是可选的。
target_text: Function Python 's function supports relativity and closures, and other first-class feature features, but does not support reloading. Python 's function, as a first-level object, has a status equal to that of an ordinary object. Python ' s official achievement does not provide end-of-call optimization or first-class extension, which Guido van Roussom claimed would never support, and is currently supported only by a third-party library. Python can define the function by specifying the default value of the formal parameter, i.e. a one-time initialization of the formal parameter in the format param=value style. The formal parameter remains bound after initialization; the subsequent call of the function can continue to access or change it. The actual parameter for the form parameter with default values is optional when the function is used.

source_text: Python的函数实际参数与形式参数之间的结合，是传递“对象引用”，函数在被调用的时候，给函数调用的实际参数，被介入到一个局部符号表中，实际参数使用传值调用来传递，而这个值总是对象引用，而非这个对象的值。如果形式参数绑定到一个可变的对象，则通过形式参数对此对象内容的修改，在函数外也是可见的。如果形式参数绑定到一个不可变的对象，则通过形式参数是不能修改此对象内容，但可以把形式参数重新绑定到其它对象上，这并不影响函数外的对象的值。
target_text: The combination of the actual parameters of Python ' s function and the formal parameters is the transfer of the " object reference " , when the function is called, the actual parameters that are called to the function are involved in a local symbol table, where the actual parameter is passed using the pass-through call, which is always the reference of the object rather than the value of the object. If the formal parameter is tied to a variable object, the modification of the object ' s content is visible outside the function by the formal parameter. If the formal parameter is tied to an object that is immutable, the formal parameter is not capable of modifying the object ' s content, but it can be rebound to another object, which does not affect the value of the object outside the function.

source_text: 在位置和关键字形式参数序列末尾，可以分别有*args或**kwargs这样的形式参数，它们对应于在函数调用时提供的，超出形式参数序列规定而无所对应的多个实际参数；在形式参数名字前加一个*号，该形式参数args是tuple类型，对应可变数目的位置实际参数；在形式参数名字前加**号，该形式参数kwargs是dict类型，对应可变数目的关键字实际参数。如果位置实际参数已经在一个序列类型如列表或元组的对象中，在引用它的变量前加一个*号传递给函数，则其中所有元素解包为多个位置实际参数；如果关键字实际参数在字典中，则加**号来传递给函数。
target_text: At the end of the position and key word form parameter series, there can be formal parameters such as *args or **kwargs, which should be provided when the function is called, and which exceed the formal parameter series without the corresponding number of actual parameters; at the end of the form parameter name, add an * number to the form parameter, which is the type that corresponds to the variable number of physical parameters; at the end of the form parameter name, add ** to the form parameter, which is the dict type, which corresponds to the variable number of key words; and at the end of the form parameter, add ** to the function if the physical parameter is already in the object of a sequence type, such as the list or array, plus an * number to the function before the variable is cited, all elements of which are disassembleded to the actual number of positions; and at the end of the form parameter is in the dictionary, add ** to the function.

source_text:
修饰器（decorator）可用来修改一个函数、方法或类定义的任何可调用Python对象。将已定义的原来对象传递给修饰器，它返回一个修改后的对象，接着把它绑定到在定义中那个名字。Python修饰器部份受到Java注解的影响，而有类似的语法；修饰器语法是纯粹的语法糖，使用@作为关键字形成修饰符。修饰器是一种形式的元编程，它们增强它们所修饰的函数或方法的行动。
多个修饰器可以链接起来，通过在毗连的行上放置多个修饰符，或者使用中间变量。
函数修饰器的正规用法包括：用来建立类方法或静态方法、设置先决条件和后置条件、实现多方法、增加函数特性、、同步；此外更远大的用法包括：尾调用消除、记忆化。
target_text: The modifier (decorator) can be used to modify any python object that is defined as a function, method or class. The original object that has been defined is passed to the modifier, which returns to a modified object and binds it to that name in the definition. The Python modifier is partly influenced by Java's annotation and has a similar syntax; the modifier syntax is pure syntax sugar, using @ as a keyword to form a modifier. The modifier is a form of metaprogram that enhances the function or method that they have modifier.
title: Python

source_text: 为了增强代码的可读性，可以在函数后书写“文档字符串”（简称docstrings），用于解释函数的作用、参数的类型与意义、返回值类型与取值范围等。可以使用内置函数help()，打印出函数的使用帮助。自从Python 3.0，函数可以对参数与返回值增加类型标注。此特性可方便对源代码进行更深入的分析。自从Python 3.5，开始支持类型提示。
target_text: To enhance the readability of the code, you can write " Document Strings " (docstrings) after the function to explain the role of the function, the type and significance of the parameter, the type of return value and the range of the value taken, etc.. You can use the built-in function help. Since Python 3.0, the function can label the parameter and the type of value added returned. This feature facilitates a more in-depth analysis of the source code. Since Python 3.5, type tips are supported.

source_text: Python使用鸭子类型，并拥有有类型的对象，和无类型的变量名字。在编译期不检查类型约束，而宁愿在一个对象上的操作出现可能的失败，表现出这个给定对象不具有适合的类型。尽管是动态类型系统，Python却是强类型的，禁止没有明确定义的操作（比如加一个数到一个字符串），而不是默默的去尝试转换使其有意义。Python支持广泛的类型和类的内省。类型是type的实例，可以被读取和比较。

It does not check the type of constraint during the compilation period, but prefers the possible failure of an operation on an object to show that the given object does not have the appropriate type. Although it is a dynamic type system, Python is a strong type and prohibits operations that are not clearly defined (e.g. by adding a number to a string), rather than attempting to convert to make sense. source_text: Python有着范围广泛的基本数据类型。同时具备常规的整数和浮点算术，它透明的支持任意精度算术、复数和。Python支持种类繁多的字符串操作。在Python中，字符串是不可变的，所以在其他编程语言中可能就地改变字符串的字符串操作，比如字符替换，在Python中返回新的字符串。

With conventional integer and floating point algorithms, it is transparent in supporting any kind of precision algorithm, complex numbers and. Python supports a wide variety of string operations. source_text: Python有一个非常有用特征，就是搜集（或称容器）类型的概念。一般的说，搜集是以一种易于引用或索引的方式，包含其他对象的对象。搜集有二种基本形式：序列和映射。Python对建立容器类型的对象有着语法上的支持。Python还提供了广泛的搜集操纵能力，比如内建的包含元素检查和通用迭代协议。
target_text: Python has a very useful feature, which is the concept of collecting (or packaging) types. Generally, gathering contains objects for other objects in a manner that can be easily quoted or indexed. There are two basic forms of gathering: sequence and mapping. Python has syntax support for creating objects of a container type. Python also provides extensive collection manipulation capabilities, such as built-in elements checks and generic overlap protocols.

source_text: 有次序的序列类型是列表（动态）、元组和字符串。所有序列类型都是位置索引的（从0到长度−1），并且除了字符串，都可以包含任意类型的对象，在同一个序列中包括多种类型的对象。字符串和元组是不可变的，使得它们成为字典的键的完美候选者。在另一方面，列表是可变的，元素可以被插入、删除、修改、添加或就地排序。
target_text: Ordered sequence types are lists (dynamic), clusters and strings. All series types are indexed with a location (from 0 to 0 to −1) and can contain any type of object, including multiple types of object in the same sequence, except for string. Strings and arrays are immutable, making them perfect candidates for dictionaries. On the other hand, the list is variable, and elements can be inserted, deleted, modified, added or sorted locally.

source_text: 在另一方面，映射是以“字典”形式实现的无次序的类型，它将一组不可变的键，映射到相应的元素上（非常像数学函数）。在字典中的键，必须是不可变的Python类型，比如整数或字符串，因为在底层它们是通过散列函数实现的。字典还是语言内部的中心，因为它们居于所有Python对象和类的核心：在变量名字（字符串）和这个名字所引用的值之间的映射，就存储为字典，而这些字典可以通过对象的__dict__特性直接访问。
target_text: On the other hand, the map is an unordered type in the form of a dictionary, which maps a set of variable keys to the corresponding element (very like a mathematical function). In the dictionary, the key must be an immutable Python type, such as an integer or a string, because at the bottom they are achieved by a hash function. The dictionary is also the centre of the language, because they are at the core of all Python objects and classes: the map between the variable name (strings) and the values cited by the name is stored in the dictionary, which can be accessed directly through the object's __dictation.

Python的算术运算，使用平常的符号+、-、*、/和模除%（这里的余数可以是负数，比如4 % -3 == -2）。它还有下取整除法算符//，指数算符**，比如5**3 == 125及9**0.5 == 3.0，和矩阵乘法算符@。这些算符就像在传统数学中一样运算，具有同样的优先级规则，中缀算符+、-，还可以分别表示取原数和取相反数的一元算符。

Python allows a boolean expression linked by a comparative calculation, as is commonly used in mathematics. For example, expression a < b < c, test a < b and b < c. source_text: 带宽（）指信号所占据的频带-{}-宽度；在被用来描述信道时，带宽是指能够有效通过该信道的信号的最大频带-{}-宽度。对于模拟信号而言，带寬又称为频寬，以赫兹（Hz）为单位。例如模拟语音电话的信号带宽为3100Hz（从300Hz到3400Hz），一个PAL-D电视频道的带宽为8MHz（含保护带宽）。对于数字信号而言，带宽是指单位时间内链路能够通过的数据量。例如ISDN的B信道带宽为64Kbps。由于数字信号的传输是通过模拟信号的调制完成的，为了与模拟带宽进行区分，数字信道的带宽一般直接用波特率或符号率来描述。
target_text: Bandwidth () means the band-{}-width of the signal; when used to describe the channel, bandwidth means the maximum frequency-{}-width that can effectively pass through the signal of the channel. For analogue signals, bandwidth is also called frequency-wide and is expressed in Hertz (Hz). For example, analogue voice calls have a signal bandwidth of 3100Hz (from 300Hz to 3400Hz) and a PAL-D television channel has a bandwidth of 8MHz (including protective bandwidth). For digital signals, bandwidth refers to the amount of data that a chain can pass within a unit time. For example, ISDN's B-band bandwidth is 64Kbps. Since digital signals are transmitted by analogue signal mode, the bandwidth of a digital channel is generally described directly by port or symbol rates for the purpose of distinguishing between analogue bandwidths.
title: 带宽

source_text:
带宽在信息论、无线电、通信、信号处理和波谱学等领域都是一个核心概念。解释
带宽在许多应用中都是一个关键的概念。例如在无线电通信中，带宽是调制载波占据的频率范围，然而在光学中带宽是单个谱线宽度或者整个频谱范围。对于不同的应用领域有不同的精确定义。例如，其中一个带宽定义就是超出范围的频率函数为零的频率范围。这就对应于数学概念中的函数，例如函数不是零的所有值的“长度”。
target_text: Bandwidth is a core concept in the fields of information theory, radio, communication, signal processing, and spectrometry. Interpretation of bandwidth is a key concept in many applications. In radio communications, for example, bandwidth is the frequency range occupied by modem waves, yet bandwidth in optics is the width of individual spectral lines or the spectrum range as a whole. There are different precise definitions for different fields of application. For example, one of the bandwidth definitions is the frequency range of zero frequency functions that go beyond the range. This corresponds to functions in mathematical concepts, such as the “length” of all values in which the function is not zero.
title: 带宽

source_text: 另外一些定义可能没有那么严格，它们丢弃了频率函数“很小”的信号频率。很小可能是意味着它的值在最大值 3 dB 以下，也就是最大值的一半（半能點）以下；也可能是小于某一个绝对值。由于函数的宽度有各种各样的定义，带宽的定义也就多种多样，分别用于不同的系统。
target_text: Other definitions may be less stringent, and they discard the signal frequency of the frequency function "small" . Very small may mean that its value is below the maximum value of 3 dB, i.e. less than half the maximum value, or less than one absolute value. Because the width of the function is defined in a variety of ways, bandwidth is defined in a variety of different systems.
title: 带宽

source_text: 根据Shannon-Hartley 定理，可靠通信的数据速率直接与通信所用信号频率范围成比例。在这篇文章中，带宽一词有时用来表示数据速率，有时也表示通信系统的频率范围，有时同时表示两个概念。在心理学上，带宽就是心智的容量，包括两种能力，分别为认知能力和执行控制力。
target_text: According to Shannon-Hartley ' s theory, the data rate of reliable communications is directly proportional to the frequency range of the signals used to communicate. In this article, the word bandwidth is sometimes used to indicate the rate of data, sometimes the frequency range of the communication system, and sometimes both concepts. In psychology, bandwidth is the mental capacity, including both cognitive capacity and executive control.
title: 带宽

source_text: 对于在数学上可以看作时间函数的模拟信号来说，带宽是以赫兹为单位、信号的傅里叶变换不为0的频率范围。这个定义也可以不严格地定义为在频域内信号的傅里叶变换功率在一个特定门限之上、例如与最大值差在 3dB 的范围之内的频率范围。信号带宽是信号随着时间波动速度的一个度量，这样，带宽越大，信号的变化越快。上面是信号带宽的描述，带宽也可以用于系统。在表示系统带宽的时候，系统带宽是系统传递函数带宽的简称。
target_text: For analogue signals that can be mathematically regarded as time functions, bandwidth is a frequency range in Hertz and the signal's Fourier variant is not zero. This definition can also be loosely defined as the frequency range of the Fourier conversion power of the signal in the frequency range above a given threshold, for example, the range of 3dB with the maximum value. Signal bandwidth is a measure of the speed of the signal over time, so that the bandwidth changes faster. It is a description of the signal bandwidth, and the bandwidth can also be used for the system. When indicating the system bandwidth, the system bandwidth is the acronym of the system's transfer function bandwidth.
title: 带宽

source_text: 实数基带系统既有负频率又有正频率这样一种现实可能使带宽变得易于混淆，因为有时带宽仅仅用来表示正的一半，例如偶尔可以看到这样的表示 ，其中 是总的带宽， 是正的带宽，如果需要为这个信号设计一个低通滤波器，那么截止频率至少要保证 不受影响。
target_text: The reality that the actual base band system has both negative and positive frequencies may make bandwidth more confusing, because sometimes the bandwidth is only half the positive, as can be seen from time to time, which is the overall bandwidth, the positive bandwidth, and if there is a need to design a low-access filter for this signal, the cut-off frequency should at least be assured that it is not affected.

source_text: 电子滤波器带宽是频率响应在峰值中心频率响应差在 3dB 范围内的频率部分。在信号处理和控制理论中，带宽是闭环控制系统增益衰减到 −3dB 的频率。在基础电路理论中带通和带阻滤波器的带宽表示频域中信号强度是最大信号强度 的两个频率之间的距离。
target_text: Electronic filter bandwidth is the frequency part of the frequency response difference within 3dB at the centre of the peak. In signal processing and control theory, bandwidth is the frequency of the closed ring control system to decrease to -3dB. In basic circuit theory, the signal strength in the bandwidth area with the filter is the distance between the two frequencies with the maximum signal strength.

source_text:
在光子学中，带宽有不同的含义：
某些光源输出的带宽，例如ASE光源或者激光；超短光脉冲的带宽可能非常宽广
光纤等一些元件能够传输的频率范围宽度
光学放大器的增益带宽
其它现象的范围（例如，反射、非线性过程的相位匹配、或者谐振）
光学调制器的最大调制频率或者调制频率范围
一些测量仪器（如功率计）能够工作的频率范围
光学通信系统能够达到的数据速率（例如 Gbit/s）
target_text: In optical science, bandwidth has different meanings: the bandwidth of certain light-source outputs, such as ASE light sources or lasers; the bandwidth of ultra-short-ray pulses may be very wide; the width of the frequency range that some components, such as fibre optics, can transmit; the width of the profit band of optical amplifiers; the range of other phenomena (e.g., reflective, non-linear process phase matching, or symmetry); the maximum modem frequency of optical modems or the frequency range of modems; the frequency range that some measurement instruments (e.g. power meters) can work; the data speeds that optical communication systems can achieve (e.g. Gbit/s);
title: 带宽

source_text:
數位系統
在數位通訊系統中，頻寬有兩種含義。從技術意義上來說，它是波特率的俗稱，波特率是系統傳輸數據符號的速度；口語中它也用來表示頻道容量，頻道容量是系統能夠傳輸數據的速度（參見Shannon Limit）。這樣，有32 條獨立數據線的66MHz 數位匯流排可以恰當地說成是66MHz 頻寬、2.1Gbit/s 的數據傳輸能力，但是對於匯流排“頻寬2.1Gbit/s”這樣一種說法這也不應感到奇怪。對於模擬的數據機來說也有同樣的問題，對它來說，每個符號攜帶多位的訊息所以通過頻寬12kHz 的電話線 能夠傳輸56kbit/s 的訊息。
target_text: Digital systems have two meanings in digital communication systems. Technically, it is the popular word for Portrate, which is the speed of system transfer data symbols; it is also used to indicate channel capacity, which is the speed at which the system can transmit data (see Shannon Limit). In this way, the 66 MHz stream of 32 standalone data lines can properly be described as 66 MHz bandwidth, 2.1 Gbit/s digital transmission capacity, but it should not be surprising that it is used to describe the current platoon as “2.1 Gbit/s”. There are similar problems with analogue numbers, for which each symbol carries a multi-digit message, and can transmit 56 kbit/s messages via 12 kHz.
title: 带宽

source_text:
在離散時間系統和數位訊號處理中，根據Nyquist-Shannon 採樣定理頻寬與採樣率有關。頻寬也用於日常生活中用表示某些有限的或者花費金錢的東西。這樣，通信消耗頻寬，不合理地使用其它人的頻寬可以稱為bandwidth theft。網路服務
一些主机服务商会给带宽以不同的含义。在这里，带宽几乎变成一个單位時間內的流量概念。意思是單位時間內的下行数据总量。意味着如果一个公司提供每月2GB的带宽，意思就是用户每月最多只能下载2GB的内容。
target_text: In separated time systems and digital signals processing, the frequency is also used to indicate certain limited or expensive items in daily life. Thus, the frequency of communications is called Bandwidth Theft, and the unreasonable use of other people's bandwidth can be called Bandwidth Theft. Some hosts give different meanings to bandwidth. Here, bandwidth becomes almost a unit time flow concept. This means total downtime data in unit time. If a company provides a band of two GBs per month, it means that a user can download only two GBs per month at most.

source_text: 信息论（）是应用数学、電子學和计算机科学的一个分支，涉及信息的量化、存储和通信等。信息论是由克劳德·香农发展，用来找出信号处理与通信操作的基本限制，如数据压缩、可靠的存储和数据传输等。自创立以来，它已拓展应用到许多其他领域，包括统计推断、自然语言处理、密码学、神经生物学、进化论和分子编码的功能、生态学的模式选择、热物理、量子计算、语言学、剽窃检测、模式识别、异常检测和其他形式的数据分析。
target_text: Information theory () is a branch of applied mathematics, electron science and computer science, dealing with the quantification, storage and communication of information. Information theory is developed by Claude Shannon to identify basic limitations in signal processing and communication operations, such as data compression, reliable storage and data transmission. Since its creation, it has been extended to many other areas, including statistical extrapolation, natural language processing, cryptology, neurobiology, evolutionary and molecular code functions, econometric model selection, thermal physics, quantum computing, linguistics, theft testing, mode recognition, unusual detection and other forms of data analysis.
title: 信息论

source_text: 熵是信息的一个关键度量，通常用一条消息中需要存储或传输一个的平均比特数来表示。熵衡量了预测随机变量的值时涉及到的不确定度的量。例如，指定擲硬幣的结果（两个等可能的结果）比指定掷骰子的结果（六个等可能的结果）所提供的信息量更少（熵更少）。
target_text: The entropy is a key measure of information, usually expressed in an average bit of information that needs to be stored or transmitted. The entropy measures the degree of uncertainty involved in predicting the value of a random variable. For example, the results specified for the coin (two or more possible) are less informative than the results specified for the dice (six or so).
title: 信息论

source_text:
一种简洁的语言（以英语为例）通常有两个重要特点：
首先，最常用的词（比如"a"、"the"、"I"）应该比不太常用的词（比如"benefit"、"generation"、"mediocre"）要短一些；其次，如果句子的某一部分被漏听或者由于噪声干扰（比如一辆车辆疾驰而过）而被误听，听者应该仍然可以抓住句子的大概意思。而如果把电子通信系统比作一种语言的话，这种健壮性（）是不可或缺的。将健壮性引入通信是通过信道编码完成的。信源编码和信道编码是信息论的基本研究课题。
target_text: A simple language (in English, for example) usually has two important features: first, the most commonly used words (e.g. "a", "the", "I") should be shorter than the less commonly used words (e.g. "benefit", "generation", "metiocre"); and secondly, if a part of the sentence is misheard or misheard because of noise disturbances (e.g., a car races), the listener should still be able to grasp the presumably meaning of the sentence. If electronic communication systems are compared to a language, this robustness () is indispensable.
title: 信息论

source_text: 注意这些内容同消息的重要性之间是毫不相干的。例如，像“多谢；常来”这样的客套话與像“救命”这样的紧急请求在说起来、或者写起来所花的时间是差不多的，然而明显后者更重要，也更有实在意义。信息论却不考虑一段消息的重要性或内在意义，因为这些是数据的质量的问题而不是数据量（数据的长度）和可读性方面上的问题，后者只是由概率这一因素单独决定的。
target_text: Attention to these elements is irrelevant to the importance of the message. For example, words such as “thank you; often” and urgent requests such as “help” take the same amount of time to speak, or write, but the latter is clearly more important and meaningful. Information theory does not take into account the importance or intrinsic significance of a message, since these are questions of data quality rather than data quantity (the length of data) and readability, which are determined by probabilities alone.
title: 信息论
