source_text: 湖南农业大学，簡稱湖南农大、湘农，是一所位于中华人民共和国湖南省长沙市芙蓉区的公办全日制本科高等院校。行政上由湖南省人民政府举办，并由中华人民共和国农业部和湖南省人民政府共建。学校自称肇始于1903年創建的修业学堂，歷經中华民国、中华人民共和国时期的改制變遷，在1951年院系調整后成立湖南农学院，并于1994年2月更名為湖南农业大学，延續至今。
target_text: The Hunan Agricultural University, which is known as Hunan Rural People’s Republic of China, is a full-time undergraduate college located in the Furong District of Hunan Province, Governor of the People’s Republic of China. It was run by the Hunan Province People’s Government and built jointly by the Hunan Province of China’s Ministry of Agriculture and the Hunan Province People’s Government. The school claims to have set up a college of applied sciences that began in 1903, was transformed by the Republic of China and the People’s Republic of China, and established the Hunan College of Agriculture following the reorganization of the Faculty in 1951 and was renamed Hunan Agricultural University in February 1994, and has continued to this day.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 湖南农业大学下设系所有着显著的农业特色，但也涵蓋了文學、管理學、經濟學、法學等學科，逐步实现了多學科的協調發展；建立了學士、碩士、博士完整的學位授權體系，该校在农业科学、植物与动物科学、生态环境学等领域的學術研究實力也居於中國領先地位，為一所學科門類齊全的綜合性、研究型的农业类大學。該校為還是中國恢復招收研究生制度後，湖南省最早招收研究生的高等院校之一。其培育的多个农作物、牲畜新品种以及相应的技术成果也在中国国内得到了一定推广。學校已经被中華人民共和國國家發展和改革委員會與中華人民共和國教育部列入國家「中西部高校基礎能力建設工程」高校，也是湖南省「國內一流大學」建設高校。
target_text: The Hunan University of Agriculture has a department with all its outstanding agricultural features, but it also covers such subjects as literature, management, economics, law, and so forth, and has gradually made progress in the development of polytechnics; it has established a full degree-granting department for baccalaureate, baccalaureate, and doctoral studies in the fields of agricultural sciences, plant and animal sciences, and eco-environmentals, which is also in China’s vanguard, and is an all-embracing, research-oriented and agricultural university. After the university resumed its post-graduate programme in China, it was one of the first institutions of higher learning in Hunan Province.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 据浙江大学教授田正平等人考证，湖南农业大学的历史可以追溯至清光緒二十九年（1903年）成立的修业学堂。1903年10月8日，清政府批准教育家周震鳞、俞蕃同、许直等人在长沙创办修业学堂。民国元年（1912年），该校更名为湖南私立修业中学校。1923年，学校创办农业部，开始教授农业技术，学校师生曾在长沙南郊荒山造林，开辟农田，设立棉花、水稻试验场，以促进在地农林业的发展。1930年，修业学校更名为湖南私立修业农业学校。1934年，再度更名为湖南私立修业高级农业职业学校。
target_text: On 8 October 1903, the Qing Government approved the establishment of a training institute for educators in Changsha. During the Chinese National Year (1912), the school was renamed the Hunan Private Secondary School. In 1923, the school founded the Ministry of Agriculture, began teaching agricultural technology, teachers and students worked in the suburb of Changshan to plant agricultural land and set up cotton and rice testing sites to promote the development of rural forestry. In 1930, the school changed its name to the Hunan Private Agricultural School. In 1934, the school was renamed the Hunan School of Advanced Agricultural Studies.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 中華人民共和國成立後，湖南省人民政府基于发展湖南农业、培养合格农业技术人才的需求，决定将湖南私立修业高级农业职业学校收归公有，并升格为湖南省立修業農林專科學校，由湖南省农林厅接管；其后，中央人民政府開始對已有的大學進行院系調整，1951年1月，湖南大學農業學院與湖南省立修業農林專科學校合併，成立湖南农学院，并设立大学部、专科部和高农部。但在1952年7月第一次全国农学院院长会议上，湖南农学院的园艺、农业经济、土壤、植物病虫害4系所转入华中农学院，而兽医科防治组则并入江西农学院，另外农田水利科则并入武汉大学。该校的高农部和农干班与农学院分家，成立湖南省长沙农业学校。1975年，中共湖南省委决定湖南农学院在省内湘潭、郴州、衡阳、常德、邵阳、黔阳建立6所分院，分设农学、兽医、畜牧兽医、植物保护、茶叶等系所，主要招收工農兵學員。
target_text: Following the establishment of the Central China People ' s Republic of China, the Hunan People ' s Government decided, on the basis of the need to develop Hunan agriculture and develop qualified agricultural skills, to host the Hunan School of Advanced Agricultural Vocational Studies in the Hunan private sector and to upgrade it to the Hunan Academy of Agroforestry, which was taken over by the Hunan Department of Agriculture; the Central People ' s Government began the reorganization of existing university departments; in January 1951, the Hunan University School of Agriculture and the Hunan Province Special School of Agriculture were merged, establishing the Hunan Academy of Agriculture and establishing the Hunan Academy of Higher Agriculture and the Hunan Academy of Agriculture. However, in July 1952, on the premises of the First National School of Agriculture, the Hunan Academy ' s Department of Horticulturalism, Agricultural Economy, Soils, Plant Diseases and Pests4 was transferred to the Chinese Academy of Agriculture, while the Veterinary Prevention and Control Unit was integrated into the Jiangxi School of Agriculture, and the other fields were integrated into the Wuhan University.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 文化大革命结束后的1977年，中华人民共和国恢复全国高等学校统一招生考试制度，国家教育部开始整顿国内教学秩序，湖南省革命委员会也因此调整了省内各高等院校的分校设置，湖南农学院位于邵阳的分院并入湖南大学邵阳分校，而其位于湘潭、郴州、黔阳的分院则直接撤销。翌年，中国恢复招收研究生制度，国家教育部也批准湖南农学院成为湖南省第一批招收研究生的大学，并由湖南省教委主管。1987年，湖南省人民政府同意湖南農學院衡陽分院改名為湖南林業高等專科學校，脱离湖南农学院；1989年5月，湖南农学院位于常德的分院亦并入常德高等专科学校，至此湖南农学院在长沙市以外的分院全部完成撤并。1994年2月，中华人民共和国教育部同意湖南农学院更名为湖南农业大学。1997年，湖南农大开始面向中国大陆全境招收本科生。2002年11月，湖南农业大学成立独立学院东方科技学院。
target_text: In 1977, following the Cultural Revolution, the People’s Republic of China restored the unified system of competitive examinations for admission to higher education throughout the country, and the Ministry of Education began to reorganize the teaching order in the country. In 1987, the Hunan Provincial Revolutionary Council agreed to change the name of the Hunan School of Agriculture to the Hunan School of Higher Studies for the Hunan Institute of Agriculture and to leave the Hunan School of Agriculture; in May 1989, the Hunan School of Agriculture in Changde was merged into the Changde School of Higher Studies, and the Hunan Academy of Agriculture was completely abolished outside the Hunan Province. In February 1994, the Hunan People’s Department agreed to change the name of the Hunan School of Agriculture to the Hunan School of Higher Studies for the Hunan Institute of Agriculture.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 湖南农学院建院之初，校址位于长沙市韭菜园圣经学院的旧址上，1952年，校址迁入东塘枫树山，1960年再迁长沙市东郊东湖（今长沙市芙蓉区东湖街道），延续至今。包含试验基地在内，学校总占地面积2.27平方公里，北邻湖南省农科院，东接东湖，南临浏阳河，校园内环境幽雅，空气清新；有逸苑湖、碧荷轩池塘等人工湖泊及湿地。
target_text: At the beginning of its construction, the Hunan Academy of Agriculture was located on the old site of the Biblical School of the Gardens in Changsha City. In 1952, the site was moved to the East Pond Maple Mountain and, in 1960, to the East Lake on the eastern outskirts of Changsha City (on the East Lake Street in the Folong District of Changsha City), which continues to this day. The school covers a total area of 2.27 square kilometres, including a pilot base, the North and South Province Farm School, the East Lake, the South River, the East River, the East River, the East River, the East River River River, the South River River, the plain environment in the campus, and the air.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 该校图书馆前路旁遍植枫树，秋季楓葉变色后，红叶缤纷，由此形成的“红枫大道”时常吸引在校师生及其他民众驻足观赏，成为长沙市内知名的赏枫景点；湖南农业大学的农业科技示范园耕园内主要种植油菜花，也曾吸引当地民众春季赏花，但基于教学及科研工作的考量，已经于2018年封闭管理。2019年以来，校内修筑了一些纪念学校前身修業學堂的仿古建筑，以发扬学校精神。此外，湖南农业大学校园内的思源馆、第一教学楼及柳子明故居等3处建筑物，则已经被长沙市人民政府列入市级不可移动文物保护单位。学校联外交通便利，邻近长沙地铁6号线農科院農大站，可经由地铁来往于长沙市区及長沙黃花國際機場。
target_text: In addition, three buildings on the campus of Hunan Agricultural University, the Think House, the First Teaching Building, and the Willow Home, have been listed by the Changsa City People’s Government as city-level non-removable preservation units. School traffic is facilitated outside the city, adjacent to the Farco Station on the 6th Line of Longsartland, which can travel by iron to the city of Changsha and to the International Airport of Sands.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 中华人民共和国成立后，湖南省农林厅接管了湖南省立修業農林專科學校，并在院系調整中成立了湖南农学院；1951年3月，李毅之出任湖南农学院首任院長，直到1954年7月卸任。现今，湖南农业大学的中心广场上设有李毅之塑像，以纪念其为学校创立所作的贡献。此后，学校曾历经11任院长（革命委员会主任）主持工作，至1990年，彭干梓成为湖南农学院院长，1994年2月，湖南农学院更名为湖南农业大学，转任首任校長。1995年，官春云接替彭干梓成为湖南农大校长，2000年，其职务由周清明接替，而官春云则于2001年当选为中国工程院院士；周清明在任13年，为湖南农业大学建校以来任期最久的校长；2014年，周清明升任中共湖南农大党委书记，由符少辉接替他出任校长。2018年，中国工程院院士邹学校成为湖南农业大学校长，任职至今。
target_text: Following the establishment of the Hunan Province Agriculture and Forestry Agency, the Hunan Province has taken over the Hunan Province School of Agriculture and established the Hunan Academy of Agriculture as part of the reorganization of the Faculty of Sciences; in March 1951, Li Yi became the first Head of the Hunan Agricultural College until his resignation in July 1954. Today, the central square of Hunan Agricultural University has a statue of Lee Yi in honour of his contribution to its creation. Since then, the school has been chaired by 11 deans (the head of the Revolution Council) and, until 1990, Penganjing became the Dean of the Hunan Agricultural College; in February 1994, the Hunan Academy was renamed the first Head of the Hunan Agricultural University; in 2014, Chuming was replaced by the Chairman of the Hunan University; in 2000, he was replaced by Zhou Chongming, who was elected President of the Chinese School of Engineering; in China, she became President of the Hunan Agricultural University; and in China, in China, she became President of the University of Hunan.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 2018年，陈弘接替周清明成为中共湖南农业大学党委书记，任职至今。在行政管理上，湖南农业大学实施中共党委领导下的校长负责制，故校内事务由中国共产党湖南农业大学委员会统一领导，校长则主持学校行政工作，由湖南省人民政府任命，也是湖南农大的法定代表人。
target_text: In 2018, Chen Hong took over from Zhou Qing Minh as Secretary of the Party of the Hunan Agricultural University of China. In administrative terms, the Hunan Agricultural University implemented the system of principals under the leadership of the Communist Party Committee, so that the internal affairs of the University of Hunan were under the unified authority of the Committee of the Communist Party of China, while the Rector presided over the school administration, which was appointed by the Hunan Provincial People’s Government and was the statutory representative of Hunan Farmers.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 自1951年建校起，湖南农学院下设系所有着显著的农业特色。20世纪90年代以来，湖南农业大学所设学科综合性得到了增强，并发展出一套以农业类学科为主体，多学科协调发展的教学体系。截至2022年，该校开设的80个专业涵盖了农业类、工科、文学类、理学类、经济类、管理学类、法学、医学、教育学及艺术学等10个门类。
target_text: Since its establishment in 1951, the Hunan College of Agriculture has had a significant agricultural dimension. Since the 1990s, the Hunan University of Agriculture has developed a system of multidisciplinary and coordinated development based on agricultural disciplines. As of 2022, 80 of its specializations covered 10 fields such as agriculture, engineering, literature, science, economics, management, law, medicine, education and art.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 湖南农业大学吸引了一些优秀的农业学人才前来任教，学校首任校长李毅之就任伊始，就聘请了20多位享有一定声誉的教授来校执教；其中就包括园艺专家柳子明、苧麻科學专家李宗道、植物生理学家胡笃敬、遗传学家裴新澍、茶学家陈兴琰等人。2021年，该校有中国工程院院士4人，双聘院士6人。科技创新团队2个，农业农村部“科研杰出人才”及其创新团队3个、湖南省“科技创新团队”6个，国家教学团队1个、“黄大年式”教师团队1个、湖南省优秀教学团队6个、省部级教学团队17个等。油菜种植研究专家官春云、杂交水稻之父袁隆平、辣椒遗传育种专家邹学校、茶学专家刘仲华等一批农业界学者皆曾任教于此。其中，袁隆平曾被湖南农大聘为名誉校长，他也时常出席学校的开学典礼等重大活动。
target_text: In 2021, the University of Hunan attracted four outstanding agriculturalists and six double-employers. Two of its scientific and technological innovation teams, three of its innovative teams, six of its "Technology and Innovation Teams" in Hunan province, and six of its national teaching teams, one of its "Yang-yun" teachers, six of its "Hungol-yung-yun" teachers, and 17 of its ministerial teaching teams.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 自20世纪50年代成立以来，湖南农学院相继建立了一些研究所、研究室，文化大革命期间，因科研工作中断，学校系所没有增建。1984年，中国国家科委在湖南建立了苎麻技术开发中心，其中苎麻种植部门由湖南农学院苎麻研究所主管。至2022年，湖南农业大学有国家级科研平台9个、省部级科研平台83个，有中药资源与中兽药创制国家地方联合工程研究中心、植物激素与生长发育湖南省重点实验室、动物营养基因组与种质创新研究中心、园艺作物种质创新与新品种选育工程研究中心、国家植物功能成分利用工程技术研究中心等研究中心。学校也在湖南省内金井镇、金盆鎮等地有育种基地，以开展科研教育。
target_text: Since its establishment in the 1950s, the Hunan Academy of Agriculture has set up several research institutes, research rooms, and during the Cultural Revolution, it has not been built because of the interruption of scientific research. In 1984, the Chinese National Science Committee established the Centre for the Development of Pine Technology in Hunan, under the supervision of the Hunan Institute of Agriculture. By 2022, the Hunan Agricultural University had 9 national scientific research platforms, 83 departmental scientific research platforms, the National Centre for Joint National Engineering Research on Chinese Drug Resources and Veterinary Pharmacy, the National Centre for Research on Botanical Hormogens and Development, the Centre for Research on Plant nutrient Genomics and Quality Innovation, the Centre for Research on Circulation of Horticultural Species and New Varieties, and the National Centre for Research on Technology for the Use of Plant Functional Components.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 作为中国中南地区重要的农业类大學。湖南农业大学致力于培育优良的农粮作物、牲畜品种，以提高产量，并促进种业产业链协同发展。自1952年院系调整以来，湖南农学院开始有组织地开展科研活动。1955年，学校育成了番薯“湘杂9号”新品种。1956年，学院教授胡笃敬对苏联生物学家李森科的“植物阶段发育论”中的某些观点提出了不同见解，一定程度上动摇了李森科主義在中國科學界的地位。但在大跃进及文化大革命期间，受到政治运动的影响，学校的科研工作一度陷入停摆状态。
target_text: Since the restructuring of the Faculty in 1952, the Hunan College of Agriculture began to conduct organized scientific research. In 1955, the school developed a new variety of potatoes, “Scaffles No. 9.” In 1956, Professor Hu Dynasty presented different ideas about some of the ideas of Soviet biologist Li Senko’s “plant-stage development theory” and, to some extent, shaken Li Sencoism’s position in Chinese science.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 自1969年起，湖南农学院曾派出教员轮流到海南崖县藤桥公社（今海南省三亚市）参加杂交水稻的良种繁育工作数年，为杂交水稻的推广作出了贡献。1975年3月，柳子明教授对马王堆汉墓出土的农作物种子进行研究考证后，发表了论文《中国栽培稻的起源及其发展》，认为现代稻种的起源地在中国云贵高原，而非源于印度，《中国栽培稻的起源及其发展》也与其另一篇论文《柑橘类的起源和发展》引起了世界反响，此外，柳子明还为中国江南地区葡萄的引种栽培做出了贡献，从而得到了中国农学会的褒奖。
target_text: Since 1969, the Hunan Academy of Agriculture has sent its instructors on a rotational basis to the Toto Bridge Commune of Hainan County (Tiya City, Hainan Province) to participate in the breeding of hybrid rice for several years, contributing to the promotion of hybrid rice. In March 1975, Professor Yooko Ming, after researching seeds from the Ma Wang Han Tomb, published a paper entitled " Origins and Developments of Chinese Rice Growing " , which considered that the origins of modern rice species were in the Yunguo Plateau, China, rather than India, and that the Origins and Developments of Chinese Rice Growing and its other paper, " Origins and Developments of citrus Oranges " , generated world resonance. In addition, Yoko Ming also contributed to the cultivation of grapes in the Jiangnan region of China, and was awarded a prize by the Chinese Agricultural Society.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 1978年，中华人民共和国国务院、湖南省革命委员会先后召开了科学大会，恢复科研工作。1981年，湖南农学院开始承担“发展洞庭湖区粮食生产的综合技术研究”的重点科研课题，在湖南省内多个县市开展水稻、小麦、棉花等多种作物的栽培，并建立了农技教学、科研、推广基地，以促进该省粮食产量的提升。1987年，官春云教授主持育成了中国大陆第一个低芥酸、低硫苷的油菜品种湘油11号，其后更成功培育了一批优质高产量的油菜新品种，并在湖南、江西、广西等省市推广种植。邹学校教授则主持了一系列辣椒遗传育种工程，并参与建立了4,000余份育种材料的辣椒种质资源库，其规模居中国之冠，培育出了165个辣椒新品种，在中国国内外广泛种植。茶学家刘仲华提升了茶叶种植技术及茶叶品质，并在茶叶功能成分提制上取得了突破。
target_text: In 1978, the State Council of the People's Republic of China and the Hunan Province Revolutionary Council held scientific conferences and resumed scientific research work. In 1981, the Hunan Academy of Agriculture began to focus on the topic of “Integrated technical research for the development of food production in the Lake Toyako region”, promoting the cultivation of a variety of crops, including rice, wheat and cotton, in several counties and municipalities in Hunan Province, and establishing agricultural techniques, research and extension bases to promote the improvement of food production in the province. In 1987, Professor Chunyun led the development of China's first low mustard acid, low sulfur vegetable varieties, No. 11, and subsequently successfully developed a number of new high-yielding oil varieties, promoting cultivation techniques and tea quality in the provinces of Hunan, Jiangxi, and Guangxi.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 湖南农大的植物与动物科学、农业科学等學科因發展較早，在中國大陸有一定的知名度；2022年，学校有国家重点学科1个，农业农村部重点学科1个，湖南省国内一流建设学科3个、省国内一流培育学科7个，省“十二五”优势特色学科2个，省“十二五”重点学科15个。其中植物与动物科学、农业科学、环境/生态学、化学、工程科学、生物与生化6个学科ESI排名已经进入全球前1%。
target_text: In 2022, there were one schools of national priority, one in the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, three in the province's first-class construction programme, seven in the province's first-class culture programme, two in the province's “12th Five” specialty and 15 in the province's “12th Five” priority subjects. The six subjects of plant and animal sciences, agricultural sciences, environmental/ecosystems, chemistry, engineering sciences, biology and biochemistry were among the top 1% of the world.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text:
形象标识
湖南农业大学的校训为“朴诚，奋勉，求实，创新”；校歌则由音乐家于沙作词，邹启炎谱曲而成；该校校徽为圆形，上下分别写有中英文校名，其中中文校名为毛体字，由中共领导人毛泽东亲笔书写；中心绘有该校具代表性的第一教学楼，以及写有学校前身修业学堂创校年份“1903年”的深绿色草坪。其中深绿色象征学校稳步发展、践行环保理念；徽章色彩则以红色为主，象征学校师生的热情、自信与奋进精神；中英文字体则为金黄色；象征学校历史悠久、文化底蕴深厚。因袁隆平长期在校任教，对湖南农大的发展做出贡献，学校在校内建立了袁隆平纪念馆，并将一栋教学楼命名为“隆平楼”，以发扬袁隆平精神。
target_text: The school name of Hunan Agricultural University is “Puchen” and “Truthful” and “Innovation”; the school song is written by musicians in the sand and by the Quixin spectra; the school's logo is a circular form, with the name of each school in Chinese and Chinese, which is written by the leader of the Chinese Communist Party, Mao Zedong; the centre has a representative first teaching building, as well as a deep green grass with the founding year “1903” of the school's former gymnasium. Deep green symbol schools have steadily developed and practiced the concept of environmental protection; the logo colours are red, symbolizing the passion, confidence and spirit of the school's teachers and students; the Chinese and English fonts are golden yellow; symbolizing the school's long history and deep cultural background.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 学生生活在湖南农学院建校之初，《湖南农学院同学爱国公约》就明定该校在校生应该加强体育锻炼、积极参加文娱活动；该校亦曾结合体育达标测试开展群众性文体竞赛活动，其评比制度亦为湖南省教育厅所推广。截至2022年，湖南农业大学有40个校级社团及43个学院级社团，均由中国共青团湖南农业大学委员会主管，各社团每年定期通过招新活动吸收在校生，并由指导教师协助开展活动。。
target_text: As of 2022, the Hunan Agricultural University had 40 school-level associations and 43 college-level associations, all under the supervision of the Huanan Agricultural University Board of China, which regularly recruits students through new recruitment activities and is supported by teachers.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 根据《湖南农业大学章程》第7条，湖南农业大学校友的範圍是曾在湖南农业大学學習、工作、進修以及被聘為學校名譽博士、名譽教授、客座教授、兼職教授等人士。在建校之初，学校就建立了校友联谊会。2001年3月9日，湖南省教育厅、湖南省民政厅同意成立湖南农业大学校友总会，校友总会下尚包含数个分会。
target_text: On 9 March 2001, the Hunan Department of Education and the Hunan Department of Civil Affairs agreed to the establishment of the Hunan University of Agriculture Association, which includes several chapters.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 自1951年成立以来，湖南农业大学及其各分校為中國培養了一些農林、学术、政治领域的人才。农业领域的知名校友有油菜种植研究专家官春云、辣椒遗传育种专家邹学校、湖南省农业科学院党委书记柏连阳、聯合國糧食及農業組織總幹事屈冬玉、湖南雜交水稻研究中心研究员袁定陽等人。政界知名校友有中共中央機構編制委員會辦公室主任李小新、國家反壟斷局局長甘霖、国家教育部副部长杜占元、農業農村部副部長邓小刚、湖南省人大常委會副主任肖雅瑜、株洲市市長陈恢清、张家界市市长王洪斌、中共韶山市党委书记曹偉宏等人。
target_text: Since its establishment in 1951, Hunan Agricultural University and its branches have trained a number of people in the agricultural, academic, and political fields in China. Among the prominent students in agriculture are Chun-yun, the expert expert in oil gardening research; Choon-yun, the expert in chili genetic breeding; Burjan-yang, the secretary-general of the Hunan Agricultural Academy of Sciences; Chuo Toyu, the researcher of the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization; Yuan Dingyang, the researcher of the Hunan Multimodal Rice Research Centre.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 1978年以后，中华人民共和国政府开始实行改革开放政策，随着中国与世界各国交往日多，湖南农学院也开始加强与外国友好院校、国际机构的接触。湖南农业大学已经与40多个国家的130多所大学及政府机构、国际机构建立了密切联系；其中美国夏威夷大学、日本鹿儿岛大学等高等院校还与湖南农大确立了合作办学关系。从1980年代开始，湖南农大也常年聘请外籍教师、专家进行外语教学；自1978年起，学校开始派出教员、学生到国外开展交流、学习与培训。1998年，更开始招收留学生，延续至今。
target_text: Since 1978, the Government of the People’s Republic of China has embarked on a policy of reform and opening up. As China interacts with other countries around the world, the Hunan College of Agriculture has also begun to strengthen contacts with foreign friendly institutions and international institutions. The Hunan University of Agriculture has established close ties with more than 130 universities and governmental and international institutions in more than 40 countries; among these, the United States University of Hawaii and the Japanese University of Kagoshima have also established cooperative relationships with Hunan University.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 進入21世紀以來，湖南农业大学也響應中國政府的「一帶一路」政策，深化與各參與國的合作，不僅積極招收留學生，也積極帮助参与国发展农业。2019年6月，中非经贸博览会在长沙市举办后，湖南农业大学成立了“中非农业发展与合作基地”，该基地以农业科学技术为中心，整合农业研究资源，以帮助非洲邦交国改良农业技术、并共享农业信息与数据，参与共同培育非洲农业人才。
target_text: In the 21st century, Hunan Agricultural University also responded to the Chinese government’s “one-way” policy by deepening its cooperation with the participating countries, not only by recruiting students, but also by helping the participating countries to develop agriculture. In June 2019, after the China-Africa Trade Fair was held in Changsha City, Hunan Agricultural University established the Central African Agricultural Development and Cooperation Base, which is centred on agricultural science and technology, integrating agricultural research resources to help African countries to improve agricultural technology and share agricultural information and data, and participating in the development of African agricultural talent.
title: 湖南农业大学

source_text: 抗體（Antibody，Ab）又稱免疫球蛋白（Immunoglobulin，Ig），是一种主要由浆细胞分泌，被免疫系统用来鉴别与中和外来物质如细菌、病毒等病原体的大型Y形蛋白质，仅被发现存在于脊椎动物的血浆等细胞外液中，及其B细胞的细胞膜表面。抗体能通过其可变区唯一识别特定外来物的一个独特特征，该外来目标被称为抗原。蛋白上Y形的其中两个分叉顶端都有一被称为互补位（抗原結合位）的锁状结构，该结构仅针对一种特定的抗原表位。这就像一把钥匙只能开一把锁一般，使得一种抗体仅能和其中一种抗原相结合。体液免疫系统的主要功能便是制造抗体。抗体也可以与血清中的补体一起直接破壞外来目标。
target_text: The antibody (Antibody, Ab), also known as Immunoglobulin (Ig), is a large Y-form protein that is used by the immune system to identify the complementarities (antigens) at the top of two of the Y-forms, which are used to identify the pathogens, such as bacteria, viruses, and is found only in vertebrates’ plasma fluids and their cellular surfaces. The antibody is unique in identifying specific externals through its variable zone. The antibodies are known as antigens.
title: 抗体

source_text: 抗体和抗原的结合完全依靠“非”共价键的交互作用，这些非共价键的交互作用包括：静电力、氢键、疏水效应、范德华力。这些交互作用可以发生在侧链或者多肽主干之间；这些力量虽然不比共价键强，但此多个非共价键加成的结果，能让抗原与抗体紧密结合，却又具可逆性。正因这种特异性的结合机制，抗体可以“标记”外来微生物以及受感染的细胞，以诱导其他免疫机制对其进行攻击，又或直接中和其目标，例如通过与入侵和生存至关重要的部分相结合而阻断微生物的感染能力等，就像通緝犯上了手銬和腳鐐一樣。针对不同的抗原，抗体的结合可能阻断致病的生化过程，或者召唤巨噬细胞消灭外来物质。而抗体能够与免疫系统的其它部分交互的能力，是通过其Fc区底部所保留的一个糖基化座实现的。
target_text: The combination of antibodies and antigens depends entirely on the interaction of the non-combustion keys, the interactions of which include static electricity, hydrogen keys, hydrologic effects, and van der Waals. These interactions can take place between the side chains or multipolar backbones; these forces, while not more powerful than the covalent keys, add up to these noncombustion keys, which allow the antigens to be closely integrated with the antigens, but are reversible. As a result of this unique combination, the antibodies can “mark” alien microbes and infected cells, in order to induce other immune mechanisms to attack them, or directly target them, such as the ability to block the infection of microorganisms through a combination of invasion and survival essential parts, as in the case of handcuffs and footlides.
title: 抗体

source_text: 抗體主要由一種B细胞所分化出来的叫做漿細胞的淋巴細胞所製造。抗体有两种物理形态，一种是从细胞分泌到血浆中的可溶解物形态，另一种是依附于B细胞表面的膜结合形态。抗体与细胞膜结合后所形成的复合体又被称为B細胞受體，这种复合体只存在于B细胞的细胞膜表面，是激活B细胞以及后续分化的重要结构。B细胞分化后成为生产抗体的工厂的浆细胞，或者长期存活于体内以便未来能迅速抵抗相同入侵物的记忆B细胞。在大多数情况下，与B细胞进行互动的辅助型T细胞对于B细胞的完全活化是至关重要的，因为辅助型T细胞负责识别抗原，并促使B细胞能分化出能与该抗原相结合的抗体的浆细胞和记忆型B细胞。而可溶性抗体则被释放到血液等体液当中（包括各种分泌物），持续抵抗正在入侵的外来微生物。
target_text: The antibodies are mainly produced by lymphocytes, known as lymphocytes, which are divided by a B cell. There are two physical forms of antibodies, one of which is a form of soluble material from the cell secretion to the plasma, and the other a form of membrane binding on the B-cell surface. The compound formed by the combination of antibodies and membrane is also known as the B cellular receptor, which is present only on the B-cell surface and is an important structure for activating the B-cell and subsequent partitioning. The B cell is divided and then becomes the molten cell of the plant that produces the antibody, or the memory B cells that remain in the body for a long time in order to rapidly resist the same intrusion in the future. In most cases, the auxiliary T-cell that interacts with the B-cell is essential for the complete activation of the B cell, since the auxiliary T-cell is responsible for identifying the antigen and enabling B-cells to separate the antigen and memory B cells that combine with the antigen. The soluble antibodies are released into the blood fluids

source_text: 抗体是免疫球蛋白超家族中的一种醣蛋白。它们是血浆中丙种球蛋白的主要构成成分。抗体通常由一些基础单元组成，每一个抗体包括：两个長（大）的重链，以及两个短（小）的轻链。而輕鏈和重鏈之間以雙硫鍵連接。輕鏈和重鏈又分為可變區和恆定區，而不同类型的重链恆定區，将会导致抗体种型的不同。在哺乳类动物身上已知的不同种型的抗体有五种，它们分别扮演不同的角色，并引导免疫系统对所遇到的不同类型外来入侵物产生正确的免疫反應。
target_text: The antibodies are one of the main components of the immunoprotein superfamily. They are the main components of the C-protein in plasma. The antibodies are usually made up of basic units, each of which consists of two long (large) chains, and two short (small) light chains.
title: 抗体

source_text: 尽管所有的抗体大体上都很相似，然而在蛋白质Y形分叉的两个顶端有一小部分可以发生非常丰富的变化。这一高变区上的细微变化可达百万种以上，该位置就是抗原结合位。每一种特定的变化，可以使该抗体和某一个特定的抗原结合。这种极丰富的变化能力，使得免疫系统可以应对同样非常多变的各种抗原。之所以能产生如此丰富多样的抗体，是因为编码抗体基因中，编码抗原结合位（即互补位）的部分可以随机组合及突变。此外，在免疫种型转换的过程中，可以修改重链的类型，从而制造出对相同抗原專一性的不同种型的抗体，使得同种抗体可以用于不同的免疫系统过程中。

source_text: B细胞的抗体种型会随着B细胞的发育和活化而有所变化。从未接触过任何抗原的未成熟B细胞（也称为初始B细胞或處女B细胞）仅在细胞表面表达IgM种型的膜结合形态。当其成熟后，将会同时表达IgM和IgD两种形式，这表明该B细胞已能够对抗原产生响应，亦即“成熟”了。

The immaturity B cells (also known as the initial B cells or the virgin B cells) that have never been exposed to any antigens express only the membrane patterns of the IgM type on the cell surface. When they mature, IgM and IgD will be expressed simultaneously, indicating that the B cells have been able to counter the original response, which is “mature”.

source_text: 透過株係選擇抗原与某一株B细胞上抗体的结合，将会导致該株係的B细胞活化，并随之分裂并分化成生产抗体的浆细胞（又稱效應B細胞、P細胞）及少量的記憶B細胞（Bm）。浆细胞这种活化形态的B细胞将会产生大量分泌形态的抗体，而不是膜结合形态的抗体。其中部分子代会发生免疫种型转换，该机制将会导致生产的抗体从IgM或IgD种型，变成IgE、IgA或者IgG种型。

Some of the subgenerations would undergo an immunotype transformation, which would lead to the production of antibodies from the IgM or IgD type to the Ige, IgA or IgG type.

结构
抗体是一种高分子球状血液蛋白质，重量约为150kDa。由于在部分氨基酸残基中含有糖链，抗体也是一种糖蛋白。能发挥功能的基本单位是一个免疫球蛋白单体。在分泌形态的抗体中包括：二聚体IgA、真骨附类鱼的四聚体IgM以及哺乳动物的五聚体IgM。可发生变化的部分称为V区（或变化区、可變區），而不变的部分称为C区（或恒定区）。

The antibody is also a sugar protein because of the sugar chain contained in parts of the amino acid residue. The basic functional unit is an immunoglobin monomer. Among the antibodies in the secretive form are diden IgA, quartile IgM for real bone-dependent fish, and pentagram IgM for mammals. 免疫球蛋白结构域

target_text: The immune protein structure field, the antibodies, is a Y-shaped molecule with four multi-strength chains. It consists of two identical heavy chains, and two identical light chains, which are connected by two sulfur keys. Each chain consists of multiple structural domains called the immune protein structure field. Each has about 70 to 110 amino acids, which are separated according to size and function. For example, variable IgVs and constant IgCs. They are folded in a very special way: they involve another chain in a sandwich form through two beta folds, and they are closely associated with each other through semi-camino acids and other charged amino acids.

source_text: 重链哺乳动物的免疫球蛋白重链有5种，分别用希腊字母记为：α、δ、ε、γ以及μ。根据重链类型的不同，抗体被分为不同的种型，它们被发现依序分别存在于抗体IgA、IgD、IgE、IgG以及IgM中。不同的重链其大小和组成各不相同：α和γ大约有450个氨基酸组成，而μ和ε大约有550个氨基酸组成。在鸟类的血液和蛋清中，还发现了被称为IgY的血清抗体种型。这种抗体种型和哺乳动物的IgG有很大的区别。然而在一些旧资料，甚至是生命科学商业产品的网站上，仍然称之为IgG。这是错误的，并且容易引起混淆。

Depending on the type of chain, the antibodies are divided into different types, and they are found to be in sequence in the antibodies IgA, IgD, IgE, IgG, and IgM. There are different sizes and compositions of the chain: there are about 450 amino acids for alpha and gamma, and there are about 550 amino acids for μ and radium. source_text: 每一条重链有两个区域：恒定区与可变区。同种型的抗体，其恒定区都是一样的，但不同种型之间该区域是不相同的。例如：γ、α以及δ型重链由三个免疫球蛋白结构域串联而成，并且还有一个用于增加弹性的铰链区；而μ及ε型重链则包括四个免疫球蛋白结构域。不同B细胞所生产抗体的重链可变区是不同的，但是同一个B细胞及其克隆体所生产的不同种型抗体的可变区则是完全相同的。重链的可变区由一个结构域组成，包含大110个氨基酸。
target_text: Each chain has two areas: a constant zone and a variable zone. The same type of antibody, the constant zone, is the same, but it varies between different types. For example, gamma, alpha, and cylindrical heavy chains are linked by three immune protein-structured domains, and there is an additional elastic chain area for increasing elasticity; the μ and thorium heavy chain includes four immunoglobin-structure domains. The heavy chain area of the antibodies produced by different B cells is different, but the variable area of the different types of antibodies produced by the same B cell and its clones is identical. The variable area of the heavy chain is made up of one structural area, containing a large 110 amino acids.

source_text: 免疫球蛋白轻链由大约211至217个氨基酸组成，分为两个结构域，分别是恒定区和可变区。哺乳动物的轻链有两种，分别命名为λ（lambda）和κ（kappa）。每一个抗体的两个轻链的恒定區永远是完全相同的，例如对于哺乳动物而言，同一个抗体要么是λ型，要么是κ，不会同时存在。在如软骨鱼纲（鲨鱼）及真骨下纲的低级脊椎动物中，还可发现其它类型的轻链，如ι（iota）型。
target_text: The immunoglobin chain consists of about 211 to 217 amino acids, divided into two structural domains, the constant zone and the mutagenic zone. There are two types of small chains in mammals, named Rambda and centa (kappa). For each antibody, the constant zone is always the same. For mammals, for example, the same antibody is either a titanium or a hundred, and does not exist at the same time. source_text:
CDRs、Fv、Fab以及Fc结构域
抗体的某些部分具有独特的功能。比如说Y形的臂区，包含了两个可以结合抗原的位点，是识别外来物的关键所在。该区域被称为Fab区，即抗原结合区段（fragment, antigen binding）。无论是重链还是轻链，抗原结合区段均包括一个可变区与一个恒定区，其中可变区的互补位成型于抗体单体氨基酸链的末端。可变区又被称为FV区，是与抗原结合的最关键区域，无论是轻链还是重链都包含该区域。实际上可变区的变化并非随机或者均匀散布的。更具体的说，这些变化分布在三个可变的β折叠-转角上，该区域被称为互补决定区（Complementarity Determining Region，CDR），也叫做高变区。乔西亚（Chothia）等人，以及后来的诺斯等人对互补决定区的结构进行了归类。在免疫网络理论中，每个抗体的互补决定区又被称为独特型或者基因型。适应性免疫系统的适应过程，就是依靠有各个独特型之间的互动来进行调整的。
target_text: CDRs, Fv, Fab, and parts of the Fc structural area have unique functions. For example, the Y-shaped arms zone contains two sites where antigens can be combined, and is key to the identification of outsiders. The region is known as the Fab zone, the antigen complex (fragmentation, antigen binding). Whether it is a heavy chain or a light chain, the antigen band includes a variable zone with a constant zone in which the complementarities form the end end of the antibody amino acid chain. The variable zone is also called the FV zone, which is the most critical region in which the antigenesis is combined, whether light or heavy. In fact, changes in the mutant zone are not random or evenly dispersed. More specifically, these changes are spread across three mutable beams-reverses, which are known as the complementary decision-making zone (Complementary Determining Region, CDR), which is also called the high-changed zone.

source_text: Y形结构的基座的作用是调节免疫细胞的活动，该区域被称为Fc区(Fragment crystallizable region，可结晶区域片段)，由两条重链组成。根据抗体类型不同，该区域的每一条重链由2个或者3个恒定结构域组成。因此，Fc区可通过与特定类型的Fc感受器，或者其它免疫分子如补体蛋白质相结合，来确保每个抗体可对一特定抗原产生一个正确的免疫应答。通过这一过程，可引发不同的生理学效果，包括识别调理颗粒、细胞溶解，以及肥大细胞、嗜碱性粒细胞和嗜酸性粒细胞的脱颗粒过程。
target_text: The role of the base of the Y-shaped structure is to regulate the activities of immune cells, a region known as the Fc Zone (Fragment Crystallizable Region, crystalline Zone Fracture), consisting of two heavy chains. Depending on the type of antibodies, each chain in the region consists of two or three constant structural domains. Thus, the Fc Zone can ensure that each antibodies can produce a correct immune response to a given antigen by combining it with a specific type of Fc receptor, or other immune molecules, such as refilled protein. This process can lead to different physiological effects, including the identification of modifier particles, cell solution, and the decoupling process of fat, alkali and acidic cell cells.

source_text: 胎儿和新生儿体内的抗体是由母亲所提供的，是一种被动免疫。在出生后一年内，新生儿就可自行产生许多不同的抗体。由于抗体可以溶解在血液当中，因此它们是体液免疫系统的一部分。体液循环中的抗体，是由应答某一特定抗原如病毒衣壳片段的B细胞克隆子代所产生的。抗体从下列三个方面为免疫力做出贡献：通过与病原体结合来避免入侵和破坏自身的细胞；通过刺激巨噬细胞等免疫细胞来包裹并清除病原体；以及通过刺激其它免疫应答过程如补体路径，来消灭病原体。
target_text: Antibodies in foetuses and newborns are supplied by mothers and are a passive form of immunization. Within a year of birth, newborns can produce many different antibodies themselves. Since antibodies dissolve in blood, they are part of the body fluid immune system. Antibodies in the body fluid cycle are produced by B-cell clones that respond to a particular antigen, such as a strain of a virus. Antibodies contribute to immunity in three ways: by combining pathogens to avoid intrusion and damage to their cells; by covering and removing pathogens by stimulating immune cells, such as megaphages; and by stimulating other immune response processes, such as rehydration pathways, to eliminate pathogens.

source_text:
补体的活化
当补体与细菌结合形成补体级联时，也是一种能和抗体结合的抗原。当抗体的Fv区与之结合时，会激活典型的补体系统。这将会通过两种途径消灭该细菌：第一种途径是通过抗体与补体的结合在微生物上作标记，使得噬菌細胞受到补体级联所产生的特定的补体的吸引，并通过一个叫做噬菌作用的过程吞噬细菌；第二种途径是通过形成一种叫做补体膜攻击复合物的补体抗体复合物来直接杀死细菌。
target_text: Reclamation is also an antigen that can be combined with antibodies when the supplement is combined with bacteria. When the antibodies in the Fv zone are combined, the typical supplementation system is activated. This will eliminate the bacteria in two ways: the first way is by marking microbes through a combination of antibodies and refills, which attracts ingested cells to a specific supplement created by the rehydration cascade and devours bacteria through a process called the fungus function; the second way is by directly killing bacteria through the formation of a supplemental antibodies complex called the reciprocating membrane attack complex.

source_text:
效应细胞的活化（調理作用）
为了阻止病原体在细胞外进行复制，抗体通过与之结合而将其聚集在一起，即凝集。由于抗体至少拥有两个互不结合位，因此理论上它可以与不只一个相同类型的抗原相结合。通过对病原体的覆盖，抗体可以激活能识别该抗体Fc区的细胞的效应作用。拥有可以识别覆盖病原体的抗体Fc区的细胞，可以和IgA、IgG以及IgE型抗体的Fc区发生互动。某一特定细胞上的Fc区感受器遇到特定的抗体后，会引发该细胞的效应作用，例如：吞噬细胞会进行吞噬，肥大细胞和中性粒细胞会脱颗粒，而自然杀伤细胞会释放细胞因子和细胞毒素等化学物质。这些作用最终会导致入侵微生物的解体。Fc区感受器是种型敏感的，因此可使得免疫系统具备更高的灵活性，当不同的病原体入侵时可以仅仅触发正确的免疫机制。
target_text: The active cell activity (reconstructing) is a combination of antibodies that can interact with IgA, IgG, and IgE antigens in the Fc area in order to prevent their reproduction outside the cell. Since the antibody has at least two separate sites, it can theoretically be combined with more than one antigen of the same type. By covering the pathogen, the antibodies can activate the effects of the cells that recognize the antigen Fc region. The cells that can identify the antigenesis Fc region, which can be affected by it, can interact with IgA, IgG, and IgE. The Fc zone receptors on a particular cell have a specific antibodies effect that can trigger greater flexibility in the immune system, e.g. when the ingestion cells consume, the fertilization cells and the neutral particles of cells can be removed, and the natural killer cells can release chemical substances such as cells and cell toxins. These effects can eventually lead to the disintegration of invasive microorganisms.

source_text:
凝集與沉澱反應
抗体上的抗原結合位可與抗原結合而将其聚集在一起，即凝集反應。由于抗体至少拥有两个抗原结合位，因此理论上它可以与不只一个相同类型的抗原相结合，使其抗原－抗體複合體更容易被吞噬細胞吞噬。若為可溶性抗原，則抗體能以形成抗原－抗體複合體的方式大大增加其分子量，使其溶解度降低而沉降於血管壁上，最後被吞噬細胞清除。

source_text:
中和抗体
人类及高级灵长类动物还可以在病毒入侵之前，在血液中释放中和抗体。中和抗体是指那些在任何感染、接种疫苗、接触任何外来抗原或者接受被动免疫之前，即已被制造和释放出来的抗体。这类抗体可以在适应性免疫响应被启动之前，激活经典的补体路径，来消解有包膜的病毒颗粒。许多中和抗体的目标抗原是双半乳糖α(1,3)-半乳糖（α-Gal），后者通常出现在糖基化的细胞膜蛋白的糖基终端上，也是人类消化道中细菌的代谢产物。通常认为异种器官移植所引起的排斥，部分是由接受移植者血清中流动的中和抗体和移植器官上的α-Gal抗原结合造成的。
target_text: Medium and antibodies are antibodies that have been manufactured and released before any infection, inoculation, exposure to any alien antigens or passive immunisation. Such antibodies can activate the classic rehydration path to dissipate viral particles with a packaged membrane before an adaptive immune response is activated. Many of the intermediate and antibody target antigens are bi-lactose alpha (1,3)-semi-lactose (α-Gal), which is usually found on the sugar-based cytofilm protein base terminal, which is also the metabolic product of bacteria in human digestive tracts.

source_text:
多样性
几乎所有的微生物都可以触发抗体的免疫应答。若想要成功识别并清除各种微生物，需要丰富多样的抗体，而这种多样性来自于抗体氨基酸的重组变化。据估算，人类可以产生大约100亿种不同的抗体，每一种都可以与特定抗原的表位相结合。尽管每个人可以产生的抗体是如此之多，但是产生这些蛋白质的相关基因却十分有限。脊椎动物发展出了一些复杂的基因机制，使得其B细胞可以利用有限的基因产生非常多样的抗体。
target_text: It is estimated that humans can produce about 10 billion different types of antibodies, each of which can be combined with specific antigens. Although there are so many antibodies that each person can produce, the genes that produce these proteins are very limited. The vertebrates have developed complex genetic mechanisms that allow their B cells to produce very diverse antibodies with limited genes.

source_text: 染色体当中用于编码抗体的基因座范围很广，其中包含了编码各个结构域的基因。其中编码人类重链的基因座（IGH@）位于第14号染色体，而编码λ和κ型轻链的基因座（IGL@和IGK@）则位于第22号染色体和第2号染色体。重链和轻链中均存在的可变区，在不同的B细胞所产生的抗体中是不一样的。控制这些差异的三个转角被称为超变区（HV-1、HV-2及HV-3），又称为互补决定区（CDR1、CDR2及CDR3）。编码重链部分的基因座包含了65种不同的可变区基因，通过将这些基因与其它结构域的基因相组合，就可以产生高度差异的大量不同抗体，这一组合过程被称为V(D)J重组过程。
target_text: The gene constellations used to encode antibodies in chromosomes are wide-ranging and contain genes from various structural domains of code. The gene constellations that encode the human chain (IGH@) are located in chromosome No. 14, while the gene pads that encoded the human chain (IGL@ and IGK@) and the 100-type light chain are located in chromosome No. 22 and chromosome No. 2. The grids that control these differences are known as hypervariable zones (HV-1, HV-2 and HV-3) and are also known as complementary decision areas (CDR1, CDR2 and CDR3). By combining these genes with the gene profiles of other structural areas, there are a large number of different antibodies that can be highly different. The combination is called the V(D)J reorganization process.

source_text: 体细胞的免疫球蛋白重组又被称为V(D)J重组，该过程可导致可变区发生独特的变化。免疫球蛋白中每一条重链和轻链的可变区是由若干个基因片段（亚基因）所编码的，这些片断分别被称为可变段（V）、多样段（D）以及连接段（J）。这三种片段均存在于编码重链的基因片段中，而编码轻链的基因片段中只存在V和J段。在哺乳类动物的基因中，V、D和J段的重复基因序列串联在一起。骨髓中正在发育的B细胞，通过随机选择和组合V、D及J段各一段（轻链没有D段），来产生免疫蛋白的可变区。由于每段都有多个不同的拷贝，各段之间还存在不同的组合方式，因此抗体的可变区可以产生数量巨大的变化。正因有如此数量巨大的不同抗原结合位，所以可以产生对大量不同抗原具有特异性的抗体。有趣的是，λ型轻链免疫球蛋白的某些亚基因（例如V2家族）的重排，和miR-650微RNA的活耦联，而后者则对B细胞的生化特性进一步发挥影响。

These three segments are found in gene segments of the coded heavy chain, while the cells of the coded low-chain are only in V and J. In the genes of the mammals, the regenerative sequences of V, D and J are linked together. source_text:
体细胞超突变与亲和力成熟过程
详细请参见：体细胞超突变与亲和力成熟过程
B细胞被抗原激活之后，将会迅速的增殖。在快速增殖的过程中，编码重链及轻链可变区的基因，会通过一种称为体细胞超突变过程，发生非常高概率的点突变。体细胞超突变会使得每一次细胞分裂，在基因的可变区中会产生大约一个核苷酸的变化。这一过程将导致每一个子代B细胞会与亲代的DNA，在抗体氨基酸链的可变区部分产生细微的差异。

The hypertransformation of the body cell can cause each cell to split and produce about one nucleic acid change in the mutagenic zone of the gene. This process will lead to a slight difference between each sub-generation B cell and the DNA of the parent and the variable part of the antiamino acid chain.

source_text: 这种突变方式可以增加抗体池的多样性，并且对抗体与抗原的亲和力产生影响。例如，突变的子代中，某些所产生的抗体与抗原结合的能力，比亲代所产生的抗体相比反而变弱了（亲和力下降），但另一些则可能变强了（亲和力增强）。那些表达亲和力更强的抗体的B细胞，会在与免疫系统其它部分的交互过程中，获得比较弱者更强的生存信号，后者会逐渐因为凋亡作用而消失。这种使得生产的抗体逐渐增加结合亲和力的过程，就是亲和力成熟过程。亲和力成熟过程发生在已发生过V(D)J重组后的成熟B细胞上，并需要辅助T细胞的帮助。

source_text:
种型转换
免疫种型转换是在活化后的B细胞中发生的一个生物学过程，该过程使得细胞可以产生不同种型的抗体，如IgA、IgE及IgG等。不同种型的抗体及其效应作用，是由免疫球蛋白重链中的恒定区决定的。最开始的时候，初始B细胞僅表达抗原结合区域相同的膜结合形态IgM和IgD抗体。而在活化之后，由于不同种型的抗体仅应对特定的功能，B细胞会根据清除抗原所需要的功能，选择生产具备IgG、IgA或者IgE效应作用的抗体。通过种型转换，从同一个活化B细胞分裂出来的子代细胞就可以生产不同种型的抗体。在种型转换的过程中，只有重链的恒定区发生了改变，而可变区则没有发生任何改变，因此所针对抗原的特异性也不会发生改变。因此，同一个B细胞的子代都能生产针对同一抗原的抗体，但却可以对各种抗原状况提供恰当的效应作用。生产哪一种型的抗体，是由B细胞所处环境中存在的细胞因子类型所决定的。

After the vibration, the different types of antibodies can produce different types of antibodies, such as IgA, IgE, and IgG. The first B cell can only express the same membrane combination form in the same active B cell. In subsequent studies, other researchers argued that antibodies could be stabilized in the blood. In 1904, Omros Leit further proposed that it be the target of ingestion, and eventually eliminated.

source_text: 到了二十世纪二十年代，迈克尔·海德堡和奥斯瓦尔德·埃弗里观察到抗原可以被抗体所凝结，并进一步发现抗体是一种蛋白质。在三十年代，约翰·马拉克对抗原-抗体结合活动的生物化学性质做了更详尽的实验。接下来的一次重大突破发生在四十年代，莱纳斯·鲍林通过抗体抗原的互动能力取决于各自的形状而不是其化学成分，证明了埃尔利希所提出的一把钥匙配一把锁的免疫学理论。1948年，阿斯特丽德·法戈瑞奥司发现B细胞的其中一种形式浆细胞就是负责生产抗体的工厂。
target_text: In the 1920s, Michael Heidelberg and Oswald Effrey observed that antigens could be condensed by antibodies and further discovered that antibodies were proteins. In the 1930s, John Marak experimented with the biochemistry of antigen-antibody combinations. The next major breakthrough occurred in the '40s, when Linus Pauling's ability to interact through antibodies depended on their shapes rather than on their chemical composition, confirming the immunological theory that Ellich proposed a key with a lock. In 1948, Astrid Fagorios found that one of the forms of magma cells in B cells was the plant responsible for producing antibodies.
title: 抗体

source_text: 此后，研究工作的重点转向了识别抗体蛋白质结构中各部分的作用。二十世纪六十年代，杰拉尔德·埃德尔曼和约瑟夫·盖里发现了抗体的轻链，并且发现这和1845年由亨利·本册·琼斯所发现的本周氏蛋白质是同一种物质，这是一项重大的突破。紧接着，埃德尔曼在进一步发现抗体中的重链和轻链是由双硫键连接在一起的。与此同时，罗德尼·罗伯特·波特识别出了免疫球蛋白的抗体结合区（Fab）及抗体尾部的可结晶区。根据这些发现，科学家们对免疫球蛋白的结构进行了推测，并描述了IgG蛋白质的完整氨基酸序列。以上这些发现，使得他们被共同授予1972年的诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。Fv区则由戴维·吉沃尔（David Givol）所首先制备和识别。正当人们对抗体的大多数早期研究还集中在IgM和IgG上时，六十年代还发生了重要的事情：托马斯·托马西发现了属于新种型的分泌形态IgA抗体，戴维·S·罗维和约翰·L·费伊则识别出了IgD，石坂公成和石坂照子夫妇则共同发现了与过敏反应有关的抗体种型IgE。1976年，利根川进对免疫球蛋白相关基因进行研究，发现了抗体通过基因重排实现多样性的体细胞超突变基本原理。
target_text: In the 1960s, Gerald Edelman and Joseph Gehri discovered a light chain of antibodies, which was the same as the weekly protein found in 1845 by Henry B. Jones, which was a major breakthrough. Immediately thereafter, Edelman discovered that the heavy and light chains in the antibodies were connected by two sulfur keys. At the same time, Rodney Robert Potter identified the antibin zone (Fab) and the crystallized zone of the antibodies. On the basis of these findings, scientists speculated on the structure of the immunoglobin and described the complete amino acid sequence of the Igg proteins. These findings, which led them to the joint award of Nobel College of Physiology or Medical Awards in 1972.
title: 抗体

剑桥大学的 麦克的免疫球蛋白结构功能网页；
在蛋白质资料库中的 口腔蛋白质分子资料库中的抗体 讨论到抗体的结构；
