source_text: 任何物质的化学性質，均是由其原子或分子的电子结构所决定的。通过解析包括了所有相关的原子核和电子的多粒子薛定谔方程，可以计算出该原子或分子的电子结构。在实践中，人们认识到，要计算这样的方程实在太复杂，對於許多案例，必需使用简化的模型，找到可行的數學計算方法，才能夠找到近似的电子结构，從而确定物质的化学性質。實際上，量子電動力學是化學的基礎原理。
target_text: The chemical properties of any substance are determined by the electron structure of its atoms or molecules. It is possible to calculate the electron structure of the atoms or molecules by diagnosing multi-particle equations that include all the relevant atomic nuclei and electronics. In practice, it is recognized that calculating such equations is too complicated. For many cases, it is necessary to use simplified models to find viable mathematical methods to find similar electron structures and to determine the chemical properties of the substance. In practice, quantum electrodynamics are the bedrock of chemistry.
title: 量子力学

source_text: 量子力學可以詳細描述原子的電子結構與化學性質。對於只擁有一個束縛電子的氫原子，薛丁格方程式有解析解，可以計算出相關的能級與氫原子軌域，而且能級符合氫原子光譜實驗的數據，從每一種氫原子軌域可以得到對應的電子概率分佈。對於其它種原子（多電子原子），薛丁格方程式沒有解析解，只能得到近似解，可以計算出近似氫原子軌域的哈特里原子軌域，形狀相同，但尺寸與能級模式不一樣。使用哈特里原子軌域，可以解釋原子的電子結構與化學性質，週期表的元素排列。
target_text: Quantum mechanics provide a detailed description of the electron structure and chemical properties of the atoms. For hydrogen with only one beam of electrons, the Xerdinger equations interprets and calculates the respective levels of energy versus the hydrogen atom orbit, and can be graded in accordance with the data from the hydrogen atom spectrum experiment. The electro-probability of the corresponding electrons can be separated from each of the hydrogen atom orbits. For other atoms (multi-electric atoms), the Xerding equations are not solved, and can only be approximated to calculate the Khatli atom orbit near the thorium orbit, in the same shape, but in different sizes than in the grade pattern. Using the Hartley atom orbit, the electron structure of the atoms can be explained by chemical properties, and the elements of the periodic tables are arranged.
title: 量子力学

source_text: 量子力學能夠解釋，在分子裏的束縛電子怎樣將分子內部的原子綑綁在一起。對於最為簡單，只擁有一個束縛電子的氫分子離子H2+，應用玻恩–奥本海默近似（兩個原子核固定不動），薛丁格方程式有解析解，可以計算出它的分子軌域。但是對於其它更為複雜的分子，薛丁格方程式沒有解析解，只能得到近似解，只能計算出近似的分子軌域。理论化学中的分支，量子化学和计算化学，專注於使用近似的薛定谔方程，来计算复杂的分子的结构及其化学性質。
target_text: Quantum mechanics can explain how beam electrons in molecules tie together atoms within molecules. For the simplest, there is only one beamed electron ion H2+, which uses the Bohn-Oppenheimer approximation (two atomic nuclei immobilized), and the Xerdinger equation, which solves and calculates its molecular trajectory. But for other, more complex molecules, the Xerding equations have not been solved, they have only approximated, and they can only calculate near molecular orbits. The branches of theoretical chemistry, quantum chemistry and computational chemistry, focus on the structure of complex molecules and their chemical properties, using the approximating equation of Xerding.
title: 量子力学

source_text: 目前的研究聚焦於找到可靠與能夠直接处理量子态的方法。量子系統擁有一種特性，即對於量子數據的測量會不可避免地改變數據，這種特性可以用來偵測出任何竊聽動作。倚賴這特性，量子密碼學能夠保證通信安全性，使得通信双方能够产生并分享一个随机的，安全的密钥，来加密和解密信息。比較遙遠的目標是發展出量子電腦。由於量子态具有量子叠加的特性，理论而言，量子電腦可以達成高度并行计算，其計算速度有可能以指數函數快過普通電腦。另外，應用量子纏結特性與經典通訊理論，量子遙傳能夠將物體的量子態從某個位置傳送至另一個位置。這是正在積極進行的一門學術領域。
target_text: Current research focuses on finding reliable and direct ways to process quantum patterns. Quantum systems have a feature that inevitably alters data for measurement of quantum data, which can be used to detect any bugging. Relying on this feature, quantum cryptography can guarantee the security of communications and enable both parties to generate and share a random, secure key to encrypt and decipher information. The distant goal is to develop quantum computers. Because of the quantum state ' s mass-combined properties, the quantum computer can theoretically be calculated at a high parallel rate, which can be calculated at a speed faster than a normal computer by a finger function.
title: 量子力学

source_text: 1948年，香农发表了划时代的论文——《》，奠定了现代信息论的基础。不仅如此，香农还被认为是数字计算机理论和数字电路设计理论的创始人。1937年，21岁的香农是麻省理工學院的硕士研究生，他在其硕士论文中提出，将布尔代数应用于电子领域，能够构建并解决任何逻辑和数值关系，被誉为有史以来最具水平的硕士论文之一。二战期间，香农为军事领域的密碼分析——密码破译和保密通信——做出了很大贡献。
target_text: In 1948, Shannon published a landmark paper — The Law, which laid the foundation for modern information theory. Moreover, Shannon was considered to be the founder of the theory of digital computer theory and digital circuit design. In 1937, Shannon, 21-year-old, was a master's degree student at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, where he suggested in his master's paper that the application of Bur algebra in the electronic field, capable of building and resolving any logical and numerical relationship, was recognized as one of the most advanced master's thesis ever. During World War II, Shannon made a significant contribution to the analysis of passwords in the military field — cryptography and confidential communications.
title: 克劳德·香农

source_text:
生平
香农出生于密歇根州佩托斯基 。父亲克劳德（1862–1934）与他的姓名完全相同，是新泽西州早期移民的后裔，曾自主创业经商，也担任过审核遗嘱的法官。母亲玛贝尔·沃夫·香农（1890–1945）是德国移民的女儿，职业是语言学教师，曾长期担任密歇根州盖洛德高中的校长。香农人生的前16年都是在盖洛德度过，他在那儿接受了公立学校教育，并于1932年从盖洛德高中毕业。香农对机械和电气电子表现出了极大爱好。他最优秀的学科就是科学和数学，并在家中制作了模型飞机、无线电控制的模型船和一个可与半英里内的朋友家联系的无线电报系统。大一点的时候，他做过西联汇款的投递员。
target_text: Shannon was born in Petowski, Michigan. His father, Claude (1862–1934), was a descendent of early immigrants from New Jersey, a self-employed businessman and a probate judge. Her mother, Mabel Wolf Shannon (1890–1945), was the daughter of an immigrant in Germany, a language teacher who had long served as a head teacher at Gallord High School in Michigan. He spent the first 16 years of his life in Gallod, where he was educated in a public school and graduated from Gallod High School in 1932. Shannon showed great interest in mechanics and electrical electronics. His best discipline was science and mathematics, and he made model airplanes, a radio-controlled ship and a radio report system with links to friends in half a mile.
title: 克劳德·香农

source_text:
布尔理论和二战前研究
1932香农进入密歇根大学学习，在大学的一门课程中接触到了乔治·布尔的理论。1936年大学毕业时，香农获得了两个学士学位：电子工程学士和数学学士。不久，香农进入麻省理工学院开始研究生学习，参与了万尼瓦尔·布什的微分分析机（Differential Analyzer）的相关工作。微分分析机是一种模拟计算机，是现代电脑的鼻祖。
target_text: When he graduated from the University in 1936, Shannon obtained two bachelor's degrees: a bachelor's degree in electronic engineering and a bachelor's degree in mathematics. Soon after he entered the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Shannon began postgraduate studies and participated in the work of the Differential Analyzer of the Vannival Bush microanalyst.
title: 克劳德·香农

source_text: 用电子开关模拟布尔逻辑运算是现代电子计算机的基本思路，香农的工作成为数字电路设计的理论基石，完全取代了之前盛行的ad hoc方法。Vannevar Bush建议香农将类似的数学方法应用于孟德尔遗传学，香农接受了这个建议，写出了An Algebra for Theoretical Genetics。凭此论文，香农于1940年获得麻省理工学院博士学位。
target_text: Using electronic switches to simulate the logic of Boolean is the basic idea of modern computers, and Shannon’s work became the theoretical cornerstone of digital circuit design, replacing entirely the ad-hoc method that had prevailed before. Vannevar Bush suggested that Shannon apply similar mathematical methods to Mendel genetics, and Shannon accepted the proposal, writing An Algebra for Theoretic Genetics.
title: 克劳德·香农

source_text:
1940年，香农成为普林斯顿高等研究院的研究员。在那里香农有很多机会与当时有影响力的科学家和数学家交流，比如阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦、赫尔曼·外尔和约翰·冯·诺伊曼，现代信息论的思想逐渐在他脑海中成型。二战期间的研究
二战期间，香农加入贝尔实验室，研究火力控制系统和密码学，相关课题直属国防研究委员会领导。
target_text: Shannon became a researcher at the Princeton Institute of Advanced Studies in 1940. There were many opportunities for Shannon to interact with influential scientists and mathematicians at the time, such as Albert Einstein, Herman Ear and John von Neumann, whose ideas of modern information theory were gradually forming in his mind. During World War II, Shannon joined the Bell Laboratory, researched fire control systems and cryptography, and was directly under the leadership of the Defence Research Council.
title: 克劳德·香农

source_text: 1943年，香农有机会和英国数学家和密码学家艾伦·图灵合作。图灵被派到华盛顿和美国海军交流破译德国的北大西洋潜艇舰队密码的成果，并在贝尔实验室待了一段时间。香农和图灵在一个自助餐厅见面。图灵向香农介绍了现在被称为“通用图灵机”的概念。香农对此很感兴趣，因为图灵机的概念和香农自己的很多想法相吻合。
target_text: In 1943, Shannon had the opportunity to work with British mathematicians and cryptographers Alan Turing. Turing was sent to Washington and the United States Navy to share the results of deciphering Germany's North Atlantic submarine fleet codes, and spent some time in Bell's lab. Shannon and Turing met in a cafeteria. Turing introduced Shannon to what is now known as the General Turing Machine.
title: 克劳德·香农

source_text: 1945年，战争进入尾声，国防研究委员会NDRC的使命即将结束。在正式解散之间，NDRC决定将重要研究成果整理成册，其中有一篇论文“火力控制系统的数据平滑和数据预测”是香农和、亨德里克·韋德·波德一起写的，它的思路和“通信系统中将信号和噪声相分离”是类似的，也就是说，香农在火力控制系统研究中已经发现了后来成为信息论的基本概念和框架体系。
target_text: In 1945, when the war ended, the mission of the National Defence Research Council’s NDRC was coming to an end. Between the formal dissolution, the NDRC decided to compile important research results. One of the papers, “Diplomatic smoothness and data prediction in the fire control system”, was written by Shannon and Hendrik Wade Pod, and its thinking was similar to that of “separation of signals and noises in the communications system” – that is, Shannon’s research into the fire control system has revealed the basic concepts and framework that later became information theory.
title: 克劳德·香农

source_text: 战时香农在密码学领域的研究与通信领域的关系更加密切。1945年，香农向贝尔实验室提交了一份备忘录，题目是“密码学的一个数学理论”，之后在1949年以“保密系统的通信理论”的标题在Bell System Technical Journal正式发表，包含了很多在“通信的一个数学理论”出现的概念和数学公式。香农说，战时对通信理论和密码学的研究使他认识到“两者密不可分”。
target_text: Shannon's research in the field of cryptology in wartime is more closely related to the field of communications. In 1945, Shannon submitted a memorandum to Bell's lab, entitled “A Mathematical Theory of cryptography”, which was then officially published in 1949 under the title “Theory of Communications in Secret Systems” in Bell System Technical Journal, containing a number of concepts and mathematical formulas that emerged in “A Mathematical Theory of Communication.” Shannon said that wartime research on the theory of communications and cryptography had led him to realize that “the two are inextricably linked”.
title: 克劳德·香农

source_text:
战后的贡献
1948年，划时代的“通信的一个数学理论”分成两部分，在7月和10月的Bell System Technical Journal发表。文章系统论述了信息的定义，怎样数量化信息，怎样更好地对信息进行编码。在这些研究中，概率理论是香农使用的重要工具。香农同时提出了信息熵的概念，用于衡量消息的不确定性。
target_text: In 1948, the landmark “Mathematical Theory of Communication” was divided into two parts, published in July and October in Bell System Technical Journal. The articles discussed the definition of information, how to quantify it, and how to better encode it. In these studies, the probability theory was an important tool for Shannon.
title: 克劳德·香农

source_text: 1949年，香农和沃倫·韋弗合著了“通信的数学理论”，包含了香农1948年的论文“通信的一个数学理论”和韦弗为非专业人士写的介绍通信理论的内容。韦弗指出，在信息论中"information"这个词不是指“你说了什么”，而是指“你能够说什么”，也就是说，信息表示人们可有多少选择。之后，约翰·罗宾森·皮尔斯在“Symbols, Signals, and Noise”这本书中也对香农的概念作了通俗的介绍。
target_text: In 1949, Shannon and Warren Weaver co-authored the “Mathematical Theory of Communication”, which included the Shannon's 1948 paper “A Mathematical Theory of Communication” and Weaver's introduction of communication theory for non-professionals. Weaver pointed out that the word “information” in information theory does not mean “what you say”, but “what you can say”, which means that information shows how many options people can choose. Then John Robinson Pierce also gave a popular introduction to the Shannon concept in the book “Symbols, Signals, and Noise.”
title: 克劳德·香农

source_text: 1951年，香农写了"Prediction and Entropy of Printed English"，说明信息基础理论能够应用于自然语言和计算机语言，计算了英语这门语言的熵，从而为从统计的角度分析语言打下了基础。而且，香农认为如果把空格当作英语字母表上的第27个字母，能够降低提取英语处理的不确定性。数字通信的基础理论——抽样分析理论——的提出也有香农的贡献。抽样分析理论将连续的模拟信号抽样成离散的数字信号，为20世纪60年代之后数字通信的兴起奠定了基础。
target_text: In 1951, Shannon wrote "Prediction and Entrophy of Primed English," explaining that basic information theory can be applied to natural and computer languages, calculating entropy in the English language, thus laying the foundation for statistical analysis of languages. Moreover, Shannon believes that using spaces as the 27th letter on the English alphabet would reduce the uncertainty of English extraction. The introduction of the underlying theory of digital communication – the theory of sampling analysis – also contributed to Shannon.
title: 克劳德·香农

source_text:
爱好和发明
除了学术研究，香农爱好杂耍、骑独轮脚踏车和下棋。香农发明了很多用于科学展览的设备，比如火箭动力飞行光盘、一个电动弹簧高跷和一个喷射小号。香农的办公桌上放着一个他称之为“终极机器”的盒子，这是香农众多好玩的发明之一，是根据人工智能研究的先驱、数学家马文·闵斯基提出的想法而做出来的。这个盒子外表平淡无奇，只是在一侧有一个开关，弹一下开关，盒盖就会打开，一个机械手会伸出来；将开关复原，机械手就缩回盒子。香农还做了一个设备能够复原魔方。
target_text: In addition to academic research, Shannon prefers juggling, cycling and chess. Shannon has developed a lot of equipment for scientific exhibitions, such as a rocket-powered flight disk, an electric spring high and a projectile. Shannon has a box on his desk that he calls the "final machine," which is one of many interesting inventions by Shannon and is based on the ideas of the pioneer in artificial intelligence research, mathematician Marvin Szyski. It's a flat-faced box, with a switch on the side, and a switch on the side, and the cap will open, and a mechanical hand will come out; it will be restored, and the mechanical hand will come back to the box. The Shannon has also made a device that will restore the cube.
title: 克劳德·香农

source_text: 植物（）是植物界（Plantae）各式生物的统称，对于其范围，在历史上多有变动。在前林奈时代到林奈时代，除了现今所熟知的植物类群外，原核生物、真菌及藻类因不能主动运动或能进行光合作用等与植物类似的特性，也被划分进植物界内。而根据恩斯特·海克尔、、琳·馬古利斯、湯瑪斯·卡弗利爾-史密斯等生物学家的进一步研究，原核生物、真菌和部分藻类先后被排除出植物界。在近年来的系统发育和分类学研究中，一个常被采用的定义是1981年湯瑪斯·卡弗利爾-史密斯定义的植物界（Plantae Caval.-Sm. 1981），将原始色素体生物视为与植物等同的概念；另一常见的观点则由赫伯特·科普兰在1956年定义、只包含绿色植物（Viridiplantae）的植物界（Plantae H.F.Copel., 1956）。
target_text: Plants () are the names of the various species of the plant community (Plantae), which have changed a lot in history in their scope. In the pre-Linnet era to the Linnai era, in addition to plants that are now well known, former nuclear organisms, fungi, and algals have been divided into plants because of their inability to exercise proactively or to perform photo-cooperative properties similar to plants. In recent years, a plant boundary (Plantae Caval-Sm. 1981), based on further research by biologists such as Ernst Hacker, Lin Magulis, Thomas Caflier-Smith, has been excluded from the plant world; another common view was defined by Herbert Copeland in 1956 and contains only green plants (Viriplantae).
title: 植物

source_text: 據估計，植物界現存大約有450000個物種，根据邱园的统计，直至2017年，在维管植物中，381910个物种已被描述和命名，其中369000种被子植物，1110种裸子植物，1300种石松类植物，10500种链束植物（狭义蕨类植物）。与此同时，也不断有新的物种被发现，例如在2016年，有1730种有胚植物被发现和命名。
target_text: It is estimated that there are approximately 450,000 species in the plant world, and that until 2017, according to Kew, 38,1910 species were described and named in the pipeline, including 369,000 beetles, 1110 nudity plants, 1,300 pine pine plants and 10,500 chain-bound plants (panel plants). At the same time, new species have been discovered, for example, in 2016, 1730 embryonic plants were found and named.
title: 植物

source_text: 有丝分裂和减数分裂是植物细胞主要的增殖方式，但無絲分裂在植物生长和发育中也有重要作用。有性生殖和世代交替是植物的重要特征，但无性繁殖也是重要的繁殖方式。植物的共同祖先通过与蓝菌内共生获得了质体，并具备了光合作用的能力。绝大多数植物从祖先那里继承了这一结构及能力，但也有少数植物丧失了叶绿体这一结构和光合作用的能力，转为营寄生生活或腐生生活。
target_text: Fragmentation and decomposition are the main breeding methods of plant cells, but they also play an important role in plant growth and development. Sexual reproduction and intergenerational rotation are important features of plants, but also in the form of sterile reproduction. Plant co-ancestores have acquired physiotherapism through symbiotic symbiotic growth in blue bacterium, and have acquired the capacity for photo-cooperative use. Most plants have inherited this structure and capabilities from their ancestors, but a small number of plants have lost the structure and photo-cooperative capacity of leaf greens, which translates into parasitic or corrosive life.
title: 植物

细胞
植物作为真核生物，其细胞具有真核细胞的共同特征：被核膜包裹的真正的细胞核和具膜细胞器。植物细胞由細胞壁和原生质体组成，原生质体又可分为细胞膜、細胞質和细胞核。细胞膜又称原生质膜，由磷脂双分子层和镶嵌在其上的糖蛋白构成，它将原生质体与外部环境分离，并能介导物质进出原生质体。
target_text: The cellular plant, as a true nuclear organism, has the common characteristics of a true nuclear cell: a real cellular nucleus and a membrane cell that is wrapped in a nuclear membrane. The plant cell is made up of cell walls and primary matter, which can be divided into cell membranes, cellular matter and cellular nuclesias. source_text: 细胞质包括细胞质基质和细胞器，植物细胞中有无膜结构的细胞器如核糖体等，也有双层膜细胞器如质体、線粒體，单层膜细胞器如内质网、高尔基体、溶酶体、液泡；核膜、内质网、高尔基体、溶酶体、液泡等的膜结构共同组成植物细胞的內膜系統。在活的植物细胞中，细胞质总是在运动，可以观察到细胞器以及悬浮在细胞质基质中的各种物质在有序地运动，这种运动被称为细胞质环流。

source_text: 植物的根通常位于土壤中，主要功能为吸收、输导和固着支持，气生根、贮藏根等变态根还具有合成、贮藏、呼吸等功能。真正的根最早在维管植物中产生，苔藓植物和藻类也有类似的结构，称为假根，只起固着作用，不具备其他功能。种子植物的主根由种子中的胚根发育形成，主根垂直向下扎入土壤中，长到一定长度后，从主根的中柱鞘结构产生侧根，侧根上还可以进一步生出更多侧根，在主根和侧根以外的部分如茎、叶、胚轴或老根上产生的根称为不定根。

source_text:
有性生殖

target_text: The sexual reproduction of plants has a complex life cycle, known as "intergenerational rotation" and includes all terrestrial plants and some alga. During the reproduction process, the formulas of the monolithic, double-fold spores occur. Some algal spores may be separate organisms with the same or different appearances of their own organisms. The moss have the advantage of subsistence formulations, of which the spores are born on protons and cannot live independently. The tubes have the advantage of spores, which depend on their survival. The sorghums have roots, runners, leaves are divided, but the formulations are described as having a low degree of separation and can be separated from or co-born with the fungus.

source_text:
无性生殖
無性生殖是指生物體不通過生殖細胞的結合，也就是不經由減數分裂來產生配子，直接由母體細胞分裂後產生出新個體的生殖方式。主要分為孢子繁殖、分裂生殖、出芽生殖、斷裂生殖和營養器官繁殖等。這種生殖的速度通常都較有性生殖快很多。例如苔藓植物能够产生称为孢芽的细胞团，从母体身上分离并形成独立个体，甚至碎块也能能够重新长成完整的植物体。在林业和农业上常用的扦插技术也属于无性生殖。而也有些植物能够用匍匐茎扩展种群，形成一大片克隆。许多植物的营养贮存器官，例如块茎、块根或鳞茎]]也能够用于无性生殖。
target_text: Non-sexual reproduction refers to the biological form of reproduction that does not result from the confluence of the reproductive cells, i.e. from the loss of numbers, but directly from the separation of the mother cells, which produces a new form of reproduction. It is divided mainly into spores, split reproduction, germ reproduction, filamental reproduction, and nutrient reproduction. This type of reproduction is usually much faster than sexual reproduction. For example, moss plants can produce cells called spores, separate from the mother and form independent individuals, or even fragments that can regenerate into complete plants. The technique of scavenging that is commonly used in forestry and agriculture is also sexual reproduction. And some plants can expand their populations with runners, forming large clones. The nutrient storage organs of many plants, such as tubs, roots or tubs, can also be used for non-sexual reproduction.

source_text: 陸生植物和藻類所行使的光合作用幾乎是所有的生態系中能源及有機物質的最初來源。光合作用根本地改變了早期地球大氣的組成，使得現在有21%的氧氣。動物和大多數其他生物是好氧的，依靠氧氣生存。植物在大多數的陸地生態系中屬於生產者，形成食物鏈的基本。許多動物依靠著植物做為其居所、以及氧氣和食物的提供者。
target_text: The photosynthetic uses of land-based plants and algae are the first sources of energy and organic matter in almost all ecosystems. Photocooperatives radically alter the composition of the early Earth's atmosphere, making 21% of the oxygen available today. Animals and most other organisms are good oxygen and rely on oxygen. Plants are the producers in most terrestrial ecosystems and form the basis of food chains. Many animals rely on plants as providers of shelter, oxygen and food.
title: 植物

source_text: 植物的光合作用是生物圈物质循环和能量流动的重要环节，是地球大部分生态系统的基础，一些植物（如豆科植物等）和固氮菌共生，使得植物成為氮循環重要的部分。植物根部在土壤發育和防止水土流失上也扮演著很重要的角色。植物通常是它們棲所上主要的物理及結構組成。许多类型的形态系统即以植被的類型而命名，如草原和森林等等。它们通过遗传分化和表型可塑性来适应不同环境。
target_text: The photosynthesis of plants is an important link in the circulation of biosphere matter and energy flows. It is the foundation of most of the Earth’s ecosystems, where plants (e.g., legumes) and nitrogen-fixing bacterium co-habitate, making plants an important part of the nitrogen cycle. Plant roots also play an important role in soil breeding and preventing soil erosion. Plants are often the main physical and structural components of their morphology. Many types of morphological systems are named after vegetation types, such as grasslands and forests. They adapt to different environments through genetic differentiation and plasticization.
title: 植物

source_text: 許多動物和植物共演化，例如：許多動物會幫助花授粉以交換其花蜜；許多動物會在吃掉果實且排泄出種子時幫到植物散播其種子。適蟻植物是一種和螞蟻共演化的植物。此類植物會提供螞蟻居所，有時還有食物。做為交換，螞蟻則會幫助植物防衛植食性动物，也幫助其和其他植物競爭。螞蟻的廢物還可以提供給植物做有機肥料。
target_text: Many animals and plants evolve together, for example: many animals help pollinate them in exchange for honey; many animals help plants spread their seeds when they eat fruit and eject seed. Ant plant is a plant that evolves with ants. It provides ants with shelter and sometimes food. In exchange, ants help plants to protect them from edible animals and to compete with other plants. Ant waste can also provide plants with organic fertilizers.
title: 植物

source_text: 大部份植物的根系會和不同的真菌有互利共生的關係，稱之為菌根。真菌會幫助植物從土壤中獲得水份和礦物質，而植物則會提供真菌從光合作用中組成的碳水化合物。一些植物會提供內生真菌居所，而真菌則會產生毒素以保護植物不被草食性動物食用。植物的根系也可与细菌共生，形成根瘤，是根上的瘤状突起，如豆科植物、木麻黄、罗汉松、杨梅等，能够与土壤中的根瘤菌共生，根瘤菌能将空气中的氮转变为氨，提供给植物，同时根瘤菌可以从植物的根中吸取水分和养料，供自身生长发育所需。
target_text: The roots of most plants have a mutually beneficial symbiotic relationship with different fungi, which are called fungi. fungi help plants to extract water and minerals from the soil, while plants provide the carbohydrates that fungi make up from photo-cooperative uses. Some plants provide home for endogenous fungi, which produce toxins to protect plants from herbivores. Plant root systems can also co-exist with bacteria and form root tumors, such as soybean plants, ephedra, Rohanson, Yangmei, etc., and can co-exist with root cancers in the soil, which can transform nitrogen from air into ammonia and provide plants with water and nutrients from the roots of plants for their own growth and development.

target_text: Many types of parasites are also common in plants, with about 1 per cent living in plant parasites, from semi-stolen parasites (which receive only some nutrients from their host, but still have photosynthetic leaves) to whole-stolen mossaics and mosses (all of which are derived from links to other roots of plants, so there are no chlorophylls). source_text: 許多植物是附生植物，即長在其他植物（通常是樹木）上，而沒有寄生在其上頭。附生植物可能被間接地傷害到其宿者，經由截取宿者本應得的礦物質和太陽光。大量附生植物的重量可能被折斷樹幹。許多蘭花、鳳梨、蕨類植物和苔蘚通常會是附生植物。鳳梨科的附生植物會在其葉腋上累積水份而形成樹上水池，一種複雜的水生食物鏈。

source_text: 少部份（约有630种）植物是食蟲植物，如捕蠅草和毛氈苔。它們捕捉及消化小動物以獲取礦物質，尤其是氮和磷。生理光合作用植物细胞的细胞器叶绿体中含有叶绿素，是一类能够捕获光能的色素。植物通过光合作用，以水和二氧化碳为原料，将光能保存在有机物中并释放出氧气。光合作用的化学方程式为：6CO2{} + 6H2O{} ->[\text{光照}] C6H12O6{} + 6O2{}。

source_text: 研究植物對人類的用途的學科被稱之為經濟植物學或民族植物學。這兩個詞通常被當做同義詞，但有些人認為經濟植物學主要專注於對現今作用的用途，而民族植物學主要則是在研究當地住民對其本土植物的應用。人類對植物的栽種是農業的一部份，其為人類文明的基礎。植物農業可分成農學、園藝學和林業。

Brainfuck，简称BF，是一种极小化的程序语言，由Urban Müller在1993年创造。Fuck在英語中是髒話，所以这种语言有时称为Brainf*ck或Brainf***，或者只用简称。概述

source_text: 西班牙语书写遵循一些明确的标注重音的规则。缺省情况下，当单词的以元音、 n 或 s 结尾时倒数第二个音节重音，以其它辅音结尾时最后一个音节重音。如果单词中含有标有尖音符的元音，则不遵循缺省规则。标注的重音因此会只出现在单词的某些形式中，例如 andén 的复数形式是 andenes。在很多情况下，重音在理解词意时是必不可少的，如 （我讲）、（他/她/它讲过）。
target_text: Spanish writing follows a number of clear language-based rules. In defaults, when the word is accentuated by a vowel, n, or s at the end of the word, the last syllable at the end of the second syllable at the end of the other syllable. If the word contains a vowel marked with a sharp note, it does not follow the default rule. The accent of the sign therefore appears only in certain forms of the word, such as the double form of the andén, andenes. In many cases, accent is indispensable in understanding the word, such as (I say) (he/she/it has spoken).
title: 西班牙语正写法

source_text: 西班牙语单词要计算音节数和判断重音位置，一个未标记重音的闭元音（i 或 u）与一个其它元音在一起时，该序列被视为升双元音，算作一个音节。 一个音节的组成方式为 XAXX：X表示辅音、复辅音或跟本没有，A表示元音、双元音或三元音。双元音是由非重音的闭元音与另一个元音任意顺序构成（如 或 ）。三元音由头尾两个非重音的闭元音和中间一个其它元音构成（如 或 ）。西班牙语在书写 时无需重音符号，而重音在第一个 i。
target_text: The Spanish word calculates the number of syllables and determines the resounding position, and when a closed vowels (i or u) that are not marked with accent, the sequence is considered to be an ascending binary and is counted as a syllable. One syllable is made up of XAXX: X expresses an ancillary, recordant or non-syllable, A means a vowel, a bicordal or a triad. The binary is composed of a non-recorded closed vowel with another vowel in any order (e. g. or ). The triad is composed of two non-rewrites at the end of the head and one of the other vowels in the middle (e. g. e. ). Spanish does not need to rewrite the sign, but it is resounded in the first i.

source_text: 与英语比起来，西班牙语中的首字母大写比较少。一般来说，只有人和地点的名字、一些单词缩写使用首字母大写（如Sr. López，而señor López不大写)；书籍、电影、歌曲等的标题，仅第一个单词首字母大写（除非这个标题只有两个单词，第二个单词才有时侯首字母大写）；每个句字的第一个单词，企业、政府机构等的名字，首字母大写。国家或语言的名字、星期、月份不大写。
target_text: In general, only the names of people and places, some initials of words are used in capital letters (e.g., Sr. López, while Señor López is not written); titles of books, films, songs, etc., only the first word is written in capital letters (unless there are only two words for this title, the second word is sometimes written in capital letters); the first word of each word, the name of the enterprise, government agency, etc., is used in capital letters. The name of the country or language, week or month is not written in capital letters.
title: 西班牙语正写法

source_text: 一个墨西哥西班牙语的惯例，使用⟨x⟩而不是西班牙语标准拼写中的⟨j⟩来拼写某些土著词汇。这通常由于其原词（或现在的发音）包含清颚龈擦音 /ʃ/ 或另一个现代西班牙语中已经没有的咝音。这个特征最引人注目的词便是墨西哥这一名称 México（见）。西班牙皇家学院建议这样拼写。
target_text: One Mexican Spanish-language practice is to spell some indigenous terms using j instead of j in the standard spellings in Spanish. This is usually because its original (or now pronunciation) contains a punctuated sound / / or a sound that is no longer available in another modern Spanish language. The most striking feature of this is the Mexican name, México (see). The Royal Academy of Spain suggests this type of spelling.
title: 西班牙语正写法

source_text: 在机械打字键盘上的实现方式是，键盘上包括一个单独的死键，其小写位置是尖音符、其大写位置是分音符。有了这个键，即可以输入á、é、í、ó、ú 和 ü。另外还有一个分开的键：ñ/Ñ、¿ 和 ¡ 完成了所需的最低限。（西班牙语键盘并没有死键 ~，葡萄牙语键盘上有。）电子键盘上增加了一键，用于 ª 和 º，尽管不是必需的。（它们是有些古老的序数词缩写：1º 用于 primero，2ª 用于 segunda 等等。)

source_text: 藏文（）是藏语、宗喀語、锡金语、普米语等语言的文字系统，基本上是一種元音附標文字，它根據古典藏語语音而建立，共三十个字母。目前通用的藏文罗马化方案为威利转写方案。除此之外，還有藏語拼音、《藏文拼音教材（拉薩音）》拼音方案、及THL拼音等羅馬化方案。
target_text: Tibetan () is a text system in Tibetan, Zongka, Sikkim, Pumi, etc., which is basically a vowel text, which is based on the classical Tibetan voice and has 30 letters. The current common romanization of Tibetan is Willy's transliteration. In addition, there are other Romanization programmes, such as the Tibetan spelling, the Tibetan spelling package, and the THL spelling.
title: 藏文

source_text: 藏文是吐蕃時代公元7世紀由國王松贊干布派遣藏族語言學家吞弥·桑布扎到北印度學習梵文，回國後參照悉曇體梵文字母創製的。藏文虽是为书写藏语而创制，但也和很多其它婆罗米系文字一样，能用于书写梵语。另外，在漢藏語系诸語中，藏文的历史长度、文献丰富程度都仅次于汉文。不过，这大量的文献中，绝大多数皆系佛教典籍，世俗文献不算太多。
target_text: Tibetan was written in Sanskrit by a Tibetan linguist who studied Sanskrit in North India in the 7th century under the King’s generous patronage. Tibetan was created to write Tibetan, but it is also used in Sanskrit, as is the case with many other Brahmi languages. Moreover, the history and literature of Tibetan is second only to that of Han. However, of this vast literature, most are Buddhist and not so many are secular.

The link order of the syllable is followed by the first word, the upper word, the base word, and the lower word. At times there is one or two subsequent characters on the back of the base, indicating that the syllable has one or two syllable ends.

source_text:
信息处理用标准
1997年9月2日，中华人民共和国国家技术监督局发布了《中华人民共和国国家标准GB 16959—1997 信息技术 信息交换用藏文编码字符集 基本集》（以下简称“《基本集》”），于1998年1月1日起实施。该标准由中华人民共和国电子工业部提出，全国信息技术标准化技术委员会归口，起草单位为西藏自治区藏语文工作指导委员会办公室、西藏大学、西藏自治区技术监督局、西北民族学院、青海师范大学。该标准是中华人民共和国第一个少数民族语言文字的信息处理用国际标准，也是中华人民共和国现行全部藏文信息处理用国家标准。
target_text: On 2 September 1997, the State Technical Supervisory Authority of the People's Republic of China issued the Basic Set of Tibetan Encoded Characters for the Exchange of Information Technology of the People's Republic of China GB 16959-1997 (hereinafter “the Basic Set”), which became effective on 1 January 1998. The standards were proposed by the Ministry of Electronic Industry of the People's Republic of China, and the National Technical Committee for the Standardization of Information Technology came to the fore. They were drafted by the Office of the Steering Committee for Tibetan Language Work in the Tibet Autonomous Region, the Tibet University, the Tibet Autonomous Region Technical Supervisory Authority, the North-West National Institute, and the Qinghai Teachers' University. The standards are international standards for the processing of information in the first minority languages of the People's Republic of China and are also national standards for the processing of all Tibetan-language information in the People's Republic of China.
title: 藏文

source_text: 《基本集》收录的藏文字母，可组成任意藏文词句，包括藏文古籍的文字。1997年《基本集》刚刚发布时，因技术局限，藏文字母的上下叠加构造无法方便处理，难以实现藏文的动态组合，故后来西藏大学藏文信息技术研究中心陆续制定6项藏文信息处理交换标准国家标准。2007年，共有8个国际标准及国家标准获得中华人民共和国教育部批准。经过上述完善，《基本集》已成为如今国际普遍应用的标准，微软、苹果等国际软件企业开发藏文产品时，均依照该标准，如微软从Windows7系统开始便依照该标准支持了藏文字母的上下叠加构造。
target_text: As soon as the Basic Series was published, the tops and bottoms of the Tibetan alphabet could not be easily processed and the dynamic mix of Tibetans was difficult to achieve, due to technical constraints. The Tibetan Information Technology Research Centre at the University of Tibet subsequently developed six national standards for the exchange of Tibetan information. In 2007, eight international standards and national standards were approved by the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China.
title: 藏文

source_text: 现有的藏文信息处理中的键盘均是依据西藏大学藏文信息技术研究中心确定的，包括微软2007年推出的Windows Vista操作系统（Operating System，OS）中藏文输入系统也对此基本遵循。过去，包括1998年实施的《基本集》在内，藏文的上下叠加构造无法方便实现；但在西藏大学藏文信息技术研究中心推出的藏文信息处理用国家标准实现了藏文的上下叠加构造之后，藏文的横向组合与纵向叠加已经全部实现。
target_text: The keypads in the processing of Tibetan information are based on the Tibetan Information Technology Research Centre of the University of Tibet, and include the Windows Vista operating system (Operating System, OS) launched by Microsoft in 2007, which is largely followed. In the past, including the Basic Collection of 1998, the top-down and bottom-up construction of the Tibetan language could not be easily achieved; but the horizontal combination and vertical stacking of the Tibetan language have been fully achieved after the introduction of the Tibetan Information Technology Research Centre at the University of Tibet, which achieved the top-down construction of the Tibetan language using national standards for the processing of Tibetan information.

source_text: 2007年11月，甘肃省推出藏文彩信手机报，成为中国第一份藏文彩信手机报。在1998年实施的《基本集》的基础上，西南民族大学民族文字信息处理研究所组成手写藏文手机输入法和藏文字库的课题组，创建24点阵的藏文点阵字库，翻译5000多条手写藏文手机术语。2009年，西南民族大学与北京网道信通科技发展有限公司共同研制的世界上第一款手写藏文手机正式推出，包括GSM手机和CDMA手机两种。2012年6月，中国电信西藏公司藏文版手机上市，受到西藏自治区藏族民众特别是藏传佛教僧众及农牧民的欢迎。
target_text: On the basis of the 1998 Basic Collection, the Institute for the Processing of National Words of the University of the South-West Nation organized a group of subjects on hand-written Tibetan mobile phone entry laws and Tibetan text banks, creating a 24-point Tibetan site array and translating over 5,000 hand-written Tibetan cellular terminology. In 2009, the first hand-written Tibetan mobile phone, developed by the University of the South-West Nation in cooperation with the Beijing Networking Information and Communications Technology Development Corporation, was officially launched, including the GSM mobile phone and the CDMA mobile phone. In June 2012, the Tibetan version of the Chinese telecommunications company was launched and welcomed by Tibetans in the Tibetan autonomous region, particularly Tibetan Buddhist monks and farmers and herders.
title: 藏文

source_text:
牛顿引力的几何学
经典力学的一个基本原理是：任何一个物体的运动都可看作是一个不受任何外力的自由运动（惯性运动）和一个偏离于这种自由运动的组合。这种偏离来自于施加在物体上的外力作用，其大小和方向遵循牛顿第二定律（外力大小等于物体的惯性质量乘以加速度，方向与加速度方向相同）。而惯性运动与时空的几何性质直接相关：经典力学中在标准参考系下的惯性运动是匀速直线运动。用广义相对论的语言说，惯性运动的轨迹是时空几何上的最短路径（测地线），在闵可夫斯基时空中是直的世界线。
target_text: The fundamental principle of classical mechanics is that the movement of any object can be seen as a free movement (inert movement) free from any outside force and a combination of deviations from this free movement. This deviation is derived from the external forces applied to the object, the size and direction of which follow the second law of Newton (the size of which is equal to the inertial mass of the object multiplied by acceleration, the direction of which is the direction of acceleration). Inherent motion is directly related to the geometric nature of time and space: the inertial movement in the classical mechanics under the standard reference system is a flat-rate straight movement.

source_text: 反过来，原则上讲也可以通过观察物体的运动状态和外力作用（如附加的电磁力或摩擦力等）来判断物体的惯性运动性质，从而用来定义物体所处的时空几何。不过，当有引力存在时这种方法会产生一些含糊不清之处：牛顿万有引力定律以及多个彼此独立验证的相关实验表明，自由落体具有一个普遍性（这也被人們稱作弱等效原理，亦即惯性质量与引力质量等价），即任何测试质量的自由落体的轨迹只和它的初始位置和速度有关，与构成测试质量的材质等无关。
